entries.text: Yes. While I was there, I had no way to know what was happening in the hallways or in the event room. I took my time to look at the footage of all the other rooms, but I didn't see anything suspicious at all. No people, either.
entries.new: 对。我待在监控室里时，完全不知道走廊和活动室里发生了什么。我把其他所有房间的录像都慢慢看了一遍，却没发现任何可疑之处，也没看到人。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: ...But I should get into what's most important. The alarm that played wasn't your usual emergency alarm. It was one that hadn't played before.
entries.new: ……不过，先说最要紧的事。刚才响起的并不是平常那种紧急警报，而是一种从未响过的警报。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: I said that I stayed in the security room out of panic, but that's not all. Even if I'd left, it would've been pointless. One of the special functions of the alarm is to shut down all methods of escape. This means that we have no way to leave this building, and that people outside can't enter.
entries.new: 我说过，我是慌了才留在监控室，但原因不止于此。就算当时离开，也没有意义。那个警报的特殊功能之一，就是封锁所有逃生手段。也就是说，我们没法离开这栋楼，外面的人也进不来。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: ...Although I'd been kind of anticipating those words, it was still a heavy blow. Shiroya and I looked at each other. It seemed everything insisted on getting worse.
entries.new: ……虽然我隐约已有预感，这话听着仍是不小的打击。我和 Shiroya 面面相觑。看来一切偏要往更糟的方向去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Hang on, hang on. What the fuck? We're trapped in here? How long does it close the exit for? Why!? And is there no way to undo it or contact the outside!?
entries.new: 等等，等等。搞什么鬼？我们被困在这儿了？出口要封多久？为什么！？就没办法解除，也没法和外面联系吗！？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: ...It closes all the exit routes for twelve hours. The reason as to why is a bit complicated, and for our purposes, confidential. I'm sorry, but I can't get into that.
entries.new: ……所有出口会封闭十二个小时。至于原因，说来有些复杂，而且按规定属于机密。抱歉，这一点我不能细说。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: As for a way to contact the outside, there should be one. We can try it.
entries.new: 至于联络外面的方法，应该是有的。可以试一试。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Shiroya wasn't faring well, and Akaro seemed to be in complete disbelief at what he was hearing.
entries.new: Shiroya 的脸色不太好，Akaro 则似乎完全不敢相信自己听到的话。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Hey.
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: ...It's going to be fine. Okay?
entries.new: ……不会有事的。好吗？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Yeah. Yeah, okay.
entries.new: 嗯。嗯，好。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: I turned back to the others. Barring Akaro, none of them seemed very surprised about the situation.
entries.new: 我转回其他人那边。除了 Akaro，其他人都没显得多意外。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Is this not a shock for you?
entries.new: 你们就不觉得震惊吗？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I already told them. Getting Isla out of here would normally have been the first thing any of us would have done.
entries.new: 我已经跟他们说过了。换作平常，我们任何人第一个念头都是把 Isla 带出去。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: It didn't seem like the type of building to have medical equipment stored in it, so the woman must have immediately tried to extract who I could only assume was her daughter.
entries.new: 这栋楼不像是会存放医疗设备的地方，所以她当时一定立刻想把那个女孩带出去——我只能猜那是她女儿。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There was no reason to think that some secret entrance existed, so I more or less had to assume that we really were trapped for half a day. The existence of such an alarm seemed absurd, but it also might've succeeded at trapping whoever'd been responsible for the smoke.
entries.new: 没有理由认为存在什么秘密通道，我多少只能认定，我们确实要被关在这里半天。这种警报的存在显得荒唐，不过它或许也成功困住了放出烟雾的罪魁祸首。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: S-So, you're right, Naomi still has to be here.{w} And is that everyone? I get that most people were in the lobby, but if someone else entered the hallways, they couldn't have evacuated either.
entries.new: 那、那么，你说得对，Naomi 肯定还在这里。{w} 在这里的人就这些了吗？大部分人当时在大厅，这我明白，可要是有人进了走廊，也一样没法撤离吧。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Is it possible the smoke in the hallway wasn't as dense, which gave people time to run from it before the alarm went off?
entries.new: 走廊里的烟雾会不会没那么浓，让人能在警报响起前跑开？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: No, that can't be.
entries.new: 不，不可能。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: The guy who'd remained quiet finally spoke.
entries.new: 一直沉默的那个人终于开口了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We were right here when the smoke appeared. The moment we inhaled a bit of it, we were out like a light. We pretty much collapsed instantly.
entries.new: 烟雾出现的时候我们就在这儿。才吸进一点，就什么都不知道了。几乎是当场倒下。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I see. Then I couldn't tell you.
entries.new: 原来如此。那我就说不准了。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: ...From what I could see from there, the other rooms in the hallway were clean. If someone had been in one, they were definitely trapped too. I could recall that the alarm played approximately twenty seconds after the smoke's appearance, but it was unlikely that had been enough time for it to entirely dissipate.
entries.new: ……从我当时所在的位置看过去，走廊里其余的房间都是干净的。要是有人在里面，也肯定一样被困住了。我记得烟雾出现大约二十秒后警报才响，但这点时间不足以让烟雾完全散去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I-I can't believe what you're telling us. What the fuck does this mean? Why are we trapped here!?
entries.new: 我、我不敢相信你刚才说的。这到底是什么意思？我们为什么会被困在这里！？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: I sincerely apologize. I'm confused as well, but there's nothing I can tell you. We'll have to be here all day, but I'll try to figure out what happened. My name is Katei Kuiji.
entries.new: 实在抱歉。我也很困惑，但能告诉你们的就这些了。我们怕是要在这里待上一整天，不过我会尽力查明发生了什么。我叫 Katei Kuiji。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: It was ridiculous, but we couldn't do anything about it. After a period of silence where nobody knew how to react, the woman spoke.
entries.new: 荒唐归荒唐，我们却无能为力。沉默了一阵，谁都不知道该怎么反应，那位女士开了口。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: She's Isla, my daughter. She's been unconscious since the smoke appeared, but her breathing's steadier now. I'm Erina.
entries.new: 她是 Isla，我女儿。烟雾出现后她就一直昏迷，不过现在呼吸平稳些了。我叫 Erina。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: ...I'm Shiroya.
entries.new: ……我叫 Shiroya。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: And my name's Atsuki. We came here together. ...How old is she?
entries.new: 我叫 Atsuki。我们是一起来的。……她多大了？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: She'll be ten in a bit more than a week. Her birthday is two days before Christmas.
entries.new: 再过一个多星期她就十岁了。生日是圣诞节前两天。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Realizing the rest of his group had introduced themselves, the guy followed.
entries.new: 见同伴都报了名字，那个人也跟着开口。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'm Sai.
entries.new: 我叫 Sai。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: We looked back at the man separated from us.
entries.new: 我们回头看向那个离我们有些距离的男人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Akaro.
entries.new: Akaro。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Immediately, the silence returned. What the hell had happened? I thought back on the wordless alarm that had locked us in. It communicated zero information, seemingly only designed to tell us that we'd been trapped.
entries.new: 四周立刻又安静下来。到底发生了什么事？我回想起那道把我们锁在里面的警报。它没透露任何信息，似乎只是为了告诉我们：我们被困住了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It made sense if the culprit was one of us, but not even the staff member who was still there had any idea who it could have been, which made things difficult.
entries.new: 如果犯人就藏在我们之中，那倒说得通，可就连还留在这里的那位职员也毫无头绪，这就麻烦了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: And the target of the attack... It had to be the Sekimeiya. There was no way it wasn't related. The very first showing of a newly-discovered gemstone being interrupted meant only one thing.
entries.new: 至于袭击的目标……只能是 Sekimeiya。不可能与它无关。一颗新发现宝石的首次公开展示被打断，只意味着一件事。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We hadn't checked whether the Sekimeiya was still in the room, but it was confirmed that it was still in the building with us, even if it had been taken out of its cabinet.
entries.new: 我们还没确认 Sekimeiya 是否仍在展室里，但已经确定它仍和我们同在这栋楼里——即便它被人从展示柜中取走了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The attack had been deliberate. That was the most important point. Whoever was responsible, I wanted to find them out and expose them. It was deeply personal.
entries.new: 这场袭击是蓄意的。这才是最关键的一点。不管下手的人是谁，我都要把他找出来、揭穿他。此事与我切身相关。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: *cough*... *cough*
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: We all glanced at Isla's pained face. After the second cough, she proceeded to slightly open her eyes.
entries.new: 我们纷纷看向 Isla，她脸上露出痛苦的表情。第二声咳嗽之后，她的眼睛微微睁开了一条缝。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Isla! Finally! Are you okay? How do you feel?
entries.new: Isla！你总算醒了！你没事吧？感觉怎么样？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Erina's sudden outburst seemed to confuse her daughter. She raised her head and blinked blearily at all of us.
entries.new: Erina 突然的呼喊似乎让女儿有些发懵。她抬起头，睡眼惺忪地眨着眼看我们。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Looking back at her mother, she coughed weakly again and spoke.
entries.new: 她转头看向母亲，又虚弱地咳了一声，开口道。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wh-Where are we...? What are we... d-doing here?
entries.new: 这、这是哪里……？我们……在、在这儿做什么？
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: Her disorientation definitely wasn't helped by the fact that all the walls were stained black. Shiroya seemed like she wanted to say something, but she held back and let Erina speak.
entries.new: 四周墙壁全被熏成黑色，无疑让她更加茫然。Shiroya 似乎想说些什么，却忍住了，让 Erina 先开口。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We're still inside Ashiya Tower. Do you remember all that smoke? It knocked us out, and you're the last one to wake up.
entries.new: 我们还在芦屋塔里。你还记得那些烟吗？我们都被熏晕了，你是最后一个醒过来的。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Erina stroked Isla's hair gently, which seemed to soothe her.
entries.new: Erina 轻轻抚着 Isla 的头发，似乎让她安定了些。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Weren't we going to see the Sekimeiya? I'm trying to remember what happened after that, but I can't. Did we ever do that?
entries.new: 我们不是要去看 Sekimeiya 吗？后来发生了什么，我想回忆却怎么也想不起来。我们到底去看了没有？
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: No, sweetie. We were waiting for that in this very hallway when the smoke came out. Do you not remember?
entries.new: 没有哦，乖孩子。我们当时就在这条走廊上等着，烟就是那时候冒出来的。你不记得了？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Oh... smoke? I'm not sure... Is this that hallway? Why is everything black?
entries.new: 咦……烟？我不太记得……这里就是那条走廊吗？为什么到处都是黑的？
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: That's also the smoke's doing. It stained everything it touched.
entries.new: 那也是烟造成的。凡是它碰过的东西，都被染黑了。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Shiroya finally spoke up. Isla seemed to realize that everyone else had faint black stains on their clothes, so she looked down at her own to find them almost completely clean. At her height, her head had been primarily affected, but Erina had evidently wiped off the remnants already.
entries.new: Shiroya 终于开口了。Isla 似乎这才发现，其他人衣服上都带着淡淡的黑色污迹，便低头看自己身上，却发现几乎干干净净。以她的身高，受波及的主要是头部，不过 Erina 显然已经替她把残留的污迹擦掉了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Do you feel okay? You've been out for a long time. I was really worried...
entries.new: 你感觉还好吗？你昏过去好久了，我一直很担心……
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Sorry... I think I feel okay, but my head hurts.
entries.new: 对不起……我觉得还好，就是头有点疼。
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: But why are we here? Why is there no light, and why are we alone?
entries.new: 可是我们为什么会在这里？为什么没有灯，又为什么只有我们几个？
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: We all looked at each other, and for a few seconds, nobody knew how to answer. Katei quickly decided it was his job to do so.
entries.new: 我们面面相觑，有那么几秒，谁也不知道该怎么回答。Katei 很快决定由他来回答。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We're not aware of what caused the smoke, but it must've triggered a special alarm that shut down all entrance and exit methods. That means that we will have to stay here for the next twelve hours, and it's possible there's only eight of us who didn't evacuate in time.
entries.new: 烟是怎么来的，我们也不清楚，但它一定触发了某种特殊警报，把所有的出入口都封住了。也就是说，接下来十二个小时我们只能待在这里；而且很可能只有我们八个人没来得及疏散。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: We all slightly lowered our heads, unsure whether his abrupt explanation had been a good idea to direct at a kid who had just woken up.
entries.new: 我们都微微低下了头，不确定他这番突兀的解释，对一个刚醒来的孩子来说是否妥当。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Isla processed that information in silence for a minute. I didn't expect she'd take it well.
entries.new: Isla 沉默了一阵，把这些话在心里慢慢过了一遍。我本以为她会承受不住。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But against my own prediction, she passively tossed out some words in response.
entries.new: 可出乎我的预料，她只是淡淡地抛出一句话来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Oh... I see... What are we going to do until then?
entries.new: 哦……这样啊……那在那之前，我们要做什么？
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: I was relieved that she hadn't reacted badly. Telling a kid something like that could've gone much worse.
entries.new: 她没有闹起来，我松了口气。那种话对一个孩子说出口，反应再糟也不奇怪。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Sadly, there's not much to do here. This first floor is filled with exhibition rooms, and it's officially called the "crystal floor" in reference to all the gems. The upper floors are nothing but offices, and I'm afraid they're as uninteresting as they sound.
entries.new: ……可惜，这里没什么可做的。这一层全是展览室，因为陈列着各色宝石，正式名称叫「水晶层」。楼上清一色是办公室，恐怕就和听起来一样无趣。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: They're offices? Does that mean we could use them to communicate with the outside? Is that what you meant earlier when you said that could be possible?
entries.new: 办公室？那是不是说，我们可以用它们和外面联络？你刚才说也许有办法，指的就是这个吗？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Oh, no. Usually, that would be the case, but the local internet connection is also something that the alarm shuts down, precisely to block all communication methods.
entries.new: 哦，不是。平时确实可以，但这里的网络也会被警报切断，为的就是堵死所有联络手段。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: You people cut the internet too? Is that only going to come back when the exit opens?
entries.new: 你们连网络都切了？也要等出口打开才会恢复吗？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Yes. We can't access it until then. There's no phone either, and I don't have mine here.
entries.new: 对。在那之前都连不上。电话也没有，我自己的那部也没带在身上。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: What did you mean, then? How do we have any way to speak to anyone outside?
entries.new: 那你刚才说的是什么办法？我们还能怎么和外面联系？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: The room where I work, the security room, has a function that lets us enable communication with the outside. That one should not be out of commission.
entries.new: 我工作的房间，也就是监控室，有一项功能可以启用对外的通讯。那个应该还没有失效。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: That was slightly relieving. If we could talk with people and understand the situation better, that'd make the wait much more bearable.
entries.new: 这让我稍稍安心了些。能和人联系上、把情况弄清楚，这段等待也会好熬不少。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: However, it seemed strange to me that a communication method wouldn't be disabled. Entirely blocking off the exit and shutting down the internet connection seemed to indicate the goal was to fully isolate the interior. Leaving one method available didn't fit, which meant it wasn't one anyone would know how to access.
entries.new: 可是一种联络手段居然没有被切断，这让我觉得蹊跷。封死出口、断开网络，看来都是为了让内部彻底与外界隔绝。偏偏留下一条通路，实在说不通——也就是说，那绝不是谁都知道该怎么用的手段。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Isla stood up and brushed herself off. She seemed ready to say something else, but a nearby sound startled us.
entries.new: Isla 站起身，拍了拍衣服。她似乎还想说什么，近旁却传来一声响动，把我们吓了一跳。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We turned to face it and were met with a door opening. It was the one that led to the lobby.
entries.new: 我们循声望去，只见一扇门正被打开。那是通往大堂的门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Had someone else gotten trapped? I thought that until I saw Sai next to the door. Then, I realized he hadn't said anything since he'd told us his name.
entries.new: 难道还有别人被困在这里？我这么想着，直到看见门边的 Sai，才意识到他自报姓名之后就再没开过口。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: His left hand was gripping the knob.
entries.new: 他的左手还握着门把。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Where are you going?
entries.new: 你要去哪儿？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: It looked like we were all a little confused that he'd been about to leave without warning.
entries.new: 他一声不吭就要走，我们似乎都有些摸不着头脑。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'm going to check the lobby. I'm not doubting what Katei has said, but I haven't personally seen the exit closed, so I'm curious if it could be forced open, for example.
entries.new: 我去大堂看看。不是不信 Katei 的话，只是我没亲眼见过出口封死，所以想试试看能不能硬撬开之类。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Nobody said anything. Instead, everyone but Shiroya, who was still sitting down, began to slowly walk to the door.
entries.new: 谁都没有说话。除了仍坐着的 Shiroya，大家都慢慢朝门口走去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I took the opportunity to pull her aside and check on her.
entries.new: 我趁机把她拉到一旁，问问她的情况。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...This was a deliberate attack, and I want to find out who did it if I can. Are you okay with that?
entries.new: ……这是一场有预谋的袭击，可以的话，我想把出手的人揪出来。你能接受吗？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Why are you asking me that?
entries.new: 你为什么要问我这个？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: If you want to just hole up in a room for twelve hours, I'll respect it. But I don't want the person or people responsible getting away, and I think you feel the same way.
entries.new: 如果你想找个房间躲上十二个小时，我尊重你的意思。可我不想让凶手逍遥法外，我想你也是一样。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: ...Yeah. I'm... I just don't want you to get caught up in something dangerous, Atsuki.
entries.new: ……嗯。我只是……不希望你卷进危险里去，Atsuki。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: It's not like I'm some detective... I know that. But if you notice someone lying, or find out something I don't, I want to know.
entries.new: 我又不是什么侦探……这点自知之明还是有的。但要是你看出谁在撒谎，或者查到我不知道的事，我希望你告诉我。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I just figure if we really are trapped here, we should keep track of what happens. The culprit must've gotten trapped, so we can't trust anyone here.
entries.new: 我只是想，既然我们真的被困在这儿了，就该把发生的事一一记下来。凶手多半也被困在里面，所以这里的谁都不能轻信。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I know. Usually, the police would handle this, but... if the cameras are all covered, there might be no records.
entries.new: 我知道。这种事平常该交给警察，可是……如果摄像头全被遮住了，恐怕一点记录都不会留下。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: And if they got away... If they got away, I'd...
entries.new: 要是让他们跑了……让他们跑了的话，我……
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: I knew perfectly well what she meant without her finishing the sentence.
entries.new: 她没说完，我也完全明白她的意思。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'm hoping that whoever did this was stupid enough to get caught on camera before that happened, but we'll see. I know you're right. We're not the police. I just don't know who we can trust.
entries.new: 我倒是希望凶手蠢到在遮住摄像头之前就被拍了下来，不过只能走着瞧了。我知道你说得对，我们不是警察。我只是不知道该信谁。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: S-Sorry, I'm just trying to... process everything. I didn't mean to be so quiet until now. I feel the same way you do.
entries.new: 对、对不起，我只是在……把这些事理清楚。我不是故意一直不说话的。我的想法和你一样。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Maybe I feel worse, actually. I... hate this. I want this to be over.
entries.new: 说实话，我可能比你更难受。我……讨厌这样。我想早点结束。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Yeah... Yeah. Me too. Let's get going.
entries.new: 嗯……嗯，我也是。走吧。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I helped Shiroya to her feet, and we headed to where everyone else had gone.
entries.new: 我扶 Shiroya 站起来，一起往其他人去的方向走。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: As if we'd stepped into another world, the lobby looked almost as it had when we'd last been there. The lights weren't blackened, but some had been turned off, most likely automatically. Only a bit of the smoke had sneaked through the gaps of the doors, forming a dark outline around them.
entries.new: 仿佛踏进了另一个世界，大堂几乎还是我们上次离开时的样子。灯光没有被熏黑，只是有几盏灭了，多半是自动关掉的。只有少许烟雾从门缝里渗进来，在门四周勾出一圈黑影。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: That would've been all if it weren't for the metal shutter blocking the door we'd entered through. Aside from the reception desk, the only things of note in the room were the couch and cleaning bucket.
entries.new: 如果不是我们进来的那道门被金属卷帘封住，这里看起来应该和上次离开时差不多。除了接待台，屋里也就只有沙发和清洁桶了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Everyone seemed to have lapsed into silence except for Katei, who simply appeared as if he didn't know what to tell us.
entries.new: 除了 Katei，大家都沉默了下来。他看上去也像是不知道该对我们说什么。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Oh. Guess there's no way we're opening that.
entries.new: ……哦。看来这门是别想打开了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Isn't it... a bit excessive? Why would they trap us like this?
entries.new: 这是不是……有点过头了？为什么要这样把我们关起来？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: I agree that this looks over the top, but I'm afraid the same has occurred with every window of the tower, and all the blockades are designed to not let sound pass. We won't be leaving earlier than intended. I apologize that this has happened.
entries.new: 我也觉得这阵仗有点过了，但很遗憾，塔里每一扇窗户都是这样，而且所有封堵都做了隔音。我们没法提前离开。发生这种事，我很抱歉。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Can't you at least tell us why? Why is there a metal shutter here? This doesn't look normal at all.
entries.new: 至少能告诉我们原因吧？这里为什么会有金属卷帘门？这怎么看都不正常。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: My apologies, but as I said earlier, I'm not allowed to supply that information.
entries.new: 抱歉，但就像我之前说的，这些信息我不能透露。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: But don't misinterpret me. Even though I could give you some details, I'm mostly kept in the dark when it comes to knowing the reasons. I'm only charged with making sure the system is functional, so I wouldn't be able to tell you much about what you want to know.
entries.new: 但请别误会。就算我能说一些细节，背后的原因我自己也基本不清楚。我只负责确保系统正常运转，你们想知道的事，我恐怕说不出多少。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: What are the details you know, then? Look at it from our perspective. We deserve the basics.
entries.new: 那你到底知道些什么？替我们想一想。至少最基本的情况，总该让我们知道吧。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: I understand, I promise. However, I can't say anything.
entries.new: 我明白，真的。但我什么都不能说。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: We all felt the need to sigh. Knowing information was being kept from us wasn't a pleasant thought, and it disrupted any cooperation we might've wished for. However, it would've been pointless to press the issue further.
entries.new: 我们都不由得想叹气。明知有人对我们隐瞒信息，这滋味并不好受，也打消了我们本可能有的合作意愿。但继续追问下去也没有意义。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Twelve hours it is, then.
entries.new: 那就十二个小时吧。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: After saying that, he walked up to the shutter and tried to move it aside to confirm that it was as sturdy as it looked.
entries.new: 说完，他走到卷帘门前，试着把它挪开，想确认它是否真如看上去那样结实。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Of course, it didn't budge at all.{w} Shrugging a little, Sai turned back.
entries.new: 当然，它纹丝不动。{w}Sai 微微耸了耸肩，转过身来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: This door wasn't closed, by the way. It was slightly open.
entries.new: 顺便说一句，这扇门当时并没有关。它是半开着的。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Yeah, I saw that.
entries.new: 嗯，我也看到了。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: And look, very little smoke passed through it.
entries.new: 而且你看，从这扇门穿过去的烟很少。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: So it was opened after the smoke was released.
entries.new: 所以它是在烟雾释放之后才被打开的。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Yes. It was closed when we were knocked out.
entries.new: 对。我们被迷晕的时候，它还是关着的。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I was the one who opened it.
entries.new: 是我打开的。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: ...I see.
entries.new: ……原来如此。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I looked at the other door. Although it was closed, it appeared that more smoke had gone through it.
entries.new: 我看向另一扇门。它虽然关着，但穿过它的烟似乎更多。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...{w}There was something else piquing my curiosity.
entries.new: ……{w}还有一件事勾起了我的好奇。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Katei, you said all methods of escape were sealed. What are those? Or rather, how many of them are on this floor?
entries.new: Katei，你说所有逃生手段都被封死了。都有哪些？更准确地说，这一层有几处？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: On this floor, only this one. There are no windows at ground level, so this is all that's locked. The other floors do have windows, though, and they were fully sealed too as soon as the alarm went off.
entries.new: 这一层只有这一处。一楼没有窗户，所以需要上锁的只有这里。其他楼层倒是有窗户，但警报一响，它们也全都被封死了。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: I see. I assumed the point of the smoke was to isolate the event room for an easy path to it, obtain the gem, and then leave with it. But that's strange.
entries.new: 原来如此。我本以为放烟是为了隔离活动室，好方便接近、取走宝石再带着它离开。可这就说不通了。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Strange? I think that's the most likely scenario too.
entries.new: 说不通？我倒觉得这是最有可能的情形。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: I say that because the lobby has been left alone. If the goal was to bring the Sekimeiya outside, why wouldn't they also release the smoke here? After all, two full hallways were attacked, so why not the lobby too?
entries.new: 我这么说，是因为大厅完全没有被动过。如果目的是把 Sekimeiya 带出去，为什么不在大厅也放烟？毕竟整整两条走廊都遭了殃，大厅为什么偏偏例外？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Yeah. If the goal was to bring the Sekimeiya out during all the confusion, it doesn't make sense that they didn't do it here.{w} I don't know what released the smoke. I didn't see anything in the hallways, but this is a much bigger room. It could be that whatever method they used simply wouldn't have worked here.
entries.new: 是啊。如果目的是趁混乱把 Sekimeiya 带出去，那没在大厅动手就说不通。{w}我不知道烟是怎么放出来的。走廊里我没看到任何装置，而这里空间大得多。也许他们用的手段在这里根本行不通。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Maybe. If you wanted to block off the security cameras and then immediately get spotted in this hall, your plan obviously wasn't very well thought out.
entries.new: 也许吧。可要是你遮住监控摄像头，转眼却在这座大厅里被人看见，那这计划显然没怎么经过推敲。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Could it be that leaving with the Sekimeiya wasn't the goal of the plan? Or maybe that they intend to do it later?{w} ...Is it realistic to think anyone could cause panic with the smoke, leave with this incredibly rare item, and not be caught immediately? Even if the cameras were blocked, once outside, you're still one of the last people to exit and would be searched.
entries.new: 会不会带着 Sekimeiya 离开并不是计划的目的？又或者他们打算之后再动手？{w}……放烟制造混乱、带走这件稀世珍品，还能不被立刻抓住——这种事真有可能吗？就算摄像头被遮住了，到了外面，你终究是最后离场的那批人之一，照样要被搜查。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: There is something that comes to mind, and it's why I only asked about this floor's escape routes.{w} The lobby was never used to escape. Now, Katei says the windows on the upper floors are sealed, but when they're open, they provide a feasible way out.
entries.new: 我想到了一种可能，这也是我只问这一层逃生路线的原因。{w}大厅从来就不是逃生出口。Katei 说楼上的窗户都封死了，可只要打开，它们就是一条可行的出路。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Keeping in mind that the alarm came late and that we never actually saw the Sekimeiya, could it be that by the time we stepped into the room, it already wasn't there?
entries.new: 别忘了警报来得迟，而且我们其实从未亲眼见到 Sekimeiya 本身。会不会在我们踏进那间房的时候，它早已不在那里了？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: The culprit could've gone up a floor to escape through the windows. Katei hasn't spoken about the footage of this timeframe, so he might not have been looking at the cameras. Then again, even if the cameras spotted the culprit, they'd be able to leave through a prepared window route and flee immediately once outside.
entries.new: 犯人可以先上一层楼，从窗户逃走。Katei 一直没有提到这段时间的录像，也许他当时并没有盯着监控。再说，就算摄像头拍到了犯人，对方也能沿着预先安排好的窗户路线离开，一出楼就立刻逃之夭夭。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Then... use an automated mechanism to create the smoke and lock the tower right before the Sekimeiya is ever shown to the public. For the people outside, this would make it look as if it's still in the building and entirely obscure the time in which it was stolen.
entries.new: 那么……就用自动装置制造烟雾，并在 Sekimeiya 对外展示之前锁死整座塔。在外人看来，它似乎还留在楼里，失窃的时间也就彻底模糊了。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: We started our session a bit later than expected because Shiroya and I were slightly delayed, but even if we'd gone faster and seen the missing Sekimeiya, it wouldn't have meant anything to the person who'd successfully stolen it since we'd soon be locked inside.
entries.new: 我和 Shiroya 耽搁了一点，所以参观开始得比预定晚了些。可就算我们走得快些、发现 Sekimeiya 不见了，对那个已经得手的犯人来说也毫无意义——我们很快就会被关在里面。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: If I assume some cameras recorded the culprit leaving through the window, it doesn't make sense that the smoke would then be deployed. However, if they also had a way around those cameras using another method, it'd give off the illusion that someone who got trapped must've been the one to steal the Sekimeiya, and only after the smoke showed up. After all, the lobby was left untouched, and no one would've left through it after the smoke appeared.
entries.new: 如果我假设有摄像头拍到了犯人从窗户离开，那之后再放烟就说不通了。可要是他们另有一套办法绕开那些摄像头，就能制造一种假象：偷走 Sekimeiya 的，必定是被困在里面的人，而且是在烟雾出现之后才下的手。毕竟大厅没被动过，烟雾出现后也不会有人从那里离开。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Since the alarm came later, whatever else the culprit did one floor above must've triggered it. Maybe the culprit triggered it purposely, which is why it didn't match the smoke's timing. That would be a bit involved, but it would work.
entries.new: 既然警报来得晚，那多半是犯人在楼上做的事触发了它。也许犯人是故意触发的，所以时间才和烟雾对不上。这样是麻烦了些，但确实行得通。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I might be deluding myself a bit too much. I'm also assuming they were able to get the Sekimeiya out of the cabinet without being noticed, which is probably too hard to believe. Not to mention Naomi unlocked the cabinet with her key, meaning it was locked by that time, so why would the culprit lock it after getting the Sekimeiya out, let alone have a way to do it...?
entries.new: 或许我想得太玄了。我还假设他们能神不知鬼不觉地把 Sekimeiya 从展示柜里取出来，这本身就难以令人信服。更何况，展示柜是 Naomi 用她的钥匙打开的，也就是说那一刻它还是锁着的。犯人取走 Sekimeiya 之后为什么还要上锁，又怎么上得了锁……？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I believe it's far simpler than that, Sai.
entries.new: Sai，我觉得事情远比这简单。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Katei took a while to answer. While I'd been thinking, he also had.
entries.new: Katei 隔了一会儿才回答。我在思索的同时，他也在思考。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: After all, the lobby doesn't have security cameras.
entries.new: 毕竟，大厅里根本没有监控摄像头。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Wh-What...?
entries.new: 什、什么……？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I realized immediately I'd already gone too far and got slightly embarrassed. Making up complicated theories was a habit of mine, but making a leap without even considering the facts was the last kind of mistake I needed to be making given the circumstances.
entries.new: 我立刻意识到自己扯得太远，脸上有些发烫。凭空构想复杂的推理是我的老毛病，但连基本事实都不顾就妄下结论，在当前这种局面下，正是我最不该犯的错误。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Regardless, that seemed pretty ridiculous. It was a big lobby, so even though I couldn't spot any cameras, I had figured they were well-hidden. All of us frowned, doubting that decision.
entries.new: 可无论如何，这都显得相当荒唐。大厅这么大，我虽然没看到摄像头，也只当它们藏得隐蔽。我们全都皱起眉头，对这做法心存疑虑。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I know it might sound strange. Next to the main door are guards who inspect everyone who enters, making sure they don't possess any kind of suspicious item. For this very reason, the fact that a big quantity of smoke was somehow released from the inside is already very strange.
entries.new: 我知道这听起来可能很奇怪。正门旁边有警卫检查每一位入场者，确保没人携带任何可疑物品。也正因如此，大量烟雾竟然从馆内释放出来，这件事本身就已经非常蹊跷了。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: There's nothing of value in this lobby. The only way to access any valuable item is by entering the actual exhibition section through one of the two hallways. There is no other way to reach the gemstones aside from these two doors.
entries.new: 这座大厅里没有任何值钱的东西。要接触任何贵重品，只能经由两条走廊之一进入真正的展区。除了那两扇门，没有别的路能通到宝石那里。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Since there are cameras in the hallways, the entrance to the valuables is monitored. Having them here is simply not necessary.
entries.new: 走廊里装有摄像头，通往贵重品的入口始终在监控之下。这里根本没必要再装。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: What the hell...? You guys aren't very good at this security thing, are you?
entries.new: 搞什么……？你们这安保还真是不怎么样啊。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: We have our reasons, but nobody could steal anything and leave without being recorded.
entries.new: 我们有我们的考虑。但不管是谁，想偷走东西又不被拍到，都是不可能的。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: But it meant, with the smoked hallways, it was actually possible someone could've stolen something and left without being seen by the cameras. However, it was pretty hard to believe that they could've managed to leave with the stolen object, even more so after seeing how harsh the security measures were.
entries.new: 可这也意味着，走廊被烟雾笼罩后，确实可能有人偷了东西还没被摄像头拍到。不过要说他们能带着赃物顺利离开，实在很难相信，特别是见识过这么严密的安保之后。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: You said there's no way to make it to the actual rooms containing the gemstones. Then what about that door?
entries.new: 你说过，存放宝石的展室根本进不去。那扇门呢？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: She was pointing at a smaller door situated behind the reception desk.
entries.new: 她指的是前台后面一扇较小的门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Oh, that leads to a room right under us. Past the door, a staircase goes to the room that stores the main boiler for the building, the electricity meter, the circuit breakers, and some pieces of furniture that we don't use anymore. Naturally, there are no cameras there either.
entries.new: 哦，那扇门通向正下方的一个房间。进去后有段楼梯，通往一个房间，里面放着主锅炉、电表、断路器，还有一些不用的旧家具。那里当然也没有摄像头。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: It's right under us...?
entries.new: 就在我们正下方……？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Yes. The staircase is a semicircle, so that room, which we call the mechanical room, is below the lobby.
entries.new: 对。楼梯是半圆形的，所以那个房间——我们叫它机械室——就在大堂下面。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: What about that computer? Can we use it for anything?
entries.new: 那台电脑呢？能用上吗？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: No. As I said earlier, the internet connection has been cut. That's not all, though. The alarm also disabled this computer so that the people trapped inside couldn't look through its files.
entries.new: 不行。我刚才说过，网络已经断了。而且不止如此。警报系统还把这台电脑锁死了，免得被困在里面的人翻看里面的文件。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Is the door locked?
entries.new: 那扇门锁着吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: It's not. Since it's right behind the reception counter, visitors can't enter it.
entries.new: 没锁。不过它就在前台柜台后面，客人进不去。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: I doubt that room could've been used for anything regarding this incident. Even if someone managed to make it inside, they would've needed a key to access the breakers, but it's not like the lights went out.
entries.new: 我看那个房间跟这次事件扯不上什么关系。就算有人溜进去，想碰断路器也得有钥匙，况且灯也没灭过。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Would Naomi have had that key?
entries.new: Naomi 会有那把钥匙吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Naomi? No, that's not part of her job. I do have it, but I don't think I've ever used it.
entries.new: Naomi？不会，那不在她的职责范围内。钥匙倒是在我这儿，不过我好像从来没用过。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: As a thought, could we power off the system in charge of the alarm to open up the exit?
entries.new: 我在想，能不能把负责警报的系统断电，这样出口就能打开了？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: No, of course not. It'd be a big oversight if a thief could go there, force open the lid, and then break free. Not every circuit can be handled from that room—only the basic ones that power on the lights and such. Essential operations like the security system and maintenance functions can't be turned off.
entries.new: 不行，当然不行。要是小偷跑到那儿，撬开盖子就能脱身，那也太疏忽了。那个房间只能控制一部分线路——只有照明之类的普通电路。安保系统和维护设施这类关键功能，是关不掉的。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: ...I see.
entries.new: ……原来如此。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: With another escape method eliminated, our spirits sank.
entries.new: 又一条脱身之路被堵死，众人的心沉了下去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Meanwhile, Isla had been watching our discussion and stared at us intensely.
entries.new: 另一边，Isla 一直看着我们讨论，目光紧紧钉在我们身上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What is that?
entries.new: 那是什么？
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: She seemed to be looking at Shiroya's neck.
entries.new: 她似乎在看 Shiroya 的脖子。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Hm, this?{w} It's a pendant.
entries.new: ……嗯？这个？{w}是条吊坠。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: I believe it's tanzanite, right?
entries.new: 这应该是坦桑石吧？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Yeah.
entries.new: 嗯。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Oh, it's really pretty! I want one like it!
entries.new: 哇，好漂亮！我也想要一个一样的！
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: Tanzanite? I doubt that. This seems to be an imitation; they're very common.
entries.new: 坦桑石？我看未必。这像是仿制品，市面上到处都是。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: ...Is that so? I don't know.
entries.new: ……是吗？我不太清楚。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Shiroya gave him a terse reply, obviously displeased.
entries.new: Shiroya 简短地应了一句，显然不太高兴。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If it's not, then that gem must be worth quite a lot.
entries.new: 如果真是的话，那颗宝石可值不少钱。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Ah. ...It doesn't matter, though. I really like it.
entries.new: 啊。……不过没关系，我很喜欢它。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Isla, you wanted to say something else before, right? What was it?
entries.new: Isla，你刚才是不是还有话要说？是什么？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Yeah...! We came here for the Sekimeiya, right? I just wanted to go see it...
entries.new: 对……！我们不是为 Sekimeiya 来的吗？我就是想去看看它……
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: She glanced down, expecting to get scolded, but nobody reacted that way.
entries.new: 她垂下视线，像是等着挨骂，可谁也没有责怪她。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There's no way it's still there, right? What even was it?
entries.new: 那东西不可能还在吧？话说回来，它到底是什么？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Sai began looking at me and ended his sentence at Akaro. We hadn't mentioned that we never directly saw the Sekimeiya, so since I'd referred to it being stolen, it was only natural for him to assume it was missing.
entries.new: Sai 先看向我，话说完时目光已经落到 Akaro 身上。我们没提过自己从未亲眼见过 Sekimeiya，而我说过它被偷了，他自然就以为它已不在原处。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Actually, we don't know... We were gonna check it when we woke up, but Erina's shout interrupted us.
entries.new: 其实我们也不清楚……本来打算醒来后就去查看，结果被 Erina 的喊声打断了。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Are you serious...?
entries.new: 真的假的……？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Shiroya and Akaro nodded as well, and everyone else had the same look as Sai. It seemed they'd all assumed the Sekimeiya had been stolen.
entries.new: Shiroya 和 Akaro 也点了点头，其余人的神情都跟 Sai 一样。看来他们都以为 Sekimeiya 已经被偷走了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Once again, without warning, Sai made his way out of the lobby. Isla was the first to follow him. No one objected, as we were all curious about what the Sekimeiya actually was and whether it would even be there.
entries.new: Sai 又一次毫无预兆地走出了大堂。Isla 头一个跟了上去。没人提出异议——我们也想知道 Sekimeiya 究竟是什么，它到底还在不在那里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Shiroya and I made our way back to the room where we'd fallen unconscious. Once Katei entered, our seven pairs of eyes focused on the dark-colored curtain that blocked the view to the cabinet's interior.
entries.new: 我和 Shiroya 回到了我们昏倒的那个房间。Katei 一进门，我们七个人的视线便齐齐落在那块深色的遮布上——它挡住了展示柜内部。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: So, none of you saw what was behind this curtain before or after the smoke, right?
entries.new: 那么，烟雾出现前后，你们都没看见这遮布后面是什么，对吧？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Yes. Naomi was about to raise it, but then the smoke appeared.
entries.new: 对。Naomi 正要掀开遮布，烟雾就出现了。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: People went quiet at the mention of Naomi. Given the alarm had played when she'd been there, her disappearance was still peculiar.
entries.new: 一提到 Naomi，大家都沉默了。警报偏偏在她待着的时候响起，她的消失至今仍透着蹊跷。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Let's see, then. What do you guys think? Is it still here?
entries.new: 那就看看吧。你们觉得呢？它还在吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...It was very hard to think it still would be, and going off their expressions, everyone else agreed with me.
entries.new: ……实在很难相信它还在，看众人的表情，大家也都这么想。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I say it is. That would make things more interesting, wouldn't it? And I'm curious about how it looks.
entries.new: 我觉得它还在。那样事情会更有意思，不是吗？我也挺好奇它长什么样。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: After those questionable words, Sai proceeded to slowly raise the curtain, exaggerating his own action.
entries.new: 说完这番不着调的话，Sai 便缓缓掀起遮布，动作夸张得很。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: As the curtain was being raised, dust that had gotten stuck on it shook loose and formed a little pile on the floor.
entries.new: 遮布掀起时，积在上面的灰尘簌簌落下，在地板上堆成一小撮。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The majority of the curtain was covering clean wood that contrasted the stained room. Finally, a transparent pane of glass sheltering a cushion came into view.
entries.new: 遮布遮着的大部分是一块干净的木板，与污迹斑斑的房间格格不入。最后，一片透明玻璃露了出来，玻璃罩着里面的一块软垫。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The curtain had been fully raised. Because of the darkness of the room, it took us a bit to see what was behind that glass.
entries.new: 遮布已经完全掀开。房间里光线昏暗，我们花了一会儿才看清玻璃后面的东西。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Let me see, is it there?
entries.new: 我看看，它还在不在？
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: Sai, directly next to the cabinet, stared inside. We all got closer as well.
entries.new: Sai 就站在展示柜旁，探头朝里面看。我们几个也凑了过去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Inside was a red cushion, a color that would've definitely looked beautiful if not for the lack of proper illumination.
entries.new: 里面铺着一块红色垫子。若不是光线太暗，那颜色一定很好看。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: And on that cushion, occupying the middle of it, was what appeared to be a white-colored sphere. Looking closer, it wasn't actually a sphere, but an egg-shaped stone. It shined very faintly.
entries.new: 垫子正中放着一个乍看像是白色球体的东西。凑近细看，那并不是球，而是一块蛋形石头，表面泛着极淡的光泽。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It could easily have been mistaken for an actual egg, albeit a large one. However, we all knew it wasn't. Naomi had told us that it was an incredibly rare gem, and despite its simplicity, it was pretty and elegant.
entries.new: 很容易让人误以为是一枚真正的蛋，只是个头大了些。可我们都知道并非如此。Naomi 告诉过我们，那是一块极其稀有的宝石；它虽然朴素，却漂亮而雅致。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It's this, right? It wasn't taken.
entries.new: 就是这个吧？没被人拿走。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: So this is Ashiya's big find? How can we be sure it's the real thing?
entries.new: 这就是芦屋的重大发现？我们怎么能确定它是真品？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: It is. I have seen it before. I happen to spend hours in front of the security cameras.
entries.new: 是真的。我以前见过——我时常在监控画面前一待就是几个小时。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Isla looked dumbfounded and couldn't help but stare.
entries.new: Isla 目瞪口呆，忍不住盯着它看。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: How disappointing. I guess it'd still please all those other people, but I came here purely out of curiosity. Despite not having any kind of expectations, I'm embarrassed to admit I'm a bit let down. You can call this thing rare all you want, but it's just an egg.
entries.new: 真叫人失望。其他人或许还是会满意，可我来这里纯粹是出于好奇。明明本来没什么期待，说来惭愧，我还是有点失落。你们尽可以说这东西有多稀有，可它终究只是个蛋。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: An incredibly valuable one, apparently.
entries.new: 不过，听说它价值连城。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: And it's still here? What was all the smoke for, then?
entries.new: 那它怎么还在这儿？那阵烟又是为了什么？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: I know I said I hoped for this to be the case, but I'm not too sure anymore. This probably means that the culprit's plan wasn't really all that elaborate.{w} They might just plan to spend twelve hours with us and take this thing out of here when it's time to leave.
entries.new: 我确实说过希望事情如此，可现在也没那么确定了。这大概说明犯人的计划没那么周密。{w} 也许对方只打算陪我们耗上十二个小时，等该离开时再把东西带走。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...And how exactly will they pull that off?
entries.new: ……那他们到底打算怎么做到？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: I don't know, but it's practically impossible that what's happening doesn't have to do with this, right? The end goal must be to steal it, so this just means that the plan isn't over yet.
entries.new: 我不知道，但眼下发生的事几乎不可能和它无关吧？最终目的肯定是偷走它，所以这只说明计划还没结束。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I'm not so sure.{w} Hey, Katei, do you know if Naomi was aware of the existence of that alarm?
entries.new: 我可不这么认为。{w} 喂，Katei，你知道 Naomi 是否知道有那道警报吗？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Naomi? She should not have been, but I couldn't tell you for sure. Why?
entries.new: Naomi？按理说她不该知道，但我也不能确定。怎么了？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Imagine this for a second. Naomi's job is perfectly positioned for this. She acted confused when the attack happened but was prepared for the smoke.
entries.new: 不妨设想一下。Naomi 的职位正好方便她做这件事。袭击发生时，她装出一副不知所措的样子，可对那阵烟早有准备。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: However, the alarm that locked her inside didn't factor into her plan because she wasn't aware of it.
entries.new: 然而，把她关在里面的那道警报并不在她的计划之中，因为她根本不知道有这回事。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Atsuki, you said you heard the alarm a few seconds after the smoke was released. Do you know how many, approximately?
entries.new: Atsuki，你说过烟雾放出几秒后你听见了警报。具体大概几秒，你还记得吗？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: ...Twenty, maybe?
entries.new: ……二十秒吧，也许？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: So twenty seconds later, pretty much everyone is unconscious and Naomi hears this alarm. By this point, she doesn't know that it's trapping her in the tower. If she had, she would've pretended to be unconscious until we all woke up.
entries.new: 也就是说，二十秒后，几乎所有人都失去了意识，而 Naomi 听见了警报。此时她还不知道这道警报会把她困在塔里。如果她知道，她大可以一直装昏，直到我们全部醒来。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: But she didn't. Instead, she obtained the Sekimeiya thanks to her key and left with it to proceed with her plan.
entries.new: 但她没有。她反而用自己的钥匙取得 Sekimeiya，带着它离开，继续她的计划。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: I'm not sure how it continues now or how she intended to escape, but she realized that the exit had been blocked off. Katei said this was a very specific alarm that hadn't gone off before, so it'd make sense if she didn't recognize the sound.
entries.new: 我不知道接下来会怎样，也不知道她原本打算怎么逃出去，但她已经发现出口被封死了。Katei 说过，这是种很特殊的警报，以前从没响过；她听不出那声音，也说得通。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: ...Well, as she finished searching for an exit or a way to continue with her plan, she thought her only choice was to come back and play the confused card. But, as she was coming back, she probably heard me opening this door and backed out.
entries.new: ……于是，她找遍了出口，也没找到把计划继续下去的办法，便认定自己只剩一个选择：回来装糊涂。可就在她折返时，大概听见我在开这扇门，又退了回去。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: It's clear she's the most suspicious person in the building. It's possible she was listening to us and heard that we didn't look behind the curtain. By leaving before doing so, we gave her a chance to look innocent.
entries.new: 这栋楼里最可疑的人显然就是她。她可能一直在偷听我们，知道我们没去看遮布后面。我们没查就先离开，反倒给了她装无辜的机会。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: When we were in the hallway, she simply entered the room again and placed the Sekimeiya back in the cabinet. Now it's possible we'll find her playing dumb or pretending to be knocked out somewhere, claiming she was disoriented and trying to assess the situation. It's impossible she's not trapped in here with us.
entries.new: 我们还在走廊时，她只要重新进房间，把 Sekimeiya 放回展示柜就行。现在她很可能躲在某处装傻，或者装成昏倒的样子，说自己当时晕头转向，正在摸清状况。她必定也和我们一样被困在这里。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: I see. That would make sense. It could very well be that this top-secret alarm only played whenever someone tried to get the Sekimeiya out of here and that she hadn't been informed of it.
entries.new: 原来如此，这样就说得通了。很可能这道绝密警报只在有人试图把 Sekimeiya 带出去时才会响起，而她并未被告知这件事。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Sai shot Katei a glance, clearly displeased that he had to make that assumption based on limited information.
entries.new: Sai 朝 Katei 瞥了一眼，显然不满他只能凭有限的信息作出这种推断。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Come on. We haven't found her yet, so shouldn't you wait to draw conclusions until we do? For all we know, she's looking for a way out to help us.
entries.new: 别急着下结论。我们还没找到她，不该等找到人再说吗？说不定她正在替我们找出口。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: ...You're right. We can't assume that Naomi is responsible, and we need to establish something that clears her name a little bit.
entries.new: ……你说得对。不能就这样认定 Naomi 有责任，我们得找出点能替她洗清一些嫌疑的东西。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Even though you guys just tried to explain things with the delayed alarm, it doesn't make a lot of sense to me.
entries.new: 虽说你们刚才想用警报延迟来解释，可我还是觉得说不通。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Naomi's job was to explain everything about the Sekimeiya and make sure the exhibition happened smoothly. An alarm that's triggered when the Sekimeiya is removed is something she would know about, so thinking that she was unaware of it is pretty ridiculous.{w} And, while her position is convenient to orchestrate this, it also makes her a very strong suspect from the get-go.
entries.new: Naomi 的职责就是讲解 Sekimeiya 的一切，并确保展览顺利进行。Sekimeiya 被取走时会触发警报，这种事她不可能不知道；所以认为她对此毫不知情，实在很离谱。{w} 再说，她的职位虽然方便她策划这一切，却也让她从一开始就显得非常可疑。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I can't be sure of this, but before the time I heard the alarm, I did hear the sound of a body falling, and given all three of us were already down on the floor, it must've been Naomi's. On top of that, the cabinet hadn't been opened, so if she opened it while I was on the floor and triggered the alarm, I think I would've heard it.{w} Not to mention how risky this is. Surely she would've waited until all of us were definitely unconscious to get the Sekimeiya out.
entries.new: 这一点我不能确定，但在我听见警报之前，确实听到了有人倒地的声响；既然我们三个当时都已经倒在地上，那多半是 Naomi。更何况，展示柜并没有被打开过。如果她是在我倒地后打开柜子、触发了警报，我想我应该会听见。{w} 更别说这有多冒险了。她肯定会等到我们全都彻底失去意识，才把 Sekimeiya 取出去。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: This also implies the alarm was unstable. Even if she triggered it by opening the cabinet, she had previously unlocked it. Wouldn't the alarm have gone off when someone forced it open, not when someone opened it after unlocking it?
entries.new: 这也说明警报本身并不可靠。就算她是打开展示柜时触发了警报，可柜子之前是她解锁的。警报难道不该在有人强行打开时响，而不是在解锁后正常打开时响吗？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Also, there's one thing that's totally impossible, and that is that the Sekimeiya was first stolen and then brought back.
entries.new: 还有一点是绝对不可能的，那就是 Sekimeiya 先被偷走、之后又被放回来。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Akaro seemed intrigued to know why his idea was incorrect.
entries.new: Akaro 似乎很想知道自己的推断到底错在哪里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Remember the curtain back then?
entries.new: 还记得当时那块遮布吗？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Oh...{w} I think I see what you mean.
entries.new: 哦……{w} 我好像明白你的意思了。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: The black substance was already dried on the curtain. But just now, when Sai raised it, a bunch of those particles fell on the floor, and almost none of them stayed on the curtain.
entries.new: 那些黑色物质原本已经干在遮布上了。可刚才 Sai 把遮布掀起来时，一大堆颗粒落到了地上，几乎没多少还留在遮布上。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: So it didn't move after you left.
entries.new: 所以在你离开之后，它就没被动过了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: And it's not possible to touch the glass without moving the curtain. ...The Sekimeiya must've also been here when we woke up.
entries.new: 而且不掀动遮布，就不可能碰到玻璃。……那我们醒来时，Sekimeiya 应该也一直在这里。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: It could be that Naomi brought back the Sekimeiya while we were still sleeping. That wouldn't contradict anything since the substance might not have fully dried on the curtain by that point. That doesn't make sense either, though.
entries.new: 也可能是 Naomi 趁我们还在睡的时候把 Sekimeiya 放了回来。这倒不矛盾，因为那时遮布上的物质可能还没完全干透。不过，这样也说不通。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: She would've only done that if she hadn't accounted for the alarm, so if she gave up on her plan and placed the Sekimeiya back before we woke up, she would've also closed her eyes and laid on the floor as if nothing had happened.
entries.new: 她只有在没料到警报的情况下才会这么做；所以，如果她放弃计划、在我们醒来前把 Sekimeiya 放回去，她也应该会闭上眼躺在地上，装作什么都没发生过。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Regardless of what the exact events had been, the Sekimeiya was inside its cabinet. What had the point of the smoke been? What had triggered the alarm, and what would happen next...? It still felt surreal, everything that had suddenly happened.
entries.new: 不管经过究竟如何，Sekimeiya 确实还在展示柜里。那阵烟到底有什么意义？警报又是怎么被触发的，接下来还会发生什么……？突然发生的这一切，仍让人觉得不真实。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Can I touch it?
entries.new: 我可以摸一下吗？
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: ...What!? No, don't.
entries.new: ……什么！？不行，别碰。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Isla had been staring at the Sekimeiya with an astonished face. Maybe because it seemed to be the core of everything, touching it must have sounded almost dangerous.
entries.new: Isla 一直满脸惊讶地盯着 Sekimeiya。或许因为它像是所有事情的核心，光是碰一下都让人觉得危险。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Why not? Naomi was going to let us do it.
entries.new: 为什么不行？Naomi 本来还打算让我们碰的。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Is this even open? It looks like the glass is shut.
entries.new: 这柜子开了吗？玻璃看起来是关着的。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: It shouldn't be. According to what Naomi said earlier, the key she had would've unlocked it.
entries.new: 按理说不该如此。Naomi 之前说过，她手里的钥匙应该能打开它。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: If it's open, you should be able to move the glass.
entries.new: 如果锁开了，应该就能推动玻璃板。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Let me see.
entries.new: 让我看看。
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: It's open, yes. I can scroll the glass down.
entries.new: 嗯，锁开了。我可以把玻璃板往下滑。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: The glass had a little opening to put your fingers in and push it down. If the lock was open, we'd be able to move it.
entries.new: 玻璃板上有一处小开口，能把手指伸进去往下推。只要锁是开的，就能挪动它。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: From the looks of it, it wasn't particularly sturdy or thick glass, so breaking it with force seemed possible too.
entries.new: 看样子，那玻璃板既不算厚，也不怎么结实，硬砸开似乎也不是不行。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Sai scrolled it all the way down, and we fixed our eyes on the Sekimeiya, no longer protected by any layer of security.
entries.new: Sai 把玻璃板一路滑到底，我们的目光落在 Sekimeiya 上——它已不再有任何一层防护。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Isla extended her arm slowly. Nobody except Erina looked concerned about her doing it, but I could tell that Shiroya was still agitated by the fact that none of them wanted to drop everything and find the missing person.
entries.new: Isla 慢慢伸出手。除了 Erina，没人在意她这么做，但我看得出，Shiroya 还是很不安，因为谁都不愿意放下手头的事去找那个失踪的人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Before Isla got to touch the Sekimeiya, she spoke.
entries.new: Isla 还没碰到 Sekimeiya，就先开了口。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It's cold.
entries.new: 好冷。
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: You're right, actually. The air inside the cabinet is cold.
entries.new: 说得没错，展示柜里的空气确实是冷的。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Oh, right, I was told about this. Apparently, the Sekimeiya must remain in a cold place. This was a very basic thing everyone was told, and it sounded very important.
entries.new: 哦，对，我听说过。据说 Sekimeiya 必须存放在寒冷的地方。这件事每个人都被告知过，而且听起来非常重要。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Why would that be needed?
entries.new: 为什么需要这样？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: I'm afraid I'm clueless. This is why the temperature inside the cabinet is very low, though.
entries.new: 这我就不清楚了。不过展示柜里的温度之所以这么低，就是因为这个。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: That sounded interesting. For whatever reason, the Sekimeiya had to always stay in a cold place, or at least that was what the Ashiya family had instructed.
entries.new: 这倒有点意思。不知出于什么原因，Sekimeiya 必须始终存放在寒冷的地方——至少芦屋家是这么交代的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Do we check what happens if we get it out?
entries.new: 要试试把它拿出来会发生什么吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What!? Of course not! The Sekimeiya must remain inside this cabinet. We were very specifically told not to remove it or subject it to any kind of heat.
entries.new: 什么！？当然不行！Sekimeiya 必须留在展示柜里。我们被明确告知过，绝不能把它拿出来，也不能让它接触到任何热源。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: I suppose it's still Katei's duty to act according to the rules. If something happened to the Sekimeiya, there would probably not be a positive outcome for him given that he was basically supervising us.
entries.new: 我想，按规矩行事毕竟还是 Katei 的职责。万一 Sekimeiya 出了什么事，考虑到他基本上是在监督我们，结果对他恐怕不会有利。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Assuming the blame didn't get shifted to Naomi for some reason, at least.
entries.new: 至少，前提是责任不会因为某种原因被推到 Naomi 身上。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: If the Sekimeiya was actually left here due to the cold temperature, it follows whoever put the attack together must've somehow learned of that requirement...
entries.new: 如果 Sekimeiya 真是因为低温才被留在这里，那么策划这场袭击的人一定以某种方式得知了这个要求……
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Isla, who'd paused her movement due to Katei's serious voice, continued moving her arm toward the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: Isla 被 Katei 严肃的语气说得停住了动作，随后又继续把手伸向 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: In just a second, she placed her small hand on top of it. Silently, she felt it for a few moments before letting out an amazed gasp.
entries.new: 转眼间，她的小手就放了上去。她安静地摸了几秒，随后发出一声惊叹。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Oh...! It's super smooth. I love it!
entries.new: 哇……！好光滑。我太喜欢了！
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: She started feeling it conspicuously with a smile on her face.
entries.new: 她脸上带着笑，毫不掩饰地摸了起来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Is it? Naomi did say that touching it was part of the experience.
entries.new: 是吗？Naomi 确实说过，亲手摸一摸也是体验的一部分。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Shiroya joined her, evidently trying to make Isla feel better.
entries.new: Shiroya 也凑了过去，显然是想让 Isla 心情好一点。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: You're right, this feels very pleasant to the touch, and also really cold.
entries.new: 你说得对，摸起来很舒服，而且真的很凉。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Worth all the advertisements and expectations?
entries.new: 配得上那些宣传和期待吗？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Yes!
entries.new: 嗯！
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: ...N-No, not really, but touching it is pretty relaxing. It feels almost silky.
entries.new: ……不、不算吧，不过摸起来挺让人放松的，几乎像丝绸一样。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Given our situation and the fact Naomi is missing, we should let this be. I know we'll most likely be here for twelve hours, but this piece is very important, and we should not be careless.
entries.new: 考虑到我们现在的处境，还有 Naomi 失踪这件事，还是到此为止吧。我知道我们多半要在这里待上十二个小时，但这件东西非常重要，不能大意。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Sai and I were going to be the next ones to touch it, but we had to respect that. Without responding verbally, Isla and Shiroya removed their hands from the cabinet. Katei's request was a reasonable one, and we still had more important things to think about. Even though six of us had come to see the Sekimeiya, only Isla seemed to have a legitimately strong interest in it.
entries.new: 接下来本来轮到我和 Sai 去摸，但我们必须尊重 Katei 的意思。Isla 和 Shiroya 没有作声，把手从展示柜上收了回来。Katei 的要求合情合理，何况我们还有更重要的事要考虑。虽然我们六个人都是来看 Sekimeiya 的，但真正对它抱有强烈兴趣的，似乎只有 Isla。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I looked at the left side of the cabinet, expecting to find something. There was the keyhole Naomi had used.
entries.new: 我看向展示柜左侧，想找点什么，那里有 Naomi 用过的锁孔。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It says "unlocked" right here. This is how Naomi unlocked the cabinet. Katei, do you know how many keys can open it?
entries.new: 这里显示的是“已解锁”。Naomi 就是这样打开展示柜的。Katei，你知道有几把钥匙能打开它吗？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I don't know for sure, but certainly not many. I'm only aware of the one Naomi had.
entries.new: 我不确定，但肯定不会多。我只知道 Naomi 手里那一把。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: So the only person who can open this is Naomi, who just happened to disappear and might be hiding somewhere.
entries.new: 也就是说，能打开它的只有 Naomi——而她偏偏失踪了，还可能藏在某处。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: ...Stop assuming her intentions are bad just because we haven't seen her yet. We have to find her as soon as we can.
entries.new: ……别因为我们还没见到她，就把她往坏处想。我们得尽快找到她。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Yes, but before that, we have to contact the outside from the security room. I would like to know what our situation actually looks like, and if Naomi went upstairs all by herself and chose to leave us unconscious, I won't be prioritizing her now.
entries.new: 对，但在那之前，我们得先去监控室联系外界。我想弄清楚我们现在的处境究竟如何；如果 Naomi 是自己上楼，还丢下我们昏迷不醒，那我现在不会优先去找她。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: I guess so. Splitting up is probably a bad idea, but if she isn't back when we finish, we really need to go looking.
entries.new: 好吧。分头行动多半不是好主意，但等我们办完事她还没回来，就真的得去找她了。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: There wasn't any other opposition. If Naomi intended to show herself to us, she would come back eventually.{w} We worked under the assumption that she still had the cabinet key. However, if she'd ever fallen unconscious, someone could've easily grabbed it, maybe failing to recognize that the cabinet was already unlocked. If she'd woken up as that happened, the culprit might've panicked and been responsible for her disappearance.
entries.new: 没人再提出反对。如果 Naomi 有意现身，迟早会回来的。{w}我们暂且认定钥匙还在她手上。不过，若她曾经失去意识，别人很容易就能把钥匙拿走，而且对方也许没发现展示柜已经解锁了。如果她恰在那时醒来，下手的人说不定会惊慌失措，那她的失踪可能就是这么造成的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...But that was a worst-case scenario, and not something we could easily jump to. It was true that contacting the outside was much more important.
entries.new: ……但那只是最坏的情况，不能轻易下这种结论。联系外界确实重要得多。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Let's go to the security room. That is where I work. We're very close to it, actually. It is beneficial to have it on the lowest floor, next to the entrance.
entries.new: 去监控室吧。我就在那里工作。其实我们离得很近。监控室设在最底层、紧挨入口，是有好处的。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Katei closed the glass and gave us a look that once again indicated how precious of an item the Sekimeiya was.
entries.new: Katei 把玻璃板合上，又看了我们一眼，那眼神再次表明 Sekimeiya 是何等贵重的物品。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Subsequently, he opened the opposite door of the room. Past it was a very similar hallway.
entries.new: 随后，他打开了房间另一侧的门。门后是一条十分相似的走廊。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Like in the other one, the ceiling and walls were stained by an ugly, dark color. It had been a while since the smoke's release, so the substance was fully dried up, letting more light pass through.
entries.new: 和另一条走廊一样，天花板和墙壁上染着难看的深色。烟雾释放已经有一阵子，那层物质彻底干透，能透过更多光线。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Once everyone was with us, I peeked into one of the rooms in front of us.
entries.new: 等所有人都到齐后，我朝前方的一间房间探头看了看。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: As Akaro had said, it looked clean, creating the same contrast as the lobby. The light worked perfectly, and there was almost no trace of the smoke apart from the small amount that had passed through the gaps of the door.
entries.new: 正如 Akaro 所说，里面看上去很干净，和门厅形成了同样的反差。照明完全正常，除了从门缝渗进来的少许烟雾，几乎看不到任何痕迹。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It seemed the function of the room was only to showcase different kinds of gemstones placed inside cabinets. I couldn't be sure, though, as all of them were covered by curtains.
entries.new: 这间房似乎只用来展示各种放在展示柜里的宝石。不过我也说不准，因为它们都被遮布盖着。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It's that door.
entries.new: 就是那扇门。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Without moving, Katei indicated the single door that stood out.
entries.new: Katei 没有挪步，只是抬手指了指那扇格外显眼的门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: While all the others were normal wooden doors, that one was gray and looked much more sturdy. Once Katei approached it, we walked behind.
entries.new: 其余的都是普通木门，唯独那一扇是灰色的，看上去结实得多。Katei 朝它走过去，我们跟在后面。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: On it was a nameplate with the words "security room".
entries.new: 门上挂着一块门牌，写着「监控室」。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: {w=0.6}Katei grabbed the doorknob, and upon turning it, he tried to push the door forward. However, it didn't budge.
entries.new: {w=0.6}Katei 握住门把，拧了一下，向前推门。门却纹丝不动。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Oh, right. I locked it earlier. Let me see.
entries.new: 哦，对了。我之前把门锁上了。我看看。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: You locked it?
entries.new: 你锁了门？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Yes, I have the key right here.
entries.new: 嗯，钥匙就在我身上。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Taking a couple of keys out of his pocket, Katei inserted one of them in the keyhole.
entries.new: Katei从口袋里掏出几把钥匙，挑出一把插进锁孔。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: This is an important room. When I left, I wasn't exactly aware of the situation, given I couldn't see through some of the cameras. I found it appropriate to lock the only room that allows communication with the outside until I knew more about what had happened.
entries.new: 这间屋子很重要。我离开时，有些监控看不到画面，所以对情况还不太清楚。在弄清究竟发生了什么之前，把唯一能与外界联络的房间锁上，我觉得是妥当的。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: That was probably a good idea.
entries.new: 那大概是个明智的决定。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: With a simple turn, the door was audibly unlocked. Before entering, I inquired about something I found next to it.
entries.new: 钥匙只转了一圈，便传来开锁的声响。进门之前，我问起了门边的那样东西。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Oh, is this a map? I almost didn't notice it since the entire wall looks the same.
entries.new: 哦，这是地图吗？整面墙都一个样，我差点没注意到。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Yes. It's a map of this first floor. The rooms labeled with a letter and a number are what we call the "crystal rooms". They're the exhibition rooms, where all the gemstones are displayed.
entries.new: 对。这是一楼的地图。标着字母和数字的房间，就是我们所说的『水晶展室』，也就是陈列所有宝石的展厅。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: I brushed off the dry dust and looked at it.
entries.new: 我拂去上面干结的灰尘，仔细看了起来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Minimap unlocked.   Press {} or {} to access it.   You can display it permanently in Settings > General > Other.
entries.new: 小地图已解锁。   按 {} 或 {} 打开。   可在「设置 > 通用 > 其他」中设为常驻显示。

entries.text: Minimap unlocked.   Press {} to access it.   You can display it permanently in Settings > General > Other.
entries.new: 小地图已解锁。   按 {} 打开。   可在「设置 > 通用 > 其他」中设为常驻显示。

entries.text: As Katei had said, the map only showed the first floor's contents, and it seemed stairs and an elevator would lead us to the others. It was the only floor that was usually open to the public, so there were a large number of rooms to visit.
entries.new: 正如Katei所说，地图上只标出一楼的内容，通往其他楼层似乎要靠楼梯和一部电梯。平时对外开放的只有这一层，因此房间数量相当多。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We found ourselves in hallway A, next to the security room, and had plenty left of the whole floor to look through.
entries.new: 我们此刻在A走廊，紧挨着监控室，整层楼还有大半地方等着查看。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: As a notable point, the event room was the only place that connected both hallways apart from the lobby and the perpendicular hallway C. As expected, there were bathrooms too, so we wouldn't have to worry on that front.
entries.new: 值得一提的是，除了大厅和与之垂直的C走廊之外，活动室是唯一连通两条走廊的地方。这里果然也有洗手间，这方面不必担心。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There's light coming from the end of the hallways. That means the horizontal one wasn't hit by the smoke, right?
entries.new: 走廊尽头透着光。也就是说，横向那条走廊没有被烟雾波及，对吧？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Yes, only these sections were.
entries.new: 对，只有这几段被波及了。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Katei, who'd claimed to have slightly inspected the floor, showed us exactly where the smoke had been released.
entries.new: Katei说过自己略微查探过这一层，他指了指烟雾释放的确切位置。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Hm...{w} So, if one of the goals of the smoke was to disable the security cameras, they didn't use hallway C for anything.
entries.new: 嗯……{w}这么说，如果放烟雾的目的之一是要让监控失效，那他们并没有借C走廊做什么。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Yes. I looked at the live footage of it while I was in this room, and no one showed up. They still would've had two available ways to cross the hallways, though.
entries.new: 对。我待在这间屋里时看过那里的实时画面，没有一个人出现。不过，他们要横穿走廊，本来也还有两条路可走。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Everyone looked pensive, including Isla, but they voiced none of their thoughts.
entries.new: 所有人都若有所思，Isla也不例外，却没人把想法说出口。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The layout was pretty simple. Remembering it wouldn't be a problem, but we could always look at the map again.
entries.new: 布局相当简单，记住它并不成问题，何况随时可以再回来看地图。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Katei waited until everyone was done examining it to open the door.
entries.new: Katei等大家都看完了，才打开门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Window Net
entries.new: Window Net

entries.text: Like the lobby and the room I'd just looked into, the place was completely clean, and no traces of smoke could be found, not even any that had slipped through the door. However, the contrast wasn't as noticeable given the room's darker colors and faint light.
entries.new: 与大厅以及我刚才看过的那间屋子一样，这里一尘不染，也找不到丝毫烟雾的痕迹，就连从门缝渗进来的也没有。不过，这间屋子色调偏暗、光线微弱，与外面的反差并不那么醒目。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Paying no mind to everyone's silence, Katei made his way to the chair and sat down. When he moved the mouse, the computer exited its suspended state and reactivated the three monitors above it, showing us what the last person to use it had been doing.
entries.new: Katei没有理会众人的沉默，径直走到椅子前坐下。他一动鼠标，电脑便从休眠中醒来，上方的三台显示器重新亮起，仍留着上一个使用者当时在做的事。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Above those three screens were many more monitors that displayed the real time footage of the cameras. While there was no way every room of every floor was shown there, at first glance, there was no trace of Naomi or another person.
entries.new: 那三块屏幕上方还装着更多显示器，实时播放着监控画面。所有楼层的每个房间不可能都出现在这里，但一眼望去，既不见Naomi，也不见其他人的踪影。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: All these security cameras... Does this mean we'll be able to look at the recorded footage?
entries.new: 这么多监控摄像头……这么说，我们能看到录下来的画面？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...We should be able to. I don't believe you'd be authorized to, but given the situation, we might be able to look at it after we talk with the outside.
entries.new: ……应该可以。按规矩你们恐怕没有权限，但事已至此，等我们和外界联络上之后，或许就能查看。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: That was an interesting proposition. Looking at the recorded footage might have revealed the source of the smoke, if someone else hadn't been able to evacuate, and information on Naomi's whereabouts.
entries.new: 这个提议很有意思。查看录像，或许能弄清烟雾的来源、有没有其他人没能撤离，以及Naomi的下落。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We all got closer to Katei and looked at the screens. It seemed the computer was using a standard operating system.
entries.new: 我们围到Katei身边，看向屏幕。这台电脑用的似乎是常见的操作系统。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Is this the time it is right now?
entries.new: 这是现在的时间吗？
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: Oh, yes. It's {time=9:41.}
entries.new: 哦，对。现在是 {time=9:41.}
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: As Katei said, next to the numbers that displayed the date, the current time showed {time=9:41.} That meant the exit would unlock at approximately {time=21:05}, in eleven hours and twenty minutes.
entries.new: 正如Katei所说，日期旁边显示的当前时间正是 {time=9:41.}。也就是说，出口大约会在 {time=21:05} 解锁，距此还有十一小时二十分钟。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We started a bit late, so I think the smoke appeared five minutes after we left the lobby. I'd say we've been awake for more than twenty minutes already, so this would mean we were unconscious for about fifteen minutes.
entries.new: 我们出发得晚了些，所以我想烟雾是在我们离开大厅五分钟后出现的。算下来我们醒着已经有二十多分钟了，那么昏迷的时间大约是十五分钟。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Yes, this matches with the amount of time I stayed here after I saw the smoke.
entries.new: 对，这和我看到烟雾之后留在这里的时间对得上。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Shortly after that, the alarm went off, so I knew I was already trapped. During that time until I exited, I kept my eyes on the cameras. I also tried to use the computer to look up information about what had happened, but the alarm even shut down my internet connection.
entries.new: 那之后不久警报就响了，我便知道自己已经被困住了。在离开这里之前的那段时间，我一直盯着监控。我也试着用电脑查过发生了什么，可警报把网络连接也切断了。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Wait, what? Why would it do that? You said you still have a way to communicate with the outside, so why didn't you use it?
entries.new: 等等，什么？为什么要切断网络？你说过还有办法和外界联络，那为什么不用？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Oh, I did not find it appropriate. My top priority was to find out what was happening here, so I focused on looking at all the cameras that remained functional.
entries.new: 哦，我认为那样不妥。当务之急是弄清这里发生了什么，所以我就专心盯着所有还能用的监控。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Don't you think a very good way to find out what was happening would've been to ask the outside?
entries.new: 你不觉得，问一问外界才是弄清状况的好办法吗？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: You might be right. That could've been the smarter choice, but I did not think it through well enough.
entries.new: 或许你说得对。那也许是更明智的选择，只是我当时没考虑周全。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: So, even though the internet connection is cut off, you have a communication method?
entries.new: 也就是说，就算网络断了，你还有联络的办法？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Yes. This computer is connected to all the computers on the upper floors. Even though there's no connection, a way exists to connect with the Ashiya family, and only the security staff knows about it. It does not use the normal internet connection, and it was designed in case of emergencies.
entries.new: 是的。这台电脑与楼上所有电脑相连。即使没有网络，也有一条能与芦屋家联系的途径，只有安保人员知道。它不走普通的网络线路，是为应对紧急情况而设计的。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: So, if you weren't here, we would have to spend twelve hours locked up not knowing what's actually happening and without a way to communicate with the outside world.
entries.new: 这么说，要不是你在这里，我们就得在不知实情、也无法与外界联系的情况下被关满十二个小时。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Yes... It sounds rough, but this alarm doesn't go off for no reason. We should just be content with the fact that I stayed inside. I wouldn't have been doing my job if I'd evacuated.
entries.new: 嗯……听起来是够呛，但这警报不会无缘无故地响。我留在了馆内，我们该庆幸这一点。要是我当时撤了出去，那才叫没尽到职责。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Nobody had anything else to add, so Katei proceeded.
entries.new: 没有人再补充什么，Katei 便继续操作。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Deep within many folders, he started up a program that contained a very simple interface. After inputting a username and a password we couldn't read, he pressed the enter key.
entries.new: 他在层层叠叠的文件夹深处启动了一个界面极为简单的程序。输入我们看不清的用户名和密码后，他按下了回车键。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The small window shifted into a much larger and empty one. The first thing we noticed was that a loud, unintelligible audio feed was being played. Seconds later, a video appeared in the center of the window.
entries.new: 那个小窗口随即变成了一个大得多的空白窗口。我们首先注意到，里面正播放着嘈杂难辨的音频。几秒后，窗口中央浮现出画面。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Is this a car?
entries.new: 这是车吗？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Yeah, it looks like a car seat.
entries.new: 嗯，看上去像汽车座椅。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Everyone looked at Katei, but he shrugged and kept watching.
entries.new: 所有人都看向 Katei，他却耸了耸肩，继续盯着屏幕。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The video was probably live, and the echo was obnoxiously loud. We could hear many people talking in the background, but it was impossible to make out any words.
entries.new: 画面大概是实时传输的，回声响得刺耳。背景里能听见许多人在说话，却一个字也辨不清。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We continued staring at the screen, unsure what we were actually looking at.
entries.new: 我们继续盯着屏幕，说不清眼前究竟是什么。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Is anything going to change?
entries.new: 会有什么变化吗？
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: After more than fifteen seconds, nothing had happened, and the audio continued playing.
entries.new: 十五秒过去，什么也没发生，音频仍在播放。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: This is for communication, right? Can they hear us right now?
entries.new: 这是用来联络的吧？他们现在能听见我们说话吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: They actually should be able to.{w} ...Hello? Can anyone hear us?
entries.new: 按理说应该听得见。{w}……喂？有人能听见吗？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Hello? Can anyone hear me!?
entries.new: 喂？有人听得见我说话吗！？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Amid the messy noise, we noticed one of the voices was getting louder.
entries.new: 在一片杂乱的声响中，我们注意到其中一个声音渐渐大了起来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'm from Ashiya, talking from inside the tower. Is anyone there?
entries.new: 我是芦屋的人，正在塔里通话。有人在吗？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: ...Oh, yes, it's coming from inside. There's finally an incoming connection.
entries.new: ……哦，对，信号是从塔里来的。总算接通了。
entries.speaker: q

entries.text: My apologies. He-Hello? Is this working? Do you see me?
entries.new: 抱歉。你、你好？这个能用吗？能看到我吗？
entries.speaker: q

entries.text: The camera was manually moved by the person who sat in front of it. Still inside a car, a police officer was uncertainly fixing his eyes on the lens.
entries.new: 坐在前面的人手动调了一下镜头。一名警察还坐在车里，目光迟疑地盯着镜头。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Y-Yes. By the looks of it, you're aware of the situation.
entries.new: 是、是的。看样子，你已经了解这边的情况了。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Katei said that because Ashiya Tower could be seen through the car's windows. A great deal of police officers were in front of it, and I could see that the metal shutter looked just as ridiculous from the other side.
entries.new: Katei 这么说，是因为透过车窗就能望见芦屋塔。塔前聚着大批警察，而我能看出，那扇金属卷帘从外面看同样荒唐。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It was a bizarre thought knowing that we were inside. We definitely hadn't been on a streak of good luck, but getting trapped inside a building the first time we'd stepped into it let us know that life wouldn't feel like redeeming itself any time soon.
entries.new: 一想到我们就在那里面，这念头透着说不出的怪异。我们的运气显然一直不怎么样，可头一次踏进这栋楼就被困在里面，足以说明生活短时间内不会忽然对我们仁慈起来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I had been trying to act composed and stave off all my negative thoughts, but the prospect of having to spend another eleven hours trapped in a building was daunting, and Shiroya surely felt similarly.
entries.new: 我一直努力保持镇定，把消极的念头挡在外面，可一想到还得在这栋楼里再困上十一个小时，心里就发沉。Shiroya 想必也有同感。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We know what occurred, yes. The Ashiya family was in contact with us, and we were informed of this communication method. Since a member of the security staff was assumed to still be in the tower, we kept this device with us expecting it to be activated at any moment.{w} I'm a police officer. My name is Suripo.
entries.new: 是的，我们清楚发生了什么。芦屋家的人联系过我们，也告知了这种联络方式。考虑到可能还有安保人员留在塔内，我们一直带着这台设备，等着它随时接通。{w}我是警察，名叫 Suripo。
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: So, can you see us?
entries.new: 那么，你能看到我们吗？
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: Ah... No. I can only receive audio feed.
entries.new: 啊……不行。我只能收到音频。
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: The man sounded a bit thrown off after hearing the voice of a little girl. It was only natural, given the vast majority of the people who'd been inside were adults.
entries.new: 听到小女孩的声音，那人似乎有些不知所措。这也难怪，毕竟原本在塔里的绝大多数人都是成年人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What happened in there? How many of you are inside?
entries.new: 里面出了什么事？你们一共有多少人在里面？
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: There should be eight of us, even though only seven are present. However, we can't be certain someone else didn't get trapped either. We have not inspected the entire building yet.
entries.new: 连我在内应该有八个人，尽管现在只有七人在场。不过，我们无法确定是否还有别人也被困住了。整栋楼我们还没查过。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: You're in the security room, right? If there were more people, couldn't you see them through the security cameras?
entries.new: 你们在监控室吧？如果还有别人，难道不能通过监控摄像头看到吗？
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: Let me see. We just got here, so we haven't looked extensively. Some cameras have been disabled by the smoke, and some places are without cameras, but I can try looking through the ones that remain functional.
entries.new: 我看看。我们刚到这儿，还没来得及仔细查。有几台摄像头被烟雾挡住，用不了了，有些地方本来也没装，不过我可以试试调出还能用的那些。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Since the number of monitors wasn't enough to display all the live cameras at once, Katei started to move through them with a program that seemed to manage the entire system. Presumably, only the first floor was being monitored continuously, being the one with unfettered public access.
entries.new: 监视器的数量不足以同时显示所有实时画面，于是 Katei 用一个似乎能统管整个系统的程序逐一翻看。想来只有一楼是持续监控的，因为那是公众可以随意进出的楼层。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: He was able to change all the cameras being displayed at once, making the process simple and brief.{w} As he'd said, the only thing to be seen through a handful of them was a black screen created by the smoke. Even after the substance had solidified, there was no chance we could see well through it.
entries.new: 他可以一次性切换所有显示的摄像头，整个过程既简单又迅速。{w}正如他所说，有几台摄像头里只有漆黑一片，那是烟雾造成的。即便那东西已经凝固，也绝不可能透过它看清什么。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Strangely enough, the last cameras that Katei displayed showcased a much different environment. The first floor had contained all the exhibition rooms, and from there, it had only been dull offices. But some of the cameras were displaying a bedroom.
entries.new: 奇怪的是，Katei 最后调出的几台摄像头显示的却是截然不同的景象。一楼全是展厅，再往上就只有乏味的办公室。可其中几台摄像头里，出现的竟是一间卧室。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: This must look odd to you all, correct? Do you know the story behind this place? This was the Ashiya family's residence until a decade ago. Then, its purpose changed, and work floors began to be added.{w} This is why it's called a tower. The townspeople saw that floors kept being constructed, and they started to call it a tower sarcastically, as if it would never stop increasing in height. I don't know if Ashiya liked the name or if they officialized it to counter its negative connotations. You might've also heard it called the "Ashiya skyscraper".
entries.new: 你们一定觉得奇怪吧？知道这地方的来历吗？十年前，这里还是芦屋家的宅邸。后来用途变了，办公楼层才一层层加上去。{w}塔这个名字就是这么来的。镇上的人看着楼层不断加盖，便带着几分讥讽地叫它塔，仿佛它会一直往上长，永不停歇。我不知道是芦屋家喜欢这个名字，还是为了消除其中的贬义才正式沿用下来。你们或许也听过「芦屋摩天楼」这种叫法。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: What you're seeing is the very top floor. When the structure was expanded, for a while, the living area was kept as the highest floor, and now it's referred to as the Ashiya floor or the attic.
