It's not possible to enter it without a very particular key, one I most certainly don't possess. In fact, I have never set foot inside it despite monitoring these cameras daily.
entries.new: 你们看到的是最顶层。建筑扩建时，居住区一度被保留在最高层，如今那里被称作芦屋层，或者阁楼。没有一把特别的钥匙就进不去，而我当然没有。事实上，尽管我每天都盯着这些监控，却从未踏进去过一步。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Of course, the cameras were installed after the place stopped being their residence, and they were only placed in some of the rooms before continuing was deemed unnecessary.{w} The initial reason was to make sure it was preserved well, given that it was of great importance to the Ashiya family. They were installed with the thought of someone breaking in and expecting to find unguarded, hidden information. However, the installation process was never completed.
entries.new: 当然，摄像头是在他们不住这里之后才装的，而且只装了一部分房间，后来觉得没必要再继续装。{w}最初的用意是确保这里得到妥善保护，因为这个地方对芦屋家意义重大。装上摄像头，是考虑到可能有人闯进来，想找一些没人看守的隐秘信息。然而，安装工程始终没有完成。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: While I don't know many of the details, I can say that not one time have I seen anything of importance happening inside.
entries.new: 具体细节我了解不多，但我可以肯定，里面从来没发生过什么要紧的事。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: ...That was all well and good, but it didn't mean much to us. Those cameras still showed an entirely desolate space.
entries.new: ……这番话固然不错，对我们却没多大意义。那些摄像头拍到的，仍旧是一片彻底的荒凉。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Every room with a camera is empty at the moment. This doesn't account for places like bathrooms, areas where the cameras are blocked by smoke, the lobby, other staff-only rooms, and the section of the attic that's not monitored.
entries.new: 目前，凡是装有摄像头的房间都空无一人。这还不包括洗手间这类地方、被烟雾遮住镜头的区域、大厅、其他员工专用房间，以及阁楼里没有监控的那部分。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: I'm just curious, but this room doesn't have a camera either, does it? I didn't see it on the monitors.
entries.new: 我只是好奇，这个房间也没有摄像头吧？我在监视器上没看到。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: No, it doesn't. For now, the number of us in the building is no lower than eight. We haven't been able to find the eighth person yet, but she must be here. I'm talking about Naomi Cabca, another staff member.
entries.new: 对，没有。目前楼里至少有八个人。第八个人我们还没找到，但她一定在这里。我说的是 Naomi Cabca，另一名员工。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: I understand. Give me the name of everyone present. I will add Miss Cabca to the list.
entries.new: 明白了。把在场每个人的名字告诉我。我会把 Cabca 小姐也加进名单。
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: I am Katei Kuiji. I'm the main person in charge of the tower's security system. Everyone else I have with me is a visitor.
entries.new: 我是 Katei Kuiji，主要负责芦屋塔的安保系统。跟我在一起的其他人都是访客。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Understood. What are your names?
entries.new: 明白。你们叫什么名字？
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: I'm Erina Majutsu. My daughter, Isla Majutsu, is who spoke earlier.
entries.new: 我是 Erina Majutsu。刚才说话的是我女儿，Isla Majutsu。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: I'm noting it down.
entries.new: 我记下了。
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: Akaro Esata.
entries.new: Akaro Esata。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Atsuki Hakutoki.
entries.new: Atsuki Hakutoki。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Shiroya Mirana.
entries.new: Shiroya Mirana。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Sai.
entries.new: Sai。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Sai what?
entries.new: Sai……姓什么？
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: Sai Yomiya.
entries.new: Sai Yomiya。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: All right, thank you.
entries.new: 好，谢谢。
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: So, adding in Miss Cabca, these are the eight people we know for sure are currently inside. This will be helpful.
entries.new: 那么，再加上 Cabca 小姐，目前能确定在里面的就是这八个人。这很有帮助。
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: Yes. Right now, she has to be in a place we can't see from here. The chances someone else is too are slim.
entries.new: 嗯。眼下她一定在从这里看不到的地方。至于还有别人也藏在那儿，可能性不大。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: So, how's our situation looking? We'd also appreciate having information.
entries.new: 那么，我们这边的情况怎么样？也希望能得到些消息。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: We don't have much to work with, only the testimony from people who were inside at the time. Given all the visitors were in the lobby, we don't have a comprehensive rundown to give you.
entries.new: 我们手头能用的线索不多，只有当时在里面的人的证词。来访者全都待在大厅，所以我们也拿不出完整的说法。
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: Unidentified smoke appeared on the first floor, and shortly after, an alarm went off. An effect of this alarm was to seal all the exit routes.
entries.new: 一楼出现了不明烟雾，紧接着警报响起。警报的作用之一，是把所有出口都封死。
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: We already know this. Why was the alarm triggered, and how can we leave?
entries.new: 这些我们已经知道了。警报为什么会响，我们又该怎么出去？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: There's one thing that triggers the alarm. According to what we've been told, it's forcing open the Sekimeiya cabinet.
entries.new: 触发警报的条件只有一个。据我们得到的说法，是强行打开 Sekimeiya 的展示柜。
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: What do you mean? We were there just now, and the cabinet looked fine. Not only that, but when the alarm went off, I was in the room with that very cabinet, and I didn't hear anything happening to it.
entries.new: 什么意思？我们刚才就在那儿，展示柜好好的。而且警报响的时候，我人就在放着那个柜子的房间里，根本没听见它那边有什么动静。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: That... doesn't sound right. This is reliable information that's been provided to us, so I don't know if it's possible something else triggered it. Maybe the system broke.
entries.new: 这……就说不通了。这条情报是可靠渠道给我们的，所以会不会是别的东西触发了警报，我也说不准。也许是系统出了故障。
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: What's for sure is that we just observed the Sekimeiya. Everything there is intact.
entries.new: 能确定的是，我们刚刚亲眼看过 Sekimeiya。那里一切完好。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: I'm sure the Ashiya family will be glad to hear that. I'll tell them immediately. However, that is as expected, seeing as all that was stolen were a few gemstones of little value.
entries.new: 芦屋家听到这个消息一定会安心。我这就去通知他们。不过，这也是意料之中的事——被偷走的只是几颗不值钱的宝石。
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: Everyone had a hard time processing that last sentence. Meanwhile, Suripo looked to be sending a text message, most likely to Ashiya, assuring the well-being of the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 最后那句话，让所有人都一时没反应过来。与此同时，Suripo 似乎在发短信，多半是发给芦屋家，告知 Sekimeiya 安然无恙。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...What do you mean? What was stolen?
entries.new: ……什么意思？被偷了什么？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Well, naturally, after the alarm went off, it took a while to confine everyone who had evacuated. A young individual carrying a black suitcase dashed off, so they were pulled aside. Inside it, we found various gemstones that belonged to Ashiya.
entries.new: 这个嘛，警报响起之后，把疏散的人群全部控制住花了些时间。有个年轻人提着黑色手提箱想溜，被我们拦了下来。箱子里装的是芦屋家的各种宝石。
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: That individual has refused to say anything. However, we assumed that some part of their actions triggered the alarm. If the Sekimeiya cabinet hasn't been damaged, we'll have to reconsider.
entries.new: 那个人什么都不肯说。不过我们原本推测，是他某个举动触发了警报。既然 Sekimeiya 的展示柜没有损坏，那就得重新考虑了。
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: If their plan triggered the alarm, how did they manage to avoid getting trapped?
entries.new: 如果他们的计划触发了警报，那他们又是怎么没被一起困住的？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: We don't know, but since nothing is wrong with the Sekimeiya, this seems to confirm the goal was to divert everyone's attention and steal a bunch of regular gems while everyone in charge thought that they knew the next target.
entries.new: 我们也不清楚。不过既然 Sekimeiya 没事，这似乎恰好印证了他们的目的：把所有人的注意力引开，趁管理层自以为已经掌握下一个目标的时候，卷走一批普通宝石。
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: What do you mean the next target? ...And how long will we need to stay here as a result of this stunt?
entries.new: 下一个目标是什么意思？……还有，被这一出闹的，我们得在这儿待多久？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Both of your questions are related, actually. I assume this means you haven't heard of the past incidents?
entries.new: 其实你这两个问题是连在一起的。看来你们没听说过以前那些案子？
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: Past incidents? What does that mean?
entries.new: 以前的案子？你指什么？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I read about it not too long ago, in Yushinews. About how Ashiya Tower had suffered another robbery yet again by a group called Xyn, I believe.
entries.new: 我不久前在 Yushinews 上读到过。说的是芦屋塔又一次遭到一个叫 Xyn 的团伙抢劫。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Yushinews was a monthly newspaper that released a compilation of every notable recent event. Given our town wasn't very big, it was a popular way to keep oneself updated, but it wasn't something I often looked at.
entries.new: Yushinews 是一份月刊，专门汇总近期发生的各种要闻。我们镇子不大，想了解近况的人常看它，不过我本人很少翻。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Exactly. The Ashiya family and Xyn have a history together. Even though Ashiya are perceived as a major influence around here, when they attracted people interested in their business, they inevitably drew in competition and enemies too.
entries.new: 正是。芦屋家和 Xyn 之间积怨已久。芦屋在这一带被视为极有势力的一方，可一旦有人盯上他们的生意，竞争者和仇敌也就不可避免地随之而来。
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: That's when Xyn started moving in. They're a long-running group that specializes in robberies of valuable objects, alongside similar criminal activities. When the Ashiya family became an established and wealthy entity, they also became a perfect target for Xyn. The fact they had developed in such a calm environment meant their security measures weren't adequate.
entries.new: Xyn 就是那时开始插手的。这是个活动多年的团伙，专门盗取贵重物品，也干其他类似的勾当。芦屋家一旦成了根基稳固的豪门，也就成了 Xyn 再合适不过的目标。他们是在这样安稳的环境里发展起来的，安保自然谈不上充分。
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: It's rumored that Xyn is a small group of people who work together and put a great deal of effort into their plans. None of them have ever been caught, which evidently gave them a reputation among plenty of people.
entries.new: 据说 Xyn 人数不多，彼此配合，在筹划上极费心思。他们至今无一人落网，名声自然也就传开了。
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: While the Ashiya family might look like an almighty entity for Yushibana residents, they're not one at all in the bigger picture. This led to them focusing on expanding themselves before even foreseeing or trying to prevent these attacks, which have only been getting bolder.
entries.new: 在丰花居民眼里，芦屋家或许无所不能，可放到更大的格局里，他们远没有那么强大。结果他们把心思都放在扩张上，连这些袭击都未能预见，更谈不上防范，而对方的行动也一次比一次大胆。
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: The first one happened two years ago. The security at the time was nothing special, so it looked like a small job, not anything of particular note...
entries.new: 第一起发生在两年前。那时的安保平平无奇，看起来只是桩小案子，没什么特别值得在意的……
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: However, since then, the attacks increased in both scale and frequency. I couldn't tell you how big this group calling itself Xyn really is, but they've been tormenting Ashiya for a while now.
entries.new: 然而从那以后，袭击的规模和次数都在增加。自称 Xyn 的这个团伙究竟有多大，我说不准，但他们已经折腾芦屋很久了。
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: Stopping them has been pretty problematic, and now they're moving in broad daylight with mass panic like this. At least, we assume they're involved here.
entries.new: 要拦住他们相当棘手，而如今他们竟敢在光天化日之下动手，闹出这么大的恐慌。至少我们是这么推断的——这次也有他们插手。
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: ...{w}Had such a battle actually been happening in the town I'd always lived in? I'd purposely avoided anything to do with that aspect of Yushibana, but I hadn't heard of Xyn even once. I could vaguely recall hearing about Ashiya Tower being robbed, but I'd never imagined the situation was so large scale.{w} No one I frequently talked to had an interest in the topic, so if it was common knowledge, I'd never been told. Ashiya had always felt like a taboo, and I'd never personally researched them.
entries.new: ……{w}这样的争斗，真的一直发生在我生活了这么多年的镇子上吗？关于丰花的这一面，我一向刻意回避，可即便如此，Xyn 这个名字我竟一次也没听过。芦屋塔遭劫的事，我隐约有些印象，却从没想过规模如此之大。{w}常和我来往的人里没人关心这类话题，所以就算这早已人尽皆知，也从来没人跟我提起。芦屋对我而言一直像个禁忌，我也从未主动去了解过他们。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I think the last time this happened wasn't too long ago, right? I was a bit hesitant to bring Isla here, but she was really excited.
entries.new: 我记得上一次发生这种事，离现在也没多久吧？我本来还有点犹豫要不要带 Isla 来，可她特别兴奋。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Yes. On the 24th of November, 21 days ago, Xyn attacked again. Ignoring the latest security upgrades, they made their way in during the night and stole a lot of valuable gems. It was one of the worst blows Ashiya's taken.
entries.new: 对。11 月 24 日，也就是 21 天前，Xyn 又一次动手。他们无视最新的安保升级，趁夜潜入，盗走了大量贵重宝石。那是芦屋遭受过的最沉重的打击之一。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Correct. Nothing actually indicates Xyn were the ones involved, and in fact, nothing ever does. However, the way everything goes smoothly and all of Ashiya's efforts are proven futile screams "Xyn" to everyone.
entries.new: 没错。其实没有任何证据表明是 Xyn 干的，事实上从来都没有过。可每次行动都顺顺当当，芦屋的所有努力全成徒劳，任谁看了都只会觉得是 Xyn。
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: So this time, Ashiya took it a step further, right?
entries.new: 所以这一次，芦屋又往前迈了一步，是吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Perhaps we'd all been thinking that. It looked like we had simply been caught in the middle of a rivalry, and Ashiya's latest move had imprisoned us.
entries.new: 也许我们都是这么想的。看起来，我们只是被卷进了两方的争斗之中，而芦屋最新的这步棋，反倒把我们关在了里面。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Yes.{w} It's possible that Xyn aren't actually involved, given the stolen gems were found. Nonetheless, the method used to get them out is still unknown. They were in one of the deepest rooms of the floor you're on.
entries.new: ……是的。{w}既然被盗的宝石已经找回来了，Xyn 也未必真的参与其中。但宝石是怎么被运出去的，至今仍是个谜。它们原本放在你们这层最深处的一间房里。
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: What closed the exit was the alarm, which had never gone off in the past. While Ashiya are denying it, malfunctions are a possibility.{w} The alarm was supposed to only go off whenever the Sekimeiya cabinet was forced open. If stealing the gems we found was what triggered it, it doesn't make sense that they were brought outside. And on top of that, you're telling me the Sekimeiya and the cabinet are completely fine...
entries.new: 封死出口的是警报，而这种警报过去从未响过。芦屋家否认存在故障，但也不能排除这种可能。{w}按设计，只有 Sekimeiya 的展示柜被强行打开时，警报才会响。如果真是因为偷走那些宝石才触发的警报，那宝石被带到外面就说不通了。更何况，你们还说 Sekimeiya 和展示柜都完好无损……
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: It all sounded very strange, and I was admittedly intrigued.
entries.new: 这一切听来都透着古怪，而我不得不承认，自己被勾起了兴趣。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I've been given authority to tell you about Ashiya's latest move against Xyn, which led to this incident.
entries.new: 我已经获准向你们说明芦屋为对付 Xyn 采取的最新举措——也正是这次事件的起因。
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: I see. This is what I felt I couldn't say earlier.
entries.new: 原来如此。这就是我刚才觉得不便说出口的事。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Keep in mind that what I'm about to tell you is a confidential matter that you're only allowed to hear because of your circumstances.
entries.new: 请记住，我接下来要说的是机密，你们能听到，纯粹是因为眼下的处境特殊。
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: One constant that has always followed with Xyn's attacks is that they attack during the night, presumably to minimize risks.
entries.new: Xyn 的袭击有一个始终不变的特点：他们总在夜里动手，大概是为了把风险降到最低。
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: Since Xyn bypassed anything Ashiya did without an issue, they recently put their full effort into a way to eliminate the threat.
entries.new: 既然芦屋做的任何防备都被 Xyn 轻易绕过，他们最近便倾尽全力，想找出一个根除威胁的办法。
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: The Sekimeiya exhibition... was no more than bait they put out to lure in Xyn. That, and the alarm they secretly designed, were the main two factors of their plan.{w} The tower is equipped with cameras and security. However, Ashiya hoped Xyn wouldn't anticipate such an abrupt jump in their measures.
entries.new: Sekimeiya 的展览……不过是他们放出的诱饵，用来引 Xyn 上钩。这场展览，加上他们暗中设计的警报，就是整个计划的两大支柱。{w}塔内装有监控和安保人员。不过芦屋希望 Xyn 料想不到他们的手段会如此突然地加强。
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: There was so much advertising done for this particular showing that everyone in town bought into it. That was the goal. But, on the side, Ashiya secretly designed the alarm.
entries.new: 这次展出宣传得铺天盖地，镇上的人全被吸引来了——这正是他们的目的。不过与此同时，芦屋还暗中设计了那套警报。
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: It was going to be activated whenever the cabinet was forced open. Only one key for the cabinet was made, and the lock was very carefully designed to only allow the correct one. The cabinet itself, however, was one they already had and could easily be broken with force.
entries.new: 只要展示柜被人强行打开，警报就会启动。柜子的钥匙只配了一把，锁也经过精心设计，只认那一把。可柜子本身却是现成的旧物，用力一砸就能砸开。
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: Obviously, breaking the glass of the cabinet would also activate the alarm. It was done so that any method of getting the Sekimeiya out without the key would trigger the alarm and trap the culprit with no way to escape.
entries.new: 当然，砸碎柜子的玻璃同样会触发警报。这样一来，任何不借助钥匙、想把 Sekimeiya 取出来的手段都会触发警报，把犯人困在里面，无路可逃。
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: What the hell is this about? That shutter could've injured people as they were escaping!
entries.new: 这算怎么回事？卷帘门落下的时候，正在往外逃的人可是会受伤的！
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: No. The mechanism is equipped with a sensor. If anyone had been in front of the shutter before it closed, it would've stopped moving until they stepped away.
entries.new: 不会。装置里装有感应器。卷帘门关闭之前，只要有人站在门下，它就会停住，等人走开才继续落下。
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: We all kept silent at the realization that our situation was far more unusual than we'd thought.
entries.new: 意识到处境远比我们想象的离奇，所有人都沉默了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The final element of the plan was the room you're currently in: the security room.
entries.new: 计划的最后一环，就是各位现在待的这个房间——监控室。
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: The alarm, along with blocking off all methods of escape, has other smaller functions such as disabling the elevator, some lights, and communication methods. The maximum time the exit was going to be shut was twelve hours.
entries.new: 警报除了封死所有逃生的途径，还兼有一些次要功能，比如让电梯、部分照明和通讯手段失效。出口最长会被封闭十二个小时。
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: ...Maximum time? Does that mean it can be less than that?
entries.new: ……最长？也就是说，也可能不到十二个小时？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Yes, but please don't get your hopes up.
entries.new: 没错，不过还请别抱太大希望。
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: After the alarm, the Xyn members that got trapped inside would have no way to leave. You might've noticed the security room's door is sturdier than the others. The last function of the alarm was to lock it.{w} Like the cabinet's lock, once the security room's door is locked, it can only be opened with the actual key, which is possessed by the security staff. Every staff member worked to put this mechanism and plan into effect, and they knew very well what they had to do. Today, only Katei Kuiji was present.
entries.new: 警报启动之后，被困在里面的 Xyn 成员就再也出不去了。各位或许已经注意到，监控室的门比别处结实得多。警报的最后一项功能，就是把这扇门锁上。{w}和展示柜的锁一样，监控室的门一旦锁死，就只能用真正的钥匙打开，而钥匙在保安人员手里。所有员工都为这套装置和方案的实施出过力，对自己该做什么一清二楚。可今天在场的，只有 Katei Kuiji 一人。
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: A security member would be inside the room constantly, monitoring the cameras. Of course, this is always done. Xyn have shown multiple ways to overcome the cameras, but this time, this was of little importance.
entries.new: 监控室里始终有一名保安留守，盯着摄像头画面。当然，平时本来就是这样。Xyn 已经展示过好几种避开摄像头的法子，但这一次，这一点无关紧要。
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: During the time anyone from Xyn was trapped, the security member in the security room would have one job: to relay information between the inside and the outside. This is why the security room is the only place where communication methods aren't cut off.
entries.new: 只要还有 Xyn 的人被困在里面，监控室的保安就只负责一件事：在内外之间传递消息。也正因如此，监控室是唯一没有被切断通讯的地方。
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: Once it was all over, the security staff would be able to unlock the exit before twelve hours had passed. To ultimately ensure nothing funny occurred, that request would have to be approved by the Ashiya family themselves. Only then would the exit be opened before the maximum time.
entries.new: 等一切结束，保安人员就能在十二个小时之内解除出口的封锁。为了确保不出岔子，这个请求必须由芦屋家的人亲自批准。只有得到批准，出口才会提前打开。
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: So what, they aren't approving it?
entries.new: 怎么，他们不肯批？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: No. They can't.{w} They don't know why, but they are unable to even access the command that would let them give their approval to open the exit.
entries.new: 对。他们做不到。{w}原因不明，但他们连那条批准开启出口的指令都调不出来。
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: They aren't sure, but most likely something went wrong. Given the cause of the alarm is unknown, the most reasonable explanation is a malfunction.
entries.new: 他们也不确定，但多半是哪里出了差错。既然警报的起因不明，最合理的解释就是故障。
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: Hey, Katei, you knew about this function, right? Why did you say that we'd be here for twelve hours without mentioning that you had the chance to open the shutter earlier?
entries.new: 喂，Katei，这个功能你是知道的吧？那你为什么只说我们要在这里待上十二个小时，却完全没提你有可能提前打开卷帘门？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Oh... Back then, I didn't think I was allowed to explain the mechanism and reason behind the alarm, but I was certain we wouldn't be leaving before the time was up.
entries.new: 啊……当时我以为自己没有权限解释警报的机制和缘由。但我很确定，时间没到之前，我们出不去。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: When I was still in this room, I noticed the same thing the Ashiya family noticed. I didn't have permission to access that command. That meant that we would have to spend the full time here.
entries.new: 我还待在这个房间的时候，就发现了芦屋家后来发现的同一件事：我没有权限调出那条指令。这就意味着，我们必须在这里待满规定的时间。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: In case something went wrong, this failsafe was designed: the exit would always open twelve hours after it locked. Obviously, that much time ensured that if a Xyn member had gotten trapped, they couldn't escape when the time ran out.
entries.new: 为了防止出岔子，还设了一道保险：出口在封锁满十二个小时后必定开启。显然，留出这么长的时间，就是为了确保万一有 Xyn 成员被困，也没法等到时间结束再逃出去。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: How is it possible that you don't have access to it? Can't you fix it?
entries.new: 你怎么可能没有权限？难道不能修好吗？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: I'm afraid I wouldn't know where to start. I have no clue what caused it, but if the Ashiya family is encountering the same error, it doesn't look like something I could solve.
entries.new: 恐怕我连从哪儿下手都不知道。起因我毫无头绪，可既然芦屋家也遇上同样的错误，那多半不是我一个人能解决的。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Then... isn't there a way to take down the shutters from the outside?
entries.new: 那……就没有办法从外面把卷帘门拆下来吗？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: No.{w} ...The attack was assumed to come during the night, but it happened this morning instead. I don't know a lot of details about this, but evidently Ashiya were going to trap at least one Xyn member inside and try to squeeze them for information over the security room microphone.
entries.new: 没有。{w}……原本预计袭击会发生在夜里，结果却是在今天早上。细节我了解得不多，但看来芦屋是打算至少困住一名 Xyn 成员，再通过监控室的麦克风从他嘴里撬出情报。
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: No one really knows how big Xyn is, but the shutters were designed in such a way that, in case members came to rescue their trapped comrades, they couldn't do anything from the outside. This is why, in much the same way, we can't do anything to break them down without a method that would also collapse the entire building. They might look flimsy, but I guarantee you they're not.
entries.new: 没人真正清楚 Xyn 的规模，但卷帘门的设计，就是为了在同伙前来营救时，让他们从外面无从下手。同样地，我们也拿它没办法——除非连整栋楼一起弄塌。它们看着单薄，但我可以保证，绝不单薄。
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: I'm confused. Katei, if you knew about this, why did you ever leave the security room? Why didn't you use the microphone to talk to the trapped culprit, as you'd all agreed?
entries.new: 我有点糊涂了。Katei，既然你清楚这些，当初为什么要离开监控室？为什么不像事先商量好的那样，用麦克风和被困的犯人说话？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: To tell you the truth, I did. All of you were unconscious, though, so you didn't hear me. I didn't receive any reply, and since the most important cameras had been disabled, I wanted to see for myself what had happened.
entries.new: 老实说，我说了。只是你们当时全都昏迷着，没听见。我没有得到任何回应，而最重要的几台摄像头又已经失效，所以我想亲眼看看出了什么事。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: So, all of this means that there's no way out right now. At all.
entries.new: 这么说，现在是真的出不去了。一点办法都没有。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Yes. Ashiya informed us of this plan days ago. They were certain Xyn would attack, so the police had to be caught up.
entries.new: 是的。几天前芦屋就把这个计划通知了我们。他们确信 Xyn 会动手，所以警方也必须知悉。
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: Since today was the last possible day, we were all anticipating Xyn to come during the night. Long before {time=9}, I myself was in the tower, aware that the chances of a theft were incredibly likely. I was in contact with Ashiya staff about what the procedure would be if something were to happen.
entries.new: 今天是最后的机会，所以我们都预料 Xyn 会在夜里行动。早在 {time=9} 之前，我就已经待在塔里，清楚盗窃的可能性极高，并一直与芦屋的员工联络，确认万一出事该如何应对。
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: Sure enough, after thinking about it, I recalled seeing him next to the entrance while we'd been waiting.
entries.new: 仔细一想，确实如此——我们等候的时候，我的确见过他站在入口旁边。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I left before the hallway doors opened. We were told something could still happen, and one of us had also been pretty insistent in saying there'd be an attack. That's why we stayed outside and were able to contain everyone who evacuated very quickly.
entries.new: 我是在走廊门打开之前离开的。上头说过仍有可能出事，我们当中也有人坚称袭击会发生。所以我们才守在外面，疏散的人一出来，就能迅速把所有人控制住。
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: I believe this is the scenario Ashiya will be going with: this was an attack by Xyn intended to subvert their expectations and target a lot of regular gems instead of the Sekimeiya. Maybe it would've been a success if it hadn't been for the new alarm. The suitcase was discovered right away, and all the gems were retrieved.
entries.new: 我想芦屋那边会这样定性：这次是 Xyn 的一次袭击，意在出乎他们的意料，不冲着 Sekimeiya，而是瞄准大量普通宝石。要不是有那套新警报，说不定就让他们得手了。手提箱当场被发现，所有宝石都追了回来。
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: It's possible the alarm went off due to a malfunction, which is also preventing them from opening the exit before the maximum time. Right now, all they can do is wait and tell you guys to do the same. They don't believe anything else has happened and will most likely be calling this their victory.
entries.new: 警报有可能是故障触发，而同样的故障也让他们无法提前打开出口。眼下他们只能等，并且让你们也一起等。他们不认为还发生了别的事，多半会把这次当成一场胜利。
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: I'm sorry I can't be of more help. While some details are still unclear, it all more or less makes sense.
entries.new: 抱歉，我能帮上的有限。虽然还有些细节不清楚，但大体上都说得通。
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: All right. Is there anything else you should tell us?
entries.new: 好吧。还有别的该告诉我们的吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...I don't believe so. There's nothing you should worry about besides having to be in there for a while. I personally apologize for all the inconvenience, and I'm sure Ashiya will compensate all of you for being innocently trapped.
entries.new: ……我想没有了。除了要在里面待上一阵子，没什么需要担心的。给你们添了这些麻烦，我个人深表歉意；各位无辜被困，芦屋一定会给予补偿。
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: Nobody wanted to mention that someone among us might not have been "innocently" trapped, and instead we stayed silent, thinking about the hours that awaited us.
entries.new: 没有人愿意提起，我们当中或许有人并非「无辜」被困。大家只是沉默着，想着接下来那几个小时该如何度过。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Was that really everything, though? Was it all just a malfunction? Was Xyn actually involved? I knew many things didn't quite add up.{w} What the hell had happened to Naomi, on top of it all?
entries.new: 可真的就只有这些吗？一切都只是故障？Xyn 真的牵涉其中吗？我知道有很多地方对不上。{w}更何况，Naomi 身上到底出了什么事？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Recently, there had been... a similar attack in Yushibana, where smoke had also been released. Assuming that Xyn were involved in the attack on the tower, it was a pretty easy leap to assume that they had been behind the other.
entries.new: 最近在丰花也发生过……一次类似的袭击，同样放出过烟雾。假设芦屋塔这次是 Xyn 所为，那么很容易就能推断，那一次也是他们干的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...So, what are we gonna do? Twelve hours is a lot of time. Can we go to the Sekimeiya again?
entries.new: ……那，我们接下来怎么办？十二个小时可不短。还能再去看 Sekimeiya 吗？
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: I think you should first reunite with Miss Cabca. After that, make sure not to do anything Ashiya might not be happy with, or they could find a way to avoid compensating you.
entries.new: 我看你们还是先和 Cabca 小姐会合为好。之后，千万别做让芦屋不高兴的事，否则他们可能会找借口不给补偿。
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: Suripo forced a smile and was about to put an end to the conversation.
entries.new: Suripo 勉强笑了笑，打算就此打住。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Suddenly, out of the three computer monitors, the leftmost one went black.
entries.new: 突然，三台显示器中，最左边的那台黑了下去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wh-What? What just happened to this screen?
entries.new: 什、什么？这屏幕怎么了？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Sai, who was the one in front of it, was first to react.
entries.new: 站在那台屏幕前的 Sai 最先反应过来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Let me see... It's possible the computer stopped recognizing the screen. One second...
entries.new: 我看看……可能是电脑突然认不出显示器了。等一下……
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Sai's overreaction threw everyone off, including Suripo. That was because we had only been looking at the middle screen, and the computer was still working. The leftmost screen had been displaying nothing but an empty part of the desktop.
entries.new: Sai 反应过度，把所有人都弄懵了，连 Suripo 也不例外——因为我们一直只盯着中间那块屏幕，而电脑明明还在运转。最左边那块屏幕显示的一直只是桌面上的空白区域。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Regardless, Sai quickly grabbed the mouse and navigated to the screen configuration settings.
entries.new: 不管怎样，Sai 很快抓起鼠标，打开了屏幕设置界面。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: At least you aren't using some custom operating system. I know what I'm looking for.
entries.new: 至少你们用的不是什么自制系统。我知道该看哪里。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I see... How strange. The left monitor isn't being detected at all...
entries.new: 原来如此……真奇怪。左边那台显示器完全检测不到……
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Does it matter? The computer didn't actually shut down, did it?
entries.new: 这有关系吗？电脑又没有真的关机，对吧？
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: Oh, no, obviously not. We can still hear and see you. Sorry, I was just confused. I don't know what caused it, though. It just stopped detecting it out of the blue.
entries.new: 啊，没有，当然没有。我们还能听见、看见你们。抱歉，我只是有点困惑。不过我也不知道是什么原因，它突然就检测不到了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: You'll have time to figure it out. For now, there are better thi—
entries.new: 你有的是时间慢慢查。眼下还有更要紧的——
entries.speaker: su

entries.text: Suripo never finished that sentence. Before he could, the other two screens also went black.
entries.new: Suripo 那句话没能说完。还没等他继续，另外两块屏幕也黑了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What... happened now?
entries.new: 又……怎么了？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: It wasn't only the screens this time. The computer seems to have shut down too.
entries.new: 这次不只是屏幕。电脑好像也关机了。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: How...? What the hell?
entries.new: 怎么会……？搞什么鬼？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Shiroya, Erina, and Isla were looking upward. It seemed the three computer screens weren't the only ones to turn off.
entries.new: Shiroya、Erina 和 Isla 都抬头向上看。看来熄掉的并不止那三块电脑屏幕。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: All the security cameras too...? Oh no...
entries.new: 连监控摄像头也……？糟了……
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: The light works, so it can't be a power outage.
entries.new: 灯还亮着，应该不是停电。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Did a cable get disconnected?
entries.new: 是线松了吗？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Katei crouched under the desk and looked behind the computer.
entries.new: Katei 蹲到桌下，查看电脑背面。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There's nothing that looks wrong.
entries.new: 看不出有什么不对劲。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: He pressed the power button multiple times, but the computer refused to start up.
entries.new: 他连按了几次电源键，电脑始终没能启动。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What the hell just happened?
entries.new: 到底是怎么回事？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Was it Naomi?
entries.new: 是 Naomi 干的吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Naomi...?
entries.new: Naomi……？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: We were almost done with Suripo, and it was time to look at the recorded footage. If it implicated her, she might be responsible for the computer shutting off.
entries.new: 我们快问完 Suripo 了，接下来就该看录像。如果录像里牵涉到她，电脑关机或许就是她动的手脚。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Is... Is she listening to us?
entries.new: 她……她是不是在听我们说话？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Katei sprinted out of the room and looked at both sides of the hallway. He even peeked at the lobby.
entries.new: Katei 冲出房间，朝走廊两端张望，甚至还探头看了看大厅。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: While he was out and everyone's focus had diverted to the door, I noticed something behind me.
entries.new: 趁他出去、众人的注意力都转向门口时，我却注意到身后有什么。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Sai had just taken his arm away from the leftmost monitor.
entries.new: Sai 刚把手臂从最左边那块屏幕上移开。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: When he noticed I was looking at him, our eyes met, and he smirked.
entries.new: 他发觉我在看他，与我对上视线，嘴角一扬。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Before I could think, noise filled the room again.
entries.new: 我还没来得及细想，房间里又响起了声音。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Katei came back, panting. It seemed the possibility of being spied on in his workroom had really gotten to him.
entries.new: Katei 喘着气回来了。看来，一想到自己的工作室也可能被人监视，他是真的慌了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We didn't have to ask to know he'd found nothing.
entries.new: 不用问也知道，他什么都没找到。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Do you know how someone would have turned off the computer from outside the room?
entries.new: 你知道有什么办法能从房间外面关掉这台电脑吗？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: No... That should be impossible.
entries.new: 不知道……那应该不可能。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: As I said earlier, underneath the lobby is the panel that handles the tower's electricity. While it isn't incredibly well protected, it should be impossible to power off the main computer from there.
entries.new: 就像我之前说的，大厅底下是控制整座塔供电的配电盘。虽说防护算不上严密，但想从那里切断主电脑的电源，应该是不可能的。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: That doesn't make sense... Are you sure it wouldn't be possible?
entries.new: 这说不通……你确定真的不可能吗？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: I have worked here for many years, so yes.
entries.new: 我在这里工作很多年了，所以我很确定。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Maybe we should go check anyway.
entries.new: 还是去确认一下吧。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I agree. Let me go with you, esteemed visitor.
entries.new: 我同意。让我陪你走一趟吧，尊贵的访客。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Without waiting for a reply, Sai grabbed me by my shirt and lightly ushered me out of the room.
entries.new: Sai 没等回答，便抓住我的衣襟，半推半送地把我带出了房间。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Hey, wait.
entries.new: 喂，等等。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: He didn't wait.
entries.new: 他没有等。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I-It's fine. I'll be right back.
entries.new: 没、没事，我很快就回来。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: That must have been enough for Shiroya, because she didn't follow us.
entries.new: 这句话大概足以让 Shiroya 放心，她没有跟上来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I did actually want to see the panel, so I let Sai do what he wanted. It was better to not put up a fight if it gave me the same result either way.
entries.new: 我本来也确实想看看那个配电盘，便随 Sai 去了。既然横竖都是一个结果，与其争执，不如顺着他。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We'd talked about the room before, so we knew how to access it even though it wasn't marked on the map.
entries.new: 那间房间我们之前聊起过，所以即便地图上没有标注，我们也知道该怎么过去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Sai started walking without uttering a word, and I followed behind.
entries.new: Sai 一言不发地走了起来，我跟在后面。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I wanted to ask what exactly was up with him, but the words didn't leave my mouth.
entries.new: 我想问他到底是怎么回事，话却没能说出口。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We went past the reception desk. Being behind it was a strange feeling, but I didn't have time to look around.
entries.new: 我们走过前台。站在柜台后面的感觉怪怪的，但我没工夫四处张望。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: As Katei had said, the door to the mechanical room was unlocked. Past it was a very narrow and dark staircase that made a sharp turn to the right.
entries.new: 正如 Katei 所说，机械室的门没有上锁。门后是一道狭窄昏暗的楼梯，向右急转。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: How scary. You go first.
entries.new: 真吓人。你先走。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: His nonchalant way of speaking made it clear he wasn't being serious. If it was supposed to be a joke, it didn't seem very appropriate.
entries.new: 他说话时那副漫不经心的样子，摆明了没在认真。如果这算玩笑，也不怎么合适。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Nonetheless, I entered the stairwell first. The ceiling became a bit lower, which required me to crouch to advance. Both of us stepped into the mechanical room after opening a smaller second door.
entries.new: 尽管如此，我还是率先走进了楼梯间。天花板矮了一截，我得弯着腰才能前进。推开第二道小门后，我们两人一同进了机械室。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The temperature didn't change, but the light was very dim, much worse in quality than the other ones used throughout the tower. The illumination was worse than the smoke-filled hallways'.
entries.new: 温度倒没变，光线却暗得厉害，灯的质量比塔里其他地方用的差远了。连那些烟雾弥漫的走廊都比这儿亮。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: High up on the wall was the panel Katei described. I had to move aside a low table to walk up to it, but reaching it didn't present a problem: I could easily touch the ceiling with my hand.
entries.new: Katei 说的那块面板就装在墙面高处。我挪开一张矮桌才走到墙边，要够到它却不成问题——我随手一抬就能碰到天花板。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I looked around me. Past all the cobwebs, I could see the boiler Katei had mentioned, and it emitted a constant buzzing sound. There were also small, worn-out pieces of furniture littered around, presumably because nothing bigger could fit through the staircase.
entries.new: 我环顾四周。穿过层层蛛网，能看见 Katei 提过的那台锅炉，一直发出嗡嗡的声响。地上还散落着几件破旧的小家具，大概是因为再大些的东西根本搬不进楼梯间。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It seems he was right. All the switches are on.
entries.new: 看来他没说错。所有开关都开着。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...Yeah. This probably hasn't been used lately. It's covered in dust.
entries.new: ……嗯。这里最近应该没人动过，上面全是灰。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I agree.
entries.new: 我同意。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: The panel was protected by a plastic cover with a key lock, and every switch had a label on top of it. They were hard to read, but the one labeled "security room", just like all the others, was on.
entries.new: 面板外罩着一层带锁的塑料盖，每个开关上方都贴着标签。字迹很难辨认，但标着「监控室」的那个和其余开关一样，都开着。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Can I ask something?
entries.new: 我能问一句吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Hm?
entries.new: 嗯？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Do you believe a word of what Katei's been saying?
entries.new: Katei 说的那些，你信几分？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Wh-What...?{w} What do you mean?
entries.new: 什、什么……？{w}你这话是什么意思？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: That took me by surprise. Maybe not so much the fact that he'd been suspecting Katei, but that he'd asked me so suddenly.
entries.new: 这话让我吃了一惊。倒不是因为他怀疑 Katei，而是他问得太突然了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I mean what I said. Everything that Katei has said... There's no way you believe it, right?
entries.new: 就是字面意思。Katei 说过的每一句话……你总不至于都信吧？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: From the beginning, when he found us. When he claimed to have searched the entire floor without finding your group.{w} About monitoring the cameras and trying to open the exit.
entries.new: 从最开始他找到我们那会儿。他说自己把整层都搜遍了，却没发现你们几个。{w}还有他盯着监控、试着打开出口的那些话。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Remember what he said? That he hadn't found it appropriate to try to talk to the outside and instead kept looking at the available cameras?
entries.new: 还记得他是怎么说的吗？说自己觉得不该贸然联系外界，就一直盯着能调出来的监控画面。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: You can't seriously tell me you believe that.
entries.new: 你总不会真跟我说你信这套吧。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I... I don't know.
entries.new: 我……我不知道。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: It's true that I've thought that some of his claims sounded a bit off, but this might be taking it a bit too far.
entries.new: 我确实觉得他有些说辞不太对劲，可怀疑到这个地步，未免有些过了。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I can't definitely doubt what he said, that he panicked and prioritized figuring out what was happening before trying to contact anyone.
entries.new: 他说自己当时慌了神，只顾先弄清状况，才没去联系别人——这一点我也没法一口咬定是假的。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: It's weird that he didn't find us, yeah, but he said he hadn't thoroughly examined the floor...
entries.new: 他没找到我们，确实奇怪，可他自己也说了，没有把整层仔细查过……
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: He's been helpful to us and let us contact the police. I don't think he's as suspicious as you think.
entries.new: 他帮过我们，还让我们联系了警察。我觉得他没你想的那么可疑。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Hm...{w} Then I'll put it bluntly.
entries.new: 嗯……{w}那我就挑明说吧。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I guarantee you that everything he's said has been a lie. Don't trust anything he says.
entries.new: 我可以打包票，他说的话全是假的。一个字都别信。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...{w}How can you be sure...?
entries.new: ……{w}你怎么能确定……？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: You're free to not believe me. I told you this because I thought you'd realized it earlier.
entries.new: 信不信由你。我之所以说这些，是以为你早就察觉到了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: He smiled the same way as earlier and left the room with a shrug. From his face, all I could make out was that he was trying to have fun, but I couldn't tell if he was just messing with me.
entries.new: 他又是先前那副笑容，耸耸肩走出了房间。从他的表情里，我只能看出他在自得其乐，却分不清他是不是在拿我寻开心。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I went upstairs. Through the door, I saw Sai in hallway B. I wanted to shout at him, but I caught up to him instead.
entries.new: 我上了楼。隔着门，我看见 Sai 在 B走廊。我本想冲他喊，最后还是追了上去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There's hallway C ahead, the one that's clean. Do you feel like investigating the upper floors?
entries.new: 前面就是 C走廊，那条干净的。想不想去上面几层看看？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...What? Let's go back.
entries.new: ……什么？回去吧。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: He ignored me and kept walking forward.{w} Instead of repeating myself, I felt like being the one to ask something.
entries.new: 他没理我，继续往前走。{w}我没再重复，反倒想换我来问他点什么。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What do you think happened to Naomi?
entries.new: 你觉得 Naomi 出了什么事？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I couldn't quite grasp Sai's behavior, but he was also trying to piece things together and might've agreed that more than met the eye was going on.{w} He didn't seem unintelligent, and since his approach appeared different from mine, his input was potentially useful.
entries.new: 我实在摸不透 Sai 的举动，不过他也在拼凑真相，或许同样觉得事情并不简单。{w}他看上去并不笨，而且思路与我不一样，听听他的看法也许有用。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I couldn't tell you for sure. Katei seemed fine looking through the monitors, but it was also not his priority.
entries.new: 这我可说不准。Katei 查监控时看着挺上心，可那也不是他最要紧的事。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: This probably means that either he doesn't think much of Naomi's disappearance, or he knew we wouldn't spot her even if we looked through all the available cameras.
entries.new: 这大概说明，要么他根本没把 Naomi 的失踪当回事，要么他早就知道，就算把能调的监控全看一遍，也找不到她。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Are you sure she really passed out?
entries.new: 你确定她真的昏过去了吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I'm almost certain, yes.
entries.new: 几乎可以肯定。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Then it's hard to believe she regained consciousness before a person as big as Akaro did. If she really inhaled the smoke and wasn't there by the time the three of you woke up, the easy explanation is that she was moved.
entries.new: 那就很难相信她会在 Akaro 那么壮的人之前醒过来。要是她真吸进了烟，而你们三个醒来时她已不见踪影，最简单的解释就是有人把她挪走了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Who would do that though, and why?
entries.new: 可谁会这么做？又为了什么？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: How about the only person out of all of us who was conscious at the time?
entries.new: 那当时我们之中唯一清醒的人呢？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: But why?
entries.new: 可他为什么这么做？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Don't ask me. It certainly makes him look obviously suspicious, so if he still did it, he must've had a good reason.
entries.new: 别问我。他这么做，嫌疑明摆着，所以若他真动了手，一定有非做不可的理由。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Let's check the Sekimeiya. I entered this hallway so that they wouldn't see us from the security room.
entries.new: 去看看 Sekimeiya 吧。我特意走这条走廊，就是为了不让监控室里的人看见我们。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Why?
entries.new: 为什么？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: He turned to the left and opened the event room door. Why else, though? He wanted to see if it was still there.
entries.new: 他向左一转，推开了活动室的门。还能为什么？他想确认那东西是否还在原处。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If it's not here, Naomi took it. It's as simple as that, so I'm only curious.
entries.new: 要是它不在了，那就是 Naomi 拿走的。就这么简单，我不过是好奇罢了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Sure, go ahead.
entries.new: 行，你请便。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: It'd be pretty interesting if it wasn't here.
entries.new: 要是它真不在，那就有意思了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: We would know we hadn't taken it, but the other five wouldn't. Not only has this room's camera been blocked off, now they can't access any.
entries.new: 我们自己清楚没拿，可另外五个人不会这么想。这间房的摄像头本来就被人挡住了，如今他们连任何画面都调不出来。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Imagine we tell them the cabinet was empty. They would have three suspects. If we look throughout the entire tower and can't find Naomi, do you think they'd suspect us?
entries.new: 假设我们告诉他们展示柜是空的。他们就有三个嫌疑人。要是我们把整座塔搜遍都找不到 Naomi，你觉得他们会怀疑到我们头上吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: They would insist it could have only been us—that Naomi was never trapped to begin with, and we would be the only ones to know the truth. How would you suggest we'd defend ourselves?
entries.new: 他们一定会咬定只可能是我们——说 Naomi 根本没被困住，而知道真相的只有我们。你说我们该怎么替自己辩解？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...I don't know. I'm sure Shiroya would believe me. I honestly doubt they would actually suspect us.
entries.new: ……我不知道。Shiroya 肯定会信我。说实话，我不觉得他们真会怀疑我们。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Hm, you might be right. What if I claim you took off running and came here? ...That could be why we took so long.
entries.new: 要是我说，你是突然跑到这里来的呢？……这样就能解释我们为什么去了那么久。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...Why the hell are you acting like this?
entries.new: ……你到底为什么要这样？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Don't worry, I wouldn't do that.{w} Let's see. In case it's not here, should we tell them?
entries.new: 放心，我不会那么做的。{w}这样吧。万一东西不在这儿，我们要告诉他们吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Of course.
entries.new: 当然。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Why? We would be certain only Naomi or a mysterious ninth person could've taken it, but from their point of view, we would be possible suspects too.
entries.new: 为什么？在我们看来，能拿走它的只有 Naomi，或者那个神秘的第九人；可在他们眼里，我们也一样可疑。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: If we didn't tell them, we could proceed to split up. Someone would find out that the Sekimeiya was stolen, which would lead to many more possible suspects, and their focus on us would decrease. They'd have no way to know we had already seen the empty cabinet.
entries.new: 不告诉他们也行，之后我们照常分头行动。总会有人发现 Sekimeiya 被偷了，嫌疑人一下子多出一大堆，他们对我们的注意力自然就淡了。他们根本无从知道我们早已看过那个空柜子。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: It might be unfair for them since we're giving them a bunch of fake suspects, but I'd say it's pretty fair for us since we know we didn't do it, right?
entries.new: 这对他们或许不太公平，毕竟我们凭空塞给他们一堆假嫌疑人；可对我们来说倒是挺公平的——我们知道自己没拿，对吧？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I wasn't sure how to respond. I didn't disagree with him, but it was hard for me to humor his presumptuous attitude. Although I couldn't easily imagine being suspected, the thought of him falsely accusing me was a bit unnerving.
entries.new: 我不知该如何回应。我并不反对他的说法，只是实在难以迁就他那副自以为是的态度。虽然很难想象自己会被怀疑，但一想到他竟会反过来诬陷我，心里还是有些不舒服。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Sai didn't make a lot of sense to me unless I assumed that he was just messing around for the sake of messing around.
entries.new: Sai 的话，我实在听不出多少道理，除非他纯粹就是闲得无聊、故意胡闹。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Whatever, let's look first.
entries.new: 算了，先找找看吧。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I walked forward and raised the curtain. Unlike before, very few dust particles fell off, leaving the pile on the floor practically unchanged.
entries.new: 我走上前，掀起遮布。与之前不同，这次几乎没落下多少灰尘，地板上那堆灰尘也几乎原封未动。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Here it is.
entries.new: 在这儿。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I wanted to say something along the lines of "see, you're just being paranoid", but he beat me to it.
entries.new: 我本想揶揄一句「看吧，就是你多心了」，却被他抢先开了口。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Of course it is.{w} After all, if it weren't, it could only have been Naomi, and that'd be too simple.
entries.new: 当然在。{w}毕竟要是不在，那就只可能是 Naomi 拿的——那也未免太简单了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...{w}Are you sure you wouldn't want to consider the other five conspiring together and taking it while we were in the mechanical room? Then they could point the finger at us.
entries.new: ……{w}你真不考虑一下吗？剩下五个人串通好，趁我们在机械室的时候把它拿走，之后再把矛头指向我们。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: What exactly is your deal? What were you even doing behind the monitor earlier?
entries.new: 你到底是怎么回事？刚才在显示器后面，你又到底在做什么？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: That's what I was talking about. You should think about what I told you.
entries.new: 我说的就是这个。我跟你讲的那些，你该好好想想。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I could only sigh. I lowered the curtain and left the room.
entries.new: 我只能叹了口气，放下遮布，离开了房间。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: When we returned to the security room, everyone but Katei was next to the monitors. He was on the ground, and from the looks of it, he hadn't fixed a thing.
entries.new: 我们回到监控室时，除了 Katei，其他人都围在显示器旁。他趴在地上，看样子什么也没修好。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: You were gone for a while.
entries.new: 你们去了好一阵子。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Yeah, we took the time to go to the bathroom.
entries.new: 是啊，顺路去了趟洗手间。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I had no reason not to call him out, but that might've pointlessly complicated things or ended up being exactly what he wanted. ...His approach to our situation was an enigma.
entries.new: 我并没有理由不拆穿他，可那样做也许只会徒增麻烦，甚至正中他的下怀。……他对待眼前局面的方式，实在令人费解。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Shiroya was looking right at me, so I decided to ignore Sai's lie and moved on.
entries.new: Shiroya 正看着我，于是我决定无视 Sai 的谎话，继续说下去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: How are things going?
entries.new: 情况怎么样？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Katei has been trying to power the computer back on. It doesn't seem like he's achieving much, though.
entries.new: Katei 一直在试着把电脑重新启动。不过看样子没什么进展。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: He appeared to be messing with some cables under the table. After a few seconds, he got out and stood up.
entries.new: 他似乎正在摆弄桌子底下的几根线缆。几秒过后，他从桌下钻出来，站直了身子。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Let's try again...
entries.new: 再试一次……
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: He pressed the power button, but nothing happened.
entries.new: 他按下电源键，却毫无反应。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Damn it... I don't know what the problem is.
entries.new: 该死……我搞不清问题出在哪儿。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Oh, I assume all the power switches were on, correct?
entries.new: 对了，我猜所有电源开关都开着，对吧？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Yes.
entries.new: 对。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: He sighed and kneeled down once again. I didn't know what he was trying, but so far, it hadn't given him any results.
entries.new: 他叹了口气，又一次蹲下身去。我不知道他在试什么，但到现在还没有任何成效。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Everybody kept looking at him even though there wasn't much to observe, as Katei's body covered all that he was doing.
entries.new: 大家的目光都没离开他，尽管根本看不出什么——他整个身子把手上动作都挡住了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Sai's indictment replayed in my mind.
entries.new: Sai 的指控又在我脑中回响。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: "I guarantee you that everything he's said has been a lie. Don't trust anything he says."
entries.new: 「我可以打包票，他说的话全是假的。一个字都别信。」
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Why had Sai sounded so sure? And how was Katei trying to fix the issue?
entries.new: Sai 为什么说得那么笃定？而 Katei 又在用什么办法排除故障？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If Katei was part of that group, Xyn, and had been shamelessly working under the pretense of security, their massive success rate could begin to be explained.
entries.new: 倘若 Katei 就是 Xyn 那伙人的一员，一直打着安保的幌子行事，那他们高得离谱的成功率也就不难解释了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Under the table, he kept sighing methodically while making noise with the cables.
entries.new: 桌子底下，他一边拨弄线缆发出声响，一边有节奏地叹着气。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I can't figure out what the problem is. It could be that electricity stopped coming from an outlet. I've been trying many different things, but this is just an incomprehensible mess of cables, and I'm not sure the problem is here.
entries.new: 我找不出问题所在。可能是某个插座不再供电了。我试了很多办法，可这线缆乱成一团，让人摸不着头脑，问题未必出在这里。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Some seconds after nobody had answered, he repeated the cycle of trying to power on the computer, kneeling down again, messing further with the cables, and standing back up.
entries.new: 无人应声，过了几秒，他又重复起那一套：试着开机，再蹲下去，继续摆弄线缆，然后站起身。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I apologize, but I don't seem able to fix this. I don't know what the cause was nor what's remaining a problem. All I could do here has proven useless.
entries.new: 抱歉，看样子我修不好。我不知道起因是什么，也不知道眼下还卡在哪儿。我在这里能做的都试过了，全是白费。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: We understand. The way it happened was odd in the first place.
entries.new: 我们明白。这事本来就很蹊跷。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Do you not have any idea what could've gone wrong? Everything just turned off instantly, and this is the office where you work.
entries.new: 你一点头绪都没有吗？所有东西都是一瞬间断电的，而且这里还是你工作的办公室。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: I just told you... I can't begin to think of anything. However, it wasn't all instant, was it? This monitor was the first one to stop functioning.
entries.new: 我刚才说过了……我根本想不出任何原因。不过，也不是一次全断的吧？最先停掉的是这台显示器。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: He was talking, of course, about the leftmost computer monitor. He approached it and examined it carefully.
entries.new: 他说的当然是左边那台显示器。他走过去，仔细端详了一番。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Everything looks fine... It pains me to say it, but I'm completely lost.
entries.new: 看上去一切正常……说来惭愧，我完全摸不着头脑。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Had Sai created the situation? The smirk he'd given me alongside what he'd said seemed to indicate that he at least had something to do with it.
entries.new: 难不成这局面是 Sai 一手造成的？他说那番话时冲我露出的那抹笑，似乎至少说明此事与他脱不了干系。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Hey, Katei, are you done with the cables? Since you got up from there, you haven't tried to power on the computer. Why not?
entries.new: 喂，Katei，线接好了吗？你从那儿站起来以后，就没再试着开机。怎么不试？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Oh, you're right. I did this a few times when you two were gone, but nothing worked. This last time I didn't actually change anything important, so it hardly mattered.
entries.new: 哦，你说得对。你们俩不在的时候我试过好几次，都没用。刚才那一次，我其实也没动到什么要紧的地方，试不试都差不多。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: While he said that, he approached the computer. With a single finger, he pressed the power button.
entries.new: 他边说边走向电脑，伸出一根手指按下电源键。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: In the blink of an eye, the middle screen lit up and a sound that indicated the computer had begun to run echoed throughout the narrow room.
entries.new: 转眼间，中间那块屏幕亮了起来，电脑启动的提示音在狭小的房间里回荡。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Sai met Katei's eyes quietly, and Isla was the first to break the silence.
entries.new: Sai 静静地与 Katei 对视，Isla 先打破了沉默。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It's finally working, right? Great!
entries.new: 总算能用了，对吧？太好了！
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: Y-Yes... It seems so.
entries.new: 是、是啊……看样子是这样。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: ...Do you think you were the one to fix it?
entries.new: ……你觉得是你修好的？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: There's no way. This is as strange as it powering off... I really don't even think I ended up changing anything since the last time I tried it.
entries.new: 怎么可能。这跟它莫名其妙关机一样蹊跷……我甚至觉得，从上次试过到现在，自己根本没改动什么。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: How bizarre.
entries.new: 真是怪事。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Yes... It very much is.
entries.new: 是啊……确实怪得很。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Do you think this was also done from outside the room?
entries.new: 你觉得这次也是从房间外面动的手脚？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: I can't tell. It's possible the electrical system was the problem and that it just fixed itself.
entries.new: 我说不准。也许问题出在供电系统上，而它自己恢复了。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Wouldn't the system have powered on automatically if that had happened?
entries.new: 要是那样，系统不会自动通电吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Possibly...
entries.new: 有可能……
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Katei sat back on his chair and grabbed the mouse once the computer had finished booting up. After bringing the keyboard closer to him, he logged onto his user account.
entries.new: 电脑启动完毕后，Katei 靠回椅子上，握住鼠标，又把键盘拉到身前，登录了自己的账户。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What happened to the cameras, though?
entries.new: 那摄像头是怎么回事？
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: Even though the computer had been brought back online, a dozen powered-off screens still remained on the wall.
entries.new: 电脑虽然恢复了运行，墙上却仍有十几块屏幕黑着。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: This computer is connected to the entire tower. That includes the computers upstairs and the security system. I must first initiate the program that will display the footage up there in real time.
entries.new: 这台电脑和整座塔都连着，包括楼上的电脑和安保系统。我得先启动程序，才能把楼上的画面实时显示出来。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Upon saying that, he double-clicked on a security camera logo, and a program with a messy interface covered the entire screen.
entries.new: 说着，他双击了一个监控摄像头的图标，一个界面杂乱的程序占满了整个屏幕。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: This was running earlier as well, but it was minimized. The cameras won't be shown without it open.
entries.new: 这个程序之前也开着，只是被最小化了。不打开它，摄像头画面就显示不出来。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: After looking at the taskbar icon, I did recognize it from earlier, and it was the same one he'd used to change the cameras being displayed.
entries.new: 我看了看任务栏上的图标，认出之前确实见过——就是他用来切换显示画面的那个程序。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Katei once again typed out what looked like gibberish as the username and a password that was obfuscated from us. After he pressed the enter key, access was granted.
entries.new: Katei 又一次输入了那串乱码似的用户名，密码也照旧遮着不让我们看见。按下回车键后，访问权限通过了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: All right, this button will start up the system.
entries.new: 好，按下这个按钮就能启动系统。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Below the text "Logged in as Katei Kuiji" was a button that read "Initialize Camera Monitoring", which Katei quickly clicked on.
entries.new: 「已登录为 Katei Kuiji」的下方是一个写着「初始化摄像头监控」的按钮，Katei 飞快地点了下去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: However, upon doing so, an error window showed up. The text "Couldn't detect video footage" was written on it.
entries.new: 然而一点下去，就弹出了报错窗口，上面写着「无法检测到视频画面」。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wh-What...? What the hell does this mean? I-I've never seen this error message.
entries.new: 什、什么……？这到底是什么意思？我、我从没见过这种报错。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: You can't look through the cameras?
entries.new: 看不到摄像头画面？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Yes. Usually, after pressing this button, the screens would turn on and automatically display the live feed the cameras are recording.
entries.new: 对。平时按下这个按钮，屏幕就会亮起，自动显示摄像头拍到的实时画面。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: What if you check the saved footage?
entries.new: 要不要查查存档的录像？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Yes, that's what I was going to try...
entries.new: 好，我正打算试试……
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: The cursor, controlled by Katei, hovered over and clicked on the "archived footage" button.
entries.new: Katei 把光标移过去，点下了「存档录像」按钮。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Once again, though, an error window followed by an obnoxious sound appeared, containing the text: "No archived footage detected. No camera system detected."
entries.new: 可这回又是一声刺耳的提示音，弹出报错窗口：「未检测到存档录像。未检测到摄像头系统。」
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Okay, what the hell is this!? This has never happened before!
entries.new: 搞什么，这到底是怎么回事！？以前从没出过这种事！
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: It's outright saying the camera system isn't being detected...
entries.new: 它明说检测不到摄像头系统……
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Sai made his way out of the room and returned before anyone had time to be confused.
entries.new: Sai 走出房间，转眼又折了回来，快得没人来得及多想。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I looked at one of the hallway's security cameras. It's showing a tiny green light. That means it's currently functioning and recording, right?
entries.new: 我去看了走廊里的一台监控摄像头，上面亮着很小的绿灯。那说明它还在工作、还在录像，对吧？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Yes. If the green light is there, it means the camera is recording.
entries.new: 对。亮着绿灯就说明摄像头在录像。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: So, the problem here is that we can't currently access the live footage or look at the recordings. The cameras are still actually functioning.
entries.new: 也就是说，问题在于我们现在既看不到实时画面，也调不出录像。摄像头本身其实还在运行。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Yes, I think so. For some reason, the computer won't connect to the system.
entries.new: 对，我想是这样。不知为什么，这台电脑连不上系统。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Heh. Looking at the recorded footage so easily sounded too good to be true anyway.
entries.new: 呵。能这么轻易调出录像，本来就好得让人不敢相信。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I'd been doubting we would find anything in the recordings since the relevant cameras had been disabled by the smoke, but it was true that it could've given us crucial information, especially regarding Naomi.
entries.new: 相关摄像头已经因烟雾失效，我本就怀疑录像里查不出什么，但也不可否认，它或许能提供关键线索，尤其是关于 Naomi 的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Well, let's talk to the police again. They might know what caused this.
entries.new: 算了，再去问问警察吧。他们或许知道是什么原因。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: You're right, we should still be able to do that.
entries.new: 说得对，这个我们应该还做得到。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Give me a second.
entries.new: 稍等一下。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Katei did everything he'd done the last time. When the small window appeared, he input a password and pressed the enter key.
entries.new: Katei 把上次的操作又做了一遍。小窗口弹出后，他输入密码，按下回车键。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: "Access Denied" appeared in red letters below the login information.
entries.new: 登录信息下方，红色的「拒绝访问」字样浮现出来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wh-What...!?
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Access denied? What the fuck does it mean by that!?
entries.new: 访问被拒绝？这他妈是什么意思！？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: That's what I was about to say! I know I'm repeating myself here, but this has never happened before!
entries.new: 我也正想说！我知道这话我已经说过了，可这种情况以前从没发生过！
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: I'll try again...
entries.new: 我再试一次……
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: He reentered the login information four times, but that same message kept appearing.
entries.new: 他又输入了四次登录信息，可屏幕上反复出现同一行提示。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I don't understand this...
entries.new: 我不明白这是怎么回事……
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Do you think your authority has been revoked?
entries.new: 你觉得你的权限被收回了？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I-It must... But why? Why would that happen now!?
entries.new: 只、只能是这样了……可为什么？为什么偏偏是现在！？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: It's not like we can contact the outside to ask. I know you said earlier that the alarm cut off access to the internet, but everything's out of order anyway, so there's no harm in checking.
entries.new: 我们也没法联系外界去问。你之前说过警报切断了网络，但反正现在一切都乱套了，确认一下也无妨。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Yes, you're right. It might not be disabled.
entries.new: 对，你说得对。也许网络并没有真的断。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Katei double-clicked on the browser icon, and we were met with a white screen containing the text: "There is no internet connection".
entries.new: Katei 双击了浏览器图标，屏幕上随即跳出一片白色，上面写着：「没有网络连接」。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: To further make sure, he typed a common URL, but the same screen appeared.
entries.new: 为保险起见，他又输入了一个常用网址，可出现的还是同一个页面。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I guess we're not getting that lucky...
entries.new: 看来我们没那个运气……
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: I'm sorry... I don't think I can do anything about this.
entries.new: 抱歉……这件事我恐怕无能为力。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: It's okay, it's not your fault. If we can't access the security cameras or connect to the outside, our priority should be to investigate this whole building. Naomi's still a mystery.
entries.new: 没关系，这不是你的错。既然监控摄像头连不上，外面也联系不了，我们就该先调查整栋楼。Naomi 的下落也还是个谜。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: That's true... We should try to find her and gather any useful information we can.
entries.new: 说得对……我们得试着找到她，一边找一边尽可能搜集有用的信息。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: B-But, how could this have happened? I don't understand it.{w} The timing was too coincidental. Did Ashiya remotely power off the computer to revoke my access? All I could do with it was talk to them.{w} Maybe the problem with the security system is a side effect of whatever happened...{w} I will stay here for a bit, while you go. I have a couple more things to do.
entries.new: 可、可这怎么会发生？我实在不明白。{w}时机也太巧了。难道是芦屋远程关掉了电脑，收回了我的权限？我只能靠它和他们通话。{w}也许安保系统的问题是那件事引起的副作用……{w}你们先走吧，我在这里待一会儿。我还有几件事要处理。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Such as?
entries.new: 比如？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Well, I'd like to investigate more about what caused the shutdown. The security system not being detected is very strange, and in addition, it seems my authority might've been revoked.
entries.new: 我想再查查这次系统怎么会停机。安保系统完全检测不到，这已经很奇怪了，况且我的权限似乎也被收回了。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: You must understand how odd of a situation this is for me. I'd like to see if I can figure something out.
entries.new: 你们应该能明白，这情况对我来说有多反常。我想看看能不能查出点什么。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: However, there are a few things I'll work on for sure. This computer is still connected to the rest of the tower, so I can undo a few smaller effects of the alarm. I can try to restore power to the elevator and some lights; those don't really require any kind of login. I'll catch up with you all once I'm done.
entries.new: 不过，有几件事我肯定能处理。这台电脑还连着塔里其他设备，所以我能撤销警报造成的一些小影响。我可以试着恢复电梯和部分照明的供电，这些并不需要登录权限。等我弄完就去找你们。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: I see. That sounds fair to me. We'll go, then.
entries.new: 原来如此。这样安排也合理。那我们就先走了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Should we really be splitting up? It'd be better if we moved in groups, at least.
entries.new: 真的要分头行动吗？至少也该几个人一起走比较好吧。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: There's no real point to any of you staying here. I am the only person here who knows how to access these parts of the system, and it would be better to have the elevator available than not. Go on ahead.
entries.new: 你们留在这里也没有任何意义。整个塔里只有我懂得怎么进入系统这些部分，而且电梯能恢复总比没有好。你们先走吧。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: ...All right. Good luck. It's weird to think that Naomi is out there and hasn't tried to reach us, so I'm a bit worried.
entries.new: ……好吧。祝你好运。Naomi 明明就在外面，却一直没试着联系我们，怎么想都奇怪，我有点担心。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: You're right. Let's go with them, Isla.
entries.new: 说得对。Isla，我们跟他们一起走吧。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Everybody started to look a bit more tense in the hallway, maybe because we hadn't yet seen anything beyond the first floor, or maybe because the reality of being trapped was creeping in.
entries.new: 走廊里，大家的神色都渐渐紧绷起来。也许是因为我们还没看过一楼以外的任何地方，也许是因为被困住的现实正一点点压上心头。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I looked at the cameras and noticed that the tiny, green recording light could only be noticed on some of them, as the dried smoke fully covered a good number.
entries.new: 我看了看那些摄像头，发现只有少数几个还能看见那颗小小的绿色录制指示灯——大部分摄像头都被干结的烟尘糊了个严实。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We walked together a few steps until we all stopped silently. Our task was to investigate a huge building we had never entered before only to track down someone who could've been hiding with malicious intent.
entries.new: 我们一起走了几步，随后不约而同地停下，谁也没有出声。我们要搜索的是一栋从未踏足过的巨大建筑，只为找出一个可能怀着恶意藏身其中的人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Isla started talking casually to Erina about their daily life. I didn't disturb them, figuring it was better if Isla remained as calm as possible.
entries.new: Isla 开始和 Erina 闲聊起日常。我没有打扰她们，心想让 Isla 尽量保持平静也好。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I leaned against a wall, next to Shiroya. I didn't think she wanted to talk, so I kept quiet.{w} The handrail made the position uncomfortable, but I tried not to mind it. Instead, I focused on thinking...
entries.new: 我靠着墙，站在 Shiroya 旁边。我觉得她不想说话，便保持沉默。{w}扶手让这个姿势很不舒服，但我尽量不去在意，转而把心思放在思考上……
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What exactly had happened in the security room? What had Sai done?
entries.new: 监控室里究竟发生了什么？Sai 又做了什么？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I looked at him. He wore a silent, carefree expression, appearing almost on a different plane from the rest of us.
entries.new: 我看向他。他神情安静，甚至有些若无其事，仿佛与我们不在同一个世界里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Earlier, when I looked at him after Katei rushed out of the room, he took his hand out from behind the leftmost monitor. What exactly did I see?
entries.new: 刚才 Katei 冲出房间后，我看向他时，他正把手从最左边那台显示器后面抽出来。我到底看见了什么？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Let me take a different approach. Assuming the monitor powering off was his doing, what could the reason be?
entries.new: 换个角度想。假设显示器熄灭是他动的手脚，那理由会是什么？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: What did he do right after the monitor stopped working? He tried to see what had happened... But if he'd been the one to cause it, that couldn't have been his goal...
entries.new: 显示器出故障后，他立刻做了什么？他试着查看发生了什么……可如果事情正是他造成的，那他这么做就不可能是为了弄清状况……
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: After considering a couple of possibilities, an idea came to me. If I was right, what he'd told me later made sense.
entries.new: 考虑过几种可能后，我忽然有了一个想法。如果我想得没错，他后来对我说的那番话就说得通了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: "I guarantee you that everything he's said has been a lie. Don't trust anything he says."
entries.new: 「我可以打包票，他说的话全是假的。一个字都别信。」
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: At that point, with what he did to the monitor, he was probably confirming his suspicion.
entries.new: 那时，他对显示器所做的那番举动，大概是在确认自己的怀疑。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: He was right: a lot of things Katei has been saying have been questionable at best, but now that I think about it, there was one major thing that I overlooked.
entries.new: 他说得没错：Katei 说过的许多话，往好了说也只是可疑。可如今回想起来，有一件关键的事被我忽略了。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: "Katei grabbed the doorknob, and upon turning it, he tried to push the door forward. However, it didn't budge."
entries.new: 「Katei 抓住门把手，转动之后试着往前推门。然而门纹丝不动。」
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: "Oh, right. I locked it earlier. Let me see."
entries.new: 「啊，对了。我之前把门锁上了。让我看看。」
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I bet Sai noticed this. Katei didn't think the door would be locked.
entries.new: Sai 肯定注意到了这一点。Katei 当时根本没想到门会被锁上。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: He was quick to make up a lie. He said that since it's an important room, he thought it appropriate to lock it before going outside to inspect things.
entries.new: 他立刻就编了个谎。他说既然这是重要房间，出去查看情况前把它锁上比较妥当。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: He even claimed to have done it because the room contained the single way to communicate with the outside, but later, he showed us that you could only enable it with a password that only the security staff knew.
entries.new: 他甚至声称，之所以锁门，是因为房间里有着唯一能联系外界的手段；可后来他又亲口向我们证明，那套设备只有输入安保人员才知道的密码才能启用。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: It's probably not that he thought the door would be open, but that he didn't realize it wouldn't be.
entries.new: 问题大概不在于他以为门会开着，而在于他根本没意识到门会被锁上。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: After all, we know what actually locked it—the alarm.
entries.new: 毕竟，我们知道真正把门锁上的是什么——是警报。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Suripo explained the entire function and mechanism behind the alarm to us. The person inside the security room would relay information between the people that got trapped and the outside. The door of the security room would close alongside the exit, and it would be impossible to open it with anything but the right key.
entries.new: Suripo 把警报的功能和运作机制完整讲了一遍。待在监控室里的人负责在受困者和外界之间传话。警报启动时，监控室的门会和出口一起关闭，没有正确的钥匙绝对打不开。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Meaning that if I'm right, from the time I heard the alarm to the time we entered the security room... no one was inside it.
entries.new: 也就是说，如果我没猜错，从我听见警报响起，到我们进入监控室为止……里面根本没有人。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Katei had actually never been inside the security room. This was a huge lie, and most likely something Sai assumed after noticing Katei's actions before he opened the door, or when the alarm's functions were explained.
entries.new: Katei 其实从没进过监控室。这是个弥天大谎——Sai 多半是在开门前注意到 Katei 的举动，或者是在听到警报功能的说明时，就已经猜到了这一点。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: A lot of things Katei said hinge on him being in the security room during the time the smoke was released.
entries.new: Katei 的不少说法，都建立在烟雾释放时他人在监控室这一点上。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Seeing the smoke appearing out of nowhere through the cameras, looking at the available ones and not seeing anyone, not trying to contact the outside, not being allowed to input his command to open up the exit...
entries.new: 从监控里看到烟雾凭空冒出来，把能看的画面都翻了个遍也不见半个人影，没有试着联系外界，权限又不允许他输入打开出口的指令……
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: All those claims are impossible if I assume he was never in the security room during that period of time. Even seeing the smoke through the cameras and then exiting the room before the alarm went off would be far from believable. This would have both stained his clothes and knocked him out.
entries.new: 可只要假定那段时间他根本不在监控室，这些说法就全都站不住脚。就算他只是通过监控看到烟雾，然后在警报响起前离开房间，也很难让人相信。那样一来，他的衣服会沾上烟渍，人也会被熏倒。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I should question something important if he truly was never in the room. Katei's clothes weren't stained, but he still knew about the smoke. Did Erina's group tell him and he acted as if he'd seen it through the cameras? Did he see it from far away? Or did he have another way to know about it without personally seeing it?
entries.new: 如果他真的一次都没进过监控室，有个关键问题就必须问清楚：Katei 的衣服没有沾上烟渍，可他知道烟雾的事。是 Erina 他们告诉了他，他再装作是从监控里看到的？还是他远远地看见了？又或者，他另有别的途径，不必亲眼看到也能知道？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: To maintain his claim of seeing the smoke appear through the cameras, it's possible he knew it would appear and quickly left the security room with a mask and spare clothes right before the alarm sounded. Like this, he would've been able to lie about his location the whole time. After all, it would have been too risky for him to leave before the smoke was released.
entries.new: 为了保住「从监控里看见烟雾冒出」这个说法，也可能他早就知道烟雾会出现，赶在警报响起前带着面罩和换洗衣物迅速离开监控室。这样一来，他就可以一直谎报自己的位置。毕竟，在烟雾释放之前离开，风险实在太大了。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: If this is what he did, he must've used the time we were unconscious to do something. What's for certain is that aside from seeing the smoke through the cameras, if he wasn't in the room by the time the alarm went off, all his other claims become impossible.
entries.new: 如果真是这样，他一定趁我们昏迷的那段时间做了什么。可以确定的是：除了「透过监控看到烟雾」之外，只要警报响起时他不在监控室里，他其余的说法就全都无法成立。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: ...But he also might not have been on this floor during the attack. If he showed up later, that could explain why he found Erina's group before ours. They told him what had happened, and he made up a lie accordingly. This would mean that everything he's told us has been a fabrication.
entries.new: ……不过，袭击发生时他也许根本不在这一层。如果他出现得比较晚，那就能解释为什么是他先找到 Erina 他们，而不是先找到我们。他们把发生的事告诉了他，他再据此编出一套谎话。若果真如此，他告诉我们的每一句话就都是捏造的。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Once I assume Katei was never in the room, the exact reason for that lie is not too important. What it means is that he's untrustworthy and that he has an ulterior motive.
entries.new: 一旦认定 Katei 从未进过监控室，他撒这个谎的具体理由反倒不那么重要了。重要的是：他不值得信任，而且另有图谋。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: And... it is very possible his authority as a security member has been revoked. The timing was too precise to be a coincidence. It could be that Ashiya and the police figured something out about him and removed his privilege as a security member. However, they'd know that doing so would also prevent us from contacting them again, so they must've had a very good reason.
entries.new: 还有……他作为安保人员的权限，很可能已经被取消了。时机太巧，不像是偶然。也许是芦屋和警方查出了他的什么问题，才剥夺了他安保成员的特权。不过他们应该清楚，这么做同时也等于让我们再也联系不上他们——所以他们必然有充分的理由。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Then, what Sai did to confirm his theory...
entries.new: 接着，Sai 为了证实自己的推测，做了这样一件事……
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: He pulled it off shamelessly, in front of everybody. I'm sure he could've done it later alone, but it's possible he feared Katei would've prevented it with a new lie.
entries.new: 他当着所有人的面，毫无顾忌地做了。他完全可以之后独自去确认，但他也许担心 Katei 会再编一套新谎话来阻挠他。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Right before Sai started, he asked Suripo: "Is there anything else you should tell us?" He wanted to check something as soon as possible, before Katei could interfere again.
entries.new: 动手之前，Sai 先问 Suripo：「还有别的该告诉我们的事吗？」他是想趁 Katei 再次插手之前，尽快确认某件事。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Once Suripo said he'd told us everything we needed to know, Sai unplugged the cord behind the leftmost monitor—the one he was next to.
entries.new: 等 Suripo 说该讲的都已经讲了，Sai 就拔掉了最左边那台显示器背后的线——他当时正站在那台旁边。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: This was only done to have a justification for checking the screen settings. He quickly grabbed the mouse and opened them from the desktop.
entries.new: 这么做只是为了给查看屏幕设置找个由头。他迅速抓起鼠标，在桌面上打开了设置。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: "I see... How strange. The left monitor isn't being detected at all..."
entries.new: 「原来如此……真奇怪。左边那台显示器完全检测不到……」
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: However, that's not what Sai was actually looking at.
entries.new: 然而，Sai 真正在看的并不是那个。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: When we all entered the security room, Katei quickly went to use the computer.
entries.new: 我们一起进监控室时，Katei 立刻就跑过去用那台电脑。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: "Paying no mind to everyone's silence, Katei made his way to the chair and sat down. When he moved the mouse, the computer exited its suspended state and reactivated the three monitors above it, showing us what the last person to use it had been doing."
entries.new: 「Katei 不在意众人的沉默，径直走到椅子前坐下。他一动鼠标，电脑便退出休眠状态，上方三台显示器也随之亮起，显示出上一个使用者当时在做些什么。」
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I bet Sai's goal was actually to look at how long it'd take for the computer to enter sleep mode, which is information found on the same settings screen. That's because Katei said he'd used it while he'd been in the room.
entries.new: 我猜 Sai 的真正目的，其实是看电脑进入睡眠模式需要多长时间——这项信息正好也在同一个设置界面上。因为 Katei 说过，他在监控室待着的时候用过这台电脑。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: "Shortly after that, the alarm went off, so I knew I was already trapped. During that time until I exited, I kept my eyes on the cameras. I also tried to use the computer to look up information about what had happened, but the alarm even shut down my internet connection."{w} He'd also said that he tried to input the command to unlock the exit.
entries.new: 「紧接着警报就响了，我知道自己已经被困住。从那时到离开，我一直盯着监控画面。我也试过用电脑查发生了什么，可警报连网络都切断了。」{w}他还说过，自己试过输入解锁出口的指令。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We know the alarm went off at approximately {time=9:05.} Thanks to the time the computer displayed and that it was in sleep mode when we entered the room, if the settings perhaps showed that an hour of inactivity had been needed to enter that state, Sai could've confirmed that Katei had not been there at all.
entries.new: 我们知道警报大约是在 {time=9:05.} 响起的。借助电脑上显示的时间，加上我们进屋时它正处于睡眠模式，只要设置里显示进入该状态需要闲置一小时，Sai 就能确认 Katei 根本不曾待在那里。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: And, apparently, it did confirm it. That's why he was sure that Katei was lying.
entries.new: 而结果显然正是如此。所以他才会断定 Katei 在说谎。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: This also explains his subsequent action. When I saw Sai taking his arm out from behind the leftmost monitor, he'd just plugged the cord back in.
entries.new: 这也解释了他随后的举动。我看到 Sai 把胳膊从最左边那台显示器后面抽出来时，他刚把线重新插回去。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Despite sounding risky, he'd had nothing to lose, and if he'd waited longer, Katei could've prevented it.
entries.new: 这听起来冒险，可他其实没什么可失去的；而且若再拖下去，Katei 说不定就能加以阻挠。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: And Sai's timing had been great: right after that, all the monitors and even the computer stopped working. That probably wasn't his doing, even though Katei implied otherwise.
entries.new: 而且 Sai 的时机挑得极好：就在那之后，所有显示器连同电脑一起失灵了。这大概并非他造成的，尽管 Katei 话里话外是这个意思。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: "However, it wasn't all instant, was it? This monitor was the first one to stop functioning."
entries.new: 「不过，并不是一下子全部失效的吧？这台显示器是最先停止工作的。」
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: He said it as if both things were connected, but I don't think that was right. Sai unplugged the first monitor, but the rest must've had a different cause.
entries.new: 他说得好像两件事互有关联，但我认为并非如此。Sai 拔掉的是第一台显示器的线，其余那些必定另有原因。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: One thing is for sure: Sai has confirmed his theory and is now certain Katei has fed us lie after lie.{w} And I should probably think the same.
entries.new: 有一点是确定的：Sai 已经验证了自己的推论，如今确信 Katei 对我们满口谎言。{w}而我大概也该这么想。
entries.speaker: n
