entries.text: Is this it, then...? Is Katei simply a blatant liar with an ulterior motive?
entries.new: 难道就这样了……？Katei 只是个心怀鬼胎、谎话连篇的人？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I thought about everything that had happened up until then and shortly noticed another inconsistency Katei presented very early on. He'd later introduced a contradiction himself.
entries.new: 我把此前发生的一切在心里过了一遍，很快又注意到 Katei 很早就露出的另一处破绽。而这处矛盾，是他后来自己说出来的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: "Did all of you hear the alarm that played throughout the building? After I heard it, I saw all the smoke."
entries.new: 「整栋楼响起的警报，你们全都听见了吧？我听见警报之后，才看到那片烟雾。」
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: He claimed to have heard the alarm, then seen the smoke. However, just after that, he said the smoke disabled the cameras instantly. Given the alarm went off some seconds after the smoke was released, he could only have seen smoke after hearing the alarm if he had been outside the security room.{w} It's a bit strange that he said that but was still correct in saying that the smoke disabled the cameras.
entries.new: 他声称先听到警报，然后才看到烟雾。可就在这之后，他又说烟雾瞬间就让监控失效了。既然烟雾释放后过了几秒警报才响，那么他若真是在听到警报之后才看到烟雾，就只能说明他当时人在监控室外。{w}奇怪的是，他一方面这么说，另一方面关于烟雾让监控失效的说法又完全正确。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: If he planned his phrasing well enough to make it sound as if he'd been inside the room, to the point of realizing that the cameras would've become useless, it follows he wouldn't have mentioned the huge inconsistency of seeing the smoke after hearing the alarm.
entries.new: 如果他把说辞编排得足够周密，听起来仿佛自己就在室内，甚至顾及到监控会因此失效，那么他按理不会提起「先听到警报、后看到烟雾」这种明显的自相矛盾。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: If there's a reason for this, it must be that without looking at the monitors, he knew the smoke would've left them useless. However, he must not have thought about it too hard, or else he would've never contradicted himself so blatantly.
entries.new: 若要说有什么缘由，那一定是他不必看画面也知道烟雾会让监控彻底失效。可他显然没在这上面多想——否则绝不会如此露骨地自相矛盾。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: There is one simple way this could've happened: if he designed the plan. He would've known the effects of the smoke but would not have thought of what they would've entailed if he'd truly been in the security room.
entries.new: 有一种再简单不过的解释：这计划本就出自他手。他清楚烟雾的效果，却没细想，倘若他真的待在监控室里，这些效果意味着什么。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I didn't want to believe that. Not because I trusted a stranger by default, but because I wasn't sure if I was only deluding myself by believing it.
entries.new: 我不愿相信这一点。并非因为我天生就信任陌生人，而是因为我不确定，这样相信是不是只是在自欺欺人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I went back to my previous thought. Could Katei have still been inside the security room until he'd left it before the alarm had played? That would've made him a bit more trustworthy, even if it wasn't much.
entries.new: 我又回到先前的想法上。会不会 Katei 一直待在监控室里，只是在警报响起前才离开？若真如此，他多少还值得一点信任——尽管并不多。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The problem was, once again, that he didn't have any traces of smoke on him. Even if he'd changed clothes, his face and hair would've been noticeably stained.{w} Technically, there was a way to get around that. I knew hallway B had been hit by the smoke by the point I'd noticed the lack of light under the door. However, I couldn't be sure the same thing could be said of hallway A, the third and last section that had been inundated. We'd only seen it filled with smoke after waking up.
entries.new: 问题依旧在于，他身上没有任何烟雾的痕迹。就算换了衣服，脸和头发也会明显沾上。{w}严格说来，倒有一种能绕过去的可能。我注意到门缝下透不进光时，B走廊已经灌满了烟雾。可 A走廊是否同样如此，我无法确定——那是第三处、也是最后一处被烟雾淹没的区域，我们醒来之后才看到它烟雾弥漫。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But if he left because he saw the smoke through the cameras, he realistically would've mentioned that hallway A hadn't yet been darkened by that point...
entries.new: 可如果他是因为从监控里看到烟雾才离开的，按说他会提到，那时候 A走廊还没有被烟雾遮蔽……
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: The only confirmed fact is that he wasn't in the room from the time the alarm went off to the point we entered it. It could be that he saw the smoke disabling the cameras, left the room, and then the alarm locked it. If this happened, the smoke in hallway A must've been released afterward.
entries.new: 唯一能确定的事实是：从警报响起到我们进入监控室，他都不在屋里。也许他看见烟雾让监控失灵，便离开房间，随后警报把门锁上了。若情况如此，A走廊的烟雾应该是在那之后才释放的。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Finally, if I'm only pointlessly trying to reduce the number of lies Katei has been spewing, it could be that he was in the room but never touched the computer. Then, the sleep mode settings wouldn't mean anything, but lying about using the PC seems pointless.
entries.new: 最后，如果我只是在做无用功，想把 Katei 撒的谎减少几条，那也可能他确实在屋里，却从未碰过电脑。这样的话，睡眠模式的设置就说明不了什么——但在用电脑这件事上撒谎，似乎毫无意义。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Is there a way to go against Sai's confirmed theory?
entries.new: 有没有办法推翻 Sai 已经证实的那套推论？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I suppose there's only one.
entries.new: 想来只有一种。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: If the computer's current time is incorrect, the time shown in the screen settings could be refuted.
entries.new: 如果电脑当前的时间不准，那么屏幕设置里显示的时间也就不足为凭。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Considering that when we talked to Suripo, at no point was the actual time mentioned... if it wasn't actually {time=9:41} when we checked the time, it could all hold up.
entries.new: 回想我们和 Suripo 说话时，从头到尾都没提过真实时间……如果我们查看时间的那一刻，实际并非 {time=9:41}，那么一切就都还站得住脚。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: If the computer was an hour behind and the real time was {time=10:45}, we would've been unconscious for longer than we thought, and everything could fit. Katei could have been in the security room, and enough time for the suspended state to be reached could've passed.
entries.new: 如果电脑慢了一小时，真实时间是 {time=10:45}，那我们昏迷的时间就比以为的更久，所有事情也就都能对上了。Katei 完全可能待在监控室里，而且已经过了足够长的时间，让电脑进入休眠状态。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: However, this single last possibility was denied by the only person who didn't fall unconscious... Katei himself.
entries.new: 然而，这最后一种可能，却被唯一没有昏迷的人否定了……正是 Katei 自己。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: "Yes, this matches with the amount of time I stayed here after I saw the smoke."
entries.new: 「没错，这和我看到烟雾之后在这里停留的时间正好吻合。」
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It seemed it was unquestionable. For one reason or another, Katei had lied about what he'd been doing during the incident. He hadn't been where he should've been, and he had continuously claimed to do things that would've been impossible.
entries.new: 看来这已是无可置疑的了。不管出于什么理由，Katei 对事件发生时自己的所作所为撒了谎。他没有待在该待的地方，还一再声称做过那些根本不可能做到的事。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Before we'd all entered the security room, he wasn't fast enough to think that the alarm would have locked the door. He simply tried to open it manually, as he hadn't locked it himself.
entries.new: 我们还没全进监控室的时候，他根本没来得及想到警报会把门锁上。他只是去手动开门——毕竟门不是他锁的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What is Katei after...? Why did he lie so much? After all, he was the one who told us about the way to communicate with the outside. All of his actions have been bizarre.
entries.new: Katei 到底想干什么……？他为什么要撒那么多谎？和外界联络的方法，毕竟还是他告诉我们的。他的一举一动都透着古怪。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Hang on... I haven't considered this, but what if he isn't who he claimed to be?
entries.new: 等等……这种可能我还没想过。万一他根本不是他自称的那个人呢？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Could it be he isn't actually part of the security staff? He refused to explain anything because it would've been "confidential", but then Suripo didn't have an issue doing so. What if he simply didn't know anything? The only thing he said was that we'd be locked inside the building for twelve hours and that he knew of the way to communicate with the outside.
entries.new: 他会不会根本就不是安保人员？他拒绝解释任何事，说那属于「机密」，可 Suripo 解释起来却毫无顾忌。万一他其实什么都不知道呢？他说过的只有两件事：我们会被关在这栋楼里十二个小时，以及他知道和外界联络的方法。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: His clothes weren't stained, but he knew about the smoke. He had a safe place he should've stayed in, but he wasn't in it. He had the security room key, but he didn't think the door would be locked. He investigated this floor, but he didn't look in the event room...
entries.new: 他的衣服没有沾上痕迹，却知道有烟雾。他本有一个该待着的安全之处，人却不在那里。他拿着监控室的钥匙，却没想到门会被锁。他查过这一层，却没有查看活动室……
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: If this was all his plan... it could be that he borrowed the name of Katei, an actual security staff member. Not only his name, but also his clothes and room. Then, those stained clothes the actual Katei was wearing would've been disposed of.
entries.new: 如果这一切都是他计划好的……那他可能是冒用了某个真正的安保人员 Katei 的名字。不只是名字，还有衣服和房间。至于真正的 Katei 穿的那身沾了痕迹的衣服，想必已经被处理掉了。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Suripo admitted that a security staff member hadn't evacuated the tower, and he was familiar with the name "Katei Kuiji", but this could simply mean that the real Katei Kuiji is still trapped with us. Maybe his body was hidden in a spot out of the cameras' reach.
entries.new: Suripo 承认有一名安保人员没有撤出塔楼，他也确实听过「Katei Kuiji」这个名字。但这也许只说明，真正的 Katei Kuiji 还和我们一起困在这里。也许他的尸体被藏在了摄像头拍不到的角落。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Suripo talked to Katei, but he was a simple police officer and had no way to confirm that the voice belonged to the actual staff member. On top of that, he never actually saw us. It was only audio from our end.
entries.new: Suripo 和 Katei 通过话，可他只是个普通警察，没办法确认那个声音是否真属于那名安保人员。更何况，他始终没见到我们本人，只有我们这边传过去的音频。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: ...{w}Since I couldn't arrive at a conclusion, I lowered my head after being lost in thought for a while.
entries.new: ……{w}想了半天也得不出结论，我最终还是低下了头。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Shiroya was standing near me, looking almost as detached as I was sure I did.
entries.new: Shiroya 站在我旁边，神情有些恍惚，我猜自己看起来也差不多。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Shiroya?
entries.new: Shiroya？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: H-Hm?
entries.new: 唔、嗯？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Are you okay?
entries.new: 你没事吧？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Yeah... I am.
entries.new: 嗯……没事。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: I rubbed at my face with one hand and pulled her aside, speaking in a hushed tone.
entries.new: 我用一只手抹了把脸，把她拉到一旁，压低声音说话。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Shiroya. It's fine. We're fine. Naomi is fine too. You can't let this stuff get to you.
entries.new: Shiroya，没事的。我们都没事，Naomi 也没事。别让这些事压垮你。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I-I'm not...
entries.new: 我、我没有……
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Don't get sucked into some depressive loop, okay? I'm here. We're going to find her.
entries.new: 别让自己陷进没完没了的消沉里，好吗？有我在。我们会找到她的。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I mean it.
entries.new: 我是认真的。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: All right. I'm sorry. It was just... the camera footage is...
entries.new: 好。对不起。只是……那段监控录像实在……
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: The police will recover it.
entries.new: 警方会把它找回来的。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: ...You're right.
entries.new: ……你说得对。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Somewhat satisfied, I patted her shoulder and stepped back into the middle of the hallway.
entries.new: 我这才稍稍放心，拍了拍她的肩膀，回到走廊中央。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Close by, Isla, who had finished talking with her mother, was walking to the event room.
entries.new: 不远处，和母亲通完话的 Isla 正朝活动室走去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We were supposed to investigate the building, but we had all silently agreed to wait a bit out of either anxiety or hesitation.
entries.new: 按说我们该去搜查这栋楼，可不知是出于不安还是犹豫，大家都不约而同地选择再等一等。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Where are you going?
entries.new: 你要去哪儿？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: I wanna see it again!
entries.new: 我还想再看一遍！
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: Without further explanation, she quickly made her way into the room.
entries.new: 她没再多说，快步走进了房间。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: *sigh*
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Erina followed behind her. The rest of us did the same since staying by ourselves didn't seem very useful.
entries.new: Erina 跟在她身后。我们也纷纷跟上——各自留在原地也没什么用。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The previous two weeks had been difficult for Shiroya and me. I knew the cheerful Shiroya I was fond of would take a longer time to come back, but all things considered, both of us were handling the situation pretty well. I was just concerned about pushing her too far.
entries.new: 过去这两周，对 Shiroya 和我来说都很难熬。我知道，我喜欢的那个开朗的 Shiroya 还要过些日子才能回来，但总的来说，我们两个都应对得还算不错。我只是担心把她逼得太紧。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Isla was in front of the cabinet. I entered the room just as she was about to uncover the cabinet, and Akaro and Sai followed silently after me.
entries.new: Isla 站在展示柜前。我走进房间时，她正要掀开柜上的罩子，Akaro 和 Sai 默默跟在我身后。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Blue Light
entries.new: 蓝光

entries.text: Look at how pretty it is! Now that the light has gotten a bit better, I like it even more.
entries.new: 你们看它多漂亮！光线比刚才好了些，我就更喜欢它了。
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: I agree, it's pretty elegant-looking.
entries.new: 是啊，确实挺雅致的。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Akaro and Sai walked in farther. However, once Akaro stopped, Sai did not.
entries.new: Akaro 和 Sai 又往房间里走了几步。可 Akaro 停下时，Sai 却没有停。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: He placed himself in front of the cabinet and stared at the Sekimeiya. In the same way, everybody else just stared at him while he thought to himself.
entries.new: 他在展示柜前站定，盯着 Sekimeiya。而在他独自沉思的时候，其他人也同样只是盯着他看。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Then, with the same neutral expression, he scrolled the glass down.
entries.new: 然后，他依旧面无表情，把玻璃罩往下拉。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What are you doing...?
entries.new: 你在做什么……？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Instead of responding, he reached to touch the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 他没有回答，伸手去碰 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Or that's what I first thought. Instead, he grabbed it and took it out of the cabinet.
entries.new: 我原本是这么以为的。可他却一把抓住它，把它从展示柜里取了出来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Hey, what's up with you!? Didn't Katei say not to take it out!?
entries.new: 喂，你搞什么！？Katei 不是说过不能把它拿出来吗！？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: I guess he did. However, right now, he's in the security room doing God knows what.
entries.new: 他确实说过。不过此时此刻，他正在监控室里，天知道在干什么。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...What are you trying to do?
entries.new: ……你到底想做什么？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Isla extended her arm and let out a charming "Can I have it?"
entries.new: Isla 伸出手，甜甜地说了句「可以给我吗？」
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Yeah, of course, here.
entries.new: 嗯，当然，给你。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I looked at the camera in the upper right corner and saw the flickering green light. After handing Ashiya's precious gem to the nine-year-old, Sai answered Akaro.
entries.new: 我看向右上角的摄像头，只见绿灯一闪一闪。Sai 把芦屋的珍宝交到那个九岁女孩手里，这才回答 Akaro。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I was just considering that what Katei said earlier might've been false. Just in case he's not been the most sincere person.
entries.new: 我只是在想，Katei 之前说的那些话说不定是假的。也许他并没有那么诚恳。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What part of it?
entries.new: 哪一部分？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I'm talking about when he said that the Sekimeiya has to be kept in a cold place.
entries.new: 我指的是他说 Sekimeiya 必须放在低温环境里那句。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I'm just floating the possibility of him saying it to scare us into not taking it out.
entries.new: 我只是提出一种可能：他那么说，是为了吓住我们，让我们不敢把它拿出来。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Why would he lie like that? And really, why else would the cabinet be refrigerated other than because it's beneficial for the Sekimeiya?
entries.new: 他何必撒这种谎？再说了，要不是对 Sekimeiya 有好处，展示柜为什么非得制冷？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Why would he lie? I just told you: so that we keep it in the cabinet. Keeping this thing cold might be "beneficial", but he made it sound essential.
entries.new: 他为什么撒谎？我刚说了：好让我们把它留在展示柜里。保持低温也许确实「有好处」，可他把它说成了非如此不可。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...And look.
entries.new: ……而且你看。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Sai pointed at Isla, who looked to be enjoying her time despite the serious situation. She was clearly delighted at being able to hold the Sekimeiya, something she would never have been able to do under normal circumstances.
entries.new: Sai 指向 Isla。眼下情况明明很严重，她却一副乐在其中的样子。能亲手捧着 Sekimeiya，她显然高兴极了——换作平时，她绝不会有这种机会。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Right now, the Sekimeiya looks perfectly fine to me, yet it's not inside a cabinet that provides it a very low temperature. Curious, isn't it?
entries.new: 就我看来，Sekimeiya 现在完好无损，可它并没待在能维持极低温的展示柜里。不觉得奇怪吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: You don't know how the temperature might damage it. It could slowly crack it, which would be very bad. Its strongest point is how smooth it is... Right, Isla?
entries.new: 你根本不知道温度会怎样损伤它。也许会让它慢慢裂开，那可就糟了。它最出彩的地方就是光滑的质地……对吧，Isla？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Isla nodded strongly. She definitely agreed, as she wouldn't stop fiddling with it.
entries.new: Isla 用力点头。她显然完全赞同，手上还一直摆弄着它。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: You're right. I was just testing what would happen.
entries.new: 你说得对。我只是想看看会有什么结果。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What if the Sekimeiya melted after getting it out? Do you know the consequences that would follow!?
entries.new: 万一 Sekimeiya 拿出来之后就融化了怎么办？你知道那会引发什么后果吗！？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Then Katei would've been telling the truth. Right now, the Sekimeiya looks perfectly normal to me, and it's not like Katei told us exactly what a higher temperature would do. He was just "told" a low one was needed.
entries.new: 那说明 Katei 说的是实话。可眼下 Sekimeiya 在我看来毫无异样，再说 Katei 也没讲清楚温度升高究竟会造成什么。他也只是「被告知」需要低温罢了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Don't worry, though. If it had melted, we all would've said that he'd forgotten to warn us and they would've busted his ass.
entries.new: 不过别担心。真要融了，我们就一致咬定是他忘了提醒，上头自然会狠狠收拾他。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I don't think that's something Katei made up. Naomi also said something similar.
entries.new: 我不觉得那是 Katei 编出来的。Naomi 也说过类似的话。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: As if he'd been summoned, Katei appeared behind the open door.
entries.new: 仿佛被召唤而来一般，Katei 出现在敞开的门后。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Isla, plenty aware of impending trouble, instinctively hid the Sekimeiya behind her back. But she wasn't fast enough.
entries.new: Isla 很清楚麻烦要来了，下意识把 Sekimeiya 藏到身后。可她的动作还是不够快。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What are you guys doing here...? Why is the Sekimeiya out of the cabinet!?
entries.new: 你们在这里做什么……？Sekimeiya 怎么会被拿出展示柜！？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Rather, what were you doing in the security room? Did you find a way to restore the security system or contact the outside again?
entries.new: 倒是你，在监控室做什么？找到恢复安保系统的办法了，还是又联系上外界了？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...No. Nothing worked. I did undo some effects of the alarm, though. The elevator is now functioning, and proper illumination has been restored.
entries.new: ……没有。什么都没成。不过警报造成的部分影响我已经解除了。电梯恢复了运行，照明也恢复正常了。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Sounds great.
entries.new: 听起来不错。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What do you mean, "sounds great"!? Why did you get the Sekimeiya out!? I told you how important it is not to remove it from the cabinet!
entries.new: 什么叫「听起来不错」！？你们为什么把 Sekimeiya 拿出来了！？我明明告诉过你们，绝不能把它从展示柜里取出来，这有多重要！
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Katei, who looked and probably was rightfully angry, walked forward and forcefully took the Sekimeiya out of Isla's hands. She gave him a blank, depressing look in response.
entries.new: Katei 满脸怒色——他大概也确实有理由发火——走上前一把从 Isla 手中夺过 Sekimeiya。Isla 则回以一道空洞而沮丧的目光。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Important why? What is the higher temperature gonna do? It looks perfectly fine to me.{w} Don't tell me: it's a real egg, right? It must be kept cold so it doesn't hatch.
entries.new: 有什么重要的？温度高一点又能怎样？它看起来明明好得很。{w}别告诉我：它其实是个蛋吧？得一直冷藏，免得孵出来。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Listen, kid. I know you might find this a boring situation and you're trying to stay entertained. However, you should understand how serious this is.
entries.new: 听好了，小子。我知道你觉得这局面很无聊，想找点乐子。但你该明白这事有多严重。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: It seemed Katei had correctly assumed that the whole thing was Sai's idea.
entries.new: 看来 Katei 猜得没错，这整件事就是 Sai 的主意。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I don't know what the effects will be. I don't know if they'll happen immediately, but I know one thing. I know that my superiors told me that no matter the circumstances, the Sekimeiya could never be taken out of this cabinet, and that while they were saying it, their eyes were as serious as they could've been.
entries.new: 我不知道会有什么影响，也不知道会不会立刻发作，但有一点我清楚。上级告诉过我，无论出于什么情况，Sekimeiya 都绝不能离开这个展示柜。他们说这话时，眼神严肃得不能再严肃。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: The cameras here are disabled, so I'm sure you think you can do as you please without facing consequences. For your own good, or for our entire good, rather, do not think of doing this again.
entries.new: 这里的摄像头已经失效，所以你肯定觉得可以随心所欲、不用承担后果。为了你自己好——不，倒不如说是为了我们所有人好——别再动这种念头。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Katei placed the Sekimeiya back in the cabinet, shut the glass and the curtain, and looked into Sai's eyes as he finished.
entries.new: Katei 把 Sekimeiya 放回展示柜，拉上玻璃和遮布，说完时直视着 Sai 的眼睛。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Sai kept staring back, unfazed, but his expression had slightly changed.
entries.new: Sai 毫不退让地继续回望，神情却有了细微的变化。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If I had to guess what he was thinking... It was probably something along the lines of "You're one hell of an actor."
entries.new: 硬要猜他在想什么的话……大概是「你可真会演戏」之类的吧。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: However, to me, it didn't look like Katei was lying. I didn't rule it out, but I could believe he was very worried the orders he'd been given wouldn't be followed, foreseeing the punishment he'd be dealt by the Ashiya family.
entries.new: 不过，我不觉得 Katei 在说谎。我并不排除那种可能，但更愿意相信他是真的担心上级的命令没被遵从，也预见到了芦屋家会怎样责罚他。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Yeah, sure.
entries.new: 行，知道了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I don't know why you don't seem able to believe me. I can't tell you everything, but if it's going to make you feel better, I can tell you all that I know about the Sekimeiya. Maybe I can earn your trust like this.
entries.new: 我不知道你为什么就是不肯信我。我不能把一切都告诉你，但如果这能让你安心些，我可以把我知道的 Sekimeiya 的事全说出来。也许这样能换来你的信任。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: He didn't only look at Sai, but also at the rest of us. Suddenly, he seemed very serious about proving his sincerity. Perhaps he felt that everybody had been suspecting him in some way.
entries.new: 他不只看着 Sai，也看向我们其他人。忽然间，他像是下定决心要认真证明自己的诚意。也许他觉得，每个人都在以某种方式怀疑他。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Again, I was told about this very briefly and only to have the needed context as part of the security staff. I can't elaborate much on it, but given all that Suripo said, it's probably fine if I tell you the basic outline I know.
entries.new: 再重申一次，我当初只得到过极为简短的说明，仅仅是为了让安保人员掌握必要的背景。我没法细讲，但既然 Suripo 已经说了那么多，我把知道的大致轮廓告诉你们，应该也无妨。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Instead of saying anything, everybody stayed silent, intrigued by whatever Katei could have to say.
entries.new: 谁都没有开口，所有人都保持沉默，被 Katei 可能要说的话勾起了兴趣。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...As you all already know, the Sekimeiya was no more than bait for Xyn. After the last time the tower was attacked, on the 24th of November, Ashiya began to look for something they could use.
entries.new: ……正如你们所知，Sekimeiya 不过是用来引诱 Xyn 的诱饵。11 月 24 日芦屋塔上次遇袭之后，芦屋家便开始寻找能加以利用的东西。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Yushibana is now full of people who dedicate their lives to gemstone location and extraction. The number of them increased exponentially when the tower's opening informed people of the valuable gems in the nearby mountains.
entries.new: 如今丰花遍地都是靠寻找和开采宝石为生的人。芦屋塔开放后，人们得知附近山中藏有贵重宝石，这类人便成倍暴增。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: For many people, going and finding these all around the mountains became a successful gamble. The Sekimeiya was found by a single person who did just that, on the 27th of November.
entries.new: 对许多人来说，进山四处寻宝成了一场成功的赌博。11 月 27 日，就有一个人这样做，结果发现了 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Another common practice upon finding a rare or valuable gem is informing the Ashiya family with hopes that they'll be interested in it. For this reason, we were the first ones to be informed of the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 发现稀有或贵重宝石后，另一种常见做法是通知芦屋家，希望他们能感兴趣。正因如此，我们是最先得知 Sekimeiya 的人。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: A unique-looking gemstone worked perfectly for Ashiya. Regardless of its actual value, it did look special, so that was enough to work as the bait they needed.
entries.new: 一块外形独特的宝石对芦屋家来说再合适不过。不管它实际价值如何，看上去确实特别，这就足够充当他们需要的诱饵了。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: After paying the original discoverer for the Sekimeiya and their silence, they purposely touted the Sekimeiya's value as hard as they could. The first mention of the Sekimeiya by that name was made on the 29th, as you probably know. Ashiya told everyone who would listen they were in possession of something incredibly rare and that it'd be shown today, on the 15th of December.
entries.new: 他们付钱给最初的发现者，买下 Sekimeiya 并让对方守口如瓶，随后便刻意拼命抬高它的价值。你们大概也知道，Sekimeiya 这个名字第一次出现是在 29 日。芦屋家逢人便说，他们手中有一件极其稀有的宝物，并将在今天——12 月 15 日——公开展出。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Every night until today, we've been expecting Xyn's attack.{w} Everyone was led to think Ashiya had their rarest find in a while, so as Suripo said earlier, regardless of its actual initial worth, after all the publicity, the Sekimeiya was incredibly valuable for Xyn.
entries.new: 直到今天为止，每一晚我们都在提防 Xyn 来袭。{w}所有人都被引导相信，芦屋家得到了近年最稀有的发现；所以正如 Suripo 之前所说，不管 Sekimeiya 最初的实际价值如何，经过这一番宣传，它对 Xyn 而言已价值连城。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: We sold many tickets for today's event—you all saw how far the line of people extended in the lobby. Despite realizing Xyn could pass up on the bait, Ashiya still went with the option of letting the Sekimeiya they'd praised nonstop be seen.
entries.new: 今天的活动，我们卖出了许多门票——你们都看见大厅里的队伍排得有多长。尽管知道 Xyn 可能放过这个诱饵，芦屋家仍旧选择把不停吹捧的 Sekimeiya 公开展出。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Naomi was instructed to give out a bunch of made-up facts about it and its worth during her guided visit to try to justify all the hype. To add interaction and lengthen the visit time, the visitors were going to touch its surface, but only inside the cabinet.
entries.new: Naomi 被指示在导览过程中讲一堆关于它本身及其价值的编造说辞，好让这番炒作站得住脚。为了增加互动、延长参观时间，原本还安排参观者触摸它的表面，但只能在展示柜内触摸。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: To tell you guys the truth, Xyn did actually attempt to steal the Sekimeiya once. Suripo had no reason to inform you of this, but almost as soon as its existence was announced, Xyn made a move for it.
entries.new: 实话告诉你们，Xyn 确实试图偷走 Sekimeiya 一次。Suripo 本来没理由把这件事告诉你们，但它的存在刚一公布，Xyn 就出手了。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: As you can see, their plan ended in failure. We even came close to catching someone from Xyn for the first time, but they were able to escape. This was almost Ashiya's success, but this information was never published even though it would've been seen as Xyn's first failure.
entries.new: 如你们所见，他们的计划以失败告终。我们甚至头一次差一点就抓到 Xyn 的人，可对方还是逃脱了。这几乎可算芦屋家的一次成功，但这个消息从未公开，尽管它本可被视为 Xyn 的首次失手。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: The reason was that they wanted to keep up the charade and put the plan in motion to catch Xyn for real. The Sekimeiya wasn't in this building yet, so the mechanism we had designed wasn't activated.
entries.new: 理由是，他们想继续把这出戏演下去，并推进真正抓捕 Xyn 的计划。当时 Sekimeiya 还不在本楼里，所以我们设计的机关并未启动。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Additionally, even though Xyn were the ones to try to steal it, Ashiya had no way to prove it. Since the circumstances were unusual and everyone knew they wanted to crush Xyn, people could've thought they'd made it all up, as no one had actually been apprehended.
entries.new: 此外，尽管动手偷窃的确实是 Xyn，芦屋家却无法证明这一点。当时情况非同寻常，而所有人都知道他们急于击溃 Xyn；既然根本没有抓到人，外界很可能会认为这一切都是他们编造的。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: That's all I can say about this. Now, the cold temperature rule was not something Ashiya realized, but something the seller instructed. They said that it had to always be kept chilled to preserve it based on their own experience.
entries.new: 关于这件事，我能说的就这么多。至于必须低温这一条，并非芦屋家自己发现的，而是卖家叮嘱的。对方说，根据自身经验，必须始终冷藏，才能将它保存好。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: The fact they knew that putting it under a higher temperature could damage it implies they did so at one point and noticed the damaging effects. However, as Sai said, after you all took it out for a bit, it still seemed to be fine. They probably did the same and found out that leaving it for longer could be harmful.
entries.new: 他们既然知道放在更高温度下会损坏它，就说明曾经这么干过，并且察觉到了损坏的后果。不过，正如 Sai 所说，你们把它取出来放了一阵，它看起来仍然完好。他们大概也做了同样的事，发现放得太久会有害。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Ashiya did not particularly care, so they naturally accepted and followed that single rule without much of a concern. Ashiya already had this cabinet, alongside others that also possess temperature functions, so it was a convenient place to keep it after stylizing it a little.
entries.new: 芦屋对此并不特别在意，自然就接受了那一条规矩，照做时也没多少顾虑。芦屋本来就有这只展示柜，另外还有几只有温控功能的柜子，所以稍微改装一下之后，放在这里很方便。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Since it was found pretty high up on the mountains behind the tower, the temperature there was already very low. At their request, the location where it was found was revealed to Ashiya.
entries.new: 它是在塔后群山相当高的地方被发现的，那里气温本来就极低。应他们的要求，发现地点被透露给了芦屋。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: A vast mountain range surrounds Yushibana, which I'm sure you see daily. On Airun, a mountain close to this building, there is a little upward path that was much more visible a few years ago.{w} That part of the range has almost been abandoned. Over time, many fewer gemstones have been found on Airun than the others.
entries.new: 丰花四周环绕着广阔的山脉，想必你们每天都看得见。离这栋楼不远的艾伦山上，有一条向上延伸的小径，几年前要比现在显眼得多。{w} 那一片山域几乎已被废弃。久而久之，在艾伦山发现的宝石远比别的山少。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Eventually, up that mountain is a small field that's pretty well-hidden. It's not easy to spot, and you have to deviate onto a smaller path. All I was told was that it's fairly tucked away.
entries.new: 沿山而上，最后会到一小片相当隐蔽的平地。那里不容易发现，得岔到一条更窄的小路上去。我得到的说法只是，那地方藏得很深。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: That's where this was found.
entries.new: 这东西就是在那儿被发现的。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Katei pointed at the cabinet.{w} That was all interesting and consistent with what we knew, but my mind had gone someplace else.
entries.new: Katei 指了指展示柜。{w} 这些话都很有意思，也和我们已知的对得上，可我的思绪已经飘到了别处。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: As I expected, when I looked at Shiroya, she was already looking at me. It seemed she'd thought the same thing.
entries.new: 果然，我看向 Shiroya 时，她也正看着我。看来她想到了同一件事。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Bizarre as it sounded, the location Katei had just described matched perfectly with the place where we used to play as kids. Past that grassy terrain, there used to be a cabin she and I would frequently visit.
entries.new: 说来离奇，Katei 刚刚描述的地点，和我们小时候玩耍的地方完全对得上。那片草地再过去，曾有一间我和她常去的小屋。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It was the same mountain, the same narrow path, and maybe the same plain and grassy field which were covered by snow.
entries.new: 同一座山，同一条窄路，或许还是同一片被雪覆盖的平地与草地。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It seemed pointless to think much of it; we hadn't been there for more than a decade, but back in the day, it was the perfect hidden place for us to go spend our time.{w} Not once had we seen anyone else there, but eventually, going to the mountains just to play was seen as rude by the people who tried to make a daily living on them.
entries.new: 多想似乎也没什么意义；我们已有十多年没去过那里，可当年，那正是我们消磨时光的绝佳藏身处。{w} 我们在那儿从没见过别人，但后来，在靠山讨生活的人眼里，只为玩耍就上山，渐渐成了一件失礼的事。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Admittedly, we also didn't want to have anything to do with the strangers on the mountain, which decreased the frequency of our visits until we finally stopped going altogether. The final visit was something we hadn't even realized was final.
entries.new: 平心而论，我们也不想和山上的陌生人有什么牵扯，于是去的次数越来越少，最后干脆不去了。那最后一次，我们当时甚至没意识到那就是最后一次。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Do you remember?
entries.new: ……你还记得吗？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Yeah, of course. I'm not sure the place is the same, but thinking back on those times makes me happy.
entries.new: 嗯，当然记得。我不确定是不是同一个地方，但回想那段日子，心里很高兴。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: You're right. We used to have a lot of fun there.
entries.new: 是啊。我们那时候在那里玩得很开心。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Reminiscing evoked a very particular feeling within me. When the weather was ideal, we would spend entire afternoons in our unreachable hidden place, playing all sorts of different games. We brought things from home every day we went to make it ours.
entries.new: 回忆让我心里涌起一种很特别的感觉。天气好的时候，我们会在那个谁也到不了的秘密基地里待上一整个下午，玩各种各样的游戏。每次去，我们都会从家里带些东西过去，把那地方变成我们自己的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Even though if you were to look at Shiroya, you might not have believed it, her usual self was a very cheerful one, so remembering some of those early memories was bittersweet.
entries.new: 如今看着 Shiroya，或许很难相信，可她向来是个非常开朗的人，所以回想起那些早年的往事，心里五味杂陈。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: On the other hand, after I looked at her... She was smiling, and wore an expression that had lately disappeared from her face. The memories we shared from that time were very special.
entries.new: 不过，我看向她时，她笑了，脸上露出了近来许久未见的神情。我们共同拥有的那段记忆，实在太特别了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: No matter what I'd tried to say, I hadn't been able to cheer her up. That might've been the first time in two weeks she'd clearly reacted positively to anything, and I probably knew why.
entries.new: 不管我说什么，都没能让她振作起来。这大概是她两周以来第一次对什么明显露出积极的反应，而我多半也明白原因。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Those memories were so old that Miiya had not yet appeared in our lives. That was why Shiroya was able to think about them without sparking the negative reactions that obfuscated everything else.
entries.new: 那些记忆太过久远，那时 Miiya 还没出现在我们的生命里。正因如此，Shiroya 想起它们时，才不会激起那种把其他一切都搅得模糊不清的负面反应。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Maybe we should go back one day and see what it looks like now.
entries.new: 也许哪天我们该回去看看，现在那里是什么样子。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Yeah... That is a good idea.
entries.new: 嗯……这是个好主意。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Even though her smile had slightly faded, she seemed to genuinely mean that. It was reassuring to hear, and it made me trust that everything would eventually get better.
entries.new: 她的笑容虽然淡了些，但这话听着是真心实意的。听她这么说，我安心了不少，也相信一切终究会好起来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Katei had continued talking while I'd been digging up old memories, but he'd only gone back over his previous points.
entries.new: 在我翻捡旧日回忆的时候，Katei 一直在往下说，不过他只是把先前的话又重复了一遍。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: This is all I know. It's not much, but hopefully you can at least believe me.
entries.new: 我知道的就这些。虽然不多，但希望你们至少能信我。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: You sure are good at coming up with stories to cover your ass. It's honestly impressive.
entries.new: 你还真擅长编故事给自己开脱。老实说，挺让人佩服的。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Sai said that, but it didn't look like he disbelieved Katei's explanation. He was most likely referring to everything else Katei said previously with the sole intention to provoke him.
entries.new: Sai 虽然这么说，但看起来他并不是不信 Katei 的解释。他多半指的是 Katei 先前说的那些话——那些话本来就是为了激怒他。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If that didn't please you, there's not much else I can say. This was probably more than I am allowed to, actually.
entries.new: 要是这还不能让你满意，我也没什么可说的了。其实，我说的这些，大概已经超出我能说的范围了。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Ah. I see.
entries.new: 啊。原来如此。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Even though I could've seen Sai's playful behavior as intriguing earlier, it had become off-putting. After shifting my thoughts to some of my childhood memories, the thought of getting out of the tower was much more appealing.
entries.new: 早些时候，我或许还会觉得 Sai 这种玩闹似的态度有意思，现在却只觉得不舒服。想起一些童年回忆后，我更想离开这座塔了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Finding out who was responsible for the attack was a goal, but as long as the police had some way to recover the camera footage, they could handle that. They could have already captured the person responsible for all we knew. Ashiya's compensation was certainly a nice thought to keep in mind, too.
entries.new: 查出袭击的主使者是个目标，但只要警方有办法恢复监控录像，这件事交给他们就好。说不定他们早就抓到犯人了。而且，芦屋的赔偿也确实是个值得惦记的好事。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It was more important to keep an eye out for anyone doing anything suspicious and nail them once we got out than constantly and baselessly accuse anyone in the vicinity like Sai seemed to want to.
entries.new: 与其像 Sai 那样，不停毫无根据地指控身边的每一个人，不如留心有没有人形迹可疑，等出去之后再把他揪出来，这才是更重要的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Anyway... weren't you all supposed to be investigating the building? I think it's time for that. We keep repeating this, but Naomi's disappearance gets weirder by the second.
entries.new: 总之……你们不是该去调查这栋楼了吗？我看差不多该动手了。这话我们说了又说，可 Naomi 的失踪一秒比一秒更离奇。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Yeah, we should go.
entries.new: 嗯，我们走吧。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: I agree. Let's look through this floor first; it's where she was when the smoke appeared, and it has plenty of disabled cameras.
entries.new: 我同意。先搜这一层吧。烟雾出现的时候她就在这层，而且这一层有不少摄像头被停用了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: We made our way to hallway A. Finally starting to inspect the huge building was an imposing task.{w} A lot of time had already passed, so I had no idea what to think of Naomi's disappearance. She was either incapable of reaching us... or didn't want to.
entries.new: 我们来到 A走廊。终于要开始搜查这栋庞大的建筑了，这可是一项令人生畏的工程。{w} 已经过去了这么长时间，我对 Naomi 的失踪毫无头绪。她要么是无法联系我们……要么是不想。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: How do we do it? Do we split up?
entries.new: 怎么查？要分头行动吗？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: No. Let's make the situation clear first. Funny things can happen later.
entries.new: 不。先把情况弄清楚。之后要是出了什么怪事，再作打算。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Let's enter every room in this hallway and then move on to the other one. After we're done with this floor, we'll move up one at a time.
entries.new: 先把这条走廊的每个房间都进去看一遍，再去另一条。这一层查完之后，我们一层一层往上走。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Yeah. Let's begin there.
entries.new: 好。就从那里开始吧。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Erina looked at the crystal room in front of the security room. It was the one labeled "A1" on the map.
entries.new: Erina 望向监控室前面的那间水晶展室。就是地图上标着「A1」的那间。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Given the floor's layout, if there was someone who wanted to avoid being seen, as long as we didn't split up, they could easily achieve that.
entries.new: 照这一层的格局，要是有人想避开我们的视线，只要我们不分开，对方就能轻易做到。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There were three different ways to make it from one hallway to the other, so we would never be able to rule out a sneaky moving culprit.
entries.new: 从一条走廊到另一条有三条路可走，所以我们始终无法排除有人暗中转移的可能。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Taking that same possibility in mind, though, the thought of splitting up was distressing. It was better to investigate together and hope that wouldn't happen.
entries.new: 可正因为有这个可能，分头行动的念头才让人不安。还是一起调查，但愿不会发生那种事。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We were in front of the room we'd start with. Katei opened it, and yet again, I felt the same recurring sensation of stepping into a different world.
entries.new: 我们站在要搜查的第一个房间门前。Katei 推开门，我又一次感到那种熟悉的感觉，仿佛踏进了另一个世界。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: A clean floor, walls, and ceiling awaited us. Just like in the room I'd looked at, there were many cabinets, presumably displaying different kinds of valuable gemstones.
entries.new: 迎接我们的是干净的地板、墙壁和天花板。和我看过的那间一样，这里摆着许多展示柜，想必陈列着各式各样的贵重宝石。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Why are they covered?
entries.new: 为什么都盖着？
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: As Isla said, the interior of the cabinets wasn't visible. Velvet curtains, as pretty as the Sekimeiya's had once been, were neatly placed over all of them.
entries.new: 正如 Isla 所说，看不见展示柜里面。所有柜子都整齐地罩着天鹅绒遮布，漂亮得就像 Sekimeiya 当年的一样。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Oh, yes, this is something that we do every morning. Except on Sundays, when the tower is closed.
entries.new: 哦，对，这是我们每天早上都要做的事。周日闭馆时除外。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: While at {time=9:00}, the floor opens to the public, it isn't until {time=9:10} that the showcase cabinets are uncovered. This is purely done for dramatic effect and, honestly, to give the visitors the impression that they're about to witness something very valuable.
entries.new: {time=9:00}时，这一层便向公众开放；但展示柜要到{time=9:10}才会揭开遮布。这纯粹是为了制造戏剧效果，说实话，也是为了让参观者感到自己即将见证一件极其贵重的珍宝。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Oh... Can I?
entries.new: 哦……可以吗？
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: Yeah, of course. Let me raise them for you.
entries.new: 当然可以。我来帮你把它们卷起来。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: In the same manner that Katei might've seen it done daily through the cameras, he carefully rolled up every curtain, letting us see what they were hiding.
entries.new: Katei 或许每天都在监控画面里看惯了这套动作，此刻也依样而行，小心翼翼地卷起每一道遮布，让我们看清遮布后藏着的东西。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: As amazed as a little girl trapped in a building could be, Isla lit up while Katei uncovered the next mysterious interior.
entries.new: 一个被困在这栋楼里的小女孩，再惊喜也不过如此——Katei 揭开下一处神秘陈设时，Isla 的眼睛一下子亮了起来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Sai gave it a similar look, one I couldn't help but question.
entries.new: Sai 也露出了相似的神色，我不禁有些起疑。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The cabinets in those rooms were different from the Sekimeiya's. They were lower to the ground, and on top of them was a screen of glass that sheltered the gemstones.
entries.new: 那些房间里的展示柜与 Sekimeiya 的不同。它们更贴近地面，上方还罩着一层玻璃，把宝石护在里面。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wow, look at this black one, Mom! Isn't it pretty? I love it.
entries.new: 哇，妈妈你看这颗黑色的！是不是很漂亮？我好喜欢。
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: It's quite pretty. I wish I could wear it as a necklace.
entries.new: 确实很漂亮。要是能把它做成项链戴上就好了。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: If nothing else, it was good that Erina treated Isla as if they were in a normal visit, letting her feel comfortable.
entries.new: 至少，Erina 让 Isla 觉得这就是一次寻常的参观，使她放松了不少，这总归是件好事。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Shortly, Katei finished with every cabinet.{w} They had all contained gemstones of different shapes and tones. Some also had a brief explanation below them, detailing where they'd been found along with the name of who'd found them. Most were discovered in the mountains I was used to seeing in the background of Yushibana.
entries.new: 很快，Katei 把所有展示柜都揭完了。{w}每只柜里都放着形状、色泽各异的宝石。有些柜子下方还附有简短说明，写明发现地点和发现者的名字。其中大多数都发现于我早已看惯的、丰花远景中的群山里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Despite the events and my lack of interest, I spent some time looking at each one, immersing myself in them without noticing it. Everyone else did the same, drawn into Isla's rhythm briefly.
entries.new: 尽管经历了那些事，我本来也没什么兴致，却还是挨个看了一会儿，不知不觉便沉浸其中。其他人也一样，一时都被 Isla 的步调带了进去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Do you like this one?
entries.new: 你喜欢这颗吗？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Shiroya was pointing at a tiny, light blue jewel with round white marks on its smooth surface. She'd said it because I'd been looking at it for a while, and she knew that shade of blue was my favorite color.
entries.new: Shiroya 指着一颗小小的浅蓝色宝石，光滑的表面上有几处白色圆斑。她之所以这么问，是因为我盯着那颗宝石看了好一会儿，而她知道这种蓝色是我最喜欢的颜色。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I really do. I wouldn't mind going to the mountains someday if I can manage to find one like this.
entries.new: 真的很喜欢。要是能亲手找到一颗这样的，哪天进山一趟也无妨。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I'm sure it wouldn't be easy, but it'd be worth the effort.
entries.new: 我想那肯定不容易，不过值得费这番功夫。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Yeah.
entries.new: 嗯。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: After talking about going back to our personal playground, I started to really look forward to the time where we'd visit it again, spending a day trying to find a gem as pretty as that one.
entries.new: 聊起要回我们自己的那片私人乐园后，我便开始真心期待再次前往的那一天——花上一整天，找一颗和那颗一样漂亮的宝石。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Can I see it again, Tanya?
entries.new: 坦桑娅，能再让我看看吗？
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: ...Huh? Are you talking to me?
entries.new: ……咦？你是在叫我吗？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Yes! Can I see your pendant?
entries.new: 对呀！我能看看你的吊坠吗？
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: A bit confused, Shiroya took it out.
entries.new: Shiroya 有些困惑，还是把它取了出来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I knew it! It's even prettier than everything here!
entries.new: 我就知道！它比这里所有的宝石都漂亮！
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: ...What's with that name, though?
entries.new: ……不过，这名字是怎么回事？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Hm? Tanya? That's you! It's for tanzanite.
entries.new: 嗯？坦桑娅？就是你呀！是从坦桑石来的。
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: Oh, I see.
entries.new: 哦，原来如此。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: I'll admit I'm a bit fascinated by these myself.
entries.new: 我得承认，我自己也有点被这些宝石迷住了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Sai's voice sounded from behind us as he peeked over my shoulder.
entries.new: Sai 的声音从身后传来，他正越过我的肩膀探头看过来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I came here of my own volition, after all. We shouldn't spend so much time doing this in the next rooms, though. We have other priorities.
entries.new: 毕竟，我是凭自己的意愿来这里的。不过接下来的房间，我们不该再在这上面花太多时间了，还有更要紧的事。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Yes. Sorry, Isla, but once we're done, we'll have more than enough time to revisit every room.
entries.new: 嗯。抱歉，Isla，不过等我们办完事，回来看遍每个房间的时间多得是。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Hm. You'll still let me see them though, right?
entries.new: 唔。不过你之后还是会让我看它们的，对吧？
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: Yeah. We'll briefly look over them.
entries.new: 会。我们每间都简单看一遍。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: We moved on to the next room, which looked almost identical.
entries.new: 我们来到下一个房间，这里看上去几乎一模一样。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The same procedure was repeated: Katei uncovered every cabinet, and Isla had a few seconds to appreciate all of their contents.
entries.new: 同样的流程又重复了一遍：Katei 揭开所有展示柜，Isla 则有几秒钟时间欣赏柜中的每一颗宝石。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Undercurrent
entries.new: 暗流

entries.text: After we finished with it, Akaro spoke.
entries.new: 我们看完这个房间后，Akaro 开口了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Do we really have to look at the inside of every cabinet? It's only slowing us down.
entries.new: 我们非得把每个展示柜里面都看一遍吗？这只会拖慢我们的脚步。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Yes. It doesn't take up a lot of time, and remember what Suripo said. He mentioned some gems on this floor had been stolen. We need to find that room and see if there's something to find there.
entries.new: 对。这花不了多少时间，而且别忘了 Suripo 说过的话。他提到这一层有宝石被盗。我们得找到那个房间，看看那里能不能发现什么线索。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Oh, yes, that's true. He said it happened in one of the farther back rooms.
entries.new: 哦，对，确实如此。他说过事情发生在靠后的某个房间里。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: You're right... I'd forgotten about that, but it still sounds very weird to me. What do these gems have to do with anything? It sounded like Ashiya have already assumed those gems were the target, which feels off considering nobody even knows how they were brought outside.
entries.new: 你说得对……我都忘了这回事，不过我还是觉得很奇怪。那些宝石和整件事到底有什么关系？听上去芦屋已经认定宝石就是目标，可没人知道它们是怎么被带出去的，这一点实在说不通。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: You mean to say they were probably a measure to distract, right?
entries.new: 你是说，那些宝石很可能只是用来分散注意力的幌子，对吧？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I agree. If this supposed theft is over or already failed, it could be that some kind of trick was used to get the gems outside and make Ashiya think they were the goal. Once their guard is lowered, steal the actual target: the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 我同意。如果这场所谓的失窃已经结束，或者本来就失败了，那也许是有人用了某种手法，把宝石弄到外面，让芦屋以为宝石才是目标。等他们放松警惕，再偷走真正的目标——Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Yeah, something like that, even though I can't really visualize how the plan would work.
entries.new: 嗯，差不多是这样，只是我实在想不出这计划要怎么实施。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Before you assume that, there's something else to consider in opposition.
entries.new: 在你们下这个结论之前，还有一个相反的情况需要考虑。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...What would that be?
entries.new: ……是什么？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Well... the two side hallways and the event room were put out of commission with the smoke. If the gems were the goal, it could be assumed that the event room was, for some reason, only attacked because it's the only way to go from the middle of one hallway to the other.
entries.new: 嗯……两条侧廊和活动室都被烟雾弄得无法通行。如果目标真是宝石，那就只能推测：他们之所以对活动室下手，是因为从一条走廊的中段通往另一条走廊，只能经过那里。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: However, that has a flaw. Even though the smoke certainly disabled the security cameras, the room those gems were stolen from wasn't ever subjected to the smoke, according to what Katei told us.
entries.new: 可这个说法有个破绽。烟雾确实让监控摄像头失了效，但按 Katei 告诉我们的，那些宝石失窃的房间根本没有被烟雾波及过。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: That's weird, don't you think? It outright implies that the room's security camera was never a factor they took into consideration. So, if that were the case, why did they disable all the others?
entries.new: 很蹊跷，不是吗？这分明意味着，他们压根没把那个房间的监控摄像头放在心上。既然如此，他们又何必让其余所有摄像头失灵？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What I mean to say is that the robbery of those gems could've been executed without needing to release smoke in the event room, and the substance to cover the lenses of the security cameras wouldn't have been needed.
entries.new: 我的意思是，偷走那些宝石根本不需要在活动室放烟雾，也不需要用到遮住监控镜头的东西。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: If being spotted by the security cameras in the room of the robbery wasn't an issue, it means the only other goal of the smoke was to provide a clear route to the outside. The event room and the opposite hallway wouldn't have been needed, and there would be no point in disabling the cameras. This immediately indicates that the gems were never the goal, which shatters any illusion with them.
entries.new: 如果无须担心被失窃房间的监控拍到，那就意味着，烟雾剩下的唯一目的，就是清出一条通往外面的路。活动室和对面那条走廊都用不上，让摄像头失灵也毫无意义。这就直接说明，宝石从来不是目标，围绕宝石的假象也就不攻自破。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Maybe you're right... If they were the goal, only one hallway and that very room would've been attacked.
entries.new: 也许你说得对……如果那些宝石才是目标，被袭击的应该只有一条走廊和那个房间才对。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: And you also can't assume the smoke was released to make everyone nearby fall unconscious because not all the rooms where people could've been were attacked.
entries.new: 而且也不能断定放烟就是为了让附近的人全部昏迷，因为并不是所有可能有人待着的房间都被波及了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: And yet those gems were brought outside in a suitcase before the exit closed...
entries.new: 可那些宝石偏偏在出口封闭之前，被人用手提箱运到了外面……
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Yeah, only for that person to then be arrested immediately. I can't quite figure out what the whole deal is here, especially given the Sekimeiya is still with us.
entries.new: 是啊，结果那人紧接着就被抓了。我实在想不明白这一连串到底是怎么回事，尤其是 Sekimeiya 现在还留在这里。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: The people outside think the gems were the goal and that the robbery was a failure. However, part of that relies on them not knowing the exact rooms that were covered in the smoke.{w} I'm sure more people will conclude what I'm saying once they enter the tower. If the culprit intended to use those gems as a feint, this plan is lacking.
entries.new: 外面的人认为宝石才是目标，抢劫已经失败。不过这种看法有一部分建立在他们不清楚烟雾究竟覆盖了哪些房间之上。{w} 我相信等更多人进入塔里，就会得出和我相同的结论。如果犯人本想用那些宝石作幌子，这个计划未免太不高明。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: There's no way it ends with someone sneaking the Sekimeiya out as soon as the exit opens, right? That would be beyond stupid. Not to mention that stealing the gems would be rendered useless since Ashiya would quickly notice that the Sekimeiya has been stolen too. Then, the gems would ultimately return to Ashiya, and the person who had them would be arrested.
entries.new: 总不可能等出口一开，就有人把 Sekimeiya 偷偷带出去吧？那也太蠢了。更何况，偷走宝石也毫无意义——芦屋很快就会发现 Sekimeiya 也失窃了。到头来，宝石还是得回到芦屋手里，而拿着它的人只会被逮捕。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I hadn't taken those gemstones into consideration for any of my thoughts, but he was right.
entries.new: 我此前所有推想都没把那些宝石算进去，可他说得没错。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Hey, Katei. I know you brought this up earlier, but are you sure that the exit was sealed immediately after the alarm went off?
entries.new: 我说，Katei。我知道你之前提过这事，但你确定警报一响，出口就立刻封死了吗？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Hm... While it is the first time the alarm has been activated, it's how it was programmed to work. Anything else would be pointless, really.
entries.new: 嗯……虽然这是警报头一次启动，但程序本来就是这么设定的。否则根本没有意义。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Could it have been another malfunction? I was just thinking that Naomi might have brought the gems out.
entries.new: 会不会又是故障？我刚才在想，会不会是 Naomi 把宝石带出去的。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Naomi? But that should be impossible, right?
entries.new: Naomi？可那应该不可能吧？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Not if that malfunction actually occurred. When Suripo mentioned the person who brought them outside, he only said it had been an "individual". It could've been a woman, but I think he would've said it when we mentioned Naomi was still with us.
entries.new: 除非那个故障真的发生了。Suripo 提到把宝石带出去的人时，只说那是「某个人」。也可能是个女人，但要是 Naomi 的话，我们提到她还在这里时，他就该说出来了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: If the alarm's effects were delayed, Suripo would've brought it up, or someone from the outside would've entered. But it is true that Naomi, who's disappeared and knows the entire layout of the tower, is a pretty good candidate to take out a bunch of gems and play this silly role of purposely getting arrested with a conspicuous suitcase.
entries.new: 如果警报的效果真的延迟了，Suripo 应该会提到，外面的人也该会进来。不过话说回来，Naomi 确实很合适——她人不见了，又熟悉整座塔的布局，完全可能把一批宝石带出去，再提着显眼的手提箱演一出故意被捕的蠢戏。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: If that is what happened, targeting the event room too would make sense even if the goal was elsewhere. It was Naomi's location, and she would've needed a way to escape.
entries.new: 如果真是这样，那么即便目标在别处，连活动室一起攻击也说得通。那是 Naomi 所在的地方，而她需要一条逃路。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: You're... right. I hadn't thought of this, but I'm not convinced.{w} Targeting both hallways still wouldn't make much sense, and most importantly, it implies her plan only worked because the alarm's effects got delayed; it would've been no so-called malfunction.
entries.new: 你说得……也对。这一点我倒没想到，可还是说服不了我。{w} 而且同时袭击两条走廊仍然说不通，最重要的是，照这说法，她的计划能成全靠警报效果延迟——那可就谈不上什么「故障」了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Yeah... Also, we still don't know what actually triggered the alarm, and while I could be wrong, it really seemed to me like Naomi did fall unconscious in our room.
entries.new: 嗯……而且我们至今还不知道警报到底是怎么触发的。虽说我可能看错了，但我真觉得 Naomi 当时确实在我们房间里昏过去了。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Hm...{w} Remember what Suripo said? If anyone was in front of the shutter as it closed, it would've stopped. It's possible it was delayed, which gave Naomi enough time to leave even though she was in the event room when the alarm played.
entries.new: 嗯……{w}还记得 Suripo 说过的话吗？卷帘门下降时若有人挡在前面，就会停下来。也许它确实延迟了，这样即使警报响起时 Naomi 在活动室里，也有足够的时间离开。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: That's true, but Suripo would've told us as well.
entries.new: 确实如此，可那样的话 Suripo 也会告诉我们。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Wait, no. I don't think that could've happened.
entries.new: 等等，不对。我觉得那不可能发生。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Why not?
entries.new: 为什么？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: When I heard the alarm, there was another sound too, much fainter. I just realized that must've been the shutter closing, because it was pretty rough and came from the lobby.{w} That means there was no delay, and there was a louder sound at the end when it hit the floor. I'm almost certain it went the whole time without stopping.
entries.new: 听到警报的时候，我还听见了另一个声音，轻得多。我刚刚才意识到，那一定是卷帘门在下降——那声音很粗重，是从大厅方向传来的。{w} 也就是说根本没有延迟，最后落到地面时还有一声闷响。我几乎可以确定，它中途一直没有停过。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: If that's true, it confirms Naomi's still here.
entries.new: 如果真是这样，那就证实 Naomi 还在这里。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Yeah.
entries.new: 嗯。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: ...Is this a key?
entries.new: ……这是钥匙吗？
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: I saw Shiroya staring at the floor, confused as to where to direct her gaze.
entries.new: 我看见 Shiroya 盯着地面，神情困惑，不知该把视线投向哪里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Oh, you're right. What's this doing here?
entries.new: ……啊，真的。这东西怎么会在这里？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: When we went quiet, the two people who hadn't participated in the conversation spoke.{w} They were a bit ahead of us, so we walked up to them. After focusing on the point where they were staring, we saw what Isla had found. Next to the right wall was a small, rusty key.
entries.new: 我们安静下来后，那两位一直没参与讨论的人开了口。{w} 他们走在我们前面一点，我们便走上前去。顺着他们注视的地方看去，我们看见了 Isla 发现的东西。右侧墙壁旁边，躺着一把小小的、生锈的钥匙。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Isla kneeled to pick it up. Once in her hands, she showed it to us.
entries.new: Isla 蹲下身把它捡起来，拿到手里给我们看。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Was this on the floor?
entries.new: 这是掉在地上的？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Yes... I just saw it.
entries.new: 嗯……我刚看见的。
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: There's no way we've missed it until now, right?
entries.new: 我们总不至于到现在都没发现吧？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: The color is close to the floor's, and the lighting is bad. I'd say we did since it took me a few seconds to see it.
entries.new: 它和地板颜色接近，光线又暗。我看我们确实漏掉了，因为我自己也看了好几秒才看见。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: ...Really? It was right next to the event room.
entries.new: ……真的？就在活动室旁边啊。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: More importantly, what's it for? Do you recognize it, Katei?
entries.new: 更重要的是，它是开什么的？Katei，你认得吗？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: ...No. I don't think I've ever seen this key before.
entries.new: ……不认得。我应该从没见过这把钥匙。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Katei grabbed it to give it a closer look. It appeared very old and rusty; it wasn't the kind of key that would be used in a modern building.
entries.new: Katei 拿过钥匙凑近细看。它显得陈旧斑驳、锈迹很重，不像是现代建筑会用的钥匙。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It's impossible this belongs here. I know it's an old building and there are keys I don't possess, but it must be for something else.{w} Keys are not prohibited items in this tower. It's possible someone dropped it and didn't realize it.
entries.new: 这东西不可能属于这里。我知道这栋楼年头久了，有些钥匙不在我手上，但这把肯定是开别的东西的。{w} 塔里并不禁止携带钥匙。也许是有人掉了却没发觉。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: How would you not notice it? If you drop it here, it would make a noise when it hit the floor.
entries.new: 怎么会没发觉？掉在这种地方，砸到地上总会有声音吧。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: For sure. Which means that whoever dropped it knew they did and then didn't pick it back up.
entries.new: 确实。也就是说，掉钥匙的人知道自己掉了，却没有回头捡。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: It would have been a bit ridiculous to think that it had been left purposely to indirectly pass it on to someone or something of the sort. Given what we knew had happened so far, what Sai said made a lot of sense.
entries.new: 若认为它是被人故意留下，好间接交到某人手里，未免有些荒唐。而就我们目前所知的情况来看，Sai 的推断相当合理。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: You get what I mean, right? This key probably belonged to the culprit.
entries.new: 你明白我的意思吧？这把钥匙多半是犯人的东西。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: As they were running against a timer that would trap them, they dropped this key. Naturally, they didn't waste time stopping to retrieve it.
entries.new: 他们当时正争分夺秒，想赶在被困住之前脱身，钥匙就是那时候掉的。他们自然不会浪费时间停下来去捡。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: It could be a pretty important key if it's one the culprit was holding as they were committing a crime.
entries.new: 如果这是犯人在作案时随身带着的钥匙，那它很可能相当重要。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I'll keep it safe and give it to the police as soon as I can.
entries.new: 我会好好保管，尽快交给警方。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: That's a good idea.
entries.new: 这主意不错。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: You might be jumping to conclusions again, though. It could belong to an innocent person who rushed to escape from the tower.
entries.new: 不过你们也许又把结论下得太早了。它也可能属于某个慌忙逃出塔的无辜者。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: You think so? I'm not sure that's possible. I've gone over this.
entries.new: 你这么想？我看不太可能。这一点我已经反复想过了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Why would an innocent person ever rush to escape? One reason would be if they saw smoke appearing out of nowhere. However, they would've fallen unconscious if they ran through this hallway.
entries.new: 无辜的人为什么要慌忙逃跑？一种可能是他们看见烟雾凭空冒了出来。可要是从这条走廊跑过去，他们早就昏倒了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: The other reason would be if they heard an unknown alarm, but this can also be ruled out because the alarm blocked off the exit. Naturally, this key doesn't belong to any of us, right?
entries.new: 另一种可能是听到了莫名其妙的警报，但这也可以排除——警报一响，出口就封死了。再说，这把钥匙也不属于我们中的任何人，对吧？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Nobody answered.{w} He was saying that no innocent person aware of danger could've escaped through the hallway.
entries.new: 没有人回答。{w} 他的意思是，任何察觉到危险的无辜者都不可能从这条走廊逃出去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If the key didn't belong to the culprit, it had to belong to someone who'd also gotten trapped and we hadn't seen. Even Naomi didn't make sense as a candidate—I'd been with her up until the alarm had sounded.{w} If someone had fallen unconscious there, they could have dropped the key and failed to realize it upon waking up. Perhaps even the sound of it falling was obscured by the alarm, but I considered it unlikely.
entries.new: 如果这把钥匙不是犯人的，那就只能是另一个同样被困住、我们却没见过的人留下的。就连 Naomi 也说不通——警报响之前，我一直和她在一起。{w} 要真有人在那儿昏了过去，钥匙可能会从他手里掉出来，而他自己醒来后也没发觉。说不定连钥匙落地的声音都被警报盖过去了，不过我觉得这种可能性不大。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I doubt this was here before the attack. There was a janitor cleaning the floor in the lobby, so I'm sure these hallways were cleaned today too.
entries.new: 这东西在袭击之前应该不在这儿。大厅里有清洁工在拖地，所以这几条走廊今天肯定也打扫过。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...On the surface, that appeared to be a very solid argument, but there was a way around it, and it involved something I'd thought before.
entries.new: ……表面上看，这套说法无懈可击，但还是有办法绕开它，而且这办法跟我之前想到的一件事有关。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We didn't know for a fact the smoke in hallway A had been released at the same time as in the other two places. There was no reason to believe it hadn't been, but it also would've allowed one of Katei's claims be the truth.{w} One part of me wanted to directly ask Katei, but I held off.
entries.new: 我们并不能确定 A 走廊的烟雾和另外两处是同时放出来的。虽然没有理由认为不是，但要不是同时，Katei 说的某句话就有可能是真的。{w} 我有点想直接去问 Katei，但最后忍住了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If someone had heard yells coming from the lobby or seen smoke coming through the door of the event room, they might've rushed out without stopping to retrieve their key...{w} I recalled that I'd heard only silence when we were about to fall unconscious.
entries.new: 若是有人听见大厅传来的喊声，或是看见烟雾从活动室的门缝里涌出，也许就会慌忙跑出去，顾不上取回自己的钥匙……{w} 可我记得，就在我们即将失去意识的时候，听到的只有一片寂静。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I saw Isla in front of the next door. Even though she'd found a key, she didn't seem very interested. Inspecting the contents of every cabinet was probably far more exciting for her.
entries.new: 下一扇门前，我看见了 Isla。她虽然也找到了一把钥匙，却似乎并不怎么在意。对她来说，逐一查看每个展示柜里的东西恐怕要有趣得多。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Let's continue for now. If this was important for the culprit, it's likely they'll try to get it back, so I'll make sure to keep it safe until we get out.
entries.new: 先继续走吧。如果这东西对犯人来说很重要，对方多半会设法取回去，在出去之前，我会妥善保管。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: We accepted that and moved on.{w} The next room was no different from the previous. Katei went ahead and began to make sure nothing had been stolen from its cabinets.
entries.new: 我们接受了这个安排，继续前进。{w} 下一个房间与之前那间并无不同。Katei 走在前面，开始逐一确认展示柜里没有东西失窃。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Sai approached me while I was separated from the others. Anticipating his reason, I was first to speak.
entries.new: 我与其他人分开的时候，Sai 走了过来。我料到他的来意，便先开了口。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Do you still doubt Katei? I think he did a good job of proving his sincerity.
entries.new: 你还在怀疑 Katei 吗？我觉得他已经很好地证明了自己的诚意。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Oh, of course I do. I'll agree that he's pretty good at lying.
entries.new: 哦，当然怀疑。我倒是承认，他撒谎的本事相当高明。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: You already realized he was never in the security room, right? Why are you defending him?
entries.new: 你早就发现他根本没在监控室里待过，对吧？为什么还要替他说话？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...I looked at Katei. He was putting up with Isla and acting interested in the gems he'd presumably seen hundreds of times.
entries.new: ……我看向 Katei。他正耐着性子应付 Isla，装出一副对宝石很感兴趣的样子——那些宝石他大概已经看过几百遍了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Are you certain he wasn't?
entries.new: 你确定他不在？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: He couldn't have been there after the alarm went off. I checked the time needed for the computer to go to sleep, and that confirmed it. The only other possibility is that he was there and lied about using the computer, but that doesn't make it any better.
entries.new: 警报响过之后，他不可能在那里。我查过电脑进入休眠需要多久，这就足以确认了。剩下的唯一可能，就是他当时确实在监控室，却谎称自己用过电脑，可这只会让情况更糟。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Have you considered that the computer time might not have been accurate?
entries.new: 你有没有想过，电脑上的时间也许并不准确？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: The computer time?
entries.new: 电脑上的时间？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Yes. If it was wrong, Katei could've had the time to be there without lying.
entries.new: 对。如果时间有误，Katei 就有可能真的去过监控室，而不必撒谎。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Yeah, and then lied about how much time he spent outside it.
entries.new: 是啊，然后再谎报自己在外面待了多久。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I know. Maybe you're right and there's no other explanation.
entries.new: 我知道。也许你说得对，除此之外没有别的解释。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I have considered the computer time being wrong, and not only that.
entries.new: 电脑时间出错的可能，我早就想过，而且还不止这一点。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Sai raised his sleeve. Under it, there was a digital wristwatch.
entries.new: Sai 撩起袖子，腕上戴着一块电子手表。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I always wear this. It doesn't seem like there are wall clocks anywhere, so the time displayed on the computer is the only source we have available.
entries.new: 我一直戴着它。这里似乎哪儿都没有挂钟，所以电脑上显示的时间是我们唯一能参照的。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Besides my wristwatch, that is. My time and the computer's are the same.
entries.new: 当然，除了我这块表。我的时间和电脑上的时间是一致的。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I see... So that can't be it either.
entries.new: 原来如此……那么这条也说不通了。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Well, as I said, I didn't consider that the computer time was wrong, but rather that someone went way further than that.
entries.new: 就像我说的，我考虑的根本不是电脑时间出错，而是有人做得远比那更绝。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Oh... I-I see what you mean. Yeah, that should be the only way out Katei has.
entries.new: 哦……我、我明白你的意思了。是啊，那应该是 Katei 唯一的出路了。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Yeah. If someone messed with my wristwatch while I was unconscious, they could've made me falsely confirm the computer's time.{w} Someone could have done that to frame Katei.{w} It's too ridiculous to consider it seriously. They'd need to know that Katei would say everything he said only to turn around and disprove it with the computer's sleep mode, risking the possibility of nobody noticing it.
entries.new: 对。如果有人趁我昏迷时动过我这块表，就能让我错误地替电脑时间作证。{w} 也可以借此栽赃 Katei。{w} 不过这种设想太过荒唐，不值得当真。对方必须事先料到 Katei 会说出那一整套话，然后再用电脑的休眠模式把它推翻——而且还得赌没人会察觉。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: And not only that, but it's also something that only works with the people who got trapped. This wouldn't mean anything if we brought it up outside.{w} And Katei, who didn't fall unconscious, would've said the time was wrong. It would be insane for him to create a problem for himself by changing my watch time.{w} He also let us talk to Suripo, who could've mentioned the time at any moment.
entries.new: 而且不止如此，这种做法只对被困在这里的人有效。要是我们到外面提起，根本说明不了什么。{w} 再说，Katei 并没有失去意识，大可以一口咬定时间不对。他若改了我的表，等于给自己找麻烦，实在说不通。{w} 他还让我们和 Suripo 交谈，而 Suripo 随时都可能提到时间。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...But why would Katei lie about being in the security room? Do you actually think he's responsible?
entries.new: ……可 Katei 为什么要谎称自己去过监控室？你真的认为他就是幕后之人？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Or heavily involved in some way. There's no way he's not hiding anything or looking to gain something.
entries.new: 或者至少深度参与其中。他绝不可能毫无隐瞒、也别无所图。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: So, you don't believe his story about how the Sekimeiya was found? You were accusing him of lying about that too.
entries.new: 那么，你不信他说的 Sekimeiya 是怎么被发现的那套话？你刚才也在指责他在这件事上撒谎。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Oh, no. I do believe everything that he said there. It just gave him even more of a motive.
entries.new: 哦，不。那部分我全都相信。正因为如此，他的动机反而更充分了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I still think the Sekimeiya has to be the core of all this. That has to be right.{w} Now, don't you find it strange that a simple security member would know all that?
entries.new: 我仍然认为，Sekimeiya 才是这一切的核心。这一点应该没错。{w} 那么，你不觉得奇怪吗——区区一个保安，竟然知道这么多？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: He said it in a desperate time because he wanted to earn our trust, which is why he relied on factual truth to lessen our suspicion.
entries.new: 他是在那种走投无路的关头说出口的，为的是博取我们的信任，所以才会借着事实来减轻我们的怀疑。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: But what I think he did was change his own perspective. I'm telling you this in case you think I'm missing something, but I think all he did was merge his version with what Suripo told us to form an accurate story and pass it off as something Ashiya told him.
entries.new: 但我认为，他只是换了个角度。我提前说明，是怕你觉得我漏掉了什么——我觉得他做的只是把自己的说法和 Suripo 告诉我们的内容拼在一起，凑成一个准确的故事，然后说成是芦屋告诉他的。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I don't follow.
entries.new: 我没听懂。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I'm saying he could be the the guy who originally found the Sekimeiya. He didn't know about what Suripo told us beforehand. Otherwise, he would've said it all to earn our trust.{w} Once he knew about Suripo's factual story, he combined his own knowledge with it to make us believe he truly works in the tower.
entries.new: 我是说，他很可能就是最初发现 Sekimeiya 的那个人。他事先并不知道 Suripo 告诉我们的那些事。否则，他早就全盘说出来博取信任了。{w} 等他听说了 Suripo 那套有据可查的说法之后，便把自己的见闻和它拼在一起，好让我们相信他真的在塔里工作。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: The way he detailed some things was very questionable. He knew the exact location where the Sekimeiya was found, and everything he told us was information the person who found it would've known after hearing Suripo's story.
entries.new: 他描述某些细节的方式很可疑。他知道 Sekimeiya 被发现的准确位置，而他告诉我们的每一件事，都是一个发现者在听过 Suripo 的说法之后就能掌握的信息。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...That might be true, but it sounds like a pretty big assumption, and didn't he say the seller was already paid?
entries.new: ……也许吧，但这听起来是个相当大的假设。而且他不是说，卖家已经拿到钱了吗？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I'll tell you one of the theories I formed. It's all speculation, yes, but I think it could make sense given whoever's behind this already went pretty far with all the smoke.
entries.new: 我把我想到的一个推测告诉你。没错，这全是猜想，但考虑到幕后之人连那些烟雾都用上了，事情已经做得相当出格，我觉得这个推测还算说得通。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I haven't told you this since it might not mean anything. You and I both showed up early and were at the front of the line for a while, in front of the hallway B door.
entries.new: 这件事我一直没说，因为可能毫无意义。你和我都到得很早，还在 B走廊门前排了一阵子的队，位置相当靠前。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Right. We didn't have a way to check the time, but we were definitely there for a few hours.
entries.new: 没错。我们当时没法确认时间，但确实在那里等了几个小时。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: All right. So at approximately {time=8}, I saw Katei in the lobby. The reason why I started questioning him so quickly was because when I first saw him, he was wearing normal clothes.
entries.new: 好。大约在 {time=8}，我在大厅里看见了 Katei。我之所以那么快就开始质问他，是因为我第一次看见他的时候，他穿的是便服。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Of course, back then, I didn't think anything of it. I don't know what he did either. I just saw him for a few seconds, and I'm certain he was never actually in line.
entries.new: 当然，那时我并没多想，也不知道他做了什么。我只看见他几秒钟，而且可以肯定，他从来没真正排过队。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Considering everything, I think this is one of the ways everything could've played out. Take whatever you want from it.
entries.new: 综合这些来看，整件事可能是这么发生的。至于你能从中得出什么，随你。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: The person claiming to be called Katei found the Sekimeiya a couple weeks ago. He contacted the Ashiya family, and given their interest, they bought it from him.
entries.new: 那个自称 Katei 的人，在两三周前发现了 Sekimeiya。他联系了芦屋家，对方正有兴趣，便从他手里买下了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: At no point did he expect they'd set up so much advertisement for his own find. It's possible Ashiya said things that were wrong only to draw people in, and perhaps not being credited with the discovery bothered him.
entries.new: 他万万没想到，他们会为他发现的这东西大张旗鼓地宣传。芦屋说不定故意说了些不实之词来招揽人群；而发现者的名分没落到自己头上，或许也让他心里不快。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: It's a pretty plain motive, but think about it. If you sold it to them and they started playing up its value like crazy, would you be happy about how little you were paid? The scale of this attack is a bit much for one normal person to come up with, but things line up here.
entries.new: 这动机很普通，但你想想：如果你把它卖给了他们，他们却开始拼命抬高它的价值，你会甘心自己只拿到那么点钱吗？这样一场袭击，不是普通人一个人能策划出来的，但在这件事上，线索都对得上。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Xyn isn't behind this, which is why it's happening during the day. He enters the tower at {time=8:00} this morning. He could have somehow met with the real Katei Kuiji and learned about the alarm and emergency contact line from him.
entries.new: 这事背后不是 Xyn——也正因如此，它才会发生在白天。他今天早上 {time=8:00} 进入塔内，有可能设法见到了真正的 Katei Kuiji，并从对方口中问出了警报和紧急联络线路的事。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: The way he learned that information isn't important. At the very least, I know the man with us right now wasn't in the lobby shortly after I saw him. What matters is that they met and he put on Katei's clothes. Then, he proceeded to hide Katei somewhere without cameras.
entries.new: 他是怎么问出来的并不重要。至少我知道，此刻跟我们待在一起的那个男人，在我看见他之后没多久并不在大厅里。要紧的是他们见了面，他换上了 Katei 的衣服，随后把 Katei 藏到了没有监控的地方。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: He could have done this any number of ways, but Katei was charged with keeping track of the security cameras, so obviously nobody would notice his body being hidden if he was the one who was supposed to watch everything.
entries.new: 他动手的方式可以有很多种。但负责看监控的偏偏是 Katei——既然本该盯着所有画面的人就是他自己，自然谁也不会察觉他被藏了起来。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Along with the clothes, he also took the security room key. Then, he released the smoke in the two hallways and event room through some method I'm unaware of. It's likely he knew he'd get trapped by doing so.
entries.new: 除了衣服，他还拿走了监控室的钥匙。接着，他用某种我不知道的手段，让两条走廊和活动室都弥漫起烟雾。他多半清楚，这么做会把自己也困在里头。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: He acted as if he'd found us and played the role of a security member to justify his presence in the tower.
entries.new: 他装作偶然发现了我们，又扮演起保安的角色，好让自己待在塔里显得名正言顺。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Naomi... It's possible he hid her body while she was unconscious. He'd have a good reason for it, because Naomi would've revealed that he doesn't work in the tower.
entries.new: Naomi……他有可能趁她昏迷时把她藏了起来。他这么做理由充分——Naomi 一旦开口，就会戳穿他根本不在塔里工作。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: By saying everything is confidential, he's managed to avoid explaining anything he doesn't know. He lied about spending any time in the security room since he'd been carrying out this plan of his. That's why he knew things only a person inside the room with all the monitors would've known without actually being there.
entries.new: 他一句「一切保密」，就避开了所有自己答不上来的事。他谎称在监控室待过，因为他一直在执行自己的计划。所以他明明从未进去过，却知道些只有守着满墙监视器的人才说得出的事。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Suripo clearly told us that security staff would stay in the room and relay information through the installed microphone. But Katei told us that he left it because he didn't know about that before talking to Suripo. He said he used the microphone while we were unconscious, but I'm sure he was lying.
entries.new: Suripo 明确告诉过我们，保安应当留在房间里，通过装好的麦克风传递消息。可 Katei 说，他在和 Suripo 谈过之前并不知道这回事，所以才离开了监控室。他还说在我们昏迷时用过那支麦克风——我敢肯定他在撒谎。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I don't know why he let us talk to the outside, but it's possible he had something to gain from that. Maybe he wanted everyone outside to think that Katei Kuiji really is in the tower and that everything here is going well.{w} Maybe he wanted to make sure the bait gemstones worked and tricked Ashiya. This is so messy that it almost feels unrelated to what he did, but that can't be it.
entries.new: 我不知道他为什么让我们和外界通话，但也许他能从中得到什么好处。也许他想让外面的人都相信 Katei Kuiji 确实在塔里，这里一切顺利。{w} 也许他想确认那些诱饵宝石起了作用，骗过了芦屋。整件事太乱了，简直像跟他做的事无关，但不可能只是这样。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Anyway, it all comes down to this: he had no way to get the Sekimeiya out without spending twelve hours here, so he's intentionally spending twelve hours here.
entries.new: 总之，一切归结起来就是：他若不在这里耗满十二个小时，就没法把 Sekimeiya 带出去，所以他是有意在这里待满十二个小时的。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I don't know how this plan ends. I have no idea how he intends to get the Sekimeiya out once the exit opens, but consider the following. If he manages to do it, nobody will miss him—none of us will know who he actually was. I'm only speculating that he originally found the Sekimeiya to give an easy explanation for all the knowledge he's had since the start.
entries.new: 我不知道这个计划最终会怎样收场，也想不出出口一开，他打算怎么把 Sekimeiya 带出去。但请想一想：如果他真做成了，没有人会惦记他——我们谁都不会知道他到底是谁。我只能推测，他最初发现 Sekimeiya，不过是为了给自己从一开始就掌握的那些知识找个现成的解释。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Once he makes it out, only the Sekimeiya will be missing. Katei Kuiji will still be here, since he's where that guy talking to Isla right now hid him. This ghost of a person will have escaped with the real target.
entries.new: 等他一出去，失踪的只会是 Sekimeiya。Katei Kuiji 仍会留在这里——此刻正和 Isla 说话的那个家伙，就把他藏在了那里。这个连身份都不存在的幽灵，将带着真正的目标扬长而去。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...After saying it all out loud, I know it sounds pretty absurd, but whatever this plan is, it has to be far from over. There are a lot of things that don't make sense, and somehow, the Sekimeiya is still in its cabinet as if nothing happened.
entries.new: ……全部说出来之后，我自己也知道听起来相当荒唐。但不管这个计划是什么，它都远没有结束。说不通的地方太多了，而 Sekimeiya 竟然还好端端地待在展示柜里，像什么都没发生过一样。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Also, one last thing.{w} We only think that what we saw is the Sekimeiya because Katei told us so. The plan could already be further along. The real Sekimeiya could've been replaced while we were asleep.{w} That could be another reason why Naomi's presence had to be taken care of, as she would expose that illusion.
entries.new: 另外，还有最后一件事。{w} 我们之所以认定看到的就是 Sekimeiya，全是因为 Katei 这么说。计划也许早就推进得更远了——真正的 Sekimeiya 可能在我们睡着时就被换掉了。{w} 这也许也是必须处理掉 Naomi 的另一个原因，因为她会戳穿这个假象。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...I'm done. What do you think? Do you agree with anything?
entries.new: ……我说完了。你怎么看？有哪一点你同意吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I was looking at the floor, and I'd been listening to everything expressionlessly. Katei remained engaged with Isla while her mother looked on from behind. Akaro and Shiroya were leaning against the wall, waiting to move on. Before I responded, we all walked to the next room, A4.
entries.new: 我一直低着头盯着地面，面无表情地听完了这一切。Katei 仍在和 Isla 周旋，她母亲在后面看着。Akaro 和 Shiroya 靠着墙，等着继续往前走。我还没开口，大家已经一起走向了下一个房间——A4。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I waited for Katei and Isla to begin uncovering the cabinets before resuming the conversation with Sai.
entries.new: 等到 Katei 和 Isla 开始掀开展示柜的遮布，我才接着和 Sai 说下去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: *sigh* I don't think I can directly object to anything you said...
entries.new: 唉……你说的这些，我好像哪一条都没法直接反驳。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Admittedly, I did think Sai's theory was a leap. It didn't have to be wrong, and I had come to a similar idea myself, but some of his assumptions were a bit of a reach. Despite Sai's fervor, I cared about what was going on as well.
entries.new: 我承认，Sai 的推理确实有些跳跃。它未必就是错的——我自己也想到过类似的思路——但他有些假设实在牵强。尽管 Sai 说得激动，我也一样在意眼前的局面。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There was no way it had been an accident. Many things indicated that nothing had happened coincidentally: the particular day, the smoke locations, the alarm, the recurring Xyn events, Naomi...
entries.new: 这绝不可能是意外。太多迹象都表明，没有一件事是巧合：特意选定的这一天、烟雾出现的位置、警报、反复出现的 Xyn 事件、Naomi……
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Before anything else, there are two options to choose from. The plan failed, probably because of the new alarm, or the plan hasn't ended yet.
entries.new: 首先，摆在我们面前的只有两种可能：计划失败了——多半是因为那套新警报；或者，计划还没有结束。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: If whatever this plan is hasn't ended, it's almost certain that a culprit must be here with us.{w} Who would that be, and what do they intend to do next?
entries.new: 如果这个计划尚未结束，那几乎可以肯定，犯人就在我们之中。{w} 会是谁？接下来又想做什么？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: There weren't that many possibilities.
entries.new: 可能性并不多。
entries.speaker: i
