entries.text: What, did Naomi jump into the wall and break her head open?
entries.new: 怎么，难道是 Naomi 自己一头撞上墙，把头撞破了？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...Remember when the elevator went up before you all reached this floor? It stopped on the sixth. Shiroya and I made sure nobody could've gone unnoticed, but there's a way around that.
entries.new: ……还记得你们上来之前，电梯先往上走了一趟吗？它停在了六楼。Shiroya 和我确认过，没人能在不被察觉的情况下上去——不过，还有办法可以绕开。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Right, through the door we can't open.
entries.new: 对，走那扇我们打不开的门。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: The one leading to the attic.
entries.new: 通向阁楼的那扇。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: ...He's right. Someone could've gone in before we got there.
entries.new: ……他说得对。也许有人在我们赶到之前就进去了。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Shiroya was trying not to let the shock and despair consume her, and I was glad to be backed up. Even though Erina and Isla should've reacted to the mention of a door they hadn't seen, they didn't so much as twitch.
entries.new: Shiroya 正竭力不让震惊与绝望将自己吞没；有人替我说话，我自然松了口气。提到一扇她们从未见过的门，Erina 和 Isla 本应有所反应，可她们连眉头都没动一下。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But it was locked, right? Didn't Katei say that a unique key was required to enter the attic?
entries.new: 可那扇门是锁着的吧？Katei 不是说过，要进阁楼必须用一把专用的钥匙吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Yes, but imagining a culprit with that key isn't all that crazy, is it?
entries.new: 没错，可假设凶手手里有那把钥匙，也不算荒唐吧？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: *sigh*
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Please... This is just pathetic to watch.
entries.new: 够了……这种戏码，实在让人看不下去。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Hm? What is?
entries.new: 嗯？看不下去什么？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: It also took me by surprise. Katei was looking directly at me.
entries.new: 我也吃了一惊。Katei 正直直地看着我。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Atsuki, stop trying to find nonexistent ways out.{w} You are the one who killed Naomi.
entries.new: Atsuki，别再去找那些根本不存在的方法了。{w} 杀死 Naomi 的人，就是你。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: You're kidding, right...? You're accusing him?
entries.new: 你在开玩笑吧……？你是在指控他？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: He absolutely could not have done it. You had the opportunity to at least accuse me.
entries.new: 他绝对不可能做到。真要指控，至少也该冲我来——我才有那个机会。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I was still recovering from the most unexpected words I could've heard. He had, without warning, accused me of killing Naomi...
entries.new: 这句话完全在我的意料之外，我一时回不过神。他毫无征兆地指控我杀了 Naomi……
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I'm sorry, but how do you think I did that? I was always with Shiroya, and security cameras recorded every one of my actions on the upper floors.
entries.new: ……抱歉，可你觉得我是怎么办到的？我一直和 Shiroya 在一起，上层的监控也把我的一举一动全拍了下来。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: And not only that, he didn't have a chance to make it down without being spotted.
entries.new: 不止如此，他根本不可能下楼还不被人发现。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: That's why I have to come to the conclusion that you're all lying to me. All of you.
entries.new: 所以我只能得出这个结论——你们全都在骗我。你们每一个人。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: I'm sure of it. Atsuki was here when Naomi and I were on this floor. You guys are giving him a very solid alibi, one that's not possible to circumvent. That's why you must all be lying.
entries.new: 我确信如此。我和 Naomi 在这一层的时候，Atsuki 就在这里。你们给他编了一个无懈可击的不在场证明，根本无从绕开。所以你们一定都在说谎。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: However, it is as you say. Security cameras had to record what happened in this room and on the office floors. Your lie won't last long once the system is recovered.
entries.new: 不过，正如你们所说。监控一定拍下了这个房间和办公层发生的事。等系统恢复，你们的谎言撑不了多久。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: What's gotten into you...? At least your lies earlier had some effort.
entries.new: 你这是怎么了……？至少你先前编的谎话还费了点心思。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: He's right. This is almost disappointing. Try to convince anyone of that.
entries.new: 他说得对。这话听着简直令人失望。你倒是去说服别人看看。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: For the first time, one of Sai's retorts was well-received by everyone else. Katei had alleged they were all liars, but they knew the truth: I hadn't killed Naomi.
entries.new: 这是头一回，Sai 的反唇相讥得到了其他人的一致认可。Katei 一口咬定他们全在撒谎，可他们清楚真相：Naomi 不是我杀的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: You're only digging your own grave by acting as if we're all conspiring against you. You had an actual method of escape that Atsuki provided you with. Taking it would've been a much smarter decision than accusing him.
entries.new: 你非要把我们都说成串通一气，只会自掘坟墓。Atsuki 明明给了你一条真正的脱身之路。接受它，可比反过来指控他明智得多。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: It's especially idiotic even for this guy. Why are you saying that Atsuki was on this floor?
entries.new: 这种事搁在他身上也蠢得离谱。你凭什么说 Atsuki 就在这一层？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Because I saw him!{w} After Naomi left, when she understood that I wasn't buying it, I heard a noise. In this hallway, B, I saw Atsuki.
entries.new: 因为我亲眼看见他了！{w}Naomi 走后——她明白我根本不信那套说辞——我听见了动静。就在这条 B走廊上，我看见了 Atsuki。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: It surprised me, so I kept silent and waited for him to move. However, trying not to be seen also made me lose track of him completely. I looked around a bit, but I couldn't find him or Naomi again.
entries.new: 我吃了一惊，便没有出声，等着他先动。可我一心不想被看见，反倒彻底跟丢了他。我四下找了一阵，却再没找到他，也没找到 Naomi。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: When I went back up, I saw him with the others, and you all said that he could not have been downstairs. That's what leads me to the conclusion that you've all been lying to me.
entries.new: 等我回到上面，却看见他和大家待在一起，而你们都说他不可能在楼下。这让我只能断定，你们全都在骗我。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: ...That ridiculous claim, if anything, explained why Katei had insisted multiple times that the elevator group might've been able to sneak down. Naturally, though, it was met with silence and shared disapproval.
entries.new: ……这番荒唐的说辞，倒是解释了他为何几次三番咬定电梯那一组人有可能偷偷下楼。当然，回应他的只有沉默和众人的不以为然。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: At least this proves you're nothing but a lying machine. Your fuel must've run out and now you can only fabricate these limp little things.
entries.new: 至少这证明了你就是个撒谎机器。看来你的燃料已经耗尽，如今只能编出这种软绵绵的瞎话。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: You think you sound smart, but I believe all of us here know that you are the one lying.
entries.new: 你自以为说得聪明，可我相信这里所有人都清楚，撒谎的人是你。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Let me just tell it to you straight. In the one in a million chance that you're either telling the truth or hallucinating, what you saw could not have been Atsuki. If you actually saw someone, it wasn't him.
entries.new: 我就直说了吧。即便你真有百万分之一的可能说了实话，或者只是产生了幻觉，你看见的也不可能是 Atsuki。你若真看见了什么人，那也不是他。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Incorrect. I am certain it was him. His clothes could've been borrowed, but borrowing a face and the size of someone's body is much different. I don't know why you're all lying and aiding a criminal, but I'm certain of what I saw.
entries.new: 不对。我确信那就是他。衣服可以借，但一张脸、一副身量，可不是随便借得来的。我不知道你们为什么都要撒谎、包庇一个凶手，但我对自己看见的东西深信不疑。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Then we're left with a hallucination. You get your brain checked recently?
entries.new: 那就只剩下幻觉这一种可能了。你最近检查过脑子没有？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I will refrain from saying anything else. When this is all thoroughly investigated by the police, the truth will be proven.
entries.new: 我不再多说了。等警方把这一切彻底查清，真相自会水落石出。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: As I knew I hadn't killed anyone, I hadn't been seriously considering any of it. I'd ruled it as just Katei's desperate, pathetic, and ineffective way of not being suspected.
entries.new: 我清楚自己没杀过人，所以这些话我根本没往心里去。我只当那是 Katei 为了摆脱嫌疑，走投无路之下使出的拙劣手段，既可怜又无用。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: My attention had been drawn to one of the cabinets present with us in the room. At first glance, it looked like every other cabinet we'd seen, but there was something unusual about it.
entries.new: 它的右侧有个像是小转轮的东西。我想看仔细些，便走了过去，小心不踩到地上的血迹。走近时，我又闻到那股从未闻过的奇怪气味——它已经开始不知不觉地和周围的空气混在一起。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: On its right side was what looked to be a small wheel. To get a closer look, I approached it, making sure not to step on any of the blood. As I moved to it, I was once again reminded of the inexplicable odor I had never smelled before, which was starting to blend in seamlessly.
entries.new: 它的右侧有个像是小转轮的东西。我想看仔细些，便走了过去，小心不踩到地上的血迹。走近时，那股从未闻过的莫名气味又一次扑来——它已经开始悄无声息地融入四周。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Did you see something?
entries.new: ……你看到什么了？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Yes, this.{w} Oh, it's a temperature regulator.
entries.new: 嗯，这个。{w}哦，是温度调节器。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: How interesting. What's it set at?
entries.new: 有意思。设定在多少？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Nothing. It says "room temperature".
entries.new: 什么都没设。上面写着「室温」。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I turned around to meet Katei's eyes.
entries.new: 我转过身，迎上 Katei 的目光。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Some cabinets have temperature functions, like the Sekimeiya's. This room has them.
entries.new: ……有些展示柜带温控功能，存放 Sekimeiya 的那只就是。这个房间里也有。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: The white wheel looked a bit damaged, which was what caught my attention. Anything could've caused that, but it stood out from everything else in the room.
entries.new: 那个白色转轮看上去有些损坏，正是这一点引起了我的注意。造成损坏的原因可能有很多，但它在这房间里格外扎眼。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I kept inspecting it. Behind it, I quickly noticed another similar wheel, a bit smaller in size.
entries.new: 我继续查看。很快，我注意到它后面还有一个类似的转轮，个头略小一些。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: And what's this one for?
entries.new: 那这个又是做什么的？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: That one? It regulates the temperature.
entries.new: 那个？也是调节温度的。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: I can see the degrees symbol, but this one isn't set to anything, not even to "room temperature". I mean, why are there two of them?
entries.new: 我能看到度数符号，可这个什么都没设定，连「室温」都不是。我是说，为什么会有两个？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Well, I think that one regulates the temperature of the gems behind the glass while the big one regulates the temperature inside the cabinet.
entries.new: 这个嘛，我想那个是调节玻璃后面宝石的温度，大的那个则调节展示柜内部的温度。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: I see, to store gems that also require a determined temperature.
entries.new: 原来如此，用来存放那些同样需要恒定温度的宝石。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I tried to lift up the cover, but it was too heavy.
entries.new: 我试着抬起盖子，可它太重了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: How do I open it, though? I don't seem to be able to.
entries.new: 不过，这要怎么打开？我好像打不开。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I don't know, I've never opened one.
entries.new: 我不知道，我从没开过这种东西。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: And you've never seen anyone opening one through the cameras.
entries.new: 而且你也从没在监控里见过别人打开它。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...Perhaps I have. I think they first look behind the cabinet, but I'm not sure what the process is. These cabinets have an actual method of locking them so that the temperature inside is well-preserved.
entries.new: ……也许见过。我记得他们先是查看展示柜后面，但具体流程我不清楚。这种展示柜有专门的锁定方式，好让内部温度保持稳定。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: I tried following his instructions. Behind the cabinet and next to the wheel, there was a tiny plastic latch that I was able to open.
entries.new: 我照他说的试了试。展示柜后面、转轮旁边，有一个小小的塑料卡扣，我把它打开了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I think it should be unlocked now...
entries.new: 现在应该解锁了吧……
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I put my hands under the lid and brought it up while everyone else stared at me dubiously. Then, Sai began to approach me with curiosity.
entries.new: 我把双手伸到盖子底下，将它抬起，其他人则一脸狐疑地盯着我。随后，Sai 好奇地朝我走了过来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Like before, I was able to open it with ease. When I had fully opened it and kept the lid supported against the wall, I looked inside.
entries.new: 和刚才一样，我没费什么力气就打开了。我把盖子完全掀开，让它靠着墙撑住，然后朝里面看去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There was no appreciable change in temperature, as the wheel hadn't been set to anything. However, there certainly was something inside. I saw the Sekimeiya resting at the bottom, covered by walls with a velvet texture and emitting a faint glow.
entries.new: 转轮没有设定任何温度，所以温度几乎没有什么变化。然而，里面确实有东西。我看见 Sekimeiya 静静躺在底部，四壁覆着天鹅绒般的质地，隐隐泛着微光。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I-It's here.{w} I have no idea why, but it's here.
entries.new: 它、它在这里。{w}我不知道为什么，但它就在这里。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Before the others could react, I stretched out my arm to grab it. With one hand, I leaned on the cabinet to support my weight while I put the other inside. As I slowly approached it, I thought to myself: what possible purpose could anyone have for leaving the Sekimeiya there?
entries.new: 没等其他人反应过来，我已伸出手去抓它。我一只手撑在展示柜上支住身体，另一只手探了进去。手缓缓靠近时，我心里想着：究竟谁会出于什么目的，把 Sekimeiya 留在那种地方？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Without giving it much thought, I touched the surface of the egg-shaped object.{w} A burst of heat flowed through my fingers, and the world broke.
entries.new: 我没再多想，指尖触上了那枚蛋形物体的表面。{w}一股灼热顺着手指导入体内，随即，世界碎裂了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: B-Side
entries.new: B-Side

entries.text: The burning sensation vanished, and I was no longer stretching out my arm. Before me was a long corridor that I'd seen before.{w} My body froze, and I broke out in a cold sweat. A heavy cloak of confusion was cast on me as my heart took off like a rocket.
entries.new: 灼烧感消失了，我的手臂也不再向前伸着。眼前是一条我见过的长走廊。{w}我浑身僵住，冷汗直冒。浓重的困惑笼罩着我，心脏狂跳不止。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Something had happened to me—something that I hadn't ever experienced before. When I slowly began to discern my surroundings, I saw that I was in hallway A, next to the lobby.
entries.new: 我身上发生了什么——一件我从未经历过的事。等我慢慢辨清周围，才发现自己身处A走廊，就在大厅旁边。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I tried to calm down and think. I timidly moved my head and saw the huge shutter blocking my way to the outside world. Around the hallway A door, dark marks left by the smoke were easily noticeable.
entries.new: 我试着冷静下来思考。我怯怯地转过头，看见那扇巨大的卷帘门堵住了通往外面的路。A走廊的门周围，烟雾留下的暗色痕迹清晰可见。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Next, I moved my legs forward. I was still able to control my whole body; nothing seemed to have changed in that regard. I moved up to hallway B, which surrounded me with its dark, unsettling scenery and pure silence.
entries.new: 接着，我迈步向前。我仍能自如地控制全身，这方面似乎没有任何异样。我走到B走廊，那里幽暗而不安的景象与彻骨的寂静将我团团围住。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: In the right wall, I could see the door of the room I'd been in a few seconds ago. It was closed, like all the others.
entries.new: 右侧的墙上，我能看见几秒前自己还待着的那间房的门。它关着，和其余的门一样。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: As I gently approached it, I tried to think about what could've happened. However, it was as bizarre as it sounded: I had touched the Sekimeiya and appeared in the lobby.
entries.new: 我轻手轻脚地靠近，一边琢磨究竟发生了什么。可这件事说起来就匪夷所思：我碰了一下Sekimeiya，人就出现在了大厅。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Not only that, but it had been instantaneous. Not a moment of time had seemed to pass before my surroundings changed.
entries.new: 不仅如此，这一切还是瞬间发生的。周围景象变换之前，仿佛连一瞬的时间都没有流逝。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I gripped the knob. As soon as I started to open the door, I saw blood. On the floor, Naomi's dead body rested, her face clearly distressed. My senses alerted me of another change: the strange smell didn't appear to exist anymore.
entries.new: 我握住门把手。刚一推开门，我就看见了血。Naomi的尸体躺在地上，脸上分明写满痛苦。我的感官又察觉到另一处变化：那股奇怪的气味似乎已经不存在了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I kept looking inside the room. Everyone else had already left it, and the cabinet I'd opened was closed.
entries.new: 我继续往房里看。其他人都已经离开了，我打开过的展示柜也合上了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The haunting atmosphere radiating throughout the room was overwhelming, and it chased me out. I closed the door behind me and made an effort at breathing properly to calm myself down. What the hell was happening?
entries.new: 弥漫在整个房间里的阴森气息压得人喘不过气，把我逼了出来。我随手关上门，努力平稳呼吸让自己镇定下来。到底出什么事了？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Was there a blank spot in my memory? Had I forgotten about something past the last memory I had?
entries.new: 是我的记忆出现了空白吗？我是不是不记得最后那段记忆之后发生的事了？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Nothing made sense. It couldn't make sense. The others had disappeared, and I had, in the blink of an eye, moved from one place to another.
entries.new: 一切都说不通。根本不可能说得通。其他人不见了，而我眨眼之间就从一处到了另一处。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Was I knocked out?{w} I had my back against the others when I reached for the Sekimeiya, but wouldn't I remember it? Wouldn't I feel pain in my head if I was hit?
entries.new: ……我是被打晕了吗？{w}我伸手去够Sekimeiya的时候，背还对着其他人，可真要那样，我总该记得才对。要是挨了一下，头上也该疼吧？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: And... when I realized I was somewhere different than before, I was standing up. If I'd been knocked out, I would've woken up on the floor...
entries.new: 而且……等我意识到自己不在原来的地方时，我是站着的。如果真被打晕了，我醒来时该是躺在地上的……
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: No matter how I thought of it, it felt as if no time had passed between the Sekimeiya's touch and the change in what I was looking at. To put it bluntly, it felt as if I had teleported between places.
entries.new: 无论怎么想，从碰到Sekimeiya到眼前的景象改变，中间好像一点时间也没过去。说得直白些，就像我是传送到了别处。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: However, that was impossible. There must've been a reason why it had felt like that.
entries.new: 可那是不可能的。我会有那种感觉，一定另有原因。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I opened the door to the event room. Nothing but a single, ugly cabinet was inside. I couldn't see its contents, but I didn't care. I kept looking through every room in the hallway to find the people that should've been there—to confirm that I hadn't been left alone and to understand what had happened to me.
entries.new: 我推开活动室的门。里面只有一个难看的展示柜。我看不见柜里的东西，也不在意。我把走廊上的每一间房都看了个遍，想找到本该在这里的那些人——想确认自己没有被独自丢下，也想弄清我到底出了什么事。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I opened and closed every door in quick succession until I knew that I was on a desolate floor. ...Where was Shiroya?
entries.new: 我一扇接一扇地开门又关门，直到确定这一层空无一人。……Shiroya在哪里？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: In front of me was the elevator door. I wanted to see the others, so I called it. If they were somewhere above me, they would hear the sound and come down to find me.
entries.new: 面前是电梯门。我想见到其他人，于是叫了电梯。如果他们在我上面某层，应该能听见声音，下来找我。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: After I pressed the button, though, nothing happened.
entries.new: 然而按下按钮之后，什么反应都没有。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Is it here?
entries.new: ……是在这里吗？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I grabbed the handle of the large, metallic door. As I'd suspected, I was able to open it.
entries.new: 我抓住那扇金属大门的把手。果然如我所料，门能打开。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Since I wouldn't be able to draw people down to me, I had to modify my idea. I boarded the tiny elevator and pressed the button for the sixth floor. If anyone could hear it, I hoped they'd be lured.
entries.new: 既然没法把人引下来，我只好换个办法。我走进狭小的电梯，按下六楼的按钮。要是有人听见，我希望那声音能引他们过来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It was my second time taking a full six-floor trip in that gloomy space, and being alone only made it worse. Just what had happened? I'd been accumulating questions since we'd gotten trapped, but the situation I was in surpassed all of them.
entries.new: 这是我第二次在这个阴暗的空间里坐完六层楼，独自一人只觉得更难熬。究竟发生了什么？自从被困在这里，我心里的疑问越积越多，可眼下的处境却比所有疑问都更叫人费解。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Being alone let me look inside the elevator freely. ...I stared at the red button with the word "stop" on it. They would usually stop it abruptly, mostly in case someone got stuck on a door. Other times, they'd only play a loud alarm throughout the building.
entries.new: 独自一人，反倒让我能随意打量电梯内部。……我盯着那个写着“stop”的红色按钮。平常他们会直接按下它让电梯急停，多半是为了防止有人被门夹住。还有些时候，整栋楼里只会响起刺耳的警报。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: On the wall next to it, there was a little paper with instructions detailing how it worked. I took the time to read it, trying to calm myself down.
entries.new: 旁边的墙上贴着一张纸条，上面详细说明了这个按钮的用法。我索性花时间读了一遍，借此让自己冷静下来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: "Pressing the stop button will instantly deactivate the elevator and contact an emergency line. It is strictly prohibited to press it without a good reason, and to prevent ulterior uses, the elevator won't be enabled again until a staff member consents. Keep in mind that you are being recorded."
entries.new: 「按下停止按钮，电梯将立即停止运行，并接通紧急专线。严禁无故按下此按钮；为防止不当使用，在工作人员确认之前，电梯不会重新启用。请注意，本区域设有监控录像。」
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I looked behind me, and sure enough, I saw a small camera in an upper corner with a green light on it. It seemed Ashiya had made sure the button would only be used during a real emergency. Regarding the contact line, it was likely it had been nullified by the alarm.
entries.new: 我回头看去，果然在上方角落发现一台小摄像头，绿灯正亮着。看来芦屋早已确保这个按钮只在真正的紧急情况下才会被按下。至于那条紧急专线，多半已经随警报一起失效了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The remaining seconds once again left me in awe at how unsettling that small and quiet elevator could get. Even though I could hear the friction of the ropes, that imposing and deep sound that was more than apparent outside couldn't be appreciated well from the interior.
entries.new: 余下的几秒又让我领教了这部狭小安静的电梯能阴森到什么地步。绳索的摩擦声我听得见，可那在外面格外明显的低沉压迫声，在轿厢里却听不真切。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I went to the highest accessible floor and hastily pushed the door open. The sight was just as I remembered. I remained solitary and was met with another silently overwhelming floor.
entries.new: 我来到能到达的最高一层，匆匆推开门。眼前的景象和我记忆中别无二致。我依旧孤身一人，面对的是又一个沉默得令人窒息的楼层。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: While I hoped people had heard me and were coming, I had to know whether there was someone around. We'd seen how easy it was to inspect those floors, so I started the same procedure from before.
entries.new: 我一方面盼着有人听见动静正赶过来，一方面也必须确认附近有没有人。我们已经知道检查这些楼层并不费力，于是我照旧开始。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I looked at the empty left corridor. A door was hiding from my field of vision, but there was nobody to be seen.
entries.new: 我望向空荡的左侧走廊。有一扇门藏在我的视野之外，但看不见半个人影。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Then, I made my way to the offices to see if they weren't vacant for some reason.{w} There was something I recognized in the first one.
entries.new: 随后我走向办公区，看看那里是不是也空无一人。{w}第一间里有样东西我认得。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The computer we'd powered on earlier still showed a lit screen and an empty prompt to input access information.
entries.new: 我们先前开过的那台电脑依然亮着屏，停留在等待输入访问信息的空提示框上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Without paying any mind to it, I entered the second partition. Being alone meant that I couldn't keep watch over the connecting corridor.
entries.new: 我没再多看它一眼，走进了第二个隔间。独自一人，就意味着我无法兼顾连接走廊那边的动静。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: In the second and third partitions, my only company was a functioning camera recording my every movement.{w} I sat on a chair and sighed deeply, unraveling at the sudden turn things had taken. Did we not have enough already? What the fuck had just happened!? My whole body hadn't stopped shaking for a second. I rejected the thought that any of it was real.
entries.new: 在第二和第三个隔间里，陪着我的只有一台运转中的摄像头，记录着我的一举一动。{w}我在椅子上坐下，长长叹了口气，被这突如其来的转折弄得心神溃散。我们遇到的麻烦还不够多吗？刚才到底他妈发生了什么！？我浑身抖个不停，一刻也没停过。我不肯相信这一切是真的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I left the offices once I felt ready to continue, but I was still hopeless.{w} I was about to repeat my movements on the floors below when I heard a very distinguishable sound coming from my left.
entries.new: 等我觉得自己能继续了，便离开办公区，可心里依旧茫然无着。{w}我正要下楼重复同样的搜索，左边忽然传来一个一听便知的声音。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Footsteps. And ones I knew I'd heard many times in the past. I turned around and saw Shiroya coming out of the left corridor.
entries.new: 脚步声。而且是我过去听过许多次的脚步声。我转过身，看见Shiroya从左侧走廊里走出来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I didn't have time to act surprised or throw a bunch of questions at her before she spoke.
entries.new: 我还没来得及露出惊讶的表情，也没来得及把一肚子问题抛给她，她就先开口了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Oh, you're here. I found something.
entries.new: 哦，你在这儿啊。我发现了点东西。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Completely unfazed, she opened the transparent door and entered the first partition. I was left outside, utterly bewildered.{w} Without looking back, she stepped to the next door.
entries.new: 她神色如常，推开那扇透明门走进了第一个隔间。我被撇在外面，彻底懵了。{w}她头也不回地走向下一扇门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: How was that her reaction after seeing me? I was too shocked to follow her. Even though my confusion had only intensified, I was at least glad to see I wasn't alone, and she had appeared from the left corridor...
entries.new: 见到我之后，她怎么是这个反应？我惊得没能跟上去。困惑只增不减，可至少看见自己不是孤身一人，我心里还是松了口气，而且她是从左边走廊出来的……
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I walked over to it. I knew an extra door was located at the end, so I approached it, wondering if she'd come out of it.
entries.new: 我走了过去。我知道走廊尽头还有一扇多出来的门，于是走近它，心想她会不会就是从那里出来的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But it was still locked, and there was nothing out of the ordinary about it.
entries.new: 可那扇门依旧锁着，看不出任何异常。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Trying to decipher what she said, I ran back to the door of the offices and entered them in a desperate attempt at understanding.
entries.new: 我想弄懂她那句话的意思，便跑回办公区门前，不顾一切地闯了进去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The first partition was empty. So was the second one. A chill ran down my spine when the third one didn't appear any different.
entries.new: 第一个隔间空着。第二个也是。等到第三个也不见不同，一股寒意顺着脊背爬上来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I froze for a few seconds, questioning what had happened to me and Shiroya.
entries.new: 我僵了几秒，心里反复追问我和Shiroya到底出了什么事。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I recalled teleporting from one place to another. She couldn't have disappeared from the offices, could she? I exited them to look at the other corridor.
entries.new: 我想起自己从一处传送到另一处。她总不能凭空从办公区消失吧？我退出来，朝另一条走廊望去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There was nobody there.
entries.new: 那里空无一人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Dumbfounded, I went down the stairs.
entries.new: 我怔怔地走下楼梯。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There was nobody on the outer part of the fifth floor, so I looked through the partitions.{w} The three of them were empty.
entries.new: 五楼外侧空无一人，我便挨个查看隔间。{w}三间隔间里都没有人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: As I was about to make it out, I stopped myself in the middle partition, far beyond confusion. What the hell was my objective?
entries.new: 眼看就要走出去，我却停在中间那间隔间里，茫然得无以复加。我究竟想干什么？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Hadn't I just found Shiroya and been completely ignored? She'd acted as if I was a ghost and moved on only to immediately disappear again.
entries.new: 我不是刚找到 Shiroya，却被她彻底无视了吗？她表现得好像我是幽灵，径直走开，转眼又消失不见。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'd been in continuous motion since we'd gotten trapped, but that was the first time I couldn't settle on an objective to pursue. I took advantage of it to sit on a chair for a little while, attempting to calm my alarmed heart down.
entries.new: 自从被困在这里，我一直没停下过脚步，可这是第一次，我连该追什么目标都定不下来。我索性趁这机会在椅子上坐了一会儿，试着让惊惶的心平静下来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But it was useless. I thought about what had happened and felt as if I was driving myself crazy. What could I make of Shiroya's behavior after feeling like I'd literally teleported? It was insane, and I feared there was something wrong with me.
entries.new: 可这毫无作用。一想到刚才发生的事，我就觉得自己快被逼疯了。亲身经历了一次传送之后，我又该如何理解 Shiroya 的举动？太荒唐了，我甚至怕是自己出了问题。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: After a while, I knew I had to continue looking around, but no determination came to me. Since I'd already seen Shiroya, everyone else should've been nearby, so I kept moving down the floors.
entries.new: 过了一会儿，我知道自己该继续去找，却没有半分干劲。既然已经见到 Shiroya，其他人应该也在附近，于是我继续往楼下走。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I went to the fourth floor and looked through it. I slowly moved down to the third and repeated the same process.
entries.new: 我来到四楼，逐一查看，又慢慢下到三楼，重复同样的步骤。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I didn't see any signs of life.
entries.new: 看不到任何有人活动的迹象。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I repeated the same inefficient movements on floor 2, and yet again, the result was the same. The crystal floor, where my lonely adventure had begun, was the one that remained.
entries.new: 我在二楼又重复了一遍这徒劳的搜索，结果依旧相同。只剩下水晶层——我这场孤独的冒险开始的地方。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Surely anyone would've been able to make it past me while I'd been looking through the offices, so I couldn't even be certain nobody was above me, even less so having spent minutes inside one of them.
entries.new: 我翻查办公室的时候，任何人都有可能从我身边溜过去。我连楼上是否真的没人都不敢确定，何况我还在其中一间里待了好几分钟。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I didn't know where to begin, but I quickly spotted an obvious point. After peeking at both hallways, I saw an open door in hallway B.
entries.new: 我不知该从哪儿找起，却很快发现了一处显而易见的地方。我朝两条走廊各瞥了一眼，便看到 B走廊有一扇门开着。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It belonged to the room where we'd found Naomi's corpse—where I'd last seen the others.
entries.new: 那是我们发现 Naomi 尸体的房间，也是我最后一次见到其他人的地方。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I approached it, but I couldn't see what was behind it through the small gap.{w} As I approached, I started to hear something. There were voices, ones that sounded shocked.
entries.new: 我走近那扇门，可透过窄窄的门缝看不清里面的情形。{w}越往前走，我越听到些动静。是说话声，语气里透着震惊。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The doorknob was finally in reach. I ignored it, simply pushing the door open, and a very familiar sight appeared before me.
entries.new: 门把手终于近在手边。我没有去碰它，直接推门而入，眼前出现了再熟悉不过的景象。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wh-What...!? How did you...?
entries.new: 什、什么……！？你怎么会……？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Where the fuck did you go?
entries.new: 你他妈跑哪儿去了？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Shiroya rushed to me and asked the same thing. Meanwhile, I looked at the six pairs of eyes focusing their most intense gazes on mine. ...On the floor, Naomi still lay in her own blood.
entries.new: Shiroya 冲到我面前，问的也是同一句话。与此同时，六双眼睛用最锐利的目光盯着我。……地板上，Naomi 还躺在血泊里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I-I don't know? What exactly are you asking me?
entries.new: ……我、我不知道？你们到底在问我什么？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Just a minute ago, you were looking inside that cabinet. How did you make it out of the room?
entries.new: 就在一分钟前，你还在往那个展示柜里看。你是怎么离开这个房间的？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: "Just a minute ago"? Were they messing with me? There was no way Shiroya would...
entries.new: 「就在一分钟前」？他们在耍我吗？Shiroya 不可能……
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...You mean to say that I disappeared from in front of the cabinet?
entries.new: ……你是说，我从展示柜前面消失了？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Atsuki, don't fuck around. We don't mean to say that you disappeared, we're asking you how you did it.
entries.new: Atsuki，别他妈装傻。我们不是说你消失了，是问你到底怎么做到的。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...I didn't do anything. I touched the Sekimeiya and instantly appeared in hallway A.
entries.new: ……我什么都没做。我碰了一下 Sekimeiya，转眼就出现在 A 走廊了。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Excuse me?
entries.new: 你说什么？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: We were talking about how you were the true culprit of this murder. You clearly did something to shift our focus.
entries.new: 我们刚才在说你才是这起命案的真凶。你显然动了什么手脚，好转移我们的注意力。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Wait a second, though. What's in this cabinet is not the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 不过，等一下。这展示柜里的东西不是 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Huh? I'm certain it was. I touched it and felt a burn on my fingers.
entries.new: 咦？肯定是。我碰到它的时候，手指还被烫了一下。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Not the one we saw earlier, at least. Look.
entries.new: 至少不是我们之前看到的那个。你看。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: He put his right arm inside the cabinet and removed it, holding an object that looked very similar to the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 他把右臂伸进展示柜，抽出来时，手里拿着一个和 Sekimeiya 非常相似的东西。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Yeah. That's the only thing that was inside.
entries.new: 没错。里面就只有那个。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: I have no idea how you made it to the hallway. There's nothing else in the cabinet.
entries.new: 我完全想不通你是怎么到走廊去的。展示柜里没有别的东西。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: My eyes were still directed at the Sekimeiya in Sai's hand. It no longer glowed at all, and it was gray.
entries.new: 我的目光仍停在 Sai 手里的 Sekimeiya 上。它已经完全不发光了，整个是灰色的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'm telling the truth. Wh-What I found in the cabinet looked like the Sekimeiya we'd seen. I saw it glowing in the dark.
entries.new: 我说的是实话。我、我在展示柜里看到的东西，就跟我们之前见过的 Sekimeiya 一样。我看见它在黑暗里发光。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I had to explain myself however I could, but I had no concept of what had happened.
entries.new: 我必须想办法解释清楚，可我自己也完全不明白发生了什么。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But this thing doesn't glow. Katei says he doesn't know what it is, even though that means nothing.
entries.new: 但这玩意儿不发光。Katei 说他不知道这是什么，不过他那话也说明不了什么。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...I'm telling you what I know. This Sekimeiya was never here.
entries.new: ……我只是把我知道的说出来。这个 Sekimeiya 从来就不在这里。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Atsuki, let me try to understand what you're saying. You mean that when you touched that thing, you teleported outside?
entries.new: Atsuki，让我理理你的意思。你是说，你碰到那东西的时候，就被传送到了外面？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: ...{w}Th-That's what it felt like.
entries.new: ……{w}感、感觉就是这样。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Everyone looked skeptical, but they remained quiet.
entries.new: 每个人脸上都写着怀疑，却都没出声。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...You weren't here by that point yet, though. When I found myself in the lobby, I entered this room and only saw Naomi's body on the floor.{w} I went up to the sixth floor to find you and eventually went back down. That's when I just found you here.
entries.new: ……可那时候你们还没到这儿。我发现自己在大厅里后，就进了这个房间，只看到 Naomi 的尸体躺在地上。{w}我上六楼去找你们，后来又下来了。就是在那时，我才在这里碰到你们。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I felt strangely uncomfortable while I attempted to explain myself. I sounded crazy, and if I wasn't, they were the ones tricking me. The only explanation was that I'd been knocked out in some way and they were acting as if it had just happened seconds ago.
entries.new: 解释的时候，我心里莫名地难受。我听起来像个疯子；可如果我没疯，那就是他们在骗我。唯一的解释是：我不知怎么失去了意识，而他们装作那不过是几秒钟前的事。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Isla, still between Erina's arms, looked the least dubious of me, but she still seemed to be trying to process that her friend's prediction hadn't come true.
entries.new: ……Isla 仍被 Erina 搂在怀里，在众人当中，她看起来最不怀疑我，但似乎仍在想着，她朋友的预言竟没有应验。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: So, you want to make us believe that you traveled to the past. That's impressive.
entries.new: 所以，你是想让我们相信你穿越到了过去。真了不起啊。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: "To the past", right. That was the conclusion to draw from what I'd said.{w} Not only teleportation, but time travel too. It was a ridiculous claim even if they'd really seen me disappear.
entries.new: 「到过去」，没错。按我刚才说的，只能得出这个结论。{w}不只是传送，更是时间穿越。就算他们真的亲眼看见我消失，这说法也荒唐得可笑。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Are you hearing him? I bet you all thought he was innocent before seeing his true colors. You can't honestly tell me you believe a word of what he's saying.
entries.new: 你们都听见了吧？我猜在看清他的真面目之前，你们个个都以为他是清白的。别告诉我你们真信了他一个字。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Then how do you think he escaped from this room? I... I saw him vanish with my own eyes, and I believe we all did. You told us there's no hidden paths in these rooms.
entries.new: 那你说他是怎么逃出这个房间的？我……我亲眼看见他消失的，我想我们也都看见了。你还跟我们说过，这些房间里没有暗道。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Tell us, Atsuki. How did you do it? There is a security camera here, so your trick has been recorded. Are you going to claim ignorance and state that you traveled to the past?
entries.new: 说吧，Atsuki。你到底是怎么做到的？这里装了监控摄像头，你的把戏都被拍下来了。你还打算装糊涂，说自己穿越到了过去吗？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Did I travel to the past? I couldn't have. That's impossible.
entries.new: 我回到过去了？不可能。这种事根本不可能发生。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Even if such a thing were possible, would everything hold up?
entries.new: 就算真有可能，一切都能对得上吗？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I have no idea what caused it, but if the others didn't knock me out, I must've teleported in some way. I guess traveling to the past only adds a bit more impossibility to that.
entries.new: 我不知道是什么原因，但既然不是其他人把我打晕的，那就只能是我以某种方式被传送了。要说还顺带穿越了时间，也不过是在这上面再添一层不可能罢了。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: At least, one thing would begin to make sense if that's what happened. Earlier, when I looked in this room, Naomi was already dead. Didn't Katei say this? That I was on this floor during the time Naomi died?
entries.new: 至少，若真是如此，有一件事就说得通了。先前我查看这个房间时，Naomi 已经死了。Katei 不是说过吗？说在 Naomi 遇害的那段时间里，我就在这一层。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Through normal means, I wouldn't have been able to be on the crystal floor. I was upstairs, and I would've been noticed if I'd headed down. This would make it possible.
entries.new: 正常来说，我不可能出现在水晶层。我当时在楼上，若往楼下走，必定会被人看见。而这样一来，就有了可能。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: It would be absurd to immediately justify Katei's accusation like this, but it would explain why he decided to make such a nonsensical claim in the first place, and it would make a lot of what he said believable.
entries.new: 就这样立刻替 Katei 的指控找到依据，未免荒唐；可这样一来，他当初为何要提出如此荒谬的论断，反倒有了答案，他所说的许多话也就变得可信了。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I'd seen it countless times: time travel appearing out of nowhere to construct crazy events. I'd experienced many stories that were ruined by such an exploitable mechanic. Thinking about it, I felt as if the same thing was happening to my reasoning.
entries.new: 这样的桥段我见过无数次：时间穿越凭空冒出来，拼凑出一连串离奇的事件。我也读过不少故事，就是被这种可以随意取巧的设定毁掉的。想到这儿，我仿佛觉得自己的推理也正走上同一条路。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If I couldn't explain my own experience, did I have to assume that time traveling was possible? Had it been a factor the whole time?{w} I thought about the full sequence of events up until that point. If they were somehow related to time travel, how were we supposed to think about that?
entries.new: 既然我解释不了自己的遭遇，就非得认定时间穿越可行吗？它会不会从一开始就是整件事的一环？{w}我把此前发生的一切按顺序梳理了一遍。若这些事真与时间穿越有所牵连，我们又该怎么去看待？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What would be more reasonable? To deny its existence and ignore my unexplained experience, or to think that it could be possible?
entries.new: 哪一种更合理？是拒不承认它存在，把自己无法解释的遭遇置之不理，还是承认它或许真有可能？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I felt no enthusiasm thinking about either option, so I thought back on the previous few minutes.
entries.new: 两个选项都提不起我的兴致，于是我回头去想刚才那几分钟里的事。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: How would this even work? Whenever time travel comes up, the word "paradox" is usually thrown all around. Depending on its rules, the way time travel works can greatly differ.
entries.new: 这究竟是怎么运作的？一提到时间穿越，人们总爱把「悖论」这个词挂在嘴边。规则不同，时间穿越的方式也会大相径庭。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: One simple type of paradox is the famous "going back to the past and preventing your birth". Would you instantly disappear, or would you live a life in a world where you never existed? Either way, the past was changed.
entries.new: 一种简单的悖论就是著名的「回到过去，阻止自己出生」。你会当场消失，还是在一个你从未存在过的世界里活下去？无论哪种，过去都被改变了。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: On the other side is the bootstrap paradox: you find a key, open a door with it, find a time travel machine inside, use it to go back to the past, and finally place the key on the floor so that your past self can find it.
entries.new: 另一类则是自举悖论：你捡到一把钥匙，用它打开一扇门，在门内发现一台时间机器，乘它回到过去，最后把钥匙放在地上，好让过去的自己捡到。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: In that case, did time travel matter at all? The past was not changed, so by traveling back, you only understood how it all came to happen. Essentially, it's a loop without a starting point, and it only occurred because it occurred.
entries.new: 若是如此，时间穿越还有什么意义？过去并未改变，回到过去只是让你明白这一切是如何发生的。说到底，这是一个没有起点的循环，它之所以发生，仅仅因为它已经发生。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: That's a concept far from sensible. It could come in handy to justify grand motives in a story, but it's nothing short of completely impractical.
entries.new: 这种说法实在谈不上合理。在故事里用来给宏大的动机找理由或许方便，可实际上完全行不通。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: However, no matter how I feel, I think that everything points to this direction: that if I have just traveled to the past, I haven't actually changed anything. It seems like I just reexperienced the events I previously lived.
entries.new: 然而无论我作何感想，种种迹象似乎都指向同一个方向：倘若我方才真的回到了过去，那我其实什么也没有改变。我似乎只是重新经历了一遍自己已经历过的事。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: The starting point seems to have been making physical contact with the Sekimeiya. As nothing that I did once I arrived in the past directly led to my travel, I'm not sure I'd quite perceive it as that kind of paradox.
entries.new: 起点似乎是我与 Sekimeiya 发生了身体接触。我回到过去之后所做的任何事，都没有直接导致这次穿越，所以我不太确定这能否算作那种悖论。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Looking ahead, though, it seems that I unconsciously repeated the past I had lived with Shiroya.
entries.new: 可往后看，我似乎无意识地重演了与 Shiroya 共同度过的那段过去。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: "Just a minute ago, you were looking inside that cabinet." According to this, I can draw that I supposedly went back about twenty minutes to the past. That's the time I estimate I spent confusedly looking around for people.
entries.new: 「就在一分钟前，你还在看那个展示柜。」照此说来，我大概是回到了二十分钟前。那正好是我东奔西走、四处找人所花去的时间。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: By that point, Naomi had already been killed. Shortly after, I took the elevator that was on this floor up to the sixth.
entries.new: 那时 Naomi 已经遇害。不久之后，我便乘这一层的电梯上到了六楼。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: This cleanly holds up with what we experienced... At that point, the elevator was on the crystal floor, as it had probably arrived there when we'd heard it on the fifth.{w} Then, when I went up to the sixth would be when Shiroya and I rushed to follow it up.
entries.new: 这一点与我们经历过的完全对得上……那时电梯停在水晶层，大概是我们在五楼听见它时，它正好到了那里。{w}而我上到六楼的那一刻，正是 Shiroya 和我匆忙追上去的时候。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: What the hell is this? Did I, without being aware of it, replicate the past I'd experienced?
entries.new: 这到底是怎么回事？难道我在毫不知情的情况下，重现了自己经历过的过去？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I think that something curious happened when we chased the elevator up. If the elevator hadn't been empty, we had to assume that whoever went up entered the attic. The only other explanation was that the person inside vanished.
entries.new: 我想，我们追着电梯上楼时，发生了些蹊跷的事。如果电梯里并非空无一人，那就只能认为上去的人进了阁楼。除此之外唯一的解释，就是里面的人凭空消失了。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: But... it seems that what I just went through explains what actually occurred.
entries.new: 不过……我刚才经历的一切，似乎正好解释了实际发生的情形。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I got out of the elevator and looked through the sixth floor. The corridor appeared empty, and I spent a bit of time inside the offices.
entries.new: 我走出电梯，在六楼各处查看。走廊里空无一人，我又在几间办公室里待了一阵。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: As I was there, Shiroya and another version of myself were chasing me. They called the elevator to the fifth floor, but as I saw earlier, that wouldn't have made a noticeable sound from where I was.
entries.new: 我在那里的时候，Shiroya 和另一个我正追着我。他们把电梯叫到了五楼，可正如我刚才所见，从我所在的位置根本听不出什么动静。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Then, as I remember, the previous me stayed next to the elevator while Shiroya looked through the two main parts of the floor. She also mentioned how she'd first looked through the opposite corridor.
entries.new: 然后，按照我的记忆，先前的我守在电梯旁，Shiroya 则查看了这一层的两个主要区域。她还提到，自己最先查看的是对面的走廊。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: She and I saw each other when I was about to continue looking for people. She was about to look through each partition.
entries.new: 我正要接着去找人时，和她打了个照面。她那时正要逐个查看隔间。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: That's why she reacted the way she did. From her perspective, I should've been next to the elevator, but where she found me, my job still would have worked. From there, you could still prevent anyone from escaping, so she thought I had moved from next to the elevator to outside the offices.
entries.new: 她之所以有那样的反应，原因就在这里。在她看来，我本该待在电梯旁，但她找到我的地方，同样能起到看守的作用。站在那里照样能防止有人逃走，所以她以为我是从电梯旁挪到了办公室外面。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: So, to her, it appeared as if the floor had been empty. She didn't realize that she'd actually seen the person who'd brought the elevator up.
entries.new: 所以在她眼中，这一层仿佛空无一人。她并没有意识到，自己见到的其实正是把电梯叫上来的人。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Oh, you're here. I found something.
entries.new: 哦，你在这儿啊。我发现了点东西。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: That was her reaction when she thought I'd slightly moved.
entries.new: 那便是她以为我只是略微挪了位置时的反应。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Similarly, when she was done investigating, something she said did throw me off a little.
entries.new: 同样，她调查完之后，有一句话让我有些摸不着头脑。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: But look, this is what I wanted to show you.
entries.new: 不过你看，这就是我想给你看的东西。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: She was referencing what she'd told me just before that point, unaware that she wasn't talking to the same person.
entries.new: 她在说刚才对我说过的话，却没意识到面前已经不是同一个人了。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: When she reacted coldly to my presence and said she'd found something in the corridor, I thought I had to look at it, so I went to check. During that time, she confirmed that the offices were empty.
entries.new: 她见我出现，反应冷淡，说在走廊里发现了东西。我觉得非得去看看不可，便过去查看。就在那段时间里，她确认了办公室里没有人。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I didn't see anything of importance in the corridor because what she had found was the attic door itself. I entered the partitions to demand a further explanation, but she was already talking to the previous me, next to the elevator.
entries.new: 我没在走廊里看到什么要紧的东西，因为她发现的其实就是那扇通往阁楼的门。我走进隔间想再问个明白，她却已经在电梯旁和先前的我说话了。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: When I left, the two of them had gone around to inspect the door they'd just discovered.
entries.new: 我离开时，她们两人已经绕过去查看刚发现的那扇门了。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: And later, I spent a few minutes inside the offices of the fifth floor, so I didn't notice Akaro going up or the three of us going down.
entries.new: 后来，我在五楼的办公室里待了几分钟，因此既没注意到 Akaro 上楼，也没注意到我们三人下楼。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: After a while, I continued looking through every floor until I reached the point I'd traveled from.
entries.new: 又过了一阵，我继续逐层查看，直到走到我穿越而来的那个节点。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: ...Even though I couldn't easily accept such a concept, it neatly explained many things.{w} Was it all a ridiculous coincidence...? A trick, maybe?
entries.new: ……虽然我很难轻易接受这种说法，但它确实把许多事情解释通了。{w}难道这一切都只是荒唐的巧合……？又或者，是某种把戏？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Insulation
entries.new: 隔音

entries.text: ...Do you intend to answer?
entries.new: ……你打算回答吗？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: I'd briefly fallen silent. Once I'd thought of the possibility, answers had quickly fallen into place.
entries.new: 我一时沉默了。这个可能性一旦浮上心头，答案便接连归位。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Something so outlandish certainly sounded impossible under any normal circumstances, but the simple fact was that it had happened to me. Unless there was another explanation I was missing, there was no choice but to accept it.
entries.new: 如此离奇的事，在平常情况下当然显得不可能，但事实很简单，它偏偏就发生在了我身上。除非还有什么我没想到的解释，否则只能接受。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I... don't have a reason to deny that traveling to the past seems to be the most likely answer. Rather, it's the only one.
entries.new: 我……没有理由否认。回到过去似乎就是最可能的答案。不如说，那是唯一的答案。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Pathetic. You were accusing me of being a bad liar, Sai?
entries.new: 可笑。你先前不是还说我连谎都撒不好吗，Sai？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: If that was truly what had happened, it also meant that Katei had to be the killer.
entries.new: 如果真相确实如此，那也就意味着，凶手只能是 Katei。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The elevator going up was my doing, so there'd been nobody else on the first floor. Nobody had gone to the attic.
entries.new: 电梯是我叫上去的，所以一楼再没有别人。也没有人进过阁楼。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But a line of reasoning that time traveling demolished was another one that it created. That was the can of worms that thinking about possibilities involving time travel opened.{w} After all, I had randomly teleported to hallway A. Someone could've been on the same floor, killed Naomi before we'd thoroughly investigated it, and then traveled through time to an entirely different place.
entries.new: 可时间穿越推翻了一条推论，却又造出了另一条。这就是一去设想时间穿越的种种可能，就会惹出来的那堆麻烦。{w} 毕竟，我是随机传送到 A 走廊的。当时也许有人就在同一层，趁我们尚未彻底调查便杀了 Naomi，再穿越到完全不同的地方。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There was still one thing to keep in mind: the first time the elevator had gone down.
entries.new: 还有一点不能忘记：电梯第一次下行的时候。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It was possible someone had been in the attic before we'd heard it. They could've gone down with the elevator, killed Naomi, and then traveled to the past, back inside the attic. Thinking about tight possibilities with such uncertain and volatile mechanics was impossible.
entries.new: 也许在我们听见电梯声之前，就已经有人待在阁楼里。那人可以随电梯下去，杀死 Naomi，再穿越回过去，回到阁楼之中。可这种机制既不确定又反复无常，想严密地推敲各种可能性，根本不可能。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: So according to you, his claim is as bad as or worse than yours, but yours were all easily disproven. Can you give an alternative to what Atsuki's saying?
entries.new: 照你这么说，他的说法和你的一样糟，甚至更糟，可你的说法全都被轻易推翻了。那你能对 Atsuki 的说法提出另一种解释吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Are you going to tell me that because I don't know how he made it out of this room, he must've time traveled? For the love of God, Sai, and you were trying to act smart?
entries.new: 你是想告诉我，就因为我不知道他怎么离开这个房间，他就肯定时间穿越了？老天啊，Sai，你刚才还一副自作聪明的样子？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Well, let me tell you something. If Atsuki didn't time travel, he can't be Naomi's killer. If he did, though, it's still an option.
entries.new: 那我来告诉你。如果 Atsuki 没有时间穿越，他就不可能是杀死 Naomi 的凶手；可要是他穿越了，那他仍然有嫌疑。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Sai and Shiroya had realized the same thing. I was really there by the time she died.
entries.new: Sai 和 Shiroya 也想到了同一件事。Naomi 死的时候，我确实就在那里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Okay, it might happen to explain that Katei saw Atsuki here, but it doesn't make it any less insane.
entries.new: ……好吧，这或许正好能解释 Katei 为什么会在这里看见 Atsuki，但这依然一样荒唐。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Hm, why not? I think it makes sense.
entries.new: 嗯，为什么不行？我觉得说得通。
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: ...What? Don't be crazy. We can't use time travel to explain anything...
entries.new: ……什么？别胡说了。我们不能拿时间穿越来解释任何事……
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Why not?
entries.new: 为什么不行？
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: I'd say that's a fair question. By the way, it seems Katei was right about something. The Sekimeiya appears to have broken, right?
entries.new: 这问题问得倒没错。话说回来，Katei 似乎有件事说对了。Sekimeiya 好像坏了，对吧？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: We were all taken aback by that question, but we quickly understood what he meant. It had changed colors to a much less pleasant gray.
entries.new: 这话让我们都愣住了，但很快就明白了他指的是什么。它的颜色变了，变成了一种不怎么讨喜的灰色。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: See! This is all because it was removed from the cabinet!
entries.new: 看吧！这都是因为把它从展示柜里拿出来了！
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Are you sure? It was still white when I saw it.
entries.new: 你确定？我看到它的时候，它还是白色的。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Go ahead and prove that. Did you put it there and just want to avoid facing the consequences?
entries.new: 那你证明啊。是不是你把它放回去的，现在只想逃避后果？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Shut up. God.{w} This is what Atsuki asked about earlier. It's a function to regulate the cabinet's temperature, is it not?
entries.new: 闭嘴。天哪。{w} Atsuki 之前问的就是这个。那是用来调节展示柜温度的功能，不是吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Yes, but it's set to room temperature.
entries.new: 没错，不过它设定的是室温。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: It's slightly damaged, though. And let's think: out of all of us, who would hide the Sekimeiya in a place that has a cold temperature function?
entries.new: 可它有点损坏了。再说了，我们这些人里，谁会特意把 Sekimeiya 藏在一个带制冷功能的地方？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...Even when I'm proven innocent, you still insist on suspecting me.
entries.new: ……就算证明了我的清白，你还是非要怀疑我。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: This guy was scared out of his mind at his bosses, remember? He would be dumb enough to hide the Sekimeiya here after he told us that story.
entries.new: 这家伙被上司吓得魂都没了，记得吧？他跟我们讲完那件事以后，完全可能蠢到把 Sekimeiya 藏在这里。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Do I have to repeat it? The cold function wasn't activated.
entries.new: 还要我重复一遍吗？制冷功能根本没有启动。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Who cares about that? It was still hidden here of all places. You'd also be the only one to know about the function of the cabinets, right?
entries.new: 那又怎样？它到底还是被藏在了这种地方。再说，知道展示柜功能的人也只有你，对吧？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What? Didn't Atsuki notice it too? That's why he appeared intrigued by this cabinet while he was being accused, acting as if he'd found the Sekimeiya he hid. I bet he put it here to frame me after I explained the cold rule.
entries.new: 什么？Atsuki 不也注意到了吗？所以他在被指责时才对这个展示柜表现出兴趣，像是找到了自己藏起来的 Sekimeiya。我敢说，他就是在听我解释完制冷规则后把它放进去，好栽赃我。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: ...That's not at all what happened, and the cameras will eventually prove it.
entries.new: ……根本不是这么回事，监控迟早会证明的。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I'm sure they will. For now, let's hurry up and put this thing where it belongs. Just in case it's not too late.
entries.new: 我相信会的。现在先赶紧把这东西放回该放的地方，免得来不及。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Yeah, sure. We can try that.
entries.new: 嗯，行。试试也无妨。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Holding the Sekimeiya in his hands, Sai closed the cabinet, which made a metallic sound as if it had locked automatically. Then, he left the room followed by Katei.{w} Shiroya was still unsure of what to say, and Akaro and Erina both looked at me with uncertainty.
entries.new: Sai 双手捧着 Sekimeiya，合上了展示柜。柜子发出金属声响，像是自动锁上了。随后他离开了房间，Katei 跟在后面。{w} Shiroya 仍不知道该说什么，Akaro 和 Erina 都带着不安看向我。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We were in front of the event room. I squeezed my eyes shut and rubbed at the bridge of my nose, remembering that someone in the building had actually died. Things were moving too fast. A death, moving through time after touching a gem...{w} But it would have been even more dangerous to stop thinking. Before I entered the room, I realized that something else went against the theory that Katei hadn't killed Naomi.
entries.new: 我们站在活动室前。我闭上眼，揉了揉鼻梁，想起这栋楼里真的有人死了。事情发生得太快。一桩命案，一次触碰宝石后的穿越……{w} 可要是就此停下思考，只会更危险。进房间之前，我意识到还有一点与「Katei 没有杀 Naomi」的推论相悖。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Sai was holding the Sekimeiya with his hands. However, I recalled feeling a painful burn on my fingers during the split second before I'd disappeared from the room.
entries.new: Sai 是亲手拿着 Sekimeiya 的。可我记得，在我从房间里消失的前一瞬，指尖曾传来灼痛。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: At that moment, the Sekimeiya was glowing white, so if that was still the same object, it meant it had changed colors as soon as I'd traveled. In other words, it had powered off.
entries.new: 那时 Sekimeiya 正发着白光。如果那还是同一件东西，就说明它在我穿越的同时变了颜色。换句话说，它已经停止运转。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: So, if anyone had consciously vanished from the first floor after killing Naomi, it should've powered off just like it did when I'd been the one to travel.
entries.new: 所以，如果有人杀了 Naomi 后有意从一楼消失，它也应该像我穿越时那样停止运转。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I couldn't know how it worked, but the fact that I'd seen it glowing might've indicated that nobody had traveled before me—that Katei was the only suspect.{w} In addition, the Sekimeiya had been inside a locked cabinet. To travel and leave it inside, the culprit must've had to shut themselves inside it and then touch the Sekimeiya...
entries.new: 我不知道它的原理，但我看见它发光这件事，或许说明在我之前没有人穿越过——Katei 是唯一的嫌疑人。{w} 此外，Sekimeiya 原本锁在展示柜里。凶手若要穿越后还把它留在柜中，就只能把自己关进展示柜，再触碰 Sekimeiya……
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There was another problem, though. I didn't think about it until we'd all entered the room.{w} "Touching the Sekimeiya made me travel to the past". Ignoring how an item with such an obvious power could've made it to a place where they'd let us touch it, something directly contradicted its powers.
entries.new: 不过，还有另一个问题。直到我们全都进了房间，我才想到。{w}「触碰 Sekimeiya 让我穿越到了过去」。先不论一件拥有如此明显力量的物品怎么会落到允许我们触碰它的地方，有一点直接与它的力量相矛盾。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Earlier, Isla had touched it inside its cabinet, and so had Shiroya. Following that, Sai even took it out of the cabinet while holding it with his hands, and none of them teleported at all.
entries.new: 先前，Isla 曾在展示柜里碰过它，Shiroya 也是。之后，Sai 甚至亲手把它从展示柜里取了出来，可他们谁都没有传送。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Was I the difference? Since I hadn't touched it back then, I couldn't discern whether the differing factor was the person to touch it or something about the Sekimeiya itself.
entries.new: 难道差别出在我身上？那时我没有碰过它，所以无法判断，造成差异的究竟是触碰它的人，还是 Sekimeiya 本身。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Maybe it wasn't actually powered off. It could be that Sai couldn't travel.
entries.new: 也许它并没有真的停止运转。也可能只是 Sai 无法穿越。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Can I touch it again?
entries.new: 我能再碰它一次吗？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Of course. Have at it.
entries.new: 当然。随你。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: He handed me the gray gemstone.{w} I felt no burn, and I remained where I was. However, I was able to appreciate the smooth surface of the Sekimeiya, which definitely hadn't disappeared with its beautiful white.
entries.new: 他把那颗灰色宝石递给我。{w} 我没有感到灼痛，也没有离开原地。不过，我仍能摸到 Sekimeiya 光滑的表面——它并没有随着那抹漂亮的白色一同消失。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: You're putting on such a pathetic show. You should know that.
entries.new: 你这场戏演得真够难看，自己心里该有数。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: You're beginning to get on my nerves. I know how crazy I sound, but if anyone's been putting on a pathetic show from the start, it's been you.
entries.new: 你越来越让我烦了。我知道自己听起来有多荒唐，可要说从一开始就在演一出难看的戏，那个人是你。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Oh, he caught you.
entries.new: 噢，被他戳穿了吧。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: This is unbelievable. Put it in the cabinet already.
entries.new: 真是难以置信。快把它放回展示柜。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: I didn't want to argue further, so I opened the glass covering and placed it inside. The colder temperature became easily noticeable as I left it on top of the cushion.
entries.new: 我不想再争下去，便打开玻璃罩，把它放了进去。将它搁在垫子上时，明显能感到里面更冷。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Then I closed it again, and everyone remained staring at the mysterious source of the day's incident.
entries.new: 随后我又合上柜门，所有人仍盯着这个引发今日事件的神秘源头。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...What? Did it change back?
entries.new: ……什么？它变回去了？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: It did...?
entries.new: 真的变回去了……？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Yes! It's white!
entries.new: 对！是白色的！
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: We all saw it firsthand. A couple seconds after I put the Sekimeiya in the cabinet, it regained its old white glow.
entries.new: 我们全都亲眼看见了。我把 Sekimeiya 放进展示柜后不过几秒，它就重新泛起了原先那种白光。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: That's interesting. The temperature brought it back.
entries.new: 有意思。是温度让它恢复的。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: That's it, then. We must not take it out of here until the front door opens. It's clear that will bring us a bunch of issues with Ashiya.
entries.new: 那就这么定了。前门打开之前，不能把它带出这里。否则显然会给我们和芦屋之间惹来一堆麻烦。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Katei, this thing made Atsuki travel through time. Can you shut up for a second about goddamn Ashiya?
entries.new: Katei，这东西让 Atsuki 经历了时间穿越。你能不能先闭嘴，别再提该死的芦屋？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: You were right. The cold fixed it, so isn't it strange? According to your story from earlier, the original discoverer of the Sekimeiya realized the cold was needed.
entries.new: 你说对了。低温把它修好了，这不奇怪吗？按你刚才的说法，Sekimeiya 最初的发现者早就知道需要低温。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: If this can send you to the past, they must've certainly touched and tried all sorts of things to keep it stable. Could they have not noticed its power?
entries.new: 如果这东西能把你送回过去，他们为了让它保持稳定，肯定碰过它，也试过各种办法。他们怎么可能没发现它的力量？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What power!? Kid, this thing will not send you to the past! Something like that is impossible!
entries.new: 什么力量！？小鬼，这东西不会把你送回过去！那种事根本不可能！
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Didn't we touch it earlier? Isla definitely held it, and nothing happened to her.
entries.new: 我们之前不是碰过它吗？Isla 明明拿过它，也没出什么事。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: That's true... Why didn't it make me go anywhere?
entries.new: 对啊……为什么我没被送到别处去？
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: Because it's just a gemstone!
entries.new: 因为它只是块宝石！
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Well, it appears to have fixed itself. Shall we test it?
entries.new: 看来它自己好了。要不要试一下？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I'm beginning to wonder if you process any of what I say. We're not taking this out of here again.
entries.new: 我开始怀疑你到底有没有听进去我的话。我们不会再把它带出去了。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Okay. Sure thing.
entries.new: 好。当然。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Sai's insincere reply left us with a few seconds of silence. Erina was the one to break it.
entries.new: Sai 这句毫无诚意的回答让场面静了几秒。最后是 Erina 打破了沉默。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Isn't that a lock?
entries.new: ……那不是锁吗？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: I tilted my head to look at where Erina was pointing. Under the keyhole, on the left side of the cabinet, there was a small arrow directed to the word "unlocked", with "locked" being right under it.
entries.new: 我偏过头，顺着 Erina 手指的方向看去。钥匙孔下方、展示柜左侧，有一个小箭头指向「unlocked」，正下方则是「locked」。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: That's just indicating the status of the cabinet, right?
entries.new: 那只是在显示展示柜的状态吧？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Let me see.
entries.new: 我看看。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: With a finger, I rotated the dial. It didn't appear to move at first, but as soon as I applied a bit of pressure, it gave out and locked itself into place with a click.
entries.new: 我用一根手指转动旋钮。起初它似乎纹丝不动，可我稍一用力，它便松开了，随着咔哒一声锁到位。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Did that do it?
entries.new: ……这样就成了？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Sai, next to the glass, tried to scroll it down.
entries.new: Sai 在玻璃旁，试着把它向下拨。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I think so. I did hear a sound coming from here.
entries.new: ……应该是。我确实听见这边响了一声。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I attempted to set it back to "unlocked", but it was impossible.
entries.new: 我试着把它拨回「unlocked」，却怎么也拨不动。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: You must actually need the key for that.
entries.new: 看来要解锁，还是得用钥匙。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: So we can lock it manually but not unlock it again. That's almost fair.
entries.new: 也就是说，我们可以手动上锁，却不能再解锁。倒还算公道。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Katei, you work here, right? Did you not know about this mechanism with how much you've insisted to keep the Sekimeiya inside?
entries.new: Katei，你在这里工作吧？你一直那么坚持要把 Sekimeiya 留在里面，难道不知道有这个机关？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...I didn't. It seems changes were made to this cabinet, as the others don't possess this function.
entries.new: ……不知道。看来这个展示柜被人改动过，其他展示柜并没有这种功能。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Well, congratulations. You did it. Now we'll have to keep it here for the remainder of the day. Ashiya will be pleased.
entries.new: 好吧，恭喜。你如愿了。今天剩下的时间，我们都得把它留在这里。芦屋会很高兴的。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Since we'd evidently not looked through the cabinet well enough, I inspected it further. Shortly, I noticed something else.
entries.new: 显然我们之前没把展示柜检查仔细，于是我又细看了一遍。很快，我注意到了另一样东西。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There's an outlet behind it, and the cabinet's connected to it.
entries.new: 它后面有个插座，展示柜正接在上面。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Of course. It's needed for the temperature regulation. Every cabinet with that function has to be connected to a power supply.
entries.new: 当然。温度调节需要用电。每个具备这种功能的展示柜都必须接电源。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: It had already happened a few times, but once again, the immediate shock of hearing something we couldn't have heard infested the room. From outside, we all distinctly heard the sound of a door closing.
entries.new: 这种事已经发生过几次，可这一次，听见本不可能听见的声音，那股瞬间的冲击又一次笼罩了整个房间。我们所有人都清楚地听见外面传来一声关门声。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...That was a door, right?
entries.new: ……刚才是门吧？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Shit, there's actually someone else here!
entries.new: 该死，这里竟然真的还有别人！
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: We all hurried to open the right door, but we were stopped by Sai.
entries.new: 我们急忙去开右边的门，却被 Sai 拦住了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What are you doing? Someone look at hallway A too!{w} The staircase is there, so we can't all leave from here.
entries.new: 你们在干什么？也得有人去 A走廊看看！{w}楼梯在那边，不能所有人都从这里离开。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Sai, Shiroya, and Akaro exited through the right door since they'd been next to it. I'd been to the left of the cabinet, so I went with the others through the left door.
entries.new: Sai、Shiroya 和 Akaro 原本就在右门附近，便从那里出去了。我站在展示柜左侧，就和其他人一起走了左门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: As usual, hallway A appeared empty. We'd continuously done the same thing, but it seemed we had to search it one more time. ...Was it really possible a hidden culprit had remained unspotted for that long? The question had already come back.
entries.new: A走廊一如往常，看上去空无一人。同样的事我们已经做过一遍又一遍，可看来还是得再搜一次。……那个躲在暗处的人，真有可能这么久都没被发现吗？这个疑问又浮了上来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Looking through the whole tower left me exhausted, so I moved to the lobby door to make sure nobody was there and to keep watching the hallway.
entries.new: 把整座塔搜下来让我筋疲力尽，于是我走到大厅门口，确认那里没人，也顺便继续盯着走廊。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The atmosphere continuously shifted in the span of a few seconds. After looking at the empty hallway C, Erina and Isla entered every room together while Katei checked through some others to speed up the process. My position guaranteed that nobody could come out of a room while the others were busy inspecting them.
entries.new: 短短几秒间，气氛几度变化。看过空无一人的 C走廊后，Erina 和 Isla 结伴逐个进入房间，Katei 则去检查另外几间，好加快进度。我守的位置正好能保证，其他人在房里搜查时，不会有人从房间里出来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I sighed deeply. If nothing was found in either of the two hallways, would we have to move upward once again and look through every floor? The door we'd heard couldn't have closed on its own.
entries.new: 我深深叹了口气。如果两条走廊都没找到什么，我们难道还得再往上走，把每一层都搜一遍？我们听见的那扇门，不可能自己关上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Surprisingly, the others were taking a while with every room, as they knew that they all contained cabinets with empty interiors big enough to fit a person. While I stared ahead, I realized that making such an obvious sound seemed to defy the persistent stealth of the culprit.
entries.new: 出乎意料的是，其他人每查一间房都要花上不少时间，因为他们知道，每间房里都有内部空得足以藏下一个人的展示柜。我盯着前方，忽然觉得，弄出这么明显的声响，与那人一直以来的悄无声息实在不符。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: About ten minutes later, the search in our hallway concluded. I could hear that Isla, who was still holding up surprisingly well, had slowed them down, constantly asking to stay with the gems for longer. My group came to me and reported the result I'd already seen. The mechanical room still remained unchecked, so since I'd stayed put, I told them to make sure nobody appeared in the hallway while I went to inspect it myself.
entries.new: 大约十分钟后，我们这边的走廊搜完了。我能听出来，Isla 虽然仍出奇地撑得住，却一再要求多看看宝石，拖慢了他们的进度。我这边的人走过来，把我已经看到的结果告诉了我。机械室还没查，因为我一直守在原地，便让他们盯紧走廊，确保没人出现，我自己去查看。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: On the way, I looked at the few drawers the reception desk had, which were only filled with papers.
entries.new: 路上，我拉开接待台的几个抽屉看了看，里面只有文件。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Downstairs, I was reminded of the fact that such an off-putting place existed on that same floor. Being alone there was much different from the time I'd looked through it with Sai, and when I considered that I was searching for a hidden culprit that could easily catch me off guard, tension constricted my body once more.
entries.new: 下到楼下，我才重新想起这一层还有那么一个令人发怵的地方。独自待在那里，和上次与 Sai 一同查看时截然不同；一想到自己是在找一个随时可能趁我不备的藏匿者，紧张感又一次攫紧了我的身体。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Fortunately, it wasn't a big space, so confirming it was empty was easy. I went back up to see my group where I'd left them, and I saw that the others were by the end of hallway B.
entries.new: 幸好空间不大，确认里面没人并不难。我返回楼上，回到同伴们等候的地方，看见另一组人已经聚在 B走廊尽头。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I approached my group first. Erina told me that nothing had happened in hallway A, so we regrouped in C.
entries.new: 我先走到自己这组人身边。Erina 告诉我 A走廊没有异样，于是我们便在 C走廊会合。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Nothing, huh?
entries.new: 什么都没有，是吧？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Yeah, the rooms were all empty.
entries.new: 对，所有房间都是空的。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: ...So, if a person made the noise, they must be above us right now.
entries.new: ……这么说，如果那声响真是人弄出来的，那他现在一定在我们楼上。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Someone watched your hallway to make sure it was always being observed, right?
entries.new: 有人守着你们的走廊，确保那里始终在视线之内，对吧？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Yes, Sai did. We also checked the bathrooms once we were done.
entries.new: 是，Sai 守的。查完之后，我们也把洗手间查了一遍。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Who remained outside in yours?
entries.new: 你们那边留在外面的是谁？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: It was Atsuki.
entries.new: 是 Atsuki。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Oh, my friend Atsuki? That's good.{w} Say, did Katei look at any room all by himself?
entries.new: 哦，是我的朋友 Atsuki 啊？那就好。{w}对了，有没有哪间房是 Katei 一个人查的？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I did. Are you implying that perhaps I ignored something on purpose?
entries.new: 是我查的。你是在暗示，我可能故意漏掉了什么？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Yup. Stay here. Sorry for slowing the process down, but I can't just take his word for it.
entries.new: 没错。你留在这儿。抱歉拖慢了进度，不过光凭他一句话，我可不能就这么信了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Sai stepped into hallway A. He didn't ask for the rooms Katei had entered and simply went ahead with looking through all of them.
entries.new: Sai 走进了 A走廊。他没有问 Katei 查过哪几间，只是径直把每一间都看了一遍。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I couldn't blame him for suspecting Katei, and the rest of us felt the same: there was no complaint besides Katei's outraged look.
entries.new: 他怀疑 Katei，我怪不着他，其他人也是一样的心思：除了 Katei 一脸愤慨，谁也没有异议。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: After the smoky crystal room, Sai entered the storeroom. We expected him to silently move on to the next one again, but once he exited it, he directed his look at us and showed what he had between his hands.
entries.new: 查过那间烟雾弥漫的水晶展室后，Sai 走进了储藏室。我们以为他还会一言不发地转去下一间，可他一出来，目光便投向我们，亮出了手里的东西。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Upon processing the sight, we ran to him in a daze.
entries.new: 看清那东西的瞬间，我们恍恍惚惚地朝他跑了过去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What...? Was it in the storeroom?
entries.new: 什么……？在储藏室里？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Held in Sai's hands was the Sekimeiya. It was white, as being touched hadn't changed its color at all.
entries.new: Sai 手里拿着的正是 Sekimeiya。它是白色的——被触碰过，颜色却丝毫没有改变。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Yes. I found it hidden behind the sofa.
entries.new: 没错。它就藏在沙发后面。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Without warning, he moved the object to make contact with my skin. It scared me a bit, but nothing happened.
entries.new: 他毫无预兆地把那东西贴上我的皮肤。我吓了一跳，却什么也没发生。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: So it's not working now.
entries.new: 看来它现在不起作用了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Anyway, Katei, did you look through this room?
entries.new: 总之，Katei，这间房你查过吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...Yes.
entries.new: ……查过。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Not only that, but it was the first one he entered.
entries.new: 不止查过，这还是他进去的第一间。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: That's true, I remember.
entries.new: 没错，我记得。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: But that's because it's the farthest room from this side. I was looking for a person, so I didn't look behind the sofa.
entries.new: 那是因为它离这边最远。我要找的是人，就没去看沙发后面。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: What a convenient excuse.
entries.new: 借口找得可真方便。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Do you actually think I hid it? I couldn't have done that. We locked the cabinet.
entries.new: 你真觉得是我藏的？我不可能做到。展示柜是我们锁上的。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Atsuki, was Katei the last person to exit the event room? He might've had a key.
entries.new: Atsuki，最后一个离开活动室的是 Katei 吗？他手里可能有一把钥匙。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I don't know, but we all left very fast. I don't think he could've had the time.
entries.new: 我不清楚，不过我们走得都很快。我觉得他来不及。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Someone stay here. This floor is definitely empty, but we need to check the event room while making sure that nobody can move between the floors.
entries.new: 留几个人守在这里。这层楼肯定是空的，但我们要去查活动室，同时还得保证没人能在楼层之间来回。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: All right. We'll stay behind.
entries.new: 好。我们留下。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Can't we go too...?
entries.new: 我们不能一起去吗……？
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: Isla, enough. You all can go.
entries.new: Isla，别闹了。你们都去吧。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Let's see what happened.
entries.new: 去看看究竟是怎么回事吧。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Erina and Isla stayed where they were. That was the safest option up until that point, but as things were, staying in an uncertain spot such as the stairs was more dangerous than moving through an empty floor. It was something Erina must not have realized, but her demeanor was clear: she wasn't leaving Isla alone.{w} Nonetheless, the rest of us agreed and entered the event room once again.
entries.new: Erina 和 Isla 留在了原地。放在此前，这是最稳妥的选择，可照眼下的情形，守在一处前景不明的楼梯间，反倒比穿过空荡的楼层更危险。Erina 大概没意识到这一点，但她的态度很明白：她不会把 Isla 一个人留下。{w} 尽管如此，其余的人还是达成一致，再次走进了活动室。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I-It's really not here. How's that possible?
entries.new: 真、真的不在了。这怎么可能？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Raising the curtain revealed that the Sekimeiya we'd left there a few minutes ago was gone.
entries.new: 掀开遮布，几分钟前我们放在那里的 Sekimeiya 已经不见了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It shouldn't be, right? We made sure nobody was in the two hallways.
entries.new: 不该会这样吧？我们可是确认过两条走廊里都没人。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: That's why I said that the last person to exit must've already had it.
entries.new: 所以我才说，最后一个离开的人早就把它拿走了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Look. It's unlocked.
entries.new: 你看，锁开了。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Of course it is. Katei must have a key.
entries.new: 当然开着。Katei 手上一定有钥匙。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...I already said that I don't have it. There's no way I could've unlocked this cabinet.
entries.new: ……我说过了，钥匙不在我手里。我不可能打开这个展示柜。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Could he even have unlocked it if he had it? Did he enter this room again?
entries.new: 就算他有钥匙，他有机会开吗？他后来又进过这间房？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Not that I saw. When they were done, I went to the mechanical room, so he might've had his chance then. Erina would've brought it up, though.
entries.new: 我没看见。他们查完之后，我去了机械室，他要是有机会，也只能是那时候。不过真要有这回事，Erina 会说的。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I see, so he had an opportunity.
entries.new: 原来如此，那他确实有机会。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: But there's no way he did that, right? Our group was done quickly, so we could've appeared at any moment. And Erina would've had to keep this from us.
entries.new: 可他不可能那么做吧？我们那组查得很快，随时都可能出现。再说，那也得 Erina 替他瞒着我们才行。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: It's amusing to see that now you have to resort to this to keep suspecting me. Erina wouldn't lie to you.
entries.new: 真是可笑，为了继续怀疑我，你们已经沦落到要靠这种猜想了。Erina 不会对你们说谎。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Weren't we all liars a second ago? And what else makes sense? Did it disappear magically?
entries.new: 刚才不是还说我们个个都在撒谎吗？那除此之外还有什么说得通？难不成它是凭空消失的？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Well... It made me teleport. Would it be that crazy to think that maybe it did?
entries.new: 唔……毕竟它让我传送过。要说它自己也传送走了，也不算太离谱吧？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: And it unlocked the cabinet too, right? Did the fucking Sekimeiya send the cabinet to the past to when it wasn't locked and just stroll on out of it?
entries.new: 还顺手把展示柜打开了，是吧？难道这该死的 Sekimeiya 把柜子送回没上锁的过去，然后自己溜达出来了？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I didn't discard the possibility of you traveling to the past purely because nothing else explained what happened. This has a simple explanation: Katei did it.
entries.new: 我之前没排除你们穿越到过去的可能，纯粹是因为别的说法都解释不通。这事解释起来很简单：就是 Katei 干的。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I know that you think he didn't have the time, but I don't care about that. I left this room when he was inside, so for all I know, he could've easily done it, even if all of you are lying.
entries.new: 我知道你们觉得他来不及，可我不在乎。我离开这间房的时候他还在里面，所以我觉得他完全可能轻松办到——哪怕你们全都在撒谎。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Well, you're free to think that. I highly doubt it, though.
entries.new: 随你怎么想。不过我真的很怀疑。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: It seems that your reasoning has stopped being so influenced by Sai. That's good, Atsuki.
entries.new: 看来你的判断已经不再那么受 Sai 左右了。这是好事，Atsuki。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Now put the Sekimeiya in the cabinet at once. It hasn't changed colors yet.
entries.new: 现在立刻把 Sekimeiya 放回展示柜。它还没变色。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Fine. There you go.
entries.new: 好吧，放进去了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Sai put it in the cabinet and closed the glass. It was a slightly funny sight after hearing him say that we wouldn't take it out again.
entries.new: Sai 把它放进展示柜，合上了玻璃门。他刚说过不会再把它取出来，眼前这一幕便显得有些滑稽。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Do we lock it?
entries.new: 要上锁吗？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Why would we? Katei will be able to keep getting it out.
entries.new: 何必上锁？Katei 照样能把它拿出来。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: You can watch everything I do if you so desire. I will never get the Sekimeiya out of here.
entries.new: 你愿意的话，尽管盯着我的一举一动。我绝不会把 Sekimeiya 从这里拿出去。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: You said that Naomi had the only key to open this cabinet, right?
entries.new: 你说过，能打开这个展示柜的钥匙只有 Naomi 那一把，对吧？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: The only one I'm aware of, yes.
entries.new: 据我所知，只有那一把。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: But she's... The culprit must have her key.
entries.new: 可她人已经……钥匙一定落到了犯人手里。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: We saw her unlocking the cabinet before the smoke appeared. If the culprit didn't take it, could anyone have picked it up from her dead body?
entries.new: 烟雾出现前，我们看见她打开了展示柜。如果犯人没有拿走钥匙，那会不会有人从她尸体上捡走了钥匙？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Sai checked her pulse, isn't that right?
entries.new: 是 Sai 探的脉搏，对吧？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: I did. Why, are you concerned that she had a key up by her neck?
entries.new: 是我。怎么，你担心她脖子上挂了把钥匙？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: No, but only you approached her.
entries.new: 不。但靠近过她的只有你。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: That was after you killed her, though. It sounds to me like you had a much better opportunity.
entries.new: 可那是在你杀了她之后。照我看，你的机会比我大得多。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...Sai couldn't have picked it up. I was paying attention.
entries.new: ……Sai 不可能捡走它。我一直留意着。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Thank God someone's competent enough. Nobody else checked her corpse after that, so the key must've already been gone.
entries.new: 谢天谢地，总算还有个靠得住的。那之后没人再碰过她的尸体，所以钥匙肯定早就不在了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Why don't we go see if we can find it?
entries.new: 不如我们去看看能不能找到？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: ...Sure.
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Sai opened the hallway A door to indicate to Erina and Isla that we'd go check the other hallway.
entries.new: Sai 打开 A走廊的门，向 Erina 和 Isla 示意我们要去查看另一条走廊。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: They're still there, so let's go see if we find the key.
entries.new: 他们还在那边，我们走吧，看看能不能找到钥匙。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Opposite to the event room in hallway B was the room where we'd found Naomi—B4. The last time, we hadn't searched her body.
entries.new: B走廊里，活动室的正对面就是我们发现 Naomi 的房间——B4。上一次，我们没有搜过她的尸体。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Who wants to look for it? I'd do it, but I don't wanna be suspected even more.
entries.new: 谁愿意去找？我可以去，但我不想再被多怀疑一层。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Nobody volunteered. Being close to a corpse was already enough for us.
entries.new: 没人愿意动手。光是靠近一具尸体，就已经够我们受了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Fine. I'll do it, but if I find it, don't suggest that I could've skillfully placed it in one of her pockets.
entries.new: 行，我来。但要是我真找到了，可别又说是我手法高明，自己塞进她口袋里的。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Go ahead already.
entries.new: 那就快点。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Sai started feeling every pocket of Naomi's clothes. It didn't take long for him to find something.
entries.new: Sai 开始逐个摸 Naomi 衣服上的口袋。没多久，他就摸到了东西。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Here, these are keys.
entries.new: 喏，是钥匙。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Yeah, this is the pocket where she had the cabinet key.
entries.new: 没错，她放展示柜钥匙的就是这个口袋。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Sai was holding a keyring containing three keys: two big ones and a small one.
entries.new: Sai 手里拿着一串钥匙，上面挂着三把：两把大的，一把小的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It's none of those. They wouldn't fit.
entries.new: 哪一把都不是。插不进去的。
entries.speaker: k
