We only had those hours to understand what the rules were and if the Sekimeiya would ever be useful to us.
entries.new: 怀着这个念头，我们头一次有了倒计时的实感。出口大概还有不到八小时就会打开，而我们连现在几点都还没确认。要弄清规则以及 Sekimeiya 究竟能否为我们所用，只剩这几个小时。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But the specter of the voice recorder haunted us; we'd found something that implied we'd be there for a whole month.{w} For the first time, that sounded just a bit desirable, as it would've given us more time to comprehend what was going on and how to use the Sekimeiya. It was possible someone was angling to trap us for a month just to accomplish that, but I couldn't begin to imagine how the rest of the plan would unfold in that case.
entries.new: 可录音笔的阴影始终挥之不去：我们发现的东西暗示，我们会在这里待上整整一个月。{w}这个念头头一次让人觉得还有几分可取之处，因为那会给我们更多时间去弄清究竟发生了什么，以及如何使用 Sekimeiya。或许有人正是为了这个目的才想把我们困上一个月；但若真是如此，我完全想象不出计划的其余部分会如何展开。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: At the same time, the exit was going to open at some point, and the Sekimeiya would be exposed to the world. Supposedly, it had been found two weeks prior on a nearby mountain. It was hard to believe nobody had experienced its supernatural powers, but as I thought that, I recalled that I was also harmlessly holding it in my hands.
entries.new: 与此同时，出口终将有打开的一刻，Sekimeiya 也会暴露在世人面前。据说它是在两周前于附近的一座山上被发现的。很难相信没有人体验过它的超自然力量——可这么想着，我又想起自己此刻正安然无恙地把它捧在手里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We entered B4, the room with the first Naomi. I remembered where the keys were, so I found them easily.{w} Two keys remained: the small one I wanted and the one for the door in the first staircase. I took the smaller one off the keyring; otherwise, it was too large to keep on my person, and it might've made noise.
entries.new: 我们走进水晶展室 B4，也就是第一个 Naomi 所在的房间。我记得钥匙放在哪里，所以很轻松就找到了。{w}钥匙圈上只剩两把：我想要的那把小钥匙，以及第一段楼梯那扇门的钥匙。我把小的那把从钥匙圈上取了下来；否则整串太大，揣在身上不方便，还可能发出声响。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Then, we moved to the staff room.{w} I inserted the key into a locker—I'd once again been correct about the purpose of a key.
entries.new: 随后我们去了员工室。{w}我把钥匙插进一个储物柜——我又一次猜对了这把钥匙的用途。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'm pretty sure it'll work. It's not for this locker, so let me find the right one.
entries.new: 我觉得应该能开。这把不是这个柜子的，让我找找是哪一个。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I inserted the key into another locker and attempted to turn it, to no avail. Then, I repeated the process with others until one opened.
entries.new: 我把钥匙插进另一个柜子，试着转了转，却没有转动。然后我一个个试过去，直到有一格打开了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Good. It's this one.
entries.new: 好，就是这个。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Two compartments were inside: a small and empty one on the top, and the bigger, main one that had Naomi's coat hung inside it.
entries.new: 柜子里分两格：上面一格很小，空着；下面较大的是主格，Naomi 的外套挂在里面。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I placed the Sekimeiya in the smaller one and took the coat out. I felt through the pockets, but they were all empty aside from a single handkerchief that I left alone.{w} I put the coat back inside. It was a bit disappointing that we hadn't found anything substantial, but I hadn't expected to.
entries.new: 我把 Sekimeiya 放进上面那格，取出外套，逐一摸过口袋。里面都是空的，只有一条手帕，我没有动它。{w}随后我把外套挂了回去。什么像样的线索都没找到，多少有些失望，不过这本来也在意料之中。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I closed the door and locked it with the key while Shiroya observed all my actions from the side.
entries.new: 我关上柜门，用钥匙锁好，Shiroya 一直在一旁看着我做完这些。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: That's it, then. At least there are no security cameras here, so we won't be seen hiding it.
entries.new: 那就这样吧。至少这里没有监控，我们藏东西的过程不会被人看到。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I know. That's good.
entries.new: 我知道。这样正好。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: By the way, regarding the cart disappearing...{w} I think it makes more sense than not. What's really strange is that apparently nobody noticed the Sekimeiya after it fell.
entries.new: 对了，关于推车消失的事……{w}我倒觉得这样才说得通。真正奇怪的是，Sekimeiya 掉下来之后，居然没有人注意到它。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: For example: when I touched the Sekimeiya, why did I teleport, but not the cabinet? And why did my clothes teleport?
entries.new: 比如说：我碰到 Sekimeiya 的时候，为什么传送的是我，而不是展示柜？我的衣服又为什么跟着一起传送？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I was stepping on my shoes, so they teleported. My shoes were stepping on the floor, though, so why didn't the floor teleport?{w} It's probably just because my clothes were under my possession, while the floor wasn't.
entries.new: 我脚上穿着鞋，所以鞋也传送了。可鞋踩在地板上，地板为什么没有传送？{w}大概只因为衣服算我的所有物，而地板不算。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Similarly, the cabinet I was touching wasn't in my possession, but the cart was in yours. Isn't that interesting? The cart is designed to be moved by whoever is holding it while the cabinets aren't. That's why the simple act of touching the cart makes it "yours", but touching a cabinet or the floor isn't enough.
entries.new: 同样，我碰到的展示柜不算我的所有物，而那辆推车却算你的。有意思吧？推车本来就是给人推着走的，展示柜却不是。所以只要碰一下推车，它就成了「你的」；光碰一下展示柜或地板则远远不够。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: That's about what I imagined, but it means that the Sekimeiya somehow recognized the cart was movable and the cabinet wasn't.
entries.new: 和我预想的差不多。不过这也就是说，Sekimeiya 不知通过什么方式分辨出推车可以移动，而展示柜不行。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Exactly, which is convenient for us, or else we could've made a bunch of other things disappear just because we were making contact with them.
entries.new: 正是如此。这对我们倒方便，否则光是碰到别的东西，就可能让它们跟着一起消失。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Remember the suitcase in the attic? Something similar must've happened. Naomi traveled holding it, so it traveled along too.{w} We didn't find it strange at all since it's natural to imagine it'd happen, but your purse has traveled both times when it was only touching your clothes. It has to be because it's recognized as part of your whole entity when you travel.
entries.new: 还记得阁楼里的手提箱吗？应该也是同样的道理。Naomi 传送时提着它，它便跟着一起传送了。{w}我们丝毫不觉得奇怪，因为理所当然地认为会这样；可你的手提包两次都只是贴着衣服，却也跟着传送了。这只能是因为传送时，它被认定为你这个整体的一部分。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: But we didn't appear upstairs with the cart, while I had my purse.
entries.new: 可我们出现在楼上时，推车并没有跟着，而我的包却在。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Right. If the cart actually appeared somewhere else, that would indicate again that the location where we appear isn't determined by where we are when we touch the Sekimeiya, or else it would've appeared with us.
entries.new: 没错。如果那辆推车真的出现在了别处，那就再次说明，我们出现的位置并不取决于碰到 Sekimeiya 时所在的地方；否则它应该和我们一起出现。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: So if the cart has appeared somewhere else, that position is determined by where the cart was at another point in time... And it should be easy to draw conclusions from that because it spent the entire time in the cleaning room.
entries.new: 那么，如果推车出现在了别处，那个位置就取决于它在另一个时间点所在的地方……这一点应该不难推断，因为它一直放在清洁间里。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: I'd think so. Finally, consider this as well: when the cart traveled, everything that formed the "cleaning cart" disappeared alongside it. That included the bag covering its interior and the cleaning products that were placed at the front of it. All of that disappeared. It was treated like a single element you were holding.
entries.new: 我也这么想。最后，再考虑一点：推车传送时，构成「清洁推车」的一切都随之消失了。包括套在车内的袋子，以及放在车前的清洁用品。全部一起消失。它被当成你手里握着的单一物件来处理。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: That's why it's notable that the Sekimeiya didn't disappear while it was also part of the cart. It was inside it, so it should've been part of what you were touching with your other hand. However, it remained in place and fell in the bucket that was underneath it, which didn't teleport as it wasn't attached to the cart.
entries.new: 所以值得注意的是，Sekimeiya 明明也算推车的一部分，却没有消失。它就在车里，按理说也该算你另一只手触碰到的东西。可它留在了原地，掉进了下方的水桶——水桶没有传送，因为它并没有连在推车上。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: And just like we thought, the Sekimeiya can't go along with us.
entries.new: 正如我们所想，Sekimeiya 无法跟着我们一起走。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Pretty much. Even though it's what allows you to travel in the first place, it should've been included in your possessions. That wasn't necessarily the case in the previous travels—I wasn't holding the cabinets in the same sense.{w} The Sekimeiya must exclude itself when it comes to what it makes travel. And lastly, even if it had traveled, it's unlikely we would've appeared with it, which is what I speculated happened with the Sekimeiya in Sai's hip pack. Since the cart didn't appear with us in the attic, the Sekimeiya probably wouldn't have either.
entries.new: 差不多吧。虽然正是它让你能够穿越，它本身也该算在你们的随身物品里。之前那几次穿越就未必如此了——那时我算不上真正「拿着」展示柜。{w} Sekimeiya 在让物体穿越时，必然要把自己排除在外。最后，就算它真的穿越了，我们也不太可能和它一起出现——我先前推测 Sai 腰包里的 Sekimeiya 就是这种情况。既然推车没有和我们一起出现在阁楼，Sekimeiya 多半也不会。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I guess you're right... This clears a few things up.{w} We should probably try to get an idea of what happened here, though.
entries.new: 大概吧……这样一来，有几件事就说得通了。{w} 不过，我们最好还是先弄清楚这里究竟发生了什么。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Yeah, the others should still be around. I'd imagine they looked at the place we disappeared from, so I have no idea why the Sekimeiya was still there. Let's go find them.
entries.new: 嗯，其他人应该还在附近。我想他们肯定查看过我们消失的地方，所以我实在不明白 Sekimeiya 为什么还留在那儿。我们去找他们吧。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: We'd been moving through hallway B for a few minutes, so it seemed appropriate to begin there. It was unlikely anyone had been near us, but we weren't going to lose much time by making sure to glance over every room.
entries.new: 我们已经在 B 走廊走了好几分钟，从那里开始找也顺理成章。应该不会有人靠近过我们，不过把每个房间都扫一眼，也耽误不了多少时间。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The start was the two bathrooms, and aside from Naomi's body, there was nothing there. Rapidly, we began to open every door to see if anything we could easily spot was around. The Sekimeiya cabinet, as expected, was empty.
entries.new: 最先查的是两间洗手间，除了 Naomi 的遗体，里面空无一物。随后我们加快速度，挨个打开每一扇门，看看有没有一眼就能发现的东西。Sekimeiya 的展示柜果然空了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The original Naomi was still partially under a curtain after I'd grabbed her key, so I covered her properly again. The last crystal rooms were as they'd been from the start.
entries.new: 我取走钥匙之后，原本的 Naomi 还半露在遮布外面，于是我重新替她盖好。最后几间水晶展室也和最初一样，没有任何变化。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: To cross to the opposite hallway, we went through the lobby, knowing that the mechanical room was also on our way.{w} Unexpectedly, our search came to an abrupt stop when we stepped into the large hall.
entries.new: 为了到对面的走廊去，我们穿过大厅，顺路也能看看机械室。{w} 没想到，刚一踏进那座宽阔的厅堂，搜索就戛然而止。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: People were next to the metallic shutter. We recognized them immediately: Erina, Akaro, and Katei were kneeling down next to the wall, while Sai looked at them from above.
entries.new: 金属卷帘门旁有人。我们一眼就认了出来：Erina、Akaro 和 Katei 跪在墙边，Sai 站在一旁俯视着他们。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: As soon as we opened the door, their heads lifted to meet our gazes. After a couple quiet seconds, Katei was first to further acknowledge our presence and stood up from the floor. He began walking toward us, and we did the same until we met in the middle of the room.
entries.new: 门一开，他们就抬起头，迎上我们的目光。安静了几秒之后，Katei 最先反应过来，从地上站起身。他朝我们走来，我们也迈开脚步，最终在房间中央碰面。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Where were you...? What the hell happened earlier?
entries.new: 你们去哪儿了……？刚才到底出了什么事？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: While the conversation started, we approached the others who had kept silent. Strangely, they were looking down again, wearing unsettling expressions.
entries.new: 谈话开始时，我们走近了那些一直沉默的人。奇怪的是，他们又低下头去，脸上的神情让人不安。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: You mean when Sai sneaked away? Right, we disappeared. The Sekimeiya made us go to the past again, and this time we appeared in the attic.
entries.new: 你是说 Sai 悄悄溜走的时候？对，我们消失了。Sekimeiya 又让我们回到了过去，这次出现在阁楼里。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Oh. I... see.
entries.new: 哦。原来……是这样。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: After his strangely short response, we went over to the shutter. Something might've happened, as everyone else appeared quiet and unresponsive. I wondered why they'd decided to stay there, too.
entries.new: 他只应了这么一句，短得有些反常。我们走向卷帘门。其他人个个沉默不语、毫无反应，看样子是出了什么事。我也纳闷他们为什么要一直待在这里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Did you search for us at all?
entries.new: 你们到底有没有找过我们？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Since that wasn't a question directed at anyone in particular, Sai decided to speak.
entries.new: 这话并没有特意问谁，于是 Sai 开口了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: You were in the attic, you said? Why didn't you come down sooner?
entries.new: 你说你们在阁楼？那怎么没早点下来？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: We fell asleep and lost track of time. Did something happen?{w} Where's Isla?
entries.new: 我们睡着了，没注意时间。出什么事了吗？{w} Isla 呢？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I asked that instinctively, but I hadn't consciously realized that Isla wasn't with them.
entries.new: 我脱口而出，直到这时才真正意识到，Isla 并不在他们当中。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Erina, who I'd imagined would quickly answer, remained looking down at her lap, hiding her face from us. Strain filled my body, as that mere action made me imagine that something terrible could've happened.
entries.new: 我本以为 Erina 会立刻回答，她却一直低头看着自己的膝头，把脸藏了起来。仅仅这一个动作，就让我全身绷紧——我忍不住想，是不是出了什么可怕的事。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: None of the others decided to respond either, and instead shut their eyes before lowering their heads. Finally, I noticed that their expressions were tinged with sorrow.
entries.new: 其他人也都没有作声，只是闭上眼，低下头。我这才注意到，他们的神情里带着悲伤。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: They understood that their own reactions had started to fill us in. After a few unsettling seconds, Sai began speaking in a faint voice, uncharacteristic of the way he'd come across at any other time.
entries.new: 他们明白，自己的反应已经让我们猜到了几分。令人不安的几秒过去，Sai 开口了，声音微弱，与他平日给人的感觉截然不同。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Shiroya and I, along with the others against the wall, listened to the words that narrated what had taken place while we'd been sleeping six floors above.
entries.new: 我和 Shiroya，还有靠墙站着的其他人，一起听着那段讲述——就在我们睡在六楼上的时候，这里发生过什么。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Hidden Cliff
entries.new: 隐秘悬崖

entries.text: At the same time that Shiroya and Atsuki disappeared from the cleaning room, Erina and Isla, who were in the opposite hallway, saw Sai appearing from hallway C.
entries.new: Shiroya 和 Atsuki 从清洁间消失的同时，身在对面走廊的 Erina 和 Isla 看见 Sai 从 C 走廊走了出来。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: As soon as they made eye contact, Sai's body visibly relaxed. As if he'd changed personalities in an instant, he began slowly walking toward the two next to the event room, who hadn't said anything yet.
entries.new: 四目相接的瞬间，Sai 整个人明显放松下来。仿佛一瞬间换了个人，他慢悠悠地朝活动室旁那两个还没开口的人走去。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Without a care in the world, he was the first to ask a question.
entries.new: 他一副若无其事的样子，反倒先开了口。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: What's going on? Where did the others go?
entries.new: 怎么回事？其他人去哪儿了？
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: What...? They went to find you since you disappeared all of a sudden. Why did you do that?
entries.new: 什么……？你突然就不见了，他们才去找你的。你为什么要那样做？
entries.speaker: akinn

entries.text: Naturally, Erina didn't know how to react, given that the others had made it seem essential to guard hallway A in case Sai went there before they could get him.
entries.new: 其他人先前反复强调必须守住 A 走廊，免得 Sai 先赶到那里、他们却来不及拦他，所以 Erina 自然不知该如何应对。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: What do you mean? We were gonna start searching for the Sekimeiya, so I just went ahead first.
entries.new: 什么意思？我们本来就要开始找 Sekimeiya，我就先走一步了。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: What? Why didn't you tell us, then? Didn't you go to hallway B?
entries.new: 什么？那你怎么不跟我们说一声？你不是去 B 走廊了吗？
entries.speaker: akinn

entries.text: Yes, but I headed over here since it's a better place to start with. I was gonna tell you two to come, but you were looking at me weird, so I wasn't sure if anything happened.
entries.new: 是啊，不过我觉得从这边开始找更合适，就先过来了。我本来想叫你们俩一起，可你们看我的眼神怪怪的，我怕是不是出了什么事。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: Those weren't very convincing words, but Erina didn't question him further, mostly because Sai's own question cut in.
entries.new: 这话听着并不怎么可信，但 Erina 没有继续追问，主要是因为 Sai 自己又问了起来。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Where are the others?
entries.new: 其他人呢？
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: Peeking inside the event room with a frown, Sai noticed the lack of other people.
entries.new: Sai 皱着眉往活动室里探了一眼，发现里面一个人也没有。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Didn't I just say they went behind you? They're in hallway B.
entries.new: 我刚才不是说了吗，他们跟在你后面去了。人在 B 走廊。
entries.speaker: akinn

entries.text: The door to the opposite hallway was open, and Akaro could be seen with his own frown, evidently ignoring the sound of their conversation.
entries.new: 通往对面走廊的门开着，可以看见 Akaro 也皱着眉，显然没在听他们的谈话。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Sai said Akaro's name out loud, and a few seconds later, his head finally turned to face them. Upon asking him what he was worried about, he let them know that Shiroya and Atsuki had not yet left the cleaning room.
entries.new: Sai 高声叫了 Akaro 的名字，过了几秒，他才终于转过头来。被问起有什么心事时，他告诉他们，Shiroya 和 Atsuki 还没有离开清洁间。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Sai, showing the strongest reaction, approached the room while letting out a conspicuous grunt.{w} He opened the door and stayed still for some time. Then, he entered the small space. Before the others had time to wonder what he was doing, he exited and told them that it was empty.
entries.new: 反应最大的是 Sai，他闷哼一声，走向那间房。{w} 他推开门，在门口一动不动地站了好一会儿，随后才走进那个狭小的空间。其他人还没来得及琢磨他在做什么，他就已经出来，说里面空无一人。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Akaro, who had a hard time believing it, stepped forward and became aware of the glaring contradiction within the room.
entries.new: Akaro 难以置信，走上前去，随即察觉到房间里那处再明显不过的矛盾。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Seeing his dumbfounded face, Erina and Isla got closer too. The four of them saw that not only had Shiroya and Atsuki vanished from the room, the cleaning cart had too.
entries.new: 见他一脸愕然，Erina 和 Isla 也凑了过来。四个人这才看清：不光 Shiroya 和 Atsuki 从房间里消失了，连清洁推车也不见了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: A disappearing cart was nothing compared to everything that had already happened. Once the other three stepped in, they became aware of the cause. The Sekimeiya sat inside one of the few buckets that remained on the floor of the cramped room.
entries.new: 和先前发生的种种相比，一辆消失的推车实在算不了什么。另外三人走进去后，也明白了原因。Sekimeiya 就躺在狭小房间里还留在地上的几只水桶之一里。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: It was Sai who first questioned its status, as it somewhat contradicted a few things they'd concluded earlier. It was white instead of the gray color they thought it'd become after teleporting two people and a whole cleaning cart.
entries.new: 最先察觉不对劲的是 Sai——它的状态与他们先前的几项推断有些出入。它仍是白色，而他们原以为，在传送了两个人外加一整辆清洁推车之后，它应该已经变成灰色。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Not much discussion was had. Up until then, they'd grown accustomed to Katei's voice immediately instructing them to put the Sekimeiya back in its cabinet. It was the lack of those words that alerted them that Katei wasn't there.
entries.new: 他们没有多作讨论。此前每次都是 Katei 立刻出声，吩咐他们把 Sekimeiya 放回展示柜，他们早已习惯。而这一次，正是因为那句话迟迟没有响起，他们才意识到 Katei 不在这里。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Where is Katei?
entries.new: Katei 在哪儿？
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: He followed you to hallway C.
entries.new: 他跟着你去 C 走廊了。
entries.speaker: aknn

entries.text: Me? Then why didn't he come to the event room when we were in hallway A?
entries.new: 跟着我？那我们在 A 走廊的时候，他怎么没来活动室？
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: Doubtful looks were the only answer. Sai, Erina, and Isla had spent a few seconds talking next to its door. Of course, Katei should have been visible.
entries.new: 回应他的只有几道怀疑的目光。Sai、Erina 和 Isla 在那扇门旁谈了几秒钟。按理说，他们本该看得见 Katei。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Taking advantage of Katei's absence, they removed their full focus from the Sekimeiya and left it where they'd found it, prioritizing finding him.
entries.new: 趁着 Katei 不在，他们不再把全部注意力放在 Sekimeiya 上，任它留在原处，先去找人要紧。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: All of them assumed that attempting to locate Shiroya and Atsuki was futile, as they'd most likely teleported through time and were somewhere else entirely. Sai was first to suggest going to see where Katei had gone, which shouldn't have taken a long time.
entries.new: 他们都认定，寻找 Shiroya 和 Atsuki 已经毫无意义——两人多半是穿越了时间，此刻身在别处。Sai 最先提议去看看 Katei 去了哪里，那本该花不了多少时间。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: With Akaro in the front and Sai in the back, the four left the room and saw the empty hallway C. The stairs presented the possibility of Katei moving upstairs, but hallway A was the most likely option.
entries.new: Akaro 在前，Sai 在后，四人离开房间，望见空无一人的 C走廊。楼梯那边意味着 Katei 有可能上了楼，但最有可能的仍是 A走廊。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Shiroya and Atsuki should still be here even if they traveled back in time. It could be that Katei took advantage of this situation to do something.
entries.new: 就算 Shiroya 和 Atsuki 回到了过去，他们也该还在这里。说不定 Katei 就是趁这个空当做了什么。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: Sai called out Katei's name while Akaro viewed the entire situation with suspicion, as he'd seen Sai in front of the cleaning room, where the Sekimeiya turned out to be. He asked Sai why he'd disappeared earlier, which was answered the same way he'd justified his actions to Erina.
entries.new: Sai 呼喊着 Katei 的名字，Akaro 则满腹狐疑地打量着整个局面——他曾在清洁间门口看见 Sai，而 Sekimeiya 恰恰就在那里。他质问 Sai 先前为何消失，得到的答复与 Sai 向 Erina 辩解时如出一辙。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: They stopped in front of the stairs, and Sai sighed as soon as he saw the other long, empty hallway.
entries.new: 他们在楼梯前停下。Sai 一看见另一条同样漫长而空荡的走廊，便叹了口气。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: You all rushed too quickly to find me when I was only trying to move things along, and now this happened. We found the Sekimeiya already, at least, but now we have to search for three people, which is just great...
entries.new: 我不过是想推进一下，你们就急着跑来找我，结果就成了这样。至少 Sekimeiya 已经找到了，可现在得去找三个人，真是好极了……
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: Sai began directing the others. With Atsuki and Katei gone, his demands met no resistance. His arrangement consisted of Erina and Isla staying next to the stairs and Akaro checking hallway B, while he himself looked through the hallway A rooms. That way, the search wouldn't take more than two minutes.
entries.new: Sai 开始指挥众人。Atsuki 和 Katei 都不在，他的安排没遇到任何阻力。他让 Erina 和 Isla 守在楼梯旁，Akaro 去查 B走廊，自己则搜 A走廊的各个房间。这样，搜寻用不了两分钟。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: As they put that into practice, Sai continued yelling out Katei's name. He wasn't being drawn to the noise, so it followed that he wasn't nearby.{w} Drawing a zigzag pattern, Akaro and Sai met in the lobby after looking through every room in their respective hallways. In the meantime, Isla observed next to her mother. Despite her initial optimism, she was aware of what the situation had become.{w} Sai put an end to the search by concluding that the mechanical room was empty.
entries.new: 方案付诸实施，Sai 一边搜一边继续高喊 Katei 的名字。他没有循声而来，可见并不在附近。{w} Akaro 和 Sai 走着之字形路线，搜完各自走廊的每个房间后在大厅会合。这期间，Isla 在母亲身旁看着。她起初虽抱着乐观，此刻也明白局面变成了什么样。{w} Sai 断定机械室是空的，结束了这次搜索。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: They walked back to the starting point, where Erina and Isla waited. Once the four of them knew that they were the only people on that floor, they could only speculate on where Katei'd gone off to. With a free way to the other floors, he could have been anywhere, and even though they'd quickly accepted that Shiroya and Atsuki had once again traveled through time, they should've reappeared by that point.
entries.new: 他们回到出发的地方，Erina 和 Isla 正在那里等候。四人确认这一层只剩他们之后，也只能猜测 Katei 去了哪里。通往其他楼层的路畅通无阻，他可能在任何地方；尽管他们很快接受了 Shiroya 和 Atsuki 又一次穿越时间的事实，可到这时他们也该重新出现了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Atsuki's and Shiroya's actions weren't openly questioned. After all, everyone had assumed they'd found the Sekimeiya and touched it without malicious intentions. After Akaro revealed that Sai had been about to enter the cleaning room, Erina couldn't help but suspect that they were being shamelessly manipulated.
entries.new: 没有人当面质疑 Atsuki 和 Shiroya 的举动。毕竟大家都以为，他们找到 Sekimeiya 后触碰它是出于无心。可自从 Akaro 揭出 Sai 当时正要走进清洁间，Erina 便不由得怀疑，他们正被人毫无廉耻地耍得团团转。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: She sat on the stairs.{w} She was tired and had to bear the constant burden of bringing her daughter into danger. They were locked up in a huge building with a murderer, and the people she wanted to trust had accepted that time travel was an ongoing factor they'd used to explain the mysteries pressing down on them.
entries.new: 她在楼梯上坐下。{w}她累了，还不得不一直背负着把女儿带入险境的压力。他们被困在一栋巨大的建筑里，里面还有杀人凶手；而她本想信任的那些人，早已把时间穿越当成反复出现的一环，用它来解释压在众人头上的种种谜团。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Mentally, she was exhausted. Ever since the first time they had found Naomi's body, she had been especially careful not to let Isla out of her sight or go off with anyone else. She simply couldn't fully trust them. From finding Naomi's second body onward, it was irrefutable that something unnatural was happening, but her only priority was her daughter's safety.
entries.new: 她的精神已经疲惫不堪。自从第一次发现 Naomi 的尸体起，她就格外小心，不让 Isla 离开自己的视线，也不让她跟别人走开。她实在没法完全信任那些人。从发现 Naomi 的第二具尸体开始，有非同寻常的事在发生便已无可辩驳，但她唯一在乎的，是女儿的安全。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Isla had initially been eager to go to what was supposed to be a routine event, but it had morphed into something incomprehensible. Erina couldn't imagine that someone would want to harm her, but the risk of being there at all gradually eroded any confidence she had in that notion.
entries.new: Isla 起初还盼着去参加这场本该寻常的活动，可它已经演变得叫人摸不着头脑。Erina 想象不出会有人想伤害她，然而光是身在此处的风险，就一点点磨掉了她对这一想法的笃定。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: By taking a seat, she only wanted to show that she needed a short break before the search that inevitably followed. Her own daughter, though, didn't grasp that intention, as she suddenly walked off toward hallway A while the others watched her curiously.
entries.new: 她坐下，只是想表明：在接下来不可避免的搜寻之前，她需要稍作歇息。可她女儿并没领会这层意思，忽然就朝 A走廊走去，其余的人则好奇地望着她。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Sweetie...? Where are you going?
entries.new: 宝贝……？你要去哪儿？
entries.speaker: akinn

entries.text: With distress and concern lacing her voice, Erina asked that question, looking up from the stairs. Isla turned around and saw her mother's face, which she found a bit tricky to decipher. Choosing to answer the question with her own actions, she continued walking and stopped next to room A5. It was the place where gemstones had been stolen, the sole crystal room exposed to the smoke.
entries.new: Erina 从楼梯上抬起头，声音里掺着不安与担忧。Isla 转过身，看见母亲的脸，却觉得那神情有些难以读懂。她选择用行动作答，继续往前走，在水晶展室 A5 旁停下。那里正是宝石失窃的地方，也是唯一被烟雾侵入的水晶展室。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Isla reached up to grab the doorknob and turned it to open her way in. From the stairs, three people looked at her, finding what they were seeing very odd. As soon as they saw Isla entering the room, Erina gave up on her brief rest and stood.
entries.new: Isla 踮起脚抓住门把手，拧开，走了进去。楼梯上的三人望着她，都觉得眼前这一幕十分古怪。一看到 Isla 进了房间，Erina 也顾不上短暂的休息，站起身来。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: While she approached the room, she timidly called Isla's name. Once she was by the door, the two men behind started to approach her, intrigued by Isla's behavior.
entries.new: 她朝房间走去，一边怯怯地唤着 Isla 的名字。等她来到门口，身后的两个男人也被 Isla 的举动勾起了好奇，跟了上来。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Isla had left the door open, so Erina was the first one to see the interior. Just as she remembered, it was dirtied by a purplish black color, and almost no brightness penetrated the coating on the ceiling.{w} The light leaking in from hallway C was the main source of illumination. It took her a second to spot Isla with how dark it was; she was putting all of the force she could into opening up a cabinet. Unbeknownst to Erina, what would then occur would not leave her memories until they all faded away.
entries.new: Isla 没关门，Erina 便成了第一个看清室内的人。正如她记忆中那样，里面被一层紫黑色污迹浸染，天花板上的涂层几乎透不进半点光。{w}主要的光源，是从 C走廊漏进来的微光。光线太暗，她花了一秒才找到 Isla——那孩子正用尽全身力气去掀开一个展示柜。Erina 并不知道，接下来发生的事，将一直盘踞在她的记忆里，直到一切褪色。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Applying force with her two small arms, Isla lifted up the heavy cover of the cabinet, found deep in the room. To prevent it from closing, she leaned it on the wall. After that, she attempted to peek inside, but her short body didn't make it easy. With both hands, she grabbed the top of the cabinet and propelled herself upward to see inside it.
entries.new: Isla 用两条纤细的胳膊使劲，掀起房间深处那个展示柜沉重的柜盖，又把它靠在墙上，免得盖回去。随后她探头往里看，可个子太矮，怎么也够不着。她双手扒住柜顶，把身子往上撑，好瞧见里面。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Once her eyes made contact with what lay within the compartment she'd uncovered, a nightmarish scream tore through the room, terrifying Erina while she looked in from the hallway.
entries.new: 她的目光刚一触及自己掀开的柜格里那样东西，一声凄厉得如同噩梦的尖叫便撕裂了整间房，把在走廊上往里张望的 Erina 吓得魂飞魄散。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: But that was only half of what she had to witness. Isla's face was hidden in the cabinet, so Erina was unable to see that her confident look had shifted into an agonizing expression.
entries.new: 可她要目睹的还不止这些。Isla 的脸埋在展示柜里，Erina 看不见她那原本自信的神情已经扭曲成了痛苦的模样。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Erina's mind reeled in response, and as she began running to aid her daughter, she frantically questioned what the cause of such a horrible scream could've been. Had it been physical pain, or a reaction to something she'd seen?
entries.new: Erina 脑中一阵天旋地转。她拔腿奔向女儿，心里疯狂地追问：这样骇人的尖叫究竟因何而起？是身体的疼痛，还是看见了什么？
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: As Erina rushed inside, Isla's instincts told her to get out of the position she'd put herself in. However, due to jumping upward, the front of the cabinet had suspended her in midair, painfully pressing into her stomach and preventing her legs from reaching the floor.{w} The only way she could move was by leaning forward.
entries.new: Erina 冲进房间时，Isla 的本能正催她脱离自己摆出的姿势。可她是往上跳的，柜子的前壁把她悬在半空，硬生生压进她的肚子，疼得厉害，双腿也够不到地面。{w}她唯一能动的方向，就是往前倾。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Next to the door, Erina's senses all perceived the same thing: Isla, in her helpless state, inclined forward and fell inside the cabinet. Only the sound of her body landing was audible, as no yell came out. Like the curtain falling after a play, the impact made the lid fall, shaken out of its precarious balance.
entries.new: 门边的 Erina 所有感官都指向同一件事：无力的 Isla 往前一倾，跌进了展示柜里。只有身体落下的声响，没有传出任何喊叫。仿佛戏剧落幕时垂下的遮布，那一撞震动了本就摇摇欲坠的柜盖，使它顺势合上。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Erina let out a cry and ran as fast as she could. Meanwhile, Sai and Akaro looked on from the door.{w} When Erina reopened the lid and leaned in, she finally saw what the ominous cabinet contained.
entries.new: Erina 惊叫一声，拼了命地跑过去。与此同时，Sai 和 Akaro 在门口看着。{w}等 Erina 重新掀开柜盖、俯身探入，她终于看清了那个不祥的展示柜里装着什么。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Nothing.{w} Erina didn't see anything but the five faces of the cabinet, covered by a velvet texture that, while untainted by the smoke, appeared black due to the lack of light.
entries.new: 什么都没有。{w}Erina 看到的只有柜子那五面内壁，铺着天鹅绒般的质地；它虽没被烟雾侵蚀，却因光线不足而显得漆黑。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: She stood still while her heart took off. Then, she snapped and began to feel its walls, trying to understand how that cabinet had swallowed up her daughter.
entries.new: 她僵立着，心脏却狂跳不止。接着她猛地回过神，开始摸索柜壁，想弄明白这个展示柜是怎么把女儿吞进去的。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Unable to find anything, she desperately looked around the cabinet in case she'd misinterpreted what had happened. Akaro and Sai, however, both bewildered, had arrived just in time to corroborate that Isla's lower body had fallen inside.
entries.new: 她什么也没摸到，便绝望地绕着柜子查看，生怕自己误解了刚才发生的事。而一脸茫然的 Akaro 与 Sai 恰好赶到，证实了他们确实看见 Isla 的下半身掉了进去。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: They stepped in while Erina's next reaction was to open up the adjacent cabinets in hope of a hidden connection. Within all of them, the only contents were a handful of gems.
entries.new: 两人走进房间，而 Erina 的下一步反应，是去打开旁边的那些展示柜，指望能找到什么暗中的连通。可那些柜子里，都只放着寥寥几颗宝石。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: As that wordless commotion continued, Sai moved toward the cabinet Isla had fallen into. He looked inside it for a few seconds and verified with his own eyes that there was nobody inside. Just as Erina had done, he couldn't suppress the need to reach in, attempting to find a hidden passageway. He felt the entire interior, and once he was done, he stood back up to gesture at Akaro that Erina was right: there was nothing there.
entries.new: 无声的骚动还在继续，Sai 走向 Isla 跌入的那个展示柜。他往里看了几秒，亲眼确认里面空无一人。和 Erina 一样，他也按捺不住伸手进去，想找找有没有暗藏的通道。他把内壁摸了个遍，摸完后直起身，朝 Akaro 比了个手势，表示 Erina 说得没错：里面什么也没有。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: They turned to Erina, who had gone completely immobile. Every cabinet had been opened and closed, and she was leaning against the last one without the strength to look up. Before the others had to wait, she spoke with a nearly broken voice.
entries.new: 他们转向 Erina，她已彻底僵在原地。所有展示柜都被开过又合上，她靠着最后那一个，连抬头的力气都没有。没等大家多等，她便用几乎破碎的声音开了口。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Where did she go...? She couldn't have disappeared.
entries.new: 她到哪儿去了……？她不可能就这么消失的。
entries.speaker: akinn

entries.text: In their circumstances, that normally sensible claim had no basis. Of course she could have disappeared, as such a thing had already happened multiple times. The real question they had to ask themselves was how. Sai and Akaro knew that, but they didn't reply, unable to find appropriate words.
entries.new: 在他们这样的处境里，这句平日再合理不过的话毫无根据。她当然可能消失——这样的事已经发生过好几次了。真正该问自己的，是怎么消失的。Sai 和 Akaro 明白这一点，却找不到合适的话，只能沉默。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Tell me. Something must've happened to her, and it has to do with this... teleportation you two keep talking about. What happened...!?
entries.new: 告诉我。她一定是出了什么事，而且和你们俩一直说的那个……传送有关。到底发生了什么……！？
entries.speaker: akinn

entries.text: They had realized that the room was empty. Isla had suddenly disappeared without leaving a trace. Even though disappearances had become commonplace, they'd thought that the Sekimeiya had to be directly involved for one to occur.{w} Despite that, they'd found it in the cleaning room and left it there. Furthermore, Atsuki's earlier explanation of the "range" emitted by the Sekimeiya couldn't explain what had occurred, as nobody else nearby had disappeared along with Isla.
entries.new: 他们这才意识到，房间里已空无一人。Isla 骤然消失，没留下半点痕迹。虽说消失这种事早已见怪不怪，他们却一直以为，发生这种事时 Sekimeiya 必定直接参与其中。{w}可尽管如此，Sekimeiya 明明是在清洁间被找到、又被留在那里的。况且，Atsuki 先前解释过 Sekimeiya 会散发某种「范围」，这也无法解释眼前的事——因为 Isla 消失时，附近并没有其他人一起不见。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: And even though it seemed of less importance, there was one last thing without an explanation: Isla's scream. She'd let out a terrifying cry as soon as she looked inside the cabinet. However, Erina had immediately looked inside and seen nothing.
entries.new: 还有最后一件看似不那么重要、却同样无从解释的事：Isla 的尖叫。她一往展示柜里看，便发出了骇人的哭喊。可 Erina 立刻往里看，却什么也没看到。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Sai and Akaro told all of that to Erina, who until that point hadn't completely considered the full implications of the paranormal events she had witnessed. They wanted to reassure Erina that even though Isla had somehow disappeared, she had gone to the past and was safe somewhere else.
entries.new: Sai 和 Akaro 把这些一五一十地讲给 Erina 听——在此之前，她还没真正想过自己目睹的这些超常事件意味着什么。他们想宽慰 Erina：Isla 虽然不知怎么消失了，但她去了过去，在别处安然无恙。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Erina knew that what had happened couldn't be immediately answered, so she rushed out to find Isla, hoping they would reunite soon. They had a whole building to search through and no guarantee that Isla was still in it. At the same time, a part of Erina was still trying to understand why Isla had suddenly walked up to that cabinet.
entries.new: Erina 知道眼前发生的事无法立刻得到答案，便冲出去找 Isla，盼着母女能尽快重逢。整栋楼都要搜，而且没人能保证 Isla 还在里面。与此同时，Erina 心里也有一角仍在琢磨：Isla 为什么会忽然走向那个展示柜。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: She tried to comfort herself when she remembered the recording they'd heard in the attic since, in the worst-case scenario, it told her that Isla was going to be safe in a month. For the first time, Erina viewed it as a failsafe instead of one of the worst possibilities.
entries.new: 她想起在阁楼听过的那段录音，便借此安慰自己——按最坏的情况说，那段录音告诉她，一个月后 Isla 会平安无事。这是她第一次把它当作一颗定心丸，而不是最糟的可能之一。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Only three people were part of the group that still remained on the crystal floor. They wanted to urgently find Isla, whose vanishing had suddenly generated the first real instance of chaos since the start of their imprisonment. They confirmed that the Sekimeiya hadn't moved from the cleaning room, and their rushed search began.
entries.new: 仍留在水晶层的人只剩下三个。他们急着找到 Isla——她的消失，突然引发了自他们被囚禁以来第一场真正的混乱。他们确认 Sekimeiya 没有离开清洁间，随后便开始了匆忙的搜寻。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: They continually yelled Isla's name, hoping that she would appear before them. Even though a single disappearance hadn't yet been linked to direct danger, Erina's nerves were clearly shot, which was why they went through the whole building as fast as they could.
entries.new: 他们不断高喊 Isla 的名字，希望她会出现在眼前。虽说单独一次消失还没和直接的危险联系起来，可 Erina 显然已濒临崩溃，正因如此，他们才拼尽全力把整栋楼飞快搜了个遍。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Having recently looked through the entire bottom floor, they were done with it swiftly. The elevator should've still been disabled in the attic, so their search continued through the stairs.
entries.new: 最底层不久前才刚搜过，他们很快便查完了。电梯应该仍旧停在阁楼、处于停用状态，于是他们顺着楼梯继续往上搜。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Emitting clear desperation, they hastily looked through the rest of the building, yelling for Isla.
entries.new: 他们毫不掩饰地流露出绝望，一边呼喊 Isla，一边匆匆搜完了建筑的其余部分。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Once they finished, the result took a bit of time to sink in. Not only had they not found Isla, but Katei, Shiroya, and Atsuki hadn't been drawn to their yells either.
entries.new: 搜完之后，好一会儿他们才回过神来。他们不但没找到 Isla，就连 Katei、Shiroya 和 Atsuki 也没被喊声引来。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: As they thought, the elevator was still open, and they chose not to reenable it yet.
entries.new: 果然不出所料，电梯门还开着，他们决定暂时不重新启用。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: With a much slower pace and devoid of energy, they headed downstairs, surrounded by the haunting silence. Erina's thoughts kept returning to the recording, which she could no longer make Sai and Akaro listen to even if she wanted to, as it had disappeared along with Isla's purse.
entries.new: 他们拖着疲惫的身子，以慢得多的速度下楼，四周萦绕着令人不安的寂静。Erina 的思绪一次次回到那段录音——如今即便她想让 Sai 和 Akaro 再听一遍也做不到了，它已随着 Isla 的手提包一同消失。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The crystal floor was just as empty as before. None of them knew what to do, so they lethargically walked to the lobby.
entries.new: 水晶层和先前一样空荡。三人都不知如何是好，只好无精打采地走向大厅。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Before them was the immutable shutter preventing them from escaping and obtaining help. Erina leaned against it while the other two stayed still. Imagining how much Erina was suffering, being faced with the precarious disappearance of her child, they had chosen long ago not to say anything unnecessary.
entries.new: 拦在他们面前的，还是那道纹丝不动的卷帘门，挡住他们逃生求援的路。Erina 靠着它，另外两人静静站着。想到 Erina 面对孩子下落不明，该是何等痛苦，他们早就决定不说多余的话。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: For a while, they stayed there, powerless against the confusing reality, hoping that waiting would lead them somewhere.
entries.new: 有好一阵子，他们就这样待着，对眼前这令人费解的现实无能为力，只盼着等待能带来些什么。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: They knew where the Sekimeiya was, but without Katei, dealing with it seemed far from their priority. It appeared impossible that it had been related to Isla's disappearance, but no other explanation existed. Out of the blue, they found themselves alone in a huge building with two identical corpses after four people had vanished.
entries.new: 他们知道 Sekimeiya 在哪里，可 Katei 不在，处理它远谈不上是当务之急。要说这东西与 Isla 的失踪有关，几乎不可能，可除此之外再无别的解释。转眼之间，四个人下落不明，偌大的建筑里只剩他们自己，以及两具一模一样的尸体。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The silence had continued uninterrupted since they'd set foot on the crystal floor, but the three of them had been thinking about drastically different things.{w} It was an outside sound that finally breached the empty air, coming from hallway A.
entries.new: 自从踏上水晶层，沉默便一直延续，未曾中断，可三个人心里想的却是天差地别的事。{w} 最终打破这片空寂的，是外面传来的一声响动，来自 A走廊。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: They immediately lifted their heads. The door had been left open, so they all rushed to see if they could spot the origin of the sound.
entries.new: 他们立刻抬起头。门本就敞着，三人一齐冲过去，想看看声音是从哪儿来的。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: They did so easily. Katei's figure was in the middle of the wide floor, his shoulders slumped. As soon as they saw each other, Katei hurried over to them.
entries.new: 他们一眼便看清了。Katei 就站在宽阔楼层的中央，双肩低垂。两边一对上视线，Katei 便急忙朝他们走来。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Where did you go...? We searched for you.
entries.new: 你去哪儿了……？我们一直在找你。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: Sai shot the first question, and an immediate answer came that left the three of them unsatisfied.
entries.new: 先开口的是 Sai，回答来得也快，却让三人都不满意。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: I don't know. I think I experienced what Atsuki said... That teleportation. I've been searching for you.
entries.new: 我不知道。我大概经历了 Atsuki 说的那件事……那个传送。我一直在找你们。
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: That brief explanation was all they got, as the next thing that came out of his mouth was the question they'd known would come.
entries.new: 他们只得到这么一句简短的解释，因为他接下来问出口的，正是他们早就料到的问题。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Where are Isla, Atsuki, and Shiroya?
entries.new: Isla、Atsuki 和 Shiroya 呢？
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: Katei looked through the door and saw the empty hall. Three faces lowered in front of him, communicating what had occurred. Akaro, knowing how hard it was for Erina to hear those words, chose to speak and briefly explained the recent events.
entries.new: Katei 透过门望向空荡的走廊。三张脸在他面前低了下去，已经把发生的事说明白了。Akaro 知道那些话让 Erina 听着有多难受，便主动开口，简要讲了讲最近的经过。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: It was a lot of information to take in for Katei, and it only made everything that had recently happened even more confusing. Despite that, he had a few thoughts that he chose to keep to himself.
entries.new: 这些信息对 Katei 来说太多了，只让近来发生的一切更加扑朔迷离。尽管如此，他心里还是有了些想法，只是选择不说出口。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: I see. I'm sorry, but I have no clue what happened to any of us. You said you searched the building, right...?
entries.new: 原来如此。抱歉，我们几个到底出了什么事，我也毫无头绪。你们说已经搜过这栋楼了，对吧……？
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: The others nodded.
entries.new: 其余三人点了点头。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: They'd told him where Isla, Atsuki, and Shiroya had disappeared from, so he began walking to where they'd last seen Isla, as that part of the story was what he least understood.
entries.new: 他们已把 Isla、Atsuki 和 Shiroya 各自失踪的地点告诉了他，他便先朝最后见到 Isla 的地方走去——那一段他听得最不明白。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: They all entered room A5 and were hit by the memory of Isla's body falling into that looming void. They'd lowered every lid before leaving, so Sai pointed at the one in question.
entries.new: 他们一同走进水晶展室 A5，Isla 的身体坠入那片幽暗虚空的画面立刻涌上心头。离开前他们把每个柜盖都放了下来，Sai 便指了指出事的那一只。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Katei approached it, finding it hard to believe that nothing had been found inside. He completely denied the thought of any opening or passage within the cabinet, so he wanted to see if he could get a good idea of what had happened or if he could reinforce what he believed had truly occurred.
entries.new: Katei 走上前去，很难相信里面什么都没找到。他完全不接受展示柜里有什么开口或通道的说法，所以想亲眼看看，或许能弄清发生了什么，或许能印证他所认定的真相。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He gripped the lower part of the lid with his right arm and lifted it. As soon as the smallest gap appeared, he peeked inside.{w} Even though there was very little light, he frowned.
entries.new: 他右手抓住柜盖下沿，向上抬起。刚露出一丝缝隙，他就朝里看去。{w} 光线虽暗，他的眉头却皱了起来。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: As he continued revealing the cabinet, that frown shifted into a much darker expression. Once he was done, he could only gesture at the others to see with their own eyes, as he couldn't bring himself to say the words out loud.
entries.new: 随着柜盖越抬越高，他的眉头越皱越紧，表情也越发阴沉。完全打开后，他只能朝其他人示意，让他们亲眼看一看——那话他说不出口。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Hearing his faint but trembling voice, Erina ran up to see what he'd seen.
entries.new: 听见他那微弱而发颤的声音，Erina 跑了过来，想看看他究竟看到了什么。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: When she saw the body of her daughter lying face-up, her mind broke, and all of her thoughts were defied. Isla almost looked like she was sleeping, but the lack of her chest rising made Erina fear the worst.
entries.new: 看到女儿仰面躺着的身体，她的心彻底碎了，脑海里的一切念头都被击得粉碎。Isla 看上去几乎像是睡着了，可胸口毫无起伏，Erina 不敢再想下去。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Without thinking, she reached inside, and as soon as she felt Isla's skin, she gave out and collapsed onto the cabinet, creating a sight reminiscent of the last time Isla had been seen.
entries.new: 她想也没想就伸手探了进去，一触到 Isla 的皮肤，整个人便支撑不住，瘫倒在展示柜上——那副模样，恰似 Isla 最后一次被人看见时的情景。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: She had felt no trace of life—only a cold piece of flesh with a texture far from the one she recognized as her daughter's.
entries.new: 她感觉不到一丝生气，只有一块冰冷的血肉，那触感与她记忆中女儿的肌肤相去甚远。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: While the others stared with pity, Erina didn't move, her sharp cries piercing the air. The recording, which she had begun to see as proof of hope, had become an impossibility.
entries.new: 其他人只能怜悯地望着，Erina 却一动不动，尖利的哭声划破了空气。那段录音，她本来已经开始当作希望的证明，如今却彻底落空了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: After some time, Katei looked inside the cabinet again while everyone kept an eye on him. He didn't see anything else; Isla rested alone in the space she'd disappeared from.
entries.new: 过了一会儿，在众人的注视下，Katei 又朝柜里看了一眼。他没有再看到别的东西；Isla 独自躺在她当初消失的那方空间里。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The others knew how heartless it was to attempt to solve what had happened right away, but nobody could help but think about how little sense it all made. Isla had disappeared from an empty cabinet and reappeared inside it later, the only change her status from alive to dead.
entries.new: 其他人都明白，此刻就急着解开谜团有多无情，可谁也忍不住去想这事有多么不合常理。Isla 从一只空柜子里消失，之后又出现在同一只柜子里，唯一的变化只是从生到死。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: A third death had surfaced, and that time, someone who'd been with the group from the start was the victim. Once again, a number of questions came along with it, but no answers—not even the cause of death.
entries.new: 第三起死亡浮出水面，而这一次，倒下的是从一开始就与他们同行的人。疑问照旧随之而来，却依旧没有答案——连死因都无从得知。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Regardless, the unfortunate reality was that a mother had lost her child on what should've been an enjoyable day which had transfigured into an inexplicable nightmare. The rest of them verified that Isla was no longer alive, and while they were hit hard by such a tragedy, they knew they couldn't begin to imagine what Erina was feeling.
entries.new: 无论如何，残酷的现实是：这本该是愉快的一天，却化作了一场无从解释的噩梦，一位母亲失去了自己的孩子。其余的人确认了 Isla 已经不在人世，这场悲剧固然令他们深受打击，但他们也知道，Erina 的心情是他们根本无法想象的。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: They exchanged looks without interfering with her, her body trembling as she hid her face. Eventually, she stood up abruptly and bolted out of the room, briefly displaying her tormented expression.
entries.new: 他们没有去打扰她，只是彼此交换了眼神；她掩着脸，身体不住地颤抖。终于，她猛地站起，冲出房间，一瞬露出了饱受折磨的神情。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Erina had left due to her recollection of Naomi's death. A killer was nearby and had managed to remain unseen.
entries.new: Erina 之所以离开，是因为她想起了 Naomi 的死。凶手就在近旁，却始终没被看见。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Even though she couldn't begin to take in what had happened, she understood that her life had warped into something terrible, regret her only companion. She took advantage of the last amount of strength she had within herself and used it while adrenaline still let her.
entries.new: 尽管她一时还理解不了发生的一切，却明白自己的人生已经扭曲成了可怕的模样，只剩下悔恨相伴。她用尽体内最后一点力气，趁着肾上腺素还未退去。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Frantically, she opened every door in the hallway. Then, she looked through every cabinet in case the killer had brazenly hidden in one. Her thoughts on the matter were clear, and she knew who to suspect. Katei, Atsuki, and Shiroya could've been responsible in some way.
entries.new: 她发疯似的打开走廊上的每一扇门，又逐一查看每一只展示柜，生怕凶手就公然藏在其中。她心里很清楚该怀疑谁：Katei、Atsuki 和 Shiroya 都可能脱不了干系。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: However, as soon as she entered the huge and overwhelming lobby, her body gave out under the full weight of her daughter's death. She wouldn't be able to find her killer, and most likely, she would never begin to understand what had happened to her.{w} Suffering from the ultimate feeling of emptiness, she slumped on a wall and slowly slid to the ground.
entries.new: 然而，一走进那空旷而令人窒息的大厅，女儿的死便如山压顶，她的身体再也撑不住了。她找不到凶手，多半也永远弄不明白女儿遭遇了什么。{w} 被极致的空虚吞噬，她靠上墙壁，缓缓滑坐到地上。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Sai, Akaro, and Katei, upon noticing that the sound of Erina's movements had abruptly faded, walked to the lobby and saw her sitting on the floor ahead.
entries.new: Sai、Akaro 和 Katei 察觉到 Erina 的动静忽然消失了，便走到大厅，看见她坐在前方的地板上。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: They approached her slowly and remained at her side.{w} A loud noise resounded through the entire floor... and they understood what it had been.
entries.new: 他们缓缓走近，守在她身旁。{w} 一声巨响在整个楼层回荡……他们明白那是什么声音。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The cabinet's lid had fallen when nobody had been looking, sealing Isla inside while also letting her rest peacefully.
entries.new: 就在无人留意时，展示柜的柜盖落了下来，将 Isla 封在其中，也让她得以安息。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Nobody chose to leave the lobby. They knew that gravity, a simple law of the universe, had closed Isla's coffin by itself.{w} However, they didn't know the true consequences that sound had brought, and spent the time unaware until the hallway B door opened.
entries.new: 谁也没有离开大厅。他们知道，是重力这条再简单不过的宇宙法则，自行合上了 Isla 的棺盖。{w} 可他们并不知道那声响真正带来了什么后果，就这样毫无察觉地待着，直到 B走廊的门打开。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Sai finished summarizing what had happened, avoiding explicit words that would've hurt Erina even more. It was way too much to take in, and it revealed that we'd slept for longer than we'd thought.
entries.new: Sai 把经过讲完了，措辞避开了那些会更深地刺痛 Erina 的字眼。信息量太大，一时难以接受，也说明我们睡的时间比以为的要长。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: As I looked at Erina, who hadn't raised her head since we'd entered, I saw the wet stains on her lap that I'd missed before.
entries.new: 我看向 Erina——自从我们进来，她一直没抬过头——这才发现她膝上那片湿痕，之前竟没有留意。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Shiroya looked crushed. She couldn't believe such a sudden and tragic story had unfolded while she'd slept.{w} I began to feel guilty about my recent actions, ones I'd taken in ignorance.
entries.new: Shiroya 神情黯然，几乎垮了。她无法相信，就在自己睡着的时候，竟发生了这样突然而惨烈的事。{w} 我开始为自己近来的举动感到愧疚——那些事都是我在一无所知中做下的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I didn't know what to say, so I just stood there, repelling the thought that Isla was really no longer with us.
entries.new: 我不知道该说什么，只能站在原地，竭力不去想 Isla 真的已经不在了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I felt terrible for her and Erina, but also unimaginably pissed off. Instead of having the chance to mourn privately, Erina had to spend hours locked up with us, not understanding how or why her daughter had passed away.
entries.new: 我为她和 Erina 难受，同时又一肚子说不出的火。Erina 连独自哀悼的机会都没有，只能和我们一起被关了几个小时，却始终不明白女儿是怎么死的、为什么而死。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It was a bad idea, but I asked it regardless, in a quiet voice.
entries.new: 我知道这不合时宜，却还是低声问了出来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Can I go see?
entries.new: ……我能去看看吗？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Sai nodded hesitantly, as it wasn't his decision. Shiroya must have been horrified at the thought of seeing Isla with her own eyes. I didn't want to see her either, but I wanted to understand what had happened more than anything. It was the least we could do.
entries.new: Sai 迟疑地点了点头——这事本不该由他决定。想到要亲眼去看 Isla，Shiroya 一定吓坏了。我也不想看，可我更想弄清到底发生了什么。至少这是我们能做的事。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I didn't know how to act, only that attempting to comfort Erina was foolish. We'd told her how sorry we were as soon as Sai mentioned Isla's death, but that had been it.
entries.new: 我不知道该怎么做，只知道这时候去安慰 Erina 是愚蠢的。Sai 一提到 Isla 的死，我们便说了几句惋惜的话，可除此之外，什么也做不了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Before I could move, Erina stood up and looked at us. Although she didn't have the strength to speak, she breathed while wiping her face and walked toward hallway A.
entries.new: 我还没来得及动，Erina 已经站起身，看向我们。她连开口的力气都没有，只是喘着气擦去脸上的泪，朝 A走廊走去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: She needed to know what had occurred. Many things stood out, starting with Isla's behavior. She had gone to that cabinet by herself without explaining why, so there had to be something important there.
entries.new: 她必须弄明白发生了什么。可疑之处太多了，首先是 Isla 的举动。她独自走向那只展示柜，却没说原因，那里一定有什么要紧的东西。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Then, her yell upon seeing its contents. Given how Erina had found the cabinet empty, it seemed possible to conclude what Isla had witnessed... And even though the Sekimeiya had been in the cleaning room, there was a chance that two existed.
entries.new: 其次是她看到柜中之物时的喊叫。既然 Erina 后来发现柜子是空的，Isla 当时看见了什么，似乎也能推断出来……而且，就算 Sekimeiya 在清洁间里，也不排除存在两个的可能。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If Isla's disappearance had been caused by the Sekimeiya, it was possible that she had seen a human body. It would have warranted the scream, and humans were all that the Sekimeiya seemed to make travel. Maybe there'd been someone in the cabinet and they'd disappeared at the same time as Isla.
entries.new: 如果 Isla 的消失是 Sekimeiya 造成的，那她当时看到的很可能是人的身体。那声尖叫便说得通了，而且 Sekimeiya 似乎只能让人类穿越。说不定柜里当时有个人，和 Isla 一起消失了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: However, I kept in mind what Shiroya and I had just discussed. If falling into the cabinet made Isla touch what was inside, she might've traveled with it if it had become something she possessed, for lack of a better term.
entries.new: 不过，我记着我和 Shiroya 刚才的讨论。如果 Isla 跌进柜子时碰到了里面的东西，而那样东西——姑且这么说——成了她随身之物，她就可能连同它一起穿越了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: And if that was what had happened, the source of the range had to have been outside the cabinet, or else the Sekimeiya would've remained inside it.{w} If the range came from the Sekimeiya in the cleaning room, Erina, by the entrance to room A5, should've traveled as well. Sai and Akaro saw Isla falling into the cabinet, so Katei, who had just disappeared, could've been who'd activated it. In that case, nobody would have noticed he'd traveled too.
entries.new: 如果真是这样，那么范围的源头就只能位于展示柜之外，否则 Sekimeiya 应该仍留在柜中。{w}倘若范围源自清洁间的 Sekimeiya，那么守在 A5 展室入口旁的 Erina 也该被传送走才对。Sai 和 Akaro 亲眼看见 Isla 倒进展示柜，那么刚刚消失的 Katei，或许正是启动它的人。若果真如此，谁也不会注意到他也被传送了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: However, the crystal floor had just been searched, so if Katei's range had encompassed the whole cabinet... it might have come from floor 2.{w} If the range went through solid objects and Katei was above the room, the ceiling was no obstacle.
entries.new: 不过，水晶层才刚刚被搜寻过；如果 Katei 的范围覆盖了整个展示柜……那源头或许来自二楼。{w}如果范围能穿透实体，而 Katei 就在展室上方，那么天花板也构不成阻碍。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: In fact, my third travel suggested that the range could go through solid objects. The Sekimeiya had been in the cleaning cart and I'd been picked up too, so if the Sekimeiya was the nucleus of the range, the cart's walls should've prevented me from traveling.
entries.new: 事实上，我第三次被传送的经历已经说明范围可以穿透实体。当时 Sekimeiya 在清洁推车里，而我也被卷了进去；若 Sekimeiya 是范围的中心，推车的箱壁本该阻止我被传送才是。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: After Isla's disappearance, the group searched through the whole building and didn't find Katei. If he activated the travel from floor 2, he could appear on the crystal floor, escaping the search.{w} However, it was important to note that they never found me and Shiroya, so their search wasn't perfect.{w} That theory explained Katei's and Isla's disappearances along with the lack of the Sekimeiya in the cabinet. ...Would it mean that it was all just a very unfortunate coincidence, though?
entries.new: Isla 失踪后，众人搜遍了整栋楼，也没找到 Katei。如果他是在二楼启动传送的，就可能出现在水晶层，从而躲过搜索。{w}不过有一点值得留意：他们始终没发现我和 Shiroya，可见搜索并不彻底。{w}这套推断能解释 Katei 与 Isla 的失踪，也能解释展示柜里为何没有 Sekimeiya。……可这难道意味着，一切只是极为不幸的巧合？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Isla had found something peculiar about the cabinet, and there had been something frightening inside it...
entries.new: Isla 曾发现展示柜有些蹊跷，而柜里确实有什么令人害怕的东西……
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We were all in front of it. Since nobody else was going to step in, I walked forward myself.
entries.new: 我们全都站在柜前。既然没人肯上前，我便自己走了过去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I was afraid and worried about how Isla would look, but I needed to find something that hinted at what had happened. I began raising the lid while everyone kept their eyes slightly diverted from me.
entries.new: 我又怕又担心 Isla 会是什么样子，但我必须找到能暗示事情经过的线索。大家都不太敢正眼看，视线稍稍避开，我则动手掀起了柜盖。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I carefully leaned it on the wall so that it wouldn't close again. Then, I finally looked inside, hoping that the dim light would prevent the sight from being too harsh.
entries.new: 我小心地把柜盖靠在墙上，免得它再次合上。随后，我终于朝里面看去，只盼昏暗的光线能让眼前的情景不至于太过刺目。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: W-Wait...{w} This isn't what you said.
entries.new: 等、等等……{w}这跟你说的不一样啊。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: What isn't?
entries.new: 哪里不一样？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Sai, thinking that I'd accused him of lying, walked forward while everyone else frowned. As soon as he looked, he understood what I meant.
entries.new: Sai 以为我在指责他撒谎，便走上前来，其余人则皱起了眉。他只看了一眼，就明白了我话里的意思。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Huh? I-I don't get it, why is this...?
entries.new: 咦？我、我不明白，这东西怎么会……？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: The others all got closer. They saw Isla resting face-up with her knees folded.{w} However, my own tiny wish had been denied by the Sekimeiya beside her, emitting a faint light which illuminated her more than I'd wanted.
entries.new: 其余人也纷纷凑近，看见 Isla 仰面躺着，双膝蜷曲。{w}然而，我那个小小的愿望被守在她身旁的 Sekimeiya 打破了——它散发着微弱的光，把她的样子照得比我期望的更清楚。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What? I-It shouldn't be here...{w} I haven't gone to the cleaning room myself, but I'm certain that when I saw her, there was nothing else here. I didn't find it appropriate to blame them for leaving the Sekimeiya out of the cabinet since Isla had disappeared, but none of us could have moved it.
entries.new: 什么？它、它不该在这里……{w}我虽然没亲自去过清洁间，但我很确定，我见到她的时候，这里没有别的东西。Isla 失踪之后，他们没把 Sekimeiya 收回展示柜，我不好因此责怪他们，可我们之中谁都不可能挪动过它。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Y-Yes. I'm sure the Sekimeiya wasn't here when we left.
entries.new: 对、对。我们离开的时候，Sekimeiya 肯定不在这里。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Erina, who had been the only one to refrain from looking, gave a small nod when our eyes met.
entries.new: 唯独 Erina 始终没有上前去看。我们的目光相遇时，她轻轻点了点头。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There's no way it got here by itself.
entries.new: 它绝不可能自己跑到这儿来。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Katei left the room as he gestured at us to follow. Naturally, he was going to the cleaning room, so Shiroya and I instinctively looked at each other, knowing how that would end.
entries.new: Katei 朝我们示意跟上，随即走出房间。他自然是要去清洁间，我和 Shiroya 心知这一去会是什么结果，下意识地对视了一眼。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What the...?{w} Oh, right, you said the cleaning cart disappeared after our travel.
entries.new: 搞什么……？{w}啊，对了，你说过我们传送之后，清洁推车就不见了。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: This is too much. Does it simply not exist anymore?
entries.new: 这也太离谱了。难道它就这么凭空没了？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: We'd hidden the Sekimeiya, but admitting it was pointless, as that had nothing to do with Isla's death and would only make us extremely suspicious. I made sure to communicate my stance on it to Shiroya by appearing to be surprised.
entries.new: Sekimeiya 是我们藏起来的，可坦白毫无意义——这跟 Isla 的死无关，只会让我们显得格外可疑。我装出一副惊讶的样子，好让 Shiroya 明白我的立场。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It's not here... We left the Sekimeiya in this bucket.
entries.new: 不在这里……我们明明把 Sekimeiya 留在这只桶里了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What, then? Did it teleport to Isla?
entries.new: 那又是怎么回事？它自己传送去找 Isla 了？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Listen, Atsuki. I don't want to throw out useless accusations right now, but you understand that you and Shiroya are the only two people who could've moved it, right?
entries.new: 听我说，Atsuki。我现在不想胡乱指控谁，但你也明白，能挪动它的只有你和 Shiroya 两个人吧？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: That's not true... Someone who came from the future could've done it too.
entries.new: 不对……从未来来的人也可能动过它。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: You're right, but assuming that didn't happen, it could only have been you two. Katei could've taken it as well, but he couldn't have left it in the cabinet.
entries.new: 你说得对，但假定没有这回事，那就只可能是你们俩。Katei 也可能拿走它，但他不可能把它放进展示柜。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: This is the first time you've seen the cleaning cart gone, right? You came to the lobby from hallway B, so did you not explore these rooms? Why did you go straight to the lobby?
entries.new: 你们是头一次发现清洁推车不见的吧？你们是从 B走廊来到大厅的，那这些房间你们没搜过？为什么径直去了大厅？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Understand that what you've told us is that you two spent all this time asleep in the attic. Despite this, you weren't found.
entries.new: 你要清楚，按你的说法，你们俩这段时间一直在阁楼里睡觉。可即便如此，你们却没被找到。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...You didn't find Katei either, so you obviously didn't do a great job. And you were in a rush, so you kept yelling Isla's name while quickly looking. I bet you didn't look at the upper levels of the bedrooms, which is where we were, and since we were asleep, we didn't hear you.
entries.new: ……你们不也没找到 Katei 吗？可见搜得也不怎么样。而且你们当时急匆匆的，一边喊着 Isla 的名字一边草草查看。我敢说，你们根本没看卧室上层——我们就待在那儿；再说我们睡着了，也听不见你们。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: And yes, we found it unlikely you'd be in a crystal room, so our first instinct was to go to the event room and then to the lobby.
entries.new: 还有，我们觉得你们不太可能待在水晶展室，所以第一反应是先去活动室，再去大厅。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Forgive me, but I find this hard to believe. You came from hallway B, which is unneeded for what you're saying. In fact, since you knew the Sekimeiya had been in the cleaning room, what I find most believable is that you came here straight away.
entries.new: 恕我直言，这很难让人相信。按你们的说法，根本不需要走 B走廊。倒不如说，既然你们知道 Sekimeiya 曾在清洁间，我觉得最可信的解释就是你们直接来了这里。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: We didn't. We just had to go to the bathroom after sleeping, so we took hallway B afterward.
entries.new: 我们没有。我们睡醒后只是去了趟洗手间，之后才走 B走廊的。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Both of you?
entries.new: 你们两个都去了？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Yes. Does that matter?
entries.new: 对。这有什么关系？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: If I'm not misremembering, there's a corpse covering the entire floor of the men's. Did it not bother you?
entries.new: 如果我没记错，男洗手间的地板上躺着一具尸体。你们不觉得碍事吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...{w}Don't be stupid. I used the other one too.
entries.new: ……{w}别犯傻了。另一个洗手间我也用过了。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I'd admittedly missed that, but Sai stopped talking, as it had started to feel very disrespectful. I wasn't sure if he was accusing us of hiding the Sekimeiya or of being involved in Isla's death. I didn't have to say it, but I'd been ready to claim that if we'd hidden it in Isla's cabinet, we would have appeared from hallway A.
entries.new: 我确实没留意这一点，但 Sai 已经闭了嘴，因为话说到这份上，多少显得对死者不敬。我拿不准他是在指控我们藏了 Sekimeiya，还是在暗示我们与 Isla 的死有关。这话不必我说出口，但我早已备好一套说辞：若真把 Sekimeiya 藏进了 Isla 的展示柜，我们本该从 A走廊出现。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Well, no matter how, the Sekimeiya moved from here to the cabinet. I don't know why the culprit would do this.
entries.new: 总之，不管是怎么做到的，Sekimeiya 就是从这儿移动到了展示柜。我不明白犯人为什么要这么做。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Shiroya and I had hidden the Sekimeiya in Naomi's locker, so it was even more confusing for us. Nobody could've put it in the cabinet, the goal seemed impossible to decipher, and there was the entire existence of another Sekimeiya to deal with.
entries.new: Sekimeiya 其实被我和 Shiroya 藏进了 Naomi 的储物柜，所以我们更加摸不着头脑。没人能把它放进展示柜，其目的也完全无法推测，更何况还有另一枚 Sekimeiya 的存在需要应付。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Something Sai had said bothered me: "the culprit".{w} He was implying that what happened to Isla was someone's fault, and one who had orchestrated everything deliberately. I wasn't so convinced about that, so we moved again to where Isla lay to determine an important fact: the cause of her death.
entries.new: ……Sai 有句话让我耿耿于怀：「犯人」。{w}他言下之意，Isla 的遭遇是某人的过错，而且是有人刻意安排好了一切。我并不那么确信，于是我们再次回到 Isla 躺着的地方，要弄清一件要紧的事——她的死因。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We'd left the lid uncovered, and as I peeked inside, I saw that the Sekimeiya was still present. It was white, and it emitted a bit of light around itself.
entries.new: 柜盖我们一直敞着没合上。我朝里张望，Sekimeiya 仍在那儿。它通体白色，周身泛着淡淡的光。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I covered my hand with my sleeve and reached in to grab it. I underestimated the depth of the cabinet, and my fingers brushed the Sekimeiya, causing it to roll and contact Isla's face.{w} Frowning, I retrieved it properly and stood up straight.
entries.new: 我用袖子裹住手，探进去拿它。我低估了展示柜的深度，指尖擦到了 Sekimeiya，它滚了一下，碰到了 Isla 的脸。{w}我皱起眉，好好把它取了出来，直起身子。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Remember what we thought about Naomi? That maybe the Sekimeiya replicated her dead body...? Well, I accidentally knocked it into Isla's cheek, and given how the Sekimeiya is still white and I wasn't picked up by any range, it's unlikely anything happened.
entries.new: 还记得我们关于 Naomi 的猜测吗？也许 Sekimeiya 复制了她那具尸体……？刚才我不小心让它磕到了 Isla 的脸颊，而 Sekimeiya 现在仍是白色，我也没有被任何范围卷进去，所以多半什么也没发生。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Is it hot?
entries.new: 它是热的吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Slightly, yes.
entries.new: 有点温，是的。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Really, it was almost hot enough to hurt, but I didn't feel like indulging Sai.
entries.new: 其实它烫得几乎有些灼手，可我不愿顺着 Sai 的话往下说。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Since I didn't know what to do with it, I made my way to the event room and put it in the cabinet. I explored the possibility of activating it myself, but I discarded it quickly, as it was clear that we didn't truly know how it worked, and a death that seemed to have been closely tied to its mechanics had just taken place.
entries.new: 我不知该拿它怎么办，便走到活动室，把它放进了展示柜。我也想过由自己来启动它，但很快打消了这个念头——我们显然并不真正了解它的运作方式，何况刚刚才发生过一起似乎与它的机制密切相关的死亡。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Going back, I met Katei in the hallway.
entries.new: 回去的路上，我在走廊里遇见了 Katei。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I went to grab this from the security room. It's a little flashlight I use to move around this floor when the lights are off. It should be helpful.
entries.new: 这是我从监控室拿来的。是我平时关灯后在这层走动用的小手电。应该能派上用场。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: I see. It will.
entries.new: 我明白了。会派上用场的。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Once I returned, I showed the light to Erina, letting her know that it'd help us examine Isla and the cabinet.
entries.new: 回去后，我把手电拿给 Erina 看，告诉她这能帮我们查看 Isla 和展示柜。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Erina, are you okay with this? If you prefer, we can wait until the police investigate. I... do want to see if there's anything to find and learn what happened, but I understand if you want us to hold off.
entries.new: ……Erina，你同意这么做吗？如果你更愿意，我们可以等警方来调查。我……确实想看看能发现什么、弄清发生了什么，但如果你想让我们先别动，我也理解。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: ...No. Go... Go ahead.
entries.new: ……不。继续……继续吧。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: ...Okay.
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: If nothing else, it was good to see that she didn't strongly suspect us of being responsible even though it seemed that only Shiroya and I could've had the chance to move the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 至少让我感到宽慰的是，她并没有强烈怀疑是我们所为——毕竟有机会移动 Sekimeiya 的，似乎只有 Shiroya 和我。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Based on the story that Sai told us, it should've also been possible for Sai, Akaro, and Katei to be working together and put the Sekimeiya there themselves, but I considered it far from likely.
entries.new: 根据 Sai 告诉我们的说法，Sai、Akaro 和 Katei 也有可能联手，亲手把 Sekimeiya 放到那里，但我觉得这几乎不可能。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I stepped forward again. My intention was not to touch Isla directly, and even though I'd appreciated the lack of proper illumination earlier, I was about to use a light myself. It made me uneasy, but the darkness could easily obscure something vital.
entries.new: 我又往前迈了一步。我并没打算直接触碰 Isla；先前光线不足，我反而不介意，可现在我要亲自打光。这让我不安，但黑暗很容易掩盖关键之处。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: As soon as I turned it on, the flashlight proved to be potent. I illuminated the entire room, and for the first time, we clearly saw what the walls and ceiling looked like. They could almost be called disfigured, but nothing else stood out.
entries.new: 手电一打开，光亮得惊人。它照亮了整个房间，我们第一次看清墙壁和天花板是什么样子。那几乎可以说是面目全非，但除此之外没有别的异样。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I moved to the cabinet, and aside from Erina, who remained by the door, the rest got closer too.
entries.new: 我走到展示柜前，除了留在门边的 Erina，其他人也都靠了过来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I could clearly see Isla's hauntingly peaceful face. It was overwhelming, and for an instant, I thought I'd suddenly wake back up in the attic.
entries.new: 我能清楚地看见 Isla 那张安详得令人心悸的脸。那股冲击几乎压得人喘不过气，有一瞬间，我甚至以为自己会突然在阁楼里醒来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: However, apart from that, the result wasn't what I expected. The cabinet wasn't concealing anything from us. In fact, the interior was exactly as it appeared. Not a single drop of blood had stained it, and there was no hint toward the way Isla lost her life.
entries.new: 然而除此之外，结果并不如我所料。展示柜没有藏起任何东西，里面和外观看起来完全一致。没有一滴血沾在上面，也没有任何线索指向 Isla 的死因。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: For the first time, and with a slight frown, I reached my hand out to touch her.{w} However, any doubts I had were wiped away by contacting her lifeless skin. Even though nothing indicated how it had happened, Isla was not alive.
entries.new: 我微微皱眉，第一次伸手去碰她。{w}可一碰到她那毫无生气的皮肤，我心中的疑虑便烟消云散。尽管没有任何迹象说明事情是如何发生的，Isla 确实已经死去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: How had the leap from life to death happened? I had no good guess.{w} I spoke in a faint voice so that Erina wouldn't hear me. Two weeks prior, a death had destroyed my life, but that was almost minuscule compared to how Erina must have felt. If I had any answers for her, they needed to be certain.
entries.new: 从生到死的这一步究竟是如何发生的？我毫无头绪。{w}我压低声音，不让 Erina 听见。两周前，一场死亡毁掉了我的生活，但和 Erina 此刻的感受相比，那几乎微不足道。如果我要给她答案，那答案就必须确凿无疑。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I can't know what happened to her just by looking, but there's no blood at all. It reminds me a bit of the second Naomi.
entries.new: 光看是看不出她出了什么事的，但完全没有血。这让我有点想起第二个 Naomi。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: So physical damage wasn't the cause, unless brain damage from a blow didn't leave a wound. It could've been poisoning.
entries.new: 所以不是外伤致死，除非是头部受击造成脑损伤却没有留下伤口。也可能是中毒。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: You think someone had the chance to poison her in a situation like this?
entries.new: 你觉得这种情形下，有人能有机会给她下毒吗？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I'm just keeping my options open.
entries.new: 我只是不想排除任何可能。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I don't know.{w} If someone did this to her, sure, but in terms of natural deaths, not many things would apply. Children don't really have their hearts suddenly fail very often.
entries.new: 我不知道。{w}如果是有人对她下了手，那倒说得通；可若论自然死亡，符合条件的并不多。小孩子心脏突然衰竭，毕竟不常见。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: The Sekimeiya was involved in some way, so we have to think about more out of the ordinary causes.
entries.new: Sekimeiya 以某种方式牵涉其中，所以我们必须考虑更不寻常的死因。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Yeah. ...What if traveling is what caused this to begin with? When she disappeared, she traveled through time and appeared somewhere else. If she couldn't have existed at that point, it's possible she appeared in this state.{w} Even though she reminds me of the second Naomi, that body had a head wound. ...I can't see any such thing here, though.
entries.new: 嗯。……如果一开始就是时间穿越造成的呢？她消失的时候穿越了时间，出现在别处。如果她在那个时间点本不可能存在，那她以这种状态出现也有可能。{w}虽然她让我想起第二个 Naomi，但那具尸体头上有伤。……可这里看不到那样的伤。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: What else would leave her in this state? Starvation, for example?
entries.new: 还有哪种死法会让她变成这样？比如饿死？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Well... she would have died of dehydration before starvation, and that has effects on the skin.
entries.new: 这个嘛……她会先死于脱水，而不是饥饿，而脱水会在皮肤上留下痕迹。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I gently pinched Isla's cheek, lightly pulled it, and then released it.
entries.new: 我轻轻捏起 Isla 的脸颊，稍微拉了拉，然后松开。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If someone is dehydrated, their skin isn't very elastic. I don't see anything indicating it here. It looks normal. Also, she'd have to have spent a pretty long time in here. Definitely more than a day.
entries.new: 人若脱水，皮肤就会失去弹性。我在这里看不出这种迹象，皮肤看起来很正常。而且，她得在这里待上相当长的时间，肯定超过一天。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: What about asphyxiation?
entries.new: 窒息呢？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Someone could easily do that since she's a kid... but there are no marks on her neck.
entries.new: 她还是个孩子，别人要掐死她并不难……可她脖子上没有痕迹。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Uh, I meant... asphyxiation within the cabinet. It doesn't seem very large, so could that have happened?
entries.new: 呃，我是说……在展示柜里窒息。柜子看起来不大，有可能发生这种情况吗？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: ...{w}I doubt it. It's true that something was up with this cabinet, but that'd require her to spend a long time inside, and there's no reason why she wouldn't have gotten out. That would take a lot less time than dehydration, but it's still considerable.{w} Let's say that she couldn't escape, though. The way she'd die would be from carbon dioxide intoxication, not from lack of oxygen. Even in a small space like this, I think it'd take six or seven hours. Maybe even more since a child would breathe less.
entries.new: ……{w}我不这么认为。展示柜确实有些不对劲，可若真如此，她得在里面待上很长时间，而她没理由不出来。这虽然比脱水所需的时间短得多，但也相当可观。{w}不过，假设她真的逃不出来。那她的死因会是二氧化碳中毒，而非缺氧。即便在这么小的空间里，我想也要六七个小时。孩子呼吸量小，也许还更久。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: It was far less than seven hours ago when we last looked through this room and these cabinets.
entries.new: 我们上次查看这个房间和这些展示柜时，离现在远不到七个小时。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Right. The way this happened, we can't tell if it was a homicide or an accident caused by the Sekimeiya. She most likely traveled to the past, but even if she spent that time in the cabinet, it wouldn't have been enough to kill her. And since Erina wasn't picked up by the travel, it's likely she didn't go very far back.
entries.new: 对。照目前的情况，我们无法判断是凶杀，还是 Sekimeiya 引发的事故。她多半穿越到了过去，可就算她在展示柜里待了那么久，也不足以致死。而且既然 Erina 没有被那次穿越带走，她大概没有回到太远的过去。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: There was another reason why I believed something like that might've happened, and it was Isla's yell. If she'd traveled to the past and spent time in the cabinet, it meant that Isla screamed because she saw her own body.{w} However, that same travel would've made two bodies travel back, multiplying the number every time. That couldn't be right, and it also meant that the body she saw was alive.
entries.new: 我之所以觉得可能发生过那样的事，还有一个理由：Isla 的喊叫声。如果她穿越到了过去，又在展示柜里待过一段时间，那就说明 Isla 之所以尖叫，是因为看见了自己的尸体。{w}可同一次穿越会让两具身体一起回到过去，而且每经历一次，数量还会翻倍。这说不通；这也意味着她看见的那具身体当时还活着。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...{w}What I'd just said replayed in my mind: probably six or seven hours would've been needed for her to suffocate inside the cabinet. That time could be cut in half if two Islas had been in the cabinet, breathing twice as much air...
entries.new: ……{w}我刚才说的话在脑中回放：她要在展示柜里窒息，大概需要六七个小时。可如果有两个 Isla 待在柜子里，呼吸量翻倍，这个时间就会缩短一半……
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Nonetheless, if that was completely off the mark, there was no other possibility except a bizarre homicide, which was one of the most unnerving thoughts that could come to me.
entries.new: 然而，如果这个推测完全不着边际，那就只剩一种可能：离奇的凶杀。而这是我能想到的最令人不安的念头之一。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I still have no idea why the Sekimeiya appeared here. You're sure it wasn't here before you left, right?
entries.new: 我还是不知道 Sekimeiya 为什么会出现在这里。你确定在你们离开之前，它不在这里，对吧？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Yes, we checked around her.
entries.new: 确定。我们在她周围检查过了。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Then something else happened that put it here. If someone brought it deliberately, it was the culprit, who needed it for whatever happened. If not, then it means that the Sekimeiya can teleport on its own.
entries.new: 那就是后来发生了别的事，把它带到了这里。如果是有人刻意带来的，那这人就是凶手，他需要它来造成后来发生的一切。若不是，那就说明 Sekimeiya 能自行传送。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Maybe that's why we didn't find it when Isla disappeared. The Sekimeiya she traveled with also teleported.
entries.new: 也许这就是 Isla 消失时我们没找到它的原因。和她一起穿越的 Sekimeiya 也发生了传送。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Yes... but if that's it, it would've appeared with Isla's body, not later.
entries.new: 对……可如果真是这样，它应该和 Isla 的尸体一起出现，而不是之后才出现。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: We continued looking at her face, slight traces of pain present behind its seeming serenity. A few hot tears stung the corners of my eyes. The peaceful appearance she had was a cruel joke, nothing more.
entries.new: 我们继续看着她的脸，那看似安详的神情背后，隐约透着痛苦的痕迹。几滴热泪刺得我眼角发疼。她脸上的平静不过是个残酷的玩笑，仅此而已。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Although I kept trying to reach a conclusion, everything was too broad and nebulous to definitely conclude anything. At my side, Shiroya hadn't taken her eyes off Isla, and she hadn't spoken in a while.
entries.new: 我一直在试图得出结论，可一切都太笼统、太模糊，根本无法定论。我身旁的 Shiroya 始终没有把目光从 Isla 身上移开，也已经有一阵没说话了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Eventually, we turned around. Erina was by the door, looking at the ground. I couldn't imagine what her thoughts were, but we let her know the gist of what we'd determined.
entries.new: 最后，我们转过身。Erina 站在门边，低头看着地面。我想象不出她在想什么，但我们把得出的结论大致告诉了她。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: She accepted what we said with almost imperceptible nods. We didn't know what else to do, but as we were about to leave, she stepped into the room and walked up to Isla again.
entries.new: 她几不可察地点着头，接受了我们的话。我们也不知还能做什么，可就在准备离开时，她走进房间，再次来到 Isla 身边。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I wasn't sure why until I saw her staring inside and crying again. ...We silently watched her, understanding how excruciating the sight was but that she still had to look.
entries.new: 我起初不明白为什么，直到看见她再次望着柜内哭了起来。……我们默默看着她，明白那景象有多令人痛苦，也明白她仍然必须去看。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: When she was ready, she stood up straight and approached us. We had only known her for a few hours, but I felt the most sincere pity for her.
entries.new: 等她准备好了，便挺直身子朝我们走来。我们认识她才不过几个小时，我却对她生出最真切的怜悯。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Excluding Naomi, Isla was the second death I'd had to directly face. If the past two weeks hadn't drained me like they had, I probably would've been unable to control my emotions.
entries.new: 除去 Naomi，Isla 是我不得不直接面对的第二个死者。若不是过去两周已经把我耗成了这样，我大概早已控制不住情绪。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I recalled the recording that told us Isla would be alive in a month. How to treat it, I had no idea, but it had ironically become a last hope.{w} Could the Sekimeiya have the power to bring a person back to life? It wasn't that crazy of a thought depending on how it worked, so the recording coming true at the cost of spending a month in the tower was the best-case scenario.
entries.new: 我想起那段录音，它告诉我们 Isla 一个月后还会活着。我不知道该如何看待它，可讽刺的是，它竟成了最后的希望。{w}Sekimeiya 难道有让人复活的力量？取决于它的运作方式，这想法倒也不算太荒唐。因此，只要付出在塔里待一个月的代价，让录音成真，就已经是最好的结果。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If one thing was certain, it was that some kind of plan existed behind it. Out of everyone there, the recorder had appeared inside Isla's purse. Not only that, the audio on it was downright bizarre. In a few hours, at {time=21}, we'd have a much better understanding of its veracity. Although we hadn't checked, it was very likely within that mysterious cabinet, still inside Isla's purse.
entries.new: 有一点可以肯定：这背后必然藏着某种计划。在场所有人里，录音笔偏偏出现在 Isla 的手提包中。不止如此，里面的录音简直诡异至极。再过几个小时，到 {time=21}，我们对它真伪就能有更清楚的判断。虽然还没确认，但它很可能就在那个神秘的展示柜里，仍旧放在 Isla 的包中。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: After giving the flashlight back to Katei, he brought it to the security room. Once again, we moved to the lobby due to its proximity to the outside world and how spacious it was.{w} Shiroya, Katei, and I sat on the couch. There were chairs next to the reception desk, but everyone else chose to sit on the floor in silence, leaning against a wall.{w} Every speck of motivation within me had been crushed. While I wanted to know what was going on even more, I only had the energy to think to myself.
entries.new: 我把手电筒还给了 Katei，他把它送回了监控室。我们又一次聚到大堂——这里离外界最近，地方也宽敞。{w} Shiroya、Katei 和我坐在沙发上。接待台旁明明有椅子，其他人却都默不作声地靠墙坐在地上。{w} 我身上最后一点干劲也被压垮了。我更加想知道究竟出了什么事，却只剩下独自胡思乱想的力气。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I was almost sure that two Sekimeiya existed and that one had been the source of Isla's death. I still held the key to the other one.
entries.new: 我几乎可以确定，Sekimeiya 有两台，其中一台正是 Isla 的死因。而另一台的钥匙仍在我手里。
entries.speaker: i
