If they quit looking and want to ambush us instead, it could mean nobody is working with them. Their partner would've taken care of that while the other kept trying to find us.
entries.new: 明知我们就在阁楼里，他们为什么停止搜索了？{w}……也许说明他们只有一个人。如果对方不再找人，转而打算伏击我们，那就可能没有同伙。若有同伙，本该一个继续搜，另一个去准备伏击。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: So, where are they waiting? No matter who we're dealing with, they aren't stupid: they must've grabbed the bedroom key just now, so going there is too obvious of a mistake.
entries.new: 那么，他们究竟守在哪里？不管对手是谁，对方都不蠢：刚才肯定顺手拿走了卧室钥匙，所以我们要是去卧室，就成了再明显不过的失误。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: If the elevator is working, it means they have a contingency for us going down. It sounds illogical, but trying to walk out could be the best idea.
entries.new: 如果电梯还能用，就说明他们早就防着我们下楼这一手。听起来不合常理，但直接从正门走出去，或许反而是最好的选择。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: It doesn't make sense to think they're just outside of the storeroom, waiting for us to leave. That implies they know we're somewhere around here, and if they did, they would be rushing in. After all, they were opening every room earlier...
entries.new: 说他们就在储藏室外等我们出去，讲不通。那等于他们知道我们就在附近；若真知道，早就冲进来了。毕竟刚才他们还在一间间开门……
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Therefore, for some reason, they might've left the attic. Even though we're exhausted, we're also faster than them. We should be able to run away again if they see us on a floor below, where there's more space.
entries.new: 所以，出于某种原因，他们可能已经离开阁楼了。我们虽然筋疲力尽，但速度仍比他们快。要是在下面楼层更开阔的地方被看见，应该还能再逃掉。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I thought about going to a bedroom to pick up a screwdriver. It was the only weapon I could think of, but I abandoned the thought. It was no match against a knife, and the more I thought about it, the more I felt that going back to a bedroom was a bad idea.{w} Furthermore, if the person chasing us had taken the key, they would probably have taken such an obvious weapon as well.
entries.new: 我想过去卧室拿螺丝刀。那是我唯一能想到的武器，但很快打消了这个念头。它敌不过刀，而且越想越觉得，折回卧室不是个好主意。{w}再说，追我们的人既然拿走了钥匙，多半也不会漏掉这么显眼的武器。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Let's go. We'll try to leave through the main entrance.
entries.new: ……走吧。我们试着从正门出去。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Shiroya responded with a confused look, but she didn't object. We had to hope that, out of the few options we had, one would let us live. I wasn't confident I'd picked the correct one, but that applied to all of them.
entries.new: Shiroya一脸困惑地看了我一眼，却没有反对。我们只能指望，在仅有的几条路里，总有一条能让我们活下来。我没有把握自己选对了，但换作其他几条，我也同样没把握。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We stepped into the hallway, praying that the faint noise our feet produced wasn't being conveyed to the attacker.
entries.new: 我们走进走廊，祈祷脚下那点细微的声响不会传到袭击者耳中。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Every corner made my heart stop, and my senses were on higher alert than they'd ever been. Knowing a knife could suddenly swing at any time, we took short steps forward until we saw the entire empty hallway.
entries.new: 每经过一个转角，我的心都会骤然一紧，感官也绷到了从未有过的极限。明知刀锋随时可能从某处劈来，我们只能小步向前，直到整条空荡的走廊尽收眼底。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But our terror couldn't subside yet. Silently, I peeked into the living room and let out a long-coming breath as soon as I saw it empty.
entries.new: 但我们的恐惧还没有消退。我悄悄往客厅里看了一眼，见里面空无一人，才吐出憋了许久的一口气。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Okay, we need to leave.
entries.new: 好，我们得走了。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: The tension I felt when I found myself in the middle of the living room was unlike anything I'd ever experienced. There were three doors someone could suddenly appear through. We paid attention to everything in our surroundings until the staircase came into view.
entries.new: 当我站到客厅中央时，那种紧张感是我从未经历过的。有三扇门，随时可能有人从其中一扇后出现。我们留意着周围的一切，直到楼梯出现在视野里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Nobody was there, but I knew I had to look for something else.
entries.new: 那里没有人，但我知道自己还得去确认另一样东西。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: That's our key...
entries.new: 那是我们的钥匙……
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: On the floor, the key we'd used to lock ourselves in showed that the culprit hadn't taken it.
entries.new: 地上躺着我们反锁房门时用的那把钥匙——看来犯人并没有把它拿走。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We can leave, at least.
entries.new: 至少，我们能离开了。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Making it to wherever the Sekimeiya was still felt like the single goal we could attempt to achieve. We started to walk down at the same time. At the bottom, I crouched to pick up the key, but midway through, I realized we wouldn't need it to leave: the door wasn't closed.
entries.new: 想办法赶到 Sekimeiya 那边，仍是我们唯一能尝试完成的目标。我们一同动身下楼。到了下面，我蹲身去捡钥匙，弯到一半却意识到出门根本用不上它：门并没有关。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Look. This settles it. They have another key for this door, and that's how they entered.
entries.new: 看吧。这下就说得通了。他们有这扇门的另一把钥匙，就是这么进来的。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: While they could've teleported inside and unlocked the door with our own key, they wouldn't have left it behind. I reached for the door and began to push it from a distance so that I'd be able to quickly turn around if someone was behind it.
entries.new: 他们确实可能直接传送进来，再用我们的钥匙开门，但那样就不会把钥匙留下。我伸手够到门，隔着距离慢慢推开，这样万一门后有人，我也能立刻转身。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...But nobody was. The barren scenery of floor 6 felt almost harmless, although nothing would've made us fully lower our guard.
entries.new: ……但门后没有人。6楼那片空旷的景象几乎显得无害，不过无论看到什么，我们都不可能真正放下戒备。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wait, one second.
entries.new: 等等，稍等一下。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Shiroya turned around and grabbed the attic key from the floor. Then, from the outside, she locked it.
entries.new: Shiroya转身从地上捡起阁楼钥匙，然后从外面把门锁上了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If they're still inside and disabled the elevator, I just locked them in. If they already left, they might think we locked ourselves inside again.
entries.new: 要是他们还在里面，而且把电梯弄停了，我这一锁就把他们关在阁楼里了。要是他们已经离开，说不定会以为我们又把自己反锁在里面了。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: It was a good idea. She put the key in her purse, and attaching ourselves to the left wall, we picked up a fairly brisk pace, intending to reach the crystal floor.
entries.new: 这主意不错。她把钥匙放进手提包，我们贴着左墙，加快脚步，打算前往水晶层。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Every floor was packed with perilous turns where our attacker could've been waiting, and I found it very likely they were near an elevator door, expecting us to use it at any point.
entries.new: 每一层都布满危险的转角，袭击者可能就藏在某处；而我觉得，对方很可能守在电梯门旁，等着我们随时去乘电梯。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We circled through the entire sixth floor and went down the first staircase. We still had our shoes in our hands, so we were making the least amount of noise possible. Unfortunately, the strong echo amplified our steps enough to nullify the effect.
entries.new: 我们绕过整层6楼，从第一段楼梯下去。鞋还提在手里，我们已经尽量不发出声音。可不幸的是，强烈的回声把脚步声放大，这点小心完全白费了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Running through floor 5, I thought of what we'd do if the Sekimeiya hadn't been taken from the cabinet. Unable to undo our own lock, we'd be done for. Going to the security room to try and get Katei's bathroom key would be the last thing we could depend on. However, it was very likely the killer had taken it.
entries.new: 跑过5楼时，我想起了另一种可能：如果Sekimeiya并没有被人从展示柜里拿走，我们该怎么办。我们打不开自己上的锁，那就只有死路一条。去监控室试着拿Katei的浴室钥匙，就是我们最后的指望了。然而，凶手极有可能已经把它拿走了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We made it to floor 4. We continually made a series of turns moving down through the building; meanwhile, I kept trying to force out the thought that any of those plain walls could be the last thing we ever saw.
entries.new: 我们到了4楼。穿行下楼时，我们不断拐过一个又一个弯；与此同时，我一直努力把那个念头压下去——这些平平无奇的墙壁，随时可能成为我们此生最后见到的景象。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: {w=0.6}The same knife, the same breeze at my side... After leaving the partitions, as if the culprit had teleported behind me, I saw another missed swing that was incredibly close to taking my life. It had happened again—a sudden ambush.
entries.new: {w=0.6}又是那把刀，又是身侧那阵风……绕过隔板后，犯人仿佛传送到了我身后，我又一次看见挥空的刀锋，离夺走我的性命只差毫厘。又来了——又一次突袭。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Shiroya let out a cry at my side. We didn't stop running, but something had taken my desire to react. That time, I saw it.
entries.new: Shiroya在我身旁惊叫出声。我们没有停下脚步，可我却莫名没了反应的心思。这一次，我看清了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The hand gripping the knife—and a wristwatch.
entries.new: 握着刀的那只手——还有一块手表。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Then, the voice of the person who'd tried to kill me broke out and resounded through the entire floor.
entries.new: 接着，那个试图杀我的人的声音骤然响起，回荡在整层楼中。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: {w=0.7}"Atsuki! {w=0.5}You son of a bitch!"{w=1.1}{nw}
entries.new: {w=0.7}「Atsuki！{w=0.5}你这王八蛋！」{w=1.1}{nw}
entries.speaker: saicenter

entries.text: Sai's voice echoed in my mind. Without stopping, we turned our heads around to see an enraged expression full of malice. Then, he took off behind us, knife in hand.
entries.new: Sai的声音在我脑中回荡。我们没有停步，只回头望去，看见一张写满恶意的狰狞面孔。紧接着，他提着刀追了上来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The chase resumed. Shiroya and I sprinted as fast as we could toward the staircase to floor 3 while I reeled at the fact that it had actually been Sai.{w} Why... and why then? His face had made it clear that trying to ask would be our end.
entries.new: 追逐再次开始。我和Shiroya拼命朝通往3楼的楼梯跑去，而我的脑中仍嗡嗡作响：追来的人竟然真的是Sai。{w}为什么……又为什么偏偏是那时候？他的表情已经说明，开口去问就是死路一条。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: However, as soon as I forced my body to move, it rejected me. I understood there was no way I could run for much longer, and the same surely applied to Shiroya. As we headed toward the staircase, I thought of something.
entries.new: 然而，我刚强迫身体迈开步子，身体便立刻发出抗议。我明白自己撑不了多久，Shiroya想必也一样。就在奔向楼梯的途中，我想到了一件事。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Sai's pretty far behind... It's very likely the elevator is still on floor 3, just under the stairs, since Shiroya called it before we were attacked. If it is, we might be able to get in before he can catch us this time.
entries.new: Sai已经被甩开很远……电梯很可能还停在3楼，就在楼梯下方——毕竟遇袭前Shiroya叫过电梯。如果真是这样，这次我们或许能在他追上之前进去。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: It sounded feasible. As soon as we got to the lower floor, we could attempt to open the elevator. If Sai had disabled it, it was likely still there. We'd concluded that he probably entered the attic through the main door, meaning that it wasn't in the attic.
entries.new: 这听起来可行。一到下面那层，我们就可以试着打开电梯。如果Sai让电梯停用了，它多半还停在那里。我们已经推断出他大概是从正门进的阁楼，也就是说，电梯并不在阁楼里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It was risky, but our bodies were on the verge of giving up, our lives balanced on a knife's edge.
entries.new: 这样做有风险，但我们的身体已濒临极限，性命也悬在一线。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Even if Akaro's working with Sai, as long as the elevator is here, that shouldn't be a problem... If Sai's really working with him, what's likely is that Akaro was the one to go to the attic while Sai waited here to ambush us.
entries.new: 就算Akaro和Sai是一伙的，只要电梯在这里，应该就不成问题……如果Sai真和他联手，最可能的情况是Akaro去了阁楼，而Sai留在这里伏击我们。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: The way it happened, I imagined Sai was hiding inside the first partition, waiting for us to pass by.{w} We began to speed down the stairs while I tried to decide on what to do. Sai hadn't started to chase us until he'd yelled my name, which had created enough distance between us to seriously consider the elevator.
entries.new: 从当时的情形看，我想Sai是躲在第一道隔板后，等我们经过。{w}我们加快脚步下楼，我一边盘算接下来该怎么办。Sai直到喊出我的名字才开始追，这段距离足够我们认真考虑电梯这条路。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Despite that, it still felt off. Our attacker was Sai—not many things slipped by him. The elevator wasn't particularly fast, but most importantly... would he really let us use it? Even though we could outrun him at full speed, trying and failing to open the elevator was time we didn't know we had, considering we weren't going to be able to keep running for long.
entries.new: 尽管如此，我还是觉得不对劲。袭击者是Sai——很少有事情能逃过他的眼睛。电梯并不算快，但最关键的是……他真的会让我们用电梯吗？即便全速奔跑能甩开他，可万一试着开电梯却失败，耗掉的时间我们根本浪费不起；毕竟我们撑不了多久。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Try to enter the elevator.
entries.new: 试着进电梯。

entries.text: Continue running down.
entries.new: 继续往下跑。

entries.text: The world froze.{w} However, strangely, movement was still within.
entries.new: 世界静止了。{w} 然而奇怪的是，静止之中仍有东西在动。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Atsuki and Shiroya lived in a delicate universe. A single modification could collapse the complex structure they were climbing.
entries.new: Atsuki 和 Shiroya 身处一个脆弱的宇宙。哪怕只改动一处，也可能让他们正在攀爬的复杂结构彻底崩塌。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: ...However, the structure could be partially frozen and then changed.
entries.new: ……不过，只要先让结构的一部分冻结，再加以改动，便仍有可为。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: This universe will be frozen, and that will permit its observation. A universe that would collapse if set in motion.
entries.new: 这个宇宙将被冻结，唯其如此才能被观测。一个一旦运转起来便会崩溃的宇宙。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Rules have to be bent abstractly—the flow must stop. Only that will allow an impossibility.
entries.new: 必须抽象地扭曲规则——让流动停下来。唯有如此，才容得下一件不可能之事。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Ultimately, just before stepping onto the third floor, Atsuki changed his mind. He was exhausted, and at that point, the elevator seemed safe.
entries.new: 到头来，就在即将踏上三楼时，Atsuki改了主意。他实在太累，而在那一刻，电梯似乎更安全。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: One second! I'll try to open the elevator!
entries.new: 等一下！我来试着打开电梯！
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: Shiroya had also been thinking about it, but she hadn't thought that Atsuki would attempt to use it.
entries.new: Shiroya也考虑过这件事，但没想到Atsuki会试着使用电梯。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: It was next to the staircase, so it didn't take him very long to confirm it: the elevator was still on the third floor, and it hadn't been disabled. He opened it, and its empty interior came into their view.
entries.new: 电梯就在楼梯旁，因此他没花多久便确认了情况：它仍停在三楼，也没有被停用。他打开电梯门，空荡荡的轿厢映入两人眼中。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: All right, get in!
entries.new: 好，快进去！
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: Before Sai could catch them, both of them boarded the elevator. They had enough time to press a button, but that was yet another decision to make. They looked at the panel and decided to touch one of the eight available buttons.
entries.new: 趁Sai还没追上，两人便钻进了电梯。他们还来得及按下一个按钮，可这又是一个必须做出的选择。他们看向按钮面板，决定按下八个可用按钮中的一个。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Go back to the attic and lock yourselves in a bedroom.
entries.new: 回到阁楼，把自己锁进卧室。

entries.text: Change of Mind
entries.new: 改变主意

entries.text: Atsuki's plan was simple. He wanted to take advantage of the distance they'd gained from Sai.
entries.new: Atsuki的计划很简单。他想利用他们与Sai之间拉开的距离。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Perhaps they could trick him. He thought they were going to continue running down, so if they went back up, Sai might've thought they'd already turned toward the offices. In addition, they knew the elevator couldn't be heard if it arrived at or left the floor one was on.
entries.new: 也许能骗过他。Sai以为他们会继续往下跑，所以要是他们折返上楼，他说不定会以为他们已经转向办公室那边了。况且，他们清楚电梯抵达或离开自己所处的楼层时不会传出声音。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: With eyes almost closed, Atsuki waited a few seconds so that Sai would have time to arrive and miss the sound. Meanwhile, he reached into Shiroya's purse to grab the attic key and used it to unlock the floor 7 button, which he confidently pressed.
entries.new: Atsuki几乎闭着眼，等了几秒，好让Sai有时间赶到，却听不到电梯的声响。与此同时，他把手伸进Shiroya的手提包，取出阁楼钥匙，用它解开了7楼按钮的锁，然后笃定地按了下去。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: But what was really crossing Atsuki's mind? Had that been the plan he'd designed and decided on? Sai must've known the elevator was available, and using it would've ceased their echoing footfalls. At his side, Shiroya couldn't help but be confused by the action he'd chosen to take.
entries.new: 可Atsuki心里究竟在想什么？这真是他设计并定下的计划吗？Sai一定知道电梯还能用，而一旦乘上电梯，他们回荡的脚步声便会消失。在他身旁，Shiroya不禁对他选择的做法感到困惑。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: I hate that it's come to this, but we can't escape from Sai for more than three hours. We have to put all our faith in locking ourselves up in a bedroom.
entries.new: 我很不愿事情变成这样，可我们躲Sai撑不过三个小时。现在只能把全部希望寄托在把自己锁进卧室这一招上。
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: Shiroya was speechless at his sudden change, but she couldn't object to him. She decided not to reply and trusted the decision her oldest friend had made to save both of their lives.
entries.new: Shiroya被他突然的转变惊得说不出话，却也无法反对。她决定不再多言，选择相信这位相识最久的朋友为保住两人性命所作的决定。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Up there, we'll set the chain and physically prevent the door from opening. Even if Sai has the key, he won't be able to break the door down. In case he enters... we can try to use something to defend ourselves.
entries.new: 上去以后，我们把门链挂好，从里面把门死死挡住。就算Sai有钥匙，他也撞不开门。万一他真进来了……我们也能试着拿东西自卫。
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: They had seen Sai's murderous expression and felt how strongly he'd desired their eradication. Even though the physical demand was high, keeping a chained door from opening was much more reasonable than perpetually running away.
entries.new: 他们见过Sai那副杀意毕露的表情，也感受过他有多想除掉他们。尽管很耗体力，但用门链挡住门不让它打开，总比永无止境地逃跑更现实。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The elevator stopped and began to slowly open its doors. The trip had created a great deal of tension that was released when they burst out of it. They were back in the hallway they'd just escaped from, but they'd shifted their goal.
entries.new: 电梯停了下来，门缓缓打开。这一趟下来，他们紧张到了极点，直到冲出电梯才松了口气。他们又回到了刚刚逃离的那条走廊，但目标已经改变。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: They ran, ignoring the turns they'd previously handled with care. They wanted to enter the bedroom, which they began to see as their only salvation.
entries.new: 他们拔腿就跑，不再顾忌先前小心应对的拐角。他们只想冲进那间卧室——在他们眼中，那已是唯一的救赎。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Both open doors were in sight. Only the right one possessed a chain, so they didn't hesitate over which one to enter. Running, the lack of friction between Atsuki's socks and the wooden flooring almost made him trip, but he managed to steady himself. Shiroya made her way in first and immediately shut the door as soon as Atsuki joined her.
entries.new: 两扇敞开的门都映入眼帘。只有右边那扇挂着门链，所以他们毫不犹豫地选择了它。奔跑时，Atsuki的袜子与木地板之间几乎没有摩擦，险些让他摔倒，但他还是稳住了身子。Shiroya先一步进去，等Atsuki一跟进来，便立刻关上了门。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: On the left side of the door, the chain began to swing in response to the abrupt slam. As Atsuki hurried to check the drawers, Shiroya's trembling arm set the chain, recalling how unreliable it had been in the past.
entries.new: 门被猛地摔上，左侧的门链随之晃动起来。Atsuki急忙去翻抽屉，Shiroya则用发抖的手扣上门链，心里想起它过去多么不牢靠。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Do you see the key?
entries.new: 你看到钥匙了吗？
entries.speaker: snn

entries.text: Atsuki remembered. He had left it in the top drawer of the stand.
entries.new: Atsuki想起来了。他把钥匙放在了床头柜最上面的抽屉里。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: "Yes!" He let out a cry of joy when he saw that {tip=key}it hadn't been taken{/tip}. Their chances of surviving had just drastically increased.
entries.new: “找到了！”看到{tip=key}钥匙没有被拿走{/tip}，他欣喜地喊出声来。他们活下来的几率顿时大增。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: But nothing had been settled. While holding the key, the nightmarish sound of a bursting door struck Atsuki's ears. When he turned around, he saw Shiroya's body being knocked away.
entries.new: 可一切还没有尘埃落定。他握着钥匙，门被撞开的声响如噩梦般传来。回头时，他看见Shiroya的身体被撞飞出去。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Past the door, the terrifying silhouette of Sai paralyzed Atsuki's mind. The knife was still gripped in his right hand, and as soon as he saw Atsuki's defeated expression, Sai grinned.
entries.new: 门后，Sai那骇人的身影让Atsuki的脑子一片空白。他右手仍紧握着刀，一看到Atsuki那副认命的表情，便咧嘴笑了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: On the floor, Shiroya yelled desperately, but Sai ignored her. He began to approach Atsuki, who stared at him in regret. He hadn't even had time to grab the screwdriver.
entries.new: Shiroya倒在地板上拼命喊叫，Sai却置若罔闻。他朝Atsuki逼近，而Atsuki只是悔恨地望着他。Atsuki甚至没来得及去拿螺丝刀。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: "Stop!"{w} Shiroya cried again, but anything she could say was meaningless to Sai, who was certain of her fate.
entries.new: “住手！”{w}Shiroya再次喊道，可她说什么对Sai都已毫无意义——他早已认定她难逃一死。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Atsuki's hands let go of his shoes, and he made his first step backward, inevitably backing himself into the wall. When he made eye contact with his killer, he noticed Sai had a bit of blood in his mouth. Such trivial information had become utterly pointless, but he thought that blood might've dripped off him some time in the past.
entries.new: Atsuki松开了手里的鞋，第一次向后退了一步，结果不可避免地把自己逼到了墙边。与杀自己的人对上视线时，他注意到Sai嘴边沾着一点血。这种无关紧要的信息此刻已毫无用处，但他还是想，那血或许是之前从Sai身上滴落的。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He made no attempt at putting that information to use. His mind had broken down, and he couldn't move. He'd realized his reckless action had resulted in not only his own death, but Shiroya's.
entries.new: 他根本没打算利用这条信息。他的思绪已经崩溃，身体也动弹不得。他意识到，自己的鲁莽不仅害死了自己，也害死了Shiroya。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: She placed her hand on the floor and attempted to stand up. Wasting no time, she launched herself toward Sai, whose murderous aura had spoken every needed word.
entries.new: 她把手撑在地上，试图站起来。她毫不迟疑，朝Sai扑了过去；Sai浑身散发的杀意已经说明了一切。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Once again, she was ignored, and instead, Sai dashed forward. ...Atsuki had no time to even react.
entries.new: 她又一次被无视，Sai却向前冲去。……Atsuki连反应的时间都没有。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: When he looked down, he saw the knife had pierced through his stomach. "So this is how being stabbed feels". Such a ridiculous thought was all that crossed his mind. The sensation surprised him; it hadn't been as painful as he'd expected.
entries.new: 他低头看去，刀已经刺穿了他的腹部。“原来被刺中是这种感觉。”他脑中闪过的竟只有这个荒唐的念头。那感觉让他意外——并没有他预想中那么疼。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: But his body crumpled down, unable to keep supporting itself. From a lower perspective, he saw that Sai's face had become even more warped. Behind him, Shiroya's fell into disrepair. She reached for Atsuki, but Sai did not allow it.
entries.new: 可他的身体再也支撑不住，瘫倒下去。从更低的位置望去，他看到Sai的脸扭曲得更厉害了。他身后，Shiroya的脸也彻底垮了。她伸手想够Atsuki，Sai却不允许。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Mercilessly, he moved his arm in an arc, drawing a long horizontal cut through Shiroya's chest. Inwardly, Atsuki cried in anguish.{w} But Sai frowned. After instinctively reacting to Shiroya's attempt at aiding Atsuki, he looked at his second victim in disbelief.
entries.new: 他毫不留情地挥臂划出一道弧线，在Shiroya胸前横着划开一道长长的口子。Atsuki在心里痛苦地嘶喊。{w}可Sai却皱起了眉。他本能地对Shiroya救助Atsuki的举动做出反应，随后难以置信地看向自己的第二个受害者。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: "{tip=pendulum}What...?{/tip}" He sounded surprised, but soon snapped out of it. Before Atsuki could make a last effort at understanding why they'd had to be finished off like that, Sai jumped back at him and stabbed him a second time.
entries.new: “{tip=pendulum}什么……？{/tip}”他听起来很吃惊，但很快便回过神来。Atsuki还来不及拼尽最后的力气想明白他们为何非得这样被了结，Sai便又扑了回来，第二次刺中了他。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: And then a third, and a fourth... All of them felt much more painful, but he couldn't move. "You brought this on yourself, you fucking idiot!"{w} Those words were received as static noise. An irreversible cloudiness began to fill Atsuki's consciousness, and eventually, his brain stopped interpreting the splashes of blood that every stab produced, shortly cutting off forever.
entries.new: 接着是第三刀、第四刀……每一刀都比之前疼得多，可他已经动弹不得。“这是你自找的，你这该死的蠢货！”{w}那些话落进他耳中，只剩一片杂音。不可逆转的混沌开始充满Atsuki的意识；最终，他的大脑不再去辨认每一刀溅起的血，很快便彻底停止了运作。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Ending: Pendulum
entries.new: 结局：钟摆

entries.text: Bloodhound
entries.new: 血猎犬

entries.text: Stay inside the elevator.
entries.new: 留在电梯里。

entries.text: Self-Causality
entries.new: 自我因果

entries.text: When Atsuki ran down through all the buttons, he realized there was one he hadn't considered. Above the others, a red button with the word "Stop" immediately grabbed his attention.
entries.new: Atsuki扫过所有按钮后，意识到有一个自己先前忽略了。其余按钮上方，一个写着“停止”的红色按钮立刻吸引了他的注意。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The stop button! We'll be safe if we lock ourselves in here!
entries.new: 停止按钮！只要把自己锁在这里面，我们就安全了！
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: Shiroya's eyes widened in amazement. Both of them had failed to recall its existence.{w} They thought back on Katei's words. He'd told them that if the button was pressed while the elevator was moving, only an entity from outside the tower could enable it again.
entries.new: Shiroya惊讶地睁大了眼睛。两人都忘了还有这个按钮。{w}他们回想起Katei的话。他说过，如果电梯运行时按下那个按钮，就只有塔外的人才可能让它重新启动。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Before Sai had time to arrive and open the door, Atsuki rushed to press the floor 4 button. That was solely done to begin motion, since stopping it while stationary might've left the outer button functional.
entries.new: 趁Sai还没来得及赶到把门打开，Atsuki急忙按下四楼按钮。这么做只是为了先让电梯动起来，因为若在静止时按下停止按钮，外面的按钮说不定仍能使用。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: As soon as they departed the third floor, Atsuki pressed the stop button. Without any delay, the whole structure abruptly ceased moving and kept itself suspended between the third and fourth floors.
entries.new: 他们刚离开三楼，Atsuki便按下停止按钮。整个电梯结构毫无迟滞地骤然停住，悬在三楼与四楼之间。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: There we go... It worked!
entries.new: 好……成功了！
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: Both of them breathed with relief. An inaccessible elevator in the middle of an inaccessible tunnel; they'd reached the safest position within the tower.
entries.new: 两人松了一口气。一部外人也无法靠近的电梯，停在同样无法进入的通道中央；他们已抵达塔内最安全的位置。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Like Katei said, no connection with the outside occurred because it's something the alarm disabled. We'll have to wait until the front door opens to be rescued, but that's more than okay.
entries.new: 就像 Katei 说的，外界之所以联络不上，是因为警报把通讯切断了。我们只能等正门打开后才能获救，不过这样已经足够好了。
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: Shiroya agreed with a faint voice. They knew they had slightly more than three hours to go, and a narrow elevator was all the space they had. Deciding to rest as best they could, they put their shoes on and let their bodies drop until they sat on the floor.
entries.new: Shiroya 轻声应下。两人知道还剩三个小时多一点，而身边只有这部狭窄的电梯。他们决定尽量休息，于是穿上鞋，任由身体滑下去，坐到地上。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: After the elevator had stopped, not the faintest external sound had been heard. Their bodies were still tired, so despite the long wait, they knew they could wait through it with ease. Leaning on opposite corners, they let their bodies loosen, starting to feel their heartbeats slowing down.
entries.new: 电梯停稳后，外面再没传来半点声响。两人的身体依旧疲惫，所以哪怕等待漫长，他们也知道熬过去并不难。他们各靠在相对的两个角落里，任由身体松下来，渐渐觉得心跳慢了下去。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Both of them wanted to talk to the other, but didn't do so. Instead, they used their imaginations to explore what they'd do after escaping.
entries.new: 两人都想和对方说些什么，却都没有开口。他们只是在脑海里想象，逃出去之后要做些什么。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Shiroya had been living in Atsuki's house for a week, and they'd never set an end date. She hoped she could stay with him for a little bit longer without being a bother.{w} In the meantime, Atsuki's mind kept going to what they'd talked about hours previously. It had been so long since they'd visited their old cabin that he really felt a strong desire to go back there with her.
entries.new: Shiroya 已经在 Atsuki 家住了一个星期，两人却从未定下期限。她希望能再多留一阵子，又不至于给他添麻烦。{w} 与此同时，Atsuki 的思绪一直绕着几小时前他们谈过的事打转。他们已经太久没去过那座旧小屋了，他实在很想再和她回去看看。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: But he knew what had been happening around them. He knew that, for some reason, Sai wanted them dead. He'd somehow acquired a knife and abused the Sekimeiya's powers. It was very unlikely he could reach their position, but depending on his true motives, the chase might've continued even after exiting the tower.
entries.new: 但他清楚他们周遭正发生着什么。他知道，不知出于什么原因，Sai 想要他们的命。他不知从哪弄来一把刀，还滥用 Sekimeiya 的力量。他很难追到他们所在的位置，但视他真正的动机，这场追逐或许在离开塔之后仍会继续。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: After all, it appeared the cameras hadn't been working, and with the aid of the Sekimeiya, Sai could've known how to avoid being caught by the police. Even if they'd outsmarted him once, it was impossible to be at peace yet.
entries.new: 毕竟，监控似乎一直没有工作，而借助 Sekimeiya，Sai 也许知道该如何避开警方的追捕。就算他们曾智胜他一次，现在也远远不能安心。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Minutes started to pass. Not a thing had reached their ears, but as they were between two floors, it was unlikely even a loud sound could have.
entries.new: 时间一分一分过去。他们什么也没听见，但他们正卡在两层楼之间，就算外面有再大的声响，也未必传得进来。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Every now and then, they'd raise their heads to check on each other. It was impossible to keep a comfortable position, so they continued slightly adjusting themselves.
entries.new: 每隔一会儿，他们就抬起头看看对方。无论怎么坐都不舒服，两人便不时微微调整姿势。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: As soon as Atsuki realized that he was still thirsty, he knew he wouldn't be able to get it out of his mind. He was about to attempt some small talk by saying it, but stopped himself, as it could've made Shiroya feel the same way.
entries.new: Atsuki 一意识到自己还是渴，就知道这个念头会一直缠着他。他本想拿这件事随口聊两句，却又忍住了，因为那可能会让 Shiroya 也觉得渴。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: A few more minutes went by. Atsuki didn't know how long they'd been in the elevator. Without a watch, and given how tired they were, it was far too difficult to tell. Any range from ten to twenty minutes seemed possible to him.
entries.new: 又过了几分钟。Atsuki 不知道他们在电梯里待了多久。没有手表，加上身体疲惫，实在很难判断。十分钟到二十分钟，似乎都有可能。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: But... a sudden, dark atmosphere began to creep up on them.
entries.new: 可是……一股阴郁的气氛突然向他们袭来。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: With a broken sense of time, Atsuki remembered one of the most mysterious events they'd experienced. They had listened to a recording that had claimed the exit would never open... that the alarm's effects would be permanent.
entries.new: 时间感已经错乱，Atsuki 想起了他们经历过的最离奇的事情之一。他们听过一段录音，说出口永远不会打开……说警报的影响会一直持续。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: When he'd made the rushed decision of activating the emergency stop function of the elevator, he hadn't thought of it. If it was legitimate, nobody was going to let them out.{w} When the thought came to him, Atsuki's heart began to speed up again.
entries.new: 他匆忙决定按下电梯的紧急停止按钮时，并没有想到这一点。如果那段录音是真的，就没人会放他们出去。{w} 这个念头一冒出来，Atsuki 的心脏又开始狂跳。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Had Shiroya thought of it? He couldn't tell her. In less than a minute, the claustrophobic sensation had begun to invade Atsuki's body.
entries.new: Shiroya 想到了吗？他不敢对她说。不到一分钟，幽闭感便开始侵入 Atsuki 全身。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: ...Are you okay?
entries.new: ……你还好吗？
entries.speaker: snn

entries.text: Yes, don't worry.
entries.new: 嗯，别担心。
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: Shiroya noticed he'd started to take deeper and faster breaths. Their decision was irreversible, but the process to learn if it had been the correct one was what began to assault Atsuki.
entries.new: Shiroya 注意到他的呼吸开始变得又深又急。他们的决定已无法撤回，而真正折磨 Atsuki 的，是等待验证这个决定是否正确的过程。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Had his finger already sealed their fate? He didn't know how much longer they'd have to wait to find out. Atsuki began to sweat nervously as he imagined the terrifying scenarios they could've already caught themselves in.
entries.new: 那根手指是否已经替他们定下命运？他不知道还要等多久才能知道答案。Atsuki 想象着他们可能已经陷入的可怕境地，紧张得开始冒汗。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: How long until {time=21}? If they could be sure that point in time would mark the end to their suffering, reaching it wouldn't be an issue. As soon as Atsuki had thought of the not-unlikely worst scenario, though, every second had begun to feel unbearable.
entries.new: 距离 {time=21} 还有多久？如果能确定那个时刻就是痛苦的终点，熬到那时也不成问题。然而，Atsuki 一想到最坏的情况并非不可能发生，每一秒都开始变得难以忍受。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Would they die inside the elevator if help never came? It should've been impossible. After all, if the recording was legitimate and they'd spend a month in the tower, it must've also been true that Atsuki would survive until it occurred.
entries.new: 如果救援始终不来，他们会死在电梯里吗？按理说不可能。毕竟，如果那段录音是真的，他们要在塔里待上一个月，那么 Atsuki 也一定能活到那一刻。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: ...However, what about Shiroya? She hadn't been mentioned in it.
entries.new: ……可是，Shiroya 呢？录音里没有提到她。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Atsuki was used to feeling betrayed by his own mind. Shiroya had been wearing a neutral expression, but if nothing had happened in three hours... what kind of expression would she have? Would he be the only one to survive after seeing his friend deteriorate?
entries.new: Atsuki 早已习惯被自己的思绪背叛。Shiroya 一直面无表情，可如果三小时后什么也没发生……她会露出怎样的表情？难道他会眼睁睁看着朋友衰弱下去，最后只有自己活下来？
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The rational part of him denied it: there was no food anywhere, and none of them could survive for so long. Yet, he couldn't relieve any of his worries.
entries.new: 他理智的一面否定了这个念头：这里根本没有任何食物，他们谁都不可能撑那么久。可即便如此，他还是没法减轻半点忧虑。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He stood up and stretched his body as much as he could. Maintaining the verbal silence, he sat back down. His mind begged for noise, the lack of anything else happening driving him mad.
entries.new: 他站起身，尽可能伸展身体。他依旧没有说话，又坐了回去。他的脑子渴望听到些声响，周围什么也没发生，快把他逼疯了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He wasn't sure how much longer they had to wait for... Perhaps they'd been inside for half an hour. As much as he wanted the time to pass, he knew an inevitable time would come: almost {time=21.}
entries.new: 他不确定他们还要等多久……也许他们已经在里面待了半个小时。他虽盼着时间快点过去，却也知道那个无可避免的时刻终将到来：将近 {time=21.}。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The uncertain period of time in which nothing would be known. Was it past {time=21}, and they were already doomed? Was the way out about to unlock? ...How could they know?
entries.new: 那是一段什么都无法确定的时间。是不是已经过了 {time=21}，他们早已注定无救？出口是不是马上就要解锁了？……他们又怎么可能知道？
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: If it was truly never going to open... when would they know it? Would they have to wait for six hours before being sure that their perception of time hadn't shattered?
entries.new: 如果出口真的永远不会打开……他们又要到什么时候才能确定？难道要等上六个小时，才能确认自己的时间感没有错乱？
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He didn't know what to think. Nearby, Sai might've been trying to find a way to kill them. Could it be that he wouldn't let the exit open precisely to achieve that?
entries.new: 他不知道该作何感想。Sai 也许就在附近，正想办法杀掉他们。会不会他正是为了这个目的，才不让出口打开？
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The tendency Atsuki had to overthink everything made for the perfect paranoid mind. Beyond everything, thinking about a reality in which they'd be trapped there forever, sharing a long and agonizing end while he could only blame himself, was the most petrifying conclusion he could imagine.
entries.new: Atsuki 凡事都爱想太多，这性子让他格外容易疑神疑鬼。他能想象到的最可怕结局，就是两人永远被困在这里，一起熬过漫长而痛苦的末路，而他只能责怪自己。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: And it wouldn't occur.{w} He had spent the past few minutes with his eyes closed when he opened them after a sudden noise.
entries.new: 而这一切并没有发生。{w} 过去几分钟他一直闭着眼睛，直到一声突如其来的响动让他睁开眼。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He looked up. A knife had been stabbed into his chest, one gripped by a hand. When it was taken out, blood began to pour out of him, wetting his shirt.
entries.new: 他抬起头。一把刀已经刺进他的胸口，刀柄握在一只手里。刀被拔出时，鲜血从他体内涌出，浸湿了衬衫。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: A cold and simultaneously hot pain invaded his whole torso. He couldn't comprehend what had happened and looked at the blood in disbelief.
entries.new: 一股又冷又热的疼痛侵入他整个躯干。他无法理解发生了什么，难以置信地看着鲜血。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Then, his gaze turned to Shiroya's expression. It was one he'd never seen on her.
entries.new: 随后，他的目光落到 Shiroya 的脸上。那是他从未在她脸上见过的神情。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: His mind fell into disarray as he frantically looked around the cramped space. He couldn't believe what he was seeing. The situation was so laughable that he couldn't bring himself to scream or utter a word.
entries.new: 他的思绪陷入混乱，发疯似的环视这个狭小的空间。他无法相信眼前的景象。这情形荒唐得可笑，他竟连喊一声、说一句话都做不到。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Flickering shreds of sound began to fill his ears while his sight blackened. "No, why...?" Those words echoed within himself, unable to be released.
entries.new: 断续的细碎声响开始灌入耳中，视野逐渐发黑。「不，为什么……？」这句话在体内回响，却怎么也吐不出来。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He opened his eyes to confirm it one more time: indeed, what he saw was a senseless nightmare. Every scenario he'd thought of had been erased.
entries.new: 他睁开眼，想再确认一次：没错，他看到的是一场毫无道理的噩梦。他此前设想的每一种情形都被抹去了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Atsuki felt a disconnect from reality, as if his body had been hijacked. Without the strength to resist, he gave out on keeping hold of himself, and as soon as he collapsed to the ground, his consciousness burst like a bubble.
entries.new: Atsuki 感到自己与现实脱了节，仿佛身体已被他人夺走。他没有力气抵抗，再也撑不住自己；刚一倒在地上，意识便像泡沫般破灭。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Ending: Personal Paradox
entries.new: 结局：个人悖论

entries.text: Bloodhound
entries.new: 寻血猎犬

entries.text: Catch-22
entries.new: 第二十二条军规

entries.text: Entering the elevator was too risky; that was my final conclusion. There was no way Sai hadn't prepared for it.
entries.new: 进电梯太冒险了——这是我最后的结论。Sai 不可能没为此做准备。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We set foot on the third floor. I glanced at my right and saw the shut elevator. That meant it probably hadn't been disabled, giving off a further feeling of a trap. I saw the bathrooms again as well.
entries.new: 我们踏上了三楼。我往右边一瞥，看见电梯门紧闭。那大概说明电梯并没有被停用，反而更让人觉得是个陷阱。我又看见了那些洗手间。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We had the opportunity to lock ourselves inside one, but I doubted the inner lock would be able to withstand the force of someone turning a key from outside. Ignoring both options, we continued running forward.
entries.new: 我们本有机会把自己锁进其中一间，但我怀疑里面的锁根本挡不住有人从外面用钥匙开门。我把这两个选择都抛在脑后，继续向前跑。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Sai had probably been waiting for us inside the first partition of the previous floor, so running next to them was hair-raising. Behind us, Sai's noisy attempts at catching up began growing audible throughout the entire floor. We had to put the distance between us to good use.
entries.new: Sai 很可能就等在我们上一层的第一间隔间里，所以从旁边跑过时，我吓得头皮发麻。身后，Sai 追赶时弄出的声响渐渐传遍整层楼。我们必须好好利用拉开的距离。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: When we arrived on the second floor, my limbs began to tremble, pushed harder than I had ever expected.
entries.new: 到达二楼时，我的四肢开始发颤，它们承受的负荷远超出我的预料。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: W-W-We should probably go to the... event room... to s-see if the Sekimeiya's still there.
entries.new: 我、我们最好去……活动室……看、看看 Sekimeiya 还在不在那里。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Shiroya didn't react to what I said, but we continued to make our way through the floor.{w} There was another reason we had to target the event room: if Sai was our only attacker, for as long as we circled in and out of it, we wouldn't be caught. Of course, we couldn't do that for the remaining three hours, but it was better than putting ourselves in a corner.
entries.new: Shiroya 没有回应我的话，但我们继续穿过这一层。{w} 我们非去活动室不可，还有另一个原因：如果袭击者只有 Sai，那么只要我们在活动室里外绕圈子，就不会被他抓住。当然，剩下三个小时不可能一直这样，但总比把自己逼进角落要好。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The final staircase was just ahead of us. We'd begun to slow down, but Sai hadn't been able to close the distance between us. We could hear his footsteps still descending the previous flight of stairs.
entries.new: 最后一段楼梯就在前方。我们的速度已经慢了下来，但 Sai 始终没能缩短我们之间的距离。还能听见他的脚步声，他仍从上一段楼梯上往下追。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: When we crossed the door in the middle of the staircase, we saw the floor of hallway A. Without hesitating, we kept running toward the door in the middle.
entries.new: 我们穿过楼梯中段的那扇门，A走廊出现在眼前。我们没有迟疑，继续朝正中的门跑去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There was another drop of blood... on the floor of hallway C.
entries.new: C走廊的地板上又有一滴血……
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: What...?
entries.new: 什么……？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: It looked recent too...
entries.new: 看上去也是刚留下不久的……
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Had someone been occasionally bleeding small drops for two hours...? I had no time to wonder about it as I pushed open the door in front of us.
entries.new: 难道这两个小时里，一直有人断断续续地在滴血……？我没空多想，推开了面前的门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: In the dark room, the covered cabinet appeared camouflaged by the walls. Drawn by its overwhelming aura, I grabbed the bottom of the curtain and lifted it.
entries.new: 昏暗的房间里，蒙着布的展示柜几乎与墙壁融为一体。那股压倒性的气息吸引着我，我抓住遮布的下摆，将它掀了起来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Really...?
entries.new: 真的……？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: What do we do?
entries.new: 我们该怎么办？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: The Sekimeiya was behind the glass. Neither the mysterious Shiroya nor Sai had taken it.
entries.new: Sekimeiya 就在玻璃后面。无论是神秘的 Shiroya 还是 Sai，都没有把它取走。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I tried to open it, which confirmed that our lock was still in effect. Only the key would deliver the Sekimeiya back to us, and Akaro or Sai surely had it. ...And even though another Sekimeiya could exist, that was no guarantee.
entries.new: 我试着打开，确认我们的锁仍然有效。只有那把钥匙才能把 Sekimeiya 交还到我们手上，而钥匙必定在 Akaro 或 Sai 那里。……况且，就算可能存在另一个 Sekimeiya，也无从保证。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We can't keep running away forever, but there's no safe place...!
entries.new: 我们总不能一直逃下去，可又没有安全的地方……！
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I froze, trying to think, but my nerves prevented me from doing so. There was nothing we could do but keep running to escape from Sai.
entries.new: 我僵在原地，想要理清思路，可紧绷的神经根本不容我思考。除了继续逃、躲开 Sai，我们别无他法。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Another Sekimeiya could be somewhere, but we can't enter any of the rooms to find it, or we could be backing ourselves into a dead end...
entries.new: 说不定哪里还有另一个 Sekimeiya，可我们没法挨个进房间去找，否则很可能把自己逼进死路……
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: The intense sound of Sai's footsteps hadn't been audible since we'd arrived on the crystal floor.
entries.new: 自从我们来到水晶层，就再没听到 Sai 那逼人的脚步声。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Let's go. I don't know where, but we should at least be in a hallway to see him coming.
entries.new: 走吧。去哪儿都行，至少得待在走廊里，才能看见他过来。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: The hallway B door hadn't been closed. We rushed to it, but that thoughtless action immediately proved to be a critical mistake.
entries.new: B走廊的门没有关上。我们冲了过去，可这不过脑子的举动，立刻成了致命错误。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...There we go.{w=0.5} You two were starting to really tire me out.
entries.new: ……找到了。{w=0.5} 你们俩还真让我费了不少劲。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: As soon as we tried to leave, Sai's body collided with mine at full speed. I was knocked down and fell by his feet.{w} When his terrifying voice made me look up, I saw the knife we'd been running from, pointed right in front of my face.
entries.new: 我们刚要离开，Sai 整个人便全速撞了上来。我被撞倒在地，摔在他脚边。{w} 听到他那骇人的声音，我抬起头，随即看见我们一路躲避的那把刀，正对着我的脸。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Sai... what the fuck are you doing!?
entries.new: Sai……你他妈到底在干什么！？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I knew I couldn't run away. Behind me, I could feel Shiroya's trembling legs. She still had the chance to escape, but the shaking of her body ruled that out.
entries.new: 我知道自己逃不掉了。身后能感觉到 Shiroya 的双腿在发抖。她本来还有机会逃，可身体抖成那样，根本跑不了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Tell me, Atsuki. What do you think I'm doing?
entries.new: 说说看，Atsuki。你觉得我在做什么？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: His face shifted into an unsettling smile while he slowly brought the knife closer to me.
entries.new: 他脸上浮起一个令人发毛的笑容，同时慢慢把刀凑近我。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Please, stop! Wh-Why do you want to kill us!?
entries.new: 求你了，住手！你、你为什么要杀我们！？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: "Us"? Don't worry, I was only chasing Atsuki. I'm not gonna be the one to kill you.
entries.new: 「我们」？放心，我追的人一直只有 Atsuki。杀你的人不会是我。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Do you mean... someone else will?
entries.new: 你是说……会有别人来杀我？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Precisely.
entries.new: 正是。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Shut the fuck up! There's no way she'll die!
entries.new: 少他妈胡说！她怎么可能死！
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Oh... I guess you haven't seen it? I thought for sure you had.
entries.new: 哦……看来你没看到？我还以为你肯定看见了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Wh-What?
entries.new: 什、什么？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Let me make it clear for you: Shiroya's fate is death. She is close to dying, and I will be the cause behind it if I have to be.
entries.new: 我就直说吧：Shiroya 注定会死。她已经离死不远了，必要的话，我会亲手促成这件事。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Unfortunately, you won't get to see it. You brought this upon yourself for being so fucking stupid.
entries.new: 可惜，你是看不到了。落得这个下场，全怪你自己蠢得离谱。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: The knife seemed to grow bigger as it approached me. Was I truly about to die, without understanding anything, in that pathetic position...?
entries.new: 刀离我越近，就越显得巨大。难道我就要这样不明不白地死在这么难看的姿势里……？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wait! Stop!
entries.new: 等等！住手！
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Tell me, at least! Why do you want to kill me!?
entries.new: 至少告诉我！你为什么要杀我！？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I started to use my arms to drag myself backward. Sai followed my movements with his knife, his expression growing absent.
entries.new: 我开始用双臂撑着身体往后挪。Sai 的刀跟着我的动作移动，神情却渐渐变得恍惚。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Answer me!
entries.new: 回答我！
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: No, just let him go! He hasn't done anything!
entries.new: 不行，放他走！他什么都没做！
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: You stay right there.
entries.new: 你给我待在那儿别动。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: For the first time, Sai's voice wavered.
entries.new: Sai 的声音第一次发颤了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Why...? Did he realize something?
entries.new: 为什么……？他想通了什么吗？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Then, he stared at my eyes with the most incensed and serious expression I'd seen on him.
entries.new: 随后，他盯住我的眼睛，那是我见过他最愤怒、最严肃的神情。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'll ask again: why do you think?
entries.new: 我再问一遍：你觉得是为什么？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I don't know! That's why I'm asking!
entries.new: 我不知道！所以才问你！
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I continued to move back, and he stopped following me. When I'd separated myself enough from him, I stood up, but I couldn't run away. I'd ended up in the corner of the room, and there was no real method of getting around him.
entries.new: 我继续往后退，他不再跟上来。等我与他拉开足够的距离，我站了起来，却还是逃不掉。我已经退到了房间角落，根本没有办法绕过他。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Are you okay...?
entries.new: 你没事吧……？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: I nodded uncertainly. Keeping her eyes on Sai, she walked up to me, abandoning any remaining chance of fleeing. Sai at least appeared not to be an immediate threat to Shiroya, so I didn't tell her to stay back.
entries.new: 我没有把握地点了点头。她视线不离 Sai，走到我身边，把仅剩的逃跑机会也放弃了。Sai 至少看起来暂时不会对 Shiroya 动手，我便没有叫她退开。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: When I looked at Sai with a clearer mind, I saw something of importance that stood out: there was a bit of blood in his mouth. Immediately, I associated it with the drops we'd found.
entries.new: 脑子稍微清醒后，我再看 Sai，注意到一件要紧的事：他嘴里有血。我立刻把它和我们发现的血滴联系了起来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Why is your mouth bleeding? When did that happen?
entries.new: ……你嘴里为什么在流血？什么时候弄的？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: After looking down for a few seconds, he lifted his head back up, regaining his imposing aura.
entries.new: 他低下头，过了几秒又抬起来，那股逼人的气势重新回来了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Are you laughing at me?
entries.new: 你在笑话我？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What...? No, why?
entries.new: 什么……？没有，怎么了？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: To answer your question, not more than thirty minutes ago.
entries.new: 回答你的问题——不超过三十分钟前。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: O-Oh.
entries.new: 哦、哦……
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Was that supposed to mean something? The way he said it made it sound like he wanted to convey something more.
entries.new: 那句话是有什么含义吗？他的语气听上去像是还想传达别的什么。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I thought you might've left some blood behind, like that drop, for example.
entries.new: ……我还以为你留下了血迹，比如那一滴。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I pointed at the floor, where the fully dried-up drop was.
entries.new: 我指向地板——那滴血已经完全干涸了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I don't know where that came from, but it's not mine. That has been here for longer than thirty minutes.
entries.new: 我不知道那是从哪来的，但不是我的。它在这儿的时间不止三十分钟了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I thought so...{w} Have you stopped trying to kill me...? I don't understand what you're doing.
entries.new: 我也这么想……{w}你不打算杀我了……？我不明白你在做什么。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Shut up.
entries.new: 闭嘴。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Unable to feel completely relieved, Shiroya and I glanced at each other. Had Sai been trying to kill me for something he thought I did? His murderous intent previously seemed incredibly determined, but my own bewilderment caused it to diminish out of nowhere.
entries.new: 我和 Shiroya 对视一眼，谁都没能真正松口气。Sai 想杀我，是因为他认定我做了什么吗？方才那股杀意坚决得不容置疑，可我这一脸茫然，却让它凭空消退了下去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Pensively, Sai glanced around the room. Suddenly, in visible shock, his whole body went one step backward.
entries.new: Sai 若有所思地环顾四周，突然像是受了什么惊吓，整个人后退了一步。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Did something happen...?
entries.new: 怎么了……？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Atsuki, tell me something. What time do you think it is?
entries.new: Atsuki，我问你，你觉得现在几点了？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Uh... Right now... it should be around {time=17:40.}
entries.new: 呃……现在……应该是 {time=17:40.} 左右。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: You're right. My watch says it's {time=17:41}, and I'm sure it's correct.
entries.new: 你说得没错。我的表显示 {time=17:41}，而且我确定它走得准。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...Does that tell you anything?
entries.new: ……这能说明什么吗？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I suppose so, but I'm not sure what.
entries.new: 大概能，但我还说不清是什么。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What the fuck...? Did he think I'd say an incorrect time?
entries.new: 搞什么……？他以为我会把时间说错吗？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Do you know where Akaro is?
entries.new: 你知道 Akaro 在哪儿吗？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: That son of a bitch? No idea.
entries.new: 那个混蛋？不知道。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Did something happen between you two? You escaped the bedroom together. How did you do it?
entries.new: 你们之间出什么事了？你们是一起逃出卧室的。怎么做到的？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Try to figure it out yourself. Telling you anything I've concluded wouldn't be smart. I don't think Akaro is with us anymore, though. He might be outside.
entries.new: 你自己琢磨去。我推断出来的东西，告诉你可不明智。不过我觉得 Akaro 已经不在我们这边了。他可能在外面。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What? Using the Sekimeiya?
entries.new: 什么？用 Sekimeiya？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Yes, most likely.
entries.new: 对，多半如此。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: A few minutes after you two left, Akaro came back to the bedroom.
entries.new: 你们走后没几分钟，Akaro 就回到了卧室。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Excuse me?
entries.new: 你说什么？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Yes. He said he didn't remember leaving, but he disappeared again without removing the chain.
entries.new: 对。他说他不记得自己离开过，可门链没被取下，他又不见了。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: What the fuck?{w} Don't tell me you believed him. I knew he could try to enter from the storeroom door, but I haven't guarded it the entire time.
entries.new: 搞什么？{w}别告诉我你信了他。我早知道他会试着从储藏室的门进来，可我不可能一直守着那儿。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: You think he entered from the outside after escaping? ...Still, he vanished, and the Sekimeiya is right here.
entries.new: 你觉得他是逃出去之后又从外面进来的？……可他还是消失了，而 Sekimeiya 就在这儿。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Show me.
entries.new: 让我看看。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Shiroya went ahead and raised the curtain, which had fallen by itself at some point. As we'd seen, the Sekimeiya was behind the glass.
entries.new: Shiroya 上前掀起遮布——不知何时它自己落了下来。和先前看到的一样，Sekimeiya 就在玻璃后面。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Did you two put it inside?
entries.new: 是你们把它放进去的？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Yes, a long while ago.
entries.new: 是，很久以前了。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: ...{w}Was it in the farthest back room in hallway B? B6?
entries.new: ……{w}是在 B走廊最里面那间？B6？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...Yes.
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I thought about it again. The origin of that Sekimeiya still didn't make sense.
entries.new: 我又想了想。那台 Sekimeiya 的来历依旧说不通。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Where?
entries.new: 在哪儿？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: First, it was on the floor. We used it, but when we came back, we couldn't find it. Then we found it inside a drawer in the same room.
entries.new: 一开始它放在地上。我们用了它，可回来之后就找不到了。后来才在同一个房间的抽屉里找到。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: ...{w}Huh. I see.{w} It teleported there after you used it... I get it.
entries.new: ……{w}哼，原来如此。{w}你们用过之后，它传送到了那里……我明白了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: How did you know we found it in that room?
entries.new: 你怎么知道我们是在那间房里找到它的？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I just remembered that it could have been there. Now, let me pass.
entries.new: 我只是想起来它可能在那儿。好了，让开。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What?
entries.new: 什么？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Move away.
entries.new: 让开。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Do you want the Sekimeiya? Do you have the key?
entries.new: 你想要 Sekimeiya？你有钥匙？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Shut up and move away.
entries.new: 少废话，让开。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I couldn't decipher his intent. His voice had changed completely, and he sounded as if we were the present threat instead of him, keeping him away from the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 我摸不透他的意图。他的语气彻底变了，仿佛此刻真正的威胁是我们，是我们挡着他、不让他接近 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: You just wanted to kill me! Why would we let you use the Sekimeiya?
entries.new: 你刚才还想杀我！我们凭什么让你用 Sekimeiya？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Are you really this dense? I have a knife.
entries.new: 你真有这么迟钝？我手里有刀。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: That's a fair point. Are you going to kill us if we don't step aside?
entries.new: 说得有理。我们要是不让开，你打算杀了我们吗？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Yes.
entries.new: 是。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: There was no determination in that threat. For some reason, everything murderous about him was gone.
entries.new: 那句威胁里听不出半点决心。不知为何，他身上那股杀气已经荡然无存。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Where did you even get that knife!? Did you kill Katei and Erina?
entries.new: 你从哪儿弄来那把刀的！？你杀了 Katei 和 Erina 吗？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: No. I haven't killed anyone.
entries.new: 没有。我没杀任何人。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Don't lie. You have a knife which was definitely used to kill Erina.{w} You're trying to trick us, aren't you? You used the Sekimeiya to escape the tower, and then you entered again through the storeroom with that knife that you brought from the outside.{w} You traveled from the hallway B room, which is how you knew we found the Sekimeiya there.{w} The state we saw Akaro in... did you do that?
entries.new: 少骗人。你手里那把刀，分明就是杀死 Erina 的凶器。{w}你想骗我们，对吧？你用 Sekimeiya 逃出了塔，然后带着从外面弄来的那把刀，从储藏室重新进来。{w}你是从B走廊那间房穿越回来的——所以你才知道我们在那里找到了 Sekimeiya。{w}我们看到 Akaro 时他那副样子……也是你干的？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Regarding where I found this knife... I just did. I'm not gonna tell you where, but I found it inside this building, poorly hidden.
entries.new: 至于这把刀是从哪儿找到的……反正就是找到了。在哪儿我不会说，但就在这栋楼里，藏得也不怎么高明。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What...? And you mean to tell us that we never found it before?
entries.new: 什么……？你是说，我们之前居然一直没发现？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Listen, here's a good question for you. I've seen Katei's and Erina's corpses. If I killed them, how come there's no blood on my clothes?
entries.new: 听好，我倒要问你们一个问题。Katei 和 Erina 的尸体我见过。如果是我杀的，那我衣服上怎么一点血都没有？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I was taken aback. He was right: blood would've splashed onto the killer's clothes after killing both of them, but Sai's were completely clean.
entries.new: 我一时语塞。他说得没错：连杀两人，凶手的衣服上不可能不溅到血，可 Sai 的衣服干干净净。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Suddenly, a needle pierced my heart when I remembered something. ...The Shiroya who'd changed clothes.
entries.new: 忽然，我想起一件事，心口像被针扎了一下。……那个换过衣服的 Shiroya。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: That doesn't mean anything. If you used the Sekimeiya to travel back in time after you killed them, it would have given you clean clothes from a past point, and the stained ones would have disappeared forever.
entries.new: 那说明不了什么。你要是杀了人之后用 Sekimeiya 回到过去，它就会把过去那个时间点的干净衣服给你换上，沾血的那身则会永远消失。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: ...She's right. You could've easily gotten rid of them like that.
entries.new: ……她说得对。用这个办法，你轻易就能把血衣处理干净。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Heh... That's wrong.
entries.new: 呵……错了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What is?
entries.new: 哪里错了？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: What you two just said... is wrong.{w} However, I didn't have to get rid of any clothes, seeing as I didn't kill anyone.
entries.new: 你们俩刚才说的……都错了。{w}不过，我根本不需要处理什么衣服，因为我没杀过人。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What exactly are we wrong about?
entries.new: 到底哪里说错了？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: As I said before, telling you anything wouldn't be smart.
entries.new: 我说过了，什么都说出来可不聪明。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Were we wrong? ...About what?{w} His clothes still had very faint traces of the smoke on them. If he had traveled outside the tower and then entered from the storeroom, there would've been no smoke on them. ...Was that wrong as well?
entries.new: 我们错了？……错在哪儿？{w}他衣服上还残留着极淡的烟味。如果他先前去过塔外，再从储藏室进来，衣服上就不该沾着烟味。……这一点也错了吗？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I didn't know how to object. After Katei and Erina died, it was unlikely anyone activated the Sekimeiya. How had it appeared inside the drawer? Either it teleported there, or someone deliberately left it inside. Going off how clumsily that drawer was shut, the latter sounded a lot more plausible.
entries.new: 我不知该如何反驳。Katei 和 Erina 死后，不太可能有人启动过 Sekimeiya。那它怎么会出现在抽屉里？要么是被传送过去的，要么就是有人刻意放进去的。看那抽屉关得那么马虎，后一种可能听起来合理得多。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Regardless, it was still shut, so nobody could have traveled after leaving the Sekimeiya there. The window for that explanation was incredibly tight—it had to have happened before that point or after the present time if the Sai we were talking to was the result of an upcoming time travel.{w} We also couldn't rule out the possibility that someone took the Sekimeiya out of the cabinet, used it, and placed it back inside.
entries.new: 不管怎样，抽屉当时是关着的，所以把 Sekimeiya 留在那里之后，就不可能再有人穿越离开。这一解释能成立的时间窗口窄得惊人：事情要么发生在那之前；要么，如果我们面对的这个 Sai 是未来一次时间穿越的结果，那事情就得发生在当下之后。{w}此外，也不能排除另一种可能：有人从展示柜里取出 Sekimeiya 用过，又放了回去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Anyway, I wouldn't want to kill you two now since there's more stuff I want to think about. I'd still get out of my way if I were you, though.
entries.new: ……总之，现在我还有别的事要想，不想杀你们俩。不过换作我，还是会乖乖让开。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: You definitely have the key for the cabinet, right? You took it from the bedroom before escaping... Does that mean that Akaro never had it? It doesn't sound as if you two got along too well despite leaving together.
entries.new: 展示柜的钥匙肯定在你手上吧？你逃走之前从卧室里拿走了……这么说，Akaro 从来没拿过钥匙？你们虽然是一起离开的，听起来关系却不怎么样。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Atsuki, overcome your stupidity and move. Do you want to put her in danger?
entries.new: Atsuki，收起你的蠢劲，让开。你想把她也拖进危险里吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I don't want to move either. Giving the Sekimeiya to you can't be a good idea no matter what.
entries.new: 我也不想让开。不管出于什么理由，把 Sekimeiya 交给你都不会是好事。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: I have a knife, for the love of God! You were scared out of your minds running away before. Where did your balls come from?
entries.new: 老天，我手里有刀啊！之前逃跑的时候你们吓得魂都没了。现在这胆量是从哪儿冒出来的？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: At this point, I'm pretty sure that you don't intend to use it.
entries.new: 事到如今，我很确定你并不打算用它。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Sai's lips curved into a grin.{w} Then, he kneeled and left the knife on the floor.
entries.new: Sai 嘴角一弯，笑了。{w}随后他蹲下身，把刀放在了地上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: All right, let's play your game then.
entries.new: 好啊，那就照你们的规矩来。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What game?
entries.new: 什么规矩？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: You two don't understand anything. You think you do, and it's laughable.{w} Right. I don't want to use my knife because overpowering you physically right now would be a loss. I'll have to go one step further and show you how pathetic your resistance is.
entries.new: 你们俩什么都不懂，却自以为都懂，真是可笑。{w}没错，我不想动刀，是因为现在靠武力制服你们反而是我输。我得再进一步，让你们看看自己的抵抗有多可悲。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Without abandoning his unsettling smirk, he dashed out of the room, toward hallway B.
entries.new: 他带着那抹令人发毛的笑，冲出了房间，朝B走廊奔去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Huh...?
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: I didn't understand anything, but Sai had a plan. Given what had happened the previous time, I hesitated to chase after him, but I immediately realized that was a mistake.{w} To prevent him from completely leaving our line of sight, I sprinted toward the door and looked down the hallway.
entries.new: 我完全摸不着头脑，但 Sai 一定有计划。想起上次发生的事，我迟疑着不敢追上去，可随即意识到这是错的。{w}为了不让他彻底脱离视线，我冲向门口，望向走廊。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Before I got there, the loud noise of a door being slammed boomed out. By the time I arrived, all I saw was a bunch of closed doors with no indication of which one had created the noise.
entries.new: 我还没跑到，一声摔门的巨响就炸了开来。等我赶到，眼前只有一排紧闭的门，看不出哪一扇是声音的来源。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...He has to be inside one of them. No way he had time to get to hallway C or the lobby.
entries.new: ……他一定在其中一间里。他不可能有时间跑到C走廊或大厅。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Going off what he said, I figured he would have created that noise to lure us out and make us mistakenly think that he was still in the hallway, but that couldn't be it—with such a brief window of time, he was definitely in one of those rooms.
entries.new: 按他说的那些话推测，那声巨响多半是他故意弄出来引我们出去，好让我们误以为他还在走廊上。可事情没这么简单——时间那么短，他肯定就在其中一间房里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: He must think we'll search for him, but he has something in mind... Do you want this just in case?
entries.new: 他一定算准了我们会来搜，心里肯定打着什么主意……这个你拿着，以防万一？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Shiroya had retrieved the knife from the floor. I understood her proposition, but I declined it.
entries.new: Shiroya 已经把刀从地上捡了起来。我明白她的意思，却没有接。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If he wanted to harm us, he would've done so just now. He wants to trick us somehow.
entries.new: 他真想伤我们，刚才就动手了。他是想用什么法子算计我们。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: But how...? He's in one of the rooms, so how would he be able to do anything?
entries.new: 可是怎么算计……？他就在某间房里，能做什么？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: His goal was clearly to open the Sekimeiya cabinet, so there's a very simple way.
entries.new: 可他要怎么做到……？他就在某间房里，能做什么？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: It seems he understands how the Sekimeiya works better than us... and it's still possible another one exists.{w} If he entered the room where he knew the other Sekimeiya was, he could've gone back to the past. Maybe he thought both of us would chase behind him and he could immediately enter the event room from hallway A.{w} That's why it should be fine if you stay here, looking at the hallway. I'll open the doors while you make sure Sai doesn't leave and nobody enters from the other side.
entries.new: 他似乎比我们更清楚 Sekimeiya 的运作方式……而且，很可能还有另一台。{w}如果他进了自己知道放着另一台 Sekimeiya 的房间，就能回到过去。他也许以为我们俩都会追在他身后，这样他就能立刻从A走廊进入活动室。{w}所以，你留在这里盯着走廊就好。我来开门，你负责看住 Sai，别让他跑掉，也别让任何人从另一头进来。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Shiroya walked back and closed the hallway A door, hindering any entrance. She nodded, knowing we couldn't just ignore him.
entries.new: Shiroya 走回去关上了A走廊的门，堵住了那一侧的入口。她点了点头，也明白我们不能就这么放着他不管。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Just watch out, okay? He dropped the knife to bait us into following him. He sounded pretty confident, and knowing Sai, he's got some plan...
entries.new: 你小心点，好吗？他扔下刀，就是想引我们追过去。他语气那么笃定，以 Sai 的性子，肯定有算计……
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: I know... I'll be careful, but he still has to be here, and it's important to find him. Even though he gave it to us, the fact is we have his knife. If we find him, we can keep him in one place until we're out of here.
entries.new: 我知道……我会小心。可他终究还在这里，必须找到他。刀虽说是他自己丢下的，但现在确实在我们手上。只要能找到他，我们就能把他困在一个地方，直到离开这里。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: She agreed. I stepped out of the room, glancing around me as I put my shoes on. I was absolutely certain that one of the closed doors hid Sai behind it.
entries.new: 她同意了。我走出房间，边穿鞋边环顾四周。我确信，那些紧闭的门中有一扇后面藏着 Sai。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: With how fast everything happened, it was also likely he hadn't gone to any room on the extremes of the hallway. However, I started with those to rule them out.
entries.new: 事情发生得那么快，他多半也没跑到走廊两端的房间。不过我还是从那几间查起，好先排除掉。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: On full alert, I turned the doorknob of the cleaning room and pushed the door open.
entries.new: 我绷紧神经，拧动清洁间的门把手，推开了门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The empty space came into view, still missing the cart that used to occupy much of it. I knew he could've used a Sekimeiya to escape, so I briefly searched around for it. There were some shelves and buckets, but I doubted something as big as the Sekimeiya could be hidden there.
entries.new: 那片空出来的地方映入眼帘，原本占去大半空间的手推车仍不见踪影。我想到他可能用 Sekimeiya 逃出去，便匆匆在四周搜了一遍。那里只有几排架子和几只桶，Sekimeiya 那么大，我想不至于藏得下。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Before moving on, I saw something.{w} On top of one shelf, there was a key.
entries.new: 正要离开时，我却看见了什么。{w} 有个架子的顶上放着一把钥匙。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Surprised, I jumped to grab it. In my hand was a small key I hadn't seen before, so I put it in my pocket.
entries.new: 我心中一惊，纵身伸手去够。落到手里的是一把从没见过的小钥匙，我便把它揣进了口袋。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I don't get it... This room has been searched before with the intention of finding the Sekimeiya, right? How come this key was never found?
entries.new: 想不通……这房间之前为了找 Sekimeiya 被彻底搜过一遍吧？怎么这把钥匙一直没被发现？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: It was no time to wonder that, so I exited as soon as I determined nothing else was hidden out of sight.
entries.new: 现在不是琢磨这些的时候。我确认暗处没再藏着别的东西，便退了出去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The room in front of me, B6, was where we'd found the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 眼前这间是 B6，我们当初就是在那里找到 Sekimeiya 的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I entered it and looked in every cabinet and drawer. All of them were empty.
entries.new: 我走进去，把每个柜子和抽屉都查看了一遍。里面全都空空如也。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: As soon as I set foot in the staff room, I remembered that a complete search couldn't be performed. What if Sai could open one of the lockers?
entries.new: 一踏进员工室，我才想起这里没法彻底搜。万一 Sai 打得开其中某个储物柜呢？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wait, no. That's fine.
entries.new: 等等，不对。这不成问题。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: They can't be locked from the inside. Although they're big enough to contain a person, if Sai had the brilliant idea to hide in one, it must currently be unlocked.
entries.new: 柜子没法从里面上锁。它们虽然大得能装下一个人，可要是 Sai 真聪明到躲进去，那柜子现在必然没锁。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: And if he used a Sekimeiya that he hid inside one, he needed to unlock it first. So after traveling, it would remain unlocked...
entries.new: 而如果他用的是藏在柜里的 Sekimeiya，那他也得先把柜子打开。那么穿越之后，柜子应该还开着……
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I had to try opening every single one. The higher compartments had three narrow slits I could barely put my fingers through. I used them to try pulling the doors toward me, sure that they'd open if they were unlocked.
entries.new: 我只能逐个试着打开。上层的柜门上有三道窄缝，勉强够我把手指伸进去。我就勾住这些缝往自己这边拉，心想只要没上锁，门总能拉开。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: One locker opened: Naomi's. Only her coat was inside, and I made sure its pockets were empty. After that, no more doors budged.
entries.new: 有一扇柜门开了：Naomi 的。里面只挂着她的外套，我确认过口袋是空的。之后，再没有一扇门动过。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Not here either...{w} Unless he used the Sekimeiya and then it teleported itself away like he said happened earlier...
entries.new: 这里也没有……{w} 除非他用了 Sekimeiya，然后它真的像他先前说的那样自己传送走了……
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I entered the following crystal room, and after the same quick search, I confirmed neither Sai nor the Sekimeiya were inside.
entries.new: 我走进下一间水晶展室，照旧匆匆搜了一遍，确认里面既没有 Sai，也没有 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: From the event room, Shiroya let me know that nothing had happened on her end. She was looking at hallway B to prevent Sai's escape while paying very close attention to the door behind her.
entries.new: Shiroya 从活动室那边告诉我，她那边没有动静。她一边盯着 B走廊 防止 Sai 逃走，一边留意着身后的门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Perhaps Sai could enter from it at any time, make it to the cabinet faster than Shiroya, and then overpower her. However, he willingly gave up his knife, and that was his best opportunity to do so.
entries.new: Sai 说不定随时会从那扇门进来，抢在 Shiroya 之前冲到展示柜前，再把她制住。可他连刀都主动丢了，而那本来是他最好的机会。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Next, I entered room B4. It exuded a sinister aura, exhibiting Naomi's and Erina's deaths. Trying to ignore my sudden heartache, I inspected every cabinet where Sai or the Sekimeiya could be.{w} As usual, they were all empty.
entries.new: 接着我走进 B4 展室。这里透着一股不祥的气息，Naomi 和 Erina 就死在此处。我强压下心头骤然的刺痛，把 Sai 或 Sekimeiya 可能藏身的展示柜一一查过。{w} 和之前一样，全是空的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Just three more... We have to find something in one of these.
entries.new: 只剩三间了……总得在其中一间里找到点什么。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I continued by entering the room on my left. At first glance, it was another empty crystal room where nothing of importance had occurred.
entries.new: 我接着走进左边那间。乍看之下，又是一间空荡荡的水晶展室，没出过什么要紧事。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: After looking through every cabinet, that sensation hadn't changed: yet again, a few spare gems were all I was able to find inside them.
entries.new: 我把所有展示柜查完，那种感觉依旧没变：里面照旧只有几颗备用的宝石。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It was the same in the next one. It was full of uninteresting cabinets storing nothing but air and gemstones.
entries.new: 下一间也是一样。满室的展示柜里除了空气就是宝石，没什么好看的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There's only one more... Could it be we left the correct one for the end?
entries.new: 只剩最后一间了……难道说，我们恰好把对的那间留到了最后？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Shiroya looked unsure. She was constantly glancing behind her while giving Sai no time to escape hallway B.
entries.new: Shiroya 神情有些迟疑。她一次次回头张望，却始终没给 Sai 逃出 B走廊 的空隙。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I opened the door and stepped into the last crystal room. Nothing appeared different from the others. To prevent a sudden attack, I'd been getting used to immediately looking behind the doors. That first step was completed without an issue.
entries.new: 我推开门，走进最后一间水晶展室。这里看上去和其余几间并无不同。为防突袭，我已经习惯了进门先看门后。这一步没有出任何岔子。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Those cabinets were the sole remaining places where Sai could be. Starting from the right ones, I uncovered their lids one by one, progressively narrowing down the last options.
entries.new: 那些展示柜是 Sai 唯一可能藏身的地方。我从右边开始，一具一具掀开柜盖，把最后的可能逐个排除。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: And when I opened the last one, it was finally confirmed: Sai wasn't anywhere.
entries.new: 掀开最后一具时，事情终于有了定论：Sai 不在这里，哪儿都不在。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Feeling defeated, I returned to hallway B and rejoined Shiroya.
entries.new: 我满心挫败，回到 B走廊，与 Shiroya 会合。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I don't get it... There's not much he could've done.
entries.new: 我想不明白……他能做的事应该不多。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: He said the Sekimeiya could teleport itself after being used. Maybe that's why you didn't find it.
entries.new: 他说过 Sekimeiya 用过之后会自己传送。也许你没找到它，就是这个原因。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: But... do you think that's what he did?
entries.new: 可是……你觉得他真会这么做吗？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I mean, I've searched enough to be sure that he isn't in any of these rooms, but there might be a very good spot I've missed where he hid the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 我是说，我搜得够仔细，可以确定他不在这些房间里；不过也许有个绝佳的藏身处被我漏掉了，他把 Sekimeiya 藏在了那儿。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: But why would he do that? Does he really want to get his hands on the Sekimeiya in the cabinet when he knew where another one was?
entries.new: 可他为什么要那样做？明明知道另一台 Sekimeiya 在哪儿，他真会那么想去拿展示柜里的那一台吗？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: And was his plan simply to use it, lure us out while he trusted his hiding spot, and enter the event room from hallway A? There's no way, right?
entries.new: 他的计划难道就是用它，把我们引出来，仗着藏的地方够隐蔽，再从 A走廊 进活动室？这怎么想都不可能吧？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Probably not... He knew one of us would stay here.
entries.new: 大概不会……他知道我们总有一个会留下。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Yeah. He left his knife behind to make us chase after him, but there's no way he thought both of us would go.
entries.new: 是啊。他丢下刀，好让我们去追他，可他绝不可能以为我们两个都会去追。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Do you think he had time to go to hallway C or the lobby?
entries.new: 你觉得他有时间跑去 C走廊 或大厅吗？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: He wasn't very fast when he was chasing us, and I doubt he faked his speed just for this... I suppose we can't completely rule it out, but I didn't hear his footsteps in the distance.
entries.new: 他追我们的时候跑得并不快，我不觉得他跑那么慢是故意装出来的……我想也不能完全排除，但我在远处没听见脚步声。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Whatever Sai was planning... we had to stop it. He might've given up on killing us, but nothing guaranteed he hadn't simply held off on it after realizing something important.
entries.new: 不管 Sai 在盘算什么……我们都得阻止他。他也许已经放弃杀我们，但也可能只是察觉到了什么要紧的事，才暂时没有动手。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We need to search hallway A, but the lobby and hallway C are a problem.{w} Wait here, watching over this hallway and the other door like you were doing. I'll be back in a second.
entries.new: A走廊 得搜一遍，可大厅和 C走廊 是个麻烦。{w} 你守在这儿，照刚才那样看着这条走廊和另一扇门。我很快就回来。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: ...Okay.
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: I took off toward the lobby. Nobody was there, and I made sure to check that Sai wasn't behind the columns and couch. It was unlikely for him to hide in the mechanical room, but I had to look.
entries.new: 我朝大厅跑去。那里没有人，我还特意确认了柱子后和沙发背后都没有 Sai。他不太可能藏在机械室，但我还是得看一眼。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I opened the door and headed down the stairs. It was going to be hard to conclude that nobody was hiding with the provided light, but I had to do it. If nothing else, I felt like I didn't have to be scared of sudden physical attacks.
entries.new: 我推开门，走下楼梯。凭现有的光线，要断定里面没人并不容易，可我还是得查。别的先不说，至少我觉得不必担心会突然挨上一下。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: After some time, I was sure the room was uninhabited, and I didn't see the Sekimeiya either.
entries.new: 过了一会儿，我确定这间屋子里没有人，也没看见 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I headed back up, knowing what I'd do next.
entries.new: 我心里清楚接下来该做什么，便沿楼梯返回。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Instead of joining Shiroya through hallway B, I entered hallway A and opened the door to the event room.
entries.new: 我没有从 B走廊 过去与 Shiroya 会合，而是走进 A走廊，推开了活动室的门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It startled her, but she quickly realized it was me.
entries.new: 她吃了一惊，但很快认出是我。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wait, don't come over. The lobby is empty, and from here, I can see hallway A, the event room, and the way to the other floors...
entries.new: 等等，别过来。大厅是空的，而且从这里能看到 A走廊、活动室，还有通往其他楼层的路……
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Do what I did from the other side. Check the bathrooms and come here through hallway A. If you do that, we'll have successfully isolated this hallway, and we'll be able to make sure nobody enters from floor 2.
entries.new: 照我刚才的路线，从另一侧走一遍。检查洗手间，然后从A走廊过来。这样这条走廊就被我们彻底隔开了，也能确保没人从二楼进来。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Got it.
entries.new: 明白了。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: She disappeared from view, walking toward hallway C. For some seconds, I did what she'd been doing earlier: keep track of the event room and the hallway simultaneously.
entries.new: 她朝C走廊走去，身影从视野里消失。有那么几秒，我学着她先前的样子，同时留意活动室和走廊的动静。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: As soon as she appeared from hallway C, I could stop focusing on the event room because nobody could've been behind us. I knew not to lower my guard, though, given Sai's evident confidence.
entries.new: 她一从C走廊现身，我就不必再盯着活动室了——我们身后已经不可能有人。可看Sai那副笃定的样子，我知道不能就此松懈。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I saw her trying to open the elevator door, but it wasn't there. Then, she sprinted toward me.
entries.new: 我看见她伸手去开电梯门，门却不在那里。紧接着，她朝我飞奔过来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...He wasn't in the bathrooms. I didn't find the Sekimeiya either.
entries.new: ……洗手间里没有他。Sekimeiya也没找到。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: So, if he's still on this floor, he has to be inside a room in this hallway.{w} We'll do the same thing, then.
entries.new: 那么，只要他还在这一层，就只可能藏在这条走廊的某个房间里。{w}那就照老办法再来一遍。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Shiroya came to my side, where she would stand while I entered every remaining room.
entries.new: Shiroya来到我身旁，之后我逐个进入剩下的房间时，她都会站在那里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...That was, until a sound made us turn around.
entries.new: ……直到一声响动让我们回过头去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: All right.{w} What are you doing over there? Searching for me?
entries.new: 好吧。{w}你们在那头做什么？找我？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...Next to the cabinet, Sai stood, the Sekimeiya between his hands. He hadn't teleported yet, and he was covering his skin under his shirt.
entries.new: ……Sai就站在展示柜旁，Sekimeiya捧在双手之间。他还没传送，正用衬衫遮住自己的皮肤。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: With a smile, he closed the glass and let go of the curtain.
entries.new: 他微微一笑，合上玻璃柜门，松开了遮布。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What the fuck...? What did you just do?
entries.new: 搞什么……？你刚才做了什么？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Let me make something clear. If you try to approach me, I'll touch it immediately, and I'll disappear. Even though I'd go just a bit back in time, that's all I need.
entries.new: 我把话说明白。你们要是敢靠近，我立刻碰它，然后消失。哪怕只是回到稍早一点的时间，对我也足够了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...All you need for what? You'd leave the Sekimeiya with us.
entries.new: ……足够做什么？你一走，Sekimeiya可就留在我们手上了。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: I don't care about that. I've definitely thought about what I'm doing, don't worry.
entries.new: 那无所谓。我在做什么，自己早就想清楚了，不用担心。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Even though it wasn't visible, as soon as he'd gotten the Sekimeiya out of the cabinet, it started to build up time and energy. I was able to see the cabinet key in his other hand, explaining how he'd been able to get it open so easily.
entries.new: 虽然肉眼看不出来，但从他把Sekimeiya取出展示柜的那一刻起，它就开始积蓄时间与能量。我也看见他另一只手里握着展示柜的钥匙——难怪他能那么轻易地打开。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What's with those faces? Are you that surprised to see me again?
entries.new: 都什么表情？再见到我，有这么吃惊吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Don't be silly. You weren't in hallway B. You probably just traveled from the future and arrived someplace I'd already investigated.
entries.new: 少装傻。你根本不在B走廊。你多半是从未来穿越回来，落在我已经查过的地方了。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: But I didn't do that at all. I haven't touched the Sekimeiya once since I last talked with you.
entries.new: 可我根本没这么干。自从上次和你们说完话，我一次都没碰过Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Don't lie. You had the other Sekimeiya hidden somewhere, and you activated it to go back to the past. You'll touch it again in the future, and you'll appear in one of the hallway B rooms I just checked. Maybe you just traveled some seconds into the past from one room to the other, making it all more simple. Am I wrong?
entries.new: 别撒谎。你把另一件Sekimeiya藏在某处，启动它回到了过去。未来的你还会再碰它一次，然后出现在我刚查过的B走廊某个房间里。说不定你只是从一个房间穿越回几秒之前，落到另一个房间，这样一来就简单多了。我说错了吗？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Didn't I just tell you that? Yes.
entries.new: 我不是刚说过吗？没错。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I also just said what my plan relies on: I must go back to the past, but I don't need to go too far. If I had another Sekimeiya hidden, what would the point of using this one be? I would just go back to the past with the other one I have, right?
entries.new: 我也刚说过我的计划靠的是什么：我必须回到过去，但不用回得太远。如果我另藏了一件Sekimeiya，那还用这一件做什么？直接拿手上那件回去不就行了？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: This is an actual question. If I know where another Sekimeiya is like you say, why would I not simply use that one?
entries.new: 我是认真在问。如果真像你说的，我知道另一件Sekimeiya在哪儿，那我为什么不干脆用那一件？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I don't know! But enlighten us, how come you weren't anywhere if you didn't use the Sekimeiya?
entries.new: 我不知道！那你倒是说说，既然没用Sekimeiya，你怎么会哪儿都找不到？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Oh, are you just trying to be funny? You said you haven't touched the Sekimeiya, but you simply got caught up in the range of a travel you knew you'd create after traveling, right? So you didn't actually "touch" it.
entries.new: 哦，你这是在耍嘴皮子吧？你说自己没碰过Sekimeiya，可你只是被自己穿越后必然会形成的范围卷了进去，对吧？所以你其实并没有「碰」它。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: You just jumped ten steps too far, Atsuki. It's baffling how easy it is to trick you.{w} I really just relied on a trick I felt could work, which you might discover eventually.
entries.new: Atsuki，你这步子迈得太大了。骗你竟然这么容易，真让人吃惊。{w}我不过是用了自认为可行的一个小把戏，你也许迟早能想明白。
