entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...What trick!?
entries.new: ……什么把戏！？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I don't feel like telling you. Take my word for it, though—I did not travel with the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 我不太想说。不过你信我一句——我没有用Sekimeiya穿越。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: There's no way. You weren't in hallway B. Your only way out was going to the past.
entries.new: 不可能。你不在B走廊。你唯一的出路就是回到过去。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: *sigh*{w} Aren't you missing a really easy way I could've escaped?
entries.new: 唉……{w}你们是不是漏掉了一个我本来很容易就能脱身的办法？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...Huh?
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Fine, I'll tell you. I don't need her cooperation any longer.
entries.new: 算了，告诉你们。我已经不需要她配合了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What?
entries.new: 什么？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Sorry, Shiroya, I'm nullifying our deal. Atsuki deserves to know what happened.{w} It was simple. Atsuki, the first room you went to was the cleaning room, right? You were close—I was in the staff room.{w} The moment you entered it, I left. In the hallway, Shiroya winked at me and let me escape. I feel awful keeping you in the dark, honestly.
entries.new: 抱歉，Shiroya，我们的交易作废。Atsuki有资格知道真相。{w}事情很简单。Atsuki，你最先进的是清洁间，对吧？只差一点——我当时在员工室。{w}你进门的那一刻，我就离开了。在走廊里，Shiroya朝我眨了眨眼，放我走了。说真的，一直把你蒙在鼓里，我心里过意不去。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What are you talking about!? Why would I let you go!?
entries.new: 你在说什么！？我凭什么放你走！？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Feigning ignorance, huh? That's okay. You can keep lying to him for all I care.
entries.new: 装傻是吧？无所谓。你尽管继续骗他，我不在乎。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: You're not gonna trick me, Sai. You used the Sekimeiya in some way.
entries.new: 你骗不了我的，Sai。你肯定以某种方式用了Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: As if I'd ever side with you. You're a horrible person.
entries.new: 我怎么可能和你一伙。你这个人坏透了。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: That hurts. I really thought we had something going.
entries.new: 这话真伤人。我还真以为我们之间有点交情。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I'm kidding, of course. I just used my invisibility cloak. Now I'll peace out and appear somewhere in the past. After I do what I need to do, I'll show up again, so you won't have to wait too long for me. From your perspective, I'll probably enter from the door as soon as I disappear. I bet a future version of me is waiting in hallway B for his cue to enter.
entries.new: 当然是开玩笑。我只是用了隐身斗篷。现在我这就走人，在过去的某个地方现身。等我做完该做的事，还会再出现，所以你们不用等我太久。你们大概会看到，我一消失，就立刻从门口走进来。我敢说，未来的我正待在B走廊，等着进去的时机呢。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Stop! What do you even need to do? You said you didn't necessarily need to travel too far back. Why not?
entries.new: 等等！你到底要做什么？你说过不一定非得回到很远之前。为什么？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Perhaps you'll get something right for once if you keep thinking. I can definitely wait a little more.
entries.new: 你接着想下去，说不定总有一次能猜对。我不介意再多等一会儿。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: He put the cabinet key in his pocket, signaling that he could use his free hand at any time to activate the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 他把展示柜的钥匙收进口袋，这无异于告诉我：他随时都能用空出来的那只手启动Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Fuck! We can't let him travel. I'm not sure what he's doing, but he just has to go a few minutes back in time... He might need it to escape from us in hallway B. That must be what we're missing. He's just trying to mess with my head by accusing Shiroya.
entries.new: 该死！不能让他穿越。我搞不清他要做什么，可只要回到几分钟前就够了……他也许需要靠这个在B走廊甩掉我们。我们漏掉的肯定就是这一点。他诬陷Shiroya，只是在扰乱我的思路。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: But if that's the case, is there a point in trying to stop him? He already escaped, so he's guaranteed to succeed.
entries.new: 可如果是这样，拦他还有意义吗？他既然已经逃掉了，就说明他注定会成功。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Wait, no. What am I thinking? When he took off toward hallway B, his goal was already to touch this Sekimeiya—he has another reason to use it, no matter what it is. It's still possible the travel he's about to perform will let him not be found, though.
entries.new: 等等，不对。我在想什么？他往B走廊跑的时候，目标就已经是碰这件Sekimeiya了——不管出于什么，他还有别的理由要用它。不过，他接下来这次穿越，仍有可能让他不被人找到。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I met Shiroya's eyes. She was at my right, and silently, she communicated to me that we had to stop him. He'd tried to kill me and had been holding a knife; whatever his intentions were, we had to assume they weren't great.
entries.new: 我对上Shiroya的目光。她就在我右侧，无声地告诉我：必须拦住他。他拿着刀，还曾想杀我；不管他打的是什么主意，我们都只能往坏处想。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: No more questions?
entries.new: 没有别的问题了？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: We stood, looking at each other. No matter how much he waited or what he said, he would never be at risk.
entries.new: 我们就这样面对面站着，彼此对视。无论他等多久、说什么，他都不会有半点危险。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'm all ears. I might just go already, though.
entries.new: 我听着呢。不过，我也许马上就走。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Wait.
entries.new: 等等。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Hm?
entries.new: 嗯？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I didn't know what to say. I was trying to think of a way to get the upper hand.
entries.new: 我不知道该说什么，只想着怎样才能占得上风。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Nothing?
entries.new: 没话说了？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: The seconds continued ticking, and most of them were filled with silence. Our disadvantage was too significant.
entries.new: 时间一秒秒流逝，大部分时间都是沉默。我们的劣势实在太大了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Why are you not activating it?
entries.new: ……你为什么还不启动它？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Throw me your guesses. Why am I not activating it? I had fun figuring my stuff out, but it's better if I can see how ignorant you still are.
entries.new: 猜猜看吧。我为什么还不启动它？我挺享受把自己的事弄明白，不过能见识一下你们有多无知，还是更有意思。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Why is he not activating it...? He said he didn't care about traveling shortly into the past, but what else could it be?
entries.new: 他为什么还不启动……？他说过不在乎穿越到不久前的过去，可除此之外还能有什么原因？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Yet again, silence engulfed us while Sai looked at ease, ready to touch the Sekimeiya at any moment.
entries.new: 沉默再次笼罩了我们。Sai 却一脸从容，仿佛随时都会伸手触碰 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Why are you so tense? I'm doing this to take care of one little thing, and you have no way to stop me, so instead of trying to do that, you can keep displaying how much you don't get.
entries.new: 你们紧张什么？我只是要处理一件小事，你们根本拦不住我。既然这样，与其费劲阻止我，不如继续让我看看你们有多搞不清楚状况。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I can assure you I'll accomplish what I want, so relax a bit. When I disappear, I'll show up immediately, and I won't try to do anything to the Sekimeiya. Until then, I'm not in a hurry.
entries.new: 我可以保证，我想做的事一定会成，所以你们放松点。等我消失，我会立刻重新出现，也不会对 Sekimeiya 动手。在那之前，我不急。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What the hell do you want, then?
entries.new: 那你到底想干什么？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Don't you want to keep begging for my knowledge? I'm sure you're curious about a bunch of things.
entries.new: 你们不是还想继续求我告诉你们吗？我确信你们对很多事都很好奇。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: You're the one who keeps refusing to answer. I bet you're trying to feel really smart.
entries.new: 一直不肯回答的人是你。我看你就是想显得自己很聪明。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Right. I'm so smart that I turn myself on. That's true, though. I suppose it's not fair if I won't answer anything.{w} Remember at the beginning? I had no issues sharing my thoughts with you, but that changed at one point. There's no way you're dense enough to not know when.
entries.new: 没错，我聪明得连自己都要迷上自己了。不过这也是事实。要是什么都不回答，确实不太公平。{w}还记得一开始吗？那时我很乐意把自己的想法告诉你们，但后来某个时候变了。你们总不至于迟钝到连这都看不出来吧。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What, when the Sekimeiya made me travel?
entries.new: 什么，你是说 Sekimeiya 让我穿越的那时候？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: We found out we were next to a time travel device, yes. Then, keeping everything to myself became the smarter option.{w} I did not in any way suspect what the Sekimeiya would be capable of, but I was expecting something to occur. I thought I'd have to be very perceptive to understand whatever could be going on, but everything happened in front of our eyes.
entries.new: 是啊，我们发现身边就是一台时间穿越装置。从那之后，把一切藏在心里就成了更聪明的选择。{w}我完全没有想到 Sekimeiya 会有这种能力，但也预感到会出事。我原以为必须非常敏锐才能弄懂到底发生了什么，结果一切就明明白白地发生在眼前。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What were you expecting? Xyn to attack?
entries.new: 你预料到什么了？Xyn 会袭击我们？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Yeah, but that was fairly obvious. However, I suppose I came across {tip=traces}traces of the Sekimeiya{/tip} some time ago.
entries.new: 是啊，不过那并不难猜。只是，我前阵子大概发现过 {tip=traces}Sekimeiya 的痕迹{/tip}。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What...?
entries.new: 什么……？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: That's my answer. You were complaining I wasn't giving you any, so you have something to decipher if you please. That's a lot more fun than being straightforward for no reason.
entries.new: 这就是我的回答。你刚才还抱怨我什么都不肯给，现在有东西可以慢慢琢磨了。总比无缘无故直说有意思得多。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Then tell me, why did you try to kill me and then stop?
entries.new: 那你告诉我，你为什么想杀我，后来又停手了？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: It's not like I understand everything. I'm partly humoring you for the hell of it, but I'd also like to hear what you think. For old times' sake, give me your best deductions. Why do you think?
entries.new: 我又不是什么都懂。一半是闲得无聊逗你们玩，不过我也想听听你的想法。看在老交情上，拿出你最好的推理吧。你觉得是为什么？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I told you that I have no idea! Hearing that I didn't know why you were chasing us seemed to be what made you stop, so maybe you thought I did something I actually didn't.
entries.new: 我告诉过你，我根本不知道！你好像是听到我说不知道你为什么要追我们，才停的手。所以，也许你以为我做了什么，其实我并没有。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: If you're telling the truth, that's enough of an answer. I suppose I have to think of a cryptic response from my point of view.
entries.new: 如果你说的是真话，那也算回答了。看来我得从自己的角度想一个故弄玄虚的回答。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I thought you'd overstepped, but it seems I was the one who had.
entries.new: 我本以为是你越界了，看来越界的是我。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What?
entries.new: 什么？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: You have no idea what I'm talking about. I understand, and it's great. I promise there's some meaning behind that, but don't think I'll be stupid enough to tell you anything undesirable.{w} Now, explain something for me. I thought about it a little, and I don't understand what you said regarding Akaro.{w} He came back up to the bedroom and opened the door with the key, which was later left in the original drawer—
entries.new: 你完全不知道我在说什么。我明白，这很好。我保证这话自有含义，但别以为我会蠢到把不该说的都告诉你们。{w}现在，给我解释一件事。我想了想，还是没搞懂你说的关于 Akaro 的事。{w}他回到楼上的卧室，用钥匙开了门，而那把钥匙后来被留在了原来的抽屉里——
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: So you really grabbed it when you were chasing us? You wanted to trap us in the bedroom.
entries.new: 所以你在追我们的时候，真的把钥匙拿走了？你想把我们困在卧室里。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: This is very confusing. Shut up for now.
entries.new: 这太奇怪了。先给我闭嘴。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What exactly did he say, and how did he escape?
entries.new: 他到底说了什么？又是怎么逃出去的？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: He said he didn't remember escaping in the first place. Then he left again, probably the same way you did.
entries.new: 他说他根本不记得自己逃出去过。后来他又走了，大概和你离开的方式一样。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I left out a lot of information purposely, and I didn't think he'd used the same method, but there was no way I'd give Sai an accurate response.
entries.new: 我故意省略了很多信息。虽然我不觉得他用的是同一种方法，但无论如何，我都不会给 Sai 一个准确的回答。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But where was the key left after he escaped? You retrieved it at the end and were able to open the door, so he didn't leave it outside, right?
entries.new: 可他逃出去之后，钥匙被留在哪儿了？你们最后取回了钥匙，还能打开门，所以他没有把钥匙留在外面，对吧？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: How intriguing. I just glossed over it when you mentioned his reappearance, but I'm not certain what to think anymore.{w} When you let him enter, you made sure he didn't have a key on his person, right?
entries.new: 真有意思。你刚才提到他重新出现时，我还没细想，现在却不知道该怎么看了。{w}你们放他进来时，确认过他本人身上没有钥匙，对吧？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Of course. We're not that stupid.
entries.new: 当然。我们还没蠢到那种地步。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Then, there's only one way he could've disappeared...
entries.new: 那么，他消失的方式就只剩下一种可能了……
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: He let us know he wouldn't continue, but there was no doubt he was talking about the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 他告诉我们，他不打算继续说了。但毫无疑问，他说的是 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Where did you get this knife?
entries.new: 这把刀你从哪儿弄来的？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: No cryptic answer needed. I was honest earlier.
entries.new: 这个不用故弄玄虚。我刚才说的是实话。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: You just found it, right?
entries.new: 你是刚捡到的，对吧？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Good memory.
entries.new: 记性不错。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I wanted to ask about what he'd said regarding Shiroya's fate, but I couldn't bring myself to do it with her next to me.
entries.new: 我想问他那些关于 Shiroya 命运的话，可她就站在我身边，我实在开不了口。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Are you done?
entries.new: 问完了？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I'll repeat an earlier question: what the fuck are you trying to do now?
entries.new: 我再问一遍之前的问题：你现在到底想干什么？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Hm...{w} I'm just finishing off your ignorance.
entries.new: 嗯……{w}我只是来结束你们的无知。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...What?
entries.new: ……什么？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: How did I know you'd respond with a stupid-sounding "what"? Did you not understand I'm purposely being unclear? Being told the answer is no fun. I'm sorry if you disagree.
entries.new: 我怎么知道你一定会回一句傻乎乎的『什么』？你是没看出来我故意不说清楚吗？直接告诉你答案就没意思了。你要是不乐意，那就抱歉了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Why would I even assume you're not being misleading?
entries.new: 我凭什么不能认为你在误导我？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Why would you assume that? Naturally, you should keep it in mind, but understanding what I'm saying and then deciding whether to trust it is what I'd advise.
entries.new: 你凭什么这么想？当然，这一点你该记在心里；不过我的建议是，先听懂我在说什么，再决定要不要信。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Are you not going to touch the Sekimeiya?
entries.new: 你不打算碰 Sekimeiya 吗？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Are you that eager to see me disappear? I will, don't worry. It's been eleven minutes already, so I'd have no problem leaving now.
entries.new: 你就这么急着看我消失？放心，我会碰的。已经过去十一分钟了，我现在走也没问题。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...Where were you? Why did you not show yourself until now?
entries.new: ……你刚才在哪？为什么到现在才现身？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I was here, searching for you.
entries.new: 我一直在这儿，找你。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: There's no way you didn't see us for so long.
entries.new: 你不可能那么久都没看见我们。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Well, it's not my problem if you're not content with my answers.
entries.new: 你要是不满意我的回答，那也不关我的事。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I fell quiet again. I had no idea how to interpret his attitude, but I wouldn't refuse to ask more questions if he had some of his own to respond with.
entries.new: 我又沉默了。他这副态度究竟是什么意思，我毫无头绪；不过只要他还愿意回答，我也不会停止追问。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Why did I not find you in hallway B?
entries.new: 为什么我在B走廊没找到你？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Because you are incompetent.
entries.new: 因为你没本事。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Where were you, then?
entries.new: 那你到底在哪？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: In hallway B.
entries.new: B走廊。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...{w}Who killed Katei?
entries.new: ……{w}是谁杀了 Katei？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Either Akaro or Erina.
entries.new: 不是 Akaro 就是 Erina。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...Who killed Erina?
entries.new: ……是谁杀了 Erina？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Me.
entries.new: 我。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I'm just kidding. It was Isla.
entries.new: 开个玩笑。是 Isla。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I'm just kidding. Either Akaro or Katei.
entries.new: 开个玩笑。不是 Akaro 就是 Katei。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I stopped caring about his behavior. Additionally, I'd found a reason to stall for time.
entries.new: 我不再理会他这副态度了。况且，我已经找到了拖延时间的理由。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: You perfectly remember when we went up to the attic to get the lithium battery, right?
entries.new: 我们上阁楼去拿锂电池那件事，你记得一清二楚，对吧？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Of course.
entries.new: 当然。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: How did you do that?
entries.new: 你是怎么做到的？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I said you're incompetent, but at least you're doing your best, unlike the others.
entries.new: 我说过你没本事，不过至少你还在尽力，不像其他人。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: That's my answer. I suppose it just appeared impressive from your point of view.
entries.new: 这就是我的回答。大概只是从你的角度看，才显得了不起吧。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Okay, then who killed Naomi? Who's the culprit behind everything?
entries.new: 好，那 Naomi 是谁杀的？这一切幕后的凶手又是谁？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: The culprit? Don't be silly.{w} And I'm not sure why you're asking me this when I recall saying over and over that Katei did it.
entries.new: 凶手？别傻了。{w}我记得自己反复说过，是 Katei 干的，真不明白你为什么还要问我。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Then... why the fuck were there two Naomis?
entries.new: 那……为什么会有两个 Naomi？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: That's a big one. I only have vague ideas, unfortunately, and none that I'm willing to share.
entries.new: 这可是个大问题。可惜我只有些模糊的想法，而且哪条都不想说。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: You talk a lot, but you're not really saying anything. How did you escape from the bedroom?
entries.new: 你话是不少，可什么都没说。你是怎么从卧室里逃出来的？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: With this.
entries.new: 用这个。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: He looked down at the Sekimeiya and signaled that it was his answer.
entries.new: 他低头看向 Sekimeiya，示意那就是答案。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What about this blood on the floor? Whose is it?
entries.new: 那地上这些血呢？是谁的？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: No idea.
entries.new: 不知道。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What about in the lobby? It should've been left while you were alone with Akaro.
entries.new: 大厅里的呢？那应该是你和 Akaro 单独待着的时候留下的吧。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: You mean the one drop, right?
entries.new: 你是说那一滴，对吧？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What else would I mean?
entries.new: 还能是哪滴？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: That's a great question, as you could only mean the one drop... We said I'd answer cryptically, right?
entries.new: 问得好，毕竟你只可能是指那一滴……我们说好了我会卖关子，对吧？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: If I'm right, that drop belongs to a person whose blood is not currently anywhere else, and they were one of the people who did not escape the attic's bedroom before Akaro and I did. Currently, that person is alive, and is found inside the tower. Furthermore, I estimate they're on one of the first four floors, standing up.
entries.new: 如果我没猜错，那滴血属于一个人——他的血目前不在其他任何地方；我和 Akaro 逃出阁楼卧室之前，他也没逃出来。这个人现在还活着，就在塔里。而且，我估计他在前四层中的某一层，站着。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Also, their name starts with "Shiroy".
entries.new: 还有，这个人的名字以『Shiroy』开头。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: You have time to think.
entries.new: 你有时间慢慢想。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...Why would it be me? Did you actually see me?
entries.new: ……怎么会是我？你真的看见我了？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: This is the part where a lot of things get a little too confusing. I'm not fully certain about what I'm saying, but decently so. Nonetheless, what I said about your fate still stands, and I'm much more certain about it, so my condolences. It appears it won't be me who will kill you, though.
entries.new: 接下来这段，很多事情会变得相当混乱。我没法完全确定自己说的话，但把握还不小。不过，关于你命运的判断依然成立，而且我对此更有把握，所以节哀。只不过，看来杀你的人不会是我。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Why are you saying this...!?
entries.new: 你为什么要说这种话……！？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Because I have eyes. That might sound unfair, though—you do too, but you don't understand. That's what I don't quite get.{w} Regardless, that's it. I'll touch the Sekimeiya and immediately appear from hallway B. I'll see you.
entries.new: 因为我有眼睛。这话听着或许不公平——你也有眼睛，只是看不懂。这一点我倒是真不明白。{w}总之，就到这里。我去碰 Sekimeiya，然后立刻从B走廊出现。回见。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Before he could finish that sentence, Shiroya and I dashed at him, reacting the way we'd prepared ourselves to.
entries.new: 他话还没说完，我和 Shiroya 就朝他冲了过去，身体完全是按事先准备好的那样动的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Hm? What are you...?
entries.new: ……嗯？你们要做什么……？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Of course, we weren't going to stop him—we knew that. He was slightly taken aback, but he had more than enough time to touch the Sekimeiya before we got to him.
entries.new: 当然，我们并不打算拦住他——我们清楚这一点。他稍稍一怔，却仍有充裕的时间，在我们赶到之前碰到 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: However, we didn't need to touch it directly. Alongside the stored time, the range of the Sekimeiya had to be small. If we could enter it before he touched it, we'd travel the same amount of time as him. Then, in the recent past, we'd have one chance to stop or understand his actions.
entries.new: 不过，我们并不需要直接碰到它。除了蓄积的时间，Sekimeiya 的作用范围也必定很小。只要在他触及之前进入范围，我们便能穿越与他相同长度的时间。这样一来，在不久前的过去，我们就有一次机会阻止他，或者弄清他的举动。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: As soon as he realized that was our plan, his face showed its first sign of uncertainty, and he rapidly moved his right arm to reach the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 他一看出这是我们的打算，脸上第一次显出犹疑，随即迅速抬起右臂去够 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It should've been futile. The room wasn't very big, and our sprint had put us fairly close to him...
entries.new: 这本该是徒劳。房间并不算大，而我们一路冲刺，已经离他相当近了……
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: However, when his skin made contact with the Sekimeiya, his entire figure disappeared in an instant.
entries.new: 然而，他的皮肤刚一触到 Sekimeiya，整个人便在一瞬间消失了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: In midair, the Sekimeiya turned gray, and when it hit the floor, the sound made it seem almost like it had broken. I stared at it, dumbfounded, while it rolled around for some long seconds.
entries.new: 半空中，Sekimeiya 化成了灰色，落地时的声响几乎像是摔碎了。我怔怔地望着它在地上滚了好几秒。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I guess we weren't fast enough...
entries.new: 看来我们还是慢了一步……
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Huh?
entries.new: 嗯？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I turned to my side.{w} Nobody was there.
entries.new: 我转头看向身旁。{w}空无一人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Shiroya... wasn't there. I spun and saw that I was alone with the powered-off Sekimeiya.
entries.new: Shiroya……不在。我转过身，房间里只剩我和已经熄灭的 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What the fuck...?{w} Did the range reach her?{w} Why her but not me?
entries.new: 怎么回事……？{w}范围波及到她了吗？{w}为什么是她，不是我？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I stood still and imagined where the three of us had been. ...Could the range have only missed me?
entries.new: 我立在原地，回想我们三人方才各自的位置。……难道范围恰好只漏掉了我？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I think so...  She was at my right side, but directly faced Sai, unlike me.
entries.new: 应该是……她当时在我右侧，但正面朝着 Sai，而我并不是。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: It didn't directly prove it, but it would've made sense if the range was circular, probably spherical.
entries.new: 这算不上直接证明，但如果范围是圆形的——多半还是球形——那就说得通了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'd been visualizing it that way already, and it seemed like it fit. The range must've been small, so perhaps only she had been in it.
entries.new: 我本来就一直这样设想，如今看来也吻合。范围一定很小，所以当时在里面的，或许只有她。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I didn't know how it worked—maybe your entire body had to be part of the range, or maybe only being partially hit was enough.
entries.new: 我不知道它的判定方式——也许整个人都得落在范围内，也许只碰到一部分就足够。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Transparent Reality
entries.new: 透明的现实

entries.text: Or... was there another reason? What if I was encompassed inside, but for some reason, I didn't travel?
entries.new: 又或者……另有原因？万一我其实也在范围之内，只是出于某种缘由没有穿越呢？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I was very lost, and I began to have a hard time working with what had happened. Until then, a maximum of two people had traveled each time. Was that the maximum amount? Had I been excluded for another reason, maybe?
entries.new: 我完全摸不着头脑，渐渐理不清眼前的状况。在此之前，每次穿越的最多不过两人。这就是上限吗？还是说，我被排除在外另有原因？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But... why is nothing happening?
entries.new: 可是……为什么什么都没发生？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Both of them just traveled to the past, so why haven't they arrived already? They must be somewhere...
entries.new: 他们俩刚刚穿越回过去，怎么到现在还没出现？他们肯定在某个地方……
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: That was what Sai had said: a version of himself might've been waiting in hallway B.{w} I approached the door and looked through it. I saw a handful of open doors that I'd left that way, but no sign of life.
entries.new: Sai 是这么说的：另一个他也许正等在 B走廊。{w}我走到门边，透过门看去。几扇被我敞开的门仍开着，却不见半点人影。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I turned around and looked at hallway A instead. While most of the doors were closed in its case, I still couldn't see anyone.
entries.new: 我转身改看 A走廊。那边大多数门都关着，可同样看不到任何人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Could something have happened that's preventing them from reappearing? They have to be in the tower, right?
entries.new: 会不会出了什么变故，让他们无法现身？他们总该还在塔里吧？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I walked up to the Sekimeiya and kneeled next to it. Then, I placed my right hand on it and felt its cold and smooth surface. Once again, it had powered off after a travel, but it hadn't teleported itself away.
entries.new: 我走到 Sekimeiya 旁跪下，把右手搭上去，掌心传来冰凉光滑的触感。它又一次在穿越后熄灭，却没有把自己传送走。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I waited. I was banking on something being about to happen, so I stood still, glancing back and forth between the two doors and trying to shake away the bitter taste the conversation with Sai left in my mouth.
entries.new: 我等着。我在赌接下来会发生些什么，于是静静站着，目光在两扇门之间来回游移，想把与 Sai 那番对话留在口中的苦涩甩掉。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: However, nothing was changing. I was getting worried, but I didn't know what to do.{w} After some minutes of standing up, I started to feel uncertain.
entries.new: 可是，一切毫无变化。我越来越不安，却不知该如何是好。{w}站了几分钟后，心中开始动摇。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Suddenly, the Sekimeiya turned white. I estimated about five minutes had passed since Sai and Shiroya vanishing, and the Sekimeiya had probably been storing energy for close to fifteen before their travel.
entries.new: 忽然，Sekimeiya 变白了。我估摸距离 Sai 和 Shiroya 消失才过了五分钟，而在他们穿越之前，Sekimeiya 大概已经蓄能将近十五分钟。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I looked at it intensely and had an idea. Could touching it while in the gray state prevent it from teleporting itself as soon as it turned white? I couldn't think of much else if Sai had been correct earlier.
entries.new: 我紧盯着它，忽然冒出一个念头：在它呈灰色时触碰它，会不会让它变白的瞬间无法自我传送？要是 Sai 先前所言不虚，我实在想不出别的解释。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: No, that doesn't make sense... When we traveled from the cleaning room, it fell in the buckets below the cleaning cart, and when the others found it, it was already white. Of course, I'd have to believe Sai's story to be sure, but nobody objected to it.
entries.new: 不对，这说不通……我们从清洁间穿越那次，它掉进了清洁车下面的水桶里，等其他人找到它时，它已经是白色的了。当然，要确定这一点，我得先相信 Sai 的说法，可当时并没有人提出异议。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I was really unsure about what to do. The silence had become unbearable in just those five minutes, and I couldn't understand why neither Sai nor Shiroya had returned.
entries.new: 我实在拿不定主意。仅仅五分钟，这份寂静就已让人难以忍受，我不明白 Sai 和 Shiroya 为什么都还没回来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Like Sai had done, I put my hand under my sleeve and grabbed the Sekimeiya. Then, I placed it inside the cold cabinet that Sai left unlocked and scrolled the glass shut. I didn't lock it—I'd just felt the need to not leave it outside, and I knew Sai was the one who had the key anyway.
entries.new: 我学着 Sai 的样子，把手缩进袖子里，拿起 Sekimeiya，放进 Sai 没上锁的冰冷展示柜，再把玻璃门拉上。我没有上锁——只是觉得不该把它留在外面，况且我知道钥匙在 Sai 手上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Afterward, I didn't know what to do. I felt a pressing atmosphere, as if I was the sole remaining being in that immense building.
entries.new: 之后，我不知道该做什么。空气沉重得压在胸口，仿佛这栋巨大的建筑里只剩下我一个人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Is it possible they appeared outside the tower...? Even though the distance traveled had to be short, the replicated location is an entirely different deal. Maybe that's what Sai meant when he said that he didn't care about how far he'd make it to the past, if he knew he'd appear outside regardless and was lying about immediately reappearing from hallway B.
entries.new: 他们会不会出现在塔外……？就算穿越的时间跨度很短，复制的落点也完全是另一回事。也许 Sai 那句话就是这个意思——他说过不在乎自己会回到多远的过去；若他明知无论如何都会落在塔外，那么所谓立刻从 B走廊现身，就只是谎话。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: But it can't be that Sai's goal was to leave. He wouldn't willingly walk away from all of this. Unless he learned something very important that would've changed his mind, if he wanted to escape, it must be that he planned to eventually reenter through the storeroom...
entries.new: 但 Sai 的目的不可能是离开。他不会甘愿抛下这一切。除非他得知了什么足以改变主意的重要事情；倘若他真想脱身，那必定是打算之后从储藏室再进来……
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: And what about the other Shiroya? She should be still here.
entries.new: 那另一个 Shiroya 呢？她应该还在这里才对。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Given the circumstances, she's sealed inside the tower. There's no way she could've left through the storeroom since no handle could be reattached to the door—opening it from the inside is pretty much out of the question.
entries.new: 照这情形，她被封在塔里。她不可能从储藏室出去——那扇门已经装不回把手，想从里面打开几乎无从谈起。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Using the Sekimeiya to escape should've been equally hard, though. While she could've taken it out of the cabinet while we went to the attic, it was still locked inside when we came back. She couldn't have appeared outside the tower because she couldn't have left it locked again.
entries.new: 不过，想靠 Sekimeiya 逃出去，应该也同样困难。我们上阁楼那段时间，她本可以把它从展示柜里取出来，可我们回来时它仍锁在里面。她不可能出现在塔外，因为她没法再把它锁回去。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I was just trying to reinforce the thought that I wasn't alone, acting as if it was impossible.{w} What if she'd appeared outside the tower, entered through the storeroom from the outside, and left the door open to leave after placing the Sekimeiya in the cabinet? It looked like motives behind actions had stopped mattering, so being sure about any detail had started to feel impossible.
entries.new: 我只是在反复说服自己并非孤身一人，装作那根本不可能。{w}可万一她真的出现在塔外，从外面经储藏室进来，把 Sekimeiya 放进展示柜后又敞着门离开呢？行动背后的动机似乎早已不重要，任何细节都变得无法确定。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The existence of that secret door made me anxious every time I thought about my situation. Not only did I not know if more people were around, but I also had no way to know if they would enter at any time. I didn't even know if the door led outside, if opening it from the other side was possible, or if anyone would be able to enter without being seen.
entries.new: 一想到自己的处境，那扇暗门就让我坐立不安。我既不知道还有没有别人在，也无从得知他们会不会随时进来。我甚至不知道那扇门是否通向外面、能否从另一侧打开，也不知道有没有人能神不知鬼不觉地进来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But only being able to hear my own breath, more empty minutes passed.
entries.new: 然而耳边只有自己的呼吸，空荡荡的几分钟又过去了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What could be going on? Sai said he hadn't killed anyone, so could it be that the true culprit found them and that's why they haven't come back?
entries.new: 究竟出了什么事？Sai 说过他没有杀任何人，那会不会是真正的凶手找上了他们，所以他们才没回来？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: At some point, my anxiety had become overwhelming. I didn't know whether to fear Sai, a different, true culprit, or the sudden solitude itself.
entries.new: 不知从何时起，我的不安已经压得人喘不过气。我分不清自己该害怕的是 Sai，是另一个真正的凶手，还是这突如其来的孤独本身。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I walked out to hallway B and began to take automatic steps toward the lobby. I'd been trying not to leave the Sekimeiya behind, but since I hadn't been able to let the proposition of being alone sink in, I succumbed to the need to wander around.
entries.new: 我走到 B走廊，脚步不由自主地朝大厅而去。我本想尽量不要把 Sekimeiya 留在身后，可「只剩我一人」这个念头始终压在心里，终究还是忍不住四处走动。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I looked at the vast, empty lobby, and what felt like a metal ball started to make its way down my stomach. Every step I took was all I could hear.
entries.new: 我望着空旷的大厅，仿佛有一颗铁球顺着胃往下坠。除了自己的脚步声，我什么也听不见。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: When I entered hallway A, I became convinced of it: Sai and Shiroya had escaped. That had to have been the meaning behind Sai's words, but it was impossible to know if I'd see them again before {time=21.}
entries.new: 走进 A走廊时，我总算确信了：Sai 和 Shiroya 已经脱身。Sai 那番话的意思必定如此，只是我无从知道，在 {time=21.} 之前还能不能再见到他们。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Even the other Shiroya, whose existence seemed incredibly volatile, had hidden from me as her only action. Without a search partner, anyone could stay out of my view if they so desired.
entries.new: 就连那个存在极不稳定的 Shiroya，唯一的举动也只是躲着我。没有同伴一起搜寻，任何人只要愿意，都能一直不出现在我的视野里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I continued walking toward hallway C, not even trying to find anyone. When I completed the full lap, I stepped into the event room and let out a sigh full of myriad emotions.
entries.new: 我继续朝 C走廊走去，甚至没再想着找人。绕完一整圈后，我走进活动室，长叹一声，百感交集。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I guess that... if I am alone, it wouldn't be that bad. I would only have to wait three hours to see Shiroya again.
entries.new: 我想……如果只有我一个人，倒也没那么糟。只要等上三个小时，就能再见到 Shiroya。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: But if Sai wasn't a killer, they still have to be here. And I don't know what Sai's plan was, but it could still be in motion.
entries.new: 可如果 Sai 不是凶手，就一定还在这里。我不知道 Sai 的计划是什么，但计划可能还在继续。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Once again, I stood still and waited, leaning against the wall while a few more minutes of silence passed.
entries.new: 我再次靠着墙站定，静静等着，沉默又过去了几分钟。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I walked up to the cabinet and uncovered the curtain.
entries.new: 我走到展示柜前，掀开了盖在上面的遮布。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Should I try to use it...?
entries.new: 要不要试着用一下……？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Anything could determine the replicated location. Perhaps Sai knew that touching the Sekimeiya would bring him outside, so the same could apply if I do it now myself.
entries.new: 任何细节都可能决定复制出的地点。也许 Sai 知道，只要碰一下 Sekimeiya 就会被带到外面；如果我现在这么做，或许也会一样。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: It wasn't too bad of an idea. If anything had gone wrong for them, I had the opportunity to reproduce it with the purpose of understanding what had happened.
entries.new: 这主意倒不算坏。如果对方那边出了什么岔子，我正好可以重现一遍，弄清究竟发生了什么。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I opened the glass and rolled the cold Sekimeiya to my shirt. I knew I'd have to wait some time for it to gain energy, but it would only be a few minutes. Even if I couldn't conclude anything, I'd travel some time back, so I could retrieve the Sekimeiya as soon as I disappeared.
entries.new: 我打开玻璃柜门，把冰冷的 Sekimeiya 裹进衬衫贴住身体。我知道要等它蓄能，但只需几分钟。哪怕最后什么也推断不出，我也能回到过去，这样一消失就能立刻取回 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...{w}Out of the blue, I recalled something else.{w} Awkwardly, I put my free left hand in my right pocket and took out a key. I'd found it in the cleaning room just earlier, high on a shelf.
entries.new: ……{w}忽然，我又想起了另一件事。{w}我别扭地用空着的左手伸进右边口袋，掏出一把钥匙。那是我刚才在清洁间找到的，就放在架子高处。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Nothing on it indicated what it was for, as it looked like a simple key that could unlock any normal door. I gave it a good look, sensing that something was about to come to me.
entries.new: 钥匙上没有任何标记能说明用途，看上去只是一把普通钥匙，能打开任何一扇寻常的门。我仔细端详着它，感觉有什么念头正要浮上来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Oh... Am I actually stupid?
entries.new: 哦……我难道是傻子吗？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: It looks a lot like the one for Naomi's locker. That's what it is, even though the color is slightly different.
entries.new: 没错，就是它，只是颜色稍有不同。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I had no simple way to compare them since I'd gotten rid of the other one through the toilet.
entries.new: 我已经把另一把钥匙冲进马桶了，没法再拿来简单比对。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I remembered that her locker had potentially been opened while we were in the attic. Could that have been the key to that mystery?
entries.new: 我记得我们在阁楼时，她的储物柜可能被人打开过。这会不会就是解开那个谜团的钥匙？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I shut myself in the staff room with the Sekimeiya since I wanted it to spend a few minutes out of the cabinet. I knew which locker was Naomi's, and as I thought, it was open.{w} I attempted to insert the key in the keyhole, but it didn't fully go in.
entries.new: 我带着 Sekimeiya 进了员工室，关上门，好让它在展示柜外待上几分钟。我知道哪个是 Naomi 的储物柜，过去一看，果然开着。{w}我试着把钥匙插进锁孔，却插不到底。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Huh, it's not the right one.
entries.new: 咦，不是这把。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: It almost fits, though. Does it open another one?
entries.new: 不过几乎能对上。难道是开别的柜子？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Eager to find out, I left the Sekimeiya on the floor and began to insert the key in every locker.
entries.new: 我急于确认，便把 Sekimeiya 放在地上，开始把钥匙逐个插进每个储物柜。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I started with the left ones and saw that the key would always enter partially. Some of them looked like they'd almost open, but I could never turn the key. I continued with the middle group and was met with the exact same result.
entries.new: 我先从左边的柜子试起，钥匙每次只能插进去一截。有几个似乎差一点就能打开，可钥匙始终转不动。我又接着试中间一排，结果完全相同。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I was about to sigh in disappointment, but when I tried to turn it after inserting it in the last one of the rightmost set, I heard a sudden, sharp sound. Understanding its meaning, I dragged the metallic door toward me and saw the interior of a new locker.
entries.new: 我正要失望地叹气，可当我把钥匙插进最右侧最后一个柜子并试着转动时，忽然听见一声清脆的响动。我立刻明白那意味着什么，把金属柜门朝自己拉开，看见了这个柜子的内部。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: However, its contents were painfully similar to Naomi's. There was nothing in the highest compartment, and a winter coat hung in the main one. As the biggest difference, a pair of brown, corduroy pants were folded on the bottom.
entries.new: 可里面的东西却和 Naomi 的柜子像得令人无奈。最上层空着，主格里挂着一件冬季外套。最大的不同，是底层叠着一条棕色灯芯绒长裤。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Even though they didn't seem to be much use, there was a chance someone left their phone in those clothes. I put the key back in my pocket, crouched to grab the pants, and held them up with one hand while I felt them.
entries.new: 虽然这条裤子看上去没什么用，但也许有人把手机落在了衣服里。我把钥匙收回口袋，蹲下拿起裤子，用一只手提着，另一只手摸索起来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Not only was there not a phone, every pocket was completely empty and clean, making it seem like the pants had been recently bought. I determined that they belonged to a considerably sized adult, probably male. Since clothes had been left in the locker, it was more than likely that it belonged to a staff member who wore a uniform during work.
entries.new: 里面不仅没有手机，每个口袋都空空荡荡、干干净净，像是刚买不久。我判断裤子属于一个体型相当魁梧的成年人，多半是男性。既然有便服留在柜子里，这个柜子很可能属于一名上班时穿制服的员工。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I recalled Katei had told us that the employees used the room to store personal objects and to leave their uniforms before heading off. There was no uniform in the locker, so everything indicated that the owner had come to work that day.
entries.new: 我想起 Katei 说过，员工会用这个房间存放私人物品，下班离开前也会把制服留在这里。柜子里没有制服，种种迹象都表明，柜子的主人那天来上过班。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I knew that I'd found the key in the cleaning room, but something still felt iffy about that, preventing me from jumping to conclusions.{w} I folded the pants and put them inside before I grabbed the heavy coat.
entries.new: 我知道钥匙是在清洁间找到的，可这件事总觉得哪里不对，让我不敢贸然下结论。{w}我把裤子叠好放回柜中，又拿起那件厚重的外套。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It was pretty big, so I began to run my hand over its surface in search of anything I could find.{w} Almost immediately, I took something from a pocket.
entries.new: 外套相当大，我开始用手在表面摸索，想找出些什么。{w}几乎立刻，我就从口袋里掏出了一样东西。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It was a set of four keys with a dog-shaped keychain. I had nothing to use them for, and I didn't recognize any, so I put them back in the pocket. I continued searching for anything else and shortly confirmed that every other pocket was empty.
entries.new: 那是一串四把钥匙，挂着狗形钥匙扣。我拿着它们毫无用处，也一把都不认识，便放回口袋。我继续翻找，很快确认其余口袋全是空的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But I continued feeling the surface of the coat because something had prompted my attention. I didn't know if I'd imagined it, but I thought I felt a minuscule bulge near the neck.
entries.new: 但我仍在摸索外套表面，因为有个地方引起了我的注意。我不知道是不是自己多心，但领口附近似乎有一处极小的凸起。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I kept going over the same spot until I was sure that I'd been right. Something very hard to notice was there.{w} Intrigued, I turned the cloth around and saw that part of the neck area was covered by a different type of material. I put my finger under it and found that the two layers allowed for a narrow cavity.
entries.new: 我反复摸同一处，直到确信自己没有弄错。那里确实有一样极难察觉的东西。{w}我来了兴趣，把布料翻过来，发现领口一部分覆着另一种材质。我把手指探到下面，发现两层布料之间有一道狭窄的空隙。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I drew my finger up to the spot where I'd felt the bulge, trying to find it on the opposite side.
entries.new: 我把手指移到刚才摸到凸起的位置，试图从另一面找到它。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There it is.
entries.new: 就是这里。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: It felt cold and round. With my thumb, I managed to grab and extract it.
entries.new: 那东西摸起来冰冷、圆润。我用拇指捏住，把它取了出来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Oh, what the fuck? Isn't this...?
entries.new: 妈的，这不是……？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: A bug. That was what it looked like.{w} I'd never personally seen one, but it had a very similar shape to the ones I'd seen in television shows. It was circular, and on its surface was what looked like a microchip. By adding the location where I'd found it, I could only recognize it as a spying bug.
entries.new: 窃听器。看上去就是那种东西。{w}我从没亲眼见过，但它的外形和电视节目里出现的非常相似。它是圆形的，表面有个像微型芯片的东西。再结合发现它的位置，我只能认定这是窃听器。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Was a staff member being monitored? Could Xyn have planted a bug on a staff member to learn about the measures Ashiya were taking against them?
entries.new: 有员工正在被监视吗？难道是 Xyn 把窃听器装在某个员工身上，好掌握芦屋针对他们的对策？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: No, that doesn't make a ton of sense. They wouldn't plant it on clothes that are always left in this locker.{w} Could it be the inverse, then? Did Ashiya suspect they were part of Xyn?
entries.new: 不，这不太说得通。他们不会把窃听器装在这种一直留在柜子里的衣服上。{w}那么，反过来呢？难道是芦屋怀疑这名员工是 Xyn 的人？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Even though the day's events had morphed into something nearly incomprehensible, they had started from Ashiya and Xyn's battle; it was foolish to think Xyn weren't involved in some way.
entries.new: 尽管今天发生的一切已经变得几乎令人费解，但事情的起点是芦屋与 Xyn 的争斗；若以为 Xyn 与此事毫无关系，未免太天真了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: And something had been cemented as reality: one of Ashiya's staff members was being monitored. I'd already seen the interior of Katei's and Naomi's lockers, the two staff members I was familiar with. Someone else must've owned that one.
entries.new: 而且有一件事已经成了确凿的现实：芦屋的一名员工正受到监视。我已经看过 Katei 和 Naomi 的储物柜内部，那是我熟悉的两个员工。这个柜子一定属于另一个人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I looked at it closely, haunted by the truth behind it. Could someone have been hearing my movements in a completely safe space somewhere in Yushibana? If so, they might've realized the bug had been found, but I couldn't imagine they were listening to it at all times.
entries.new: 我仔细端详着它，心头被它背后的真相压得发沉。是不是有人正待在丰花某个绝对安全的地方，听着我这边的动静？如果是这样，对方或许已经察觉窃听器被发现了，但我想他们不可能时时刻刻都在听。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I put the coat back in the locker, but I didn't reattach the bug to it, mainly because it looked tricky to do. Instead, I left it in one of its pockets, knowing it'd be found by the police if I mentioned it to them.
entries.new: 我把外套放回柜子，却没有把窃听器重新装回去，主要是因为装回去太麻烦。我把它留在其中一个口袋里，心想只要我向警方提起，他们自然会找到。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I glanced down at the Sekimeiya. Since I had the key to a new locker, I could lock it inside and look around the entire building for Shiroya.
entries.new: 我低头瞥了一眼 Sekimeiya。既然现在有了另一个柜子的钥匙，我就可以把它锁进去，再搜遍整栋楼去找 Shiroya。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: No, I shouldn't do that. This could be part of someone's plan.
entries.new: 不，不能这么做。这可能正是某个人计划中的一环。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: How can it be that this key was never found in the cleaning room with how much we've searched this floor? Doesn't it look like obvious bait to make someone believe they have a safe space to hide the Sekimeiya?
entries.new: 我们把这层楼翻来覆去搜了这么多遍，这把钥匙怎么可能在清洁间里一直没被发现？这难道不是明摆着的诱饵，让人以为自己有了一个藏 Sekimeiya 的安全地方？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: If the culprit, or let's say Sai, found the key well-hidden or had it somewhere, they could've duplicated it with the Sekimeiya. Then, they left it in the cleaning room and hoped someone would take the bait and keep the Sekimeiya in a locker they also had access to.
entries.new: 如果凶手——干脆就说 Sai——找到了这把藏得很好的钥匙，或者本来就有这把钥匙，那他就能用 Sekimeiya 复制一把。然后把它留在清洁间里，指望有人上钩，把 Sekimeiya 放进一个他们同样能打开的柜子里。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: But it was all right. I intended to touch the Sekimeiya, so, I'd have time to search the building in the past. That way, I'd know for a fact that nobody could take it in the meantime.
entries.new: 不过没关系。我本来就打算触碰 Sekimeiya，所以能回到过去，花时间搜完整栋楼。这样一来，我就能确定在此期间没人能把它拿走。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I put my hand behind the cloth of my shirt and felt the Sekimeiya's surface. As I thought, it had begun to heat up.
entries.new: 我把手伸进衬衫里，摸了摸 Sekimeiya 的表面。果然，它已经开始发热。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I couldn't take my eyes off of it. Sai chose to leave it behind, which made his intentions feel impossible to understand.
entries.new: 我无法把视线从它上面移开。Sai 选择把它留下，这让他的意图显得难以理解。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Ever since the time he'd escaped from the attic's bedroom, he had undoubtedly learned a few key details and found some attainable goals. ...A sudden thought confused me: if a culprit had been using the Sekimeiya to never be found and was responsible for all the deaths, why had they not targeted Sai?
entries.new: 自从他从阁楼的卧室逃走后，他无疑已经掌握了一些关键细节，也找到了几个可行的目标。……一个忽然冒出的念头让我困惑起来：如果凶手一直借助 Sekimeiya 让自己永远不被发现，而且所有死亡都是他造成的，那为什么没有对 Sai 下手？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I had no idea, but thinking that Sai was the killer didn't fit very well either. Why had he spared my life earlier? Could he really have found a hidden knife we all missed? He even said it was poorly hidden and that he'd overstepped... What the hell did that mean?{w} "Heh... That's wrong." Sai's voice played in my head.{w} "What you two just said... is wrong."
entries.new: 我毫无头绪，可认为 Sai 是凶手也同样说不通。他之前为什么放我一条生路？他真的找到了我们都没发现的藏刀吗？他甚至说那把刀藏得很拙劣，还说自己越界了……那到底是什么意思？{w}「呵……不对。」Sai 的声音在我脑中响起。{w}「你们俩刚才说的……错了。」
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: That had been in direct denial of Shiroya's claim: "That doesn't mean anything. If you used the Sekimeiya to travel back in time after you killed them, it would have given you clean clothes from a past point, and the stained ones would have disappeared forever."
entries.new: 那是在直接否定 Shiroya 的说法：「那说明不了什么。如果你杀了他们之后用 Sekimeiya 穿越回过去，它就会让你换上过去某个时间点的干净衣服，而沾了污渍的那套则会永远消失。」
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Should I take his word at face value and accept that he knows better than us?{w} What exactly is wrong about that? I can think of three different things.
entries.new: 我该不该就这么信了他的话，承认他比我们更清楚内情？{w} 可这话究竟错在哪里？我能想到三种可能。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: He might've been referring to the part where his clothes would disappear forever. Perhaps they would appear somewhere, but that doesn't sound too likely.{w} Maybe he really meant that the Sekimeiya couldn't have achieved that, but there's no way we were wrong. We know such a thing could've occurred because the key to Naomi's locker was reconstructed in my pocket by traveling.{w} Did he maybe mean that he never could've achieved that under his own circumstances? Maybe he figured out what determines the replicated location, and he knew that given the way it works, the Sekimeiya would never have replicated a point in which his clothes were clean. Could that be it...?
entries.new: 他指的也许是衣服会永远消失这件事。那些衣服或许会出现在别的地方，但这听起来不太可能。{w} 又或者他真正的意思是，Sekimeiya 根本做不到这种事——可我们绝不可能弄错。钥匙就是证据：Naomi 储物柜的钥匙，是通过时间穿越在我口袋里重新构建出来的。{w} 难道他想说的是，换作他自己的处境，他绝无可能做到？也许他已经弄清是什么决定了复现位置，并且知道按这套机制，Sekimeiya 绝不会复现出他衣服干净的那个时间点。会是这样吗……？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: It was inscrutable. I had previously thought that the existence of the replicated location was something we'd finally deduced about the Sekimeiya's mechanics, and I'd been pretty confident about it. Sai could also have purely intended to taunt us and appear to have superior knowledge while we'd really been right on the mark.
entries.new: 实在难以捉摸。我原以为，复现位置的存在是我们终于推断出的一条 Sekimeiya 机制，而且对此颇有把握。也有可能 Sai 纯粹是想挑衅我们，好显得他掌握的情报更高一筹，而实际上我们恰恰猜中了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Is there any travel we know has occurred that directly denies our theory?
entries.new: 有没有哪一次已知的时间穿越，能直接推翻我们的推论？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I ran through every travel I knew about. Fairly quickly, I found an inconsistency.
entries.new: 我在脑中把已知的每一次穿越都过了一遍。没过多久，就发现了一处矛盾。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Oh, right, when I appeared in the security room and fell backward because the chair wasn't properly positioned for me to sit on it. The position where I appeared indicated that the replicated location was of me sitting on that chair, but I had never done that.{w} Oh, and the recording too. Of course, if it's legitimate, we assumed it was brought from the future. While there isn't a big issue, the way we were thinking the Sekimeiya worked doesn't make it that simple.
entries.new: 哦，对了——那次我出现在监控室，因为椅子没摆正、坐不上去，整个人向后摔倒。我出现的位置表明，复现位置对应的是我坐在那把椅子上的样子，可我从没那样坐过。{w} 还有那段录音。当然，如果它是真的，我们之前一直推测它是从未来带回来的。这本身问题不大，但按照我们原先对 Sekimeiya 运作方式的理解，事情没这么简单。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: In a month from now, someone would have to hold the voice recorder. Then, farther in the future, that same person would have to go all the way back to today and have the time in which they held it as the replicated location.{w} It's not reasonable to rule that out, but it complicates everything a lot more.{w} But I can't just abandon that way of thinking about it. It can't be that you can bring any item you have to the past, or else the cleaning cart would've appeared with Shiroya in the attic.
entries.new: 一个月后，得有人拿着那支录音笔。然后在更远的未来，同一个人还得一路回到今天，把他拿着录音笔的那段时间作为复现位置。{w} 这固然不能排除，但会让一切都复杂得多。{w} 可我也不能就此放弃这种思路。总不至于身上的任何东西都能带回过去吧——否则清洁车早该跟着 Shiroya 一起出现在阁楼里了。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: How can we be wrong? There's no way we are...! We appeared in the attic exactly where we'd been prior to that point. That position was definitely based on a previous one, so we can't be completely wrong. However, there's the security room instance...{w} Like I thought back then, that can't be a random location... Sitting in front of the computer... Could it have been influenced by Katei's past position?{w} He was the one who sat on that chair a while before our travel, but why would this have mattered!?
entries.new: 我们怎么会错？绝不可能……！我们出现在阁楼时，位置正是之前待过的地方。那个位置绝对是基于先前的经历，所以我们的想法不可能全盘皆错。可监控室那一次……{w} 就像我当时想的，那不可能是个随意的位置……坐在电脑前……难道是被 Katei 之前的位置影响了？{w} 在我们穿越前不久，坐过那把椅子的人正是他，可这又有什么关系！？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Sai was right. Something about what we'd said was wrong, but I didn't know what it was. It could've been a minor detail or a major contradiction.
entries.new: Sai 说得对。我们的话里确有错处，可我找不出是哪儿。也许只是一处细枝末节，也许是根本性的矛盾。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I kneeled next to the Sekimeiya, ready to touch it. Sai had figured out a few things in a very short time, so I could do the same if I kept experimenting. The main purpose was to comprehend why Sai and Shiroya hadn't appeared, so I knew it was possible the travel wouldn't go smoothly.
entries.new: 我在 Sekimeiya 旁边跪下，准备伸手触碰。Sai 在那么短的时间里就弄清了几个问题，只要我不断尝试，也能做到。眼下主要是想弄清 Sai 和 Shiroya 为什么没有出现，所以我也明白，这次穿越未必能顺利。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I hesitated and had to take a moment to steady myself. I'd gotten used to sharing each travel with Shiroya, so doing it alone again like the first time was a bit imposing.
entries.new: 我迟疑了一下，花了片刻才定下心神。每次穿越都有 Shiroya 同行，我已经习惯了；如今又要像第一次那样独自面对，多少有些令人发怵。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I relaxed myself and let some more time pass. I estimated it was fifteen minutes since I'd gotten the Sekimeiya out of the cabinet, so I was about to travel just as far back as Sai and Shiroya had.
entries.new: 我放松身体，又让时间过去了一阵。我估计自把 Sekimeiya 从展示柜里取出，已经过了十五分钟，于是我准备穿越到和 Sai、Shiroya 同样远的时间点。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Remembering the loud crack the Sekimeiya made when it fell to the floor, I realized that grabbing it before activating it was a bad idea. I stopped touching the floor with my right hand and approached the unmoving Sekimeiya, determined to travel once more.
entries.new: 想起 Sekimeiya 落到地上时发出的一声脆响，我意识到在激活前就抓住它可不是个好主意。我把右手从地面收回，走向纹丝不动的 Sekimeiya，下定决心再穿越一次。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I found myself standing up in the middle of the event room, looking at the covered cabinet. That time, the instantaneous pain of the Sekimeiya's surface was interpreted by my brain as an electric shock moreso than a burn.
entries.new: 我发现自己已经站在活动室中央，看着那个盖着布的展示柜。这一次，Sekimeiya 表面那瞬间的疼痛，比起灼伤，更像是被电了一下。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I won't be able to deduce much if I appear here, where I've been so many times. I was here just before I went to the staff room.
entries.new: ……出现在这个我待过无数次的地方，怕是推断不出什么。我去员工室之前，正站在这里。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: But I knew that the amount of time traveled was an entirely different matter. While I shouldn't have been too far back, nothing was for certain.
entries.new: 但我知道，穿越的时间跨度完全是另一回事。我按理说不该回到太早的时候，可谁也无法确定。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I was about to check inside the cabinet when a sound stopped me. Someone was still there.
entries.new: 我正要查看展示柜里面，一个声响让我停住了手。这里还有人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It had come from hallway A, so I cautiously went to check. What I saw was something I had been wholly unprepared to see.
entries.new: 声音是从 A走廊传来的，我小心翼翼地过去查看。映入眼帘的景象，我毫无心理准备。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It's... me. It's totally me.
entries.new: 那是……我。真真切切是我。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I saw my own back, walking away.{w} I immediately understood where I'd gone. Definitely more than fifteen minutes back, to the point where I'd circled around the crystal floor hallways.
entries.new: 我看到了自己的背影，正往远处走。{w} 我立刻明白自己回到了什么时候，绝对不止十五分钟，而是一直回到了我绕着水晶层走廊打转的那段时间。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: When my past self disappeared toward hallway C, I calmly stepped out of the room. I knew I'd come from the other door and wouldn't see myself.
entries.new: 过去的我朝 C走廊走远后，我才从容地走出房间。我知道自己是从另一扇门进来的，不会撞见自己。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I see. So I went about twenty minutes into the past, and I can't precisely know what point the location was based on. Most likely a recent one, though.
entries.new: 原来如此。我回到了大约二十分钟前，却无法确切知道复现位置依据的是哪个时间点。不过多半是最近的一个。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: With only that, I wasn't any closer to understanding anything. I could at least be sure that the time the Sekimeiya spent out of the cabinet was related to the distance traveled and that they weren't equal; more time was traveled than the Sekimeiya spent building up energy... at least at fifteen minutes and above.
entries.new: 仅凭这些，我还是没弄明白多少。至少能确定一点：Sekimeiya 离开展示柜的时间与穿越的距离有关，但两者并不相等；穿越的时间比 Sekimeiya 蓄能的时间更长……至少在十五分钟以上是这样。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I put my hand in my right pocket and saw that I had the locker key. That meant the replicated location was restricted to the time where I'd been in the event room after I found it. I could make out that it wasn't Naomi's.
entries.new: 我伸手探进右边口袋，摸到了储物柜的钥匙。这说明复现位置被限定在我找到钥匙之后、待在活动室的那段时间里。我辨认出来，那不是 Naomi 的柜子。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: In any case, I had a little while where I could move while my past self protected the Sekimeiya. As long as nothing happened to the present me, I'd be able to enter the staff room right after traveling from it.
entries.new: 总之，趁着过去的我在看守 Sekimeiya，我有一小段时间可以自由行动。只要现在的我不出意外，等过去的我从员工室穿越离开，我就能紧跟着进去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I was almost intimidated by my past self, who was very close to me and putting conscious effort into hearing any noise. Until he shut himself in the staff room, I wouldn't be comfortable looking around for anyone. Then again, it was incredibly unlikely the Shiroya I was searching for was close by.
entries.new: 过去的我就在不远处，还刻意竖起耳朵留意任何动静，几乎让我有些发怵。在他把自己关进员工室之前，我没法安心四处找人。话说回来，我要找的 Shiroya 也不太可能就在附近。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: So I decided to start going upstairs, feeling forced out by an old version of me I had been minutes prior. Fully comprehending how absurd it all was, I silently stepped to hallway C.
entries.new: 于是我决定上楼，像是被几分钟前的那个自己赶了出去。我完全明白这一幕有多荒谬，默默走向 C走廊。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Something that I hadn't seen before caught my attention. It was the drop of blood Shiroya spotted next to the stairs. I looked at it closely and determined that it was just about done drying up.
entries.new: 一样我之前没注意到的东西吸引了我的视线。是 Shiroya 在楼梯旁发现的那滴血。我凑近细看，判断它快要干透了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: This one has to belong to Sai. The others are too old to match the blood he had in his mouth, but this one fits perfectly.
entries.new: 这滴一定是 Sai 的。其他几滴太久了，和他嘴里的血对不上，这一滴却完全吻合。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Could he have traveled, replicated the blood in the past, and left older-looking drops? At that point, I had no idea, but I felt certain that something abnormal was behind all the drops we'd found.
entries.new: 会不会是他穿越回过去，复现了自己的血，留下那些看起来更陈旧的血滴？那时我毫无头绪，但我确信，我们找到的这些血滴背后必有异常。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If I had to take Sai's word for it, the one in the lobby belonged to Shiroya, while he hadn't known about the one in the event room. It wasn't only that I didn't want to believe it, I also didn't know how that could be true. The other Shiroya hadn't looked injured at all during the brief moment I'd seen her, so I couldn't assume it came from her.
entries.new: 若按 Sai 的说法，大厅里的那滴是 Shiroya 的，而活动室的那滴他并不知情。我不只是不愿相信，更想不通那怎么可能。我见到另一个 Shiroya 的那一瞬间，她身上没有任何受伤的迹象，所以我没法认定那滴血出自她。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I walked up the stairs since I wanted to look through every floor. I thought about making my presence known by using the elevator, but I decided against it.
entries.new: 我想把每一层都查看一遍，便沿着楼梯往上走。我一度想坐电梯，好让人知道我在这里，但最终还是打消了这个念头。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I arrived on the second floor and felt, once again, a desolate atmosphere. I wasn't sure what my goal was anymore, but I looked around the bathrooms and offices.
entries.new: 我来到二楼，又一次感到一股荒凉的气息。我已说不清自己的目的究竟是什么，却还是把洗手间和办公室都查看了一遍。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If I was alone, I wanted to be sure about it. Every time I opened a door, I felt my heart resonating within me, remembering that it was possible I was about to find what the culprit had done to Sai and Shiroya.
entries.new: 如果这里只有我一个人，我想确认这一点。每推开一扇门，我都能感到心脏在胸腔里怦怦直跳——我记起，门后也许就是凶手对 Sai 和 Shiroya 下手的地方。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I forcibly expelled that thought from my mind. There was no way Shiroya could suddenly die like that.{w} ...But as much as I tried to reassure myself of that, Miiya's abrupt end pressed down on the back of my head.
entries.new: 我强行把这个念头赶出脑海。Shiroya 怎么可能就这么突然死了。{w} ……可无论我怎样安慰自己，Miiya 那突如其来的死始终压在我脑后。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Only one thing backed me up: if the Shiroya with different clothes was a result of a future travel, the original Shiroya was definitely safe.
entries.new: 只有一点支撑着我：如果那个衣着不同的 Shiroya 是未来某次穿越的结果，那么原本的 Shiroya 就一定平安无事。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...After dealing with the second floor, I went to the third, finding my existence there surreal.
entries.new: ……查看完二楼，我上到三楼，觉得自己的存在有种说不出的虚幻。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Reluctant to find anything, I repeated the process above as my isolation intensified.
entries.new: 我不愿找到什么，却还是重复着先前的流程，孤独感愈发深重。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The fourth and fifth floors weren't any different. Was someone still deliberately hiding from me? If they were the killer, why didn't they just try to take me out?
entries.new: 四楼和五楼也没什么不同。还有人在刻意躲着我吗？若那人就是凶手，为什么不干脆对我下手？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I was in the perfect defenseless position, so if anyone wanted to harm me, that was their best chance. Going off the fact that nothing had happened to me yet, I tried to stop myself from getting too paranoid.
entries.new: 我正处于毫无防备的状态，谁想对我不利，这都是最好的机会。既然至今什么都没发生，我便努力让自己不要过分疑神疑鬼。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: As usual, I first glanced inside the floor 6 bathrooms to find out they were empty. Subsequently, I entered the three partitions, but I didn't see anyone either.
entries.new: 照例，我先瞥了一眼六楼的洗手间，里面空无一人。接着我逐个进了三个隔间，同样没见到人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Lastly, I walked up to the attic's door to search through the final section of the tower.
entries.new: 最后，我走向阁楼的门，准备查看塔里剩下的最后一处。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: {w=1.6}I instantly understood that I had forgotten a crucial detail.{w} I couldn't open the door since Shiroya had recently locked it. Not only that, she'd kept the key.
entries.new: {w=1.6}我立刻明白，自己遗漏了一个关键的细节。{w} 门打不开了——Shiroya 不久前刚把阁楼锁上，而且钥匙还留在她手上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: This isn't good... I'm locked out of the attic.
entries.new: 糟了……我被锁在阁楼外面了。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Could it be they appeared inside and can't exit?
entries.new: 难道说他们出现在里面，却出不来？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I knocked on the door and yelled Shiroya's name a few times, but there was no response.
entries.new: 我敲了敲门，喊了几声 Shiroya，却没有回应。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: That doesn't make sense, though. If Shiroya appeared in the attic, her replicated location wouldn't yet have had the key, but Sai definitely would have appeared with it since he was able to chase us inside.
entries.new: 可这说不通。如果 Shiroya 出现在阁楼，她复现的位置还不该有钥匙；但 Sai 身上一定带着钥匙，因为他当时能追着我们进阁楼。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: And even if neither of them has it, they'd still have the elevator. From the inside, they could freely call it and go down.
entries.new: 再说，就算他们两个都没钥匙，也还有电梯。从里面就能自己叫电梯下去。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Of course, unless it had been disabled somewhere. I hadn't been checking every elevator door, which I realized had been a mistake.
entries.new: 当然，除非电梯在某处被人停用了。我一直没检查每层的电梯门，现在才意识到这是一个疏忽。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I tried to open the door on the sixth floor, which proved that the elevator wasn't there. Calling it was a bad idea—it would prevent me from knowing where it was beforehand.
entries.new: 我试着打开六楼的电梯门，结果证明电梯不在那里。把电梯叫过来不是好主意——那样我就没法提前知道它停在哪儿了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I walked down to the fifth floor and once again attempted to open the elevator to no avail.
entries.new: 我走到五楼，又一次试着打开电梯门，仍然打不开。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I circled the corridors to end up on the fourth floor, but the elevator wasn't there either. I felt like the next attempt would be correct—the third floor was where Shiroya and I had been intercepted.
entries.new: 我绕过走廊，来到四楼，电梯也不在。我隐约觉得下一次就该对了——三楼正是我和 Shiroya 被拦住的地方。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: And, as I suspected, the door opened.
entries.new: 果然，门开了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It hasn't been used since then, I suppose. I wonder if Sai prepared something in case we used it to escape.
entries.new: 看来从那以后就没人用过它。不知道 Sai 有没有设下什么防备，以防我们乘它逃走。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Regardless, the door was closed, so it could have been called from the attic.
entries.new: 不管怎样，门是关着的，所以电梯也可能是从阁楼叫上去的。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: It was as frustrating as it was frightening to think about. Had the culprit been in the attic and prevented them from leaving? I discarded that thought, wanting to believe they'd appeared outside the tower.
entries.new: 光是想到这些，就既令人烦躁又令人害怕。难道凶手就在阁楼里，拦住了她们的去路？我甩开这个念头，宁愿相信她们是出现在了塔外。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Did that really make sense, though? If Shiroya appeared outside the tower, her first move would be to tell the police about the secret door. They would have knocked it down from the outside as soon as she had disappeared.
entries.new: 可这真的说得通吗？如果 Shiroya 出现在塔外，她首先要做的就是把暗门的事告诉警察。只要她一不见踪影，警方就会从外面把门砸开。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...No matter the case, with the key, the attic was a perfect place to hide from me.
entries.new: ……无论如何，只要手里有钥匙，阁楼就是躲开我的绝佳去处。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If the other Shiroya was still present and had it, it was possible I wouldn't see her in the next three hours. While her face and body were Shiroya's, I was having trouble accepting her as the same person. I'd only seen her for a couple of seconds, but her very existence felt alien, and even the Shiroya I was with thought they couldn't be one and the same.
entries.new: 如果另一个 Shiroya 还在这里，而且钥匙在她手上，那接下来三个小时里我可能都见不到她。她的脸和身体明明是 Shiroya 的，我却很难把她当作同一个人。我只见过她两三秒，可光是她的存在就让我觉得格格不入；就连和我在一起的这个 Shiroya 也认为，她们不可能是同一个人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I simply didn't know what to think. I'd done all I could on the office floors, and I had to accept that entering the attic would be impossible.
entries.new: 我实在不知道该作何感想。办公楼层能做的我都做了，也只能接受进不去阁楼这个事实。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I started to go back down, paying as much attention to my surroundings as possible. Soon, my quiet steps reached the last staircase, leading to the floor where my past self still was.
entries.new: 我开始往回走，尽量留意四周的动静。不久，我放轻脚步来到最后一段楼梯前——那段楼梯通往过去的我所在的那一层。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I knew I hadn't looked through every room below yet, but I still felt that task to be too perilous, knowing any sound could alert the Atsuki in the staff room.
entries.new: 我知道下面还有房间没查完，可一想到任何响动都可能惊动员工室里的 Atsuki，我就觉得这差事太过冒险。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Therefore, I decided to first look through hallway A, which Shiroya and I didn't have time to start before Sai reappeared. After that, I'd wait for my past self to disappear.
entries.new: 于是我决定先去查 A走廊——上次 Sai 再度出现之前，我和 Shiroya 还没来得及开始。之后再等过去的我从那里离开。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I carefully walked down the stairs and directed myself toward the storeroom.
entries.new: 我小心翼翼地走下楼梯，朝储藏室走去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I hadn't been in there since Sai and Shiroya traveled together, but there was no change that caught my eye. Knowing whether the door had recently opened was impossible.
entries.new: 自从 Sai 和 Shiroya 一起穿越之后，我就没再进过那里，但眼前看不出任何变化。至于那扇门最近有没有开过，根本无从判断。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: As soon as I opened the next door, something stood out. One of the cabinets had its lid open and leaning on the wall. I frowned while trying to understand if that made sense.
entries.new: 我刚打开下一扇门，就注意到一处异样。有个展示柜的盖子开着，斜靠在墙上。我皱起眉，想弄清这到底合不合理。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Inside it was Isla. It was the cabinet where she'd been found. But I knew it had been closed the last time I was there.
entries.new: 里面躺着的是 Isla。那正是她被发现时所在的展示柜。可我上次来的时候，它明明是合上的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: And that was just before I saw Katei's death. I looked at every room, and there's no way I left this cabinet open.
entries.new: 而且那还是在我目睹 Katei 死亡之前。每个房间我都看过，我不可能把这个展示柜敞着就走。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Was it a confirmation that someone else was still with me? Sai and the other Shiroya were the two likely candidates to have done it...{w} I was more confused than surprised. Why would someone have opened that cabinet... and left it open?
entries.new: 这是否说明还有别人和我一起待在这座塔里？最有可能动手的就是 Sai 和另一个 Shiroya……{w} 比起惊讶，我更觉得困惑。为什么会有人打开那个展示柜……还让它就这么敞着？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There was no need to leave Isla's body on display, so I gingerly lowered the lid. I scanned the rest of the room, but I found nothing else of importance.
entries.new: 没有理由把 Isla 的遗体就这么摆在外面，于是我小心地把盖子放下。我又扫视了房间其余的地方，没再发现什么要紧的东西。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Afterward, I proceeded with the search, my expectations of finding something suddenly higher.
entries.new: 之后我继续搜查，心里忽然对能有所发现多了几分期待。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But every room was empty. I still didn't want to make any accidental noise, so I only took a peek at them. I finished at the security room, where the scene of Katei's death appeared essentially unchanged.
entries.new: 可每个房间都空无一物。我仍不愿不慎弄出声响，只探头看了一眼。最后我来到监控室，Katei 死时的现场看上去几乎没有变化。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I moved the chair and looked at the computer, which displayed {time=18:24.} I felt that going back to the staff room at {time=18:30} was appropriate, but I didn't want to risk being too early.
entries.new: 我挪开椅子，看向电脑，屏幕上显示着 {time=18:24.}。我觉得 {time=18:30} 再回员工室正合适，可又不想冒过早回去的风险。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It wasn't exactly the most comforting room with the state Katei was in, but I decided to stay there for the remainder of the time since it gave me access to the computer's clock.
entries.new: Katei 那副样子摆在那儿，这房间实在算不上让人安心，但我还是决定剩下的时间就待在这里——至少能看着电脑上的时间。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: His face was under his desk, so I didn't have to look at it, and the unsettling smell of blood quickly became an afterthought. Standing straight and with a blank mind, I stiffly waited for the time to pass.
entries.new: 他的脸埋在桌子底下，我不必看到，那股令人不适的血腥味也很快被我抛在脑后。我直挺挺地站着，脑子里一片空白，僵硬地等着时间流逝。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Until I remembered the chase from earlier.{w} I kneeled beside Katei and put my hand in the pocket where he'd kept most of his keys.
entries.new: ……直到我想起先前的那场追逐。{w} 我在 Katei 身边跪下，把手伸进他平时放大部分钥匙的口袋。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It's not here... the key to the bathrooms. All the others are, though. His killer must've picked it up, or maybe it was Sai, if they're not the same person. Regardless, it definitely would've been a bad idea to hide inside one.
entries.new: 不在这里……洗手间的钥匙不见了。其他钥匙倒都还在。凶手多半把它拿走了；如果 Sai 和凶手不是同一个人，那拿走它的人也可能就是 Sai。不管怎样，躲进洗手间显然不是个好主意。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Upon further inspection, I realized that the rusty key, which he'd kept in another pocket, was gone too.
entries.new: 再一细看，我发现他放在另一个口袋里的生锈的钥匙也不见了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: They also took that old-looking key... Was the person who originally dropped it in hallway A responsible for this?{w} Maybe that's not it. I've been thinking that someone could enter the tower through the storeroom, but if that key belonged to that door, maybe they'd need it from the outside. I'm not sure they would try picking it up to appear in the past with it because their replicated locations holding the key would all be inside the tower...
entries.new: 那把旧模样的钥匙也被拿走了……难道当初把它掉在 A走廊的人就是这一切的元凶？{w} 也许并非如此。我一直在想，有人可以从储藏室进入这座塔；可如果那把钥匙是开那扇门的，他们也许得从外面用它开门。我不确定他们会不会特意捡起那把钥匙、带着它回到过去，因为这样一来，他们持着钥匙的复制位置就全都在塔里面了……
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Unless I go back to thinking about thought-up loops, I guess. There could be something that would work.{w} The person who killed Katei took that rusty key and walked out of the tower through the storeroom door, which was open. That created a location outside the tower where they were holding the key that could be replicated. Then, they reentered and used the Sekimeiya to go back in time. In the past, they appeared outside the tower holding the key, so they were able to unlock the door and reenter with something they'd obtained outside—like a knife. They left the door open so that their past self could exit with the key and create the replicated location.
entries.new: 除非我又绕回假想的循环上去。说不定真有什么办法行得通。{w} 杀死 Katei 的人拿起那把生锈的钥匙，从敞开的储藏室门走出塔外。于是，就产生了一个他们持着钥匙、位于塔外的位置，而这个位置可以被复制。接着，他们重新进塔，用 Sekimeiya 回到过去。在过去，他们持着钥匙出现在塔外，因此能够打开那扇门，带着从外面弄到的东西——比如一把刀——再走回来。他们故意没关门，好让过去的自己带着钥匙出去，造出那个可复制的位置。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Would that work? The key isn't here, so I can't even attempt it. But if the culprit's plan was to leave with the Sekimeiya, they would've been able to achieve it very easily by doing this.
entries.new: 这样行得通吗？钥匙不在手上，我连试都没法试。可如果凶手的目的是带着 Sekimeiya 离开，这么做就能轻易得手。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I stood back up, trying not to meet Katei's eyes. When I glanced around the room again, I became aware of an obvious detail.
entries.new: 我重新站起，尽量不去看 Katei 的眼睛。再次环视房间时，我注意到一个明摆着的细节。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Hang on, this is strange.
entries.new: 等等，有点不对劲。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: The computer's screen is lit, meaning that someone used it in the past fifty minutes. It was exactly {time=17} when we found Katei's body, so it's been far more than that.
entries.new: 电脑屏幕亮着，说明过去五十分钟里有人用过它。我们发现 Katei 的尸体时正好是 {time=17}，到现在早就超过五十分钟了。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I suppose Sai did say he saw Katei here. Unless someone else was here semi-recently, he saw it after us.
entries.new: 说起来，Sai 确实说过他在这里见过 Katei。除非还有别人不久前也来过，否则他看到的就是我们离开之后的情形。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: What I found most strange was that the three screens looked identical to how they had at {time=17.}
entries.new: 最让我觉得奇怪的是，三块屏幕的样子和 {time=17.} 时一模一样。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: "{time=10:04}: Camera(s) disabled and associated footage erased". That same message was on the side I'd dragged it to, and behind it was the security camera program.
entries.new: 「{time=10:04}: 摄像头已停用，相关录像已删除」。这条提示仍在我先前拖到的位置，它后面是监控摄像头的程序。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I grabbed the mouse and clicked on its "accept" button. The program used a pretty complicated interface, and I didn't know what many things meant. As I'd seen before, there was a list of all the cameras on the left.
entries.new: 我抓起鼠标，点了上面的「确认」按钮。这程序的界面相当复杂，很多东西我都不明白是什么意思。和之前看到的一样，左侧列着所有摄像头。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: When I looked at it again, I saw that one in particular was selected, named "RECAM_12_01". I brought the cursor over and tried to view it.
entries.new: 再看一眼，我发现其中一个被选中了，名字是「RECAM_12_01」。我把光标移过去，试着查看它。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But an error sound played, accompanied by the same message. "{time=10:04}: {tip=camera}Camera(s) disabled and associated footage erased{/tip}".
entries.new: 可随即响起一声报错音，跳出的仍是那条提示。「{time=10:04}: {tip=camera}摄像头已停用，相关录像已删除{/tip}」。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It appeared we really couldn't look at the footage, but the message still felt like it too obviously incriminated Katei. I let go of the mouse and stepped aside from the computer.
entries.new: 看来我们确实无法查看录像，但这条提示太明显地把嫌疑指向了 Katei。我松开鼠标，从电脑前退开。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I tried to think if the selected camera meant anything, but I had nothing to work with. Instead, I did what I'd planned to do and managed to let go of my thoughts until the time came.
entries.new: 我试着琢磨那个被选中的摄像头是否有含义，却毫无线索可依。于是我索性按原计划行事，努力放空思绪，一直等到那一刻到来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: At {time=18:30}, I left the room. It was time to reunite with the Sekimeiya, so I went to hallway B through the event room.
entries.new: {time=18:30}，我离开房间。该去和 Sekimeiya 会合了，于是我穿过活动室前往 B走廊。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The staff room was closed, like I'd left it. Warily, I stepped up to it and turned the knob.
entries.new: 员工室的门关着，和我离开时一样。我警惕地走上前，转动门把手。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I pushed the door open and saw the gray Sekimeiya on the floor.{w} Since everything had gone as expected, I entered, reclaiming my place as the sole Atsuki.
entries.new: 我推开门，看见灰色 Sekimeiya 躺在地上。{w} 一切都在预料之中，我走了进去，重新做回唯一的我。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I was relieved that nothing unexpected had occurred. I knew that I couldn't stop looking for Shiroya yet, so I picked up the Sekimeiya and put it in the newly accessible locker.
entries.new: 没出什么意外，我松了口气。我知道还不能停下寻找 Shiroya，于是捡起 Sekimeiya，放进如今已经能打开的储物柜。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It's good that I still have the key. If the replicated location was from earlier, I would've lost it. I shouldn't have traveled holding it, just in case.
entries.new: 还好钥匙还在我手上。要是复制出的场景来自更早的时间点，我早就把它弄丢了。为了以防万一，我本就不该带着它穿越。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I left the Sekimeiya above and closed the door. Then, I proceeded to lock it so that I would be able to wander around without leaving it easily accessible.
entries.new: 我把 Sekimeiya 留在上面的柜子里，关上门，又上了锁——这样我四处走动时，它就不会轻易落到别人手里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I quickly became indecisive. Perhaps it was smarter to bring it with me while I searched so that I had an emergency escape method.
entries.new: 我很快又犹豫起来。也许搜查时把它带在身边更稳妥，万一情况紧急还能用它脱身。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Having to constantly fear my death was disheartening, to say the least. While I decided, I sat next to the middle lockers. Maybe staying there was a better idea. I couldn't enter the attic, but it was clear that anyone remaining in the tower didn't want to show themselves.
entries.new: 时时刻刻提防着自己会死，实在令人心灰意冷。我一边拿主意，一边在中间那排储物柜旁坐下。也许留在原地更好。阁楼我进不去，但留在塔里的人显然都不想露面。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I felt I had to look through the hallway B rooms before deciding to stop. I prayed that Shiroya was safe, but I could only assume that she wasn't nearby anymore.
entries.new: 我觉得在决定收手之前，总得把B走廊的房间都查一遍。我祈祷 Shiroya 平安，却只能认定她已经不在附近了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I might've already been in the tower for longer than the initially proposed twelve hours. Adding all the time I'd relived by traveling through time, I figured I was minutes away from meeting the mark.
entries.new: 我在塔里待的时间，或许早已超过最初说好的十二小时。再把时间穿越中重复度过的那几段算进去，我估计自己离那个界限只剩几分钟了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Once again thoroughly regretting my choice to ever set foot inside that building, I stood up to make sure a nightmare didn't await in hallway B.
entries.new: 我再一次为踏进这栋楼的选择深感后悔，却还是站起身，去确认B走廊里没有噩梦等着我。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I had repeatedly considered that my hours in the tower were a dream. Had I already accepted the reality in which a time travel device existed? No matter what everything was leading to, would the world undergo a drastic change upon being exposed to the Sekimeiya? I'd wanted that day to be the first day of my new life with Shiroya... but was it set to be a turning point for every human being?
entries.new: 我不止一次想过，自己在塔里度过的这些时辰不过是一场梦。我是否已经接受了时间穿越装置确实存在的现实？无论这一切通向何处，世界在接触到 Sekimeiya 之后，是否会迎来剧变？我本希望那一天是我与 Shiroya 新生活的第一天……可它注定要成为全人类的转折点吗？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The item I'd just locked away... What was it going to be responsible for? I felt like it had nearly broken when it fell in the event room, something that might honestly have been for the better.
entries.new: 我刚刚锁起来的那件东西……往后会引出怎样的后果？它在活动室里摔落的时候，我总觉得它差一点就碎了——说实话，那样或许反倒更好。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I was walking to the door when I turned to glance at the locker. The thought of breaking the Sekimeiya crossed my mind, but my eyes locked on one spot for another reason.
entries.new: 我走向门口，途中回头看了一眼那排储物柜。砸碎 Sekimeiya 的念头一闪而过，可我的视线却被另一处吸住了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...There was something on the floor—to the left of where I'd been sitting. I approached it and saw a small piece of paper, hastily folded.
entries.new: ……地上有样东西——就在我刚才坐的位置左边。我走近一看，是张随手折起的小纸片。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Naturally, I frowned. I didn't recognize it from anywhere in the tower.
entries.new: 我自然皱起了眉。塔里任何地方都没见过这东西。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I grabbed it and scanned its contents. A few lines of text had been written in black.
entries.new: 我把它捡起来，扫了一眼上面的内容。几行黑字。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But before I read it, I had already stopped breathing. A single peek made my hand begin to tremble and my thoughts collapse entirely.
entries.new: 可还没读进去，我的呼吸就已经停了。仅仅瞥了一眼，我的手便开始发抖，思绪彻底崩塌。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Fractal Freefall
entries.new: 分形自由落体

entries.text: One day, before the afternoon ended, you could see the figures of two young students on a bench, letting a cold breeze hit their faces while they looked at the park they'd grown to love.
entries.new: 某一天，午后将尽，长椅上坐着两个年轻学生的身影，任凭冷风拂面，望着他们渐渐爱上的那座公园。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: They had been talking for a while, so they proceeded to quietly look at the younger kids run around, making good use of the last few minutes of sunlight.
entries.new: 两人已经聊了一阵，便安静下来，看着更小的孩子们四处奔跑，尽情享受最后几分钟的阳光。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: They were a boy and a girl who had known each other for many years. For that reason, the level of trust they'd built allowed them to feel a peaceful warmth just by being next to each other.
entries.new: 他们是一对相识多年的男孩和女孩。正因如此，彼此间建立的信任让他们只要待在对方身边，就能感到一种安宁的暖意。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Soon, after the other kids left, they would do so as well. After walking down a few streets, one of the two would take a different turn to complete the day on their own.
entries.new: 不久，别的孩子散去后，他们也会起身离开。走过几条街，两人中的一个会拐向另一条路，独自结束这一天。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: That was a routine they were happy with and felt lucky to share. The boy let his mind relax, looking at the sky as it began to darken. It would soon be the winter, and the temperature would attempt to hinder those moments.{w} That was why he did as much as he could to enjoy the scenery he'd been granted, hoping the girl at his side was doing the same.
entries.new: 这样的日常让他们心满意足，也庆幸能一同分享。男孩放松下来，望着天色渐暗。冬天很快就要到了，气温会试图夺走这样的时刻。{w} 所以他尽可能多地去享受眼前这片景色，也希望身旁的女孩同样如此。
entries.speaker: i
