entries.new: 你该不会有个双胞胎姐妹吧？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: What? No.
entries.new: 什么？没有。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: But, then... It doesn't make any sense. I'm still really confused...
entries.new: 可是，那……这可就说不通了。我还是想不明白……
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: What the fuck do you mean you're "confused"!? She just showed up like that! Did you enter through the storeroom?
entries.new: 你他妈在说什么「想不明白」！？她就是这么突然冒出来的！你是从储藏室进来的？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I've been with you since {time=9}, Sai.
entries.new: Sai，从 {time=9} 起，我就一直和你们在一起。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: That's a load of crap. Regardless, you'll definitely die. I'm sorry to tell you like that, but you're not making it easy for us. Atsuki, I know you know her.
entries.new: 一派胡言。不管怎样，你肯定会死。很抱歉这样跟你说，可你实在让我们难办。Atsuki，我知道你认识她。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...{w}I do, and she's telling the truth.
entries.new: ……{w}我认识，而且她说的是实话。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Are you just fucking with me? What's the point of lying so blatantly?
entries.new: 你他妈是在耍我吗？这么明目张胆地撒谎，有什么意义？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: He's... He's telling the truth. Shiroya's been with us the entire time.
entries.new: 他……他说的是真的。Shiroya 一直都在我们身边。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: The entire time? Not even you have been here since {time=9}!
entries.new: 一直都在？你才不是从 {time=9} 起就在这里的！
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: E-Excuse me?
entries.new: 什、什么？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Well, you get what I mean. You don't remember when you got attacked or where you came from very well, right?
entries.new: 行了，你懂我的意思。你既记不清自己是什么时候被袭击的，也不太记得自己是从哪儿来的，对吧？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Of course, Erina and Isla have been here the whole time, {tip=clash}but not you{/tip}.
entries.new: 当然，Erina 和 Isla 倒是一直都在，{tip=clash}可你不是{/tip}。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: It was settled. They had either gone completely insane or their plan was to make us go insane. After being told once again that Shiroya's fate was sealed, I continued to search for a method to refute it.
entries.new: 结论已经很明显了。他们要么是彻底疯了，要么就是想逼我们发疯。Shiroya 的命运再一次被宣判为定局，而我继续寻找着推翻它的方法。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What?
entries.new: 怎么了？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I turned to look at her, but I couldn't make heads or tails of her expression. Her eyes fixed on a point in the distance, and that was all I knew. It had become a challenge just to know what anyone trapped in the tower was thinking.
entries.new: 我转头看向她，却完全看不透她的神情。她的目光定在远处的某一点上——除此之外，我一无所知。到了这一步，哪怕只是想弄清困在这座塔里的某个人在想着什么，都成了难事。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Did you notice something?
entries.new: ……你发现了什么？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: ...{w}I... need to go somewhere.
entries.new: ……{w}我……得去个地方。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Wh-What...?
entries.new: 什、什么……？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I'm sorry, I need to go to the attic.
entries.new: 抱歉，我得去阁楼一趟。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: She ran toward hallway C. There I stood, petrified, until she turned around to say one last thing.
entries.new: 她朝 C走廊 奔去。我僵立在原地，直到她回过头来，留下最后一句话。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Please, don't follow me.
entries.new: 请你别跟来。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: I could only stare at her eyes, in search of any compassion. Why was she being so cryptic?
entries.new: 我只能盯着她的眼睛，想从中找出一丝怜意。她为什么要这样神神秘秘的？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: With an apologetic look, she spun and sprinted off.
entries.new: 她带着歉意的神情转过身，飞奔而去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: "Please, don't follow me." Why...? Why did she want to go alone...?{w} I was sure I looked devastated, but I was only trying to decipher the sudden change of behavior my oldest friend had undergone.
entries.new: 「请你别跟来。」为什么……？她为什么非要独自前往……？{w}我那时的样子一定很难看，可我只是想弄明白，这位我认识最久的朋友为什么会突然变成这样。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wow. Are we going to just let her go? Didn't you see how suspicious that was?
entries.new: 哇哦。我们就这么放她走了？你没看出那有多可疑吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Well, that's fine. She's just gonna get herself killed somehow. It's already unavoidable.
entries.new: 算了，无所谓。反正她总会以某种方式把自己害死。这已经是躲不掉的了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Why!? Why is she gonna die!?
entries.new: 为什么！？她为什么会死！？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Did you hit your head and lose your memories? We know it will happen.
entries.new: 你是撞到头失忆了？这件事我们早就知道了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: How!? You seem pretty certain, so prove it!
entries.new: 怎么知道的！？你说得这么肯定，那就拿出证据来！
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: You know we can't anymore.
entries.new: 你也知道，我们已经做不到了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What the fuck does that mean!?
entries.new: 这他妈是什么意思！？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Akaro looked at me as if he was witnessing a man who'd gone mad.
entries.new: Akaro 看着我，像是在看一个发了疯的人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What's with that look!? Where did you even go!? You just appeared again, out of nowhere!
entries.new: 你那是什么眼神！？你到底去了哪儿！？你就这么又凭空冒了出来！
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Huh...? It's you who appeared again.
entries.new: 咦……？这次冒出来的又是你。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: I hit the wall, furious. Their responses were making my blood boil, like they were sneering at me.
entries.new: 我怒火中烧，一拳砸在墙上。他们的回应让我火冒三丈，就像在嘲笑我。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: You too, Sai! Did your memories also happen to get fucked? You traveled from the event room. Remember that?
entries.new: Sai，连你也一样！你的记忆也被搞乱了吗？你是从活动室穿越过来的，还记得吧？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: ...From the event room? No, I don't.
entries.new: ……从活动室？不，我不记得。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Have you two just lost it completely? Or this is a side effect of the Sekimeiya?
entries.new: 你们两个是彻底疯了吗？还是说，这是 Sekimeiya 的副作用？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: You can stop trying already. Since you sided with that girl, you made it clear you'll only spit out bullshit. I don't know what you're trying to pull, but you look pathetic.{w} She'll come back whenever she feels like, if she doesn't die in the process. Meanwhile, let's keep waiting for the shutter to open. I'd appreciate it if you told the truth, though. How did she get in?
entries.new: 省省吧。你既然站在那女孩那边，就摆明了只会满嘴胡扯。我不知道你想耍什么花样，但你看起来真可悲。{w}只要她没死在半路，想回来时自然会回来。在这之前，我们继续等卷帘门打开吧。不过，你要是肯说实话，我会很感激。她是怎么进来的？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: She was with us from the beginning...
entries.new: 她从一开始就跟我们在一起……
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: That's false. Since she seems to be with you, I really doubt you were stupid enough to make her enter through the storeroom. That's what's strange, but perhaps you did.{w} Let me see.
entries.new: 不对。她看起来是和你一起的，所以我实在不觉得你会蠢到让她从储藏室进来。奇怪就奇怪在这里，不过也许你真这么做了。{w}让我看看。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Indifferent to my confusion and rage, Sai walked to hallway C.
entries.new: Sai 毫不在意我的困惑和怒火，朝 C 走廊走去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What are you doing!?
entries.new: 你干什么！？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Instead of answering, he entered the storeroom.{w} Seconds later, he returned.
entries.new: 他没有回答，径直走进储藏室。{w}几秒后，又折了回来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I just wanted to verify that she hasn't entered through the storeroom yet.
entries.new: 我只是想确认她还没有从储藏室进来。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What?
entries.new: 什么？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: ...Have you thought of a plan to keep the Sekimeiya for yourself? Then, once you succeed, you'll eventually make her go back in time to appear inside the tower and take care of whatever your plan requires.
entries.new: ……你是不是想好了计划，要把 Sekimeiya 据为己有？然后等成功之后，再让她穿越回过去，出现在塔里，完成你计划中需要她做的事。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What are you even talking about...?
entries.new: 你到底在说什么……？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Maybe two of you weren't enough, I don't know. Although if that's what you did, you had to know you were sending her to die, even if she was already supposed to be dead. I don't get exactly what your idea is or how this all came to happen. It's a damn mess.
entries.new: 也许你们两个人还不够，我不知道。不过，如果你真这么做了，你总该知道这是在送她去死——哪怕她本来就注定要死。我搞不懂你到底打的什么主意，也搞不懂这一切怎么会变成这样。真是一团乱麻。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Again, what the fuck are you talking about? What does "maybe two of you weren't enough" even mean?
entries.new: 你又他妈在说什么？「也许你们两个还不够」到底是什么意思？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Of course, I'm assuming Miiya's in on it as well.
entries.new: 当然，我猜 Miiya 也有份。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I gave up. I approached the nearest wall and kneeled next to it, only capable of breathing. It was incomprehensible. Nonsense.
entries.new: 我彻底放弃了。我挪到最近的墙边跪下，除了呼吸，什么也做不了。这一切根本无法理解。简直荒唐透顶。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Not gonna keep trying to clear your name? I suppose it'd be futile with how obvious it is that this is your doing.
entries.new: 不打算继续证明清白了？事情明摆着是你干的，再挣扎也是白费。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...Okay, I'll ask. How do you know about Miiya?
entries.new: ……好吧，我问。你怎么知道 Miiya 的事？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: What? She's been here—
entries.new: 什么？她一直就在这里——
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: That's it, ignore him from now on. He can't get out of the corner he's backed himself into.
entries.new: 行了，从现在起别理他。他已经把自己逼进死角，出不来了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...I covered my eyes with my arm, applying as much pressure against my face as I could. Who had decided to make me go through hell, and why had Shiroya left me behind!?
entries.new: 我用胳膊遮住眼睛，尽可能用力压住脸。到底是谁让我受这种罪，Shiroya 又为什么把我丢下！？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Letting out a casual laugh, Sai sat next to me.
entries.new: Sai 轻笑一声，在我身旁坐下。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Aren't you going to follow her? It seemed really obvious that you gave her some kind of cue to leave, you know?
entries.new: 你不打算跟上去吗？当时你明显给了她某种暗示让她离开，不是吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: She just got this blank look and suddenly had to go... Was that all you could come up with? I gave you a little bit of credit earlier, but honestly, what happened to Erina could definitely have been all you.
entries.new: 她刚才一脸茫然，突然就非走不可……你就想出这种办法？我先前还稍微高看过你，可说实话，Erina 的事完全可能都是你干的。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I pushed Sai aside with as much force as I could gather. If my mind had already broken, he was doing all he could to scatter all the pieces around.
entries.new: 我攒足力气，一把将 Sai 推开。若说我的理智已经支离破碎，那他就是在拼命把碎片撒得到处都是。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: That's harsh. I suppose that's the only way you can defend yourself. We'll see what your plan amounts to soon.{w} Maybe not, actually. Maybe we'll just never see that girl again. At least not alive, of course.
entries.new: 真狠啊。看来你也只能用这种方式自保了。很快就能看出你的计划究竟能成什么气候。{w}不过，也许不会。也许我们再也不会见到那女孩了。当然，至少不会活着见到。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Sai, I swear if you open your mouth again, I'm going to fucking break it.
entries.new: Sai，我发誓，你再敢张嘴，我就把你的嘴打烂。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I get it, I get it. Let's wait as much as you want.
entries.new: 知道了，知道了。你想等多久，我们就等多久。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: My vision was dark, partly covered by my arm. Standing up were Akaro and Erina, whose expressions I couldn't see.
entries.new: 我的视野一片昏暗，半边被手臂遮住。Akaro 和 Erina 站在那儿，我看不清他们的表情。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Beyond the meaning behind Sai's words and Akaro's appearance, I couldn't get my thoughts off Shiroya. Why had she left like that?
entries.new: 我顾不上细想 Sai 话里的意思和 Akaro 的出现，满脑子都是 Shiroya。她为什么要那样离开？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: She hadn't even promised me she'd return. I tried not to let Sai's voice loop in my head, but there was no stopping it.
entries.new: 她甚至没有答应过我会回来。我努力不让 Sai 的声音在脑中盘旋，却根本拦不住。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Was she going to die...? Would I write that note? ...No. Neither of those would happen.
entries.new: 她会死吗……？那张字条会是我写的吗？……不。这两件事都不会发生。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: She wouldn't just leave like that if she thought there was a chance she would die. There had to be a good reason behind her actions.
entries.new: 如果她觉得自己可能会死，就不会那么干脆地离开。她这么做一定有充分的理由。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Don't kill me, but hasn't it been a long time since she left? What do you think she's doing?
entries.new: ……先说好，别生气。她是不是已经走了挺久了？你觉得她现在在干嘛？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Be quiet.
entries.new: 闭嘴。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Listen, she looked at me as well when she said not to follow her, so I'm being considerate by staying behind. I was just wondering if you had any idea.
entries.new: 听我说，她说不许跟上去的时候也看了我一眼，所以我留在这里已经算很体贴了。我只是想知道你有没有什么头绪。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Sai was the least of my concerns. I barely put any thought into punching him, but before I did, I saw a conspicuous smile all over his face. It only faded momentarily, returning right after the blow.
entries.new: 我当时最顾不上的人就是 Sai。我几乎没多想就朝他挥拳，但在动手之前，我看见他脸上挂着一个刺眼的笑容。那笑容只消失了一瞬，挨了我一拳后又立刻回到脸上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: He didn't say anything, but he positioned himself back at my side. While I couldn't see him, his mere presence felt disgusting.
entries.new: 他什么也没说，却又站回我身旁。虽然看不见他，但光是他在旁边就让我恶心。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Not a single part left of me felt able to continue reasoning out what was happening. All I knew was that the last travel had been different and somehow led to Sai's behavior, with him being the only affected person.
entries.new: 我已经没有半点心力再去想眼前发生了什么。我只知道，上一次穿越有些不同，而 Sai 的态度变化多半和这有关——受影响的人只有他一个。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But even though I felt stuck, I couldn't stop time from ticking. Every second I spent sheltering myself from reality was another one I spent thinking that Shiroya might never come back.
entries.new: 可就算我动弹不得，时间也不会停下。我每逃避现实一秒，心里的念头就多一分：Shiroya 也许再也不会回来了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Eventually, my attempts at calming down bore some fruit. Up until then, she and I had been making our way through the day together. The version of her that had just gone upstairs had experienced things I wasn't aware of, so she'd known that following along would've been a bad idea.
entries.new: 总算，我让自己冷静下来的努力有了些效果。在那之前，我和她一直是一起度过这一天的。刚才上楼的那个她，经历过一些我并不知情的事，所以她清楚，再继续跟上去不会是什么好主意。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: However, what could she have gone to do, and why had she not explained it even vaguely? She simply left.
entries.new: 可她究竟去做什么了？为什么连一句含糊的解释都没有？她就那样走了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...She'd gone to the attic. The Sekimeiya was in the event room, so what could she have wanted to do up there?
entries.new: ……她去了阁楼。Sekimeiya 在活动室，那她上楼到底想做什么？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Do you remember anything else, Erina?
entries.new: Erina，你还记得别的什么吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...I don't think so.
entries.new: ……我想没有了。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: I think I might have an idea about who attacked you now.
entries.new: 我大概知道是谁袭击你了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Huh?
entries.new: 啊？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: I wouldn't wanna get killed, though. Atsuki, sorry to bother you, but who do you think it was?
entries.new: 不过我可不打算把命搭进去。Atsuki，不好意思麻烦你，你觉得会是谁？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...{w}I don't know.
entries.new: ……{w}我不知道。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: ...Not even the slightest idea?
entries.new: ……一点头绪都没有？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What, are you going to say it was Shiroya?
entries.new: 怎么，你该不会想说是 Shiroya 吧？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I would never say that. However, she's the most likely suspect, isn't she?
entries.new: 我可不会那么说。不过，她的嫌疑确实最大，不是吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: She isn't! Why the fuck is he saying that?
entries.new: 她才不是！他妈的，凭什么这么说？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Because "she could've traveled to the past and done it"? That's bullshit! How is she more suspicious than anyone else?
entries.new: 就因为「她可能穿越回过去下了手」？胡说八道！她凭什么比别人更可疑？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Hey, I know it could've been anyone, but it'd be a bit strange if it wasn't her. Although I only assumed you weren't guilty because I thought you wouldn't be so stupid.
entries.new: 喂，我知道谁都可能下手，但如果不是她，反倒有些奇怪。至于我为什么认定你无罪——只是觉得你不至于蠢到那种地步。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Does that make sense? I don't think she could've attacked her.
entries.new: 这说得通吗？我不认为她会去袭击人。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: I do. After all, aren't you basing that on what Atsuki said?
entries.new: 我觉得说得通。说到底，你这判断不也是听 Atsuki 说的吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Wait, you're right... Atsuki, tell me the truth. Was that what you did?
entries.new: 等等，你说得对……Atsuki，跟我说实话。你当时真的做了那种事？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Shut the fuck up! I didn't do anything!
entries.new: 少他妈胡说！我什么都没干！
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Erina, I have a question. Did you kill Shiroya? That would explain almost everything.
entries.new: Erina，我有个问题。是你杀了 Shiroya 吗？那样的话，几乎所有事都能解释得通了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: N-No...! Of course not...!
entries.new: 不、不是……！当然不是……！
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Right. I wonder... could this have worked...?
entries.new: 也对。我在想……这么做会不会行得通……？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Every time I heard him, I repeated a mantra: listening to him was pointless. Not a single thing he was saying made any sense or had any value.
entries.new: 每次听到他开口，我都在心里默念同一句话：听他说下去毫无意义。他说的每一句话都没道理，也没价值。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Earlier, he'd tried to kill us but refused to tell us why. After undergoing a sudden change, he was acting aggressive toward me again... Was it only because he'd seen Shiroya, who he didn't remember or thought couldn't be alive?
entries.new: 先前他想杀我们，却不肯说明理由。经历那场突变之后，他又开始对我咄咄逼人……难道只是因为看见了 Shiroya——一个他毫无印象、甚至认为不可能活着的人？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What about Akaro, who hadn't been anywhere for hours? What were they talking about regarding Erina? And how in the hell did they know about Miiya? Had the Sekimeiya just created an absurd clash of events and memories?
entries.new: 那好几个小时里哪里都不见踪影的 Akaro 呢？他们谈到 Erina 时究竟在说什么？又到底怎么会知道 Miiya 的事？难道是 Sekimeiya 把事件与记忆胡乱搅成了一团？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I wanted to know what had happened to Shiroya and everyone in the tower. Sai's behavior toward me was light years different from how he'd treated me at the beginning, but he'd always operated logically. I wanted to know what had caused the immense change, but arguing with him was impossible.
entries.new: 我想知道 Shiroya 和塔里所有人究竟遭遇了什么。Sai 如今对我的态度，与他最初待我时判若两人，可他做事一向合乎逻辑。我想弄清是什么造成了如此巨大的转变，却根本没法和他争辩。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There were too many things I needed to understand. Questions had barraged me since {time=9}, and each one was more complex than the last. With the little time we had left, there was no way I could be optimistic and think that everything was magically going to be resolved.
entries.new: 需要弄明白的事太多了。自从{time=9}起，疑问就接二连三地压过来，而且一个比一个复杂。剩下的时间如此有限，我根本无法乐观地相信一切会奇迹般迎刃而解。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What Shiroya and I had gotten ourselves caught up in was out of our league. So I tried to push everything that didn't directly involve us away and focused on what I most wanted to decipher.
entries.new: 我和 Shiroya 卷进的这摊事，早已超出我们的能力范围。于是我把与自身无直接关联的一切暂且搁下，专心去想我最想解开的那一环。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Shiroya had gone to the past with Sai, probably about twenty minutes. However, an extra version of her had already been in the tower for much longer—since I'd seen her in the event room.
entries.new: Shiroya 和 Sai 去了过去，大概二十分钟。然而另一个她早已在塔里待了更久——从我还在活动室看见她时算起。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Despite not knowing what that Shiroya had lived through, it was reasonable to assume it happened in the attic, which was locked and beyond my view. As such, she'd realized she had to go there.
entries.new: 我不知道那个 Shiroya 经历了什么，但可以合理推测，那些事发生在阁楼里——那里锁着，我看不到里面。正因如此，她才明白自己非去那里不可。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wait... I'm not sure if this is strange, but it could be important.
entries.new: 等等……我不确定这算不算奇怪，但也许很重要。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: "Please, don't follow me."
entries.new: 「求你了，别跟过来。」
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Yes, like Sai said, she directed that at everyone, but she was specifically looking at me. She didn't want me to follow her.
entries.new: 嗯，就像 Sai 说的，那句话是对所有人说的，可她当时偏偏看着我。她不想我跟着她。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: However, how would I?
entries.new: 可我又怎么可能跟得过去？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I can't enter the attic; she would have the key, if anyone.
entries.new: 我进不了阁楼；要说谁有钥匙，那也只能是她。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: The way she looked at me... It was like she was telling me that if I followed her, I would hinder whatever she wanted to do.{w} But she was already in hallway C. If she really wanted me not to come along, all she had to do was use the elevator up to the attic and I'd have no way to chase her.
entries.new: 她看我的眼神……像是在告诉我，如果我跟上去，就会妨碍她想做的事。{w}可她已经到了 C走廊。如果她真不想我跟着，只要乘电梯上阁楼就行，我根本追不上她。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: So what does that mean? She thought I could've followed her to the attic if I'd just run behind her... That's the impression I get.
entries.new: 那这又意味着什么？她觉得只要我追在她身后跑，就能一路跟到阁楼……我觉得她就是这个意思。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: If I'm right, that means I can enter the attic and she doesn't have the key for it. And somehow, she knew it was unlocked when I know it wasn't just minutes ago.
entries.new: 如果我没猜错，这就说明我能进阁楼，而她手里没有钥匙。而且不知怎的，她知道阁楼没锁——可我明明知道，就在几分钟前它还锁着。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: ...I'm sorry, but I can't keep staying here. Shiroya, maybe you've already accomplished what you wanted to do and I won't find you up there, but I need to find out what happened.
entries.new: ……抱歉，我不能再留在这里了。Shiroya，也许你已经做完了想做的事，我上去也找不到你，但我必须弄清楚发生了什么。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: What time is it?
entries.new: 现在几点？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Is this all the time you needed to give her?{w} Let me see... It's {time=19:08.}
entries.new: 你给她留的时间就这么点？{w}我看看……现在是{time=19:08.}
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Time was moving quickly. The shutter would retract in an hour and a half, so I the only thing I could shoot for was being with Shiroya when it happened.
entries.new: 时间过得飞快。一个半小时后卷帘门就会收起，我唯一能指望的，就是在那一刻陪在 Shiroya 身边。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If you plan to go to the attic, don't think we'll let you go alone.
entries.new: 你要是打算去阁楼，就别以为我们会让你一个人去。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I stood up, ignoring him. He didn't hesitate to stand too, and it seemed Akaro and Erina were getting closer.
entries.new: 我没理他，径自站起身。他也毫不迟疑地站了起来，而 Akaro 和 Erina 似乎也正靠过来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Should we take the elevator?
entries.new: 要坐电梯吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Do you have the attic key?
entries.new: 你有阁楼的钥匙？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: What? Of course I don't. Just go to the sixth floor and enter it.
entries.new: 什么？我当然没有。上六楼，直接进去就是了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: The elevator arrived soon after I'd called it, revealing that it had still been on a higher floor. When I opened the door, the other three each took a step forward to get in.
entries.new: 我按下呼叫键后，电梯很快就到了，看来它一直停在上面的楼层。我打开门时，另外三人各自向前迈了一步，想要进来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Sai, you are out of your mind if you think you're getting in the same elevator as me. Back off.
entries.new: Sai，你要是以为能跟我坐同一部电梯，那你是疯了。退后。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Going to make me walk all the way up? Awfully rude of you.
entries.new: 要让我一路爬上去？你可真是够无礼的。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: My glare extended to Akaro, who I also refused to be close to. I knew he could overpower me if he wanted to, but he'd reiterated the claim that Shiroya would die, so I'd fight him even if it was pointless. He shrugged and moved aside.
entries.new: 我的目光又转向 Akaro——我也不愿与他靠得太近。我知道他若愿意，轻易就能制住我，可他反复断言 Shiroya 会死，所以我哪怕徒劳也要与他抗争。他耸了耸肩，退到一旁。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...We'll see you there, then. Hopefully, we find her easily.
entries.new: ……那就在上面见了。希望我们能顺利找到她。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: It's fine. We'll make sure she doesn't come back down the stairs. But if we can't find her, you're not going to get away with keeping quiet.
entries.new: 没关系。我们会盯着，不让她再从楼梯下来。可要是我们找不到她，你可别指望一直闭口不言就能了事。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I didn't look at Erina, as I had nothing against her. She entered beside me, looking just as lost as usual.
entries.new: 我没有看 Erina，因为我对她没什么敌意。她跟着我走进电梯，神情还是一如既往地茫然无措。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: When the door closed, I pressed the floor 6 button and waited for the elevator to begin moving.
entries.new: 门合上后，我按下六楼的按钮，等着电梯启动。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We'd arrive faster than the other two, but I wasn't sure if we were going to find anything. Sai had mentioned that the attic's door would be open, so he might've been the one to leave it like that, assuming I could actually trust anything he said.
entries.new: 我们会比那两人先到，但是否能找到什么，我心里没底。Sai 说过阁楼的门会开着；如果他的话可信，那门多半就是他特意留的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Erina was at my side next to the buttons, while I was leaning back against the opposite side. Her existence likely had more mystery behind it than I knew, but it was no time to worry about it. For some reason, she had reined in her hostility toward me.
entries.new: Erina 站在我旁边，靠着按钮那一侧；我则背倚着对面的厢壁。她身上的谜团多半比我知道的还要多，可眼下不是追究的时候。不知为何，她收敛了对我的敌意。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Even Landscape
entries.new: 风景亦如是

entries.text: Ah!{nw}
entries.new: 啊！{nw}
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: W—{nw}
entries.new: 什——{nw}
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: The elevator stopped abruptly.
entries.new: 电梯骤然停住。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It couldn't have been going too fast, but as it ceased all movement, it propelled us upward, and we slammed to the floor.
entries.new: 它原本算不上快，可彻底停下的那一刻，却把我们向上抛起，随即重重摔在地上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I felt my right hand burning. I looked at it and saw a cut.
entries.new: 右手火辣辣地疼。我低头一看，手上多了一道口子。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What!? You're bleeding!
entries.new: 什么！？你在流血！
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: I could only process the intense pain coming from the wound. While I couldn't comprehend how it had happened, I understood that I had cut my hand with the handrail when our bodies lifted, as it had been right above me.
entries.new: 我只能感觉到伤口传来的剧痛。怎么弄的，我一时想不明白，只记得身体被抛起来时，手正好撞在上方的扶手上，被划开了一道口子。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Blood poured out and pain poured in equally. Overwhelmed, Erina tried to open the door.
entries.new: 血往外涌，疼痛往里钻。Erina 慌了神，伸手去开门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What? We stopped on the third floor.
entries.new: 怎么回事？电梯停在三楼了。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: I'd experienced that situation once already. Had we been intercepted again? The vast amount of blood leaving my body prevented me from thinking about it, and instead, I started to feel disoriented.
entries.new: 这种情形我已经经历过一次。又被人截住了吗？大量失血让我无法细想，只觉得眼前开始发晕。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Nobody's here! I... didn't press the button either!{w} We need to... stop the bleeding. We could use something from the attic!
entries.new: 这里没人！我……我也没按过按钮！{w}我们得先……止血。阁楼里应该有能用的东西！
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: No way... It hurts so much... Fuck!
entries.new: 不会吧……好疼……该死！
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: It wasn't too deep of a wound, but the bleeding would take a while to stop. I wouldn't pass out from it, so all I could think about was the intense pain.
entries.new: 伤口不算深，可一时半会儿止不住血。这点血不至于让我昏过去，于是我满脑子只剩下那股剧痛。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: However, the one thought that came to me was what I needed. I had to get rid of the wound. It hurt way too much to spend the entire remaining time without medical assistance, and I needed to have a clear mind.
entries.new: 然而，我想到的正是我需要的。我必须让这道伤消失。这伤疼得厉害，要是一直得不到处理，剩下的时间根本熬不过去；而且我必须保持清醒。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I could accomplish that. I only had to travel back in time.
entries.new: 我办得到。只要回到过去就行。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Perhaps the pain blinded me, but without a second thought, I yanked the door inward and pressed the button to go back to the first floor.
entries.new: 也许是疼痛冲昏了头，我想也没想，一把将门拉开，按下回一楼的按钮。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What are you—
entries.new: 你要干什——
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Her voice cut off, and I began to descend. It was fine; I'd only take a detour. After I got rid of the ridiculous pain that wouldn't let me think properly for a long time to come, I'd go up to find Shiroya. I could even go earlier.
entries.new: 她的声音被切断，电梯开始下降。没关系，只是多绕一段路。等我把这疼得离谱、让我往后好长时间都没法好好思考的伤解决掉，再上去找 Shiroya 就行。说不定还能提前到。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The single requirement was the Sekimeiya. I had to activate it and replicate an earlier position of myself without the wound, retrieving all of my lost blood in the process. I had to do it quickly so that there wouldn't be many possible locations to replicate after the wound.
entries.new: 唯一的条件是 Sekimeiya。我必须启动它，把自己复制回受伤之前的位置，顺带把流失的血全部取回。而且必须尽快动手，免得受伤之后可供复制的方位越积越多。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The doors opened, so I dashed out of the elevator as fast as I could, forcing my {tip=eyes}eyes shut{/tip} to suppress the pain.
entries.new: 门一开，我便拼尽全力冲出电梯，{tip=eyes}闭上眼{/tip}强忍疼痛。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I ran to the event room, a fair amount of blood dripping off my hand. I knew I'd have to wait a few minutes to activate it, but that was necessary. However, since I clearly didn't know much about how the replicated location operated, I could only hope it would actually work.
entries.new: 我跑向活动室，手上的血一路滴落。我知道还得等上几分钟才能启动，但这一步省不得。只是我对复制方位的运作几乎一无所知，只能祈祷它真的管用。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I felt the room was a bit colder than before... I uncovered the curtain.
entries.new: 房间里似乎比先前冷了些……我掀开了遮布。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Why?
entries.new: ……为什么？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: It wasn't there. Behind the glass, there was only a crimson cushion, and the glass {tip=cold2}wasn't fully shut{/tip}, which cooled my face while I stared in denial.
entries.new: 它不在。玻璃后只剩一只深红的垫子，玻璃{tip=cold2}没有完全合拢{/tip}，凉意拂在脸上，我却仍死死盯着，不肯相信。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Fuck! Do I have to search for it? Sai, Akaro, even Shiroya... they all could've taken it!
entries.new: ……该死！难道还得自己去找？Sai、Akaro，甚至连 Shiroya……谁都有可能把它拿走！
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: It was all right... I tried to tell myself. I would've had to wait a few minutes before activating the Sekimeiya anyway. Since someone had removed it from the cabinet for me, I'd just have to spend that time searching for it, as it was already storing energy.
entries.new: 没事的……我试着安慰自己。反正启动 Sekimeiya 之前也得等上几分钟。既然有人替我从展示柜里把它取了出来，我只要用这段时间去找它就行——它已经在蓄能了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But desperately searching by myself sounded overwhelming. I wouldn't stop losing blood any time soon, making me more and more tired. The pain wasn't going to suddenly fade, and there was no way I would be able to tolerate it until {time=21} on top of everything else.
entries.new: 可要独自一人拼命寻找，光是想想就让人吃不消。血一时止不住，我只会越来越疲惫。疼痛也不会忽然消退，何况我还得一直忍到 {time=21}，这根本不可能。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I closed the glass and nervously stepped into hallway B, where I still found no trace of anyone. Slowly, I'd begun to perceive two things.
entries.new: 我合上玻璃，忐忑地走进 B 走廊，那里依旧不见半个人影。渐渐地，我意识到两件事。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The strange smell felt {tip=smell2}very strong and prominent{/tip}. I wasn't sure that meant anything—I still didn't know where it was coming from or what it signified. However, it felt more noticeable than it had on previous occasions.
entries.new: 那股怪味{tip=smell2}格外浓烈刺鼻{/tip}。这究竟意味着什么，我也说不准——它的来源和含义我至今不明。只是比起先前几次，它明显得多。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The second thing was a thought.{w} I knew I looked just like Erina had previously, so I found myself suddenly coming back to something she'd recently said.
entries.new: 第二件是一个念头。{w}我知道自己此刻的样子和之前的 Erina 一模一样，于是忽然想起她前不久说过的话。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: "That's nonsense! I'm going to the past, so I'll prevent Isla from dying." She had completely refused Sai's claim that the past couldn't be changed.
entries.new: 「胡说！我就是要回到过去，阻止 Isla 死去。」Sai 说过去无法改变，她当时断然不信。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: My mind might've been clouded, but I started to doubt my past conclusions, feeling that Erina's words could hold some weight. I wanted to go to the past, so what if I changed it?
entries.new: 也许我的脑子已经不清醒了，但我开始怀疑自己从前的结论，觉得 Erina 的话未必没有道理。我想回到过去，那么，改变它又如何？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Would the universe really not allow it? I had been working under that assumption, but that concept had begun to feel nonsensical to me. If I actively wanted to change the past, there was no way I couldn't do it, and I didn't particularly mind trying it.
entries.new: 宇宙真的会不允许吗？我一直以此为前提行事，可这个说法如今想来却荒谬至极。若我真心想改变过去，就不可能做不到；试一试，我也不觉得有什么不妥。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I entered the cleaning room and scanned it with my eyes. ...How would the universe stop me from changing what had been decided? I wanted to find out.
entries.new: 我走进清洁间，四下扫视。……宇宙究竟会如何阻止我改变既定之事？我想亲眼看看。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Many things around me pointed at the fact that Shiroya would die at one point, and even though she was alive, she had purposely left me in the dark. If I could deviate from that reality, I would. Fortunately, finding out if it was possible appeared to be fairly easy.
entries.new: 我身边的许多迹象都指向一点：Shiroya 终有一死；她明明还活着，却有意把我蒙在鼓里。若我能偏离那个现实，我绝不会犹豫。所幸，要弄清这是否可行，似乎并不难。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I looked at the crystal room B6, but the sheer number of cabinets was dizzying. I didn't have the strength to inspect all of them, so I backed off toward the staff room.
entries.new: 我望向水晶展室 B6，可展示柜多得让人眼花。我没力气一一查看，只好退向员工室。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: When my mentality hadn't been to alter the past, everything had automatically played out as I'd once lived it. I wanted to see what would happen if I consciously attempted to alter the past through my actions.
entries.new: 当我没有改变过去的念头时，一切都自动按照我经历过的样子重演。我想看看，若我有意用自己的行动去改变过去，会发生什么。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'd already tried it once, but how could Sai's and Akaro's words make any sense? Weren't their realities completely different from mine? Had they traveled in time and altered the events they remembered? Was that why the effect had only worked on them while the reality I knew was completely different from theirs?
entries.new: 我已经试过一次了。可 Sai 和 Akaro 的说法又怎么解释得通？他们所经历的现实，难道与我的完全不同？会不会是他们自己穿越了时间，改变了自己记忆中的事件？难道这就是为什么这效果只对他们生效，而我所知的现实与他们截然不同？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I couldn't tell if I was deluding myself or somehow not making sense, but I felt like I must've been able to change the past and that it had happened to other people while we'd coexisted in a single timeline. If nothing of consequence could come out of time travel, what was the point of it anyway?
entries.new: 我分不清自己是在自欺欺人，还是逻辑上哪里出了错。可我总觉得，过去一定可以被改变，而且就在我们共存于同一条时间线时，那样的事已经在别人身上发生过。若时间穿越带不来任何结果，那它又有什么意义？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Perhaps it would complicate it all even further, throwing everything into even more disarray. But why would I care about that? I'd be able to change things anyway if that were the case. Not attempting it was stupid.
entries.new: 也许这会让一切更复杂，把局面搅得更乱。可我又何必在乎？若真如此，我照样能改变事情。连试都不试，才是愚蠢。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I could only open two lockers, so the task was far more bearable than checking inside every cabinet. I was already staggering, so I had very little hope of finding the Sekimeiya before I couldn't continue.
entries.new: 我能打开的储物柜只有两个，比起逐个翻查展示柜，这差事轻松多了。我走路都已开始摇晃，能在撑不住之前找到 Sekimeiya 的希望实在渺茫。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I opened Naomi's locker, but the Sekimeiya wasn't inside.
entries.new: 我打开 Naomi 的储物柜，里面没有 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The other one was locked, so I took out the key and unlocked it.
entries.new: 另一扇锁着，我便取出钥匙开了锁。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: In the top compartment was the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 最上层的格子里放着 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I didn't care how strange that was. Had it teleported back? How could I know? I only wanted to use it so that I could think straight once again. As I was holding the key with my left hand, I extended my right one, mixing the pain of the wound with a burn that made my sight warp.
entries.new: 它出现在这里有多么蹊跷，我已无心深究。是传送回来了吗？我又怎么会知道？我只想借它的力量，让自己的头脑重新清醒过来。我左手握着钥匙，伸出右手，伤口被牵动的剧痛与一阵灼烧感交织在一起，视线都随之扭曲。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I was at the start of hallway B, looking toward C.
entries.new: 我站在 B走廊的入口，望向 C走廊。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Huh?
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I stared at my hand.
entries.new: 我盯着自己的手。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The wound was still there, but next to no blood was pouring out of it, and it didn't hurt as much. I saw the scar that it had left, which would likely persist for many days. Furthermore, {tip=tired}I felt very tired{/tip}, but my mind was clearer.
entries.new: 伤口还在，却几乎不再流血，疼痛也减轻了许多。它已经留下了一道疤，看样子会伴随我好些天。此外，{tip=tired}我感到极度疲惫{/tip}，头脑却比先前清醒。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: How's this possible? Why do I still have the wound...?
entries.new: 怎么可能？伤口为什么还在……？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: What time even is it?
entries.new: 现在到底是什么时候了？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I began to walk toward the event room to check the time, but voices stopped me.
entries.new: 我正想走去活动室确认时间，却被人声拦住了脚步。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I got close to the door and focused my hearing.
entries.new: 我凑近门边，凝神细听。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...just suddenly ran aw— ...honestly wasn't sure.
entries.new: 「……就突然跑掉——……说实话，我也不确定。」
entries.speaker: aki4

entries.text: I recognized the conversation. I'd arrived approximately a couple minutes before the point only Sai had traveled.
entries.new: 我认出了这段对话。我抵达的时间，比只有 Sai 到达过的那个时间点大约早了两分钟。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...to interpret thi— ...Did you all—
entries.new: 「……来解释这——……你们大家是——」
entries.speaker: sai4

entries.text: I retreated and went to hallway A through the lobby.
entries.new: 我悄悄退开，穿过大堂去了 A走廊。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The computer screens were still lit, so I walked up to them to check the exact time, trying to avoid the blood on the floor.
entries.new: 电脑屏幕还亮着，我便走上前查看准确时间，同时小心避开地板上的血迹。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: {time=18:54}, precisely what I'd estimated. For a short time, at least, I could try to experiment and gain some form of knowledge, no matter how small. Feeling like I could trust my judgment a bit better than before, I stepped out and went over what I'd been thinking.
entries.new: {time=18:54}，与我的估算分毫不差。至少在这一小段时间里，我可以试着做些验证，获取些情报，哪怕再微不足道。我觉得自己比先前更能信任自己的判断了，于是走出门，重新梳理此前的想法。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What if I open the door to the event room? It's completely in reach, and if I do it, I'll be changing the past...
entries.new: 要是我推开活动室的门呢？这完全做得到，而一旦做了，我就改变了过去……
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I was intrigued. I had to accept that nothing made sense to me. Given what I'd deduced, I shouldn't have kept the wound; I knew I was operating under numerous misconceptions. If I tried to change the past, the result had untold potential to point me in a more accurate direction.
entries.new: 我来了兴致。我必须承认，眼下的一切我全然看不透。按我自己的推断，这道伤口本不该留下；可见我的认知里尽是谬误。若试着改变过去，结果说不定能为我指明更准确的方向。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But it was scary. Did paradoxes exist? Would the world crumble if I changed what I'd already experienced?
entries.new: 可这也很可怕。悖论真的存在吗？若改动我已经历过的部分，世界会崩塌吗？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Maybe the universe was pressuring me into accepting what had been decided, but I didn't feel like the pressure was strong enough. I could make any change, and the only thing in my way was myself.
entries.new: 也许宇宙正压迫我接受既定的安排，可我感到那份压力并不够强。任何改变我都做得出，唯一阻挡我的，只有我自己。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: However, I didn't want to go too many steps up. Perhaps I could change the past if I really wanted to, but what if I altered my own past actions? I would never end up traveling, so thinking that my existence could be immediately overwritten wasn't an unfounded fear.
entries.new: 不过，我不想把步子迈得太大。若我真想，也许就能改变过去——可要是改动了过去的自己所做的事呢？那我就不会穿越了。所以，担心自己的存在会立刻被改写，并非杞人忧天。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: How could I attempt to change the past while making sure that I could still end up traveling in the same way?
entries.new: 怎样才能在改变过去的同时，确保自己仍会以同样的方式穿越？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: In a few minutes, Sai will appear in hallway B from the lobby while Akaro will suddenly show up from hallway A through the event room. Preventing their arrivals could still be too big of a change that might deny my travel from occurring.
entries.new: 几分钟后，Sai 会从大堂出现在 B走廊，而 Akaro 则会穿过活动室，从 A走廊突然现身。阻止他们出现，恐怕仍是过大的变动，可能让我的穿越无法发生。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: But the more I thought about it, the more I realized that I had nothing else to alter that I could be sure I had definitely changed.
entries.new: 可越想越觉得，除此之外，我再找不到别的事情可改，也没有任何一件能让我确定自己真的改过。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It was extremely reckless, but I wanted to try it nonetheless. I wanted to understand what had happened to Shiroya and the rest of us. And although it sounded dangerous in theory, I felt no risk in play. The thought of one of my harmless actions freezing or eradicating the universe simply didn't seem right.
entries.new: 这举动极其鲁莽，可我还是想试一试。我想弄清 Shiroya 和我们其他人身上究竟发生了什么。理论上听着危险，我却没觉得真有风险。要说我某个无伤大雅的举动会让宇宙冻结、甚至毁灭，我实在无法认同。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: So, I had an idea: a sound.{w} To start off, I could produce a loud sound I knew I hadn't heard. If I managed to make it happen, the past could be changed.
entries.new: 于是，我有了个主意：制造一声响动。{w} 一开始，我可以先弄出一声我确定自己从未听过的巨响。只要能做到，就说明过去可以被改变。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I walked up to the storeroom so that I'd be able to flee. I still didn't want my past self to see me, as the chances of a paradox occurring would certainly increase if it happened, and the single thing I wanted to know was whether reality could be reshaped.
entries.new: 我走到储藏室旁，好方便随时逃走。我仍不愿让过去的自己看见我——一旦发生，出现悖论的可能性必然大增。而我想弄清的只有一点：现实能否被重塑。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I twisted the knob on the door and pushed it open. It was fully in my reach: I could slam the door and generate a considerably loud sound that hadn't previously existed.{w} Was the universe about to black out? I'd shortly find out, as I really intended to do it.
entries.new: 我拧开门把，推开门。这完全做得到：只要摔上门，就能造出一声此前从未有过的巨响。{w} 宇宙会就此陷入黑暗吗？很快便见分晓——我真的打算这么做。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I was using my left hand since the right one still hurt. Perhaps the impact wouldn't be as strong, but there was no way it wouldn't be heard throughout the entire floor.
entries.new: 我右手还疼，只能用左手。这一摔力道或许不够大，但整层楼绝不可能听不见。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I remembered Sai's words in the event room: "the past can't be changed". He'd gotten to the same conclusion I had earlier, but had he tried it himself? There was no way to be certain without attempting it.
entries.new: 我想起 Sai 在活动室里说过的话：「过去无法改变。」那正是我先前得出的结论。可他自己试过吗？不亲自动手，就无从确定。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Am I making too big of a deal about this? I'm just going to make a sound...
entries.new: 我是不是把事情想得太严重了？不过是弄出点声响而已……
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I was hesitating. Was it the universe's prediction... that no sound would be heard?
entries.new: 我竟然在犹豫。难道是宇宙的预知……断定不会有任何声音响起？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Feeling controlled, I moved my arm without thinking.
entries.new: 我感到自己被人操控着，手臂不假思索地动了起来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There... That's it! This is a new noise! One that we didn't hear.
entries.new: 来了……成了！这是一声从未有过的响动！是我们当时没听见的声音。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I had to run away. The world hadn't frozen, and I was still alive. However, all that meant was that my existence was not a paradox. Letting my past self see me had an inherent problem: he'd know he'd end up traveling and doing what he'd seen, canceling out the freedom of my own actions.
entries.new: 我得逃走。世界没有冻结，我也还活着。但这只能说明，我的存在不构成悖论。让过去的我看见我，本身就有个问题：他会知道自己终将穿越，并做出他亲眼所见之事——我行动的自由也就随之消失了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...However, that wasn't necessarily the case anymore, as the past version that could see me wouldn't be the same me anymore. He would be one who heard a sound I'd never experienced, so he might not have ended up traveling like I had.
entries.new: ……不过，如今未必还是这样了。能看见我的那个过去的我，已经不再是我。他成了听过一声我从未听过的响动的人，因此未必会像我一样穿越。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I ran toward the stairs and quickly disappeared from view. I hadn't edited my memories at all. I still remembered the reality in which no sound had played.{w} It was a potentially massive problem; I could've created a reality in which two versions of myself existed permanently. If I'd separated myself from my past version who was on the crystal floor, he wouldn't ever travel and leave his place for me to occupy like what had been happening so far.
entries.new: 我朝楼梯跑去，转眼便脱离了视线。我的记忆丝毫未变。我依然记得那个没有响起任何声音的现实。{w} 这或许是个大问题：我可能造出了一个两个我永久并存的现实。若我与留在水晶层的那个过去的我分开，他就永远不会穿越，也不会像至今这样腾出位置让我顶替。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: To understand every consequence, I'd have to wait. However, I'd already learned the most important piece of information: the past could be changed if I wanted it to. On the other hand, nothing would differ unless I intended it to.
entries.new: 要弄清所有后果，只能等。但我已经掌握了最关键的一条情报：只要我愿意，过去就能被改变。反过来说，若非出于我的本意，什么都不会有所不同。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I felt a piercing pain and looked at my hand. Running with clenched fists had slightly reopened the wound, and a small amount of blood was dribbling out. If I'd left some behind, it would create a trail to find my whereabouts.{w} I looked at the staircase and saw very little blood.
entries.new: 一阵刺痛袭来，我看向自己的手。握着拳奔跑让伤口微微裂开，渗出些许血来。若一路滴落，便会留下追查我下落的血痕。{w} 我回望楼梯，只看到很少的血迹。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The stronger pain was coming back, so I had to cover the wound. I couldn't go back down and use a curtain, and I didn't necessarily want to dirty the clothes in the attic. Instead, I entered the bathroom at my side, figuring a few strips of toilet paper would be enough.
entries.new: 剧痛又开始浮现，我得把伤口包起来。总不能下楼去扯遮布，我也不太想弄脏阁楼里的衣服。于是我进了旁边的洗手间，想着几条厕纸应该足够。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Toilet paper was far from appropriate or hygienic to cover wounds, but I had to use what I had at my disposal. I kept adding layers until no more blood could be seen. It took a while, but I managed to make it work.
entries.new: 用厕纸包扎伤口，既不合宜也不卫生，可我手头只有这些。我一层层地裹上去，直到再看不见血迹。费了些工夫，总算勉强应付过去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I should probably stay here. I don't know if the sound I made was enough to cause a search on the crystal floor, but if it was, they'll find me no matter where I go. ...Hopefully, it didn't trigger one.
entries.new: 我大概该留在这里。我不知道自己弄出的声响会不会引来对水晶层的搜查，但若真招来了，我躲到哪里都会被找到。……但愿没有。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: However, it's possible Shiroya will still suddenly go up, so if I pay attention, I'll hear her whether she uses the elevator or goes on foot.
entries.new: 不过，Shiroya 仍有可能突然上楼。只要留心，无论她坐电梯还是走楼梯，我都能听见。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I'm not sure I want to stop her, but I want to know what she went to do...
entries.new: 我不确定自己是否想拦住她，但我想知道她上去做什么……
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I waited after sitting down and slightly opening the door. It wasn't open enough to see outside, but I hoped I would hear footsteps through the gap.
entries.new: 我坐下，把门稍微推开一条缝，静静等着。缝不够大，看不到外面，但我盼着能从那道缝隙里听见脚步声。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I put my hand in my pocket. I wanted to get rid of the note through the toilet.
entries.new: 我把手伸进口袋。我想把那张纸条用马桶冲掉。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Strangely, I couldn't find it. It wasn't there, but I hadn't gotten rid of it.
entries.new: 奇怪的是，我找不到它。口袋里没有，可我并没有把它丢掉。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I checked all my pockets, but the note was gone.
entries.new: 我把所有口袋都翻了一遍，纸条却不见了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I didn't drop it anywhere, did I? That must mean I didn't appear with it when I traveled.
entries.new: 我没有把它掉在什么地方吧？也就是说，我穿越时并不是和它一起出现的。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Why, though? It was so strange. At least it had dematerialized for good, I supposed.
entries.new: 可为什么呢？实在太奇怪了。至少它已经彻底消散了——我想是这样。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Going off what I'd lived, Shiroya would be going upstairs in two to three minutes, but I had no guarantee that would repeat.
entries.new: ……按我经历过的来看，再过两三分钟 Shiroya 就会上楼，但我无法保证这件事会重演。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...It did not. Five minutes later, the elevator hadn't been used, and nobody had gone up or down the stairs. That was proof of my change.
entries.new: ……但没有。五分钟过去，电梯没动过，楼梯上也没人上下。这就是我改变了过去的证据。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I could change the past. I didn't blame myself for wrongly assuming the opposite for so long, but I'd proved that if I wanted to and was conscious of what I was doing, I could decide to alter history. To finally know with certainty was both terrifying and exhilarating.
entries.new: 我能改变过去。长久以来我一直误以为相反，这也怨不得我；但我已经证明，只要自己愿意、并且清楚在做什么，我就能决定改写历史。终于能够确定这一点，既令人恐惧，又令人振奋。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Less than two hours remained until {time=21.} The alarm had gone off at about {time=9:05}, and the automatic unlock was rapidly approaching. Was it enough time to try putting things into practice?{w} I still didn't know what consequences would truly come out of my change. Would I permanently have differing memories from the people around me? Would I have to coexist with another Atsuki?
entries.new: 距离 {time=21.} 还剩不到两个小时。警报大约在 {time=9:05} 响过，自动解锁的时刻正迅速逼近。这些时间够我试着付诸实践吗？{w}我仍不知道自己的改变究竟会带来什么后果。我会永远和身边的人拥有不同的记忆吗？我是否必须与另一个 Atsuki 共存？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: As soon as I found out, making use of time travel would become simple. Suddenly, I was presented with a dilemma.
entries.new: 只要弄明白这一点，利用时间穿越就会变得轻而易举。突然间，我面前摆上了一道难题。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Two hours remain until the front door presumably opens. In about thirty minutes is when I traveled to the past, but that might not happen anymore. This means that I could have the chance to let the Sekimeiya gather power until {time=21:05.}
entries.new: 距离前门开启大概还有两个小时。我穿越回过去是在大约三十分钟后，但如今那件事或许不会再发生。也就是说，我或许有机会让 Sekimeiya 一直蓄能到 {time=21:05.}
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I'm not sure how far back I'd go. Leaving the Sekimeiya out of the cabinet for fifteen minutes resulted in twenty minutes traveled. Just now, I went back a little over forty, but I don't know how long the Sekimeiya was in the locker; it shouldn't have been there to begin with.
entries.new: 我不确定自己会回到多早以前。让 Sekimeiya 离开展示柜十五分钟，换来的是二十分钟的穿越。刚才我回到了四十多分钟前，可我不知道 Sekimeiya 在储物柜里放了多久——它本来就不该在那里。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Meaning that I have no clue how much the distance traveled advances each minute out of the cabinet. If it goes at a consistent rate, two hours wouldn't make me travel incredibly far back. As it stands, I wouldn't appear two weeks ago.
entries.new: 也就是说，我完全不知道它在展示柜外每多待一分钟，穿越的距离会增加多少。如果速率恒定，两个小时也不会让我回到太远的地方。照这样算，我不可能出现在两周前。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: But what if I did somehow? What if I could save Miiya this way and prevent that entire thing? Would another Atsuki get to live a carefree and ignorant life, unaware of today's events while I still had to exist?
entries.new: 可万一真能做到呢？万一我能用这个办法救下 Miiya，阻止那一切？会不会有另一个 Atsuki 过上无忧无虑、对今天的事毫不知情的日子，而我却仍然要存在下去？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I had to understand how it worked before thinking of applications. If I did something like that, I'd leave behind everything. That included the note I'd found, Shiroya's strange behavior, and everything I'd been attempting to reason out. Of course, the result would more than justify it.
entries.new: 我得先弄清它的原理，再谈怎么利用。真做出那种事，我就会抛下这里的一切——包括我找到的那张字条、Shiroya 古怪的举动，以及我一直试图理清的所有事情。当然，若真能成功，这一切都值得。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I went back to a distant thought. Could it be that the shutter wasn't going to move at {time=21} so that the Sekimeiya would store enough time to grant a lengthy travel?
entries.new: 我又想起了先前的一个念头。卷帘门在 {time=21} 时不会动，会不会就是为了让 Sekimeiya 积蓄足够的时间，从而换来一次长距离的穿越？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: How would that be accomplished? I was thinking about making the recording a reality just because I'd heard it, but I wouldn't complain about the origin of events if I could achieve it. However, I still understood too little about the Sekimeiya to consider anything like that. Could I know that waiting a month would be enough just because that was the time I'd heard in the recording?
entries.new: 那要怎样才能做到？我仅仅因为听过那段录音，就想着要让它成真；不过只要能实现，我也不会去追究事情的起因。可我对 Sekimeiya 的了解还太少，根本无从设想这种事。难道就因为录音里听到的是那个时间，我就能断定等上一个月就够了？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I let go of that idea. To begin with, I had no way of prolonging our stay, and as I'd previously considered, we couldn't survive for that long without food. Despite my important discovery, the recording still made no sense.
entries.new: 我放弃了这个念头。首先，我没办法延长我们停留的时间；而且正如之前想过的，没有食物，我们撑不了那么久。尽管有了重要发现，那段录音依然说不通。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: In reality, not many things did. I could run through the day's events and find continuous unexplained mysteries. Had someone been changing reality around us, resulting in inconsistent memories and different pasts? That felt too unknowable to consider, and there was virtually no way to know if it had happened.
entries.new: 事实上，说得通的事本来就不多。把今天发生的事过一遍，处处都是悬而未解的谜团。是不是有人一直在改变我们周遭的现实，才造成记忆对不上、过去各不相同？这个念头太过难以揣测，而且几乎没有办法确认它是否真的发生过。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The replicated location, the self-teleportation of the Sekimeiya... There were many unknown factors needed to construct a sound plan that involved changing the past.
entries.new: 被复制出来的地点、Sekimeiya 自行传送……要想制订一个涉及改变过去的周全计划，未知因素实在太多。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I kept waiting, as I wanted to surpass the point I'd traveled from.
entries.new: ……我继续等着，因为我想等过自己出发穿越的那个时刻。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Minutes later, I thought that going up was probably a good idea. Someone had to have intercepted our elevator trip on the third floor, and it was very possible my change downstairs hadn't influenced their actions at all. If I went up, maybe I would see them.
entries.new: 几分钟后，我觉得上楼大概是个好主意。当初一定有人在三楼拦下了我们的电梯，而我在楼下做的改变很可能根本没影响到那人的行动。上去的话，也许就能见到对方。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Blood had stopped coming out of my wound, so I removed the toilet paper and flushed it. The sensation was uncomfortable, but it no longer hurt much. I still wasn't sure how I'd managed to injure myself like that, but if I didn't make abrupt motions with my arm, I could tolerate it easily.
entries.new: 伤口已经不再流血，我便把卫生纸取下来冲掉了。那感觉不太舒服，但已经不怎么疼。我仍不清楚自己怎么会伤成那样，不过只要手臂不做突然的动作，倒也不难忍受。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I walked up to the third floor. There was nobody in sight, so it was best to hide.
entries.new: 我走上三楼。四下不见人影，最好先躲起来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It was possible they would flee if they saw me—I needed to approach them when I knew they were close to the elevator.
entries.new: 对方看到我，也许会逃走——我得等到确定他们靠近电梯时再上前。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I entered the second partition, as I estimated a few minutes were left until the time we'd been intercepted.
entries.new: 我进了第二个隔间，估计离我们被拦截的时间还剩几分钟。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'd been in the lower bathroom for about twenty minutes, so I'd have to wait a little more. Unfortunately, since it was highly unlikely Erina and I would still take the elevator at the same time, I wouldn't have a way to know if I'd missed my target.
entries.new: 我在楼下洗手间待了大约二十分钟，所以还得再等一会儿。可惜，我和 Erina 已经几乎不可能再同时乘坐电梯了，我也没法知道自己有没有错过目标。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Once again, the silence gave no indication of the ticking seconds. I waited for minutes moving back and forth between the second and third partitions, waiting for my cue to get out.
entries.new: 寂静依旧，听不出分秒流逝。我在第二个和第三个隔间之间来回踱了几分钟，等着出去的时机。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It wasn't coming. Would I hear their movements if someone was nearby? I felt I was really close to the time we'd been stopped on that floor.
entries.new: 没有来。如果有人就在附近，我能听见动静吗？我觉得离我们当时在那层被拦下的时刻已经很近了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I left the offices. The corridor leading to the elevator was empty.
entries.new: 我离开办公区。通往电梯的走廊空无一人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I kept staring at it, but I felt no trace of life.
entries.new: 我盯着那里看了许久，却感觉不到一丝活人的气息。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Had the impact of my action on the crystal floor been large enough to remove the existence of whoever had initially intercepted us? I turned around and peeked at the opposite hallway, where the stairs led to floor 2.
entries.new: 我在水晶层的举动，影响是否大到让当初拦截我们的人根本不曾存在？我转过身，朝对面那条通往二楼楼梯的走廊瞥了一眼。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I felt no difference. If nobody was around, would I have to present myself downstairs and explain what I'd done?
entries.new: 我没有感到任何不同。如果周围真的没人，我是否该下楼现身，说明自己做了什么？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Huh?
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: The elevator? I ran back and saw something I thought I couldn't see.
entries.new: 电梯？我跑回去，看见了本以为绝不可能看见的景象。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: That's me...{w} and Erina, as well. I remember those movements.
entries.new: 那是我……{w}还有 Erina。那些动作我记得。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: From a distance, I heard my own yells and saw blood pouring out of my hand...
entries.new: 远远地，我听见自己的喊叫，看见血从我手上涌出……
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It was repeating. Despite what I'd done, the scene played out just like I remembered it.
entries.new: 它在重演。尽管我做了那些事，这一幕仍和我记忆中一模一样地展开。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I backed off, knowing Erina would turn around and see an empty corridor. Then, abruptly, my past self closed himself in the elevator and left her outside, puzzled.
entries.new: 我退开了，知道 Erina 转过身只会看到一条空荡的走廊。随后，过去的我突然把自己关进电梯，把她满腹疑惑地留在外面。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...How's this possible? I know it was a small change, but how is it possible it all still led to this, occurring just like I remember it?
entries.new: ……这怎么可能？我知道那只是个小改动，可它怎么还会变成这样，一切都和我记忆里一模一样？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I stepped out, my footsteps alerting Erina.
entries.new: 我走了出去，脚步声惊动了 Erina。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: No Longer Anywhere
entries.new: 无处可寻

entries.text: What...? A-Atsuki!
entries.new: 什么……？A、Atsuki！
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: I waved awkwardly and approached her.
entries.new: 我有些尴尬地挥了挥手，朝她走去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It's not bleeding anymore... What did you do?
entries.new: 不流血了……你做了什么？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: I used the Sekimeiya to travel to the past, and this time it worked. I wanted to get rid of the wound, but it simply stopped the bleeding, even though I'm not sure why.
entries.new: 我用 Sekimeiya 穿越回了过去，这次成功了。我本想让伤口消失，结果它只是止了血，我自己也说不清为什么。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Wait... What? There's no way.
entries.new: 等等……什么？不可能。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: No way what, exactly? That I traveled through time?
entries.new: 什么不可能？我穿越时间这件事吗？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Yes! How did you do it?
entries.new: 对！你是怎么做到的？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: By touching the Sekimeiya. What's wrong?
entries.new: 碰一下 Sekimeiya 就行。怎么了？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Nothing... I'm just... a bit confused. Ignore me. I'm happy the wound got better.
entries.new: 没什么……我只是……有点糊涂。别在意。伤口好了，我很高兴。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: I was a bit taken aback by her words. Was she the exact same Erina I remembered?
entries.new: 她的话让我有些意外。她还是我记忆里的那个 Erina 吗？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Do you understand now why we stopped on this floor?
entries.new: 你现在明白我们为什么停在这一层了吗？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Sorry, I don't. Are you sure you didn't hit the button accidentally?
entries.new: 抱歉，我不明白。你确定不是不小心按到了按钮？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Yes...{w} Should we keep going up?
entries.new: 嗯……{w}要继续往上走吗？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Hang on... What do you remember?
entries.new: 等一下……你记得什么？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Hm?
entries.new: 嗯？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Earlier, did we hear a loud door being slammed in hallway A?
entries.new: 刚才，我们是不是听到 A走廊 传来很响的摔门声？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: ...{w}When, exactly?
entries.new: ……{w}具体是什么时候？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: About 35 minutes ago.
entries.new: 大概三十五分钟前。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Uh...{w} I... don't know. My head is still a bit foggy, but I don't remember that.
entries.new: 呃……{w}我……不知道。脑子还有点迷糊，可我不记得有过这回事。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Why are you asking, though? Did we hear it?
entries.new: 不过你怎么突然问这个？我们听到了吗？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: ...I'm not sure. We must have.
entries.new: ……我不确定。应该是听到了。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: It was bizarre. Why had we used the elevator to follow Shiroya when she never went up?
entries.new: 实在蹊跷。Shiroya 根本没上楼，我们为什么要坐电梯去追她？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Did Erina not remember the sound because she hadn't heard it or because of her mental state?
entries.new: Erina 不记得那声音，是因为她没听见，还是因为她当时的精神状态？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Had realities... converged?
entries.new: 现实……重合了吗？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Let's wait a second. Sai and Akaro should be coming, right?
entries.new: 先等一会儿。Sai 和 Akaro 应该会过来吧？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: That's what they said.
entries.new: 他们是这么说的。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: I want to talk to them.
entries.new: 我想和他们谈谈。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: She looked uncertain, but she didn't complain. I began to walk in circles, wondering what to make of the baffling result.
entries.new: 她一脸茫然，却没有抱怨什么。我原地来回踱步，思索这个令人费解的结果。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: A minute later, nobody had come. It was absolutely enough time for Sai and Akaro to arrive at the third floor...
entries.new: 一分钟后，还是没人来。这点时间，怎么都够 Sai 和 Akaro 赶到三楼了……
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wait here. I'll be back in a second.
entries.new: 在这儿等着，我马上回来。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: What...?
entries.new: 什么……？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Explaining myself would've been a waste of time, especially considering the condition she was in.
entries.new: 解释也只是浪费时间，何况她现在是那个状态。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I circled down the floors until I arrived at the last staircase, not seeing anyone along the way.
entries.new: 我顺着楼梯一层层往下，一直走到最后一段，沿途一个人也没遇见。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Hm...? Oh, it's you.
entries.new: 嗯……？哦，是你啊。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Through the gray door, I saw Sai. He didn't receive me with clear hostility, so I went down the staircase.
entries.new: 透过那扇灰门，我看见了 Sai。他对我并没有明显的敌意，我便走下楼梯。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Where's Akaro?
entries.new: ……Akaro 呢？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Hell if I know. Why?
entries.new: 我哪知道。怎么了？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Was that a result of my action? Akaro had come from hallway A, where I'd made the sound. Had that made him not appear?
entries.new: 这是我那番举动造成的吗？Akaro 本是从 A走廊 过来的，声音也是我在那里弄出的。难道就因为这个，他才没有出现？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Are you alone?
entries.new: ……你一个人？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Erina's above us.{w} By the way, about 35 minutes ago, did you hear the sound of a door closing coming from hallway A?
entries.new: Erina 在上面。{w}对了，大概三十五分钟前，你有没有听到 A走廊 传来关门的声音？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: What?{w} What kind of question is that?
entries.new: 啊？{w}这问的是什么话？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Just answer. Did you?
entries.new: 回答我就是了。听到了吗？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: ...{w}{tip=lie}Yes{/tip}, why?
entries.new: ……{w}{tip=lie}听到了{/tip}，怎么了？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Something caught my attention. On the floor of hallway C, there were new drops of blood, close to drying.
entries.new: 有什么引起了我的注意。C走廊 的地板上，落着几滴新血，眼看就要干了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Do you recognize these drops? Have they always been here?
entries.new: 这些血迹你认得吗？一直都在这里？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Oh, yes, I saw them before. Are they from that wound? What happened?
entries.new: 哦，认得，之前就见过。是那道伤流的血吗？出什么事了？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: When Erina and I had taken the elevator, those drops hadn't existed. There were too many of them to think I hadn't seen them.{w} Sai was definitely living in the reality I'd changed, but I wasn't sure the same could be said for Erina.
entries.new: 我和 Erina 乘电梯经过时，那里还没有这些血迹。数量不少，我不可能没看见。{w}Sai 无疑活在我改变过的现实里，但 Erina 是否也一样，我就说不准了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I knew that was my blood and that I'd left it behind when I'd run away after slamming the door. As soon as I'd psyched myself up to alter the past, all my actions had surely been allowed to differ from what I'd experienced, including unconscious ones such as leaving blood behind.
entries.new: 我知道那是我的血，是我摔上门跑开时留下的。从我下定决心改变过去的那一刻起，我的所有行动就必然可以和原本的经历不一样——包括留下血迹这类无意识的举动。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I looked next to us, and as I thought, the other trail of blood was coming from the elevator. It was from the time I'd gone down after suffering the injury; the floor was proof of both realities at once.
entries.new: 我看了看身旁，果然，另一道血迹来自电梯方向。那是我受伤之后下楼时留下的；这一层的地板，同时印证着两个现实。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Are you just not going to answer me? Where's Shiroya, by the way? Is she in the attic?
entries.new: 你就打算一直不回答我？对了，Shiroya 呢？她在阁楼里？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...Why would she be?
entries.new: ……她怎么会在那儿？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: What's with these questions? She's not with you, so I figured she might be somewhere we can't get to.
entries.new: 你今天怎么尽问些怪问题？她既然不在你身边，我就猜她是不是待在我们进不去的地方。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Oh, right... The attic is locked, isn't it?
entries.new: 哦，对……阁楼是锁着的吧？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: It was just a bit ago.
entries.new: 刚刚才锁上的。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: But you have the key. That's how you entered it when you were chasing us.
entries.new: 可钥匙在你手上。你追我们的时候，不就是用它进去的吗？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: ...Excuse me? I don't have the key, no.{w} You can search me if you want. I don't have it.
entries.new: ……你说什么？我没有钥匙。{w}不信可以搜我的身，我没有。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: It was all too confusing. Sai had suddenly undergone yet another change in behavior, and just like the previous ones, I couldn't make sense of it. Everything had become just as incomprehensible as I'd feared. I couldn't discern what I'd changed and what I hadn't.
entries.new: 这一切太混乱了。Sai 的态度又突然变了，和之前几次一样，我完全摸不着头脑。事情到底还是变得像我担心的那样，让人没法理解。我分不清哪些是我改变的，哪些不是。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Is there nobody else on the crystal floor?
entries.new: 水晶层上就没有别人了吗？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: There shouldn't be.
entries.new: 按理说不该有。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...{w}Let's go up, then. Shiroya might actually be in the attic.
entries.new: ……{w}那就上去看看吧。Shiroya 说不定真在阁楼里。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: He shrugged and followed me up.
entries.new: 他耸了耸肩，跟在我身后上了楼。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: On the way, we found Erina, who'd been waiting for my return. She didn't welcome us, and her eyes looked even more empty than before.
entries.new: 半路上，我们碰见了正等我回来的 Erina。她没有欢迎我们，眼神比先前更加空洞。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: She also didn't reply to Sai's carefree greeting, opting to silently follow us. The attic door was three floors above.
entries.new: Sai 随口跟她打了声招呼，她也没有回应，只是默默跟在我们后面。阁楼的门在三层楼上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I told you. It's locked.{w} Do you not have the key?
entries.new: 我说过了，门锁着。{w}你没带钥匙？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: No... It's possible Shiroya does.
entries.new: 没有……钥匙也许在 Shiroya 手里。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Maybe she locked herself inside, then.
entries.new: 那说不定是她自己把自己锁在里面了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I remembered what I'd concluded earlier. Had I never been able to follow her into the attic?
entries.new: 我想起自己刚才得出的结论。难道我始终没能跟着她进阁楼？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: No matter what... I felt like Sai had to be lying. He had unlocked the door previously to chase us.
entries.new: 无论如何……我都觉得 Sai 在说谎。之前他为了追我们，明明把这扇门打开过。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Like we'd thought, he could've accomplished it by traveling inside and unlocking the door with our key, but since we'd still found it on the floor, it was very likely another one had been used.
entries.new: 正如我们所料，他也可能先穿越进去，用我们的钥匙开了门；可既然那把钥匙还留在地上，他用的多半是另一把。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If he was telling the truth, I thought that perhaps someone else had entered the attic while Sai had waited downstairs to ambush us...
entries.new: 如果他没说谎，那也许是在 Sai 守在楼下伏击我们的时候，另有某人进了阁楼……
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Hey! Shiroya! Are you inside?{w} Why would you lock yourself in like this!?
entries.new: 喂！Shiroya！你在里面吗？{w}干嘛把自己锁在这种地方啊！？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Was he just fucking around while he knew where the key was? Even if Shiroya was inside, why would she have chosen to stay hidden...?
entries.new: 他明明知道钥匙在哪儿，却还在这里演戏？就算 Shiroya 真在里面，她又为什么偏要躲着不出来……？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Do what you said earlier and show me your pockets.
entries.new: 照你刚才说的，把口袋翻给我看。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Do you not trust me? I suppose I almost killed you. Sure.
entries.new: 你信不过我？也难怪，我差点要了你的命。行吧。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...Huh?
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: I'm just kidding, of course. ...Anyway, you can see all my pockets are empty.
entries.new: 当然是开玩笑的。……总之，你也看到了，我所有口袋都是空的。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I sighed and did what I'd done in the bedroom. I felt his clothes until I could be sure that he wasn't hiding anything.
entries.new: 我叹了口气，像在卧室里那样把他身上摸了一遍，确认他没有藏着东西。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Are you sure she couldn't be anywhere else?
entries.new: 你确定她不可能在别的地方？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: We haven't searched the whole building, no, but she should still be here.
entries.new: 我们确实没有搜遍整栋楼，但她应该还在这里。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Then she must be hiding intentionally, and there's nothing we can do about that.
entries.new: 那她一定是故意躲着，我们也拿她没办法。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Maybe she'll come out eventually... Let's go back down for now.
entries.new: 说不定她迟早会出来……我们先下楼吧。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: I agree. She must not like you very much and prefers to be alone.
entries.new: 我赞成。她多半不待见你，宁愿一个人待着。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Wait, no. You're definitely lying.
entries.new: 等等，不对。你肯定在骗人。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Me? I don't ever lie.
entries.new: 我？我可从来不撒谎。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: You don't have any keys on you. That proves you hid them, because you should have the cabinet key.
entries.new: 你身上一把钥匙都没有，这正说明你把钥匙藏起来了。你本该带着展示柜钥匙的。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: The Sekimeiya cabinet's? Why would I?
entries.new: Sekimeiya 展示柜的？我为什么要带那个？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I saw it in your hand before you and Shiroya traveled!
entries.new: 你和 Shiroya 穿越之前，我亲眼看见它在你手里！
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Strangely, though, I don't have it. Check your sight too when you go check your hearing.
entries.new: 可奇怪的是，我身上就是没有。等你哪天去检查听力，顺便把视力也一起查了吧。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Before I could reply, the three of us were looking at the door. The lock clicked, the doorknob turned, and it began to open.
entries.new: 我还没来得及开口，我们三人便一齐望向了那扇门。锁咔哒一响，门把手转动，门开了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...!{w} You're all right!
entries.new: ……！{w}你们没事！
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: From the other side of the door, Shiroya looked directly into my eyes as she panted in exhaustion.
entries.new: 门后，Shiroya 跑得气喘吁吁，直直望着我的眼睛。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Oh, she was actually inside. I'm glad we found you.
entries.new: ……哦，原来她真在里面。能找到你真是太好了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Wh-What!? He locked me in here!
entries.new: 什、什么！？是他把我锁在里面的！
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: What?
entries.new: 什么？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Me? That's funny. I locked you in, but the key's in the keyhole, right?
entries.new: 我？真有意思。是我把你锁进去的——可钥匙不就插在锁孔里吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: It was her. Not the Shiroya who'd mysteriously chosen to leave by herself, but the one I'd been with the entire time. She had her normal clothes very slightly stained with smoke and still looked at me, glad to see me again.
entries.new: 是她。不是那个莫名其妙独自离开的 Shiroya，而是一直和我待在一起的那个。她穿着平时的衣服，上面沾了些淡淡的烟痕，依旧望着我，很高兴能再见到我。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Was he acting like he wanted to find me? He locked me in the bedroom!
entries.new: 他装得像是要来找我？明明是他把我锁在卧室里的！
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: I'm sorry?
entries.new: 你说什么？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I've been here for almost two hours! He shut me in!
entries.new: 我在这里困了快两个小时了！是他把我关起来的！
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: So you chose to hole up in the attic and want to blame me for it... why, exactly?
entries.new: 也就是说，你自己躲进阁楼里，还想把账算在我头上……这又是为什么？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Are you okay?
entries.new: 你没事吧？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: She hadn't stopped panting, and her voice was hoarse.
entries.new: 她的喘息还没停下，嗓子也哑了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Yes... I just ran from the bedroom. I'm fine.
entries.new: 嗯……我刚从卧室一路跑过来。我没事。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Let's pretend I locked you in a bedroom. I'm not sure why I'd even do that, but how did you leave?
entries.new: 就当是我把你锁在卧室里好了。我也不清楚自己为什么要那么做，不过你是怎么出来的？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...With the key.
entries.new: ……用钥匙。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: But I thought I trapped you there?
entries.new: 可我不是把你困在里面了吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Yes, but not with the key! I know what you did!
entries.new: 是困住了，可你没用钥匙！你干了什么，我心里清楚！
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: I became a witch and learned magic, huh? We can go with that if you don't want to tell the truth.
entries.new: 我成了魔女，还学会了魔法，是吧？你要是不想说真话，那就当是这么回事好了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...W-Wait! Erina!
entries.new: ……等、等等！Erina！
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Huh?
entries.new: 咦？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: You're alive?
entries.new: 你还活着？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Y-Yes...
entries.new: 是、是的……
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: I'm sorry if this sounds strange, but are you the same Shiroya who disappeared from the event room with Sai?
entries.new: 这话问出来或许有些奇怪，不过……你就是和 Sai 一起从活动室消失的那个 Shiroya 吗？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Hm? Yes, I've been here since then.
entries.new: 嗯？是啊，从那之后我就一直待在这儿。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: I... see.
entries.new: 原来……是这样。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I still didn't understand anything, but I was happy to be reunited with who I thought of as the real Shiroya. The other version of her was the one who had disappeared again, and she had told me that she was the same person. How she would come to exist, though—that, I didn't know.
entries.new: 我依旧什么都不明白，但能和我心目中那个「真正的 Shiroya」重逢，我很高兴。另一个她又一次消失了，而那个她曾告诉我，她们是同一个人。只是她到底是怎么出现的，我就不知道了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We didn't check Erina's pulse, remember...?
entries.new: 我们没确认过 Erina 的脉搏，记得吧……？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: O-Oh! Thank God, and sorry...{w} What's with the blood, though?
entries.new: 啊、啊啊！太好了……抱歉。{w}不过，这血是怎么回事？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: I don't know. I got hit in the head, so my memories are a little fuzzy.
entries.new: 我不知道。我头被撞了一下，记忆有些模糊。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Oh. ...What time is it?
entries.new: 哦。……现在几点了？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Hm... It's {time=19:40.}
entries.new: 嗯……现在是 {time=19:40.}
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: It's so late... What happened while I was here? And your watch is working again?
entries.new: 都这么晚了……我在这里的时候都发生了什么？还有，你的表又能正常走了？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Huh? Yes, of course.
entries.new: 嗯？是啊，当然。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I almost felt at peace. I'd changed reality in some way, but Shiroya had been unaffected up in the attic. She remembered all we'd done, and we'd be able to reach the end of the countdown together.
entries.new: 我几乎感到一丝安心。我以某种方式改变了现实，可待在阁楼上的 Shiroya 却没有受到影响。她记得我们做过的一切，我们也能够一起走到倒计时的尽头。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wait, what's with your clothes? You were wearing different ones.
entries.new: 等等，你的衣服怎么回事？刚才穿的不是这一身吧。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Right. When we went to the past, we lost track of that Shiroya, but she still has to be around. I'm confused, though. Where did she come from?
entries.new: 对。我们去到过去之后，就跟那个 Shiroya 断了线索，可她一定还在某处。不过我还是想不通——她究竟是从哪里来的？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Wh-What...?
entries.new: 什、什么……？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: "When we went to the past". I see. He was the only one to travel, but he thinks we all did. He thinks we all appeared separately in the past and that we've been unable to find Shiroya since then. I'm not completely sure why that would be his assumption, though.
entries.new: 「我们去到过去」……原来如此。真正穿越的只有他一个人，他却以为我们都去了。他以为我们各自分散地出现在过去，而且从那之后一直找不到 Shiroya。只是他为什么会这样想，我还不完全明白。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: However, one thing is strange. Sai's watch reads {time=19:40}, which I'm pretty sure is the real time. That must mean he's synced it properly.
entries.new: 不过，有一件事很奇怪。Sai 的表显示 {time=19:40}，我基本可以确定这正是真实时间。也就是说，他已经把表校准好了。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Can you come with me for a second?
entries.new: 能跟我来一下吗？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Y-Yeah.
entries.new: 好、好的。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Can't you just talk openly here?
entries.new: 在这儿不能直接说吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I ignored him and brought Shiroya down a floor.
entries.new: 我没理他，带着 Shiroya 下了一层楼。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: You know Sai's lying, right? He really locked me in a bedroom and told me you died...! I was so worried.
entries.new: 你知道 Sai 在撒谎吧？他真的把我锁在卧室里，还说你死了……！我担心得要命。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: What...? Don't worry, I believe you, even though I still don't understand Sai very much. I wanted to tell you about what just happened.
entries.new: 什么……？放心吧，我相信你——虽然我到现在还是不太懂 Sai。我想跟你说说刚才发生的事。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Hm?
entries.new: 嗯？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: I think... the past can be changed somehow.
entries.new: 我觉得……过去似乎是可以改变的。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: It can...? Did you try it?
entries.new: 真的能……？你试过了？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: I did, but I'm not sure what to make of the results.
entries.new: 试过了，可结果让我有些拿不准。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: It's possible what I changed only affected some people. I definitely went back in time and altered the events I'd experienced. Sai recognizes the change, but I'm not sure Erina does.
entries.new: 我改变的东西，可能只影响了一部分人。我确实回到了过去，改变了我经历过的那些事。Sai 记得这个变化，但 Erina 似乎并不记得。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: It felt like both realities met, leading into differing memories. That could be what happened to Akaro, when his version of events contradicted ours. Maybe someone made some change that didn't affect us, or maybe it didn't affect Akaro.
entries.new: 感觉就像是两个现实交汇在一起，各自留下了不同的记忆。Akaro 那件事或许也是同样的情况——他经历的事情和我们所说的对不上。也许是有人做了什么改动，却没有波及我们；也可能那改动并没有波及 Akaro。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: That sounds way too complicated... I'm not sure I follow, but you mean...
entries.new: 这也太复杂了……我没太听懂，不过你的意思是……
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: If we go to the past, I'm pretty sure we could drastically change the way things played out. It's possible some people would still remember this reality, but the change should persist.{w} It's possible two realities just converged, but the real one comes from my change. It overlapped the last one despite some people potentially still remembering it.
entries.new: 只要回到过去，我们肯定能大幅改变事情的走向。也许有些人仍会记得这个现实，但改动本身应该会保留下来。{w}两个现实也可能就这样汇合了，但真正的那个，来自我的改动。它覆盖了上一个现实，尽管有些人可能还记得那一个。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Or was that really the case? I hesitated when I remembered the floor of hallway C. The two trails of blood, one from before the change and the other from after it, signified that we were living in a mix of both realities.
entries.new: 可真的是这样吗？想到 C 走廊的地面，我迟疑了。那两道血迹，一道来自改动之前，一道来自改动之后，说明我们正活在两个现实混合的状态里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The things I was saying sounded complicated, but in practice, all they meant was that the past could be changed if we consciously wanted it to. Lingering memories might've been an issue for unaffected people, making them think they were in the wrong reality, but that was a minor issue given what we could accomplish.{w} Of course, I wasn't fully aware of how it worked. I didn't know why some memories could remain or what determined the people who kept them, but factually altering history was all that mattered.
entries.new: 我说的那些听起来复杂，实际上不过是——只要我们有意识地去做，过去就可以被改变。残留的记忆或许会给未受影响的人带来困扰，让他们以为自己身处错误的现实；但比起我们能达成的事，这只是小问题。{w}当然，我并不完全清楚其中的原理。我不知道为什么有些记忆会留存，也说不准是哪些人保留了记忆；但只要事实上能改写历史，其他都无关紧要。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Let's keep going.
entries.new: 继续走吧。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: We had some remaining time to try piecing together the information we needed. The Sekimeiya should've still been downstairs.
entries.new: 我们还剩一些时间，可以试着把需要的情报拼凑起来。Sekimeiya 应该还在楼下。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I last traveled from the staff room. Let's go there.
entries.new: 我上一次是从员工室穿越的。我们去那儿吧。
entries.speaker: a
