entries.text: That was where we headed. On the way, I checked my pocket and saw I still had the locker key. Fortunately, the note was no longer there, although I still couldn't understand why.
entries.new: 我们便朝那里走去。半路上，我摸了摸口袋，发现储物柜的钥匙还在。幸好，那张纸条已经不在了——尽管我仍不明白为什么。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The note, the several mentions of Miiya, and Shiroya's death... Those occurred despite the factual reality, which is that Miiya is dead and Shiroya is alive.
entries.new: 那张纸条、几次三番提到的 Miiya、还有 Shiroya 的死……这些都与真正的事实相抵触——事实上，死的是 Miiya，Shiroya 还活着。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: What's all this blood...?
entries.new: 这么多血是怎么回事……？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: It's mine. As you can see, I hurt my hand in the elevator. I don't even know why it stopped bleeding.
entries.new: 是我的。如你所见，我在电梯里弄伤了手。连我自己都不知道它为什么止住了血。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Does it hurt? That's kind of a lot.
entries.new: 疼吗？流得还挺多的。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Don't worry, it's fine...
entries.new: 别担心，没事的……
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: When we stepped into the room, we saw that the locker was open. That made sense, as I hadn't closed it before traveling.
entries.new: 走进房间时，我们看到储物柜是开着的。这也说得通，因为穿越前我并没有关上它。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...!{w} It's gone.
entries.new: ……！{w}不见了。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Did you leave it in this locker? How?
entries.new: 你是把它留在这个储物柜里了？怎么会？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: I found the key in the cleaning room. I know how that sounds, but I guess no one needed a key to get it. I touched it with the locker open.
entries.new: 钥匙是我在清洁间找到的。我知道这话听着离谱，但估计谁都不需要钥匙就能拿到它。我碰它的时候，柜门是开着的。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Oh... Could anyone have taken it, then?
entries.new: 哦……那有没有可能被别人拿走了？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: It would've been easy, but I'm not completely sure. The door doesn't look like it moved, so it also could've teleported.{w} While you were in the attic, we saw that happen. I definitely witnessed the Sekimeiya teleport to its cabinet.{w} But Sai could've easily grabbed it. Akaro as well. I saw him, and he should still be here somewhere. It was before I changed the past, but all I did was draw attention to hallway A. There's no way that was enough to overwrite Akaro's existence.
entries.new: 那本来很容易得手，但我也说不准。柜门看上去不像动过，所以它也可能是自己传送走的。{w}你在阁楼那会儿，我们见过这种事。我确实亲眼看见 Sekimeiya 传送进了它的展示柜。{w}但 Sai 完全可以顺手把它拿走，Akaro 也一样。我见过他，他应该还在这栋楼的某处。那是在我改变过去之前，可我只是把注意力引到了 A走廊。那点影响绝不可能抹掉 Akaro 的存在。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I went to the event room. Earlier, I had suspected the Sekimeiya teleported inside the cabinet, but it wasn't there.
entries.new: 我去了活动室。先前我怀疑 Sekimeiya 传送进了展示柜里，但它不在那儿。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: *sigh*
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I'd hoped we'd find it. If we wanted to change the past, it was better if we traveled together so that both of us could keep the memory of our original reality.
entries.new: 我本来还指望能找到它。如果真想改变过去，我们最好一起穿越，这样两个人都能保留原本现实的记忆。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Like always, whether it teleported or someone hid it, it has to be nearby and in a place we can access. We can find it.
entries.new: 和之前一样，不管它是自己传送走了，还是被人藏了起来，它一定就在附近，而且在我们进得去的地方。我们找得到。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: She was right. It was one of our first questions: "why would someone hide the Sekimeiya if we'll find it no matter where it is?" If it had been teleporting, that question would be obsolete.
entries.new: 她说得对。这是我们最初就提出的问题之一：「既然不管 Sekimeiya 在哪儿，我们都会找到，那为什么还要把它藏起来？」如果它一直在传送，这个问题就不成立了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: However, with the inclusion of the storeroom's hidden door, it was always possible a successful plan had already stolen it, and there were a few unreachable places, such as the remaining lockers.
entries.new: 不过，既然储藏室里还有暗门，就始终存在一种可能：别人已经得手，把它偷走了。况且还有几处我们进不去的地方，比如其余那些储物柜。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Oh, yeah, the Sekimeiya's gone. I was searching for it before we went up.
entries.new: 哦，对，Sekimeiya 不见了。我们上楼之前，我就在找它。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...I'm sure you were.
entries.new: ……你当然找过了。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Sai entered from hallway A, alone.
entries.new: Sai 独自一人从 A走廊走了进来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There's not much time left... Let's wait for the shutter to open.
entries.new: 没多少时间了……等卷帘门打开吧。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What about the Sekimeiya?
entries.new: Sekimeiya 呢？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Who knows? I couldn't find it, but why do you care?{w} Akaro might be responsible, and he could have taken it outside. If that happened, there's nothing we can do.{w} However, if it's still inside, the police will find it immediately, right? It can be hidden from us, but not from them.
entries.new: 谁知道呢。反正我没找到。不过这跟你有什么关系？{w}说不定是 Akaro 干的，他可能已经把它带到外面去了。如果真是那样，我们也没办法。{w}不过，它要是还在楼里，警察一进来就能找到，不是吗？它能瞒过我们，却瞒不过他们。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: The hallway B door opened.
entries.new: B走廊的门开了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Erina, do you know where the Sekimeiya might be?
entries.new: Erina，你知道 Sekimeiya 可能在哪儿吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What...? No, I don't.
entries.new: 什么……？不，我不知道。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Then none of us do. If it was deliberately hidden, I don't see the point in searching for it anymore.
entries.new: 那就是谁都不知道了。如果它是被人故意藏起来的，我看再找下去也没有意义。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: You know where it is, right?
entries.new: 你知道它在哪儿，对吧？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: You're free to enlighten me. If I knew where it was, what would my endgame be? Hoping the police don't find it? There's no way that would happen.{w} Someone took it when we weren't around. That must mean they have the means to conceal it from both us and the police. Otherwise, hiding it is pointless.
entries.new: 那你不妨告诉我。如果我知道它在哪儿，我到底图什么？指望警察找不到它？那绝不可能。{w}有人趁我们不在时拿走了它。那说明对方有办法把它藏得让我们和警察都找不到，否则藏起来根本没有意义。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: You say that, but it's been happening since this morning, and it was never hidden in a place the police wouldn't have inspected.
entries.new: 话是这么说，可这种事从今早就一直在发生，而它从来没被藏到警察不会去查的地方。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: You could have a plan, too. When the police enter, as soon as they find the Sekimeiya, they'll activate it. That'll make everyone around it disappear, leaving a free path for you to retrieve it.
entries.new: 你也可能另有打算。警察一进来，只要找到 Sekimeiya，就会触发它。它周围的人都会消失，正好给你让出一条路，让你把它拿走。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Are you even listening to yourself? You think I want to steal the Sekimeiya? Sure, I wouldn't say no to having it, but that's not gonna work out.{w} First of all, they'd simply appear in the past. If a bunch of people time travel, the panic would ruin any kind of plan like that. At least a few people have to know what the Sekimeiya is capable of too, right? Why would they send the police to grab it if they know what touching it would do?
entries.new: 你自己听听这话像话吗？你觉得我想偷 Sekimeiya？是，我不介意把它弄到手，可那根本行不通。{w}首先，他们只会出现在过去。那么多人一起时间穿越，引发的恐慌足以毁掉这种计划。再说，总该有几个人知道 Sekimeiya 有什么能耐吧？他们若知道一碰它会发生什么，又怎么会派警察去拿？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I think I agree with him... That wouldn't work.
entries.new: 我觉得他说得有道理……那样行不通。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Hiding the Sekimeiya is pointless, that's a fact. Incidentally, there's no place the police would ignore. What that means is that if the Sekimeiya's here, there's no reason to search for it. What I find most likely is that it's already outside, though.
entries.new: 藏起 Sekimeiya 没有意义，这是事实。再说，这楼里没有哪个地方会被警察漏掉。也就是说，如果 Sekimeiya 还在这里，我们根本没必要去找。不过，我认为最可能的情况是它已经被带到外面去了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...{w}All right. I agree, so let's just wait.
entries.new: ……{w}好吧。我同意，那就等着吧。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Shiroya gave me a dubious look, but I had to ignore it.
entries.new: Shiroya 用怀疑的眼神看了我一眼，我只能装作没看见。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Perfect. We've had enough headaches, so let's go to the lobby.
entries.new: 很好。头疼的事已经够多了，我们去大厅吧。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I didn't actually agree at all, but more than an hour remained. If Sai was up to something, it was too early to try preventing it.
entries.new: 我其实一点也不认同，但离时限还有一个多小时。若 Sai 真在打什么主意，现在就出手阻止还太早。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Shiroya's look told me she was thinking the same. Closer to the deadline, we'd push for a building search. That way, if we found the Sekimeiya, Sai wouldn't have time to arrange anything else.
entries.new: Shiroya 的眼神告诉我，她也是这么想的。等临近最后期限，我们再推动全楼搜查。这样一来，就算找到 Sekimeiya，Sai 也没时间再布置别的了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I couldn't forget that Sai had tried to kill us. Under specific circumstances, he was willing to go that far.
entries.new: 我忘不了 Sai 曾想杀我们。在特定情况下，他真会走到那一步。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Part of me had to seriously consider that he was a Xyn plant. We had surmised early on that it was possible one of us trapped inside could be from Xyn, and Sai had sown chaos the entire time he'd been in the building, even if Katei was clearly suspicious anyway. It almost felt too obvious, given how completely unconcerned he was with the safety of others, and brandishing a knife at us didn't really earn him any points either.
entries.new: 我不得不认真考虑一种可能：他是 Xyn 安插的内线。我们早就推测过，困在楼里的人中，可能有一个是 Xyn 的人；而 Sai 从进楼起就一直在制造混乱，尽管 Katei 显然早就怀疑上他了。他对他人的安危全然不顾，这几乎显得太过明显；更别提他还朝我们亮过刀，这也没给他加什么分。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I had deeply wanted to find out whatever I could and expose anyone responsible for the attack... but that had rapidly become quite difficult given the way things had gone. Even with all the information I had, I couldn't definitely conclude that he was responsible. I simply didn't know enough.
entries.new: 我原本非常想尽可能查明真相，把袭击的幕后责任人揪出来……但事情发展到这一步，要做到这点已经变得非常困难。即便握有这么多信息，我也无法断定他就是责任人。我知道的实在不够。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What was for sure was that he was exactly the type of person to try to take the Sekimeiya for his own purposes, and I couldn't allow that. He'd been pissing me off the entire day, and after he'd almost killed me, there was no way I'd let him carry out any sort of plan if I could obstruct it. Additionally, I still wanted to find the Sekimeiya, and while it was out of the cabinet, it was storing the power we needed.
entries.new: 唯一确定的是，他正是那种会为了一己目的去抢 Sekimeiya 的人，而我不能容许这种事发生。他这一整天都让我火大，何况他还差点杀了我；只要我能阻挠，就绝不会让他任何计划得逞。再说，我仍然想找到 Sekimeiya——它离开展示柜的这段时间里，一直在储存我们需要的能量。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If the video from all of the cameras was salvageable, there'd be no problem nailing the actual culprit, but I couldn't let something happen in the meantime.
entries.new: 如果所有摄像头的录像都还能恢复，揪出真凶自然不成问题，可我不能让这段时间里再出什么变故。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I whispered to Shiroya.
entries.new: 我低声对 Shiroya 说。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Did you lose the knife?
entries.new: ……那把刀你弄丢了？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Surprisingly, she shook her head and showed me the inside of her purse.
entries.new: 没想到，她摇了摇头，让我看她的手提包里面。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What...? She still has it?
entries.new: 什么……？刀还在她手上？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: When she disappeared from the event room, she had it, but every possible replicated location of hers that held it was placed in the event room too, and that's obviously not where she appeared...
entries.new: 她从活动室消失时，刀还在她身上。而她所有可能带着刀的复制位置，也都集中在活动室；她出现的地方显然不是那里……
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Did you get it from Sai after you two appeared somewhere?
entries.new: 你们俩后来在某个地方出现时，是从 Sai 那里拿到刀的吗？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: No... I still don't understand it either. Both of us appeared in the attic, and I already had it. I'd forgotten to mention it, but yeah, that doesn't make sense with how we thought the Sekimeiya worked.
entries.new: 不是……我自己也一直没想通。我们两个都出现在阁楼，而那时刀已经在我身上了。我忘了提这件事，不过确实，这和我们原先理解的 Sekimeiya 运作方式对不上。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: It was the same as my wound. We'd had the Sekimeiya at our disposal for nearly eleven hours, and despite how much I'd gone over every detail, I was ashamed by how little we'd concluded.
entries.new: 这和我身上的伤一样。将近十一个小时里，Sekimeiya 一直在我们手中，可我反复梳理了每一个细节，最终得出的结论却少得可怜，真让我羞愧。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Okay, let's sit around and wait. I'm exhausted and just want to get out, so I hope nothing else happens. Whatever Xyn or the culprit are up to is no concern of ours anymore...{w} I have no idea what happened to Akaro, but I don't care. If he's behind this whole mess, he'll face the consequences.
entries.new: 好了，我们就坐着等吧。我已经累坏了，只想出去，所以希望别再出什么事。Xyn 或者真凶想做什么，都跟我们无关了……{w}我不知道 Akaro 出了什么事，也不在乎。如果这一团乱麻是他搞出来的，他自会承担后果。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: The four of us sat next to each other on the left of the metal shutter. The entire day had been slow and dense, but it was true that very little time remained. We were nearing the end, and nothing but uncertainty awaited us.
entries.new: 我们四人并排坐在金属卷帘门左侧。这一整天过得又慢又沉，但剩下时间确实不多了。终点将近，等着我们的只有未知。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Exactly one hour and ten minutes. That's all we have to get through to reclaim our freedom.
entries.new: 整整一小时十分钟。只要熬过这段时间，我们就能重获自由。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: One hour and ten minutes... Was there any guarantee that was even correct? I'd lost my sense of time many hours earlier, and while I knew the computer in the security room probably confirmed Sai's time, it was unreasonable to blindly believe it.
entries.new: 一小时十分钟……可这个数字就一定准确吗？早在好几个小时前，我就已经失去时间感了。监控室的电脑大概印证了 Sai 所说的时刻，但盲目相信它未免草率。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Nonetheless, if the time truly was {time=19:50}, the end of the lengthy tunnel was near. Would freedom really be found at its exit, or would a new stretch of confinement begin? We were approaching the time where the truth behind the supposed month-away recording would be settled.
entries.new: 话虽如此，如果此刻真的是 {time=19:50}，那这条漫长的隧道也快到头了。出口处等着的真是自由吗？还是说，新的囚禁才刚要开始？那段号称过了一个月的录音，其真相也快水落石出了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Uncomfortably leaning against the wall, we attempted to relax our bodies. Given Sai's track record and what he was likely after, we wouldn't be there for long.
entries.new: 我们别扭地靠在墙上，想让身体放松下来。照 Sai 以往的作风，以及他多半想要的东西来看，我们不会等太久。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: He'd used a knife against me once. If he opposed us, it was only fair to return the favor.{w} Sai hadn't been wrong in suspecting Katei at the start, seeing through his myriad lies. However, he was insane if he thought he'd done a good job of hiding his own. The overconfidence he'd sheltered himself behind would prove useless if it was seen through.
entries.new: 他对我动过一次刀。若他站在我们的对立面，那我们以牙还牙也理所当然。{w}Sai 一开始就怀疑 Katei，看穿了他形形色色的谎言，这一点并没错。可他要是以为自己的谎瞒得漂亮，那简直是疯了。他拿过度自信当掩护，而那份自信一旦被看穿，就毫无用处。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But, for the time being, we waited. If everything went smoothly until the search, that'd be ideal.
entries.new: 不过眼下，我们只能等。只要到搜查开始前一切顺利，就再好不过了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Wait here. I'm going to the bathroom.
entries.new: ……在这儿等着。我去趟洗手间。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: About half an hour later, Shiroya stood up. It confused me at first, but I soon realized that it was not yet the move we'd silently scheduled for later, as another forty minutes still remained.
entries.new: 大约半小时后，Shiroya 站起身来。我起初有些不解，但很快明白，这还不是我们暗中约好稍后再做的事——离那会儿还有四十分钟。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Oh, all right.
entries.new: 哦，好吧。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Can't you wait?
entries.new: 你就不能忍一忍吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: No. Don't worry, though, I won't go anywhere else.
entries.new: 忍不了。不过放心，我哪儿也不会去。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: She went off to hallway B. Once she disappeared, we continued with our blank looks.
entries.new: 她往 B走廊去了。等她的身影消失，我们几个又继续面无表情地待着。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...{w}She'd better come back quickly.
entries.new: ……{w}她最好快点回来。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...Sai, I understand everything you said, but we should try to find the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: ……Sai，你说的我都明白，可我们还是该去找 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Huh? Why?
entries.new: 啊？为什么？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I-I need it... I can't just let Isla die.
entries.new: 我、我需要它……我不能眼睁睁看着 Isla 死。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: ...{w}Erina, it would be really bad if we searched for the Sekimeiya.{w} It's... difficult to say it, but if we do that, you'll begin to hope your daughter will be saved. I know it's harsh to hear, but it won't end well. We won't find it.
entries.new: ……{w}Erina，我们要是去找 Sekimeiya，那可就糟透了。{w}这话……很难说出口，可一旦去找，你就会开始指望你女儿能得救。我知道听着残忍，但不会有好结果的。我们找不到的。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...Didn't you lie earlier too? Regarding how it worked?
entries.new: ……你刚才不也撒了谎吗？关于它是怎么运作的。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: That wasn't a lie; I don't understand how the Sekimeiya works myself very well. I know I said you'd go far enough back, but something must've gone wrong.
entries.new: 那不算撒谎。我自己也说不太清 Sekimeiya 是怎么运作的。我确实说过你能回到足够久以前，可一定是哪里出了差错。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I also said I wouldn't travel, remember? That was something else I was wrong about. You didn't see it, but the travel encompassed me as well.
entries.new: 我还说过我自己不会穿越，记得吧？这一点我也说错了。你们没看见，可那次穿越把我也卷了进去。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What? No, we did see. You were the only one to travel.
entries.new: 什么？不，我们看见了。穿过去的只有你一个。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: ...{w}What?{w} You had to have traveled as well, right?
entries.new: ……{w}什么？{w}你们应该也穿越了才对，不是吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: She didn't. Only you did.
entries.new: 她没有。只有你。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I hadn't wanted to tell him, as keeping him in the dark felt smarter. However, I was curious to hear what he'd have to say in response.
entries.new: 我本不想告诉他，让他蒙在鼓里似乎更稳妥。可我还是好奇他会怎么回应。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...{w}That... doesn't make any sense, though. Are you telling the truth?
entries.new: ……{w}可这……根本说不通。你们说的是真话？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Yes.
entries.new: 是真的。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Erina nodded as well. Sai stayed pensive for a long while, clearly puzzled by our experience.
entries.new: Erina 也点了点头。Sai 沉默着思索了很久，显然对我们的经历百思不解。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: W-Well, I suppose there's no point in thinking about it anymore. Understanding how the Sekimeiya works in such a short period of time might just be impossible.
entries.new: 那、那什么……再想下去也没用了吧。想在这么短的时间里弄懂 Sekimeiya 的原理，恐怕根本办不到。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: He shrugged and seemingly gave up, but something about the whole situation still felt wrong. It seemed I'd overwritten the reality in which Sai and Akaro had talked to us in hallway B, and the Sai we were talking to had differing memories as a result.
entries.new: 他耸了耸肩，看样子是放弃了，可整件事仍有哪里不对劲。看来是我覆盖掉了 Sai 和 Akaro 在 B走廊与我们交谈的那个现实，眼前这个 Sai 的记忆也因此有所不同。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: However, what kind of sense did they make? He was the only one to travel, meaning that he should have gone twenty minutes into the past. If so, where had that version of him been? If he'd been nearby, he would've known that we hadn't traveled, and he'd told me that he heard the sound I made in hallway A.
entries.new: 可是这样想又哪里说得通？穿越的既然只有他，那他应该回到了二十分钟之前。若真如此，那个他当时在哪里？如果他就在附近，就该知道我们没有穿越——而且他还跟我说过，他听见了我在 A走廊弄出的声响。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It was too labyrinthine. I couldn't understand that whole series of events in the slightest. Warping realities, altered memories, and time travel... Such a conglomeration was bound to be nonsensical.
entries.new: 这太错综复杂了。那一连串事件，我一点也理不清。扭曲的现实、被改写的记忆，再加上时间穿越……这么多东西搅在一起，注定理不出头绪。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: And so I let it go. I wanted to know what had happened, but I was forced to accept it was beyond my comprehension. Perhaps the other Shiroya's appearance would go unexplained for the rest of my life.
entries.new: 于是我放下了。我想知道究竟发生了什么，却不得不承认那超出我的理解。也许另一个 Shiroya 的出现，这辈子都不会有答案。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...{w}But the real one hadn't come back after more than five minutes.{w} In addition, the other one had claimed to be the very same person, indicating that her origin point could still have been coming...
entries.new: ……{w}可真正的 Shiroya 过了五分多钟还没回来。{w}而且另一个她自称就是同一个人，那么她的出发点或许还没到来……
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Stay here. I'll be back in a second.
entries.new: 你们待在这儿。我马上回来。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Really? Are you two just ripping off Katei?
entries.new: 真的假的？你们俩这是在学 Katei 吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I went to hallway B. From there, I could clearly see that nobody was in the women's bathroom.
entries.new: 我去了 B走廊。从那儿一眼就能看清，女洗手间里没有人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: How shocking, she's not there. Are you going to propose we search the whole building to find her?
entries.new: 真叫人吃惊，她不在。接下来你是不是要提议，把整栋楼翻个遍去找她？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Could that have been her intention? To make us look everywhere? ...Wasn't it too early?
entries.new: 这会是她的用意吗？让我们到处去找她？……可这时候动手，未免太早了？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Maybe she went to the bathrooms on floor 2, like Katei.
entries.new: 也许她去了二楼的洗手间，就像 Katei 那样。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: You mean when Katei lied, and in reality, I was the one who went up? In his case, the excuse worked because Naomi's in the men's bathroom. No reason Shiroya would do the same.
entries.new: 你是说 Katei 撒谎那次，其实上去的人是我？他那个借口能成立，是因为 Naomi 在男洗手间里。Shiroya 可没有理由照做。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Sai walked up to the bathrooms and opened the closed door. Through it, we only saw Naomi's second body covered by the curtain.
entries.new: Sai 走到洗手间前，推开了那扇关着的门。门里只看见 Naomi 的第二具身体，被遮布盖着。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Is this your genius plan? To act as if you're searching for Shiroya when your goal is to find the Sekimeiya?
entries.new: 这就是你的妙计？假装在找 Shiroya，其实是想找 Sekimeiya？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: That's not it at all... I don't know where she is.
entries.new: 根本不是那么回事……我真的不知道她在哪儿。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: That can't be what she wants. She knew we could use the knife to force Sai into cooperating. By hiding, she'd be purposely removing it from the equation.
entries.new: 这不可能是她想要的。她清楚我们能用那把刀逼 Sai 就范。她要是藏起来，反而是主动把这筹码从局里抽走了。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Maybe you're right. After all, she could just use this time to search on her own.{w} And nobody else is around... There's no danger to fear.{w} By which I mean, she didn't want to go to the bathroom. She had something else in mind. Are you telling me you don't know what it is?
entries.new: 也许你说得对。毕竟，她完全可以趁这段时间自己去找。{w}而且周围没有别人……没什么好怕的危险。{w}我是说，她根本不是要去洗手间。她另有打算。你是想告诉我，你不知道那是什么？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: No, but that can't be it.
entries.new: 我不知道，可不是那么回事。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: What, then? Akaro came back out of nowhere and did something to her? Did she go to the past even though the Sekimeiya's probably gone? Why? And shouldn't she have come back if that had happened?{w} I told you I was hoping for a calm end to all this. Were you two the ones who hid the Sekimeiya after all?
entries.new: 那是什么？Akaro 凭空冒出来，对她做了什么？还是说，Sekimeiya 明明很可能已经不在了，她却跑到了过去？为什么？真要是那样，她不是早该回来了吗？{w}我说过，我希望这一切能平平静静地收场。该不会，Sekimeiya 其实是你们两个藏起来的吧？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Stop it. I don't know what happened.
entries.new: 别说了。发生了什么我根本不知道。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Shiroya! Are you here!?
entries.new: Shiroya！你在这儿吗！？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: How strange. She's not coming.
entries.new: 真奇怪。她怎么没来。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I went to the event room and verified that the cabinet was still empty. Nothing had changed there.
entries.new: 我去了一趟活动室，确认展示柜里仍旧空空如也。那里没有任何变化。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Could it really have been Akaro? Sai just sounded pretty confident when he said that nobody else is around, but he doesn't know of the reality in which Akaro appeared from hallway A.
entries.new: 真的是 Akaro 吗？Sai 刚才说附近没有别人时语气相当笃定，可他并不知道 Akaro 从 A走廊出现的那段现实。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: From his point of view, Akaro has been missing for hours, ever since they escaped from the bedroom together.{w} Is that it, though? ...Or am I being tricked?
entries.new: 在他看来，两人一起逃出卧室之后，Akaro 已经失踪了好几个小时。{w}可真是这样吗？……还是说，我被人耍了？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: In the reality where Akaro appeared, Sai didn't seem surprised to see him.{w} ...There were plenty of other things that had to be different, though.
entries.new: 在 Akaro 出现的那段现实里，Sai 见到他时似乎并不惊讶。{w}……不过，肯定还有许多别的不同之处。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I kept calling her name in hallway A, but there was no response.
entries.new: 我在 A走廊里一遍遍喊她的名字，却始终没有回应。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: And once again, nothing new caught my eye in the storeroom.
entries.new: 储藏室里也一如既往，没有发现任何新东西。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Could she have gone up?
entries.new: ……她会不会上楼去了？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: She did leave the attic key in the door. Maybe she had some final business there.
entries.new: 她确实把阁楼的钥匙留在了门上。也许她在那边还有最后一件事要办。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I didn't like it at all. Why was Shiroya surrounded by so much mystery? After finding her again, I hadn't sensed anything strange about her, but had she still kept something important from me...?
entries.new: 我一点也不喜欢这样。Shiroya 身上为什么会有这么多谜团？重逢之后，我并没有觉得她哪里奇怪，可她是不是仍有什么事瞒着我……？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Hesitating slightly, I directed myself toward the stairs.
entries.new: 我略一迟疑，还是朝楼梯走去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Man, I get it's been a bizarre day. I didn't anticipate anything like this when I woke up, but there's no reason to drag things out.
entries.new: 唉，我知道今天够离奇的。我醒来时可没想到会变成这样，但也没必要这么拖着吧。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Sai, this has nothing to do with you or the Sekimeiya. We need to find Shiroya.
entries.new: Sai，这件事跟你和 Sekimeiya 都没有关系。我们得找到 Shiroya。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: *sigh* Yes, yes. You're just too stubborn.
entries.new: （叹气）好，好。你就是太固执了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: There was no reason to take the elevator, so we walked up. On the second floor, I continued yelling her name, but we didn't so much as see her shadow.
entries.new: 没理由坐电梯，我们便走了上去。到了二楼，我继续喊着她的名字，却连她的影子都没见着。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We continued until we were in front of the attic. Sai was right—the key was still inserted.
entries.new: 我们一路走上去，停在阁楼门前。Sai 说得没错——钥匙还插在锁孔里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I know it sounds like she and I are up to something, but we need to actually search for her thoroughly.
entries.new: 我知道听起来像是我和她之间有什么名堂，但我们真的必须把她彻底找一遍。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Who could've guessed? ...That's fine.{w} If she's still here, we'll find her.
entries.new: 谁能想到呢？……算了。{w}如果她还在这栋楼里，我们会找到她的。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...{w}I don't know if you have something in mind, but you two will stay together, making sure nobody can sneak past. Not Shiroya, not Akaro, and not someone who's hiding.
entries.new: ……{w}我不知道你心里在打什么主意，不过你们两个待在一起，别让任何人溜过去。不管是 Shiroya、Akaro，还是哪个躲起来的家伙。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: ...Sure.{w} But do understand that the Sekimeiya exists somewhere. Using it, it's possible to bypass any regular search by teleporting back to a recently inspected place. I doubt we have to worry about that, though.
entries.new: ……行。{w}不过你要清楚，Sekimeiya 就在某个地方。用它传送回刚查过的地方，就能绕过任何常规搜查。但我想，这种事应该用不着担心。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: We went up the stairs. I looked at the floor of the living room, but I was unable to draw much from it. I could still recognize some of the very old footprints, but most of them were newer. It was at least clear that none had been left recently.
entries.new: 我们上了楼。我查看起居室的地面，却没能看出多少线索。有些很早以前的脚印我还能认出来，但大多数都更新一些。至少可以确定，没有哪一个是最近留下的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I went through the kitchen and entered the hallway.
entries.new: 我穿过厨房，走进了走廊。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Just stay here while I look around.
entries.new: 你们就待在这儿，我去四处看看。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: At your service.
entries.new: 遵命。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...I called the elevator. Seconds later, it arrived, empty except for the blood I'd left in it. Then, I proceeded to leave the door open, disabling it as an escape method.
entries.new: ……我按了电梯。几秒后它到了，里面空无一人，只有我先前留下的血迹。随后我让电梯门一直敞着，让它没法再被当成逃跑路线。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wait, why isn't the handle attached? This is the room where we locked ourselves in.
entries.new: 等等，门把手怎么没装上？这就是我们当初把自己反锁进去的那个房间。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Only the inner handle of the bedroom wasn't attached, and it was next to the door, in the hallway.
entries.new: 只有卧室内侧的门把手没有装上，它搁在门边的走廊上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Oh, what...? I have no idea.
entries.new: 呃，什么……？我完全不知道。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Whatever happened in the attic, it had taken place some time ago, as every room was vacant. I looked through the storeroom, the bathroom, and the two bedrooms. During that time, Erina and Sai made sure we could conclude the attic was empty.
entries.new: 阁楼里不管发生过什么，都已是一段时间以前的事了，每个房间都空无一人。我查过储藏室、浴室和两间卧室。这期间，Erina 和 Sai 守在门口，让我们得以确认阁楼里确实是空的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I glanced at the elevator and saw that the door hadn't closed. I felt confident in moving on, so we headed to the sixth floor.
entries.new: 我瞥了一眼电梯，门还开着。既然可以放心往下查，我们便前往六楼。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: While Sai and Erina stayed outside the partitions, I looked through the three of them and then in the bathrooms. That made one more floor Shiroya wasn't on.
entries.new: Sai 和 Erina 留在隔间外，我把那三个隔间逐一查看，随后又进了洗手间。于是又一层楼被排除——Shiroya 不在这里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: And quickly, those floors added up to six. One last time, the crystal floor was the final place to look through.
entries.new: 很快，这样查过的楼层就凑够了六层。最后剩下的，便是水晶层。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If she's here, I hope you admit what you're doing.
entries.new: 如果她真在这儿，我希望你能坦白你到底在做什么。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Just stay put. I'll look through the rooms.
entries.new: 待着别动。我去查看房间。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I walked to the storeroom, but Erina's voice stopped me.
entries.new: 我朝储藏室走去，却被 Erina 的声音叫住了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: W-Wait.{w} You said Shiroya wasn't in the women's bathroom, but you didn't mention this.
entries.new: 等、等等。{w}你说 Shiroya 不在女洗手间里，可你没提这个。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: What...?
entries.new: 什么……？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I stepped back. Erina had decided to inspect the bathroom herself out of either curiosity or distrust.
entries.new: 我退开一步。不知是出于好奇还是怀疑，Erina 决定亲自查看洗手间。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Don't move. I'll look myself.
entries.new: 别动。我自己来看。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I approached the doors and peeked inside. What Erina had noticed was the toilet: the water tank's lid had been removed, which we hadn't seen from hallway B.
entries.new: 我走近门边，探头往里看。Erina 注意到的是马桶：水箱的盖子被取了下来，这一点从 B 走廊那边根本看不到。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What the...?
entries.new: 搞什么……？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: On a thin pipe, close to falling into the water, was the gray Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 灰色 Sekimeiya 就搁在一根细水管上，几乎要掉进水里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Did she activate it?
entries.new: 是她启动的吗？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Touching it entailed no risk, so I put my left arm inside.
entries.new: 碰它不会有任何风险，我便把左臂伸了进去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I don't get it. It's been like ten minutes since she went to the bathroom. Even if she activated it, would it still be powered off...?
entries.new: 我不明白。她去洗手间才十分钟左右。就算她启动过，它难道还会是关着的吗……？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I set the Sekimeiya on the floor and retrieved the tank lid, which was sitting between the toilet and the far wall. It was heavier than I expected, so I gently put it back in place.
entries.new: 我把 Sekimeiya 放到地上，取回搁在马桶与对面墙壁之间的水箱盖。它比我想的重，我便小心地把它放回了原处。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I walked out, holding the Sekimeiya with my hand. I had put my sleeve between it and my skin, preventing it from activating when it regained power.
entries.new: 我用手拿着 Sekimeiya 走了出去。我把袖子垫在它和皮肤之间，以免它重新通电时启动。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The Sekimeiya's not in the tower anymore, right?
entries.new: Sekimeiya 已经不在塔里了吧？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Isn't that it?
entries.new: 不就是那个吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...Did you hide it in the water tank?
entries.new: ……你把它藏在水箱里了？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Not me.{w} I honestly thought it must've left the building some time ago. I wonder why anyone would hide it.{w} However, it seems Shiroya activated it and went to the past. Maybe she knew where it would be if she hid it herself. It doesn't make a lot of sense that she's not here, though.
entries.new: 不是我。{w}说实话，我以为它早就被带出这栋楼了。真不明白谁会把它藏起来。{w}不过，看来是 Shiroya 启动了它，去了过去。如果是她自己藏的，她或许知道它会出现在哪里。可她却不在，这就说不通了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...{w}We still haven't searched the whole floor. I'll go leave the Sekimeiya in the event room, and we won't move it again.
entries.new: ……{w}这一层还没搜完。我去把 Sekimeiya 放到活动室，之后谁都不再动它。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: ...There's nothing else to find, is there? Do you seriously believe Shiroya will be here? We've already found the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: ……已经没什么可找的了吧？你真觉得 Shiroya 会在这里？Sekimeiya 都已经找到了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I stared at Sai's eyes, a little disconcerted. His voice sounded noticeably more nervous and tense than it had recently.
entries.new: 我有些不安地注视着 Sai 的眼睛。他的声音明显比之前更紧张，也更紧绷。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Is there something else to find here?
entries.new: ……这里还有别的东西要找吗？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Hm? What would that be?
entries.new: 嗯？还能有什么？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: There was something hidden behind those words. Saying that was all he could do to try to prevent the search from concluding.
entries.new: 那句话背后藏着什么。他能做的，也只是用这样一句话拖着，不让搜索就此收场。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: "Shiroya's fate is death." His prediction hadn't yet become reality.
entries.new: 「Shiroya 注定会死。」他的预言还没有成真。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: "If she went to the past, why hasn't she shown herself yet?" It was a very good question, and one which had already come up a handful of times.
entries.new: 「如果她去了过去，为什么到现在还不现身？」这问题问得极好，而且已经被人提起过好几次了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...{w}Just keep waiting here.
entries.new: ……{w}你就在这儿等着吧。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I tried to ignore the insidious atmosphere around me and hesitantly moved to the event room.
entries.new: 我努力不去在意周围那股隐隐作祟的气息，迟疑着走向活动室。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I lowered the glass of the cabinet. When I placed the Sekimeiya inside, I didn't have to wait long for it to turn white.
entries.new: 我放下展示柜的玻璃罩。把 Sekimeiya 放进去后，没过多久，它就变成了白色。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Hello. I just wanted to see what you were doing. I'll be outside this room to make sure you don't do anything with the Sekimeiya. Don't think Shiroya's actions aren't suspicious. I don't want her to come from the other hallway and grab it or something.{w} Don't worry, either. I'll stay in the hallway, and I won't get it out myself.
entries.new: 你好啊。我只是想看看你在做什么。我会守在门外，确保你不会对 Sekimeiya 动什么手脚。别以为 Shiroya 的举动就没有可疑之处。我可不想让她从另一条走廊过来，一把把它抢走之类的。{w}你也不用担心，我会待在走廊里，不会自己去把它拿出来。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I looked through the door and saw that Erina hadn't moved, so I didn't have any particular problem.
entries.new: 我透过门望过去，见 Erina 没有动过，也就没什么特别的异议。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Fine.
entries.new: 随你。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: ...I see you haven't locked the cabinet, huh?
entries.new: ……看来你没把展示柜锁上啊。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: We'll deal with that later.
entries.new: 那事以后再说。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I disregarded him and walked away. I knew how suspicious I sounded, but I had consciously avoided locking it.
entries.new: 我没有理会他，转身走开。我知道自己这话听着多可疑，可我是有意不去锁的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It was very likely Sai had hidden the key somewhere and could open it anyway. Regardless, I didn't have it, and I wasn't sure if I wanted to activate the Sekimeiya again.
entries.new: Sai 很可能把钥匙藏在了某处，随时都打得开。何况钥匙本来就不在我手上，而我也说不准自己是否还想再启动一次 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I had learned the past could be changed in some capacity. Shiroya had also sounded interested in exploring that further. If I locked the cabinet, I would be preventing myself from trying it ever again. Before considering it further, I wanted to find Shiroya and avoid erasing or modifying the version of her I knew.
entries.new: 我已经知道，过去在某种程度上是可以改变的。Shiroya 似乎也有意继续探究这一点。要是我锁上展示柜，就等于断了自己再试一次的路。在进一步考虑之前，我想先找到 Shiroya，避免抹去或改变我所认识的那个她。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I resumed the search and went to the storeroom. As expected, it was empty, and the far door hadn't budged.
entries.new: 我重新开始搜索，去了储藏室。不出所料，里面空无一人，尽头那扇门也纹丝未动。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If this ends and we don't find her, I'll just give up on the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 如果到最后还是找不到她，我就放弃 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: If she's not here, all I can hope is that she's outside, waiting.
entries.new: 如果她不在这里，我只能指望她在外面等着。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: As had often happened, my thoughts derailed to the recording. The people mentioned in it were me, Sai, Akaro, Erina, and Isla.
entries.new: 和之前常有的情况一样，我的思绪又拐到了那段录音上。里面提到的人是我、Sai、Akaro、Erina 和 Isla。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Isla was debatable, but the rest should've been available. Naomi and Katei had died, so it made sense they hadn't been mentioned. Shiroya didn't seem to be anywhere... Was it all a coincidence?
entries.new: Isla 还说不准，但其余几个人当时应该都在。Naomi 和 Katei 已经死了，没被提到也说得通。Shiroya 好像哪儿都不见人影……这一切难道只是巧合？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I entered room A5. We'd looked inside every cabinet fairly often, as they were potential hiding spots for people. The only time someone had been in one was that very room...
entries.new: 我走进 A5 展室。我们把每个展示柜都翻看过不少次，因为那都是可能藏人的地方。唯一一次真有人在里面，就是在这间展室……
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I did the same thing. There was no way Shiroya would be hiding in a cabinet, but I had to make sure no places were ignored. Furthermore, Akaro's disappearance was still up in the air.
entries.new: 我也照做了一遍。Shiroya 不可能藏在展示柜里，但我不能漏掉任何一处。况且，Akaro 的下落至今仍不明。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Isla hadn't changed at all over those hours. Soon, I hoped, she could be brought to a much better place, outside the tower.
entries.new: ……这几个小时里，Isla 一点变化也没有。我希望不久之后，就能把她带到塔外一个更好的地方去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The next few rooms were all empty. Sai hadn't moved from next to the event room, and he shrugged every time he saw that I continued to find nothing.
entries.new: 接下来几间展室都空无一物。Sai 始终没有离开活动室旁边，每次看到我依旧一无所获，他就耸耸肩。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I entered the last crystal room. After it, only the security room would remain.
entries.new: 我走进最后一间水晶展室。剩下的就只有监控室了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The Last Bird
entries.new: 最后的飞鸟

entries.text: Next to a cabinet was Shiroya. She was leaning on it with a pained face.
entries.new: Shiroya 就在一个展示柜旁。她靠在柜子上，一脸痛苦。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: A-Atsuki...?
entries.new: A、Atsuki……？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: I frantically ran over to her. While I was relieved to see her, she didn't look well.
entries.new: 我慌忙跑到她身边。见到她让我松了口气，可她的脸色明显不对。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Are you okay...? What happened?
entries.new: 你没事吧……？发生什么了？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I'm fine, yes... And I... don't know. I don't feel great.
entries.new: 嗯，我没事……至于发生了什么，我……不知道。我有点不舒服。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Wh-What? You don't know what happened?
entries.new: 什、什么？你不知道发生了什么？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I knew I heard you talking. Look who it is... What were you doing here?
entries.new: 我就说听见有人在说话。看看这是谁……你在这里做什么？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Sorry, my head's been hurting for a while.
entries.new: 抱歉，我的头已经疼了好一会儿了。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Do I look like I care? Why have you been in this room for so long?
entries.new: 我看上去像在乎吗？你为什么在这房间里待了这么久？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I-I suddenly couldn't keep going...
entries.new: 我、我突然走不动了……
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Are you two for real? Is this the best you could think of?
entries.new: 你们两个是认真的吗？就编得出这种说法？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Shut the fuck up! We didn't plan any of this!
entries.new: 闭嘴！这根本不是我们安排的！
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I'm not stopping. You found the Sekimeiya in the bathroom, right? Then you activated it.
entries.new: 我不会善罢甘休。你们是在洗手间找到 Sekimeiya 的吧？然后就启动了它。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Ah... Yes, that's right.
entries.new: 啊……嗯，没错。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: What happened then?
entries.new: 后来发生了什么？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I don't remember. All I know is that I didn't find anyone, and I rested in this room.
entries.new: 我记不清了。只记得我没找到任何人，就在这间房里歇了一会儿。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: And you're all right now? You're standing up just fine.
entries.new: 那你现在没事了？看你站得也挺稳的。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I just felt dizzy. I'm better now.
entries.new: 只是有点头晕，现在好多了。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: I looked over her body, and a subtle discomfort wormed its way into me. Perhaps I was making it up, but her face looked almost... worn out.
entries.new: 我打量着她的身体，一丝说不清的不安悄悄爬上心头。也许是我多心了，可她的面容看上去几乎有些……憔悴。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Well, I guess this means you accomplished whatever you wanted to do, right? I'm very happy to hear it.
entries.new: 这么说，你想做的事已经办成了吧？听你这么说，我真替你高兴。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: The three of us stepped into hallway A. When Erina saw Shiroya, she approached us.
entries.new: 我们三人走进了 A走廊。Erina 一看到 Shiroya，便朝我们走来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Shiroya... I'm glad you're all right. What happened to you?
entries.new: Shiroya……你没事就好。到底出了什么事？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: She chose the "oh I'm so disoriented I can barely remember anything" excuse, just like you did earlier. Don't even bother.
entries.new: 她挑的借口是「我迷迷糊糊的，什么都记不清了」，跟你刚才一模一样。省省吧。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: H-Huh...?
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Do you only not remember what happened after you touched the Sekimeiya?
entries.new: 你记不得的，只有碰过 Sekimeiya 之后发生的事？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I think so... Before that, we were waiting in the lobby, until I had to go to the bathroom.
entries.new: 应该是……在那之前，我们一直在大堂等着，后来我去了趟洗手间。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: I see. Do you not know where the dizziness came from?
entries.new: 原来如此。你不知道头晕是怎么来的吗？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: ...{w}I don't know...
entries.new: ……{w}我不知道……
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: I had no clue what to think. She looked sad; that was all I could perceive. Maybe she'd been attacked or had an accident. ...Perhaps it was an effect of the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 我完全不知道该作何感想。我只看得出来，她很难过。也许她遭到了袭击，也许是出了什么意外。……又或许，这是 Sekimeiya 造成的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Then, the sadness faded away, and in its place came a gentle smile.
entries.new: 随后，那份哀伤淡了下去，取而代之的是一抹温和的笑容。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Don't worry, I'm okay. There's not a lot of time left, right?
entries.new: 别担心，我没事。剩下的时间不多了吧？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: It's {time=20:37.}
entries.new: 现在是 {time=20:37.}。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: See... It's almost time.
entries.new: 你看……时间快到了。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: ...Can you come here for a second?
entries.new: ……能过来一下吗？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Y-Yes.
entries.new: 好、好的。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: What, going to go rub your hands together now that your plan has succeeded?
entries.new: 怎么，计划得逞了，现在要去搓手庆祝了？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What plan, Sai? Do you think we did this to find the Sekimeiya you didn't want us to find?{w} You understand that doesn't make any sense, right? She found it in the bathroom. What's the point of forcing a search to find it if she already identified where it was?
entries.new: 什么计划，Sai？你觉得我们做这些，是为了找出你不想让我们找到的 Sekimeiya？{w} 你自己也明白这说不通吧？她是在洗手间里发现它的。既然她已经确定了它在哪儿，那还强行搜什么？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: ...{w}Why is she faking, then?
entries.new: ……{w}那她为什么要装？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I'm not. My head really doesn't feel good.
entries.new: 我没装。我的头真的很难受。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Right.
entries.new: 是嘛。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...I was ecstatic that we'd be able to stop dealing with Sai relatively soon. I sighed and walked back, bringing Shiroya to hallway C.
entries.new: ……一想到很快就不用再跟 Sai 打交道，我心里就说不出的痛快。我叹了口气，转身带着 Shiroya 往 C走廊走去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Do you remember what we talked about before waiting in the lobby?
entries.new: 还记得我们在大堂等着的时候说过什么吗？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Uh...
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: I said the past could be changed, remember?
entries.new: 我说过，过去是可以改变的，记得吗？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: O-Oh, yes. But we didn't find the Sekimeiya in that locker, where it should've been.
entries.new: 啊、对。可那个储物柜里本该有 Sekimeiya 的，我们却没找到。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Yeah.{w} You traveled through time. Do you think you might've changed anything?
entries.new: 嗯。{w}你穿越过时间。你觉得有没有可能改变过什么？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I really don't think so.
entries.new: 我觉得真的没有。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Well, right now, the Sekimeiya's in the cabinet, but I didn't lock it. There's only about thirty minutes left, but we can still use it.
entries.new: 现在 Sekimeiya 就在展示柜里，不过我没上锁。只剩三十分钟左右了，但我们还来得及用。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: We might be able to change the past. If we travel together, we'll keep our memories of this reality. I'm not sure how it works yet, but I thought of something.{w} Sai's definitely suspicious of us, so I doubt he'll let us just waltz on in and take the Sekimeiya. Obviously, given the time left, it's very unlikely we'll go back far enough even if the Sekimeiya stores energy the whole time.
entries.new: 我们或许能改变过去。只要一起穿越，我们就会保留这个现实的记忆。具体原理我还没弄明白，不过我想到了一个办法。{w}Sai 肯定在怀疑我们，他不可能就这么让我们大摇大摆地进去拿走 Sekimeiya。再说以剩下的时间来看，就算 Sekimeiya 一直在蓄能，我们也不可能回到足够远的过去。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: It could be a start, though. We'd go decently far into the past. Fifteen minutes sent me twenty minutes back, so every minute stored adds more than a minute.
entries.new: 不过这至少能算个开头。我们能回到相当一段过去。蓄能十五分钟，让我回到了二十分钟前——也就是说，每蓄一分钟，回到的就不止一分钟。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: By which I mean, we could go more than thirty minutes into the past and change it in a way so that we can begin storing time at the point we arrive. If we repeat this, we'll go even farther, and we'll be able to store a lot more time.
entries.new: 我的意思是，我们可以回到三十多分钟前，在那里做出改变，好让我们一到达就开始蓄能。这样反复几次，就能越走越远，能蓄的时间也会越来越多。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I'm not sure it'd work, but even though we can currently only store thirty minutes, we can keep doing this to maybe keep going back more and more.
entries.new: 能不能成我也不敢保证，但现在我们一次只能蓄三十分钟，只要照这样重复下去，说不定就能一次次回到更早。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: How do we store thirty minutes without Sai noticing? I feel like this is feasible.{w} Remember how the cabinet works? We could unplug the cord, which would stop the temperature regulation.
entries.new: 怎么才能瞒过 Sai 蓄满三十分钟？我觉得这事可行。{w}还记得展示柜的原理吗？只要拔掉电源线，温度调节就会停下。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Then, even though it'd look normal, it'd actually be storing power. We can hide it in plain sight like that and activate it at the last second...
entries.new: 这样一来，它表面上看一切正常，实际上却在蓄能。我们可以就把它藏在明面上，等到最后一刻再启动……
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: ...N-No, let's not.
entries.new: ……不、不要，还是算了。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: ...{w}You don't want to try it...?
entries.new: ……{w}你不想试试吗……？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I don't. Everything is fine as it is right now.
entries.new: 不想。现在这样已经很好了。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: But...{w} we'll regret it. If we don't even try it, the time will come when we'll hate not having tried it.
entries.new: 可是……{w}我们会后悔的。要是连试都不试，总有一天会恨自己当初为什么没试。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: No... That won't happen.
entries.new: 不会的……不会有那一天。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Why? That's not how you reacted the first time I proposed changing the past.
entries.new: 为什么？我第一次提出改变过去的时候，你可不是这个反应。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I know... I just thought about it more.{w} Let's wait until the time is up. We can end everything now.{w} We've been here for too long... I just want to get out.{w} Believe me, there's no need to do anything else.
entries.new: 我知道……我只是又多想了一会儿。{w} 等到时间结束吧。我们现在就可以把一切做个了结。{w} 我们在这里待得太久了……我只想离开。{w} 相信我，没有必要再做别的了。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: I really didn't get it. I couldn't blame her for saying that, but every word felt distant.
entries.new: 我实在不明白。她那样说，我怪不得她，可她的每一句话都显得那么遥远。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...We just have to accept that Miiya died. Let's do what we said and try to be strong despite it.
entries.new: ……我们只能接受 Miiya 已经死了。照我们说好的做吧，尽量坚强地撑过去。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: I know that Miiya died, but we can prevent it...!
entries.new: 我知道 Miiya 已经死了，可我们明明可以阻止这件事……！
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: No. Let's stop, please...
entries.new: 不。到此为止吧，求你了……
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: ...Tell me, at least. Why did you change your mind?
entries.new: ……至少告诉我，你为什么改变主意了？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: ...{w}To tell you the truth, I'm not even sure I'd want to do it even if we could.
entries.new: ……{w}说实话，就算真能做到，我也说不准自己还想不想做。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: What does that mean...?
entries.new: 这是什么意思……？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Most importantly, I just want to leave this place. We have to keep going with what we've got, and I'm sure it'll be fine.{w} This isn't a world where Miiya survives, so let's keep living the best we can.
entries.new: 最重要的是，我只想离开这里。我们只能靠手头这些继续走下去，我相信不会有事的。{w} 这不是 Miiya 能活下来的世界，我们就尽力活下去吧。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: What the hell was up with that change of philosophy? I was too lost to know if I agreed at all.
entries.new: 她这套想法怎么突然就变了？我完全摸不着头脑，根本不知道自己到底赞不赞成。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: However, I knew one thing. I also wanted to get out, and Shiroya was safe. ...Saving Miiya had been something of a dream rather than an actual goal. The main thing, the definitely achievable thing, was leaving with Shiroya, and it finally seemed within reach.
entries.new: 不过，有一件事我很清楚。我也想离开，而 Shiroya 是安全的。……救 Miiya 与其说是实际目标，不如说更像一个梦。真正要紧、也确定能做到的，是和 Shiroya 一起离开，而这件事终于近在眼前了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Are you sure? I know it sounds like a stretch, but I still think my idea is worth considering.
entries.new: 你确定吗？我知道这听起来有些勉强，但我还是觉得我的主意值得考虑。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: ...I am, yes.
entries.new: ……嗯，我确定。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: What about the Sekimeiya? Do you not want to try using it again?
entries.new: 那 Sekimeiya 呢？你不想再试着用它了吗？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I definitely don't. I have no idea what will happen with it, but let's forget it exists if we can.
entries.new: 绝对不想。我不知道再用它会发生什么，但能忘了它的存在就忘了吧。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: ...Okay.
entries.new: ……好吧。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: That was the end, then. I tried to think of something else to say to her, but I found nothing. If that was the life she wanted to keep living, opposing it would have been a breach of our friendship.
entries.new: 那么，事情就到此为止了。我试着想些别的话对她说，却什么也想不出来。如果那是她想继续走下去的路，我若反对，反倒像是辜负了我们的情谊。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What confused me was her change of heart. She'd been wanting to use the Sekimeiya to save Miiya up until it had actually become remotely possible...
entries.new: 让我困惑的是她的转变。她一直想用 Sekimeiya 救 Miiya，直到这件事终于有了一丝可能……
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What reason could there have been to not want to attempt it? Was she not fond of the idea of changing the cards we'd been dealt?
entries.new: 究竟是什么理由让她不愿尝试？难道她并不想改变命运发给我们的这副牌吗？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It had been a focus of my thoughts the entire day. Was I really going to give up so easily?
entries.new: 这件事我想了一整天。难道我真的要就这样轻易放弃吗？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I glanced at Shiroya's expression, which told me how serious she was. I could only be saddened and maybe a little disappointed, but logically speaking, I hadn't lost anything. Miiya was already dead before we went to the tower, and the reason we'd entered was to begin moving past it.
entries.new: 我瞥了一眼 Shiroya 的神情，看得出她是认真的。我难免难过，或许还有些失望，可理智地说，我并没有失去什么。我们去塔之前，Miiya 就已经死了；我们进塔，本就是为了开始接受这件事。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Let's go back to the lobby.
entries.new: ……回大厅吧。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Yeah.
entries.new: 嗯。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: The large room was empty. Shiroya walked up to the spot where we'd been sitting and returned to her previous position. I sat at her side, recalling the events we'd gone through. All my own recent experiences felt surreal, but I knew they had truly happened.
entries.new: 宽敞的房间里空无一人。Shiroya 走到我们先前坐过的地方，回到原来的位置。我在她身旁坐下，回想我们经历的一切。最近发生在我身上的事都显得很不真实，但我清楚，它们确实发生过。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I wonder where Erina and Sai went...
entries.new: 不知道 Erina 和 Sai 去哪儿了……
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Even if they're up to something, we just have to wait here.
entries.new: 就算他们在打什么主意，我们也只能在这里等。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Right...
entries.new: 是啊……
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: However, Erina soon arrived from hallway B.
entries.new: 不过，Erina 很快从 B走廊过来了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Here you are. I lost track of Sai at some point. Have you seen him?
entries.new: ……你们在这儿啊。我不知什么时候跟丢了 Sai。你们见到他了吗？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: No.
entries.new: 没有。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I don't know where he is, then...
entries.new: 那我就不知道他去哪儿了……
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: I saw her staring at the mechanical room. When I did, I also felt like something about it had changed. It hadn't been fully closed before, had it?
entries.new: 我看见她正盯着机械室。顺着她的目光看去，我也觉得那里似乎有什么变了。之前那扇门并没有完全关上，对吧？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: She looked away and came to sit by our side.
entries.new: 她移开视线，来到我们旁边坐下。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There's not much time left, right?
entries.new: 没剩多少时间了吧？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Less than half an hour.
entries.new: 不到半小时了。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Those twelve hours had felt so much longer. It was hard to believe they were coming to an end and that we could resume our normal lives after everything.
entries.new: 那十二个小时感觉起来漫长得多。很难相信这一切就要结束了，也很难相信经历这么多之后，我们还能回到原本的生活。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There was nothing more to be said—not from someone as tired as me. I tried not to think about Sai and focused instead on keeping my mind blank.
entries.new: 已经没什么可说的了——至少像我这样疲惫的人说不出什么。我尽量不去想 Sai，只让脑子保持一片空白。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...We won't actually get out, right?
entries.new: ……我们其实出不去，对吧？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: What?
entries.new: 什么？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: We'll stay here for more than a month, won't we?
entries.new: 我们会在这里待上一个多月，对吧？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: There's no way. The exit will definitely open soon.
entries.new: 不可能。出口很快就会开的。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: How can that be, though? In a month, Isla will be alive here, and I haven't saved her yet. If the shutter opens, that'll become impossible.
entries.new: 可这怎么可能？一个月后，Isla 会在这里活着，而我还没救她。如果闸门打开，那就再也不可能了。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: ...Every time similar things came out of her mouth, I went quiet. How was I supposed to answer that? I still didn't know what had happened to Erina, but her personality had noticeably shifted at one point. She hadn't yet recovered from her sedated appearance.
entries.new: ……每次她说出类似的话，我都会沉默。那种话我该怎么回答？我仍不知道 Erina 身上发生过什么，但她的性格确实在某时明显变了。她还没有从麻醉后的那副样子里恢复过来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I know it might sound shallow, but it'll be fine.{w} If Isla is fated to be alive in the future, she will be no matter what you do. You'll see her again, right? That's what the recording predicted. Now, you just have to wait until that happens.
entries.new: 我知道这话听起来可能很空泛，但会没事的。{w} 如果 Isla 注定在未来还活着，那不管你做什么，她都会活着。你还会再见到她，对吧？录音里就是这么预测的。现在，你只要等到那一天就好。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: ...Do I have to wait a month to see her, then?
entries.new: ……那我得等上一个月才能见到她吗？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: ...{w}I don't know.
entries.new: ……{w}我不知道。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: I couldn't get a read on Shiroya. Was she just trying to be optimistic to calm her down...?
entries.new: 我摸不透 Shiroya 的心思。她只是想表现得乐观些，好让 Erina 安心吗……？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Or was she actually considering that what we'd heard in the recording would occur in the future? I didn't think that was it—she also seemed to believe we were just about to leave the tower.
entries.new: 还是说她真的认为，录音里那些话会在未来应验？我觉得不是——她似乎也相信我们马上就要离开塔了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Erina tried to accept what she'd heard, but after a couple minutes, it became clear that she couldn't be content with that alone.
entries.new: Erina 试着接受听到的话，可几分钟后，我清楚地看出，光是这样她没法安心。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I'll go find Sai. I don't like thinking about what he might be doing.
entries.new: ……我去找 Sai。我可不想去猜他会在做什么。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Huh...?
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: At this point, why aren't we doing more than doubting him? There's been a culprit among us the whole time. Now, only four of us are left, and we didn't find Akaro. It can only be him, right?{w} Of us, he's the only one missing. I think he disappeared on purpose. I need to find him.
entries.new: 都到这一步了，我们为什么除了怀疑他，就什么都不做？一直以来，犯人就在我们当中。如今只剩四个人，而我们又没找到 Akaro。除了他还能是谁？{w}我们这些人里，只有他不见了。我觉得他是故意消失的。我必须找到他。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: She walked back to hallway B without giving us time to answer.
entries.new: 她没等我们答话，便转身走回了 B走廊。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Shiroya and I looked at each other, hesitant to react. We'd agreed to wait until {time=21:05}, so Erina's abrupt departure wasn't enough to disrupt that.
entries.new: 我和 Shiroya 对视一眼，一时都没有动作。我们说好要等到 {time=21:05}，所以 Erina 忽然离开，也不足以让我们改变计划。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I didn't like the thought of letting her and Sai both run free, but I let it go.
entries.new: 一想到她和 Sai 就这么没人管，各自行动，我心里就很不安，但最终还是算了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We were alone, and time kept passing. Three or four minutes later, Shiroya spoke.
entries.new: 只剩我们两个人，时间一点点过去。三四分钟后，Shiroya 开口了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...What?
entries.new: ……怎么了？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: ...{w}How much time is left? Less than twenty minutes, right?
entries.new: ……{w}还剩多少时间？不到二十分钟了吧？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Yeah.
entries.new: 嗯。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: ...What?
entries.new: ……什么？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Sorry, it's all fine. Ignore me.
entries.new: 抱歉，没什么事。别在意。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: ...{w}Wh-What?
entries.new: ……{w}怎、怎么了？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I'm not going to ignore you. What is it?
entries.new: 我可不会当作没听见。到底怎么了？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I was just a bit confused. It's nothing important.
entries.new: 只是我有点想不通。不是什么要紧事。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: I was almost speechless. I didn't like agreeing with Sai, but I had to. Something about Shiroya wasn't right.
entries.new: 我一时说不出话来。我不愿认同 Sai 的说法，却又不得不承认。Shiroya 身上确实有哪里不对劲。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The convenient loss of memory, the sudden appearance in that room... She'd also changed completely when I'd mentioned using the Sekimeiya again and contradicted her own past self.
entries.new: 恰巧失忆，又突然出现在那间房里……还有，当我提到再次使用 Sekimeiya 时，她的态度截然不同，甚至否定了过去的自己。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Oh... You're still here?
entries.new: 哦……你们还在这儿？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Yeah. Did you find Sai?
entries.new: 是啊。你找到 Sai 了吗？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: N-No.{w} Sorry to ask like this, but what time is it?
entries.new: 没、没有。{w}抱歉突然这么问，现在几点了？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: ...{w}I'm sorry?
entries.new: ……{w}抱歉，你说什么？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: It should be {time=20:50} soon.
entries.new: 应该快到 {time=20:50} 了。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: ...{w}R-Really...? Okay.
entries.new: ……{w}真、真的吗……？好。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: This is starting to get ridiculous. What is up with you two?
entries.new: 这越来越离谱了。你们两个到底怎么回事？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I don't understand... Maybe you were right, Shiroya. We'll wait...
entries.new: 我不明白……也许你说得对，Shiroya。我们等着吧……
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Erina made her way to where she'd been sitting, but there was only so much I could ignore.
entries.new: Erina 回到原先坐着的地方，可我再也没法装作没看见。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What the hell did you just do? "What time is it"? You might as well have said "I just used the Sekimeiya, how far back did I go?" right to my face.
entries.new: 你到底做了什么？『现在几点了』？你这话，简直就等于当着我的面说『我刚用了 Sekimeiya，回到了多久以前』。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: She'd come from hallway B, so that was where I went. Shiroya and Erina followed me without saying anything.
entries.new: 她是从 B走廊过来的，我便往那边走去。Shiroya 和 Erina 一言不发地跟在我身后。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...And the Sekimeiya's not here. You didn't even put it back?
entries.new: ……而且 Sekimeiya 也不在这里。你连放都没放回去？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: You're wrong... I didn't do this.
entries.new: 你误会了……不是我做的。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Why did you ask for the time, then?
entries.new: 那你为什么要问时间？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: To know how much time was left.
entries.new: 我想知道还剩多少时间。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Of course.
entries.new: 果然。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I'm telling the truth. I went to search for Sai, but I couldn't find him. I only meant to ask how much time I'd been gone.
entries.new: 我说的是真的。我去找 Sai，但没找到他。我只是想问一下自己离开了多久。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: I closed the glass.{w} Erina had been gone for about five minutes. If she had actually traveled, a version of her that was still to touch the Sekimeiya existed somewhere.
entries.new: 我合上了玻璃罩。{w}Erina 离开了大约五分钟。如果她真的穿越了，那么某个地方一定还有一个尚未触碰 Sekimeiya 的她。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Was everyone just a liar? She could've traveled, but Sai could've also easily hidden it himself. I hadn't locked the cabinet, so I didn't know what had happened.
entries.new: ……难道每个人都在说谎？她可能真的穿越了，但也可能是 Sai 自己把它藏了起来。展示柜我没有上锁，究竟发生了什么，我无从得知。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I felt disconcerted, frustrated, and even wary of Shiroya, who might've been hiding something from me.
entries.new: 我心里发慌，烦躁不安，甚至对 Shiroya 起了戒心——她也许有什么事瞒着我。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I noticed the brief instant in which Erina's expression showed surprise. She was still in hallway B, staring at her left.
entries.new: 我注意到 Erina 脸上闪过一丝惊讶。她还站在 B 走廊里，盯着自己的左边。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Did you see something?
entries.new: 你看到什么了？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Huh?
entries.new: 嗯？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: I walked up to her, but I found nothing that stood out in the hallway.
entries.new: 我走到她身边，可走廊里并没有什么引人注意的东西。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I didn't see anything.
entries.new: 我什么都没看见。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: I was getting mad. I wanted to get out with Shiroya more than anything, so what was with her continued silence?
entries.new: 我有些恼火。我最想的就是和 Shiroya 一起离开这里，她却一直沉默不语，这算什么？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Do we just ignore this, then? Do we think the police can understand even a shred of what happened here?
entries.new: 那我们就这么视而不见？你觉得警察能搞明白这里发生的一丝一毫吗？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Or do we use these last minutes to find Sai and the Sekimeiya? If he took it, he must have something in mind, and as much as I want to get out, I'm not fond of letting him do as he pleases.
entries.new: 还是说，用这最后几分钟去找 Sai 和 Sekimeiya？若是他拿走的，那他一定另有打算——我虽然一心想出去，却也不愿任由他为所欲为。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Y-Yes... Maybe we should search for him.
entries.new: 是、是啊……也许该去找找他。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Search complete. You all did an amazing job this time.
entries.new: 搜查结束。这次各位都干得很出色。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Ah!
entries.new: 啊！
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Sai's face peeked in from hallway B, the lobby side.
entries.new: Sai 的脸从 B 走廊靠大厅那一侧探了出来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Did I hear that the Sekimeiya's gone? We should've counted every time it happened since the start. What's this, the twelfth?
entries.new: 我是不是听说 Sekimeiya 不见了？我们本该从一开始就每次都数着的。这回是第几次了，第十二次？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: And none of them were your doing, right?
entries.new: 而这些事，没一件是你干的，对吧？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Not a single one. Of course, none of you did it this time either, right?
entries.new: 一件都没有。当然，这次你们谁也没动手，对吧？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: This sneaky Sekimeiya must keep teleporting away, making us doubt each other when, in reality, none of us would do something so dishonest as lying or taking it ourselves.
entries.new: 这个狡猾的 Sekimeiya 一定是自己不停传送跑掉的，好让我们互相猜疑——可实际上，我们谁也不会做那种撒谎、偷拿东西的不光彩事。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: And you never chased us with a knife, right?
entries.new: 你也没拿刀追过我们，对吧？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Did that happen? It's {time=20:51.} Let's go to the lobby.
entries.new: 有这回事？现在 {time=20:51.}，去大厅吧。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I'm being serious. You did try to kill me, and I still don't even know why.
entries.new: 我是认真的。你确实想杀我，而我到现在都不知道为什么。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Atsuki, are you stupid? How would I get a knife? There's no place to hide one, right?
entries.new: Atsuki，你脑子没事吧？我上哪儿弄刀去？这里根本没有能藏刀的地方，对吧？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: That Sai was not the same one I'd punched. I clenched my fist, ready to do it for the first time again.
entries.new: 这个 Sai 并不是我打过的那个人。我攥紧拳头，打算再像第一次那样给他一拳。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Are you sure you didn't imagine it? I'm not stupid enough to kill someone, and there's no knife I could've used.
entries.new: 你确定不是自己臆想出来的？我还不至于蠢到去杀人，况且我根本没有刀可用。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I glanced at Shiroya's purse and gestured at her to open it.
entries.new: 我瞥了一眼 Shiroya 的手提包，示意她打开。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: She unzipped it and showed me its contents.
entries.new: 她拉开拉链，把包里的东西给我看。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...{w}Where is it?
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: ...I don't know.
entries.new: ……我不知道。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: The knife wasn't there. She had traveled again, which might have gotten rid of it.
entries.new: 刀不在。她又穿越了一次，也许正是这样才把刀弄没了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'm sure the police will do a great job at figuring out what happened. Now, let's wait in the lobby.
entries.new: 我相信警察一定能查清到底发生了什么。好了，我们去大厅等着吧。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: No.
entries.new: 不。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I went to hallway A. Someone had hidden the Sekimeiya one last time, right before the exit would open. I had no idea what purpose that served, but there had to be one.
entries.new: 我去了 A走廊。有人在出口打开前，最后一次把 Sekimeiya 藏了起来。我不知道这么做有什么意义，但一定有原因。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I walked up to the storeroom. Every time the Sekimeiya was hidden, we were able to find it. The last few minutes we had were enough to do it one more time.
entries.new: 我走到储藏室前。每次 Sekimeiya 被藏起来，我们都找得到。剩下的几分钟，足够我们再找一次。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: You want to spend the remaining time doing this shit again? Go ahead.
entries.new: 你想把剩下的时间花在这种破事上？随你。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I would. Once I felt the storeroom was empty, I moved on to the crystal room A5.
entries.new: 我确实这么做了。断定储藏室里没有之后，我便转向水晶展室 A5。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'd hoped I wouldn't have to see Isla's face again, but there was no helping it.
entries.new: 我本希望不必再见到 Isla，可这也是没办法的事。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I kept going from room to room, meeting Sai's sneer in between. Behind him were Shiroya and Erina, completely neutral and unhelpful.
entries.new: 我一间间找下去，不时看见 Sai 那副讥笑。他身后是 Shiroya 和 Erina，两人面无表情，也不帮什么忙。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I got to the security room and was assaulted by the stench of death again.
entries.new: 到了监控室，那股死亡的气味又一次扑面而来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The computer screens were suspended, so I pressed a key to light them up, trying not to step on all the blood. The time displayed was {time=20:55}, which matched Sai's.
entries.new: 电脑屏幕都黑着，我按了个键把它们点亮，同时尽量不踩到满地血迹。屏幕上显示的时间是 {time=20:55}，和 Sai 说的一致。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Most of the drawers were filled with papers I'd never bothered to read. Something that caught my attention was that one was full of batteries, but they were too packed for the Sekimeiya to be in any of them. I looked inside the suitcase, but it was still empty.
entries.new: 大多数抽屉塞满了我从没心思去读的文件。引起我注意的是其中一格装满了电池，但塞得太满，Sekimeiya 不可能藏在里面。我又看了看行李箱，里面依旧空无一物。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: However, before I left, I kneeled beside Katei's body. Under the desk was the computer tower. To look behind it, I held my breath and crawled up to it.
entries.new: 不过离开前，我在 Katei 的尸体旁跪下。桌下放着电脑主机。为了看清主机后面，我屏住呼吸爬了过去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There it was. The Sekimeiya glowed white, contrasting the obscured space between the desk and the wall.
entries.new: 找到了。Sekimeiya 泛着白光，在书桌与墙壁之间那片昏暗里格外醒目。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Making sure not to touch it with my skin, I dragged it out. It was scorching, so I had to hold it with the bottom of my shirt to leave the room with it.
entries.new: 我小心不让皮肤碰到它，把它拖了出来。它烫得厉害，我只好用衬衫下摆裹着，才把它带出房间。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...{w}You did it. Happy now?
entries.new: ……{w}你找到了。满意了？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I made my way past the three and put it in the cabinet. Without a second thought, I locked it.
entries.new: 我从三人身旁走过，把它放进展示柜，想都没想就上了锁。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Given how hot it had been, Erina had some credibility. If she had just traveled from the future, the Sekimeiya shouldn't have been that hot, and she could no longer travel after our current point—the Sekimeiya would stay locked away until the police came. Knowing her actions could've altered reality, though, it wasn't for certain.
entries.new: 从它烫成那样来看，Erina 的话有几分可信。如果她真是刚从未来穿越而来，Sekimeiya 不该这么烫；而过了我们当前的时间点，她再也无法穿越——Sekimeiya 会一直锁在那里，直到警察赶来。可她的举动有可能改变过现实，这就无法确定了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I don't know what you hoped to accomplish, but there you go. Now we can wait. Is that a problem for you?
entries.new: 我不知道你图什么，不过就这样吧。现在可以等了。这碍着你什么了吗？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Not at all. Why would it be?{w} Oh, you still think I hid the Sekimeiya myself. Now you can see you're wrong. Let's go to the lobby, as I've been saying.
entries.new: 当然不会。能有什么问题？{w}哦，你还以为是我把 Sekimeiya 藏起来的吧。现在你该明白自己错了。就像我一直说的，去大厅吧。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...{w}All right.
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: The four of us left the Sekimeiya behind and entered the lobby. In less than ten minutes, the metal shutter was supposed to open.
entries.new: 我们四人把 Sekimeiya 留在原处，走进大厅。不到十分钟，金属卷帘门就该打开了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We approached where we'd been sitting and reclaimed our places. Everything had been set up for our departure.
entries.new: 我们回到先前坐的地方，各自归位。一切都已为离开准备好了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I glanced at the three people next to me. Sai looked indifferent, while Erina appeared serious. At my right, I began to think Shiroya was a little tense.
entries.new: 我扫了一眼身旁的三人。Sai 一脸漠然，Erina 神情严肃。至于我右边的 Shiroya，我渐渐觉得她有些紧绷。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...{w}Hm? ...Is anything wrong?
entries.new: ……{w}嗯？……有什么事吗？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: I don't know. Are you looking forward to leaving?
entries.new: 说不上来。你盼着出去吗？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: ...Yes, I can't wait.
entries.new: ……嗯，我已经等不及了。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Her melancholic tone took me aback, leaving me without a reply.
entries.new: 她语气里的那抹忧郁让我一怔，竟一时不知如何作答。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Three people had died, and Akaro had vanished. Was he somehow still in the tower? It seemed that only four of us were minutes away from feeling the cold air rolling off the mountains.
entries.new: 已经有三个人死了，Akaro 也消失了。他会不会还在塔里？看样子，再过几分钟，还能感受到山间寒风的，就只剩下我们四个人了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Shiroya and I first entered the lobby when the night sky was above us, and in a few minutes, we would hopefully see it again. The countdown was leading toward the result of a battle only a few of us were aware of—what we'd been told about the alarm versus the recording we'd heard.
entries.new: 我和 Shiroya 走进大厅时，头顶还是夜空，再过几分钟，但愿我们还能重新见到它。倒计时正指向一场较量的结果，而知道这场较量的只有我们几个人——一边是关于警报的那套说法，另一边是我们亲耳听到的录音。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: In just a few minutes, one would win. It would not take much time for us to become aware of our fate.
entries.new: 只需再过几分钟，其中一方就会胜出。用不了多久，我们便会知晓自己的命运。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Sai was the only remaining person who hadn't heard the recording and fittingly looked the most carefree. Perhaps he'd soon understand that his future was much more grim than expected.
entries.new: Sai 是唯一还没听过那段录音的人，看上去也恰好是最无忧无虑的那个。也许他很快就会明白，自己的未来远比预想的黯淡。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Erina had lost her daughter and a fair chunk of her sanity. Understanding her thoughts had, at one point, become an impossible task, and I wasn't sure what she was hoping would happen next.
entries.new: Erina 失去了女儿，也失去了相当一部分理智。揣摩她的心思，早已成了不可能的事，我也说不准她接下来期盼着什么。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: One thing was certain: during those twelve hours, we hadn't figured anything out. There were too many things left unexplained—things that had eluded me and would most likely continue to do so.
entries.new: 有一点可以肯定：那十二个小时里，我们什么也没弄明白。太多事悬而未解——那些东西我怎么也抓不住，而且多半会一直如此。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Miiya wouldn't come back to life despite the inexplicable mentions of her. People had died for incomprehensible reasons. We'd been granted access to a time travel device and gotten nothing out of it.
entries.new: 不管那些关于 Miiya 的提及多么令人费解，她终究不会复活。有人死于无法理解的原因。我们得到了接触时间穿越装置的机会，却一无所获。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Even just minutes previously, the Sekimeiya had been hidden, and I had no idea why. I could barely grasp most of the day's events and definitely couldn't understand some others at all.
entries.new: 就在几分钟前，Sekimeiya 还藏得好好的，我却不知道缘由。这一天发生的事，我大多只能勉强理解，还有一些则全然摸不着头脑。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The inevitable outcome was right around the corner. The Sekimeiya had been part of murder cases and the smoke attack. It would soon make its way into the world, potentially leading to drastic changes.
entries.new: 无可避免的结局近在眼前。Sekimeiya 牵涉进了那几起命案，还有那场烟雾袭击。它很快就要流入世间，说不定会引发剧变。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Why had an object capable of time travel been in Ashiya Tower?
entries.new: 一件能够穿越时间的物品，为什么会出现在芦屋塔里？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Thinking about the time we'd stepped into the building... We'd done that looking to overcome loss. Maybe that part had gone well.
entries.new: 回想我们走进这栋大楼的时候……我们来此，是为了战胜那份失去。也许这一点，我们算是做到了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Before that day, Shiroya had barely spoken for a week. Next to me, not much of that taciturn person remained... but I felt I understood her less than before.
entries.new: 那天之前，Shiroya 整整一个星期几乎没怎么开口。此刻坐在我身边的她，那份沉默寡言已所剩无几……可我却觉得自己比从前更看不懂她了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: In the past, I had never questioned her. I'd thought we'd known each other perfectly. That very thought was what allowed me to trust her even then, despite the oddness that seemed to emanate from her.
entries.new: 从前，我从未怀疑过她。我以为我们彼此完全了解。正是这个念头，让我即便在她身上透出异样的时候，也仍然愿意相信她。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What's the time?
entries.new: 现在几点了？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: ...{time=21:00.} Only these last five minutes are left.
entries.new: ……{time=21:00.}只剩最后五分钟了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: No sound was coming through the shutter, but many people were surely on the other side of it. Police, Ashiya, and even townspeople. As soon as they saw Erina's bloody clothes, they would begin to understand what we had gone through.
entries.new: 卷帘门那边没有传来任何声响，但门外一定挤着不少人。警察、芦屋，甚至镇上的居民。只要他们看到 Erina 那身血衣，就会渐渐明白我们经历了什么。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We'd probably be interrogated. We would become murder suspects, but we'd also see the streets of Yushibana again. After that, we'd be released, and Shiroya and I could go back home.
entries.new: 我们大概会被审问。我们会成为杀人嫌疑人，但也会重新见到丰花的街道。之后我们会被放出来，我和 Shiroya 就能回家了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I didn't know what to expect in that regard. I'd never thought about it, but perhaps some people knew about the existence of the Sekimeiya, and once we showed our knowledge of it, we'd become a threat...
entries.new: 那方面会怎样，我也说不准。我从没想过这件事，但或许有些人知道 Sekimeiya 的存在；一旦我们表现出对它的了解，就会成为威胁……
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Or would the police not believe a word we said? It wasn't clear yet whether the cameras had been working. If someone's plan to steal the Sekimeiya was about to succeed, the outside world could end up never believing our story.
entries.new: 又或者，警察根本不会相信我们说的任何一句话？摄像头是否还在工作，目前还不清楚。如果有人偷走 Sekimeiya 的计划即将得逞，外界也许永远不会相信我们的说法。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We'd all been staring at the floor or our laps—a sign of our exhaustion and need to get out. I felt I heard a sound, so I abruptly looked up.
entries.new: 我们一直盯着地板或自己的膝盖——那是精疲力竭、迫不及待想离开的表现。我似乎听见了什么声音，便猛地抬起头。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There was nothing.
entries.new: 什么也没有。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...{w}What?{w} Where's Erina?
entries.new: ……{w}什么？{w} Erina 呢？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Huh?
entries.new: 嗯？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: That's a great question. Did she go somewhere?
entries.new: 这问题问得好。她去哪儿了吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: The hallway doors were closed, and it seemed unlikely she could've left through one of them.
entries.new: 走廊的门都关着，她不太可能从哪一扇出去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: However, at our right was the mechanical room. She'd been the closest to it, and it was possible she'd silently made her way inside. I couldn't imagine why she would, and I glanced around the room to be sure she really wasn't with us.
entries.new: 不过，我们右边就是机械室。她坐得离那儿最近，说不定已经悄无声息地进去了。我想不出她有什么理由这么做，便环视了一圈房间，确认她真的不在我们中间。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: You two didn't hear anything, right?
entries.new: 你们俩什么也没听见，对吧？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: ...I didn't.
entries.new: ……我没听见。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I looked into Shiroya's eyes, but she didn't do the same. Instead, she had the same nervous look from earlier.
entries.new: 我望向 Shiroya 的眼睛，她却没迎上我的目光，脸上还是先前那副不安的神情。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Then, she stood up.
entries.new: 然后，她站了起来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Huh?
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Don't forget what I said... I meant all of it.{w} Now stay here, and don't follow me.
entries.new: 别忘了我刚才说的话……每一句我都是认真的。{w}现在待在这里，别跟过来。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Wh—
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Before I could finish, she took off.
entries.new: 我话还没说完，她已经跑了出去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: She ran to hallway B and disappeared through it.
entries.new: 她奔向B走廊，转眼消失在门后。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: My heart jumped, but I couldn't move.
entries.new: 我心里猛地一跳，身体却动弹不得。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: My suspicion had been confirmed in the easiest way. That wasn't the Shiroya I knew.
entries.new: 我的怀疑以最简单的方式得到了证实。那不是我所认识的 Shiroya。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: A flash came to me. Just earlier, I had looked at her purse.
entries.new: 一道灵光闪过。就在刚才，我看过她的手提包。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The knife wasn't there...{w} That's fine. That doesn't mean anything.
entries.new: 刀不在里面……{w}没关系。那说明不了什么。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: But... what else should have been in her purse?
entries.new: 可是……她的包里本来还该有什么？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Her wallet, my keys, our identification, and the two tickets for today's event.
entries.new: 她的钱包、我的钥匙、我们的证件，还有今天活动的两张门票。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Right... I didn't realize it. At least two of those things were missing.
entries.new: 对了……我居然没注意到。那些东西里，至少缺了两样。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: My keys weren't there, and neither were our tickets... However, there were keys. Did I recognize them...?
entries.new: 我的钥匙不在，门票也不在……不过，包里有钥匙。我认得那些钥匙吗……？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I turned my head to face Sai. Like me, he looked dumbfounded and remained immobilized by Shiroya's words.
entries.new: 我转头看向 Sai。他和我一样目瞪口呆，被 Shiroya 那句话钉在原地动弹不得。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The lights suddenly went out. Sai's face disappeared from sight as everything became dark.
entries.new: 灯光骤然熄灭。四周陷入一片漆黑，Sai 的脸也从视野里消失了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: S-Sai...?
entries.new: S-Sai……？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Yes?
entries.new: 怎么了？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: He was still there. We stood up, letting out heavy breaths.
entries.new: 他还在那里。我们站起身来，重重地喘着气。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What the fuck happened...?
entries.new: 这他妈到底是怎么回事……？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: You're asking the wrong person.
entries.new: 你问错人了。
