entries.text: After a few steps forward, I confirmed my assumption: the short door leading to the mechanical room was partially open.
entries.new: 往前走了几步后，我确认了自己的猜测：通往机械室的那扇矮门半开着。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It's this door. It was shut when we came, so the sound didn't reach us. I don't remember if we closed it when we left.
entries.new: 「是这扇门。我们来的时候它关着，所以声音传不到我们那里。我不记得走的时候有没有把它关上。」
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: Ah, I see. So at most, it means that someone went down here, but I'm sure they searched for us and Naomi. It's fine.
entries.new: 「啊，原来如此。那顶多只能说明有人下去过，不过他们肯定是在找我们和 Naomi。没什么好担心的。」
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: He began descending the stairs. If he'd really heard a sound coming from the lobby, it was possible someone was under us.
entries.new: 他开始下楼。如果他真的听见大厅传来声响，那下面说不定真有人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: After widening the gap of the door, he stepped into the basement room, which was constantly beset by the buzzing noise. I stopped behind him, waiting for my eyes to adjust to the illumination the faint light bulb offered.
entries.new: 他把门缝推得更大，走进了那间始终被嗡嗡声笼罩的地下室。我在他身后停下，等着眼睛适应那盏昏暗灯泡的光。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But even when that happened, the darkness still reigned. Atsuki started to walk slowly in order to comprehend where he was.
entries.new: 可即便如此，黑暗依旧笼罩四周。Atsuki 缓缓迈开步子，想弄清自己身在何处。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I-I don't think there's anyone here.
entries.new: 这、这里好像没有别人。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: I could discern a few pieces of furniture that Atsuki had moved aside and the walls closest to me. Strangely, I felt relieved to hear there was nobody with us, even though we wanted to find the others.
entries.new: 我能勉强辨认出 Atsuki 挪到一旁的几件家具，以及离我最近的墙壁。奇怪的是，听到这里没有别人，我竟松了口气——明明我们正是为了找其他人才来的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wait, no.
entries.new: 等等，不对。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Hm?
entries.new: 嗯？
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: Look.
entries.new: 你看。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: I thought we were about to leave, but that wasn't the case. I approached the dark blob Atsuki was next to until it was revealed to be a pile of chairs. Behind it, on the floor, was an abnormal, weak glow.
entries.new: 我以为我们就要走了，事实却并非如此。我走近 Atsuki 身旁那团黑影，才看清那是一叠椅子。椅子后方的地板上，泛着一层异样的微光。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The Sekimeiya. The gemstone we'd come to see and which possessed a mysterious power. Immobile on the floor, it resembled the ceiling light.
entries.new: 是 Sekimeiya。我们特地来看、据说拥有神秘力量的宝石。它静静躺在地板上，像天花板上那盏灯。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Sai was right. Katei had the key, and he used it while we were in the attic.
entries.new: Sai 说得没错。钥匙在 Katei 手上，我们待在阁楼的时候，他用了那把钥匙。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: ...Yeah.
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: I'm not sure why he'd hide the Sekimeiya, though.
entries.new: 不过我不明白他为什么要藏起 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: I don't think it makes any sense. He would've had better places to hide it, like his locker.
entries.new: 我也觉得说不通。他要藏，有的是更合适的地方，比如他自己的储物柜。
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: You think so? We could force him to open it at any time, and it would be easily found after the exit opens.
entries.new: 你这么想？我们随时都能逼他打开储物柜，而出口一开，那地方很容易就会被搜到。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Atsuki crouched next to the Sekimeiya and stared at it.
entries.new: Atsuki 蹲在 Sekimeiya 旁，凝视着它。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Are you gonna use it?
entries.new: ……你打算用它？
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: We don't know how long it's been here for, so it might not be a good idea.
entries.new: 我们不知道它在这里放了多久，所以最好还是别轻举妄动。
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: What do you mean?
entries.new: 什么意思？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Well, if the time you travel depends on how long it spends out of the cabinet, you could go really far back.
entries.new: 你想，如果穿越的时间长短取决于它离开展示柜多久，那你有可能一下子回到很久以前。
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: Oh... Hm, I see.
entries.new: 哦……嗯，原来如此。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Once again, he went quiet. I had no idea what he was thinking, but I knew I didn't like it.
entries.new: 他又一次沉默下来。我猜不透他在想什么，但我知道我不喜欢这样。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Sai had warned me not to let Atsuki get his hands on the Sekimeiya, and I had no idea why. All I knew was that he was keeping some of his thoughts to himself, and I suspected he'd lied to me.
entries.new: Sai 曾警告我，别让 Atsuki 拿到 Sekimeiya，我一直不明白原因。我只知道 Atsuki 有些想法没说出来，而且我怀疑他对我撒了谎。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: He was concocting something—that I was sure of. Not only because I knew him, he'd outright admitted it to me.
entries.new: 他在盘算着什么——这一点我确信不疑。不只是因为我了解他，他自己也当面承认过。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: For once, the silence wasn't entirely pure. The mechanical room's noise was pervasive. Minutes after staring at the gemstone, Atsuki's hand hovered over it.
entries.new: 难得这一次，沉默并不纯粹。机械室的声响无处不在。盯着那颗宝石看了几分钟后，Atsuki 把手悬在了它的上方。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What are you doing?
entries.new: 你在做什么？
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: It's hot, the air around it.
entries.new: 它周围那片空气，是热的。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Oh, that's weird.
entries.new: 哦，那可真是奇怪。
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: When I touched it earlier, I felt a zap for an instant before I teleported. I have no idea how, but it heated up really fast. When I was holding the cushion from below, it went from cold to hot in a minute.
entries.new: 我之前碰它的时候，传送前的一瞬间有种被电到的感觉。我不知道是怎么回事，但它升温非常快。我从下面托着坐垫的时候，它一分钟内就从冰凉变得烫手。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: I didn't know how to answer, but the bizarre situation sunk in even further. What the hell was the Sekimeiya, and what was it doing with us?
entries.new: 我不知道该怎么回答，只觉得这怪异的局面愈发压在心头。Sekimeiya 究竟是什么东西，它又想对我们做什么？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Are you going to use it to change the past?
entries.new: 你打算用它改变过去吗？
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: I don't know.
entries.new: 我不知道。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: That answer reinforced everything I'd been feeling. He couldn't not know. He knew exactly what his goal was, and I did too. So why was he acting so reserved?
entries.new: 这个回答印证了我一直以来的感觉。他不可能不知道。他清楚自己的目标是什么，我也清楚。那他为什么还要这样讳莫如深？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But he didn't flesh out his answer, opting to resume his silence. Even though I couldn't see his face, his slow breathing told me all I needed to know.
entries.new: 但他没有多说，只是重新陷入沉默。虽然看不见他的脸，他那缓慢的呼吸已经说明了一切。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I might've pushed the issue further if something hadn't hit me.
entries.new: 若不是忽然想到了什么，我或许会继续追问下去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: When he teleported...
entries.new: 他传送的时候……
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: After mentioning the time he'd touched the Sekimeiya, a glaring contradiction that I'd previously ignored reared its head.
entries.new: 他提到自己碰过 Sekimeiya 的那一刻，一个我之前视而不见的明显矛盾，就此浮出水面。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: You traveled to the attic, right?
entries.new: 你穿越回了阁楼，对吧？
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: Yes.
entries.new: 对。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: He's lying.
entries.new: 他在撒谎。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: There's no way he traveled to the attic. Did he not realize that it doesn't make sense?
entries.new: 他绝不可能穿越回了阁楼。他没意识到这根本说不通吗？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: He said he traveled twenty minutes to the past. At that point, all of us were in the attic as well.
entries.new: 他说自己回到了二十分钟前。那个时候，我们所有人也都在阁楼里。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: That's fine depending on where he appeared. It's not like he erased his past self, right? So if he appeared in one of the rooms after they'd been investigated, we wouldn't have seen him.
entries.new: 这倒要看他在哪里现身。他并没有抹消过去的自己，对吧？所以，如果他出现在某个已经搜查完的房间，我们就不会看见他。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: But there's a big problem.
entries.new: 但这里有个大问题。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Where in the attic did you appear?
entries.new: 你出现在阁楼的哪个位置？
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: Hm? In the kitchen, and I'm pretty sure that's because I went there before we left. It's something I was trying to figure out earlier.
entries.new: 嗯？厨房。我想大概是因为我们离开前我去过那里。这一点我之前也一直在琢磨。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Ah...
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: No, he's lying.
entries.new: 不，他在说谎。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: The only part of the attic where he could've appeared is the staircase at the entrance.
entries.new: 阁楼里他可能出现的地方，只有入口处的楼梯。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Every other place doesn't make sense. When we searched the whole floor, we made sure nobody could sneak past us. Katei waited in the corner of the hallway and Akaro in the living room.
entries.new: 其他任何地方都说不通。我们搜查整层楼时，已经确保没人能从我们眼皮底下溜过去。Katei 守在走廊角落，Akaro 则在客厅。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: As Erina said, twenty minutes before the time he traveled, all of us were still in the attic and were about to leave. Atsuki, who had traveled, didn't deny that.
entries.new: 正如 Erina 所说，在他穿越回过去之前二十分钟，我们都还在阁楼里，正准备离开。Atsuki 并没有否认这一点。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: According to him, he appeared in the kitchen and then we left. That's not right.
entries.new: 按他的说法，他出现在厨房，随后我们就离开了。这不对。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: For some reason, the elevator started functioning again, and Sai called it. Then he, Akaro, Erina, and Isla went to the crystal floor with it. However, Katei, Atsuki, and I left through the main door and locked it.
entries.new: 不知为何，电梯又恢复了运行，Sai 叫来了电梯。随后他、Akaro、Erina 和 Isla 乘电梯去了水晶层。而 Katei、Atsuki 和我则从大门离开，并锁上了门。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Atsuki, after appearing in the kitchen, would not have been able to leave the attic.{w} He couldn't have left through the staircase before us, because there were no footprints that started from the kitchen.
entries.new: Atsuki 出现在厨房之后，不可能离开阁楼。{w}他也无法赶在我们之前从楼梯离开，因为没有任何从厨房开始的脚印。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: When we left, we locked the main door, but most importantly, we learned that when the three of us arrived at the crystal floor, Katei saw the door of the elevator slightly open.
entries.new: 我们离开时锁上了大门，但最关键的是，我们得知：我们三人到达水晶层时，Katei 看见电梯门微微敞开着。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: How does he not understand that what he's saying is impossible? The elevator remained open on the crystal floor until a time after he'd already reunited with us. If he was in the attic, he couldn't have called it.
entries.new: 他难道不明白自己说的根本不可能吗？电梯一直停在水晶层敞着门，直到他与我们会合之后才被关上。若他当时在阁楼里，就不可能把电梯叫过去。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: It just doesn't work. When we were in the security room, the elevator was still open, and it had to be either Sai or Naomi who finally closed it.
entries.new: 这说不通。我们在监控室时，电梯还开着；最后把电梯关上的人，只可能是 Sai 或 Naomi。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Could it be that it wasn't the group of four who left the door open? ...Is it possible Atsuki used the elevator immediately after them, and it was actually him who didn't close it properly?
entries.new: 难道没关电梯门的不是那四个人？……有没有可能，Atsuki 紧跟着他们用了电梯，而真正没把门关好的人其实是他？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I don't think he would've had enough time to call it back and go all the way down. ...And it's very unlikely the others wouldn't have seen him. It's even possible we would've heard the elevator going up and down from the offices.
entries.new: 我认为他根本没时间把电梯叫回来，再一路下去。……况且其他人也不太可能没看见他。甚至我们在办公室时，都可能听见电梯上下的声响。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: So, how did he leave the attic?
entries.new: 那么，他究竟是怎么离开阁楼的？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: It's not possible. He couldn't have. Both methods were unavailable.
entries.new: 不可能。他做不到。两种方法都行不通。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: The only way would've been with the key that I have. Even if he somehow got out, maybe by Naomi unlocking the door, he should've mentioned that it was unlocked when it wasn't supposed to be. He's definitely lying.
entries.new: 唯一的办法，就是用我手上的钥匙。就算他真的设法出去了——比如是 Naomi 把门打开了——他也该提到门当时没锁，而它本不该没锁。他肯定在撒谎。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I became aware of the smell surrounding me, the one which almost seamlessly blended in. Its cold sensation had persisted in my nostrils since the first time we'd encountered it, so it hadn't immediately evident that it had strengthened again.
entries.new: 我察觉到了弥漫在四周的气味，那股气味几乎与周围融为一体。自第一次遇到它起，那股冰凉感就一直留在我鼻子里，所以它再次变浓时，我没有马上意识到。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...All right, I'll touch it. There's one thing I absolutely have to confirm.
entries.new: ……好，我碰。有一件事我无论如何都要确认。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: And what is that?
entries.new: 是什么事？
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: Whether or not the past can be changed.
entries.new: 过去究竟能不能被改变。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: ...You think it can't?
entries.new: ……你觉得不能？
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: I don't know; I wasn't able to change anything the last time. I have no idea how this will work.{w} I'll disappear from this room and appear somewhere else. If I try to change what I experienced, I don't know how the universe will react. Perhaps you won't notice any difference and I'll branch the world. Maybe this reality will instantly morph into the one I'm making.
entries.new: 我不知道；上一次我什么也没能改变。这次会怎样，我完全没把握。{w}我会从这个房间消失，出现在别处。如果我试图改变自己经历过的事，我不知道宇宙会如何反应。也许你察觉不到任何异样，而我会让世界分岔；也许这个现实会瞬间变成我正在塑造的那一个。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Despite how ridiculous he sounded, all he was really saying was that he was about to leave me there. That maybe I'd stay in the world he'd disappeared from while he went on to find his better reality.
entries.new: 不管他说得多么荒唐，他真正想表达的，不过是他准备把我丢在这里。也许我会留在他消失的那个世界，而他则继续去寻找他那个更好的现实。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It was annoying, and given everything else going on in my head, I simply shrugged. He would leave me behind with the Sekimeiya, which would be a great chance to fulfill Sai's request.
entries.new: 这让人心烦，可脑子里还装着别的一堆事，我也只是耸了耸肩。他会把我留在 Sekimeiya 旁边，而这正是完成 Sai 所托的绝佳机会。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I was going to say that if the past can't be changed, I'll be above the stairs after I disappear, but there's no way that'll be the case. If I was there right now, I'd try to make a loud noise to change the past, so I have no clue what's about to happen.
entries.new: ……我本来想说，如果过去无法改变，我消失后会出现在楼梯上方，但绝不可能如此。要是我现在就在那里，我会故意弄出很大的动静，试着改变过去；所以我完全猜不到接下来会发生什么。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: He didn't talk about it further. Finally, the hand that'd been teasing contact for so long dropped to touch the shining gem. Instantly, Atsuki's outline disappeared.
entries.new: 他没有再多说。终于，那只悬了许久、始终若即若离的手落了下去，触上发光的宝石。刹那间，Atsuki 的轮廓消失了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Ten Interloping Eyes
entries.new: 十双窥伺之眼

entries.text: Wh—!
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: And with it, the darkness disappeared as well.
entries.new: 黑暗也随之消失了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I almost fell in place. Before I could crouch to grab the Sekimeiya, the door to the lobby was in front of me.
entries.new: 我差点当场摔倒。还没等我蹲下去抓 Sekimeiya，通往大厅的门已经出现在我面前。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I was in hallway A. While the illumination was poor, it wasn't comparable to the mechanical room, mostly thanks to the light coming from the event room.
entries.new: 我人在 A 走廊。这里光线昏暗，但还没机械室那么暗，多半是靠活动室透出来的光。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I had teleported; nothing else could've happened. I took one step forward and confirmed that my legs still worked.
entries.new: 我只能是被传送了，不可能是别的情况。我向前迈出一步，确认双腿还能活动。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: A voice came from over my shoulders. I turned around and saw Atsuki, who'd stiffened.
entries.new: 身后传来一个声音。我转过身，看见 Atsuki 僵立在那里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: D-Did I just appear out of nowhere?
entries.new: 我、我是刚刚凭空出现的吗？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: What...? No, that's what happened to me.
entries.new: 什么……？不，突然出现的人是我。
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: ...Wait.
entries.new: ……等等。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Were you just in the mechanical room?
entries.new: 你刚才在机械室？
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: Yes... I touched the Sekimeiya a second ago.
entries.new: 是……我刚刚碰了 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: I showed up here as soon as you did that. Are we in the past...?
entries.new: 你刚碰完，我就出现在这里了。我们是在过去吗……？
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: ...{w}It teleported you as well? How come that didn't happen the other times?{w} And both of us appeared here...
entries.new: ……{w}它把你也传送了？为什么之前几次没发生这种事？{w}而且我们两个都出现在这里……
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Hey! What the fuck...!? Where have you two been!?
entries.new: 喂！这他妈怎么回事……！？你们俩到底去哪儿了！？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Sai emerged from the event room. Behind him was Erina, who looked surprised to see us.
entries.new: Sai 从活动室里出来。跟在他身后的是 Erina，她看到我们时露出惊讶的神色。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Has anything happened?
entries.new: ……发生什么事了吗？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: What...!? You've been gone for over two hours! Answer the question!
entries.new: 什么……！？你们已经消失两个多小时了！回答我的问题！
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Atsuki appeared wary, perhaps because Sai might have overheard what we'd been talking about.
entries.new: Atsuki 显得警惕起来，也许是因为 Sai 可能听见了我们刚才的谈话。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We entered the event room. Isla was with them, and she looked a little sad, standing next to the cabinet with its empty interior exposed. The Sekimeiya was probably still in the mechanical room at that moment.
entries.new: 我们走进活动室。Isla 也在他们当中，神情有些黯然，站在柜门敞开的展示柜旁，柜子里空空如也。那个时候，Sekimeiya 大概还在机械室里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We didn't get any sleep last night, so we were really tired and went to the attic. We woke up a few minutes ago.
entries.new: 我们昨晚一晚没睡，实在撑不住，就去了阁楼。几分钟前才醒过来。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: What the fuck? You were sleeping? Why didn't you say anything!?
entries.new: 搞什么鬼？你们刚才在睡觉？怎么都不吭一声！？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Because Katei wouldn't have let us.
entries.new: 因为 Katei 不会同意的。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: ...Excuse me?{w} Was Katei not with you?
entries.new: ……等等？{w}Katei 没和你们在一起吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What? No, he wasn't. We went alone.
entries.new: 什么？没有。我们俩是自己去的。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Where is he, then? We haven't seen him either, not for a long time.
entries.new: 那他去哪儿了？我们也很久没见过他了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: He wasn't with us.
entries.new: 他没和我们在一起。
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: We thought the three of you were in the attic, which we couldn't enter.
entries.new: 我们还以为你们三个在阁楼里，可我们进不去。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: It was just the two of us.
entries.new: 只有我们两个人。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: ...{w}What the fuck, then!?
entries.new: ……{w}那他妈的到底是怎么回事！？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: You don't have any idea where he went?
entries.new: 你们也不知道他去哪儿了？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Well, we thought you three were locked up there, so we didn't search everywhere. We even thought Naomi could have been with you since she's still missing.
entries.new: 我们以为你们三个被关在里面，就没到处搜。Naomi 到现在还下落不明，我们还以为她可能和你们在一起。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What about Akaro? Where is he?
entries.new: Akaro 呢？他在哪儿？
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: No idea, but I saw him not too long ago. He's been here the whole time.{w} Do you still have the key to the attic?
entries.new: 不知道，不过刚才我还见过他。他一直都在这儿。{w}阁楼的钥匙还在你们手上吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Yes.
entries.new: 在。
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: ...I see. That's good.
entries.new: ……这样啊。那就好。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Hold on. What happened to the Sekimeiya? Why is it not here?
entries.new: 等一下。Sekimeiya 怎么了？怎么不在这里？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: We have no idea. We thought one of you came down to pick it up and brought it to the attic. The cabinet was locked, and none of us had the key to unlock it. If you two didn't take it out, Katei or Naomi must have another key.
entries.new: 我们也不清楚。我们还以为是你们当中有谁下来把它取走，带去了阁楼。展示柜是锁着的，我们谁都没有钥匙。既然不是你们俩拿的，那肯定是 Katei 或 Naomi 另有一把钥匙。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: It's been gone from the cabinet for a while, but Akaro and I searched this floor and found it in a drawer in the lobby.
entries.new: 它从展示柜里消失过一阵子。我和 Akaro 在这一层找过，最后在大厅的抽屉里找到了它。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: We put it back in here, and about twenty minutes ago, we realized it had been taken out again. Again, Katei or Naomi did that if it wasn't one of you.
entries.new: 我们把它放回了这里，结果大约二十分钟前，我们发现它又被人拿走了。同样，如果不是你们俩，那就是 Katei 或 Naomi。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...{w}Oh, right, what time is it?
entries.new: ……{w}对了，现在几点了？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: He showed us his wristwatch. Immediately, Atsuki turned to face me.
entries.new: 他把手表给我们看。Atsuki 立刻转向我。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I knew why. At that moment, we had just walked down the stairs to the mechanical room. We'd been down there for a while, and then we had appeared in hallway A during the time we'd been in the security room.
entries.new: 我知道他在想什么。就在这一刻，我们才刚走下楼梯，进了机械室。我们在下面待了一阵子，随后却出现在了 A 走廊，时间正是我们之前待在监控室的那段。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Atsuki wanted to change the past, and he had the chance to do so. I doubted that he wanted to be seen by his past self, but making a loud noise would serve as a confirmation that the possibility existed. If nothing else, I'd be able to witness it too thanks to traveling with him.
entries.new: Atsuki 想改变过去，而眼下他正好有这个机会。我想他并不愿意被过去的自己看见，不过只要弄出足够大的声响，就足以确认这种可能确实存在。反正我是和他一起穿越的，至少也能亲眼见证。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: However, it was at that moment that a sound reached our ears.
entries.new: 可就在那个时候，我们听见了动静。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: As we glanced at the hallway A door, the sound got louder. It didn't take much time for the door to open, revealing Akaro on the other side.
entries.new: 我们朝 A走廊的门望去，声音越来越响。没过多久，门就开了，Akaro 出现在门后。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Everyone present was surprised at the same time.{w} While Akaro hadn't expected to see me and Atsuki, we hadn't expected to see who he was with either.
entries.new: 在场的人同时愣住了。{w}Akaro 没想到会见到我和 Atsuki，而我们也同样没想到他身边站着的是谁。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: At his side was Katei, who had supposedly been missing for quite some time. He stared at us hesitantly, evidently anticipating our reaction.
entries.new: 他身旁是 Katei，据说已经失踪好一阵子了。他迟疑地望着我们，显然在等着我们的反应。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...H-Hey! What the fuck have you been doing!?
entries.new: ……喂、喂！你他妈到底在干什么！？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Remaining silent, Katei turned to the cabinet.
entries.new: Katei 一言不发，转头看向展示柜。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: You found them too...?
entries.new: 你们也找到了……？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: They said they were sleeping alone in the attic. ...Katei, what are you waiting for? Where the fuck have you been?
entries.new: 他们说他们俩是单独睡在阁楼里的。……Katei，你还愣着干什么？你他妈到底去哪儿了？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...I've been here.{w} *sigh*
entries.new: ……我一直在这儿。{w}（叹气）
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: I'm sorry?
entries.new: 你说什么？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I've been here this whole time. I didn't go anywhere.
entries.new: 我一直都在这儿，哪儿也没去。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Wh-What? Do you know how long it's been since we saw you?
entries.new: 什、什么？你知道我们有多久没见到你了吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I'm being serious. Do you have any idea how long we've been looking around for you?
entries.new: 我是认真的。你知道我们找了你多久吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: It's been almost {tip=hours}three hours{/tip}, I know. I couldn't have gone anywhere. I just came across Akaro ten minutes ago.
entries.new: 已经快{tip=hours}三个小时{/tip}了，我当然知道。我哪儿也去不了。我十分钟前才碰上 Akaro。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: I saw him in hallway C and asked him the same thing. He said he'd been here looking for us. We went to the sixth floor to find you since I'd seen you there earlier and I didn't know where Erina and Isla were.
entries.new: 我在 C走廊看见他，也问了同样的话。他说他一直在这儿找我们。我之前在六楼见过你们，又不知道 Erina 和 Isla 在哪儿，就和他上六楼找你们去了。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: I looked at Atsuki, who'd been quiet for a while. He was thinking about something, but was it along the lines of everyone showing up meaning that the past couldn't change? It still should've been as simple as going to the lobby.
entries.new: 我看向已经沉默了好一会儿的 Atsuki。他在思索着什么——是在想，所有人都聚到这里，是不是就意味着过去无法改变？可这件事本来应该只是去一趟大厅那么简单。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Where is the Sekimeiya? And did I hear that you two were sleeping in the attic...? Did I not tell you—
entries.new: Sekimeiya 呢？还有，我刚才是不是听你们说，你们俩睡在阁楼里……？我不是跟你们说过——
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Shut up. What the fuck did that even mean?
entries.new: 住口。你那话到底是什么意思？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...What?
entries.new: ……什么？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: You said that it's almost been three hours since we saw you. How the fuck do you even know that?
entries.new: 你说我们快三个小时没见到你了。你他妈怎么会知道？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What? I answered your question.
entries.new: 什么？我不过是在回答你的问题。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: "Almost three hours" is awfully precise, and it's correct. If you truly were here, and for some reason didn't see anyone for three hours, would your sense of time be good enough to know that?
entries.new: 「快三个小时」——说得未免太准，而且还分毫不差。就算你真的一直在这儿，又因为什么缘故三个小时没见到任何人，你的时间感能准到这个地步吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Are you doing this again...? Trying to blame me for anything you can?
entries.new: 你又来这一套……？只要能抓到点什么，就要往我头上推？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: You're a fucking liar! You haven't been here for hours! Where the fuck were you, and why are you back? The computer doesn't work, and I'm the only one with a watch. How did you accurately say that you've been gone for three hours!?{w} Hey, did Naomi have a watch? Does anyone remember?
entries.new: 你他妈在撒谎！你根本好几个小时都不在这儿！你到底去了哪儿，又为什么回来？电脑用不了，有手表的只有我一个。你怎么可能准确说出你已经离开了三个小时！？{w}喂，Naomi 有手表吗？有人记得吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: The three members of the first group shrugged. Atsuki and I knew there was still a way to use the computer to know the time, but I didn't even get the chance to consider if we should mention it.
entries.new: 第一组的三个人耸了耸肩。我和 Atsuki 都知道，还有办法用电脑查到时间，可我连考虑要不要提一句的机会都没有。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wh...! Did you hear that!?
entries.new: 什……！你们听见了吗！？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Hear what?
entries.new: 听见什么？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Didn't a sound come from the lobby?
entries.new: 大厅那边是不是有声音？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: ...I didn't hear anything.
entries.new: ……我什么都没听见。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Nobody had. Probably not even Atsuki, who took no time to exit the room.
entries.new: 谁也没有听见。恐怕连 Atsuki 也没有——他几乎没在房里停留，转身就出了门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Our past selves still had to be in the mechanical room. If the past couldn't be changed, it meant that something would always prevent him from proceeding, but the arrival of Katei and Akaro hadn't conclusively proven it. Confused, the rest of us followed behind him and saw him opening the door to the lobby.
entries.new: 过去的我们此时理应仍在机械室里。若过去无法改变，那就意味着总会有某种东西拦在他前面——可 Katei 和 Akaro 的出现，还不足以证明这一点。我们满心困惑地跟在他身后，看他推开了通往大厅的门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Once he opened that door, he didn't take even a step forward.
entries.new: 门开了，他却一步也没有迈出去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Instead, he froze in place, and as he stopped gripping the knob, he turned his head back to us.
entries.new: 他僵在原地，握着门把的手松了下来，回头看向我们。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Who...{w} is this?
entries.new: 这……{w}这是谁？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: We dashed to the door.{w} ...When we looked through it, we immediately realized that wasn't the only question to ask.
entries.new: 我们冲到门口。{w}……往门里一看，才立刻明白，该问的远不止这一句。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Ah! Isla, stay over there!
entries.new: 啊！Isla，你待在那边别动！
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: A single body lay down on the floor over a vast pool of blood.
entries.new: 一具尸体倒在地上，身下是一大片血泊。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There was no meaning to be found. No smell of blood, no identity of the corpse, but a death that defied reason. Furthermore, the past had changed. Not because of the appearance of a body, but because of Erina's yell, which had spread throughout the crystal floor—a yell we hadn't heard while we'd been downstairs.{w} I immediately understood that someone had been killed. I'd gone over the concept of death many times in my mind, so I simply stared at that dreamlike scene before I was pushed aside.
entries.new: 这一切毫无道理可言。没有血腥味，也辨不清死者的身份，只有一桩违背常理的死亡。而且，过去已经变了。改变的原因不是这具尸体的出现，而是 Erina 的那声喊叫——它传遍了水晶层，而我们在楼下时，谁也没有听见。{w}我立刻明白，有人被杀了。死亡这件事，我早就在心里翻来覆去想过很多次，所以只是怔怔地望着那如梦似幻的一幕，直到被人推开。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Isn't he...!?
entries.new: 他不是……！？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: The shock had paralyzed everyone, and Katei was the first to snap out of it. He ran toward the body and turned it around, trying not to step on all the blood around it.
entries.new: 所有人都惊得动弹不得，Katei 最先回过神来。他朝尸体跑去，把尸体翻过来，尽量不踩到四处的血迹。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wait, I recognize him too. Wasn't he there?
entries.new: 等等，我也认得他。他之前不就在那边吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Sai pointed at the shutter, prompting me to remember that I also knew the man, who was dressed in a police uniform.
entries.new: Sai 指了指卷帘门，我这才想起自己也见过这个人——他穿着警察制服。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Y-Yes... That's where I s-saw him, while we were waiting. Fuck.
entries.new: 对、对……我们等着的时候，我就是在那里看、看见他的。妈的。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Atsuki's voice cracked. He wouldn't take his eyes off the body.
entries.new: Atsuki 的声音都变了调，目光死死钉在那具尸体上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: He's been here at the tower recently. I don't know his name, but he was investigating a possible terrorist attack.
entries.new: 他最近常来塔里。名字我不知道，不过他一直在调查一起可能的恐怖袭击。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Katei crouched and used two fingers to verify that there was no pulse.
entries.new: Katei 蹲下身，用两根手指探了探，确认已经没有脉搏。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: He didn't say it out loud.
entries.new: 他没有说出口。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: This is a knife wound.
entries.new: 是刀伤。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: The uniform on his chest had been pierced a single time, but the knife in question wasn't there.
entries.new: 他胸前的制服只被刺穿了一处，可那把刀并不在现场。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: A knife...? How did this person get in? Look at the blood. ...This happened minutes ago.
entries.new: 刀……？这人是怎么进来的？你看这血……才不过几分钟的事。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: He entered the same way Katei left.
entries.new: 他是沿着 Katei 离开的那条路进来的。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Huh?
entries.new: 啊？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: You've been missing for the last three hours. Just as you reappear, this person shows up dead. This is no coincidence.
entries.new: 你失踪了整整三个小时。你刚一回来，这个人就出现在这里，已经死了。这不会是巧合。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What the hell are you talking about? How would I have left!?
entries.new: 你在胡说些什么？我怎么可能出得去！？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: I don't know. You remember the Sekimeiya, right? As you said, it's not in the cabinet right now, and you're an excellent candidate to have taken it out.{w} It's possible this man entered the tower after it was locked down, and if you did so too, your disappearance, your knowledge of the time, and this knife you're talking about... would all make sense.
entries.new: 我不知道。你记得 Sekimeiya 吧？就像你说的，它现在不在展示柜里，最可能把它拿走的人就是你。{w}这个人有可能是在封锁之后才进塔的；如果你也是这样，那你失踪的那段时间、你对时间的了解，还有你口中的那把刀……就全都说得通了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I cannot believe what I'm hearing! I've been here the entire time! And I couldn't have unlocked the cabinet!
entries.new: 我真不敢相信自己的耳朵！我一直都在这儿！而且我根本打不开那个展示柜！
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Enraged, Katei pulled up the man's shirt and uncovered his waist.
entries.new: Katei 怒气冲冲地掀起那人的衬衫，露出他的腰侧。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Yes, look at this! This is why I thought it must've been a knife. It was his own!{w} He still has his baton, but his knife is gone. I personally saw that he had a knife right here a few days ago.
entries.new: 对，你们看这里！我就是因为这个才认定凶器是刀。那是他自己的刀！{w}警棍还在，刀却不见了。几天前我亲眼看见，他的刀就挂在这个位置。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: He continued examining his clothes and pockets.
entries.new: 他继续翻查那人的衣服和口袋。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Oh! He has a walkie-talkie!
entries.new: ……哦！他带着对讲机！
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Everyone's eyes widened until we saw Katei pressing every button and showing us its blank display.
entries.new: 众人眼睛都睁大了，可 Katei 把按键逐个按了一遍，给我们看的只有空白的屏幕。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Is it not working? Let me see.
entries.new: 坏了吗？让我看看。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Katei gave Akaro the device. After fiddling with it for a while, he noticed what was wrong.
entries.new: Katei 把对讲机递给 Akaro。他摆弄了一阵，才发现了问题所在。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...There's a battery missing, and the cover isn't properly attached. There's also a crack here on the bottom, look.
entries.new: ……少了一节电池，后盖也没盖好。底下这儿还有道裂缝，你看。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: These work with normal batteries?
entries.new: 这种对讲机用的是普通电池？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Apparently, and this cover can be manually removed. Maybe they failed to break it by force and removed a battery instead.
entries.new: 看样子是，而且这个后盖可以手动拆下来。也许对方硬砸不开，就干脆取走了一节电池。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Are there batteries like these anywhere?
entries.new: 这座塔里有这种电池吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: No, I really don't think so...
entries.new: 没有，我想应该没有……
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: He left the device on the floor.
entries.new: 他把对讲机搁回了地上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: So the killer did this to prevent us from talking to people outside once again.{w} I have to assume that you still have not found Naomi, so instead of blaming me, consider that it's very possible this person has been here since we got trapped, and we didn't find him just like we couldn't find Naomi.
entries.new: 所以凶手这么做，是为了再一次切断我们和外面的联系。{w}我只能认为你们还是没找到 Naomi——与其在这里怪我，不如想想：这个人很可能从我们被困起就一直待在塔里，我们找不到他，就像找不到 Naomi 一样。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Okay, then you killed him?
entries.new: 好，那是你杀了他？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...{w}Don't say stuff like that. I didn't do this.
entries.new: ……{w}别乱说话。人不是我杀的。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: ...Then who did? It seems like it could've been anyone, but your story is by far the most questionable one. Do we really have to keep listening to this Naomi boogeyman schtick?
entries.new: ……那是谁？这里谁都可能下手，可你的说法偏偏最站不住脚。我们难道还要继续听你拿 Naomi 当鬼来吓人吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...Stop.{w} Akaro, is what you said earlier true? That you found Katei ten minutes before coming to the event room?
entries.new: ……等等。{w}Akaro，你刚才说的是真的吗？你说来活动室之前十分钟找到了 Katei？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Uh... Yes, I don't know if it really was ten minutes, though.
entries.new: 呃……是。不过我也不确定是不是真有十分钟。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: What time is it right now?
entries.new: 现在几点？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: It's unlikely Katei did this, then. Six minutes ago, this hadn't happened yet.
entries.new: 那么就不太可能是 Katei 做的了。六分钟前，这件事还没发生。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: ...{w}Is that so? You two were talking in hallway A. Did you look at the lobby? I recall the door was shut.
entries.new: ……{w}是吗？你们俩当时在 A走廊说话。你们看过大厅吗？我记得那扇门是关着的。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: We did.
entries.new: 看过。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: He's right.
entries.new: 他说得没错。
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: At {time=13:17}, we'd walked down to the mechanical room, which meant that the man had died while we'd been under him.
entries.new: {time=13:17}，我们已经下到机械室，也就是说，那个男人死的时候，我们就在他脚下。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...If you're not lying, then forget what I said. Everyone has an alibi, unless two or more people did it.{w} You two were together, Katei and Akaro were together, and me, Erina, and Isla were together.
entries.new: ……如果你们没说谎，那就当我没说过。所有人都有不在场证明——除非凶手是两个人以上。{w}你们俩在一起，Katei 和 Akaro 在一起，而我、Erina 和 Isla 在一起。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: We looked past the door, where Erina was crouching next to Isla, comforting her from a sight she hadn't seen. Despite that, she was burying her face in her arms.
entries.new: 我们朝门里望去，Erina 正蹲在 Isla 身边安慰她，想让她避开那幅从未见过的景象。可即便如此，她还是把脸埋进了臂弯里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: A dour mood had overtaken the entire group. I wasn't sure if it was because they had been exposed to death or because they feared the killer.
entries.new: 阴郁的气氛笼罩了所有人。我不知道是因为他们直面了死亡，还是因为畏惧那个凶手。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Atsuki's demeanor had changed the least, probably because it didn't have far to go anyway. Regardless, I had to put on the same appearance, and it came naturally after the previous two weeks. The death of that man meant nothing to me, and I was only a little intrigued. I'd always known I'd react like that, and while I knew I couldn't show it, I didn't feel it was necessarily problematic as long as nobody found out.
entries.new: Atsuki 的神情变化最小，大概是因为他本来也没什么起伏的余地。无论如何，我也得装出同样的样子，而经过前两周，这已经变得自然而然。那个男人的死对我而言毫无意义，我只觉得有几分好奇。我早就知道自己会是这种反应；我也明白不能表现出来，但只要没人发现，我并不觉得这有什么问题。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: So, it was actually Naomi...?
entries.new: 这么说，真的是 Naomi……？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: I have no idea how this man entered the tower. It's possible he was here from the beginning, or there could actually be a secret way in. It wouldn't surprise me given the track record this place has. However, he's a police officer, so whoever did this might've killed him just because of that.
entries.new: 我完全不知道这个男人是怎么进到塔里的。也许他从一开始就在里面，也可能真有条秘密通道。考虑到这地方的过往记录，我也不会感到意外。不过，他是警察，所以下手的人或许正是冲着这一点才杀了他。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I'm not sure how they took his knife or how we didn't hear a fight. In fact, I have no clue what happened.{w} None of us have blood on our clothes, which I suppose doesn't mean anything since it doesn't seem like much blood sprayed out, but I'll remind you all again that the Sekimeiya was hidden a while ago. All of us go back to having no alibi when everyone is able to go to the past.
entries.new: 我不知道对方是怎么夺走他的刀的，也不知道我们为什么没听到打斗声。说实话，我完全不明白发生了什么。{w}我们身上都没有血迹——不过这大概说明不了什么，毕竟看起来并没有溅出多少血。但我要再提醒各位一次：Sekimeiya 早就被藏起来了。只要所有人都能回到过去，我们每个人的不在场证明就都不成立了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Are you joking? Do you think one of us will go to the past and kill him?
entries.new: 你在开玩笑吧？你觉得我们之中会有人回到过去杀了他？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Well, you said Naomi still has a set of keys identical to yours. Whether or not that's true, we know of someone who does for sure.
entries.new: 这个嘛，你说过 Naomi 手上还有一套和你一模一样的钥匙。不管这话是真是假，我们至少知道有一个人确实有。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Multiple pairs of eyes faced me.
entries.new: 好几道目光同时落在我身上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I have it. We didn't hide the Sekimeiya, though.
entries.new: ……钥匙在我这儿。不过 Sekimeiya 不是我们藏的。
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: ...And if we had, we wouldn't have needed it to do this because we're the ones who saw the lobby empty just minutes ago.
entries.new: ……而且如果真是我们藏的，我们也不必靠它来做这件事——几分钟前亲眼看见大厅空无一人的，正是我们。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: That's right, which forces me to point out the topic you were discussing in hallway A.{w} "I touched the Sekimeiya a second ago." Didn't those words come out of your mouth?
entries.new: 没错，所以我不得不提一提你们在 A走廊聊的那件事。{w}「我刚才碰了一下 Sekimeiya。」——这话不是从你嘴里说出来的吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: They did. So you lied; you didn't see the lobby before I heard you since you appeared there from the future.
entries.new: 确实说了。所以你在撒谎——你并不是在我听见你之前看到大厅的，因为你是从未来出现在那里的。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...You're right, but we did see it before touching the Sekimeiya. It doesn't invalidate what we said.
entries.new: ……你说得对。不过我们确实在碰 Sekimeiya 之前看过大厅。这并不影响我们说过的话。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: You're admitting it, good. Is this travel yet to happen?
entries.new: 你承认了，很好。那这次穿越是还没发生吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I think it just happened. I don't know if anything went differently this time, but we found the Sekimeiya in the mechanical room, so whoever took it hid it there.
entries.new: 我想它刚刚发生了。我不知道这一次有没有哪里不同，但我们是在机械室找到 Sekimeiya 的，也就是说，拿走它的人把它藏在了那里。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Below us...? And you appeared in the hallway...
entries.new: 在我们下面……？而你们却出现在走廊里……
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I'm confused. You found the Sekimeiya? ...And I don't get how you got to that conclusion, Sai. Atsuki appeared there from the future, so he's the only one who couldn't have been able to look at the lobby before you saw them, right?
entries.new: 我有点糊涂了。你们找到了 Sekimeiya？……而且我不明白你是怎么得出这个结论的，Sai。Atsuki 是从未来出现在那里的，所以只有他不可能在你们看到他们之前看过大厅，对吧？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: No, both of—
entries.new: 不，他们两个都——
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: He stopped himself when he realized he'd made a mistake. His pause was what made Atsuki and me notice it.
entries.new: 他意识到自己说漏了嘴，硬生生把话咽了回去。正是那一顿，让我和 Atsuki 察觉到了异样。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Oh...! You know exactly what happened, don't you?
entries.new: 哦……！你其实很清楚发生了什么，对吧？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: You overheard our conversation, when we said we had traveled together.
entries.new: 你听到了我们的谈话，听到我们说是一起穿越的。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Akaro thought only I appeared in the hallway, but you know both of us did. I touched the Sekimeiya, which made both of us travel at the same time.
entries.new: Akaro 以为只有我出现在走廊里，可你知道我们两个都出现了。我碰了 Sekimeiya，让我们两个同时穿越了。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: And you were about to say "no, both of them traveled". However, given the knowledge of the Sekimeiya you should have, that shouldn't be possible. After touching it, the Sekimeiya would power off, and it would take a while before anyone could activate it again.{w} Does that mean that you knew that was possible? You haven't explained much about what you did during the time we were in the attic.
entries.new: 而你刚才差点说出「不，他们两个都穿越了」。可是，以你本该掌握的 Sekimeiya 知识来说，这本应是不可能的。碰过之后，Sekimeiya 就会关闭，要过一段时间才能再次启动。{w}这是否说明你早就知道那种情况有可能发生？我们待在阁楼的那段时间里你做了什么，你可没怎么解释过。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: ...What are you talking about? I was gonna say that both of you traveled together because it's what you two said. I stopped myself when I realized that Akaro was right; it didn't make sense.
entries.new: ……你在说什么？我本来要说你们俩是一起穿越的，因为这是你们自己说的。我停住，是因为意识到 Akaro 说得对——那根本讲不通。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...No, I don't think so.
entries.new: ……不，我看未必。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Sai shook his head, disregarding Atsuki's accusation. Then, he walked to the mechanical room.
entries.new: Sai 摇了摇头，没有理会 Atsuki 的指责，随后走向机械室。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: So, you two traveled recently, right? Should we just ignore the fact that you avoided telling us the location of the Sekimeiya, if we're to believe you didn't hide it?
entries.new: 那么，你们俩最近穿越过，对吧？如果我们相信你们没有藏起 Sekimeiya，那你们一直不肯说出它的位置，这事就这么算了？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: He didn't wait for an answer before he began to descend the staircase. The door had been left slightly open by the two of us so that the darkness below was at least slightly alleviated.
entries.new: 他没等回答，便沿着楼梯走了下去。我们两个给那扇门留了一条缝，好歹让下面透进了一点光。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Atsuki shared dubious looks with the others at Sai sidestepping the issue, but there was no choice except waiting for him to return.
entries.new: Sai 这样回避问题，Atsuki 和其他人交换了一个怀疑的眼神，但也只能等他回来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: You don't think he wanted to use the Sekimeiya, do you?
entries.new: 你觉得他不会是想用 Sekimeiya 吧？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Atsuki walked to the door, worried about Sai's intentions, but he stopped himself short after a couple steps.
entries.new: Atsuki 担心 Sai 的意图，朝门口走了过去，但才迈出两步就停住了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I was right. They're lying.
entries.new: 我没说错。他们在撒谎。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What? We aren't.
entries.new: 什么？我们没有。
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: Where is the Sekimeiya supposed to be, then?
entries.new: 那 Sekimeiya 应该在哪儿？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: It was behind the pile of chairs.
entries.new: 就在那堆椅子后面。
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: Incorrect. There was nothing down there.
entries.new: 不对。下面什么都没有。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Are you sure?
entries.new: 你确定？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: You're all free to go see by yourselves.
entries.new: 你们自己去看吧。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I knew that couldn't be true. We'd most likely arrived at the lobby before we'd disappeared from the mechanical room, so the Sekimeiya had to still be there. If Sai was so blatantly lying, had he found a way to frame us?
entries.new: 我知道那不可能。多半是我们从机械室消失之前，就已经到了大厅，所以 Sekimeiya 一定还在那里。Sai 敢这么明目张胆地撒谎，难道他已经找到了栽赃我们的办法？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Can you open that hip pack?
entries.new: 能把那个腰包打开吗？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: This? Sure. Do you think I have it...?{w} I'm being serious. I didn't find it, but it's possible I missed it. Go look.
entries.new: 这个？行啊。你觉得东西在我身上……？{w}我说真的。我没找到，但也许是我漏看了。自己去看吧。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Sai didn't have the Sekimeiya on him, so Atsuki accepted his suggestion and gestured at me to stay put.
entries.new: Sai 身上确实没有 Sekimeiya，Atsuki 便接受了他的提议，示意我留在原地。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Everyone silently stood in anticipation next to the still-expanding pool of blood.
entries.new: 所有人都沉默地站在还在扩大的血泊旁，静静等待。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Nothing, right?
entries.new: 什么都没有，对吧？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Yeah, it's not there.
entries.new: 嗯，不在那儿。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: You should've trusted me. Do you feel like changing your version of events now?
entries.new: 早该信我的。现在要不要改改你们的说法？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: No. We already told you what happened. The Sekimeiya should still be there.
entries.new: 不改。发生了什么，我们已经说过了。Sekimeiya 本来就应该在那里。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: What, did it disappear? Guess it wouldn't be that hard to believe.
entries.new: 怎么，它自己消失了？倒也不是不能信。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Sai had managed to switch roles as soon as he was put on the defensive, but it didn't seem to be bothering Atsuki much. Did he think that the past had been changed and that what was happening was the result? It didn't make a lot of sense to me.
entries.new: Sai 一被逼到防守的位置，就立刻反过来发难，可 Atsuki 似乎并不在意。他难道认为过去已经被改变，眼前的一切正是结果？我怎么想都想不通。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What do you all think? It's not a good look to be caught lying like this, is it?
entries.new: 你们怎么看？这样被人当面拆穿撒谎，可不太好看吧？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Don't you think that if we wanted to lie, we would've said that we found the Sekimeiya somewhere it was easy to steal?
entries.new: 你们不觉得吗？真要撒谎，我们大可以声称 Sekimeiya 是在一处很容易被人偷走的地方找到的。
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: Hm, that's always too ineffective of an excuse.
entries.new: 嗯，这种借口一向不太顶用。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...This policeman either had a way to not be found for hours, or he had some way to enter the building. ...A-And... he...
entries.new: ……这个警察要么有办法在几个小时里一直不被发现，要么就有办法进入这栋楼。……而、而且……他……
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Atsuki blinked several times, almost like he was fighting back tears.
entries.new: Atsuki 连眨了几下眼，像是在忍着眼泪。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Someone... killed him... and it's not easy for any of us to have done it. Finally, the Sekimeiya isn't where it should be.{w} Added to the fact that Naomi hasn't been found, you can't possibly think we did this, right?
entries.new: 有人……杀了他……而我们谁都不容易做到。还有，Sekimeiya 也不在该在的地方。{w}再加上 Naomi 至今不见踪影，你总不可能觉得这是我们干的吧？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: You didn't?
entries.new: 不是你们？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: There's n-no way. I think Naomi's the first person to suspect. Not only has she managed to remain hidden, but she also might have the same keys that we have.{w} There are no cameras here, but we don't know if they're recording in the first place... You said you didn't inspect the whole building because you thought we were in the attic, right? We have to be missing something that the culprit is aware of. Could there be a place we're ignoring?
entries.new: 绝、绝对不可能。我觉得第一个该怀疑的就是 Naomi。她不仅一直藏得不见人影，而且可能拿着和我们一样的钥匙。{w}这里没有摄像头，可我们连它们有没有在录像都不知道……你说过，因为以为我们在阁楼，所以没有查遍整栋楼，对吧？我们肯定漏掉了凶手知道的某个东西。会不会有某个地方被我们一直忽略？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: ...That's impossible.
entries.new: ……不可能。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: If not, then one of you did this. Naomi's disappearance should be enough proof that we're missing something, though.
entries.new: 若不是这样，那就是你们当中有人下的手。不过，Naomi 的失踪已经足以证明我们漏掉了什么。
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: We have to find her or whoever else is here. It's almost guaranteed that this man was with us since this morning, and we didn't find him. I think that's much more likely than some hidden passage.
entries.new: 必须找到她，或者找到还在这里的其他人。几乎可以肯定，这个人从今早就和我们待在同一栋楼里，我们却一直没发现他。比起有什么隐藏通道，我觉得这要合理得多。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: If it's neither of those, there's still an answer with the Sekimeiya. This policeman could've come from the future if he touched the Sekimeiya after {time=21}, and Naomi could've left the tower by going far to the past. We found the Sekimeiya in the attic and don't know where it is now.
entries.new: 如果这两者都不是，那还有 Sekimeiya 这个答案。这个警察若是在 {time=21} 之后碰过 Sekimeiya，就可能是从未来来的；Naomi 也可能远赴过去，就此离开了这座塔。我们在阁楼找到了 Sekimeiya，如今却不知道它在哪儿。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: We'll look everywhere. Not only could people still be hiding, but the Sekimeiya has to be somewhere too. I can't imagine the real person responsible doesn't know where.
entries.new: 每个地方都要搜。不仅可能还有人藏着，Sekimeiya 也一定在某处。我不信真正的凶手会不知道它在哪儿。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Go ahead and find Naomi for us.
entries.new: 那就麻烦你去把 Naomi 找出来吧。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: It's certainly possible someone's on this floor. Don't move from here.
entries.new: 这一层确实可能有人。你们待在这儿别动。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: ...Okay.
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: He began by looking in the storeroom and then in the room in front. He probably didn't know about the fact that some cabinets could be opened up.
entries.new: 他先去看了储藏室，又查了前面的房间。他大概不知道有些展示柜是可以打开的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Is he doing this by himself? Does he not trust us?
entries.new: 他打算一个人查？是不信我们吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: From hallway C, six pairs of eyes stared at him moving from room to room. He took a while in each one.
entries.new: C走廊里，六双眼睛注视着他一间间地查过去。他在每个房间里都要待上一阵。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Did you hear that?
entries.new: 你们听见了吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What?
entries.new: 什么？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: No?
entries.new: 没有啊？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: I glanced at Sai and discerned that he definitely still suspected Atsuki of something.
entries.new: 我瞥了 Sai 一眼，看得出他仍然在怀疑 Atsuki 什么。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Atsuki exited from the farthest away crystal room and turned to us. Without saying anything, he entered the security room.
entries.new: Atsuki 从最远的那间水晶展室出来，转向我们。他一言不发，走进了监控室。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What the fuck is he doing?
entries.new: 他他妈在干什么？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Do you think he's taking advantage of this to do something?
entries.new: 你觉得他是想趁这个机会做什么吗？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Yes.
entries.new: 没错。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I felt like I was watching everything unfold from the sidelines, oblivious as to what was really happening. For some reason, Atsuki hadn't revealed that we'd powered on the computer despite telling me that we would.
entries.new: 我觉得自己像个局外人，看着事情一件件发生，却对真相一无所知。Atsuki 明明说过要告诉大家我们把电脑开机了，可不知为何，他始终没有说。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: When he left the security room, he looked at us again and finally addressed us.
entries.new: 他走出监控室时又看了我们一眼，终于开了口。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Stay there! I'll look at the mechanical room again.
entries.new: 待在那儿别动！我再去看看机械室。
entries.speaker: a4

entries.text: He disappeared from our sight.{w} Soon, we began to hear the same sound of doors opening coming from hallway B.
entries.new: 他从我们视野里消失了。{w}很快，B走廊那边又传来了同样的开门声。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Akaro and Sai went to look while the rest of us waited behind.
entries.new: Akaro 和 Sai 过去查看，我们其余的人留在原地等着。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: When he returned, it didn't seem like he'd found anything.
entries.new: 他回来时，看上去一无所获。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There's nobody here. I didn't find the Sekimeiya or any potential hiding spot we don't know of. If Naomi's here, she's somehow above us.
entries.new: 这里没有人。我没找到 Sekimeiya，也没发现任何我们不知道的藏身之处。如果 Naomi 在这里，那她一定是躲在我们上面的哪一层。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: ...Are you sure you were thorough? Do you know some cabinets have compartments inside? The Sekimeiya could be there.
entries.new: ……你确定都仔细查过了？有些展示柜里面还有暗格，这你知道吗？Sekimeiya 说不定就藏在那里。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Yes, I looked in all of them.
entries.new: 嗯，每一个我都看过了。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Even the ones with temperature regulation? Did you make sure to close them?
entries.new: 连那些带温控的也查了？都关严了吧？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Those too, yeah. It took me a bit to figure out how to open them.
entries.new: 也查了。我还花了一会儿才弄明白怎么打开。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Before moving on, Atsuki looked in both bathrooms. Finally, he grabbed the elevator's handle.
entries.new: 继续走之前，Atsuki 又查看了两间洗手间。最后，他握住了电梯的门把手。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The door opened, revealing the empty elevator.
entries.new: 门开了，电梯里空无一人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I'll keep it open so that it can't be used.
entries.new: ……我让它一直开着，这样谁也坐不了。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: All right. Let's go.
entries.new: 好，走吧。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: He started to go up the stairs, and I found myself following first again. After passing through the narrow, gray door, we stepped back onto the desolate second floor.
entries.new: 他踏上楼梯，我发现自己又第一个跟了上去。穿过那扇窄小的灰门，我们重新回到荒凉的二楼。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Atsuki opened both bathroom doors and quickly dismissed them.
entries.new: Atsuki 推开两间洗手间的门，匆匆扫了一眼就略过去了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Hm, nothing.
entries.new: 嗯，什么也没有。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: I hated agreeing with Sai without knowing why, but he was right. It was hard not to think that Atsuki's attitude was odd.
entries.new: 我不明白自己为什么会认同 Sai，这让我很反感，可他没说错。Atsuki 的态度确实古怪，很难不让人这么想。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...It was really frustrating. I'd always been good at reading him, but while he walked toward the offices, I had no comprehension of what his thoughts were.
entries.new: ……真让人烦躁。我一向很会看他的心思，可这一次，看着他走向办公室，我却完全猜不到他在想什么。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wait here.
entries.new: 在这儿等着。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Can I do it instead?
entries.new: 不如让我来？
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: Huh? Yeah, sure.
entries.new: 嗯？哦，好啊。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: His nonchalant reaction threw me off, but I opened the door without letting that show. It was his idea to look through the whole building, which was possibly why Sai distrusted him. However, my confusion went beyond that.
entries.new: 他随口应下，反倒让我一愣，但我没有表露，径自推开了门。搜遍整栋楼本是他的提议，Sai 不信任他，或许就源于此。可我的困惑并不止于此。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: He'd openly told me about his intentions to change the past, so why did the sensation that he was hiding something still persist when he'd confided in me?
entries.new: 他明明坦率地告诉过我，他想改变过去。既然他对我交了底，为什么我还是觉得他有所隐瞒？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I kept going over it as I opened drawers and looked behind the computers. Every time I thought that maybe it was all in my head, something else reinforced the opposite.
entries.new: 我一边拉开抽屉、查看电脑背后，一边反复琢磨。每当我以为只是自己多心，就又有别的迹象让我确信不是。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There weren't many places to look at, so I was soon done with the three partitions.
entries.new: 能查的地方不多，三个隔间很快就看完了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I didn't find anything.
entries.new: 什么都没找到。
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: You looked everywhere, right?
entries.new: 每个角落都看了吧？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: It hit me that we were still alone.
entries.new: 我这才意识到，这里始终只有我们两个人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Yes, but did the others not come with us?
entries.new: 看了。不过，其他人没跟我们一起来吗？
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: I think they stayed on the crystal floor and let us go by ourselves.
entries.new: 他们大概留在水晶层了，让我们自己上来。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Really?
entries.new: 真的？
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: Yes, and we should continue. We have to find something. Be it Naomi or the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 嗯，我们继续吧。总得找到点什么，不管是 Naomi 还是 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: I shrugged lightly before we moved up to the third floor.
entries.new: 我轻轻耸了耸肩，随后我们上了三楼。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There, the same process was repeated. He looked at the two bathrooms, and I handled the offices while he waited outside so that no one crossed the path.
entries.new: 在三楼，同样的流程又走了一遍。他查看两间洗手间，我负责办公室；他等在门外，防止有人经过。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Our repeated movements led to the first step on floor 4.
entries.new: 我们就这样重复着，踏上了四楼。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Let's see here... It's not possible she's not anywhere.
entries.new: 看看吧……她总不可能凭空消失。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Behind the glass, I started to look through the same places as below, all while wondering whether I'd report a result anyway.
entries.new: 隔着玻璃隔断，我开始像楼下那样逐一翻查，心里却在琢磨，自己究竟会不会把结果说出去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I opened the door to the second partition and vanished from Atsuki's field of vision.
entries.new: 我推开第二个隔间的门，从 Atsuki 的视野里消失了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There were only drawers that I questioned whether to keep checking. Midway through, I decided to push open the door to the last section.
entries.new: 里面只有几个抽屉，我犹豫着还要不要继续翻。查到一半，我决定推开最后一间的门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I stared inside.
entries.new: 我向里面看去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I kept doing so for many seconds, gripping the door's handle with my right hand.{w} One of the many thoughts that crossed my mind was if I should move.
entries.new: 我就这样看了好几秒，右手始终握着门把手。{w} 脑中掠过许多念头，其中之一是：我该不该动。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Until I realized that it wasn't up to me. It hadn't been my choice not to move. However, my hand soon let go of the handle, and the door was shut again.
entries.new: ……直到我意识到，这由不得我。我并没有选择不动。可没过多久，我的手松开了把手，门又合上了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: When it did, I couldn't open it again. I stood next to it for a long time, during which I only focused on my breathing.
entries.new: 门合上之后，我再也打不开了。我在门边站了很久，只留意着自己的呼吸。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Eventually, I comprehended that I was still able to move, and I took a step back. Strangely, neither my vision nor my mind seemed to be blurry.
entries.new: 良久，我才明白自己还能动，于是往后退了一步。奇怪的是，我的视线和脑子似乎都并不模糊。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I looked at the opaque wall and discerned a few silhouettes belonging to the chairs on the other side. However, I couldn't open the door again, and I didn't want to.
entries.new: 我望向那面不透明的隔板，隐约辨出另一侧几把椅子的轮廓。可是，我无法再打开那扇门，也不想打开。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'd developed an irrational fear of spiders early on in my life. Whenever I knew a spider was in a room, I'd freeze behind its door, unable to open it. That was the same sensation I felt as I slowly backed away.
entries.new: 我从小就莫名其妙地怕蜘蛛。只要知道房里有蜘蛛，我就会僵在门外，怎么也不敢推门。此刻我缓缓后退，心里正是同样的感觉。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Nothing again?
entries.new: 又是空的？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: I shook my head.
entries.new: 我摇了摇头。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If she's in the attic, she won't be able to take the elevator down, but this is very strange.
entries.new: 要是她在阁楼，就没法坐电梯下来。可这也太奇怪了。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: We walked the path to the fifth floor until we reached the staircase.
entries.new: 我们沿着通往五楼的通道往前走，一直到了楼梯口。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Are you all right?
entries.new: ……你没事吧？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: ...Huh?{w} Yes.
entries.new: ……嗯？{w} 没事。
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: You look zoned out. Are you tired?
entries.new: 你有点魂不守舍。累了吗？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: A bit. It's okay.
entries.new: 有点。不碍事。
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: All right, but don't push yourself.
entries.new: 好吧，不过别硬撑。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: I'll look myself, so wait here.
entries.new: 我自己去看，你在这儿等着。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: I didn't voice any complaints. I just gave him a tiny nod.{w} Outside, I kept glancing left and right until Atsuki was done.
entries.new: 我没有出声反对，只是轻轻朝他点了点头。{w} 到了外面，我一直左顾右盼，直到 Atsuki 查看完毕。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I don't really expect Naomi to be in these, but it all gets weirder every time we move on. Could a secret place that Katei doesn't know about exist...?
entries.new: ……我本来也没指望 Naomi 会在这里面，可每往前走一步，事情就愈发古怪。真会有连 Katei 都不知道的隐秘之处吗……？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: There's no way, right? If the answer is somehow a hidden spot, he must've made use of it as well.
entries.new: 不可能吧？如果答案真是某处隐蔽的角落，那他自己肯定也早就利用过了。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: One last identical floor remained, which we silently ascended to. I didn't know what emotion I'd been attacked by, but I wanted to see the others—the unknown people I'd met that day. I needed them as a temporary shelter, not continually being alone with Atsuki.
entries.new: 还剩最后一层，与之前别无二致，我们默默走了上去。我不知道自己是被什么情绪缠住了，但我想见到其他人——那天遇见的那些陌生人。我需要他们暂时当我的避风港，而不是一直和 Atsuki 单独待在一起。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The sixth floor was empty as well.
entries.new: 六楼同样空无一人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...{w}You have the key, right?
entries.new: ……{w}钥匙在你身上吧？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: I nodded and took the keyring out of my purse. With the right key, I unlocked the door.
entries.new: 我点点头，从包里取出钥匙串，挑出对应的那把，打开了门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Atsuki stood in front of the living room and looked at the floor.
entries.new: Atsuki 站在客厅前，低头看着地面。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: No recent footprints...
entries.new: 没有新留下的脚印……
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: It'll be fine if you stay here. If I don't find anyone, I'm gonna be pretty confused.
entries.new: 你留在这儿就好。要是一个人都找不到，我可就真懵了。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: ...{w}I don't get it. Was Naomi never with us?{w} How is this possible? I know we've already been here for a long time, but that doesn't make it any less confusing. Where the hell is the Sekimeiya, also?
entries.new: ……{w}我搞不懂了。Naomi 难道从来就没跟我们在一起？{w}这怎么可能？我知道我们在这儿已经待了很久，可我还是一样摸不着头脑。还有，Sekimeiya 又到底在哪儿？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Let's just go back down. I hope they trust what we tell them.{w} ...We can't even take the elevator, damn it.
entries.new: 先下去吧。希望他们会相信我们说的话。{w}……该死，连电梯都坐不了。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: We walked down the stairs and left the attic, heading all the way back down.
entries.new: 我们走下楼梯，离开阁楼，一路往下。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: For every floor we descended, the air got hotter, and my head number.
entries.new: 每往下一层，空气就更热一分，脑袋也越发昏沉。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Hearing different voices was like emerging from underwater. As my view of hallway C increased, so did the sound.
entries.new: 听见别的声音，就像从水下浮了上来。C走廊在视野中一点点展开，声音也随之清晰。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Where the hell are they?
entries.new: 他们到底在哪儿？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: I listened intently and frowned.
entries.new: 我凝神细听，皱起了眉。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...The storeroom?
entries.new: ……储藏室？
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: Oh. Well, I need to go to the bathroom. I'll be back.
entries.new: 哦。那我去趟洗手间，很快就回来。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: I felt like he was looking at me oddly, but I didn't have time to point it out before he turned around.
entries.new: 我觉得他看我的眼神有些异样，可我还没来得及开口，他就转身走了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I headed to the open storeroom. Everyone was inside, but the room didn't look as I remembered it.
entries.new: 我朝敞着门的储藏室走去。所有人都在里面，可房间的样子和我记忆中的并不一样。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Look at what we found, {tip=Tanya}Tanya{/tip}! There was a secret wall.
entries.new: 快看我们发现了什么，{tip=Tanya}坦桑娅{/tip}！这里藏着一面暗墙。
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: ...What?
entries.new: ……什么？
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: There you are. Where's Atsuki?
entries.new: 你来了。Atsuki 呢？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...He went to the bathroom.
entries.new: ……他去洗手间了。
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: I stepped in farther. The length of the room had increased, and with every step I took, the temperature lowered. The others were all gathered around another door.
entries.new: 我又往里走了几步。房间比原先长了不少，每走一步，温度就低一分。其他人都聚在另一扇门前。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What's this place...? Also, was that name supposed to refer to me?
entries.new: 这是什么地方……？还有，刚才那个称呼是在叫我吗？
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: Tanya? Yes! It's because of tanzanite.
entries.new: 坦桑娅？对呀！就是取自坦桑石嘛。
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: Oh.
entries.new: 哦。
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: I supposed it made perfect sense to her.
entries.new: 她大概觉得这名字再自然不过了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...When we were going up, Akaro and I heard a sound behind us and saw that the storeroom wasn't shut, although nobody was here. However, I noticed that a spot on the wall wasn't dusty, which let me uncover this section.
entries.new: ……我们上楼的时候，我和 Akaro 听见身后有响动，回头一看，储藏室的门没关，可里面并没有人。不过，我注意到墙上有一块地方没有积灰，才找到了这一片。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What the...? Why does this place exist?
entries.new: 怎么回事……？这里怎么会有这种地方？
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: Tell her, Katei.
entries.new: Katei，你告诉她。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I don't know.{w} I had no idea it existed.
entries.new: 我不知道。{w}我根本不知道还有这么个地方。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: What? H-How's that possible?
entries.new: 什么？这、这怎么可能？
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: I am aware of how it sounds, but I'm the most surprised out of anyone.
entries.new: 我知道这话听起来有多离谱，但这里最吃惊的人就是我。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Did you search the whole building?
entries.new: 你把整栋楼都查过了吗？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: ...Yes.
entries.new: ……查过了。
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: Even though there was nobody here, this door is locked.
entries.new: 明明这里没有人，这扇门却锁着。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I grabbed its handle and turned it. Indeed, it wouldn't budge.
entries.new: 我握住门把手拧了拧，果然纹丝不动。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: You saw the door open after Atsuki closed it? Is that what you meant? So someone opened it before we moved up?
entries.new: 你是说，Atsuki 关上之后，你看见那扇门又开了？是这个意思吗？也就是说，在我们上楼之前，有人把它打开了？
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: That's what we were discussing. This is obviously a spot anyone could have used to hide, but Sai doesn't believe someone left through it. He thinks someone came in. Otherwise, the door wouldn't have been left open, and nobody would've left while we were investigating.
entries.new: 我们刚才就在说这个。这里显然是个谁都能用来藏身的地方，可 Sai 认为没人从这里出去过。他觉得是有人进来了。不然门不会就那么敞着，我们调查的这段时间里也不会有人离开。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: ...But Atsuki had just finished looking through the whole floor.
entries.new: ……可 Atsuki 才刚把那一层查过一遍。
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: Exactly.
entries.new: 正是。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What I think is that this door leads outside. The storeroom now stretches farther out than the crystal rooms, and it's a hidden locked door that would explain the policeman's appearance and Naomi's vanishing.
entries.new: 我的判断是，这扇门通向外面。储藏室现在比水晶展室延伸得更靠外，而这扇上锁的暗门正好能解释警察为什么会出现在这里，以及 Naomi 为什么消失不见。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: W-Wait, really...? If a policeman entered, why did nobody else?
entries.new: 等、等等，真的吗……？既然警察能进来，为什么没有别的人进来？
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: Who knows? Maybe the door was briefly unlocked when he got in, or maybe he was behind the plan like Naomi. Nonetheless, it appears the answer really was a hidden way outside.
entries.new: 谁知道呢。也许他进来时，那扇门只是短暂地没有上锁；又或者，他也像 Naomi 一样是计划的幕后之人。无论如何，看来答案确实是：有一条通向外面的暗道。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I'm sure people are in front of the entrance, but I wouldn't bet the entire building is surrounded. It could be possible to enter and leave from this side without being seen.
entries.new: 我敢肯定入口处有人守着，但我不敢断言整栋楼都被包围了。从这一侧进出而不被看见，或许可行。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...{w}Can we not do anything to open it?
entries.new: ……{w}我们就不能想办法打开它吗？
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: My perception of our imprisonment had changed drastically. If we could open the door, I might've been able to escape, which I had started to want more than anything.
entries.new: 我对我们被困在这里这件事的看法，已经完全变了。只要那扇门能打开，我也许就能逃出去——而逃出去，已是我最渴望的事。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Would you or Atsuki know how to pick this lock? We've knocked and made noise, but there's no way we'll be heard from here, and the gaps aren't thin enough to see or slide anything through them.
entries.new: 你或者 Atsuki 会开这种锁吗？我们敲过门，也弄出过动静，可这边根本不可能有人听见；门缝也太窄，既看不清里面，也塞不进东西。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...I don't.
entries.new: ……我不会。
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: Well, you didn't find the Sekimeiya anywhere, right?
entries.new: 那么，你们到处都没找到 Sekimeiya，对吧？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: No.
entries.new: 没有。
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: Then it's possible it's not here anymore. Even if this door doesn't lead outside, it's very likely the Sekimeiya was taken away. If we're supposed to trust what Atsuki said, that could be the entire motive behind the attack.
entries.new: 那么，它有可能已经不在这里了。就算这扇门不通向外面，Sekimeiya 也很可能是被人带走了。如果 Atsuki 的话可信，这或许就是袭击背后的全部动机。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: That still doesn't make sense, though. I don't think anyone could've taken the Sekimeiya from the mechanical room.
entries.new: 可这还是说不通。我不认为有人能从机械室把 Sekimeiya 带走。
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: ...{w}Well, this door might lead outside, and Katei keeps assuring us he didn't know about it. Even if he's lying, it must be a secret door that's hard to find.{w} There's grass on the sides of the tower, meaning that if this door opened outwardly, it would leave conspicuous marks on the grass and could be noticed. It probably opens inward instead.
entries.new: ……{w}这扇门也许通向外面，而 Katei 一直坚称自己不知道有这扇门。就算他在撒谎，这扇门也必定很难被发现。{w}塔的两侧长着草，也就是说，如果这扇门向外开，就会在草地上留下明显的痕迹，容易被人察觉。所以它多半是向内开的。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What the fuck is this...?
entries.new: 这他妈是什么东西……？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: There he is. Do you know how to pick a lock?
entries.new: 他来了。你会开锁吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What? N-No?
entries.new: 什么？不、不会。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: What we'd talked about was reiterated to Atsuki, all while he wore an unchanging expression.
entries.new: 我们把刚才谈过的内容向 Atsuki 复述了一遍，他的表情始终没有变化。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Did you really not know about this?
entries.new: 你真的不知道这件事？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: I promise I didn't. I also don't think this door leads outside. There's no way I wouldn't have ever noticed it.
entries.new: 我保证我不知道。我也不认为这扇门通向外面。若真有这回事，我不可能始终没发现。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: And it makes sense that you didn't know about it if it doesn't lead outside?
entries.new: 那么，如果这扇门不通向外面，你不知道它倒也说得通？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...I'm just speechless. This room is practically unused, but I can't believe this existed.
entries.new: ……我只是无话可说。这个房间几乎没人用过，可我实在难以相信这里会有这种东西。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: ...{w}Now a few things make sense, at least. As you said, nobody was found, so Naomi must've been here at some point.
entries.new: ……{w}至少现在有几件事说得通了。就像你说的，到处都没找到人影，所以 Naomi 一定来过这里。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Yes, yes. I'd like to advise you all on something.{w} I've made sure that if this door is opened again, I'll be able to tell.
entries.new: 对，对。我想提醒各位一件事。{w}我已经做好了安排，只要这扇门再次被打开，我就能知道。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...What? How?
entries.new: ……什么？怎么做到的？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: I'm not telling you that. One of you could potentially manage to open this, so I'd rather not give you any indication of what I've done.
entries.new: 这我可不会说。你们之中说不定有人能打开这扇门，所以我不想透露自己做了什么。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: We looked at the door curiously, but it was too dim to notice whatever Sai was talking about.
entries.new: 我们好奇地打量着那扇门，可光线太暗，根本看不出 Sai 说的是什么。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I think that's fair. It wouldn't be wise to demand that you tell us.
entries.new: ……我觉得这样很合理。硬要你说出来，并不是明智之举。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Just trust me. I will know if the door opens. However, it's possible it won't and that the plan already finished after the Sekimeiya was brought outside.
entries.new: 相信我就好。门一旦打开，我会知道。不过，也可能它不会再开——Sekimeiya 被带到外面之后，计划就已经结束了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Let's go to the attic.
entries.new: 去阁楼吧。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...To the attic? Why?
entries.new: ……去阁楼？为什么？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Do you think I'll believe you were walking around for hours and we didn't see you? You either went through this door or were in the attic.
entries.new: 你觉得我会相信你转了几个小时，而我们却一次都没见到你？你要么穿过这扇门出去了，要么就待在阁楼里。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: He wasn't with us. We know that much.
entries.new: 他没和我们在一起。这点我们很清楚。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: You've said that before. I know.
entries.new: 你之前就说过了。我知道。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: How do you intend to know whether I was there? I won't allow anyone in lightly.
entries.new: 你打算怎么确认我有没有去过那里？我不会随随便便让任何人进去。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: No? Then how come they spent three hours sleeping there?
entries.new: 不行？那他们怎么会在那里睡了三个小时？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...I haven't forgotten about that.
entries.new: ……那件事我没忘。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: ...{w}In the off chance Naomi's still in the tower, she's up there, being covered by the three of you. I want to go see it by myself, and I'm sure Akaro and Erina aren't content with your words alone.
entries.new: ……{w}万一 Naomi 还在塔里，那她就在上面，正被你们三个包庇着。我要亲自去看看；而且我敢肯定，光凭你几句话，Akaro 和 Erina 也不会满意。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...All right. After that, we will all slow down. I can't believe this door exists, but the truth is that Naomi and the Sekimeiya weren't found anywhere. Once this request of yours is fulfilled, we'll stay put somewhere and wait.
entries.new: ……好吧。之后我们都会放慢脚步。我真不敢相信这扇门居然存在，可事实就是，哪里都找不到 Naomi 和 Sekimeiya。等你的这个要求满足了，我们就找个地方待着等。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: I agree with that. It's very likely the person who killed the policeman was Naomi or someone who could enter the tower again. For our safety, we'll have to stay together.
entries.new: 我同意。杀害警察的人，很可能就是 Naomi，或者是能再次进入塔里的人。为了安全，我们必须待在一起。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: That's fine.
entries.new: 可以。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: The elevator was still open, but we couldn't all take it at once. We walked up together, our footsteps clearly conveying our presence.
entries.new: 电梯还开着，可我们没法一次全部乘上去。于是一起走了上去，脚步声清清楚楚地暴露了我们的行踪。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Nobody had spoken again by the time we arrived at the attic's door, where everyone stopped.
entries.new: 我们走到阁楼门前时，谁都没再说话，大家都停了下来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Atsuki looked at me, and so did the others. It took me a few seconds to realize it was because I had the key, and when I did, I remembered we hadn't locked it when we'd left.
entries.new: Atsuki 看向我，其他人也一样。我过了几秒才反应过来，是因为钥匙在我手上；等我意识到这一点，又想起我们离开时并没有把门锁上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I stepped forward, sensing that Atsuki was trying to tell me to hide that fact so we didn't cause an unnecessary conflict with Katei.
entries.new: 我向前迈了一步，察觉到 Atsuki 是在示意我把这件事瞒下来，免得和 Katei 发生不必要的冲突。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: My body was hiding the keyhole, so I inserted the key and turned it. It was already unlocked, but I casually pulled the door toward me and took the key back out.
entries.new: 我的身体挡住了锁孔，我便把钥匙插进去转了转。门本来就没锁，我却若无其事地把门往自己这边拉了拉，再把钥匙收了回来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Nobody called me out, as I'd easily looked nonchalant. I glanced upward and began to ascend the staircase.
entries.new: 我装得若无其事，谁也没揭穿。我抬眼看了看，迈步走上楼梯。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: On the floor, traces of Atsuki and me could be noticed. Sai stared at them silently before walking in.
entries.new: 地板上能看到我和 Atsuki 留下的痕迹。Sai 默默盯着那些痕迹，随后走了进去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The elevator doesn't work, so stay here.
entries.new: 电梯不能用，就待在这里吧。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: When Akaro and Katei arrived, they went with Sai, curious to see if anything was to be found.{w} The attic was composed of only a few rooms, so they made quick work of inspecting them.
entries.new: Akaro 和 Katei 到了之后，和 Sai 一起去查看，都想看看能不能找到什么。{w}阁楼只有几个房间，很快就查完了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I suppose it's possible someone's on one of the middle floors, but given we found the storeroom's secret door, I think it's much more likely that was how Naomi managed to escape.
entries.new: ……中间某一层或许有人，但既然我们发现了储藏室的暗门，Naomi 多半就是从那里逃走的。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Yes. You can stop suggesting we covered for Naomi since it wasn't our plan to go search alone.
entries.new: 没错。你不用再暗示我们替 Naomi 打掩护了，单独去搜本来就不在我们的计划里。
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: Hmhm.{w} I suppose we might as well stay here if we're gonna remain in one place.
entries.new: 嗯哼。{w}反正都要待在一处，那就在这里吧。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What? No, that's not a good idea.
entries.new: 什么？不行，这可不是个好主意。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Listen, this place has beds, and I don't want to sit on the floor for over six hours.
entries.new: 听我说，这地方有床，我可不想在地板上坐六个多小时。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: After hearing that, Katei didn't immediately stop him, and Sai took his chance to go straight to a bedroom.
entries.new: 听到这话，Katei 没有立刻拦他，Sai 便趁势径直走进了一间卧室。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Having beds and a sofa sounded good to everyone, so we stood in front of the two doors; Sai opened the right one.
entries.new: 有床有沙发，对谁来说都是好事，于是我们走到两扇门前；Sai 推开了右边那扇。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We've already been here, so given the circumstances, I can't order you all to leave. However, do understand how important it is that you don't damage or break anything.
entries.new: 我们已经查过这里了，眼下这种情况，我也不会命令你们离开。不过请你们明白，不要损坏或打碎任何东西，这一点非常重要。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: You don't have to worry about that.
entries.new: 这点你不用担心。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Behind Sai, Akaro and Katei entered the bedroom. As each one had three beds, Erina entered the left one with Isla. Being the last two, Atsuki and I quietly made our way in as well.
entries.new: Akaro 和 Katei 跟在 Sai 身后进了卧室。因为每间房都有三张床，Erina 和 Isla 进了左边那间。我和 Atsuki 落在最后，也悄悄跟了进去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Do you want to be down here or up top?
entries.new: 你想睡下面还是上面？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Hm, I don't care.
entries.new: 嗯，都无所谓。
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: No? You can choose.
entries.new: 无所谓？你可以自己挑的。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: ...Either one is okay.
entries.new: ……哪边都行。
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: Well, what about you two?
entries.new: 那你们俩呢？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Atsuki and I shrugged.
entries.new: Atsuki 和我耸了耸肩。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Let's go up, then. You'll have a bed all for yourself.
entries.new: 那就上去吧。这样你就能独占一张床了。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Isla nodded and went up the ladder. From below, we heard them sitting on the two beds.
entries.new: Isla 点点头，顺着梯子爬了上去。我们在下面听见她们两人各自坐到了两张床上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Do you feel all right?
entries.new: 你还好吗？
entries.speaker: aki4

entries.text: ...I see. Try to sleep if you can, then. Everything will go by much faster.
entries.new: ……这样啊。那能睡就睡一会儿吧，睡着了时间会过得快得多。
entries.speaker: aki4

entries.text: We were eavesdropping on them, but since they hadn't closed the hatch, it was their own fault. Atsuki and I sat on the single bed we had and lay back.
entries.new: 我们确实是在偷听，可谁让她们没把舱门关上呢。Atsuki 和我坐到那张唯一的床上，躺了下去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: A killer had been with us in the tower—that was a guarantee. Going off of the atmosphere, it seemed everyone was trying to feel safe by staying together. It could also have been that they assumed the man was only killed because he was a policeman and the rest of us would be left alone.
entries.new: 塔里确实有杀人凶手混在我们中间——这一点毋庸置疑。从气氛来看，大家似乎都想聚在一起求个安心。也可能他们以为，那名男子之所以被杀，只是因为他是个警察，剩下的人不会被牵连。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Do you need a pillow?
entries.new: 要枕头吗？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: I'm fine.
entries.new: 不用了。
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: After a deep sigh, Atsuki closed his eyes.
entries.new: Atsuki 长长地叹了口气，闭上了眼睛。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Have you thought about what we talked about?
entries.new: 我们之前说的事，你想过了吗？
entries.speaker: aki4

entries.text: Hm?
entries.new: 嗯？
entries.speaker: il4

entries.text: Regarding Akashic Park. I know I said we could wait until the summer, but we can go during the first week of January if you want.
entries.new: 就是去阿卡西公园的事。我知道我说过可以等到夏天，不过你要是愿意，一月的第一周去也行。
