entries.speaker: aki4

entries.text: It's okay. I think it's better to wait.
entries.new: 不用了。我觉得还是等一等比较好。
entries.speaker: il4

entries.text: Are you sure?
entries.new: 你确定？
entries.speaker: aki4

entries.text: Yeah, I don't like the cold. Let's go in the summer.
entries.new: 嗯，我不喜欢冷天。夏天再去吧。
entries.speaker: il4

entries.text: I see, all right. I'm glad you made up your mind.
entries.new: 这样啊，好吧。你能拿定主意，我就放心了。
entries.speaker: aki4

entries.text: Silence.
entries.new: 一片沉默。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If I may...
entries.new: 恕我打扰一下……
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Out of nowhere, Sai burst in and walked to the drawer.
entries.new: Sai 忽然闯了进来，径直走向抽屉。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What are you doing...?
entries.new: 你在做什么……？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Oh, I'm looking in these drawers for no reason whatsoever.
entries.new: 哦，没什么理由，就是随便翻翻这些抽屉。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Once he'd gone through all of them and the wardrobe, he went up the ladder.
entries.new: 他把所有抽屉和衣柜都翻了一遍，然后爬上了梯子。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: By the sound he was making, he was doing the same with the wardrobe above.
entries.new: 听那动静，他正在楼上对衣柜做着同样的事。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: He soon came back and left without explaining himself.
entries.new: 他很快又回来，什么也没解释就走了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...At least he closed the door.
entries.new: ……至少他把门关上了。
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: As soon as Sai left, Atsuki lay back. All I could assume was that he'd been looking for the Sekimeiya or something.
entries.new: Sai 一走，Atsuki 就躺了回去。我只能猜，他是在找 Sekimeiya 之类的东西。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I looked at my purse. Thankfully, he hadn't demanded to look in it, but knowing that it could happen at any moment made me very uneasy.
entries.new: 我看了看自己的手提包。好在他没有要求检查，可一想到他随时都可能这么做，我就很不安。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Sai had shut the hatch, so I could no longer hear Erina and Isla. At my left was Atsuki, resting face-up on a white pillow. That image of him with his eyes closed was one I'd started to get used to.
entries.new: Sai 关上了舱门，Erina 和 Isla 的声音再也传不过来。Atsuki 就在我左边，枕着白枕头仰面躺着。他闭着眼睛的样子，我已经渐渐看惯了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: However, I could no longer think that his mind was completely blank. I knew for a fact that he was silently plotting something... and that it was basically guaranteed to work.
entries.new: 可是，我再也没法认为他脑中一片空白了。我清楚得很，他正默不作声地盘算着什么……而且那几乎一定会成功。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Whatever plan or conclusion he'd thought of, I wouldn't be able to stop it, so it was smarter to let him be. While I couldn't help but explore the idea of going to the past myself, I had no motivation to do so, and I didn't even know what to do if the chance ever presented itself.
entries.new: 无论他想出了什么计划、得出了什么结论，我都阻止不了，倒不如由他去。虽然我也忍不住想过自己回到过去，却没有那份动力，甚至不知道真有机会摆在面前时该做什么。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I began to hear voices coming from the other side of the door, but they were too muddled to understand.
entries.new: ……门外开始传来说话声，但混在一起，听不清内容。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: When they faded away, I thought I'd finally be able to try resting.
entries.new: 声音渐渐散去后，我想，总算能试着休息了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Sorry, I figured I'd let you know about this.
entries.new: 抱歉，我想还是跟你们说一声比较好。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I lifted my head slightly and saw him holding a note.
entries.new: 我稍稍抬起头，见他手里拿着一张纸条。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What does it say?
entries.new: 上面写了什么？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: It was pretty hidden in the kitchen. I'll read it for you.
entries.new: 藏得挺隐蔽的，就在厨房里。我念给你们听。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: "Sir, I have done as you instructed, and I didn't spot any difference in the attic since Xyn's last attack. I believe it wasn't targeted. I've finished this month's preservations, but some paint has begun to wear off, so next month I'll attempt to fix that on my own. Until then, thank you for your trust and let me know if you have any new requests. Naomi".
entries.new: 「先生，我已按你的吩咐照办。自 Xyn 上次袭击以来，阁楼里并没有任何变化，我想这里并非目标。本月的保养已经做完，不过有些漆面开始脱落，下个月我会试着自行修补。在那之前，感谢你的信任，若有新的吩咐请随时告知。Naomi」
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: So it's a note that Naomi left for Ashiya.
entries.new: 所以这是 Naomi 留给芦屋的纸条。
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: That's what Katei said, she kept this attic in good condition. I appreciate that you let us know, even if it doesn't mean much to us.
entries.new: Katei 也说过，她一直把这间阁楼打理得很好。多谢你告诉我们，虽然这对我们没什么用处。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: No problem. I'd go tell Erina and Isla, but they seemed pretty sleepy.
entries.new: 不客气。我本来也想去告诉 Erina 和 Isla，不过她们看起来困得不行。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: And we didn't?
entries.new: 难道我们就不困？
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: I closed my eyes.
entries.new: 我闭上了眼睛。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The light was right above us, so I put my arm over my face as well.
entries.new: 灯就在头顶，我索性抬起手臂，也挡在脸上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Finally, some time began to pass. I wasn't tired enough to fall asleep, but lying down was surprisingly relaxing. I kept breathing as deeply as I could, appreciating the silence.
entries.new: 总算，时间开始流逝了。我还没困到能睡着的程度，可躺下来竟意外地放松。我尽量深呼吸，享受这份安静。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Did you notice what Sai did?
entries.new: 你注意到 Sai 刚才的举动了吗？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: ...What do you mean?
entries.new: ……你是说？
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: When he left, he walked toward the living room, and he hasn't come back yet.
entries.new: 他离开的时候是往客厅方向走的，到现在还没回来。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Oh... did he? I didn't pay attention.
entries.new: 哦……是吗？我没留意。
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: It's already been a few minutes. {tip=perspective2}Do you have any idea about where the Sekimeiya could be?{/tip}
entries.new: 已经过去好几分钟了。{tip=perspective2}你觉得 Sekimeiya 可能藏在哪儿吗？{/tip}
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Me? No, not at all.{w} If it's not outside, it must be hidden pretty well...
entries.new: 我？不，完全没头绪。{w} 要是它不在外面，那一定藏得相当隐蔽……
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: Yeah. I had a couple ideas for hiding spots.
entries.new: 是啊。我倒是想到过几个可能藏东西的地方。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: You didn't look at them when we searched?
entries.new: 我们搜的时候，你没去看过？
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: ...Well, no. One of them requires unscrewing a computer tower. I also thought that maybe one of the keys you have could open Naomi's locker. I doubt it was just hidden like that, especially since it seemed to disappear from the mechanical room. I'm not even sure anyone could've moved it.
entries.new: ……嗯，没有。其中一个得把电脑主机拆开才行。我还想过，你手上的某把钥匙说不定能打开 Naomi 的储物柜。我不太相信它只是被随便藏起来了，何况它像是从机械室里凭空消失的。我甚至不确定有谁能把它搬走。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: I went quiet, wondering if the scheme I thought he was constructing was already in his head. He didn't seem to fully understand how the Sekimeiya worked.
entries.new: 我没有作声，心里琢磨着：我觉得他正在盘算的那个方案，是不是早就在他脑中成形了。他似乎并没有完全弄懂 Sekimeiya 的运作方式。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...He's still not back.
entries.new: ……他还没回来。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Do you want to go look for him?
entries.new: 你想去找他吗？
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: ...{w}I think we should. I doubt he knew where the Sekimeiya was since he was searching in this room as well, but nobody from the other room has followed him.
entries.new: ……{w}我觉得该去。他刚才也在这屋里找过，应该不知道 Sekimeiya 在哪儿；可另一个房间的人也没有谁跟上去。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: I tried not to sigh and shut my eyes forcibly. The attic wasn't locked, so the thought of going through the building again was dreadful.
entries.new: 我忍着没叹气，用力闭上眼。阁楼并没有上锁，可一想到又要在这栋楼里走上一圈，就觉得厌烦。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I lifted my body up with both hands, all while thinking about how much I wanted to stay on that bed.
entries.new: 我双手撑起身子，脑子里想的全是我有多想继续躺在那张床上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Stay.
entries.new: 留下。

entries.text: Go find Sai.
entries.new: 去找 Sai。

entries.text: Wireframe
entries.new: 线框

entries.text: The huge mountain had a delicate structure. A single modification could collapse it beyond repair.
entries.new: 那座庞大山体结构精巧，只要改动一处，就可能彻底崩塌、无法复原。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: To prevent that, the structure could be partially frozen.{w} But that wasn't all. It could also be reshaped.
entries.new: 为避免这种情况，可以先将结构局部冻结。{w} 不过，仅此还不够——它也能被重新塑形。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Reshaped in a way so that all would connect firmly and so that causality was maintained.
entries.new: 重塑的方式，要让各部分牢固衔接，同时保住因果。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Shiroya and Atsuki stayed in the attic. Sai had gone to the crystal floor, but they didn't follow him down.
entries.new: Shiroya 和 Atsuki 留在阁楼里。Sai 去了水晶层，他们却没有跟下去。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Shiroya let out a sigh.
entries.new: Shiroya 叹了口气。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: They had no strength left, so they kept resting, trying to ignore what was happening around them.
entries.new: 两人都已没了力气，便继续歇着，尽量不去理会周围发生的事。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Closing their eyes on top of a bed would quickly begin to allow them to temporarily divorce from reality, and no noise prevented it.
entries.new: 只要躺在床上合上眼，人很快就能暂时脱离现实，而周围也没有任何声响来打扰。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Very soon, both of them had abandoned consciousness.
entries.new: 没过多久，两人便都失去了意识。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: For a long time, stillness persisted, and even if sound could have been sensed, there was none.
entries.new: 长久的寂静持续着。即便侧耳倾听，也听不到任何声音。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Atsuki woke up. His mouth was dry, and the ceiling light shined brightly on his eyes. Soon, though, he understood why he was awake.
entries.new: Atsuki 醒了。他口干舌燥，天花板的灯刺眼地照进眼里。不过，他很快就明白自己为什么会醒。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Faint noises were sporadically reaching his ears. He looked down and saw Shiroya sleeping very close to him, but he refrained from alerting her.
entries.new: 细微的声响断断续续传入耳中。他低下头，见 Shiroya 就睡在自己身旁，便没有出声叫醒她。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: His unconscious mind had taken the liberty of waking him up upon the smallest perception, so he waited warily to see if he could discern what the noises were.
entries.new: 潜意识在察觉到一丝动静时便擅自把他唤醒，于是他警惕地等着，想辨清那究竟是什么声音。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: However, the answer revealed itself. After some quiet seconds, Atsuki saw the door's handle turning, and once it had opened, a recognizable figure behind it.
entries.new: 然而答案自己出现了。安静了几秒之后，Atsuki 看见门把手转动；门一开，站在后面的便是一个他认得的身影。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Atsuki, Shiroya, come to the living room. I need to show you something.
entries.new: Atsuki，Shiroya，到客厅来。我有东西给你们看。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: Immediately after tossing out that mysterious request, Sai walked away.
entries.new: 丢下这句没头没尾的话，Sai 转身就走。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: "Hm..." As Atsuki tried to process the almost surreal way in which Sai had shown up, Shiroya's moaning made him turn to her waking face.
entries.new: 「嗯……」Atsuki 还没从 Sai 那近乎梦幻的出现里回过神来，Shiroya 的一声轻哼便让他转头看向她初醒的脸。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Was that Sai...? What did he want?
entries.new: 刚才那是 Sai 吗……？他找我们做什么？
entries.speaker: snn

entries.text: Did you hear him? He told us to go to the living room, that he had something to show us, and went back there.
entries.new: 你听见他说的了吧？他让我们去客厅，说有事要给我们看，然后就先回去了。
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: What...?
entries.new: 什么……？
entries.speaker: snn

entries.text: Shiroya yawned, but she couldn't help the intrigue. Sai had only called for both of them, and nobody from the opposite bedroom could be heard.
entries.new: Shiroya打了个哈欠，却还是被勾起了好奇心。Sai只叫了他们两人，对面卧室里也听不到任何动静。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Then, as he hadn't come back, they forced their tired bodies to stand up and attentively walked to the hallway.
entries.new: 随后，见他迟迟没有回来，两人强撑着疲惫的身体起身，小心翼翼地走向走廊。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The door to the living room was closed. Atsuki pushed it inward and hesitantly glanced in.
entries.new: 客厅的门关着。Atsuki把门向内推开，迟疑地朝里看了一眼。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Sai wasn't there.{w} However, on the sofa, a recognizable shining egg lay, next to the many footprints that indicated someone had walked on that floor very recently.
entries.new: Sai并不在那里。{w}可沙发上却放着一枚眼熟的发光的蛋，旁边还有许多脚印，显然不久前有人在这块地板上走过。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Sai, where the hell are you...?
entries.new: Sai，你到底在哪儿……？
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: Atsuki and Shiroya slowly stepped forward, confirming that he was neither there nor in the staircase. The Sekimeiya, presented without context, must have been what Sai had wanted to show them.
entries.new: Atsuki和Shiroya缓缓走上前，确认他既不在这里，也不在楼梯那边。这枚被毫无来由地放在这里的Sekimeiya，想必就是Sai想让他们看的东西。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: As Sai had seemingly vanished, both of them wondered whether he'd intended for them to activate it.
entries.new: Sai像是凭空消失了，两人不由得猜想，他是不是想让他们启动它。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: That thought was denied when footsteps came from the hallway. Turning around, they saw Sai standing plainly in front of them.
entries.new: 这个念头很快被打消——走廊里传来了脚步声。两人回过头，只见Sai就站在他们面前。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Well, there it is. I brought it here from the crystal floor. It wasn't even well-hidden.
entries.new: 喏，就是它。我从水晶层把它带了过来。它藏得也不算严实。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: Is that so...?
entries.new: 是这样吗……？
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: He had found it. Nonetheless, what Atsuki and Shiroya wondered was why he'd brought it there.
entries.new: 他确实找到了。可Atsuki和Shiroya更想知道的是，他为什么把它带到这里来。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: I don't know how what I'm about to say will sound, but I think I have come to understand what this thing really does.
entries.new: 我不知道接下来的话听起来会怎样，但我想，我大概已经弄明白这东西真正能做什么了。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: Huh?
entries.new: 啊？
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: The Sekimeiya... Whatever it is, it can do much more than making one travel through time.{w} I don't think I should just explain to you two. I've had time to learn how it functions, and it's incredible.
entries.new: Sekimeiya……不管它是什么，它能做到的都远不止让人穿越时间。{w}我觉得不该只靠口头解释。我已经有时间摸清它的运作方式，而它实在不可思议。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: Atsuki and Shiroya could hardly reply. Was Sai telling the truth? They'd found out the Sekimeiya had the power to make one travel back in time, but had they failed to notice the true extent of its capabilities?
entries.new: Atsuki和Shiroya几乎答不上话。Sai说的是真的吗？他们确实已经知道Sekimeiya拥有让人回到过去的力量，可难道一直没察觉它究竟能做到什么地步？
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Speechless from the anticipation, they followed Sai to the hallway. He'd picked up the gemstone without making direct contact with it. There, everyone was called.
entries.new: 两人期待得说不出话，跟着Sai来到走廊。他没有直接碰到那颗宝石，就把它拿了起来。到了走廊，他把所有人都叫了过来。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Erina and Isla had fallen asleep; Akaro watched with concern, sitting on the lowest bed in the other bedroom. When everyone reunited in the hallway, Sai repeated the same thing he'd told Atsuki and Shiroya.
entries.new: Erina和Isla已经睡着了；Akaro坐在另一间卧室的最下铺，担忧地注视着。众人在走廊里会合后，Sai又把对Atsuki和Shiroya说过的话重复了一遍。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: "What the fuck does that mean? What else can the Sekimeiya do?" Akaro was the first to react strongly to such an assertion.
entries.new: 「这他妈是什么意思？Sekimeiya还能做什么？」Akaro最先对这番话作出了强烈反应。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: That's what I will show you. However, I have my reasons to not explain what I don't want to.
entries.new: 这一点，我会让你们亲眼看到。不过，我不想解释的部分，自有我的理由。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: Again, what the hell does that mean?
entries.new: 这又他妈是什么意思？
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: It means that if, after this, you don't want to believe what I'm saying, it won't be my problem.
entries.new: 意思是，这之后你们若仍不愿相信我说的话，那就与我无关了。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: What...?
entries.new: 什么……？
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: Everyone was confused by Sai's attitude. What was he trying to accomplish, exactly?
entries.new: Sai的态度让所有人都摸不着头脑。他究竟想做什么？
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: However, I'll make sure you believe me. The Sekimeiya's powers are much greater than you think.
entries.new: 不过，我会让你们相信我的。Sekimeiya的力量远比你们想象的更强大。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: Sai opened the door to the right bedroom.
entries.new: Sai推开了右侧卧室的门。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Just so nobody thinks I'm trying to pull something, you can check whether there's anything strange in this bedroom.
entries.new: 为了不让你们以为我在耍什么花招，你们可以检查一下这间卧室里有没有什么异常。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: ...What could there be?
entries.new: ……能有什么？
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: I don't know, but it's so that you don't try to find objections later.
entries.new: 我不知道。不过这样一来，你们之后就没法再挑毛病了。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: Even though nobody understood what exactly Sai was getting at, Shiroya, Atsuki, and Akaro followed his suggestion. Both levels of the bedroom were inspected, and nothing stood out.
entries.new: 尽管没人明白Sai到底想说什么，Shiroya、Atsuki和Akaro还是照他的话做了。卧室上下两层都检查过了，没发现任何异常。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: All right, good. It seems you're all eager to see what this thing can do. Unfortunately, you won't see it directly. The cameras aren't recording, so nobody will.
entries.new: 好，很好。看来你们都很想看看这东西能做什么。可惜，你们不会亲眼看到。摄像头没有在录像，所以谁都不会看到。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: Sai, still holding the glowing gem, took a couple steps into the bedroom and left it on the floor. Then, he approached the door and closed it from the inside.
entries.new: Sai仍拿着那颗发光的宝石，走进卧室几步，把它放在地板上。随后，他走到门边，从里面把门关上。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: "I will now lock the bedroom." From the other side of the door, Sai proceeded to set the chain. In the hallway, everyone exchanged dumbfounded looks.
entries.new: 「我现在要把卧室锁上。」门的另一侧，Sai动手挂上了门链。走廊里，众人面面相觑，满脸错愕。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Lastly, Sai locked the door with its key, which he got from one of the drawers.
entries.new: 最后，Sai用从抽屉里翻出的钥匙锁上了门。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: I am about to touch the Sekimeiya to travel to the past.
entries.new: 我这就去碰Sekimeiya，穿越回过去。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: Faint footsteps came from inside the bedroom, which very shortly ceased. The next thing they heard was a door opening behind them.
entries.new: 卧室里传来轻微的脚步声，但很快就停了。紧接着，身后传来了开门声。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: There we go. Now the Sekimeiya's isolated inside. It will do everything by itself.
entries.new: 好了。现在Sekimeiya被单独关在里面了。剩下的一切，它会自己完成。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: Sai had come from the opposite bedroom, where Atsuki and Shiroya had been sleeping.
entries.new: Sai是从对面卧室过来的，Atsuki和Shiroya之前就在那里睡觉。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: I traveled a few seconds to the past, from room to room.
entries.new: 我穿越到了几秒前，从一间房来到了另一间房。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: ...Wh-What the fuck are you even doing?
entries.new: ……你、你到底在搞什么鬼？
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: Atsuki, why don't you search me?
entries.new: Atsuki，来搜我的身吧。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: ...Search you?
entries.new: ……搜身？
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: Check that I have nothing on me. For the same reason.
entries.new: 检查我身上有没有东西。理由和刚才一样。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: Atsuki gave a sigh of frustration but conceded.
entries.new: Atsuki无奈地叹了口气，还是照做了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Aside from the personal belongings in one of his back pockets, Sai didn't have anything else.
entries.new: 除了一个后袋里的随身物品，Sai身上没有别的东西。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: However, Atsuki noticed something.
entries.new: 不过，Atsuki注意到了什么。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Is your watch not working?
entries.new: 你的表不走了吗？
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: It isn't. It stopped working earlier, unfortunately, so we won't be able to measure the time.{w} Anyway, I'm glad you're all following along. Now, Isla, mind telling me a number?
entries.new: 确实不走了。很遗憾，它早些时候就停了，所以我们没法计时。{w}总之，你们能跟得上就好。那么，Isla，能说一个数字吗？
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: A number...? Why?
entries.new: 数字……？为什么？
entries.speaker: ilnn

entries.text: You'll see.
entries.new: 待会儿你就知道了。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: Hm, nine?
entries.new: 嗯，九？
entries.speaker: ilnn

entries.text: Nine? I was expecting a longer one, but that's fine.
entries.new: 九？我还以为你会说个更长的数字呢，不过也行。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: Shiroya, say a letter.
entries.new: Shiroya，说一个字母。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: Huh...?{w} C.
entries.speaker: snn

entries.text: Perfect. Now we have to wait.
entries.new: 很好。接下来只能等了。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: Wait for what?
entries.new: 等什么？
entries.speaker: snn

entries.text: For the Sekimeiya to work. I bet you'd all assumed it had to be touched to activate it.
entries.new: 等 Sekimeiya 起作用。我猜你们都以为，非得碰到它才能启动吧。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: ...I don't think any of us are following. What will the Sekimeiya do, exactly?
entries.new: ……我看我们谁都没听明白。Sekimeiya 究竟会做什么？
entries.speaker: aknn

entries.text: Actually, I'm not completely sure myself. It can do anything, so we'll see.{w} Some time from now, it will make a sound. That'll tell us it's worked.
entries.new: 说实话，我自己也不完全确定。它什么都能做，所以等着看吧。{w}过一阵子，它会发出一点声响。那就说明它起作用了。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: "Some time from now"? Nobody understood yet what Sai was talking about or why he was doing anything they were seeing.
entries.new: 「过一阵子」？还没人明白 Sai 在说什么，也不明白他眼前做的这些究竟是为了什么。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: It shouldn't take very long. If I'm right and understand how the Sekimeiya functions, it won't take many minutes.
entries.new: 应该不会太久。只要我对 Sekimeiya 的运作方式没判断错，几分钟之内就会有结果。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: Since it was clear that Sai wouldn't explain himself further, everyone decided to continue humoring him and waited.
entries.new: Sai 显然不打算再多作解释，众人也只好继续顺着他，等了下去。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: ...What kind of sound would the Sekimeiya make? Everyone's senses had sharpened, but meanwhile, the silence was pure.
entries.new: ……Sekimeiya 会发出怎样的声响？众人的感官都已绷紧，四下却静得彻底。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Oh, I didn't mention it, but obviously, this door is now completely locked. Both the chain and the lock are in effect.
entries.new: 对了，我还没提，不过显而易见，这扇门现在已经彻底锁死了。门链和门锁都生效了。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: A couple minutes had gone by when Sai pointed out that part of the setup.
entries.new: 过了两三分钟，Sai 才提起这个布置。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He grabbed the handle and tried to open the door to demonstrate that it wasn't possible.
entries.new: 他握住门把，试着开门，以示这确实打不开。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: It doesn't matter much, but you can see that I'm not lying about this.
entries.new: 这无关紧要，不过你们能看到，我在这点上没撒谎。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: Atsuki repeated what Sai had attempted and confirmed that the door couldn't be opened.
entries.new: Atsuki 照着 Sai 试了一遍，确认门确实开不了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: So, currently, we have no way to enter this roo—
entries.new: 所以，目前我们没有任何办法进入这个房——
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: Oh, fuck. Actually, I might've overlooked something.
entries.new: 操。等等，我好像漏了什么。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: For the first time, Sai looked uncertain. He rapidly turned around and opened the opposite bedroom.
entries.new: Sai 第一次露出没把握的样子。他急忙转身，打开了对面那间卧室。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: When he came back, he had a key in his hand.
entries.new: 回来时，他手里多了一把钥匙。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: I forgot both bedrooms had a key. This one shouldn't work, though, right?
entries.new: 我忘了这两间卧室各有一把钥匙。不过这把应该开不了吧？
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: Nobody was sure.
entries.new: 谁也说不好。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Sai inserted the key into the keyhole, but he couldn't turn it.
entries.new: Sai 把钥匙插进锁孔，却拧不动。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: All right, it doesn't work. Good, so the lock is effective.
entries.new: 行，开不了。很好，说明锁确实管用。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: After that brief interlude, the standby was resumed. It had been confirmed that they had no way to open the door, which told everyone that, somehow, it was going to open. Otherwise, the Sekimeiya would get stuck on the other side.
entries.new: 这段小插曲过后，众人又重新等了起来。门确实打不开，这一点已经得到确认——也正因如此，大家反倒明白，它总归会以某种方式打开。否则，Sekimeiya 就要被困在门的那一边了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: ...How much longer are we gonna wait?
entries.new: ……咱们还得等多久？
entries.speaker: aknn

entries.text: You don't have much patience, do you? We're waiting for magic to occur, and it's only been a few minutes. The exact time, even I don't know.
entries.new: 你还真是没耐心。我们等的可是奇迹发生，才过了几分钟而已。具体要等多久，连我也不知道。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: It almost felt ridiculous, but they kept waiting, wondering if Sai was just messing with them. About ten minutes had gone by.
entries.new: 这几乎显得有些荒唐，可他们还是等着，心里怀疑 Sai 是不是在耍他们。十来分钟就这么过去了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: "There it is."{w} A metallic sound startled everyone but Sai. They stared at the locked door, as it had come from behind it.
entries.new: 「来了。」{w}一声金属轻响，除 Sai 外所有人都被吓了一跳。他们盯着那扇锁着的门——声音正是从门后传来的。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Hey, look. Didn't this change?
entries.new: 喂，看。这个是不是变了？
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: Everyone looked at Sai's palm. A key was on it, but everyone recognized it looked slightly different than it had moments prior. It wasn't the wrong one anymore.
entries.new: 众人看向 Sai 的掌心。那里躺着一把钥匙，可大家都看得出，它和片刻前不太一样了。它已经不再是那把开不了的钥匙。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: ...Are you just fucking with us? What, did the key appear in your hand out of nowhere?
entries.new: ……你他妈是在耍我们吧？怎么，钥匙凭空出现在你手里了？
entries.speaker: aknn

entries.text: No, Akaro, that's not it. It modified the other key. That's one of the powers the Sekimeiya possesses. That sound was the cue that it did what I thought it would do.
entries.new: 不，Akaro，不是那样。它把另一把钥匙改成了这样。这是 Sekimeiya 拥有的能力之一。那声响就是信号，说明它做的和我想的一样。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: Sai didn't give anyone else a chance to object, opting to insert the key into the keyhole. He swiftly turned it, and the door unlocked with a small click.
entries.new: Sai 没给其他人出言反对的余地，径直把钥匙插进锁孔。他利落地一拧，锁芯咔哒一声，门开了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: You remember the chain as well, right? Don't think that bypassing it is something the Sekimeiya isn't capable of.
entries.new: 门链你们也记得吧？别以为绕过门链这种事，Sekimeiya 做不到。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: Once the main lock had been removed, Sai pushed the door open.
entries.new: 主锁一解开，Sai 便推开了门。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: No resistance prevented him from doing so; the chain wasn't set anymore.
entries.new: 没有任何阻力拦着他——门链已经不在了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: As he kept slowly opening the door, everyone thought the same thing: Sai was putting on a show. Nobody knew why, but they'd come to understand him enough to be certain of that.
entries.new: 他慢慢把门推开，众人心里想的都是同一件事：Sai 在演戏。没人知道原因，但他们已经足够了解他，可以确定这一点。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: When the entire bedroom came into view, so did the most important thing inside. On the floor, where the Sekimeiya had been, there was only a square piece of paper.
entries.new: 整间卧室出现在眼前，里面最重要的东西也一并看清。地板上原本放着 Sekimeiya 的位置，只剩一张方形纸片。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Isla, do you mind going to pick that up?
entries.new: Isla，能麻烦你去把它捡起来吗？
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: Curious, she took tiny steps into the room. She bent down to grab the paper and turned it around. Then, she read the black letters written on it.
entries.new: 她满心好奇，小步走进房间，弯腰拾起那张纸，翻了过来，随后读出上面写着的黑色字迹。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: ...9C. That's what it says.
entries.new: ……9C。上面写着这个。
entries.speaker: ilnn

entries.text: ...Is that it? Did the Sekimeiya hear the number and letter... and it materialized that?
entries.new: ……就这样？Sekimeiya 听到了数字和字母……然后就把它变出来了？
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: Precisely.
entries.new: 正是。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: Atsuki tried not to laugh. Not particularly because he found that unbelievable, but because of what Sai's entire charade had led to.
entries.new: Atsuki 忍着笑。倒不是因为他觉得这事难以置信，而是因为 Sai 这一整场戏，最后竟落到这般结果。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He took the liberty of going to the second level, where he didn't immediately see the Sekimeiya either, nor anything of importance.
entries.new: 他自行上了二楼，在那里同样没立刻看到 Sekimeiya，也没看到任何要紧的东西。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: You're all wondering where the Sekimeiya is, right? Don't worry, I'll tell you.{w} After it does something that requires more power than usual, it teleports to its cabinet. I'm not sure why yet, but it's what I learned.{w} You'll see. Follow me.
entries.new: 你们都在想 Sekimeiya 到哪儿去了吧？别急，我告诉你们。{w}它完成一件比平时需要更多力量的事之后，就会传送到自己的展示柜里。原因我还不清楚，但这是我查到的。{w}你们看就知道了。跟我来。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: Sai exited the room. As his show hadn't ended, the rest followed him, still unsure how to feel.
entries.new: Sai 走出了房间。他的表演还没结束，众人只得跟上，一时不知该作何感想。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: They walked to the crystal floor and entered the event room. When the cabinet was uncovered, they could clearly see what was inside. Not only that, but the cabinet was locked.
entries.new: 一行人来到水晶层，走进活动室。展示柜的遮布一揭开，里面的东西便看得一清二楚。不仅如此，柜子还上了锁。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: There you have it. That's a glimpse of what the Sekimeiya can do.
entries.new: 就是这么回事。刚才那一幕，不过是 Sekimeiya 能力的一角。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: ...Why have you done all this, though?
entries.new: ……可你做这些，到底是为了什么？
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: Rather than being amazed, Atsuki asked what everyone had been wondering.
entries.new: Atsuki 没有惊叹，而是问出了所有人心中的疑问。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: To demonstrate all your misconceptions regarding the Sekimeiya. However, as I said, I didn't want to detail exactly how it works. That's why I did it in a way so that you could witness it without understanding it fundamentally.
entries.new: 为了展示你们对 Sekimeiya 的种种误解。不过，就像我说的，我不想细说它的运作方式。所以我才用了这种办法——让你们亲眼看到，却无法从根本上看懂。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: This thing possesses immense power, and I can't reveal what I learned about it. We can't take it out of here again.
entries.new: 这东西蕴藏着巨大的力量，我了解到的东西不能公开。我们不能再把它带出这里了。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: ...You said you demonstrated all our misconceptions, but I can easily think of a way you could've done this by simply traveling to the past.
entries.new: ……你说你把我们所有的误解都演示了出来，可我不费力气就能想出办法：你只要穿越到过去，就足以做到这一切。
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: How?
entries.new: 怎么说？
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: Isn't it obvious? Now, all you have to do is activate the Sekimeiya.{w} If you really understand how it works, you can make it send you to the past and to the locked bedroom. There, you'll leave the piece of paper and make the noise we heard. Before we enter, you'll touch the Sekimeiya and vanish from the room, once again to the past.{w} That could be why you locked the door, so that we wouldn't open it immediately after hearing the noise. You definitely didn't prove that the Sekimeiya is able to materialize a piece of paper.{w} ...It's true that it might've teleported from the attic to this cabinet after that. That's the most believable part of what you're claiming, though.
entries.new: 这不是明摆着的吗？现在你只要激活 Sekimeiya 就行。{w}如果你真懂它的原理，就能让它把你送回过去，送到那间上锁的卧室。你在那里留下纸条，弄出我们听到的声响。趁我们还没进门，你碰一下 Sekimeiya，从房间里消失，再次回到过去。{w}你锁门大概就是这个缘故——免得我们一听见声音就立刻开门。你根本没有证明 Sekimeiya 能凭空变出一张纸。{w}……在那之后，它确实有可能从阁楼传送到这个展示柜里。不过，这也是你那些说法里最可信的一点。
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: Sai looked surprised.
entries.new: Sai 面露讶色。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: How about this, then? I will never touch the Sekimeiya again. I promise that.
entries.new: 那这样如何？我不会再碰 Sekimeiya 一下。这一点我保证。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: ...You promise?
entries.new: ……你保证？
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: Yes. As I said, we should leave it in this cabinet and never take it out until the shutter opens. If I never touch it, I can't do what you're speculating.
entries.new: 是。我说过了，我们应该把它留在展示柜里，在卷帘门打开之前绝不取出来。只要我不碰它，你猜的那些事我就做不了。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: What will you do, then? Travel to the past without touching it? Maybe that's possible.
entries.new: 那你打算怎么办？不碰它就能穿越到过去？说不定真能做到。
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: No, no. You don't understand. I will never travel to the past again. Everything's already over, and the Sekimeiya did it all.{w} Listen, Atsuki. I can prove that what you said didn't happen. If it had, another version of myself would have to be somewhere in the tower right now. Let's confirm that version of me doesn't exist.
entries.new: 不不，你没明白。我不会再穿越时间了。一切都已经结束，都是 Sekimeiya 干的。{w}听好了，Atsuki。我可以证明你说的那些没有发生。如果真发生了，此刻塔里某处就该有另一个我。我们去确认一下，另一个我并不存在。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: "Wait." Shiroya objected.{w} "I can think of another way, if we're supposed to believe what you're saying now."
entries.new: 「等等。」Shiroya 出言反对。{w}「要是你现在说的能信，我还能想出另一种办法。」
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: "Another way". Underwhelmingly, what Sai had intended to be confirmation of the Sekimeiya's more extensive powers could be refuted with more than one method.
entries.new: 「另一种办法」。Sai 本以为这能证明 Sekimeiya 的力量更为强大，没想到能反驳的方法不止一种，难免有些扫兴。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: It's possible you'll really never travel to the past again, but another version of you could.{w} I remember when you made Atsuki and me go to the living room. Back then, you weren't there, and you appeared from the hallway. What if that was already another version of you?{w} If you lured us out of the bedroom, your original version could go in there to hide under the bed. From there, you heard what we were talking about in the hallway, "9C".{w} That version of you will travel to the past and appear inside the bedroom, where you'll leave the note. Then, you'll use the Sekimeiya to go back to the past again, and you'll appear before us in the living room to play out the rest.
entries.new: 也许你真的不会再穿越了，但另一个你却可以。{w}我记得你让 Atsuki 和我去客厅那时候。当时你不在，是从走廊里出现的。那说不定已经是另一个你了？{w}要是你把我们引出了卧室，你本人就可以进屋，躲到床底下。你在那里听见了我们在走廊里说的「9C」。{w}那个你会穿越到过去，出现在卧室里，留下字条。然后你再用 Sekimeiya 回到过去，在客厅里出现在我们面前，把剩下的一切演完。
entries.speaker: snn

entries.text: Did you even hear me? If that's what happened, another version of myself should still exist somewhere! Let's see whether we can find him.
entries.new: 你到底听没听我说话？如果真是那样，另一个我现在就该还在某处！我们去找找，看看到底能不能找到。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: Not necessarily. If that other version of yours got out from under the bed and hurried here when we saw the note, he could've already traveled to the past.
entries.new: 未必。要是你那个分身在我们看到字条的时候就从床底下出来，赶到了这里，那他可能早已穿越回去了。
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: You're pissing me off a little. How about this? That didn't happen either.
entries.new: 你有点惹火我了。那这样吧——那些也没发生过。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: And you can prove that? I'm not exactly sure what you did, but was it just to make us believe that you have a great understanding of the Sekimeiya and get us not to take it out of the cabinet again?
entries.new: 这你也能证明？我不太清楚你到底做了什么，但你的目的，不就是让我们相信你对 Sekimeiya 了如指掌，好让我们不再把它从展示柜里取出来吗？
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: Yes. You're not wrong about that.
entries.new: 没错。这一点你说对了。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: Well, I can give you a third way you could've accomplished this by just traveling to the past.
entries.new: 那好，我还能给你第三种做法——同样只需一次时间穿越。
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: Atsuki explained it with a casual voice.
entries.new: Atsuki 语气随意地解释起来。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Like I said, what I could believe is that the Sekimeiya can teleport itself. If you really came to understand how that works...{w} I remember when you claimed you forgot about the key to the other bedroom, but I don't believe you really did. That could've easily been an excuse to disappear from our sight. After all, you asked to be searched, but only before you entered the other bedroom.{w} It's possible you got both keys from that room and initially only showed us one. However, it's also possible the Sekimeiya had teleported there.{w} You touched it and went to the past, to the right bedroom. You placed the note and touched the Sekimeiya before it teleported away. You went back in time and appeared in the second level of the left bedroom. This way, as soon as you entered it, the version of yours who'd already placed the note got out, and you showed us the wrong key when you'd already done everything.
entries.new: 就像我说的，我能接受的是——Sekimeiya 能传送自己。如果你真的弄懂了它的运作方式……{w}我记得你说过忘了另一间卧室的钥匙，可我不信你真忘了。那很可能只是个借口，好从我们眼前消失。毕竟你主动让我们搜身，却偏偏是在进那间卧室之前。{w}你完全可能从那个房间里拿到两把钥匙，起初只拿出一把给我们看。不过，也有可能是 Sekimeiya 传送到了那里。{w}你碰了它，回到过去，到了右边那间卧室。你放下字条，趁 Sekimeiya 还没传送走，又碰了它。你回到过去，出现在左边卧室的二层。这样一来，你一走进卧室，那个已经放好字条的你便出来了；而你给我们看那把错钥匙的时候，其实一切都已经做完了。
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: Aren't you forgetting something?
entries.new: 你是不是忘了什么？
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: What?
entries.new: 什么？
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: The noise. How would I have done that?
entries.new: 那声响呢？那一步我又是怎么做到的？
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: Oh, I see.{w} ...I said you traveled to the past before the Sekimeiya teleported away, which must have been before we heard the noise. However, there are two ways around this.{w} One, the Sekimeiya teleported itself to the past after you made the noise. That would solve it, if it's possible.{w} Two, the Sekimeiya teleported itself to the opposite bedroom and then back to the initial one. That's how you could've stayed there for longer and made the sound.
entries.new: 哦，我明白了。{w}……我刚说你在 Sekimeiya 传送离开之前回到了过去，而那一定发生在我们听到声响之前。不过，这一点有两种绕开的办法。{w}其一，Sekimeiya 是在你弄出声响之后才把自己传送到过去的。只要这能做到，问题就解决了。{w}其二，Sekimeiya 先把自己传送到对面那间卧室，再传回原来那间。这样你就能在那里多待一阵，把声音弄出来。
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: ...How about this? That didn't happen either. You're just wrong.{w} In fact, I really did overlook that the other bedroom had a key as well. That was not part of what I intended to do.
entries.new: ……那这样吧。那些也没发生。你就是想错了。{w}事实上，我确实没注意到另一间卧室也有钥匙。那并不在我原本的计划之内。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: "I don't think so." Next, it was Akaro who objected.
entries.new: 「我看未必。」这回反对的是 Akaro。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: After all, your silly trick ended with "the wrong key transformed into the correct one". That couldn't have happened unless you had the wrong key, meaning you knew from the start you'd go to the other bedroom to pick it up.
entries.new: 毕竟你那套把戏，最后就是「错的钥匙变成了对的钥匙」。你手里要不是那把错钥匙，这根本不可能发生——也就是说，你从一开始就知道自己要去另一间卧室取钥匙。
entries.speaker: aknn

entries.text: God. That was not part of the plan at all! All I knew was that the right key would appear on me after the Sekimeiya's sound. I didn't know it would transform the wrong one.
entries.new: 天哪。那根本不在计划之内！我只知道 Sekimeiya 响过之后，正确的钥匙会出现在我身上。我并不知道它会把那把错的变过来。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: That's very hard to believe.
entries.new: 这话实在难以让人相信。
entries.speaker: aknn

entries.text: Shiroya had one last input.
entries.new: Shiroya 最后又补了一句。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: I bet the way you locked the room from the inside was part of your trick too. You set the chain and then locked the door with the key.{w} That created the illusion that the Sekimeiya removed the chain, but it could've been as simple as you taking it out right after locking the door. It's not like we would've noticed.
entries.new: 我敢说，你从里面锁上房间的手法也是把戏的一部分。你先挂上门链，再用钥匙锁门。{w}这样就造成了 Sekimeiya 取下门链的假象，可实际上，你完全可能只是锁完门之后把链子摘了下来。我们反正也注意不到。
entries.speaker: snn

entries.text: ...I actually didn't think about that.{w} However, I didn't do it.
entries.new: ……这一点我倒真没想到。{w}不过，我没有那么做。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: I also bet the reason behind the "we have to wait for the Sekimeiya to make a sound" was so you could properly time whatever you did. You had to wait a specific amount of time for it to function.
entries.new: 我还敢说，你之所以讲「必须等 Sekimeiya 发出声响」，是为了给你所做的每一步掐准时机。你得等上一段特定的时间，它才会生效。
entries.speaker: snn

entries.text: Incorrect.
entries.new: 不对。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: And you can prove all of this?
entries.new: 这些你都能证明？
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: ...Yes.
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: How?
entries.new: 怎么证明？
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: By doing it again.
entries.new: 再做一次。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: Annoyed, Sai asked for the key to the cabinet. Everyone was still intrigued, so they agreed to let him unlock it.
entries.new: Sai 被惹得心烦，讨要展示柜的钥匙。众人好奇心未消，便同意让他开锁。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He picked up the Sekimeiya without touching it with his skin and left the room.
entries.new: 他不让皮肤直接碰到 Sekimeiya，把它拿了起来，随后走出房间。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Let's go back up.
entries.new: 我们上去吧。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: You're going to do the same thing again? Can you not do it in the bathrooms?
entries.new: 你还要再来一遍？就不能换个地方，别在浴室里做？
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: I can, but that's not as aesthetic.
entries.new: 可以，但那样就谈不上美感了。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: A few eyes rolled, but they followed Sai up to the attic. Once again, everyone was in front of the two bedroom doors.
entries.new: 有几个人翻了个白眼，但还是跟着 Sai 上了阁楼。所有人又一次聚在那两扇卧室门前。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Atsuki entered the right one and checked the drawer. The key wasn't there.
entries.new: Atsuki 走进右边那间，拉开抽屉查看。钥匙不在里面。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: If the wrong key transformed into the right one, how come the original one isn't here?
entries.new: 要是那把错的钥匙变成了对的，那原来那把怎么不在这里？
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: Because we can't have two of the same, dumbass. Come here.
entries.new: 因为同样的钥匙不可能有两把，蠢货。过来。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: So that you don't think any other self of mine is hiding nearby, go ahead and verify that.
entries.new: 免得你以为我还有别的分身藏在附近，你去查就是了。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: You realize it could just appear after we search, right?
entries.new: 你该明白，它也可能等我们搜完之后才出现吧？
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: That's fine.
entries.new: 无所谓。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: Erina and Isla saw the rest dispersing through the attic and shortly coming back, claiming not to have found anyone.
entries.new: Erina 和 Isla 看着其余人散进阁楼各处，很快又陆续回来，都说没找到人。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Repeating his past movements, Sai stepped into the right bedroom and placed the Sekimeiya on the floor, close to the door.
entries.new: Sai 重复着先前的动作，走进右边的卧室，把 Sekimeiya 放在靠近门口的地板上。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: There, he stood in silence.
entries.new: 他站在那里，一言不发。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: What are you waiting for?
entries.new: 你在等什么？
entries.speaker: aknn

entries.text: I'm thinking about the best way to do this so that you don't have a hundred excuses later.
entries.new: 我在想怎么做才最妥当，免得你们事后又找出一百个借口。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: He remained in thought for a couple minutes. Then, looking composed, he walked to the door and closed it from the inside.
entries.new: 他沉思了几分钟，随后神色自若地走到门边，从内侧把门关上。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: I will only set the chain this time so that Shiroya abandons her idiotic idea.
entries.new: 这次我只挂上链条，好让 Shiroya 打消她那荒唐的念头。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: As Sai spoke, only one thought filled Atsuki's brain: "I know what you want to do."
entries.new: Sai 说这话时，Atsuki 脑中只剩下一个念头：「我知道你想做什么。」
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He'd purposely left Sai a way out by ignoring one last way in which he could've achieved the same result.
entries.new: 他故意不去考虑最后一种同样能达成目的的办法，等于给 Sai 留了一条退路。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Careful not to alert him, Atsuki walked to the light switch and turned off the light in the hallway.
entries.new: Atsuki 生怕惊动他，悄悄走到开关旁，关掉了走廊的灯。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: What he had in mind was very simple: Sai would fake his travel. He'd claim to be about to touch the Sekimeiya to lock the room from the inside and appear outside. However, he wouldn't actually touch it.
entries.new: 他的想法很简单：Sai 会假装自己完成了穿越。他会声称要碰一下 Sekimeiya，从内侧锁上房间，然后出现在门外。可实际上，他根本不会去碰它。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Instead, he would stay in the bedroom. That way, he would hear what was being talked about in the hallway.
entries.new: 他会留在卧室里，这样就能听见走廊上的人在说什么。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: At some point, after having written the note, he would touch the Sekimeiya and go minutes back to the past. He would appear somewhere in the attic and claim he'd just set the chain and traveled out of the room, when in reality he would have already left the note.{w} Then, he would ask for the specific number and wait out the time he'd spent in the bedroom before opening the door and finding the note.
entries.new: 写好纸条之后，他会再碰一下 Sekimeiya，回到几分钟前。他会出现在阁楼的某处，声称自己刚挂好链条、从房间里穿越出来——可实际上，那时纸条早就放好了。{w}接着，他会问出那个具体数字，再等够他待在卧室里的那段时间，然后开门发现纸条。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: All right, it's set. Now I will touch the Sekimeiya and appear in the past, outside the bedroom.
entries.new: 好，挂好了。现在我要碰一下 Sekimeiya，出现在过去，卧室门外。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: Atsuki gestured at everyone to keep quiet, and he'd also closed every other door in the hallway. By shutting off the light, he wanted to reveal Sai's trick.
entries.new: Atsuki 示意众人噤声，走廊上其余的每一扇门他也都关上了。他关掉灯，就是想揭穿 Sai 的把戏。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He looked down. From under the door, light was seen, as the bedroom was illuminated. However, what Atsuki had achieved was highlighting Sai's shadow.
entries.new: 他低下头。门缝下透出光来——卧室里亮着灯。可 Atsuki 这么一关灯，反倒把 Sai 的影子衬得更清楚了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: His body was blocking the light from going through the entire gap. That was how Atsuki intended to expose him. If that shadow didn't instantly disappear, he could prove Sai hadn't teleported out of the bedroom.
entries.new: 他的身体挡住了光，光没能从整条门缝透出来。Atsuki 正打算借此揭穿他：只要那道影子没有立刻消失，就能证明 Sai 并没有从卧室传送出去。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Sai took two steps into the room, but his shadow was still acting as a barrier for the ceiling light. Atsuki wanted to verify Sai's bluff and quickly turn the light back on. He was certain that a future version of him was nearby after already placing the note.{w} If he could know what Atsuki was doing, it was possible his idea would retroactively fail. However, Atsuki was confident that'd still prevent Sai from completing his setup without a hole.
entries.new: Sai 往房里走了两步，影子依旧挡着顶灯的光。Atsuki 想验证他是否在虚张声势，便迅速把灯重新打开。他确信，Sai 未来的某个分身已经放好纸条，就在附近。{w}如果那个分身能知道 Atsuki 正在做什么，他的计划就有可能被追溯推翻。不过 Atsuki 相信，即便如此，也足以让 Sai 无法毫无破绽地完成布置。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Like the last time, after two steps, the sound faded. The Sekimeiya was on the floor, but near the door. Therefore, even though Sai had to crouch to activate it, his shadow would still be visible from the other side.
entries.new: 和上次一样，脚步声在两步之后消失了。Sekimeiya 就放在地板上，但离门很近。所以，尽管 Sai 必须蹲下才能启动它，他的影子依然能从门外看见。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Atsuki stared down. The gap was very thin, and certainly not big enough to see through. As such, using Sai's shadow was all he could do.
entries.new: Atsuki 低头盯着门缝。缝隙极窄，根本不足以看清里面。他能依靠的，也只有 Sai 的影子。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Sai's steps were purposely audible. However, that time, they took longer to cease, and bigger gaps were between them. Before crouching, the shadow moved left and right, as if in thought. It seemed like Sai was conscious of his movements.
entries.new: Sai 的脚步声是故意让人听见的。可这一次，脚步声持续得更久，间隔也更长。蹲下之前，那道影子左右晃动着，像是在思索。看来 Sai 在刻意控制自己的动作。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: I'm about to touch it.
entries.new: 我要碰了。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: All right.
entries.new: 好。
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: But despite his confidence, Atsuki saw it unmistakably: the shadow disappeared in an instant. It hadn't moved away—it had vanished.
entries.new: 然而，尽管他信心十足，Atsuki 却看得清清楚楚：那道影子瞬间消失了。它不是移开，而是凭空不见了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Disconcerted, Atsuki still managed to react properly. He dashed to the light switch and turned it on.
entries.new: Atsuki 心中一惊，却还是及时反应过来，冲到开关前把灯打开。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Instants later, the door to the living room opened.
entries.new: 片刻之后，通往客厅的门开了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Oh, right. I appeared here this time since we just came from the crystal floor.
entries.new: 哦，对了。这次我出现在这里，因为我们刚从水晶层过来。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: All right, let's do this again.
entries.new: 好，我们再来一次。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: Atsuki tried not to look frustrated, as Sai didn't seem to have noticed what he'd attempted.
entries.new: Atsuki 竭力不露出挫败的神色，因为 Sai 似乎并没有察觉他刚才的举动。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: What Atsuki had tried made sense. He had assumed the least important part of Sai's show was what the trick had relied on. However, he'd been incorrect.
entries.new: Atsuki 的尝试并非没有道理。他以为这场表演里最不起眼的部分，正是戏法所依赖的关键。可他错了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The only reason Sai had done that had been for the spectacle; to be able to claim that the Sekimeiya had unset the chain. In no way had that part been necessary to accomplish the result.
entries.new: Sai 那么做，只是为了做戏——为了能宣称 Sekimeiya 解开了链条。那一步对达成结果毫无必要。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: It had not been a deception. Right after setting the chain and locking the door, Sai had touched the Sekimeiya and traveled to the past, outside the bedroom. By doing that, he'd left both levels of the bedroom truly devoid of life.{w} That was why Atsuki's very first solution had been that Sai would, in the future, travel to the past again and appear inside the right bedroom after it had been locked.
entries.new: 那并不是骗局。挂好链条、锁上门之后，Sai 立刻碰了 Sekimeiya，穿越到过去，落在卧室门外。这样一来，卧室的上下两层就真的空无一人。{w}正因如此，Atsuki 最先想到的解法是：Sai 会在之后再次穿越回过去，出现在上锁后的右边卧室里。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Yet, that was also wrong. To make that note appear, Sai wouldn't travel back to the bedroom. As a matter of fact, he hadn't done it before they'd seen it either. Incidentally, nobody had, or ever would, as he'd worked alone.
entries.new: 但这个想法同样是错的。为了让那张纸条出现，Sai 并不需要穿越回卧室。事实上，在他们看到纸条之前，他也没有这么做。顺带一提，别人既没做过，将来也不会做——因为这一切都是他独自完成的。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: So he was more frustrated than he looked by the way Atsuki had acted. He hated feeling like someone was being superior to him.
entries.new: 所以，Atsuki 刚才的举动让他比表面看起来更恼火。他讨厌被人压过一头的感觉。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Sai approached the door and grabbed its handle. When he turned it, a chain prevented him from opening the door.
entries.new: Sai 走到门边，握住门把手。一转之下，链条挡住了门，让他打不开。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The chain is set, see? You didn't want me to also lock the door from the inside, so I'll do it from here.
entries.new: 链条挂好了，看到了吧？你们不想让我从里面把门也锁上，那我就在这里锁。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: Sai made his left hand a fist and slowly opened it up as if it were a flower.
entries.new: Sai 左手握拳，又缓缓摊开，像一朵绽开的花。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: A key was on his palm.
entries.new: 掌心里躺着一把钥匙。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: You're a clown.
entries.new: 你个小丑。
entries.speaker: aknn

entries.text: Am I, Akaro? Because you seem very interested to figure out how exactly the Sekimeiya works.
entries.new: 哦？是吗，Akaro？可你看起来倒是很想弄清楚 Sekimeiya 到底是怎么运作的。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: What the fuck are you talking about?
entries.new: 你他妈在说什么？
entries.speaker: aknn

entries.text: Sai ignored him and inserted the key into the keyhole. Then, he turned it.
entries.new: Sai 没有理他，把钥匙插进锁孔，转动了一下。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Why are you locking the door if it's already locked from the inside?
entries.new: 门已经从里面锁上了，你还上锁做什么？
entries.speaker: snn

entries.text: Because the chain provides a gap you can see through. I don't want anyone seeing how the Sekimeiya writes on a note.
entries.new: 因为挂上门链后会留出一道能往里看的缝隙。我不想让人看见 Sekimeiya 是怎么在纸上写字的。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: Don't worry. This time, I won't go anywhere. Let's do what we did before, then.{w} Isla, give me three numbers from one to nine.
entries.new: 放心，这次我哪儿也不会去。那就照之前那样做吧。{w} Isla，从一到九里给我三个数。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: "Hang on. I'll give you the three numbers." Atsuki didn't want to give him any way out.
entries.new: 「等一下，三个数由我来给。」Atsuki 不想给他留任何余地。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: That's fine by me.
entries.new: 我无所谓。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: But Atsuki didn't open his mouth. Just like Sai, he formed one fist, following with the other.
entries.new: 但 Atsuki 没有开口。他像 Sai 一样，先握起一只拳头，再握起另一只。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Then, he stuck out two fingers. Next, six, and finally, nine. Those had been his three numbers.
entries.new: 接着，他伸出两根手指。然后是六，最后是九。这就是他给出的三个数。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: ...{w}Oh, certainly, Atsuki.{w} We can do it like this.
entries.new: ……{w}哦，当然可以，Atsuki。{w}那就这么办。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: Atsuki had done that to prevent something they'd mentioned earlier. If another version of Sai had appeared nearby, he could not have heard the numbers. All the doors were closed, so Atsuki's hands couldn't have been seen either.
entries.new: Atsuki 这么做，是为了防止他们先前提到过的那种情况。万一附近出现了另一个 Sai，他也听不到这几个数。门全都关着，Atsuki 的手势同样不会被人看见。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Now, do not speak about them or move in any way.
entries.new: 现在，不要提到那几个数，也不要做出任何动作。
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: Sai nodded as he smirked.
entries.new: Sai 嘴角一扬，点了点头。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Do we also have to wait a random amount of time?
entries.new: 我们也要随便等上一段时间吗？
entries.speaker: aknn

entries.text: A random amount of time? We'll see.
entries.new: 随便等一段时间？看情况吧。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: Even if they weren't sure of the real reason, everyone next to Sai felt in some way that he was trying to deceive them. However, his attitude was beginning to feel imposing.
entries.new: 即使说不清真正的缘由，围在 Sai 身边的每个人多少都觉得，他是在欺骗他们。然而，他的态度已渐渐透出一股压迫感。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Did he truly want to leave the Sekimeiya in the cabinet? That couldn't be. So, then, what exactly had he figured out?
entries.new: 他真打算把 Sekimeiya 留在展示柜里？不可能。那么，他到底算出了什么？
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Atsuki had asked for silence so that his three numbers wouldn't be transmitted to anyone within reach. Because of that, everyone waited silently, and for longer than before.
entries.new: Atsuki 要求大家保持沉默，好让他那三个数不会传到附近任何人耳中。于是众人都沉默地等着，比上一次等得更久。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Ten minutes had gone by, and everyone started to realize that they'd surpassed the previous endpoint.
entries.new: 十分钟过去了，众人渐渐意识到，他们已经超过了上次的终点。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Sai began to whisper very quietly so that only the people right next to him could hear him, puzzling them.
entries.new: Sai 开始用极低的声音数着，只有紧挨着他的人才听得见，这让他们摸不着头脑。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Seventeen. I had to count internally since my watch doesn't work, but it's been seventeen minutes since we began to wait.
entries.new: 十七分钟。我的表不走了，只能自己在心里数——不过从我们开始等起，已经过了十七分钟。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: What...?
entries.new: 什么……？
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: Seventeen minutes. 2 + 6 + 9.{w} Remember when you said I'd waited an arbitrary amount of time to time everything properly? I'm glad I can now be certain I understand exactly how to use the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 十七分钟。2 + 6 + 9。{w}你之前说，我是随意等了一段时间，才把时间点掐准的吧？好在现在我可以确定，我已经彻底弄清 Sekimeiya 该怎么用了。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: Sai inserted the key into the keyhole and unlocked the door. When he tried to push it open, the chain didn't stop him, as it was no longer set.
entries.new: Sai 把钥匙插进锁孔，打开了门锁。他推门时，门链没有拦住他——门链早已不在原位了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The Sekimeiya unfastened the chain, right?
entries.new: 是 Sekimeiya 把门链解开的，对吧？
entries.speaker: aknn

entries.text: Was it you?{w} Are you my accomplice who helped me do this? If not, I'm open to alternatives.
entries.new: 是你吗？{w}你就是帮我做成这件事的共犯？若不是，我也愿意听听别的说法。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: Six pairs of eyes saw the identical scene. The Sekimeiya had disappeared, and a small piece of paper had appeared on the floor.
entries.new: 六双眼睛看到了同一幕景象。Sekimeiya 消失了，地板上多出一小片纸。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Isla walked over to it and picked it up.
entries.new: Isla 走过去，把它捡了起来。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: She showed it to the others.
entries.new: 她拿给其他人看。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The three numbers Atsuki had chosen filled up the entire surface of the paper.
entries.new: Atsuki 选的那三个数，密密麻麻写满了整张纸。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Attempting not to look flustered, he made his way to the second level of the bedroom, but there was nothing of importance to be seen.
entries.new: 他竭力不露出慌乱，走上卧室的上一层，但那上面没有任何要紧的东西。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Like before, after it was done, the Sekimeiya produced that sound and teleported to its cabinet on the crystal floor.
entries.new: 和上次一样，事成之后，Sekimeiya 发出那个声音，传送回了水晶层上的展示柜。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: The second time, that claim was harder to believe, as they'd just come from there. On the way down, it was much more difficult for everyone to find an explanation for what Sai had done.
entries.new: 这一次，那番说法更难让人相信了，毕竟他们刚从那里下来。下楼途中，大家更难想通 Sai 是怎么做到的了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: When they arrived at the event room, they saw the same thing as before.
entries.new: 到了活动室，他们看到的情景和之前一样。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: "We didn't even lock it after we took it out, right?" Atsuki noticed the arrow on the side of the cabinet was pointing to "locked".
entries.new: 「我们把它拿出来之后，根本没上锁吧？」Atsuki 注意到展示柜侧面的指针指向了「已上锁」。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: We didn't. It might be hard to take in, but the Sekimeiya did. That's what I intended to happen.
entries.new: 确实没锁。这也许难以接受，但锁是 Sekimeiya 上的。这正是我想要的结果。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: ...Are you just fucking joking? What's this, a magical stone that can do anything?
entries.new: ……你他妈是在开玩笑吧？这算什么，一块什么都办得到的神奇石头？
entries.speaker: aknn

entries.text: You thought it could only make one go back in time? Would that be much better?
entries.new: 你以为它只能让人回到过去？那样就好接受多了吗？
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: However, there's still the principal way in which you could've accomplished this that only requires you traveling to the past.
entries.new: 不过，还是有一个主要的办法，只需要你回到过去就能做到这件事。
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: Correct. It's possible that, in the future, I'll go back to the past and appear in the locked bedroom. Then, I'll write that note and touch the Sekimeiya, which will send me farther to the past.
entries.new: 没错。有可能，将来的我会回到过去，出现在锁着的卧室里。然后写下那张字条，再触碰 Sekimeiya，让自己被送到更早的过去。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: But that will not happen. I purposely left this method possible so that you believe my intentions—that I sincerely don't want the Sekimeiya to be taken out of this cabinet again. ...That could go horribly.
entries.new: 但那不会发生。我故意让这个办法始终可行，就是为了让你们相信我的意图——我是真心不希望 Sekimeiya 再被拿出这个展示柜。……否则后果会不堪设想。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: My wristwatch doesn't work anymore, and I don't know if I can fix it.{w} We have no other way to look at the time. It'll be hard, but we'll spend every minute left together so that I can't go to the past and explain this your way.
entries.new: 我的手表不走了，也不知道能不能修好。{w}我们再没有别的办法看时间。这会很辛苦，但接下来的每一分钟，我们都要待在一起，这样我就无法回到过去，按你们说的那种方式解释这一切。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: Additionally, before that, we can search the whole tower to make sure the version of me that this method would've left behind doesn't exist.
entries.new: 另外，在那之前，我们先把整座塔搜一遍，确认这个办法本该留下的那个我并不存在。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: Once this happens, you will understand. That there's no other way I could've done this but what I'm saying. This is only a glimpse of what the Sekimeiya's capable of. That... I'm sure of.
entries.new: 等这一切发生，你们就会明白。除了我说的这个办法，我不可能有别的方式做到这件事。这不过是 Sekimeiya 能力的一角。这一点……我确信。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: Nobody could find words to reply with, let alone object with.
entries.new: 没有人找得出话来回应，更别说反驳了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: So, as Atsuki's way out still seemed to exist, they went with Sai's proposition. The seven floors of Ashiya Tower were inspected, and nobody was found. Not any other self of Sai, and not Naomi either.
entries.new: 于是，既然 Atsuki 指出的那条路似乎仍然存在，他们便采纳了 Sai 的提议。芦屋塔的七层楼都查过一遍，一个人也没找到。没有另一个 Sai，也没有 Naomi。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Before the search had started, Sai had taken the Sekimeiya out of the cabinet and brought it with them, so nobody could've used it in the meantime.
entries.new: 搜查开始前，Sai 已把 Sekimeiya 从展示柜里取出，随身带着，因此这段时间里谁也不可能用到它。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: ...What if, after touching the Sekimeiya in the bedroom, Sai would appear outside the tower? Not even that would explain everything, and it could be avoided as long as they stayed with him.
entries.new: ……万一 Sai 在卧室里碰到 Sekimeiya 之后，会跑到塔外去呢？可就算那样，也解释不了所有事；而且只要一直跟他待在一起，就能避免这种情况。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: So, lastly, they had to wait. After locking the attic behind them, they sat on the floor of the event room. They positioned the curtain so that it wouldn't fall down, providing a constant view of the glass.
entries.new: 于是，剩下的只有等待。他们锁好阁楼，在活动室的地板上坐下。他们把遮布摆好，不让它垂下来，好让他们始终看得见那面玻璃。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The idea to save Miiya... didn't go anywhere. During the following hours, it was a surreal silence that everyone shared.
entries.new: 救 Miiya 的念头……最终没有下文。接下来的几个小时里，众人只是共同守着一片近乎不真实的沉默。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: There were no tricks left. The few times anyone had to go to the bathroom, it was made sure nothing else happened. Finally, they'd managed to wait until {time=21}, keeping the cold in the cabinet sealed.
entries.new: 再也没有别的办法了。偶尔有人要去洗手间，也一定会确保没有别的动静。最后，他们总算熬到了 {time=21}，而展示柜中的那股寒气始终被封存着。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Noise came from the lobby. Without a doubt, the time had come.
entries.new: 门厅里传来响动。毫无疑问，时间到了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The police rushed in and found everyone sitting in the event room. They were hastily taken outside and put in a police car.
entries.new: 警察冲了进来，发现所有人都坐在活动室里。他们被匆匆带出去，塞进了一辆警车。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Without hesitation, Ashiya released a public statement.
entries.new: 芦屋毫不犹豫地发布了公开声明。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Nothing has been taken. Everything is safe, including the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 没有任何东西失窃。一切都安然无恙，包括 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: c5

entries.text: However, word began to circulate in the underworld:
entries.new: 然而，地下社会开始流传起这样一种说法：
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Ashiya are lying. They do not have the Sekimeiya. We do.
entries.new: 芦屋在撒谎。Sekimeiya 不在他们手上，在我们手上。
entries.speaker: c5

entries.text: "We" referred to Xyn.
entries.new: 所谓「我们」，指的便是 Xyn。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The more that rumor extended, the more it strengthened, as Xyn continually stated they were in possession of the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 流言传得越广，就越发坐实——因为 Xyn 一再声称 Sekimeiya 就在他们手中。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The general consensus of the appearance is right: pure white and shaped like an egg. However, notice that Ashiya haven't shown the Sekimeiya since the incident. Why do you think they haven't?
entries.new: 对它的外形，公认的说法并没有错：通体纯白，形状如蛋。不过请注意，自那次事件以后，芦屋就再没展示过 Sekimeiya。各位想想，他们为什么不展示？
entries.speaker: c5

entries.text: It was a very fair question, which led everyone to be certain that, once again, Xyn had outsmarted Ashiya.
entries.new: 这个问题问得很有道理，众人因此更加确信：Xyn 又一次棋高一着，把芦屋压了下去。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Nonetheless, a new question shortly arose.
entries.new: 然而没过多久，又有一个新问题冒了出来。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: "Is Xyn going to prove it?"
entries.new: 「Xyn 会拿出证据吗？」
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Weeks had gone by. Petitions to show the Sekimeiya bombarded Ashiya, but reaching Xyn wasn't as simple. Yet, after the initial statements, neither party had proven their ownership of the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 几周过去。要求展示 Sekimeiya 的呼声铺天盖地地涌向芦屋，可要联系上 Xyn 却没那么容易。而自最初的声明之后，双方都没能证明自己拥有 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: And, from one point onward, the Sekimeiya had become a myth. Neither Ashiya nor Xyn spoke again about the incredibly valuable gemstone they'd once claimed to possess.
entries.new: 而从某一刻起，Sekimeiya 成了一个传说。无论芦屋还是 Xyn，都不再提起那颗他们曾声称拥有的无价宝石。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Only a handful of people were known to have witnessed the Sekimeiya by themselves during the time they'd been locked in Ashiya Tower. However, after being talked to, none of them had valuable information to share.
entries.new: 据说，在他们被困于芦屋塔的这段时间里，亲眼见过 Sekimeiya 的只有寥寥数人。可问过之后，谁都没能提供有价值的信息。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: And still, many people thought they knew the truth. Many people thought that something must've happened during the twelve hours they'd spent shut away with the mysterious Sekimeiya, whose whereabouts were unknown.
entries.new: 但仍有不少人自认知道真相。许多人相信，他们与那颗下落不明的神秘 Sekimeiya 一同被关在塔里的那十二个小时中，必定发生过什么。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: After all, something must, in fact, have happened.
entries.new: 毕竟，确实有什么事情发生过。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Something that had caused the disappearance of a female staff member who wouldn't be seen ever again.
entries.new: 正是那件事，让一名女职员就此失踪，从此再没有人见过她。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Ending: Altered Dichotomy
entries.new: 结局：Altered Dichotomy

entries.text: Ten Interloping Eyes
entries.new: 十双窥伺之眼

entries.text: A Hole in the Earth
entries.new: 大地之洞

entries.text: ...All right. ...Let's go.
entries.new: ……好吧。……走吧。
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: I stood up slowly so that I didn't lose my balance. I waited a few seconds for my blood pressure to adjust and opened my eyes once the dizziness had faded.
entries.new: 我缓缓起身，免得失去平衡。等了几秒，让血压缓过来，头晕退去之后才睁开眼。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'm sorry, I can go alone.
entries.new: 抱歉，我一个人去就行。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: ...No, don't worry.
entries.new: ……不用，别在意。
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: I forced a yawn before walking to the hallway, where all the doors were closed.
entries.new: 我硬是打了个哈欠，才走向走廊。那里的每一扇门都关着。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'm pretty sure he didn't come back, at least.
entries.new: 至少我敢肯定，他没回来过。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Atsuki opened the other bedroom. Katei was lying on the bed while Akaro was farther back, sitting on the floor. As soon as they heard us, they faced us reflexively.
entries.new: Atsuki 打开了另一间卧室。Katei 躺在床上，Akaro 则靠里坐在地上。一听到我们的动静，两人便下意识地转向我们。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Uh, is Sai up top?
entries.new: ……呃，Sai 在上面吗？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: What? No, he isn't. Is he not with you?
entries.new: 什么？不在啊。他没跟你们在一起？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: ...No? That's what we thought.
entries.new: ……不在？我们还以为他跟着你们呢。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: I'm pretty sure he went down.
entries.new: 我敢肯定他下去了。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: ...What the hell is that idiot doing?
entries.new: ……那蠢货到底在搞什么？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Annoyed, Katei stood up, followed by Akaro. Behind us, we heard another sound.
entries.new: Katei 恼火地站起身，Akaro 也跟着起来。这时，身后又传来一声响动。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Did anything happen?
entries.new: ……出什么事了吗？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Erina was peeking down from the hatch of the other bedroom. Isla immediately appeared behind her, looking sleepy.
entries.new: Erina 正从另一间卧室的地板开口往下探头。Isla 随即出现在她身后，一副没睡醒的样子。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Sai really doesn't want to leave us be. He's taking this as a joke.
entries.new: Sai 还真是没完没了。他根本把这事当成玩笑。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: What could he want, though? Does he not realize being alone could be dangerous?
entries.new: 可他到底想干什么？难道不知道一个人待着很危险？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: I don't think he trusted Atsuki's search. He might have wanted to verify it himself.
entries.new: 我猜他并不相信 Atsuki 的搜查结果。也许他想亲自确认一下。
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: I can't believe that kid. He's stepping over every line.
entries.new: 真拿那小子没办法。他把规矩一条条都踩在脚下了。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: *yawn*
entries.new: *打哈欠*
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: Are you two coming as well?
entries.new: 你们两个也一起来吗？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: I'd rather that than stay alone. We should've all been in the same room. ...I'll go to the bathroom first.
entries.new: 与其一个人待着，还不如跟你们一起。本来大家就该待在同一个房间里。……我先去趟洗手间。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: You're right about that.
entries.new: 这话说得没错。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: He was the one who had allowed Sai to leave, but nobody said anything else until we got to the crystal floor. The center of the building had adopted a sinister aura, one that I could only tolerate as long as I wasn't alone.
entries.new: 放 Sai 离开的正是他，可直到我们抵达水晶层，谁都没有再开口。建筑中央弥漫着一股不祥的气息，只要不是孤身一人，我勉强还受得住。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What...? You all smell this too, right?
entries.new: 什么……？你们也都闻到了吧？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Yes, it's stronger here.
entries.new: 嗯，这边的味道更重。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Immediately, something else became clear: Sai had been there.
entries.new: 随即，另一件事也变得清楚了：Sai 来过这里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: A few doors in hallway A hadn't been closed. The same applied to hallway B, although not as many.
entries.new: A走廊有几扇门没关上。B走廊也是如此，只是数量少一些。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Is he in any of them? Can you hear him?
entries.new: 他是在其中一间吗？听得到他的动静吗？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: There was no sound to be perceived. As I'd said, it was very possible he'd wanted to search through the floors, unable to believe Atsuki.
entries.new: 听不到任何声响。正如我先前所说，他很可能是不肯相信 Atsuki，才想逐层搜一遍。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Akaro entered the cleaning room while Atsuki and Katei walked up to the closest crystal rooms. I didn't have it in me to look anywhere, so I stayed behind with Erina and Isla.
entries.new: Akaro 进了清洁间，Atsuki 和 Katei 则走向最近的水晶展室。我提不起劲去任何地方查看，便和 Erina、Isla 留在了原地。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Everyone seemed tired, stressed, and burned out. I no longer cared a single bit about what Sai could've been doing. I waited passively until the three of them returned from the rooms they'd entered.
entries.new: 每个人都是一副疲惫、紧绷、心力交瘁的样子。Sai 究竟在做什么，我已经一点也不在意了。我只是被动地等着，直到他们三人从各自进去的房间回来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: However, when Katei came out of room B6, I questioned my vision again.
entries.new: 可是，当 Katei 从 B6 室走出来时，我又一次怀疑起自己的眼睛。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I wasn't hallucinating. Even though his outfit was white as well, I could see that he was holding the Sekimeiya, making little to no contrast.
entries.new: 我没有看错。他的衣服同样是白的，可我仍看得出他手上拿着 Sekimeiya，两者几乎看不出区别。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What the hell...!? This thing is seriously burning!
entries.new: 搞什么……！？这东西烫得厉害！
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: He looked to be in pain even though his long sleeves were acting as protection for his skin.
entries.new: 虽然长袖护着皮肤，但他看上去仍然痛得不轻。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Oh, what? Was it there?
entries.new: 咦，什么？它就在那儿？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Yes...! It was just stashed inside one of the cabinets.
entries.new: 对……！就塞在其中一个展示柜里。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: What? How come it wasn't found before, then?
entries.new: 什么？那之前怎么一直没被发现？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: I have no clue!
entries.new: 我怎么会知道！
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: ...I don't either.
entries.new: ……我也不知道。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Atsuki appeared sincerely confused despite being the one who'd guaranteed the entire floor was empty. Suddenly, it was confirmed the Sekimeiya hadn't been taken out of the tower. It didn't come as a revelation—I'd never managed to believe it anyway.
entries.new: Atsuki 曾一口咬定这一层空无一物，此刻却显得真心困惑。Sekimeiya 并未被带出塔外——这一点突然得到了证实。可这算不上什么新发现，我本来就没能真正相信过。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I need to leave this thing somewhere.
entries.new: 我得把这东西放下。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: He indicated for us to hurry into the event room. Anticipating his request, I took the keys out of my purse, failing to remember if the cabinet should've been locked or not.
entries.new: 他示意我们赶紧进活动室。我料到他要什么，便从包里取出钥匙，却记不清那展示柜原本该不该上锁。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Y—! You scared the fuck out of me!{w} Holy shit! What the fuck are you doing!? You almost hit me with the door!
entries.new: 哇——！吓死我了！{w} 搞什么啊！你到底在干什么！？门差点砸到我身上！
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Don't you think that's a better question for you? What are you doing!?
entries.new: 这话不是该我问你吗？你在干什么！？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: I'm doing absolutely nothing.
entries.new: 我什么都没干。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: We turned to Katei, who hadn't interrupted us. He was perplexed, staring at his empty hands.
entries.new: 我们转头看向一直没插话的 Katei。他一脸茫然，盯着自己空空的两手。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What's up with you?
entries.new: 你怎么了？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...Where's the Sekimeiya?
entries.new: ……Sekimeiya 呢？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: What? I have no—
entries.new: 什么？我根本没——
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I-It disappeared. I legitimately felt it disappear.
entries.new: 它、它消失了。我真的感觉到它消失了。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Excuse me?
entries.new: 你说什么？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: It disappeared from my hands just as Akaro opened the door! I was holding it!
entries.new: 就在 Akaro 开门的那一刻，它从我手里消失了！我明明拿着它！
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Whoa, what? Where was it?
entries.new: 等等，什么？它原本在哪儿？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...It was in one of the cabinets.
entries.new: ……在其中一个展示柜里。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Did it just vanish? That's what we thought could've happened earlier, right?
entries.new: 就这么凭空消失了？之前我们不就觉得可能是这么回事吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Sai spun and looked at the cabinet covered by the curtain. Then, he looked all around the room with a slight frown.
entries.new: Sai 猛地转身，望向那个盖着遮布的展示柜，然后微微皱眉，扫视了整个房间。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I was also moderately puzzled. Katei couldn't have been lying. He didn't have the Sekimeiya, it wasn't on the floor, and he couldn't have hidden it anywhere without us seeing it.
entries.new: 我也有些困惑。Katei 不可能在撒谎。他手里没有 Sekimeiya，地上也没有，而我们都看着他，他也没法把它藏到别处。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Did it teleport away, just like that? Is that it...?
entries.new: 难道它就那样传送走了？是这样吗……？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Katei stretched his hands, still appearing slightly pained.
entries.new: Katei 伸展了一下双手，脸上仍带着些许痛楚。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Sai, answer this first. What were you doing here?
entries.new: Sai，先回答这个。你在这里做什么？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: What do you think I was doing? Searching for the Sekimeiya! Do you think I was crazy for doubting Atsuki now?
entries.new: 你说我在干什么？找 Sekimeiya 啊！现在你还觉得我怀疑 Atsuki 是胡思乱想吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...{w}I didn't lie, though. I really didn't find the Sekimeiya when I looked for it.
entries.new: ……{w}可我没有说谎。我找的时候，真的没找到 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Well, it's great that you say that. Where the fuck is it now? Can it just be anywhere?
entries.new: 你说得倒好听。那它现在到底在哪儿？它难道哪儿都能出现？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: That shouldn't be the case, right? If it actually disappeared from the mechanical room, that means it appeared in the cabinet where Katei found it. That's not a random place.
entries.new: 不该是那样吧？如果它真的从机械室消失了，那就说明它出现在了 Katei 找到它的那个展示柜里。那可不是随便什么地方。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Sai walked to the single cabinet in the room and drew back the curtain. All we saw was a crimson cushion with nothing on it.
entries.new: Sai 走到房间里唯一的展示柜前，一把掀开遮布。只见一块深红色垫子，上面空无一物。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Oh, can you tell that the smell disappeared too?
entries.new: 对了，你们有没有察觉那股味道也消失了？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Yeah... It did.
entries.new: 嗯……确实没了。
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: Everyone sniffed the air and realized that Erina was right.
entries.new: 大家嗅了嗅空气，都发觉 Erina 说得没错。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It might be gone. Did it disappear along with the Sekimeiya?
entries.new: 也许真的没了。它是和 Sekimeiya 一起消失的吗？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: I don't know if I can't notice it anymore or if my brain is playing a trick on me.
entries.new: 我不知道是真的闻不到了，还是脑子在骗我。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: It's at least less noticeable. And yes, you and Sai weren't there, but Atsuki said a while ago that the smell might be coming from the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 至少是淡了不少。没错，你和 Sai 当时不在场，不过 Atsuki 刚才说过，那股气味可能来自 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Huh, how bizarre.{w} Are we supposed to look for it now? What the hell. At least we know not to let Atsuki do it.
entries.new: 哈，真是怪事。{w}难道现在还得我们去找？搞什么鬼。至少我们知道不能让 Atsuki 去碰。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Could it have teleported to one of its previous pla—
entries.new: 会不会是传送回了它之前待过的某个地——
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Hey... What the fuck happened there?
entries.new: 喂……那儿到底他妈怎么回事？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Atsuki was looking at the end of the hallway, where the elevator was.
entries.new: Atsuki 正盯着走廊尽头——电梯就在那边。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What is it?
entries.new: 怎么了？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: We had to take one more step to see what had rightfully caught his attention.
entries.new: 我们又往前走了一步，才看清究竟是什么吸引了他的注意。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What!? Who did this!?
entries.new: 什么！？是谁干的！？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: The metallic panel with the elevator button had been ripped off.
entries.new: 电梯按钮所在的金属面板被人撬掉了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: While Katei looked enraged, the rest were speechless. We'd been in hallway C instants earlier.
entries.new: Katei 满面怒容，其余人则哑口无言。片刻之前，我们还在 C 走廊。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Naomi...? It can't be, right? She's not here anymore.
entries.new: Naomi……？不会吧？她已经不在这里了。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: She's not here? Are you still trusting Atsuki!?
entries.new: 她不在这儿？你居然还信 Atsuki！？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I didn't lie! Go ahead and look for her!
entries.new: 我没说谎！你们尽管去找她啊！
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: ...Why would she take it off?
entries.new: ……她为什么要拆掉它？
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: Probably so we can't call the elevator, right?
entries.new: 多半是想让我们没法叫电梯吧？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: But how?
entries.new: 可是怎么做到的？
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: How? By unscrewing it, I suppose.
entries.new: 还能怎么，把螺丝拧下来拆的呗。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: This was done just now. If the idea is to make us unable to use the elevator, it had to be done upstairs too. You all walked down from the attic, right? Maybe it's happening as we speak.
entries.new: 这是刚刚弄的。如果目的是让我们没法用电梯，楼上也得照做。你们都是从阁楼走下来的吧？说不定这会儿正在动手。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Sai ran up the stairs, as the person we were up against could've been in reach.
entries.new: Sai 冲上楼梯——对方可能就在附近。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Are you serious...? What the hell is this?
entries.new: 你认真的……？这到底搞什么鬼？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Up to the sixth floor, every panel had been taken off. We'd just walked down through every floor, so it was undoubtable that it had happened very recently.
entries.new: 一直到六楼，所有面板都被拆掉了。我们刚刚才一层层走下来，所以这肯定是刚发生不久的事。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'm not even sure anymore about what I said earlier. Has the smell really faded away? I think it's still here.
entries.new: 我已经不确定自己刚才说的话了。那股气味真的散掉了吗？我觉得它还在这里。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: ...{w=0.7}Oh, give me the key.
entries.new: ……{w=0.7}对了，把钥匙给我。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Wait, we didn't lock it, did we?
entries.new: 等等，我们没锁门吧？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: What?
entries.new: 什么？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: You're right... I forgot to tell you to lock it because I was annoyed that Sai left.
entries.new: 说得对……我因为 Sai 走了而心烦，忘了提醒你们锁门。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Whoa, then someone's definitely in here. Is it time to have a talk with Naomi? I wonder if she knows we can enter.
entries.new: 这么说，里面肯定有人。是不是该和 Naomi 谈谈了？不知道她知不知道我们能进来。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I took the keys out of my purse and unlocked the door.
entries.new: 我从包里取出钥匙，打开了门锁。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The dark staircase appeared, challenging us to climb it. I was the first to open the door to the living room.
entries.new: 幽暗的楼梯显现在眼前，仿佛在等着我们走上去。我率先推开了客厅的门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...{w}Excuse me?
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What's wrong?
entries.new: 怎么了？
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: Just look at the floor.
entries.new: 看看地板。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I glanced down, and so did Atsuki. As Sai had pointed out, there was one major inconsistency.
entries.new: 我低头看去，Atsuki 也照做。正如 Sai 所指出的，有一处明显不对劲。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Are our footprints gone?
entries.new: 我们的脚印不见了？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: If you walked down, you definitely went across this carpet. These few aren't recent at all.
entries.new: 既然走下来，就一定会经过这块地毯。这几个脚印根本不是最近留下的。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Marked on the floor, traces of old footprints were discernible, but they couldn't be compared to all the ones we had left before leaving.
entries.new: 地板上依稀能辨认出一些旧脚印，但和我们离开前留下的那些根本没法比。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...This is impossible, right? Those marks couldn't have been erased.
entries.new: ……这不可能吧？那些痕迹怎么可能被抹掉。
entries.speaker: k
