entries.text: You're right... I don't see my footprints anywhere.
entries.new: 你说得对……我哪儿都看不到自己的脚印。
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: This goes way beyond me. We need to find whoever removed the panels, and now.
entries.new: 这已经超出我的理解范围了。我们得立刻找出拆掉面板的人。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: We ran to the hallway, but something grabbed our attention immediately.
entries.new: 我们跑向走廊，可立刻有东西吸引了我们的注意。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It's even been taken off here?
entries.new: 连这里的也被拆了？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: What the...
entries.new: 搞什么……
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Katei emerged from the kitchen and looked at the ridiculous state of things.
entries.new: Katei 从厨房里出来，看着这荒唐的一幕。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Why the hell would anyone do this...? We can still access every floor.
entries.new: 到底为什么要干这种事……？我们明明还是能去每一层。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: I was thinking the purpose could've somehow been to prevent us from entering the attic, but it doesn't make sense if the panel was removed here as well.
entries.new: 我本来在想，目的或许是阻止我们进阁楼；可如果连这里的面板也被拆了，那就说不通了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Naomi could be here. Let's make sure we aren't missing her.
entries.new: Naomi 可能就在这里。仔细找找，别漏了她。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Most of us waited in the hallway while Atsuki, Akaro, and Sai inspected every room.
entries.new: 多数人留在走廊等候，Atsuki、Akaro 和 Sai 则逐个房间查看。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Nobody's here.
entries.new: ……这里没人。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: He's right this time.
entries.new: 这次他说得没错。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: She's just somewhere downstairs, then.
entries.new: 那她就在楼下某处了。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: There's one place we definitely need to check: the storeroom. I'll see if the door was opened.{w} The Sekimeiya disappeared out of nowhere, but who knows what else happened with that; your footprints were erased from the living room.
entries.new: 有个地方必须查——储藏室。我去看看那扇门有没有被打开过。{w}Sekimeiya 凭空消失了，可谁知道除此之外还发生了什么。你们的脚印在客厅里被抹掉了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Everything was getting more unhinged. Somehow, the Sekimeiya hadn't been the primary layer of my thoughts, but that had to change. We had to figure out what we were in the middle of.
entries.new: 一切都越发失控。说来也怪，Sekimeiya 的事竟没有占据我思绪的首要位置，但不能再这样下去了。我们必须弄清楚，自己究竟卷入了什么。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Atsuki went to the living room.
entries.new: Atsuki 去了客厅。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The screwdriver I saw earlier is still in one of the drawers. ...Also, am I the only one who feels like it's {tip=cold}a little cold{/tip}?
entries.new: 我之前看到的螺丝刀还在其中一个抽屉里。……还有，只有我觉得{tip=cold}有点冷{/tip}吗？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Cold...?
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Nobody else seemed to relate. Exposure to the outside air had chilled my bones early in the morning, and the tower couldn't seem to warm me up well, so I hadn't noticed any change.
entries.new: 似乎没有别人有同感。清早在外头冻进骨子里的寒气还没散，塔里又似乎暖和不起来，所以温度有什么变化，我根本没察觉。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I guess it's just me.
entries.new: 看来只有我这么觉得。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Are you planning to search the whole tower again? Don't think we'll take your word for it this time.
entries.new: 你打算把整座塔再搜一遍？这回可别指望我们会只凭你一句话就信。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: After disregarding him, Atsuki walked to the staircase. I followed behind him, intrigued.
entries.new: Atsuki 没有理会他，径直走向楼梯。我来了兴趣，跟在后面。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I want to look at the time.
entries.new: 我想看一下时间。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: ...Oh. Why didn't you ask Sai?
entries.new: ……哦。你怎么不去问 Sai？
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: I looked at his wristwatch, and it said it's {time=13:44.} I want to look at the computer's, though.
entries.new: 我看了一下他的手表，上面显示 {time=13:44.} 不过我想再看看电脑上的时间。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: I see.
entries.new: 原来如此。
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: Do you know what could've happened with the footprints? That's so weird.
entries.new: 你知道脚印到底是怎么回事吗？太奇怪了。
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: No.
entries.new: 不知道。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Not at all, really. I think looking at the time could be an indicator, though.
entries.new: 真的一点头绪都没有。不过我觉得，看看时间或许能成为一条线索。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: And regarding the elevator, I'm just as confused as everyone. I have no idea why anyone would want to make it so that we can't call it.
entries.new: 至于电梯，我和大家一样莫名其妙。我完全想不通，为什么会有人想让电梯叫不来。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: It seems like nobody is following us...{w} What if this was done to keep the Sekimeiya inside the elevator, for example? That's kind of flawed, because they'd have to stop the elevator between two floors and then touch the Sekimeiya to do it. But doing it like that, it'd be stuck inside, and not even the buttons would help you.{w} And even if it could be called with the buttons, we'd have to find them first. That would make the Sekimeiya simply hidden there instead.
entries.new: 看起来没人跟上来……{w}比方说，如果这么做是为了把 Sekimeiya 留在电梯里呢？可这说不通——他们得先把电梯停在两层之间，再碰到 Sekimeiya 才行。可那样一来，东西就困在电梯里了，就算有按钮也没用。{w}而且，就算用按钮能把电梯叫过来，我们也得先找到那些按钮才行。那样的话，Sekimeiya 就只是被藏在那儿罢了。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: He sounded a little disconcerted. When he went quiet, he stayed that way, looking to be deep in thought until we were on the crystal floor.
entries.new: 他的语气有些不安。说完他便沉默下来，一路若有所思，直到我们抵达水晶层。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I want to see if the BIOS's time matches Sai's wristwatch.
entries.new: 我想看看 BIOS 的时间是不是和 Sai 的手表一致。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Uh...
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: What...? It's locked.
entries.new: 怎么……？锁上了。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Locked? Only Katei had the key for this door, right?
entries.new: 锁上了？这扇门的钥匙不是只有 Katei 有吗？
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: Yes. Naomi might be able to enter the attic, but as far as we know, only Katei's key can lock this one.
entries.new: 嗯。Naomi 或许能进阁楼，但据我们所知，能锁上这扇门的只有 Katei 的钥匙。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Actually, no. Remember what happened?
entries.new: 不对，等等。你还记得当时的情形吗？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: I found the key in one of the staircases and we came here, but the door was unlocked to begin with. Then, Katei said his key he'd left inside wasn't there...{w} We assumed it was the same one, but maybe that was wrong. Maybe there were two keys, and one belonged to another employee. I'm not really sure it's that, though. It felt to me like Katei was scanning the floor for something. That's how I found the key in the first place.
entries.new: 我在一处楼梯上捡到钥匙，然后我们来了这里，可那扇门本来就是开着的。后来 Katei 说，他留在里面的钥匙不见了……{w}我们以为那是同一把，但也许想错了。也许有两把钥匙，其中一把属于别的员工。不过我也不太确定是不是这样。当时我觉得，Katei 像是在地上找什么东西——我当初之所以能找到那把钥匙，也是因为留意到他在那样找。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: So...
entries.new: 那么……
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: The computer doesn't work. We can't do anything in the security room but look at the time through the BIOS, and it was locked after we figured that out. Maybe it was done to hide the time from us.
entries.new: 电脑坏了。在监控室里，除了通过 BIOS 看时间，我们什么都做不了；而我们刚弄明白这一点，门就被锁上了。也许这么做就是为了不让我们看到时间。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: No matter which key was used, anyone could've done it. Katei left the key in the drawer, and we all saw that. It should've been as easy as going to pick it up.
entries.new: 不管用的是哪把钥匙，谁都能做到。Katei 把钥匙留在了抽屉里，这是我们亲眼所见。要去拿，本该轻而易举。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: We don't know how long the door's been locked for, though. I can't try to find a reason behind this when our fucking footprints disappeared from the attic.
entries.new: 可我们不知道这扇门锁了多久。我们的脚印他妈的从阁楼里凭空消失了，这种时候我哪还有心思去追究这个。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Irritated, he walked to the storeroom.
entries.new: 他烦躁地走向储藏室。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: As he reached the door, Sai came down the stairs.
entries.new: 他刚走到门口，Sai 就从楼梯上下来了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Have you let Naomi free already?
entries.new: 你已经把 Naomi 放了吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...I haven't even entered the room yet.
entries.new: ……我还没进房间呢。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Then hurry up.
entries.new: 那就快点。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Did we leave the movable wall in place?
entries.new: 我们把活动墙留在原位了吗？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: No, I don't think we did.
entries.new: 没有，应该没有。
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: Amazing.
entries.new: 真行啊。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Sai demonstrated how to get it to open, and the hidden portion of the room stretched before our eyes.
entries.new: Sai 示范了打开的方法，房间隐藏的那一部分随之在我们眼前展开。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...It's gone.
entries.new: ……不见了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What is?
entries.new: 什么不见了？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: You know what I'm talking about. The door was opened.
entries.new: 你知道我说的是什么。门被打开过。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Should we even trust you?
entries.new: 我们该信你吗？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Yes. The door was opened.
entries.new: 该。门被打开过。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What that means is that whoever removed the buttons must either be Naomi or the culprit, who can open this door. That's why believing you right now isn't very smart.
entries.new: 也就是说，拆掉按钮的人要么是 Naomi，要么就是能打开这扇门的犯人。所以现在相信你，可不是什么明智之举。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Ah.
entries.new: 哦。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I don't know what your deal is, but you left the attic without saying anything, and the elevator buttons were taken off as soon as we followed you.
entries.new: 我不知道你到底想干什么，可你一声不吭就离开了阁楼，我们刚跟着你出来，电梯按钮就被人拆掉了。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: We don't even know what this "mark" of yours on the door is. You could be lying about it to make us think that someone else entered the tower and is responsible for what happened.
entries.new: 我们根本不知道你留在门上的那个“标记”到底是什么。你大可以编个谎，好让我们以为有别人进了塔，该为发生的事负责。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Thank you for openly voicing your suspicion, but turn around now. Both of you.
entries.new: 谢谢你把怀疑直说出来。不过现在转过去吧，你们两个。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...Why?
entries.new: ……为什么？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: So that I can leave the same mark in case it opens again. It's all we can do. Maybe we should always stay outside the storeroom.
entries.new: 这样万一门再打开，我也能留下同样的标记。我们能做的也只有这个了。也许以后我们就该一直守在储藏室外。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Go ahead. I won't do it until you turn around.
entries.new: 转过去吧。你们不转身，我不会动手。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: We faced hallway B.
entries.new: 我们面向B走廊。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Are you stupid? You can just turn around again at any second! Just go away.
entries.new: ……你傻吗？你随时都能再转回来！快走开。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I sighed and left. Outside, Akaro, Erina, and Isla were walking down the stairs.
entries.new: 我叹了口气，走了出去。外面，Akaro、Erina 和 Isla 正沿着楼梯走下来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Is Sai here?
entries.new: Sai 在吗？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: ...Yes. He says that the door was opened.
entries.new: ……在。他说门被打开过。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: It was. I just put another mark on it.
entries.new: 确实开过。我刚又留了一个标记。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Really...? We looked through every floor on the way down, and we didn't find anyone.
entries.new: 真的……？我们下来的路上把每一层都查过了，一个人也没找到。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: I didn't foolishly doubt my memories, but if that was true... Only the crystal floor remained.
entries.new: 我没有蠢到去怀疑自己的记忆，可如果那是真的……那就只剩水晶层了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Where's Katei?
entries.new: Katei 在哪儿？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: I believe he stayed in the attic.
entries.new: 我想他留在阁楼了。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Are you serious? Why would you leave him alone? Don't you remember he's very likely working with Naomi, who might have just reentered the tower?
entries.new: 你是认真的吗？为什么把他一个人留下？你难道忘了，他很可能在和 Naomi 联手，而 Naomi 说不定刚回到塔里？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Unless she's already gone, there's only this floor left. The Sekimeiya has to be found as well.
entries.new: 除非她已经走了，否则就只剩这一层了。再说，Sekimeiya 也非找到不可。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Atsuki entered room A4. We saw him opening up the cabinets and inspecting their interiors.
entries.new: Atsuki 走进了 A4 室。我们看见他打开一个个展示柜，查看里面的情况。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Does he still think we'll believe him?
entries.new: 他还以为我们会信他？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: As if a recording of the past were replaying, while we stared in silence, Atsuki kept silently moving.
entries.new: 仿佛过去的一段录像正在重放。我们沉默地看着，Atsuki 则一言不发地继续走动。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The doors...
entries.new: 那些门……
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Hm?
entries.new: 嗯？
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: They're all closed.
entries.new: 全都关上了。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Wait, y-you're right...!{w} I left some of them open, didn't I?
entries.new: 等等，你、你说得对……！{w}我明明留了几扇没关，对吧？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Oh, yes... Some of them were open.
entries.new: 哦，对……是有几扇开着。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Honestly, I think they were already like this when we left the event room.
entries.new: 说实话，我觉得我们离开活动室的时候，它们就已经是这样了。
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: We could only be dumbfounded as we followed Atsuki's mesmerizing movements. Something had happened around us, but it felt absurd to think we could know what. Atsuki backtracked toward the elevator and entered the room with the missing gems.
entries.new: 我们只能目瞪口呆地跟在 Atsuki 身后，看他那些令人着迷的动作。周围分明出了事，但要说我们能弄明白是什么，也太荒唐了。Atsuki 折回电梯方向，走进了宝石失踪的那间展室。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The second time Atsuki came out of a room, he had the Sekimeiya between his hands. It had been in room A5.
entries.new: Atsuki 第二次走出房间时，双手捧着 Sekimeiya。它原本在 A5 室。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Oh, shit, where was it?
entries.new: 噢，该死，它原本在哪儿？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Like Katei said, inside a cabinet.
entries.new: 就像 Katei 说的，在一个展示柜里。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Is that where it teleported to...?
entries.new: 它就是传送到那里去了……？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Hold on, is this normal?{w} Katei said it was burning when he was holding it, and it was hot when I had it too. Now it's not, though.
entries.new: 等等，这正常吗？{w}Katei 说他拿着的时候，它烫得像在烧，我拿着时也很烫。可现在不烫了。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Maybe it's not gonna do anything if you touch it now?
entries.new: 说不定现在碰它也不会有什么反应了？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: You could try it.
entries.new: 你可以试试。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...{w}I'd rather not. Let's leave it in the cabinet.
entries.new: ……{w}还是算了。就把它留在展示柜里吧。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Can I touch it?
entries.new: 我可以碰碰它吗？
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: What? That's not safe, Isla.
entries.new: 什么？那可不安全，Isla。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: But now it should be fine, right?
entries.new: 可是现在应该没关系了吧？
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: Isla had been fairly quiet the entire time we'd been trapped, but I could see that some of her unease had receded. She was just a girl who wanted to see an exhibit.
entries.new: 我们受困以来，Isla 一直相当安静，不过我看得出，她的不安已经消退了一些。说到底，她只是个想看看展品的小姑娘。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'm sorry, but I think touching it could be a pretty bad idea. It's, um... Your mom is right.
entries.new: 抱歉，我觉得碰它恐怕很不妥。它，呃……你妈妈说得对。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Hm. Okay...
entries.new: 嗯。好吧……
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: She seemed a bit disappointed but gave up. Atsuki was free to go to the event room, so we all entered after him.
entries.new: 她似乎有些失望，但还是作罢了。Atsuki 动身去了活动室，我们便都跟在他后面走了进去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...The cabinet's not locked.
entries.new: ……展示柜没锁。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: After scrolling open the glass, he placed the Sekimeiya inside and shut it again.
entries.new: 他滑开玻璃罩，把 Sekimeiya 放进去，又合上了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Once the glass separated it, Atsuki stood without facing us. We awkwardly waited behind him, thinking he had something to say, but all he ultimately did was lock the cabinet manually.
entries.new: 玻璃合上后，它被隔在了里面，Atsuki 便背对着我们站着。我们有些尴尬地等在他身后，以为他有话要说，可他最后只是手动锁上了展示柜。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Katei's there.
entries.new: Katei 在那儿。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: We looked through the door and saw him by the stairs, looking lost.
entries.new: 我们透过门望去，见他站在楼梯旁，一副茫然若失的样子。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Here you are!
entries.new: 原来你们在这儿！
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: We found the Sekimeiya in that room. It's in the cabinet now.
entries.new: 我们在那个房间里找到了 Sekimeiya，现在它放在展示柜里。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Oh, that's good. It didn't disappear this time?
entries.new: 哦，那就好。这回它没消失？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: No, and I have a question. Where's the key to the security room?
entries.new: 没有。不过我有个问题——监控室的钥匙在哪儿？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: That one...? I left it in the drawer next to the computer. You all saw it.
entries.new: 那把钥匙……？我放在电脑旁的抽屉里了，你们都看见过的。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: That's what I thought. The security room is locked.
entries.new: 果然如此。监控室锁着。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Locked...?
entries.new: 锁着……？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: How do you know?
entries.new: 你怎么知道？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Because I couldn't open the door?
entries.new: 因为我打不开门？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: ...{w}But when I got here, you were in front of the storeroom. Does that mean you'd already tried to open the security room? Why was that your priority?
entries.new: ……{w}可我来的时候，你站在储藏室前面。这么说，你已经试过打开监控室了？为什么要先去那里？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Sai walked to the door and confirmed that it couldn't be opened.
entries.new: Sai 走到门前，确认那扇门打不开。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I wanted to look at the time. I thought that maybe the computer had started working again.
entries.new: 我想看看时间，以为那台电脑说不定又能用了。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Because our footprints disappeared? I'm not sure I follow that logic. Anyway, it's {time=13:50.}
entries.new: 就因为我们的脚印消失了？这个逻辑我可不太明白。总之，现在是 {time=13:50.}。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: W-Wait just a minute. Why would the security room be locked?
entries.new: 等、等一下。监控室为什么会被锁上？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Anyone could've taken the key from the drawer. We all saw where you left it.
entries.new: 谁都能从抽屉里拿走钥匙。我们都看见你把钥匙放哪儿了。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: What if someone's hiding inside?{w} Naomi...? Mind coming out?
entries.new: 要是有人躲在里面呢？{w}Naomi……？能出来一下吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I can't see anything through these gaps, but I mean, Katei's got a point; why would anyone lock this room?{w} The computer doesn't work, so unless it was done to prevent us from fixing it, I can't think of much else. There aren't that many more rooms to lock yourself up in. I can think of the bathrooms and the bedrooms, but I'm sure you'd feel much more secure behind this sturdy door.
entries.new: 从这些缝隙里什么也看不清。不过，Katei 说得有道理——为什么会有人把这间房锁上？{w}电脑坏了，除非是为了不让我们修好它，否则我想不出别的理由。能把自己反锁起来的地方也没剩几处。洗手间和卧室倒是可以，可躲在这扇结实的门后，想必会安心得多吧。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What the hell do we do, then?
entries.new: 那我们到底该怎么办？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: The Sekimeiya's in the cabinet, so unless it teleports itself to the security room, anyone in there is gonna have to come out eventually.
entries.new: Sekimeiya 在展示柜里。除非它自己传送到监控室去，否则躲在里面的人迟早得出来。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Wait.{w} Is it me, or are we very stupid?
entries.new: 等等。{w}是我多心，还是我们真的很蠢？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Likely you.
entries.new: 多半是你。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I just thought that the elevator would work as a place to hide in as well, but we haven't even tried to open it on every floor. Even though we can't call it, as long as it's not stuck between two floors, we should be able to open the door of the floor it's on.
entries.new: 我刚想到，电梯也可以用来藏身。可我们甚至没在每一层试过打开它。虽然叫不来电梯，但只要它没卡在两层之间，它停在哪层，我们就能打开哪层的门。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: As expected, it's you. I tried that when I came down, and no doors opened.
entries.new: 果然是你。我下楼时试过了，哪一层的门都没打开。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...{w}You haven't, though. At least not on this floor.
entries.new: ……{w}可你没试过。至少这一层没试。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Hm, you're right. I saw you in front of the storeroom and it slipped my mind.
entries.new: 嗯，你说得对。我看见你站在储藏室前，就把这事忘了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...And the elevator should be here, right? Were we the last ones to use it? If so, we got off on this floor.
entries.new: ……而且电梯应该就在这一层吧？最后用电梯的是我们吗？如果是，那我们就是在这层下的。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: As Atsuki gripped the handle, I noticed that the door was closed. He had previously left it open to disable the elevator before searching through the higher floors.{w} When he tugged on it, the door didn't budge.
entries.new: Atsuki 握住门把手时，我才注意到门是关着的。他先前为了让电梯停运，特意把门敞着，然后才去搜查楼上几层。{w}他用力一拉，门却纹丝不动。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Is it not on any floor, then? I suppose it could've moved.
entries.new: 那它不在任何一层吗？也可能它已经移动过了。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Well, I thought of this when I was walking down, so I didn't try to open it in the attic either. Did anyone?
entries.new: 我下楼时也想到了这点，所以阁楼那层也没试着开过。有人试过吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Katei, Akaro, and Erina all shook their heads.
entries.new: Katei、Akaro 和 Erina 都摇了摇头。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Isla?
entries.new: Isla 呢？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: No... I didn't.
entries.new: 没有……我没试过。
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: It would make sense if it was left there since the attic was locked. It didn't occur to us to open it because the button had been removed there as well.
entries.new: 阁楼一直锁着，电梯停在那里也说得通。我们没想到去打开它，是因为那里的按钮也被拆掉了。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Huh. Maybe we are stupid.
entries.new: 哈。也许我们确实很蠢。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I think it's very likely it is there. I have no idea what the purpose of this was, but we can access every floor. Even though it doesn't make a ton of sense, the reason behind removing all the panels could be to hide something in the elevator.
entries.new: 我觉得它很可能就在那里。我完全想不通这么做有什么目的，但每一层我们都能到达。拆掉所有面板虽然不太合常理，可也许就是为了把什么东西藏在电梯里。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: As we were going up the stairs, we noticed Akaro staring at the wires coming out of the wall.
entries.new: 我们上楼时，注意到 Akaro 正盯着从墙里伸出来的电线。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What's up?
entries.new: 怎么了？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I was just thinking that we should still be able to call the elevator if we cross two of these together. Katei, do you know what each wire is for?
entries.new: 我在想，要是把其中两根线接在一起，应该还是能把电梯叫下来。Katei，你知道每根线分别是做什么的吗？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: ...No, but it's not going to—
entries.new: ……不知道。不过这样做不会——
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Katei cut himself off, and at that moment, his look changed.
entries.new: Katei 话说到一半停住了，神色也在那一刻变了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: This elevator underwent maintenance a few times. We installed the stop button while aware Xyn could try using it for their plans, and I just remembered something the technician told me.
entries.new: 这部电梯做过几次维护。我们装停止按钮的时候，也知道 Xyn 可能会为了他们的计划打电梯的主意。我刚刚想起技术员对我说过的一件事。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: The elevator measures a resistance in the panel. If the circuit is open or the resistance isn't correct, the other lines are deactivated as a safety measure. This was, of course, another measure against Xyn.
entries.new: 电梯会测量面板里的电阻。如果电路断开，或者电阻不对，其他线路就会作为安全措施被停用。当然，这也是为了防 Xyn。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Crossing the wires won't work, but something is bothering me. If the intent was to disable the elevator, the culprit should have pushed the wires into the wall. But since they're sticking out, it feels like the culprit knows they're disabled.
entries.new: 把线接在一起没用。但有件事让我在意。如果目的是让电梯停用，犯人本该把电线塞回墙里。可它们现在露在外面，感觉犯人知道这些线已经被停用了。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: ...Does anyone else know about this feature?
entries.new: ……还有别人知道这个功能吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I doubt it. The technician gave me the exact details when he was installing it months ago, but it was on a Sunday when the tower was closed. I have no idea who could have overheard.
entries.new: 应该没有。几个月前技术员安装时，把具体细节告诉过我，但那天是周日，塔里不开放。我想不出会有谁听见。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: ...{w}Akaro attempted to cross the wires, but nothing happened.
entries.new: ……{w}Akaro 试着把电线接在一起，但什么也没发生。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: This isn't normal. Katei is right, anyone with any electrical knowledge would've pushed the wires into the wall.
entries.new: 这不对劲。Katei 说得对，懂点电学的人都会把电线塞回墙里。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: ...What was the purpose behind it? That question drove us to run back up, hoping to make sense of what was occurring. Stepping up the stairs, I almost gagged at the sight of the walls surrounding me. I hated that damn building, and I no longer put any effort into repressing the deep, exasperated sigh that I let out.
entries.new: ……那一切究竟是为了什么？这个疑问驱使我们跑回楼上，想弄清正在发生什么。踏上楼梯时，四周的墙壁让我几欲作呕。我恨透了那栋该死的楼，也不再费力压抑，只是长长叹了口气，满腔烦躁。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: {w=1.3}We all stared at the door in shock. It was locked.
entries.new: {w=1.3}我们全都震惊地盯着那扇门。门锁着。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Someone else is certainly in this building. I left the attic just now.
entries.new: 这栋楼里肯定还有别人。我刚从阁楼出来。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: I took the keys out.
entries.new: 我掏出那串钥匙。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: You mean that someone locked it while we were downstairs? Weren't all the floors inspected?
entries.new: 你是说，我们下楼的时候有人把门锁上了？所有楼层不是都检查过了吗？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Maybe Atsuki was right. What if someone was in the elevator and got out as soon as I left? The inner buttons should still work.
entries.new: 也许 Atsuki 说得对。要是有人藏在电梯里，等我一走就出来呢？电梯里面的按钮应该还能用。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: I inserted the bronze key in the keyhole and turned it counterclockwise.
entries.new: 我把铜钥匙插进锁孔，逆时针拧了一下。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Huh? ...I can't unlock it.
entries.new: 咦？……我打不开。
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: What? How is that possible?
entries.new: 什么？怎么可能？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: He took the key and tried it himself.
entries.new: 他接过钥匙，亲自试了试。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wh-Wh...!?{w=0.5} It won't open!
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Flustered, everyone gave it a shot, but the outcome didn't change. The key wasn't affecting the lock.
entries.new: 众人慌了神，轮番试了一遍，结果却毫无变化。那把钥匙对锁根本不起作用。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Katei, show us what you have on you. This is long overdue.
entries.new: Katei，把你身上的东西都掏出来给我们看看。早就该这样了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What?
entries.new: 什么？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Can you stop with that? You were the last to leave the attic, and I have more than one reason to believe you might still have the key to enter it. Go ahead and show us that you don't.
entries.new: 别来这套。你是最后一个离开阁楼的人，而且我有不止一个理由怀疑，进阁楼的钥匙还在你身上。那就证明给我们看，你没有。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: After a disappointed look, he conceded and showed us the contents of all his pockets. Then, Sai inspected him more closely and confirmed he wasn't hiding anything else.
entries.new: 他露出失望的神情，随后还是让步，把所有口袋里的东西都掏给我们看。接着，Sai 又仔细检查了他一遍，确认他没有藏别的东西。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: In one of Katei's deep pockets, two keys were found, which we recalled seeing in the past. According to him, they opened his locker in the staff room and the door between the first two floors.
entries.new: 我们在 Katei 的一个深口袋里找到两把钥匙，印象里以前见过。按他的说法，这两把钥匙分别能打开员工室里他的储物柜，以及一楼和二楼之间的门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I hope you're content. I'm not even sure a key was used to lock this door, or else we could open it.
entries.new: 希望你们满意了。我甚至不确定这扇门是不是用钥匙锁上的——不然我们早就能打开它了。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: The set of keys I'd had before ended up rotating back to me, so I stored it away again.
entries.new: 先前那串钥匙转了一圈，最后还是回到我手里，我便又把它收了起来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: This is insane, then! How are we supposed to get in here?{w} Is Naomi really in the attic? How does she keep doing this!?
entries.new: 那这简直荒唐透顶！我们到底要怎么进去？{w} Naomi 真的在阁楼里吗？她到底是怎么一次次做到的！？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: It could easily be any person in the world since the storeroom door was opened.
entries.new: 储藏室的门既然打开过，那谁都有可能。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What? It was?
entries.new: 什么？已经开过了？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Yeah, I checked, and my mark had disappeared.
entries.new: 对，我检查过了，我留下的标记不见了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: We can do one thing aside from thoroughly searching the places we can access yet again. We can try to open every elevator door.
entries.new: 除了再把能进去的地方仔细搜一遍，我们还可以做一件事：把每扇电梯门都试着打开。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: ...Have I not said that I've already done that?
entries.new: ……我不是说过已经做过了吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Yeah. You said you'd forgotten to check the crystal floor's, but I can think of two reasons for that to be a lie.
entries.new: 对。你说你忘了检查水晶层的电梯门，但我能想到两个理由，说明那句话是在说谎。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: One, you wanted to keep the idea of checking them to yourself.{w} Two, one of the previous doors had already opened, so you had no reason to keep checking them after that.
entries.new: 其一，你不想让别人也想到去检查电梯门。{w} 其二，之前已经有一扇门打开过，从那以后你自然没理由再继续检查。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: *sigh*{w} Okay, sure. If there's currently someone in the attic, they might want to take the elevator down and back up at some point, so it's not a bad idea to keep confirming that it can't be accessed.
entries.new: 唉……{w} 好吧，随你。如果现在真有人躲在阁楼里，他说不定什么时候会想坐电梯下来再上去，所以继续确认电梯没法用，倒也不是坏主意。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Would we hear it if it was used?
entries.new: 要是有人用了电梯，我们能听见吗？
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: Yes. It does make an audible sound.
entries.new: 会。电梯运行时有声音。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Everyone looked drained. With what little energy we had left, we circled around the floor.
entries.new: 所有人都显得精疲力尽。我们拖着仅剩的一点力气，在楼层里绕了一圈。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Atsuki grabbed the handle of the elevator and tried to open it.
entries.new: Atsuki 抓住电梯门把手，试着把它打开。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Systemic Toxin
entries.new: 全身性毒素

entries.text: My heart shrank. When Atsuki's eyes met the interior, his body became rock solid. What we saw paralyzed him on the spot, his raspy breathing the only part of him not immobilized.
entries.new: 我的心猛地一沉。Atsuki 的目光落到电梯里面的一瞬，整个人便僵得像块石头。眼前的景象让他当场动弹不得，只有沙哑的呼吸声证明他还没有彻底僵住。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Hm...? Who is she?
entries.new: 嗯……？她是谁？
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: Stop!
entries.new: 停下！
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Erina pulled Isla into the stairwell, crouching down and speaking to her softly.
entries.new: Erina 把 Isla 拉进楼梯间，蹲下身，轻声对她说话。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Not everyone knew they were witnessing a sight that defied reason. However, the way the two of us looked might have told them enough.
entries.new: 并非所有人都意识到，自己目睹的景象根本不合常理。不过，我们两人的神情或许已经足以说明一切。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It's her...
entries.new: 是她……
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: She really was here, but...
entries.new: 她真的在这里，可是……
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Two bodies lay on the floor of the elevator. Buried in the back was Naomi, and next to her were all the elevator buttons and panels, piled up together.
entries.new: 电梯地板上躺着两具躯体。靠里的是 Naomi，她身旁堆着电梯的按钮和面板。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Are they dead?
entries.new: ……他们死了吗？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Immediately, Atsuki crouched. He softly grabbed an arm and pressed his finger to its wrist.{w} His own arm lost its strength and released its grip.
entries.new: Atsuki 立刻蹲下。他轻轻抓起一条手臂，把手指按在手腕上。{w} 他自己的手臂却一下子失了力，松开了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Does he know her...?
entries.new: 他认识她……？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I nodded.
entries.new: 我点了点头。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: W-Wait... isn't she the girl who died... a few days ago?
entries.new: 等、等等……她不就是那个几天前……死掉的女孩吗？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Yes...! I remember her face from the news.
entries.new: 没错……！我在新闻里见过她的脸。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: How do you know her?
entries.new: 你怎么会认识她？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: "...She's an old friend of ours." I almost said that, but I kept it in.
entries.new: 「……她是我们的一位老朋友。」这话我差点说出口，最后还是咽了回去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Well, what the fuck...? What is she doing here?
entries.new: 搞什么鬼……？她怎么会在这儿？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: So Atsuki's plan will... fail?
entries.new: 那么 Atsuki 的计划会……失败？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Will he manage to save her, but she'll die again...?
entries.new: 他会成功救下她，但她还是会再死一次吗……？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: No, what the hell is this even about? How could she have been saved? The past wasn't changed, was it? I still remember everything as it happened.
entries.new: 不对，这到底是怎么回事？她怎么可能已经得救？过去并没有被改变吧？事情经过我记得清清楚楚。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I staggered forward and slowly reached for the arm Atsuki had dropped.
entries.new: 我踉跄着上前，缓缓伸向 Atsuki 放下的那条手臂。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There was no pulse. Despite that, no part of her body indicated what had happened.
entries.new: 没有脉搏。然而她全身上下看不出任何异状，也看不出究竟发生了什么。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Her body wasn't found, right?
entries.new: ……她的遗体一直没有被找到，对吧？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Oh...! This is how.
entries.new: 啊……！原来是这样。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I bet this is what Atsuki's idea was. He was wondering whether the past could be changed or not.
entries.new: Atsuki 的主意应该就是这个。他一直在琢磨，过去究竟能不能被改变。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Without changing the past, he still had a shot at saving her. By going to the 30th and taking her away before the explosion.
entries.new: 即便不改变过去，他也仍有机会救下她——只要去三十层，在爆炸前把她带走。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: ...Simply because her body wasn't found.
entries.new: ……只因为她的遗体没有被找到。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Does this mean that he'll still do it? Even though he's seen that she'll die anyway? But we already verified that the past could be changed, so why would he do it like this?
entries.new: 也就是说，他还是会去做？哪怕已经亲眼看到她无论如何都会死？可我们明明已经证实过去可以被改变，他为什么还要用这种办法？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Nobody had words to interrupt the tragic scene. I stood up slowly and rubbed my eyes.
entries.new: 面对这悲惨的一幕，没有人说得出话。我缓缓站起，揉了揉眼睛。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...There's a little blood on the back of Naomi's head, forming that puddle. That's definitely a wound.
entries.new: ……Naomi 后脑有少量血，积成了那摊。那绝对是伤口。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: The questions didn't end there. We'd finally found Naomi, but she wouldn't be able to answer anything for us.
entries.new: 疑问还不止这些。我们终于找到了 Naomi，可她已经什么都回答不了了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I apologize for asking this, but is it possible she has a phone on her?
entries.new: 抱歉问一句，她身上会不会带着手机？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Awaiting any response, we looked at Atsuki. Facing away, I assumed he had some kind of focused expression, but the instant I caught a glimpse, I realized that was far from the truth. He looked broken and unresponsive all over again, forced to experience the same death a second time.
entries.new: 我们看向 Atsuki，等着他开口。他背对着我们，我本以为他脸上会是某种凝神思索的神情，可只瞥了一眼便明白，事实全然相反。他又一次显得支离破碎、毫无反应，被迫第二次经历同一场死亡。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Can I look?
entries.new: ……我能看看吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Sai, you said you tried to open this door.
entries.new: Sai，你说你试着开过这扇门。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: And I did. A few minutes ago, the elevator wasn't here. It must've been in the attic and got brought down just one floor so nobody heard it.
entries.new: 我确实试过。几分钟前，电梯还不在这儿。它当时应该停在阁楼，只降了一层，好让人听不见动静。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Are we supposed to believe that?
entries.new: 你觉得这种话我们会信？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Of course? Someone just locked the attic as well, right? We're still missing the person who did this.{w} Someone killed Naomi. I have no idea what happened to this girl, but look behind Naomi's head and at the blood on the floor. Most of it is dry. She's been dead for a while; it wasn't her we were looking for.
entries.new: 那当然？刚刚不也有人把阁楼锁上了吗？做出这些事的人，我们还没找到。{w} Naomi 是被人杀的。这女孩身上发生过什么，我完全不清楚，可你看看 Naomi 的后脑，再看看地上的血——大部分都干了。她死了有一阵子了，我们要找的人根本不是她。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: But why would anyone kill them?
entries.new: 可为什么会有人要杀她们？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: How the fuck would I know? Killing Naomi can have the same motive as the policeman—just because her presence was a potential threat. But this girl...? Knowing why she was killed is far from the main question.
entries.new: 我他妈怎么知道？杀 Naomi 的动机可能和杀那个警察一样——只因为她在场就是潜在威胁。可这女孩……？她为什么被杀，根本不是眼下最要紧的问题。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Atsuki, are you responsible for this? We know she died, but her body would look much worse if she'd been dead for days. Did you do something to bring her here?
entries.new: Atsuki，这事是你做的吗？我们知道她死了，可要是已经死了好几天，遗体绝不会是这副样子。你是不是做了什么，把她弄到这里来的？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Surprisingly, Atsuki shook his head very slowly.
entries.new: 出乎意料，Atsuki 极缓慢地摇了摇头。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: No? You both know her, so there's no way her appearance isn't related to you. If someone got into the tower through the storeroom, could it be her?
entries.new: 不是？你们两个都认识她，她出现在这里，不可能跟你们无关。要是有人从储藏室溜进了塔里，会不会就是她？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: That time, there was no reaction.
entries.new: 这一次，他毫无反应。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Sai stepped forward and kneeled next to Atsuki. The first thing he did was check whether the body was truly dead.
entries.new: Sai 走上前，在 Atsuki 身旁跪下，首先确认那具身体是否真的已经死去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Then, he went from pocket to pocket while Atsuki observed his movements. It didn't take long to confirm she wasn't holding anything.
entries.new: 接着，他逐个摸过口袋，Atsuki 则注视着他的动作。没过多久就确认，她身上什么也没带。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Next, he leaned forward. The spotlight wasn't on Naomi, but she might have had something important.
entries.new: 随后，他俯身凑近。聚光灯并没有照在 Naomi 身上，但她身上或许带着什么要紧的东西。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: And she did. The inspection finished with a single result: a key that she had in her pocket.
entries.new: 而她也确实带着。检查的结果只有一样东西：她口袋里的一把钥匙。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It's the attic's.
entries.new: 是阁楼的钥匙。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: So it won't be any use. We already have it, and the attic is still inaccessible.
entries.new: 那也没用。钥匙已经在我们手上了，阁楼照样进不去。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: What the hell are you talking about? We can take the elevator up with the key.
entries.new: 你在说什么鬼话？有了钥匙，我们就能坐电梯上去。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: O-Oh! I completely ignored that.{w} ...Also, what I told you earlier was true. Naomi did have another copy of the keys.
entries.new: 啊、哦！我完全没想到这一点。{w}……还有，我之前说的没错，Naomi 确实另有一套钥匙。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: The others aren't here, though. It's not the whole set.
entries.new: 可其余的钥匙不在这儿。这不是整套。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Did they get separated?
entries.new: 是分开放了吗？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: We need to go to the attic. I don't know why the elevator was brought down, but the real culprit might be right above us.
entries.new: 我们得去阁楼。我不知道电梯为什么会被降下来，但真正的凶手也许就在我们头顶上。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Wait... we can't take the elevator with them inside.
entries.new: 等等……电梯里有她们，我们不能就这么坐上去。
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: At least one of us can.
entries.new: 至少可以上去一个人。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: That's not what I mean... We should take them out. They can't be inside an elevator until the police come.
entries.new: 我不是这个意思……我们该把她们抬出来。在警察来之前，不能让她们留在电梯里。
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: And that takes priority?
entries.new: 这比什么都优先？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Of course!
entries.new: 当然！
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: She's right. They should be taken to the lobby so that they're seen immediately when the door opens.
entries.new: 她说得对。应该把她们移到大厅，这样电梯门一开，立刻就会被人看见。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Erina had gone a few stairs down with Isla, but she'd clearly been listening to every word.
entries.new: Erina 和 Isla 已经往下走了几级台阶，可显然，她每句话都听进去了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Isn't that irresponsible? We're disrupting the scene.
entries.new: 这难道不是不负责任吗？我们这是在破坏现场。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Sai, they're right. Using the elevator would disrupt the scene as well, and I find it very unlikely they both died inside it.
entries.new: Sai，她们说得对。动用电梯同样会破坏现场，而且我很难相信她们两个是死在电梯里的。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Do you agree with this, Atsuki?
entries.new: Atsuki，你同意吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: It looked like he nodded as he stood up. Before anyone could interfere further, he pressed the floor 1 button and stepped aside to let the door close.
entries.new: 他站起身，看上去像是点了下头。谁也没来得及再拦，他已经按下了一楼的按钮，退到一旁让电梯门合上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Then, without letting anyone see his face, he walked down the stairs.
entries.new: 接着，他没让任何人看清自己的脸，沿楼梯走了下去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Erina seemed like she was going to say something to us, but she kept it to herself. Behind her legs, Isla stared with wide eyes.
entries.new: Erina 似乎想对我们说些什么，最后还是咽了回去。Isla 躲在她腿后，睁大眼睛望着。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Akaro opened the elevator on the crystal floor, and the same deathly image was reiterated. Then, my reaction was similar to the first time I'd seen a dead body.
entries.new: Akaro 在水晶层打开了电梯，那幅死亡的景象又一次重演。而我的反应，和第一次见到尸体时并无二致。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: They were really dead, but their corpses seemed as sterile as dolls. Nothing outwardly indicated their deaths. There was no smell and no substance; despite how tragic it was, the scene itself felt underwhelming.
entries.new: 他们确实死了，尸体却洁净得像人偶，从外表看不出任何死因。没有气味，也没有实感；事情明明如此惨烈，眼前的景象却平淡得让人无从反应。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: After a long breath, Akaro grabbed the first body, making it look very light. When I looked at her face properly, I saw how much paler she was than normal. She was definitely dead, but I couldn't even see a trace of blood.
entries.new: Akaro 长长呼出一口气，才抓起第一具尸体，动作轻松得仿佛那躯体很轻。等我认真看清那张脸时，才发现她比平时苍白了太多。她确确实实已经死了，可我连一丝血迹都看不到。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Nobody was going to lift the other one, so we stood in place while Akaro went and came back from the lobby. Quietly, he bent down to pick up Naomi and brought her there, the closest we could get to the outside world.
entries.new: 没人肯去抬另一具，我们便都站在原地，看着 Akaro 往大厅去了一趟又回来。他不声不响地弯下腰，抱起 Naomi 带到那里——那是我们能抵达的、最接近外界的地方。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Inside the elevator, only remnants of blood, buttons inside their covers, and scattered screws remained.
entries.new: 电梯里只剩下血迹的残痕、嵌在护盖里的按钮，以及散落的螺丝。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Does anyone want to come to the attic?
entries.new: 有人愿意跟我去阁楼吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I will.
entries.new: 我去。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Nobody else answered, so both of them stepped into the elevator, dodging the tiny pool that had formed below Naomi's head. Sai still had the attic key and inserted it to enable the floor 7 button.
entries.new: 再没有别人应答，于是两人避开了 Naomi 头下积起的那一小摊，走进电梯。阁楼的钥匙还在 Sai 手上，她插进去，七楼的按钮才恢复了作用。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: They closed the door and let the elevator bring them to the attic, the place the person we were searching for had sealed off.{w} I turned back and saw Atsuki walking to the lobby.
entries.new: 他们关上电梯门，任由电梯把他们送往阁楼——那个我们正在追查的人封锁起来的地方。{w}我回过头，看见 Atsuki 正朝大厅走去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: That was what it seemed like at first, anyway. On the way, he made a turn and entered the event room.
entries.new: 至少一开始看上去是这样。走到半途，他却拐了个弯，进了活动室。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The Sekimeiya was still being kept in the cabinet.
entries.new: Sekimeiya 依旧收在展示柜里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Give me the key.
entries.new: ……把钥匙给我。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Of course, nothing had ended yet. The Sekimeiya had the power to change the past and additionally allow us to learn what had happened. I took the keyring out and personally unlocked the cabinet.
entries.new: 当然，一切还没有结束。Sekimeiya 拥有改变过去的力量，还能让我们知晓曾经发生过什么。我掏出钥匙串，亲手打开了展示柜。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: He grabbed the cushion and placed it on top of the cabinet.
entries.new: 他拿起垫子，搁在展示柜上方。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: From hallway A, Akaro and Erina looked at him without being able to say anything. For a while, Atsuki stared at the gemstone.
entries.new: Akaro 和 Erina 站在 A 走廊，望着他，一句话也说不出来。Atsuki 对着那颗宝石凝视了好一阵。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But he didn't wait long. Just a couple minutes later, he reached forward and placed his left hand on it.
entries.new: 但他没有等太久。不过几分钟，他便伸出手，把左手覆了上去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...It's still not working...!{w} Wh-Why not? I'm doing the same thing.
entries.new: ……还是不行……！{w}为、为什么？我明明做的是同样的事。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Right. When we'd put it in the cabinet, the Sekimeiya hadn't been working. That issue persisted.
entries.new: 没错。我们把 Sekimeiya 放进展示柜时，它就已经不能用了。这个问题一直没有解决。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It's just cold...
entries.new: 只是凉冰冰的……
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: He glanced back and saw that the two people who'd gone to the attic hadn't returned. After a pause, he placed the cushion back inside the cabinet.
entries.new: 他回头看了一眼，去阁楼的两个人还没有回来。沉默片刻，他把垫子放回了展示柜里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Interestingly, like the previous time, he stood in front of it for a while before turning the manual arrow.
entries.new: 有意思的是，和上一次一样，他在柜前站了好一会儿，才转动手动箭头。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: They're back, coming from the stairs.
entries.new: 他们回来了，是从楼梯上来的。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Did you try to use the Sekimeiya?
entries.new: 你试过用 Sekimeiya 了吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Nothing in the attic?
entries.new: 阁楼里什么都没有？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: There wasn't anyone. We only found this.
entries.new: 一个人也没有。我们只找到了这个。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: In his hand was the key to the attic.
entries.new: 他手中拿着的，是阁楼的钥匙。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: This isn't the one that Naomi had. There was another one inserted in the inner lock of the door. That's why we couldn't open it from the outside.
entries.new: 这不是 Naomi 手上那把。门内侧的锁孔里还插着另一把，所以我们从外面才打不开。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: What? Another one?
entries.new: 什么？还有一把？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Yes, a third one which shouldn't exist.
entries.new: 对，第三把——一把本不该存在的钥匙。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: I'm glad you brought that up, because I can now point out how that doesn't make sense. You're saying a third one shouldn't exist, but your keyring was supposed to have one, right? Are you and Naomi the only people with this key?
entries.new: 你提起这个正好，我可以指出这有多说不通。你说第三把本不该存在，可你的钥匙串上本来就该有一把，对吧？拥有这把钥匙的，只有你和 Naomi 两个人吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...Correct. We're the only ones that I'm aware of.
entries.new: ……没错。据我所知，只有我们。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Let me remind you, I tried to open the elevator doors, and none of them opened. While the culprit could be someone who left and entered the tower, it's possible the people who came in through the storeroom were only the three victims, whose presences were harmful to the killer. Four of you were still in the attic when I went down.
entries.new: 提醒你一句，每一层的电梯门我都试过，哪一层都没打开。凶手可能是从塔外进出的人，但也可能，从储藏室进来的只有那三名死者——他们的存在对凶手不利。而我下楼的时候，你们四个人都还在阁楼里。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...Are you seriously accusing us of this?
entries.new: ……你是当真在怀疑我们？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: I'm not accusing anyone, but there weren't traces of anyone else in the attic, and the Sekimeiya is still here. It's moronic to pretend that none of you could move the elevator after I tried to open it.
entries.new: 我没有怀疑谁。但阁楼里没有别人来过的痕迹，Sekimeiya 也还在这里。在我试过开电梯之后，还硬说你们当中没人能开动电梯，那就太蠢了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Then, likewise, it's very stupid to simply believe you! You wrongly claimed that no door had opened. You could've easily done that so that we wouldn't check them.
entries.new: 单凭你一面之词就相信你，也同样蠢得可以！你谎称哪扇门都没开过，完全可能只是想让我们不去检查。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: I'm going up.
entries.new: 我上去。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Now you want to?
entries.new: 现在想去了？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: After ignoring Sai again, Atsuki walked to the staircase. As soon as we saw he wasn't going to take the elevator, the rest of us followed behind.
entries.new: Atsuki 又一次无视了 Sai，径直走向楼梯。我们一见他不是要坐电梯，便都跟在了后面。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Did you lock the door on your way down?
entries.new: 你们下楼的时候锁门了吗？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Yes.
entries.new: 锁了。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Katei inserted the single key and got the door to open. Atsuki didn't waste time before going up the stairs.
entries.new: Katei 把唯一那把钥匙插进去，打开了门。Atsuki 没有耽搁，立刻上了楼梯。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Sai's and Katei's footprints were still visible, so we stepped directly inside of them. I figured Atsuki wanted to see the state of the attic for himself, as he went ahead to the hallway.
entries.new: Sai 和 Katei 的脚印还清晰可辨，我们便直接踩着那些脚印走。Atsuki 率先往走廊里去，我想他是要亲眼看看阁楼的情形。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The people who hadn't taken the elevator dispersed through the rooms, and each verified that nothing stood out.
entries.new: 没坐电梯的人分散到各个房间里，逐一确认没有异样。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: In the end, everyone ended up scattered through the floor. Erina and Isla sat on the sofa, Atsuki stood in the staircase, and the others remained in the right bedroom. Sai was sitting in front of the elevator, seemingly lost in thought. For many reasons, the mood was dark, and it was really burning me out.
entries.new: 到头来，大家还是各自散在这一层的各处。Erina 和 Isla 坐在沙发上，Atsuki 站在楼梯口，其余的人留在右边的卧室。Sai 坐在电梯前，似乎正出着神。因为种种原因，气氛沉闷得厉害，我实在累得不行。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I walked to the bedrooms and opened the left one. I needed to throw myself onto the bed and be alone for some time.
entries.new: 我走到卧室那边，推开了左边那间。我只想扑到床上，一个人待一会儿。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: 30 Minutes Later
entries.new: 三十分钟后

entries.text: Crossover
entries.new: 交错

entries.text: I stood in the middle of the floor 3 corridor. I didn't want to see the others, so I'd been thinking to myself.
entries.new: 我站在三楼走廊的正中。我不想见到其他人，便一直独自沉思着。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: As anyone could've been anywhere, all I wanted was to wait. I could perceive faint footsteps above me, signaling someone was on the fourth floor.
entries.new: 谁也说不准谁在哪儿，我只想等着。头顶隐约传来脚步声，说明四楼有人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Are they gonna come?
entries.new: ……他们会来吗？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I approached a potted plant and sat next to it. I calmly felt the seconds pass, appreciating the sensation.
entries.new: 我走到一盆绿植旁坐下，静静体会着时间一秒一秒过去的感觉。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: When someone finally arrived, it was from the staircase leading down. ...Atsuki.
entries.new: 终于有人来了，是从下面的楼梯上来的。……是 Atsuki。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: He jogged up to me, looking anxious and disturbed.
entries.new: 他小跑着来到我面前，神情焦急而不安。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: A-Are you alone...!? Where are the others?
entries.new: 你、你一个人……！？其他人呢？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: ...I am, and I don't know. What happened?
entries.new: ……是，我也不知道。出什么事了？
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: You need to come down. Did anyone pass through this floor?
entries.new: 你得跟我下去。有人经过这一层吗？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: I haven't seen anyone, no.
entries.new: 我没看见任何人。
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: He was pretty agitated, so I kept my composure and waited for him to tell me what had occurred. Everything about him gave away that he'd seen something frightful.
entries.new: 他相当激动，我便沉住气，等他说出发生了什么。他整个人都透出一副看见了什么可怕东西的样子。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We need to find everyone else...
entries.new: 得把其他人找齐……
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Are you gonna tell me what happened?
entries.new: 你到底说不说发生了什么？
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: I'm sorry... It's on the crystal floor, but we shouldn't separate anymore.
entries.new: 对不起……在水晶层。不过我们不能再分开了。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: He grabbed my hand and dashed toward the way he'd come.
entries.new: 他抓住我的手，朝他来的方向跑去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: You're scaring me... Don't tell me...
entries.new: 你别吓我……难不成……
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: We ran around the second floor. When we got to the last staircase, Atsuki stopped and looked down. It wasn't visible yet.
entries.new: 我们在二楼绕了一圈。到最后一处楼梯时，Atsuki 停下脚步向下望去。还看不到。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I descended the steps until the crystal floor was visible through the open door.
entries.new: 我沿着台阶往下走，直到从敞开的门里看到了水晶层。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: E-Erina...!
entries.new: E、Erina……！
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: Erina's body lay facing down over a vast pool of blood, traces of which started in the middle of the staircase. I didn't have to walk farther down to know she was dead.
entries.new: Erina 俯卧在一大片血泊里，血迹从楼梯中段一路延伸过来。不必再往下走，我也知道她已经死了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Behind me, Atsuki hadn't yet stepped down. It was hard to meet his eyes; he looked only at the floor.
entries.new: 我身后的 Atsuki 还没有走下台阶。他只看地面，我不敢去看他的眼睛。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Damn it...! Where the hell are the others!? Still in the attic?
entries.new: 该死……！其他人到底在哪儿！？还在阁楼吗？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: I-I think someone was on the floor above me at some point. Were you alone when you found her?
entries.new: 我、我好像有段时间感觉楼上有动静。你发现她的时候是一个人吗？
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: Yes.
entries.new: 是。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: I kept walking down while I silently wondered why he'd been alone. On the floor of hallway C, I pressed two fingers to Erina's body and waited for any perceptible movement.
entries.new: 我一边往下走，一边暗自纳闷他怎么会是一个人。到了 C 走廊那层，我把两根手指按在 Erina 身上，试着察觉任何动静。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I've already checked...
entries.new: 我已经确认过了……
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: She was truly dead. Erina, who'd been quietly following us around the entire day, was not alive anymore. It was such a bizarre sensation.
entries.new: 她真的死了。这一整天都默默跟在我们身后的 Erina，已经没有了生命。那种感觉说不出的怪异。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Where's Isla? Sh-She can't see this.
entries.new: Isla 呢？不、不能让她看到这个。
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: I don't know where anyone is! They should be up above!
entries.new: 我哪知道他们在哪儿！应该都在上面吧！
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: It's not possible for us to take the elevator, so let's walk up. We should come across someone.
entries.new: 电梯是坐不成了，我们走上去吧。总会碰上人的。
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: My heavy breathing was interrupting my words, and I didn't let my gaze stray from Erina. Being so close to her, I noticed that blood was coming out of the part of her head that hit the edge of a step.
entries.new: 我喘得厉害，话都说不连贯，视线却始终没离开 Erina。靠得这样近，我才发现她头上撞到台阶边沿的地方还在渗血。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: H-Her killer should be here on this floor, but looking for them is way too dangerous. Like I said before, don't go alone anywhere anymore.
entries.new: 杀、杀她的人应该就在这一层，可去找他实在太危险。我说过了，别再一个人行动。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Yes, I know.
entries.new: 嗯，我知道。
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: We ran up the floors. On the fourth was Sai.
entries.new: 我们一层层往上跑。四楼是 Sai。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: However, as it was essential to find everyone, we didn't explain fully and kept moving up.
entries.new: 但找到所有人要紧，我们来不及细说，便继续往上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: One floor higher was Katei. On the sixth, Akaro.
entries.new: 再上一层是 Katei。到六楼，是 Akaro。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I saw that the attic key was inserted into the door. We all entered to find the missing person.
entries.new: 我看见阁楼的钥匙插在门上。我们一齐走了进去，寻找那个还没找到的人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I stared at the floor's footprints—the proof that the past had changed. I had no idea how, but it was undeniable that it greatly had.
entries.new: 我盯着地板上的脚印——那是过去被改写的证据。我不知道是怎么做到的，但无可否认，过去已经大不一样了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: When every room was looked into, the final result was alarming. Isla had not been found.
entries.new: 所有房间都找过之后，结果令人心惊——Isla 不见了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Isla should be somewhere...! Where did you all see her last?
entries.new: Isla 一定在什么地方……！你们最后一次看到她是在哪儿？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Only Isla? Then, what happened on the crystal floor...
entries.new: 只有 Isla？那水晶层那边到底出了什么事……
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Is it Erina...? Both of them were here not long ago.
entries.new: 是 Erina 吗……？她们两个不久前还在这儿。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Yes. They were sitting on the sofa when I left.
entries.new: 嗯。我离开的时候，她们还坐在沙发上。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: In that case, they took the elevator. That was them.
entries.new: 这么说，他们是坐了电梯。那就是他们。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Was it up here?
entries.new: 是上到这一层了吗？
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: Yes.
entries.new: 是。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: So Isla could be in danger...
entries.new: 那 Isla 可能有危险……
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: All of us ran back down. It was hard to believe anyone wasn't aware of what awaited them, but they had to see for themselves.
entries.new: 我们全都跑下了楼。谁都清楚等着自己的是什么，可他们终究要亲眼确认。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Shit...! Why the fuck would Erina be targeted...!?
entries.new: 该死……！为什么会有人对 Erina 下手……！？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Everyone saw her dead body over the slowly growing pool of blood. Sai gently checked her pulse and confirmed it for everyone.
entries.new: 所有人都看见她倒在缓缓扩开的血泊里。Sai 轻轻探了探她的脉搏，替大家确认了这个事实。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Why is Isla not with her...? It couldn't be that...
entries.new: 为什么 Isla 不在她身边……？难道说……
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Th-There's no way.{w} ...Should I bring her to the lobby?
entries.new: 怎、怎么可能。{w}……要不要把她带到大厅去？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: To the lobby? Why?
entries.new: 带到大厅？为什么？
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: So she's with the others. Sorry, that was stupid of me. This time, this is actually where she died.
entries.new: 这样她就能和其他人在一起了。抱歉，是我糊涂了。这次，她确实是死在这里的。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: I went quiet. I'd begun to form a small theory, but it appeared I was wrong. After that, I realized I had no idea what had actually happened.
entries.new: 我沉默了。我原本隐约有了一个猜想，看来是想错了。紧接着我才意识到，对于究竟发生了什么，我根本毫无头绪。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Can we be sure she was killed? What if she fell off the stairs, which shocked Isla and made her run away?
entries.new: 能确定她是被人杀死的吗？也许她是从楼梯上摔了下来，Isla 受到惊吓才跑掉的？
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: I doubt it. There's a button right here.
entries.new: 我看不像。这里有一颗纽扣。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I followed Sai's finger to one of the higher steps. We walked up and saw a silver button which had formerly been attached to Erina's turtleneck.
entries.new: 我顺着 Sai 的手指看向较高的一级台阶。我们走上去，看见一颗银色纽扣——原先是钉在 Erina 高领毛衣上的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: You mean this points to there being a fight?
entries.new: 你是说，这说明这里发生过争执？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: How else would it have ended up here?
entries.new: 不然它怎么会掉在这里？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Sai is right. This wasn't an accident, and I heard it. I-I was in the first partition of the second floor when I heard Erina.{w} Her voice hardly reached me, but the words I picked up were enough to understand what was happening. "Don't lie! It can only be you. You killed them."
entries.new: Sai 说得对。这不是意外，我亲耳听到了。我、我当时在二楼的第一间隔间，听见了 Erina 的声音。{w}她的声音传到我这里已经很微弱，但我听到的那几句，足以让我明白发生了什么。「别骗人了！只可能是你。是你杀了他们。」
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: What!? Then that's why someone killed her... She identified them.
entries.new: 什么！？所以她才被人灭了口……她认出了对方。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: ...{w}Is this true, Atsuki?
entries.new: ……{w}这是真的吗，Atsuki？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Yes! I'm not lying.
entries.new: 是真的！我没有说谎。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Did you hear anything else?
entries.new: 还听到了别的吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Y-Yes, a yell, I think, from Erina. Then, I ran here and saw her dead.
entries.new: 听、听到了，好像是 Erina 喊了一声。然后我就跑到这里，看见她已经死了。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: That means the killer is on this floor, right?
entries.new: 那凶手就在这一层了？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Maybe when he found Erina, but not anymore. Whoever killed her could be anywhere. However, this changes things a lot.
entries.new: 他发现 Erina 的时候也许还在，现在可说不准。杀她的人眼下可能在任何地方。不过，这让情况变了很多。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What are you talking about?
entries.new: 你在说什么？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Sai went to the storeroom and came back seconds later.
entries.new: Sai 去了储藏室，几秒后就回来了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The door hasn't been opened again...
entries.new: 门没有再次被打开过……
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Let me be clear. One thing would be possible: the real killer killed Erina. Then, they escaped from this floor immediately. If the real person behind all this killed Erina, the most likely thing is that they would've left through the storeroom so Atsuki never saw them. It's incredibly hard to believe they wouldn't have the key to unlock it.
entries.new: 我说清楚一点。有一种可能是：真凶杀了 Erina，随即逃离了这层楼。如果幕后的人杀了 Erina，最有可能的做法就是从储藏室离开，这样 Atsuki 就绝不会撞见他们。很难想象他们手里会没有开那扇门的钥匙。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: However, that didn't happen. Atsuki didn't find anyone when he ran here, and at this point, I seriously don't think the true culprit would've killed Erina and then hoped they wouldn't be found in a crystal room. ...So there's a second thing I could believe.
entries.new: 但事情并不是这样。Atsuki 跑过来时没有撞见任何人；而且到了这一步，我不认为真凶杀了 Erina 之后，还能指望自己不会在水晶展室里被人发现。……所以还有第二种可能，我愿意相信。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: That they activated the Sekimeiya and disappeared from this floor.
entries.new: 那就是他们发动了 Sekimeiya，从这层楼消失了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Sai seemed to have a point he was getting to, and so far, we were following along.
entries.new: Sai 似乎正一步步引向某个结论，而我们到目前为止都还跟得上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Oh, I can tell if that happened.
entries.new: ……啊，那个我倒是能判断。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Hm?
entries.new: 嗯？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: He made us follow him to the event room.
entries.new: 他让我们跟着他去了活动室。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The glass hasn't been opened either. It's very likely they had the key, but the Sekimeiya wasn't used.
entries.new: 玻璃也没有被打开过。他们很可能有钥匙，但 Sekimeiya 没有被使用。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: You can tell?
entries.new: 你能看出来？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Yes.
entries.new: 嗯。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: How?
entries.new: 怎么看出来的？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: ...{w}It's because of this thread that I detached from the curtain earlier.
entries.new: ……{w}是因为我之前从遮布上拆下来的这根线。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Atsuki explained what he'd done. The last time he'd closed the cabinet, he left a thin and short thread above the movable glass. That way, if anyone tried to get the Sekimeiya out, the thread would fall.
entries.new: Atsuki 解释了自己做过的事。上次他关上展示柜时，在可移动的玻璃上方留了一根细短的线。这样一来，只要有人试图取出 Sekimeiya，线就会掉落。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It's in the position it was when I locked the cabinet the last time.
entries.new: 它还停在我上次锁上展示柜时的位置。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: So you ripped me off? I guess that removes this option.
entries.new: 这么说，你是把我摆了一道？看来这个可能也排除了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: We all saw the thread and understood that Atsuki was telling the truth. The cabinet hadn't opened, and according to Sai, neither had the storeroom door.
entries.new: 我们都看到了那根线，明白 Atsuki 说的是实话。展示柜没有被打开，而按 Sai 的说法，储藏室的门也一样。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Katei, would there be a way to unlock the bathrooms from the outside if you were to lock yourself in? They have keyholes.
entries.new: Katei，如果有人把自己反锁在洗手间里，外面有办法打开吗？那些门上是有钥匙孔的。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...Yes, actually. I'm not sure if I still have it, but most employees were given a key to unlock them.
entries.new: ……其实，有的。我不确定钥匙还在不在我这儿，但大多数员工都分到过一把能打开它们的钥匙。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: ...So there's one last thing I believe the real culprit could've likely done.
entries.new: ……所以，真凶最后还有一种很可能的做法。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Locking themselves in the security room. There's no way to open it from the outside.
entries.new: 把自己锁进监控室。那扇门从外面打不开。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: O-Oh, yeah. We can't check that, though.
entries.new: 啊……对。可这一点我们查不了。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Sai ran to the door and tried to open it. ...It was still locked.
entries.new: Sai 跑到门边，试着开门。……门依旧锁着。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It's true that we can't be sure nobody's currently in the security room, but it's unlikely. They can't keep shut in there after {time=21.}
entries.new: 确实不能保证此刻监控室里没人，但可能性不大。到了{time=21.}这个点，他们不可能还把自己关在里面。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Is there something you're trying to say?
entries.new: 你是想说什么吗？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Definitely. I'm trying to say that it wasn't the actual person we've been chasing who killed Erina, but rather the person she thought it was.
entries.new: 当然。我想说的是——杀死 Erina 的，并不是我们一路追查的那个人，而是她自以为的那个人。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Are you seriously saying this!? None of us would kill Erina!
entries.new: 你这话是认真的吗！？我们之中没有人会杀 Erina！
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Atsuki specifically heard "Don't lie! It can only be you. You killed them." What I draw from that is that she thought otherwise. She thought one of us was the culprit, but there's no guarantee she was right.
entries.new: Atsuki 明明听见了那句『别骗我！只可能是你。人是你杀的。』照此看来，她认定的凶手另有其人。她以为凶手就在我们之中，可这未必就是对的。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Sai's voice sounded serious. We had learned long ago that a killer was confined with us, and the look in everyone's eyes told me that they wanted to figure out who they were before they could become victims themselves.
entries.new: Sai 的语气很沉重。我们早就知道，有个杀人凶手与我们关在一处；此刻每个人眼里都写着同一个念头——要在自己沦为下一个牺牲者之前，把他揪出来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I doubt she was wrong, given how it ended up.
entries.new: ……可看最后的结果，我不觉得她判断错了。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Why? The voice came from the staircase, right? We figured there was some sort of scuffle because of that shirt button. This means there was a fight above the staircase between Erina and who she thought was the real culprit.
entries.new: 为什么？声音是从楼梯那边传来的，对吧？因为那颗衬衫纽扣，我们推断那里发生过争执。也就是说，Erina 和她认定是真凶的那个人，在楼梯上方交了手。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: No matter who that person was, it could've easily ended with Erina falling or being thrown off the stairs. It doesn't matter if they killed anyone else beforehand.
entries.new: 不管那个人是谁，结果都很可能是 Erina 摔下楼梯，或是被推下去。对方此前有没有杀过人，与此无关。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: B-But none of us could've done it.
entries.new: 可、可是我们之中没人做得到啊。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Wrong. You could have. However, we're already believing you by thinking this way.
entries.new: 错了。你们谁都做得到。只不过，我们能这么想，就已经是在相信你们了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Right off the bat, the two main possibilities are that either the person behind every other death killed Erina or that Atsuki did. They could even be the same person. Technically, Isla could've too.
entries.new: 首先，最主要的两种可能是：要么杀害其他人的那个凶手杀了 Erina，要么是 Atsuki 下的手。这两者甚至可能是同一个人。严格说来，Isla 也不是没有可能。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: You're insane.
entries.new: 你疯了。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: It's possible she's still here, though. Frightening prospect, but we need to find her.
entries.new: 不过，她有可能还留在这栋楼里。这念头很可怕，但我们必须找到她。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Could she really be here? If she hasn't shown up, doesn't that mean...?
entries.new: 她真的会在这里吗？如果她一直没露面，那不就意味着……？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Sai looked into the first rooms in hallway A. We stared at him, nearly immobile, only twitching every time a new door was opened. He went from door to door, narrowing his vision as he peered into each new room.
entries.new: Sai 查看了 A 走廊最前面的几间房。我们几乎动弹不得，只盯着他看；每开一扇新门，我们都不由得一颤。他一间一间看过去，眯起眼往每间房里瞧。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: After opening the farthest away crystal room—A1—Isla's head peeked out. We ran there, relieved to see her safe.
entries.new: 等他打开最远端的水晶展室 A1，Isla 探出了头。我们跑过去，见她安然无恙，才松了口气。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wh-What are you doing here?
entries.new: 你、你怎么会在这儿？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Hm? We were looking at the gems, and Mom said to stay in here.
entries.new: 嗯？我们在看宝石呀，妈妈让我待在这里的。
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: What...?
entries.new: 什么……？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Yes, there's one I really like in this room.
entries.new: 对呀，这间房里有一颗我特别喜欢的。
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: We looked at each other, speechless. She didn't know what had happened.
entries.new: 我们面面相觑，说不出话。她还不知道发生了什么。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: After some uncountable stretch of silence, it became clear that none of us had the strength to say it.
entries.new: 沉默了不知多久，最后我们明白了：谁也没有力气开口说出这件事。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: So you haven't moved from here?
entries.new: 所以你就一直没离开这里？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: She nodded.
entries.new: 她点了点头。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Did you come here from the attic?
entries.new: 你们是从阁楼那边过来的？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Yeah.
entries.new: 嗯。
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: There were only quiet and devastated looks. Ignorant, Isla shrugged, slightly confused by our behavior.
entries.new: 四周只剩下沉默与颓然的目光。对此一无所知的 Isla 耸了耸肩，被我们的样子弄得有些困惑。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Do you wanna see it? It's really pretty.
entries.new: 你想看看吗？真的很漂亮哦。
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: ...We'll come see it in a bit.
entries.new: ……我们待会儿再来看。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Okay.
entries.new: 好。
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: With a smile, she walked to one of the uncovered curtains and admired a tiny, black stone displayed individually. Slowly, Sai shut the door to leave her in peace for as long as possible while she did as her mother had instructed.
entries.new: 她笑着走向一块掀开的遮布，端详起单独陈列的一颗小小的黑色石头。Sai 缓缓合上门，好让她安静地待着——在她听从母亲吩咐的这段时间里，越久越好。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We'll be back in just a minute.
entries.new: 我们马上就回来。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: We looked at hallway C, once again witnessing what Isla had no idea about. As we retreated, we heard Sai talking in a whisper.
entries.new: 我们望向了 C走廊，再一次目睹了 Isla 毫不知情的景象。退开时，我们听见 Sai 压低了声音开口。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: You heard what Isla said, right? Before dying, Erina told her to stay in that room. She knew she was gonna confront the person she believed to be the killer, and she didn't want Isla to see it or interfere.{w} So now tell us, Atsuki: why did you say that none of us could've done it?
entries.new: 你们都听见 Isla 的话了吧？Erina 临死前让她待在那间房里。她知道要去质问那个自己认定的凶手，也不想让 Isla 看见，或者插手。{w}那么，Atsuki，你来说说：你为什么说我们之中没人做得到？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Because I left the attic first. I walked down, but I... couldn't really bring myself to go to the crystal floor. That's why I stayed in the first partition of the second floor, thinking to myself...{w} From there, I would've seen anyone moving through floor 2.
entries.new: 因为我最先离开阁楼。我往下走，可是……实在没勇气去水晶层。所以我留在二楼最前面那一段，心里想着……{w}从那里，二楼有谁走动我都能看见。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: But you didn't see Erina.
entries.new: 可你没看见 Erina。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Like you said earlier, Erina and Isla had to use the elevator to get here.
entries.new: 就像你刚才说的，Erina 和 Isla 只能坐电梯上来。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: That's right. I heard the elevator once.
entries.new: 没错。我听到过一次电梯的动静。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: I did too.
entries.new: 我也听到了。
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: Yes, me too.
entries.new: 嗯，我也是。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Katei and I were the ones who brought it to the attic, and afterward, we left through the main door. This means it's very likely the elevator was moving down and arrived on the crystal floor.
entries.new: 把电梯开到阁楼的是我和 Katei，之后我们是从正门离开的。也就是说，电梯很可能是往下走，停在了水晶层。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Sai approached the elevator and opened it successfully. ...It had been left on the crystal floor.
entries.new: Sai 走到电梯前，顺利打开了门。……电梯果然停在水晶层。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: In addition, the panels haven't been attached yet, so there was no way to call it from here. The floor 1 button was pressed from the attic.{w} Which leaves the following way possible: someone took the elevator with Erina and Isla. That's how the killer could've gotten to the crystal floor without being seen. Did anyone see both of them taking the elevator?
entries.new: 另外，操作面板还没装上，没法从这里呼叫电梯。一楼按钮是在阁楼按下的。{w}于是只剩下一种可能：有人和 Erina、Isla 一同乘了电梯。凶手就是这样避开众人视线，来到了水晶层。有谁亲眼看到她们两个上电梯吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Every head shook.
entries.new: 所有人都摇了摇头。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We could ask Isla, but even if she says that no one else was with them, we can't blindly believe that. They could have threatened her.
entries.new: 可以去问 Isla，但就算她说没有别人同行，我们也不能全信。对方完全可能威胁过她。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What did everyone do, exactly?
entries.new: 各位具体都做了些什么？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Atsuki began.
entries.new: Atsuki 开口了。
entries.speaker: i
an
c2sn

entries.text: {w=0.4}"So, you're already unable to prove you didn't take the elevator with Erina and Isla. Did anyone see you leaving through the main door?"
entries.new: {w=0.4}「也就是说，你没法证明自己没有和 Erina、Isla 一起乘电梯了。有人看见你从正门出去吗？」
entries.speaker: sain

entries.text: Nobody answered.
entries.new: 没有人回答。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: {w=0.4}"Can you prove you didn't go down with them?"
entries.new: {w=0.4}「你能证明自己没有和她们一起下去吗？」
entries.speaker: sain

entries.text: {w=0.4}"No, but Atsuki saw me on the third floor immediately after he saw Erina."
entries.new: {w=0.4}「不能。但 Atsuki 一看见 Erina 的尸体，紧接着就在三楼看见了我。」
entries.speaker: c2sn
sain

entries.text: {w=0.4}"That doesn't matter. I can confirm that she didn't take the elevator."
entries.new: {w=0.4}「那不重要。我可以确认，她没有乘电梯。」
entries.speaker: kn

entries.text: {w=0.4}"You can, Katei?"
entries.new: {w=0.4}「Katei，你能确认？」
entries.speaker: sain

entries.text:
{w=0.4}"Yes. That's because when I left the attic, only Erina, Isla, and Akaro remained. Everyone else had already left."{w}

"I looked everywhere to see who had left, and I also opened the elevator in the attic, as I thought of using it. However, I ended up walking out through the main door. Only Akaro could've taken the elevator with Erina and Isla."
entries.new:
{w=0.4}「能。因为我离开阁楼时，留在里面的只剩 Erina、Isla 和 Akaro，其他人都已经走了。」{w}

「我把各处看了一遍，确认谁已经离开，还因为考虑过乘电梯而打开了阁楼的电梯。可最后我还是从正门走了出去。能和 Erina、Isla 一起乘电梯的，只可能是 Akaro。」
entries.speaker: kn

entries.text: {w=0.4}"I see. Well then, what did you do? I recall we found you on the fifth floor."
entries.new: {w=0.4}「原来如此。那么你做了什么？我记得我们是在五楼找到你的。」
entries.speaker: sain
kn
sain

entries.text: {w=0.4}"I'm glad we settled this quickly. This also confirms that Sai is telling the truth. Everything that he said is correct, which means that he was on the fourth floor the whole time."
entries.new: {w=0.4}「这么快就说清楚了，很好。这也证实了 Sai 说的是实话。他说的每一点都对得上，也就是说，他一直都在四楼。」
entries.speaker: kn

entries.text: {w=0.4}"Akaro, it's you left, and you understand your position, right?"
entries.new: {w=0.4}「Akaro，剩下的人就是你了，你也明白自己的处境吧？」
entries.speaker: sain

entries.text:
{w=0.4}"Yes, but I don't have much to say. I left the attic when Erina and Isla were still sitting on the sofa. I'm pretty sure Katei is right and they were the two people remaining in the attic."{w}

"I knew most people had left, but the sixth floor was completely desolate. I also had quite a few things to think about, so I eventually sat where you found me and spent the whole time there. I actually didn't hear the elevator, but I was pretty far from it and not paying much attention."
entries.new:
{w=0.4}「明白，不过我也没什么好说的。我离开阁楼时，Erina 和 Isla 还坐在沙发上。我想 Katei 说得没错，留在阁楼里的就是她们两个。」{w}

「我知道大多数人都走了，六楼又空荡荡的。我也有不少事要想，最后就坐在你们找到我的地方，一直待到你们来。其实我没听见电梯的声音，不过我离得远，也没怎么留意。」
entries.speaker: akn

entries.text: {w=0.4}"I have a question. Why didn't I hear your footsteps if I was directly below you?"
entries.new: {w=0.4}「我有个问题。我就在你正下方，为什么没听见你的脚步声？」
entries.speaker: kn

entries.text: {w=0.4}"That I can answer. Haven't you noticed? Akaro doesn't make much sound when he walks."
entries.new: {w=0.4}「这个我能回答。你没注意到吗？Akaro 走路几乎没什么声音。」
entries.speaker: sain

entries.text: That threw all of us off, but we confirmed it. Akaro walked around in front of us, and his footsteps were very quiet.
entries.new: 这话让我们都愣了一下，不过我们随即确认了。Akaro 在我们面前走了一圈，脚步声确实很轻。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text:
{w=0.4}"I know what you're all thinking—I could've gone to the crystal floor with Erina and Isla. Of course, Isla could verify that didn't happen, but even if I'd managed to make it to the crystal floor, I couldn't have been found on the sixth."{w}

"According to Sai, Katei spent the last few minutes outside the offices, one floor below me. So if I'd killed Erina, I needed to either use the elevator or walk up to reach the sixth floor. Doing that without being found or heard would've been impossible."
entries.new:
{w=0.4}「我知道你们在想什么——我可能和 Erina、Isla 一起去了水晶层。当然，Isla 可以证明没这回事；可就算我真到了水晶层，也不可能在六楼被发现。」{w}

「按 Sai 的说法，最后几分钟 Katei 一直在办公室外，就在我下面一层。那么，如果是我杀了 Erina，我要么坐电梯，要么走楼梯上六楼。无论哪种，都不可能不被人看见或听见。」
entries.speaker: akn

entries.text:
{w=0.4}"Is that it, then? Was Atsuki right? None of us could've done it?"{w}

"I'm not sure I can think of a way out that doesn't involve the Sekimeiya. We'll get there, though."
entries.new:
{w=0.4}「那就是这样了？Atsuki 说对了？我们当中谁都做不到？」{w}

「不借助 Sekimeiya 的话，我一时想不出别的解释。不过总会弄明白的。」
entries.speaker: sain

entries.text: {w=0.4}"I can think of one, I suppose."
entries.new: {w=0.4}「我倒想得出一个。」
entries.speaker: c2sn

entries.text: Everyone looked at me, but I only had a random, unlikely-sounding thought to let out.
entries.new: 所有人都看向我，但我只有一个突然冒出来、听上去也不太可能的念头。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: {w=0.4}"I'm just saying that Sai and Katei could technically have done it, right? Their versions of events are just covering each other."
entries.new: {w=0.4}「我只是说，从道理上讲，Sai 和 Katei 也有可能是凶手，不是吗？他们各自的说法不过是互相打掩护。」
entries.speaker: c2sn

entries.text: {w=0.4}"That's not true. Did you not hear what Akaro said? He said that when he left the attic, Erina and Isla were the only two people left. That means that Katei and I couldn't have gone to the crystal floor."
entries.new: {w=0.4}「不对。你没听见 Akaro 说的吗？他离开阁楼时，里面只剩 Erina 和 Isla 两个人。也就是说，Katei 和我根本不可能去水晶层。」
entries.speaker: sain

entries.text:
{w=0.4}"You could have. Erina and Isla used the elevator alone, from the attic. However, they got off on floor 4 or 5, where you two were. That way, you could've gotten to the crystal floor with a single elevator trip."{w}

"I don't mean to say I believe it to be the case, but I'm answering what you asked. Then, you could've taken the elevator back up while Atsuki and I were on the crystal floor, which we wouldn't have heard."
entries.new:
{w=0.4}「有可能。Erina 和 Isla 从阁楼单独乘了电梯，但她们在四楼或五楼——也就是你们两人所在的地方——下了电梯。这样，你们乘一趟电梯就能到水晶层。」{w}

「我不是说我相信事情就是这样，只是在回答你的问题。然后，趁 Atsuki 和我在水晶层的时候，你们可以再乘电梯上去，我们不会听见。」
entries.speaker: c2sn

entries.text: {w=0.4}"I see. So then you could have also done this."
entries.new: {w=0.4}「原来如此。那么你也可能用同样的手法。」
entries.speaker: sain

entries.text: {w=0.4}"Yes, which is why we should ask Isla. Once we rule that out, it seems like all of us have some sort of alibi."
entries.new: {w=0.4}「对，所以该去问 Isla。排除这种可能之后，我们每个人似乎都有不在场证明了。」
entries.speaker: c2sn

entries.text: Then, the final method.{w} Using the Sekimeiya in the future.
entries.new: 那么，就剩最后一种手法了。{w}在未来使用 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Atsuki confirmed it wasn't touched up until now, but someone can use it later on. They could invalidate everything we've thought of by just appearing in the crystal room from the future. However, I believe we can figure out whether that's the answer.
entries.new: Atsuki 已经确认，它直到现在都没被人碰过，但之后总有人可以用它。只要有人从未来出现在水晶展室，我们之前所有的推论就都白费了。不过，我想我们能查明答案是不是这个。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Sai walked to the room where Isla was, so we followed him.
entries.new: Sai 走向 Isla 所在的房间，我们便跟了上去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: With what we'd talked about, could Erina's killer be identified? I didn't think so, but there was a chance I was failing to consider something.
entries.new: 凭我们刚才说的这些，能找出杀害 Erina 的凶手吗？我觉得不能，但也许有什么是我没想到的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...How are you doing?
entries.new: ……你还好吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Hm? I'm fine.
entries.new: 嗯？我很好。
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: That's good. I have a question.{w} When you came from the attic, you used the elevator, right? Were you and Erina alone?
entries.new: 那就好。我有个问题。{w}你们从阁楼下来时乘的是电梯，对吧？当时只有你和 Erina 两个人吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Yes.
entries.new: 是的。
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: We were. Why do you ask?
entries.new: 只有我们两个。怎么了？
