entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: E-Erina...! What are you doing here!?
entries.new: E、Erina……！你怎么会在这里！？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: What am I doing...?
entries.new: 我在这里做什么……？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: She was there, casually leaning against the line of cabinets. I could hardly believe what I was seeing, but there was no wariness in her eyes and not even a trace of blood near her.
entries.new: 她就在那里，随意地靠在一排展示柜上。我几乎不敢相信自己的眼睛，可她眼里没有一丝警惕，她附近也看不到半点血迹。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What's with those looks?
entries.new: 你们那是什么眼神？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Do you not know what happened?
entries.new: 你不知道发生了什么吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: No? What?
entries.new: 不知道？出什么事了？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Sai responded only by peering at Isla's curious face, which communicated to Erina that it was something her daughter couldn't hear. She stood up and came over to us, clearly oblivious.
entries.new: Sai 没有回答，只是看了看 Isla 那张写满好奇的脸。Erina 立刻领会到，这话不能让她的女儿听见。她站起身走到我们这边，显然还蒙在鼓里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wait here, sweetie.
entries.new: 在这儿等一下，宝贝。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Okay.
entries.new: 好。
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: E-Erina... What happened since you two left the attic?
entries.new: E、Erina……你们俩离开阁楼以后，出了什么事？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: What does that mean? People were leaving, and Isla said she wanted to come down too since she still hadn't seen all the gems. I noticed she was trying to cheer herself up a little despite the... two bodies we found, so even though I didn't want to leave, I went with her just so that it took her mind off it.
entries.new: 这话是什么意思？当时大家都要走，Isla 说她也想下楼，因为她还没有把所有的宝石都看完。我看出她是在强打精神——毕竟我们发现了那两具……尸体——所以哪怕我自己并不想离开，也还是陪她一起去了，好让她分分心。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: And you took the elevator?
entries.new: 然后你们坐了电梯？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Yes, she wanted to. There was still a little bit of blood inside, but she insisted.
entries.new: 嗯，是她想坐。电梯里还残留着一些血迹，可她坚持要坐。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: A-Are you going to tell me something?
entries.new: 你、你们是不是有什么话要跟我说？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: She'd noticed we all looked like we were staring at a ghost, and she began to look seriously unsettled herself.
entries.new: 她察觉到我们一个个都像见了鬼似的盯着她，自己也开始明显不安起来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: And you simply stayed in this room?
entries.new: 你们就一直待在这个房间里？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: There's potentially still a murderer around, and I especially didn't want to move around this floor or go to the lobby. I noticed Isla was focused on one of these gems, so I told her we'd stay here. I wasn't going to leave her alone unless we guaranteed we were safe.
entries.new: 凶手可能还在附近，我尤其不想在这一层走动，更不想去大厅。我看 Isla 正专心盯着这些宝石中的一颗，就告诉她我们留在这里。除非能保证安全，否则我不会把她一个人丢下。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: So just earlier, when we talked to Isla, you were here?
entries.new: 那么刚才我们跟 Isla 说话的时候，你就在这里？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What? Yes, behind the door. I didn't know if you needed something, but of course I was inside.
entries.new: 什么？对啊，就在门后。我不知道你们是不是有事，但我当然在屋里。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Finally, Erina noticed where our lines of sight went and turned around.
entries.new: Erina 终于察觉我们在看什么，转过了身。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There was no pause before the gasp came.
entries.new: 她连半点停顿都没有，就倒吸了一口凉气。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Ah...! That's...!
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: What's wrong...?
entries.new: 怎么了……？
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: N-Nothing, please, stay there...
entries.new: 没、没什么，求你待在那儿别动……
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: She approached the face-down body and recognized that it was no misinterpretation. Her clothes were the ones stained by blood, and the body was her own.
entries.new: 她走近那具俯卧的尸体，确认自己没有看错。沾满血迹的正是她的衣服，而那具尸体就是她自己。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Oh my God. This is... me? H-How can... There's no way!
entries.new: 天哪。这是……我？怎、怎么会……不可能！
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: She broke down instantly. Before her was proof that she could soon die. Even though it had already happened, the Sekimeiya's existence allowed it to be a future event. Of course, that made everything even more strange. Would she travel to the past after coming up with a conclusion on who the killer was?
entries.new: 她当场就崩溃了。眼前的东西就是她可能很快就会死去的证明。事情明明已经发生，可由于 Sekimeiya 的存在，它也能成为未来的事件。当然，这让一切变得更加诡异。她会不会在推断出谁是凶手之后，穿越到过去？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: W-We know it happened a few minutes ago, but we have no idea what actually happened. We thought you'd left Isla in that room.
entries.new: 我、我们知道那是几分钟前发生的，却完全不知道究竟出了什么事。我们还以为你把 Isla 留在那个房间里了。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: She can't see this...!
entries.new: 不能让她看到这个……！
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Erina ran back and tightly gripped the doorknob.
entries.new: Erina 跑回去，死死握住门把手。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Should we bring her... you... that body to the lobby?
entries.new: 要不要把她……把你……把那具尸体搬到大厅去？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: No, we'll have to go there eventually...! So much blood can't be removed either...
entries.new: 不，我们早晚都得去那儿……！而且那么多血也清不掉……
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Isla, I'm sorry, but we need to go back to the attic.
entries.new: Isla，对不起，我们得回阁楼去。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Why? I want to stay here.
entries.new: 为什么？我想待在这里。
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: Please, do me a favor and come with us.
entries.new: 求你了，就当帮我个忙，跟我们走吧。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: We perceived a tiny nod. Relieved, Erina crouched to pick her up and brought her to the staircase, covering her face on the way.
entries.new: 我们看见她轻轻点了点头。Erina 松了口气，蹲下身把她抱了起来，一路遮着她的脸，带她走向楼梯。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'm not tired, and we can just take the elevator.
entries.new: 我又不累，而且我们坐电梯就行了。
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: I thought you preferred being picked up. You can walk if you want.
entries.new: 我还以为你喜欢被人抱着。想自己走也可以。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Hm... No.
entries.new: 嗯……不要。
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: There we go.
entries.new: 这样才对嘛。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: It seemed the surrealism wouldn't end any time soon. Everyone was glad to see Erina safe, but sheer bewilderment was even more dominant.
entries.new: 看来这份荒诞一时半会儿还不会收场。看到 Erina 平安无事，大家都松了口气，但压倒一切的反倒是满腹困惑。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Even Atsuki, who I'd assumed would be out of it for the rest of our imprisonment, had proven otherwise. However, it made sense. After all, whatever his plan entailed was still bound to happen. That was unquestionable.
entries.new: 我原以为 Atsuki 在接下来的囚禁日子里都会魂不守舍，可事实并非如此。不过这也说得通。毕竟，无论他的计划是什么，都注定会发生。这一点毋庸置疑。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Once Erina and Isla disappeared from view, Sai opened the elevator.
entries.new: Erina 和 Isla 的身影一消失，Sai 就打开了电梯。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We should send the elevator to the attic. That'll be of use.
entries.new: 我们该把电梯送到阁楼去。那样会派上用场。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Oh, sure.
entries.new: 哦，好啊。
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: I unlocked the floor 7 button with the key and pressed it before stepping out. After that, we walked all the way up.
entries.new: 我用钥匙解开了七楼按钮的锁，按下之后才走出电梯。随后，我们一路步行上楼。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: On the way, I had to stop to drink from a sink in one of the bathrooms. It wasn't exactly high quality water, but it somewhat satisfied my thirst, and after some of the others did the same, we arrived at the attic's door.
entries.new: 半路上，我不得不停下来，在某个洗手间的水龙头下喝了点水。水质算不上好，但多少解了渴。其他几个人也照做之后，我们才来到阁楼门前。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Eruption
entries.new: 爆发

entries.text: I thought you took the elevator.
entries.new: 我以为你们是坐电梯上来的。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: We sent it up empty.
entries.new: 我们让电梯空着上去了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: We saw Isla in the living room. Before Erina could join her, Sai grabbed her sleeve.
entries.new: 我们看见 Isla 在客厅里。Erina 还没来得及走过去，Sai 就抓住了她的袖子。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: This is a very important question.{w} Who do you think the killer is?
entries.new: 这个问题非常重要。{w}你认为凶手是谁？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: The killer? ...I have no idea.
entries.new: 凶手？……我完全没有头绪。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: I don't only mean the person behind whatever happened just now. I mean in general, ever since this morning.
entries.new: 我说的不只是刚才那件事的幕后之人。我是说，从今天早上开始，所有的事都不对劲。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I know, and that's what I answered.
entries.new: 我知道，我也是这么回答的。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: According to Atsuki, he heard you accusing someone of being the killer. Once he ran to the crystal floor, he saw your body.
entries.new: 据 Atsuki 说，他听见你在指责某个人就是凶手。等他跑到水晶层，看到的就是你的尸体。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Wh-What...? I don't know...! I don't have a clue who the killer could be! I don't know anything about this. Just... let me be with my daughter, please.
entries.new: 什、什么……？我不知道……！我根本不知道凶手会是谁！这件事我一点都不清楚。求你们……让我和我女儿待在一起吧。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: She entered the room and followed Isla to the hallway.
entries.new: 她走进房间，跟着 Isla 去了走廊。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Then maybe she actually saw the real culprit. Since it wasn't anyone she'd seen before, that was all she needed to know that it was them.
entries.new: 那她说不定真的看见了真凶。因为对方不是她见过的任何一个人，光凭这一点，她就能认定那是凶手。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: You could be right. The Erina who died... she could've only come from the future.
entries.new: 你说得也许没错。死去的那个 Erina……她只可能是从未来来的。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: So she had a better idea of who to suspect than she does right now?
entries.new: 也就是说，她当时比现在更清楚该怀疑谁？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Yes, that's what I mean. I have no clue how this would work, though, or why she'd travel to the past. I suppose that tells us the Sekimeiya is bound to be used again in the future.{w} Technically, all Erina needs to do to be safe is not travel to the past. But she has to... or else what happened makes no sense.
entries.new: 对，我就是这个意思。不过我想不通这到底是怎么做到的，也想不通她为什么要穿越到过去。我想，这至少说明未来一定还会有人使用 Sekimeiya。{w} 严格来说，Erina 只要不穿越到过去就能平安无事。可她非去不可……否则已经发生的事就说不通了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Don't you find something strange? How come Erina didn't hear her own words if she was in hallway A? Isla should have too, right? Didn't you say that she yelled?
entries.new: 你不觉得奇怪吗？如果 Erina 当时在 A走廊，怎么会没听见自己的声音？Isla 也本该听见的吧？你不是说她大喊了吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Yes. Are you suspecting me again?
entries.new: 没错。你又在怀疑我了？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Oh, no, actually. I meant to suspect Erina herself since she's another person who could've technically done this. Wouldn't that be just nuts? Suicide via murdering yourself.{w} Before you ask, I don't believe that happened, no, but it's a little strange.
entries.new: 啊，不，其实不是。我是想说，Erina 本人也有嫌疑，毕竟严格来讲，她也是能做到这件事的人之一。那岂不是太荒唐了？自己杀自己，这也能算自杀吗。{w} 先别问，我也不信真有这种事，不过确实有点奇怪。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: It's not. The noise came from high in the staircase, so it had to go down and maybe through the door to reach where Erina and Isla were. Given there's less echo on the crystal floor, it makes sense they heard nothing.
entries.new: 不奇怪。声音是从楼梯高处传来的，要传到 Erina 和 Isla 那里，得往下走，说不定还得穿过那道门。水晶层回音本来就小，她们什么都没听见也说得通。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: That could be it.{w} Isla nodded when I asked her "So you haven't moved from here?"{w} She probably thought "you" meant her and Erina, so by answering yes, she meant neither of them left the room.
entries.new: 有可能就是这样。{w} 我问她「你没离开过这里吧？」的时候，她点了点头。{w} 她大概把这句话里的「你」当成了她和 Erina 两个人，所以点头的意思是她们谁都没离开房间。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: You're insistent about this.
entries.new: 你倒是咬住这一点不放。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: *sigh*
entries.new: *叹气*
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: He sat on one of the steps.
entries.new: 他在一级台阶上坐了下来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wondering whether he had something else to add evolved into a few minutes of silence.
entries.new: 我正琢磨他是不是还有别的话要说，几分钟就这么沉默着过去了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I just have no idea what's happening here. Atsuki can keep denying it, but he's behind some of it, if not all.
entries.new: 我只是完全搞不懂这里到底在发生什么。Atsuki 尽可以继续否认，但就算不是全部，其中也有几分是他搞的鬼。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...Why do you think so?
entries.new: ……你为什么会这么想？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: You've been hiding something since right after we got trapped, and the girl who appeared in the elevator has to be related to you. Do you still deny that?
entries.new: 我们刚被困住不久，你就一直有事瞒着。电梯里出现的那个女孩也一定和你有关。你还要否认吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...No, I don't. I'm aware it has to be my doing, but I haven't done anything. I don't know what I would do either, and the Sekimeiya doesn't work. I promise I'm much more confused than you are.
entries.new: ……不，我不否认。我也明白那一定是我做的，可我什么都没做。我连自己会做什么都不知道，而且 Sekimeiya 根本用不了。我保证，我比你还要困惑得多。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: ...{w}I don't think you did anything to Erina, and so far the four deaths could have a motive in common. The policeman could've entered through the storeroom, and then he was killed because he was a direct threat.
entries.new: ……{w}我觉得 Erina 的事不是你做的。而且到目前为止，四起死亡可能出于同一个动机。那个警察也许是从储藏室进来的，随后因为构成直接威胁而被杀。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: The two in the elevator could have the very same motive: they were seen as threats. Both of them could've gone through the storeroom door as well since they weren't found until much later.{w} Finally, Erina might've confronted the killer. It could be that the four dead people were all seen as threats by the same person.
entries.new: 电梯里那两个人也可能是出于同一个动机：他们被视为威胁。而且他们俩也可能是从储藏室的门进出的，毕竟过了很久才发现。{w} 最后，Erina 也许是当面撞上了凶手。或许这四名死者，全都是被同一个人视为威胁的人。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: This stupid storeroom door is what pisses me off the most. Are people really entering and leaving the tower without being seen? That's nonsense, right? But it's a fact that it was opened.
entries.new: 最让我火大的就是这扇该死的储藏室门。真有人能进出这座塔还不被发现？这根本说不通吧？可它确实被打开过，这是事实。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Remember what I said. There's no way it leads outside.
entries.new: 记住我说过的。那扇门绝不可能通向外面。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: There's no way it doesn't. In fact, it's still incredibly likely you went through it.
entries.new: 它不可能不通向外面。事实上，你从那扇门过去的可能性依然非常大。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...I didn't! I never knew about it!
entries.new: ……我没有！我从来不知道有那扇门！
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Katei, if the culprit is just one of us, it's you. You disappeared for almost three hours and appeared right before the policeman did. Before the elevator opened on the sixth floor, I had already tried to open it, and it was you who stayed in the attic last. You could've moved the elevator from the attic to the sixth floor, and you could've also locked the attic from the inside.
entries.new: Katei，如果凶手就在我们之中，那只能是你。你消失了将近三个小时，又恰好在警察出现之前现身。六楼电梯门打开之前，我已经试过打开它了，而最后待在阁楼的人是你。你完全可以把电梯从阁楼移到六楼，也完全可以从里面把阁楼锁上。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I did none of that...!
entries.new: 我一样都没做过……！
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: What happened with Erina is what gives you the most benefit of the doubt. Right now, the people who could've killed Erina are Atsuki, Erina, Isla, the real culprit if they're none of us, and anyone who traveled from the future to the crystal floor.
entries.new: 偏偏是 Erina 这桩事，最能替你洗脱嫌疑。照现在来看，可能杀死 Erina 的人有 Atsuki、Erina、Isla，如果真凶不在我们之中，那就是真凶本人，还有任何从未来穿越到水晶层的人。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: If we rule out those last two options, our choices will diminish greatly, and it's possible we can, like I said earlier.{w} If someone traveled from the future and killed Erina, either they're still here or they left through the storeroom. Basically, if we can't find anyone and I confirm that the storeroom door didn't open, we can remove those possibilities.
entries.new: 如果排除最后两种可能，范围就会大大缩小，而且就像我刚才说的，我们也许真能做到。{w} 如果有人从未来穿越过来杀死 Erina，那这个人要么还在这里，要么已经从储藏室离开了。总之，如果我们找不到任何人，而我又能确认储藏室的门没有开过，这些可能就可以排除。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: That could be bypassed with the Sekimeiya by using it to travel to a place that's just been examined or outside the tower. However, Atsuki can confirm whether the cabinet was opened. I believe we have the circumstances here to accomplish a definitive search. Specifically, one where time travel isn't going to fuck us.
entries.new: 用 Sekimeiya 可以绕过这种排查：直接传送到刚检查过的地方，或者塔外。不过展示柜有没有被打开过，Atsuki 能确认。我认为这里具备条件，可以做一次彻底的搜查。确切地说，是一次不会被时间穿越搅乱的搜查。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: So you're saying that if we don't find anyone, Atsuki is our man?
entries.new: 你是说，如果找不到人，那凶手就是 Atsuki？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: He, Erina, and Isla would become the only three people who could've done it. This is the conclusion all of us reached.
entries.new: 那样的话，能做出这件事的就只剩他、Erina 和 Isla 三个人。这是我们所有人共同得出的结论。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Let's do it, then.
entries.new: 那就开始吧。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Yes. I think your logic is right, but Atsuki can't be responsible.
entries.new: 好。我认为你的推理没错，但 Atsuki 不可能是凶手。
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: ...Okay. If we do it well, no matter what the result is, it will strongly indicate something.
entries.new: ……好吧。只要我们做得好，无论结果如何，都能有力地说明一些问题。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: We walked up to the living room. Through the hallway door, we saw Erina and Isla getting closer.
entries.new: 我们走到起居室。透过走廊的门，能看见 Erina 和 Isla 越走越近。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What's that...?
entries.new: 那是什么……？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Look what I found.
entries.new: 看看我找到了什么。
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: With two hands, Isla was holding one of the bed sheets, folded up into a sphere. It was wrapped around something, and I could tell what Isla was going to say before she did.
entries.new: Isla 双手捧着一条床单，团成了一个球。里面裹着什么东西，而她还没开口，我就已经猜到她要说什么了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It's the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 是 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: What? The Sekimeiya's on the crystal floor.
entries.new: 什么？Sekimeiya 明明在水晶层。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: No, I have it here. It was in the, um... wardrobe.{w} I knew I wasn't allowed to touch it, so I had to cover it with this.
entries.new: 不对，它就在我这儿。它原本在，那个……衣柜里。{w} 我知道我不能碰它，所以只好用这个把它裹起来。
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: Great. How did this thing even get up here?
entries.new: 好啊。这东西到底是怎么跑到楼上来的？
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: Is that so? Let us see.
entries.new: 是吗？我们看看。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: No... We need to put it in the cabinet, right?
entries.new: 不行……得把它放回展示柜里，对吧？
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: ...Yes.
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: ...Is she telling the truth?
entries.new: ……她说的是实话吗？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: I don't know. She opened the wardrobe and grabbed the top bed sheet. When I stood up to see what she was doing, I couldn't see what she had.
entries.new: 不知道。她打开衣柜，抽出最上面那条床单。我起身想看她在做什么，却看不清她手里拿着什么。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: There's no way it was brought here since we saw it in the cabinet, right? It could only have happened when we were talking to Isla, if there was a time where neither the staircase nor the elevator were being observed.
entries.new: 既然我们是在展示柜里看到它的，那它不可能在那之后被带到这里来，对吧？唯一可能就是我们和 Isla 说话的时候——只要那段时间楼梯和电梯都没人盯着。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: It really may be teleporting. If the cabinet is empty and the thread is still there, it must have teleported out.
entries.new: 它或许真的是靠传送移动的。既然展示柜空了、线还留在那里，那它一定是传送出去了。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: I see, you're right.{w} Let's do what we were talking about on the way down. If we have the Sekimeiya while we search every floor, there's no way it'll be used to bypass us.
entries.new: 原来如此，你说得对。{w}就按我们下楼时说的办。只要 Sekimeiya 在我们手上，逐层搜索过去，就不可能有人用它绕过我们。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: But shouldn't we hurry up...?
entries.new: 可是，我们不是该快点吗……？
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: She's right.
entries.new: 她说得对。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: You know how important it is that we do this properly. We'll be fast.
entries.new: 你也知道，把这件事做稳妥有多重要。我们会尽快。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Isla, we'll stay here while they go down.
entries.new: Isla，他们下去的时候，我们留在这里。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: What? No. I'll keep the Sekimeiya safe.
entries.new: 什么？不行。Sekimeiya 由我来保护。
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: She tightened her arms around the ball, and Erina shut her eyes. On the way to the event room was the dead body Isla couldn't see.
entries.new: 她把怀里的球抱得更紧，Erina 闭上了眼。通往活动室的路上，躺着 Isla 看不见的那具尸体。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: You should do as your mother says. You can trust us to take good care of it.
entries.new: 听你妈妈的话。交给我们，你尽可放心，我们会好好保管。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: I can do it better, and it's dangerous to be alone. That's what you said earlier.
entries.new: 我能做得更好。而且一个人待着很危险——这是你刚才说的。
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: It's fine, we'll go. After that, Isla, we're coming back up, okay?
entries.new: 算了，我们下去。Isla，之后我们会再上来，好吗？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Yeah!
entries.new: 嗯！
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: Isla looked genuinely happy to escort the Sekimeiya all the way down, but there was no chance Erina would let her finish the trip.
entries.new: Isla 看上去是真心高兴能一路护送 Sekimeiya 下去，但 Erina 绝不会让她走完全程。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The elevator is here, and we can hear it if it's used. The intent is to make this perfect, and that won't be an issue either as long as we confirm it's empty before moving on.
entries.new: 电梯就停在这儿，有人用我们也能听见。我们要的是做到万无一失，只要离开前确认里面没人，这一点也不成问题。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: We began to put that plan into effect. If one of us was the real culprit, they could purposely leave something, or someone, undiscovered. That was why all of us looked everywhere there was to look—so that everyone could agree with the result in the end.
entries.new: 我们开始执行这个方案。如果凶手就在我们之中，他大可以故意漏掉某样东西、某个人。正因如此，所有能查的地方都由我们所有人一起查过——这样到最后，每个人都能认可这个结果。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Since Isla had claimed she'd found the Sekimeiya in one of the wardrobes, it was possible something had gone unseen for a while. We didn't only look for people, but for anything.
entries.new: 既然 Isla 说她是在某个衣柜里找到 Sekimeiya 的，那就说明有些东西可能很久都没被人注意到。我们要找的不只是人，也包括任何东西。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Every floor had a place where someone could wait to prevent anyone else from passing. Erina and Isla took that job to make the search valid.
entries.new: 每一层都有可以让人守住的关口，拦住其他人通过。为了让这次搜索站得住脚，Erina 和 Isla 负责把守。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Doing all of it took a while, but on floor 3, the search hadn't gone any differently from the others; we still had zero results.
entries.new: 整套流程花了不少时间，但三楼的搜索和其余几层并无不同，仍然一无所获。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We were in front of the floor 2 offices, ready to move on to the last floor. We expected to be stopped on the way to the staircase, as Isla couldn't be allowed to walk down.
entries.new: 我们来到二楼办公室前，准备前往最后一层。我们本以为会在去楼梯的途中被拦下，毕竟不能让 Isla 往下走。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: And yet our expectations were betrayed.
entries.new: 然而，我们的预想落空了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Look at the elevator...!
entries.new: 快看电梯……！
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Next to the elevator, the metallic panel holding the button was properly attached.
entries.new: 电梯旁，镶着按钮的那块金属面板已经完好地装了回去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Oh, what the fuck...? Weren't all the buttons inside it when we sent it up?
entries.new: 搞什么……？我们把电梯送上去的时候，按钮不是全都在里面吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...I don't know. Maybe one had been taken out.
entries.new: ……我不知道。也许有一个被取出来了。
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: It doesn't matter. Do not press it.{w} Someone is guaranteed to have been on the crystal floor, and their only way out is the storeroom. Just in case, we shouldn't bring the elevator here.
entries.new: 无所谓。别按。{w}水晶层上肯定有人，而他们唯一的出口就是储藏室。为防万一，不能把电梯叫过来。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Isla, give Akaro the Sekimeiya. It's too dangerous to go down.
entries.new: Isla，把 Sekimeiya 交给 Akaro。下去太危险了。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: H-Huh...? No.
entries.new: 哎、什么……？不行。
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: Sai was the first to walk down while Atsuki looked at both bathrooms. Meanwhile, Isla kept tightening her arms, reluctant to let go of the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: Sai 率先走了下去，我则查看了两个洗手间。与此同时，Isla 把怀里的东西抱得更紧，舍不得放开 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Isla, this is important. You can't go down there.
entries.new: Isla，这很重要。你不能下去。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: ...It's just to the event room.
entries.new: ……只是去活动室而已。
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: Erina, it's fine. You can both come.
entries.new: Erina，没关系。你们两个都来吧。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Wh-What...? Not a chance.
entries.new: 什、什么……？绝对不行。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Look, just get down here. Don't argue.
entries.new: 听我的，先下来。别争了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I looked through the door and understood what Sai meant. There was no blood. Not only that, I proceeded down, and there was no body anywhere.
entries.new: 我透过门看过去，明白了 Sai 的意思。没有血。不止如此，我继续往下走，哪儿都找不到尸体。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Oh my God, this is ridiculous.
entries.new: 天啊，这简直荒唐。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Was it all removed?
entries.new: 全都被清理掉了？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: What, with a mop? Wouldn't stains be visible?
entries.new: 什么，用拖把拖的？那也该留下痕迹吧？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: The elevator button has been reattached here too.
entries.new: 这里的电梯按钮也重新装上了。
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: I'll just go to the event room.
entries.new: 我去活动室就是了。
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: Wait...!
entries.new: 等等……！
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Erina dashed ahead of her and opened the door herself.{w} It didn't seem like there was anything inside.
entries.new: Erina 抢在她前面冲了过去，亲手推开门。{w}里面似乎什么也没有。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Whatever, put it in. Nobody can leave this floor without being seen, at least.
entries.new: 算了，放进去吧。至少没人能在不被看见的情况下离开这一层。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Okay.
entries.new: 好。
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: Wait, it's still here.
entries.new: 等等，它还在。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Huh... Really?
entries.new: 咦……真的？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Atsuki had uncovered the cabinet, and the truth was plain to see: the Sekimeiya was still on its cushion.
entries.new: 我揭开展示柜的遮盖，真相一目了然：Sekimeiya 仍好好地放在垫子上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Oh...! There are two of them!
entries.new: 哦……！有两个啊！
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: Isla rapidly unwrapped the sheet to prove that she hadn't lied.
entries.new: Isla 飞快地解开那块布，想证明自己没有撒谎。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Hang on, it's not here. The thread I left.
entries.new: 等等，不在这儿。我留下的那根线。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: It's not here...! The Sekimeiya!
entries.new: 没有……！Sekimeiya 不见了！
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: Isla desperately looked all through the sheet, but the Sekimeiya wasn't there.
entries.new: Isla 急得把整块布翻了个遍，可 Sekimeiya 就是不在里面。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I promise I didn't lie! I had it here!
entries.new: 我发誓我没骗人！它本来就在这儿的！
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: Atsuki crouched and felt the cloth.
entries.new: Atsuki 蹲下身，摸了摸那块布。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Y-You didn't lie...! It's burning.
entries.new: 你、你没骗人……！真的好烫。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Yeah. It started to feel hot on the fourth floor.
entries.new: 嗯。到四楼的时候就开始烫了。
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: You felt it when the Sekimeiya was in the center...? I'll bet it was extremely hot, then. Also, the cabinet is still locked.
entries.new: 你是说，Sekimeiya 在布中间的时候你就摸到烫了……？那它当时一定烫得厉害。还有，展示柜仍然锁着。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: ...I-Is this what you're implying? That it was taken out of the cabinet since the thread is gone and then brought to the attic? Then, at some point, it teleported inside again?
entries.new: ……你、你是这个意思吗？线没了，说明有人把它从展示柜里拿出来，带到了阁楼。然后不知什么时候，它又传送了回去？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I'm not implying anything, but that's what could've happened.
entries.new: 我没想暗示什么，只是确实有这种可能。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: That doesn't make sense.{w} It really doesn't—the cabinet is locked. That would mean that whoever took the Sekimeiya out locked the cabinet while it was empty.{w} I have another idea. Let me take the Sekimeiya. Akaro and Katei, you watch the stairs.
entries.new: 这说不通。{w}真的说不通——展示柜一直锁着。照这么说，拿走 Sekimeiya 的人还得在柜子空着的时候把它锁上。{w}我有个别的想法。Sekimeiya 由我来拿。Akaro、Katei，你们盯着楼梯。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Why?
entries.new: 为什么？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Because the last time it wasn't working, remember? I can test if it is now without activating it.
entries.new: 因为上次它没起作用，还记得吧？现在不用启动它，我也能试出它是否恢复正常。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...Okay.
entries.new: ……好吧。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Is that really okay? We came here to leave it where it's safe.
entries.new: 这样真的好吗？我们特地过来，就是为了把它放到安全的地方。
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: We need to understand what's happening. It must be done.
entries.new: 我们得弄清到底发生了什么。这一步非走不可。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: After all that time, I still had the keyring, so I took it out and unlocked the cabinet.
entries.new: 隔了这么久，钥匙串仍在我身上，我便取出来打开了展示柜。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Sai grabbed the Sekimeiya with his sleeves, causing the curtain to fall, and put it in the middle of the sheet. He then closed the glass.
entries.new: Sai 隔着衣袖抓住 Sekimeiya，遮布随之落下。他把球放到布的中央，然后合上了玻璃。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It was very cold, so let's see if that changes.
entries.new: 它刚才非常冰，看看这样会不会有变化。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: He wrapped it around with one layer of the cloth and waited a few seconds with his hand over it.
entries.new: 他用布裹了一层，把手覆在上面，等了几秒。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...It is getting hot—definitely.
entries.new: ……开始变热了——确实变热了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: When Atsuki tried it, he agreed as well.
entries.new: Atsuki 试了一下，也这么说。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: All right, I'm sure there's someone on this floor. Don't take your eyes off the stairs. I'm not sure we'll find them, though.
entries.new: 好，这一层肯定有人。盯紧楼梯，别移开视线。不过我不确定能不能找到他。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Why do you say that?
entries.new: 为什么这么说？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: The last time, the Sekimeiya disappeared from my hands when I walked to the event room, and this time, it disappeared from within the sheet when we were walking to the event room. Could it be related to that?
entries.new: 上一次，我走向活动室的途中，Sekimeiya 从我手里消失了；这一次，我们走向活动室的途中，它又从布里消失了。会不会和这个有关？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Back then, you said it was burning and you could hardly hold it. Is it possible it teleports when it gets too hot?
entries.new: 当时你说它烫得几乎拿不住。会不会是热到一定程度，它就会传送？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: And the next time we found it, it wasn't working. It could be that...
entries.new: 而下一次我们找到它时，它已经失灵了。会不会是因为……
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: It's working now, but we can test it. If the outer layer of the sheet felt hot for Isla, it's possible that it making the sheet hot made it heat up even more quickly.
entries.new: 它现在还能用，不过我们可以试一下。Isla 隔着布都能摸到烫，那也许是布被加热后反过来让它升温更快。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Sai wrapped the Sekimeiya up completely once again.
entries.new: Sai 又把 Sekimeiya 严严实实地裹了起来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Like this, I can't easily tell if the Sekimeiya's still in here or not.
entries.new: 这样裹上，我就没法轻易判断 Sekimeiya 还在不在了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: We waited a bit, but ultimately, to know if it had disappeared, the ball would have to be unwrapped.
entries.new: 我们等了一会儿，但要想知道它有没有消失，只能把布包打开。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: You remember when it disappeared the last time, right? Immediately after that, our footprints vanished from the attic...
entries.new: 上次它消失的时候你记得吧？就在那之后，我们在阁楼的脚印也消失了……
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I suppose I can try leaving and entering this room, if that's what's doing it.
entries.new: 如果进出房间就是原因，那我可以试着离开再进来。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: He picked up the sheet and went in and out of the door a couple times.
entries.new: 他抱起布包，在门口进出几个来回。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It seems that if it disappears, it appears somewhere close by. It might be impossible to understand what it's doing, though, and we can at least keep it locked up if we have it.
entries.new: 看来它消失之后，会出现在附近的某处。不过它到底在做什么，我们恐怕弄不明白；至少东西在我们手上时，还能把它锁好。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...There's no way I'm no longer holding it, right? It must still be in the center of the sheet. Let's just finish the search.
entries.new: ……我怎么可能已经没拿着它了？它肯定还在布中间。先把搜查做完吧。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Sai dropped the ball on the floor of hallway A, where he could view the staircase as well. He grabbed one edge of the sheet and began to unroll it.
entries.new: Sai 把布包放到 A 走廊的地上，那儿也能看见楼梯。他抓住布的一角，开始展开。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I think it's still he—
entries.new: ……我觉得它还在里——
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: The sheet disappeared.{w} Between Sai's hands, not only had the sheet vanished, but also the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 布包消失了。{w}Sai 两手之间，消失的不只是那块布，还有 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It did happen again...
entries.new: 果然又发生了……
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: I was able to see that the Sekimeiya was there. It disappeared when Sai touched it.
entries.new: 我看得见 Sekimeiya 就在里面。是 Sai 一碰，它才消失的。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: But why is the sheet gone too...?
entries.new: 可为什么连布也不见了……？
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: I couldn't touch it anymore because of how hot it was. That could be why it also disappeared—Isla was touching it when the Sekimeiya teleported the previous time.
entries.new: 它烫得我已经没法碰了。布也跟着消失，也许就是这个缘故——上次 Sekimeiya 传送时，Isla 正碰着布。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: She couldn't have touched the Sekimeiya itself, though.
entries.new: 不过她不可能碰到 Sekimeiya 本身。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Wh—!{w} Oh my God, I almost had a heart attack!
entries.new: 什——！{w}天啊，我差点心脏停跳！
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: The door! It fucking closed!
entries.new: 门！他妈的门关上了！
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Sai stood up rapidly and opened the event room, but he didn't see anyone.
entries.new: Sai 猛地起身打开活动室的门，却一个人也没看见。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It didn't make a sound. ...Was it the Sekimeiya?
entries.new: 它没有发出任何声响。……难道是 Sekimeiya？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Sai uncovered the cabinet's curtain, but that time, it was empty and still unlocked. I noticed that the hallway B door was slightly open—I thought that had changed too.
entries.new: Sai 掀开展示柜的遮布，可这一次里面空着，锁也依旧开着。我发现 B 走廊的门虚掩着——心想这处应该也变了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: This is going way beyond me. If there's someone on this floor, let's just fucking find them.{w} I have no idea if we were right. Maybe if the Sekimeiya overheats, it teleports away, but only this time it happened when it was touched.
entries.new: 这已经远远超出我的理解范围了。这层要是真有人，就他妈把人揪出来。{w}我根本不知道我们猜得对不对。也许 Sekimeiya 过热后就会传送离开，只是这一次是在被碰到时才发生的。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Sai went straight to the storeroom and came back with the information we needed to know the most.
entries.new: Sai 径直去了储藏室，带回了我们最需要确认的消息。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...It hasn't been opened again.
entries.new: ……那扇门没有再开过。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: That made everyone even tenser. The chance to find the culprit was closer than ever.
entries.new: 众人闻言越发紧张。找到犯人的机会，从来没有这么近过。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Fuck... Let's hurry. The Sekimeiya might've appeared on this floor.{w} I didn't think this through. If someone's actually here, there's a chance it'll allow them to escape.
entries.new: 妈的……动作快点。Sekimeiya 可能已经出现在这层了。{w}是我考虑不周。要是真有人在这儿，说不定反而会让对方有机会逃走。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Like before, while Erina and Isla stayed outside, all of us went to inspect every individual room.
entries.new: 和先前一样，Erina和Isla守在外面，我们其余人则挨个查看每一个房间。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I was first to enter room A1. Within one of the cabinets, I found the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 我第一个走进A1室，在其中一个展示柜里找到了 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I hesitated a little, but I had no reason to keep it to myself anymore, and it was going to be found anyway. I made sure not to touch it directly and brought it to the hallway.
entries.new: 我迟疑了一瞬，但事到如今也没有再隐瞒的必要，况且它迟早会被找到。我刻意不直接触碰它，把它带到了走廊上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: You found it? Thank God.
entries.new: 找到了？谢天谢地。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: ...Was it inside a cabinet again?
entries.new: ……又是在展示柜里找到的？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Yes.
entries.new: 是。
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: It's not locked anymore.
entries.new: 已经没锁了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: We faced Sai and saw he'd opened the security room. When most of us ran in, we were met with the many powered-off screens.
entries.new: 我们看向Sai，发现他已经打开了监控室。我们多数人跑进去时，看到的是许多已经熄灭的屏幕。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Sai pressed the computer's power button, and it started up.
entries.new: Sai按下电脑的电源键，机器启动了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: However, right after that, it automatically shut down.
entries.new: 然而紧接着，它又自动关机了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What the hell? Is some piece of hardware not being detected?
entries.new: 搞什么？是不是有哪个硬件没被识别出来？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Hey! Come to the lobby...!
entries.new: 喂！快来大厅……！
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Akaro's strained voice made us abandon the computer. Behind the door to the lobby, déjà vu was what awaited us.
entries.new: Akaro的声音很紧张，我们丢下电脑。大厅门后等着我们的，是似曾相识的一幕。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: She's gone...! Again...
entries.new: 她不见了……！又不见了……
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Now two bodies have disappeared, and both of them were definitely dead. If they're not on this floor, I'm just lost.
entries.new: 现在两具尸体都不见了，而且两人都确实死透了。要是这层楼里也找不到，我就彻底没辙了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Wait, no. I'm so stupid...
entries.new: 等等，不对。我真是蠢……
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: What have you done?
entries.new: 你干了什么？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I know it looks like she vanished, but I think there's more to it.{w} Naomi and the policeman are still here, but do you remember when I brought both bodies to the lobby? I don't think the policeman was here.
entries.new: 我知道她看上去像是凭空消失了，不过我觉得事情另有蹊跷。{w}Naomi和那名警察还在这里，但你们还记得我把两具尸体搬来大厅的时候吗？我印象里，那名警察并不在这儿。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: ...Excuse me?
entries.new: ……你说什么？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I think... I just placed them near the door and hardly paid attention. I think I didn't realize the policeman had disappeared. I remember this part of the floor being completely empty for the second I looked at it.
entries.new: 我想……我当时只是把它们放在门边，几乎没多留意。我大概根本没意识到那名警察已经不见了。我只记得自己看过去的那一瞬间，这一片完全空着。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: We could hardly be surprised anymore, and there was very little reason to doubt Akaro.
entries.new: 我们几乎已经见怪不怪，况且也没什么理由怀疑Akaro。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: So, the policeman disappeared and reappeared...? Let's make sure we can't find the other bodies before I go insane.{w} ...Oh wait, look at Naomi's head.
entries.new: 也就是说，那名警察消失后又出现了……？先确认我们确实找不到其他尸体，免得我发疯。{w}……哦，等等，看Naomi的头。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: From the wound she had, quite a bit of blood was pouring out.
entries.new: 从她的伤口里，正涌出相当多的血。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Yes, more blood is coming out than before.
entries.new: 没错，血比刚才流得更多了。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: And it seems like it started just now, right? Otherwise, the pool on the floor would be much bigger.
entries.new: 而且看起来是刚刚才开始流的，对吧？否则地上的血泊会大得多。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: You're right...
entries.new: 你说得对……
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Erina had kept Isla close to hallway C so that she wouldn't go near the lobby. Hammered by a thousand new questions, we confirmed there was nothing in the room below us. Afterward, I had something to say.
entries.new: Erina让Isla留在C走廊附近，免得她走近大厅。无数新疑问轮番袭来，我们还是确认了下方房间里空无一物。之后，我有一件事要说。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The Sekimeiya isn't getting hotter yet. That's not normal, right?
entries.new: Sekimeiya还没有变热。这不太正常，对吧？
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: Oh, is it not working again?
entries.new: 哦，又失灵了吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Sai felt my sleeve and confirmed that it wasn't hot at all.
entries.new: Sai摸了摸我的衣袖，确认它一点都不热。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It's just like before. After teleporting, it doesn't work.
entries.new: 和之前一样。传送之后，它就不起作用了。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: ...Right.
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: We'll just leave it in the cabinet. We only have hallway B left.
entries.new: 先把它放回展示柜吧。只剩B走廊了。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Knowing that thinking about anything would be useless until every room was searched, we entered hallway B. There, the same procedure started.
entries.new: 明知搜完所有房间之前想什么都是白费，我们还是走进了B走廊。在那里，同样的搜查又开始了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We moved in coordination from room to room, looking at every cabinet along the way. Rapidly, the number of remaining places decreased as we approached the bathrooms.
entries.new: 我们分工配合，一个房间接一个房间地查，沿途不放过任何一个展示柜。随着我们接近洗手间，尚未搜查的地方迅速减少。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Finally, there were none left. In no location had there been a person or either of the bodies that had vanished. In addition, according to Sai, the storeroom door hadn't opened again. The answer, no matter what it was, must've hinged on the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 最终，所有地方都搜遍了。哪里都没有人，消失的两具尸体也一具都没看到。此外，按Sai的说法，储藏室的门没有再开过。不管答案是什么，关键一定在Sekimeiya身上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...There's nothing else we can do. Even if there really is someone with us, they know how to not be found. It's very clear that whatever's been happening here is way over our heads.
entries.new: ……我们已经无计可施了。就算真有人和我们同在这层，对方也知道如何藏得滴水不漏。很显然，这里发生的一切早已超出我们的理解。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Sai felt my sleeve again. Failing to notice any heat, he touched the Sekimeiya, and nothing happened.
entries.new: Sai又摸了摸我的衣袖。没感觉到任何热度，他便碰了碰Sekimeiya，结果什么也没发生。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Don't touch it again. Our priority at this point is just to make it out of here safely.
entries.new: 别再碰它了。我们现在唯一要做的，就是平安离开这里。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: There was really no rebuttal to that. Since we'd been unable to figure anything out, a sensation lingered: if we truly were up against a real culprit, we were no match for them. And supposing multiple people had died due to being threats to that person, our single goal was not to become a threat ourselves.
entries.new: 这话无从反驳。我们什么也没能查清，心里始终盘桓着一种感觉：若真是有个凶手在暗处，我们根本不是他的对手。而假如那几个人之所以丧命，是因为他们构成了威胁，那我们唯一的目标，就是别让自己成为威胁。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We had just performed a perfect search. There was no room for anyone to be hiding, and as a result, there was absolutely nothing more we could do to fight back. We had to resign ourselves to passing the time and nothing more.
entries.new: 我们刚刚完成了一次彻底的搜查。任何地方都藏不住人，也正因如此，我们再没有别的反击手段，只能认命地耗着时间，别无他法。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Next to Erina and Isla was the elevator. We walked to it, following Sai.
entries.new: Erina 和 Isla 身旁就是电梯。我们跟着 Sai 走了过去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The elevator was in the attic when we left, but I didn't count on the buttons getting reattached. I can think of one escape route.{w} We saw that the call button was there on the second floor. When we were inspecting the offices, perhaps they called the elevator. If it came from the attic, we wouldn't have heard it since we were on the same floor as the elevator.{w} Similarly, if they immediately took it to escape to another floor, we wouldn't have heard that either.
entries.new: 我们离开的时候，电梯停在阁楼，可我没料到按键会被装回去。我倒是能想到一条逃跑路线。{w}在二楼那会儿，我们看见呼叫按钮还在。我们检查办公室的时候，对方也许叫了电梯。如果它是从阁楼下来的，我们跟电梯在同一层，不会听见动静。{w}同样，如果对方立刻乘电梯逃去了别的楼层，我们也一样听不到。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: N-No, that couldn't have happened.
entries.new: 不、不会的，不可能发生这种事。
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: No? What do you mean?
entries.new: 不会？你这话是什么意思？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Someone was always watching the stairs and elevator since we came to the crystal floor, right?
entries.new: 我们到水晶层之后，楼梯和电梯一直有人看着，对吧？
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: Yes.
entries.new: 对。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: So look. The elevator is open.
entries.new: 那你看看——电梯是开着的。
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: Wh-What?{w} You're... right.
entries.new: 什、什么？{w}你说得……没错。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: The door wasn't properly closed; a tiny gap was keeping it open.
entries.new: 门没有完全关上，只留着一道细缝。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There's nothing. All the buttons are gone. Even the blood is.{w} But I see what you mean. The elevator had to be here with the door open since we arrived, so if the culprit took it on the second floor, they got off here.
entries.new: 什么都没有。按键全没了，连血迹也没了。{w}不过我明白你的意思。我们到这里时，电梯就已经停在这里，门也开着；那么如果凶手在二楼搭了它，就只能是在这层下的。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...This doesn't make any sense. How did the elevator get here? If it came before us, we would've heard it.
entries.new: ……这说不通。电梯是怎么到这里的？如果它比我们先到，我们不可能没听见。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Yeah, I can only think of the way I said. When we were on the second floor, our mystery person called it, which was imperceptible for us. They brought it here, left with all the panels, and kept the door open. ...That's the only thing that makes any sense, but it still doesn't explain how the hell they managed to not be found.
entries.new: 是啊，我只能想到刚才说的那种可能。我们在二楼的时候，那个神秘人叫了电梯，我们毫无察觉。他把它带到这层，拆走了所有面板，还让门一直开着。……只有这一种解释站得住脚，可它还是没说明白，那人究竟是怎么做到不被发现的。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I guess there's one way.{w} The Sekimeiya disappeared from the sheet Isla was carrying, right? And we found it inside the cabinet in the event room.{w} Even if the killer was here, they couldn't have escaped with the Sekimeiya because they would've left the cabinet glass open. I guess it's possible they found it somewhere else, and it teleported to the cabinet after they touched it. That's all I can think.
entries.new: 我想，倒是有一种可能。{w}Isla 拿着的那张纸上，Sekimeiya 不是消失了吗？后来我们却在活动室的展示柜里找到了它。{w}就算凶手当时就在这层，也没法带着 Sekimeiya 逃出去，因为那样展示柜的玻璃就会是开着的。说不定他是在别处找到它的，一碰到，它就传送回了展示柜。我能想到的只有这些。
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: Our conclusion didn't change. There was absolutely nothing we could do.
entries.new: 结论没有改变。我们根本无计可施。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We placed the Sekimeiya in the cabinet and locked it.
entries.new: 我们把 Sekimeiya 放进展示柜，上了锁。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Afterward...
entries.new: 那之后……
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I had the chance to go to the security room and saw Atsuki was already there. The time displayed on the BIOS was {time=15:45}, which was five minutes after locking up the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 我趁机去了趟监控室，Atsuki 已经在那里了。BIOS 上显示的时间是 {time=15:45}，距离我们锁上 Sekimeiya 已经过了五分钟。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Katei was drawn in by the open door when the computer had already been shut down. He said he wanted to get to the bottom of the issue, so we left him behind, working in his room.
entries.new: Katei 是被那扇敞开的门引过来的，那时电脑已经关机了。他说一定要把事情查个水落石出，我们便留他一个人在那间房里忙。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Despite Erina saying that she and Isla would go back to the attic after we finished searching, they were still on the crystal floor. Two corpses had disappeared, and the search indicated that one of us was likely the culprit, so Erina had no problem accepting Isla's request to stay in room A1.
entries.new: Erina 说过，搜查结束后就和 Isla 回阁楼，可她们仍旧待在水晶层。两具尸体凭空消失，搜查又表明凶手很可能就在我们之中，于是 Erina 便爽快地答应了 Isla 的请求，一起留在 A1 室。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It finally began to feel like our goal was waiting for the exit to unlock. For many minutes, nothing happened.
entries.new: 终于，我们开始觉得目标就是等出口解锁。过了好几分钟，什么都没发生。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Sai and Akaro were in the lobby, avoiding the sight of the blood flowing out of Naomi's head. Atsuki sat on the staircase in hallway C.{w} ...I roamed around the floor a couple of times, and none of those positions changed.
entries.new: Sai 和 Akaro 待在大厅，避开从 Naomi 头部流出的那片血迹。Atsuki 坐在 C走廊的楼梯上。{w}……我在这一层转了两圈，他们谁都没有挪动过位置。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There were five hours left until {time=21}, and I'd never been good at waiting around. It didn't seem like anyone had more business with the Sekimeiya or any interest in continuing to argue. While that was the ideal scenario, having to simply wait began to stress me out.
entries.new: 距离 {time=21} 还有五个小时，而我一向不擅长干等。看来没人再要动 Sekimeiya，也没人想继续争执下去。这本该是最好的局面，可只能干等着，反倒让我越来越烦躁。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Over the span of an hour, I was the only person wandering around. Nobody said anything to me as they waited patiently.
entries.new: 整整一个小时里，四处走动的只有我一个。其他人都在耐心等着，谁也没对我说什么。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: My body started to severely reject the repetitive colors of the walls, and going over all the gems had only been entertaining for so long. I walked to the staircase, where Atsuki was.
entries.new: 墙上重复的颜色开始让我浑身难受，那些宝石看来看去也早就腻了。我走向 Atsuki 所在的楼梯。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Apparently, he was there to keep an eye on the storeroom so that nobody could enter the building. Before I could say anything, he asked me to briefly take over for him as he attempted to use the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 看样子，他守在这里是为了盯住储藏室，不让任何人溜进楼里。我还没开口，他就请我替他看一会儿，说他要去试试 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Silently, we unlocked the cabinet, but it didn't seem like the Sekimeiya had started working.
entries.new: 我们一言不发地打开展示柜的锁，可 Sekimeiya 似乎并没有启动。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'm going to the attic.
entries.new: 我去阁楼一趟。
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: I didn't think anyone had left the crystal floor in a while, and even though staying with the rest was safer, we'd confirmed every floor was empty.
entries.new: 这一阵子应该没人离开过水晶层；虽说跟大家一起待着更稳妥，可我们已经确认过，每一层都是空的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...But it didn't make any sense. Who had removed the bodies? Who had messed with the elevator buttons? Who had opened the storeroom door?
entries.new: ……可这说不通。是谁搬走了尸体？是谁动了电梯的按键？又是谁打开了储藏室的门？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Atsuki sounded hesitant at first, but he dropped it quickly. The tiredness was kicking in, and I missed letting the time pass on a bed.
entries.new: Atsuki 起初还有些迟疑，但很快就作罢了。疲惫涌了上来，我只想躺到床上，让时间自己过去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I looked at the elevator, which I still found unsettling, and opened the door.
entries.new: 我看向那部仍旧让我不安的电梯，拉开了门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It was empty. There was nobody inside. No buttons, and no blood either...
entries.new: 里面空荡荡的，一个人也没有。按键不见了，血迹也不见了……
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I walked up instead. As I ascended the floors, the thought strengthened: what were we doing? Someone else was with us.
entries.new: 我改走楼梯。一层层往上时，那个念头越来越强烈：我们到底在做什么？这栋楼里还多了一个人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The button had been attached on the third floor.
entries.new: 三楼的按钮已经被装了回去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...And on the fourth, on the fifth, on the sixth... I arrived at the attic door and noticed that the key was no longer inserted into the keyhole.
entries.new: ……四楼也是，五楼、六楼也是……我走到阁楼门前，发现钥匙已经不在锁孔里了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I turned the doorknob and opened the door slowly. It was still unlocked.
entries.new: 我拧动门把，缓缓推开门。门依然没有上锁。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I fixed my eyes on the floor of the living room. Our footprints were faded, and it didn't seem like anyone had been there recently.
entries.new: 我盯着起居室的地板。我们的脚印已经变淡，最近似乎没人来过。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Next to the elevator was a metallic panel with its button, exactly where it was designed to be. It only made my head feel more numb. Had someone really reattached all of them when we hadn't been looking?
entries.new: 电梯旁就是带按键的金属面板，装在它本该在的位置。这只让我的脑袋更麻木。难道真有人趁我们不注意，把按键全装回去了？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I approached both bedrooms. Even though I couldn't sense anyone around, I wasn't going to look.
entries.new: ……我走近那两间卧室。虽然感觉不到有人，我还是不打算往里面看。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I opened the left door and sat on the bed.
entries.new: 我推开左边那扇门，在床边坐下。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There was no way I could feel comfortable. The uneasiness immobilized me for a long time until I was able to lie down.
entries.new: 我怎么可能安心。那股不安让我僵坐了很久，才终于躺了下去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I had my purse next to me, and that time, I shut the light off. That finally allowed me to close my eyes and hope that the next time I opened them, I could walk out of the tower.
entries.new: 我把手提包放在身旁，这一次关掉了灯。这才总算能合上眼，盼着再睁开时，就能走出这座塔。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I didn't realize I'd fallen asleep, but a noise caused me to wake up. Once I regained my senses, I sharpened them to try to distinguish what I'd heard, but nothing else reached me.
entries.new: 我不知自己何时睡着的，一阵声响把我惊醒。回过神后，我凝神去辨认那是什么声音，却再没有别的动静传来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The situation repeated. I felt like I'd blinked in and out of existence, but the sound that woke me the second time was louder.
entries.new: 同样的事情又发生了一次。我像是眨了眨眼，就从现实里消失又回来；但第二次把我惊醒的声音更响了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Next to me, the door opened.
entries.new: 身旁的门开了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Then the light came on. I had my face under the sheet, facing the wall. With no strength to react, I waited.
entries.new: 接着，灯亮了。我把脸埋在床单下，朝着墙壁。我连反应的力气都没有，只能等着。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: "Are you awake?"{w} It was Atsuki's voice.
entries.new: 「你醒了吗？」{w}是 Atsuki 的声音。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I didn't want to reply, so I kept quiet, figuring that if he had something important to say, he'd try to wake me up.
entries.new: 我不想应声，便没有作声——心想，他若真有事，自然会来叫醒我。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Instead, the light turned back off.
entries.new: 结果，灯又灭了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Soon, so did I.
entries.new: 很快，我也睡了过去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The faintest sounds kept waking me up. They had started coming from above me.
entries.new: 极细微的声响一再把我吵醒。那声音是从我上方传来的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Someone had gone up the ladder.{w} I tried not to mind it and keep sleeping.
entries.new: 有人顺着梯子爬上去了。{w}我努力不去在意，继续睡。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: However, I felt almost rested, as if I'd slept for hours. Minutes after failing to sleep again, I stretched my limbs and yawned deeply.
entries.new: 可我却觉得几乎已经睡足了，仿佛睡了好几个钟头。再次入睡失败几分钟后，我伸展四肢，深深打了个哈欠。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It was very dark, but my purse was still on the bed. I grabbed it, slowly sat up, and then stood.
entries.new: 四周漆黑一片，提包还在床上。我摸到提包，慢慢坐起，然后站了起来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I had no sense of space, but it wasn't unpleasant. It couldn't be too late in the day either—it was likely Atsuki or someone would come get me before the deadline, and Katei probably wouldn't be a fan of Ashiya entering the tower and finding someone sleeping in the attic.
entries.new: 我分不清方位，却并不觉得难受。时间应该也不算太晚——Atsuki 或别人多半会在期限前就来接我；而要是芦屋进了塔，发现有人睡在阁楼里，Katei 大概不会乐意。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The Pond
entries.new: 池塘

entries.text: Out of nowhere, the light turned on. I found myself standing in the middle of the room, alone.
entries.new: 灯光毫无征兆地亮了。我发现自己独自站在房间中央。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...{w}Did you do that? Are you Atsuki?
entries.new: ……{w}是你开的？你是 Atsuki 吗？
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: I looked at the ceiling, figuring someone above me had flipped the switch, but there was no response.
entries.new: 我抬头望向天花板，以为上面有人按了开关，却没有回应。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Instead, a petrifying yell came from the door.
entries.new: 取而代之的，是一声从门口传来的、令人毛骨悚然的喊叫。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...oor! ...re you!?
entries.new: ……门口！……你在哪儿！？
entries.speaker: q

entries.text: I stared at the closed door before slowly approaching, wondering if I was losing it.
entries.new: 我盯着紧闭的门看了一会儿，才慢慢走过去，心里怀疑自己是不是要疯了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I turned the handle gently and peered into the hallway. The voice was coming from in front of me.
entries.new: 我轻轻转动门把手，探头望向走廊。声音来自我的正前方。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I just heard you! Please, open the door!
entries.new: 我刚刚听到你的声音了！求你，把门打开！
entries.speaker: q

entries.text: ...How is this possible? It's her again.
entries.new: ……怎么可能？又是她。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I wasn't taken aback anymore or even afraid. I just wanted out.
entries.new: 我已经不再吃惊，甚至也不害怕了。我只想出去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Between the two bedrooms, I wondered if I was being consciously punished. That couldn't be.
entries.new: 站在两间卧室之间，我怀疑自己是不是正被有意惩罚。可这说不通。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But as much as I despised it, it was reality. Once again, the obvious laws of the world were being flagrantly defied.
entries.new: 可无论我多么憎恶，这都是现实。世上显而易见的法则，又一次被明目张胆地践踏了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...You're still here, right? What are you planning?
entries.new: ……你还在那儿吧？你到底想干什么？
entries.speaker: q

entries.text: Was she actually talking to me? I had no idea.
entries.new: 她真的在跟我说话吗？我毫无头绪。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: While I wanted to know what was happening, I knew I wouldn't try to open the door. Instead, concealing my presence as much as possible, I stepped back to the living room.
entries.new: 我虽然想知道发生了什么，却也清楚自己不会去开门。于是我尽量不露痕迹，退回了客厅。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I know you're here! At least answer!
entries.new: 我知道你在里面！至少应一声啊！
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: I couldn't tell anymore if she was still yelling. I looked down and saw recent footprints going from the hallway to the staircase.
entries.new: 我已经分辨不出她是否还在喊。低头一看，地上有一串新鲜的脚印，从走廊一直延伸到楼梯口。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I gripped the handle and tried to open the door.{w} It was locked.
entries.new: 我握住门把手，试着开门。{w}门锁着。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: From my purse, I took the keys out and got the door to open.
entries.new: 我从提包里取出钥匙，把门打开。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: On the other side, I inserted the key into the keyhole again and rotated it.
entries.new: 到了门外，我又把钥匙插进锁孔，转动了一下。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I didn't know whether to keep going forward. The sixth floor felt desolate, and I had no objective. Perhaps not trying to find out what was happening was smarter.
entries.new: 我不知道该不该继续往前走。六楼荒凉得厉害，我也没有明确的目的。也许不去追究发生了什么，才是更聪明的做法。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: However, someone had been above me in the bedroom, and they hadn't answered my question. That was what made me keep walking away from the door.
entries.new: 可是，卧室上方确实有人，而且没有回答我的问题。正因为如此，我才继续朝远离那扇门的方向走去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I walked down the next staircase as the echo of my own footsteps accompanied me. If people were still waiting in the lobby, I could stay there.
entries.new: 我走下下一道楼梯，只有自己的脚步声在回响。如果大厅里还有人等着，我就可以待在那里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I hardly felt like I was alive as I descended the mirrored floors; the entire sequence of events felt like nothing more than a dream. I trudged through all of them until a gray door was in front of me.
entries.new: 一层层镜像般的楼层在我脚下退去，我几乎感觉不到自己还活着；这一连串事情就像一场梦。我拖着步子走完所有楼层，直到一扇灰色的门出现在面前。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Atsuki was no longer sitting on the lowest step behind it. Instead, there was a trail of fresh blood.
entries.new: 门后最下面那级台阶上，Atsuki 已经不在了。取而代之的，是一道新鲜的血迹。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The floor had a strange smell to it. It could've been the same one we'd smelled throughout the day, but I didn't think that was all.
entries.new: 地面散发着一股怪异的气味。也许就是我们一整天闻到的那种，但我觉得不止于此。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Cautiously, I walked to the lobby. The blood I'd seen shouldn't have been enough to cause someone to die, but there was an imposing, foreboding atmosphere permeating the crystal floor.
entries.new: 我小心翼翼地走向大厅。我看到的那点血，本不至于让人丧命，可水晶层里弥漫着一股沉重而不祥的气息。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Nobody.
entries.new: ……没有人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The two bodies had disappeared with almost all the blood, and only the shutter remained. Partially unable to believe it, I took timid steps toward the center of the lobby, where I saw that its emptiness was absolute.
entries.new: 两具尸体连同几乎所有的血迹都不见了，只剩那道卷帘门。我半信半疑，怯生生地向大厅中央走了几步，才看清那里空得彻底。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: When I opened the hallway B door, the sensation was identical. Was it possible I was alone?
entries.new: 推开 B走廊 的门，感觉如出一辙。难道真的只剩我一个人了？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The urge to find someone increased. I didn't want to go back to the attic despite knowing it was inhabited. I tried to uncoil my tightly wound muscles and opened my mouth.
entries.new: 想找到人的念头越来越强烈。明知阁楼里有人，我却不想回去。我试着放松紧绷的身体，张开了嘴。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Hey! Is anyone there...!?
entries.new: ……喂！有人在吗……！？
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: I received no answer, but one of the open doors grabbed my attention. It was the staff room's.
entries.new: 没有人回应，但其中一扇开着的门吸引了我的注意。那是员工室的门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It stood out, as it was very slightly open.
entries.new: 它格外显眼，因为门只开了一道很小的缝。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I approached it, but once inside, I wasn't sure it'd been the right call.
entries.new: 我走了过去，可进去之后，又不确定这是不是正确的选择。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I stood still and smelled the air. It was somehow fairly strong, but it wasn't a particular smell anymore.
entries.new: 我站定不动，嗅了嗅空气。那股味道莫名地浓，却已经说不上是什么气味了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Something Atsuki had said came to mind. One of the keys I had could belong to Naomi's locker. We hadn't tried that yet.
entries.new: 我想起了 Atsuki 说过的话。我手上的钥匙里，有一把或许能打开 Naomi 的储物柜。这一点我们还没试过。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If he was right, the possibility that a phone could be found was nonzero. I looked at the keys on my palm and figured the smallest one could fit in the lockers.
entries.new: 如果他说得没错，那找到手机并不是完全没有可能。我看了看掌心里的钥匙，觉得最小的那把应该能插进储物柜的锁孔。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I inserted it into the first one and tried to turn it. However, the whole locker shook, refusing to open.
entries.new: 我将它插进第一个柜子的锁孔，试着转动。整只柜子却晃了起来，怎么也打不开。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Then, a metallic sound rang out right in front of me. Something had hit the locker from the inside.
entries.new: 紧接着，一声金属撞击声就在我面前响起。有什么东西从里面撞上了柜门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I looked up and saw three slits in the door. Despite the darkness that should've existed behind them, I discerned a glow.
entries.new: 我抬起头，只见柜门上开着三道细缝。缝隙后本该是一片漆黑，我却隐约辨出了一点微光。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It could only have been one thing. Despite being filled with questions, my mind was blank. My hand was drawn to the shape that had begun to take form behind the dark lines, and through the narrow space, I made contact, hoping with all my might that I would be brought to the awaited time.
entries.new: 那只能是那样东西。我满腹疑问，脑中却一片空白。暗色缝隙后，一个轮廓渐渐成形，我的手不由自主地伸了过去，穿过那道狭窄的空隙触碰到了它——我拼尽全力祈愿，愿自己能抵达那个等待已久的时间。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: However, hallway A was my next sight.
entries.new: 然而，我看到的却是 A 走廊。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: {w=1.0}Then, I fell to the floor immediately after appearing.
entries.new: {w=1.0}可我刚一现身，便立刻跌倒在地。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Disoriented and confused, I stood back up. I had no way to know how far I'd been sent.
entries.new: 我晕头转向地爬起来，却根本无从知道自己被送到了多远的地方。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It mustn't have been too long; the hallway looked just as desolate as before. I walked ahead and opened the security room.
entries.new: 应该没过太久——走廊看上去和先前一样荒凉。我向前走去，推开了监控室的门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: An unexpected realization hit me instantly. Katei was dead—the stench of his blood had been secluded within the room.
entries.new: 我立刻意识到了一件出乎意料的事。Katei 已经死了——他的血腥味一直被闷在这间屋里，久久不散。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It seemed he had managed to get the computer back to work, its buzzing adding to the surrealness. I approached cautiously, trying not to breathe.
entries.new: 看样子他设法让电脑重新运转了起来，机器的嗡鸣让这一切更显虚幻。我小心翼翼地靠近，尽量屏住呼吸。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: When I pressed a key, the three screens lit up, and on the middle one, I saw a message.{w} "{time=10:04}: Camera(s) disabled and associated footage erased".
entries.new: 我按下某个键，三块屏幕亮了起来，中间那块上显示着一行字。{w}「{time=10:04}：摄像机已停用，相关影像已删除」。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...At {time=10:04}, the recordings were erased...?
entries.new: ……{time=10:04}，录像被删除了……？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: The screen also showed the time: {time=18:21.} Directly below it was Katei's head—the epicenter of all the blood. It was beyond doubt that he had been killed as well.
entries.new: 屏幕上还显示着时间：{time=18:21.} 正下方就是 Katei 的头——一切血迹的中心。毫无疑问，他也已经遇害了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I recalled the person above me, in the bedroom. Who was that, and what had happened while I was asleep?
entries.new: 我想起了楼上卧室里的那个人。那是谁？我睡着的时候又发生了什么？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I left the room behind. From far away, I noticed that the blood I'd seen on the staircase wasn't there yet. Slowly, I directed myself to one of the closed doors in the hallway.
entries.new: 我离开了那间房。远远地，我注意到楼梯上那些血迹此刻还不存在。我缓缓走向走廊上一扇关着的门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Wait, that...?
entries.new: ……等等，那是……？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: High up, something caught my attention. Through the smoke, a circular, intermittent green light could be seen on one of the cameras. I spun in place and saw that many of them had it. I remembered that the last time I'd seen that light was very early in the morning.
entries.new: 高处有什么东西引起了我的注意。透过烟雾，可以看到其中一台摄像机上有一个绿色圆形光点，忽明忽灭。我原地转身，发现许多摄像机上都有。我记得上一次看到那点光亮，还是清晨时分。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...The computer. It reenabled the cameras. This really must mean that they weren't recording until now, right...?
entries.new: ……是电脑。它重新启用了摄像机。也就是说，它们到现在才开始录像，对吧……？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Hopeful, I entered one of the rooms. There was something else I had to see.
entries.new: 我抱着一线希望走进一间展室。还有一样东西，我必须亲眼确认。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The cabinet was covered by its curtain. If the Sekimeiya was behind it, it was possible someone else was soon to be on the crystal floor.
entries.new: 展示柜仍盖着遮布。如果 Sekimeiya 就在遮布后面，那么说不定很快又会有人出现在水晶层上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...It wasn't. The cabinet was completely empty. I let go of the curtain and stepped back, startled.
entries.new: ……没有。展示柜里空空如也。我吓了一跳，松手放开遮布，后退了一步。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Just next to my feet, I'd noticed there was a bit of blood. That made four places I'd seen some.
entries.new: 就在我脚边，我注意到有一点血迹。这已经是我见到的第四处血迹了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'd run away from the attic, but even if I wanted to go back, it was no guarantee anyone would be there at the moment.
entries.new: 我从阁楼逃了出来，可就算想回去，此刻也未必有人还在那里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Hallway B was still empty, but I understood my situation. Any room could've been hiding a new death.
entries.new: B走廊依旧空无一人，但我清楚自己的处境。任何一间房里，都可能藏着新的死亡。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Now the staff room is closed, unlike many others... Is someone going to enter it soon?
entries.new: 现在员工室关着，和许多别的房间不一样……是不是有人很快就要进去了？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I moved to the center of the hallway, dwarfed by its overwhelming walls. There, I felt genuinely scared for my life. Had I avoided being a target by going to the attic?
entries.new: 我走到走廊中央，四壁高耸逼人，将我衬得格外渺小。站在那里，我真的很害怕自己会没命。我躲进阁楼，是否就此避开了成为目标？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Unable to decide on whether to go back up, I remained paralyzed.
entries.new: 要不要回到楼上，我迟迟拿不定主意，只能僵立在原地。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Who are you?
entries.new: ……你是谁？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: E-Erina...! You scared me. Wh-What's with all that blood?{w} Wait, who am I? {tip=miiya}A-Are you...?{/tip}
entries.new: Erina……！你吓死我了。你、你身上怎么这么多血？{w}等等，我是谁？{tip=miiya}你、你是……？{/tip}
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: Who... are you? I don't think I've seen you before. How did you get here?
entries.new: 你……是谁？我好像从没见过你。你是怎么到这儿来的？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: I don't know what that means...! I'm Miiya, I've been here the whole time! Do you not remember?
entries.new: 我不明白你在说什么……！我是 Miiya，我一直都在这儿啊！你不记得了吗？
entries.speaker: c2s

entries.text: M-Miiya...?{w} My head hurts a lot... I don't remember you.
entries.new: Miiya……？{w}我头很痛……我不记得你。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: What happened? Did you get hurt? Where are the others?
entries.new: 发生什么了？你受伤了吗？其他人呢？
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: I got hit in the head, yes. And I don't know. I-I haven't seen anyone in a long time.
entries.new: 对，我头上挨了一下。别人我不知道。我、我已经很久没见过任何人了。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: How did you get hit? You're covered in blood.
entries.new: 怎么会挨打？你浑身都是血。
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: I don't know... I was knocked out from behind.
entries.new: 我不知道……我是从背后被人打晕的。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: What...? What happened to the bodies?
entries.new: 什么……？那些尸体呢？
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: Huh?
entries.new: 欸？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Naomi and the policeman. Did they disappear?
entries.new: Naomi 和那个警察。他们不见了吗？
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: Naomi...? No, the first one's there.
entries.new: Naomi……？不，第一个还在这儿。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: There? Why?
entries.new: 在这儿？为什么？
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: I approached the door.
entries.new: 我走近那扇门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: On the floor, two curtains lay, one covering Naomi's body.
entries.new: 地板上摊着两块遮布，其中一块盖在 Naomi 身上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: See...?
entries.new: 看见了吧……？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Why was she brought here?
entries.new: 为什么把她搬到这儿来？
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: What? Hasn't she been here since she died?
entries.new: 什么？她不是一死就在这儿了吗？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: No. We brought her to the lobby. Do you really not remember?
entries.new: 不是。我们把她搬到大厅去了。你真的不记得了？
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: What about the policeman?
entries.new: 那个警察呢？
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: Wh... What policeman?
entries.new: 警……警察？什么警察？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: She was definitely not mentally stable. The hit she'd suffered had clearly been grave, and going off the blood, it was likely she only survived due to luck. However, something told me that wasn't it. The dried-up blood on her... Could she have been the body that had disappeared?
entries.new: 她的神志显然并不清醒。她所受的那一击必定不轻，单看失血量，能活下来恐怕全凭运气。可我心里总觉得，真正的原因并非如此。她身上那片干涸的血迹……那具消失的尸体，会不会就是她？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I stared at her and forced that thought out of my mind.
entries.new: 我盯着她，硬生生把这个念头压了下去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I looked around the room, figuring there wasn't much to learn from Erina. However, someone had tried to kill her, so my worries had been warranted.
entries.new: 我环视了一圈房间，心想从 Erina 身上大概也问不出什么。但确实有人想杀她，我的担心并非多余。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: When I saw the camera, I realized that the green light wasn't there despite the lack of smoke. Then, my attention was grabbed by a temperature regulation wheel next to a cabinet.
entries.new: 看到摄像头时我才发觉，这里明明没有烟雾，指示灯却没有亮起绿光。随后，我的目光被展示柜旁一个温度调节旋钮吸引过去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Why's that broken...?
entries.new: 这个怎么坏了……？
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: Hm? Oh, yeah... I think that's how we found it.
entries.new: 嗯？哦，对……我记得我们发现它的时候就是这样。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: I walked over to it, frowning. How could the wheel have broken? It had been undamaged earlier.
entries.new: 我皱着眉走过去。旋钮怎么会坏？先前它明明完好无损。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The temperature was set to 0 °C. I grabbed the bottom of the lid and tried to lift it up. It was locked, so I had to unlock it the way I'd seen it done the last time we'd all searched.
entries.new: 温度设在了 0 °C。我抓住盖子的下缘，试着把它抬起来。盖子锁着，我只好照上次大家搜查时见过的方式把它打开。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Oh, what...? It's the Sekimeiya. ...And the cabinet is super cold.
entries.new: 噢，怎么……？是 Sekimeiya。……而且展示柜里冷得厉害。
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: The Seki... But we already took it out...
entries.new: Seki……可我们明明已经把它拿出去了啊……
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: I don't understand you.
entries.new: 我不明白你在说什么。
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: It needs to be put in the cabinet. It could get damaged.
entries.new: 得把它放回展示柜里，不然可能会损坏。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Oh, y-yes.
entries.new: 哦，对、对。
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: I reached into the cabinet and picked up the Sekimeiya up without directly touching it.{w} It was considerably cold. I didn't think that touching it would send me far through time, but as it could've made me stay trapped in the building for longer, I decided I wouldn't do it again.
entries.new: 我把手伸进展示柜，尽量不直接碰到 Sekimeiya，将它拿了起来。{w}它相当冰凉。我并不认为碰一下就会把我送到很远的过去，可那样有可能让我被困在这栋楼里更久，所以我决定不再碰它。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Why are you holding it like that?
entries.new: ……你为什么要那样拿着它？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Do you not remember that either?
entries.new: 这件事你也不记得了？
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: ...{w}Oh, right...! It can send you to the past.
entries.new: ……{w}哦，对了……！它能把人送到过去。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: ...Yes.
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: I left to hallway B, unsettled by Erina's attitude, a part of me wondering if she was trying to deceive me.
entries.new: 我动身前往 B 走廊。Erina 的态度让我很不安，心里有点怀疑她是不是想骗我。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Have you gone to the past?
entries.new: ……你去过过去吗？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: What? Y-Yes. I guess you really don't remember.
entries.new: 什么？去、去过。看来你是真的不记得了。
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: ...I left the Sekimeiya in the cabinet.
entries.new: ……我把 Sekimeiya 留在展示柜里了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What did you do after?
entries.new: 之后你做了什么？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: What does that mean?
entries.new: 这是什么意思？
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: Did you change the past?
entries.new: 你改变了过去吗？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: To some degree. Why are you asking this?
entries.new: 算是改了一些。你为什么问这个？
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: Then, this is how...!
entries.new: 那么，原来是这样……！
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: When was the last time you saw the others?
entries.new: 你最后一次见到其他人是什么时候？
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: ...I don't remember.
entries.new: ……我不记得了。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: ...Oh, in the attic, I think. I haven't gone back.
entries.new: ……哦，我想是在阁楼吧。我没再回去过。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Why not? What about Isla?
entries.new: 为什么没回去？Isla 呢？
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: ...I was with her until just now.
entries.new: ……直到刚才，我还和她在一起。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: What? That's not what you said before.
entries.new: 什么？你刚才可不是这么说的。
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: No...? I didn't say anything about her.
entries.new: 不是……？我根本没提过她。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: You said you hadn't seen anyone in a while.
entries.new: 你说你已经有一阵子没见过任何人了。
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: O-Oh, I guess so. I didn't include her...
entries.new: 哦、哦，好像是。我没把她算进去……
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Why not? Where did you see her?
entries.new: 为什么不算？你是在哪儿见到她的？
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: She's still in the same room.
entries.new: 她还在原来那个房间。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: What room?
entries.new: 哪个房间？
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: We entered hallway A, and Erina brought me to the farthest crystal room.
entries.new: 我们走进 A走廊，Erina 把我带到了最里面的那间水晶展室。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: In the center of the smoke-stained walls, one of the cabinets was open. Within it, Isla rested, with a pale and somewhat peaceful expression.
entries.new: 在熏满烟痕的墙壁正中，有一具展示柜敞着。Isla 就躺在里面，面色苍白，神情甚至有几分安详。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: W-Wait, she's...?
entries.new: 等、等等，她……？
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: I-I knew it. You weren't here all this time. It wasn't me.
entries.new: 我、我就知道。这段时间你根本不在这里。不是我做的。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Of course I've been here! What happened to her?
entries.new: 我当然一直在这里！她到底怎么了？
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: Can't you see it? She was... killed. Was it you? You could have done it if it's true that you were here...!
entries.new: 你看不出来吗？她是被……被杀的。是你做的吗？如果你真的一直在这里，那你完全做得到……！
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: I don't know what you're talking about. Tell me directly. When did this happen?
entries.new: 我不知道你在说什么。直说吧，这事是什么时候发生的？
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: It was... many hours ago. It's been hours...!
entries.new: 那是……好几个小时前的事了。已经过去好几个小时了……！
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: ...{w}That's not true. You're mistaken. It couldn't have been more than three hours ago.
entries.new: ……{w}不对。你记错了。最多也就在三个小时前。
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: N-No... It's been more than that.
entries.new: 不、不是的……不止那么久。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: That wasn't right. I let go of the breath I'd been holding and looked at Isla again. It didn't seem like there was any blood around her, but her immobile face and chest were confirmation enough of her death.
entries.new: 不对。我呼出一直憋着的那口气，再次望向 Isla。她身边似乎没有血迹，可那张静止的脸和不再起伏的胸口，已经足以确认她死了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Erina had gone quiet too, and she was making no effort at hiding how much she was trying to focus. However, the thoughts whirling through her head were indecipherable.
entries.new: Erina 也沉默下来，毫不掩饰自己正拼命集中注意力。可她脑中翻涌的念头，我一点也看不透。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I waited, thinking she'd have something to say at any moment.
entries.new: 我等着，以为她随时会开口。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Was anyone else killed? I saw Katei's body in the security room.
entries.new: 还有别人被杀吗？我在监控室看到了 Katei 的尸体。
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: ...N-No. I don't think so.
entries.new: ……没、没有。我想没有。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: So, the rest were in the attic. I was utterly confused, but that seemed to be the conclusion. It was possible I was sleeping up there at that moment as well.
entries.new: 也就是说，其余人都在阁楼。我满心困惑，但结论似乎就是如此。说不定那一刻，我也正在上面睡着。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wha—!?{w=0.3} What are you doing!?
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: I still feel like I've never seen you before. ...Did you lock the cabinet?
entries.new: 我还是觉得从没见过你。……展示柜是你锁的吗？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: The cabinet...? No, I didn't.
entries.new: 展示柜……？不，不是我。
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: She had snatched the keys from my purse and was staring at them in her hand.
entries.new: 她从我的手包里抢过钥匙，正盯着手里那串钥匙看。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: These keys... Why do you have them?{w} Is this one for the cabi—
entries.new: 这些钥匙……你怎么会有？{w}这一把是展示柜的——
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: With a quick motion, I took them back, and she failed to react.
entries.new: 我飞快地把钥匙夺了回来，她甚至没来得及反应。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I don't get it! What do you—
entries.new: 我不明白！你到底——
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: ...iroya! Hey! Where are you!?
entries.new: ……iroya！喂！你在哪儿！？
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: Atsuki...!{w} Did he see her?
entries.new: Atsuki……！{w}他看到她了吗？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I dashed out of the room, paying no mind to Erina's surprise.
entries.new: 我顾不上 Erina 的惊讶，冲出了房间。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Shiroya! Can you hear me!?
entries.new: Shiroya！听得见吗！？
entries.speaker: a4

entries.text: The voice was coming from hallway B. Did that mean she was down there as well?
entries.new: 声音是从 B走廊传来的。这么说，她也在下面？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I rapidly reached the staircase and went up half of the way. From behind the gray door, I saw Erina's feet as she wandered in confusion.
entries.new: 我快步走到楼梯，上了半层。隔着灰色的门，我看见 Erina 的脚——她正茫然地来回踱步。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: —re okay, ri—!? If yo— ...me, ple— ...thing!
entries.new: ——没事吧，Shi——！？要是你——……听得见我，请——……说句话！
entries.speaker: a4

entries.text: The sound stopped soon after Erina followed it.
entries.new: Erina 循声而去，声音很快便停了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Did that mean that she'd been found, or had Atsuki given up?
entries.new: ……这是说找到她了，还是 Atsuki 放弃了？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: As I'd noticed earlier, the trail of blood had disappeared from there too. That meant it was still to happen.
entries.new: 正如先前注意到的那样，那里的血迹也消失了。也就是说，那件事还没有发生。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I began to slowly step down.
entries.new: 我慢慢走下楼梯。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I wondered what I'd be told if I showed myself, but it was hard to care about that with how much I wanted to know what the fuck was happening.
entries.new: 我很好奇自己露面后他们会说些什么，可比起弄清到底他妈发生了什么，这点顾虑实在算不上什么。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Erina wasn't there anymore. As I approached hallway B, the voices came back.
entries.new: Erina 已经不在了。我走近 B走廊，声音又传了过来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...earing them earlier, were you...?
entries.new: ……你刚才就听见了吧……？
entries.speaker: aki4

entries.text: Who the hell are you? Or even you... How can you two exist!?
entries.new: 你到底是什么人？还有你……你们俩怎么可能存在！？
entries.speaker: a4

entries.text: What? ...Does he really not know why she's here?
entries.new: 什么？……他真不知道她为什么会在这里？
entries.speaker: n
