entries.text: They sounded close to the lobby, but I didn't peek in.
entries.new: 听声音他们就在大厅附近，但我没有探头去看。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...not understand? Did— ...pop into existen—
entries.new: ……还不明白吗？难道——……凭空冒出来的——
entries.speaker: a4

entries.text: They opened a door. It must've been closer to me, as I started to understand them more easily. Erina was still clearly groggy, but I could make things out.
entries.new: 有人打开了门。那扇门应该离我更近了，他们的话我渐渐听得清楚。Erina 显然还昏昏沉沉，不过我已经能分辨出内容。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: About Erina, I think what happened isn't what you think.
entries.new: 关于 Erina，我想事情并不像你想的那样。
entries.speaker: s4

entries.text: What's with that tone of voice? When did she even get to know Erina?
entries.new: 这语气是怎么回事？她什么时候和 Erina 这么熟了？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Erina even accused me of not being here previously, so why didn't she say that to her too?{w} She's the one who hasn't been here, and earlier, it sounded like she was locked in the attic. Did the person above me do that? And that still has yet to happen...
entries.new: Erina 刚才还一口咬定我之前不在这里，那她怎么不对那一位也这么说？{w}明明不在场的是她，而且听刚才那番话，她像是被锁在阁楼里。是我上方那个人做的吗？而那件事同样还没发生……
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I'm not sure... I remember I was drawn to this room, and then I think I blacked out.
entries.new: 我也说不清……我记得自己像是被什么引到了这个房间，然后就没了意识。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: That was close to what she'd told me.
entries.new: 这和她对我说过的差不多。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Are you the same Shiroya who disappeared from the event room with Sai?
entries.new: ……你就是和 Sai 一起从活动室消失的那个 Shiroya 吗？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: ...I wish I could explain everything to you, but I still don't really know what happened.{w} But, yes. I'm really glad to see you again.
entries.new: ……我也希望能把一切都解释给你听，可我自己也还不太清楚发生了什么。{w}不过，没错。能再见到你，我真的很高兴。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: While I didn't understand Atsuki's question, it was clear something had happened while I was asleep. It all sounded like she was alive and neither of them knew how that had come to occur.
entries.new: 我不明白 Atsuki 的问题，但显然在我睡着的时候出了事。听起来她确实还活着，而他们两人都不知道这是怎么发生的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wh-What's with those clothes, then? Why is the cross not on them? Why did you ignore me when we saw each other in the event room and when I kept shouting your name?
entries.new: 那、那你这身衣服又是怎么回事？为什么上面没有十字？在活动室碰面的时候，还有我拼命喊你名字的时候，你为什么都不理我？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: ...Well, I—
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Hey... I'm still confused, but I have a question.
entries.new: 那个……我还是没搞明白，不过我有个问题。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: ...Huh?
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: The Sekimeiya... does it really make you travel through time?
entries.new: Sekimeiya……它真的能让人穿越时间吗？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: ...A girl? You saw Shiroya?
entries.new: ……女孩？你看见 Shiroya 了？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Um...{w} I guess it couldn't have been anyone else.{w} ...It must have been Shiroya.
entries.new: 嗯……{w}我想那也不可能是别人。{w}……一定是 Shiroya。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Erina asked for the Sekimeiya, but it sounded like neither of them knew where it was. However, despite Erina's condition, we had brought it to the event room minutes earlier, so she wasn't satisfied when she was told it wasn't there.
entries.new: Erina 向他们要 Sekimeiya，可听那口气，两人似乎都不知道它在哪儿。然而，就在几分钟前，我们不顾 Erina 的状况，把它带进了活动室；所以听说东西不在那儿，她并不甘心。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: That's not it at all... Remember that Sai and Akaro took the cabinet key. They probably have the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 根本不是这样……你忘了，展示柜的钥匙是 Sai 和 Akaro 拿走的。Sekimeiya 多半在他们手上。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Their words continued to make no sense. I was the one who had the key.
entries.new: 他们的话依旧让人摸不着头脑。钥匙明明在我手里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...They entered the event room. As soon as the door closed, it acted as a barrier for the sound inside.
entries.new: ……他们进了活动室。门一关上，里面的声音就被隔断了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Once I was certain the hallway was empty, I stepped in.
entries.new: 确认走廊里没人之后，我才走了进去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I approached the door and placed my ear against it.
entries.new: 我走到门边，把耳朵贴了上去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I couldn't hear anything.
entries.new: 什么也听不见。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Did they leave?
entries.new: 他们走了？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Finally, I heard a sound coming from the room. The opposite door had opened.
entries.new: 终于，屋里传来了动静。对面那扇门开了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...fuck— ...ing here?{w=0.4} ...succ— ...plan of—
entries.speaker: a4

entries.text: This door is too thick to make anything out... It sounds like he's close to the cabinet.
entries.new: 这扇门太厚，什么也听不清……听声音，他离展示柜很近。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I recognized Sai's voice, but not what he said.
entries.new: 那是 Sai 的声音，可他说的什么，我听不出来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: For as long as I stayed there, I didn't comprehend anything.{w} I knew I could be found out easily, but I wasn't against that. In fact, I considered opening the door, but I would listen from a distance for as long as I could.
entries.new: 我待在那儿的那段时间，一句话也没听懂。{w}我知道自己很容易被发现，却并不抗拒。甚至有一瞬想干脆推门进去，但终究还是想尽量隔着距离多听一会儿。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I silently entered the staff room. Then, I placed my ear against the left wall, which was directly next to the cabinet.
entries.new: 我悄声进了员工室，随后把耳朵贴到左侧墙上——那面墙紧挨着展示柜。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...as that?
entries.new: ……那是什么？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Don't mind me, like you said.
entries.new: 就像你说的，别管我。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: It was still hard to hear Sai, but the thin wall made Atsuki's voice interpretable.
entries.new: Sai 的声音依旧听不真切，但墙壁很薄，Atsuki 的话倒能辨清。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It's just a personal paper. ...nothing to do with you or the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 只是一张私人纸条。……跟你，还有 Sekimeiya，都没有关系。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Ve—
entries.new: Ve——
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: So, did any of you see Miiya...?
entries.new: 那么，你们有谁看见 Miiya 了吗……？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: There...! Is she gonna say it?
entries.new: 来了……！她要说了吗？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: You don't know her, right? I... I knew I wasn't going insane.
entries.new: 你们不认识她吧？我……我就知道我没疯。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: H-How do you know that name?
entries.new: 你、你怎么会知道那个名字？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Huh...?
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: She's the person I was with earlier, before I saw you two... It just came back to me. I don't know where she went, though.
entries.new: 她就是刚才和我在一起的人，在我看见你们俩之前……我刚刚才想起来。不过我不知道她去了哪里。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: What's with— ...elirious?
entries.new: 搞什么——……说胡话？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: That's not it. ...not just some name she made up.
entries.new: 不是那样。……那不是她随口编出来的名字。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Do you kno—
entries.new: 你们认识——
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...We do, but Erina couldn't have seen her. She couldn't be here.
entries.new: ……认识。可 Erina 不可能见到她。她不可能在这里。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: I couldn't process what I was hearing. Was I actually being punished? That insane possibility was only becoming more of a reality.
entries.new: 我无法理解自己听到的一切。难道我真的在受罚？那个荒唐的可能性，正一点点变成现实。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: That's not what she means... She's not anywhere right now.
entries.new: 她不是这个意思……她现在不在任何地方。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Oh? ...dead?
entries.new: 哦？……死了？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Dead...?{w} Are they really talking about me?
entries.new: 死了……？{w}他们真的在说我吗？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: What the fuck is this...? Of course I'm not dead!
entries.new: 这他妈算什么……？我当然没死！
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Shut up.
entries.new: 闭嘴。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: ...right? ...saving with— ...kimeiya not—
entries.new: ……对吧？……用来救——……kimeiya 不——
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Sai, shut the fuck up. If it was, I promise you that we would've done it.
entries.new: Sai，你他妈给我闭嘴。要是能救，我保证我们早就做了。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: I was right there. I'd been right there the whole time...! What were they talking about!?
entries.new: 我就在那儿。我一直都在那儿……！他们到底在说什么！？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I didn't know whether I should have entered the room or not. I was a lot more hesitant, and it almost felt as if they knew that I was listening in on them.
entries.new: 我不知道自己该不该进那个房间。我更犹豫了，甚至觉得他们仿佛知道我正在门外偷听。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It's probably been— ...minutes already, right?
entries.new: 大概已经——……过了几分钟了吧？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: ...fifteen min—... arrived.
entries.new: ……十五分——……到的。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Are you sure I'll go far enough back?
entries.new: 你确定我能回到足够早的时间？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: ...I'm going, then. ...you coming with me?
entries.new: ……那我走了。……你要一起来吗？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Is she about to touch the Sekimeiya...?
entries.new: 她这是要碰 Sekimeiya 了吗……？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: ...She said earlier she wanted to save Isla. Did they figure out how to use the Sekimeiya? They've only been there a few minutes...
entries.new: ……她刚才还说想救 Isla。是他们弄清楚了 Sekimeiya 的用法吗？可他们到那儿才不过几分钟……
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Was the past going to be changed? That could have already been happening.
entries.new: 过去是不是就要被改写了？也许那早就在发生了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It was possible that the past had changed drastically while I'd been unconscious. Was I living in a world completely different from the one I'd gone to sleep in?
entries.new: 在我失去意识的这段时间里，过去也许已经发生了翻天覆地的改变。如今我所处的世界，还和我入睡前的那个世界相同吗？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What...?
entries.new: 什么……？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Wait... what?
entries.new: 等等……怎么回事？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Why didn't it work!? Did Sai disappear?{w} Was everything that he said a lie...?
entries.new: 为什么没有生效！？Sai 消失了吗？{w} 难道他说的一切都是谎话……？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: I couldn't tell what had happened. Had Sai left, or had he time traveled?
entries.new: 我分不清到底发生了什么。Sai 是走了，还是穿越了时间？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...you ever want me to save Isla? ...you involved in the first place!?
entries.new: ……你什么时候想过要我去救 Isla？……你又到底是怎么卷进来的！？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: You're wrong. We don't know how the Sekimeiya works, but this shouldn't have happened...
entries.new: 你错了。我们确实不知道 Sekimeiya 的原理，但这种事本不该发生……
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Had nothing happened...? I'd been completely frozen for minutes, trying to pick up everything I could.
entries.new: 难道什么都没发生……？我整个人僵在原地好几分钟，竭力捕捉着每一丝动静。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Wait! Where did it go!?{w} It's not here!
entries.new: ……等等！它去哪了！？{w} 不在这里！
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: It... teleported.
entries.new: 它……传送走了。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: The Sekimeiya... teleported.
entries.new: Sekimeiya……传送走了。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: It was activated, but they didn't vanish—only the Sekimeiya teleported. That's happened before...
entries.new: 它被启动了，但他们并没有消失——只有 Sekimeiya 传送走了。这种情况以前也发生过……
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Atsuki, tell me... What do I need to do to travel through time?
entries.new: Atsuki，告诉我……我到底要怎么做，才能穿越时间？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Exactly what Sai and I told you. I don't know why it didn't work just now.
entries.new: 就像我和 Sai 告诉你的那样。刚才为什么没生效，我也不知道。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: They haven't experienced this before... Is that it?
entries.new: 他们以前没遇到过这种情况……是这样吗？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: That idea was the driving force that made me immediately turn around and dash to the door.
entries.new: 正是这个念头，让我当即转身冲向门口。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...!{w} It's closed...! I didn't close it.
entries.new: ……！{w} 门关上了……！可我没关过啊。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: The Sekimeiya had seemingly vanished by itself. I'd just had an epiphany, but instead of trying to think everything through, I opened the door and ran to hallway C.
entries.new: Sekimeiya 似乎是自己凭空消失的。我刚刚灵光一闪，却顾不上细想，推开门便朝 C走廊奔去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There's still no blood here.
entries.new: 这里还是没有血。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: And this door...
entries.new: 还有这扇门……
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Dismissing the elevator, I stepped up. There, I ran across the floor, releasing all my built-up energy. As soon as I reached the next staircase, I did the same.
entries.new: 我放弃电梯，改走楼梯。踏上那层楼后，我在走廊里全力奔跑，将积攒的力气尽数倾泻而出。一到下一段楼梯，我又如法炮制。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: So that nothing would fall out, I held my purse tightly and continued running, planning on reaching the highest place in the building.
entries.new: 为了不让东西掉出来，我紧紧按住手提包继续奔跑，打算一直跑到这栋楼最高的地方。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I didn't slow down, knowing that if I did, my exhaustion would catch up with me. I bolted up the fourth staircase and continued in a straight line.
entries.new: 我知道一旦放慢脚步，疲惫就会追上来，于是始终没有减速。我冲上第四段楼梯，继续笔直向前。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Delayed Reflection
entries.new: 迟来的倒影

entries.text: Whoa...!
entries.new: 呜哇……！
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Atsuki...!
entries.new: Atsuki……！
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: I stopped abruptly and almost fell down. If Atsuki was there, did that mean that I'd been right?
entries.new: 我猛地停住，差点摔倒。Atsuki 在那里——那是不是说明我猜对了？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wh-What happened?
entries.new: 怎、怎么了？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: I had to pant hoarsely before I could speak again. Meanwhile, I thought of the question I wanted to ask, realizing he hadn't found my presence strange.
entries.new: 我喘了好一阵粗气，才终于能重新开口。趁这工夫，我理清了想问的话，也意识到他并没有觉得我出现在这里有什么奇怪。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Th-This might sound strange, but... wh-what's the last place where you saw me?
entries.new: ……这、这话可能有点奇怪……你最后一次见到我，是在哪里？
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: The last place...? That's what I was gonna say. I saw you weren't sleeping anymore, so I was walking down to see if I could find where you'd gone.
entries.new: 最后一次见到你……？这话该我说才对。我看你已经醒了，就下楼来找，想看看你去了哪儿。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: ...{w}Then were you above me... in the bedroom?
entries.new: ……{w}那你刚才是在我上面……在卧室里？
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: Oh, yes. Sorry, was I noisy? I just climbed down the ladder and saw you weren't there anymore.
entries.new: 哦，对。抱歉，是我吵到你了吗？我刚从梯子爬下来，就发现你已经不在那儿了。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: I couldn't believe it. It was him, the Atsuki I'd been with the whole day. However, on the crystal floor, there was another Atsuki—one who had said I couldn't be there.
entries.new: 我几乎不敢相信。是他，是陪了我一整天的那个 Atsuki。可水晶层上还有另一个 Atsuki——那个说我不该出现在那里的人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Anyway, what were you in such a rush for? And that question...?
entries.new: ……话说回来，你那么急是要干什么？还有刚才那个问题……
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: ...No, I was just going back up. I didn't realize you were in the attic too.
entries.new: ……没什么，我只是正要回去。没想到你也在阁楼里。
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: Oh.
entries.new: 哦。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: ...Do you want to go up, then?
entries.new: ……那，要一起上去吗？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Yes, we can stay there.
entries.new: 嗯，就在上面待着吧。
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: Did you see anyone? They were all still waiting when I went to the attic.
entries.new: 你看到别人了吗？我上阁楼的时候，他们都还等在那儿。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: I didn't.
entries.new: 没看到。
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: I see.{w} ...It should already be pretty late, but you still have the cabinet key, right?
entries.new: 这样啊。{w} ……时间应该已经不早了，不过展示柜的钥匙还在你那儿吧？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Yeah.
entries.new: 嗯。
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: We walked up, but my heart hadn't slowed down yet. What kind of mess were we in? No matter the answer, the right call was ignoring it and trying to make the time pass without complications.
entries.new: 我们顺着楼梯走了上去，我的心跳却迟迟没有平复。我们到底卷进了什么样的麻烦？无论答案是什么，最妥当的做法都是不去理会，让这段时间平平淡淡地过去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: And yet I couldn't get the words out of my head. According to the people on the crystal floor, I should've been dead.
entries.new: 可那些话始终在我脑海里挥之不去。按水晶展室那些人的说法，我本该已经死了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Suddenly, a head appeared from around the office corridor. When we looked at each other, the three of us froze, everyone equally shocked.
entries.new: 忽然，办公室走廊的拐角探出一个脑袋。视线相触的一瞬间，我们三个人都僵在原地，谁都一样震惊。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What the fuck...?
entries.new: 搞什么……？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: It was Atsuki. A body identical to him, with his face and clothes, who had been waiting by the door to the offices. He looked at himself, speechless, and without moving an inch.
entries.new: 那是 Atsuki。一模一样的身形，同样的面孔和衣着，一直守在通往办公室的门口。他望着自己，一句话也说不出，连半步都没有挪动。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Hey, answer me! You really were here... Are you really me? What the fuck is going on!?
entries.new: 喂，回答我！你真的在这里……你真的是我吗？这到底是怎么回事！？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: For him, it must've been a surreal shock, but I looked at the bizarre scene with just as much confusion. Were there three versions of Atsuki in the building at once?
entries.new: 对他来说，眼前的一切一定像做梦一样不真实；而我看这场怪异的场面，同样满心困惑。这栋楼里同时存在三个 Atsuki？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Finally, the person in front of us spoke.
entries.new: 终于，面前的那个人开口了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I didn't think you'd be here.
entries.new: ……我没想到你会在这里。
entries.speaker: c2a2

entries.text: Wh-What!? What does that mean!? You're me, right?
entries.new: 什、什么！？这话是什么意思！？你是我吧？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: ...I am.
entries.speaker: c2a2

entries.text: What the fuck is happening, then!? I thought it was impossible that we'd see each other. Was that wrong?
entries.new: 那这到底是怎么回事！？我原以为我们不可能碰面。难道我想错了？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: In a way, yes.
entries.new: 某种意义上，是想错了。
entries.speaker: c2a2

entries.text: What the fuck...? Tell me, then! What's going on!? How the fuck can you even exist!?
entries.new: 搞什么啊……？那就告诉我！到底发生了什么！？你到底是怎么存在的！？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: While I had no idea of how to interpret the scene, it was clear the Atsuki we'd bumped into had a higher understanding of what was happening. It didn't seem he found my existence strange either.
entries.new: 我完全不知道该怎么理解眼前这一幕，但很明显，我们撞见的这个 Atsuki 对局势的了解要深得多。他似乎也不觉得我的存在有什么奇怪。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I'm sorry, I'm not sure how to answer that question.
entries.new: ……抱歉，这个问题我不知道该怎么回答。
entries.speaker: c2a2

entries.text: What...!?
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: I know exactly how you feel, I promise. I will tell you one thing, though, since we've already met: you shouldn't worry about anything.
entries.new: 我完全明白你现在的感受，真的。不过既然我们已经碰上了，我就告诉你一件事：你什么都不用担心。
entries.speaker: c2a2

entries.text: I shouldn't worry? There's no way you're actually me, right?
entries.new: 不用担心？你根本不可能是真正的我吧？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: ...I am. I promise, it will all be fine.
entries.new: ……我就是。我保证，一切都会没事的。
entries.speaker: c2a2

entries.text: Wh-What...? How can you tell? And how would that even be possible!?
entries.new: 什、什么……？你怎么知道？而且这怎么可能！？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: I know how it sounds, but I genuinely don't have time to explain, and I'm not sure I could.
entries.new: 我知道这话听起来很荒唐，但我真的没时间解释，也未必解释得清楚。
entries.speaker: c2a2

entries.text: What does that even mean...!?
entries.new: 这算什么话……！？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Look, we're the same person. Just trust me, or yourself, on this. Sincerely, everything should turn out fine.
entries.new: 听着，我们是同一个人。这件事，你就信我，也就是信你自己。我说真的，一切都会顺利的。
entries.speaker: c2a2

entries.text: Those words almost broke the person at my side. He'd been told by himself that there was nothing to fear.
entries.new: 这句话几乎击溃了我身旁的人。告诉他不用害怕的，正是他自己。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: You believe me, right? Like I said, I don't have much time.
entries.new: 你信我，对吧？我说过，我时间不多。
entries.speaker: c2a2

entries.text: Emotional, Atsuki nodded.
entries.new: Atsuki 情绪激动地点了点头。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But that c-can't be the case...! Shiroya... died again!
entries.new: 可、可这不可能啊……！Shiroya……又死了！
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Again? What do you mean?
entries.new: 又？你什么意思？
entries.speaker: c2a2

entries.text: Do you not know that? She was killed here, and her body disappeared from the lobby!
entries.new: 你不知道吗？她在这里被杀了，尸体却从大厅里消失了！
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: The other Atsuki looked confused and deep in thought.
entries.new: 另一个 Atsuki 面露困惑，陷入了沉思。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: You should believe what I say. I still don't fully understand how that works, but you have to trust me.
entries.new: 你该相信我说的话。这到底是怎么回事，我还没完全弄明白，但你得信我。
entries.speaker: c2a2

entries.text: ...You can't explain it? Then there's no way you're actually telling the truth, right?
entries.new: ……你解释不了？那你说的就不可能是真的吧？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: I am. While I can't be fully confident about what I'm saying, I'll just ask you to believe me.
entries.new: 是真的。虽然我对自己的话也没有十足把握，但我只能请你相信我。
entries.speaker: c2a2

entries.text: ...{w}Okay.
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: ...Good. I suppose there's one thing you could do, then.
entries.new: ……很好。既然如此，我想有件事你可以做。
entries.speaker: c2a2

entries.text: What?
entries.new: 什么？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Wait here a second.
entries.new: 在这儿等一下。
entries.speaker: c2a2

entries.text: He disappeared from where he'd come after giving me an intense gaze. I was right next to them, but I felt more distant than ever before.
entries.new: 他深深地看了我一眼，随即消失在他来的方向。我明明就站在他们旁边，却觉得自己从未如此遥远。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Was that a future version of you?
entries.new: ……那是未来的你吗？
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: I-I have no idea.
entries.new: 我、我不知道。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Then, is that true...? Will Shiroya be all right?
entries.new: 那他说的是真的吗……？Shiroya 会没事吗？
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: ...I don't know. I thought I'd try to use the Sekimeiya a bit later and go a few hours to the past... Th-That wouldn't be enough, but if I managed to keep doing that... That's the only idea I had, but I didn't even know if the Sekimeiya would work again.
entries.new: ……我不知道。我本来打算过一阵子试着用 Sekimeiya，回到几个小时之前……那、那点时间根本不够，可要是能一直反复这么做……我只想到这个办法，可连 Sekimeiya 还能不能再用都不知道。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: I see. ...Whoever that was, we have to put all our faith in him.
entries.new: 原来如此。……不管那人究竟是谁，我们也只能把全部希望都寄托在他身上了。
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: ...Yeah.
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: He soon came back running. Between his hands was the Sekimeiya. It seemed like it might've teleported to the attic that time.
entries.new: 他很快就跑了回来，双手捧着 Sekimeiya。看来那一次，它大概是传送到了阁楼。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Huh...?
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Take this, but don't touch it.
entries.new: 拿好，但别用手碰它。
entries.speaker: c2a2

entries.text: Atsuki handed himself the Sekimeiya and received it, hiding his hands under his sleeves.
entries.new: Atsuki 把 Sekimeiya 交到另一个自己手里，再由自己接了过去，双手都缩在袖子里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: You two should hurry back down. On the second floor, enter the second partition, leave the Sekimeiya {tip=floor}on the floor{/tip}, and wait there.
entries.new: 你们俩赶紧下楼去。到二楼，进第二间隔间，把 Sekimeiya 放在{tip=floor}地上{/tip}，就在那儿等着。
entries.speaker: c2a2

entries.text: On the second floor?
entries.new: 二楼？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Yes. From there, if anyone passes by, you should hear them. If you hear the elevator four times, you can go back down and place the Sekimeiya in its cabinet. Make sure that it isn't activated again.
entries.new: 对。待在那里，只要有人经过，你们应该都能听见。要是听到电梯响四次，就可以下楼，把 Sekimeiya 放回它的展示柜里。务必确保它不会再被启动。
entries.speaker: c2a2

entries.text: However, it's possible that the first time, instead of hearing the elevator, you'll hear someone running up. If that happens, once you hear the elevator two times, you can go down and place the Sekimeiya in the cabinet.
entries.new: 不过，第一次你听到的可能不是电梯，而是有人跑上楼的脚步声。若是那样，等电梯响过两次，你们就可以下楼，把 Sekimeiya 放回展示柜。
entries.speaker: c2a2

entries.text: O-Okay, and... after that, you're saying everything will be fine, right?
entries.new: 好、好的，那……之后，你是说一切都会没事，对吧？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Yes. Wait patiently with everyone on the crystal floor and make sure to get out safely. I'll pray with you for what will happen after that.
entries.new: 对。和大家一起在水晶层耐心等着，务必平安离开。至于之后会发生什么，我会和你们一同祈祷。
entries.speaker: c2a2

entries.text: All... All right.
entries.new: 好……好吧。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Atsuki turned around and ran back, putting all his faith in himself. As he did, the second Atsuki pierced me with his eyes.
entries.new: Atsuki 转过身，把一切都托付给自己，跑了回去。就在那时，第二个 Atsuki 的目光锐利地落在我身上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Goodbye, Miiya.
entries.new: 再见了，Miiya。
entries.speaker: c2a2

entries.text: In front of me, I saw a look I knew I'd seen before that day. However, he quickly turned it away from me, glancing downward.
entries.new: 我在他脸上看到了那副神情，知道自己在那天之前见过。然而，他很快移开视线，垂下了眼。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Goodbye.
entries.new: 再见。
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: Almost in a curious manner, I responded with only one word. Then, I turned around and started sprinting.
entries.new: 我几乎带着几分好奇，只应了这一个词，随即转身拔腿奔了出去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Atsuki and I ran all the way down until we reached the second floor. Out of breath, he held the door to the offices open, and we entered the second one.
entries.new: 我和 Atsuki 一路跑下楼，来到二楼。他气喘吁吁地撑住办公室的门，我们进了第二间。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: He placed the Sekimeiya on the floor as instructed and stepped away from it.
entries.new: 他照吩咐把 Sekimeiya 放在地上，随即退开。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There's no way this can work—whatever's about to happen...
entries.new: 这怎么可能行得通……不管接下来会发生什么。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Why not?
entries.new: 为什么不行？
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: ...He didn't know she had died again. I had the idea that she could be saved by going to the past and hiding her since she wasn't found, but doesn't this mean that she'll end up here and be killed?
entries.new: 他不知道她又死了一次。我原以为，既然没人找到她，回到过去把她藏起来就能救她；可照现在这样，她岂不是终究会来到这里，然后被杀掉？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Well, whoever that Atsuki was, he knew more than we do, and when you told him we'd found her dead, he still said it would be fine.
entries.new: 不管那个 Atsuki 是谁，他知道的都比我们多。你跟他说我们发现她死了的时候，他不还是说会没事吗。
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: That's true...
entries.new: 说得也是……
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Her body disappeared from the lobby even though we still remember it. Maybe that's what indicates that the past will be changed so she doesn't die here either.
entries.new: 她的尸体从大厅消失了，可我们都还记得。也许这恰恰说明，过去会被改写，她也不会死在这里。
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: Would it work like this...?{w} It might. The proof that she's dead doesn't exist anymore.
entries.new: 会是这样吗……？{w}也许吧。证明她死了的证据，如今已经不存在了。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: He can't just be a future self of mine; that wouldn't make any sense. ...The way he came to exist might be how he'll try to save Shiroya, but I have no idea what it could be.
entries.new: 他不可能只是未来的我，那样根本说不通。……他出现的方式，也许正是他打算用来救 Shiroya 的手段，可我完全猜不到那是什么。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: I heard a faint, deep sound.
entries.new: 我听见一声低沉而微弱的响动。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...That's the elevator, right? This is the first time.
entries.new: ……是电梯吧？这是第一次。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Yeah. He said that he didn't have much time and was right in saying that the elevator would be used.
entries.new: 嗯。他说自己时间不多，还说电梯会被用到——这一点他果然说对了。
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: So we have to hear it three more times until we can leave.
entries.new: 所以还得再听到三次，我们才能走。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: The second time came immediately.
entries.new: 第二次紧跟着就来了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Oh. It went through twice because it was called and then used.
entries.new: ……哦。先是有人叫电梯，然后坐了上去，所以它响了两次。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Where should the elevator have been?
entries.new: 电梯本来应该停在哪儿？
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: It was in the attic the last time I checked, from the time I went there. If that was still the case, someone just went up.
entries.new: 我上去那趟看过，它当时停在阁楼。要是之后没动过，那就是有人刚坐它上去了。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: That must be it. It's just like he said, either the elevator would be used twice or someone would run up.
entries.new: 一定是这样。就跟他说的一样——要么电梯被用两次，要么有人跑上楼。
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: ...So he knew someone would go to the attic, but not how.
entries.new: ……也就是说，他知道有人会去阁楼，却不知道是怎么去的。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: And at some point, it will happen again.{w} We're supposed to hear the elevator two more times. That means it'll end up in the attic again.
entries.new: 而且过一会儿，同样的事还会再发生一次。{w}我们还要再听到两次电梯声，也就是说，它最后还是会停在阁楼。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: ...If you're saying that wasn't a future version of you, how is it possible he knew all this?
entries.new: ……你说那不是未来的你，那他怎么会知道这些？
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: ...{w}I don't know.{w} It doesn't make any sense, does it? The flow of time wouldn't work like that. It's impossible.{w} ...Also, he told us to wait safely and get out of the tower. There's no way I'll be able to use the Sekimeiya once we're outside, and that still wouldn't make any sense. Nothing does.
entries.new: ……{w}我不知道。{w}这根本说不通，不是吗？时间的流动不会是这样的。不可能。{w}……还有，他让我们安稳地等着，然后离开这座塔。可一旦到了外面，我根本用不了 Sekimeiya，那样也还是说不通。没有一件事说得通。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: He's right. But she's on the crystal floor, alongside a third Atsuki. It can't be that the world was changed so that she never died, because that Atsuki was surprised to see her too.{w} One of them was probably who went up to the attic, but what will come out of this? Will different versions of us remain? The other Atsuki didn't make it sound like that.
entries.new: 他说得没错。可她就在水晶层，身边还有第三个 Atsuki。世界不可能被改写成她从未死过——那个 Atsuki 见到她时，同样一脸惊讶。{w}上楼去阁楼的，多半就是他们当中的一个，可这样又能得出什么结果？我们这些不同的版本会同时留下来吗？另一个 Atsuki 的说法听起来并不是这样。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: ...I should have been dead. Why?
entries.new: ……我本该已经死了。为什么？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: {tip=dead}{i}I should be dead. Atsuki was right.{/i}{/tip} I should be, but I'm not.
entries.new: {tip=dead}{i}我本该已经死了。Atsuki 说得没错。{/i}{/tip}我本该死了，却没有死。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: ...It can't be they were talking about that, can it?
entries.new: ……他们说的，不会就是这件事吧？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: The answer had to revolve around the Sekimeiya's disappearance. Maybe, whenever that occurred, the changes made were applied to the world.
entries.new: 答案一定与 Sekimeiya 的消失有关。也许它每次消失，那些改动就会作用在这个世界上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It had teleported to the attic, so if nothing else happened, the state of the world would stay as it was.{w} But there were so many things to iron out. Three Atsukis existed at once. She had appeared out of nowhere in front of one of them. Not all the disappeared corpses had reappeared alive.
entries.new: 它传送到了阁楼，所以只要别的什么都没发生，世界的状态就会维持原样。{w}可需要理顺的地方太多了。三个 Atsuki 同时存在；她凭空出现在其中一个面前；消失的尸体也并非全都活着回来了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Was everything really going to resolve itself if we buried our heads in the sand until we could leave the building?
entries.new: 难道我们只要装作什么都没看见，一直等到能离开这栋楼，一切就真的会自行了结吗？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...And the Sekimeiya was in the attic. Did it teleport there, or did he unlock the cabinet with a key of his own?
entries.new: ……而且 Sekimeiya 就在阁楼里。是它自己传送过去的，还是他用自己手上的钥匙打开了展示柜？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: I don't know, but I still have the keys. I should probably leave them somewhere before we get out.
entries.new: 我不知道。不过钥匙还在我这儿。出去之前，最好还是找个地方处理掉。
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: ...Did we lock the cabinet the last time?
entries.new: ……上次我们锁展示柜了吗？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Oh, you're right. I said I'd go to the attic and we never locked it.
entries.new: 啊，你说得对。我当时说要去阁楼，结果就没锁。
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: So he just brought it up.
entries.new: 所以他直接把它搬上去了。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: ...In fact, the Sekimeiya had moved twice before. Erina and I had found it in a cabinet in room B4, next to Naomi's moved body. In the future, it was in one of the lockers, and it wasn't Naomi's. We'd never seen which one was Katei's, so it might've been his.
entries.new: ……其实，Sekimeiya 之前已经移动过两次。我和 Erina 是在 B4 房间的展示柜里发现它的，就在被移动过的 Naomi 的尸体旁边。而在未来，它被放在其中一个储物柜里，而且不是 Naomi 的柜子。我们从没见过哪个是 Katei 的，所以那很可能就是他的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It was all tied together. When I'd found the Sekimeiya in the staff room, there had been blood on the crystal floor. When Atsuki had seen that I was no longer sleeping, no yells had come from the opposite bedroom.
entries.new: 这一切都串起来了。我在员工室找到 Sekimeiya 时，水晶层上有血迹。Atsuki 发现我已经不再沉睡时，对面卧室里也没有传来喊声。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But there was no way to make sense of it. Had the blood on the crystal floor disappeared at the same time as the Sekimeiya? Even if so, it was all far too volatile, and I didn't know what had happened while I was asleep.
entries.new: 可我还是理不出头绪。水晶层上的血迹，是和 Sekimeiya 一起消失的吗？就算如此，这一切变数也实在太多，我睡着的时候究竟发生了什么，我无从得知。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: A very important question came to mind.
entries.new: 我忽然想到一个极为关键的问题。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: In the bedroom... did you turn on the light?
entries.new: 在卧室里……你开灯了吗？
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: Oh, yes, sorry. I didn't know you were there.
entries.new: 啊，开了，抱歉。我不知道你在那儿。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: I mean later, when you were already above.
entries.new: 我是说后来，你已经上楼之后。
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: Hm? No, I didn't. I'm confused by what you mean.{w} I came down, and it seemed like you weren't there because I couldn't hear you. I did turn on the light to confirm it, but you were already gone. Is that what you meant?
entries.new: 嗯？没有。你这么说我倒糊涂了。{w}我下楼的时候听不到你的声音，以为你不在。我确实开灯确认过，可你已经走了。你问的是这个吗？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: ...{w}Yes, sorry. I thought someone might have turned it on after you came.
entries.new: ……{w}对，抱歉。我以为你下来之后，有人开过灯。
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: I don't know. I didn't hear anything.
entries.new: 我不知道。我什么都没听见。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: I see.
entries.new: 原来如此。
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: What the hell, then?
entries.new: 那到底是怎么回事？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I don't even know if turning off the light in the upper bedroom would've turned it off where I was anyway.{w} This doesn't make any sense...!
entries.new: 我甚至不确定，关掉楼上卧室的灯，会不会也把我那边的灯关掉。{w}这根本说不通……！
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I sat on one of the chairs. I couldn't be too frustrated—the outcome had already been guaranteed. We'd soon make it out, and she was probably going to magically revive.
entries.new: 我在一把椅子上坐下。也不必太焦躁——反正结果早就注定了。我们很快就会出去，而她多半会像奇迹一样活过来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Oh, fuck...
entries.new: 妈的……
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I should leave the keys somewhere before we get out because they'll look at my purse...
entries.new: 出去之前，我得把钥匙放到别处，因为他们会翻我的包……
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: And there was one more thing that couldn't be found.
entries.new: 此外，还有一样东西不能被人找到。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...It was fine. I'd just have to flush it down the toilet or something.
entries.new: ……没关系。大不了冲进马桶里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I realized the contents of my purse could be seen from where it was on the floor, so I slowly moved it aside.
entries.new: 我意识到包就这么放在地上，里面的东西会被人看见，便慢慢把它挪到一边。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wait...{w} ...Is it not here?
entries.new: 等等……{w}……不在这里？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: I stared at my purse, baffled. Then, I grabbed it and took the keys out.
entries.new: 我茫然地盯着自己的包，随后一把抓过来，把钥匙取了出来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Yeah, I'll leave these somewhere. I'd rather not be asked about why I had them.
entries.new: ……嗯，我会找个地方把它们处理掉。我不想被人问起为什么带着这些钥匙。
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: I'm sure it'd be fine anyway.
entries.new: 反正我觉得不会有事。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: {tip=note}It wasn't there.{/tip} In my purse were the keyring, the tickets we'd bought for the event, our identification, and our keys.
entries.new: {tip=note}它不在那里。{/tip}我的包里只有钥匙串、我们为活动买的门票、证件，还有我们自己的钥匙。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Was it really taken while I was asleep...?
entries.new: 真的是在我睡着的时候被拿走的吗……？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: There's no way.
entries.new: 不可能。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Wait, no.{w} I bet I know what happened.
entries.new: 等等，不对。{w}我想我知道是怎么回事了。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: It disappeared. That's it.
entries.new: 它消失了。就是这么回事。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: At some point, it disappeared from my purse and from this world. That's what's been happening. As Atsuki said, in this world, there's no remaining proof that she's dead.
entries.new: 不知什么时候，它从我的包里、从这个世界上消失了。一直都是这样。就像 Atsuki 说的，在这个世界里，已经没有任何能证明她死了的东西。
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: There was nothing else to care about. Knowing that, calmly waiting felt much more doable than before.
entries.new: 再没有别的可担心的事了。想通这一点，静静等待也比先前从容得多。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I remained sitting on that chair, unable to hear anything beyond Atsuki's breathing.
entries.new: 我一直坐在那把椅子上，除了 Atsuki 的呼吸声，什么也听不见。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It was many minutes later when we heard the elevator for the third time.
entries.new: 又过了好几分钟，我们第三次听到了电梯的声音。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There it is...!
entries.new: 来了……！
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Let's see if we hear it again immediately.
entries.new: 看看会不会马上又响一次。
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: We did. Just a minute later, the fourth came.
entries.new: 果然。仅仅一分钟后，第四次声响就传来了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: All right, let's go... Hopefully, nobody sees us.
entries.new: 好，走吧……希望别被人看见。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: I opened the door, and Atsuki crouched to grab the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 我打开门，Atsuki 蹲下身去拿 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: How the fuck can it be this hot...!? It hurts to even get my fingers close to it.
entries.new: 这玩意儿怎么会烫成这样……！？手指一靠近就疼。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: We heard an unexpected sound.
entries.new: 我们听到了意料之外的声响。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Oh, what...?
entries.new: 咦，什么……？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: We both listened more intently, and I could tell that we were hearing footsteps coming from the staircase leading down.
entries.new: 我们两人都凝神细听，我听出那是从下行楼梯传来的脚步声。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: W-Wait, it should be fine, right...?
entries.new: 等、等等，应该没事吧……？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: What the fuck...!? What are you doing here!?
entries.new: 搞什么鬼……！？你们在这里做什么！？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Sai saw me through the glass. Next to him was Akaro, even though his running hadn't been heard from inside.
entries.new: Sai 隔着玻璃看见了我。他身旁是 Akaro，尽管从里面听不到他跑动的声音。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Atsuki! Come here! I fucking see the Sekimeiya!
entries.new: Atsuki！快过来！我他妈看见 Sekimeiya 了！
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What did you do...? You didn't stop on this floor, right?
entries.new: 你干了什么……？你没在这一层停下吧？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Huh...?
entries.new: 什么……？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Don't be stupid. He has the Sekimeiya. He probably used it.
entries.new: 别装傻。Sekimeiya 就在他手上。多半是他用的。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Do you mean that I just took the elevator?
entries.new: 你是说，刚才坐电梯的是我？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Holy shit, man. Will this attitude stop?{w} Why were you waiting here? You knew we'd go up, right? Was your idea to make us chase you to then touch the Sekimeiya and wait here to sneak back down?
entries.new: 我靠，你这副态度有完没完？{w} 你守在这儿做什么？你早知道我们要上去吧？你是想引我们追过来，自己碰了 Sekimeiya，再守在这里偷偷溜下去？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...I didn't do any of that.
entries.new: ……这些我一件都没做过。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: He probably understood it. Another version of Atsuki had just used the elevator. That was why Sai was accusing him of touching the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 他大概已经明白了。刚才用电梯的是另一个 Atsuki，所以 Sai 才咬定他碰过 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: However, while he probably thought it was the version he'd spoken with, he was unaware of the other one who'd been on the crystal floor.
entries.new: 可是，他多半以为那是与自己说过话的那个分身，并不知道还有另一个 Atsuki 曾待在水晶层。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What now, then? What were you planning to do with that Sekimeiya? As I thought, you're also in on this plan, right?
entries.new: 那现在呢？你打算拿那台 Sekimeiya 做什么？果然，你也参与了这个计划吧？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Me...?{w} I don't even know what you're talking about.
entries.new: 我……？{w} 我根本不知道你在说什么。
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: Even though fainter, we perceived the same sound. The elevator had just been used.
entries.new: 那声音虽轻，我们却听得分明。电梯刚刚被人用过。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: That was the elevator, and I bet I know who that is.
entries.new: 是电梯。我敢说我知道是谁。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Who...?
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Atsuki looked a little uncertain. There had been no mention of a fifth elevator sound.
entries.new: Atsuki 的神情有些迟疑。此前谁也没提过第五次电梯声。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Who? The girl who I bet was supposed to meet with you two right now, after you'd made it down from here with the Sekimeiya. It's unfortunate you were too incompetent to handle such a simple plan.
entries.new: 谁？就是本该现在来和你们俩碰面的那个女孩吧——在你们带着 Sekimeiya 从这层下去之后。可惜你们太不中用，这么简单的计划都办砸了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...What?{w} I'm being serious. I have absolutely no idea what you're talking about. What girl?
entries.new: ……什么？{w} 我是认真的。我完全不知道你在说什么。什么女孩？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: I'm not sure what the idea behind this is, really. Were you actually able to open the storeroom door?
entries.new: 我真不明白这到底打的什么主意。你们真把储藏室的门打开了？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...{w}Answer me. What girl?
entries.new: ……{w} 回答我。什么女孩？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: *sigh*
entries.new: *叹气*
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What even was her name, Akaro?
entries.new: 她到底叫什么来着，Akaro？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...Hm.{w} ...Shiroya, right?
entries.new: ……嗯。{w} ……Shiroya，对吧？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: The sixth time came. The elevator passed through our floor as Atsuki's eyes widened. He understood it immediately: she was already present.
entries.new: 第六次来了。电梯经过我们这一层时，Atsuki 眼睛猛地睁大。他立刻明白了：她已经到了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Oh, fuck... She realized you hadn't come and went back up.
entries.new: 妈的……她发现你们没下来，又折上去了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Sai sprinted toward the third floor.
entries.new: Sai 朝三层冲了过去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wait! Stop!
entries.new: 等等！站住！
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Akaro! Go down and wait in front of the storeroom! It could've been sent empty!
entries.new: Akaro！你下去，守在储藏室门口！说不定电梯是空着下去的！
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Akaro looked hesitant for a moment, but he followed Sai's order. In an instant, Atsuki and I were alone.
entries.new: Akaro 犹豫了一瞬，还是照 Sai 的吩咐去了。转眼间，就只剩我和 Atsuki。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What the hell? What do we do?
entries.new: 搞什么？我们怎么办？
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: ...{w}We should put the Sekimeiya in the cabinet and stay on the crystal floor. That's what we were told.
entries.new: ……{w}照之前说的，我们得把 Sekimeiya 放进展示柜，待在水晶层。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: All right.
entries.new: 好吧。
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: We ran behind Akaro.{w} I looked down and saw that there was still no blood on the floor or the staircase.
entries.new: 我们跟在 Akaro 后面跑。{w} 我低头看去，地板和楼梯上依旧没有血迹。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What...!?
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: On the floor, below the elevator panel, there was a folded piece of paper. Atsuki and Akaro were ahead of me, so they didn't see me grabbing it and putting it in my purse.
entries.new: 电梯按钮板下方的地板上，躺着一张折起的纸。Atsuki 和 Akaro 走在我前面，没看见我把它捡起来塞进手袋。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Did it... not disappear after all?
entries.new: 那东西……终究没有消失？
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Akaro was in the storeroom, but I just followed behind Atsuki, completely lost for words. How the hell had that made it there?
entries.new: Akaro 进了储藏室，我只默默跟在 Atsuki 身后，一句话也说不出来。那东西到底是怎么到这里的？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The event room was empty.
entries.new: 活动室里空无一人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I opened the unlocked empty cabinet, and Atsuki left the Sekimeiya inside. That time, he didn't forget to lock it.
entries.new: 我打开没上锁的空展示柜，Atsuki 把 Sekimeiya 放了进去。这一次，他没有忘记上锁。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We left the Sekimeiya in the cabinet.
entries.new: 我们把 Sekimeiya 留在了展示柜里。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: ...We promise we don't know what you were talking about. Why did Sai say that it was Shiroya who'd taken the elevator? That's the... girl who died.
entries.new: ……我们保证，真的不知道你在说什么。Sai 为什么说坐电梯的是 Shiroya？那是……死掉的那个女孩吧。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: So you remember now?
entries.new: 所以你现在想起来了？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Did I not...? Of course I do. She was in the elevator and then disappeared from the lobby.
entries.new: 我什么时候忘了……？当然记得。她进了电梯，随后就在大厅里消失了。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: That's right, but she was here just minutes ago and said she was going to the attic. That's why Sai believes you're responsible.
entries.new: 没错。可几分钟前她还在这里，说要去阁楼。所以 Sai 才认定是你们干的。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: How many minutes ago?
entries.new: 几分钟前？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: I don't know, quite a few, and you were here too with the Erina who disappeared.
entries.new: 我也说不准，总有几分钟了。而且你也在这里，还带着那个消失了的 Erina。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: The Erina who died...?
entries.new: 死掉的那个 Erina……？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Yes. She had her clothes caked with dried blood. You two took the elevator up just now.
entries.new: 对。她的衣服上结满了干涸的血。刚才就是你们俩坐电梯上来的。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: So the person who used the elevator the first time was her, and the second time it was Atsuki and Erina.
entries.new: 那么第一次用电梯的人是她，第二次则是我和 Erina。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I had met that version of Erina as well, and neither she nor Atsuki were the people we'd been with since that morning.
entries.new: 那个模样的 Erina 我也见过。她和我都不是我们从那天早晨起一直相处的人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: That wasn't me. I'm being serious.
entries.new: 那不是我。我说的是真的。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: He's right. We've been in the attic all this time and haven't seen anyone.
entries.new: 他说得没错。我们一直待在阁楼里，谁都没见到。
entries.speaker: m

entries.text: That's not easy to believe. You were hiding in the offices with the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 这可不太容易让人相信。你们可是和 Sekimeiya 一起躲在办公区的。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: It wasn't us who brought the Sekimeiya up. We found it in the attic. We also weren't hiding in the offices, we were searching them before coming back down.
entries.new: Sekimeiya 不是我们带上去的。我们是在阁楼里发现它的。我们也没有躲在办公区，是逐间查看之后才下来的。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: ...I don't know.{w} I can't just assume you're lying after all that's happened.
entries.new: ……我不知道。{w} 出了这么多事，我也不能就这么认定你在说谎。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: ...Where are the others?
entries.new: ……其他人呢？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Well, Katei should be in the security room, and I saw Erina and Isla hadn't left the crystal room they were in.
entries.new: 嗯，Katei 应该在监控室；我还看见 Erina 和 Isla 一直没离开她们待的水晶展室。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: While Atsuki opened the door to the security room, I looked at the lobby.
entries.new: Atsuki 打开监控室门的时候，我朝大厅望了过去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Naomi's corpse had returned there, and along with the policeman, they were lying on the floor in solitude. The wound on Naomi's head had stopped bleeding, so the pool below it had reached its limit.
entries.new: Naomi 的尸体又回到了那里，和那名警察一起孤零零地躺在地上。Naomi 头上的伤口已经不再流血，底下的血泊也不再扩大。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The status of the room had gone back to normal after changing continuously. Was that the version the outside world would see?
entries.new: 房间的状态在不停变化之后又恢复了原样。外面的人看到的，会是这一种吗？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I looked to my right and saw Katei lying back on his chair in front of all the powered-off screens.
entries.new: 我向右看去，Katei 正靠坐在椅子上，面前是一整排熄了屏的显示器。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Oh, it's you two. It's been a while.
entries.new: 哦，是你们俩。有阵子没见了。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: ...Yes, we just came back from the attic.
entries.new: ……嗯，我们刚从阁楼回来。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: He wasn't dead below his desk, and it was clear he'd failed to fix the computer.
entries.new: 他没有死在桌子底下，而且显然没能修好电脑。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...How's this going?
entries.new: ……进展怎么样？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: I stopped a while ago. I have no idea what the issue is, so I'll need other people to look into it.
entries.new: 我早就停手了。我完全看不出问题出在哪，只能等别人来查。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: I see.
entries.new: 这样啊。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: When we opened the door in front, we saw the last two people. Isla was not lying face-up inside a dark cabinet, but instead ogling one of the uncovered glass displays.
entries.new: 推开正前方的门，我们见到了最后两个人。Isla 并没有仰面躺在哪个昏暗的展示柜里，而是在打量一个掀去了罩子的玻璃展台。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Hello.
entries.new: ……你们好。
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: Erina stood up after seeing the two of us. There was no blood on her clothes, and she seemed pretty tired.
entries.new: Erina 看到我们两个后站了起来。她衣服上没有血迹，看上去相当疲惫。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Did something happen?
entries.new: 出什么事了吗？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Oh, no. We weren't sure if you were still here.
entries.new: 啊，没有。我们只是不确定你们还在不在。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: We've been here the whole time.
entries.new: 我们一直都在这里。
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: That's good. The time is getting closer.
entries.new: 那就好。时间快到了。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: You said the Erina covered in blood was here too?
entries.new: 你说那个浑身是血的 Erina 也在这儿？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Yes. She and the girl—the two dead bodies that disappeared. For a second, I thought they'd been alive the whole time, but that couldn't be it.
entries.new: 对。她还有那个女孩——就是那两具消失的尸体。有一瞬间我还以为她们一直活着，可那不可能。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Wait, is that it...? Could it be that they were genuinely brought back to life?{w} But, no... If another version of me existed, it must be something completely different.
entries.new: 等等，难道说……？难不成她们是真的死而复生了？{w} 不对……如果真有另一个我，那一定完全是另一回事。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: If that really wasn't you, then I'm really confused. According to him, that girl had been with us the entire day. Since this morning.
entries.new: 如果那真的不是你，那我就彻底糊涂了。照他说的，那个女孩一整天都跟我们在一起。从今天早上开始。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: There was absolutely fucking nobody in the attic or anywhere.
entries.new: 阁楼里也好，别处也好，他妈的连个人影都没有。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Really?
entries.new: 真的？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Sai came from the stairs and entered the storeroom, all while I considered how strange that assertion was. Had he simply failed to find the others?
entries.new: Sai 从楼梯那边过来，进了储藏室。我一直在想，他这话也太奇怪了。难道他只是没找到其他人？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Two different versions of Atsuki, the other Erina, and her too. They all should've been there. Something else still didn't make sense either.
entries.new: 两个不同的 Atsuki、另一个 Erina，还有她，这些人都应该在那里才对。而且还有一件事说不通。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The elevator had been used two more times after the fourth. We knew who had used it the first four times and that everyone who should've been on the crystal floor was present. So, who had taken the final two trips and gone above us?
entries.new: 电梯在第四次之后又被用了两次。前四次是谁用的，我们心里有数，而且本该待在水晶层的人全都在场。那么，最后那两次是谁乘着电梯到了我们上面？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The door hasn't been opened again. ...Where's the Sekimeiya?
entries.new: 那扇门没有再被打开过。……Sekimeiya 在哪？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: In the cabinet.
entries.new: 在展示柜里。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: In the cabinet? Akaro, don't you understand that their friend could be here? She could've taken it already!
entries.new: 在展示柜里？Akaro，你难道不明白他们的朋友可能就在这儿？她说不定早就把它拿走了！
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Hey, I did what you said.
entries.new: 喂，我可是照你说的做了。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Offended, Sai hurried to the event room.
entries.new: Sai 一脸不快，匆匆赶往活动室。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Akaro explained to us what happened. That wasn't me, and we don't want to take it out of here again.
entries.new: Akaro 把事情经过告诉我们了。那不是我，而且我们也不想再把它带出这里了。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: What did he say?
entries.new: 他怎么说？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: That both of them were sleeping in the attic and found the Sekimeiya there. Then, they came down, searching through every floor until we saw them.
entries.new: 说他们俩在阁楼里睡觉，在那儿发现了 Sekimeiya。然后一路下来，一层一层地搜，直到被我们撞见。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Is that what we're supposed to believe? That the people who have the key to the cabinet conveniently found it where they were, and that instead of hurrying to bring it back, they looked through the entire building with it?
entries.new: 这就是要我们相信的说法？拿着展示柜钥匙的人，恰好就在自己待的地方捡到了它，然后不急着送回来，反而带着它把整栋楼搜了一遍？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...That's what happened.{w} Did you really not find anyone? Aren't you the one who says that I took the elevator up?
entries.new: ……事情就是这样。{w} 你真的一个人都没找到？不是你说我乘电梯上去了吗？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Yes. I'm only one person, though, so I couldn't really search optimally.{w} But it is possible there was nobody to find if the three people who should've been there merely traveled with the Sekimeiya, which, again, you happened to have.
entries.new: 没错。可我只有一个人，没法搜得面面俱到。{w} 不过，要是本该在那里的三个人只是带着 Sekimeiya 走了——而它偏偏又在你手里——那找不到人也说得通。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I don't exactly know what happened, so what is it that you're accusing me of?
entries.new: 我并不清楚到底发生了什么，你到底在指责我什么？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: ...{w}I'm accusing you of trying to execute a plan that might involve getting the Sekimeiya out of the tower. Of lying openly, and of working with that girl you know who didn't get trapped with us.
entries.new: ……{w} 我是在指责你：你想执行一个把 Sekimeiya 弄出塔的计划；你公然撒谎；还跟那个你认识、但没跟我们困在一起的女孩串通。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...I'm sorry, but I can't really take you seriously. I woke up a few minutes ago and have no idea what any of this is about. Since Akaro is backing you up, I guess it's true that the two missing bodies reappeared, but it seems they're gone again, right? Erina is with Isla two rooms over, and she looks totally okay.{w} Also, I already said that I don't want to take the Sekimeiya out of here again.
entries.new: ……抱歉，我实在没法把你的话当真。我几分钟前才醒过来，根本不知道这些事是怎么回事。既然 Akaro 也站在你那边，那两具消失的尸体确实重新出现过，我承认；可她们似乎又不见了，对吧？Erina 就在隔了两个房间的地方和 Isla 待着，看上去一点事都没有。{w} 再说，我已经说过，我不想再把它带出去了。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Sai approached Atsuki and touched his sleeves.
entries.new: Sai走到Atsuki身边，碰了碰他的衣袖。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It was working again, huh? Your shirt is burning.
entries.new: 又生效了啊？你的衬衫都烧起来了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: But we didn't activate it, and we never will.
entries.new: 可我们并没有启动它，以后也不会。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: However, if it's true that I was here and said things that didn't make sense...{w} You're right, I know that girl, Shiroya. She's an old friend of mine who... died two weeks ago. I don't have any idea why she was here today or how that's possible.
entries.new: 不过，如果我真在这里，还说了些莫名其妙的话……{w}你说得对，我认识那个女孩，Shiroya。她是我的老朋友，两周前……去世了。我不知道她今天为什么会出现在这里，也不知道这怎么可能。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: You just said that the storeroom door hasn't opened again. And the elevator was used two times, right? If it's true that they were here... they must still be. And I can guarantee it because we had the Sekimeiya and didn't use it.
entries.new: 你刚才说过，储藏室的门没有再开过。电梯被用了两次，对吧？如果他们真的来过这里……那一定还在这里。这点我可以保证，因为Sekimeiya一直在我们手上，我们并没有使用它。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: So we have to go find them. You were just one person looking around, so they could have dodged you. All of us together can find them. Then, we'll work out exactly what happened.
entries.new: 所以我们必须去找他们。你只有一个人，他们完全可能避开你。大家一起找，一定能找到。然后我们再弄清楚到底发生了什么。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Let's go.
entries.new: 走吧。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: ...Are you fucking serious?
entries.new: ……你他妈认真的？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Now I'm sure. You're spewing an immense amount of bullshit out of that idiotic mouth of yours.
entries.new: 现在我确定了。你那张蠢嘴里喷出来的，全是狗屁。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I don't care how you did it, but you're right: they have to be here because the elevator was used again. I don't care if they traveled to the past or if they just avoided me.
entries.new: 我不管你是怎么做到的，但你说得没错：电梯又被用过，所以他们一定还在这里。他们是穿越回了过去，还是单纯躲开了我，我都不在乎。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I had a theory ready that entailed Shiroya waiting for the elevator sound on the second floor and activating the Sekimeiya so that you'd all travel. After all, what's most strange is that the Sekimeiya was on the second floor right after you took the elevator up.
entries.new: 我原本准备好了一套推理：Shiroya在二楼等着电梯的声响，然后启动Sekimeiya，让你们所有人穿越。毕竟最蹊跷的是，你们刚乘电梯上去，Sekimeiya就出现在二楼。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: With all the waiting, you probably had a somewhat thought-out plan ready. However, that hardly matters. What matters is that you're not getting the chance to take the Sekimeiya out again.
entries.new: 等了这么久，你大概也准备好了一套还算周密的计划。不过那都不重要。重要的是，我不会再给你把Sekimeiya带出去的机会。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Did you think we'd all just go looking now? You're not moving from here.
entries.new: 你以为我们现在会全体出动去找人？你哪儿也别想去。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: And how will you enforce that?
entries.new: 你打算怎么拦我？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Don't you think Akaro easily could?
entries.new: 你觉得Akaro拦不住你？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Neither of you are leaving this room. Give me the keys too.
entries.new: 你们两个谁也别想离开这个房间。钥匙也交给我。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I handed him the keyring, feigning a defeated face.
entries.new: 我装出一副认输的表情，把钥匙串递给了他。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Whatever the fuck you had planned with that girl won't happen as long as we stay here.
entries.new: 不管你和那女的盘算着什么，只要我们还守在这儿，就别想得逞。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Sai moved to hallway A and went to the storeroom.
entries.new: Sai走向A走廊，进了储藏室。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It seems she didn't take the sole chance she had to escape. I'm not letting the storeroom out of my sight again, so the police will definitely catch this person who's supposedly dead.
entries.new: 看来她并没有抓住唯一一次逃跑的机会。这次我不会再让储藏室离开我的视线，那个据说已经死了的人，一定会被警察抓住。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: At least one of them must be here, between Shiroya and Erina. However, it's probably both, and they're not going to show themselves.
entries.new: Shiroya和Erina，至少有一个一定在这里。不过多半是两个都在，而且她们不会自己露面。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: The best thing is that there's no need to search for them. The Sekimeiya is shut in here, so they can't activate it to escape. The storeroom is out of the question too. They're basically trapped.
entries.new: 最省事的是，根本不用去找。Sekimeiya锁在这里，她们没法启动它逃走。储藏室更不用提。她们基本上已经无路可走了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: It's currently {time=19:32.} There's no need to search for them, but don't worry—they'll be found as soon as the police enter the building. If you really do want that, you're not opposed, right?
entries.new: 现在是{time=19:32.} 没必要去找她们，不过你放心——警察一进大楼，她们就会被找到。如果你真的希望那样，应该也不会反对吧？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...!{w} I still think we should find them because I want to understand what happened. If we find them, you'll believe all that I'm saying.
entries.new: ……！{w}我还是觉得应该去找她们，因为我想弄明白到底发生了什么。找到她们，你就会相信我说的一切了。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: I see. Then we'll go ahead and believe it after {time=21}, when two versions of you are found.
entries.new: 是吗。那就等{time=21}，等找到两个你之后，我们再相信。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...If that's what you want, I'm fine with that too. I-I suppose we can wait here. There's not that much time left.
entries.new: ……如果你坚持这样，我也没意见。那、那就等在这里好了。剩下的时间也不多了。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Precisely.
entries.new: 正是。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I think that's for the best too.
entries.new: 我也觉得这样最好。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: It appeared it had been settled. After a few minutes, I was the first to sit on the floor, leaning on the dirty wall.
entries.new: 事情似乎就这么定下来了。几分钟后，我第一个坐到地上，靠着脏兮兮的墙壁。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Everyone in the room was silently on alert. Eventually, Sai's taunting attitude receded, and he started to look doubtful.
entries.new: 房间里每个人都在默默戒备。到后来，Sai那副讥讽的态度渐渐收敛，脸上开始显出疑虑。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: However, {time=21} kept approaching at a steady pace, and nobody seemed against that. I wanted to get rid of the note in my purse, but I couldn't go to the bathroom to flush it away. When no one was looking at me, I stuffed it inside one of my shoes. The police would probably search us after we left, so my purse wasn't a good place to hide it.
entries.new: 然而{time=21}仍在稳步逼近，似乎没有人反对。我想处理掉包里的那张纸条，却不能去洗手间把它冲掉。趁没人注意我，我把它塞进了一只鞋里。离开之后警察多半会搜身，放在包里并不稳妥。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Katei left the security room and was told we were waiting together. For the last stretch of the day, he entered the dim room with us to maintain our protection of the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: Katei离开监控室，得知我们都在这里一起等着。这一天剩下的时间里，他也走进了这间昏暗的房间，和我们一同守着Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: No matter what the truth was, our shared distrust was palpable. Anyone could've been lying the entire day. Perhaps, after the police entered, we'd eventually learn all about what the people we'd gotten trapped with had done.
entries.new: 无论真相如何，彼此间的猜忌都显而易见。这一整天，任何人都可能一直在说谎。也许等警察进来之后，我们终会弄清，这些和我们一同被困的人究竟做过些什么。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I didn't think anything good could come of it. After all, there was a killer in the room.
entries.new: 我不觉得那会有什么好结果。毕竟，这间屋子里有一个杀人凶手。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Miiya and Atsuki had been told by another Atsuki that as long as they stayed on the crystal floor, everything should turn out fine.
entries.new: 另一个 Atsuki 告诉过 Miiya 和 Atsuki，只要他们待在晶体层，一切应该都会顺利。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The mystery behind the people who had gone to the attic... Nobody could be certain what had happened to them.
entries.new: 那些去了阁楼的人身上究竟藏着什么谜团……没有人能确定他们遭遇了什么。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Were they still in the tower? Or had Sai failed to find them because they had vanished?
entries.new: 他们还在这座塔里吗？还是说，他们其实已经消失了，所以 Sai 才找不到？
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: It was possible that they were waiting near the event room. If that was the case, they would be found by the police.
entries.new: 他们也许正在活动室附近等着。若真如此，警察一进来就会发现他们。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: A few of the people in the room had similar thoughts.
entries.new: 房间里有几个人也抱着类似的念头。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Should the less suspicious among them look for the others while everyone else waited in the event room? Given the amount of time left, it sounded risky and unnecessary.
entries.new: 要不要让嫌疑较小的几个人去找其他人，其余人留在活动室等候？考虑到剩下的时间，这既冒险又没有必要。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: But Miiya kept thinking about one thing.
entries.new: 但Miiya心里始终放不下一件事。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: "I want to search the building again."
entries.new: 「我想再搜一遍大楼。」

entries.text: "I want to stay in the event room."
entries.new: 「我想留在活动室。」

entries.text: Finding Self
entries.new: 寻回自我

entries.text: As the time kept passing, Miiya's conflict grew.
entries.new: 时间一点点过去，Miiya 内心的矛盾愈发深重。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The Atsuki they'd spoken with had said that if they stayed together on the crystal floor, everything would turn out to be fine.
entries.new: 他们之前对话的那个 Atsuki 说过，只要大家一同待在水晶层上，一切就不会有事。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: However, did that imply that if they were to scatter through the building, that guarantee would be voided?
entries.new: 可是，这是否意味着，一旦众人分散到楼里各处，那份保证便不再作数？
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Who had taken the last elevator trip? How did that Atsuki plan to accomplish what he'd said? ...Would anyone be found if they were to inspect every floor?
entries.new: 最后坐电梯的是谁？那个 Atsuki 打算怎么兑现他说过的话？……如果把每一层都查一遍，能找到人吗？
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: "Can't you see already that we weren't lying?" Miiya spoke.
entries.new: 「我们没撒谎，你到现在还看不出来吗？」Miiya 开口道。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Someone must definitely be here; that's not a question. If you think we want to leave this room empty as we search, someone can just stay here.
entries.new: 这里肯定有人，这根本不用问。要是担心我们出去找人时这间屋子空着，留个人守着就行了。
entries.speaker: mnn

entries.text: Atsuki threw her a frown. They had managed to keep everyone together, so what was with that sudden input?
entries.new: Atsuki 皱起眉看了她一眼。好不容易才把大家聚在一起，她这时插这句话是什么意思？
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: You didn't listen to me, did you? Neither of you will leave this room until the shutter opens. I'm sure there's a reason why you want us to look for whoever's here, and given what you just said, it might not be related to this room.
entries.new: 你们根本没听我的话吧？卷帘门打开之前，你们两个谁都别想离开这间屋子。你们想让我们去找这里的某个人，肯定有你们的理由；而照你刚才那番话，那理由恐怕和这间屋子无关。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: What would that be? There's no harm in searching as long as someone stays behind. It can be you, if you want.
entries.new: 什么理由？只要留人守着，去找一圈也没什么损失。你想的话，你留下也行。
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: Atsuki joined in, baiting the same reaction as before.
entries.new: Atsuki 也插了进来，仍是想激出方才那样的反应。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Stop it. We're not leaving. It's very late already, so there's no reason to at all.
entries.new: 别闹了。我们哪儿也不去。都这么晚了，根本没有出去的理由。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: Then I'm going alone.
entries.new: 那我就一个人去。
entries.speaker: mnn

entries.text: What? No, you—
entries.new: 什么？不行，你——
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: Miiya didn't give anyone a chance to object. She sprinted toward the hallway A door, and before Akaro had time to react, she ran to the stairs.
entries.new: Miiya 没给任何人反对的机会。她朝 A走廊的门冲去，Akaro 还没来得及反应，她已经跑到了楼梯口。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: What the fuck!? Stop! What the fuck are you doing!?
entries.new: 搞什么！？站住！你他妈到底想干什么！？
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: Sai's voice didn't reach Miiya, who had disappeared to the second floor. Everyone ran behind her, hesitant to go up, as her goal could've been to lure them away.{w} Meanwhile, Atsuki was lost and began to feel a despicable anxiety building up. Why was Miiya objecting to the only thing they had to do?
entries.new: Miiya 已经跑上二楼不见踪影，Sai 的喊声没能传到她耳中。众人跟着追了过去，却迟迟不敢上楼——她说不定就是想把他们引开。{w} 另一边，Atsuki 茫然无措，心底渐渐涌起一股令自己都感到卑劣的焦躁。那明明是唯一该做的事，Miiya 为什么要反对？
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: "What's happening...?" Erina peeked out of the crystal room after Sai had called the elevator.
entries.new: Sai 叫来电梯后，Erina 从水晶展室里探出头来。「出什么事了……？」
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Erina! Please, you and Isla stay in the event room! It's very important!
entries.new: Erina！拜托，你和 Isla 待在活动室里！这很重要！
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: Atsuki, you stop right here. I have no fucking idea what you're doing, but don't follow her!
entries.new: Atsuki，你给我站住。我他妈根本搞不懂你在干什么，但不许跟她走！
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: Knowing he was going to be physically stopped, Atsuki ignored Sai and dashed up the stairs. In his mind, he only wanted to stop Miiya and ensure that whatever she was doing didn't prove fatal.
entries.new: Atsuki 知道自己会被人拦下，索性不理 Sai，冲上了楼梯。他心里只有一个念头：拦住 Miiya，别让她正在做的事闹出人命。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: What the fuck...!? You two, follow him! Someone has to take the elevator. I'm doing it since I have the key to the attic.
entries.new: 搞什么……！？你们两个，跟上他！电梯总得有人坐。阁楼的钥匙在我手上，我来坐。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: On the second floor, Akaro and Katei found Atsuki inside the partitions. Miiya had made it sound as if she'd wanted to search the whole building, so she could've been anywhere.
entries.new: 在二楼，Akaro 和 Katei 在隔间里找到了 Atsuki。Miiya 说得像是要把整栋楼都搜一遍，那她此刻可能在任何地方。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Atsuki, wait!
entries.new: Atsuki，等等！
entries.speaker: aknn

entries.text: I won't wait...! We have to find her; it's dangerous to be alone. Sai passed us by, so this is going to go quickly.
entries.new: 不能等……！得找到她，一个人待着太危险了。Sai 已经超过我们了，所以会很快。
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: It didn't seem like Atsuki was lying. Both Akaro and Katei thought that he genuinely wanted to find Miiya as soon as possible.
entries.new: Atsuki 不像在撒谎。Akaro 和 Katei 都觉得，他是真心想尽快找到 Miiya。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: If they were to fight over it, and Miiya and Atsuki had something planned, it was possible that fighting itself was what would allow it to succeed.
entries.new: 要是他们为此与他争执起来，而 Miiya 和 Atsuki 又早有安排，那这场争执本身说不定正是让计划得逞的关键。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The three of them moved one floor higher with the condition that Atsuki wouldn't be left alone.
entries.new: 三人以不让 Atsuki 单独行动为条件，又往上走了一层。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: As long as the elevator wasn't used again, they were fairly certain that Miiya wouldn't be the only person found. They knew that it was very likely someone else was present on one of the floors.
entries.new: 只要电梯不再被人使用，他们几乎可以肯定，被找到的人不会只有 Miiya。他们清楚，别的楼层里很可能还有人在。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Atsuki and Akaro entered the three partitions of the third floor, but they were empty.
entries.new: Atsuki 和 Akaro 查了三楼的三个隔间，里面空无一人。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The same occurred one floor above.
entries.new: 再往上一层，结果也一样。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The fifth and the sixth were desolate as well. It should've been settled, then: there were at least five people in the attic.
entries.new: 五楼和六楼同样空荡荡。到这一步，答案就该定下了：阁楼里至少有五个人。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Miiya, Sai, Shiroya, another Atsuki, and a mysterious fifth person.
entries.new: Miiya、Sai、Shiroya、另一个 Atsuki，以及神秘的第五人。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: They approached the door to the attic, but someone came out of it first.
entries.new: 他们走近通往阁楼的门，却有人先从里面走了出来。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: It was Miiya.
entries.new: 是 Miiya。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: When she saw the group, she stopped moving. As the three got closer, they saw there was blood on her forehead.
entries.new: 她看见众人，脚步便停住了。三人走近后，才发现她额头上沾着血。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Wh-What happened...!? Are you okay?
entries.new: 怎、怎么回事……！？你没事吧？
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: Uh, I don't know.
entries.new: 呃……我不知道。
entries.speaker: mnn

entries.text: You don't know?
entries.new: 你不知道？
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: Yes. ...I think I might've lost my memory.
entries.new: 嗯。……我好像失忆了。
entries.speaker: mnn

entries.text: Nobody responded. Instead, they waited, wanting to hear that it had been a joke.
entries.new: 没有人接话。他们只是等着，盼着她接下来说这只是个玩笑。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: But that didn't happen. After a few silent seconds, Miiya lowered her eyebrows.
entries.new: 可她没有。沉默了几秒，Miiya 蹙起了眉。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: I'm serious. I must've hit my head on these stairs.
entries.new: 我是认真的。我大概是头撞在这楼梯上了。
entries.speaker: mnn

entries.text: She showed them what she was talking about. Just like they'd seen hours earlier on the crystal floor, the edge of one of the steps was covered in blood.
entries.new: 她把自己说的地方指给他们看。就像几小时前在水晶层看到的那样，其中一级台阶的边缘沾满了血。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: ...Did you trip while running up, then?
entries.new: ……那你是在往上跑的时候绊倒了？
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: I said that I don't know. It must be my blood, because it's fresh and I'm bleeding.
entries.new: 我说了，我不知道。那应该是我的血，因为血还是新鲜的，我也确实在流血。
entries.speaker: mnn

entries.text: W-Wait. Are you really saying that you lost your memory?
entries.new: 等、等等。你是说真的失忆了？
entries.speaker: aknn

entries.text: Yes. Do you think I'm joking?
entries.new: 是。你觉得我在开玩笑？
entries.speaker: mnn

entries.text: Atsuki, what the hell is this?
entries.new: Atsuki，这到底是怎么回事？
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: What? I have no idea. ...What exactly do you not remember?
entries.new: 什么？我怎么会知道。……你究竟是哪部分不记得了？
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: I said that I don't remember anything.
entries.new: 我说了，我什么都不记得。
entries.speaker: mnn

entries.text: Nothing at all?
entries.new: 一点都不记得？
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: I think so.
entries.new: 应该是吧。
entries.speaker: mnn

entries.text: You're joking. You hit your head and lost your memories, like in a damn movie?
entries.new: 你开玩笑吧。撞了下头就失忆，跟那种烂电影一样？
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: Yeah. Memory loss is a real thing, and why are you all so defensive? Shouldn't you be worried?
entries.new: 是啊。失忆这种事真的存在。你们干嘛一个个都这么戒备？这种时候不是该担心我吗？
entries.speaker: mnn

entries.text: Everyone was very hesitant. Could she really have been telling the truth? The fresh blood on the stairs was unquestionable.
entries.new: 所有人都迟疑了。她说的会是真的吗？可楼梯上那道新鲜的血迹，不容置疑。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: So you don't remember anything in general? What about the date or who we are?
entries.new: 那你基本上什么都不记得了？今天是几号、我们是谁，也不知道？
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: Again, no. Where are we?
entries.new: 还是不知道。这里是哪儿？
entries.speaker: mnn

entries.text: Answering that was too ridiculous. However, if she was lying, what was the purpose?
entries.new: 要回答这个问题实在荒唐。可如果她在说谎，那又是为了什么？
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: They felt conflicted, but they had already noticed that Miiya seemed different. She had never looked at them like that, and her words felt colder than before.
entries.new: 他们心里很矛盾，却早已察觉到 Miiya 有些不对劲。她从没用那样的眼神看过他们，说起话来也比从前冷淡。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: "You're Miiya. Do you not know that either?" Atsuki spoke.
entries.new: 「你是 Miiya。连这个也不知道？」Atsuki 开口道。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: No. It's pretty strange. I don't know anything about myself, but I know how to speak. I suppose this is how this kind of memory loss works.
entries.new: 不知道。说来也怪，我对自己一无所知，却还会说话。大概这种失忆就是这样吧。
entries.speaker: mnn

entries.text: You really can't be telling the truth.
entries.new: 你说的绝不可能是真话。
entries.speaker: aknn

entries.text: Why not? Would I lie about this? My head does hurt a lot.
entries.new: 为什么不可能？这种事有什么好骗人的？我的头确实很疼。
entries.speaker: mnn

entries.text: If you hit your head and you're not lying, it should be short-term memory loss, right? Everything should slowly come back to you soon.
entries.new: 如果你真是撞到了头，又没有撒谎，那应该是短期失忆吧？过一阵子，记忆应该会慢慢回来。
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: I don't know.
entries.new: 我不知道。
entries.speaker: mnn

entries.text: Where are we, though? Why is there a camera there?
entries.new: 不过，这里到底是什么地方？那边为什么会有摄像头？
entries.speaker: mnn

entries.text: ...I doubt that's recording. Do you know what Ashiya Tower is? That's where we are.
entries.new: ……那东西大概没在录。你知道芦屋塔吗？我们现在就在那里。
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: Hm... Not really, no.
entries.new: 嗯……没听说过。
entries.speaker: mnn

entries.text: It's a big building where we got trapped this morning. Do you not know any of that? There was an attack, and the exit closed.
entries.new: 今天早上，我们就是被困在这栋大楼里。这些你也不知道？当时有人袭击，出口被封了。
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: Oh, really? So we can't leave?
entries.new: 哦，是吗？那我们出不去了？
entries.speaker: mnn

entries.text: Atsuki, do you actually believe she's telling the truth?
entries.new: Atsuki，你真觉得她说的是实话？
entries.speaker: aknn

entries.text: I am telling the truth. Is memory loss that rare? I don't think so, right?
entries.new: 我说的是实话。失忆哪有那么少见？不至于吧？
entries.speaker: mnn

entries.text: I wonder what Sai will have to say about this. He should be in the attic.
entries.new: 不知道 Sai 会怎么说。他应该还在阁楼吧。
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: Who's that?
entries.new: 那是谁？
entries.speaker: mnn

entries.text: ...Someone else we got trapped with. Erina and Isla too, who are on the lowest floor. It's almost time for the exit to open, so you'll have to go straight to the hospital.
entries.new: ……也是跟我们一起被困的人。还有 Erina 和 Isla，她们在最底层。出口快开了，你得直接去医院。
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: Nobody could believe that what they were hearing was real. The timing felt too coincidental, and they knew that Miiya had run to the attic for a reason, intentionally going against what everyone else wanted.
entries.new: 谁也无法相信耳边听到的这一切是真的。这个时机未免太巧，况且他们都知道，Miiya 跑去阁楼是有原因的——她是在刻意违逆所有人的意思。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Do you think this might have anything to do with the Sekimeiya? A side effect, or something?
entries.new: 你觉得这会不会和 Sekimeiya 有关？副作用之类的？
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: The what?
entries.new: 和什么？
entries.speaker: mnn

entries.text: You really don't remember that either. What about the murders? You shouldn't be alone. Do you not remember Shiroya either?
entries.new: 你连那个也不记得了。那杀人案呢？你不能一个人待着。你也不记得 Shiroya 了？
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: ...Murders? Did someone die?
entries.new: ……杀人案？有人死了？
entries.speaker: mnn

entries.text: Yes. A killer is with us.
entries.new: 对。凶手就在我们当中。
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: Really? And it could be anyone?
entries.new: 真的？而且谁都有可能是凶手？
entries.speaker: mnn

entries.text: It's not so simple, but yes.
entries.new: 没这么简单，不过……也可以这么说。
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: I see.
entries.new: 这样啊。
entries.speaker: mnn

entries.text: Sai didn't take the elevator again, so he should still be in the attic. Maybe he found someone.
entries.new: Sai 又没坐电梯，应该还在阁楼。说不定他找到了什么人。
entries.speaker: aknn

entries.text: It's very possible.
entries.new: 很有可能。
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: Someone? Do you mean the killer?
entries.new: 找到了人？你是说凶手？
entries.speaker: mnn

entries.text: ...I don't know.
entries.new: ……我不知道。
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: They stepped into the living room, but nothing could be heard.
entries.new: 他们走进客厅，却什么声音也没听见。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Since the elevator was there, they didn't want to make noise.
entries.new: 电梯就停在那里，他们不敢弄出声响。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The door to the hallway was open, so they peeked through it. Immediately, they saw something.
entries.new: 通往走廊的门开着，他们探头望去，立刻看见了什么。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: One of the bedrooms was conspicuously open.
entries.new: 其中一间卧室的门敞着，格外显眼。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: As soon as they looked inside, there were gasps.
entries.new: 朝里一看，倒抽冷气的声音顿时响起。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Sai's body lay facing down on the floor. His back had been pierced, apparent by the narrow hole in his shirt, which was soaked in blood.
entries.new: Sai 趴倒在地，背上被刺穿了——衬衫上那个细小的破洞浸满了血，一看便知。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Oh my God, no...
entries.new: 天哪，不会吧……
entries.speaker: aknn

entries.text: The four people stared at the scene with wide eyes. ...Sai had been killed.
entries.new: 四人瞪大了眼睛，怔怔望着眼前的景象。……Sai死了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Katei slowly crouched to grab the keyring, which had fallen from Sai's pocket. Having it on his person was what had allowed his death.
entries.new: Katei缓缓蹲下身，拾起从Sai口袋里掉出的钥匙串。正是随身带着这串钥匙，才招来了他的杀身之祸。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Then, they ran to the living room. His killer must've been there, hidden in one of the rooms. ...They couldn't let them escape.
entries.new: 随后，他们奔向客厅。凶手一定就在那里，藏在某个房间里。……绝不能让他逃脱。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: You two wait here.
entries.new: 你们两个留在这里。
entries.speaker: aknn

entries.text: The young pair was left behind in the living room while Akaro and Katei looked through the rooms, their heartbeats hammering in their chests.
entries.new: 两个年轻人被留在客厅，Akaro 和 Katei 挨个房间查看，心怦怦狂跳。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Atsuki's heart did the same as he slowly opened his mouth.
entries.new: 我的心也跳得同样厉害，我缓缓开了口。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Are you telling the truth? Why did you want to go to the attic?
entries.new: 你说的是真的吗？为什么要去阁楼？
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: He had noticed something.
entries.new: 他察觉到了什么。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: When they'd all stepped into the living room, he had looked at the floor. There, he'd seen recent footprints going from the stairs to the hallway... and then back.
entries.new: 众人走进客厅时，他留意过地板。那里有新鲜的脚印，从楼梯通向走廊……然后又折返回来。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He only wanted an explanation he could accept, but his question hardly garnered a reaction.
entries.new: 他只想听到一个自己能接受的解释，可这一问几乎没有换来任何反应。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Akaro and Katei confirmed that the elevator was present—and empty. Very carefully, they looked at the storeroom and then walked to the kitchen.
entries.new: Akaro和Katei确认电梯还在——里面空无一人。他们小心翼翼地查看过储藏室，又走向厨房。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Lastly, only the two bedrooms remained. In the right one was Sai's lifeless body, but they couldn't find anyone else.
entries.new: 最后只剩下两间卧室。右边那间躺着Sai的尸体，除此之外再找不到别人。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The last place was the mirrored, opposite bedroom. Aside from its lack of a corpse, it was identical.
entries.new: 最后一处是与它相对、格局如镜像般的卧室。除了没有尸体，那里一模一样。
entries.speaker: c
