entries.text: I recalled my own selfishness and how much I despised it. If we were able to undo what had happened but chose not to, that was infinitely worse.
entries.new: 我想起自己那份自私，想起自己有多厌恶它。明明能挽回已经发生的事，却选择袖手旁观，那要恶劣无数倍。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Let's keep going.{w} I last traveled from the staff room. Let's go there.
entries.new: 继续走吧。{w} 我上一次是从员工室穿越的。就去那儿。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: We walked all the way down. In the reality where we were, many people had died. Even if changing the past was doable, how much could we really deviate from it?
entries.new: 我们一路往下走。在我们所处的这个现实里，已经死了很多人。就算过去确实可以改变，我们又能偏离多少？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: That didn't matter. As long as we could prevent the suffering I'd felt for at least one person, we had to do it.
entries.new: 那都无关紧要。哪怕只能让一个人免于我体会过的那种痛苦，我们也非做不可。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We slowly reached the crystal floor. On the way down, I noticed that the smell hanging around us all day was getting stronger.
entries.new: 我们慢慢下到水晶层。下楼途中，我察觉到整日萦绕在周围的那股气味越来越浓。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What's all this blood...?
entries.new: 这么多血是怎么回事……？
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: It's mine. As you can see, I hurt my hand in the elevator. I don't even know why it stopped bleeding.
entries.new: 是我的。如你所见，我在电梯里弄伤了手。连我自己都不知道它为什么止住了血。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Does it hurt? That's kind of a lot.
entries.new: 疼吗？流得还挺多的。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Don't worry, it's fine...
entries.new: 别担心，没事的……
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: We entered the staff room, and I saw that a new locker was open.
entries.new: 我们进了员工室，我看见又有一个储物柜开着。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...!{w} It's gone.
entries.new: ……！{w} 不见了。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Did you leave it in this locker? How?
entries.new: 你是把它留在这个储物柜里了？怎么会？
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: I found the key in the cleaning room. I know how that sounds, but I guess no one needed a key to get it. I touched it with the locker open.
entries.new: 钥匙是我在清洁间找到的。我知道这话听着离谱，但估计谁都不需要钥匙就能拿到它。我碰它的时候，柜门是开着的。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Oh... Could anyone have taken it, then?
entries.new: 哦……那有没有可能被别人拿走了？
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: It would've been easy, but I'm not completely sure. The door doesn't look like it moved, so it also could've teleported.{w} While you were in the attic, we saw that happen. I definitely witnessed the Sekimeiya teleport to its cabinet.{w} But Sai could've easily grabbed it. Akaro as well. I saw him, and he should still be here somewhere. It was before I changed the past, but all I did was draw attention to hallway A. There's no way that was enough to overwrite Akaro's existence.
entries.new: 那本来很容易得手，但我也说不准。柜门看上去不像动过，所以它也可能是自己传送走的。{w}你在阁楼那会儿，我们见过这种事。我确实亲眼看见 Sekimeiya 传送进了它的展示柜。{w}但 Sai 完全可以顺手把它拿走，Akaro 也一样。我见过他，他应该还在这栋楼的某处。那是在我改变过去之前，可我只是把注意力引到了 A走廊。那点影响绝不可能抹掉 Akaro 的存在。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: We went to the event room and saw the empty cabinet. Once more, we wanted to find the Sekimeiya that someone might have hidden.
entries.new: 我们去了活动室，看见了空荡荡的展示柜。我们又一次想去寻找可能被人藏起来的 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Since that morning, a recurring question had been why anyone would hide the Sekimeiya when it could easily be found. I'd thought of many possible answers, but if the past could be changed, it had always been a flawed question.
entries.new: 从那天早上起，有个问题一直反复出现：Sekimeiya 明明这么容易找到，为什么还要有人把它藏起来？我想过很多种可能的答案，可如果过去真的可以改变，这个问题本身就一直是站不住的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Of course, if anyone was directing things toward a future they wanted, they wouldn't want anyone to deviate things on their own with the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 当然，如果有人正把事情引向自己期望的未来，自然不会希望别人用 Sekimeiya 擅自偏离。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Like always, whether it teleported or someone hid it, it has to be nearby and in a place we can access. We can find it.
entries.new: 和之前一样，不管它是自己传送走了，还是被人藏了起来，它一定就在附近，而且在我们进得去的地方。我们找得到。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Was that person Sai, who knew the most about the Sekimeiya? Had an unknown person really orchestrated everything behind the scenes? I couldn't believe how fast I'd changed my mind and how much I wanted to find the Sekimeiya. Was it possible we could leave the tower in a world where I hadn't spent those two hours in that bedroom?
entries.new: 会是 Sai 吗？那个对 Sekimeiya 最了解的人？难道真有个身份不明的人在幕后操纵着一切？我不敢相信自己的态度转变得这么快，也不敢相信自己竟这么想找到 Sekimeiya。我们有没有可能离开这座塔，去到一个我并没有在那间卧室里度过那两小时的世界？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I was taking Atsuki's word, but if we found the Sekimeiya, determining whether the past could be changed should've been simple. However, we had concluded before that it wasn't possible because it had already been attempted. A ton of things implied that.
entries.new: 我这么做，是信了 Atsuki 的话。可只要找到 Sekimeiya，要弄清过去能不能改变本该很简单。然而我们先前已经断定那不可能——因为早就有人试过。有太多迹象都指向这一点。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I wanted to erase the painful hours we'd all spent in the tower. But if that was possible, what if we could stay there for a whole month? There would be much more we could undo.
entries.new: 我想抹去我们在这座塔里度过的那些痛苦时光。可如果这真能做到，那要是我们能在那里待上整整一个月呢？能挽回的就会多得多。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The exit was near. In two hours, we were bound to learn about the future we'd be stuck with.
entries.new: 出口近了。再过两小时，我们注定会知道自己将困在怎样的未来里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Oh, yeah, the Sekimeiya's gone. I was searching for it before we went up.
entries.new: 哦，对，Sekimeiya 不见了。我们上楼之前，我就在找它。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...I'm sure you were.
entries.new: ……你当然找过了。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: There's not much time left... Let's wait for the shutter to open.
entries.new: 没多少时间了……等卷帘门打开吧。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What about the Sekimeiya?
entries.new: Sekimeiya 呢？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Who knows? I couldn't find it, but why do you care?
entries.new: 谁知道呢？我是没找到，可你关心这个做什么？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Akaro might be responsible, and he could have taken it outside. If that happened, there's nothing we can do.
entries.new: 说不定是 Akaro 干的，他可能已经把它带到外面去了。真是那样，我们就无能为力了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: However, if it's still inside, the police will find it immediately, right? It can be hidden from us, but not from them.
entries.new: 不过，要是它还在楼里，警察马上就能找到，不是吗？它可以瞒过我们，却瞒不过他们。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Erina, do you know where the Sekimeiya might be?
entries.new: Erina，你知道 Sekimeiya 可能在哪儿吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What...? No, I don't.
entries.new: 什么……？不，我不知道。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Then none of us do. If it was deliberately hidden, I don't see the point in searching for it anymore.
entries.new: 那就是谁都不知道了。如果它是被人故意藏起来的，我看再找下去也没有意义。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: You know where it is, right?
entries.new: 你知道它在哪儿，对吧？
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: He must be the one who's been taking it all this time, and he's definitely had a reason. He doesn't want us to search for it so that he can keep it where he has it.
entries.new: 一直以来拿走它的肯定就是他，而且他一定有理由。他不想让我们去找，好把东西留在自己藏的地方。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: You're free to enlighten me. If I knew where it was, what would my endgame be? Hoping the police don't find it? There's no way that would happen.{w} Someone took it when we weren't around. That must mean they have the means to keep it out of ours and the police's sights. Otherwise, hiding it is pointless.
entries.new: 那就请你说给我听听。要是我知道它在哪儿，我图的是什么？指望警察找不到？那根本不可能。{w} 有人趁我们不在的时候把它拿走了。这说明对方有办法让它既躲过我们，也躲过警察。否则，藏起来毫无意义。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Of course, that's only assuming the past can't be changed. With how much Sai's proven to know about the Sekimeiya, there's no way he's not aware of whether it can do that or not.
entries.new: 当然，这都是以过去无法改变为前提。Sai 对 Sekimeiya 的了解已经显露无遗，他绝不可能不知道它能不能做到这一点。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: You say that, but it's been happening since this morning, and it was never hidden in a place the police wouldn't have inspected.
entries.new: 话是这么说，可这种事从今早就一直在发生，而它从来没被藏到警察不会去查的地方。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: You could have a plan, too. When the police enter, as soon as they find the Sekimeiya, they'll activate it. That'll make everyone around it disappear, leaving a free path for you to retrieve it.
entries.new: 你也可能另有打算。警察一进来，只要找到 Sekimeiya，就会触发它。它周围的人都会消失，正好给你让出一条路，让你把它拿走。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Are you even listening to yourself? You think I want to steal the Sekimeiya? Sure, I wouldn't say no to having it, but that's not gonna work out.{w} First of all, they'd simply appear in the past. If a bunch of people time travel, the panic would ruin any kind of plan like that. At least a few people have to know what the Sekimeiya is capable of too, right? Why would they send the police to grab it if they know what touching it would do?
entries.new: 你自己听听这话像话吗？你觉得我想偷 Sekimeiya？是，我不介意把它弄到手，可那根本行不通。{w}首先，他们只会出现在过去。那么多人一起时间穿越，引发的恐慌足以毁掉这种计划。再说，总该有几个人知道 Sekimeiya 有什么能耐吧？他们若知道一碰它会发生什么，又怎么会派警察去拿？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I think I agree with him... That wouldn't work.
entries.new: 我觉得他说得有道理……那样行不通。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Hiding the Sekimeiya is pointless, that's a fact. Incidentally, there's no place the police would ignore. What that means is that if the Sekimeiya's here, there's no reason to search for it. What I find most likely is that it's already outside, though.
entries.new: 藏起 Sekimeiya 没有意义，这是事实。再说，这楼里没有哪个地方会被警察漏掉。也就是说，如果 Sekimeiya 还在这里，我们根本没必要去找。不过，我认为最可能的情况是它已经被带到外面去了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: All right. I agree, so let's just wait.
entries.new: 好吧。我同意，那就等着。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: I frowned as I looked at him, but he avoided meeting my eyes and glanced back at Sai instead.
entries.new: 我皱起眉看着他，他却避开我的视线，把目光转回 Sai 身上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Perfect. We've had enough headaches, so let's go to the lobby.
entries.new: 很好。头疼的事已经够多了，我们去大厅吧。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Is this a bluff to waste time...?
entries.new: 这是在虚张声势拖延时间吗……？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: If we want to go to the past, we want the Sekimeiya to spend a while out of the cabinet, which we accomplish by doing what Sai wants for a while. Eventually, we can find it, just like we have every time we've extensively looked for it.
entries.new: 想要回到过去，就得让 Sekimeiya 在展示柜外待上一段时间；按 Sai 说的做一阵子，正好能达到这个目的。到最后总能找到它，就像我们每次大费周章去找时一样。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Atsuki whispered to me.
entries.new: Atsuki 低声对我说。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Did you lose the knife?
entries.new: ……那把刀你弄丢了？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: I shook my head and showed him my purse, still unzipped.
entries.new: 我摇摇头，把还敞着口的包给他看。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Did you get it from Sai after you two appeared somewhere?
entries.new: 你们俩后来在某个地方出现时，是从 Sai 那里拿到刀的吗？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: No... I still don't understand it either. Both of us appeared in the attic, and I already had it. I'd forgotten to mention it, but yeah, that doesn't make sense with how we thought the Sekimeiya worked.
entries.new: 不是……我自己也一直没想通。我们两个都出现在阁楼，而那时刀已经在我身上了。我忘了提这件事，不过确实，这和我们原先理解的 Sekimeiya 运作方式对不上。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Okay, let's sit around and wait. I'm exhausted and just want to get out, so I hope nothing else happens. Whatever Xyn or the culprit are up to is no concern of ours anymore...{w} I have no idea what happened to Akaro, but I don't care. If he's behind this whole mess, he'll face the consequences.
entries.new: 好了，我们就坐着等吧。我已经累坏了，只想出去，所以希望别再出什么事。Xyn 或者真凶想做什么，都跟我们无关了……{w}我不知道 Akaro 出了什么事，也不在乎。如果这一团乱麻是他搞出来的，他自会承担后果。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Exactly one hour and ten minutes. That's all we have to get through to reclaim our freedom.
entries.new: 整整一小时十分钟。只要熬过这段时间，我们就能重获自由。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: There was no reason to humor Sai anymore. I didn't believe for a second he wasn't lying. We sat on the left of the shutter without saying a word.
entries.new: 再没有理由顺着 Sai 了。我压根不信他没有撒谎。我们一言不发，在卷帘门左侧坐下。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: He had needed to leave the bedroom to finish up a part of his plan. He admitted that himself, so there was no way he simply wanted to get out of the tower while unaware of the Sekimeiya's whereabouts.
entries.new: 他亲口承认，自己是为了完成计划的一环才离开卧室。所以，在不知道 Sekimeiya 下落的情况下，他不可能只是想逃出塔去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It can't be that he's not the same Sai, right...? No... Even though his watch is working, he definitely knows what happened in the bedroom.
entries.new: 他总不可能是另一个 Sai 吧……？不……他的表还在正常走，卧室里发生的事他肯定清楚。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: We waited for a long time.
entries.new: 我们等了很久。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It was the ideal thing to do. If we were able to find the Sekimeiya, we would do it after it had gathered enough energy. If finding it wasn't possible, we were calmly going through the final stretch.
entries.new: 这是最稳妥的做法。只要能找到 Sekimeiya，就等它蓄够能再动手；要是根本找不到，我们也算平静地熬过了最后这段路。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If the recording was real, then we would either not find the Sekimeiya or changing the past would turn out to be impossible. However, I was convinced it was fake. No matter why it existed, it couldn't have been legitimate.
entries.new: 如果那段录音是真的，那我们要么找不到 Sekimeiya，要么改变过去根本不可能。但我确信那是假的。不管它为何存在，都不可能是真的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I spent some time going over all the possible outcomes. What if the Sekimeiya was in one of the temperature regulation cabinets, not gathering any heat?
entries.new: 我花了一阵子，把各种可能的结果都过了一遍。要是 Sekimeiya 就放在某个恒温展示柜里，一点热量都蓄不到呢？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If changing the past was possible, that was still fine. We could go a short time back, get it out of the cabinet, and progressively extend the distance traveled.
entries.new: 就算改变过去是可行的，那也无妨。我们可以先回到不久前，把它从展示柜里取出来，再一点点拉长回溯的距离。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Sai continued to update us with the time. We'd spent 25 minutes sitting down.
entries.new: Sai 仍在不断报时。我们坐下已有二十五分钟。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Is it possible Sai's trying to trick us again?
entries.new: Sai 会不会又在骗我们？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: What if he knows what we want to do? If he does, he could have set his wristwatch back a while to make it seem like we have more time. Did he anticipate things enough to have also edited the computer's time?
entries.new: 万一他知道我们想做什么呢？要是他知道，他大可以把手表往回拨一段，让我们以为时间还多。他连这一步都料到了，会不会连电脑上的时间也一并改过？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...The shutter could open at any moment.
entries.new: ……卷帘门随时都可能打开。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I stood up.
entries.new: 我站了起来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Wait here. I'm going to the bathroom.
entries.new: ……在这儿等着。我去趟洗手间。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: I'd been needing to go for a while, and I had to before walking through the whole building. According to Sai, there were forty minutes left, but we couldn't trust that. Once I came back, we had to find the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 我早就想去了，而且待会儿要穿过整栋楼，必须先解决。按 Sai 的说法还剩四十分钟，可那不能信。等我回来，我们就得去找 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Oh, all right.
entries.new: 哦，好。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Can't you wait?
entries.new: 不能忍一忍吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: No. Don't worry, though, I won't go anywhere else.
entries.new: 忍不了。不过放心，我哪儿也不会去。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: I knew he'd insist on stopping me, so I went over to the hallway B door.
entries.new: 我知道他一定会拦我，便径直走向 B走廊的门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I entered the left bathroom.
entries.new: 我进了左边的洗手间。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I jumped instantly, feeling my back burn.
entries.new: 我一下子跳开，后背一阵灼痛。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The tank... was burning.
entries.new: 水箱……是烫的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I knew what that had to mean. I grabbed the top with both hands and lifted it up.
entries.new: 我知道这意味着什么。我双手抓住盖子，把它掀了起来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The Sekimeiya was on top of a pipe, touching the side I'd leaned on. It was well-balanced, positioned so that it didn't fall into the water.
entries.new: Sekimeiya 就搁在一根管子上，贴着我刚才靠过的那一侧。它放得极稳，不至于掉进水里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: How hot does it have to be for the heat to reach the other side...? And I still feel the burn.
entries.new: 它得烫到什么程度，热量才能透到这一侧来……？我后背现在还火辣辣的。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: But here it is... And it's working for sure.
entries.new: 可它就在这里……而且肯定还在运转。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: The past could be changed. Were those words true?
entries.new: 过去可以改变。那句话是真的吗？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If so, I knew I could go really far back.
entries.new: 若果真如此，我知道自己可以回到很早之前。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Should I tell them? ...Was it even Sai who left it here? He knew where I was going.
entries.new: 该告诉他们吗？……真的是 Sai 把这东西留在这里的吗？他知道我会去哪里。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...{w}Atsuki wanted to find the Sekimeiya and change the past. If I told him, I knew he would activate it. However, I wasn't sure I wanted that.
entries.new: ……{w}Atsuki 想找到 Sekimeiya，改变过去。我若告诉他，他一定会启动它。可我并不确定自己是否想这样。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: His desire was to erase the deaths we'd experienced, but that wouldn't occur if he changed the past. He would still remember them, and how would it even work? Would he be stuck in a world with another self of his?
entries.new: 他想抹去我们经历过的那些死亡，可改变过去并不能做到这一点。他仍会记得一切。而且这到底是如何运作的？他会不会被困在某个世界里，与另一个自己共存？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If he went to the past and changed things, he would end up personally suffering for it and would remember everything. If I did that instead... he wouldn't.
entries.new: 若是他回到过去改变一切，最终受苦的是他自己，所有记忆也会留在他身上。换成我这样做……他就不会。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We didn't know where Akaro was, but he or Sai had the best chance of being behind everything. If I went to tell the others that I'd found the Sekimeiya, it was very possible Sai would purposely always stay in range. He could then prevent the changes we wanted.
entries.new: 我们不知道 Akaro 在哪里，但幕后之人最可能不是他就是 Sai。如果我去告诉其他人我找到了 Sekimeiya，Sai 极有可能故意一直留在范围内。那样他就能阻止我们想做的改变。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: And ultimately, it was a fact that they'd all said they talked to a self of mine I wasn't aware of. Would that end up being myself despite me being sure that it couldn't be the case?
entries.new: 而且说到底，他们所有人都说过，曾和一个连我自己都不知道的「我」说过话。这是事实。尽管我确信那不可能，可最后会不会就是我自己？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If so, then I wouldn't be able to change the past. I was in the reality where that other self of mine appeared.
entries.new: 若真是如此，我就无法改变过去。我正身处那个「另一个我」出现过的现实里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I hovered my hand over the gem and felt the imposing heat around it, repelling me. I realized I couldn't breathe properly due to the strange smell from all day. It was at its greatest intensity yet, reaching oppressive levels.
entries.new: 我把手悬在宝石上方，只觉周围热浪灼人，逼得我无法靠近。那股弥漫了一整天的怪味让我呼吸不畅——此刻浓烈到了极点，几乎令人窒息。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: With my left hand under my coat, I lifted the Sekimeiya out of the tank. Its heat was burning me through the cloth, but I resisted the intense pain.
entries.new: 我用左手隔着外套，把 Sekimeiya 从槽中提了出来。热量透过布料灼烧着我，我硬生生忍住了这股剧痛。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: This is the last chance we have to save anyone. Maybe saving Miiya is impossible, but I'm holding the possibility to erase Erina's suffering, Isla's, Naomi's, or even Katei's. If that works, nothing should be undoable, and then I could tell Atsuki what I've done and work together with him to save Miiya.
entries.new: 这是我们救人的最后机会了。也许救不了 Miiya，但我手上握着抹去 Erina、Isla、Naomi，甚至 Katei 的痛苦的希望。只要成功，就没有什么不能挽回。到那时，我就能告诉 Atsuki 我做过什么，再与他一起救 Miiya。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I still knew he wanted to change the past, and maybe he didn't want to get rid of the memories he had. Who was I to decide that by myself and effectively erase the Atsuki I knew in that moment...?
entries.new: 我知道他仍想改变过去，也许他并不想舍弃自己拥有的记忆。我凭什么擅自做这样的决定，把此刻我认识的那个 Atsuki 抹去……？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But I couldn't hesitate. If I chose not to activate the Sekimeiya, I might not have been able to live with myself. I couldn't accept acting only in my own self-interest.
entries.new: 但我不能犹豫。若我选择不启动 Sekimeiya，我恐怕无法原谅自己。只为自己打算，我做不到。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I lowered my right hand slowly, toward the harmless-looking gem. I shut my eyes and gritted my teeth in pain, pushing through the burning aura until I made contact with the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 我缓缓放下右手，伸向那颗看似无害的宝石。我闭上眼，咬牙忍痛，顶着灼热的气浪往前，直到触到 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: At that point, Shiroya disappeared from the bathroom.
entries.new: 就在那一刻，Shiroya 从盥洗室里消失了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: She also disappeared from the crystal floor and from Ashiya Tower. She went much farther through time than she had expected.
entries.new: 她也从水晶层消失了，从芦屋塔消失了。她穿越的时间，远比她预想的要远。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The oblivious people who remained in the lobby would soon realize that something had happened and would search for the missing Shiroya through all seven floors...
entries.new: 那些还留在大厅、毫不知情的人很快就会察觉出了事，然后会搜遍七层楼，寻找失踪的 Shiroya……
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Liquid Canvas
entries.new: 流动的画布

entries.text: —Wha—{w=1} ...Ow.{w=0.8} Where... is this?
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I felt my body lying on cold stone. I opened my eyes, but I couldn't see a thing.
entries.new: 我感到自己躺在冰冷的石地上。睁开眼，却什么都看不见。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Is this still the tower...?
entries.new: 这里还是塔里……？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I tried to stand up, but my whole body hurt. When I moved, I realized I was wearing different clothes under my coat and that the air was much colder.
entries.new: 我想站起来，全身却疼得厉害。一动之下才发现，外套底下的衣服换了，周围的空气也冷得多。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Ah...! What...!?
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I suddenly felt a throbbing pain in my head that stopped all my movements. It wasn't only my head—there wasn't a single part of my body that didn't hurt.
entries.new: 一阵抽痛猛地袭上头部，让我动弹不得。不只是头——我全身上下没有一处不疼。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I stayed still, hoping the unbearable headache would fade away. In the meantime, my vision began to adjust a little.
entries.new: 我一动不动，盼着那难以忍受的头痛快点退去。这时，视线渐渐适应了一些。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I couldn't see light anywhere, but I was still able to make out the space around me.
entries.new: 四下不见一丝光亮，我却仍能辨出周围的空间。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Is this underground...?
entries.new: 这是地下……？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: That was all I could really tell, but when I looked up, I understood where I was.
entries.new: 我能确定的仅止于此，可抬头一看，便明白了自己身在何处。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The ceiling is broken, and there's a bit of light... That's where I fell from.
entries.new: 天花板破了，透进一点光……我就是从那里掉下来的。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I was in some kind of channel, directly below the gem shop we'd gone to that day.
entries.new: 我在一条像是通道的地方，就在那天我们去过的那家宝石店正下方。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Bewildered, I tried to think. However, an immense headache was still numbing my mind.
entries.new: 我茫然地想理清头绪，可剧烈的头痛仍让脑子一片麻木。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Did I appear here? From the tower?
entries.new: ……我是出现在这里的？从那座塔？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I didn't think that was it. I remembered traveling from the bathroom on the crystal floor, but something was amiss.
entries.new: 我觉得不是。我记得自己是从水晶层的盥洗室穿越的，可总有什么不对劲。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Every time I'd gone through time, I'd instantly appeared somewhere. That time, I'd woken up on the ground, and my whole body hurt. ...Had there been something in between, then? It felt like there had to have been, but my mind was too foggy to know.
entries.new: 以往每次穿越，我都是在某处瞬间出现。这一次却是在地上醒来，浑身都疼。……难道中间还夹着什么？总觉得一定有过，可脑子一片混沌，想不明白。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Where am I? How far back did I go?
entries.new: 我在哪里？回到了多久以前？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Under the thick, brown coat I usually wore, I identified the clothes I was in. They were the ones I'd woken up with in the hospital—the ones I'd worn the day Miiya died.
entries.new: 在我常穿的厚棕色外套下面，我认出了自己身上的衣服。那是我在医院醒来时穿的衣服——Miiya 死去那天我穿的那一身。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I kept trying to push my mind for an answer, but I had no idea what had happened. When I finally collected myself somewhat, I noticed that I had my purse around my shoulder. I unzipped it and felt the interior with my hand.
entries.new: 我拼命想让脑子给出答案，却完全不知道发生了什么。等稍稍镇定下来，我才发觉挎包还挂在肩上。我拉开拉链，伸手探了探里面。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...The knife isn't here. Why did I not travel with it this time?
entries.new: ……刀不在。这次为什么没跟着一起穿越过来？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Wait, this...!
entries.new: 等等，这是……！
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I retracted my hand, gripping a familiar object. After fiddling with it, a rectangular light appeared in front of me.
entries.new: 我收回手，掌中握着一件熟悉的东西。摆弄几下，一块长方形的光在眼前亮起。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It was my phone. The time displayed was {time=21:10}, but I only wanted to look at the date. I navigated deeper into the settings menu to access the current date. Then, I stared at the screen, reading it over and over.
entries.new: 是我的手机。屏幕上的时间显示为 {time=21:10}，但我只想看日期。我翻进设置菜单更深处，调出当前日期，然后盯着屏幕，一遍又一遍地看。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: November 30th.
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wait... that... doesn't make any sense.
entries.new: 等等……这……说不通啊。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: November 30th? Did I go fifteen days to the past?
entries.new: 11月30日？我回到了十五天前？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: That day, at that time, I was already in a coma. I'd fallen from that ceiling up there, and I woke up in a hospital room days later.
entries.new: 那一天的那个时候，我已经昏迷了。我从上面那处天花板掉下来，几天后才在病房里醒来。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I looked around me, but I didn't see anyone else.
entries.new: 我环顾四周，不见其他人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If that's where I am... has my old body already been taken to the hospital? But why does my whole body hurt? This has never happened before...
entries.new: 如果真是这样……那我原来那具身体是不是已经被送去医院了？可我全身为什么这么疼？这以前从没发生过……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: My mind felt really clouded. After touching the Sekimeiya, I'd woken up in that sewer. I hadn't instantly appeared there, so I didn't fully understand what had happened.
entries.new: 我脑中一片混沌。碰过 Sekimeiya 之后，我就在那条下水道里醒了过来。我并非瞬间出现在那里，所以并不完全明白发生了什么。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Could I have overwritten my past self since I touched the Sekimeiya while willing to change the past?
entries.new: 我触碰 Sekimeiya 时，正怀着改变过去的念头——难道因此覆盖了过去的自己？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I tried to stand up, but a sudden, piercing headache made me collapse to the ground. My cheek hit cold stone again, and the faint light slowly vanished.
entries.new: 我想站起来，脑袋却猛地一阵刺痛，整个人又跌回地面。脸颊再次贴上冰冷的石头，微弱的光也缓缓消失了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I wanted to move, but none of my muscles responded. My entire body was sore, like I'd received countless punches. Even the scarce willpower to reopen my eyes left me, as if I'd exhausted all my energy in an instant.
entries.new: 我想动，可全身肌肉都不听使唤。身体酸痛得像挨了无数拳。就连重新睁开眼的最后一点意志也消散了，仿佛所有力气在刹那间被抽干。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: My senses dulled—the world darkened—my coat tightly enveloped me—{w} And then it was gone.{w} The cold and pain disappeared too, leaving me floating in the middle of nowhere.
entries.new: 我的感官渐渐迟钝——世界暗了下去——外套紧紧裹住我——{w} 然后，那一切都消失了。{w} 寒冷与疼痛也一并退去，只剩我漂浮在虚无之中。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There was no sound. I was conscious, but I didn't know where I was or why I was there. My awareness became a single, thin stream devoid of thought.
entries.new: 四周没有一点声音。我意识清醒，却不知道自己身在何处，又为何会在这里。我的意识只剩一缕细流，空无一念。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The stressful events of the tower disappeared, and the tension I'd been holding in for the previous weeks vanished. A great sense of relief washed over me.
entries.new: 塔中那些令人心力交瘁的事全都远去了，前几周一直积压在心里的紧张也烟消云散。一阵巨大的解脱感涌遍全身。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: No, I was on the ground in an underground tunnel. That fleeting notion sparked into my brain multiple times, but it was never enough to disrupt the silence.
entries.new: 不对，我正躺在地下隧道的地面上。这个念头一次次在脑中闪过，却始终不足以打破那片寂静。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The world was consumed by my growing existence until eventually I was the only thing in it. Perhaps it had always been like that. For longer than time itself, I drifted aimlessly.
entries.new: 我的存在不断蔓延，吞没了整个世界，到最后，其中仿佛只剩下我。也许一直都是如此。我漫无目的地漂荡，久得仿佛超过了时间本身。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Who was I? I was surprised to feel curious about that question. The nothingness had become the only thing I knew, so the tiniest vestige of uncertainty was enough to bring me into disarray.
entries.new: 我是谁？我竟对这个问题生出了好奇，连自己都感到意外。虚无已成了我唯一认得的东西，因此哪怕只剩一丝不确定，也足以让我方寸大乱。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: A distant figure began to take shape in the darkness, and it grew until I became one with it.
entries.new: 远处，一道身影在黑暗中渐渐成形，越来越大，直到与我融为一体。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: That's... me.{w} ...And there's Atsuki.{w} Not from now, but when we were still children. Laughing. Playing. Having fun.
entries.new: 那是我……{w} ……还有 Atsuki。{w} 不是现在的我们，而是我们还是孩子的时候。笑着，玩着，那么开心。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Hey, Shiroya! Check this out!
entries.new: 喂，Shiroya！快看这个！
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: He handed me a small flower with dark purple petals, contrasting with the white world surrounding us.
entries.new: 他递给我一朵小花，深紫色的花瓣与周围白茫茫的世界形成鲜明对比。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: So pretty! I'm sure Danny would love it!
entries.new: 好漂亮！Danny 一定会喜欢的！
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: I gingerly placed the flower on the stuffed tiger's head, then held it up to my face.
entries.new: 我小心翼翼地把花放到老虎玩偶头上，然后把它举到面前。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wow! It looks so good on you, doesn't it?
entries.new: 哇！这朵花戴在你头上真好看，对吧？
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Without missing a beat, the boy in front of me spoke up.
entries.new: 我面前的男孩没有半分迟疑，立刻开了口。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'm sure it would look nicer on you.
entries.new: 戴在你头上肯定更好看。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: He took the flower off the toy and began fidgeting with my shirt.{w} When he was done, I couldn't help but smile.
entries.new: 他把花从玩偶头上取下来，在我衣襟上摆弄起来。{w} 等他弄完，我忍不住笑了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Seamlessly, the world changed. We were riding on our bikes down the streets of Yushibana.{w} ...And then we were drinking hot chocolate after playing in the snow. One after another, fond memories played in my vision, and I once again became a child.
entries.new: 世界悄然变换，衔接得毫无痕迹。我们骑着自行车，穿行在丰花的街道上。{w} ……转眼又变成在雪地里玩过之后，一起喝热巧克力。那些温暖的回忆一幕接一幕在眼前浮现，我又变回了孩子。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I wasn't just experiencing memories, I also created new scenarios. We'd always wanted to hang out in the big cities, and that had become possible.
entries.new: 我不只是在重温回忆，也在创造新的场景。我们一直想去大城市里玩，而这件事竟也变得触手可及。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The innocent pleasure dimmed softly as the world faded back to nothing. I couldn't object or resist, as if I was a baby on the verge of awareness.
entries.new: 那份纯真的快乐悄然黯淡，世界也随之褪回虚无。我无法反对，也无法抗拒，仿佛只是一个刚刚萌生意识的婴儿。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: After an eternity, my mind reawakened. Another figure appeared far in the distance.
entries.new: 仿佛过了永恒那么久，我的意识才再度苏醒。远处又出现了一道身影。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Miiya.{w} I liked her as a friend, but...{w} When did it get so complicated?{w} She was gone. But even when she was alive, things didn't feel completely right. Myriad moments of before her death flowed into my mind. We were smiling and laughing in all of them, but as I watched us from above, I just wondered if she'd ever actually considered me a friend. We had spent time together, but I wasn't sure what it had meant.
entries.new: ……Miiya。{w} 我对她的喜欢，是朋友之间的那种，可是……{w} 事情是什么时候变得这么复杂的？{w} 她已经不在了。可就算她活着的时候，一切也并非全然对劲。她死前的无数瞬间涌入脑海。每一个瞬间里，我们都在笑；可当我从上方望着我们时，我只想知道，她究竟有没有真正把我当成朋友。我们曾一起度过许多时光，可那究竟意味着什么，我并不确定。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: She joined our little world and warped it into something different. Not better, not worse, just different. And her departure made it very different once again.
entries.new: 她走进了我们的小小世界，把它扭曲成了另一副模样。说不上更好，也说不上更坏，只是不同了。而她的离去，又让一切变得截然不同。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We had access to a time travel device. We had no idea how it worked, but could we use it to rescue her?{w} Did I... even want to rescue her?
entries.new: 我们手上有时间穿越装置。我们完全不知道它如何运作，但能不能用它救她？{w} 我……真的想救她吗？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Of course I did. Anything to bring us back to a sense of "normal". Anything to bring back the happier days.
entries.new: 当然想。只要能让我们重新找回「正常」的感觉，我什么都愿意做。只要能找回那些更快乐的日子。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Were the days with Miiya better than the days without her? Yes, but... why? Why was it all so messy?
entries.new: 有 Miiya 的日子，真的比没有她的日子更好吗？是的，可是……为什么？为什么一切都成了一团乱麻？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: My existence folded in on itself. A momentary jolt, a sense of disorientation, running around in the darkness.
entries.new: 我的存在仿佛向内塌陷。一阵短暂的冲击，一片天旋地转，我在黑暗中四处打转。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Was the Sekimeiya a blessing or a curse? An object that reworked the flow of time. An object that kept us confined in the past...
entries.new: Sekimeiya 究竟是恩赐，还是诅咒？一件能改写时间流向的物体，一件把我们困在过去的物体……
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: My senses dulled again. I kept drifting in the dark and gentle abyss. Or maybe I wasn't drifting at all. I realized I didn't know anything.
entries.new: 我的感官又变得迟钝了。我不断漂荡在黑暗而温柔的深渊里。又或者，我根本不曾漂荡。我意识到自己什么都不知道。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I felt a cold breeze as the darkness began to lift. Part of me wanted to stay there forever, wrapped in black.
entries.new: 黑暗开始退去时，我感觉到一阵冷风。我心底有一部分仍想永远留在那里，被那片黑色裹住。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The sensation of possessing a body gradually came back to me. My limbs existed again.{w} In an instant, I became acutely aware of a pain in my cheek. I was resting on a pebble.
entries.new: 拥有身体的感觉渐渐回来了。我的四肢重新有了实感。{w} 刹那间，我清楚地感到脸颊一阵疼痛——原来我正压在一颗小石子上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I looked around me, the faint light illuminating the sewer. My eyes were wet, almost as if I'd been crying.
entries.new: 我环顾四周，微弱的光照出下水道的轮廓。眼眶是湿的，几乎像刚刚哭过。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'm... still underground. What just happened?
entries.new: 我……还在地底下。刚才到底发生了什么？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: My head throbbed relentlessly while I came to terms with the realization that I'd fallen unconscious. After so long, I tried to move my arm and received a faint response.
entries.new: 脑袋一阵阵抽痛，我慢慢接受了自己刚才昏过去的事实。过了好一会儿，我试着动了动胳膊，才得到一点微弱的回应。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Right... I just traveled from the tower. It's November 30th... Again.
entries.new: 对……我刚从塔里穿越过来。今天是 11 月 30 日……又回到了这一天。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I exhaled deeply, pulling myself together. That dream, if it could be called that, was almost like the coma I'd been in once already, a haze of half-concepts. It was almost frightening how lost I'd gotten in it.{w} I remembered fragments of it, but the question of whether I wanted to save Miiya was still vividly present in my mind.
entries.new: 我深深呼出一口气，让自己镇定下来。那场梦——如果那也能叫梦的话——几乎像我此前经历过的那次昏迷，只剩一团半成形念头的迷雾。我在其中迷失得如此之深，事后想来几乎有些后怕。{w} 我只记得一些碎片，但「我是否想救 Miiya」这个问题，仍鲜明地留在脑海中。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Of course I want Miiya to live. What kind of question is that? And what would Atsuki do without her?
entries.new: ……我当然希望 Miiya 活着。这算什么问题？要是没有她，我自己又该怎么办？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I rested for a bit longer, trying to drive off those intrusive thoughts, until I was eventually able to sit up. I was still lost in the dark, so I pulled out my phone and looked at the time. It was {time=21:34.}
entries.new: 我又歇了一会儿，试图驱散那些侵入脑中的念头，直到终于能坐起身。四周仍是一片黑暗，我辨不清方向，只好掏出手机看时间。屏幕上显示 {time=21:34.}。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It's only been about thirty minutes...
entries.new: 才过了大约三十分钟……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I laboriously stood up and took some mindless steps. I couldn't feel anything around me except the hard concrete. I supposed it wasn't a sewer that I was in since it didn't really smell at all, but I had no idea what it was.
entries.new: 我费力地站起来，漫无目的地挪了几步。周围除了坚硬的水泥，我什么都感觉不到。这里几乎闻不到异味，我想应该不是下水道，可这到底是什么地方，我毫无头绪。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wait... What am I supposed to do now? Can I really change the past? What the hell is this? Did I appear two weeks into the past, but mere minutes too late to save Miiya? It can't be, right...? Why would I have gone so far back?
entries.new: 等等……我现在该怎么办？我真的能改变过去吗？这到底是怎么回事？我是回到了两周前，却偏偏晚了几分钟，没能救下 Miiya？不会吧……？我为什么要回到那么早的时候？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Completely perplexed, I walked forward, toward the darkness. It wasn't possible to reach the hole above me, so I had to hope I could walk out of there.
entries.new: 我满心困惑，朝着黑暗走去。头顶那个洞口够不到，我只能寄希望于顺着这里走出去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: After a few steps, I ran into a wall. The darkness should've been terrifying, but I wasn't scared. I needed to get out of there and hope I could find out where I was.
entries.new: 走了几步，我撞上了一堵墙。这样的黑暗本该令人恐惧，我却并不害怕。我必须离开这里，也希望能弄清自己身在何处。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I flipped open my phone, but the light from the screen wasn't enough to illuminate the path ahead. After feeling the space, I knew there were two tunnels in front of me, one much larger than the other.
entries.new: 我翻开手机，屏幕的光却照不亮前方的路。我伸手摸索了一番，才知道面前有两条通道，一条比另一条宽得多。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I could only go through one, so I kept walking toward the one that seemed wide and dry.
entries.new: 我只能选一条，便朝着那条显得宽敞干燥的继续走去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If I can change the past... can I prevent the attack in the tower from happening? I can at least prevent Atsuki and myself from going there, but would this really work?
entries.new: 如果我能改变过去……是不是就能阻止塔里那场袭击？至少能让我和 Atsuki 不去那里，可这样做真的有用吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: What would happen to me? I've already thought of this, but if I change the past, would I remain in a world with another version of myself?
entries.new: 那我自己又会怎样？这问题我早已想过——若我改变了过去，我还会留在一个存在着另一个我的世界里吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: And if I can do that, should I? Instead of trying to travel back one more time and save Miiya in the first place?
entries.new: 就算真能做到，我该这样做吗？而不是再穿越一次，从一开始就救下 Miiya？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...{w}The darkness had become absolute. On that day, the Sekimeiya must've been somewhere. As Ashiya's announcement had already been made public, they were probably keeping it somewhere in the tower.
entries.new: ……{w}黑暗已彻底吞没了一切。那一天，Sekimeiya 一定就在某处。既然芦屋的声明早已公开，他们多半把它存放在塔内的某个地方。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I walked for minutes, every individual step feeling surreal, and the bright image of the screen frozen in my mind. November 30th...
entries.new: 我走了好几分钟，每一步都恍如梦境，屏幕上那行明亮的内容仍定格在脑海里。11月30日……
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I kept going, hugging the wall next to me. At one point, the path began to slant up, making every step tougher.
entries.new: 我贴着身旁的墙壁继续前行。走着走着，通道开始向上倾斜，每一步都愈发吃力。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...How do I get out of here? Should there be a ladder somewhere?
entries.new: ……我要怎么出去？这附近应该会有梯子吧？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: For an entire day, I'd grown used to hearing the echo of my own footsteps with no other sound. I wasn't in that tower anymore, but the sensation was identical.
entries.new: 整整一天，我早已习惯了四下无声、只听见自己脚步的回音。我已不在那座塔里，感觉却一模一样。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I slowly increased my pace. I was so close to finally being outside again.
entries.new: 我慢慢加快脚步。终于快要重新回到外面了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The tunnel was a straight path, seemingly unending. After walking for a while, I started to feel a little desperate.
entries.new: 通道笔直延伸，仿佛没有尽头。走了一阵，我心里渐渐生出一丝绝望。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Was I going toward an exit, or was I completely lost? I couldn't see anything that distinguished where I was.
entries.new: 我是在走向出口，还是早已彻底迷了路？眼前没有任何东西能让我辨认方位。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I was too dedicated to my path to turn around and go the other way. It almost felt like there would be a monster waiting behind me if I did. I could only keep moving, almost like I was in a dream of an ever-lengthening corridor.
entries.new: 我太执着于这条路，已无法回头另走他途。仿佛只要转身，身后就会有怪物等着。我只能不停往前走，就像在梦里走过一条越走越长的走廊。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Finally, that sensation ended. I located a ladder and climbed out of the channel's end. Around me was a grassy field covered in snow, the sky firmly situated above me. It was real.
entries.new: 那感觉终于结束了。我找到一架梯子，从水道尽头爬了出去。四周是一片覆雪的草地，天空稳稳地悬在头顶。这一切都是真的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I couldn't fathom the image. In front of me, I saw Yushibana, entirely still. A chilly breeze forced me to shrug my coat higher and cover my neck.
entries.new: 眼前的景象让我一时难以置信。前方是丰花，一片寂静。冷风袭来，我只好把大衣往上拢了拢，遮住脖子。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'd been trapped for hours in a building I could see the faintest outline of on the horizon, but that wasn't all. Seeing Yushibana below me brought a relief I hadn't known was possible. Seeing that I'd been released, all my questions fell away.
entries.new: 我被困在那栋建筑里好几个小时，如今它在地平线上只剩一个模糊的轮廓。但还不止这些。俯望着下方的丰花，我感到一种从未有过的宽慰。看到自己终于脱身，所有疑问都烟消云散了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I didn't know why I was atop that hill or what had happened to me. All I knew in that moment was a soaring sense of liberty. I was actually free.
entries.new: 我不知道自己为何会站在那座山丘上，也不知道自己经历了什么。那一刻我唯一感受到的，是腾空而起的自由。我真的自由了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I looked inside my purse again and saw keys.
entries.new: 我又翻了翻手提包，看见了钥匙。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: These belong to my apartment. They're not Atsuki's.{w} ...The tickets aren't here either.
entries.new: 这是我公寓的钥匙，不是 Atsuki 的。{w}……票据也不在。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I pushed off the snow on the stone that formed the tunnel and sat on it. Every part of my body still hurt, especially my back.
entries.new: 我拂去通道口那块石头上的积雪，坐了上去。全身各处都还在作痛，尤其是后背。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I was breathing calmly, observing the silent town. From there, I could see the entirety of Yushibana. Close to me was the school I'd gone to and a familiar park next to it.
entries.new: 我平稳地呼吸着，打量着这座寂静的小镇。从这里能望见整个丰花。离我最近的是我念过的学校，旁边还有那座熟悉的公园。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There was no way to really be sure, but I assumed that the tunnel I'd gone through was part of some kind of drainage system. It sloped down the hill into the center of town, and I couldn't think of any other function for it than collecting water that would otherwise flood.
entries.new: 我无法确证，但猜想自己走过的通道属于某种排水系统。它顺着山坡向下，通向镇中心；除了汇集本会漫溢的积水，我想不出它还有别的用途。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...It didn't really matter. I was out. The drainage channel, or whatever it was, hadn't swept me away or drowned me. That long tunnel was a path to salvation. I didn't know the true state of the world I was looking down on, but all by myself, I was finally able to experience peace.
entries.new: ……这些都不重要了。我出来了。那条排水道也好，别的什么也罢，终究没有把我冲走，也没有把我淹死。那条漫长的通道，是通往救赎的路。我并不知道俯瞰的这个世界真实状况如何，但独自一人，我终于得以体会片刻安宁。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Forcing myself to move, I stood up and began to descend a thin path that started from the tunnel.
entries.new: 我勉强撑起身，沿着从通道口延伸出去的一条窄径往山下走。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I sensed my boots pressing on the snow until I was down the hill. Upon turning around, I saw the trail of footprints that I'd left. ...As bizarre as it was, I looked at them as proof that I was really there.
entries.new: 我感受着靴子踩在雪上的触感，一路走下山坡。回头望去，只见身后留下了一串脚印。……说来古怪，我却把它们当作自己确实来过这里的证明。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: My phone showed {time=21:48}, and I was behind my school, where I'd rarely ever been at such a time.
entries.new: 手机显示{time=21:48}，我正站在学校后面——这个时间，我几乎从未来过这里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Much farther in the distance, I could see the top of the only structure that rivaled Ashiya Tower's height.
entries.new: 更远处的远方，我能看见那座唯一可与芦屋塔比肩的建筑顶端。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The hospital... Is that where I am right now? Or am I being brought there?
entries.new: 医院……我现在就在那里吗？还是说，我正被送往那里？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I couldn't comprehend yet how the travel had worked, but I walked around the school and found myself in the park we'd been at that very day.
entries.new: 我还弄不明白这次穿越究竟是如何发生的，但我绕过学校，来到了那天我们待过的那座公园。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I started to hear faint voices around me and saw dark silhouettes next to one of the benches. Of course, I wasn't alone in the town.
entries.new: 我渐渐听见周围传来隐约的人声，还看见一张长椅旁有几道深色的身影。当然，镇上并不只有我一人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Unaware of where I was headed, I followed the steps we'd taken at a time that felt like a distant past.
entries.new: 我不知道自己要去哪里，只是沿着我们那天走过的路线。那时候已经像是遥远的过去了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Tall, round lights illuminated the rustic part of Yushibana. That day, we'd just happened to end up at a modest shop, but the present me deliberately walked to it.
entries.new: 高大的圆形路灯照亮了丰花古旧的那一片街区。那天我们只是偶然走进一家不起眼的小店，如今的我却特意朝它走去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What will happen if they see me? There's gotta be someone there. ...That's bound to change the past, right?
entries.new: 要是被他们看见，会怎么样？那里肯定有人。……那一定会改变过去，对吧？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I remembered all the narrow streets. No light could be seen through almost any window, and most of the footprints still on the ground ended at various doors.
entries.new: 那些狭窄的街道我都记得。几乎每扇窗里都透不出灯光，地上残留的脚印大多消失在各种门前。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I looked from the final turn and stared at where the shop had been.
entries.new: 我从最后一个拐角望去，凝视着那家小店原本所在的地方。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Hm...
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: In front of the door were two people talking to each other. One of them wore a suit, and the other wore casual clothes for the cold.
entries.new: 门前有两个人正在交谈。一个穿着西装，另一个穿着御寒的便装。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I don't recognize either of them.
entries.new: 这两个人我都不认得。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Should I step forward? What would they ask me, and how would I answer anything?
entries.new: 我该上前吗？他们会问我什么，我又该怎么回答？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I chose to stay still. If the past could be changed, that wasn't the way to do it.
entries.new: 我选择按兵不动。如果过去真的能改变，也不该用这种方式。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Next to them was the window that had once grabbed our attention. I couldn't hear anything they were saying, but they hadn't sensed me either.
entries.new: 他们旁边就是那扇曾经吸引我们目光的橱窗。我听不见他们在说什么，他们也没有察觉到我。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Not long after, the man in a suit walked away. The other person saw him off and stayed where he'd been. That gave me the chance to look at his face.
entries.new: 没过多久，穿西装的男人离开了。另一个人目送他走远，仍留在原处。这让我有机会看清他的脸。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Oh... It's the owner of the shop.
entries.new: 哦……是那家店的老板。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: The other man was walking toward me, so I backed off toward another path to avoid being seen.
entries.new: 另一个男人正朝我这边走来，我连忙退向另一条小路，以免被发现。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I suddenly bumped into a car camouflaged by the dark. In the sky, the moon was hardly visible, not helping things. Fortunately, the snow on the ground told me where I was every step.
entries.new: 我忽然撞上了一辆被夜色掩盖的车。天上的月亮几乎看不见，也没帮上什么忙。幸好地上的积雪让我每走一步都能辨清方位。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I seemed to be the only person there, so I kept going until I arrived at a road full of wheel marks.
entries.new: 那里似乎只有我一个人，我便一直往前走，直到来到一条布满车轮印的道路上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The streets were wider, and a couple walked by me. After so long, there was life around me, and the strain on my shoulders slowly faded away.
entries.new: 街道变得更宽阔了，一对情侣从身旁走过。这么久以来，身边终于又有了活人的气息，压在肩头的紧绷也一点点松了下来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Should I just go home?
entries.new: ……我是不是该直接回家？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Atsuki was also brought to the hospital, and I was there for a week. I have the keys, so I really can just do that.
entries.new: Atsuki 也被送进了医院，我在那里待了一周。钥匙就在我手上，真的可以直接回家。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: For what purpose was I in the past, standing next to a lonesome streetlight? I knew I had to do something. I could change history... But sleep was the only thing on my mind. My body still felt battered and weakened.
entries.new: 我身处过去，站在一盏孤零零的路灯旁，究竟是为了什么？我明白自己必须做点什么。我可以改变历史……可眼下我满脑子只想着睡觉。身体仍像被碾过一样，虚弱无力。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Getting to my bed was my priority. Everything else had become a background concern, as there was nothing I could do right then.
entries.new: 当务之急是回到床上。其他事都先放到一边——反正此刻我什么也做不了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Why am I so tired? I feel different from when I was in the tower. ...Is it because this is how I was at this time on November 30th?
entries.new: 我怎么会这么累？和在塔里时完全不一样。……是因为11月30日的这一刻，我本来就是这个状态吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: My apartment was close by, and I needed to rest. At that time of night, nobody should've been there.
entries.new: 公寓就在附近，我需要休息。这个时间点，那里不该有任何人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The cold was starting to get to me, so I tightened my coat around my shoulders as I walked. Taking my time, I observed my surroundings as I walked, all of them covered in the same white layer of snow.
entries.new: 寒气渐渐渗进身体，我边走边把大衣裹紧。脚步不急，我一路打量着四周——目之所及，都覆着同样一层白雪。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What will I do...? I can only hope that I'll understand everything better tomorrow, but I should have enough time to think about it. If I'm right... my parents aren't even in Japan, I'm about to spend a week in the hospital, and then I'll go to live with Atsuki. I can just be at my apartment until the 15th comes again.
entries.new: 我该怎么办……？只能指望明天能把一切想得更明白些，好在时间还算充裕。如果我没记错……父母根本不在日本，我接下来要在医院待上一周，之后会去和 Atsuki 同住。那么在15日再次到来之前，我只要待在公寓里就行。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: But then what? Should I try to make us not go to the tower? How would I attempt to prevent the attack from happening? Even if Atsuki and I don't go, there are people who will die.{w} And in both cases, I'm giving up on going to the past again to save Miiya. If the past can be changed, I can't just leave her to die.
entries.new: 可那之后呢？难道要设法让我们别去那座塔？我又要怎么阻止那场袭击？就算我和 Atsuki 不去，也还是会有人死。{w} 而无论走哪条路，我都等于放弃再次回到过去救 Miiya。既然过去可以改变，我就不能眼睁睁看着她死去。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: But this is still really scary. At the time I change the past, I'll be stuck in a world with another self of mine, and I won't be the original.{w} The me that Atsuki saw in the event room... will it really be me? Will I decide that I don't want to change the past just so that I keep living in a world where I'm the only version of myself? I wouldn't do that, would I?
entries.new: 可这仍然叫人心惊。等我改变过去的那一刻，我就会被困在一个还有另一个自己的世界里，不再是原来的那一个。{w} Atsuki 在活动室看到的那个我……真的会是我吗？我会不会为了继续待在一个只有我这个版本的世界里，就决定不去改变过去？我不会做出这种事吧？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Arriving home, I saw a few people talking to each other. They had no idea I was from the future. Of course, nobody knew about the Sekimeiya's powers yet.
entries.new: 快到家时，我看见几个人正聚在一处说话。他们全然不知我来自未来。当然，那时还没有人知道 Sekimeiya 拥有怎样的力量。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...How is that actually possible? The Sekimeiya has already been announced as a discovery, so why will they let the public touch it with what it can do? Did Ashiya not know about that? I have no idea where it even came from.
entries.new: ……这怎么可能？Sekimeiya 已经作为一项发现公开了，可它有这样的力量，他们怎么还让公众碰它？难道芦屋并不知道这件事？我连它究竟从哪来都毫无头绪。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: In the past, all those questions still had no answers. I turned toward a narrower street full of apartment blocks and looked far ahead.
entries.new: 在过去，这些问题都还没有答案。我拐进一条狭窄些的街，两旁尽是公寓楼，目光投向街道深处。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I stopped in the middle of it and went up a white, metallic staircase. On the way, I took my keys out and walked to a door below a "C" plate.
entries.new: 我在街心停下，走上白色的金属楼梯。途中掏出钥匙，走到一块写着「C」的门牌下方的那扇门前。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I stood in front of it and tried to sharpen my hearing.
entries.new: 我立在门前，竖起耳朵细听。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I can't hear anything...
entries.new: 什么也听不见……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: A little nervous, I inserted the key into the keyhole and kept it there for a while. Finally, I decided to turn it, making little noise.
entries.new: 我有些紧张，把钥匙插进锁孔，停在那里好一会儿。最后还是转动了它，尽量不发出声响。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Should I try to be silent? If I'm somehow in here, do I want to not be heard? What would I even do if I see myself? I can't go anywhere else.
entries.new: 我该尽量不出声吗？如果这屋子里真的还有另一个我，我会想不被听见吗？要是撞见自己，我又能怎么办？反正我无处可去。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I opened the door slowly.
entries.new: 我缓缓推开门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The faint light of the night illuminated the way in, and I took a hesitant step forward.
entries.new: 夜色微光透进来，照亮了门内的路，我迟疑着迈出一步。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Naturally, I knew where the light switch was, so I reached out to it while I glanced around. When the ceiling lit up, I saw the same entrance I'd seen countless times before.
entries.new: 电灯开关在哪，我自然一清二楚，于是一边伸手摸过去，一边环视四周。天花板亮起来后，映入眼中的是见过无数次的玄关。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Next to the door, I saw my reflection in the mirror. I looked a lot better than I'd imagined, probably because the body I was in hadn't made it to December yet.
entries.new: 门旁的镜子里映出我的身影。气色比我想象中好得多——大概因为这具身体还没撑到12月吧。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I closed the door and stood in the middle of the room, not much warmer. I still felt uneasy, so instead of taking off my shoes, I opened the door to the living room.
entries.new: 我关上门，站在屋子中央，并没暖和多少。心里仍不安稳，便没脱鞋，直接推开了通往客厅的门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There was a large window with its blinds closed, and in the center of the room, a wooden table on top of a green carpet. Everything looked like it had when I'd left on the 30th.
entries.new: 大窗的百叶帘拉着，房间正中，一张木桌摆在绿色地毯上。一切都和我30日离开时一模一样。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I really was at home. There was an old TV on top of a low stand that I rarely used due to the poor signal, and colored cushions were scattered all over the floor.
entries.new: 这里确实是我的家。矮柜上摆着一台旧电视，信号太差，我很少开；彩色的坐垫散落了一地。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Next to me was the door to the kitchen. In the sink were the few dishes I hadn't washed, and in a corner was the laundry I hadn't finished. That day, I'd been really looking forward to meeting Atsuki and Miiya, and although we hadn't ended up doing much, I'd been excited to go.
entries.new: 身旁是通往厨房的门。水槽里泡着几只没洗的碗碟，角落里堆着没洗完的衣物。那天我满心期待着去见 Atsuki 和 Miiya，虽然最后也没做什么，出门时却是兴致勃勃的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I walked back and opened the other door in the entryway.
entries.new: ……我折回去，打开了玄关里的另一扇门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: After lighting up the short hallway, I stepped to the first door. My bedroom was behind it.
entries.new: 短廊的灯亮起后，我走到第一扇门前。那后面是我的卧室。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Farther back were the last three doors. One led to my parents' bedroom, the other to the bathroom, and the last was a guest room with a small bed.
entries.new: 再往里是最后三扇门。一扇通父母的卧室，一扇通浴室，最后一扇后面是摆着小床的客房。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'd been storing things in the guest room since it'd been unused for so long, cramming a bookcase full. Recently, my drive to read had dropped off, but I still kept my favorites front and center.
entries.new: 客房闲置已久，早被我拿来堆东西，书架塞得满满当当。最近看书的劲头淡了，可最喜欢的那些，仍摆在最显眼的位置。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Nothing was out of place. Everything I'd put in there hadn't moved even slightly.
entries.new: 没有任何异样。我放在那里的东西，一丝一毫都没动过。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There really is nobody here.
entries.new: 这里真的一个人都没有。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It was the same modest apartment I'd always lived in, but it seemed like I'd last been there a very long time in the past.{w} I'd left a trail of slick, snowy footprints, so I went to the entrance and dropped my boots beside the door.
entries.new: 这还是我住惯的那间朴素公寓，可上一次待在这里，仿佛已是极为遥远的过去了。{w} 我留下一串湿滑的雪脚印，于是回到玄关，把靴子脱在门边。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I entered my bedroom and draped my wet coat on a chair. My headache had been weakening, but many of my muscles were still sore.
entries.new: 我走进卧室，把湿外套搭在椅子上。头痛已经减轻了些，肌肉却仍酸痛不已。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I couldn't even tell if I was hungry, and my thirst was dwarfed by how tired I was. I left my purse next to the bed and fell on it with the clothes I'd been wearing.
entries.new: 我连自己饿不饿都分辨不出，口渴也被疲惫压得不见踪影。我把手提包丢在床边，衣服都没换就扑倒在床上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I closed my eyes on top of the large pillow and gradually wormed my way under the blankets.
entries.new: 我把脸埋进大枕头里闭上眼，一点点挪进被窝。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I was exhausted, but I didn't fall asleep immediately. There were too many things I had to think about.
entries.new: 我筋疲力尽，却没能立刻睡着。要想的事情太多了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'd just spent more than twelve hours sealed inside Ashiya Tower, so the sensation of my bed was far beyond welcome. However, it seemed I had suddenly arrived on the day where everything started.
entries.new: 我刚在封闭的芦屋塔里熬过十二个多小时，床铺的触感简直让人感激涕零。可看来，我是一下子落到了这一切开始的那一天。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: In the distance of the town must've been Atsuki, crying about the possibility of losing his two closest friends. Somewhere else, other people were surely thinking about the attack they'd orchestrate on December 15th.
entries.new: 小镇的某处，Atsuki 大概正为可能失去两位挚友而哭泣。而在另一个地方，也一定有人正在盘算着12月15日要发动的那场袭击。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I soon felt like I should've turned on the heater, but I couldn't get out of bed. My mind went through most of the events I'd been caught up in, and I still didn't reach a single conclusion. I had wanted to change the past, but comfortable as I was beneath two blankets, that was comparable to moving a mountain by hand.
entries.new: 我很快觉得该把暖气打开，却怎么也起不了床。脑海中把卷入的那些事过了一遍又一遍，仍没得出任何结论。我明明想改变过去，可此刻裹着两层毯子舒服得很，要起身简直如同徒手移山。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Huh—
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: A sound reached my covered ears and woke me up. I was frightened at first, but I quickly realized it had come from outside.
entries.new: 有声响透过被子传进耳朵，把我惊醒。起初吓了一跳，随即明白是从外面传来的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: And it didn't stop.
entries.new: 而且一直没停。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Fireworks?
entries.new: ……烟花？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Hearing fireworks in Yushibana was rare, but it was the start of the holiday season.
entries.new: 在丰花能听到烟花声实属少见，不过，节日季已经开始了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I removed my head from under the blankets and paid attention to the sound. While it wasn't close to where I was, brief sparks of light could be seen through the window.
entries.new: 声音离我并不近，但透过窗户能看见一闪一闪的光。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I knew the air was still chilly, but I braced myself and pushed the blankets aside.
entries.new: 我知道屋里还冷，还是咬咬牙，把被子掀开了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I sat up and looked at my phone. It was {time=1:06.}{w} When I looked behind me, I saw the large screen of glass turning orange momentarily, reflecting the distant light.
entries.new: 我坐起身，看了眼手机。时间是{time=1:06.}{w}回头望去，只见那片巨大的玻璃屏一瞬间染上橘色，映着远处的光。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...They really are fireworks. I never hear them here because the police always shut them down, but I bet someone sneaked some into town and wanted to celebrate the holidays.
entries.new: ……真的是烟花。我在这儿从没听过烟花声，因为警察总是会取缔，不过准是有人偷偷带进城，想庆祝节日吧。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I see...
entries.new: 原来如此……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I couldn't help but feel as if they were welcoming me, although I knew the truth was far from that.
entries.new: 明知事实远非如此，我却不由得觉得，那烟花像是在迎接我。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I was in a coma, so I'd never truly heard or seen those fireworks. There was nothing I wanted more than to view them with Atsuki and Miiya, but that couldn't happen.
entries.new: 那时我昏迷不醒，从未真正听过、看过这场烟花。我最想的，就是和 Atsuki、Miiya 一起看，可那终究不可能。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Would it be possible to change the past so that it could?
entries.new: 改变过去，就能让它成真吗？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The past is really changing, though.
entries.new: 不过，过去确实正在改变。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It had already been changed. That I was seeing those fireworks was the proof.
entries.new: 它早已被改变过了。我能看见这场烟花，就是证明。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I was allowed to live through what I'd missed out on—the two weeks where I hadn't lived.
entries.new: 我得以把错失的那段日子重新活过一遍——那我不曾活过的两周。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I simply stared at the distant lights. My eyelids were drooping, but I didn't want to stop watching.
entries.new: 我只是凝望着远处的灯火。眼皮渐渐发沉，我却不愿移开视线。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The fireworks didn't last much longer. After a few minutes, the stronger ones went off, and they all calmly ceased.
entries.new: 烟花没有持续太久。几分钟后，最猛烈的一轮放完，一切便都悄然平息。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I dropped back onto the bed, still with no energy to turn on the heater or put on warmer clothes. That time, I fell asleep almost instantly.
entries.new: 我重新倒回床上，依旧提不起力气去开暖气，也懒得添件厚衣。这一次，我几乎立刻就睡着了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I opened my eyes.
entries.new: 我睁开眼。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Fresh Start
entries.new: 全新的开始

entries.text: I wasn't in the attic. I was in my own bedroom, facing the pillow I'd evidently rolled off of.
entries.new: 我不在阁楼，而是在自己的卧室里，脸贴着枕头——看来我是从枕头上滚下来的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The whole room was lit, sunlight streaming through the window. With my face still under the blankets, I closed my eyes again, not yet wanting to face the cold.
entries.new: 整间屋子都亮着，阳光从窗口倾泻进来。我把脸埋回被子里，又闭上了眼，还不想去面对那股寒气。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The first day of December...{w} Miiya's not here anymore, I'm in the hospital, and Atsuki's probably at his house.{w} Or, I guess I'm actually in my bed.
entries.new: 十二月一号……{w}Miiya 已经不在了，我在医院，Atsuki 大概在他家。{w}不对，我现在其实躺在自己床上。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I vividly remembered parts of a dream I'd just had. We'd all still been in the tower, and while the details escaped my grasp, it had entailed a messy conflict with the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 刚才那个梦的片段，我记得清清楚楚。我们还在塔里，细节已经记不清了，只记得那是一场与 Sekimeiya 之间混乱的冲突。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Out of nowhere, I realized I'd been lying in bed for a while without doing anything.{w} ...It had happened so quickly. It felt like just minutes ago I'd been waiting with everyone in the lobby.
entries.new: 不知怎的，我忽然发觉自己已经躺了好一阵，什么都没做。{w}……事情发生得太快了。仿佛几分钟前，我还在大厅里和大家一起等着。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'd been distressed in the tower, so why was I acting like nothing had happened? Was it just because I'd traveled to the past? Because there were two blank weeks ahead of me, and there was no reason to go over things I'd worried about once already? That logic didn't make a lot of sense.
entries.new: 在塔里时我明明那么痛苦，如今为何像个没事人一样？难道只因为我回到了过去？因为眼前还有空白的两个星期，所以没必要再去想已经烦恼过的事？这道理说不通。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'd gone to the past to change it, and I hadn't known how far I'd go. Since I was in the hospital at the time, as long as I went to Atsuki's house, I'd be changing the past. If he saw two versions of myself, he would have to believe anything I said.
entries.new: 我回到过去，是为了改变它，只是不知道自己究竟能走到哪一步。既然那时的我正躺在医院，只要我去了 Atsuki 家，过去就已经改变。要是他看见两个我，无论我说什么，他都只能相信。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But I didn't rush out of bed, and I probably knew the real reason why. It was sheer burnout.
entries.new: 可我并没有急着下床，真正的原因，我大概也心知肚明——纯粹是心力耗尽了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: In a way, it was similar to how I'd felt before meeting up with Atsuki and Miiya, the period when I had absolutely no idea what to do with myself. I'd gone nowhere and done nothing for an amount of time I couldn't measure. I had lost track of days, existing solely in my apartment.
entries.new: 某种意义上，这和与 Atsuki、Miiya 重逢之前的感觉很像——那时我完全不知道自己该做什么。我哪儿也不去，什么也不做，日子过得一片模糊，只是待在公寓里活着。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It had been a major depressive episode at the very least, but getting back together with not only one friend, but two, was the remedy for that. That was what I'd thought, anyway.
entries.new: 至少那是一次严重的抑郁发作，而与朋友重聚——不是一个，而是两个——便是它的解药。至少我那时是这么想的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Miiya had died, and I'd entered a coma. If I'd been living in a haze before, it evolved into a thick fog at that point. I was a shell of a person for a while, thinking almost exclusively about dangerously dark things. I was grateful that Atsuki hadn't given up on me entirely for everything I'd put him through.
entries.new: ……Miiya 死了，我也陷入了昏迷。如果说之前我只是活在迷雾里，那时便成了伸手不见五指的大雾。有很长一段时间，我只是一具空壳，脑子里几乎只剩危险的黑暗念头。我那样折腾他，Atsuki 却没有彻底放弃我，我对此心怀感激。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But it was a distinctly different situation. Rather than falling deeper into dysfunction, I had obtained a goal after going so far into the past. An abstract one, but a goal nonetheless.
entries.new: 可这次的情形截然不同。我没有陷得更深，反而在回到这么远的过去之后，得到了一个目标。虽然抽象，但终究是个目标。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I kept lying there until my remaining tiredness dissipated. I knew I had to do something, but I didn't know what.
entries.new: 我继续躺着，直到残余的倦意散尽。我知道自己必须做点什么，却不知道究竟该做什么。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I gathered the strength to sit up and looked at the window. Going off the strong light, I had slept for quite a few hours.
entries.new: 我攒起力气坐起身，望向窗外。看这光线的强度，我应该已经睡了好几个小时。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: My purse was next to the bed, so I grabbed my phone.
entries.new: 手提包就放在床边，我从中取出手机。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: {time=12:43.}..{w} It's late.
entries.new: {time=12:43.}……{w}都这么晚了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: As the buildings in Yushibana weren't very tall, I was able to see a good deal of the snow-covered town from my room. It wasn't snowing, and the sky was pretty clear. From behind the window, I felt as if I was aware of the fate of the entire town, even though what I knew was only related to a modest fraction of all those buildings.
entries.new: 丰花的建筑都不算高，从我的房间能望见大片积雪覆盖的城镇。雪已经停了，天空相当晴朗。隔着窗户，我仿佛知晓了整座城镇的命运——尽管我所知道的，只与那些建筑中很小的一部分有关。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The icy air quickly got to me, so I went to the hallway, carefully walking on the wooden floor so that I wouldn't stagger.
entries.new: 刺骨的寒气很快就逼了上来，我于是走向走廊，在木地板上小心迈步，免得脚下一个趔趄。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I reached the heater, which I'd normally only turn on during the nights since my parents were the ones who paid for my expenses and I didn't want to risk upsetting them.
entries.new: 我走到暖气前。平时我只在夜里才开，毕竟我的开销都由父母承担，我不想惹他们不快。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: This will be fine, right? Nobody's supposed to be living here, but I doubt it'll be noticed that gas and water were used.
entries.new: 这样应该没问题吧？这房子本该没人住，不过用了多少煤气和水，大概也没人会在意。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I hesitated a little, but I needed to get rid of the oppressive cold. Seconds after I turned the heater on, it let out a buzzing sound from the pipes running behind the wall.
entries.new: 我犹豫了一下，可这压人的寒意实在受不了。暖气开了不过几秒，墙后管道里便传来嗡嗡的声响。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I guess even if someone does notice, it'll be at the end of this month or maybe after that. It should be okay.
entries.new: 就算真有人发现，估计也要到月底，或者更晚。应该不要紧。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I had a water bottle on the table. I never liked drinking tap water, so I always spent a bit of my monthly money on bottled water. Filters just weren't enough.
entries.new: 桌上放着一瓶水。我一向不爱喝自来水，所以每个月总会花点钱买瓶装水。光靠滤水器并不够。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I didn't bother pouring it in a glass. The hours I'd spent in Ashiya Tower no longer applied to my body, but I was extremely thirsty.
entries.new: 我懒得倒进杯子。在芦屋塔里度过的那几个小时，对我这具身体已经不算数了，可我实在渴得厉害。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: To avoid grocery shopping too often, I usually had a cabinet packed with supplies. I would refill it at the beginning of every month, which was why it was almost empty. I looked inside and grabbed a bag of mixed nuts. As expected, they weren't very good, as they had sat in the cabinet all month, but I ate all of them almost instantly due to how hungry I was.
entries.new: 为了少跑几趟超市，我平时总把橱柜塞满存粮。每月初补一次货，所以现在里面几乎空了。我翻了翻，拿出一袋混合坚果。果然，放了一整月，味道已经不太行，可我饿得厉害，三两口就吃了个精光。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I walked to the living room, almost like it was routine. The blinds were keeping the space dim, but I rarely bothered raising them.
entries.new: 我几乎是习惯性地走向客厅。百叶窗让屋里显得昏暗，不过我很少会去拉开。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: After going to the bathroom, I stood in front of my wardrobe, wondering which clothes to change into. I'd lived alone for many months already, so I started the day as if it were a normal one.
entries.new: 去过洗手间后，我站在衣柜前，琢磨该换哪身衣服。独自生活已有好几个月，我便像平常一样开始了这一天。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Is it worth trying to make it seem like nobody's been here?
entries.new: 要不要费心装出没人住过的样子？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I don't know how, but if the past can be changed, I'm planning on doing it. There shouldn't be a huge need to hide my stay.
entries.new: 我不知道该怎么做，但只要过去能改变，我就打算去改。应该没必要大费周章地隐瞒我在这儿住过。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...Or is that right? Could it be that while I was in the hospital and at Atsuki's house, another version of me was already living here? There's no way, is there? That would mean that everything will happen as I remember it.
entries.new: ……真是这样吗？会不会在我住院、待在 Atsuki 家的时候，另一个我就已经住在这里了？不至于吧？若真如此，就意味着一切都会按我记忆中的样子发生。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: If the past will only change if I consciously make it, it shouldn't matter whether I was already living here in the reality I know. After all, I didn't come home for the purpose of changing the past.
entries.new: 如果过去只有在我有意识地去改变时才会变，那在我所知的现实里，我是否早就住在这里，也就无关紧要了。毕竟，我回家来并不是为了改变过去。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: If it's like this, and I intend to say that up until I decide to change history, everything could play out exactly as it once did, it should be confirmation that I'll be able to safely stay here until the 15th.
entries.new: 若真是如此，只要我认定——在我决定改变历史之前，一切都会照旧上演——那就足以证明，我可以安稳地在这里住到十五号。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: There's nothing that makes it an impossibility, so it could be that I always lived here and that I'm not changing the past yet. My parents never called me to say that someone was living at my place, and I never learned about it otherwise before the 15th, so I can secretly stay here, right? No contradictions.
entries.new: 没有任何理由说这不可能，所以也可能我一直就住在这里，而此刻的我还没有改变过去。父母从没打电话说有人住在我的住处，十五号之前我也没从别处听说过这事，那我偷偷住在这里也没问题吧？没有矛盾。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I had no clue if it would work like that, but worrying about it felt pointless. I chose some casual clothes to put on and stepped back to the living room.
entries.new: 我不知道事情是否真会这样，但干着急也无济于事。我挑了几件便服换上，又回到客厅。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...{w}And now what?
entries.new: ……{w}那么，接下来呢？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Even though I had spent a long while living alone in that apartment, I'd always had plenty of things to think about, all of which I'd ended up pushing aside.
entries.new: 我在那间公寓独自住了很久，心里一直有不少事要想，可到头来全被搁在了一边。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I wouldn't, by chance, remember a lottery winning combination, would I...?
entries.new: 我该不会……碰巧记得彩票的中奖号码吧？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...The only reason why I hadn't thought that seriously was because I knew I didn't. Sai had mentioned using the Sekimeiya to win the lottery, but it wasn't actually that crazy of an idea.
entries.new: ……我没往这上面认真想，唯一的原因就是我知道自己根本不记得。Sai 提过用 Sekimeiya 中彩票，可这主意其实也没那么离谱。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I didn't think it was greedy, either. In fact, what felt selfish was not taking the chance when it was provided.
entries.new: 我也不觉得这算贪心。真要说自私，反倒是机会摆在眼前却不去用。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If I could change the past, I would go back in time again, because that would allow Miiya to be saved. That meant I simply had to remember a winning number before that point. That would create the possibility of a perfect future.
entries.new: 只要过去能改，我就愿意再穿越一次时间，因为那样就能救下 Miiya。也就是说，我只要在那一刻之前想起中奖号码就够了。这样一来，一个完美的未来便有了可能。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Was I simply daydreaming in a hellish world? As long as the past could be changed, it didn't seem so. That future certainly felt attainable.
entries.new: 我这是在人间地狱里白日做梦吗？只要过去还能改变，似乎就不算。那样的未来，确实让人觉得触手可及。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Where is the Sekimeiya right now? Ashiya should have it somewhere, but they must be protecting it from Xyn, so there's no way I could touch it.
entries.new: Sekimeiya 现在在哪儿？应该就在芦屋那里，可他们一定防着 Xyn，我根本碰不到。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...Wait, no. That might not be the case.
entries.new: ……等等，不对。也许并非如此。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Katei and Suripo explained it to us. The Sekimeiya is merely bait for Xyn to get trapped in the tower. So it's definitely there right now.
entries.new: Katei 和 Suripo 跟我们解释过。Sekimeiya 只是引 Xyn 上钩、把他困在塔里的诱饵。所以它现在一定就在塔里。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: They also said that the mechanism to trigger the alarm is based on the cabinet being forced open. Also, Xyn never attacked before the 15th.
entries.new: 他们还说，警报的机制是：展示柜一旦被强行打开就会触发。而且 Xyn 在十五号之前从没动过手。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Doesn't that mean that I can change the past by going there during the night and forcing the cabinet open? It's probably not in the event room yet, but it must be somewhere unavailable to the public.
entries.new: 那不就意味着，我只要夜里过去把展示柜强行撬开，就能改变过去？它大概还没摆进活动室，但一定放在外人进不去的地方。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: If I break it open, the alarm will lock me inside, and someone else will be locked in the security room. According to Katei, he hadn't been taking the night shifts recently, so it'll probably be someone else. Will they buy that I'm a Xyn member?
entries.new: 我要是把它撬开，警报会把我锁在里面，同时另一个人会被锁在监控室。按 Katei 的说法，他最近没值夜班，那多半是别人。对方会相信我是 Xyn 的人吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It sounded pretty dangerous. That could've been a way to travel to the past again, but if it didn't work, I would be caught by the police, ruining everything.
entries.new: 听起来相当危险。这或许能成为再次穿越到过去的一条路，可万一不成，我就会被警察抓住，一切全毁。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Why were there times where touching the Sekimeiya didn't do anything? What if it just won't work before the 15th, which is why nobody noticed its powers?
entries.new: 为什么有时碰到 Sekimeiya 也毫无反应？会不会它在十五号之前根本不起作用，所以一直没人察觉它的力量？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Even if the main entrance of the building is locked, assuming the storeroom door did lead to the outside, I could maybe enter through it.{w} ...There's no way I could take the entire cabinet out without triggering the alarm. Someone would be looking at the cameras, and I don't even know where the cabinet is.
entries.new: 就算大楼正门锁着，假如储藏室的门真能通到外面，我也许还能从那里进去。{w}……可我不可能不触发警报就把整个展示柜搬出去。总会有人盯着监控，何况我连展示柜在哪儿都不知道。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...But to begin with, why did I go so far into the past? I still don't get that.
entries.new: ……可话说回来，我为什么会跑到那么早的过去？这一点我至今想不通。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: The Sekimeiya was in the water tank, but it couldn't have been there for very long. According to Atsuki, he hid it in one of the lockers a while before that. ...Is it possible it gathered a lot of energy for another reason?
entries.new: Sekimeiya 是在水箱里，可它不可能在那里待很久。按 Atsuki 的说法，他在那之前一段时间才把它藏进其中一个储物柜。……有没有可能，它是因为别的原因积蓄了大量能量？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Even thinking about it in my living room, there were many things I didn't know about the Sekimeiya. If I could be sure such a plan could work, and I knew how to go days into the past, saving Miiya should've been fairly simple.
entries.new: 就算只是坐在客厅里想，我也清楚自己对 Sekimeiya 还有很多不了解的地方。若我能确定这个计划行得通，又知道该怎么回到好几天前，救下 Miiya 本该是相当简单的事。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There's no way that I'll let everything happen exactly as it did already just so that I have a guarantee that the Sekimeiya will work, right...?
entries.new: 我总不可能为了让 Sekimeiya 确定能生效，就任由一切照原样重演一遍吧……？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: The unknown version of me that had been seen in the tower still haunted me, but that couldn't be it.
entries.new: 塔里那个来历不明的我始终让我耿耿于怀，但原因不会是这个。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: No. If I were to do that, I would also prevent Atsuki and myself from going. That's completely out of the question.
entries.new: 不行。真那么做，我和 Atsuki 就不会去了。这绝对不行。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...I wasn't even sure about my situation. My appearance in that dark tunnel was different from all the other times. Instead of teleporting instantly, I had awakened, so I still felt like there was something I was missing.
entries.new: ……连我自己的处境都说不清楚。我出现在那条漆黑隧道里的方式，和以往任何一次都不同。我不是瞬间被传送过去，而是醒过来的，所以我总觉得还有些关键的东西没弄明白。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We thought about this once, didn't we? That maybe traveling very far through time would make your memories foggy. Could that be why I feel this way? Is there something that I can't remember...?
entries.new: 我们以前想过这种可能吧？穿越的时间跨度太大，记忆也许会变得模糊。我现在这样，会不会就是这个缘故？是不是有些事我想不起来了……？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I wasn't sure. If there were some memories missing, I had no idea how to get them back.
entries.new: 我无法确定。就算真有什么记忆缺失，我也不知道该怎么找回来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I stood up from the carpet and went to my room.
entries.new: 我从地毯上站起身，走向自己的房间。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: My purse was still next to my bed. I picked it up and put on my coat. Then, I walked to the doorway, where I'd left the keys I'd appeared with.
entries.new: 手提包还放在床边。我拿起包，穿上外套，然后走到玄关——我出现时带着的那串钥匙就搁在那里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I wanted to go outside. If it really was the first day of December, and what I'd thought of applied, there should've been no issue with that. Nobody would be aware that I couldn't be walking in the streets.
entries.new: 我想出门。如果今天真是十二月一日，而我想到的那点也成立，那出门应当毫无问题。没有人会知道，我本不该出现在街上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I put on my boots and opened the door. As expected, the air enclosed by all the mountains was overwhelmingly cold, but I really wanted to go out. On the snow were my footprints from the previous day, and some others ending at the nearby apartments.
entries.new: 我穿上靴子，推开门。四面群山围拢的空气果然冷得逼人，可我还是很想出去。雪地上留着昨天的脚印，还有另一些延伸到附近公寓门口的足迹。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It was very rare for me to want to leave the house without knowing why. I usually only went outside with some purpose in mind.
entries.new: 我很少会莫名其妙就想出门。平时只有带着目的，我才会走到外面去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It was true that a lot of responsibility was weighing on me, but I didn't feel pressured. The freedom to make choices allowed me to remain relaxed to some degree.
entries.new: 确实有沉重的责任压在我身上，我却没觉得有多大压力。正因为还能自己选择，我多少保持了从容。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I looked at my purse. My wallet was inside it, containing the same amount of money I'd counted before leaving to meet Atsuki and Miiya—not that much.
entries.new: 我看了眼手提包。钱包就在里面，钱数和我去见 Atsuki、Miiya 之前清点过的一样——并不多。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I closed the door and walked down the stairs. I lived close to the outskirts, and there usually weren't many people around. That wasn't too different that day, as only a handful of people were slowly walking on the sidewalk, wearing overcoats and exhaling misty breaths.
entries.new: 我关上门，走下楼梯。我住在靠近郊区的地方，平时人就不多。那天也差不多，只有寥寥几个人在人行道上慢慢走着，裹着大衣，呼出团团白气。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Maybe I really should've thought about where to go before leaving.
entries.new: 也许我出门之前，真该先想好要去哪儿。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I walked toward the center of Yushibana, every street looking identical due to the coating of snow. There were a few parked cars and a bunch of footprints on the ground, but the environment felt pretty desolate. Everyone was inside.
entries.new: 我朝丰花中心走去，积雪覆盖之下，每条街看上去都一模一样。地上停着几辆车，还有一片杂乱的脚印，可四周相当冷清。大家都待在屋里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Everything in the immediate vicinity was residential, so I kept thinking about where to go.
entries.new: 附近一带全是住宅，我一路都在琢磨该往哪里去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I guess I don't have to go anywhere. I could just come back when I get tired.{w} This is only for today, though. I seriously need to decide on what to do.
entries.new: 算了，也不必非去哪里。累了直接回来就好。{w}不过仅限今天。我确实得认真想好接下来该怎么办。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: There were enough citizens in Yushibana that it wasn't very common to know people on the street. That was what allowed me to be unafraid of being recognized and questioned about being in the hospital.
entries.new: 丰花的居民够多，在街上碰见熟人并不常见。也正因为这样，我才敢放心出门，不怕被人认出，质问我怎么不在医院。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Should I go to the tower? What would I even do?{w} And what else is there in town? The library? How long has it been since I went there? Too long, honestly...
entries.new: ……要去塔那边吗？去了又能做什么？{w}再说镇上还有别的地方可去吗？图书馆？我多久没去过了？老实说，真的太久了……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I could try to eat something.
entries.new: 也可以去吃点东西。
entries.speaker: nm
