entries.text: It had also been a while since I'd eaten anything outside. I always had to use my money well and cook at home.
entries.new: 我也很久没在外面吃过饭了。钱一向要精打细算，我总是在家自己做。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I guess I can do whatever I want with the money that I have. It's been duplicated.
entries.new: 我想怎么花手头的钱都行，反正这钱是多出来的一份。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I had my purse next to me when I woke up in the hospital, so the original money is there. ...And I'm thinking about winning the lottery.
entries.new: 我在医院醒来时，手提包就在身边，所以原本那份钱还在那儿。……而我居然还在盘算着中彩票。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I arrived at the busier section of Yushibana, where I immediately saw a lot more people. Looking all around, I saw that not many stores were open.
entries.new: 我走到丰花比较热闹的地段，人一下子多了起来。环顾四周，开门的店铺却没几家。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: This might not be a good idea. I've been to all these places at some point.
entries.new: 这也许不是个好主意。这些地方我或多或少都去过。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Is it possible that being recognized could be problematic? Would I be changing the past if I accidentally see someone who knows I should be in the hospital?
entries.new: 被人认出来会不会出问题？要是不小心撞见一个知道我该待在医院的人，我是不是就改变了过去？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: There's no way what happened wasn't on the news. Even people who don't know me could recognize me.
entries.new: 那件事不可能不上新闻。就算不认识我的人，也可能认出我来。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Nothing should happen. If someone sees it as a big issue, then the past has been changed, but that seems very unlikely. And there's no way anything would happen to me. ...Even if I'm found out, it won't make getting to the Sekimeiya any harder.
entries.new: 应该不会出什么事。要是有人把这当成大问题，那就说明过去已经被改变——可这种事几乎不可能发生。而且我更不可能出什么事。……就算被人发现，也不会让我更难接近 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: What would I do, though? I wouldn't want to let Atsuki know. I already traveled to the past alone, going against what the Atsuki in the tower said.
entries.new: 可万一被发现了，我该怎么办？我不想让 Atsuki 知道。毕竟我已经违背了塔里那个 Atsuki 的话，独自穿越到了过去。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Was I being selfish again? ...Potentially hindering any attempt to save Miiya?
entries.new: 我是不是又自私了？……甚至可能妨碍到救 Miiya 的行动？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I hadn't personally seen the past change yet. Only Atsuki had said that it was possible, and even he hadn't known the full specifics behind it. The worst scenario simply seemed to be me having to use the Sekimeiya on the 15th, taking advantage of the attack.
entries.new: 过去被改变这种事，我还没有亲眼见过。说它有可能的只有 Atsuki，就连他也不清楚其中的具体缘由。最坏的情况，无非是我必须在十五号那天利用那场袭击的机会动用 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I turned toward a narrower street. As expected, Ina Café was open. It was pretty rare for it to be closed.
entries.new: 我拐进一条更窄的街道。果然，伊娜咖啡馆还开着门。这家店很少歇业。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The barista there definitely knows me, and I need to understand better where I am. ...How will someone who knows me react if they see me on this day?
entries.new: 那家店的咖啡师肯定认识我，而我也得先弄清自己究竟身在何处。……一个认识我的人，在这一天看见我，会是什么反应？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I walked to the entrance, finally making up my mind. Through the glass, I saw that the interior was empty and Darfee was wiping down one of the tables. It had been a long time since I'd been there, but there was a time in my life where I frequented the place, enjoying the calm atmosphere.
entries.new: 我终于下定决心，走到店门口。透过玻璃看去，店里空无一人，Darfee 正在擦拭一张桌子。我已经很久没来过这里，但曾有一段日子常来光顾，享受那份安静的氛围。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: On the ground was a square carpet to clean the snow off my shoes. I used it before opening the door and hesitantly walking in, immediately feeling the warm temperature.
entries.new: 地上铺着一块方形地毯，用来蹭掉鞋上的雪。我先在上面踩了踩，才推开门，迟疑地走进去，暖意立刻扑面而来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Darfee didn't turn around yet, so I looked at what was on the menu. Like in the past, there were light drinks and meals, as well as alcoholic beverages closer to the night.
entries.new: Darfee 还没转过身来，我便先看了看菜单。和从前一样，有清淡的饮品和简餐，越接近夜晚，还会供应酒类。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Hello.
entries.new: ……你好。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Hello.
entries.new: 你好。
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: He suddenly turned around.
entries.new: 他猛地转过身来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: {tip=ha}Ha—{/tip}
entries.new: {tip=ha}哈——{/tip}
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: Shiroya...!
entries.new: Shiroya……！
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: Yeah. It's been a while.
entries.new: 嗯，好久不见。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Oh my God! Y-You're all right!
entries.new: 天哪！你、你没事了！
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: ...So you know what happened. I am, yes.
entries.new: ……看来你知道发生了什么。是的，我没事。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Of course! You were on the news!
entries.new: 当然知道！你都上新闻了！
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: I managed a bitter smile in response to his relieved expression.
entries.new: 面对他如释重负的神情，我只能回以一个苦笑。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'm so glad you were released so quickly! How are you?
entries.new: 你能这么快出院，真是太好了！现在感觉怎么样？
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: Makes sense. I'm supposed to be in a coma.
entries.new: 也难怪。按说这个时候，我还该昏迷不醒才对。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I'm okay. I was released yesterday. Fortunately, nothing major happened to me.
entries.new: 我没事。昨天刚出院。幸好没受什么重伤。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: That's really good to hear. If you came to relax and try to forget things, we don't have to talk about it.
entries.new: 听你这么说，我就放心了。如果你是来放松、想把事情忘掉的，那我们就不提这些了。
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: ...It's fine. You don't have to worry.
entries.new: ……没关系，你不用顾虑我。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Are you sure? I can't imagine what it must be like to lose someone close to you at your age. I'm so sorry.
entries.new: 真的吗？你这个年纪就失去亲近的人，我实在难以想象那是什么滋味。真的很抱歉。
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: ...{w}Thank you.
entries.new: ……{w}谢谢你。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Do you have any idea what happened? A lot of details weren't published.
entries.new: 你知道到底发生了什么吗？很多细节都没有公开。
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: Unfortunately, no. It all happened suddenly, and we were just caught up in it.
entries.new: 很遗憾，不知道。一切发生得太突然，我们只是被卷了进去。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: He looked down, very clearly pitying me.
entries.new: 他垂下目光，那份怜悯再明显不过。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Do you want coffee? I'm sorry, I don't have much else right now.
entries.new: 要喝咖啡吗？抱歉，现在店里也没什么别的。
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: N-No, I don't think I need any right now.
entries.new: 不、不用了，我现在应该不需要。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Are you sure? I can make you the Kalitsu Special.
entries.new: 真的不要？我可以给你做一杯 Kalitsu 特调。
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: ...What is that?
entries.new: ……那是什么？
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: It's nothing. That's the special.
entries.new: 没什么，就是所谓的「特调」。
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: He cracked a halfhearted smile, obviously trying to cheer me up. I tried to return the look, but I wasn't sure if my own smile was visible or not.
entries.new: 他勉强扯出一丝笑，显然是想让我打起精神。我也想回他一个笑容，却不知道那笑有没有真的挂在脸上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I looked behind the glass cover, where a few pastries remained.
entries.new: 我看向玻璃罩后面，那里还剩着几块点心。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I'm a bit hungry. I could go for this.
entries.new: ……我有点饿了。就要这个吧。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: I pointed at one covered with dried chocolate.
entries.new: 我指了指其中一块表面覆着干硬巧克力的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Of course. Give me a second.
entries.new: 好，稍等。
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: ...He moved behind the bar, removed it with metallic tongs, and put it on a small plate, which he placed in front of me.
entries.new: ……他走到吧台后，用金属夹子夹起那块点心，放进小碟子里，摆到我面前。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Here. Don't worry about asking for anything else.
entries.new: 给。还想要什么尽管开口，别客气。
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: Thank you.
entries.new: 谢谢。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: I bit into it—I was hungrier than I'd thought.
entries.new: 我咬了一口——我比自己以为的还要饿。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What will happen when he realizes that I'm still in the hospital? I haven't heard anything about Darfee in a while, so if everything were to happen as I remember, he shouldn't do anything. I really don't like having to lie to him, though.
entries.new: 等他发现我其实还躺在医院里，会怎么样呢？我已经很久没有 Darfee 的消息了。如果一切都像我记得的那样发生，他应该不会做什么。只是，我实在不喜欢这样骗他。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I kept eating while he washed the few dishes left.
entries.new: 他洗着剩下的几只盘子，我则继续吃着。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: You're done? Do you want another one?
entries.new: 吃完了？要不要再来一块？
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: I'm okay, but thank you.
entries.new: 不用了，谢谢你。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: All right. I'm seriously happy to see you, though. I couldn't believe it when I saw your face on the news.
entries.new: 好吧。不过说真的，见到你我很高兴。在新闻上看到你的脸时，我简直不敢相信。
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: ...Me too. Sorry for not coming around in a while.
entries.new: ……我也是。抱歉，这么久没来看看你。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Don't worry about that. Are your parents here?
entries.new: 这有什么好道歉的。你父母在这边吗？
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: Darfee had to be in his late thirties, but he was a good friend of my parents, who'd actually brought me there for the first time. I hadn't spoken to him that many times, but I figured he was familiar enough with me, as he'd known me since I was a kid.
entries.new: Darfee 应该快四十了，却和我父母是至交——第一次带我来这里的，正是他们。我和他说话的机会不算多，但我想他对我足够熟悉，毕竟从我小时候起就认识我了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: They aren't.
entries.new: 他们不在这里。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: No? Will they come soon? They will, right?
entries.new: 不在吗？他们很快就会来吗？会的，对吧？
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: ...I don't know. As of now, they'll stay overseas.
entries.new: ……我不知道。目前他们会留在国外。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: He looked puzzled and disappointed. In fact, I did know that they wouldn't come. Even after waking from my coma, they would only talk to me through phone calls. ...Too busy with administrative work, of course.
entries.new: 他一脸困惑，又难掩失望。其实我很清楚他们不会来。就连我从昏迷中醒来之后，他们也只通过电话和我说话。……当然，是行政事务太忙。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: That's right. What will even happen now? Two identical copies of my phone exist. How will calls work?
entries.new: 没错。那现在到底会怎样？现在有两部一模一样的手机。电话打进来又该怎么算？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I suppose it doesn't matter. If both phones react when they call me, I'll just have to not pick up. If only mine rings, the past would be changing.
entries.new: 算了，大概也无所谓。他们打来的时候两部手机都响，我不接就是。要是只有我这部响，那就说明过去正在改变。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Do come here any time you want. You're more than welcome.
entries.new: 想来随时都可以来。非常欢迎。
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: ...I will. I just wanted to leave my home today.
entries.new: ……我会的。今天只是不想待在家里。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: I completely understand. That's good for you to do.
entries.new: 我完全理解。出来走走对你挺好。
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: Yeah...
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: I think I will have coffee.
entries.new: 那还是来杯咖啡吧。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Absolutely. How do you want it?
entries.new: 当然。想要什么样的？
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: ...It's pretty late for coffee, actually. I'm not sure, anything that's not too strong, and without milk or sugar.
entries.new: ……不过这个点喝咖啡确实有点晚了。我也说不好，别太浓就行，不加奶，也不加糖。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: As always. Give me a second.
entries.new: 还是老样子。稍等。
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: He grabbed a short, transparent glass and filled it halfway.
entries.new: 他取来一只矮身透明玻璃杯，倒了半杯。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Do you want it alongside anything?
entries.new: 要配点什么吗？
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: He pointed at some bottles higher up.
entries.new: 他指了指上层架子上的几个瓶子。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Those have alcohol, right?
entries.new: 那些是酒，对吧？
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Yes.
entries.new: 没错。
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: ...Then no. I've never had any of that.
entries.new: ……那不用了。我从来没喝过酒。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: I understand, but maybe you should. Last thing I wanna do is make an alcoholic out of you, but it doesn't hurt in small quantities.
entries.new: 我明白，不过你或许该尝尝。我最不想做的就是把你变成酒鬼，但少量喝一点并无坏处。
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: It's okay. I'd prefer not to.
entries.new: 不用了。我还是不想喝。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: He nodded and filled it all the way up. I was kind of surprised he offered—I wasn't old enough to drink, and I could have gotten away with technically barely breaking the law, but I wasn't in the mood anyway.
entries.new: 他点点头，把杯子斟满。他会开口请我喝酒，让我有些意外——我还没到能饮酒的年纪，真要喝了也只是勉强算违法，也不会有人追究；只是我本来也没那个心情。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: He left the glass next to the empty plate. As usual, it was overly hot.
entries.new: 他把杯子放在空盘子旁边。和往常一样，烫得厉害。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I stretched my hands behind my back and looked around me. I was the only person there.
entries.new: 我把双手背到身后伸了伸，环顾四周。店里只有我一个人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: A newspaper...
entries.new: 一份报纸……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: A few seats away, there was an open newspaper that someone had probably started reading and left behind. I pinched it and pulled it toward me.
entries.new: 隔着几个座位，有一份摊开的报纸，大概是有人读到一半就丢下的。我捏住一角，把它拉了过来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It should say today's date.
entries.new: 上面应该写着今天的日期。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I looked at the top right corner, and, as expected, there was the date.
entries.new: 我看向右上角，日期果然印在那里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...It really is December 1st.
entries.new: ……真的是十二月一日。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Is this new?
entries.new: 这是新的吗？
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: The newspaper? Yes.
entries.new: 报纸吗？对，是新的。
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: I brought it closer and looked at the pages for current news. It was Yushinews, so events from Yushibana were highlighted.
entries.new: 我把它拉近了些，翻到时事版面。报头是 Yushinews，所以丰花一带的消息被特别标注出来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Miiya and I must appear somewhere in here.
entries.new: 这上面一定有 Miiya 和我的消息。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I flipped the pages toward the start, as I felt it should've been important enough to put it at the beginning. When I got to the initial two, I stopped myself.
entries.new: 我往前翻，觉得那件事够重要，理应放在开头。翻到最前两页时，我停了下来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Here it is.
entries.new: 找到了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: The category was "November", and there were many brief articles. The last one was titled "Gas Explosion Late at Night".
entries.new: 栏目是「十一月」，里面有许多短讯。最后一条的标题是「深夜煤气爆炸」。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I read the tiny letters next to a black and white picture of the shop.
entries.new: 店铺的黑白照片旁印着细小的字，我读了下去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: "Miiya Moiromo, a twenty-year-old girl, is the only casualty of a local gas explosion that occurred in the evening of November 30th. Shiroya Mirana, another young girl nineteen years of age, was gravely injured and immediately sent to the hospital. Her condition is critical, although she wasn't directly hit by the explosion."
entries.new: 「十一月三十日晚间，本地发生一起煤气爆炸，二十岁的女孩 Miiya Moiromo 是唯一的死者。另一名十九岁的女孩 Shiroya Mirana 身受重伤，被立即送往医院。她虽然并未直接受到爆炸冲击，情况仍然危急。」
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: "The incident occurred when an unknown individual released smoke that caused four people inside to lose consciousness. The other two were too far from the range to receive any serious injuries. While everyone was unconscious, a heater depleted its surrounding oxygen after its flame went out, and when a visitor turned on the lights, an immediate explosion of short radius but intense force occurred.{w} It killed the first victim instantly and broke the floor of the shop. The second girl, Mirana, was protected by the furniture next to her but fell through the broken floor."
entries.new: 「事发时，一名身份不明者释放烟雾，致使店内四人失去意识。其余两人距离较远，未受重伤。众人昏迷期间，一台取暖器的火焰熄灭，耗尽了周围的氧气；一名来客开灯时，随即发生了爆炸，波及范围不大，威力却极强。{w} 第一名遇难者当场死亡，店铺的地板也被炸裂。另一名女孩 Mirana 因身旁家具的遮挡而免于冲击，却从破裂的地板坠落。」
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It happened just like I remember.
entries.new: 和我记得的一模一样。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: And it doesn't even say why the incident happened.{w} ...Right, on the 15th, when smoke knocked us out for the second time, I thought that both incidents must have been caused by the same people. That would be Xyn.
entries.new: 而且报道里根本没提事故的原因。{w} ……对了，十五号那天，烟雾第二次把我们熏晕时，我就觉得这两起事件一定是同一伙人干的。那应该就是 Xyn。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...{w}Wait, it actually is this. I'm not wrong.{w} It was caused by Xyn. That's why no further details got published.{w} That's what Katei told us. Xyn had already tried to steal the Sekimeiya once, but they failed. They almost caught the person behind it, but since they ended up escaping, it wasn't published that they'd been from Xyn.
entries.new: ……{w}等等，原来就是这个。我没记错。{w} 的确是 Xyn 造成的。所以才没有公布更多细节。{w} 这是 Katei 告诉我们的。Xyn 早就试图偷走 Sekimeiya 一次，但失败了。他们差点抓到幕后的人，可对方最后还是逃了，所以报道里没有说这是 Xyn 所为。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Oh, of course... In the attic, I knew I recognized that smell. I smelled it in that shop. ...That's what happened there. Xyn tried to steal the Sekimeiya before it was brought to Ashiya Tower.{w} The Sekimeiya was in the shop, and for some reason, Xyn didn't succeed.
entries.new: 啊，原来如此……在阁楼里，我就觉得那股气味在哪儿闻过。我在那家店里闻到过。……那里发生的就是这么回事。Sekimeiya 被送进芦屋塔之前，Xyn 就想把它偷走。{w} 当时 Sekimeiya 就在那家店里，而不知为何，Xyn 没能得手。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: That made sense as the outline of what had occurred, but it didn't mean anything to me aside from the fact that Miiya's life had been taken during an attempt to steal a gemstone.
entries.new: 事情的大致经过是说得通的；可对我来说，它只意味着一件事——Miiya 是在一次宝石盗窃中丧命的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: At that point, did Xyn know what the Sekimeiya would do, or did they attempt to steal just another simple gem that Ashiya had? The advertising had just started.
entries.new: 那时候，Xyn 知道 Sekimeiya 有什么用处吗？还是说，他们只是想偷走芦屋家的又一颗普通宝石？毕竟宣传才刚开始。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I huffed, deeply frustrated.{w} I began to drink the coffee, and as I scanned the pages, more concise articles came into view.
entries.new: 我重重吐了口气，满心烦躁。{w} 我一边喝着咖啡，一边扫视报纸，更多简短的报道映入眼帘。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I read the title of one higher up on the page.
entries.new: 我读了页面上方另一篇报道的标题。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Huh?
entries.new: 咦？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: "Unknown Man Escapes from Prison Cell".{w} Intrigued by the premise, I read the body of the article.
entries.new: 「不明男子逃离牢房」。{w}这个标题勾起了我的兴趣，我接着往下读正文。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: "In the afternoon of November 24th, the camera of a prison cell recorded a prisoner escaping from it."
entries.new: 「11月24日下午，一间牢房的监控摄像头拍下了一名囚犯从牢中逃脱的画面。」
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What...? Is it talking about a prison here?{w} I don't think there's a proper one in Yushibana, so maybe it's just talking about holding cells in the police department.
entries.new: 什么……？说的是这里的监狱吗？{w}丰花应该没有正规的监狱，大概指的是警局里的拘留室吧。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: "The identity of that person remains unknown. They were dressed as a prisoner, but no footage shows who they were or how they ended up in that cell. The corridor they were in was unprotected, as nobody should've been inside the cell. By the time the footage recording them was noticed, they'd already disappeared.{w} The cell itself was unlocked, supposedly due to being vacant. There was no security in that area, so it is possible the individual left the entire building. Their identity and the way they got to that cell are under investigation, but no method to reach it such as a hidden passage between cells was found to exist."
entries.new: 「该人物的身份至今不明。其人身着囚服，但没有任何影像拍到此人是谁，又是如何进入那间牢房的。此人所在的走廊无人看管，因为那间牢房本不该有人。等到拍下此人的录像被人注意到时，他早已不见踪影。{w}牢房本身没有上锁，据称是因为当时空置。那一带没有任何安保措施，因此此人有可能已经离开整栋建筑。关于其身份以及进入牢房的方式仍在调查中，但并未发现牢房之间存在暗道之类的进入途径。」
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What the hell?{w} I never heard about this. I guess I don't really watch or read the news.
entries.new: 怎么回事？{w}我从没听说过这件事。也难怪，我本来就不怎么看新闻。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Next to the paragraph was a picture. It showed a still black and white image of the footage, which displayed the bars protecting the cell. The door was open, and the man could be seen leaving it. However, due to the high angle, his face couldn't be seen, and the single detail to go off of was his short, dark-looking hair.
entries.new: 那段文字旁边配着一张照片，是录像的黑白截图，画面里是牢房的栅栏。门开着，能看到那个男人正从里面走出来。然而由于拍摄角度很高，他的脸看不清，唯一能辨认的细节只有那一头深色短发。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: This person supposedly appeared in a cell, huh? I guess there are many unsolved mysteries I could solve by factoring in the Sekimeiya. Who's to say it hasn't been used in crimes before it made its way to Ashiya...?
entries.new: 这个人算是凭空出现在牢房里吧？只要把 Sekimeiya 算进去，大概有不少悬案都能解开。在它被送到芦屋塔之前，谁又能保证它没被用于犯罪呢……？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I downed the rest of my coffee. It wasn't supposed to be strong, and I didn't feel any reaction from it. At one point, coffee had stopped always having a positive effect on me, and sometimes it would do more harm than good, so I'd stopped drinking it frequently.
entries.new: 我把剩下的咖啡一饮而尽。这咖啡本来就不浓，我也没觉得有什么反应。不知从什么时候起，咖啡不再总是对我有好处，有时反而弊大于利，我便不再常喝了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: You're done? Do you want anything else?
entries.new: 喝完了？还要点别的吗？
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: I'm fine.
entries.new: 不用了。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: I stood up from the stool and looked at my purse.
entries.new: 我从高脚凳上起身，看了看自己的钱包。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: You're not going to try to pay me, are you? Don't even think about it.
entries.new: 你不会还想付钱吧？想都别想。
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: Oh... Are you sure?
entries.new: 啊……你确定吗？
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Of course, and come back any time you feel like it. I'm serious when I say that I was really glad to see you, and I'm relieved to see that you're all right.
entries.new: 当然。你想来就随时来。我说真的，见到你我真的很高兴；看到你平安无事，我也就放心了。
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: Okay. I really appreciate it.
entries.new: 好。真的太谢谢你了。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: I don't want to stick my nose in your business, but I think you should talk to your parents. I can do it if you prefer. I can't believe they haven't come.
entries.new: 我本不想多管闲事，不过我觉得你该和父母谈谈。你要是愿意，我替你去说也行。他们居然一直没来，我真是不敢相信。
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: ...Don't worry, I have been talking to them. I think I prefer to be alone, though.
entries.new: ……别担心，我一直在和他们联系。不过，我还是想一个人待着。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Is that so...? I see.
entries.new: 是这样吗……？我明白了。
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: I smiled and walked to the entrance. Seeing the desolate street from such a warm place made for a very pleasant contrast.
entries.new: 我笑着走向门口。从这样温暖的地方望出去，看那条萧索的街道，这种反差让人心里很舒服。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Bye.
entries.new: ……再见。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: I'll see you. There are a lot of things I want to talk to you about, so come back when you want. As you can see, we're not even closed on Sundays, so it can be any day. I wish you the best to get through this.
entries.new: 再见。我有很多话想跟你说，想来的话随时过来。你也看到了，我们连周日都不休息，哪天都行。希望你能顺利熬过这一关。
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: I nodded and left the shop.{w} Did I look like a person burying a lot of pain? To be talking casually and smiling only one day after Miiya's death, I assumed that was the only explanation to Darfee.
entries.new: 我点点头，离开了店里。{w}我看起来像是个把痛苦深埋心底的人吗？Miiya 才去世一天，我就能谈笑自如——在 Darfee 眼里，恐怕也只有这一个解释吧。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I unconsciously picked a side and walked away.
entries.new: 我下意识地选了街道的一边，走了出去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Everything around me, existence itself, felt calm. I still wondered how that was possible. Only days previously, I'd questioned whether I would even speak again. Just what had happened to me?
entries.new: 周围的一切，甚至存在本身，都显得平静。我仍不明白这怎么可能。就在几天前，我还在怀疑自己是否还能再开口说话。我究竟是怎么了？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It wasn't that I didn't feel that pain as my own anymore or that I simply expected Miiya's death to be overwritten. After all, even if I did erase it, my memories wouldn't go away. Had all the terrible events afterward outweighed it, made it insignificant? How did that make sense?
entries.new: 并不是我不再觉得那痛苦是自己的，也不是我单纯指望 Miiya 的死会被改写。毕竟，就算我真的抹去了它，我的记忆也不会随之消失。难道是之后接连发生的惨事压过了它，让它变得无足轻重？这又怎么可能说得通？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: No matter the reason why I felt so tranquil, I liked it. Being able to feel any kind of comfort was a welcome change, even if the future was uncertain, and even if it all still revolved around the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 不管我为何如此平静，我都喜欢这份平静。哪怕未来仍不确定，哪怕一切依旧围绕着 Sekimeiya，能感到哪怕一丝安慰，也是难得的转变。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I went back to Ramon street. In the center of Yushibana, it was the largest one, ending at the town hall. No cars could go through it, and it was where you could usually see the most people.
entries.new: 我回到了拉蒙街。它是丰花中心最宽阔的一条街，一直通到市政厅。街上不通车辆，平时也是人最多的地方。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It was Sunday, so it made sense that most places were closed. I'd thought of going to the tower earlier, but that wasn't even possible, as it closed on Sundays.{w} While I thought about what to do next, my legs automatically turned me toward a branching street.
entries.new: 今天是周日，多数店铺关门也理所当然。我本打算早些去芦屋塔，可那根本行不通，因为塔周日不开放。{w}我一边想着接下来做什么，双腿却已经自行把我带向了一条岔路。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I didn't know whether to stop myself, so I continued. I hadn't really intended to go any direction in particular, but it was a path I'd taken before.
entries.new: 我不知道该不该停下脚步，于是索性继续往前走。我并没有特别想去哪里，只是这条路我以前走过。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: As opposed to the wider street, that one was only lined by residences, and it led to a one-way road, just as I remembered it.
entries.new: 和那条宽阔的大街不同，这条路两旁只有住宅，尽头是一条单行道，和我记忆中一模一样。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: After ignoring two branching paths, I turned toward Enric avenue. From both sidewalks grew tall, skinny trees covered by the snow, elegantly draping over the path. It was a pretty place to live in, situated on the opposite side of Yushibana from my apartment.
entries.new: 走过两个岔口之后，我拐向了恩里克大道。两侧人行道上长着细高的树，枝头覆着雪，优雅地垂在路面上方。这里住起来很舒服，风景也好，跟我的公寓隔着丰花一东一西。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I couldn't bring myself to walk any farther, and I only stared into the distance from the corner. I was looking at Atsuki's house.
entries.new: 我再也迈不动步子，只是站在街角望向远处。我看的是 Atsuki 的家。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Near it, I could discern some people outside of their own houses, but Atsuki's was still.
entries.new: 附近几户人家门前隐约有人，唯独 Atsuki 家毫无动静。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I don't think I should let myself be seen...
entries.new: 还是别让人看见我比较好……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I hadn't had any reason to go there, but I knew that if Atsuki saw me, I'd end up explaining everything that had happened. While a part of me wanted to do that, it wasn't strong enough to force me.
entries.new: 我本没有理由去那里，可我知道，一旦被 Atsuki 看见，我就得把发生的一切都解释一遍。虽然我心里有一部分想这么做，但那点念头还不足以推我上前。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Is there light...?
entries.new: 有灯光吗……？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: The road had very few wheel marks, and no cars were allowed to park. I crossed it to get a little closer.
entries.new: 路面上几乎看不到车辙，这里也不准停车。我穿过马路，靠近了一些。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Yeah. He's in the living room.
entries.new: 嗯，他在客厅。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Through his window, it was possible to see the light on the opposite side.
entries.new: 透过他那扇窗，能看到对面房间亮着灯。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: After waking up from my coma, he'd told me that he'd only left his house to go to the hospital, and that he'd otherwise spent all his time miserable.
entries.new: 我从昏迷中醒来后，他告诉过我，那段时间他除了去医院，几乎不出家门，其余时候都过得很痛苦。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I knew how he was feeling on the other side of the glass, and if I simply showed myself, I could help him. So then, why did that not feel like the best idea?
entries.new: 我清楚玻璃另一边的他是什么心情，只要我露个面，就能帮到他。那么，为什么我并不觉得这是最好的办法？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I surreptitiously approached the door, wondering if it was simply because I would ideally overwrite time anyway. Since I planned to change the past, was there no need to make the reality I was in better?
entries.new: 我悄悄走近门口，心想，是不是因为反正我迟早要改写时间。既然我打算改变过去，那还有必要让眼前的现实好过一些吗？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It also meant that if everything were to somehow play out as I remembered, the Atsuki I'd been with had always known that I'd traveled to the past and hadn't mentioned it so that it could happen. How likely was that, honestly?
entries.new: 这也意味着，如果一切真的照我记忆中的样子发展，那么一直和我在一起的那个 Atsuki 早就知道我穿越回了过去，却为了让它成真而只字未提。老实说，这有多大可能？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I got startled as soon as I peeked through the bars of his front gate. I hadn't seen Maxi sitting in front of the wooden door, where there was no snow.
entries.new: 我从他家院门的栅栏间探头望进去，当即吓了一跳——Maxi 正坐在木门前没有积雪的地方，我先前竟没看见。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: He seemed afraid for an instant when he saw me, but then he ran to me, squeezing his head through the bars.
entries.new: 他看见我的瞬间似乎有些害怕，但随即朝我跑来，把头从栅栏缝里挤了出来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It's just me. Do you know that I should be in the hospital? What are you doing here? It's very cold.
entries.new: 是我。你知道我本该待在医院里吧？你怎么在这儿？天这么冷。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: I looked up as I petted him. I knew Atsuki wouldn't look through the window since Maxi tended to bark whenever other dogs passed by anyway.
entries.new: 我一边抚摸他，一边抬起头。我知道 Atsuki 不会往窗外看——反正只要有别的狗经过，Maxi 就会叫个不停。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I figured Umi was inside the house. Both of them had a hole in the door to enter and exit through.
entries.new: 我想 Umi 应该在屋里。门上开着一个洞，他们俩都能从那里进出。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If nothing changes, what will happen on the 15th? I still don't understand what was up with the recording.{w} Could it really be that the exit will be locked for a month? If so, the police should take care of these two, right...?
entries.new: 如果什么都没改变，15号那天会怎么样？我到现在还是不明白那段录音到底是怎么回事。{w}出口真的会被锁上一个月吗？真是那样的话，警察总会照顾这两个家伙的吧……？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I looked at Maxi's face as he happily stared back at me. If I remembered well, he was eight and had been born on May 26th.
entries.new: 我看向 Maxi 的脸，他也高兴地回望着我。我没记错的话，他已经八岁，生日是5月26日。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What if Atsuki was wrong and the past can't be changed? I could change it by ringing the doorbell right now, but that's not something I want to do.
entries.new: 万一 Atsuki 说错了，过去根本改变不了呢？只要我现在按响门铃，过去就会改变——可我不想那么做。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...Doesn't me constantly not wanting to do things that change the past indicate that it can't change?
entries.new: ……我一直不愿做那些会改变过去的事，这不正说明过去根本改变不了吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: What if I leave a note saying that I'm fine?
entries.new: 如果我留张字条，说我没事呢？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: That didn't sound like a good idea either. There was no way Atsuki would read it and assume that I'd traveled to the past. Although he would then tell me after I woke up, so it would guarantee a change.
entries.new: 这主意听起来也不怎么样。Atsuki 看到字条，绝不可能想到我穿越到了过去。不过这样一来，等我醒来他总会告诉我，改变也就成了定局。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: When will I be able to tell whether things can change or not? There should be something I could do to confirm it.
entries.new: 我什么时候才能弄清事情到底能不能改变？总该有什么办法能证实这一点吧。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: And I suppose that if it can't happen in the end, it's a given that the version of me they saw on the 15th will end up being me.
entries.new: 而如果真的改变不了，那他们15号见到的那个我，到头来自然也就是我。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Could it be that I'll have failed to conclude whether I can change the past even by the 15th? If I haven't been able to touch the Sekimeiya by then, I'll go to the tower. It just doesn't make sense that I would let everything repeat...
entries.new: 难不成直到15号，我还是没能弄清自己究竟能不能改变过去？要是到那时还碰不到 Sekimeiya，我就去那座塔。我总不能眼睁睁看着一切重演吧……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I could prevent the recording from occurring so that Maxi and Umi aren't in danger. What if I decide to be the one who removed the handle in the storeroom and keep it so that I can leave at any time? Would that make any sense...?
entries.new: 我可以阻止那段录音发生，这样 Maxi 和 Umi 就不会有危险。要是我决定由自己拆下储藏室的门把手，自己留着，好随时能离开呢？这样行得通吗……？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I stepped away from the door.
entries.new: 我从门前走开。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Don't worry. I'll be back soon.
entries.new: 别担心，我很快就回来。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: I kept walking back, but Maxi didn't take his eyes off me until I'd disappeared from his view.
entries.new: 我一步步往后退，Maxi 却始终盯着我，直到我从他视野里消失。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: One of Atsuki's neighbors was looking at me too, and she waved at me from a distance. I knew I'd seen her before, so I awkwardly returned the gesture. She opened her mouth to say something brief, but I couldn't hear her.
entries.new: Atsuki 的一位邻居也在看我，隔着一段距离朝我挥了挥手。我记得见过她，便有些拘谨地朝她挥了挥手。她张嘴说了句很短的话，但我听不见。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I waited to see if she'd repeat herself, but it didn't seem like she'd realized I hadn't heard her.
entries.new: 我等了一会儿，看她会不会再说一遍，可她似乎并没察觉我没听见。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...{w}I don't know enough about what happened these days to do something and actually be sure I've changed the past. At least not in a non-drastic way, like by speaking to Atsuki. I could go to my hospital room and draw something on my face that I didn't wake up with...
entries.new: ……{w}这些天发生的事，我知道得还不够多，随便做点什么，也没法确定自己真的改变了过去。至少，我没法通过不激烈的方式——比如找 Atsuki 说话——来确定这一点。我可以回病房，在脸上画点什么——醒来时明明没有的东西……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I walked all the way down the street until I was back at the wider Ramon.
entries.new: 我沿着街道一路走去，回到了拉蒙街较为宽阔的那一段。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I seriously need to know if I'm going to be able to change what happened, and pretty urgently too. If it's not possible, then every attempt I make at getting to the Sekimeiya before the 15th is automatically bound to fail.
entries.new: 我真的很想知道自己到底能不能改变已经发生的事，而且非常迫切。如果根本改不了，那我在15号之前为接近 Sekimeiya 所做的一切尝试，注定都会失败。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: The time Katei said that someone from Xyn had tried to steal the Sekimeiya... There's no way I'll be the person behind that, right? Would he have said so if he'd known about it? I guess if the past can't be changed and someone did attempt to steal the Sekimeiya on the 30th, I have a guarantee that I won't be caught because he didn't mention that.
entries.new: Katei 说过，Xyn 那边有人试图偷走 Sekimeiya……那个人总不会是我吧？他要是知道内情，还会那样说吗？我想，如果过去确实改不了，而30号那天真有人去偷 Sekimeiya，那反倒能保证我不会被抓——因为他没提过这种事。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: A lot more people than I remembered were walking up and down the stone path. As usual, most of the snow had been removed so it didn't hinder anyone.
entries.new: 石板路上来往的人比我记忆中要多得多。和往常一样，积雪大多已被清走，不会碍着谁。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I tended not to like being in that busy street, but I wanted to appreciate people simply existing around me. Most of them were slightly hunched over to feel warmer, wearing scarves around their necks.
entries.new: 我向来不太喜欢待在那条热闹的街上，但此刻我想好好感受身边这些人的存在。他们大多微微缩着身子取暖，脖子上围着围巾。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I was still a little hesitant. At any point, someone could've asked me about the hospital. I could recognize a few people I'd seen before, and I wasn't sure if I was imagining the stares I felt.
entries.new: 我心里仍有些迟疑。随时都可能有人问起我住院的事。人群里有几张脸我认得，而落在身上的视线，我也说不准是不是自己多心。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Are they actually looking at me? There's no way it's because I'm supposed to be at the hospital, right...?
entries.new: 他们真的在看我吗？总不会是因为我本该待在医院里吧……？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I looked back, but the feeling had disappeared. I thought to myself that I was probably just pointlessly worried about that.
entries.new: 我回头看了看，那种感觉却消失了。我暗想，大概只是自己白担心一场。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I was directing myself back home. The cold would soon become hard to bear, and I was a little tired. Nonetheless, going outside had been as pleasant as I'd thought it would be.
entries.new: 我正往家走。寒气很快就要变得难以忍受，我也有些累了。尽管如此，这趟外出还是像我预想的那样令人舒畅。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: On my way to the drier roadway, I'd passed plenty of people living their own lives. Evidently, the time had only stopped for me and Atsuki.
entries.new: 走向较为干燥的车道途中，我从许多过着自己日子的人身边经过。显然，时间只在我和 Atsuki 这里停住了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'd left the center of Yushibana, so my surroundings felt a lot less lively. Due to the temperature, the sky was devoid of birds, and seeing other animals wasn't common. Walking on the snow became a lot harder, but I'd grown used to it more every year.
entries.new: 我已离开丰花的中心，四周冷清了许多。天冷，空中看不到鸟，别的动物也不常见。在雪上走要吃力得多，可我一年比一年习惯了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I saw something wrapped around a streetlight and approached it warily.
entries.new: 我看见路灯上缠着什么东西，便小心地走了过去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: "The Sekimeiya".{w} It was a flyer marked by the touch of many snowflakes. I'd seen it before, but I didn't want to look at it.
entries.new: 「The Sekimeiya」。{w}那是一张传单，上面落满了雪花的痕迹。我以前见过它，却不愿去看。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I walked away, my eyes locked on my feet.
entries.new: ……我转身走开，目光落在自己的脚上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...What if I draw something on the door of my apartment? I know that when I went home after waking up in the hospital, I didn't see anything. I think that was on the 8th, when I came home and just slept before calling Atsuki.
entries.new: ……要是我在自己公寓的门上画点什么，会怎么样？我记得出院回家那天，门上什么都没有。那应该是8号，我回到家就睡了，之后才给 Atsuki 打电话。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It's very possible that the past will only change if I intend my actions to cause a change. This means that everything I've done up until now could've always happened. If I put something on my door with the intent to change the past, that could prove it can happen.
entries.new: 很有可能，只有当我抱着改变过去的目的去做一件事，过去才会改变。也就是说，我到现在做过的每件事，或许原本就发生过。如果我带着改变过去的意图在门上留下点什么，就能证明过去确实可以被改变。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I guess it wouldn't be absolute, though. I could only be sure if it's still there on the 8th. It wouldn't be an instant confirmation.
entries.new: 不过这也算不上绝对。只有到了8号，看到那东西还在，我才能确定。这不是立刻就能验证的。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: One of the purposes of changing the past is to prevent Atsuki and myself from going to the tower. What if I send a warning to him saying not to go? If that ends up being all I'll be able to do, I shouldn't let Erina and Isla go either, but I don't know where they live.
entries.new: 改变过去的目的之一，就是阻止我和 Atsuki 去那座塔。要是我给他发个警告，叫他别去呢？如果到头来我能做的只有这些，那我也不能让 Erina 和 Isla 去，可我不知道她们住在哪儿。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I got my keys ready and put aside my musings until I got to the staircase of my apartment.
entries.new: 我把钥匙掏出来备好，暂时把这些念头搁到一边，等走到公寓楼梯口再说。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I went up and unlocked the door. As soon as I opened it, the inner temperature hit me, and I remembered I'd left the heater going.
entries.new: 我上了楼，打开门锁。门一开，屋里的热气扑面而来，我这才想起取暖器一直开着。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Just in case, I shouldn't have it on very often.
entries.new: 保险起见，还是别老开着它。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: After closing the door, I left my boots on the floor, my coat on a wooden hanger, and went to turn the heater off.
entries.new: 关上门后，我把靴子脱在地上，大衣挂上木衣架，然后去把取暖器关掉。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Sky Signals
entries.new: 天空信号

entries.text: I was beginning to feel a little dubious and nervous about Atsuki's assertion. Did the Sekimeiya really have the power to let someone alter the past?
entries.new: Atsuki 的说法让我越来越怀疑，也有点紧张。Sekimeiya 真的拥有让人改变过去的力量吗？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I'll find out right now. I just need to decide that my next action will change history.
entries.new: ……我现在就来验证。只要打定主意，让下一个举动改变历史就行。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Wait... that would be very thoughtless.
entries.new: 等等……那也太欠考虑了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I'd thought of calling Atsuki's phone for a second and then hanging up. As long as I did that, the past would change. He'd never told me about a call like that.
entries.new: 我想到一个主意：拨通 Atsuki 的电话，响一下就挂断。只要这么做，过去就会改变。他可从没跟我提过这样一通电话。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But I couldn't do it. It would tell him that I'd woken up, and then he'd find out otherwise. I hadn't thought it through.
entries.new: 可我不能这么做。那样一来他就知道我醒了，别的也会跟着暴露。我还没想周全。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Is there anything else I could do to get the same result...?
entries.new: 还有没有别的办法，能得到同样的结果……？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Oh, I can call my parents. When I talked to them on the phone, they definitely would have told me about receiving a call from my phone on December 1st.
entries.new: 对了，我可以打给父母。之前和他们通话的时候，他们要是真在十二月一日那天接到过我的来电，肯定会跟我提起的。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: All right, so should I just consciously aim to change the past?
entries.new: 好吧，那我只要刻意去改变过去就可以了？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: This won't get me into trouble, right...? They'll simply call the hospital, and nobody will understand what happened.
entries.new: 这不会给我惹上麻烦吧……？他们无非是打到医院去问问，谁也不会明白到底发生了什么。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I took the phone from my purse and looked at the screen. It was almost {time=15.}
entries.new: 我从手提包里取出手机，看了看屏幕。时间快到 {time=15.} 了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I went to the contacts list, selected my mom, and pressed the call button.
entries.new: 我打开通讯录，选中妈妈的号码，按下了拨号键。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The signal usually wasn't great, so I got closer to the window. Immediately after the first beep, I heard a voice.
entries.new: 这里的信号一向不好，我便走到窗边。第一声提示音刚响过，就传来了人声。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Shiroya...! How are you!?{w} I'm so glad you called! We were so worried!
entries.new: Shiroya……！你怎么样！？{w}你能打来真是太好了！我们担心死了！
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: My mom's voice came through the speaker, her disturbance making her sound a little distorted.
entries.new: 妈妈的声音从听筒里传出来，她情绪激动，声音有些失真。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Hello...! Are you there? What happened? You're okay, right?
entries.new: 喂……！你在听吗？出什么事了？你没事吧？
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: I didn't want to speak, so I pressed the red button and cut the call, surprised to feel a sharp heartache as I did so.
entries.new: 我不想开口，便按下红色按键挂断了电话。那一瞬间，胸口竟传来一阵尖锐的痛楚，让我有些意外。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I see. The past can be changed. Atsuki was right.
entries.new: 原来如此。过去是可以改变的。Atsuki 说得没错。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: A call request appeared, "Mom" listed as the name.
entries.new: 屏幕上跳出来电请求，名字显示为「妈妈」。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I didn't pick it up and simply waited it out.
entries.new: 我没有接，只是任它一直响到停止。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: No other call came afterward.
entries.new: 之后再也没有来电。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: They must've called the hospital.
entries.new: 他们一定是打去医院了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I let out a nervous breath and closed my phone.
entries.new: 我紧张地吐出一口气，合上了手机。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...{w}Why did I travel so many days back? That doesn't make sense. Were we wrong, and the time the Sekimeiya spent out of the cabinet wasn't what influenced the time traveled?
entries.new: ……{w}为什么我会回到这么多天以前？说不通。难道我们弄错了，影响穿越时长的并不是 Sekimeiya 离开展示柜的时间？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It's not possible that it spent enough time in the water tank to send me here. Either way, what's important is that I can replicate it.
entries.new: 它待在水箱里的时间，不可能长到足以把我送到这里。不管怎样，重要的是这个现象我能重现。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Before the 15th, if I'm not able to get the Sekimeiya, I can change the past and prevent Atsuki and myself from going to the tower. The 15th is the only time where I'm guaranteed to be able to touch the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 如果在十五号之前我拿不到 Sekimeiya，我也可以改变过去，让 Atsuki 和我都别去那座塔。而十五号，是我唯一确定能接触到 Sekimeiya 的时候。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: There'll be the attack, and people will fall unconscious, probably except the attacker. If that period of time isn't enough, I'll have twelve hours to use it, during which people will get trapped again.{w} If it comes down to it, I might have to think of how to take advantage of what happened. When the smoke went off, there were many places that weren't hit...
entries.new: 到时候会发生袭击，除袭击者之外的人大概都会失去意识。如果那段时间还不够，我还有十二个小时可以利用，那期间人们会再次被困住。{w}真到了那一步，我或许得想想怎么利用当时发生的事。烟雾弹炸开的时候，还有很多地方没有被波及……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Since the past can be changed... Even though the Sekimeiya must currently be in the tower to bait an attack from Xyn, it's possible that I'll be caught by the police if I try to go and touch it before the 15th. ...Just which option is better?
entries.new: 既然过去可以改变……虽然为了引出 Xyn 的袭击，Sekimeiya 现在必须放在塔里，但如果我在十五号之前去碰它，很可能会被警察抓住。……到底选哪条路更好？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: At least if I get trapped by myself on a night before the 15th, the only person trapped with me will be the person in the security room. I only need to learn how to jump days into the past, which should be a lot more feasible if there aren't seven other people there.
entries.new: 至少，如果我在十五号之前的某个夜晚独自引发被困，和我一起被困的就只有在监控室里的那个人。我只需要学会怎么跳回几天前，如果没有另外七个人在场，这应该容易得多。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...I really appeared just minutes too late to save Miiya. That's ridiculous.
entries.new: ……我偏偏晚了那么几分钟才出现，没能救下 Miiya。简直荒唐。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: And instead of appearing instantly, I felt like I woke up. ...When I touched the Sekimeiya in the water tank, the heat around it was clearly a lot stronger than every other time. So the heat it releases is related to the distance traveled, but the way it increases might be different from what we thought.
entries.new: 而且我不是凭空出现的，感觉更像是醒了过来。……我碰到水箱里的 Sekimeiya 时，它周围的热度明显比之前任何一次都强得多。也就是说，它释放的热量与穿越的距离有关，但增长的方式或许和我们想的不一样。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...I should probably try to eat something.
entries.new: ……我大概该吃点东西了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I went to the kitchen. I didn't like cooking and I wasn't great at it, but I'd lately gotten used to making my own food, as I didn't have many alternatives.
entries.new: 我走进厨房。我不喜欢做饭，也不擅长，但最近已经习惯了亲自动手，毕竟没有别的选择。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: When I'd been living at Atsuki's house, I'd only eaten by heating up prepared food that I couldn't afford. I opened the fridge, and as expected, there wasn't much to choose from. I was hungry due to walking around in the cold, so I wasn't picky.
entries.new: 住在 Atsuki 家那阵子，我都是把现成的饭菜热一热凑合吃，那些东西我自己是买不起的。我打开冰箱，里面果然没什么可挑的。在冷风里走了那么久，我早就饿了，也顾不上挑剔。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: A bit of meat remained in a plastic tray. I really only kept buying it because my parents used to.{w} I grabbed it and looked at my side. Thankfully, the frying pan was clean.
entries.new: 塑料托盘里还剩一点肉。我之所以一直买它，只是因为父母以前常买。{w}我端起托盘，又看了看旁边。还好，平底锅是干净的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I usually avoided using oil because the sizzling always startled me, and as a result, I'd basically stopped caring about eating things that were plain. I ignored the full bottle and heated up the empty pan for a few seconds. Then, I carefully placed the last pieces of meat on it and took a step back as they cooked.
entries.new: 我平时尽量不用油，那滋啦作响的声音总把我吓一跳，久而久之，也就不在乎吃的东西有没有味道了。我没去碰那瓶满满的油，先把空锅烧了几秒，然后小心翼翼地把最后几块肉放进去，退开一步等它们煎熟。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: After staring from a few steps back for a while, I used chopsticks to flip the chunks of meat around, forcefully ungluing them from the surface. I added salt and spice powder, garnished them the best I could, and cut it all up. The meal looked exactly like every other time I'd prepared it, and I brought it to the living room.
entries.new: 我站在几步远的地方看了一阵，才用筷子把肉块翻过来，用力将粘在锅底的部分剥开。撒上盐和香料粉，尽量装点得像样些，再全部切碎。成品和我每一次做的一模一样，我把它端到了客厅。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I left the plate on the table and sat on a cushion.
entries.new: 我把盘子放在桌上，在坐垫上坐下。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: This doesn't even make sense. Where are the others?
entries.new: 这根本说不通。其他人到底在哪里？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I thought of something that should've come to mind much sooner.
entries.new: 我想到了一件早该想到的事。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Atsuki, Erina, Sai, and maybe Akaro. A bunch of people who must have been outside the tower too. Where are they?
entries.new: Atsuki、Erina、Sai，或许还有 Akaro。这些人当时应该也在塔外。他们现在在哪儿？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I've been assuming I traveled alone, but that doesn't make any sense if we were at least right about one thing. If the range of the Sekimeiya was related to how far you went, there's no way the lobby wasn't included given that I traveled more than two weeks to the past.
entries.new: 我一直假设只有我一个人穿越了，可只要我们的判断有一点是对的，这就不成立。如果 Sekimeiya 的范围与穿越的距离有关，那我回到了两周多以前，大堂绝不可能不在范围之内。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...Where are they? I had to have made someone else travel with me, and everyone should've appeared at the same time that I did... but I'm also not sure I was immediately aware right after touching the Sekimeiya and passed out for a little while, so who knows when that would be?
entries.new: ……他们在哪里？我一定把别人也一起带了过来，大家应该和我同时出现……可我碰过 Sekimeiya 之后，也不确定自己是不是立刻就清醒了，还是昏迷了一小会儿，所以谁知道那个时间点到底是什么时候？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Was our understanding of the range incorrect too? If the range equaled the size of a crystal room when we traveled less than an hour... traveling fifteen days must have meant it extended far outside the tower.
entries.new: 难道我们对范围的理解也错了？如果穿越不到一小时时，范围相当于一间水晶展室……那穿越十五天，范围必定已经延伸到塔外很远的地方了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I grabbed a slice of meat and brought it to my mouth.
entries.new: 我夹起一片肉送进嘴里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It's not good at all.
entries.new: 一点也不好吃。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: The taste was weird, but the spice did its job at obfuscating it.
entries.new: 味道很怪，但香料总算起了作用，把它盖了过去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Ashiya and the police were right outside the tower. If they traveled to the past, I'm sure information about that would be widespread. There's no way a bunch of people traveling through time wouldn't create an uproar.
entries.new: ……芦屋的人还有警察就在塔外。如果他们也被送到了过去，消息肯定会传得满天飞。一大群人穿越时间，绝不可能悄无声息。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I appeared late on November 30th, where I'd been on that day. When we were in the tower, we thought about going ten minutes back but appearing where we'd been five minutes before traveling.{w} Did something like that happen again? Maybe I appeared at {time=21:10} where I'd been at {time=21:00}, so my old self wasn't there anymore. If I showed up exactly where I was at the time, I would've replaced my old self, and now I know that didn't happen.
entries.new: 我是在十一月三十日的深夜出现，位置是当天自己待过的地方。我们在塔里的时候曾推测，穿越回十分钟前，却会出现在穿越前五分钟所在的位置。{w}难道这次也是这样？也许我在 {time=21:10} 出现在自己 {time=21:00} 待过的地方，所以原来的我已经不在那里了。如果我恰好出现在当时自己所在的位置，就会取代过去的我——而现在我知道，并没有发生这种事。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: We definitely know that the location you appear is based on a past one. If multiple people from Ashiya or the police were sent to the past, they might have all appeared in the same area, like their workplace.
entries.new: 我们至少确定一点：出现的位置取决于过去的某个位置。如果芦屋和警察有多人被送到过去，他们也许都出现在同一片区域，比如各自的工作地点。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Even if I tried to explain it like that, it didn't make a ton of sense. The range had to be immense, not just big enough to encompass the policemen right outside.
entries.new: 就算这样解释，也还是说不通。那个范围一定大得惊人，绝不只是大到能把门外的警察都包进去而已。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I ate more, trying not to chew much. I wasn't sure if the meat was bland or just plain tasted bad, so I could avoid finding out by not biting into it.
entries.new: ……我又吃了一些，尽量不去多嚼。我分不清那肉是没味道还是本身就难吃，索性不去咬，也就不会知道了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I bet we just were mistaken about the range as well. Or maybe it wasn't necessarily that. Maybe the range and the time the Sekimeiya spent out of the cabinet were related... that'd still make some sort of sense.
entries.new: 说不定我们连范围也弄错了。也可能并非如此。也许范围和 Sekimeiya 离开展示柜的时间有关……这么说倒也勉强讲得通。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Because again, when I touched it, it couldn't have been there for too long. And the range couldn't have been that large either, so the question should only be why I went so many days into the past.
entries.new: 毕竟我碰它的时候，它不可能已经在那里搁了太久。范围也不可能那么大，那问题就只剩下：我为什么会回到那么多天以前。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: What if it's just random? We kinda let go of that thought because we didn't want it to be true, but it would make enough sense.
entries.new: 万一它本来就是随机的呢？我们之所以放下这个念头，只是不愿它成真，可这其实挺说得通的。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I stopped eating. The aftertaste was getting worse, and the hunger had somewhat faded.
entries.new: 我不再吃了。嘴里的余味越来越难受，饥饿感倒是退了几分。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: This could be really bad.
entries.new: 这下可能真的糟了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: If I was the only person who traveled, then everything I've thought should still apply. On the other hand, if a bunch of other people went with me and there's no news about it, I have no idea what will happen.
entries.new: 如果穿越的只有我一个人，那我之前推断的那些应该都还成立。可要是还有一大群人跟我一起回来，却又毫无消息，那我就完全说不准会发生什么了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Xyn members from the future could be here. They would know about the incident and about the secret alarm. And if they do, they know what to expect and would alter their plans on the 15th.
entries.new: 来自未来的 Xyn 成员也可能在这里。他们会知道那起事件，也知道那个秘密警报。如果真是这样，他们早有准备，15 号的计划也会随之改变。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Even if Ashiya members or the police are here from the future, as long as they somewhat understand what happened, there's no guarantee the events of that day will happen again.
entries.new: 就算芦屋的人或警察是从未来回来的，只要他们对当时的情况略知一二，那一天的事就未必会重演。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...{w}If Sai also traveled, there's no way he won't try to steal the Sekimeiya before then, when nobody else seemed aware of its powers. I didn't consider that more people could be here with the same intentions that I have, aside from the original Xyn plan.
entries.new: ……{w}如果 Sai 也穿越了，在那一天之前，还没有旁人察觉 Sekimeiya 力量的时候，他绝不会放过偷走它的机会。除了 Xyn 原本的计划之外，我从没想过还会有别人抱着和我一样的打算来到这里。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I bit my lip. If more people had traveled from the future, anyone could change the past, significantly obstructing me.
entries.new: 我咬住嘴唇。如果从未来回来的人不止一个，谁都能改写过去，这会大大妨碍我。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: My phone insistently vibrated against the table. It was another incoming call.
entries.new: 手机在桌上不停震动，又是一通来电。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I leaned in to look at the tiny screen on its back.
entries.new: 我俯身去看机身背面那块小屏幕。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: My mother again... I imagine she was told I still haven't woken up.
entries.new: 又是母亲……多半是有人告诉她我还没醒。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I let the ringing continue, but it stopped very quickly.
entries.new: 我随它响，但铃声很快就停了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Huh...
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Did she just hang up?
entries.new: 她这就挂了？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Maybe not. Right now, my original phone should be next to me in the hospital. If the call showed up on both devices, it's possible someone picked it up from there and it stopped ringing here.
entries.new: 也许不是。此刻，我原本那部手机应该就放在医院里我的床边。如果两边的手机同时收到来电，也许有人在那里接了起来，这边的铃声才随之停下。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I let myself fall back on the floor and waited to see if she'd call again.
entries.new: 我顺势又倒回地板上，等着看她会不会再打来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There had been no new calls, and I hadn't sat back up. I'd been lying there for quite a while, so hunger started to claw at me again.
entries.new: 再没有新的来电，我也没有重新坐起。就这么躺了好一阵，饥饿又挠了上来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'd looked through my food supplies that morning, so I knew no instant noodles were left. I lay there for a while, with no strength to stand.
entries.new: 早上我把存粮翻过一遍，知道泡面已经吃完了。我又躺了一会儿，连站起来的力气都没有。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Should I go buy something? I don't mind spending the money that I have.
entries.new: 要不要出去买点吃的？手头的钱花掉些也无所谓。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...Wait, I can't. It's Sunday.
entries.new: ……等等，不行。今天是星期天。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I sighed, both frustrated and relieved.
entries.new: 我叹了口气，既懊恼，又松了口气。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I kept staring at the ceiling, noticing the sky turning dark through the gaps of the blinds. Thankfully, even though people lived on the other side of the walls, they tended to be very silent.
entries.new: 我继续盯着天花板，透过百叶窗的缝隙看见天色暗下去。所幸一墙之隔虽然住着人，他们却一向安静得很。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: My phone vibrated again, even more briefly than before.
entries.new: 手机又震了一下，比刚才更短。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...{w}I finally got up, supporting my body with one arm. As I did so, I realized what that had been.
entries.new: ……{w}我终于用一只手臂撑起身子。就在起身的时候，我明白那是什么了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Oh, it's just gonna be that message.
entries.new: 哦，原来是那条短信。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I picked up my phone and flipped it open. As I'd thought, the expected message was on the screen, so I dismissed it with a button.
entries.new: 我拿起手机翻开盖子。果然是那条预料之中的短信，我按了一下键把它关掉。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: "Today at {time=9:51}, a deposit of ¥20,000 was transferred into your bank account. This will be reflected in 3 to 4 business days."{w} The time showed {time=17:57.}
entries.new: 「今天 {time=9:51}，你的银行账户存入 ¥20,000。此笔款项将在 3 至 4 个工作日内到账。」{w} 屏幕上的时间是 {time=17:57.}。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I received that message on the first day of every month, with the monthly money my parents and I had agreed on. It said the payment had been confirmed in the morning, but it was normal for me to receive the message many hours later.
entries.new: 每月一号我都会收到这条短信，那是父母和我约好的生活费。上面说款项在早上就已确认，可我往往要过好几个小时才收到消息，这也很平常。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I remember seeing that message days after I woke up, so it just appeared on both phones. Either that, or back then I hadn't been living here and now it only appeared on this one...
entries.new: 我记得醒来后过了几天才看到那条短信，说明它当时是两部手机都收到了。又或者，那时我还没住在这里，所以现在它才只出现在这一部上……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I could use this money if I need to. I didn't buy anything when I was staying at Atsuki's house, and I definitely didn't check my recent transactions, so it shouldn't be noticed if I take it.
entries.new: 需要的话，这笔钱我可以动用。住在 Atsuki 家时我什么都没买，也肯定没去查过最近的交易记录，所以就算取了也不会有人察觉。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I yawned. Despite lying down for a while, I felt lethargic.
entries.new: 我打了个哈欠。躺了这么久，身子却依旧发沉。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It was still somewhat early, and the hunger had fully returned. However, I didn't feel like eating anything I had, and even less so like making it myself.
entries.new: 时间还算早，饥饿感已经彻底回来了。可家里现有的东西我一样都不想吃，更懒得自己动手做。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I went to drink some water and left the plate in the sink. The lingering warmth of the heater had almost disappeared, so I turned it back on.
entries.new: 我去喝了点水，把盘子留在水槽里。暖炉的余温几乎散尽了，我又把它打开。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I guess I'll buy more food tomorrow. If it's possible that more people traveled to the past with me, and I intend to try to find the Sekimeiya before the 15th, I should do it as soon as possible, before anyone else who's possibly here can beat me to it.
entries.new: 明天再去多买些吃的吧。如果真有可能还有别人和我一起回到了过去，而我又打算在 15 号之前找到 Sekimeiya，那就得尽快行动，抢在其他可能也在这里的人前面。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Even with the heater on, I had to sleep with nightwear during the winter. I was tired enough to go to bed, so I put it on.
entries.new: 冬天就算开着暖炉，睡觉也得穿睡衣。我累得只想上床，便换上了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: No light was coming from the window. The sun had set very early, giving me the impression that it was already time to sleep.
entries.new: 窗外透不进一丝光。太阳落得极早，让人错觉已经到了该睡觉的时候。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I lowered the blinds, which I'd forgotten to do the previous night.
entries.new: 我放下百叶窗——昨晚我忘了放。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Then, I turned off the light and made my way under the blankets in the dark.
entries.new: 然后我关了灯，在黑暗里钻进被窝。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: As always, I left my phone on the bedside table next to me so that I could check the time after waking up or to set an alarm.{w} I hugged the pillow and closed my eyes.
entries.new: 和往常一样，我把手机放在床边的桌上，好醒来时看时间，或者设闹钟。{w}我抱住枕头，闭上眼睛。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It had been a pretty messy day. Aside from the arriving from the future aspect, I'd had many similar days that year.
entries.new: 这一天过得乱七八糟。撇开从未来回来这件事不谈，那一年里我也有过很多差不多的日子。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The reason why I'd been able to relax and enjoy the tranquility was probably simple. My preoccupations were much different from the usual.
entries.new: 我之所以能放松下来，享受这份安宁，原因大概很简单——我操心的事和平时大不一样。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Those days were bound to end. I'd eventually have to find a job or study far from home. The weeks without obligations were ideal, but the feeling of wasting them was what made them stressful. I'd rarely been able to feel so calm, even though I still had very serious concerns on my mind.{w} I hated thinking about it, but what would I do in the future? My parents wouldn't keep sending me money for many more months, so what job could I find? I was only a little interested in studying medicine, but I didn't want to move, and I'd have to spend years and years pursuing it. Of course, it was expensive too, so I felt I had to completely discard the idea.
entries.new: 这样的日子终究会结束。我迟早得去找工作，或者离家去读书。无所事事的几周本该是理想的，可那种虚度光阴的感觉反倒让人心焦。我很少能像这样平静，尽管心里仍压着极重的顾虑。{w}我一想到这些就厌烦，可将来到底要做什么呢？父母不会再给我汇多少个月的钱了，那我能找到什么工作？我对学医只有那么一点兴趣，却又不想搬家，而且要为此耗上好几年。当然，学费也很贵，所以我觉得这个念头只能彻底打消。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What I had to do was very important. I had to erase Miiya's death and make sure Atsuki wouldn't go to the tower. If I could travel to the past and win the lottery, I would do it. It wasn't an answer I'd ever imagined, but it was perfect.
entries.new: 我该做的事非常重要。我要抹去 Miiya 的死，还要确保 Atsuki 不会去那座塔。只要能回到过去，中一次彩票，我就愿意去做。这答案我从前从未设想过，却完美无缺。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...It's almost perfect. There's this huge problem.
entries.new: ……几乎完美无缺。只是还有一个天大的问题。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: The past can be changed, but the way it happens... even if I am able to save Miiya, two versions of myself will remain.
entries.new: 过去可以改变，但改变的方式……就算我救下 Miiya，也仍然会留下两个我。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...{w}I have to assume that's how it'd work. It's the most logical answer, isn't it? Neither of us would blink out of existence.
entries.new: ……{w}只能这么想了吧。这是最合逻辑的答案，不是吗？我们谁都不会凭空消失。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: What would I do? Claim my lottery prize and go live on the other side of the world while the other version of me stays with Atsuki and Miiya?
entries.new: 那我该怎么办？去领我的彩票奖金，跑到世界另一头过日子，让另一个我留在 Atsuki 和 Miiya 身边？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I don't want that. It sounds ridiculous too.
entries.new: 我不想那样。而且听起来也太荒唐了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Is there even a solution here?
entries.new: 这件事到底有没有解法？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I suddenly felt the same way I did every time I thought about my future. Neither answer was any good at all.
entries.new: 我忽然又有了每次思考未来时的那种感觉。两个答案都糟糕透顶。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There's no way around it, right? I couldn't just show up in front of the three of them and explain everything, could I...?
entries.new: 躲不过去的，对吧？我总不能就这么出现在他们三个面前，把事情全盘托出吧……？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: In a reality after saving Miiya, the Sekimeiya would still exist, and it's not like its existence could stay a secret. I have no idea what would happen.
entries.new: 在救下 Miiya 之后的那个现实里，Sekimeiya 依然存在，而它的存在也不可能一直保密。之后会发生什么，我完全无法预料。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I guess that if I can get to the Sekimeiya before the 15th, I could get it again after Miiya is safe. At the very least, if I had it, that'd prove that I'm right, and nobody else could steal it from Ashiya later on. ...I doubt I'd be questioned if I appear in front of another version of myself, though.
entries.new: 我想，只要能在 15 号之前拿到 Sekimeiya，等 Miiya 平安之后我就能再把它取回来。至少只要手里有它，就能证明我是对的，之后也没有谁能从芦屋手上把它偷走。……不过，我要是出现在另一个自己面前，大概也不会被怀疑吧。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Excavation
entries.new: 发掘

entries.text: Is it morning?
entries.new: 天亮了吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I looked at the window behind me. Through the upper gaps of the blinds, faint light was entering the bedroom.
entries.new: 我回头看向身后的窗户。微光从百叶窗上方的缝隙里透进卧室。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'd slept well, and likely for a long time.
entries.new: 我睡得很沉，大概也睡了很久。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: One day closer to the 15th. I'm just in a countdown.
entries.new: 离 15 号又近了一天。我只是在倒数而已。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I wonder where the Sekimeiya is now. If Xyn has already failed to steal it once, are they already planning their daylight attack?
entries.new: 不知道 Sekimeiya 现在在哪里。如果 Xyn 已经偷过一次却失败了，他们是不是已经在计划白天动手了？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I sat up and leaned against the pillow. The room was still pleasantly warm, a luxury I appreciated.
entries.new: 我坐起身，靠在枕头上。房间里依旧暖得舒服，这份奢侈让我很受用。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I reached for my phone to look at the time.{w} It showed {time=9:07}, confirming how long I'd slept.
entries.new: 我伸手拿过手机看时间。{w}屏幕上显示 {time=9:07}，看来我这一觉睡了很久。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Katei said that the Sekimeiya had been found recently on a nearby mountain. Could that be true, though? Was a stone with time traveling powers on a mountain next to Yushibana?
entries.new: ……Katei 说 Sekimeiya 是不久前在附近的山上被发现的。可那是真的吗？一颗拥有时间穿越之力的石头，就躺在丰花旁边的山上？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It doesn't even make sense. The place he described would have been close to where Atsuki and I used to go as kids. That place is mostly ignored nowadays because it lacks caves. If the Sekimeiya was found there, it shouldn't have been inside the mountain.
entries.new: 这根本说不通。他描述的那个地方，就在我和 Atsuki 小时候常去的那一带附近。那里如今几乎没人会去，因为没有洞穴。如果 Sekimeiya 是在那儿被发现的，它就不该在山体里面。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: That's really strange, though. It's been snowing a lot recently... If the Sekimeiya was simply sitting around, it would've been deep under the snow.
entries.new: 可这真的很奇怪。最近雪下得那么多……如果 Sekimeiya 只是随便搁在那儿，早就被埋在厚厚的雪下了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...So either Katei's story was false, or the Sekimeiya had been recently left there and wasn't completely buried by the falling snow when someone found it.
entries.new: ……那么，要么 Katei 说的是假话，要么 Sekimeiya 是不久前才被放在那里，被人发现时还没有被落雪完全掩埋。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Neither option makes much sense. Why would it be put there? It's rare for anyone to go up there, so maybe they expected it to not be found. But that's insanely coincidental.
entries.new: 两种可能都不太说得通。为什么要把东西放在那种地方？很少有人会上那儿去，也许对方就是算准了不会被人发现。可这也太巧了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Just a few days ago, where was the Sekimeiya? I can't seriously think that it was on that mountain for all the years I've lived here.
entries.new: 就在几天前，Sekimeiya 在哪里？我在这里住了这么多年，总不能真以为它一直待在那座山上吧。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: What exactly is the likelihood that it was left there recently? Maybe there actually could be a reason behind that.
entries.new: 它是最近才被放在那里的可能性究竟有多大？说不定这背后真有什么缘由。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I languidly reached for my phone again and opened it. On the screen was an icon that I hadn't clicked on for a very long time. It said "browser".
entries.new: 我懒洋洋地又伸手拿起手机，解了锁。屏幕上有一个我很久没点开过的图标，上面写着「浏览器」。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: My phone could connect to the internet at all times. It was extremely slow, and I never used it. Before my parents had left, we had local internet access, but they shut it down once they took their laptop away.
entries.new: 我的手机随时都能联网。只是速度慢得离谱，我从来不用。父母离开之前，家里本来有本地网络，可他们把笔记本电脑带走后，就把网也停了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I pressed the button and waited for a white screen to load. I had to look away from the glaring brightness, falling back onto the pillow.
entries.new: 我按下那个按钮，等着一片白屏加载出来。刺眼的白光让我不由得移开视线，重新倒回枕头上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Weeks ago, who had the Sekimeiya? If someone had it, is it possible it was already given that name? I don't think Katei mentioned who named it. ...If I recall correctly, he said that it was found on the 27th, and Ashiya announced the event on the 29th, three days ago.
entries.new: 几周之前，Sekimeiya 在谁手上？就算有人拿着它，它当时就已经叫这个名字了吗？Katei 好像没提过是谁给它取的名。……如果我没记错，他说它是 27 号被发现的，而芦屋在 29 号、也就是三天前公布了那场活动。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: If I search for the word "Sekimeiya", I'll probably just find mentions of Ashiya's announcement. I wonder if I could find an instance of that word from before the 29th.
entries.new: 只要搜索「Sekimeiya」这个词，多半只能搜到芦屋公告的相关报道。不知道能不能找到 29 号之前就出现过这个词的记录。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: The search engine loaded, and I considered what to type into it.
entries.new: 搜索引擎加载完毕，我斟酌着该往里输入什么。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Is it possible I'll find traces of the people who want to steal it? I wonder... if what happened on the 30th was an attempt to steal the Sekimeiya, even though it wasn't publicly stated, could there be any mention of this somewhere online?
entries.new: 我会不会找到那些想偷走它的人留下的痕迹？我在想……如果 30 号发生的事就是有人企图偷走 Sekimeiya，虽然官方没有明说，网上会不会有哪里提到过？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I knew Ashiya's announcements would cover up what I wanted to find, so I set the results of the search to be ordered by oldest first, to truly find the first recorded instance of the word. I typed "Sekimeiya" and pressed the search button.
entries.new: 我知道芦屋的公告会把我想找的东西盖住，于是把搜索结果按时间从旧到新排序，好找出这个词最早被记录下来的那一次。我输入「Sekimeiya」，按下搜索键。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The white screen returned with a slowly-filling blue bar on top, which I patiently watched finish.
entries.new: 又是白屏，顶端一条蓝色的进度条缓缓填充，我耐着性子看它走完。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I lost myself in anticipation, forgetting to even blink. Just when had the word "Sekimeiya" been recorded for the first time? I doubted I would find valuable information about Xyn, but that shouldn't have been out of the question either.
entries.new: 我满心期待，连眨眼都忘了。「Sekimeiya」这个词最早是什么时候被记录下来的？我不指望能找到关于 Xyn 的有用信息，可那也并非全无可能。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The results all appeared at once. I glanced at all of them hastily, reading common page titles in blue reporting Ashiya's announcement on the 29th.
entries.new: 结果一下子全冒了出来。我匆匆扫过，蓝色的标题大同小异，都是报道芦屋29 号那场公告的页面。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Wait, what's this?{w} ...The Sekimeiya incident might happen soon...?
entries.new: ……等等，这是什么？{w}……Sekimeiya 事件或许即将发生……？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It was the very first entry. Below it, in gray, I read the creation date.
entries.new: 那是列表最顶端的一条。它下方有一行灰色小字，是发布日期。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Written on the 24th of November... Did I find it?
entries.new: 发布于 11 月 24 日……难道我找到了？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I pressed down once to highlight the text and then clicked on "OK". Once again, the screen turned white and began to slowly load the page.
entries.new: 我按了一下，把那段文字选中，再点下「确定」。屏幕再一次变白，开始慢慢加载页面。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There'd been a brief preview below the title, but I'd advanced before reading it fully. However, it seemed that whoever wrote it was pretty disconcerted.
entries.new: 标题下方本来有一小段预览，可我还没读完就点了进去。不过看得出来，写这段话的人相当心神不宁。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I waited for the screen to transition, blocking out anything else in my field of view. Meanwhile, I looked at the URL of the website and recognized it as a well-known forum used worldwide.
entries.new: 我等着页面跳转，视线里再容不下别的东西。趁这工夫，我看了眼网址，认出那是一个全球知名的论坛。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The loading speed seemed much slower that time, and I worried it would just hang. I held my breath every time the progress bar froze.
entries.new: 这次加载似乎慢得多，我担心它会直接卡死。进度条每停一下，我都屏住呼吸。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The screen turned gray, and the header of the website appeared. Instants later, the rest of its contents popped up in a flash.
entries.new: 屏幕转成灰色，网站的页眉浮现出来。转眼间，其余内容也唰地一下全部显示出来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I relaxed my eyes, the darker screen reducing the strain. Then, I attempted to read the two blocks of text below the title, displayed in minuscule letters.
entries.new: 屏幕暗了下来，眼睛不再那么吃力，我也松弛下来。随后，我试着去读标题下方那两段小得可怜的文字。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: "I swear this is all the truth, I'm not messing around. I'm a bit scared, though, and I'm not sure what to do. I think I just woke up from a really strange dream. It felt hyperrealistic, and I'm still shaking..."
entries.new: 「我发誓，我说的全是真的，绝不是在开玩笑。不过我有点怕，也不知道该怎么办。我想我刚从一个怪梦里醒来。那感觉真实过头了，我现在还在发抖……」
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: "I don't know if it means anything. Maybe it was a premonition, I'm not sure. However, I'd be careful on the 15th of next month. If I don't say this anonymously, I'll be laughed at, or even fired... On the 15th, Ashiya will hold a big event in the tower, and there'll be a terrorist attack."
entries.new: 「我不知道这有没有意义。也许那是个预兆，我也说不准。不过，下个月 15 号还是小心为妙。要不是匿名，我说这些只会被人笑话，甚至会被炒鱿鱼……15 号那天，芦屋会在塔里举办一场大型活动，到时候会有恐怖袭击。」
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: "It will be called... the Sekimeiya."
entries.new: 「它的名字会叫……Sekimeiya。」
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: "Soon, maybe they will announce it. I don't think I'm a prophet or anything, but I'm still trying to calm down. This time, it felt too real to let it pass."
entries.new: 「也许过不了多久，他们就会公布。我并不觉得自己是什么预言家，可我到现在还在设法让自己冷静下来。这一次的感觉太真实了，我没法当作没发生过。」
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Speechless, I scrolled the page down so that I could read the entirety of the following paragraph.
entries.new: 我说不出话来，只能把页面往下滚，好把接下来那一整段读完。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: "That's what I dreamed. It's so bizarre I still think it might've really happened. That's why I feel the need to post it, in case it actually means something. Do not go to that event if it happens. Some people even got trapped inside, but I don't know what happened to them."
entries.new: 「这就是我梦到的。太离奇了，我至今都觉得那可能真的发生过。所以我才想把它发出来，万一它真有什么意义。如果那个活动真的办了，千万别去。有人甚至被困在了里面，可他们后来怎么样，我不知道。」
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: "I think something might be wrong with me... I don't know why, but I'm not home. I can hardly believe it's still the 24th, and I don't know what I'm doing at my parents' house."
entries.new: 「我觉得自己可能出了什么问题……不知为什么，我不在自己家里。我几乎无法相信现在还是24号，也不知道自己为什么会在父母家。」
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: "Sorry to rant about this, but I need to let it out somewhere. I've been suffering from a few mental issues, but nothing has been as bad as this. I've been living alone for two years while my condition has gotten worse and worse. I feel I can't continue on my own, and letting people around me know it might be a horrible idea."
entries.new: 「抱歉在这里倒这些苦水，可我总得找个地方说出来。我一直有些精神方面的毛病，但从没像这次这么严重。我独自生活了两年，状况却越来越糟。我觉得一个人撑不下去了，而让身边的人知道这件事，也许是个糟糕透顶的主意。」
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: "Anyway, maybe some of you will have some advice. I know posting here isn't the most effective thing, but it's very hard for me to talk about this out loud. Thank you for reading."
entries.new: 「总之，也许有人能给我点建议。我知道发在这里未必有什么用，可要我当面对人讲这些，实在很难开口。谢谢你读到这里。」
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: That was where it ended. I looked at the username on the post and read "7md_ag".
entries.new: 帖子到这里就结束了。我看向发帖人的用户名，读出了「7md_ag」。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Astonished, I read through it all again.
entries.new: 我震惊不已，又从头读了一遍。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...{w}Who is this?{w} There's no way it's from the people who organized the attack. The Sekimeiya hadn't been given to Ashiya yet, and they wouldn't know people will get trapped since the alarm's existence was supposed to be a secret.
entries.new: ……{w}这是谁？{w}绝不可能是策划那场袭击的人。Sekimeiya 当时还没交到芦屋手上，而且警报的存在本该是秘密，他们不可能知道有人会被困在里面。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Could it be that someone from Ashiya posted this? If not, they must not have seen it, because it reveals that someone knew about the alarm. ...Even though Ashiya didn't have the Sekimeiya on the 24th, is it possible this person knew they'd obtain a gem to use as bait and what they'd name it?
entries.new: 难道是芦屋的人发的？若不是，那他们一定没看到这帖子——它暴露了有人知道警报的事。……24号那天芦屋还没拿到 Sekimeiya，可这个人会不会早就知道他们会得到一颗宝石用作诱饵，甚至连名字都猜到了？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...There's no way. This can only be one thing.{w} ...Someone who traveled from the future—from the 15th. If it's not that, whoever posted this knew about the Sekimeiya's powers.
entries.new: ……不可能。那就只剩下一种解释。{w}……有人从未来穿越而来——从15号。若非如此，发帖的人就是知道 Sekimeiya 的力量。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: "I can hardly believe it's still the 24th, and I don't know what I'm doing at my parents' house." Did they appear there from the future...?
entries.new: 「我几乎无法相信现在还是24号，也不知道自己为什么会在父母家。」难道这个人是从未来出现在那里的……？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: "Some people even got trapped inside, but I don't know what happened to them."{w} ...If I'm right, this person must have been outside of the tower. They knew some of us had gotten trapped, but not what was happening inside. Then, before {time=21}, they traveled to the past.
entries.new: 「有人甚至被困在了里面，可他们后来怎么样，我不知道。」{w}……如果我猜得没错，这个人当时就在塔外。他知道我们中有人被困住了，却不知道里面发生了什么。然后在 {time=21} 之前，他穿越回了过去。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I thought about that for a while. Was it possible such a thing had happened?
entries.new: 我琢磨了一阵。这种事真的可能发生吗？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If they were outside the tower and suddenly traveled, did people see that? Did someone from inside the building travel to the 24th and bring this person with them?{w} That can't be, right? It's the same thing I thought about regarding my own travel. It would've had an immense range, and it would've picked up so many more people, including me.
entries.new: 如果他在塔外，又突然被传送走，有人看见了吗？会不会是楼里的人穿越到24号，把他一起带了过去？{w}不可能吧？我对自己那次穿越也是这么想的。那范围会大得离谱，还会把更多的人卷进来，包括我在内。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Maybe I have this wrong. If the recording was genuine, the exit wouldn't have unlocked after {time=21.} That could be why this person doesn't know what happened to us, and they could've traveled after the 15th. Maybe when they did, nobody else was outside the tower, and that's why only one person traveled.
entries.new: 也许是我弄错了。如果那段录音是真的，出口在 {time=21.} 之后就不会解锁。这或许就是这个人不知道我们遭遇了什么的原因，而他可能是在15号之后才穿越的。也许他穿越的时候，塔外再没有别人，所以才只有他一个人被传送走。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I got really confused. None of my ideas seemed very reasonable.
entries.new: 我越想越糊涂。哪一个推测都站不住脚。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Does this confirm that what we thought about the range was completely wrong? Now it's not only my travel that doesn't make sense.
entries.new: 这是否说明我们对范围的判断完全错了？如今说不通的，已经不只我那次穿越了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: There's no way this person knew all this without being present on the 15th. Even if they somehow knew what would happen, what's the reason to post it online? The only people who would know about the alarm ahead of time would be Xyn members or Ashiya, two groups that would never publicly post this. Traveling from the future and posting it makes far more sense.
entries.new: 这个人若没在15号那天在场，绝不可能知道这些。就算他不知怎么预知了会发生什么，又有什么理由把它发到网上？能提前知道警报的，只有 Xyn 的人和芦屋；而这两方都绝不会公开贴出这种东西。相比之下，从未来穿越回来再发帖，要合理得多。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I read it one more time, and what they described sounded exactly like they had been sent fairly far back in time.
entries.new: 我又读了一遍。他描述的情形，分明就是被送回了相当久远的过去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But if that's it, who made that travel happen? Whoever did would've disappeared from the tower.{w} ...Was it Akaro?{w} When we left the attic's bedroom, we found the Sekimeiya powered off in a hallway B room. After that time, I didn't see Akaro again, and he could've touched it. ...Also, the rest of us but Sai were in the attic, so maybe that's why we didn't travel alongside Akaro.
entries.new: 可若真是这样，那次穿越又是谁触发的？触发的人本该从塔里消失。{w}……是 Akaro 吗？{w}我们离开阁楼那间卧室时，发现 Sekimeiya 在 B走廊的一个房间里，已经关掉了。那之后我就再没见过 Akaro，他有机会碰到它。……而且，除了 Sai，我们几个当时都在阁楼里，也许正因如此才没跟着 Akaro 一起被传送走。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: But... much later, Atsuki said that he'd seen him.{w} ...Maybe I'm wrong. If the range isn't an obstacle, anyone could've gone so far back. Then, they either could've reentered through the storeroom or been inside since that morning.
entries.new: 可是……很久之后，Atsuki 说他见过他。{w}……也许我错了。如果范围不是障碍，那谁都有可能回到那么早的过去。那样的话，这个人要么是从储藏室重新进来的，要么从那天早上起就一直待在楼里。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It's also possible the Sekimeiya was taken out through the storeroom at some point, and that's how this person traveled without affecting anyone nearby.
entries.new: 也有可能 Sekimeiya 在某个时候被从储藏室带了出去，这个人正是借此穿越，才没有波及附近的任何人。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...{w}If this person was outside the tower and went to the past alongside someone who activated the Sekimeiya, would they have thought that they'd experienced a hyperrealistic dream? That sounds pretty strange, but I suppose there aren't many more interpretations. They don't exactly seem to have a record of being mentally stable...
