entries.new: ……{w}如果这个人当时在塔外，跟着某个启动 Sekimeiya 的人一起回到了过去，他会不会就以为自己做了一场无比真实的梦？这听起来很荒唐，但除此之外恐怕也没有多少解释。毕竟从帖子里看，他的精神状态本来就算不上稳定……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: So did this thread always exist? Did the event still occur when the Sekimeiya's existence had been foreseen days before its announcement because nobody saw this? Did this person not try to make waves once it was announced...?
entries.new: 那么这个帖子是一直就存在的吗？早在公布之前好几天，就有人预见了 Sekimeiya 的存在，事件却照样发生了——是因为没人看到这帖子吗？还是说，等消息公布之后，这个人并没有试图闹出什么动静……？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I tried to keep scrolling down and realized that the page was larger than I'd thought.
entries.new: 我继续往下滚，才发现这页面比我想的要长。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Below the initial post was a short reply.{w} "Yeah, right? If you can see the future, do me a favor and PM me tomorrow's lottery numbers. That'd be sick. I'd make a nice long reservation at that comfy Damski resort place, always wanted to go."
entries.new: 原帖下面是一条简短的回复。{w}「可不是嘛？你要是能看见未来，就帮个忙，私信我明天的彩票号码。那可太爽了。我要在 Damski 那家舒服的度假村订一间长住房，我一直想去。」
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...The poster was "IloveAgathodaemon". I went down farther and saw another reply by the original poster.
entries.new: ……发帖人叫「IloveAgathodaemon」。我继续往下翻，又看到一条楼主自己的回复。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: "I'm telling the truth. I've cooled off, but I still feel like I shouldn't be here. I am not the crazy one. I just spoke to my parents, and they also said I shouldn't be here. There is no way it's the 24th. I can't believe any of this."
entries.new: 「我说的是真话。我已经冷静下来了，可我还是觉得自己不该在这里。不是我疯了。我刚跟父母谈过，他们也说我不该在这里。现在绝不可能是24号。这一切我都没法相信。」
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The next reply had been posted one day later. Below it, the dated entry showed it had been sent on the 25th of November, at {time=20.}
entries.new: 下一条回复是一天之后发的。下面标着的日期显示，它发送于11月25日 {time=20.}。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: "But where's my lottery number? I was excited to go buy my ticket. I don't know if you're just bored, but there's not much time until the 15th. Don't worry. I promise you I won't go if what you're saying happens."
entries.new: 「可我的彩票号码呢？我还兴冲冲地准备去买呢。我不知道你是不是只是无聊，但离15号可没多少时间了。放心吧，如果真像你说的那样，我保证不去。」
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Next, a third person had left a comment. Their name was "RentALiver".
entries.new: 接着，第三个人留了言。名字是「RentALiver」。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: "Are you someone from Sasameyuki? Is this what you all do now? If this event at the skyscraper is actually announced, it'll confirm I'm right. Are you trying to scare people off from going? I bet you're not even from Yushibana."
entries.new: 「你是 Sasameyuki 的人吧？你们现在都干这种事了？如果那栋高楼的活动真的公布了，就证明我没说错。你是想吓唬别人别去吗？我看你根本就不是丰花的人。」
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I frowned and tried to remember what I knew about that name.
entries.new: 我皱起眉，努力回想我对这个名字的了解。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Is that a company Ashiya had a conflict with? ...That has to be it. They're not from Yushibana, which must be why this person's saying that.
entries.new: 是跟芦屋有过冲突的那家公司吗？……一定是了。这人说对方不是丰花的人，大概就是指这个。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: There was another reply posted early on the 26th by the original poster.
entries.new: 26号一早，楼主又发了一条回复。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: "I am from Yushibana. It's where I am right now. I just came back from my parents', but my memories of the days leading up to the 15th only intensified. It's impossible I dreamed all that. I really have no idea what happened to me."
entries.new: 「我就是丰花的人。我现在就在这儿。我刚从父母家回来，可我对15号之前那几天的记忆反而越来越清晰。那不可能只是一场梦。我真的不知道自己身上发生了什么。」
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...A picture?
entries.new: ……一张照片？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Below that comment, there was an attached picture that just finished loading. It was from high up, and you could see the tower in the distance, its surroundings all lightly covered by snow.
entries.new: 那条评论下面附着一张刚加载完的照片。拍摄位置很高，远处能看到那座塔，四周覆着一层薄雪。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: This was taken in Yushibana. I see, they posted this to show that they live here.
entries.new: 这是在丰花拍的。原来如此，他贴这张照片是为了证明自己住在这里。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I scrolled down more and came to a yellow line of text saying "This topic has been locked. You cannot post a new reply."
entries.new: 我又往下滚，看到一行黄色的字：「本帖已锁定，无法发表新回复。」
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: This is all there is...
entries.new: 就这些了……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: This person definitely traveled from the 15th. They even said their memories end there, so that's the day they went to the past.
entries.new: 这个人确实是从15号穿越回来的。他甚至说自己的记忆就断在那里，可见他就是那天回到过去的。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It doesn't make sense, though. How did that happen...?
entries.new: 可这说不通啊。到底是怎么发生的……？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: And did this thread change the past, or did it always exist and the incident occurred anyway?
entries.new: 还有，这个帖子究竟是改变了过去，还是它一直就存在，事件却照样发生了？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It seems so strange... What if Xyn gets in touch with this person after Ashiya announces the Sekimeiya event, and that's how they'll learn about the alarm? That'd be a paradox, but maybe it's possible.
entries.new: 太奇怪了……万一芦屋公布 Sekimeiya 的活动之后，Xyn 联系上这个人，就这样得知警报的事呢？那就成悖论了，但也未必不可能。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I selected the username "7md_ag" and pulled up the profile.
entries.new: 我点开用户名「7md_ag」，打开了个人主页。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The page loaded much more quickly. A history of the account activity appeared before me, but unfortunately, they hadn't posted anything after their last reply.
entries.new: 这次页面加载得快多了。账号的活动记录出现在眼前，可惜在最后那条回复之后，他再没发过任何东西。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I felt a little dizzy after reading all of that, probably thanks to not having eaten much the previous day. Sapped of energy, I got out of bed and steadied myself.
entries.new: 读完这些，我有些头晕，多半是前一天没吃多少东西的缘故。身上提不起劲，我下了床，站稳身子。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I picked out some fresh clothing and stepped to the bathroom.
entries.new: 我挑了几件干净衣服，走进浴室。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I still don't have anything to eat.
entries.new: ……家里还是一点吃的都没有。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I could feel the demands of my stomach. Given the unpleasant meat I'd cooked, it wanted something actually edible.
entries.new: 我能感觉到胃在抗议。想想自己之前煎的那两块难吃的肉，它现在想要点真正能入口的东西。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It's really early... I should just go to the grocery store. Better watch out for no low-quality cuts of meat before I buy them, though...
entries.new: 确实还早……干脆去趟超市吧。不过买肉之前得看清楚，别挑到那种劣质肉……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Sidnoc was a grocery close to my apartment that I visited often, and that was my target for the time being. I knew I wouldn't be able to think properly before eating something filling.
entries.new: Sidnoc 是离我公寓不远的一家超市，我常去，眼下就打算去那儿。我知道，不先吃点顶饱的东西，脑子根本转不动。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I drank some chilly bottled water and approached the heater.
entries.new: 我喝了几口冰凉的瓶装水，走到暖气旁。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I guess I can leave it on. I'll be really cold once I come back.
entries.new: 就让它开着吧。回来的时候肯定冷得够呛。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I grabbed my purse in the living room. In the entrance, I made sure I wasn't forgetting anything and picked up my keys. I had my wallet too, so I put on the boots and coat I'd left next to the door.
entries.new: 我在客厅拿上手提包，到玄关确认没落下东西，又拿起钥匙。钱包也在身上，我便穿上放在门边的靴子和大衣。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It wasn't snowing that day either, and my street seemed empty.{w} I went down the stairs and walked ahead. The direction was the same I'd taken the previous day, but Sidnoc was located before the center of Yushibana.
entries.new: 那天也没有下雪，我那条街看上去空无一人。{w}我走下楼梯，往前走。方向和前一天一样，只是 Sidnoc 在丰花中心前面。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I recognized the wide tire marks on the snow. Once a week, a garbage truck would pass through my street to collect the grouped-up cans farther ahead.
entries.new: 我认出雪地上那几道宽轮胎印。每周会有一次垃圾车开过这条街，去前面收走堆好的易拉罐。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I guess the lady at the store also knows me.
entries.new: 看来店里那位女士也认得我。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I didn't know her name, or if she was the owner of the place or just a cashier, but she was usually there when I went. I wondered if she'd say anything, as I'd never really spoken to her.
entries.new: 我不知道她叫什么，也不知道她是店主还是普通收银员，但每次去她几乎都在。我从没和她好好说过话，不知道她会不会提起什么。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Normally, after leaving my house with the heater on, the outside would feel very cold. It was a little bit warmer than I expected, so I kept a steady pace.
entries.new: 家里开着暖气，出门时外面照例冷得刺骨。今天却比预想的暖一些，我便不紧不慢地走着。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I saw more clouds above me, as white as the ground. ...After walking for a bit, I still hadn't seen anyone on the street.
entries.new: 抬头望去，天上的云多了起来，白得和地面一样。……走了一段，街上仍不见半个人影。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...After firmly pressing down on the snow with a step, I brought myself to a halt.
entries.new: ……我重重踩下一步，在雪里陷稳了脚，才停住身子。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Still looking upward, I was staring at the structure that reached higher than the others. I'd seen it throughout my entire life, but I'd only recently entered it for the first time.
entries.new: 我依旧仰着头，望着那栋比周围都高的建筑。它从我记事起就在那里，可我直到最近才第一次走进去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I remembered having been told before that it was visible from any place in Yushibana, and I'd just seen it was the truth.
entries.new: 我记得以前听人说过，在丰花任何地方都能望见它——刚才一看，果然不假。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I guess when we were inside of it, all of Yushibana could see us.
entries.new: 这么说，我们待在里面的时候，整个丰花都能看见我们。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: From where I was, I could only see a few of the higher windows, but it was enough to notice that there were no shutters covering them.
entries.new: 从我这儿只能看见高处的几扇窗，但也足够看出，那些窗上并没有卷帘遮着。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I looked at it for a while, my mind blank. It seemed there was no light on the other side of the windows. As Katei had said, nobody had been recently working on those floors.
entries.new: 我望着它出了会儿神，脑中一片空白。窗后似乎没有一丝灯光。正如 Katei 所说，那些楼层最近都没人用过。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I shook it off and kept going. I was already pretty close.
entries.new: 我甩开这些念头，继续往前走。已经离得不远了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: As I got closer to the busier center of town, more and more tire marks crisscrossed the snow. I could see the shop ahead of me, and I shortly arrived in front of it.
entries.new: 越靠近热闹的镇中心，雪地上的轮胎印就越交错密布。那家店已经出现在前方，我很快就走到了门口。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Hello.
entries.new: 你好。
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: ...Good morning.
entries.new: ……早上好。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: I walked past her. The streets had been desolate, but I saw someone I didn't recognize picking up cereal in an aisle.
entries.new: 我从她身边走过。街上冷冷清清，店里却有个陌生的面孔在货架前挑麦片。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...She didn't say anything.
entries.new: ……她什么也没提。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I figured not everyone had seen the news, and even if she had, she didn't have to mention it. I knew where everything was, so I kept walking as I wondered what to get.
entries.new: 我想，不是每个人都看到了那则新闻；就算看了，也未必非要提起。店里的东西我熟，便一边走一边想着买些什么。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I really wanted to use my time well, and I never felt like cooking. I stopped in front of the stand full of instant food.
entries.new: 我实在想把时间用在刀刃上，也从来懒得做饭。我在摆满速食的货架前停下。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'll get tired of these if it's the only thing I buy. ...They're all instant noodles.
entries.new: 要是只买这些，很快就会吃腻。……可这里全是泡面。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I frowned a little, but there was nothing to worry about. On the 8th, I'd gone home from the hospital, but it had been late, and I'd eaten a little before leaving. I didn't think I'd checked the kitchen where I could've seen my food supply.
entries.new: 我微微皱眉，不过也没什么好担心的。八号那天我从医院回家，时间已经很晚，出门前也吃过一点。我记得自己回来时并没查看过厨房，不然就能知道家里还剩多少吃的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: And even if I did, I could simply be changing the past now.
entries.new: 就算看过，也无非是现在正在改变过去罢了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It keeps occurring, though. I went to buy food without the intention to change the past, and it happened to match what I already lived through once. Maybe it really is correct that everything will happen as it did if I don't purposely think about changing anything.
entries.new: 可这种事一再发生。我出来买吃的，并没有改变过去的打算，结果却恰好和已经经历过的那一次吻合。也许那种说法确实没错：只要我不刻意去想改变什么，一切就会按原样发生。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: But that also doesn't make complete sense. I've already made one change by calling my mom, so now "everything" can't really happen as it did as long as I don't intend otherwise. Down the line, more things are bound to differ...
entries.new: 但这也不全说得通。我已经给妈打了一通电话，改变了一件事；既然如此，只要我没有别的打算，『一切照旧』就说不通了。往后，肯定还会有更多地方不一样……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I sighed, picked up a few packs of instant noodles without any special flavoring, and wandered around the shop.
entries.new: 我叹了口气，拿起几包没有特别调味的泡面，在店里转了起来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I hadn't grabbed a cart, so I soon found myself carrying noodles, cookies, milk, chips, almonds, and my favorite cereal bars.
entries.new: 我没推购物车，很快就发现自己怀里抱着泡面、饼干、牛奶、薯片、杏仁，还有我最喜欢的麦片棒。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I should get meat too.
entries.new: ……还得买点肉。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I felt a little reluctant to buy more after the two nasty pieces I'd eaten.
entries.new: 吃过那两块难以下咽的肉之后，我实在不太情愿再买。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I stared through the transparent door of the fridge. I didn't feel like looking at the eggs, so I scanned the scarce meat that was there.
entries.new: 我隔着冷柜的透明门往里看。懒得去看鸡蛋，便把所剩不多的肉扫了一遍。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I guess I just have to heat these up.
entries.new: 这些大概只要热一下就行。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I lifted up the top and grabbed some prepared meat. I knew I'd seen the same brand at Atsuki's house.
entries.new: 我掀开柜盖，拿了几份调理好的肉。我记得在 Atsuki 家里见过同一个牌子。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Careful not to let anything fall, I stepped up to the cashier and dropped everything on the conveyor belt. It would all last me a few days, but not until the 15th.
entries.new: 我小心不让东西掉下来，走到收银台前，把它们一股脑放到传送带上。这些够我吃上几天，但撑不到十五号。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: She quietly scanned all the items.
entries.new: 她一声不响地把所有东西扫过码。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It'll be ¥2,739 total.
entries.new: 一共 2,739 日元。
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: Ah, give me a plastic bag too, please.
entries.new: 啊，再给我一个塑料袋。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: ...Here.
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: I grabbed my wallet, but I knew I barely didn't have enough cash to pay for everything.{w} I took out my credit card instead and handed it to her.
entries.new: 我掏出钱包，可我知道身上的现金差一点点不够付全款。{w}于是我改拿信用卡，递给她。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: She inserted it into a tiny device and asked me to put in my PIN.
entries.new: 她把卡插进一个小机器里，让我输入密码。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: 1{w=0.4}9{w=0.2}9{w=0.3}1.{w=0.3} I pressed "okay" and waited a few seconds.
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: All right, thank you.
entries.new: 好，谢谢。
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: After she handed me the receipt, I put everything in the bag and walked out.
entries.new: 她递来收据后，我把东西都装进袋子，走出了店门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The other shopper had left at some point, but the outside was as devoid of life as before.
entries.new: 不知什么时候，另一名顾客已经走了；外面依旧空无一人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I retreaded my footprints to make it home. I'd already done what I wanted, so I moved slower, trying not to exhaust the minimal energy I still had.
entries.new: 我沿着来时的脚印往家走。想办的事已经办完，我便放慢脚步，尽量不耗尽所剩无几的力气。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I took the keys out while I went up the stairs. Opening the door caused the heat stored inside to leak out, so I moved in quickly.
entries.new: 我一边上楼，一边掏出钥匙。门一开，屋里积存的暖意便向外散，我赶紧闪身进屋。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I left the bag on the floor to take off my coat and shoes and brought it to the kitchen.
entries.new: 我把袋子搁在地上，脱下外套和鞋，再提着它进了厨房。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Except for a portion of noodles, I stored everything in a low cabinet and the fridge. I didn't have any way to obtain hot water, so I put some in a pot and placed it on the gas stove. I tended to cook with bottled water because I didn't particularly trust tap water. Fortunately, I still had plenty of bottles left.
entries.new: 除了一份面条，其余东西我都收进了矮柜和冰箱。我没法直接弄到热水，便往锅里倒了些水，放到燃气灶上。我做饭一向用瓶装水，因为不太信得过自来水。幸好剩下的瓶装水还很多。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: After grabbing the chopsticks, I waited for the water to boil. It didn't need to get overly hot, so as soon as tiny bubbles began to form on the surface of the pot, I turned off the stove and poured the water in a bowl with the noodles and other ingredients.
entries.new: 我拿好筷子，等水烧开。水不用烧得太烫，锅底刚冒出细小的气泡，我就关掉灶火，把水倒进盛着面条和配料的碗里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Within five minutes, they would be cooked. As usual, I brought the bowl to the living room and left it on the table.
entries.new: 五分钟之内就能泡熟。我照例把碗端到客厅，放在桌上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I hadn't turned on the light, so the only illumination came from outside. I felt much more comfortable not having my window exposed to anyone outside of it, and the lighting was preferable anyway.
entries.new: 我没开灯，屋里只有外面透进来的光。窗外的人看不到室内，这让我自在得多，况且这样的光线也更合我意。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Nonetheless, I still turned on the ceiling light to force myself to be more awake.
entries.new: 尽管如此，我还是打开了顶灯，逼自己清醒一些。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I tried to simply wait for the noodles to cook, but it was hard not to remember what I'd read.
entries.new: 我想干脆等着面泡好，可脑子里总忍不住回想刚才读到的内容。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Who had written those posts, and where had they been on the 15th? Since they'd traveled back, on that day, two versions of them should have existed simultaneously.
entries.new: ……那些帖子是谁写的？15号那天，那个人又在哪里？既然对方回到了过去，那一天就该同时存在着两个他。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: My mind clouded as soon as I tried to think about it, so I knew it was a bad idea trying to get anywhere before eating.
entries.new: 刚试着去想，脑子就乱成一团，所以我知道，吃饭前再怎么想也是白费。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I poked the noodles with the chopsticks, but I had to wait a little more.
entries.new: 我用筷子戳了戳面条，还得再等一会儿。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Enough time had probably passed, so I brought some to my mouth.
entries.new: 时间应该差不多了，我便夹起一些送进嘴里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...They were good, and not too hot either, so I continued.
entries.new: ……味道不错，也不烫嘴，我便继续吃。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The issue with those packets of ramen was that there wasn't much in them. It only took me about a minute to finish.
entries.new: 这种袋装拉面的毛病就是分量太少，我大约一分钟就吃完了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I tried not to wolf it down so fast, but it had at least been what I'd needed, because my mind started regaining some focus soon after beginning to eat.
entries.new: 我尽量不狼吞虎咽，不过至少这碗面正是我需要的——刚吃没多久，脑子就清醒了一些。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Hm...
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Maybe I could try to figure out who posted that thread.
entries.new: 也许可以试着查清那个帖子是谁发的。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: When I got that idea, I put the noodles on hold and walked to my bedroom.
entries.new: 冒出这个念头后，我暂且放下筷子，走回卧室。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: My phone was still next to the pillow, so I grabbed it and flipped it open.
entries.new: 手机还放在枕头边，我拿起来翻开。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: 7md_ag's profile was still there. As I walked back to the living room, I pressed the "return" button.
entries.new: 7md_ag 的个人资料页还在。我一边走回客厅，一边按下「返回」键。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I left the phone on the table and continued eating. As soon as the page loaded, I navigated to the bottom of it.
entries.new: 我把手机搁在桌上，继续吃面。页面一加载完，我就翻到最下方。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Yeah, this picture... I could try to pinpoint where it was taken from.
entries.new: 嗯，这张照片……也许可以查出拍摄的位置。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: The angle was from a little high up, so it was likely taken through an apartment window.{w} In Yushibana, most apartments didn't have different floors, so it was likely that if I simply found the place it'd been taken from, I could also find out who lived there.
entries.new: 拍摄角度略高，很可能是透过某间公寓的窗户拍的。{w}丰花的大多数公寓都只有一层，所以只要找到拍摄地点，或许就能查出住在那里的住户。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Actually, no... I know this street. That's where there are a few slightly higher buildings, so they should have more than one floor. ...This is close to Atsuki's house.
entries.new: 等等，不对……这条街我认识。那里有几栋稍高的楼，应该不止一层。……这里离 Atsuki 家很近。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I ate the remaining noodles, scratching the bottom of the bowl so that none were left behind.
entries.new: 我吃掉了剩下的面，还把碗底刮得干干净净，一根不剩。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Would knowing who this person is be useful? ...It might be.
entries.new: ……查清这个人是谁，会有用吗？……也许会有。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I'm not sure how much I can do. I really doubt I could stop the incident from happening myself, but I should try to learn as much as I can about it. ...What really happened on the 15th? There were a lot of strange things about the attack.
entries.new: 我不确定自己能做多少。我实在不觉得自己能阻止那起事件发生，但至少该尽量多了解一些。……15号究竟发生了什么？那次袭击有太多蹊跷之处。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: There's also the chance the person who posted the thread is someone I know. Assuming I manage to travel back in time again, it's definitely possible that they'll still go all the way back as long as the incident occurs. It shouldn't even matter if Atsuki and I don't go.{w} I'll definitely have to go to the tower before the 15th. I guess the best I can hope for is that I'll be able to touch the Sekimeiya and go far enough back to save Miiya. Most likely, the biggest issue right now is not knowing how to make myself go so far back again.
entries.new: 发帖人也可能是我认识的人。假设我还能再次穿越回过去，只要那起事件发生，对方完全有可能仍旧一路穿越回过去。即使我和 Atsuki 不去，应该也无所谓。{w}我无论如何都得在15号之前去一趟芦屋塔。我能指望的最好结果，大概就是碰触 Sekimeiya，并回到足够早的过去救下 Miiya。眼下最大的问题，恐怕是我不知道怎样才能让自己再次回到那么早的过去。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: But if I can pull that off, alongside saving Miiya, the ideal scenario would be to obtain the Sekimeiya myself. What if I go many days into the past, before the 27th? I could find the Sekimeiya on the mountain, which would save Miiya and prevent the incident from happening.
entries.new: 但如果真能做到，最理想的情况，就是在救下 Miiya 的同时，由我拿到 Sekimeiya。要是我回到许多天前，回到27号之前呢？我可以在山上找到 Sekimeiya，这样既能救下 Miiya，也能阻止那起事件发生。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...I suppose Ashiya would find a replacement for the Sekimeiya to bait Xyn, but that doesn't really matter as long as people don't get trapped with something that causes time travel. That could outright stop any deaths from happening just by itself.
entries.new: ……我想芦屋会找一件 Sekimeiya 的替代品来引诱 Xyn；但只要不会有人被困在会引发时间穿越的东西里，那也无妨。单凭这一点，或许就能彻底避免死亡。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I walked to the kitchen and left the bowl in the sink. I still felt hungry, so I took the chocolate cookies I'd bought out of the cabinet.
entries.new: 我走到厨房，把碗放进水槽。肚子还饿，我便从柜子里拿出买来的巧克力饼干。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If I find the person behind the thread, maybe I could speak to them. They could still have important information if they merely traveled from outside the tower. It's also possible other people will try to get in touch with them now that the Sekimeiya has been announced officially.
entries.new: 如果能找到发帖人，也许我可以和对方谈谈。哪怕对方只是从塔外穿越回来的，也可能掌握重要信息。而且 Sekimeiya 已经正式公布，说不定还会有别人想联系对方。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: There were a number of reasons why discovering their identity would potentially be useful. If even one of them was correct, that was enough.
entries.new: 查清对方身份可能有用，理由不止一个。只要其中一条站得住脚，就足够了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Should I go there and knock on the door, hoping it's the right one...?
entries.new: 我该不该直接过去敲门，指望没找错地方……？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: We gave our names to Suripo when we talked to him, so this person could potentially recognize mine. Would it be a good idea to say that I've experienced the same thing as them...?
entries.new: 我们和 Suripo 谈话时报过名字，对方有可能认出我的名字。要不要直接说，我和对方有过同样的经历……？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I lay back on the carpet, a bit indecisive.
entries.new: 我躺回地毯上，一时拿不定主意。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I also keep thinking that before the 15th, if I haven't been able to use the Sekimeiya, I'll prevent Atsuki and myself from going to the tower. How exactly do I plan to do that...?
entries.new: 我也一直在想，如果在15号之前还是用不上 Sekimeiya，我就得阻止自己和 Atsuki 去芦屋塔。可我究竟打算怎么阻止……？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...There's no way writing an anonymous note would be enough.
entries.new: ……光写一张匿名纸条，肯定不够。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Oh, actually, it should be simple.{w} When I woke up in the hospital, it was the afternoon of the 8th, and Atsuki was there. So I know for a fact that he'll be out at that time.
entries.new: 啊，其实应该很简单。{w}我在医院醒来时是8号下午，Atsuki 就在那里。所以我确定，那个时间他不在家。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I could go to his house then and take the tickets we bought. The three of them should be in the purse Miiya used, and the pamphlet advised people to hurry before they ran out. There were so many people at the tower when the shutter closed that I bet they sold out, too. We didn't look at those tickets again until the 14th, so that'll definitely be too late to buy new ones.
entries.new: 到时我可以去他家，把我们买的票拿走。三张票应该在 Miiya 用过的钱包里；宣传册也提醒过人们要趁售罄前赶快买。卷帘门落下时，塔里人那么多，我敢说票早就卖光了。我们直到14号才又去看那些票，所以那时再想买新票，肯定已经太迟。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I should be able to enter his house when he's out. I know where he keeps a hidden key close to his door just in case he ever forgets his inside. If it's not there anymore, I might be able to open the window of his bedroom as long as the shutter isn't down. He doesn't usually lock it.
entries.new: 他不在家时，我应该进得去。我知道他在门附近藏了一把备用钥匙，以防哪天把钥匙忘在屋里。要是钥匙已经不在了，只要卷帘窗没放下，我也许能打开他卧室的窗户。他通常不锁窗。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I spent a while lying down, but I began to feel really curious about the mysterious forum poster, wondering if there'd been an ulterior reason behind their text.
entries.new: 我在地上躺了一阵，却对论坛上那个神秘发帖人越发好奇，忍不住去想对方写下那些话是否另有隐情。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I put my phone in my purse and prepared to leave.
entries.new: 我把手机放进手提包，准备出门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: My boots and coat were where I'd just left them, so I put them on and stepped out, then headed down the stairs.
entries.new: 靴子和外套还搁在我刚才放下的地方。我穿上它们出了门，走下楼梯。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I knew approximately where to go. Once I was at the street where the picture had been taken, I expected to be able to look at it and determine the exact building I was searching for.
entries.new: 大致该往哪儿走，我心里有数。只要到了拍照的那条街，我想我就能对照照片，找出自己要找的那栋楼。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I could take different paths to make it to the opposite side of the town, but I simply walked as if I was going to Atsuki's house.
entries.new: 要去镇子的另一头，本可以绕别的路，我却只是照着去 Atsuki 家的方向走。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: His house and Ashiya Tower were both in the distance, but they were also on opposite sides. The tower was right in front of the mountains, whereas Atsuki's house was near the road to leave Yushibana.
entries.new: 他家与芦屋塔都在远处，方向却正好相反。塔就立在山前，Atsuki 家则靠近离开丰花的那条路。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: As always, the center of the town felt much more lively. At a crosswalk hidden by the snow, a car waited for people to cross. That time, instead of going with them to Ramon street, I went directly to Enric avenue.
entries.new: 镇中心像往常一样热闹得多。一处被积雪盖住的斑马线前，一辆车停下来等行人通过。这次我没有跟着人群去拉蒙街，而是直接去了恩里克大道。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I chose not to walk past Atsuki's house and kept moving ahead. If I wasn't mistaken, the street I was going to was called Ampla, and it was parallel to Enric.
entries.new: 我选择不经过 Atsuki 家门前，径直往前走。如果没记错，我要去的那条街叫安普拉街，与恩里克大道平行。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wait a second.
entries.new: 等等。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Thinking about the movements I'd made the previous day, an important connection arose in my mind.
entries.new: 回想前一天的行程，一个重要的关联忽然浮上心头。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Huh...
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: The forum thread had been posted on November 24th. I'd read about that date in the newspaper.
entries.new: 论坛上的帖子发布于 11 月 24 日。而那个日期，我在报纸上读到过。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Also in the afternoon of November 24th, a camera had recorded a prisoner escaping from a cell. No one had any idea how they'd even gotten in there.
entries.new: 同样在 11 月 24 日下午，监控拍到一名囚犯从牢房里逃了出去。可谁也不知道那人究竟是怎么进去的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Was I actually right? Was it the Sekimeiya's teleportation?
entries.new: ……我猜的真是对的？那是 Sekimeiya 的传送？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: If the person who posted the forum thread was outside the tower on the 15th, like I thought, someone touched the Sekimeiya from inside. So both of them appeared at the very same time on November 24th.
entries.new: 如果发帖的人真如我所想，15 日那天在塔外，那么塔内便有人触碰了 Sekimeiya。于是这两个人在 11 月 24 日的同一时刻同时现身。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It fit perfectly. Someone else who'd been caught up in that travel had appeared inside a vacant prison cell.
entries.new: 一切正好对得上。另一个被卷入那次穿越的人，出现在了一间空牢房里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Was it the person who touched the Sekimeiya or someone else who was waiting outside?
entries.new: ……是碰到 Sekimeiya 的那个人，还是当时在外面等候的另一个人？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: The article said they were dressed as a prisoner. This must mean that the position they appeared in was based on a time they were jailed, right? ...Had one of us in the tower been in prison in the past?
entries.new: 报道说那人一身囚犯打扮。也就是说，他现身的位置取决于他被关进牢里的那个时间，对吧？……难道当时在塔里的人中，有谁过去坐过牢？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I attempted to visualize the picture next to the article.
entries.new: 我试着在脑中回想报道旁的那张照片。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It had been taken from the ceiling, so measuring the person's height with it was very hard. Since it had been in black and white, I couldn't discern the color of their hair either, so all I knew was that they were a man with short and dark hair.
entries.new: 照片是从天花板俯拍的，很难据此判断那人的身高。又因为是黑白照，连发色也看不出来——我只知道他是个留着深色短发的男人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It's not possible it was a police officer waiting outside. If that was the case, they wouldn't have appeared dressed up as a prisoner. Just going off that fact, it's incredibly likely it was one of us who were inside the building.
entries.new: 等在外面的那个人不可能是警察。真要是警察，出现时也不会是一身囚犯打扮。光凭这一点，那人极可能是楼里的我们之一。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: So... someone else who got trapped and knows about the Sekimeiya's powers is here, in the past with me. This is what I was afraid of.
entries.new: 这么说……还有一个和我一样被困住、也知道 Sekimeiya 力量的人，跟我一起待在这个过去。我最怕的就是这个。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I bit my lip and tried to keep walking.{w} I'd already thought of the negative implications of that, but I had to start seriously worrying about them.
entries.new: 我咬住嘴唇，继续往前走。{w}那些糟糕的可能我早就想到过，只是如今不得不认真对待了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If they'd been in prison before, their reason to be in the tower had to be stealing the Sekimeiya. Everyone there with me understood at least the basics of what it could do, so now that person must be entirely aware of the fact that they're in the past...
entries.new: 如果那个人过去坐过牢，那他进塔的目的只可能是偷 Sekimeiya。当时和我一起在塔里的人，多少都了解它的基本能力，那么那个人现在一定清楚自己身处过去……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...They have the ability to change the past and know about Ashiya's alarm. At any point, I could hear the news that the Sekimeiya has been stolen before the 15th.
entries.new: ……他有改变过去的能力，也知道芦屋的警报。随时都可能传来消息，说 Sekimeiya 在 15 日之前就被偷走了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I tried to calm myself down, but it wasn't easy. If Xyn, or anyone, stole the Sekimeiya, the incident on the 15th wouldn't happen. The deaths of that day would be erased, but an alternate outcome like that came with its own problems.
entries.new: 我试着让自己冷静下来，却没那么容易。如果 Xyn 或别的什么人偷走了 Sekimeiya，15 日的事件就不会发生。那天丧命的人会被抹去，可这样的另一种结局也有它自己的麻烦。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I wouldn't be able to save Miiya, and I would remain in a world with two versions of myself. The only way to make the latter work would become impossible as well, as I wouldn't be able to go back in time with any winning lottery number.
entries.new: 我就救不了 Miiya，而且会一直留在一个有两个自己的世界里。而唯一能让两个我并存的办法，也会落空——我没办法带着中奖号码回到过去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Does this pretty much mean that I have to go to the tower as soon as possible, find the Sekimeiya, and somehow activate it to go days back?{w} That could easily go wrong in so many ways...!{w} What if I stay in front of the tower permanently to see what Xyn do with the Sekimeiya once they steal it?{w} This could also very easily end up being a mistake, and there's no way I could do it.
entries.new: 这基本上就是说，我得尽快赶到塔里，找到 Sekimeiya，然后想办法启动它，回到几天前？{w}这中间随随便便就能出岔子……！{w}又或者，我干脆一直守在塔前，看 Xyn 偷走 Sekimeiya 之后会拿它做什么？{w}这同样极可能是个错误的决定，而且我根本做不到。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...Is it likely that whoever traveled to the 24th thinks the past can't be changed? If so, they'll be afraid to attempt to steal it before the 15th, and they'll try to do it on that day with the information they have, just like I was thinking of doing.
entries.new: ……那个穿越到 24 日的人，有没有可能也认为过去无法改变？若真如此，他就不敢在 15 日之前动手去偷，而是会带着手上的情报，在那一天动手——和我原本的打算一样。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I guess I can hope that's the case.
entries.new: 但愿如此吧。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I'd left my apartment to figure out who 7md_ag was, so I did my best to let go of those worries for the moment and reach my target street.
entries.new: 我出门本是为了查清 7md_ag 是谁，于是暂时放下那些忧虑，朝目标街道走去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Well, it should be this one.
entries.new: ……嗯，应该就是这条了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I took my phone out and looked at its screen.{w} Then, I peered into the distance, toward the tower.
entries.new: 我掏出手机看了看屏幕。{w}随后抬眼望向远处，朝塔的方向。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Yeah, it has to be this street.
entries.new: 没错，一定是这条街。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: The structures around me were slightly taller than in most of Yushibana, and the number of windows showed that they had several floors.
entries.new: 周围的建筑比丰花多数地方都要高些，从窗户的数量看得出都有好几层。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I kept walking to get closer to where I thought the picture had been taken from.
entries.new: 我继续往前走，靠近我推测的拍摄地点。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Hm...{w} Around here?
entries.new: 嗯……{w}就在这附近？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I looked at the building behind me. The picture could've been taken from any of those windows.
entries.new: 我回头打量身后那栋楼。照片可能是从其中任何一扇窗户拍下的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Oh... Is it actually this building?
entries.new: 哦……难道就是这栋楼？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: There was something that made it stand out. Next to the door, there was a sign with three words on it.
entries.new: 有样东西让它格外显眼。门旁挂着一块牌子，上面写着三个词。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: "Apartment for sale".
entries.new: 「公寓出售」。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I guess that doesn't have to mean anything.
entries.new: 不过，这未必说明什么。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: But I frowned a little. While I didn't know which apartment was the one for sale, light could be seen on the other side of the four windows above the door.
entries.new: 我却微微皱起眉。虽然不知道出售的是哪一间，但门上方那四扇窗户后面，都透着灯光。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The entrance was locked, and I couldn't see anyone nearby. Next to the door, below the sign, was a panel with four numbers and four buttons to press.
entries.new: 入口上了锁，附近也看不到人影。门旁牌子下方有一块面板，上面标着四个房号，配着四个按钮。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Should I try to ring the bell...? It could be any of the four.{w} If the person from the forum is someone I know, maybe I could recognize their voice.
entries.new: 要不要按门铃试试……？四户里哪一户都有可能。{w}如果论坛上那个人是我认识的，说不定能听出声音。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I felt pretty hesitant, wondering what to say after ringing.
entries.new: 我有些犹豫，不知道按了门铃后该说什么。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Do I ask for a name and just say that I made a mistake if I don't recognize them? ...What if they live with someone else who answers instead?
entries.new: 先问对方姓名，听不出来就说自己弄错了？……可要是同住的人接了，又该怎么办？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I looked at the sign again.
entries.new: 我又看了一眼那块牌子。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...There's a phone number. Maybe I should call it instead.
entries.new: ……上面有个电话号码。也许我该打电话过去。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Would I be told information about the previous resident...? Could it be that the person I'm looking for decided to move out immediately, afraid of what they thought was a grave mental issue?
entries.new: 对方会告诉我前任住户的信息吗……？会不会我要找的人以为这是严重的精神问题，吓得立刻搬走了？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Given the way their posts had been written, that wasn't unthinkable. Maybe they'd just decided to move somewhere else, and that was why someone still seemed to be living behind every window at that moment.
entries.new: 从他们那些帖子的措辞来看，这倒也不是不可能。也许他们只是决定搬到别处去了——所以此刻每扇窗后，才会让人觉得还有人住着。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Still holding the phone, I pressed the call button and dialed the numbers on the wall.{w} 1989-1815-251...{w=0.6} I started to hear the high-pitched beeps.
entries.new: 我仍拿着手机，按下通话键，拨出墙上写的那串号码。{w} 1989-1815-251……{w=0.6} 听筒里响起尖锐的提示音。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: A little half-hearted, I waited with the phone on my ear.
entries.new: 我有些提不起劲，把手机贴在耳边等着。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Hello?
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: Oh, hey.{w} ...I'm calling for an apartment I see for sale at Ampla.
entries.new: 哦，你好。{w}……我是想问问在 Ampla 看到的那套出售的房子。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Ah, great! You're the first person to be interested, but the interior there is well-maintained, and it's in a very good area. Are you from here?
entries.new: 啊，太好了！你是第一个来问的人。房子里面保养得很好，地段也相当不错。你是本地人吗？
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: ...I am, yes.
entries.new: ……是的，我是。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: That's great.{w} ...Are you perhaps at the address right now?
entries.new: 那太好了。{w}……你现在是不是就在房子那儿？
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: Yes. I'm looking at it.
entries.new: 对，我正看着呢。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: I can see you from my window. Wait a second, I'll come out.
entries.new: 我从窗户就能看见你。稍等一下，我这就出来。
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: O-Oh, all right.
entries.new: 哦、哦，好的。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: He hung up, so I stood still nervously, failing to see anyone behind a window.
entries.new: 他挂了电话，我只好紧张地站在原地，可怎么也看不出哪扇窗后有人影。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I didn't have to wait long for a door farther back to open.{w} A middle-aged man came out and shuffled up to me.
entries.new: 没过多久，靠里的一扇门开了。{w}一个中年男人走出来，拖着步子来到我面前。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Hello! What's your name?
entries.new: 你好！请问怎么称呼？
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: Shiroya.
entries.new: Shiroya。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: I see. Glad to meet you. I'm Cecal Fray.
entries.new: 明白了，幸会。我叫 Cecal Fray。
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: He bowed enthusiastically and turned to the sign.
entries.new: 他热情地鞠了一躬，然后转身走向那块牌子。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It hasn't been up for sale very long, but I'm sure it'll be purchased quickly. Would you like to see the inside? Since you're here, I'm assuming you've not seen the pictures on the website.
entries.new: 房子挂牌出售还没多久，但我相信很快就会有人买下。你想进去看看吗？既然你都到这儿了，我猜你还没看过网站上的照片吧。
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: I haven't, and yeah, I'd like to. Isn't someone currently inside, though? There's light coming from all the windows.
entries.new: 确实没看过，好，我想看看。不过现在里面不是还住着人吗？每扇窗户都透着灯光。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Ah! Yes, you're perceptive. The previous resident is currently preparing to move out. We agreed he could receive visits while he's still here. Don't worry, it'll be vacant quite soon.
entries.new: 啊！你观察得真仔细。之前的住户正在准备搬走。我们说好了，他还住在这里的时候可以接待看房的人。请放心，很快就会空出来。
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: I didn't know what to say, but I couldn't back off.
entries.new: 我不知道该说什么，但也不能就这样退缩。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I'm sorry to ask this, but why is he leaving? Did he have an issue with the apartment?
entries.new: ……不好意思问一句，他为什么要搬走？是这房子有什么问题吗？
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Oh, not at all. Evidently, he wanted to go live with his parents. I've spoken to him personally. He's well-mannered and intelligent, no problems on my end, but it seems he's not well, so he couldn't keep living by himself.
entries.new: 哦，完全没有。听说他想搬去和父母一起住。我亲自跟他谈过，他很有礼貌，人也聪明，我这边没发现任何问题；只是他状态似乎不太好，没法继续独自生活了。
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: ...It is him.
entries.new: ……是他。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I looked up, but I still couldn't see anyone through the glass.
entries.new: 我抬头望去，可隔着玻璃依旧看不见任何人影。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...He's not well? I'm sorry for asking. ...Is he gonna be okay?
entries.new: ……他状态不好？抱歉多问了。……他会没事吧？
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Yes, you shouldn't worry. I'm not sure exactly what the issue is, but he was very recently at his parents' house, preparing to move. He seemed fine to me when we spoke briefly. I didn't want to pry, though.
entries.new: 会的，你不必担心。具体是什么情况我也不太清楚，不过他前不久还去了父母家，为搬家做准备。我们简短交谈时，他看起来一切正常。只是我也不好多问。
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: Ah, I'm glad.
entries.new: 啊，那就好。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: He had two keys on his palm and used one to unlock the entrance.{w} I saw a gray hall with stairs leading up.
entries.new: 他掌心里握着两把钥匙，用其中一把打开了大门。{w}我看见一个灰色的门厅，里面有通往楼上的楼梯。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I think he implied he had some kind of mental disorder, but I'm not really well-informed. He called me in late November saying that someone had broken into his house.
entries.new: 他话里的意思，好像是自己有某种精神方面的疾病，不过我也不太了解详情。十一月下旬他打电话给我，说有人闯进了他家。
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: ...Wait, really? Did they take anything?
entries.new: ……等等，真的？有丢东西吗？
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: No, that's what I'm saying. Soon after, he called again, assuring me that he'd imagined it and not to worry, but that he'd still move out.
entries.new: 没有，我说的就是这个。没过多久他又打来，说那是他自己想多了，让我别担心，但他还是要搬走。
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: I followed him up the stairs with a pensive frown.
entries.new: 我皱着眉，若有所思地跟着他上楼。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: He stopped in front of the first door, which had an "A" above it.{w} Instead of unlocking it himself, he rang the bell.
entries.new: 他在第一扇门前停下，门上标着「A」。{w}他没有自己开锁，而是按响了门铃。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I started to feel nervous. Would the person about to open the door recognize me? ...Would I recognize him?
entries.new: 我开始紧张起来。即将开门的那个人会认出我吗？……我又会认出他吗？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I heard footsteps approaching, and the door jittered. In one motion, I saw the face of the person I'd been searching for.
entries.new: 脚步声由远及近，门轻轻晃了一下。就在那一瞬间，我看清了那张我一直在找的脸。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...No, I don't think I know him.
entries.new: ……不，我应该不认识他。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Ah, good morning.{w} ...Well, I guess it's close to noon already.{w} Are you coming to see my apartment?
entries.new: 啊，早上好。{w}……不过看样子都快中午了。{w}你是来看房的吗？
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: ...Yeah.
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Come in, then. It's a very nice place. I've really enjoyed living here.
entries.new: 那就请进吧。这地方很不错，我一直住得很舒心。
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: I didn't take my eyes off his face, but all I could conclude was that I'd never seen him before. He wore a sympathetic smile, and his voice sounded kind.
entries.new: 我一直盯着他的脸，却只能得出一个结论：我从没见过他。他脸上挂着温和的笑，声音也很亲切。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I stepped in timidly, unaware of where to set my eyes. Following the agent, or landlord, whoever he was, I entered the living room.
entries.new: 我怯生生地走进去，不知该把目光放在哪里。跟着那个中介——也可能是房东，管他是谁——我进了客厅。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The furniture won't be taken away. You'll notice the heating is working just fine, but sunlight makes it inside all day too.{w} You might've noticed that there's no elevator below, but fortunately, you only have to go up a single set of stairs.
entries.new: 家具不会搬走。你也看到了，暖气运行良好，而且一整天都有阳光照进来。{w}你可能已经注意到楼下没有电梯，不过好在只需要爬一层楼梯。
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: ...Yeah. I like it.
entries.new: ……嗯，我喜欢。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: I wasn't necessarily lying. Everything looked clean and neatly arranged.
entries.new: 这话倒也不算违心。屋里的一切都干净整洁，摆放得井井有条。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Great! ...You'll see how spacious the rooms are. There are two of them.
entries.new: 太好了！……你来看看房间有多宽敞。一共有两间。
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: I kept following behind, still thinking about what he'd said in the staircase.
entries.new: 我跟在后面，心里还想着他在楼梯间说过的话。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: He called saying that someone had broken in, but later retracted that.
entries.new: 他打电话说有人闯进他家，后来又把这话收回了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I looked back at the man, who was just tagging along in silence.
entries.new: 我回头看向那个男人，他一言不发地跟在后面。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...He must know what will happen.
entries.new: ……他一定知道会发生什么。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Someone broke into this place a few days ago... He appeared at his parents' house on the 24th, and later on, he replied again from this apartment, when he took that picture.
entries.new: 几天前，有人闯进了这里……他在24号出现在父母家，后来又从这间公寓回了消息——就是拍下那张照片的时候。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Did he break into his own house...? If he appeared at his parents' without the keys, that could have happened. Maybe he did have them and his original self noticed someone had entered.
entries.new: 难道是他闯进了自己家……？如果他没带钥匙就出现在父母家，那倒说得通。又或者他其实带着钥匙，是原来的自己发现有人进来过。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...There are more possible explanations. What if it was the version from the future who noticed his original self when he made it back home and thought he was a thief? ...Then, he figured out what had happened and called to say he'd just imagined it.
entries.new: ……还有其他可能的解释。如果是来自未来的那个他回到家，撞见了原来的自己，还把他当成了小偷呢？……后来他弄清了原委，才打电话说自己看错了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Do you like it?
entries.new: 你觉得如何？
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: He opened the door to a bedroom.
entries.new: 他推开一扇卧室的门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Yeah. That's a big bed.
entries.new: ……嗯。床很大。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: As I said, everything you see is a fixture. It's part of the package.
entries.new: 就像我说的，你看到的家具全都固定在房里，属于配套的一部分。
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: That's good.
entries.new: 那挺好。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: So, if I'm right at all, two versions of him must currently exist. ...Is the one right here the one who traveled from the future? Is it possible they've seen each other? Surely that would be changing the past.
entries.new: 那么，如果我猜得没错，现在一定同时存在两个他。……眼前这个是从未来来的那个吗？他们有没有可能见过面？那肯定就是在改变过去。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...Here's the other room. It's a little smaller, but it can also work as a bedroom if anyone stays over.
entries.new: ……这边是另一个房间。稍微小一点，不过要是有人留宿，也能当卧室用。
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: I see.
entries.new: 原来如此。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: The room was pretty messy, and it stored different kinds of objects and old devices.{w} My attention was quickly directed to a framed picture.
entries.new: 房间里相当杂乱，堆着各式各样的物件和旧设备。{w}我的目光很快被一个相框吸引过去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I leaned forward to take a better look at it. I could see the man who lived in the apartment in front of someone a little older than him.
entries.new: 我凑近了些，想看得更清楚。照片里，住在这间公寓的男人站在一个比他稍年长的人身旁。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...A police uniform.
entries.new: ……警服。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: They were both dressed as police officers, and the background was a simple white wall.
entries.new: 两人都穿着警服，背景只是一面白墙。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: You have the bathroom right here.
entries.new: 浴室在这边。
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: I looked through the door and saw a bathroom similar to mine. The structure of the apartment was similar to my own, but everything felt more taken care of, and the rooms were slightly larger.
entries.new: 我朝门里望去，看见一间和我那里相似的浴室。这间公寓的格局与我那间相仿，但处处更显用心，房间也稍大一些。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: When we'd seen all of them, we ended up at the front door.
entries.new: 看完全部房间，我们回到了玄关。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I know we haven't spoken about price—I can be a bit flexible. Right now, the set price is ¥42,000 a month, but you'll need to make an initial deposit of ¥126,000.{w} How does that sound?
entries.new: 我知道我们还没谈过价钱——这方面我可以稍微通融。目前的定价是每月 ¥42,000，不过首次需要缴纳 ¥126,000 的押金。{w}你觉得怎么样？
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: If only. ...Maybe after I win the lottery.
entries.new: 哪有这个闲钱。……大概得等我中了彩票才行。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Hm... I certainly liked this place. It's a big decision, though...{w} I'll have to think about it.
entries.new: 嗯……我确实挺喜欢这里。不过这是个大决定……{w}我得再考虑考虑。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: ...Of course. Keep in mind more people are likely to be interested.
entries.new: ……当然。不过还请留意，对这房子感兴趣的人恐怕不少。
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: I know. I'll try to make up my mind quickly and call you. I've got your number saved now.
entries.new: 我知道。我会尽快做决定，然后给你打电话。你的号码我已经存好了。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: All right. I'll await your call, Shiroya. It was a pleasure.
entries.new: 好的。那我就等你的电话了，Shiroya。今天很荣幸。
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: ...Likewise.
entries.new: ……我也是。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: I was about to bow, but the wide eyes of the man holding the door froze me before I could.
entries.new: 我正要鞠躬，可一看到扶门男人睁大的双眼，我僵住了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Also frozen, the man's eyes pierced mine until I forcibly ripped my gaze away and completed the bow.
entries.new: 那男人也同样僵着，目光直直地刺向我。我硬生生移开视线，才把躬鞠完。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Did he react to my name?
entries.new: ……他是对我的名字起了反应吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: G-Goodbye.
entries.new: 再、再见。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Goodbye. I hope to see you again.
entries.new: 再见。希望能再见到你。
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: The other man wasn't saying anything, so I slowly stepped away, unsure whether that look had been a reaction to my name or if he'd had it from the beginning. It seemed both of them would stay there, so I left by myself.
entries.new: 另一个男人始终没有开口，我便慢慢退开。那眼神究竟是因我的名字而起，还是从一开始就是那样，我无从判断。看样子两人都会留在原处，我便独自离开了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: As soon as I turned around, I was met with the same sensation.{w} The door to the outside closed, and I saw a man walking up the stairs. The look he gave muddled my mind, instantly making me doubt everything I'd just determined.
entries.new: 刚一转身，同样的感觉又袭了上来。{w}通往外面的门关上，我看见一个男人正走上楼梯。他投来的目光搅乱了我的心绪，让我瞬间怀疑起刚才得出的所有结论。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It was the very same look as the other man's, down to the piercing pause.{w} When time continued, he stepped up and unlocked the opposite door, quietly shutting it behind him without saying a word.
entries.new: 那眼神和另一个男人如出一辙，连那令人窒息的停顿都分毫不差。{w}时间重新流动，他走上楼梯，打开对面那扇门的锁，一言不发地轻轻带上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...What the hell? What was that?
entries.new: ……搞什么？那到底是怎么回事？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: He'd been skinny and a little older, but I hadn't recognized him either, so I simply stood still, wondering which of those two stares had been given by 7md_ag.
entries.new: 他身形瘦削，年纪稍长，可我也认不出他是谁，只能干站着，心里琢磨那两道目光里究竟哪一道来自 7md_ag。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Was it just that he was surprised to see someone he'd never seen in this building?
entries.new: ……难道只是因为在这栋楼里见到从未见过的生面孔，感到意外而已？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Had I only overreacted internally? It had seemed bizarre to me, but maybe I'd just misinterpreted the second look due to seeing it immediately after the first.
entries.new: 难道只是我自己在心里反应过度？我觉得那眼神很古怪，但也许只是因为刚看过第一道目光，才误读了第二道。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I went down the stairs and opened the door in a haze of confusion.
entries.new: ……我混混沌沌地下了楼，推开门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Outside, I merely stood still, trying to sort out my thoughts.
entries.new: 到了外面，我只是站着不动，试图理清思绪。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The first man must be the forum poster. What I was told about him fits perfectly.
entries.new: 第一个男人一定就是论坛上发帖的那个人。我听到的关于他的描述完全吻合。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I walked away, intending to take the second stare out of my mind and telling myself that I'd really overreacted to it.
entries.new: 我迈步离开，想把第二道目光从脑中抹去，并告诉自己确实是反应过度了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I guess it doesn't really matter. It was one of them for sure, and I didn't recognize either of them.
entries.new: ……算了，这大概无关紧要。那人肯定是他们两个之一，而我谁都没认出来。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It's much more likely it was the first guy because of that framed picture. He was one of the police officers outside the tower, so I was right. He was suddenly picked up by a travel that was activated within the building.
entries.new: 从那张带相框的照片来看，多半是第一个男人。他就是塔外那些警察中的一个，所以我没猜错。他是被楼内启动的一次穿越突然带走的。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...But he is a policeman. Is he not going to try to prevent the attack from happening somehow? If he made that call saying there was no actual burglar, he must understand enough of what happened to him. He has to know he's in the past.
entries.new: ……可他毕竟是警察。难道他不打算设法阻止那场袭击吗？既然他打电话说并没有真正的入侵者，那他对发生在自己身上的事，应该已经明白得够多了。他一定知道自己身处过去。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Lost in thought, I arrived at Ramon.{w} In contrast to the early morning, the street was fairly busy, partially thanks to the good weather. I recognized a group of kids years younger than me, so I avoided even looking at them.
entries.new: 我一路沉思，不觉已到了拉蒙街。{w}与清晨不同，这条街相当热闹，多半是天气晴好的缘故。我认出几个比我小上好几岁的孩子，索性连看都不往那边看。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: And like I thought, two versions of him must currently exist. I can't be sure I just talked to the one aware of the incident.
entries.new: 而且正如我所料，此刻世上必定存在两个他。我刚说过话的那一位，未必就是知道那起事件的人。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: But the stare stuck in my mind strongly implied he was.
entries.new: 但那个留在我记忆里的眼神，分明在说：他就是。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I wondered whether to go home. I'd accomplished my goal, even though I couldn't draw much from it. I hadn't recognized the person known as 7md_ag, but I felt confident that the solution to the forum thread was a police officer who'd traveled through time.
entries.new: 我犹豫着要不要回家。目的算是达成了，收获却寥寥无几。我并没有认出那个叫 7md_ag 的人，但我确信，论坛那帖的答案就是一名穿越了时间的警察。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Maybe I should've tried to talk to him. ...But I doubt he would tell me anything new, and I'd very much rather not say what I'm doing here.
entries.new: 或许我该试着跟他搭话……不过他恐怕也说不出什么新东西，而我实在不愿解释自己为何会在这里。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: With that out of the way, I was forced to go back to my previous thoughts. What could I do about the person who'd probably traveled with him to the prison cell?
entries.new: 这件事暂且了结，我又不得不回到先前的思虑上。那个很可能与他一同穿越到牢房的人，我究竟该如何应对？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I wandered around slowly, hoping something would come to mind.{w} ...Knowing that the future I was envisioning could have been destroyed at any moment caused a hollow anxiety to form in my chest. It was the same one I'd felt after Miiya died.
entries.new: 我缓缓地四处闲逛，盼着能想到些什么。{w}……一想到自己所设想的未来随时可能被摧毁，胸口便涌起一阵空洞的不安。那感觉，和 Miiya 死后我曾有过的一模一样。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: At least I was pretty sure that I was in the best place to sort it all out. Not inside an oppressive, enclosed building, but free in Yushibana.
entries.new: 至少我相当确定，这里才是理清一切的最佳地点。不是在那座压抑封闭的楼里，而是在自由自在的丰花。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: When I thought about it more, it was almost worse, in a way. Miiya had died instantly, and I'd been forced to confront that reality instantly. Similarly, in Ashiya Tower, the attack had been instant and all the consequences of it had been fairly quick to follow.
entries.new: 再细想下去，换个角度看，这反而更糟。Miiya 死得猝然，我也被迫当场面对那一切。芦屋塔里的袭击同样发生在一瞬之间，其后果也紧随其后，来得极快。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But what I was doing then, walking around town and slowly gathering information... was not the same. If I didn't save Miiya through my actions, all I was really doing was letting things slowly play out, gradually getting worse.
entries.new: 可我现在做的——在镇上四处走动、慢慢搜集情报——却全然不同。若不能靠自己的行动救下 Miiya，我实际做的只是任事情缓缓演变，一点点地坏下去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Distracting myself from that was the best I could do in the meantime, while I decided whether taking action was really the wisest thing to do. I buried that creeping dread as deep as I could and returned to thinking about the man in the apartment.
entries.new: 在我权衡究竟是否该出手之前，能做的也只有借此分神。我把那份悄然蔓延的恐惧尽量深埋，转而又去想公寓里的那个男人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The thread had said that he'd appeared at his parents' house on the 24th. I found myself going back to that.
entries.new: 帖子里说，他是在24号出现在父母家的。我的思绪又绕回了这一点。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: And his parents said that he shouldn't have been there. That contradicts what I thought yesterday regarding my own travel.
entries.new: 而他父母说，他本不该出现在那里。这与我昨天对自己那次穿越的推测相矛盾。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I thought that on the 30th, I appeared underground at {time=21:10} where I'd been only minutes prior. Plenty of travels that happened in the tower can fit that idea, but there were already some that didn't, and neither does this one.
entries.new: 我原以为，30号那天我在{time=21:10}出现在地下，而那正是我几分钟前待过的地方。塔里发生的许多次穿越都能套用这个说法，但已经有些不符，这一例同样不符。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: If his parents said that he shouldn't have been there on the 24th, it can't be that it was a coordinate mere minutes away from the point he appeared.{w} But of course, his parents' house isn't a random position. It definitely had to have been based on one from his past.
entries.new: 既然他父母说他24号本不该在那里，那就不可能是他出现之处几分钟前所在的坐标。{w}不过话说回来，他父母家也并非随意选定的位置。那必定取自他过去的某个地点。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Admittedly, thinking about that was frustrating. I'd gone over similar thoughts so many times, but it didn't seem like reaching a conclusion was feasible, and especially not when I couldn't know if the Sekimeiya was consistent.
entries.new: 平心而论，想这些只会令人烦躁。类似的念头我已反复琢磨过许多遍，却似乎根本得不出结论，何况我连 Sekimeiya 是否自洽都无从知晓。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Orbit Crash
entries.new: 轨道崩毁

entries.text: Wh-What...?
entries.new: 什、什么……？
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: I stopped myself in the middle of the street.
entries.new: 我在街心停下了脚步。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Ahead of me, I saw something I recognized.{w} The very same stare I'd just been given.
entries.new: 前方，我看见了似曾相识的一幕。{w}正是方才落在我身上的那种眼神。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Someone else who I didn't recognize had suddenly looked at me like that, but when I noticed it, they were looking somewhere else.
entries.new: ……又一个素不相识的人忽然那样看向我，可等我察觉时，对方已把目光移向别处。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Am I just imagining it? Am I just paranoid after the first time?
entries.new: ……是我多心了吗？还是刚才那一次让我神经过敏了？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I spun around me, and after a full circle, my heart hammered once.{w} All around, I'd seen people fixing their eyes on me.
entries.new: 我原地转了一圈，整整一圈之后，心脏猛地一跳。{w}四周的人，全都直勾勾地盯着我。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I spun once again, more slowly.
entries.new: 我又转了一圈，这一次慢了许多。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Afterward, I closed my eyes. I hadn't seen a single person looking at me the second time.
entries.new: 随后我闭上眼。第二次转身时，我没有看见任何人在看我。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I have to be making it up.
entries.new: 一定是我自己瞎想的。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: The thin white trees came back to me, but I was slightly dizzy. I surveyed my surroundings again, and everyone was only looking straight ahead as they walked across the ground.
entries.new: 细白的树影又浮现在眼前，我却有些眩晕。我重新环视四周，行人都只是目视前方，走在地上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It couldn't be that they know I should be in the hospital, right?
entries.new: 总不会是他们知道我现在该待在医院里吧？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: That thought made me feel a little uncomfortable, so I stepped away.
entries.new: 这念头让我有些不安，我便迈步走开。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It's gotta be just me. Nobody's looking now. ...Even if that was the case, it shouldn't matter.
entries.new: 肯定只是我多心。现在根本没人在看。……就算真是那样，也不该有什么关系。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: But it still made me uneasy, so I walked toward a narrower branching street which was much less crowded.
entries.new: 可我还是觉得不自在，便朝一条狭窄的岔路走去，那里人要少得多。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I advanced without thinking about where I was going. Eventually, I turned around and still saw no one looking back at me.
entries.new: 我也不去想方向，只管往前走。到最后回头一看，依旧没有人看我。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'm going the wrong way if I want to go home, though.
entries.new: 不过，要回家的话，我这方向可走反了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I moved to the end of the street. There, the atmosphere was completely calm, similar to how things had been that morning.{w} Slightly ahead of me was the school I'd always gone to, in front of the end of the mountain range.
entries.new: 我走到街的尽头。那里气氛一片宁静，与今早的情形颇为相似。{w}前方不远处，就是我读了多年的学校，坐落在山脉尽头的跟前。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I kept moving forward, accepting my own improvised detour.
entries.new: 我接受了这临时起意的绕路，继续向前。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Past the corner, I saw a green bus I hadn't noticed beforehand. Making no noise, it crossed my view and disappeared as it curved away.
entries.new: 转过街角，我看见一辆先前没留意到的绿色巴士。它悄无声息地驶过我的视野，拐了个弯便消失了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It wasn't common to see a bus like that in Yushibana. Since it had been green, I knew it had come from outside the town. There were local buses as well, but they were blue and took very few paths.
entries.new: 在丰花，这样的巴士并不常见。既然是绿色的，我就知道它是从镇外开来的。本地也有巴士，不过是蓝色的，而且线路极少。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I crossed the road, stepping on the recent wet tracks.
entries.new: 我横穿马路，脚下踏过刚留下的湿漉车辙。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I shortly arrived at the entrance to my school. The tunnel I'd come out of two days earlier was very close by.
entries.new: 不多时，我便到了学校门口。两天前我走出来的那条隧道就在近旁。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: And of course, Seeuta D'ella Park too. Like every year, it would spend a few months covered by snow.
entries.new: 当然，还有 Seeuta D'ella 公园。和往年一样，它会有好几个月被积雪覆盖。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Without a clear purpose in mind, I strolled over to it, surrounded by pure silence.
entries.new: 我没什么明确的目的，就这样信步走了过去，四周一片寂静。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I could see people in the distance, too tiny to recognize.{w} I'd pretty much circled around Yushibana, and it was fairly smaller than the perception of it I'd always had.
entries.new: 远处能望见人影，小得辨不清面容。{w}我几乎绕着丰花走了一圈，它比我向来以为的要小上不少。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I could make it home without crossing the center again, so I headed toward the path I'd often taken after classes.{w} However, I abruptly forced my legs to stop.
entries.new: 不必再穿过镇中心也能到家，于是我走向放学后常走的那条路。{w}然而，我猛地停下脚步。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Am I just stressed out?
entries.new: ……只是我太紧张了吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I kept walking, shrugging off whatever was up with me.{w} But I soon had to stop again.
entries.new: 我甩开心里那点莫名的异样，继续走着。{w}可没过多久，又不得不停下。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Perhaps I'd sharpened my senses during the hours I'd spent on edge in the tower.
entries.new: ……也许，是在塔里提心吊胆的那几个小时，把我的感官磨得过于敏锐了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Nobody seemed to be behind me, but something inside me told me otherwise.{w} The first time, I'd turned around after stopping and hadn't seen anyone. The second, I hadn't sensed anything, but I wanted to make sure.
entries.new: 身后似乎没有人，可我心底有种感觉，告诉我并非如此。{w}第一次，我停下脚步回头，谁也没看见。第二次，我什么都没察觉到，却还是想确认一下。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Have I hit the point of thinking that I'm being followed? ...I should just make it home.
entries.new: 我已经疑心到自己被人跟踪的地步了吗？……总之，先回家吧。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I continued walking around the rim of Yushibana, slightly on alert.
entries.new: 我沿着丰花外围继续走着，多少留了几分警惕。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The sound of my footsteps was all I picked up. I looked at the sky and noticed the dense white clouds.
entries.new: 耳边只听得见自己的脚步声。我抬头看天，望见层层叠叠的白云。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...In the park, I'd felt like there was movement behind me as soon as I'd started to walk. With how likely it was that I'd been mistaken, I was sure I was more nervous than I thought.
entries.new: ……在公园时，我刚迈开步子，便感觉身后有动静。那多半是我多心，可我还是确信，自己远比想象中紧张。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The third time I stopped myself, I didn't just look back.
entries.new: 第三次停下脚步时，我不只是回头看了一眼。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I turned around and ran toward the way I'd come.
entries.new: 我转过身，朝来时的方向跑去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I didn't immediately see anyone. Seconds later, I'd covered quite a bit of distance, and nobody had come into view yet.
entries.new: 我没有立刻看见任何人。几秒过去，我已跑出好一段路，视野里却依旧没有人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But when I looked down, my heart sank like a stone.
entries.new: 可低头一看，我的心顿时沉了下去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Footprints.{w} They weren't mine, and I hadn't seen them seconds earlier. They came from the park hugging the edge and then disappeared toward faraway trees.
entries.new: 脚印。{w}那不是我留下的，几秒前我也根本没看见。它们是从紧挨着边缘的公园那头延伸过来的，随后消失在远处的树丛间。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Was I not imagining anything? Am I actually being followed...?
entries.new: ……难道这一切都不是我的错觉？我真的被人跟踪了……？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: The footprints were too big to be my own, and I noticed a detail that reinforced my fear.
entries.new: 那些脚印太大，不可能是我的。我还注意到一个细节，让恐惧又加深了一层。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: As soon as they turned toward the trees, the distance between each step increased.
entries.new: 它们一转向树丛方向，每一步的间距就变大了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Did they run away the moment I looked back?
entries.new: ……难道是在我回头的那一刻逃走的？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It had become more than just paranoia. I turned around to my previous path and sped up considerably.
entries.new: 这已经不只是我多心了。我转回原来的方向，明显加快了脚步。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Who would follow me, though? Is it someone else who traveled to the past?
entries.new: ……可是谁会跟踪我呢？难道是另一个时间穿越者？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I couldn't think of many possibilities. I knew the past wasn't guaranteed to repeat, but even if someone who knew me had seen me, they wouldn't have run away as soon as I'd noticed them.
entries.new: 我想不出多少可能。我知道过去未必会重演，可就算认识我的人看见了我，也不会在我一察觉时就立刻逃走。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The path was mostly straight until my apartment. It wasn't too cold, so I didn't slow down.{w} On the way, I crossed paths with a neighbor of mine. Naturally, her footprints didn't match the ones I'd seen...
entries.new: 回公寓的路大半笔直。天不算太冷，我也就没有放慢脚步。{w}路上，我遇见了住在附近的邻居。她的脚印自然和我看见的那些对不上……
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I slowed down when I got to the metallic staircase and unlocked my door. I glanced all around me before opening it, and I didn't see anyone.
entries.new: 走到金属楼梯前，我放慢脚步，打开门锁。开门前，我环顾四周，一个人也没看见。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I panted for a bit, the comforting warmth helping me to calm down. After some time, I shrugged off my coat and boots.
entries.new: 我喘了一阵，屋里的暖意让我慢慢平静下来。过了一会儿，我脱下外套和靴子。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I really didn't like having to feel wary even in my apartment, but I couldn't shake it.
entries.new: 我很不喜欢连在公寓里都得提心吊胆，可这种感觉怎么也甩不掉。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Was it possible I was mistaken? I couldn't really put into words why I'd felt someone had been behind me, so I tried to believe that I'd made it all up.
entries.new: 会不会是我弄错了？我说不清自己为什么觉得身后有人，只好试着相信这一切都是我的错觉。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The ground had been covered in footprints. Even if the ones I'd seen had looked more recent than the others, that didn't prove anything.
entries.new: 地上满是脚印。即使我看见的那串看起来比别的更新，也证明不了什么。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Why would anyone follow me?{w} To confirm that it was me because I should be in the hospital? ...It wouldn't be to hurt me, right?{w} ...If it was someone from Xyn who traveled to the past, would I actually be seen as a threat to them? If they know I should be in the hospital, they could figure out that there are two of me and I came from the future.
entries.new: ……为什么会有人跟踪我？{w}是因为我本该待在医院，所以来确认我的身份？……应该不会是来伤害我的吧？{w}……如果对方是来自 Xyn 的时间穿越者，我会被他们当成威胁吗？只要他们知道我本该住院，就能推断出有两个我，而且我是从未来来的。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I had a building headache, and I'd been sweating profusely for a while. I thought about turning off the heater, but I chose to try loosening up instead.
entries.new: 我的头痛越来越重，也已经出了一阵子汗。我想过关掉暖气，但最后还是决定先放松一下。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I went to the kitchen. If I could eat something, that'd give me something to do and allow me to trust my own judgment a bit more.
entries.new: 我走进厨房。吃些东西的话，既能有点事做，也能让我更相信自己的判断。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I took the prepped meat from the fridge. I didn't have a microwave, so I still had to use the stove. The frying pan was dirty from the last time, so I listlessly poured dish soap on a sponge and scrubbed the pan before rinsing it.
entries.new: 我从冰箱里取出备好的肉。家里没有微波炉，只能用炉灶。平底锅上次用完还没洗，我无精打采地往海绵上挤了些洗洁精，把锅刷干净，再冲了冲。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I dried it with a hanging towel and put it on the burner with the food.{w} I knew not to turn the intensity all the way up or it would burn easily. I stood in front of the pan, focusing only on evenly heating the meat.
entries.new: ……我用挂着的毛巾把锅擦干，放到炉灶上，再放入肉。{w}我知道火不能开到最大，否则很容易烧焦。我站在锅前，只专心把肉均匀加热。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Seconds later, I turned it around with a knife and waited a bit longer for it to be done.
entries.new: 几秒后，我用刀把它翻了个面，又等了一会儿，好让它熟透。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Only one bowl was still clean, so I used it to bring the food to the living room.
entries.new: 只剩一个碗还干净，我就用它把食物端到了客厅。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The pieces were small, so I didn't have to cut them. I quickly brought one into my mouth.
entries.new: 肉块很小，不用再切。我很快夹了一块送进嘴里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...The inside's still a little cold, but the taste isn't bad. Unfortunately, I probably have no future as a fry cook.
entries.new: ……里面还有点凉，不过味道不坏。只可惜，我大概没有当煎肉厨师的前途。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Well, actually, maybe that's fortunate...?
entries.new: 不过，真要说起来，说不定这也算件好事……？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...{w}I should just try not to think about it too much. Even if I was being followed, what's most important is still that the Sekimeiya could be taken before the 15th.
entries.new: ……{w}还是别想太多了。就算真有人跟踪我，最重要的仍然是 Sekimeiya 可能会在 15号之前被夺走。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...And if I try to enter the tower during the night and I'm caught before I can trigger the alarm, it could all fail.{w} My main two worries are not knowing where the Sekimeiya is and not knowing how to travel a lot of days back in time.
entries.new: ……再说，要是我夜里进塔，还没触发警报就被抓住，一切就可能全盘失败。{w}我最担心的两点，一是不知道 Sekimeiya 在哪里，二是不知道怎么回到许多天之前。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I could go to the tower during the day and try to find the cabinet. If it's there, I know the mechanism behind the alarm will already be working, so I could try to consciously change the past the following night by entering the tower and forcing the cabinet open. I suppose it's possible it already is in the event room if nobody's allowed in for now.{w} There wasn't a camera in the storeroom, so maybe I could see if the handle of the hidden door is still there and if it really leads outside.{w} Using that hidden section is my best bet to make it to the tower during the night. I could either try to enter it from the outside or wait behind the movable wall during the day, where I won't be found before the tower closes.
entries.new: 我可以白天先去塔里，试着找到展示柜。如果它还在，我就知道警报背后的机关已经启动了，那么第二天夜里，我就能有意识地改变过去——进塔，强行撬开展示柜。既然现在不许人进入，展示柜也可能已经被移到活动室了。{w}储藏室里没有摄像头，所以我可以去看看暗门的把手还在不在，以及那扇门是否真的通向外面。{w}我要进塔，最靠谱的办法就是利用那个隐蔽区域。要么从外面设法进去，要么白天躲在可移动墙壁后面——这样在塔关闭之前，不会有人发现我。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: So, the other issue is the truly concerning one.
entries.new: 那么，另一个问题才是真正让人担心的。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I would break open the cabinet and activate the alarm. That would lock me in the tower with the person in the security room.
entries.new: 我会撬开展示柜，触发警报。这样一来，我就会和监控室里的人一起被困在塔里。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: However, even though we had to spend twelve hours inside, that wouldn't necessarily repeat. They explained to us that there was a way to open the exit before the maximum time. Both the security member and Ashiya can work together to remove the shutter.
entries.new: 不过，就算我们必须在里面待满十二个小时，那种情况也未必会重演。他们跟我们解释过，在达到最长时间之前，有办法打开出口。监控室的人和芦屋可以合力拆下卷帘门。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: On the 15th, this system didn't appear to be working for either of them... I can't be sure the same will happen before that day, though. What if interfering with the mechanism was part of the attack? If so, it's very possible it'll still work properly before the 15th.
entries.new: 15号那天，这套系统对他们两人似乎都没有起作用……可我无法确定在那天之前是否也会如此。万一干扰机关本就是袭击的一环呢？若真是这样，15号之前它很可能还能正常运作。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I can't assume I'll have half a day to experiment with the Sekimeiya. To avoid being seen through the cameras, I could go to a place without them. The attic would be locked, so there wouldn't be many options.
entries.new: 我不能指望自己能有半天时间拿 Sekimeiya 做试验。为了避开摄像头，我可以去没有摄像头的地方。阁楼应该锁着，能选的地方并不多。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: There, assuming the person in the security room doesn't leave, I could try to mess with the Sekimeiya. Maybe I'll touch it and appear somewhere that's being recorded, though.{w} If that's seen from the security room and I don't reply to whatever I'm told by the guard, it's incredibly likely they'll go ahead and unlock the exit.
entries.new: 在那里，只要监控室里的人不离开，我就能试着摆弄 Sekimeiya。不过，也许我一碰它，就会出现在有摄像头拍摄的地方。{w}如果监控室看见了这一幕，而我又对守卫的话毫无回应，他们极有可能直接去解锁出口。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I kept eating the last slices.
entries.new: 我继续吃着剩下的几片。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Even though the handle of the hidden door was removed, since the door had two holes, we were able to deduce that the handle used to have a keyhole. So even if the handle is still there, I'll probably need the key in order to open it.
entries.new: ……虽然暗门的把手被拆掉了，但门上留有两个孔，我们因此推断那个把手原本带有一个钥匙孔。所以，就算把手还在，我大概也得有钥匙才能打开门。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: But if I see that I can open the door, it's possible I'll have a good way out.{w} During the night, I could enter the tower through that door and quickly go to the Sekimeiya cabinet to trigger the alarm. Then, as soon as possible, I could leave with the Sekimeiya through the storeroom.
entries.new: 但如果我确认自己能打开那扇门，说不定就有了一条很好的退路。{w}夜里，我可以从那扇门进塔，迅速赶到放 Sekimeiya 的展示柜前触发警报。然后，尽快带着 Sekimeiya 从储藏室离开。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: If nobody's watching that side of the building and I hide my face from the cameras, I could bring it home and experiment with it here...
entries.new: 如果大楼那一侧没有人盯着，而我也能不让摄像头拍到脸，我就能把它带回家，在这里慢慢试验……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: This doesn't sound like it has drawbacks, and it only requires that the storeroom door actually leads outside and that I can open it.
entries.new: 听起来没什么坏处，只要储藏室那扇门确实通向外面，而且我能打开它就行。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...{w}But did that bring serious risks? Even if I was later found outside, I could touch the Sekimeiya and go to the past before my identity was given away. Although I would lose the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: ……{w}可这样做真就没有严重风险吗？就算之后在外面被人发现，我也能赶在身份暴露之前碰到 Sekimeiya，回到过去。代价是会失去 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Why does the hidden area in the storeroom even exist? It's possible Katei lied when he said he didn't know about it. If Ashiya were completely aware of it, there's no way they'll allow it to be opened.
entries.new: 储藏室里为什么会有那样一块隐蔽区域？Katei 说自己不知道，也许是在撒谎。要是芦屋那边完全知情，他们绝不可能允许那地方被打开。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Wait...{w} there might be a way to solve the problem of not being able to figure out why I went so many days to the past.
entries.new: 等等……{w}我一直想不通自己为什么会回到那么多天前，可这个问题或许有办法解决。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It makes sense that the time the Sekimeiya spent out of the cabinet was a factor to determine the time traveled, even if there's more to it. After all the time I spent in the tower, what I can be almost certain of is that one minute stored comes out to more than one minute traveled.
entries.new: 决定穿越时间长短的因素里，Sekimeiya 离开展示柜的时长应该算一项，哪怕还有其他条件。在塔里待了这么久，我几乎可以肯定：蓄能一分钟，换来的穿越时间不止一分钟。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: If I can't open the storeroom door, I could still make it inside the tower during the night if I wait in the section past the movable wall, assuming someone else who knows about it doesn't check it.{w} After that, I could activate the alarm and leave the Sekimeiya out of its cabinet for a really long time.
entries.new: 要是打不开储藏室的门，我也能趁夜里留在塔内——只要躲在活动墙后面的那块区域，而且知道那里的人不会过来查看。{w}之后触发警报，让 Sekimeiya 长时间留在展示柜外就行了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: How would I prevent the exit from opening early? I'd be talked to from the security room, so maybe I could reply and act as if I really am from Xyn.{w} Could I try to negotiate for hours or somehow convince them not to open the exit prematurely?
entries.new: 怎么才能阻止出口被人提前打开？监控室那边一定会跟我通话，我或许可以答话，装成 Xyn 的人。{w}能不能设法拖上几个小时，或者想办法说服他们不要提前开门？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: If I could think of something to say so that they keep me there, I could be in hallway A all the time.{w} Assuming twelve hours pass, I could run to touch the Sekimeiya just before the deadline. And if at least one stored minute means two minutes traveled, I would go 24 hours into the past. As long as I can make it to the previous night, to a time before the tower is open to the public, I could change the past and repeat the process.{w} I could progressively go days back without understanding how to travel such a long distance at once.
entries.new: 只要能想出说辞把他们拖住，我就能一直待在 A走廊。{w}等十二个小时过去，赶在时限前跑回去碰 Sekimeiya。如果蓄能一分钟至少能穿越两分钟，我就能回到二十四小时之前。只要回到前一晚、回到塔还没对外开放的时刻，我就能改变过去，再把这套流程重来一遍。{w}这样一天天往回退，哪怕我始终不明白怎样才能一次穿越那么长的距离。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: While I considered my options further, I went to the kitchen and left the bowl in the sink.
entries.new: 我一边继续盘算着各种办法，一边走进厨房，把碗搁进水池。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Is this a good idea? I'm not sure I could pull it off.
entries.new: ……这办法真行得通吗？我没把握能做成。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: There are issues too. The person in the security room could see that the Sekimeiya's outside the cabinet and demand that I put it back, knowing that the refrigeration is essential to keep it safe.{w} And if one minute stored doesn't come out to two or more minutes traveled, I could appear during daytime, so I couldn't repeat the process until the same night I started from in the first place.
entries.new: 问题也不少。监控室的人一看到 Sekimeiya 不在展示柜里，就会明白制冷对它有多要紧，然后要我把东西放回去。{w}而且，万一蓄能一分钟换不来两分钟以上的穿越时间，我就会出现在白天，那样非得等到与出发时同样的夜晚，才能再走一遍流程。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...{w}What would even happen if I went back to the 30th and could save Miiya? Where would I stay?
entries.new: ……{w}就算我真回到 30 号、救下了 Miiya，之后又会怎样？我住哪儿？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Since the past would greatly change, the current version of me who traveled from the 15th would very likely be overwritten.{w} Even if my original self still goes to the hospital on the 30th, that me wouldn't go to live with Atsuki, so I'd instantly have to figure out what to do in a world with two versions of myself.
entries.new: 过去被大幅改写，从 15 号穿越而来的这个我，多半会被覆盖掉。{w}即便原本的我在 30 号仍会去医院，那个我也不会再去和 Atsuki 同住，于是我立刻就得在这有两个我的世界里想好该怎么办。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: That aspect of the loose plan I had still brought me nothing but regret. As much as it was undeniable that saving Miiya would be the ideal outcome, it really wouldn't mean that to me. I was the one whose entire existence would be like a foreign body.
entries.new: 这个尚不成形的计划，光是想到这一层，就让我只剩下悔意。救下 Miiya 固然是无可否认的最好结局，可对我而言并不是。要被当成异物排挤的，是我这整个存在。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Oh, I don't actually think this can work.{w} If the Sekimeiya really was in that shop on the 30th, as long as it wasn't immediately brought to the tower, there could be a point where I couldn't keep progressively going one day back at a time. There'd eventually be no Sekimeiya in the tower to travel with.
entries.new: ……唔，这办法恐怕行不通。{w}如果 30 号那天 Sekimeiya 确实还在那家店里，只要它没被立刻送进塔里，早晚有一天我会退到无处可退——塔里根本没有 Sekimeiya 可供穿越。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: And there's something else... I only thought of this idea assuming I can't open the storeroom door or that it doesn't lead outside. If I wanted to trap myself during the night, I would need to enter the tower before it closes and wait in the hidden segment of the storeroom.
entries.new: 还有一点……我这个主意，是建立在打不开储藏室的门、或者那扇门不通向外面这一前提上的。要想夜里把自己关在塔里，我得赶在闭馆前进去，躲在储藏室那块隐蔽区域里等着。
entries.speaker: nm
