entries.text: If I can only go one day back at a time, I'll eventually reach Sunday, when the tower is closed and I can't get in. The last possible night where I could do this would be Monday—tonight.{w} ...So Miiya died on a Saturday, and I can't save her if I don't figure out why I went so far back.
entries.new: 一次只能往回退一天的话，迟早会退到星期日——那天塔闭馆，我根本进不去。能动手的最后一晚就是星期一，也就是今晚。{w}……也就是说，Miiya 死在星期六，而我要是弄不清自己为什么回到那么久以前，就救不了她。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: In the end, no matter how much I thought in the living room of my house, I had to go to the tower.{w} During the day, I had to try to find the Sekimeiya and check the status of the storeroom door so that I could determine the best course of action.
entries.new: 说到底，我坐在自家客厅里想得再多，也还是得去一趟塔。{w}白天我必须设法找到 Sekimeiya，再看看储藏室那扇门的情况，才能定下最妥当的做法。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I rested my head on one of the pillows. After recalling the footprints in the snow, I felt reluctant to leave my apartment again.
entries.new: 我把头靠在枕头上。想起雪地里的那些脚印，我又不愿再走出这间公寓了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I would leave, just not immediately... I closed my eyes, overwhelmed by all the doubts I had.
entries.new: 要走，但不是现在……我闭上眼睛，满腹疑虑压得我喘不过气。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: *sigh*
entries.new: *叹气*
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: I stood up and turned off the lights.
entries.new: 我站起身，把灯关了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I heard a faint sound.{w} After suddenly raising my head, I noticed it was coming from next to me.
entries.new: 我听见一点细微的声响。{w}猛地抬起头，才发现声音来自旁边。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I reached for my purse and took my phone out.
entries.new: 我伸手去摸手提包，把手机取了出来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The number calling me was displayed on the back screen. I read it a couple times, wondering if I recognized it.
entries.new: 来电号码显示在背面小屏上。我看了好几遍，想着自己是否认得这个号码。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I don't think I've ever been called by this number.
entries.new: 这个号码应该没给我打过电话。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Since there was no name below it, it wasn't on my contacts list.
entries.new: 号码下面没有名字，说明它不在我的通讯录里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It's also not the number I just called earlier.
entries.new: 也不是我刚才打出去的那个号码。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: They hadn't hung up yet, so I debated what to do.
entries.new: 对方还没挂断，我一时拿不定主意。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Should I pick up? It doesn't seem like anyone has in the hospital.
entries.new: ……要接吗？医院那边好像一直没人接。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It was rare for me to receive a strange call. Given my situation, I hesitantly pressed the "accept" button.
entries.new: 我很少接到陌生来电。眼下这情形，我还是迟疑着按下了「接听」。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Hello?
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: O-Oh, you picked up. Good.{w} Hey there.
entries.new: 啊……你接了，太好了。{w}那个，你好。
entries.speaker: q

entries.text: I frowned, unable to recognize the relieved-sounding voice.
entries.new: 那声音听着像是松了口气，我却听不出是谁，皱起了眉。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Are you Shiroya...?
entries.new: 请问是 Shiroya……吗？
entries.speaker: q

entries.text: Huh? Yes. ...Who are you?
entries.new: 嗯？是我。……请问你是哪位？
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: You were at my place earlier, remember? My name's Vaisude.
entries.new: 你之前来过我那儿，还记得吗？我叫 Vaisude。
entries.speaker: v

entries.text: Ah... from the apartment? Are you the one who's currently living there?
entries.new: 啊……是公寓那边？现在住在那里的是你吗？
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Yes. I'm sorry to suddenly call you like this. I got your number from Cecal's phone.
entries.new: 是我。突然打给你，真不好意思。号码是我从 Cecal 的手机里找到的。
entries.speaker: v

entries.text: What...? Why?
entries.new: 什么……？为什么？
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: I asked that, but I figured I already knew the answer. He had recognized me.
entries.new: 我这么问了，但心里已经知道答案了。他认出我了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I just need to ask this first. You were in Ashiya Tower during the terrorist attack on December 15th, right?
entries.new: 有件事我想先确认。12 月 15 号那起恐怖袭击的时候，你在芦屋塔里，对吧？
entries.speaker: v

entries.text: ...{w}December 15th? What are you talking about?
entries.new: ……{w}12 月 15 号？你在说什么？
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Wh-What? You know all about it, right? That's why you came to my place.
entries.new: 什、什么？你明明什么都知道吧？不然你怎么会到我那儿去。
entries.speaker: v

entries.text: ...{w}I do, yeah. I was there.
entries.new: ……{w}是啊，我知道。我就在现场。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: There was no reason to keep hiding it.
entries.new: 事到如今，也没必要再瞒下去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I see. I knew I wasn't wrong.
entries.new: 原来如此。我就知道自己没猜错。
entries.speaker: v

entries.text: There's a reason why I'm calling you. ...I don't know how this will sound, though.
entries.new: 我打电话给你，是有原因的。……只是不知道这话说出来，听起来会是什么样。
entries.speaker: v

entries.text: ...What is it?
entries.new: ……什么事？
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: ...Do you know... what I experienced? You read my thread from November, didn't you? That's how you found my apartment.
entries.new: ……你知道……我经历了什么吗？你读过我十一月发的那个帖子，对吧？你就是那样找到我公寓的。
entries.speaker: v

entries.text: What did you experience?
entries.new: 你经历了什么？
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Exactly what I wrote about...! From the 15th of December, I suddenly appeared on the 24th of November!
entries.new: 就是我写的那样……！12 月 15 号那天，我一下子就出现在了 11 月 24 号！
entries.speaker: v

entries.text: Once again, there was no reason to deny it. Since I'd shown up at his place days before the 15th and been one of the people to get trapped, from his perspective, it was fair to conclude that I'd also traveled through time.
entries.new: 这一次，我还是没有理由否认。我早在 15 号前几天就出现在他家，而且也是被困在塔里的人之一。在他看来，自然会推断我也经历了时间穿越。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I see. You're right. I also traveled back in time.
entries.new: ……原来如此。你说得对。我也回到了过去。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Wh— R-Really...!?{w} So that is what happened! How, though!?
entries.new: 什——真、真的吗……！？{w} 原来是这么回事！可到底是怎么做到的！？
entries.speaker: v

entries.text: I breathed steadily, wondering what to say.
entries.new: 我平稳地呼吸着，思量着该怎么开口。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I don't know. I'm confused as well.
entries.new: ……我不知道。我也一样困惑。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: I didn't want to reveal the Sekimeiya's powers, as I'd been fearing someone could get to it before me.
entries.new: 我不愿暴露 Sekimeiya 的力量——我一直担心有人会抢在我之前拿到它。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: You don't know...? Something happened inside the tower, right? How is it possible that I appeared in November like that!?
entries.new: 你不知道……？塔里一定发生了什么，对吧？我怎么可能就那么出现在十一月！？
entries.speaker: v

entries.text: I'm telling the truth. I don't know. I also suddenly traveled through time when I was in the tower, but I don't know why. I'm kinda glad to know I wasn't the only one, though.
entries.new: 我说的是实话。我真的不知道。我在塔里的时候也突然经历了时间穿越，原因同样不明。不过，知道不止我一个人这样，我多少安心了些。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: S-So, time traveling really is possible...! I was so scared I'd lost it completely!{w} Do you really not know anything about what happened?
entries.new: 那、那么说，时间穿越真的存在……！我还一直怕是自己彻底疯了！{w} 你对当时发生的事，真的一点都不知道吗？
entries.speaker: v

entries.text: ...I don't. I went to the event with a friend, and we all got knocked out by smoke that came out of nowhere. I know I traveled to the past, but not anything about what happened in that place.
entries.new: ……不知道。我和一个朋友去参加活动，不知从哪里冒出来的烟雾把我们都熏晕了。我知道自己回到了过去，可那个地方究竟发生了什么，我一无所知。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: What the hell...? I don't get it. ...How's that possible? A lot more people had to have come with me, right?
entries.new: 怎么会……？我不明白。……这怎么可能？肯定还有很多人跟我一起被送回来吧？
entries.speaker: v

entries.text: It's possible, but I don't know. You're the first one I've come across.
entries.new: 有可能，但我不知道。你是我遇到的第一个。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Whoa... This is unreal.
entries.new: 天哪……真不敢信。
entries.speaker: v

entries.text: ...I know. I can still hardly believe it.
entries.new: ……是啊。我到现在也几乎无法相信。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Why didn't you say anything to me? Isn't that why you came to my place?
entries.new: 那你为什么什么都没跟我说？你来我家，不就是为了这个吗？
entries.speaker: v

entries.text: Yeah, I'm sorry... I didn't know what to say.{w} It was hard to ask out of nowhere if you'd traveled through time.
entries.new: 嗯，抱歉……我不知道该怎么开口。{w} 突然问别人有没有经历时间穿越，实在很难说出口。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Ah, I understand. The same thing happened to me.
entries.new: 啊，我明白。我也一样。
entries.speaker: v

entries.text: He kept going after a pause.
entries.new: 他顿了顿，又接着说下去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Then what will happen in two weeks? Do you think it will repeat?
entries.new: 那两周之后会怎样？你觉得还会重演吗？
entries.speaker: v

entries.text: It's very possible, but I'm not sure everything will be identical.
entries.new: 很有可能，但是否一切都一模一样，我说不准。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Yeah, that wouldn't make sense. I have no idea how it'll come to occur, but it'll happen again. People will travel to the past. I can't believe it.
entries.new: 是啊，那样才说不通。我不知道它会以什么方式发生，但它一定会再来一次。会有人被送回过去。真难以置信。
entries.speaker: v

entries.text: ...I'm as confused as you are.
entries.new: ……我和你一样想不通。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: ...{w}So, are you okay now? I figure getting caught in that attack and suddenly traveling through time was hard on you. I know I didn't take it well.
entries.new: ……{w}那么，你现在还好吗？被卷进那场袭击，又突然经历时间穿越，我想这对你来说一定很难熬。我自己就承受得很艰难。
entries.speaker: v

entries.text: I am. Don't worry about me.{w} But I do have a question. Did you let your past self see you?
entries.new: 我还好。不用为我担心。{w} 不过我有个问题。你有没有让过去的自己看到你？
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: My past self? No... I didn't, but I-I did see him.{w} I came back to my place on the 25th of November, and in the afternoon, I saw myself coming back from work. I got scared when I heard the sound, so I escaped without being seen.{w} When I started to understand what had happened to me, I managed to avoid problems pretty easily by staying at home before the evening or at my parents'.
entries.new: 过去的我？没有……我没让他看见，倒是我、我确实看见了他。{w} 我回到自己住处时是十一月二十五日，那天下午，我看见自己下班回来。听到动静时我吓坏了，趁没被发现赶紧躲开。{w} 等渐渐弄明白自己身上发生了什么，我只要在傍晚前待在家里，或者去父母那边，就能很轻松地避开麻烦。
entries.speaker: v

entries.text: ...So, since it wasn't his intention to change the past, he didn't.
entries.new: ……也就是说，既然他并无改变过去的意图，过去也就没有被改变。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I'm incredibly relieved I was right, you really can't imagine it. I'm still going to move, but I'm so glad I can stop doubting what I felt sure of.
entries.new: 自己没猜错，这让我如释重负，你根本想象不到。我还是要搬家，但能不再怀疑自己原本确信的事，我真的很高兴。
entries.speaker: v

entries.text: ...That's good to hear. I'm sure everything will be all right.
entries.new: ……那就好。一切都会好起来的。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Yeah, I think so too.
entries.new: 嗯，我也这么想。
entries.speaker: v

entries.text: You're with the police, right? I saw a picture in your apartment.
entries.new: 你是警察吧？我在你公寓里看到过一张照片。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Yes, but I'm afraid I won't work there much longer.{w} ...Honestly, I have been told in the past I'm not always mentally stable. I'm relieved that it's not at the point I'd feared, but staying at my job would be very irresponsible... and dangerous. ...I didn't share it at first, but I think that just made it worse, so I've already accepted my condition.
entries.new: 是的，不过恐怕我在那里也干不了多久了。{w}……说实话，以前就有人说过，我的精神状态并不总是稳定。我很庆幸情况还没到我所害怕的地步，但继续留在那个岗位上会非常不负责任……也很危险。……我一开始没把这件事说出来，可我觉得那样反而更糟，所以我已经接受了自己的状况。
entries.speaker: v

entries.text: I winced sympathetically at what he was saying. His voice still sounded very calm, but there was a definite trace of sadness in it. It didn't seem like he wanted to specify any details, so I didn't ask for them.
entries.new: 听着他的话，我心里不由得一紧。他的声音依旧很平静，却分明透着一丝哀伤。他似乎并不想细说，我也就没有追问。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I'm sorry. I hope it gets better once you move out.
entries.new: ……抱歉。希望搬走之后，情况会好一些。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Thank you. I do as well.
entries.new: 谢谢。我也这么希望。
entries.speaker: v

entries.text: You were still working with the police up until the 15th, right?
entries.new: 你直到十五日都还在警局工作，对吧？
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: I was, yes.
entries.new: 是的，没错。
entries.speaker: v

entries.text: In that case, is there something you know about the attack? ...Do you know what could've happened?
entries.new: 既然如此，关于那次袭击，你知道些什么吗？……你知道可能发生了什么吗？
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Oh, I'm sorry. I don't know anything.{w} It was a highly entertained possibility that Xyn could've been planning something, but I don't know anything beyond that.
entries.new: 哦，抱歉。我什么都不知道。{w} 当时局里颇为认真地考虑过 Xyn 是否在谋划什么，除此之外，我就一无所知了。
entries.speaker: v

entries.text: I see. That's fine.
entries.new: 原来如此。没关系。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: ...Sorry, I'd love to give you more information. Ashiya quickly put out a statement about their version of what had happened, but nobody really believed it. We thought that something in the security system went wrong because Ashiya were having problems unlocking the way in and the communication with the interior suddenly cut.
entries.new: ……抱歉，我也希望能给你更多信息。芦屋很快就发布了他们那个版本的事件声明，可没人真的相信。我们当时认为安保系统出了问题，因为芦屋那边一直打不开入口，和内部的通讯也突然中断了。
entries.speaker: v

entries.text: Yeah, that's what happened inside as well, but we couldn't figure out what caused it.
entries.new: 嗯，里面也是这样，可我们查不出原因。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: I see... I apologize for not being more helpful.
entries.new: 这样啊……没能帮上更多忙，实在抱歉。
entries.speaker: v

entries.text: Don't worry, I wanted to ask just in case.
entries.new: 别在意，我只是想以防万一问一句。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: I wasn't sure whether asking my next question was the right call, but I had to know.
entries.new: 我不确定接下来这个问题该不该问，但我必须弄清楚。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Oh, something else. I don't mean to be rude or anything, but were you in Seeuta D'ella earlier?
entries.new: 哦，还有件事。我没有冒犯的意思，只是刚才你是不是在修塔·德埃拉公园？
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: ...The park? No. Why...?
entries.new: ……公园？没有。怎么了……？
entries.speaker: v

entries.text: I thought I might've seen you there. Was I wrong?
entries.new: 我好像在那儿见过你。是我看错了吗？
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: ...Yes. I'm still at my apartment.
entries.new: ……嗯。我还在公寓里。
entries.speaker: v

entries.text: I was mistaken, then.
entries.new: 那是我认错了。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Yeah, it wasn't me.
entries.new: 嗯，你看见的不是我。
entries.speaker: v

entries.text: ...I see, sorry.
entries.new: ……这样啊，抱歉。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: I didn't want to push it, but I still halfway doubted him.
entries.new: 我不想追问下去，可心里仍半信半疑。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It's fine. I guess this was all I called you for, but thank you for telling me the truth. Hearing that really was a relief.
entries.new: 没关系。我打电话给你，大概也就是为了这件事。不过谢谢你跟我说实话，听你这么说，我确实松了口气。
entries.speaker: v

entries.text: I'm glad. ...Do you think you'll be okay?
entries.new: 那就好。……你觉得自己撑得住吗？
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: I will. I'm not sure what I'll do now, knowing what happened, but I'll manage. I hope you will too. Is there anything else you want to know?
entries.new: 会的。知道真相以后，我还没想好接下来该怎么办，不过总有办法。希望你也一样。你还有别的想知道的事吗？
entries.speaker: v

entries.text: Uh...{w} yes.{w} Do you know exactly when you traveled through time on the 15th?
entries.new: 呃……{w}有。{w}你知道自己15号是几点穿越的吗？
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: The time? ...It might've been close to {time=16}, I think.
entries.new: 时间？……我想，大概快到{time=16}的时候吧。
entries.speaker: v

entries.text: Hm...{w} I don't know, then. I traveled hours later, so I don't know what to think.
entries.new: 嗯……{w}那我就不知道了。我是在几个小时后才穿越的，实在想不明白。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: ...That's unbelievable. I just can't wrap my head around it.
entries.new: ……真难以置信。我实在想不通。
entries.speaker: v

entries.text: I know...
entries.new: 是啊……
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Can you think of anything else that could be of use? I'd really like to help understand what happened. This is way too crazy.
entries.new: 你还能想到别的有用的线索吗？我真的很想帮忙弄清楚到底发生了什么。这件事太离谱了。
entries.speaker: v

entries.text: ...{w}I don't think so, no.
entries.new: ……{w}没有了，我想不到。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: I see... Do call me if you think of anything, then. Even though we still can't understand anything, at least now I can be somewhat at ease.
entries.new: 这样啊……那你要是什么时候想到了，一定要打给我。虽说我们还是什么都没弄明白，至少现在我多少能安心一些。
entries.speaker: v

entries.text: ...Okay. I will.
entries.new: ……好。我会的。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: And if you realize something or can think of what happened, please tell me. I would really appreciate that.
entries.new: 还有，如果你弄明白了什么，或者想起了当时的情况，也请告诉我。我会很感激的。
entries.speaker: v

entries.text: All right.
entries.new: 好的。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Thank you.
entries.new: 谢谢。
entries.speaker: v

entries.text: After a few seconds, he said goodbye, and the call ended.
entries.new: 几秒后，他道了别，通话便结束了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...So that's that.
entries.new: ……也就是说，事情就是这样了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I left my phone on the floor and rested my head back on the pillow. I'd briefly looked at the time, which had shown {time=16:58.}
entries.new: 我把手机搁在地板上，又把头靠回枕头。刚才我瞥过一眼时间，显示是{time=16:58.}。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'm glad all that makes more sense now. ...It's probably fine that I revealed I traveled through time.{w} At {time=16} we were in the attic, and I think Sai and Akaro had already escaped from the bedroom... I might've been right with what I thought before.
entries.new: 现在总算理清了不少，我也安心了。……我透露了自己穿越过时间，应该没关系吧。{w}在{time=16}的时候，我们还在阁楼里，我记得 Sai 和 Akaro 已经逃出卧室了……我之前想的说不定没错。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I forgot to ask, but Xyn definitely didn't approach him. It seems that all the information he could give them would be the very basic details behind the alarm, although I really doubt he would. He knows he's in the past, so if someone approaches him asking questions without knowledge of what happened on the 15th, it'll be easy to conclude they're not good people.
entries.new: 我忘了问，不过 Xyn 肯定没有去找过他。看来他能透露给他们的，最多也只是报警背后那些最基本的情况——虽然我实在怀疑他会说。他知道自己在过去，所以如果有人跑来问他，却对15号发生的事一无所知，他很容易就会判断对方不怀好意。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It didn't sound like he was taking it that badly, though. I guess he'll be at his parents' house from now on. If everything were to repeat, his original self would still live in his apartment until the 15th, when he'd travel to the past.
entries.new: 不过听他的语气，倒也没那么难以承受。我想他接下来会待在父母家吧。如果一切重来一遍，原本的他会一直住在公寓里，直到15号才回到过去。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I figured I didn't have to think too hard about it, so after wondering if there was anything else important I could ask him, I shut my eyes and buried my face in my pillow.
entries.new: 我想自己不必在这件事上钻得太深。琢磨过还有没有别的要紧事该问他之后，我合上眼，把脸埋进枕头里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: A while later, I went to the hallway. I tended not to enjoy taking showers during the winter, but as the heater had been working all day, it felt like a good idea. ...And I just wanted to do something.
entries.new: 过了一会儿，我走到走廊。冬天我向来不太爱淋浴，但暖气开了一整天，这时洗个澡感觉倒也不错。……而且，我单纯想找点事做。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Technically, I'd showered two days earlier, on the 30th. I went to my bedroom and selected the clothes I usually slept in.
entries.new: 严格说来，两天前的30号我才洗过澡。我回卧室挑了一套平常睡觉穿的衣服。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I had a bathtub in the bathroom, as my apartment wasn't big enough to have a dedicated room for it. I wasn't good at taking short showers, so I generally opted to take baths and avoid using up all the hot water.
entries.new: 我的公寓没有大到能单独隔出浴室，所以浴缸就装在卫生间里。我不擅长速战速决地淋浴，通常干脆泡澡，也免得把热水用光。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I turned on the water and waited for it to heat up as I left my nightwear ready.
entries.new: 我打开水龙头等水烧热，同时把睡衣摆好。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I opened the door and stepped out. Thanks to the heater, the hallway felt cold in a pleasant way.
entries.new: 我推门出来。多亏暖气，走廊里的凉意反倒让人觉得舒服。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: How much time had I spent there? I'd tried to keep my mind empty, but it wasn't easy, especially after Vaisude's call.{w} As usual, the bath had been relaxing, but it also made me more tired.
entries.new: 我在里面待了多久？我试着什么都不去想，可这并不是件容易事，尤其是 Vaisude 那通电话之后。{w}和平时一样，泡澡让人放松，却也让我更疲惫了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I didn't usually like how my hair looked after using the hair dryer, so I only used a towel, leaving it slightly wet. I'd tried not to soak it too much since I had to sleep soon, but that hadn't worked out, and I wasn't sure where the dryer even was.
entries.new: 我向来不喜欢吹风机吹过后的发型，所以只用毛巾擦了擦，头发还带着点湿。想到马上就要睡觉，我本打算尽量别把头发弄得太湿，结果并没做到，而且我连吹风机放在哪儿都不清楚。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: No sunlight was left. I approached my phone and glanced at the time.{w} {time=19:19.} The previous day, I'd gone to sleep very early, so my body was demanding that I repeat the schedule.
entries.new: 外面已经没有日光。我走到手机旁看了一眼时间。{w}{time=19:19.} 前一天我睡得很早，身体似乎正催着我照同样的作息再来一遍。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I'm not sure this is gonna go well if I'm going to spend the entire night in the tower soon.
entries.new: ……过不了多久就得在塔里过上一整夜了，现在这样下去，可不一定撑得住。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I'd had a pretty sad thought in the bathtub. My birthday was on the 19th of December, and Atsuki's was on the 21st. Earlier that year, the three of us had celebrated Miiya's, but it could end up being the first year I could remember where Atsuki and I wouldn't be together those two days.
entries.new: 泡澡时，我想到了一件挺难过的事。我的生日是12月19日，Atsuki 的是21日。今年早些时候，我们三个人还一起给 Miiya 庆过生，可这一年也许会变成我记忆中第一次，Atsuki 和我不在那两天一起过生日。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If we'd continued in the tower and the exit hadn't opened, we would've spent them locked inside. I was already moving the world away from that reality... The thought of having to miss those days was pretty disheartening, even if they would technically happen with another version of me present.
entries.new: 如果我们留在塔里，出口又没打开，那两个日子就会在封闭中度过。而我已经在让这个世界远离那种现实……一想到可能错过那两天，我还是很失落，哪怕从某种意义上说，另一个版本的我也照样会经历它们。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But I knew I wouldn't let myself be tricked. I wouldn't abandon the wish to save Miiya because of that. If I did, spending our birthdays together wouldn't mean anything anymore.
entries.new: 但我知道，我不会让自己被这种事动摇。我不会因此放弃救 Miiya 的愿望。否则，就算一起过生日，也再没有意义了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Yawning, I brought my phone to my bedroom. Sometimes, I got pretty hungry after bathing, but I really just wanted to lie down. ...The time had been passing so fast since I'd made it home.
entries.new: 我打了个哈欠，把手机拿回卧室。泡完澡有时会挺饿，可我实在只想躺下。……从回到家以后，时间过得真快。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I turned off the hallway light and walked to my bed. The blinds were still down, so I turned off the light there too and covered myself with the blankets, their soft touch highlighted after the bath.
entries.new: 我关掉走廊的灯，走到床边。百叶窗还拉着，我便也关了房里的灯，再裹上被子。刚泡过澡，被褥的柔软触感格外分明。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'm gonna wake up on December 3rd...
entries.new: 等我醒来，就是12月3日了……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...Atsuki's probably suffering by himself in his house. ...Or maybe he's in the hospital. This is about the time I woke up on the 8th, and he was there.
entries.new: ……Atsuki 现在大概正一个人在家里受苦吧。……又或者躺在医院里。我8号醒来的时候，差不多也是这个时间，那时他就在医院。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: No matter what I do, things won't ever be the same, will they?
entries.new: 不管我做什么，事情都再也回不到原样了，对吧？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I have to go to the tower tomorrow, don't I...? That'll tell me which options I have.{w} Assuming I'm able to find the cabinet, what would I choose? If I can't decide now, how will I be able to decide tomorrow?
entries.new: 明天我必须去塔里，对吧……？去了就能知道我有多少选择。{w}假如我真能找到展示柜，我该选什么？现在都决定不了，明天又怎么可能决定得了？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I was so comfortable in my bed that it was almost impossible to believe that, within a few hours, I might have been living in a world where I wouldn't really be myself.{w} Instead, I could end up in a prison cell. The choices I had weren't just freeing, they were daunting.
entries.new: 躺在床上的舒适感让我几乎无法相信，再过几个小时，自己也许就会活在一个不再真正是自己的世界里。{w}又或者，最终落得身陷牢房的下场。眼前的选择固然让我感到自由，却也令人望而生畏。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...{w}If I changed the past, I would pretty much be sacrificing myself. It's already changed in a very minor way, but that might not matter.{w} Even if I can't ever use the Sekimeiya again, if I simply prevent Atsuki and myself from going to the tower on the 15th, the other version of me will never travel through time, so both of us will persist.{w} ...That is assuming I don't get dematerialized by a paradox. Since the past can be changed, I should probably not be worried about that. Hopefully.
entries.new: ……{w}如果我改变过去，就等于牺牲我自己。过去确实已经发生了很细微的改变，不过那也许无关紧要。{w}就算我再也用不了 Sekimeiya，只要阻止 Atsuki 和我在15号去塔里，另一个我就不会去穿越时间，两个我都能继续存在。{w}……前提是我不会被悖论抹消。既然过去可以改变，我大概不必担心这一点。但愿如此。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It was just so frustrating to think about. Like in the bathroom, I forced the thoughts away and tried to breathe calmly.
entries.new: 光是想到这些就令人烦躁不已。就像在洗手间时那样，我强压下这些念头，试着平稳地呼吸。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Mutual Reject
entries.new: 相互拒绝

entries.text: I looked at my window. It was still pretty early, as I couldn't see light through the gaps.
entries.new: 我朝窗户望去。缝隙间不见光亮，天色还早。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It seemed I'd woken up as early as I'd gone to sleep. I felt well-rested, so I sat up instead of lounging around.
entries.new: 看来我睡下得早，醒来也早。我感觉睡得很足，于是没有赖床，直接坐了起来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'd realized that the time I had left was potentially scarce, and it felt like a long, long time since I'd appreciated ordinary days so much. ...I didn't want them to end any time soon, so I got out of bed right away.
entries.new: 我意识到，自己剩下的时间也许不多了；而我已经很久没有像这样珍惜平常的日子。……我不想让这样的日子这么快结束，于是立刻下了床。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The time was {time=7:45.}{w} I set the phone back on the table while a glimpse of the dream I'd just had returned to me.
entries.new: 时间已是{time=7:45.}{w}我把手机放回桌上，方才梦中的些许片段又浮上心头。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I wasn't able to piece it together properly, but I knew it had been very similar to the one from two nights prior. I had been in the tower, working through an infinite cascade of headaches caused by the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 我没能把梦境的片段拼凑完整，但我知道，它和两天前夜里的那个梦十分相似。梦中的我在塔里，被 Sekimeiya 引发的一波接一波的头痛折磨着。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Hm... maybe it's a little interesting that I'm dreaming about this.
entries.new: 嗯……我会梦见这种事，倒也有点意思。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: The body I'm currently in was never in the tower. The part of me that's causing these dreams traveled alongside my consciousness from the 15th.
entries.new: 我现在这具身体从未进过塔。让我做这些梦的，是随着意识一同从15号穿越而来的那部分我。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I was no expert on how dreams worked, and there wasn't much I could really glean from that anyway.
entries.new: 我对梦的机制并不了解，再说，就算了解，也从中得不出多少有用的线索。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Actually, wait a second. I went fifteen days back in time, but mentally, I still aged those fifteen days. I'm not sure exactly how old my body actually is after doing that, but wouldn't that mean that my birthday is technically on December 4th from now on instead? So, tomorrow.
entries.new: 等等。我穿越回了十五天前，但精神上又确实度过了这十五天。这样一来，我这具身体究竟算几岁，我也说不准；不过照理说，从今以后我的生日岂不是要变成12月4日了？也就是明天。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Huh. I'm just going to ignore that. It seems easier.
entries.new: 哈。我还是别去想这件事了，这样似乎更省心。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I stood up as I stretched my limbs and walked to the wardrobe while rubbing my eyes. Sleeping so long would actually tire me out sometimes, but I felt completely rested.
entries.new: 我站起来伸了伸四肢，一边揉着眼睛一边走向衣柜。有时睡得太久反而会让人疲倦，但我此刻只觉得神清气爽。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The radiators had been emitting heat for a long time, so the temperature was very pleasing.
entries.new: 暖气已经开了很久，室温十分宜人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I took some time to drink water and eat a few almonds. For some reason, I felt the impulse to go out, just like the first day.
entries.new: 我花了一点时间喝水，又吃了几颗杏仁。不知为何，我忽然很想出门，就像第一天那样。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I tried to open the door and check the temperature, but it didn't open smoothly. When I peeked out, I understood why.
entries.new: 我试了试开门，想看看外面的温度，门却不好推开。探头一看，我便明白了缘由。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...It's snowing. The sun is rising from behind the mountains, too.
entries.new: ……下雪了。太阳也从山后升起来了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It wasn't very dense snow, and only a bit of it had piled in front of the door. It didn't feel unbearably cold, so I stepped back in to go grab my phone and put on my coat.
entries.new: 雪不算大，门前只积了薄薄一层。外面并不冷得难受，我便退回屋里，去拿手机、穿上外套。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I remembered the footprints from the previous day again. I didn't want to let them intimidate me, so I discarded the thought. Despite that, I knew that finding out who was responsible for them, if I could, was a fairly good idea.
entries.new: 我又想起了前一天的那些脚印。我不想被它们吓住，于是把这个念头压了下去。尽管如此，我也清楚，若有机会查明那是谁留下的，倒很值得一试。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I stepped out but stopped myself as I was walking down the stairs.
entries.new: 我走出门，却在走下楼梯时停住了脚步。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Maybe it's too early. ...It's also colder than I thought.
entries.new: 也许太早了。……而且比我想象中更冷。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I didn't want to turn around so soon, so I kept going down, taking a few uncertain steps.{w} There was nobody outside. I was the only person I could see being hit by the falling snow.
entries.new: 我不想这么快就折返回去，便继续往下走，脚步有些迟疑。{w}外面空无一人。视野之中，只有我一个人任由落雪打在身上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I put on the heavy hood and began to make distance from my apartment.
entries.new: 我戴上厚重的兜帽，朝远离公寓的方向走去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'd previously wandered around Yushibana without a purpose, but the weather no longer made that a good idea. If I decided not to turn back, I had to actually go somewhere.
entries.new: 以前我也曾在丰花漫无目的地闲逛，但眼下的天气已经不适合这么做。既然不打算回头，我就得真正去一个地方。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It's so early, though. ...Should I just go to the tower?
entries.new: 可现在也太早了。……我该不该直接去塔里？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I didn't change direction, well aware that a part of me didn't want to go back there.
entries.new: 我没有改变方向，心里很清楚，自己有一部分并不想回到那里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Would I only go when I'd made up my mind? If so, that would never happen.{w} My whole life, I'd always avoided getting near that building. After the hellish day I'd spent there, that resistant part of me had only gotten stronger.
entries.new: 我难道非得等下定决心了才会去吗？要真是这样，就永远去不成了。{w}我这一辈子都在避开那栋建筑。我在那里熬过地狱般的一天后，心里抗拒的那一面只会更强。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Last night, I decided I'd go today, though. I really should...{w} I should, because if I don't, Miiya's fate could be set in stone at any time.
entries.new: 不过昨晚我已经决定，今天就去。我确实该去……{w}必须去，否则 Miiya 的命运随时都可能再无转圜余地。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I'd once thought that it already had been set in stone, even after learning about the Sekimeiya. Even with all the dilemmas I had, the impulse to go outside took priority over them. It was a strange, new sensation, and I hoped it would persist. Going to the tower would remove the faint traces of freedom I was feeling.
entries.new: 我曾以为，即便得知了 Sekimeiya 的存在，一切也早已尘埃落定。尽管心中有种种两难，想出门的冲动却压过了它们。这是一种陌生而新鲜的感觉，我希望它能一直持续下去。可一旦去了塔里，我此刻感到的那一丝自由便会消失。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...The streets were completely desolate. I'd gotten pretty far without noticing it, absorbed by the same persistent quandary.
entries.new: ……街上荒凉至极。我沉浸在那个挥之不去的难题里，不知不觉已经走出了很远。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Am I just afraid of being alone in a world where Miiya's alive? I don't even think I'm that concerned about getting caught by the police.{w} Right now, I'm all by myself, and I don't dislike it like I have in the past. ...It's probably because I know it's not indefinite, though.
entries.new: 我难道只是害怕独自待在这个 Miiya 还活着的世界里吗？我甚至不觉得自己有多担心被警察抓到。{w}此刻我孤身一人，却不像过去那样讨厌这种感觉。……不过这大概是因为我知道，这种状态不会一直持续下去。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: If that's all it is, couldn't I just go talk to Atsuki? If I explain everything to him, both of us could travel to the past and save Miiya. Another version of both of us would remain, but I wouldn't have to be by myself.
entries.new: 如果只是这样，我直接去找 Atsuki 谈谈不就行了？只要把一切解释清楚，我们两个就能穿越回过去，救下 Miiya。那样还会留下另一个版本的我们两人，但至少我不必独自一人。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: He would probably agree to it...
entries.new: 他大概会答应吧……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: But by traveling from the tower alone, I'd willingly avoided that already. ...Hadn't I traveled to the past precisely to also erase Atsuki's pain, so that he wouldn't have to remember everything?
entries.new: 然而，我决定独自去塔里穿越，就已经主动避开了这条路。……我回到过去，不正是为了也抹去 Atsuki 的痛苦，让他不必记得这一切吗？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: At once, I realized that the sight in front of me was not one I'd seen before.
entries.new: 我马上意识到，眼前的景象我从没见过。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: A foggy Ramon street extended far ahead of me, but only a handful of people were walking, covering their heads due to the snow. I had never seen it so devoid of life.{w} The entire area had begun to be coated by a thin layer of whiteness. I'd gotten there early enough to witness it before it was manually removed.
entries.new: 雾气弥漫的拉蒙街在眼前延伸开去，路上只有零星几个人，因为下雪都遮着头。我从没见过这里如此人烟稀少。{w}整片街区已经覆上了一层薄薄的白色。我到得够早，才赶在有人清扫之前见到这一幕。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I crossed the empty road. On the other side, I looked around me and saw that every shop was closed.
entries.new: 我穿过空荡荡的马路。到了对面，我环顾四周，发现所有店铺都关着门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: For a while, I didn't move. It was such an unusual sight that I had to wonder if it made any sense.
entries.new: 我呆立了片刻。眼前的景象太过反常，我不禁怀疑这究竟是否合乎常理。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It's... never been like this, has it?
entries.new: 这里……从来没有这样过吧？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Everything was closed, and there were so few people... It was hard to think I was at the same place as always.
entries.new: 所有店铺都关着，人又这么少……很难相信这里还是我平时熟悉的那个地方。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Even the times I went to school through Ramon, there were a lot more people, right? It was also around this time of day.
entries.new: 就算是我走拉蒙街去上学的时候，路上的人也多得多吧？而且差不多也是这个时间。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I was heading to Ina Café, but I started to doubt it'd be open, as nothing else was.
entries.new: 我本来要去伊娜咖啡馆，可别处都关着门，我也不禁怀疑它是否营业。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: That didn't feel right. I didn't think I'd ever seen it closed, not even on any special holiday.
entries.new: 这不太对劲。我记得自己从没见过它歇业，哪怕是特别的节日也一样。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It was at a branching street farther up, so I kept going, assuring myself that it would be up and running.
entries.new: 那家店在前方一条岔路口上，我继续往前走，一边安慰自己：它肯定已经开门了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Sometimes, I'd seen people out walking their dogs so early in the morning, but the snow made that impossible. When someone finally passed me by, I glanced at their face, and it didn't seem like they found the state of their surroundings strange.
entries.new: 平日里这个时候，我也见过有人出来遛狗，可今天下了雪，不可能有人出来遛狗。好不容易有人从我身边经过，我抬眼看了看对方的脸，那人似乎并不觉得周围有什么奇怪。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I got more and more confused. ...Was the lack of people normal? Perhaps the few memories I had of my morning trips to school were mistaken.{w} I was sure of one thing, though. When I'd taken Ramon street to go to classes, it had been to stop by Ina and eat something. While I couldn't be sure about the other places, I knew that not once had Ina been closed.
entries.new: 我越来越困惑。……街上没人，是正常的吗？也许我早上上学的那点记忆本来就不可靠。{w} 但有一件事我很肯定。我走拉蒙街去上课，是为了顺路去伊娜吃点东西。别的地方我不敢说，可伊娜从来没有关过一天门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Starting to get impatient, I accelerated toward Costa, the small street I'd always turned to.
entries.new: 我有些按捺不住，加快脚步朝 Costa 走去——那是我总拐进去的小街。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: When it finally came into view, I raised my head, letting the falling snow collide with my face. Soon, Ina came up, and I slowed down.
entries.new: 等它终于出现在视野里，我抬起头，任落雪打在脸上。很快，伊娜咖啡馆映入眼帘，我放慢了脚步。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...It really is closed.
entries.new: ……真的关门了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I stared at it from a distance. It shouldn't have been that strange, but a surrealness similar to the one I'd felt in the tower started to creep into the edges of my mind.
entries.new: 我远远地望着它。这本不该有多奇怪，可一种在塔里感受过的、近乎超现实的异样感，开始悄悄爬上心头。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I wasn't wrong, though. I've never seen it closed before.
entries.new: 可我没记错。我以前从没见过它关门。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I could be sure of that since there was an emblem of a coffee mug on the shutter that I was certainly seeing for the first time.
entries.new: 这一点我有把握——卷帘门上印着的咖啡杯图案，我绝对是第一次见到。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I continued getting closer without looking away. As I did, I thought of a time Darfee had said they didn't close a single day of the year.
entries.new: 我目不转睛地盯着它，继续靠近。走着走着，我想起 Darfee 曾说过，这家店全年一天都不休息。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Could he be sick?
entries.new: ……是他病了吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: No, that's not it. ...Everything else is closed too.
entries.new: 不对，不是这样。……别的店也都关着。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I tried to think of a reason, but I couldn't. The lack of people and open stores... Something about Yushibana was off.
entries.new: 我试着找个理由，却想不出来。没人，也没开门的店……丰花有什么地方不对劲。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I got to the shutter and tried to find a note explaining why it was closed. But there was nothing.
entries.new: 我走到卷帘门前，想找一张说明停业原因的告示。可什么都没有。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I took my phone out and looked at the time. It was {time=7:59.}
entries.new: ……我掏出手机看了看时间。{time=7:59.}
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It's possible he recently started to open later. That'd be weird, because students usually buy pastries here on the way to school.
entries.new: 也许他最近改成晚点开门了。可这说不通，学生上学路上一般都会来这儿买点心。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: The classes started at {time=8:00}, and I'd always been under the impression that Ina opened half an hour earlier.{w} I stepped under a thin stone roof to shield myself from the snow.
entries.new: 课是 {time=8:00} 开始，而在我印象里，伊娜总是提前半小时开门。{w} 我站到一道窄窄的石檐下躲雪。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I was lost, not knowing what to think. ...Surely Yushibana would soon look as it always had.
entries.new: 我茫然无措，不知该如何去想。……丰花很快就会变回平时的样子吧。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'd spent a couple of minutes crouching down under the roof, almost afraid of the silent street.
entries.new: 我在檐下蹲了好几分钟，几乎有些怕了这条寂静的街。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Wait. There's nobody here.{w} Why did I not see anyone going to school?
entries.new: ……等等。这里一个人都没有。{w} 我怎么没看见一个去上学的人？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I didn't understand. That didn't make sense.
entries.new: 我不明白。这说不通。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Classes had to be starting, but everything around me was deserted.
entries.new: 课马上就要开始了，可我周围空无一人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I used to see a few people going to school when I went through the center. Why have I not seen anyone?
entries.new: 以前我穿过中心区的时候，总能看见几个上学的学生。为什么今天一个都没见到？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I hadn't gone to school in months. Had something changed? The schedule, maybe? Some emergency? Was December 3rd a holiday I wasn't aware of? ...I couldn't be sure of anything, as I'd spent the entire time in a coma.
entries.new: 我已经好几个月没去学校了。是有什么变了吗？作息时间？还是出了什么紧急情况？十二月三日该不会是什么我不知道的假日吧？……这些我全都无法确定——那段时间我一直昏迷不醒。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What was wrong...!? No matter how much I looked around me, the absence of people wasn't normal, and even if there were no classes for some reason, Ina should have been open.
entries.new: 到底是怎么回事……！？不管我往哪儿看，街上一个人都没有，这太不正常了；就算今天因为什么原因不上课，伊娜也应该开着门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I stared at the snow piling on the ground. Beyond my safe place, the white curtain extended ahead, almost like a cloud.
entries.new: 我望着地上的积雪越积越厚。在我这个小小的避雪处之外，白色的雪幕一直向前延伸，几乎像一片云。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I didn't have gloves, so I tended to keep my hands warm in the pockets of my coat. Snow had slipped its way inside, and the cold ate at my fingers.
entries.new: 我没戴手套，一向把手揣在大衣口袋里取暖。雪不知何时钻了进去，寒气一点点啃噬着我的手指。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I didn't know what to do. There was nowhere I could go, and the temperature was imposing, rapidly becoming oppressive as soon as I'd stopped moving.
entries.new: 我不知该怎么办。无处可去，而气温逼人，我一停下脚步，寒意便迅速压了上来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I should just go home.
entries.new: ……我还是回家吧。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I hung my head. I'd been feeling fine when I left my apartment, but the atmosphere outside was completely unwelcoming, repelling me.
entries.new: 我垂下头。出门时我还没觉得有什么，可外面那股气氛全然拒人于外，像是把我往回推。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: So I stubbornly stayed there. Perhaps the mornings in Yushibana had become a lot more empty than before, but I knew it wouldn't be like that all day. Shortly, Ramon would fill up as always, practically bustling by comparison.
entries.new: 于是我固执地留在原地。也许丰花的早晨比从前冷清了许多，但我知道不会一整天都这样。再过一会儿，拉蒙街就会像往常一样热闹起来，相比之下简直称得上熙熙攘攘。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I clenched my hands and shuffled my feet repeatedly. The cold was sapping my energy bit by bit, so I had to keep confirming that I was capable of movement.
entries.new: 我攥紧双手，反复跺着脚。寒冷正一点点抽走我的力气，我必须不断确认自己还能动弹。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I knew I wasn't wrong. Ahead of Ina was a clothing store that had always been open at that time, but I could see it was closed as well. The Yushibana I was in didn't make sense. It was abnormal.
entries.new: 我知道自己没弄错。伊娜前面有一家服装店，这个时间向来都是开着的，可我看得出来，它也关了门。我所在的这个丰花不合常理。它不正常。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: How long had I been there? I was too cold to curl my fingers around my phone.
entries.new: 我在这里待了多久？冷得连手指都蜷不起来，握不住手机。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What am I doing...? I need to go home.
entries.new: 我在做什么……？我该回家了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Remembering the heater, I almost stood up. However, looking at my right, I noticed that some people had arrived at Ramon. It didn't feel normal yet, but it was getting there.
entries.new: 想起家里的暖气，我几乎要站起来。可往右边一看，我发现拉蒙街上已经有了几个人影。虽说还谈不上正常，但总算渐渐有了样子。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I just had to wait a little more. At any point, one of the shops had to open, and I could enter it to eat something.
entries.new: 我只要再多等一会儿。总有一家店会开门，到时我就能进去吃点东西。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Would that really happen? Everyone I could see walked ahead individually, either hidden behind an umbrella or disappearing into the distance without looking anywhere else.
entries.new: 真会这样吗？我能看见的人全都独自向前走着，不是躲在伞下，就是头也不回地消失在远处。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I turned abruptly to a nearby sound.{w} An old man was walking toward me from the wider street.
entries.new: 身旁传来响动，我猛地转过头。{w} 一位老人正从宽阔的街道那边朝我走来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: He hadn't seen me, and his tired eyes stared ahead as he walked through his own breath. I forced my body to stand up and stepped out from under the roof.
entries.new: 他没有看见我，疲惫的双眼望着前方，一边走一边穿过自己呼出的白气。我勉强撑起身子，从檐下走了出来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...A-Ah, I'm sorry...
entries.new: ……啊、啊，抱歉……
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: "Oh?"{w} He suddenly noticed I'd addressed him and focused his expression, trying to hear my voice.
entries.new: 「哦？」{w} 他这才注意到我在跟他说话，神情一凝，侧耳来听我的声音。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Um... is it normal that everything is closed? Shouldn't Ina be open already?
entries.new: 那个……所有店都关着，这正常吗？Ina不是早该开门了吗？
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: ...Huh? I-Ina...?
entries.new: ……嗯？I、Ina……？
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: He frowned and looked at the shutter.
entries.new: 他皱起眉头，望向卷帘门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I've never been there, but it's true that it's usually open.{w} You think it should be?
entries.new: 我没进去过，不过那家店平常确实开着。{w} 你觉得它现在该开门了？
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: Yes. I think so.{w} It's not only Ina, though. Everything's closed.
entries.new: 是的，我想是这样。{w}不过不止Ina，所有店都关着门。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: ...He looked all around him.
entries.new: ……他把四周看了个遍。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Hm, that's true. I don't think they should be closed today, so you probably only have to wait a little more. It's still pretty early.
entries.new: 嗯，说得也是。今天按理说不该关门的，所以你大概再等一会儿就好。现在还早得很。
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: ...I see.
entries.new: ……这样啊。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: He was about to drop it, but I insisted before he kept walking.
entries.new: 他看样子打算就此打住，我却没等他迈步，又追着问了一句。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But... aren't there far fewer people around than usual? It's Tuesday, right? There's no reason why that'd be the case.
entries.new: 可是……街上的人比平时少了很多吧？今天才周二，按理说不该这样。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Fewer people...? You think so?
entries.new: 人少……？你这么觉得？
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: After a bit, he shook his head.
entries.new: 过了一会儿，他摇了摇头。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Like I said, it's very early in the morning.
entries.new: 我说了，现在天刚亮没多久。
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: ...{w}Maybe I'm wrong. ...It's just the impression I got.
entries.new: ……{w}也许是我弄错了。……只是我有这种感觉罢了。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: He shrugged and gave a short, dry laugh before nodding his head and parting.
entries.new: 他耸了耸肩，干笑了一声，点点头便走了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'd felt before that I was being a little paranoid. Was that all it was...?
entries.new: 我以前就觉得自己有些疑神疑鬼。难道真的只是这样……？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I stepped back, shaking a bit of snow off my head. Maybe I'd internally exaggerated things, but I didn't think my memories were off.
entries.new: 我往后退了一步，抖掉头上的雪。也许是我把事情想得太严重了，但我不觉得自己的记忆出了错。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I should just wait, then—that's all. At some point, nobody will be able to say it's too early for the stores to be closed.
entries.new: ……那就等着好了——只能这样。再等一阵，总不会有人再说这个点关门太早了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I'd been below that short roof for some minutes, and while I couldn't stay there for much longer, there was nowhere else to take shelter. However, the thought of going all the way home before eating anything was intimidating.
entries.new: 我在那片矮檐下已经站了几分钟，虽说不宜久留，可也找不到别处避雪。可要空着肚子一路走回家，光是想想就让人发怵。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There's definitely more people than before. ...It's all fine.
entries.new: 人确实比刚才多了。……没事的。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Minutes earlier, I'd been considerably anxious due to the state of Yushibana. ...And I'd just made it up. That was all I could think it was.
entries.new: 几分钟前，我还为丰花的景象心神不宁。……结果全是我自己编出来的。我只能这么想。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I couldn't be relieved yet, because all around me, I could only see shutters. Only after one of them moved would any remaining doubt dissipate.
entries.new: 可我还不能安心，因为放眼望去，全是落下的卷帘门。非得等到其中一扇动起来，剩下的疑虑才会消散。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I leaned against the cold wall, questioning myself. ...It was such a horrible feeling.
entries.new: 我靠在冰冷的墙上，反复问自己。……那种感觉真是糟透了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Very soon, I heard a loud grinding sound.
entries.new: 没过多久，我听见一阵刺耳的摩擦声。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I turned to the mug symbol and saw it rising, uncovering the dim interior through the glass.
entries.new: 我朝那个杯子图案望去，只见它正缓缓升起，玻璃后昏暗的店内露了出来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Darfee was inside with a ring of keys in his hand. He unlocked the door and pushed the shutter all the way up.{w} I approached nervously before he noticed me.
entries.new: Darfee 就在里面，手里拿着一串钥匙。他打开门锁，把卷帘门一直推到了顶。{w}我趁他还没注意到我，忐忑地走上前去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...!{w} Shiroya! What are you doing here so early?
entries.new: ……！{w}Shiroya！你怎么这么早就来了？
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: ...I was waiting for you to open. I really wanted to go somewhere, for some reason.{w} I thought you opened at {time=7:30}, though.
entries.new: ……我在等你开门。不知怎么的，今天特别想出门。{w}不过我记着你 {time=7:30} 开门才对。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: ...You're right, I'm sorry if I'm late. Have you been waiting for a while?
entries.new: ……你说得对，来晚了，抱歉。等很久了吗？
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: I've been here a bit, but don't worry.
entries.new: 等了一会儿，不过没关系。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: ...Well, now I feel bad. Come in... You must be really cold.
entries.new: ……这可让我过意不去了。进来吧……你一定冻坏了。
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: I went through the transparent door, lightly tapping the snow off my shoes. I was glad that everything was all right. I couldn't understand if something strange had really just happened, but the warmth alleviated my worries.
entries.new: 我穿过透明的门，轻轻跺掉鞋上的雪。一切平安无事，这让我松了口气。刚才是否真的发生了什么怪事，我仍然想不明白，但屋里的暖意冲淡了我的不安。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Sorry, it'll take a bit for the heat to get going.
entries.new: 抱歉，暖气还得过一会儿才热得起来。
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: That's fine. ...It's much better than outside.
entries.new: 没关系。……比外面好多了。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: I stepped farther in and looked at the multitude of pastries behind the glass as I removed my hood. Meanwhile, Darfee grabbed a few chairs from a pile in the corner and put them beside the tables.
entries.new: 我往里走了几步，一边摘下兜帽，一边望着玻璃柜里琳琅满目的糕点。Darfee 则从角落里的一摞椅子中抽出几把，摆到桌边。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What do you want? These are all recently baked.
entries.new: 要哪个？这些全是刚烤好的。
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: I pointed at the same chocolate-covered one I'd had before, unaware of its name. I'd heard before that eating warm pastries wasn't healthy and to always wait for them to cool off, but I was too hungry to care.
entries.new: 我指了指之前吃过的那种裹着巧克力的，尽管并不知道它叫什么名字。以前听过一种说法，刚出炉的糕点趁热吃对身体不好，要放凉了再吃，可我饿得顾不了这些。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I eagerly waited while Darfee went behind the counter, biting in immediately after the tiny plate was placed in front of me.
entries.new: Darfee 绕到柜台后面，我满心期待地等着。小碟子刚一放到我面前，我立刻咬了一口。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Darfee looked pretty busy preparing everything. He got two batches of bread out of the oven and placed them in the usual spot.
entries.new: Darfee 忙着准备各样东西。他从烤箱里取出两盘面包，放到惯常的位置上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I'll need a coffee too.
entries.new: ……再给我来一杯咖啡。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: The same way?
entries.new: 和上次一样？
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: ...Yes.
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: All right. Give me a moment.
entries.new: 好，稍等一下。
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: I'd felt completely rested after waking up, but that had drastically changed.{w} Staring at the wood, I kept biting the pastry, its warmth permeating my body.
entries.new: 刚起床时我还觉得精神十足，如今却已大不相同。{w}我盯着木纹桌面，一口口咬着糕点，暖意渐渐渗进身体。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Darfee put an empty cup below the coffee machine and filled it up.
entries.new: Darfee 把一只空杯放到咖啡机下面，接满了咖啡。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Do you want to sit at a table?
entries.new: 要不要坐到桌边去？
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: I looked behind me. Next to the low tables was the wide window, intercepting soft flakes of snow.
entries.new: 我回头看去。矮桌旁是一扇宽大的窗，细软的雪花正落在窗上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Yeah. I'll sit there.
entries.new: 嗯，我就坐那边。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: I'd already finished up the pastry, so I grabbed the cup by its rim and carefully brought it to the closest table.
entries.new: 糕点已经吃完了，我捏着杯沿，小心地把咖啡端到最近的那张桌子。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I sat on one of the two chairs, its angle allowing Ramon to be seen.{w} ...What had I been going on about? There were a number of pedestrians walking with an umbrella above them.
entries.new: 我在两把椅子中的一把上坐下，这个角度正好能望见拉蒙街。{w}……我刚才都在胡思乱想些什么？路上有不少行人，头顶撑着伞。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I touched the glass with a finger, feeling again how cold it was outside. With the other hand, I gripped the hot coffee tightly, a stark contrast. Then, I slowly brought it to my lips.
entries.new: 我用一根手指碰了碰玻璃，再一次感到外面有多冷。另一只手紧紧握着滚烫的咖啡，冷热对比分明。然后，我慢慢把杯子送到唇边。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...!{w=0.5} It's burning.{w} It's a lot less hot when I make it at home.
entries.new: ……！{w=0.5}烫死了。{w}我自己在家冲的，可没这么烫。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I placed it back down, Darfee still arranging everything properly behind the counter.
entries.new: 我把杯子放回去，Darfee 还在柜台后有条不紊地整理着东西。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I waited a bit for the coffee to cool off and started to drink it.
entries.new: 我等咖啡稍微凉了些，才端起来喝。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I finished it in a few sips.{w} Seconds later, I began to notice a faint headache, a frequent side effect coffee had on me.
entries.new: 几口便见了底。{w}不过几秒，一阵隐隐的头痛就泛了上来——这是咖啡常给我带来的副作用。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Do you have any water?
entries.new: ……有水吗？
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Water? Yeah, of course.
entries.new: 水？有，当然有。
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: Darfee's head peeked out from under the counter, and he filled up a glass with a bottle of water. I stood to grab it from the other side and drank it in hopes of alleviating the pain.
entries.new: Darfee 从柜台底下探出头来，用一瓶水倒满了一杯。我起身从另一头接过，喝了下去，盼着能压住那阵疼。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...The effect was almost immediate, and the pleasant change of temperature refreshed my mouth.
entries.new: ……几乎立刻见效，温度一变，口中顿时清爽了许多。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I reclined in the chair, still a little rattled.
entries.new: 我靠回椅背，心里还有些发虚。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I turned my head to the door after hearing it open. A man I hadn't seen outside entered the café and stepped up to the bar with moist footsteps.
entries.new: 听见开门声，我转头看向门口。一个刚才在外面没见过的男人走进咖啡馆，脚步带着湿意，来到吧台前。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: "What'll it be?" Still looking a little busy, Darfee addressed him while he scanned the wooden trays behind the counter.
entries.new: 「要点什么？」Darfee 似乎还在忙，一边问他，一边打量着柜台后面的木托盘。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'll have two loaves of spelt bread.
entries.new: 我要两条斯佩尔特小麦面包。
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: This one?
entries.new: 这一种？
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: The man nodded, and Darfee packed both loaves into a thin bag that he handed over.{w} "What else?"
entries.new: 男人点点头，Darfee 把两条面包装进一只薄袋子递过去。{w}「还要别的吗？」
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: That's all.
entries.new: 就这些。
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: It'll be ¥280, then.
entries.new: 那就算 280 日元。
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: "Thank you." After being handed a few coins, Darfee bowed, and the man quietly walked out.
entries.new: 「谢谢。」Darfee 接过几枚硬币，躬身道谢，男人便悄无声息地走了出去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Following that, more people began to enter.
entries.new: 那之后，进来的客人渐渐多了起来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I saw everyone come in and out from my chair. Most of them had come to buy bread, which had almost run out already.
entries.new: 我坐在椅子上，看着人来人往。多数人是来买面包的，而面包眼看就要卖光了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It was hard to believe the place would evolve throughout the day, becoming a bar in the evening. Everyone had instantly left without sitting anywhere, as the chairs and stools were primarily used later in the day.{w} The café was open the entire day on every day of the week. However, even though Darfee was the main person behind it, I'd frequently seen members of his family behind the counter. He couldn't do it all himself.
entries.new: 很难想象这地方会在一天里变样，到了傍晚就成了酒吧。客人都是买完就走，谁也没坐下——椅子凳子多半是留给晚些时候用的。{w}咖啡馆一周七天，整天营业。可虽说这里主要靠 Darfee 操持，我也常看见他的家人站在柜台后。他一个人忙不过来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Once a few minutes had gone by without any new customers, Darfee addressed me.
entries.new: 几分钟过去，没有新客人进门，Darfee 便跟我搭起话来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: You've been here a while. Do you want anything else?
entries.new: 你在这儿待了好一阵子了。还要点别的吗？
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: ...Hm.{w} I don't think so.{w} I'm still hungry, but I don't really want another pastry.
entries.new: ……嗯。{w}不用了。{w}我还饿着，可实在不想再吃一块点心。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: That's fine.{w} ...Have you talked to your parents?
entries.new: 也好。{w}……跟你父母联系过了吗？
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: ...Yeah, I called my mom the other day.{w} ...We talked a bit, but they're gonna stay where they are. I already mentioned that's also what I prefer.
entries.new: ……嗯，前几天给我妈打过电话。{w}……聊了几句，他们还是打算留在那边。我也说过，这样正合我意。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: ...Are you sure about that? Is it that you want to be alone or that you don't want your parents to come?
entries.new: ……你确定？是你想一个人待着，还是不想让父母回来？
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: ...{w}I think I prefer being alone, at least at home.
entries.new: ……{w}我想我还是更喜欢一个人，至少在家里是这样。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: I can understand that. I'm glad you're okay, but I suppose I can't really accept they won't come back. I was really shocked when I learned they'd moved away without you.
entries.new: 我能理解。你没事，我很欣慰，可他们要是不回来，我实在没法坦然接受。听说他们撇下你搬走了，我真是吃了一惊。
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: I didn't know what else to say. He realized I was looking a little down and changed the subject.
entries.new: 我不知道还能说什么。他看出我有些低落，便换了话题。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Well, I'm happy you came back already. You were there very early, though.
entries.new: 总之，你这么快就回来了，我很高兴。不过，你来得可真早。
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: I went to sleep pretty early too, and for some reason, I felt like going out somewhere again.
entries.new: 我也睡得很早，不知怎么的，又忽然想出门走走。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: You should've at least grabbed an umbrella. But it's impressive how strong you are.
entries.new: 至少也该带把伞。不过你身子骨倒挺硬朗。
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: He smiled gently at me.
entries.new: 他朝我温和地笑了笑。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Oh, right, I guess he isn't aware that I'm still in the hospital. There's no reason he would know that without calling my parents.{w} Will he find out on the 8th...? I don't know what I'll say if he does.
entries.new: 啊，对了，他大概还不知道我还在住院。他总不会平白无故给我父母打电话，所以应该不知道。{w}到了 8 号，他会知道吗……？到时候我该说什么，自己也不知道。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: So what have you been doing these last couple of days?
entries.new: 这两天你都在做些什么？
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: ...{w}Not much. I went to Atsuki's house yesterday, and I was there for a while.
entries.new: ……{w}没做什么。昨天去了 Atsuki 家，待了好一阵子。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Atsuki's house? You think being there helps you?
entries.new: Atsuki 家？你觉得待在那儿对你有帮助？
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: ...I think so, yeah.
entries.new: ……我想是有的。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: I see.
entries.new: 这样啊。
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: He looked saddened too, but I hadn't lied. I wasn't entirely certain how I was able to feel so tranquil at home by myself, but I suspected that if Atsuki hadn't invited me to his house from the hospital in the first place, I wouldn't have been able to bear it. The pain we'd felt from Miiya's death had practically hung in the air at his house, but we'd been able to withstand it together.
entries.new: 他的神情也黯淡下来，可我并没有说谎。独自待在家里为什么能那样平静，我自己也说不清；但我猜，要是当初 Atsuki 没有把我从医院叫到他家，我怕是撑不住的。Miiya 的死带来的那份痛几乎弥漫在他家的空气里，可我们两个人一起，终究熬了过来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I don't want to put any pressure on you, but I'm curious if you have an idea about what you'll do. Last I heard, you were considering studying medicine, right?{w} ...Sorry, maybe this isn't a good time to ask these questions.
entries.new: 我不想给你压力，只是想知道你心里有没有个打算。上次听你说，你在考虑学医，对吧？{w}……抱歉，也许现在不该问这些。
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: Don't worry... I don't know, though.{w} I don't even know anything about medicine. It's just one of the few areas I think I could find interesting, but I'm not sure I want to keep studying. I think it's a lot more likely I'll try to find a job.
entries.new: 别在意……不过，我自己也没想好。{w}我对医学本来就一无所知，只觉得那大概是我少数几个能提起兴趣的领域，可要不要继续读书，我也说不准。更有可能的是，我会去找份工作。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Is that so? I was thinking that I wouldn't at all mind letting you work here a few hours a week. Would you be interested? It'd give you something to do, and you wouldn't have to depend exclusively on your parents.
entries.new: 是这样吗？我倒想着，你要是愿意，每周来这儿干几个小时的活也无妨。有兴趣吗？这样你手头有点事做，也不必完全依靠父母。
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: That offer came out of nowhere, and I was left a little shocked.
entries.new: 这话来得突然，我一时有些发怔。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Um... I don't know.{w} Maybe.{w} I'll think about it. Can I? I really appreciate it, though.
entries.new: 呃……我不知道。{w}也许吧。{w}让我想想，可以吗？不过真的很谢谢你。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Of course, this isn't a decision you have to rush, and it's an offer that isn't going anywhere, so tell me if you think it'd be good for you.
entries.new: 当然，这事不用急着定，提议也一直作数。你若是觉得对你合适，就告诉我。
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: Okay.
entries.new: 好。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Admittedly, if that had been proposed to me before December, I might've accepted immediately, as I'd been desperately lacking an actual path to take.{w} But part of me just wanted the days to continue. It was a selfish and impossible wish, but the two days of December I'd redone had possessed a calmness I'd rarely known despite my own paranoia.
entries.new: 说实话，这话要是放在十二月之前对我说，我大概会一口答应——那时的我正急需一条实实在在的路。{w}可我心里有一部分，只盼着这样的日子能一直延续下去。这个愿望自私，也不可能实现；而重过的那两天里，却有一种我极少体会过的安宁，纵使那时我满心猜疑。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Someone opened the door, so Darfee had to attend them.
entries.new: 有人推门进来，Darfee 只得去招呼。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I looked through the glass. At Ramon, I could see a person dressed in a green uniform removing the snow on the ground. Some was still falling, but it had become too light to build up.
entries.new: 我透过玻璃望去。拉蒙街上，一个穿绿色制服的人正在清扫地上的积雪。雪还在下，却已细得积不起来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: After my brief talk with Darfee, I'd taken notice of something. Everything that I'd been worrying about for months had become meaningless.
entries.new: 与 Darfee 简短交谈之后，我留意到一件事：这几个月来我一直忧心的一切，都已变得毫无意义。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Technically, at the moment, none of that mattered anymore. Studying medicine, moving away, getting a job... All of that would be irrelevant if I traveled to the past again or if I modified history.{w} It would all have been for nothing. I would strive to prevent the death of a friend, isolating myself in a world where not a single thing of what I'd constantly worried about would occur.
entries.new: 严格来说，此刻那些都已无关紧要。学医、搬离这里、找工作……只要我再次穿越回过去、改写历史，这一切便毫无意义。{w}全都付诸东流。我会一心阻止朋友的死，把自己封闭起来，活在一个我所担忧的种种都不会发生的世界里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...And I would really try to do it. Sitting on that chair, I'd sporadically feel a sharp pain in my chest. A pain warning me that it could've been my last visit to Ina and my last real day in Yushibana. Any day could have been my last one before needing to take action.
entries.new: ……而且我真会那样做。坐在那把椅子上，胸口时而无端一阵刺痛。那痛楚像在警告我：这也许是我最后一次来伊娜咖啡馆，是我在丰花最后一个真正意义上的日子。在不得不行动之前，任何一天都可能是我的最后一天。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'd come to massively appreciate the odd serenity I could feel. For that reason, if the end of the countdown was that close, I'd try to prolong it a little bit more.
entries.new: 我对这份奇异的宁静越来越珍惜。正因如此，若倒计时真的已近在眼前，我只想再把它拖长一点。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: And since all I wished for was the calmness I felt, I remained on that chair where it existed, witnessing the outside world move through the glass.
entries.new: 既然我所求的只是这份平静，我便一直坐在那把留住这份平静的椅子上，隔着玻璃看外面的世界流转。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Letting the time pass was what I most and least wanted. I stayed there, glancing out and believing it was the best way to use the time I still had.
entries.new: 任时间流逝，是我最想、也最不愿做的事。我留在原处，偶尔向外瞥一眼，相信这就是用掉余下时间的最好方式。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Darfee noticed that, as he didn't resume the conversation once the silence had returned.
entries.new: Darfee 察觉到了这一点——沉默重新降临后，他再没有开口。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There was nothing else I thought I could do on December 3rd. The only thing that remained was going to the tower and learning what would come next.
entries.new: 12月3日这天，我想不出还能做别的什么。剩下的只有去那座塔，看看接下来会发生什么。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Before that, there was only an optional step. It was deciding.{w} I still had the ability to choose. It wasn't true that going to the tower was essential for that.
entries.new: 而在那之前，只有一个可选的步骤——做出决定。{w}我仍然有权选择。去塔里并不是做出选择的必要条件。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: No matter what I'd find there, deciding whether to change the past or not was possible, even though I'd done my best to believe that I'd never choose the latter.{w} After all, I'd touched the Sekimeiya to change the past, and it would've been for nothing if I later decided not to.
entries.new: 无论在那里发现什么，我都仍有办法决定是否改变过去——尽管我一直极力让自己相信，我绝不会选择不改变过去。{w}毕竟，我触碰 Sekimeiya 就是为了改变过去；若到头来决定放手，那一番举动岂非白费。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But perhaps that was wrong. I couldn't think anymore that touching the Sekimeiya would've been for nothing even if I decided not to alter history. The days I was living through did mean something to me.
entries.new: 但也许我想错了。即便最终决定不去改写历史，我也不该认定触碰 Sekimeiya 是徒劳。我正在度过的这些日子，对我而言确实有意义。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...What would actually happen if I step aside and choose not to go to the tower again? I don't think that'd actually be so simple either.{w} Late on the 15th, I disappeared from the tower, leaving the others behind. If everything happens as it did, Atsuki will try to travel to the past himself, and the problem of the recording will come back in full force.
entries.new: ……如果我抽身而退，选择不再去那座塔，究竟会发生什么？我想事情也不会那么简单。{w}15日深夜，我从塔里消失，把其他人留在那里。若一切照旧发生，Atsuki 就会自己尝试穿越回过去，而录音的问题也会再次变得严重起来。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: There really wasn't a single good option, so maybe deciding simply wasn't possible.
entries.new: 确实没有一个选项是好的，也许根本无从决定。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Instead of trying to determine which of the choices I had was better, would attempting to find a new one serve any purpose?
entries.new: 与其去权衡手中哪个选择更好，试着再找出一个选择，又有什么意义？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There's just... nothing else, is there?
entries.new: 只是……再没有别的路了，对吧？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: There'd always been a concealed alternative that I'd been aware of, but it was so unthinkable that I'd chosen to immediately dismiss it.
entries.new: 一直有一个我早就知道、却始终刻意回避的选项；只是它太过不可想象，我才刚一想到就立刻打消了念头。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If I didn't change the past, Miiya would stay dead, and so would the people who'd died in the tower. It was even possible Atsuki would too if the exit didn't open after twelve hours. At that point, I could try to enter the building through the storeroom or make the police do so, but if that door didn't actually lead outside, the recording had a chance to occur a month later.
entries.new: 如果我不改变过去，Miiya 就会一直死着，塔里死去的那些人也是。若十二小时后出口没有打开，连 Atsuki 都可能同样丧命。到那时，我或者警方也许能从储藏室进入大楼；可如果那扇门并不通向外面，那段录音就仍可能在一个月后成为现实。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Even though I'd changed the past by calling my mother, that wouldn't necessarily prevent the events of the 15th from occurring—the version of me in the hospital at that moment could still travel back in time the same way I had.{w} I knew that could be wrong. If I still went back in time after my mom told me about the call she got when I was in the hospital, I wouldn't ever try to change the past by calling her. The distinction between that Shiroya and me already somewhat existed.
entries.new: 即便我曾给母亲打过电话、改动了过去，也未必能阻止15日的事件发生——那一刻躺在医院里的那个我，仍可能像我当初一样回到过去。{w}但我知道这也未必。如果母亲告诉过我，我住院时她接到过那通电话，而我仍然回到了过去，那我就绝不会再试图通过给她打电话改变过去。那个 Shiroya 与我之间，某种程度上已经有所不同。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: So if that's not the case, and I further change the past, the only negative is that the self of mine currently in the hospital will stop being me, and I'll have to abandon my current life. I'm... not really sure I could do that.
entries.new: 那么，如果情况并非如此，而我又进一步改写过去，唯一的坏处就是此刻在医院里的那个我将不再是我，而我也必须舍弃现在的人生。我……不确定自己真能做到。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Then yes, of course, there was a way to prevent that from happening.{w} Upon changing the past, the problematic variable was solely the other version of myself. Therefore, by removing that variable, I'd have everything I wanted.{w} ...But that wasn't something I could seriously consider.{w} That possibility simply didn't exist.{w=0.8}{nw}
entries.new: 那么，当然，确实有办法阻止这件事发生。{w}一旦改变过去，成问题的变量就只剩下另一个自己。既然如此，只要消除这个变量，我想要的一切便都能得到。{w}……但这不是我能认真考虑的事。{w}那种可能根本不存在。{w=0.8}{nw}
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'd spent a very long time beside that glass as it was marked by unending snow. I was getting alarmingly hungry, but for as long as I stayed there, I would be fine.
entries.new: 我在那扇玻璃旁坐了很久，外面的雪下个不停，玻璃上落满了雪。饥饿已到了令人发慌的地步，但只要还留在这里，就不会有事。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Through the glass and the whirls of white, I was able to see the sun. It had reached the center of the sky.
entries.new: 透过玻璃与旋飞的雪片，我望见了太阳。它已经升到天空正中。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I continued staring through it, watching the part of Yushibana that had become as lively as always.
entries.new: 我仍旧望过去，看着丰花那一带恢复了一如往常的喧闹。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: That was until I recognized something in the distance.
entries.new: 直到我认出远处的一样东西。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Axis Ropeway
entries.new: Axis 索道

entries.text: I stood up from the chair, realizing that I had forgotten something.
entries.new: 我意识到自己忘了某件事，从椅子上站起身来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I'll be leaving. How much is it?
entries.new: ……我要走了。多少钱？
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: What? You still think that you have to pay?
entries.new: 什么？你还觉得自己非付钱不可？
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: Just tell me. I'll feel bad about coming so often if I don't pay.
entries.new: 你就说吧。来得这么勤还不付钱，我心里过意不去。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: That's mean...{w} It's ¥300.
entries.new: 真伤人……{w}300日元。
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: I took my wallet out and paid with the exact amount.
entries.new: 我掏出钱包，付了正好的数目。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Thank you. Sorry for leaving so suddenly, but I need to be somewhere.
entries.new: 谢谢。抱歉突然就走，我还有地方要去。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Don't worry. You know you can come back any time.
entries.new: 别在意。你知道的，随时都可以再来。
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: I nodded and left, flipping up my hood.
entries.new: 我点点头，拉起兜帽，转身离开。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I walked directly to Ramon street. In the distance, I had recognized a purse.{w} ...After staring at it for a few seconds, I knew exactly where I'd seen it.
entries.new: 我径直走向拉蒙街。远处，我认出了一只手提包。{w}……盯着它看了几秒，我便想起在哪儿见过它。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I dashed toward the direction it had been. Right above the purse, an umbrella was covering the face of its owner.
entries.new: 我朝它刚才所在的方向奔去。手提包上方，一把伞遮住了持包人的脸。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But that didn't matter. I knew that purse. While identical ones could exist, I'd recognized it as... Isla's.
entries.new: 但那无关紧要。我认得那只包。就算有一模一样的，我也认得出，那是……Isla 的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I ran to the street the umbrella had turned to. Even though I hadn't seen the face of the person holding it, that umbrella was lower to the ground than all the others...
entries.new: 我跑向那把伞拐进去的街道。虽说没看清撑伞人的脸，可那把伞比周围所有的伞都低……
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I started moving faster as I reached an area with less snow stuck to the pavement. Ramon was pretty crowded, so I wasn't sure if anyone had been walking beside that umbrella, but I'd recalled something else I'd entirely forgotten about.
entries.new: 走上积雪较少的路面后，我加快了脚步。拉蒙街上人不少，我不确定有没有人和那把伞并肩而行，但我又想起了一件被自己忘得干干净净的事。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Isla's friend... That's right. They must be here.
entries.new: Isla 的朋友……对了。那个人一定就在这里。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: A sudden wave of bleariness crashed through my head, demanding me to slow down, but I didn't stop until I'd arrived at the dimmer street I'd seen the umbrella at.
entries.new: 一阵突如其来的眩晕冲上头顶，逼我放慢脚步，可我一路没停，直到走进那把伞消失的昏暗街巷。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I couldn't see anyone.{w} There were multiple doors on both sides and more branching paths farther ahead.
entries.new: 我看不到任何人。{w}两侧有好几扇门，前方还有更多岔路。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I don't know what happened to me this morning, but today's definitely a school day. ...If that was really Isla, it could've actually been her "friend", right?{w} Was I correct, and her identity was Isla herself?
entries.new: 不知道今天早上我到底是怎么了，但今天确实是上学的日子。……如果那真是 Isla，那说不定其实是她的「朋友」？{w}我猜得对吗？那个人的身份就是 Isla 本人？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: That thought had seemed a little strange in the tower for a number of reasons.{w} She couldn't have gone back in time to repeat exactly what she'd lived through, but I had since learned that a long travel like that could've happened without needing to store energy for a month.
entries.new: 在塔里时，这个念头因为种种原因显得有些奇怪。{w}她不可能回到过去，把经历过的日子原样重演一遍；但后来我得知，那样的长途穿越并不需要蓄能一个月也能实现。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I looked down. From there onward, snow still covered the ground. As a result, I was able to see a pair of footprints, smaller and less faded than the rest, disappearing ahead.
entries.new: 我低下头。从这里往前，地面仍覆着雪。因此我看见了一对脚印——比其余的都要小，也都要清晰，一路延伸到前方，消失不见。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I stepped forward, careful not to lose track of them. The buildings weren't casting dark shadows on the ground, so I was able to follow them without mixing them up.
entries.new: 我迈步向前，小心不跟丢。建筑物没有在地面投下浓重的阴影，所以我能一路追下去，不至于认错。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I went all the way down the street, where the footprints turned to the right.{w} Once again, I was close to Atsuki's house, but the marks on the ground deviated from it. There was still no indication of them ending, and I wasn't able to see anyone farther ahead.
entries.new: 我一路沿着街道走到尽头，脚印在那里向右拐去。{w} 我又一次来到 Atsuki 家附近，可地上的痕迹却偏离了那里。脚印仍没有到头的迹象，前方也望不见半个人影。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'd been trying to go fast, but once again, the footprints turned to the right and I couldn't spot the umbrella.
entries.new: 我本想走得快些，可脚印又一次向右拐去，那把伞始终不见踪影。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Isn't this a dead end?
entries.new: 这不是死路吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Like I thought, that turn brought me to a short street filled with houses. That meant the footprints had to end at a door.
entries.new: 果然如我所料，那个拐弯把我带到一条短短的小街，两旁尽是住家。也就是说，脚印一定停在了某扇门前。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: And they did. When I lifted my head, I saw a house, the trail ending at its entrance.
entries.new: 果然如此。我抬起头，一栋房子映入眼帘，那道痕迹止于它的门口。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Does Isla live here?{w} ...Should I ring the bell?
entries.new: 这里是 Isla 的家吗？{w} ……我该按门铃吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Instead, I warily stepped back, as letting myself be seen had some worrying implications.
entries.new: 我没有按，反而警惕地后退了一步——被人看见，后果实在令人不安。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Even if I'd just seen an Isla who'd traveled from the future, while the original one was likely to not be home, it was very possible Erina was. She'd told us that she once found out Isla hadn't gone to school, so there was nothing stopping her from being inside right then.
entries.new: 即便我刚见到的只是从未来穿越而来的 Isla，原本那个 Isla 多半不在家，Erina 却很可能会在。她说过，她曾发现 Isla 没去上学，所以此刻她人在屋里也毫不奇怪。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Whether I ring the bell or not... that's the same as finally deciding whether to change the past or not.
entries.new: 按不按门铃……就等于最终决定要不要改变过去。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I'd like to know who Isla's friend is, and if it really is herself, I might learn something very important from her. However, it's also possible Erina will see me, which will change things pretty drastically...
entries.new: 我想知道 Isla 的朋友究竟是谁；如果真是她自己，我或许能从她口中得知极重要的事。可与此同时，我也可能被 Erina 撞见，那事情就会天翻地覆……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I looked at the building from behind a car. I couldn't see light through any of the windows, and nobody else was close by.
entries.new: 我躲在一辆车后面打量那栋房子。没有一扇窗透出灯光，附近也没有别人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I needed to make up my mind, but it was impossible...! If I pressed the button next to the door, the rest of my life might have gone up in smoke.
entries.new: 我必须下定决心，可这根本做不到……！只要按下门旁的那个按钮，我的余生说不定就会化为泡影。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Is it true that the past will only change if I want it to? If so, I could try to ring without that being my intention, but that's so risky. I don't know how it works...!
entries.new: 过去真的只在我希望它改变时才会改变吗？如果是这样，我大可以试着在不抱此意的情况下按铃，可这太冒险了。我根本不知道其中的原理……！
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I felt my heart racing as I worried about making any rushed action.
entries.new: 我害怕自己一时冲动做出什么，心脏怦怦直跳。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Should I just watch from here and try to observe who the friend is?{w} Maybe I should just leave. I know where Isla lives now, so I can try to prevent them from going to the tower on the 15th.{w} That might be best.
entries.new: 还是说，我该在这里守着，看看那位朋友究竟是谁？{w} 也许我干脆离开算了。我已经知道 Isla 住在哪里，可以设法阻止她们在十五号那天去塔里。{w} 那样或许最好。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: If I were to do that, and Isla's friend is really herself, she'd end up in the same situation as me, stuck in a world with two versions of her.{w} What will happen after that? How would the world even take it? If they don't go to the tower, Isla won't be able to travel to the past. Will that simply not matter, and both of them will continue to live?{w} If her existence gets overwritten, mine will be too, right?
entries.new: 可要是我真那么做，而 Isla 的朋友确实就是她自己，那她就会落到和我一样的境地——被困在一个同时存在两个自己的世界里。{w} 之后会怎样？世界又承受得住吗？如果她们不去那座塔，Isla 就无法穿越到过去。难道这根本无关紧要，两个人都能继续活下去？{w} 可要是她的存在被覆盖，我的存在不也会一样吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: How was I supposed to reason any of that out when I knew nothing about what would happen?
entries.new: 我对将会发生什么一无所知，又怎么可能理得清这些？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Time was passing with no progress being made. Every time I questioned what to do, the same fundamental bifurcation emerged; I needed to know what I wanted.
entries.new: 时间一点点流逝，事情却毫无进展。每当我自问该怎么办，总会面临同一个根本的分岔；我必须弄清自己究竟想要什么。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Can I not do it? Is it actually impossible to decide?
entries.new: 难道我做不到吗？难道真的无法做出决定？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It shouldn't be, right? Even if I don't like any of the choices, there has to be one I prefer.{w} If they're all equally bad, then I can just choose one to stick to, can't I? I can just decide my entire life like that.
entries.new: 不该如此吧？就算没有哪个选项让我满意，总该有一个相对能接受的。{w} 要是它们一样糟，那我随便挑一个坚持到底不就行了？我的人生就可以这样定下来。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I need to do it, and this is when. I'm stretching out the time I have too much, and I could end up immensely regretting it at any point.
entries.new: 我必须做出决定，就是现在。我拖得太久了，随时都可能追悔莫及。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I just have to decide now. Even if I wish I'd made another choice later, I can't know that now. So I just need to make the decision based on what I feel at this moment.
entries.new: 现在就必须决定。就算日后会后悔当初该选另一个，此刻的我也无从知晓。既然如此，我只能凭此刻的心意来选。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: But even after thinking all that, I didn't move from behind the car. My thoughts were in complete disarray.
entries.new: 可即便想通了这些，我仍没有从车后挪开半步。思绪乱成一团。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I finally stepped out and inspected the dark windows. If I didn't care about changing the past again, trying to reach Isla's friend was the right call.
entries.new: 我终于走了出来，打量着那些昏暗的窗户。如果我毫不在乎再次改变过去，那么设法接触 Isla 的朋友才是正确的选择。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But of course I cared. I couldn't suddenly press a button that would influence my whole life.
entries.new: 可我当然在乎。我不可能贸然按下那个会影响我一生的按钮。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I looked at the way I'd come from.{w} Nobody was there.
entries.new: 我回头望向来路。{w} 空无一人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I could see my footprints coming toward me, so I quietly traced them, peeking at the previous street.
entries.new: 我能看见自己的脚印一路延伸过来，便顺着脚印悄悄回望，窥探先前的那条街。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Again, nobody was in sight.
entries.new: 依旧不见半个人影。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I had felt the same sensation as the day before. I didn't know if I'd noticed a sound or a movement, but my head had suddenly turned to that corner.{w} I looked at the ground, but many footprints were there, and due to the falling snow, it was hard to tell which were recent.
entries.new: 我又有了和昨天相同的感觉。我分不清自己是听见了声响还是看到了动静，头却猛地转向了那个角落。{w} 我低头看地面，那里脚印杂乱，加上落雪不停，很难分辨哪些是新的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Is it just me? ...It's not, right?{w} Yesterday, someone was definitely following me. Did I only imagine it this time?
entries.new: 是我的错觉吗？……不是吧？{w} 昨天确实有人在跟踪我。这一次难道只是我多心了？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I looked left and right, confirming I was alone.
entries.new: 我左右张望，确认四下无人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I still felt that Vaisude might have followed me, but he wouldn't do it again...
entries.new: 我仍觉得可能是 Vaisude 跟了过来，可他不会再做这种事了吧……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Could it be Isla...?{w} No, the footprints I saw yesterday belonged to an adult.
entries.new: 会是 Isla 吗……？{w} 不对，昨天我看到的脚印分明属于一个成年人。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I tried to compose myself and walked farther into the street.
entries.new: 我定了定神，继续朝街道深处走去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I should just leave. I'm not gonna be able to ring the bell.
entries.new: 我还是走吧。这门铃，我终究按不下去。
