entries.text: Perfect. Have you come here before? I don't think you have.
entries.new: 好的。你以前来过吗？我想应该没有吧。
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: ...No, I have. I came a while ago, but I'd forgotten to check if I'd won anything until now.
entries.new: ……不，我来过。之前来过一次，只是一直忘了来核对有没有中奖。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Ah, I see. What would you like, then?
entries.new: 啊，原来如此。那么你想查点什么？
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: I thought about how to phrase the few questions I had.
entries.new: 我在心里琢磨着，该怎么把想问的几个问题说出口。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The number I had was for December 1st, I believe. I wonder, by the way, how long would it be valid for?
entries.new: 我记得我买的那组号码是十二月一日的。对了，请问它的有效期有多久？
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Oh, it's still valid, don't worry. They last a whole year.{w} Anyway, December 1st? Let me see.
entries.new: 哦，还来得及，不用担心，有效期整整一年。{w} 话说回来，十二月一日是吧？我看看。
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: I hadn't been sure what day to say, but I hadn't wanted to ask for the previous day's. If I went back to November, I'd change the past in a considerable way. Then, the butterfly effect could affect what I was doing.{w} I knew each digit of a winning lottery number was manually drawn every time, so if I changed the past and made it back to the same day, it was entirely possible the latest winning number would differ. A mere millisecond of difference could result in a different draw. I'd chosen December 1st because it was the next day after Miiya's death, and I didn't know how far back I'd end up being able to go.
entries.new: 我拿不准该报哪一天，却又不愿问前一天的开奖结果。若回到十一月，过去就会被大幅改动，随之而来的蝴蝶效应也可能波及我眼下要做的事。{w} 我知道中奖号码的每一位都是每次人工摇出的，所以只要改动过去、再回到同一天，最新的中奖号码完全可能变掉——哪怕只差一毫秒，摇出的结果也会不同。我选十二月一日，是因为那是 Miiya 死后的第二天，而我不清楚自己究竟能回到多久以前。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: After looking at a computer screen for a few seconds, the woman voiced a number.
entries.new: 那女人盯着电脑屏幕看了几秒，报出了一串数字。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: December 1st... I'm assuming you bought a standard Lotus-6 combination, correct?
entries.new: 十二月一日……我猜你买的是标准的 Lotus-6 组合，对吧？
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: ...Yes.
entries.new: ……是的。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: On December 1st, the number drawn was 30-05-12-31-15-26, and the bonus number was 24.
entries.new: 十二月一日开出的号码是 30-05-12-31-15-26，特别号码是 24。
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: ...Ah, I don't think that was it. It would've been great to win on the first attempt.
entries.new: ……啊，好像不是这组。要是第一次就中了，那该多好。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Do you have the ticket? You might've won one of the secondary prizes if any of the last numbers coincide.
entries.new: 你带着彩票吗？只要尾号有对上的，说不定能中个次级奖项。
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: ...I didn't bring it, no. I'm sure none match, though.
entries.new: ……没有，我没带。不过我确定一个都没对上。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: I see. That's unfortunate.{w} Do you want to try again?
entries.new: 这样啊，那真是可惜。{w} 你要再买一组吗？
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: Maybe. I have a couple questions, though. I've always been curious about this.
entries.new: 也许吧。不过我想先问几个问题，这些事我一直挺好奇的。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Would I be able to ask for a specific number that I want?
entries.new: 我可以指定自己想要的号码吗？
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Yes, that's possible. We tend to sell packs of five different combinations, but you can also choose the numbers you want if it's what you prefer.
entries.new: 可以。我们通常是五组不同号码打包出售，不过如果你愿意，也可以自己挑号码。
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: All right.{w} How much would I have won if all the digits matched?
entries.new: 好的。{w} 要是数字全对，能中多少钱？
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Let me see...{w} The main prize money of December 1st was ¥917,999,011.{w} It's even higher now. Nobody's won the jackpot in a while.
entries.new: 我看看……{w} 十二月一日的头奖金额是 917,999,011 日元。{w} 现在更高了，已经有一阵子没人中头奖。
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: Oh, wow. I'm not sure what I'd do with so much money.
entries.new: 哇……这么多钱，我都不知道该怎么花。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Some people say it's unlucky to win that much. It has ruined people's lives.
entries.new: 有人说中这么大一笔钱反而不吉利，它毁掉过别人的人生。
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: Yeah, I would be very overwhelmed.
entries.new: 是啊，我大概会不知所措吧。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: I don't remember: how much does buying a number cost?
entries.new: 我记不清了，买一组号码要多少钱？
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: It's just ¥200.
entries.new: 只要 200 日元。
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: I see. ...Is it possible to buy a number that will be played the same day you buy it?
entries.new: 原来如此。……能不能买当天就开奖的号码？
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Yes, but only before {time=17.} You don't have to worry about this today since the next Lotus-6 will be held on the 5th, this Thursday.
entries.new: 可以，不过得在 {time=17.} 之前买。今天不用着急，下一期 Lotus-6 是这周四（5号）开奖。
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: Ah, I understand. I think I'll come back, then. I'd like to think about the number I want.
entries.new: 啊，我明白了。那我改天再来吧，我想好好想想选哪组号码。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: That's perfectly fine. I hope you're right on the mark.
entries.new: 当然可以。祝你一击即中。
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: Me too.{w} I'm sorry for having so many questions, but if I won, would my identity have to be revealed?
entries.new: 我也希望如此。{w} 抱歉问了这么多，不过如果我中了奖，身份会被公开吗？
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Oh, no, Japanese law doesn't enforce that.
entries.new: 哦，不会，日本法律没有这样的规定。
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: ...And how long would I have to wait to receive the money?
entries.new: ……那奖金要等多久才能到手？
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: No more than two weeks. You'd be able to choose whether to receive the full amount at once or monthly. You wouldn't have to worry about taxes, either.
entries.new: 最多两周。你可以选一次性领取全额，也可以按月领取，税也不用操心。
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: Thank you! I was always curious about this.
entries.new: 谢谢！这些事我一直很好奇。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: I'm glad I could help. I'll see you next time.
entries.new: 能帮上忙就好。那下次见。
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: I bowed and walked out.
entries.new: 我行了一礼，走出店门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I began to walk down the street, repeating the numbers mentally. While writing them down was a good idea, I had to ensure I could memorize them, because it was likely any written note would disappear if I traveled far to the past again, just like the knife had.
entries.new: 我沿着街道往前走，边走边在心里默念那串号码。写下来固然稳妥，但我必须确保自己记得住——因为若再次穿越到遥远的过去，任何写下的字条多半都会像那把刀一样消失。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'll probably just get in big trouble. Within two weeks, I'd receive the money in my bank account, so I'd probably have to take out the money before the other me notices what happened...
entries.new: 搞不好只会惹上大麻烦。两周之内，钱就会打进我的账户，所以我大概得赶在另一个我发现之前把钱取出来……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: For that, I'd have to duplicate my bank card or try to take it out of the other me's purse.{w} What would I do if I saw that so much money was added and immediately taken from my account? If it was investigated, security cameras would probably see me in the bank.
entries.new: 为此，我得复制一张银行卡，或者设法从另一个我的钱包里把卡拿出来。{w} 换作是我，看到账户里突然多了一大笔钱、转眼又被人取走，会怎么做？要是有人查起来，监控多半会拍到我在银行里的身影。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Maybe not taking everything would be a good idea. If I leave a part for the other me, would she keep quiet...? I'm not sure what I would do myself in that situation, honestly.
entries.new: 也许不把钱全部取走比较好。如果给另一个我留下一部分，她会不声张吗……？说实话，换成我自己处在那种境地，我也不知道会怎么做。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I could hardly take those thoughts seriously. ...Had I really assumed that I'd try to go live far away all by myself?
entries.new: 这些念头，我实在没法当真。……难道我真的以为自己会独自远走他乡、在那里生活下去吗？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: She also said that she'd never seen me there before. I suppose that means that there currently is no me who bought that number after going to the past. Of course, that will only happen when history is greatly altered, so it isn't the case yet.
entries.new: 她还说从没见过我去那里。看来，眼下并不存在一个回到过去、买下那组号码的我。当然，那要等历史被大幅改动之后才会发生，所以现在还不是那样。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I still felt a little unsure. Would the number stay the same if I changed the past even a little bit...?
entries.new: 我心里仍有些没底。哪怕只把过去改动一点点，那组号码还会一样吗……？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: On December 1st, I will already have changed the past. However, I guess that if I travel to days before the 30th, I'll be able to obtain the Sekimeiya myself and redo this in a way so that the past only changes when I buy the number. I guess the past wouldn't even have to change in that instance. Buying the ticket wouldn't contradict any previous experiences.
entries.new: 到了十二月一日，我早已改变了过去。不过我想，如果能穿越到三十日之前，我就能亲自拿到 Sekimeiya，把整件事重新安排，让过去只在我买下号码的那一刻才发生改变。那样的话，过去甚至根本不必改变——买下那张彩票，也不会与任何已有的经历相矛盾。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: A bit of snow was still falling, but it was hard to see it without looking at the streetlights. Yawning as I went, I walked back over my own steps until I arrived at my apartment.
entries.new: 雪还在零星地落着，若不往路灯下细看，几乎分辨不出。我一路打着哈欠，踩着来时的脚印走回公寓。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I stepped in, leaving my coat and boots behind as usual. I thought of trying to eat something else, but I was too tired to bother, and nothing I had was appetizing anyway.
entries.new: 我进了门，照例脱下外套和靴子。本想再吃点别的，可实在懒得费那个劲，何况家里也没有一样能勾起胃口的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I changed into the same nightwear and turned off the light in the entrance.
entries.new: 我换上那套睡衣，关掉了玄关的灯。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I took a piece of paper and a pen out of a drawer. Just in case, I wrote down the winning combination.
entries.new: 我从抽屉里取出纸笔，为防万一，把那串中奖号码记了下来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: After that, I straightened up my blankets and buried myself underneath them, leaving my phone by the side of my bed.
entries.new: 之后我铺好被子，钻进里面，把手机搁在床边。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Mom hasn't tried to call me again. I wonder what happened with that.
entries.new: ……妈妈没再打来过电话。也不知道那件事后来怎么样了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Once again, I found myself comfortably lying on my soft mattress while another version of myself was suffering in the hospital.
entries.new: 我再一次舒舒服服地躺在柔软的床垫上，而另一个我却在医院里受苦。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I moreso felt bad for the me I was, who only had two last opportunities to appreciate the touch of that old bed.
entries.new: 说起来，我反倒更心疼现在的自己——还能再感受那张旧床触感的机会，只剩最后两次了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...What was it?
entries.new: ……是什么来着？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I felt my head hurt a bit, but I tried to recall the winning combination before looking at the bedside table.
entries.new: 头有点发疼，但我还是先努力回想那串号码，然后才望向床头柜。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I felt like I'd only slept for the blink of an eye, as I vividly remembered the thoughts I'd had in the evening. I looked up, still covering my eyes with the bed sheets.
entries.new: 仿佛只睡了一眨眼的工夫，昨晚的念头却还清清楚楚。我抬起头，被子仍蒙着眼睛。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Saving Reverie
entries.new: 拯救幻梦

entries.text: ...I shuffled the blankets aside. I'd gotten too used to the feeling of waking up to a warm room. It was almost more pleasant than being covered in softness.
entries.new: ……我把被子掀到一边。我已经太习惯醒来时满屋的暖意，那感觉几乎胜过被褥裹身的柔软。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I didn't want to spend a long time in bed, so I pushed myself to get up.
entries.new: 我不想在床上赖太久，便硬撑着起了身。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I raised the blinds, filling the bedroom with light. Behind the glass was the still image of a white Yushibana with the sun already up.
entries.new: 我拉起百叶窗，光线顿时灌满卧室。玻璃窗外，朝阳已升，丰花铺成一片静止的白。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The snow had ceased during the night, and a bit of fog was all that remained, especially prominent in the distant mountains. It was a beautiful and peaceful thing to see, but I felt some deep strain as well.
entries.new: 雪在夜里停了，只余下薄薄的雾气，远山一带尤为明显。那景致宁静而美，我心里却隐隐绷着一根弦。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: My phone showed {time=9:57.} I had no plans for the day, but it was a very special one. Like usual, I stepped to the bathroom and rubbed my eyes.
entries.new: 手机显示 {time=9:57.} 今天没有任何安排，却是格外特殊的一天。我照常走进卫生间，揉了揉眼睛。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I still had two cereal bars left. I tossed the wrappers in the trash and started to eat them as I tiredly stretched my arms.
entries.new: 麦片棒还剩两根。我把包装纸丢进垃圾袋，一边倦倦地伸着胳膊，一边吃了起来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'd been nervously pacing as I ate them and stopped myself as soon as I realized it.{w} I didn't have anything to do, and repeatedly going over the same thoughts was only stressful. I'd decided to spend my final free day in as relaxing of a manner as I could manage, but I couldn't let myself keep worrying about losing precious time.
entries.new: 吃着吃着，我才察觉自己一直不安地来回踱步，便立刻停住。{w} 我无事可做，反复琢磨同一件事只会徒增压力。我早已决定，最后一个自由的日子要尽量过得轻松，可又没法不去担心白白耗掉时间。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I went back to my bedroom and looked at the wardrobe to pick something to change into.
entries.new: 我回到卧室，望着衣柜挑选要换的衣服。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I stared at what I had. I'd been selecting random clothes for the past few days, but I found myself thinking a little harder about it.{w} I had a blue hoodie that I really liked in mind, but I couldn't find it, so I ended up grabbing a long-sleeved orange shirt instead.
entries.new: 我盯着柜里的衣物。这几天我都是随手抓一件，这回却不由自主地多琢磨了几分。{w} 我惦记着一件很中意的蓝色连帽衫，可怎么也找不到，只好拿了件橙色长袖衬衫。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: My laundry basket was nearly full. The previous day's clothes were there, and it had been a while since I'd washed them.
entries.new: 洗衣篮快满了。昨天的衣服都在里面，距上次洗衣已经有些日子。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Doing the laundry most certainly didn't matter anymore, but I dragged the basket to the kitchen nonetheless. The washing machine was there, next to another basket which was close to full.
entries.new: 洗衣服这事早已毫无意义，我还是把篮子拖去了厨房。洗衣机就在那里，旁边另有一只同样快满的篮子。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I tended to prioritize washing what I left in my bedroom, but I still had the blue hoodie in mind, so I rifled through both piles.
entries.new: 我惯常先洗卧室里那一篮，可心里还惦记着蓝连帽衫，便在两堆衣服里都翻了一遍。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I wasn't able to find it with a cursory inspection, but I didn't want to empty both baskets just for that, so I began to fill the washer.
entries.new: 粗略翻找并没有找到，我也不愿为一件衣服把两篮全倒出来，便开始往洗衣机里装。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The machine wasn't too spacious, so I could only pick out part of the basket. Once I'd filled it with the top half, I pushed the round door shut and poured in a bit of laundry detergent.
entries.new: 机器容量不大，一篮只能装下一部分。我装满上面那半篮，把圆形舱门推上，又倒进些洗衣液。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I had a number of clothes at home that I'd accumulated throughout the years, but since they were all on the cheap side, I didn't trust using hot water. When I pressed the big blue button, "30:00" appeared in red digits on the screen and began to count down.
entries.new: 家里这些年攒下不少衣服，可件件都便宜，我不敢用热水洗。按下那个蓝色大按钮后，屏幕上浮出红色的「30:00」，开始倒数。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I grabbed the lighter bucket and brought it back to my bedroom, where it was more convenient.
entries.new: 我拎起较轻的那只桶，拿回卧室，在那里收拾起来更方便。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I ended up sitting on the carpet. I was trying to calm my nerves, but as soon as I made any attempt to stop thinking, it became incredibly difficult.
entries.new: 最后我在地毯上坐了下来。我试着让心神安定，可越是想停下思绪，就越是艰难。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I wanted to go out again, somewhere. Staying still, the mess of emotions inside me was uncontrollable.
entries.new: 我想再出门去，去哪儿都好。就这样干坐着，心里翻涌的情绪根本压不住。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Does it even matter, though? I can go to Ina, but it's not fair to say goodbye to someone without them knowing it, and I'd just be so sad without being able to say why...
entries.new: 可这又有什么意义？我可以去伊娜，但瞒着对方道别并不公平，而且连理由都说不出口，只会让我更难过得要命……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Then, the past would change, and that'd be overwritten anyway.
entries.new: 再说，过去一旦改变，那些也都会被覆盖掉。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...I really tried to keep my mood pleasant. It was possible I wouldn't find the Sekimeiya the next day, and even after traveling, I could go to Ina Café before the 30th to reach a time that wouldn't be deleted.
entries.new: 我真的很努力想让心情保持愉快。也许第二天找不到 Sekimeiya；就算穿越之后，我也可以在30日之前去伊娜咖啡馆，进入一段不会被抹去的时间。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The time had been passing far too fast, so I rested my head on a pillow, knowing that would slow it down. I stayed there for a few minutes and listened to the washer work. Even if doing the laundry didn't matter, my clothes could get moldy if they stayed inside for too long...
entries.new: 时间流逝得太快了，我把头枕在枕头上，知道这样能让它慢下来。我就那样待了几分钟，听着洗衣机运转的声响。洗衣服虽已无关紧要，可衣服闷在里面太久也会发霉……
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I heard it running from the living room. When the intensity increased, I knew the spin-dry had begun and that only a few minutes were left. I went to check.
entries.new: 我在客厅就听得见它运转。声音一急，我便知道是脱水开始了，只剩几分钟。我过去看了看。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I could see the meshed clothes rapidly spinning behind the glass, and the countdown approaching the last three minutes.
entries.new: 隔着舱门玻璃，能看见缠搅在一起的衣物飞速旋转，倒计时也快到三分钟了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I watched the seconds tick until four zeros filled the screen. Then, I grabbed the plastic handle and opened the door. I placed a blue bucket below it and dropped the compact, wet mess of clothes in it.
entries.new: 我盯着秒数跳动，直到屏幕上剩下四个零。随后我抓住塑料把手打开舱门，把蓝桶放在下面，将那团紧实潮湿的衣服塞了进去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I dragged it to the wardrobe as well. I didn't have a dryer, so since the outside was freezing, I had to use a foldable washing line with the help of the heater.
entries.new: 我把它也拖到衣柜旁。家里没有烘干机，外面又天寒地冻，只能靠取暖器，用折叠晾衣架来晾。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I made room on the floor and opened it up, proceeding to grab the pieces and hang them individually.
entries.new: 我在地板上腾出地方，撑开晾衣架，接着一件件拿起来挂好。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: They weren't too wet, so I kept crouching and using as few of my scarce clothespins as possible.{w} I took out a pretty blue and white shirt. I figured that I was still pretty tired since I thought I'd left it out of the washer due to the bad memories it brought, but I still hung it properly and kept going.
entries.new: 衣服不算太湿，我便一直蹲着，尽量少用那些本就不多的衣夹。{w} 我取出一件漂亮的蓝白衬衫。我大概是太累了，竟以为是因为它勾起的不好回忆，才没把它放进洗衣机。但我还是把它好好挂上，继续干活。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I was done fairly quickly and looked at the neatly-hung laundry that would likely never be used. I turned around, looking down at my feet until I got to the front door.
entries.new: 没多会儿就晾完了。我望着那一排多半再也用不上的衣服，转过身，低着头一路走到玄关。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'd been going outside without a defined reason, and I felt obligated to do it again. Spending the entire day inside would have been too difficult.
entries.new: 我这些天出门都没什么明确理由，可还是觉得该再出去一趟。整天闷在屋里，实在熬不住。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I got ready to leave and recalled I'd left my purse in my bedroom, so I went to grab it along with my phone.
entries.new: 我做好出门的准备，想起钱包落在卧室，便回去连同手机一起拿了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I was about to reach for the front door, but I walked to the kitchen instead, remembering the garbage bag where I'd thrown the cereal bar wrappers. It was almost full, so I made a knot with the bands and returned.
entries.new: 我正要伸手开门，却又想起装麦片棒包装的垃圾袋，便拐进厨房。袋子快满了，我把抽绳打了个结，再回到门口。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I pushed away a bit of snow that had accumulated on the ground, just like most of the neighboring apartments had.
entries.new: 我把地上积的薄雪推到一边，附近人家大多也是这么做的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The cold was still biting, but I'd come to expect it by that point. Stepping with satisfying crunches, I went down the stairs. The sky had cleared completely, and the street seemed especially bright. I walked the opposite way as usual, toward the garbage bins.
entries.new: 寒气依旧刺骨，可我早已习惯。脚下踩着雪，发出舒服的咯吱声，我走下楼梯。天空彻底放晴，街道显得格外明亮。我朝与平日相反的方向走去，往垃圾桶那边去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: They were at the very end of the street, past the curve that could be seen in the distance.
entries.new: 它们就在街道最尽头，过了远处那道弯。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I threw the bag in the bin for combustibles and started to walk toward the center of Yushibana.
entries.new: 我把袋子扔进可燃垃圾箱，随后朝丰花的中心走去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: As opposed to the previous day, my first view of Ramon was the crowded street it had always been. After crossing the road, I walked near the left buildings until I was on the thinner path.
entries.new: 与昨天不同，我第一眼看到的拉蒙街，还是它向来那副熙攘模样。穿过马路后，我贴着左侧的建筑走，一直走到那条较窄的小路。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Of course, Ina was open. I saw the large screen of glass and Darfee behind the counter, seemingly texting with his phone.
entries.new: 伊娜咖啡馆当然开着。我望见那面巨大的玻璃屏，还有柜台后的 Darfee，他似乎正在用手机发消息。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Oh, hey! I'm glad to see you've taken a liking to this place again.
entries.new: ……哦，是你啊！你能重新喜欢上这地方，我很高兴。
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: ...Yeah.
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: I stepped up to the bar. Like the previous day, there was no one inside at that time.
entries.new: 我走到吧台前。和昨天一样，那个时间店里没有别的客人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: How are you?
entries.new: 你还好吗？
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: I'm okay.
entries.new: 还好。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: I must have looked a little worse than before. I figured he thought it was just due to Miiya's death, but there was much more affecting me than solely that.
entries.new: 我看起来一定比之前更憔悴了些。我猜他只当是 Miiya 的死让我变成这样，可压在我心上的远不止那一件事。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Do you want one of these?
entries.new: 要来一个吗？
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: He pointed at the pastries I'd been eating across the past couple of days.
entries.new: 他指的是我这两天一直在吃的那种点心。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Yeah, I'm hungry.
entries.new: ……嗯，我饿了。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: He grabbed a small plate from below the counter and placed it in front of me with the pastry. I bit into it, a little bit tired of eating the same thing repeatedly, but glad that I at least had the option.
entries.new: 他从柜台下取出一个小碟子，连点心一起放到我面前。我咬了一口——同样的东西连着吃有点腻，但至少还有得选，我挺高兴。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Going to sit at the same place again?
entries.new: 还是要坐老位子？
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: I turned to the table he was pointing to.{w} As I spun, something caught my eye.
entries.new: 我朝他指的那张桌子转过身去。{w}就在转身的一瞬，有什么东西映入了我的眼帘。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There was a TV close to the entrance. It was muted, but I could see a reporter speaking into a microphone.{w} I recalled the words of the police officer.
entries.new: 入口附近有台电视，没开声音，但能看见一名记者正对着话筒讲话。{w}我想起了那名警察说过的话。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I will, yeah.
entries.new: 嗯，我会的。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: I grabbed the plate and stepped back, but I sat on the opposite chair from last time so that I could see the screen.
entries.new: 我端起碟子退开，却坐到了和上次相对的椅子上，好让自己能看见屏幕。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Would it be announced today...? That seems unlikely.
entries.new: 今天就会公布吗……？不太可能吧。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: But as soon as I sat on the chair, I read the white text at the bottom of the screen, which had just changed from a different headline.
entries.new: 可我刚一坐下，就看清了屏幕底部那行白色文字——它刚刚才从另一条标题换成了这个。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Stopping Power
entries.new: 停止作用

entries.text: "Xyn member caught for the first time yesterday in Yushibana".
entries.new: 「Xyn 成员昨日在丰花首次落网」。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I had to read it two more times. That didn't make sense.
entries.new: 我又读了两遍。这说不通。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Can you turn the volume up, please?
entries.new: ……能麻烦你把声音调大吗？
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Darfee looked at the TV, and when he read what it said, he did as I asked despite his own surprise.
entries.new: Darfee 看向电视，读清上面的字之后，尽管自己也吃了一惊，还是照我说的做了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Before he did, the image changed. That time, I immediately recognized what I saw, but once again, it didn't make any sense.
entries.new: 还没等他调，画面就换了。这一次，我一眼就认出了看到的东西，可它同样说不通。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What the hell...? ...Wasn't that in the newspaper?
entries.new: 搞什么……？……那不是报纸上的吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: The voice of the reporter began to reach us, and when it did, the image had transitioned once again.{w} For a second, it had been a short video recorded from a security camera. It showed a prison cell and a person in prison clothing hard to recognize due to the high angle.
entries.new: 记者的声音传了过来，画面也就在这时又切换了。{w}刚才那一瞬，是一段监控摄像头拍下的短片：一间牢房，一个穿着囚服的人，因拍摄角度太高而难以辨认。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...ested yesterday in a lonely street of Yushibana. He is believed to be a member of the criminal group Xyn, but his identity is unknown.
entries.new: ……昨日在丰花一条僻静的街上被捕。据信他是犯罪组织 Xyn 的成员，但身份尚不明确。
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: What...?
entries.new: 什么……？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I tried to give meaning to those words, but I couldn't. The brief footage had been almost identical to the picture from the newspaper, and they were saying that the man's identity was unknown, just like in that article.
entries.new: 我试着弄清这些话的含义，却怎么也想不通。刚才那段短短的影像和报纸上的照片几乎一模一样，而他们说的是此人的身份不明——和那篇文章里写的一样。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: An interrogation is taking place, and the police are actively attempting to identify the suspect. This is likely to be the first member of the group to be caught, so the situation is being properly taken care of.
entries.new: 审讯正在进行，警方正积极确认嫌疑人身份。这很可能是该组织首次有成员落网，所以相关情况正在妥善处理。
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: After those words, the reporter bowed, and an ad began to play.
entries.new: 说完，记者鞠了一躬，随后开始播放广告。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I looked at Darfee, who appeared confused as well. Before he could say anything, I stood up and approached a table next to the counter.
entries.new: 我看向 Darfee，他似乎也一头雾水。没等他开口，我便起身走向吧台旁的一张桌子。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'd seen a pile of newspapers there before, and it hadn't moved. Immediately, I saw that the one I'd read was still there, facing down. I opened it and rushed to the first two pages.
entries.new: 之前我在那里见过一叠报纸，一直没被动过。我一眼就认出，自己读过的那份还在，正面朝下。我把它翻开，急急翻到前两页。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It's here—what was just shown looked exactly like this picture.
entries.new: 在这儿——刚才电视上放的，和这张照片一模一样。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Darfee was looking at me with a serious face, and I brought the newspaper to him.
entries.new: Darfee 一脸严肃地看着我，我把报纸递了过去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Sorry, I might be going insane, but I could've sworn I'd seen that before. Wasn't it exactly like this?
entries.new: 抱歉，我可能有点神志不清了，但我敢肯定以前见过那个。不就是这个样子吗？
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: U-Uh...
entries.new: 呃、嗯……
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: He looked at the article I was pointing to and narrowed his eyebrows further.
entries.new: 他看着我指的那篇文章，眉头皱得更紧了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Y-You're right... It's the same cell, but this says it's from November 24th.
entries.new: 你、你说得对……是同一间牢房，可这里写着是 11 月 24 日。
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: Didn't the person also look the same?
entries.new: 那个人看起来不也一样吗？
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Did he...? I couldn't get a good look at him, but I can't in this picture either.
entries.new: 有吗……？我没能看清他的脸，这张照片也看不清。
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: He began to read the text.
entries.new: 他开始读正文。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I never learned about this... On November 24th, a prisoner escaped from a cell.{w} But Xyn isn't mentioned here even though they also said the identity of the person wasn't known.{w} ...How's that possible? They don't know the identity of someone they arrested?
entries.new: 这件事我从没听说过……11 月 24 日，一名囚犯从牢房里逃走了。{w}可这里没提到 Xyn，尽管同样说此人的身份不明。{w}……这怎么可能？人都抓到了，还不知道是谁？
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: I looked back at the TV, but it was still only ads.
entries.new: 我回头看向电视，屏幕上仍只有广告。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Yeah, it's strange. My mind immediately went to this article, but there's probably no correlation. Every cell must be recorded from this angle, so to me it seemed like they were the same.
entries.new: 是啊，真奇怪。我一下子就想到了这篇文章，不过大概没什么关联。每间牢房应该都是从同一个角度拍的，所以在我看来才像是同一间。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Ah, it could be that.
entries.new: 啊，说不定真是这样。
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: I sat on the chair again. Of course, it was no coincidence.
entries.new: 我又坐回椅子上。当然，这并非巧合。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The person who'd been arrested had been following me, meaning that it was very likely they had come from the future. Then, the person from the article had appeared in the cell on the 24th, a day I knew for a fact people had arrived at from the 15th.
entries.new: 被捕的那个人一直在跟踪我，可见他极可能来自未来。而报道中的那人，是在24日出现在牢房里的；我确切知道，曾有人从15日穿越到那一天。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What the hell was going on, then? Could they have been the same person? A few days earlier, they'd appeared in that cell. The previous day, they'd been arrested.{w} What kind of coincidence was that? Had he been sent to the same cell? Had the police not realized that he was the person who'd escaped on the 24th? And why was his identity unknown if they thought he was a Xyn member?
entries.new: 那么，究竟发生了什么？会不会是同一个人？几天前，那人出现在那间牢房里；而昨天，他又被捕了。{w}这算什么样的巧合？他是被关进了同一间牢房吗？警方难道没发现，他就是24日逃掉的那个人？可既然他们认为他是Xyn成员，为什么又不知道他的身份？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I was baffled, but an important piece of the puzzle came back to me. Once again, it was what Katei told us.
entries.new: 我一时理不清头绪，但拼图中重要的一块又浮现在脑海里。又是Katei对我们说过的那件事。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Xyn had attempted to steal the Sekimeiya once before the 15th. They failed, and while the police had the chance to catch a Xyn member, they escaped.{w} I couldn't remember the exact way it was phrased, but that had happened once before the 15th...
entries.new: Xyn曾在15日之前试图偷走Sekimeiya。他们失败了，警方本有机会抓住一名Xyn成员，却还是让对方逃掉了。{w}我记不清原话是怎么说的，但15日之前确实发生过这样一件事……
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What is the connection between the article and this arrest...?
entries.new: 那篇报道和这次逮捕之间，到底有什么联系……？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I couldn't help but feel that something was incredibly backward. The resemblance between both events was undeniable. Even Darfee immediately noticed it, unaware of the extra links I knew regarding the person and the Sekimeiya's travel.
entries.new: 我不由得觉得，有什么地方完全反了。两件事的相似之处无可否认。连Darfee都立刻注意到了，只是他并不知道我还掌握着那人与Sekimeiya穿越之间的额外关联。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: They caught a Xyn member for the first time.{w} ...But they'll escape before the 15th. Katei and the article prove that.
entries.new: 他们第一次抓住了一名Xyn成员。{w}……但在15日之前，那人会逃掉。Katei和那篇报道都能证明这一点。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It couldn't be so straightforward because the article discussed an event from November 24th. While both events couldn't be the very same, they couldn't be separate either.
entries.new: 事情不可能这么简单，因为报道讲的是11月24日的事。两件事虽然不可能是同一件，却又不可能彼此无关。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I ate what remained of the pastry, trying to clear the cloudy confusion that had arisen in my mind. Behind both of those events was the Sekimeiya—that by itself already gave away that something unnatural was at work.
entries.new: 我吃掉剩下的点心，想把脑中那片混沌的困惑驱散。两件事背后都有Sekimeiya——单凭这一点，就已经说明有某种超乎常理的东西在起作用。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There's something crucial that I can't ignore.{w} In both cases, someone ended up in a prison cell. I don't know if the same person was caught both times, but it's very likely they came from the future. So, anything regarding them could differ from the reality I know.
entries.new: 有一点至关重要，我不能忽略。{w}两起事件里，都有人被关进了牢房。我不知道两次被抓的是不是同一个人，但那人极有可能来自未来。所以，任何与他有关的事，都可能和我所知道的现实不同。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: The Xyn member who traveled from the 15th could've already changed this. If he got arrested after traveling in this reality, there would be a second Xyn member caught after the first time—the person from the future who was following me.
entries.new: 从15日穿越来的Xyn成员可能已经改变了这一点。若他在这个现实中穿越后被捕，那就会是在第一次之后又有一名Xyn成员被抓——也就是那个从未来来、跟踪我的人。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...{w}Trying to work it all out, I'd locked up.
entries.new: ……{w}我试图理清这一切，脑子却僵住了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wasn't there something else Katei said? ...That Ashiya or the police chose not to reveal that they'd almost caught a Xyn member before they'd escaped.
entries.new: Katei是不是还说过别的？……芦屋或警方选择不公开他们差点抓到一名Xyn成员、但最终还是让对方逃掉的事。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Doesn't this fit all too well with the article? If both events are connected, the fact that the person in the cell was a Xyn member must match as well. However, in the article, that wasn't revealed. ...Could that be the original event that Katei told us about?{w} That person escaped and managed to get to the tower. After that, they traveled to the past and got caught again when they were following me. Somehow, the police still didn't know their identity, but this time it was revealed that they were a Xyn member.
entries.new: 这和那篇报道未免也太吻合了吧？如果两件事有关联，那么牢房里那人是Xyn成员这一点也应该对得上。可报道里并没有提到这一点。……Katei说过的原本那起事件，会不会就是这个？{w}那个人逃掉后设法到了塔里，之后又穿越回过去，在跟踪我时再次被抓。不知为何，警方仍然不知道他的身份，但这一次，他是Xyn成员的事被公开了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: That's right. This must be a change made by a person who traveled from the 15th. After all, someone from Xyn was just revealed to have been caught, which never happened in our reality.
entries.new: 没错。这一定是从15日穿越而来的人造成的改变。毕竟，刚刚公开了一名Xyn成员被捕的消息，而在我们的现实里，这种事从未发生过。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...But what I just came up with doesn't make sense either.
entries.new: ……可我刚想到的这套说法也说不通。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It doesn't make sense if the person from the 24th really teleported to the cell. Which must have happened, given what I know happened to Vaisude...
entries.new: 如果24日那个人真的是被传送到牢房的，那就说不通了。可我知道Vaisude身上发生了什么，所以这一定发生过……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: If whoever that person was traveled to the cell from the 15th, they couldn't have been the same person to be caught yesterday, because the second arrest must be a new event.{w} Could it be that history was changed, but I still remember the one that both I and that man came from because I also traveled from it?
entries.new: 不管那人是谁，既然他是从15日穿越到牢房的，他就不可能是昨天被抓的同一人，因为第二次逮捕必定是新增的事件。{w}难道说，历史真的被改写了，而我和那个男人都来自原来的历史——因为我也是从那里穿越来的，所以还记得它？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I noticed a mistake I'd made.
entries.new: 我察觉到自己犯了一个错误。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: On the 24th, it's very likely a Xyn member appeared in a cell from the future. Now that I think of it, though, it can't be that he was actually caught and then escaped while Ashiya decided not to reveal he was from Xyn.
entries.new: 24日，极有可能是一名Xyn成员从未来出现在了牢房里。可仔细一想，他不可能真的是被抓到后又逃走，而芦屋决定不公开他是Xyn成员。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: That doesn't match because Katei said they were caught after trying to steal the Sekimeiya before the 15th. It hadn't even been found on the 24th.
entries.new: 这说不通，因为Katei说过，他们是在15日之前试图偷走Sekimeiya后被捕的。可24日时，Sekimeiya甚至还没被找到。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: What the hell, then?
entries.new: 那到底是怎么回事？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I had very little information, so I looked at the screen when I heard the news had come back. Unfortunately, they began to talk about a different topic, and Darfee quickly turned down the volume and looked at me.
entries.new: 我掌握的信息太少，所以听到新闻重新开始播放时，便看向屏幕。可惜他们很快又聊起了别的话题，Darfee也立刻调低音量，转头看向我。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Nonetheless, it was probably a good thing. A member from Xyn who'd traveled from the 15th had been caught, and since that had been revealed, there was no reason to think he would escape. It was an event that hadn't occurred when we'd originally stepped into the tower.
entries.new: 不过，这大概是件好事。一名从15日穿越来的Xyn成员被捕了，而且这件事已经公开，按理说他就没有理由再逃掉了。这是我们最初进入塔里时未曾发生的事。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Piecing all the details together with what I knew seemed almost impossible, as no possibility made total sense.
entries.new: 要结合我所知道的一切来拼凑所有细节，几乎是不可能的，因为没有哪一种可能完全说得通。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Hm... I did wonder before why he appeared in a jail cell on the 24th.{w} From the 15th, it's very likely he'd appear somewhere he'd been before in the past.
entries.new: 嗯……我之前就纳闷过，他为什么会在24日出现在牢房里。{w}从15日穿越的话，他极有可能出现在自己过去曾待过的地方。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: And now this could fit. If the arrest from yesterday always occurred, the position on the 24th could be based on today.
entries.new: 而现在这就对得上了。如果昨天的逮捕一直都会发生，那么他24日出现的位置，也许就是以今天为基准确定的。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: But then questions like how he was in the tower on the 15th or why he was following me start to crop up.
entries.new: 可这样一来，又冒出了新的疑问：他15日是怎么会在塔里的，又为什么跟踪我？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I slowed down, sensing a headache. No matter what the truth was, it was messy.
entries.new: 我感到一阵头痛，思路也慢了下来。不管真相是什么，事情都乱成一团。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What was the link between both events? Which one was new, and which one had always happened? Regardless of the arrangement I tried, something always seemed to get in the way.
entries.new: 两件事之间究竟有什么联系？哪一件是新增的，哪一件又是一直存在的？无论我怎么排列组合，总有什么地方卡着说不通。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: And when I'd calmed down internally, one option seemed more plausible than the others.
entries.new: 等我内心平静下来，便觉得其中一种可能比其他几种更站得住脚。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I believed that the 30th of November was the day somebody attempted to steal the Sekimeiya. That was probably correct since nobody was caught and no connection to Xyn was made. Katei would've been talking about this.
entries.new: 我原本认为11月30日就是有人试图偷走Sekimeiya的日子。这个判断大概没错，因为那时没人被捕，也没有查出与Xyn的关联。Katei说的应该就是这件事。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: On the 15th, a Xyn member traveled to the 24th and appeared in an unlocked cell. Due to that, he was able to escape.
entries.new: 15日，一名Xyn成员穿越到了24日，出现在一间没有上锁的牢房里。正因如此，他才能逃掉。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: After following me, he was caught yesterday. That changed the past because no Xyn member had been caught yet on the 15th.
entries.new: 后来他跟踪我，在昨天被捕。这改变了过去，因为在15日时，还没有任何Xyn成员被捕。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: What's iffy about this? That their identity was unknown, that the cell could've been the same one...?{w} The fact that they appeared in a cell on the 24th might also be a contradiction—they wouldn't have been there before traveling. I feel like there are more problems, but I don't know how to identify them.
entries.new: 这套说法哪里有问题？他的身份不明，那间牢房又可能是同一间……？{w}他24日出现在牢房里这一点也可能自相矛盾——穿越之前，他根本不可能在那里。我感觉还有更多问题，却说不清具体是什么。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...But if this is what happened, Xyn must be in disarray. Someone from their group was arrested when they're all still free. Could this make them rethink their attack? That could be bad.{w} Maybe Ashiya won't care about using the Sekimeiya as bait now that a Xyn member's been caught, but the event should still happen...
entries.new: ……可如果事情真是这样，Xyn内部一定乱作一团。他们组里有人被抓，其他人却还都逍遥法外。这会不会让他们重新考虑袭击计划？那就糟了。{w}也许既然有Xyn成员被捕，芦屋就不会再在意拿Sekimeiya当诱饵，但那件事仍然应该会发生……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Oh, one thing definitely is strange, though.{w} On the 24th, the police weren't able to identify the person who appeared in the cell. But he was arrested in the street yesterday, and that policeman almost seemed like he knew that it was a good arrest to make.{w} That doesn't make any sense. That man was in the tower on the 15th, so if the police were fine with arresting him yesterday, it follows they would've also arrested him immediately on the morning of the 15th.
entries.new: 哦，不过有一点确实很奇怪。{w}24日，警方没能查明出现在牢房里的人的身份。可他昨天在街上被捕，那名警察几乎像是知道这次抓对了人。{w}这完全说不通。那个男人15日就在塔里，如果警方昨天愿意逮捕他，那他们15日一早也该立刻逮捕他才对。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...Could it be that didn't happen because he entered the tower through the storeroom? And, if what happened on the 24th somehow made the police arrest him yesterday, wouldn't they have said that he'd been the one who had appeared in the cell on the 24th?
entries.new: ……之所以没发生，会不会是因为他是从储藏室进入塔里的？还有，如果24日发生的事以某种方式促使警方昨天逮捕了他，那他们难道不会说，他就是24日出现在牢房里的那个人吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Whatever the case, it seemed like an enigma that I probably had to put aside. It was at least good that the person following me had been caught. It could only have been beneficial to my plan.
entries.new: 看来这个谜团我大概只能先放到一边。至少跟踪我的人被抓了，这点是好事。这对我的计划只会有利。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Are you thinking about the news?
entries.new: 你在想那条新闻吗？
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: Darfee addressed me after I'd been in thought for a few minutes.
entries.new: 我沉思了几分钟后，Darfee开口问我。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: A bit. It just threw me off.
entries.new: 有点。刚才那消息让我有些措手不及。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: I see. Well, it's good that someone from that group finally got caught.
entries.new: 原来如此。不过，那个组织终于有人被抓，倒是件好事。
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: Yeah, I agree.
entries.new: 嗯，我也这么觉得。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: The past had certainly changed in front of me. I wasn't in the same reality I knew, so letting everything repeat to remain as the only me was not an option anymore.
entries.new: 过去确实已在我眼前改变。我身处的现实，已不是我熟悉的那个了；让一切重演、好让自己仍是唯一的我，这条路再也走不通。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There was still the major worry that the Sekimeiya could be stolen at any moment. Even if someone from the future had been removed from the equation, that didn't completely rule out the possibility.
entries.new: 不过，最大的隐忧仍然存在——Sekimeiya 随时可能被人偷走。就算来自未来的某个人已经被排除在外，也还不能完全排除这种可能。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: As a matter of fact, the Sekimeiya could have already been stolen. How did the police know that the person they'd caught was with Xyn? Was it because he'd already taken it? The thought of that sent a chill down my spine.
entries.new: 事实上，Sekimeiya 说不定早已被偷走了。警察怎么会知道他们抓到的那个人和 Xyn 有关？难道是因为他已经得手了？想到这里，我脊背一阵发凉。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Do you know about the Sekimeiya?
entries.new: ……你知道 Sekimeiya 的事吗？
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Huh? ...What do you mean?
entries.new: 咦？……你指的是什么？
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: Ashiya's event.
entries.new: 芦屋的那场活动。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Hm? Yeah, of course.
entries.new: 嗯？当然知道。
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: Well, nobody stole the Sekimeiya, right...?
entries.new: 那个……Sekimeiya 并没有被偷，对吧……？
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: The Sekimeiya...? N-No. ...As far as I know, at least.
entries.new: Sekimeiya……？没、没有。……至少据我所知是这样。
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: All right, I just wanted to make sure since I haven't been paying attention to the news.
entries.new: 那就好，我只是想确认一下，最近都没怎么看新闻。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: He looked a little concerned, so I turned to the window. Did he think it was bad I had my thoughts elsewhere after a friend of mine had died? I doubted it, but that was the impression his look gave me.
entries.new: 他看上去有些担心，我便转头望向窗外。他是觉得，朋友刚去世，我却心不在焉，很不好吗？我想他应该不是这个意思，可他的神情给我的感觉正是如此。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I stared out the window. I could only see the narrow street, as opposed to the moving Ramon. ...Just what had happened to the world I knew?
entries.new: 我凝视着窗外。能看见的只有那条狭窄的街道，而不是移动的拉蒙街。……我熟悉的那个世界，究竟出了什么事？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: At that point, it was best to focus on what still mattered.
entries.new: 眼下，最该做的还是把心思放在真正要紧的事上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: With no snow falling, there'd been hardly any movement outside. A few people had come to buy the remaining bread, but time seemed to have stilled for a while.
entries.new: 雪停了，外面几乎没什么动静。有几个人来买走了剩下的面包，但时间仿佛静止了一阵子。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I stood up from the chair and informed Darfee that I'd be heading out.
entries.new: 我从椅子上起身，告诉 Darfee 我该走了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: All right, Shiroya. Have a good day. It'll be ¥150.
entries.new: 好，Shiroya，路上小心。一共 ¥150。
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: I took out three coins from my wallet and handed them to him. He mirrored my smile but not the underlying sadness behind it.
entries.new: 我从钱包里掏出三枚硬币递给他。他对我报以同样的微笑，却没有我笑容背后那层悲伤。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Goodbye.
entries.new: 再见。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: I'll see you.
entries.new: 回头见。
entries.speaker: d

entries.text: ...I walked out of the door and stepped onto the snow again.
entries.new: ……我走出门，再次踏上雪地。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I made some distance from Ina, brooding all the while. I had a hard time accepting that it might have been my last visit.
entries.new: 我离开伊娜咖啡馆，走出一段路，一路心事重重。这或许是我最后一次来这里——这个念头让我难以接受。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'd been slowly walking down Ramon when I stopped myself to stare at a street branching off on the other side.
entries.new: 我沿着拉蒙街慢慢走着，忽然停下脚步，望向对面一条岔出去的小路。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'd taken that path many times to get to Atsuki's house, so I soon realized I was nervously biting my lip again.
entries.new: 为了去 Atsuki 家，我走过那条路很多次，所以我很快意识到，自己又不自觉地咬起了嘴唇。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I didn't have anywhere to go in more ways than one. A huge change in history had occurred—I'd never go back to the world I knew.
entries.new: 无论从哪层意义上说，我都已无处可去。历史发生了巨大的改变——我再也回不到我熟悉的那个世界了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: That meant that making sure Atsuki and I couldn't go to the event had become an even higher priority. It no longer had a downside.
entries.new: 这意味着，确保我和 Atsuki 去不成那场活动，已经成了更优先的事。这件事再没有任何坏处。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I'd decided the previous day that I'd do it on Thursday, but that was potentially a bad idea. I didn't know when Atsuki would leave his house, and waiting in front of it all day wasn't something I wanted to do.
entries.new: ……昨天我决定在周四动手，可那或许不是个好主意。我不知道 Atsuki 什么时候会出门，而且我也不想在他家门口守上一整天。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: After all, if it got too late, I'd have to ring the bell and face him.{w} ...I didn't think I could do that.
entries.new: 毕竟，要是拖得太晚，我就得按门铃去面对他。{w}……我想我做不到。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I only had one job: setting up a future that was perfect for everyone but me, then walking away from it. I couldn't fight that anymore.
entries.new: 我只有一件事要做：铺好一个对所有人都完美、唯独没有我的未来，然后从那里抽身离去。这一点，我已经无力违抗。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I crossed the street and walked through the narrower one, arriving at a part of Yushibana I'd always found pretty.
entries.new: 我穿过马路，走进那条更窄的街道，来到丰花一处我一直觉得很漂亮的地方。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: At other times of the year, you could see the green leaves beneath the snow of the tall trees. The road was still white, but it was almost immaculate. I slowly crossed to the opposite sidewalk.
entries.new: 要是在一年中的其他时节，还能透过高树的积雪看见绿叶。如今路面依旧一片雪白，却几乎纤尘不染。我慢慢走到对面的人行道。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Atsuki's house was there. Before I got too close, a sharp pain in my chest stopped me.
entries.new: Atsuki 的家就在那里。还没等我走近，胸口的一阵剧痛便让我停住了脚步。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Would I really never enter it again?{w} Could I really have been mere minutes away from going in and out of that door for the last time?
entries.new: ……我真的再也不会踏入那栋房子了吗？{w}难道我真的只差几分钟，就要最后一次进出那扇门了吗？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I had a hard time believing it.
entries.new: 我实在难以相信。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I ran up to the gate before that hesitation could take hold of me completely.
entries.new: 趁那份迟疑还没彻底将我抓住，我跑到大门前。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I looked through the bars. Maxi wasn't in front of the door anymore, but his small paws had left imprints in the snow around it.
entries.new: ……我透过栅栏往里看。门口已经不见 Maxi，但它小小的爪印还留在周围的雪地上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: He is here.
entries.new: 他在这里。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: There was light behind a curtain. With no guarantee that Atsuki wouldn't see me, I stepped behind a tree.
entries.new: 遮布后透出灯光。我无法保证 Atsuki 不会看见我，便躲到了树后。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I really didn't want to be seen. If I talked to Atsuki, I was afraid that I would lose any resolve I had.
entries.new: 我实在不想被他看见。要是和 Atsuki 说上话，我怕自己仅剩的那点决心也会烟消云散。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I can't just stay here all day, waiting for him to leave. I don't even know if he will.
entries.new: 总不能在这儿守一整天，等他出门。我甚至不知道他到底会不会出来。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: There was a last resort available. Since I knew where he kept an extra house key, just behind the gate, I could try to enter the house and silently grab Miiya's purse, which had been left in the living room.
entries.new: 还有最后一个办法。我知道他备用的钥匙放在哪儿——就在大门后头，所以我可以设法进屋，悄悄拿走 Miiya 落在客厅的手提包。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Not now, though. If it wasn't a coincidence that he was in the hospital when I woke up, he should leave at some point.
entries.new: 但现在不行。我醒来时他正好在医院，如果那不是巧合，那他迟早会出门的。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...Would he leave if I called him from my phone and quickly hung up?
entries.new: ……如果我用手机打给他，再马上挂断，他会出门吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...{w}I decided against that again.
entries.new: ……{w}我再次打消了这个念头。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...{w}Should I just wait here...?
entries.new: ……{w}难道真要在这里一直等下去……？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I crossed back to the other side of the road and surveyed the door from afar. I looked around; it appeared I was the only person there.
entries.new: 我回到马路对面，远远地打量那扇门。环顾四周，这条街上似乎只有我一个人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Most of the trees there were too thin to cover me, so there was nowhere I could safely watch from.
entries.new: 那一带多数树木太过纤细，遮不住我，找不到可以安心监视的地方。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I glanced at a corner far ahead. I'd be able to see the window from there.
entries.new: 我瞥了一眼前方远处的转角。从那里应该能看到那扇窗。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Slightly hesitant, I walked to it and peered at his house. As I'd thought, I'd be able to see him leaving while still being out of sight.
entries.new: 我略微犹豫，还是走了过去，打量着Atsuki的房子。果然如我所料，我既能看见他出门，又不会被发现。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There was something a bit worrying that I also noticed, however. It was the trail of footprints I'd left.
entries.new: 不过，我也注意到了另一件让人有些不安的事——我在地上留下了一串脚印。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Will he notice the trail going behind the tree?
entries.new: ……他会注意到那串通向树后的脚印吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It seemed unlikely that he'd think it was suspicious, but he could find me by following them with his eyes.
entries.new: 他大概不会觉得可疑，但只要顺着脚印看过去，说不定就能发现我。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'll just have to be careful.
entries.new: 只能多加小心了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...But no matter what I thought, I was uncomfortable. I couldn't take my eyes off his house, and I didn't particularly enjoy the thought of spending my last real day in Yushibana spying on Atsuki.
entries.new: ……可无论怎么想，我心里都不舒服。视线始终离不开他的房子，而且，要在丰花度过的最后一个真实的日子里监视Atsuki——这念头实在让我高兴不起来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I need to do it, though.
entries.new: 但我非做不可。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I hid myself and leaned against the dark, cold wall.{w} Suddenly, I recognized what I was looking at.
entries.new: 我藏好身子，靠在昏暗冰冷的墙边。{w}忽然，我认出了眼前的景象。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'd seen that very street the previous day, when I'd been following Isla.
entries.new: 我昨天跟踪Isla的时候见过这条街。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: That's right... There's no reason not to do the same with Isla since I might know where she lives as well.
entries.new: 对了……既然我可能也知道她住在哪儿，没理由不对Isla也这样做。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Leaving Enric behind, I walked until a crossing street turned to the right. There was the entrance to the dead end I'd been at.
entries.new: 我离开恩里克大道，走到一个向右拐的横街。昨天那条死路的入口就出现在眼前。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I stared at the short house where the small footprints had ended the previous day. I couldn't see any light coming from inside, and nobody was around me.
entries.new: 我望着那栋矮小的房子——昨天，那串小小的脚印就止于那里。屋里看不见一丝灯光，我周围也不见人影。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Faded footprints were scattered all over the ground, and some ended at that front door. I placed myself behind the same black car as before to avoid being right in the middle of the path.
entries.new: 地上散落着浅浅的脚印，有几道一直延伸到那扇前门。我躲到上次那辆黑色轿车的后面，免得自己正站在路中间。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I wondered what to do. Changing the past no longer felt like an obstacle, so I was free to decide on anything.
entries.new: 我在想接下来该怎么办。改变过去已经不再是什么障碍，我可以随心所欲地做决定。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Isla should be at school, but I don't know about Erina, and I don't know if anyone else lives here. ...How the hell can I take their tickets for the event when I don't even know where they're keeping them?
entries.new: Isla现在应该在学校，但Erina就说不准了，我也不知道这里还住着谁。……连她们把票放在哪儿都不清楚，我到底要怎么把活动门票弄到手？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...{w}I considered two important facts: in the attic, Erina had implied they'd bought the tickets pretty early. That meant they were likely to already have them.
entries.new: ……{w}我想到两个要紧的事实。在阁楼里，Erina曾暗示她们的票买得相当早。也就是说，票多半已经在她们手上了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Secondly, before locking ourselves in the bedroom, everyone's possessions had been looked at. While tickets for the event had been found on almost everyone who'd been a visitor, none had been in Erina's purse.
entries.new: 第二，在我们把自己锁进卧室之前，所有人的随身物品都被检查过。几乎每个来访者身上都搜出了活动的门票，可Erina的钱包里一张也没有。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: They were probably inside Isla's, then. Could they already be there...?
entries.new: 那么票多半在Isla的包里。说不定现在就已经在了……？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: The pressure of being in a crucial moment was getting to me. I stepped out and slowly approached the door.
entries.new: 身处关键时刻的紧张感压得我喘不过气。我从藏身处走出来，慢慢靠近那扇门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If Erina and Isla didn't go to the tower, different people would in their place. It was overwhelmingly likely that as long as Ashiya had the Sekimeiya, people would get trapped in that building. However, Isla's fate could be averted.
entries.new: 如果Erina和Isla不去那座塔，就会有别的人顶替她们。只要芦屋还握着Sekimeiya，几乎可以肯定，总会有人被困在那栋楼里。不过，Isla的命运或许能够避开。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...And I could change the past. When I was in front of the door, I stared at the tiny white bell at its side.
entries.new: ……而我可以改变过去。站在门前，我盯着门边那只小小的白色门铃。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Erina and Isla don't know me. I can just press it.
entries.new: Erina和Isla都不认识我。直接按下去就行。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: But what about Isla's friend? What was the truth behind that...? Is someone else really living here with them?
entries.new: 可Isla的那位朋友呢？那背后究竟是什么真相……？真的还有别人和她们住在一起吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: My arm reached out and touched the cold doorbell almost unconsciously, like it was another organism.
entries.new: 我的手臂几乎是不由自主地伸了出去，碰上了冰冷的门铃，仿佛那条手臂是另一个活物。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But really, what should I say...? I suppose that'll vary depending on who opens the door.
entries.new: 可话说回来，我该说什么才好……？这大概得看开门的是谁了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I'd seen no light inside, so maybe nobody would. I firmly rang the doorbell.
entries.new: 屋里没有灯光，也许根本不会有人来开门。我用力按下了门铃。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Is there actually nobody here?
entries.new: ……难道真的没人吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: A day earlier, the small footprints had ended at the door, and it was close to the same time of the day that it had been.
entries.new: 一天前，那串小脚印就止于这扇门前，而现在的时刻也和那时差不多。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Hm...
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I suspected I knew what the reason was.
entries.new: 我隐约猜到了原因。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Isla! Are you here...!?{w} It's me, Shiroya!
entries.new: Isla！你在吗……！？{w}是我，Shiroya！
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: There was no reply.
entries.new: 没有回应。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Is she out again?
entries.new: 她又出门了吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I'd wondered about it already, but my intention was to take the tickets from Erina and Isla. If I did that, Isla couldn't travel to the past... so her "friend" might no longer have existed.
entries.new: 这事我先前就琢磨过，但我的打算是从Erina和Isla手里拿走那些票。一旦得手，Isla就无法穿越到过去……那么她的那位「朋友」或许也就不复存在了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But I'd seen her from the café during school hours. That had to be an Isla who'd traveled from the future.{w} Why had she been out of her house? I figured she wouldn't have wanted to show herself anywhere, which was why she wasn't opening the door.
entries.new: 可是，我在上课时间从咖啡馆里看见过她。那一定是从未来穿越而来的Isla。{w}她为什么会走出家门？我猜想，她不愿在任何地方露面，所以才不肯开门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Isla, are you here?
entries.new: Isla，你在吗？
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: I knocked on the door lightly, but it didn't seem like I'd be answered.
entries.new: 我轻轻敲了敲门，但看起来不会有人应门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The mystery behind Isla's friend was nowhere near solved. If their real identity was an Isla who'd come from the future, why hadn't she prevented herself from going to the event? My intention was to do just that, so my unease grew. Plenty of things about Isla had been questionable when looking back at it, but the voice recorder and her friend's existence were the biggest ones.
entries.new: Isla那位朋友的谜团远未解开。如果此人的真实身份是从未来归来的Isla，那她为什么不阻止自己去参加那场活动？我要做的恰恰就是这件事，所以心里的不安愈发浓重。回头细想，Isla身上可疑之处不少，其中最让人耿耿于怀的，便是那支录音笔和她这位朋友的存在。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'd been standing there for a while, and nothing had changed. Part of me wanted to give up, but the idea of her friend purposely not opening the door was one I didn't like at all.
entries.new: 我在那儿站了好一阵子，情况没有丝毫变化。我多少有点想放弃，可一想到她的朋友是故意不开门，我就很反感。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Suddenly, the door opened wide and I saw the dark interior.
entries.new: 门忽然大开，我看见里面一片昏暗。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There was nobody there. I'd simply tried to open the door and succeeded.
entries.new: 门里空无一人。我只是试着开了开门，没想到就开了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...It was unlocked?
entries.new: ……门没锁？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I'd grabbed the handle to make some noise, and I'd accidentally pushed forward.{w} I didn't move. I kept staring inside until I was sure it was vacant. Then, I lightly pushed the door a bit more and took a careful step in.
entries.new: 我本来只是握住门把手想弄出点声响，却一不小心把它推开了。{w}我没有动，只盯着屋里看，直到确定里面空无一人。然后，我又轻轻把门推开一些，小心翼翼地迈了进去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I scanned the area and immediately noticed a wide assortment of items on the ground. Toys, dolls, coloring books, and markers. In the corner was a pile of laundry, and the walls had a few faded scribbles on them, as if someone had tried to wash them away. There were also pictures of a child at various stages of growth, and her mother was occasionally in the shot with her.
entries.new: 我扫视四周，立刻注意到地上散落着各式各样的东西。玩具、人偶、涂色本和马克笔。角落里堆着一堆待洗的衣物，墙上有几道褪了色的涂鸦，像是有人试图把它们擦掉。墙上还挂着照片，记录着一个孩子不同成长阶段的样子，其中几张里她的母亲也和她在一起。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I opened the entryway closet in search of the purse and was faced with a few women's and girls' jackets. Scattered in the closet were clothes you wouldn't typically see when visiting someone's house.{w} An apron with the name of a local restaurant, a uniform for a factory worker, and a cap branded with the logo of a convenience store.
entries.new: 我打开玄关的柜子想找那只包，映入眼帘的却是几件女人和女孩的外套。柜子里还零散挂着几件一般做客时不会见到的衣服。{w}一条印着本地餐馆名字的围裙、一套工厂工人的制服，还有一顶印着便利店标志的帽子。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I didn't have to search for long. Right inside was the purse Isla had been wearing.
entries.new: 我没费多少工夫就找到了。Isla 之前挎着的手提包就在里面。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Without hesitation, I looked inside.
entries.new: 我毫不迟疑地往里看去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The most important issue was resolved immediately—the recorder wasn't there. I saw a pack of tissues and small sunglasses, but no tickets either.
entries.new: 最要紧的事立刻有了答案——录音笔不在里面。里面有一包纸巾和一副小墨镜，却也没有门票。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wait, this is strange. When we found the recorder, I looked at this purse, and the tickets weren't there either. ...Were they in Isla's pockets?
entries.new: 等等，有些不对劲。我们找到录音笔的时候，我看过这个手提包，里面同样没有门票。……难道是放在 Isla 的口袋里了？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I felt a sudden chill and looked at my sides. Nobody was there, but that in itself was very strange...
entries.new: 我忽然一阵发冷，转头看向身旁。四周没有人，可这本身就很不对劲……
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Why... is this purse here? Yesterday, the reason why I recognized Isla was precisely because she was wearing the purse outside. If she's outside right now, why is her purse here?
entries.new: 为什么……这个手提包会在这里？昨天我之所以认出 Isla，正是因为她挎着这个包走在外面。如果她此刻就在外面，包又怎么会在这里？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: There was some kind of creeping, unknown dread at my back, but I immediately rationalized it away.
entries.new: 一股莫名的恐惧沿着后背悄悄爬上来，我却立刻给自己找了个合理的解释，把它压了下去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...The person I saw yesterday was likely Isla's "friend". She was wearing her purse, and she isn't here right now.
entries.new: ……我昨天见到的人，多半是 Isla 的「朋友」。她当时挎着那个手提包，此刻却不在这里。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: This purse belongs to the original Isla who's at school. If that's it, this makes a lot of sense.
entries.new: 这个手提包是还在学校的那个 Isla 的。要这么想，就解释得通了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: But why was the door unlocked? Was it a normal thing for them? ...And why would the other Isla be going anywhere during the day?
entries.new: 可门为什么没锁？这对她们来说是平常事吗？……而且，另一个 Isla 为什么会在白天出门？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The chance to take their tickets was there. Instead of focusing on specifics, I just had to take that simple action.
entries.new: 拿走她们门票的机会就摆在眼前。我不必再纠结细节，只要完成这个简单的动作就好。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: And when I let go of the purse, I noticed I'd missed a lower pocket.
entries.new: 而当我松开手提包时，才发现自己漏掉了下面的一个口袋。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I unzipped it and narrowed my eyes. All I saw were two folded pieces of paper that I easily recognized.
entries.new: 我拉开拉链，眯起眼睛。里面只有两张折起来的纸，我一眼就认了出来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I grabbed them with two fingers and unfolded them, confirming they were the event tickets.
entries.new: 我用两根手指把它们夹出来展开，确认正是活动门票。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I didn't give it another thought before dashing out and closing the door.
entries.new: 我没有再多想，冲出门外，顺手把门关上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I froze up, realizing how suspicious I looked. I instinctively crumpled the tickets in my fist, but nobody was around to see me.
entries.new: 我僵在原地，这才意识到自己看起来有多可疑。我下意识把门票攥成一团，但周围并没有人看见。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I breathed deeply and began to walk away, calm and nonchalant. I had prevented it; I wasn't in my world anymore, but Isla wouldn't die.
entries.new: 我深吸一口气，若无其事地走开。我已经阻止了那件事；这里不再是我的世界，但 Isla 不会死了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What would happen with Isla? If two versions of her really existed, then it seemed they'd both permanently persist in a single reality. However, I'd already decided once that was the better option, so I'd just put her in the same situation as me.
entries.new: Isla 会怎么样？如果真有两个她同时存在，那她们似乎都会永久留在同一个现实里。不过，我早就认定那已是更好的选择，所以只是让她落得和我一样的处境。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I soon made it back to Enric avenue. From the same corner, I saw light behind Atsuki's window.
entries.new: 我很快回到了恩里克大道。从同一个街角望去，Atsuki 的窗户后亮着灯。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I stared at it for a bit, but I gave up after a short while. I just wanted to go home and wait for tomorrow to come.
entries.new: 我盯着那点灯光看了一会儿，没多久便放弃了。我只想回家，等着明天到来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'd always liked walking through that street, but I turned around and moved to Ramon as I stepped through the thin, parallel path.
entries.new: 我一向喜欢走那条街，但这次我转过身，穿过那条窄窄的平行小径，朝拉蒙街走去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Tomorrow, I'll definitely have to take our tickets, no matter how. It might not be as much of a priority as I thought, though.{w} If I find the Sekimeiya in the tower and enter it during the night, I'll either travel through time or be caught by the police. If I travel through time, taking our tickets won't matter since I'll change the past. ...And if I get caught by the police, there's no way Atsuki won't learn about it. I'm not sure what would happen to my other self, but I doubt she and Atsuki would just go to the tower on the 15th.
entries.new: ……明天，我无论如何都得把我们的门票拿到手。不过，这件事也许没有我以为的那么要紧。{w}如果我在塔里找到 Sekimeiya，并在夜里进入其中，要么会完成时间穿越，要么会被警察抓住。若真能完成时间穿越，拿门票也就没有意义，因为我会改变过去。……而要是被警察抓住，Atsuki 不可能不知道。我不清楚另一个我会怎样，但我不觉得她会在 15 号那天和 Atsuki 一起去塔里。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I would still do it, just in case. For the time being, I simply kept going over the lottery numbers in my head, slowly approaching my apartment. When I was getting close, I saw the footprints I'd left earlier, but again, it seemed that the previous day's weren't there. ...However much my steps left impressions, it was clear that they were all bound to eventually fade.
entries.new: 以防万一，我还是会去做。眼下，我只是在脑中反复默念着彩票号码，慢慢朝公寓走去。快走到时，我看见了先前留下的脚印，但和之前一样，前一天留下的脚印似乎已经不在了。……无论我的脚步留下多深的印记，显然终究都会消失。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Of course, it was warm inside my apartment again. I shrugged off my coat almost immediately.
entries.new: 公寓里果然还是那么暖和。我几乎立刻就把外套脱了下来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I looked at my phone. It was {time=14:04.}{w} There was nothing else I wanted to do for the day, so I went to the kitchen after a long pause.
entries.new: 我看了一眼手机，时间显示 {time=14:04.}{w} 今天已经没有别的事想做了，过了好一会儿，我才走向厨房。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: As much as I disliked the idea of eating noodles again, I had nothing else. I didn't want to go buy food again because I'd just feel like I was doing something else in Yushibana for the last time. Like the day before, I washed the only pot I had and boiled a bit of water before dropping a stiff block of noodles in it.
entries.new: 我虽然很不想再吃面，却也没有别的可吃。我不想再去买吃的，因为那只会让我觉得自己又要在丰花最后一次做某件事。和前一天一样，我把唯一的一口锅洗了洗，烧了一点水，然后丢进一块硬邦邦的面饼。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I waited for them to be cooked, sparingly moving them with two new chopsticks. When four minutes had passed, I poured most of the liquid out and let the noodles fall into a bowl.
entries.new: 我等着面煮好，偶尔用一双新筷子拨弄几下。四分钟过去后，我倒掉大半汤汁，把面盛进碗里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I knew exactly what their taste would be before I began to eat. It was really getting old, but I powered through.
entries.new: 还没动筷，我就知道它会是什么味道。实在吃腻了，我还是勉强吃了下去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The bowl was empty, and I could hardly tell I'd just eaten. I tried to lie on the floor, but it was a bit uncomfortable for my stomach. Instead, I grabbed the bowl and brought it back to the kitchen.
entries.new: 碗空了，我却几乎感觉不到自己刚吃过东西。我试着躺到地板上，可胃里有些难受。于是我拿起碗，把它端回厨房。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I placed it in the sink and opened the cabinet with the food I'd bought. After inspecting it briefly, I indifferently closed the wooden door.
entries.new: 我把它放进水槽，打开装着买来食物的橱柜。草草看了一眼后，我漠然关上木门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I was about to drop the packaging of the noodles into the trash, but I remembered I'd thrown out the bag earlier. I took the roll out of a drawer and placed a new, empty bag in the corner. I thought back on the tickets and looked inside my purse. I'd left both of them there, so I threw them in the garbage as well.
entries.new: 我正要把面条的包装袋丢进垃圾桶，却想起垃圾袋早就被我扔掉了。我从抽屉里取出一卷垃圾袋，在角落里放了一个新的空袋。想到门票，我又看了看自己的手提包。两张票都还留在里面，于是我把它们也扔进了垃圾桶。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I went back to sit on one of the scattered cushions. As much as I felt incredibly overwhelmed, I was out of things to think about. Eventually, I dropped on the floor and emptily let time pass.
entries.new: 我回去坐到其中一个散落的坐垫上。尽管心里压得几乎喘不过气，我却已经没什么可想的了。最后，我索性倒在地板上，茫然地任时间流逝。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It was surreal to think the walls around me, which I'd seen for so many years, could soon disappear forever. There was so much uncertainty.
entries.new: 想到这些看了许多年的墙壁也许很快就会永远消失，总觉得不真实。未知的东西实在太多了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: No matter what awaited... my future was going to be miserable. Every scenario led to roughly the same thing.
entries.new: 无论前方等着我的是什么……我的未来都注定凄惨。每一种可能，最终都殊途同归。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...How was it going to be anything better than terrible? I would either get caught by the police or have to keep on living with sketchy money I wasn't even sure I knew how to obtain.
entries.new: ……它又怎么可能比“糟糕”好到哪儿去？我要么被警察抓住，要么只能靠来路不明的钱继续活下去——而我甚至不确定自己能不能弄到那些钱。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'd have no proper identity and no idea how to get a new one or do anything else... There's no way this will work, and the other version of me will live her life completely clueless, maybe until she finds out she was arrested somewhere.
entries.new: 我没有正式身份，也不知道该怎么弄到新身份，或者还能做什么……这条路根本行不通。而另一个我会一无所知地过她的日子，也许直到某天发现自己在什么地方被捕了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Even if none of those options occur... if I can't go back in time again, but I also don't get caught... What the hell happens then? I'd just have to explain everything to Atsuki and myself. ...What would my thoughts have been if another version of myself appeared like that during the impact of Miiya's death?
entries.new: 就算这些情况都没发生……如果我无法再次回到过去，却也没有被抓住……那到底会怎样？我就只能把一切向 Atsuki 和另一个我解释清楚。……如果在 Miiya 死去的冲击中，另一个版本的我突然这样出现，我当时会怎么想？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: There really wasn't a good possible way it could all end. Even though I'd chosen the sole path that could save Miiya, achieving it was actually no guarantee.
entries.new: 这件事无论怎么收场，都不会有好的结果。即便我选了一条唯一可能救下 Miiya 的路，也并不能保证真的走得到终点。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: At this time tomorrow, I'll already have been in the tower, and I'll be thinking about the best way to act. If I can't pull things off in the night, what the hell will I say to the police? They'll immediately realize another me is in the hospital.
entries.new: 明天的这个时候，我已经身在塔里，正琢磨着最妥当的行动方式。如果夜里没能成事，我到底该怎么跟警察说？他们立刻就会意识到另一个我正躺在医院里。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I wonder what would happen if I revealed what the Sekimeiya can do. They'd have to believe me due to my existence.{w} And then what? Would they let me go with no real identity of my own? Would the Sekimeiya be kept a secret? If so, there's no chance I'd be able to live anything akin to a normal life.{w} Honestly, maybe getting caught by the police would be better... Or, if I'm able to save Miiya, I could reveal myself, and they'd decide what to do.
entries.new: 如果我说出 Sekimeiya 能做到什么，会怎么样？我的存在本身就是证据，他们不信也得信。{w}然后呢？他们会让我这个没有真正身份的人离开吗？Sekimeiya 的事会被保密吗？如果是那样，我根本不可能过上任何正常生活。{w}说实话，也许被警察抓住反而更好……或者，如果我能救下 Miiya，我可以自己现身，让他们决定怎么处置我。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...{w}I realized I'd just thought that and pitied myself. I'd been feeling sporadic senses of liberty the past few days after being shut away for so long, so the fact that I'd seen an outcome deprived of any freedom as acceptable was just disheartening.
entries.new: ……{w}我意识到自己刚冒出这种念头，便不由得可怜起自己来。被关了那么久之后，这几天我偶尔能感到一点自由；可即便如此，我居然觉得一个毫无自由可言的结局也可以接受，这实在令人心灰意冷。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It was undoubtedly absurd that I'd held off from going to the tower for so long. My hesitation could have doomed me at any point. I was just selfish. I wanted those tranquil days to continue despite knowing they couldn't—being in my living room was proof enough of that...
entries.new: 我拖了这么久还不去塔里，实在荒唐。我的犹豫随时都可能让我万劫不复。我只是自私罢了。明知那些平静的日子不可能继续，我却还是想留住它们——此刻待在客厅里，就是最好的证明……
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It appeared to just be misfortune that what I wanted was the single thing that definitely couldn't happen. Ironically, there was no going back. The important decision had already been made, and I was only stalling out the clock.
entries.new: 我所渴望的，偏偏是唯一绝不可能发生的事，这看来只能归咎于不幸。讽刺的是，已经没有回头路了。重要的决定早已做出，我不过是在拖延时间。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: My mind hadn't changed, and if I went back to the time I'd decided, the result wouldn't differ. It had been clear from the beginning that there was no win-win situation.
entries.new: 我的心意没有改变，就算回到当初做决定的那一刻，结果也不会有什么不同。从一开始就很清楚，根本不存在两全其美的选择。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It wasn't possible to go back to my old world, not even with the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 我回不到原来的世界了，就算借助 Sekimeiya 也不行。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If I traveled days through time, I wouldn't be able to let everything play out as it once had anymore. There were people who'd traveled from the 15th and changed history... In the blink of an eye, the world I'd always lived in had distanced from me so much that it was no longer reachable.
entries.new: 如果我穿越回几天前，就再也没有办法让一切照原来的样子发展。已经有人从 15 号穿越回来，改变了历史……转眼之间，我一直生活的世界已经离我如此遥远，再也触不可及。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: So, with no room for doubt, attempting to save Miiya was what I had to do. I needed to figure out a way to travel days through time once more and save her. If I took the Sekimeiya before November 27th, that'd be the best I could do. ...And then, after that would come a new decision, almost as important as the last.
entries.new: 所以，毫无疑问，我必须去救 Miiya。我得想办法再穿越一次时间，回到几天前救她。如果能在 11 月 27 日之前拿到 Sekimeiya，那已经是我能做到的最好了。……而在那之后，还会有一个几乎和上次同样重要的新决定。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: After lying on the floor for so long, my nervousness gradually dissipated. There was no way I'd be able to calm myself the next day, but the beige walls of my living room were oddly relaxing.
entries.new: 在地板上躺了这么久，紧张感也渐渐散去。到了明天，我绝不可能这样平静，但客厅那米色的墙壁却莫名让人放松。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Maybe I really was spending my last hours there, as unbelievable as it felt. I was in a situation I didn't think anyone else had ever been in, and I was the one who had chosen to go through it alone. But I was at a point where I really had to believe in my decisions, and I was confident in thinking that giving myself that last day had been the right thing.
entries.new: 也许我真的要在这里度过最后的几个小时了——尽管这令人难以置信。我现在的处境，我觉得从来没有人经历过，而且是我自己选择独自面对的。但事到如今，我只能相信自己的决定；我也确信，给自己留下最后一天是正确的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I couldn't keep the myriad of thoughts from circling through my mind, but they eventually faded into the background. Time advanced, the light slowly abandoning the room.
entries.new: 无数念头在脑中盘旋，挥之不去，但最终都退到了意识边缘。时间推移，光线也一点点从房间里退去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...{w}What the hell was I thinking?
entries.new: ……{w}我到底在想什么？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I'd had to keep so many things in mind that I couldn't really be surprised I'd made such a large oversight.
entries.new: 需要留意的事太多，犯下这么大的疏漏，我其实也怪不得自己。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I took Isla's and Erina's tickets to prevent them from going to the tower on the 15th. It sounded like a good idea because they could've sold out quickly...{w} I completely ignored that they could simply print them out again. ...I don't think they'd have to buy new ones.
entries.new: 我拿走了 Isla 和 Erina 的票，是为了阻止她们在15号去芦屋塔。当时觉得这主意不错，因为票很可能很快售罄……{w} 却完全忽略了她们只要重新打印一份就行。……我想她们应该不用再买新票。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I sighed, exasperated. I'd never had a printer, so I hadn't thought it through. I knew Atsuki and I hadn't checked our tickets until the 14th, but we would've been able to print new ones if they hadn't been there.
entries.new: 我无奈地叹了口气。我从来没用过打印机，所以根本没往这方面想。我知道我和 Atsuki 直到14号才查看门票，可要是票不在，我们本可以重新打印。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: How the hell do I do this, then? Unless Erina and Isla don't notice that their tickets are gone until they're in the tower, they can just go anyway.{w} At least in the case of Atsuki and myself, it was seeing our tickets that made us decide to go through with attending the event, so we might actually not go if I do take them.
entries.new: 那我到底该怎么做？除非 Erina 和 Isla 一直到进了芦屋塔才发现票没了，否则她们照样可以去。{w} 至少对我和 Atsuki 来说，是看到票之后才决定去参加活动的，所以如果我把票拿走，我们说不定真就不会去了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I really didn't want to think very hard about it, but I wasn't too worried. If I got caught by the police, Atsuki and I probably wouldn't go to the event, but if I wasn't able to find the Sekimeiya, I'd have to think of something else. Maybe a note wasn't a horrible idea, or I could break his printer. There had to be at least one way to stop Atsuki and me from going.
entries.new: 我实在不愿多想，但也没有太过担心。要是我被警察抓住，我和 Atsuki 大概就去不成活动了；可要是我找不到 Sekimeiya，就得另想办法。留张字条或许也不算坏主意，或者我还可以弄坏他的打印机。总该有办法阻止我和 Atsuki 去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: And Erina and Isla... If I'm not able to travel, I could just try to talk to them again, but I'm not sure what I'd say. I wonder if they'd accuse me of stealing their tickets if I suddenly show up warning them not to go.
entries.new: 还有 Erina 和 Isla……要是时间穿越行不通，我就只能再试着和她们谈谈，可我不确定该说什么。如果我突然出现，警告她们别去，她们会不会怀疑是我偷了票？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I'd think about that tomorrow, after getting inside the tower.
entries.new: 等明天进了芦屋塔再想吧。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I hadn't moved in too long, and I'd begun to feel tired. The sun was setting, so my body was requesting that I sleep at the same time it had gotten accustomed to.
entries.new: 我太久没有动弹，倦意开始涌上来。太阳正在落山，身体也到了习惯的入睡时间，催我睡下。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It seemed laughable to think I'd be able to fall asleep. I could try to quell the onslaught of my thoughts, but there was no getting rid of them.
entries.new: 现在想睡着，简直可笑。我可以试着压住纷涌的思绪，却根本赶不走它们。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Once again, the same sharp pain hit me when I thought that it could have been my last night in that apartment. If I managed to go back in time the next day, it really was possible I'd never rest in my bed again.
entries.new: 一想到那也许是我在那间公寓度过的最后一夜，同样的刺痛便再度袭来。如果明天我真的成功回到过去，我或许再也不会躺在那张床上休息了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I already thought of this, but I shouldn't take it lightly. How exactly am I going to get in the tower tomorrow night if I'm getting tired at this time?
entries.new: 这事我早就想过了，可也不能掉以轻心。这个时间就开始犯困，明晚我到底要怎么进芦屋塔？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I'd enter the tower with a plan in mind. It could entail staying there for the entire duration or rushing out of the building with the Sekimeiya. While I wasn't sure yet, I didn't want to blow it due to a lack of sleep, and simply drinking coffee to stay awake had backfired numerous times.
entries.new: 我会带着计划进入芦屋塔。也许是在里面一直待到结束，也许是拿到 Sekimeiya 后冲出大楼。具体怎么做还没定，但我不想因为睡眠不足而功亏一篑；光靠喝咖啡硬撑，已经失败过很多次了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I thought of placing the clothes I'd washed into the wardrobe, but I just couldn't bring myself to do it. There was nothing I could do but keep lying down, awaiting the time where I'd force myself into bed.
entries.new: 我想过把洗好的衣服放进衣柜，却实在提不起劲。除了继续躺着，等着非逼自己上床睡觉不可，我什么也做不了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But a while later, that time hadn't come. While I was tired, I couldn't manage to stand up, as that would mean finally abandoning the life I had.
entries.new: 可过了好一阵，那个时候也没有来。我明明累了，却站不起身——因为站起来，就意味着彻底舍弃我现在的生活。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...If I stayed on the floor, it would mean the last night in my bed had already happened, and for some reason, I preferred that.
entries.new: ……如果我继续躺在地板上，就意味着在床上的最后一夜已经过去了。不知为何，我宁愿如此。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Sleep Paralysis
entries.new: 睡眠瘫痪

entries.text: I managed to stand up, but only to turn off the light.
entries.new: 我好不容易站起身，却只是为了关灯。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The room had become fully dark. I couldn't tell how much time had passed since I had looked away from the small, red light on the TV.
entries.new: 房间已经完全暗下来。自从我移开视线、不再看电视机上那点红色小灯，也不知过了多久。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: However, I knew it had been a while. My head rested on a cushion, and the feel of the carpet was comforting. Even though I had no blanket, the heater allowed me to remain in the middle of the floor, contacting the table with my back.
entries.new: 不过我知道，已经过了不少时间。我的头枕在靠垫上，地毯的触感也让人安心。虽然没有被子，但暖气让我能一直躺在地板中央，后背挨着桌子。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But I hadn't fallen asleep. I had only sensed time passing, my vivid trains of thought infinitely spiraling into chaotic repetition.
entries.new: 可我并没有睡着。我只是感觉到时间在流逝，鲜明的思绪无限盘旋，陷入混乱的重复。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: That became mentally exhausting. I just wanted to fall asleep, but it didn't seem like it would ever happen.
entries.new: 这让我精神上疲惫不堪。我只想睡着，却似乎怎么都做不到。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The absolute silence had persisted for what felt like hours. At one point, I realized that I'd fallen asleep just for my awareness to instantly return.
entries.new: 死一般的寂静仿佛持续了好几个小时。有那么一刻，我发觉自己刚睡着，意识却又立刻回来了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: That might've happened a few more times. However, I still felt as if I'd been awake the whole time, desperately trying to lose consciousness.
entries.new: 这种情况也许又发生过几次。可我仍觉得自己一直醒着，拼命想让自己失去意识。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Was the sun going to rise at any point? I had to go to the tower in the morning so that I had enough time until the next night.
entries.new: 太阳到底还会不会升起？我必须在早上去芦屋塔，这样才能留出足够的时间撑到第二天晚上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I thought of setting an alarm, but I couldn't briefly sleep and be drowsy on such an important day.
entries.new: ……我想过设个闹钟，但在这么重要的日子，我不能只睡一小会儿就昏昏沉沉的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'd been thinking about grabbing my phone for a while until I finally extended my arm and felt around the surface of the table. I dragged my phone toward me and shut my eyes tightly as I flipped it open.
entries.new: 我想拿手机想了好一阵，才终于伸出手在桌面上摸索。我把手机拖到面前，翻开它时紧紧闭上了眼睛。
entries.speaker: i
