entries.text: I'd been looking at the floor, stuttering as I made everything up. ...When I finally looked at the rest, I noticed what greatly stood out from them.
entries.new: 我一直低着头，一边结巴，一边把谎话编下去。……等我终于抬头看向其余的人时，才注意到其中有一处格外扎眼。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Akaro's eyes. They couldn't believe what they were seeing, and his body was solid as a rock. I needed nothing else to know who my killer was.
entries.new: ……是 Akaro 的眼睛。那双眼睛里写满了难以置信，他的身体僵得像块石头。不必再看别的，我已经知道杀我的人是谁。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: In his hands was a glowing Sekimeiya. However, I immediately saw something I assumed nobody had realized.{w} His sleeve was between it and his skin. He was purposely avoiding contact with it.
entries.new: 他手里握着一枚发光的 Sekimeiya。然而，我立刻发现了一处大概谁都没注意到的细节。{w}他的袖子隔在它和自己的皮肤之间——他是故意不去碰它。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...What did Naomi have to tell you, I mean.
entries.new: ……我是说，Naomi 到底要跟你说什么。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I... don't know. She didn't tell me anything. Can you explain what happened there? Why is the elevator button gone?
entries.new: 我……不知道。她什么都没跟我说。倒是这边出了什么事，你能说明一下吗？电梯按钮为什么不见了？
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: ...Slow down. What do you mean she didn't tell you anything? She asked to talk to you and Akaro privately. Did she never follow up on that?
entries.new: ……你先别急。什么叫她什么都没跟你说？她明明说过要跟你和 Akaro 单独谈谈。后来她没再提过这事？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: N-No. ...I told her I was cold, and she gave me this.
entries.new: 没、没有。……我只跟她说了我冷，她就把这个给了我。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: I see. That's also what Akaro said. That you two suddenly disappeared.
entries.new: 原来如此。Akaro 也是这么说的，说你们两个突然就不见了。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Y-Yes, sorry.
entries.new: 是、是的，对不起。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: That's when we heard the elevator, then. Did Naomi activate it?
entries.new: 那么，我们听见电梯声就是那时候了。是 Naomi 启动的？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...You heard it?
entries.new: ……你们听见了？
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Yes, it passed through the fourth floor twice. We thought it couldn't have been the elevator since it wasn't working, but it had to be.
entries.new: 嗯，它两次经过四楼。我们本来觉得电梯坏了，不可能是它，可看来只可能是电梯。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I see. I don't know why, but it worked when Naomi called it.
entries.new: 这样啊。我也不知道为什么，但 Naomi 一按，电梯就能用了。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: ...It did? After that, we all came here and saw that the Sekimeiya had been stolen. Did neither of you do that?
entries.new: ……真的？之后我们都赶到这里，发现 Sekimeiya 被人偷了。你们两个都没动过它？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Wait, wh-what? No. We never went there.{w} In the attic, she gave me these, and when we left, she suddenly ran back and locked herself inside.
entries.new: 等等，你、你说什么？没有。我们根本没去过那里。{w}在阁楼里，她把这些给了我，我们出来之后，她突然又跑回去，把自己锁在了里面。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: I really hated lying like that. Naomi had been killed, and I was setting her up as the culprit. Meanwhile, Akaro's body hadn't moved in the slightest.
entries.new: 我实在厌恶这样撒谎。Naomi 已经遇害，我却把罪名安在了她头上。而另一边，Akaro 的身体纹丝未动。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It seemed they had accepted my claims. They were absurd, especially the clothing part since I was colder than before, but Naomi was already suspicious to them, so they seemed to believe what I was saying.
entries.new: 看来他们接受了我这套说辞。这些话本就荒唐，尤其是衣服那部分——我明明比之前更冷了——但他们对 Naomi 本就心存疑虑，似乎就信了我的话。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Really, though, what happened to the button...?
entries.new: ……不过，那个按钮到底是怎么回事……？
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: ...When we saw that the Sekimeiya was gone, Akaro told us to run upstairs. He'd been searching for you two, and we missed him when he was in the offices.{w} On the fourth floor, the panel had been ripped off. We went up and saw that they were gone on the fifth and sixth as well. Sai tried to open the doors, but the elevator wasn't there.{w} By the time we ran all the way down, it had happened on the first three floors too, and the elevator wasn't there either.
entries.new: ……我们发现 Sekimeiya 不见了之后，Akaro 就叫我们往楼上跑。他一直在找你们俩，在办公室那一带时我们和他走散了。{w}四楼的面板已经被撬了下来。我们再往上，五楼、六楼也一样。Sai 试着开门，可电梯不在那里。{w}等我们一路跑到楼下，底下三层也成了这样，电梯同样不在。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Yeah. We heard it moving two more times when we were going down. If you're telling the truth, I guess that was Naomi.
entries.new: 对。我们下楼的时候又听见它动了两次。你要没说谎，那应该就是 Naomi 了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I am... I don't know what she did after she locked herself up, but I've been looking for you until now...
entries.new: 我没说谎……她把自己锁起来之后做了什么，我不知道，但我一直在找你们……
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: In any case, it doesn't matter. We found the Sekimeiya, and we'll stay with it in a room until we can leave so that it isn't stolen again.
entries.new: 总之，那都不重要了。Sekimeiya 已经找回来了，在能离开之前，我们就守在一间屋子里看着它，免得再被偷走。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Only one door was open in hallway B.
entries.new: B走廊上只有一扇门敞着。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Was that where you were going?
entries.new: ……你们是要去那间屋子？
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Yes.
entries.new: 嗯。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Finally, Akaro spoke. From the storeroom, I'd noticed his voice sounded rougher and sharper than I remembered, but that seemed to have disappeared.{w} When I looked at him, he turned around and walked to that room.
entries.new: Akaro 终于开口了。我在储藏室里就注意到，他的嗓音比我记忆中更粗、更尖，可这会儿那种感觉似乎已经消失了。{w}我看向他时，他转过身，朝那间屋子走去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I thought we should leave the Sekimeiya here. ...Naomi can open the other cabinet, and just like it, I noticed these can get cold too.
entries.new: 我想，Sekimeiya 就放在这里吧。……另一个展示柜 Naomi 能打开，而且我注意到，这些柜子跟那个一样，也是会变冷的。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: That was why the room had caught my attention. It was room B4, where we'd found the first Naomi and where the Sekimeiya had been hidden.
entries.new: 那间屋子之所以引起我的注意，原因就在这里。那是 B4 房间——我们找到第一个 Naomi 的地方，也是 Sekimeiya 原先被藏起来的地方。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It's bigger too, so I think it's a good idea.
entries.new: 而且这个也更大一些，我觉得这样挺好。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Once again, without looking at us, Akaro walked into the room and raised the lid of a cabinet, undoing the back lock. After placing the Sekimeiya inside, he rotated the two temperature wheels.
entries.new: Akaro 又一次看也不看我们，径直走进房间，掀起一个展示柜的盖子，解开了后侧的锁。他把 Sekimeiya 放进去，随后转动了两个温度旋钮。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I set it to 5 °C. Let's just leave it in here.
entries.new: ……我设成了 5 °C。就放在这里吧。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Everyone entered while I narrowed my eyes. Katei wasn't there, so he hadn't repeatedly warned them not to get the Sekimeiya out of the cabinet. Despite that, Akaro had gone out of his way to keep it in a cold space.
entries.new: 众人陆续进来，我眯起了眼。Katei 不在，所以没人再三叮嘱他们别把 Sekimeiya 拿出展示柜。可即便如此，Akaro 还是特意把它保存在低温的地方。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: He had knowledge of the Sekimeiya—the way he held it was the giveaway. He had to be the one who had stolen it, not just the killer. Atsuki and I had seen the temperature set to 0 °C more than once, and Akaro specifically set it to 5 °C, so there was no way he didn't know about that requirement.{w} ...The temperature of the Sekimeiya's display cabinet wasn't visible, so I wondered what it was.
entries.new: 他了解 Sekimeiya——看他拿它的手法就明白了。偷走它的人一定是他，而不只是凶手。我和 Atsuki 不止一次见过温度被设在 0 °C，而 Akaro 特意把它设成 5 °C，他不可能不知道这个要求。{w}……Sekimeiya 展示柜的温度从外面看不到，我有些在意那究竟是多少。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Nobody was questioning Akaro's bizarre actions. Perhaps it was normal only I was seeing them as such. Similarly, as nobody was questioning what I'd said, I made my way in and sat on the floor, leaning against a cabinet.
entries.new: 没有人质疑 Akaro 那些古怪的举动。也许觉得古怪的只有我一个。同样，也没有人质疑我说过的话。我走进房间，靠着展示柜坐到地上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Atsuki sat to my left. Most strain had disappeared from his face, but I could only feel like I was lying to him. The person he'd entered the building with had been killed, something I could hardly believe.
entries.new: Atsuki 坐在我左边。他脸上的紧绷褪去了大半，可我只觉得自己在骗他。和他一起走进这栋楼的人死了，这件事我至今难以相信。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: How had everything taken that turn...? I didn't want to be there. I wanted to be back home or in the lobby, about to leave with Atsuki. I was foolish to hope anything would get better by simply waiting.
entries.new: 事情怎么会变成这样……？我不想待在这里。我想回到家，或者待在大厅，正准备和 Atsuki 一起离开。指望光靠等待就能让一切好转，是我太天真了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The door closed. Sai sat in front of it, blocking the exit. He was insistent about not leaving, and as he looked at me from the opposite end of the room, I could still sense his suspicion.
entries.new: 门关上了。Sai 坐在门前，堵住了出口。他执意不肯离开；他从房间另一头望过来，我仍能感到他的怀疑。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Lastly, when I least expected it, Akaro approached us. ...I glanced at him, but his eyes didn't meet mine.{w} Then, he sat to my right, between me and the cabinet containing the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 最后，在我最没料到的时候，Akaro 朝我们走来。……我瞥了他一眼，他却没有与我对视。{w}随后他在我右边坐下，就坐在我和放着 Sekimeiya 的展示柜之间。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: For long seconds, I nervously waited for him to say something while he stared at his lap. In the end, when he raised his head, all he did was exhale a long-held breath before staring back down.
entries.new: 好几秒里，他低头看着自己的膝盖，我紧张地等着他开口。最后他抬起头，只是吐出一口憋了很久的气，又低下头去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Simulation Therapy
entries.new: 模拟疗法

entries.text: A while later, the single sound within the room had been that of Isla's steps. She continually walked from cabinet to cabinet.
entries.new: 过了一阵，房间里唯一的声响就是 Isla 的脚步声。她不停地从一个展示柜走到另一个展示柜。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Oh...! Look at this one!
entries.new: 哦……！快看这个！
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: Erina followed her daughter around the room and mimicked her sounds of amazement.
entries.new: Erina 跟着女儿在房间里转，也学着她发出惊叹声。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wow, the swirls on it are so pretty!
entries.new: 哇，上面的纹路好漂亮！
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Gleefully, they circled the room until they'd observed all the gems.
entries.new: 她们兴高采烈地绕了一圈，把每颗宝石都看了个遍。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The last time, all of us had looked at the gems, so the situation clearly differed.{w} Atsuki hadn't so much as shifted one of his legs since we'd come in. I'd wanted to talk to him, but I hadn't expected he would act that way. Before entering the tower, he and I had spoken very little. That gradually changed during the day, but the Atsuki next to me looked just like he had at his house.
entries.new: 上一次来的时候，我们所有人都去看那些宝石了，眼下的情形显然不同。{w}自从进来，Atsuki 连腿都没挪过一下。我本想和他说话，却没想到他会是这副样子。进塔之前，他和我说的话少得可怜。这一天里好不容易渐渐熟络起来，可坐在我身边的 Atsuki，却像回到了他家里的那副模样。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Oh, let me see that, Isla.
entries.new: ……哦，让我看看那个，Isla。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Everyone looked at her purse, where I was staring. I'd just realized there was something very important to check.
entries.new: 大家都顺着我的目光看向她的手提包。我刚刚意识到，有一样非常要紧的东西必须确认。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: These? They're sunglasses!
entries.new: 这个吗？是太阳镜！
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: Sunglasses in the winter? Isn't that a little strange?
entries.new: 冬天戴太阳镜？是不是有点奇怪？
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Nope! They block the sun reflecting off the snow. Here, try them on.
entries.new: 才不会！它能挡住雪地反射的阳光。来，你戴上试试。
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: She came closer and handed them to me.
entries.new: 她走近几步，把眼镜递给了我。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Hm... They're too small for me, but I'm sure they fit you perfectly.
entries.new: 嗯……对我来说太小了，不过你戴一定正合适。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: She put them on with a big grin.
entries.new: 她咧开嘴笑了，把眼镜戴上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It's okay! You can try again when I'm bigger.
entries.new: 没关系！等我长大一点，你再试一次。
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: ...The recorder isn't there. I don't get it.
entries.new: ……录音笔不在里面。真搞不懂。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: From farther away, Erina smiled at us. I couldn't help but feel that I'd never seen her look that way in the other world.
entries.new: 远处的 Erina 朝我们微笑。我忍不住想，在另一个世界里，我从没见过她这副神情。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Isla took off her glasses and ran across the room. I had no idea what to think of her, the recording, or her friend. I knew she had died once, though. If we stayed put, that was much less likely to repeat.
entries.new: Isla 摘下眼镜，跑过房间。我不知道该如何看待她、那段录音，还有她的朋友。可我知道她死过一次。只要我们不乱走，那样的事就不太可能重演。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: For a while, Isla's quiet footsteps punctuated the silence as she moved to each cabinet. She'd already looked through all of them, but staying still seemed to be difficult for her. Erina simply followed her daughter's movements with her eyes.
entries.new: 有一阵子，Isla 轻盈的脚步在寂静中起落，她一个接一个地走到展示柜前。每个柜子她都已经看过了，可要她安分待着似乎很难。Erina 只是用目光跟着女儿的身影。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: When I noticed that the silence had gone on for longer than usual, I glanced back up. It took me a bit to spot Isla in front of the cabinet with the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 等我发觉这阵安静持续得比平时更久，便抬起头来。我花了一会儿才看见 Isla 站在放着 Sekimeiya 的展示柜前。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: She was staring at it with a piercing gaze, her figure completely rigid. Out of nowhere, her right hand began to reach for the lid, moving almost imperceptibly.
entries.new: 她死死盯着它，整个人僵直不动。忽然，她的右手几乎难以察觉地朝柜盖伸去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But before she made contact with it, Akaro noticed what I was looking at.
entries.new: 可就在她碰到之前，Akaro 注意到了我在看什么。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Hey, Isla, what are you doing? The Sekimeiya shouldn't be taken out of there.
entries.new: 喂，Isla，你在干什么？Sekimeiya 不能从里面拿出来。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: ...Why not?
entries.new: ……为什么不行？
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: I already explained. I put it somewhere cold, like it was in the event room. Naomi told us not to take it out of the cabinet, so it's better to keep it shut.
entries.new: 我已经解释过了。我把它放在了低温的地方，和它在活动室时一样。Naomi 说过不能把它拿出展示柜，所以还是关着比较好。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: I won't take it away. I just want to look at it again.
entries.new: 我不会拿走。我只是想再看一眼。
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: You have plenty of other gems to look at. I know you came to the tower for the Sekimeiya, but it's a lot more boring than all the other stones in this room.
entries.new: 这里有那么多别的宝石可以看。我知道你是冲着 Sekimeiya 来的，可它比这房间里的任何一块石头都无趣得多。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Hmph.
entries.new: 哼。
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: Disappointed, Isla turned around. She continued going from cabinet to cabinet, and every once in a while, she'd glare at Akaro from a distance.
entries.new: Isla 失望地转过身。她继续在各个展示柜之间游走，时不时从远处瞪 Akaro 一眼。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Once she had circled around the room, she was once again in front of the cabinet with the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 等她绕完一圈，又回到了放着 Sekimeiya 的展示柜前。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But it was glowing, right? Ash, um... Ashiya said that it was the rarest discovery of the century! What if it has super... um, supernatural powers?
entries.new: 可它会发光，对吧？Ash——呃，芦屋说它是本世纪最稀有的发现！说不定它有什么超……呃，超自然的力量呢？
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: Don't be silly. You don't know much about Ashiya, do you?
entries.new: 别说傻话了。你对芦屋了解得不多吧？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: I do! I hear about them all the time!
entries.new: 我了解！我天天都能听到他们的事！
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: Heh, yeah, but I'll give you some advice. Don't trust anything Ashiya say. You wouldn't like to know how they obtained some of the gemstones you were looking at.
entries.new: 呵，是吗。那我给你个忠告：别信芦屋说的任何话。你刚才看的那些宝石，有些是怎么弄到手的，你知道了可不会高兴。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Hmm?
entries.new: 嗯？
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: Unprompted, Isla sat next to Akaro, demanding a detailed explanation.
entries.new: 没人叫她，Isla 就自己坐到 Akaro 旁边，要他详细讲讲。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...They've never been known for their decent practices. That's the best way I can put it. I guess kids nowadays aren't very in touch with their history.
entries.new: ……他们做事的手段从来都算不上正派。我只能这么说。看来现在的孩子对自己的历史都不太了解啊。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Upon seeing that Isla had sat with us, Erina came over too.
entries.new: 见 Isla 在我们身旁坐下，Erina 也走了过来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: You mean they're not good people?
entries.new: 「你的意思是，他们不是好人？」
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: Ah, I've told her about this before. It's why I had reservations about bringing her here.
entries.new: 「啊，这事我以前跟她说过。所以我才犹豫要不要带她来。」
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Huh? I don't remember that.
entries.new: 「咦？我不记得有这回事。」
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: Well, at least in the past they weren't. Right now, it's a bit harder to say, but God only knows what the reason behind today's event was.
entries.new: 「至少过去还算不上。至于现在，就不好说了。不过今天这场活动背后究竟图个什么，只有天知道。」
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: What did you mean before? How have they gotten all these gems?
entries.new: 「你刚才那话是什么意思？他们哪来这么多宝石？」
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: Do you know anything about gemstones? There are many types. Geodes, for example, look like normal rocks on the outside but are fractal-like on the inside. Ashiya push themselves to have an event every week and change the displayed gemstones often, so in the past they've displayed fake geodes.
entries.new: 「你了解宝石吗？种类多得是。就说晶洞吧，外表看着跟普通石头没两样，切开后内部却布满晶簇。芦屋每周都要办活动，展出的宝石也常换，所以以前就拿假晶洞充过数。」
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: People love looking for extraterrestrial gems—materials that came from space. I bet you that if any of the ones here are supposedly one of those, they were found in one of the mountains you see every day.
entries.new: 「人们总爱追捧天外来的宝石——那些来自太空的东西。我敢打赌，这里要真有哪颗号称是天外来的，八成就是从你天天看得见的那几座山里拣的。」
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: I can't give you proof of this, but some of them are lab-created too. Ashiya can't trick everyone, but it clearly works favorably for them. For a while, they displayed a Verdelite Tourmaline labeled as a Chrome Tourmaline, which is much rarer. They're easily distinguished if you have a magnet, but they look very similar if you only have your eyes.
entries.new: 「我拿不出证据，不过其中有些也是实验室里合成的。芦屋骗不了所有人，可这么做显然对他们有利。有一阵子，他们把绿碧玺标成铬碧玺展出——后者稀有得多。有块磁铁就很容易分辨，可光凭眼睛看，两者几乎一模一样。」
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Oh...! You know a lot about this!
entries.new: 「哇……！你懂得真多！」
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: Not as much as you would imagine. It's hard not to hear about these things, really. Of course, I'm not surprised the Sekimeiya doesn't seem to be anything special.
entries.new: 「没你想的那么多。这种事，想不听都难。当然，那颗 Sekimeiya 看起来没什么特别，我一点也不意外。」
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Even if it's not, we would have to pay a fortune if we broke it. Akaro's right, it's better to leave it be.
entries.new: 「就算它真没什么特别，弄坏了我们也赔不起。Akaro 说得对，还是别碰为好。」
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Exactly.
entries.new: 「正是。」
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: I didn't want Isla to object, so I attempted to change the topic, and the appearance of her house was the first thing that came to my mind.
entries.new: 我不想让 Isla 出言反驳，便试着转移话题，第一个浮上脑海的就是她家的样子。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: She must be a handful. I bet she leaves a mess at home.
entries.new: 「这孩子肯定不好带。我猜她在家把屋子弄得一团糟吧。」
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: She's got her moments, but we manage. She's all I've got, after all.
entries.new: 「她是有闹腾的时候，不过我们还应付得来。毕竟我就只有她了。」
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Akaro's expression softened. I knew he had to be hiding a lot, but it was hard to think even his appearance was insincere.
entries.new: Akaro 的神情柔和下来。我知道他一定藏着许多事，可很难想象连他的模样都是装出来的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I see. That must be difficult. Say, Isla, how's school going? Shouldn't you be there right now?
entries.new: 「原来如此。那一定很辛苦。对了，Isla，学校怎么样？这个时间你不是该在学校吗？」
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Yes, but Mom let me skip classes! I like having a day off because not everyone there is nice.
entries.new: 「嗯！不过妈妈让我请假了！我喜欢放假，因为学校里不是每个人都好相处。」
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: Some kids are mean to you?
entries.new: 「有小孩欺负你？」
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Well, Amelie never lets me play with them, and everyone does what she says.
entries.new: 「Amelie 从来不许我跟她们一起玩，而且大家都听她的。」
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: Ah, is that so? Well, I'll come talk with Amelie once we're out. I had to deal with people like her when I was your age too.
entries.new: 「哦，是这样啊。行，等我们出去了，我去找 Amelie 谈谈。我像你这么大的时候，也应付过她这种人。」
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Really? My teacher already tried, but Amelie didn't change at all.
entries.new: 「真的吗？老师已经找她谈过了，可 Amelie 一点都没变。」
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: Don't worry. If she continues, we'll have another talk.
entries.new: 「别担心。她要是还这样，我们就再谈一次。」
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Isla grinned at the thought of a big, scary man like Akaro intimidating her school enemy. Meanwhile, Erina watched over them from above with melancholic eyes.
entries.new: 一想到像 Akaro 这样高大吓人的男人会去镇住她在学校里的对头，Isla 就咧嘴笑了。而 Erina 从高处望着他们，眼里带着几分忧郁。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Mom, Mister Akaro is a nice man. Can he be my new daddy?
entries.new: 「妈妈，Akaro 先生是个好人。他能当我的新爸爸吗？」
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: ...You want him to be your dad? What do you think he'll say when he sees your bedroom?
entries.new: 「……你想让他当你爸爸？你说，他要是看见你的房间会怎么说？」
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Huh? I'll clean it! I promise!
entries.new: 「咦？我会收拾干净的！我保证！」
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: You always say that. It stays clean for three days, and then you forget about your promise.
entries.new: 「你每次都这么说。干净三天，然后就把保证忘到脑后了。」
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Not this time! You'll never remind me again!
entries.new: 「这次不一样！以后你再也不用提醒我了！」
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: Sweetie, you know how much work being in charge of you is, right? Do you really want to put that on him?
entries.new: 「宝贝，你知不知道照顾你有多费心？你真想把这份担子推给他？」
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: I-I'm not that bad!
entries.new: 「我、我才没那么糟！」
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: ...It sounded like it was Akaro's time to chime in, but he kept quiet, looking somewhere else.
entries.new: ……这种时候本该轮到 Akaro 接话了，他却一声不吭，视线飘向别处。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: His lack of input abruptly ended that topic, so Isla stood up. Instead of returning to the cabinet with the Sekimeiya, she continued romping around the room.
entries.new: 他不接话，话题就此断了，Isla 便站了起来。她没有回到放着 Sekimeiya 的展示柜旁，而是继续在房里跑来跑去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It took a while, but eventually, she calmed down and sat a bit away.
entries.new: 过了好一阵，她才安静下来，在稍远的地方坐下。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Time passed, and everyone kept to themselves. Sai still leaned against the door, looking nowhere but the floor. It probably hadn't been long enough for the others to get to know his personality and why the way he was acting was unusual.
entries.new: ……时间一点点过去，大家都各待各的。Sai 依旧倚着门，目光只落在脚下的地板上。其他人跟他相处的时间大概还不够长，既摸不清他的性子，也看不出他这副样子有多反常。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I realized I no longer had the pendant I'd worn on the 15th. It didn't seem like anyone had noticed, but I would have no excuse if someone did.
entries.new: 我这才意识到，自己15号戴的那条吊坠不见了。似乎没人注意到，可一旦有人问起，我找不出任何说辞。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...So Naomi hasn't shown up.{w} Did she not say anything when she locked herself inside the top floor?
entries.new: 「……Naomi 还是没露面。{w} 她把自己关在顶层的时候，什么都没说吗？」
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Finally, Akaro spoke again. His voice was quiet, and the steely look in his eyes from before we'd entered the room was completely gone.
entries.new: Akaro 终于又开口了。他的声音很轻，进这间屋子之前眼里那股冷硬的神色已经荡然无存。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: No, she didn't... I don't know what got into her, but I assume she wanted to do whatever she did to the elevator.{w} I guess while we're here, there's nothing she can do anymore.
entries.new: 「没有，她什么都没说……我不知道她是怎么了，不过我猜，她想做的就是对电梯做过的那种事。{w} 既然我们待在这儿，她大概也翻不出什么花样了。」
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: I understand.
entries.new: 「我明白了。」
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Out of curiosity, are you the girl who fell into a coma two weeks ago? I think I saw your name on the news.
entries.new: 「顺便问一句，你就是两周前陷入昏迷的那个女孩吧？我好像在新闻上看到过你的名字。」
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Uh, y-yes. ...That was me.
entries.new: 「呃，是、是的。……就是我。」
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Although he was speaking quietly, Atsuki heard that too and looked at Akaro curiously.
entries.new: 尽管他压低了声音，我还是听见了，好奇地看向 Akaro。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Damn, that must've been a scare. It's good to see you're all right now.
entries.new: 「天哪，那一定吓坏了吧。看到你现在没事，我就放心了。」
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Yeah...
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: There was an explosion close to here, right? Didn't someone die, and {tip=gan}a person{/tip} was sent to the hospital?
entries.new: 「这附近发生过一场爆炸，对吧？好像有人死了，还有{tip=gan}一个人{/tip}被送进了医院？」
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Y-Yes... A friend of ours died. Two people were hospitalized.
entries.new: 「是、是的……我们的一个朋友死了，两个人住了院。」
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: ...Oh.{w} I'm very sorry.{w} I can't imagine what that would be like at your age. I thought earlier that something about you two looked off. I'm really sorry for bringing it up.
entries.new: 「……哦。{w} 实在抱歉。{w} 你们这个年纪经历这种事，我实在想象不出有多难受。刚才我就觉得你们俩有点不对劲。真不该提这事，对不起。」
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: It's all right. Don't worry about it.
entries.new: 没关系，别放在心上。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Atsuki said what I'd been about to.{w} Then, Akaro gave us a look of pity. I could only wonder why he'd said any of that.
entries.new: 我正要开口，Atsuki 却先说了出来。{w}随后，Akaro 投来怜悯的目光。我实在不明白他为什么要说那些话。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I did lose someone very close to me a long time ago too. I don't imagine this is something you want to hear from a person you don't know, but all I wish now is that I hadn't thought that much about it.{w} At the time, I thought I'd be disrespecting the dead if I tried to get over it, but that nearly ate me alive.{w} I guess you're already doing much better than me if you're here. Thinking too hard about these things when they just happened can be pure torture.
entries.new: 我很久以前也失去过一个很亲近的人。我知道这话从一个素不相识的人嘴里说出来，你们可能不爱听，但我现在只希望自己当初没有想那么多。{w}当时我觉得，如果试着放下，就是对死者的不敬，可那种想法差点把我整个人吞掉。{w}你们现在能来到这里，已经比我强多了。事情刚发生时想太多，纯粹是折磨。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: The worst part is trying to convince yourself that there's some meaning in it. Sometimes, bad things just happen because they happen, and that's all there is to it. I wanted to believe there was a greater plan, but...
entries.new: 最难受的是，你硬要说服自己这一切有什么意义。有些坏事发生了就是发生了，仅此而已。我也曾想相信冥冥之中自有安排，可是……
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Anyway, the important thing is that you're both still alive. Finding any meaning in that is up to you. Just living and moving past it is enough.
entries.new: 总之，要紧的是你们两人都还活着。至于能否从中找到什么意义，那要看你们自己。只要活下去，跨过这一关，就够了。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: ...I agree. That's why we came here.
entries.new: ……我同意。我们正是为此才来这里的。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Atsuki spoke where I couldn't. Akaro being supportive was something I hadn't expected in the slightest, especially given that I was sure he'd killed me.
entries.new: 我说不出口的话，Atsuki 替我说了。我万万没想到 Akaro 会这样宽慰我们——尤其在我确信他曾杀过我之后。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I know people can't choose a way to react, and I shouldn't be giving any advice. ...It's much easier said than done, but if you can, don't regret anything that you did.
entries.new: 我知道人没法选择怎么反应，也轮不到我来提什么建议。……说来容易做来难，但只要做得到，就别为自己做过的任何事后悔。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: ...Are you okay?
entries.new: ……你没事吧？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Atsuki looked at me with sorrowful eyes. When I nodded, he went back to staring at his lap.
entries.new: Atsuki 悲伤地望着我。我点了点头，他便重新低下头，盯着自己的膝盖。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...And you? I'm sorry, we shouldn't have come.
entries.new: ……你呢？抱歉，我们本不该来的。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Don't be. I'm still glad we're here, and don't worry about me. I'm fine.
entries.new: 别道歉。我还是庆幸我们来了。别担心我，我没事。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: All right.
entries.new: 好吧。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: I smiled, but he didn't look up again.
entries.new: 我笑了笑，他却再没抬起头。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Isla had finished her most recent survey of the cabinets and was sitting in the middle of the room. I looked at the ceiling, where the camera was, and noticed that no green light flickered below the lens.
entries.new: Isla 刚又检查了一遍展示柜，正坐在房间中央。我抬头看向天花板上的摄像头，发现镜头下方没有绿灯闪烁。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Huh...
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I saw Sai looking at his wristwatch.
entries.new: 我看见 Sai 在看手表。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: How long have we been trapped for?
entries.new: 我们被困了多久了？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Uh... almost two hours. It's {time=11.}
entries.new: 呃……快两个小时了。现在是 {time=11.}。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Two hours...? How much longer do we have to be here? This is getting ridiculous.
entries.new: 两个小时……？我们还得在这儿待多久？这也太离谱了。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: It's really strange. I wonder if they're having issues opening the shutter.
entries.new: 真奇怪。会不会是他们那边打不开卷帘门？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: In any case, it has to unlock at any moment.
entries.new: 不管怎样，门随时都可能开。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: ...If only we had waited like that the first time. Nobody knew about the Sekimeiya's powers. That was likely why the time had been passing so smoothly.
entries.new: ……要是第一次我们也这样等下去就好了。那时没人知道 Sekimeiya 的力量，或许正因如此，那段时间才过得如此平静。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Of course, nobody but Akaro. The way he had held it hadn't been a coincidence. ...I didn't know why, but aware of its powers, his intention was to keep us shut in a room while the Sekimeiya was with us.{w} Did he know about the twelve hour limit? ...Or was the reason tied to the other Sekimeiya that I'd seen? I still potentially had one hidden in the attic.
entries.new: 当然，除了 Akaro。他握着它的方式绝非偶然。……我不知道原因，但他既然知道它的力量，那他的意图就是趁 Sekimeiya 还在我们这里时，把我们关在房间里。{w}他知道十二小时的时限吗？……还是说，原因与我见到的另一个 Sekimeiya 有关？阁楼里我可能还藏着一个。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: He was the killer who'd hidden his victims' bodies. He had conjured the illusion that Naomi was still alive thanks to the Sekimeiya.{w} ...Next to me, he hadn't opened his mouth again. He knew that I was lying and must've seen me as a threat, but his brief conversation with us had left me dazed.
entries.new: 他就是那个藏匿受害者尸体的凶手。他借 Sekimeiya 之力，制造出 Naomi 还活着的假象。{w}……坐在我身旁的他再没开过口。他知道我在撒谎，一定也把我视作威胁，可他方才那几句简短的交谈，却让我心神恍惚。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Everyone was quiet. For a long time, all we heard was Isla fidgeting with her sunglasses and sporadic sighs.
entries.new: 所有人都沉默着。很长一段时间里，耳边只有 Isla 摆弄墨镜的细响，和时不时的叹息。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I tried to keep excess thoughts to a minimum. I couldn't understand the strange world I'd suddenly been sent to, so to stave off exhaustion, my mind had remained empty for a while.
entries.new: 我尽量不让多余的念头冒出来。我搞不懂自己怎么突然被丢进这个陌生的世界，为了不让自己累垮，我索性让脑子空了一阵子。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...It's {time=13.}
entries.new: ……现在是 {time=13.}。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Sai read the time out loud every half hour. Rather than comforting us, it made things drag on. I'd gotten pretty tired again just by sitting down for so long.
entries.new: Sai 每半小时就报一次时间。这非但没让人安心，反倒使等待更加漫长。光是坐这么久，我就又累得不行了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: After a while, Sai spoke again.
entries.new: 过了一会儿，Sai 又开口了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: *sigh*{w}{w=0.7} ...I'm going to the bathroom.
entries.new: 唉……{w}{w=0.7}我去趟洗手间。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Everyone watched him stand up, but the silence remained as he left the room. We'd been sitting for a long time, so it wasn't reasonable to stop him.
entries.new: 所有人都看着他起身，可他离开房间后，沉默依旧。我们已经坐了那么久，拦着他也没有道理。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Sai had been practically parked in front of the door, but the atmosphere hadn't changed with him gone. The concern began when a few minutes passed without him returning.
entries.new: Sai 几乎一直守在门口，但他走后，气氛也没有变化。几分钟过去，他仍没回来，不安这才开始蔓延。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'd immediately considered the possibility that he had an ulterior motive, but everyone else took longer to reach that conclusion.
entries.new: 我立刻想到他可能另有目的，其他人却过了好一阵才想到这一层。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Where exactly did Sai go?
entries.new: ……Sai 到底去哪儿了？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Do you think he was lying? It's been a long time since he left.
entries.new: 你觉得他是在骗我们？他走了好久了。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Don't think about him. If he doesn't want to come back, it's not our problem.
entries.new: 别管他。他自己不想回来，那就不关我们的事。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Could Akaro and Sai have been working together? What the hell were they doing, then...?
entries.new: Akaro 和 Sai 会不会是一伙的？那他们到底在做什么……？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What if something happened to him?
entries.new: 万一他出了什么事呢？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Don't be ridiculous. Do you think Naomi attacked him? We would've heard that.
entries.new: 别胡思乱想。你觉得是 Naomi 袭击了他？那动静我们不可能听不见。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: I don't trust him. I think he might be trying to make us search for him so that we leave the room.
entries.new: 我不信他。我看他是想引我们去找他，好让我们离开这个房间。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: ...Really? I don't think that makes much sense.
entries.new: ……是吗？我觉得这说不通。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Forget about him. No matter why he left, staying here is the right call.
entries.new: 别管他了。不管他为什么离开，留在这里才是正确的选择。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: It eventually became clear Sai wasn't coming back. He'd left with our only method to measure the time, but it felt like almost half an hour had passed.
entries.new: 时间一久，谁都明白 Sai 不会回来了。他带走了我们唯一能计时的手段，可感觉上已经过了将近半小时。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Seriously, what the fuck is happening? It's been hours.
entries.new: 说真的，这他妈到底是怎么回事？都过去好几个小时了。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Nobody responded.
entries.new: 没有人应声。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Still next to me, Atsuki and Akaro patiently waited. On the floor lay a tired Isla, while Erina's face showed the most worry.
entries.new: Atsuki 和 Akaro 仍守在我身旁，耐心地等着。Isla 累了，直接坐在地上，而 Erina 脸上的担忧最为明显。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Simultaneously, Atsuki and I looked at the ceiling.
entries.new: 我和 Atsuki 同时抬头看向天花板。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Did you hear something?
entries.new: ……你们听见什么了吗？
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: I think so.
entries.new: 好像有。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: ...What are you talking about?
entries.new: ……你们在说什么？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: It sounded like someone just walked above us. And did you not hear sounds coming from the crystal floor a few minutes ago?
entries.new: 刚才好像有人在咱们头顶上走。还有，几分钟前水晶层那边传来的声音，你没听见？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: What? I didn't hear that.
entries.new: 什么？我没听见。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Erina hadn't noticed anything either.
entries.new: Erina 也什么都没察觉到。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Everyone was on alert, but the sound had been very brief, immediately engulfed by the silence again.
entries.new: 所有人都警觉起来，可那声音极短，转瞬又被寂静吞没。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: However, just a few minutes later, it repeated.
entries.new: 然而只过了几分钟，那声音又响了一次。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Th-There! Did you hear it?
entries.new: 就、就是现在！听见没有？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: We all nodded that time.
entries.new: 这一次，我们都点了头。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Someone's on the second floor.
entries.new: 有人在二楼。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Didn't it sound like more than one person?
entries.new: 听起来不像只有一个人吧？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: ...More than one?
entries.new: ……不止一个？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: My mind jumped to the other Atsuki. ...Was he still there?{w} We listened with rapt attention, but there was nothing else to hear.
entries.new: 我脑中立刻闪过另一个 Atsuki。……他还在那里吗？{w} 我们屏息凝神地听着，却再没听到别的动静。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It took less time to repeat than before, and when it did, we were sure more than one person was outside our room.
entries.new: 这次间隔比之前更短，等声音再响起时，我们已能确定，门外不止一个人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It's Sai and Naomi. ...What the fuck are they doing?
entries.new: 是 Sai 和 Naomi。……他们到底在搞什么鬼？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Erina grimaced at his language but opted not to reprimand him.
entries.new: Erina 听到这粗话皱了皱眉，却没有开口责备他。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It has to be them. There's no way we missed anyone.
entries.new: 只能是他俩。我们不可能漏掉什么人。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Don't think about leaving. Whatever they're doing won't matter as long as we're here.{w} It's not our business either. They're the ones who could be committing a crime.
entries.new: 别想着出去。不管他们在做什么，只要我们还待在这里就与我们无关。{w} 那也不关我们的事。真要有人犯法，也是他们。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: We didn't move, but during the following minutes, the same faint sound of footsteps was heard two more times.
entries.new: 我们没有动，可接下来的几分钟里，同样轻微的脚步声又响了两次。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Whoever they were, they'd been moving through the building. At one point, it seemed as if a sound came from the crystal floor itself, but I didn't mention that.
entries.new: 不管那是谁，他们一直在楼里走动。有一刻，声音似乎就来自水晶层，但我没有说出来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Who was there? Akaro had reiterated that Naomi and Sai were trying to lure us out, but my curiosity went beyond that.
entries.new: ……那边到底是谁？Akaro 反复说 Naomi 和 Sai 是想引我们出去，可我的好奇不止于此。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Unmistakably, more than one person was moving around. However, Naomi couldn't have been included. I knew she was dead.
entries.new: 毫无疑问，来回走动的绝不止一个人。但其中不可能有 Naomi。我知道她已经死了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Then who was the other person? With everything seemingly unchanging, my need to know had only grown larger. Could it have been Atsuki? I didn't think so. Had Katei been there the whole time? I didn't think so either.{w} ...Was it someone who'd traveled through time?
entries.new: 那么另一个人是谁？周围的一切看起来毫无变化，我想知道答案的念头反而越来越强。会是 Atsuki 吗？我觉得不像。Katei 会不会一直就在那里？我也不这么认为。{w} ……难道是某个穿越时间而来的人？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Whoever it was, they hadn't been heard in a while.
entries.new: 不管那人是谁，已经有一阵子没听到动静了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...What time is it now? Are we going to be here all day?
entries.new: ……现在几点了？我们要在这里耗上一整天吗？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: It was getting unbearable even for me, who knew when the supposed end was.
entries.new: 连我这个知道所谓终点何时到来的人，也快要撑不住了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Erina walked a few steps. I thought she only wanted to stretch her body again, but that wasn't it.
entries.new: Erina 走了几步。我以为她只是想再活动一下身体，但并不是。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I have to go to the bathroom.{w} Do you need to go too, Isla?
entries.new: ……我得去趟洗手间。{w} Isla，你也需要去吗？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Hm...
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: She shook her head.{w} At the same time, the rest of us looked on with skepticism after what had happened with Sai.
entries.new: 她摇了摇头。{w} 因为 Sai 之前的事，我们其余人都带着怀疑看着她。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Don't worry, it shouldn't matter if only one of us leaves. I doubt I'll come across Sai or Naomi, but I'll be right back.
entries.new: 别担心，只出去一个人应该没关系。我想我不会碰上 Sai 或 Naomi，很快就回来。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: ...But she wasn't.{w} After a little while, we realized the same thing had occurred.
entries.new: ……可她并没有回来。{w} 过了一会儿，我们意识到同样的事又发生了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: And since she'd left, the sporadic sounds had returned. Someone had walked above us and on the crystal floor, but all of those noises were faint.
entries.new: 而且自从她离开，零星的响声又回来了。有人从我们头顶走过，也有人走在水晶地面上，但那些声音都很轻。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Eventually, even Isla began to look concerned, quietly staring at the empty door.
entries.new: 到最后，连 Isla 也露出了不安的神色，静静地盯着空无一人的门口。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: When Sai didn't come back, it was natural to assume it was his choice. The case wasn't the same with Erina.
entries.new: Sai 没有回来，大可以认为那是他自己的选择。Erina 却不同。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Someone was there—someone who shouldn't have been there. Had they prevented both people from coming back to us...?
entries.new: 那里有人——一个本不该在那里的人。难道是那人让两个人都回不来……？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I couldn't take it anymore. Once again, the sounds had momentarily stopped, but I had to know who else was in the building. As I was convinced Akaro had been my killer, I didn't fear leaving the room anymore.
entries.new: 我再也忍不下去了。响声又一次暂时停了，可我必须知道楼里还有谁。既然我认定杀我的人是 Akaro，那离开这个房间也没什么好怕的了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'll go too.
entries.new: 我也去。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: H-Huh?
entries.new: 诶、诶？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: I'll come back, though. Sorry, we've been here for too long.
entries.new: 不过我会回来的。抱歉，我们在这里待得太久了。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Before he could object, I walked to the door. I didn't exactly want to leave Atsuki behind, but I had no choice.{w} I hadn't missed Akaro's sudden frown, but he kept his mouth shut as I passed by Isla.
entries.new: 没等他出言反对，我已经走向门口。我并非真的想丢下 Atsuki，但别无选择。{w}Akaro 骤然皱眉，我看在眼里；可我从 Isla 身旁经过时，他终究什么也没说。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I looked both ways. Nothing about the hallway appeared immediately odd, but the darkness was imposing.
entries.new: 我左右张望。走廊乍看之下并无异样，可那片黑暗却透着一股逼人的压迫感。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The lobby door was open. Drawn to it, I tried not to make a sound.
entries.new: 大堂的门开着。我像被它引着一般走过去，尽量不发出声响。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What the hell!?
entries.new: 这到底是怎么回事！？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Both bodies were there, near the hallway A door. Like before, my own looked at the ceiling with empty eyes, while drops of blood had stained the floor beneath Naomi's head.{w} In addition, all the ceiling lights were on, even the ones that the alarm had disabled and weren't working in the morning.
entries.new: 两具尸体都在，就在 A走廊门口附近。和先前一样，我自己的那具尸体用空洞的双眼望着天花板，Naomi 头下的地板则被滴落的血染红了。{w}此外，天花板上的灯全亮着，连早晨因警报而失效、本不亮的那些也亮了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I knew Sai had once tried to kill us, but those bodies couldn't have been his doing alone. Recalling the faint sounds I'd heard from inside the room, I slowly stepped to the other door.
entries.new: 我知道 Sai 曾经想杀我们，但那两具尸体不可能全是他一人所为。回想起刚才从房间里隐约听到的声响，我慢慢朝另一扇门走去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The bodies had been moved to the lobby, and there was no way the other Atsuki would've done that. Unable to look at them up close, I hurried out.
entries.new: 尸体已经被搬到了大堂，另一个 Atsuki 绝不可能这么做。我无法凑近去看那两具尸体，只能匆匆离开。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: No way.
entries.new: 不可能……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Someone was far ahead, next to the staircase.{w} A pool of blood extended around a third fallen body, lying in the illuminated zone.
entries.new: 前方远处有个人影，就在楼梯旁。{w}第三具尸体倒在灯光照亮的区域，身下漫开一摊血。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Erina. What's happening...!?
entries.new: Erina……到底发生什么了……！？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: My heart dropped like a stone. I looked away from her body, but I had to fight back tears.
entries.new: 我的心猛地沉了下去。我移开视线，不忍再看她的尸体，却还是得强忍住眼泪。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Had the killer been outside all along?{w} It was too overwhelming—I couldn't bear it anymore. But the next thing I heard was footsteps from hallway B, causing my heart to drop even further.
entries.new: 难道凶手一直就在外面？{w}这一切太沉重，我再也承受不住。可紧接着，B走廊传来的脚步声让我的心又往下沉了一截。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I ran as fast as I could, but I was too late. All I saw was Atsuki's figure disappearing into the lobby.
entries.new: 我拼命跑去，却还是晚了一步。只看见 Atsuki 的身影消失在大堂里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I clenched my fists, desperately thinking about what to do. He had already seen both bodies, but there'd been no audible reaction.
entries.new: 我攥紧拳头，拼命想着该怎么办。他已经看见了那两具尸体，却一点动静也没有。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Suddenly, someone else came out of the crystal room. Before I hid myself behind the wall, I was able to see Akaro.
entries.new: 忽然，又有人从水晶展室出来。我赶在躲到墙后之前，看清了那是 Akaro。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What now...!? Do I have to hide again?
entries.new: 现在又怎么了……！？我还得再躲一次吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Everything had gone down the drain so fast. I felt unable to move, as if my racing heart was using all my energy.
entries.new: 一切转眼间全都完了。我连动都动不了，仿佛狂跳的心脏已经抽干了我全部力气。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Hey! Where the fuck are all of you!?
entries.new: ……喂！你们他妈都死哪去了！？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Huh?
entries.new: 诶？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I looked at the hallway again.
entries.new: 我又朝走廊看去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: As soon as I did, I saw Akaro coming out of the event room.
entries.new: 这一看，正好看见 Akaro 从活动室里出来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Then, he began to get closer.
entries.new: 接着，他开始朝这边靠近。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: He might notice me if I try to leave.
entries.new: 我要是现在出去，说不定会被他看见。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...What?
entries.new: ……什么？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Did he enter... the staff room?
entries.new: 他进了……员工室？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I'd heard Akaro's short steps and then a door closing.
entries.new: 我听见 Akaro 短促的脚步声，随后是一道门关上的声音。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...But before I could think about it, I realized Atsuki was in hallway A, slowly approaching Erina.
entries.new: ……可还没等我细想，就发现 Atsuki 正在 A走廊里，慢慢朝 Erina 走去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I had nowhere to hide. As a last-ditch effort, I darted to the bathrooms, which I could see were empty.
entries.new: 我无处可藏。走投无路之下，我冲进洗手间——我能看见里面空无一人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I slowly closed the door of the women's and locked it with the inner latch.
entries.new: 我慢慢关上女洗手间的门，用内侧的插销锁好。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I can stay here. Katei was the one who had the key.
entries.new: 我可以待在这里。钥匙在 Katei 手上。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Soon after I heard Atsuki's steps reach Erina's body, they ran up the stairs.
entries.new: 没过多久，我听见 Atsuki 的脚步声来到 Erina 的尸体旁，随即又跑上了楼梯。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What is he doing? Does he want to find whoever else is in the building?
entries.new: 他在干什么？是想找出楼里其余还活着的人吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: From Atsuki's point of view, only Sai or an extra person could've killed the three of them. My body wore different clothes, but there was no way he'd care about that while unaware of what the Sekimeiya could do.
entries.new: 在 Atsuki 看来，能杀死那三个人的，只可能是 Sai 或某个多出来的人。我的尸体穿着不同的衣服，可他既然不知道 Sekimeiya 能做什么，就不可能去在意这种事。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I hated thinking about it. He'd found me dead, and I couldn't even imagine what I would've felt in his place.
entries.new: 我不愿去想这件事。他看见我死了，我甚至无法想象，若换成我，会是什么感受。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Once his steps had disappeared, I continued to pay attention so that I could hear what was happening in hallway B.
entries.new: 等他的脚步声消失后，我仍留心听着，想弄清 B走廊里有什么动静。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But nothing did. Since Akaro had shut himself in a room, I'd heard no new movement.
entries.new: 可什么也没发生。自 Akaro 把自己关进房间后，我就再没听到新的动静。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Is he still there? ...What about Isla?
entries.new: 他还在那儿吗？……Isla 呢？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Could the door have been preventing the sound from reaching me?{w} No. I'd heard Atsuki going up the stairs.
entries.new: 难道是门挡住了声音，才传不到我耳中？{w}不，我连 Atsuki 上楼的声音都听见了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...And why did he only call for us once? He immediately went quiet.
entries.new: ……再说，他怎么只喊了我们一次？喊完就立刻没了声音。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I didn't know where Akaro was, but the time when Atsuki had seen the me in different clothing was slowly approaching. I just had to wait a bit more to see whether my hopes had been in vain.
entries.new: 我不知道 Akaro 在哪里，但离 Atsuki 见到我穿着另一身衣服的那一刻已经越来越近了。我再等一会儿，就能知道自己的希望有没有落空。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: How's this possible? Where did everyone go?
entries.new: 这怎么可能？人都去哪儿了？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I'd been in the bathroom for several minutes, but the impossible silence hadn't ceased. We'd heard sounds from the crystal room. Someone had to be there. ...Why was everything so quiet, then?
entries.new: 我在洗手间里待了好几分钟，那份反常的死寂却始终没有消散。我们明明听到水晶展室传来声响，那里一定有人。……可为什么四周这么安静？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Should I go to the storeroom?
entries.new: ……我该去储藏室看看吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I unlocked the door. I had the chance to go back there, so I slowly opened the way out.
entries.new: 我拧开门锁。既然有机会回到那里，我便缓缓推开了门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Is there really nobody here?
entries.new: 这里真的一个人都没有？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: The silence persisted once I stepped out. I'd wanted to run straight to the storeroom, but I noticed that all the doors in hallway B were closed.
entries.new: 走出门外，寂静依然。我本想直奔储藏室，却发现 B走廊的每一扇门都关着。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What about Isla? She can't see Erina's body.
entries.new: Isla 怎么办？不能让她看到 Erina 的尸体。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Wait.
entries.new: 等等。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I approached room B4 as soon as a thought came to mind.
entries.new: 念头一起，我便走向 B4。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: After a deep breath, I twisted the doorknob.
entries.new: 深吸一口气，我拧动了门把手。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Undertow
entries.new: 暗流

entries.text: She's not here.{w} Oh... I was right.
entries.new: 她不在这里。{w} 哦……我猜对了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: The cabinet where the Sekimeiya had been was open. I stepped up to it and glanced inside.
entries.new: 原本放着 Sekimeiya 的展示柜敞开着。我走上前，朝里面看了一眼。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The Sekimeiya was still there, and its color was white. After staring at it for a while, I reached inside and took it out, protected by my long sleeves.
entries.new: Sekimeiya 还在里面，通体白色。我盯着它看了一会儿，才隔着长袖伸进去把它拿了出来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It's cold.{w} ...They must've traveled, though. That's why the sounds stopped.
entries.new: 好冰。{w} ……不过，他们一定是穿越走了，所以声音才停下。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...But where were they? I was clueless.{w} Why had the Sekimeiya been touched, and why had it allowed someone to travel? The temperature in the cabinet was frigid.
entries.new: ……可他们去了哪里？我毫无头绪。{w} Sekimeiya 为什么会被人碰过，又为什么会让人穿越？展示柜里冷得刺骨。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I walked to the hallway and then to the staff room.
entries.new: 我走到走廊，又去了员工室。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Holding the Sekimeiya with one hand, I opened the door.
entries.new: 我一手抱着 Sekimeiya，推开了门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: He's not here. I'm pretty sure this is where he went.
entries.new: 他不在这里。我很确定他来了这里。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I... should bring the Sekimeiya to the storeroom.
entries.new: 我……得把 Sekimeiya 带去储藏室。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Without thinking twice, I ran to hallway A.
entries.new: 我想都没想，便朝 A走廊跑去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I looked both ways to confirm that nobody was there and gripped the doorknob.
entries.new: 我左右张望，确认四下无人，才握住门把手。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What?
entries.new: 什么？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: My jaw dropped, and I stared at the lobby. Its door had been left open.
entries.new: 我目瞪口呆，怔怔地望着大厅。大厅的门竟然敞开着。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Were my eyes betraying me? As I got closer, I knew that I hadn't imagined it.
entries.new: 是我看错了吗？走近之后，我才明白那不是错觉。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Where's Naomi...?
entries.new: Naomi 呢……？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Only my own corpse remained on the floor. Although the red pool of Naomi's blood was still next to it, the body it belonged to wasn't there.
entries.new: 地板上只剩我自己的尸体。旁边 Naomi 的那摊血还在，可血的主人却不见了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The sensation that had once faded came back, reminding me of where I was. Inexplicable mysteries were bound to occur on December 15th.
entries.new: 曾经淡去的感觉又回来了，提醒我此刻身在何处。12月15日，注定会有无法解释的怪事发生。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I turned around; trying to think it through was useless. Even though I didn't know what I was waiting for, it was clear anything could happen, so going back to my own world wasn't far-fetched.
entries.new: 我转过身。再怎么想也无济于事。虽然不知道自己还在等什么，但既然什么都可能发生，回到自己的世界也不足为奇。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I entered the hidden part of the storeroom and dropped the Sekimeiya on the floor. Glowing in the darkness, its temperature was noticeably higher than after I'd taken it out of the cabinet.
entries.new: 我走进储藏室里隐蔽的那一侧，把 Sekimeiya 放在地上。它在黑暗中发着光，温度明显比我刚从展示柜里取出时更高。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: When I least expected it, a crucial piece of the puzzle fell into place.
entries.new: 偏偏在我最没想到的时候，最关键的一块拼图归位了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wait, of course...! How did I not realize this earlier?
entries.new: 等等，原来如此……！我怎么早没想到？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I left the storeroom. If what had been in the lobby was a pool, near the staircase, Erina's body lay on a sea of blood.{w} ...That Erina, below the broken elevator... We had never spoken to her. That was because she had died.
entries.new: 我离开储藏室。如果说大厅里的只是一小摊，那么楼梯附近，Erina 的尸体就躺在一片血海之中。{w} ……那个倒在损坏的电梯下方的 Erina……我们始终没能和她说上话。因为她早已死了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Did it make any sense? My idea was muddled, but I was sure it was on the right track.
entries.new: ……这说得通吗？我的思路还很混乱，但我确信方向没错。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I had to make sure of something. ...I had to make sure Akaro and Isla weren't anywhere.
entries.new: 我必须确认一件事。……必须确认 Akaro 和 Isla 哪儿都不在。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Even though an immense amount of things didn't add up, I thought I'd found one of the keys. As I bolted up the stairs, details reinforced that thought.
entries.new: 尽管还有太多事情对不上，我仍觉得自己找到了其中一把钥匙。我飞奔上楼，一个个细节也印证着这个念头。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It's gotta be later than {time=15.} That fits perfectly.{w} And... the drop of blood that Atsuki and I saw in the lobby... It was exactly where Naomi's body left it before vanishing.
entries.new: 现在肯定已经过了 {time=15.}。这样就全对上了。{w} 还有……我和 Atsuki 在大厅看到的那滴血……正是 Naomi 的尸体消失前留下它的位置。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: When I reached the offices, I stopped myself abruptly. There was something on the floor.
entries.new: 到了办公区，我猛地停住脚步。地板上有什么东西。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Another Sekimeiya...?{w} Could this be the one I hid?
entries.new: 另一个 Sekimeiya……？{w} 难道是我藏起来的那个？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I hovered my hand over it. An aura of heat surrounded it, so it was functional as well.
entries.new: 我把手悬在它上方。一股热气环绕着它，看来它同样还能用。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: When I picked it up, I felt that it was even hotter than I'd thought. Thanks to the thick clothes from the attic, I was able to bring it with me.
entries.new: 拿起来才发现，它比我以为的还要烫。多亏从阁楼拿的厚衣服，我才能把它带上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Did Atsuki see it? This had to be here for a while.
entries.new: ……Atsuki 看到了吗？这东西应该已经在这儿放了很久。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Running up the floors, I saw that every elevator panel had been taken off. Had Akaro been responsible for that? I had no clue anymore.
entries.new: 我一路往上跑，发现每层电梯的操作面板都被拆了下来。是 Akaro 干的吗？我已经毫无头绪。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Eventually, I reached the attic's door. Every floor had been vacant, but the attic couldn't be.
entries.new: 我终于来到阁楼门前。每一层都空无一人，可阁楼不该如此。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It was open, so I could see the narrow staircase ahead.{w} Why? Why wasn't the door locked anymore? Furthermore, the key was inserted in the outer keyhole.
entries.new: 门开着，前方的窄梯一览无余。{w}为什么？门为什么不再上锁了？不仅如此，外侧的锁孔里还插着钥匙。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Many footprints were pressed into the carpet. It didn't make any sense, but I didn't care. I also saw that the suitcase was no longer on the sofa.{w} As soon as I stepped into the living room, I heard a noise coming from one of the bedrooms.
entries.new: 地毯上印着许多脚印。这说不通，可我已经不在乎了。我还发现沙发上的行李箱不见了。{w}刚踏进客厅，我便听见某间卧室里传来响动。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'd hidden the Sekimeiya there hours earlier. When I got closer, I could make out the sound better, and I locked up.
entries.new: 几个小时前，我把 Sekimeiya 藏在了那里。走近之后，声音听得更真切，我顿时僵在原地。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Atsuki was crying. I could see his torso on top of the bed, twitching rhythmically.
entries.new: Atsuki 在哭。我看见他伏在床上的上半身，正有节奏地抽动着。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: He had seen the dead bodies—my own death.{w} I was still alive, though.
entries.new: 他看见了那些尸体——看见了我的死。{w}可我还活着。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I recalled what Sai had told us a long time in the past. According to him, the drop of blood in the lobby was mine.{w} He'd been wrong, hadn't he? It was Naomi's.{w} In that case, why had he said that? And why had he been both right and wrong about my fate?
entries.new: 我想起很久以前 Sai 对我们说过的话。据他所说，大厅里那滴血是我的。{w}他弄错了，不是吗？那是 Naomi 的。{w}既然如此，他为什么要那么说？而对于我的命运，他又为何既说对了，又说错了？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I stepped back, careful not to make a sound. Perhaps I was a monster for that, but it was the only thing I could do.
entries.new: 我向后退去，不敢发出一点声音。也许正因如此，我才像个怪物，可我别无他法。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Atsuki had learned that the me of his world had died. I wanted to go back to mine, so I couldn't show myself and disappear on him again.
entries.new: Atsuki 已经知道，他那个世界的我已经死了。我想回到自己的世界，所以我不能现身，再从他眼前消失一次。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Aside from Atsuki and me, the whole tower was empty. How could that be, though? Where were Akaro and Isla?
entries.new: 除了 Atsuki 和我，整座塔空无一人。可这怎么可能？Akaro 和 Isla 到哪儿去了？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The answer to that question was one I already knew.{w} They were in my world. They were the proof that going back was possible.
entries.new: 这个问题的答案，我其实早已知道。{w}他们在我那个世界里。他们就是能回去的证明。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: At the point I was, an Akaro had appeared in the attic. His memories had differed from ours, and there had been a major distinction between us—he didn't know Katei.
entries.new: 在我所处的那个时刻，阁楼里曾出现过一个 Akaro。他的记忆与我们不同，而他和我们之间有一个关键区别——他不认识 Katei。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It had taken me a while to process it, but everything he said had started to make sense. The events he described were the ones I'd just lived through.{w} He'd sympathized with us, and he'd been surprised to hear we'd found Naomi's body but not that she'd died. After all, he had killed her in the world I was in, hadn't he?
entries.new: 我花了一阵子才理清，但他说的话渐渐都说得通了。他描述的，正是我刚刚经历过的事。{w}他对我们表示同情；听说我们找到了 Naomi 的尸体，他很吃惊，但听说她已经死了却并不意外。毕竟，在我所在的那个世界里，杀死她的人正是他，不是吗？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Sai? I have no idea. He left the room earlier and didn't come back. What are you all even doing here?
entries.new: Sai？我完全不知道。他早些时候出了房间，就没再回来。你们到底在这儿干什么？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: I mean... what I said. Why are you all here?
entries.new: 我是说……我刚才问的。你们为什么都在这儿？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: We tried to stay put in one place together. Do you not remember that?
entries.new: 我们不是一直守在同一处地方吗。你不记得了？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: No, I do. That doesn't answer my question, though.
entries.new: 不，我记得。可这没回答我的问题。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: How does it not answer your question? You and Sai escaped, and now you came back.
entries.new: 怎么没回答？你和 Sai 逃了出去，现在又回来了。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: What!? That's not true! I didn't escape.
entries.new: 什么！？胡说！我根本没逃出去。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: And Isla... What the hell happened to her?{w} At the same time that Akaro appeared, Erina swore she heard Isla just outside the bedroom.
entries.new: 还有 Isla……她到底出了什么事？{w}就在 Akaro 出现的同时，Erina 坚持说她听见 Isla 就在卧室门外。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Then, the last person, Sai... Where was he?
entries.new: 那么，最后一个人，Sai……他在哪儿？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The Sai who chased us with a knife... Who was he?{w} ...The one who left the crystal room a while ago is the one who had the chance to see my body in the lobby. Is that where he made a mistake?
entries.new: 那个拿着刀追我们的 Sai……他到底是谁？{w}……刚才离开水晶展室的那个人，才可能在大厅看见我的尸体。他是不是就在那儿搞错了？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I went back to the storeroom and moved behind the wall.
entries.new: 我回到储藏室，绕到墙后。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: After dropping the Sekimeiya, I shifted my focus to the one I'd left there earlier.
entries.new: 放下 Sekimeiya 后，我把注意力转向先前留在这里的那一台。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: How did they reach that world? There can only be one answer: with the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 他们是怎么到达那个世界的？答案只有一个：靠 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: The cabinet was open, so they touched the Sekimeiya. Even Sai could've touched the other one after leaving the room.
entries.new: 展示柜开着，所以他们碰过 Sekimeiya。就算是 Sai，离开房间后也可能碰过另一台。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: That's what brought them there. It has to be.{w} How did I even get here in the first place? It was by touching the Sekimeiya. ...And why did Atsuki disappear from this world? I'd bet it happened when Naomi touched the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 就是它把他们送到了那里。一定是这样。{w}那我自己最初又是怎么来到这里的？是因为碰了 Sekimeiya。……还有，Atsuki 为什么会从这个世界上消失？我猜，是在 Naomi 碰 Sekimeiya 的时候。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: So then, why would it send me to another world as opposed to making me travel through time?
entries.new: 那么，它为什么把我送去另一个世界，而不是让我穿越时间？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I didn't know that. It didn't make any sense. However, I could be confident it would work. It had already been proven.
entries.new: 我不知道。这毫无道理。但我确信它会奏效——这一点早已得到证实。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: After all, Atsuki had seen me on the crystal floor wearing the clothes I was wearing that very second. If I touched the Sekimeiya, I was guaranteed to go back.
entries.new: 毕竟，Atsuki 曾在水晶层看见我，穿着与我此刻一模一样的衣服。只要我碰 Sekimeiya，就必定能回去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I didn't waste any more time. The darkness highlighted two glows, but my hand only approached one. It was the one I believed Akaro and Isla used.
entries.new: 我不再多耽搁。黑暗中有两处微光格外醒目，我的手却只伸向其中一处。我相信那就是 Akaro 和 Isla 用过的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Before I realized it, the glow disappeared in an instant of brief heat.
entries.new: 还没等我反应过来，那点微光便带着短暂的热意消失了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Did it power off...?
entries.new: 是断电了吗……？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I extended my hand more and understood that wasn't the case. ...It hadn't just powered off. The Sekimeiya wasn't there anymore.
entries.new: 我把手再往前探，才知道并非如此。……不只是断电。Sekimeiya 已经不在那里了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I tried to find the other one, but I couldn't. The darkness had become absolute yet again, and as I smelled the air, I felt I noticed a difference.
entries.new: 我试着去找另一台，却找不到。四周又陷入彻底的黑暗，我嗅了嗅空气，似乎察觉到了什么不同。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Did it work? I didn't teleport.
entries.new: 成功了吗？我没有被传送走。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I touched the walls around me. I was still in the storeroom.
entries.new: 我摸了摸四周的墙壁。我仍在储藏室里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Oh!
entries.new: 啊！
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I stood up and took off to the door at the end of the corridor. When I hit it, I frantically felt its surface with my hand.
entries.new: 我站起身，冲向走廊尽头的那扇门。一到门前，我就慌忙用手摸索门面。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It's not here! The handle's gone!
entries.new: 不在这里！门把手不见了！
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I had... made it back. I really had.
entries.new: 我……回来了。我真的回来了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I dropped to the floor, exhausted and overwhelmed. There were so many things that I didn't understand, but I'd been right about the most important one. I closed my eyes, letting out short breaths until they slowed down.
entries.new: 我瘫坐在地上，筋疲力尽，心绪翻涌。有太多事我仍不明白，但最关键的那一点，我猜对了。我闭上眼，急促的呼吸渐渐平缓下来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Transformative Interference
entries.new: 转化性干涉

entries.text: What do I want to do now...?
entries.new: 我现在想做什么……？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I wasn't safe in the storeroom anymore. The handle was gone, so everyone should have known about the hidden section. It appeared I had two options to choose from.
entries.new: 储藏室已不再安全。门把手没了，那处暗藏的空间想必人人都已知道。看来我只有两条路可选。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: How did the world function? Even though I'd changed the past, I'd gone back to a reality that I'd long thought erased. Just that fact made me doubt it was possible to alter history.
entries.new: 这个世界究竟是如何运作的？我明明改变了过去，却回到了一个我早已认定被抹消的现实。单是这一点，就让我怀疑历史是否真能被改写。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: However, I had to think it was possible. I could do it right that moment. If I showed myself, I would change the events I'd experienced. And that was what I had to choose.
entries.new: 可我得相信这是可能的。此刻我就能做到。只要我现身，就能改变我经历过的那些事。这就是我必须做的选择。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Whether to change the past or not. ...Did both options make sense?
entries.new: 要不要改变过去。……这两个选择都说得通吗？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If I let everything repeat, the current version of myself will travel from the bathroom. That will let me take her place once again. ...I'd have to let Katei die for that.
entries.new: 如果我让一切重演，现在这个我就会从洗手间那边穿越过来。那样我就能再一次取代她。……可为了这个，我就得让 Katei 死去。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: And still, to do it, I couldn't merely stay put. I had to purposely let Atsuki see me to seal the start and end of the loop.
entries.new: 而且，要做到这一点，我不能只是按兵不动。我必须故意让 Atsuki 看见我，好让这条循环的首尾闭合。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Will that be how it'll work in the end?
entries.new: ……到头来，一切真会变成那样吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: If I divert the events from the ones I remember, two versions of me will persist. It might also erase the Atsuki I met this morning, or myself, depending on what the consequences will be...
entries.new: 如果我让事情的走向偏离记忆中的样子，就会出现两个我。这或许还会抹消今早遇见的那个 Atsuki，也可能抹消我自己——要看后果如何……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Like I'd wanted, I had eventually returned to my target world by just waiting. The proper circumstances had aligned to fulfill what had to happen. If I just waited a while longer, I would arrive at the truth of Atsuki seeing me.
entries.new: 如我所愿，我只是等待，最终还是回到了目标世界。该发生的事，条件都已齐备。只要再等上一阵，我就能查明 Atsuki 看见我的那个真相。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I didn't know the exact time, so I got as close to the hallway as possible.
entries.new: 我不知道确切的时间，只好尽量贴近走廊。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I can't really hear anything.
entries.new: ……什么也听不见。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Hm...{w} I'm pretty sure someone should be here, no matter what time it is.
entries.new: 唔……{w}不管是什么时候，这里按理都该有人才对。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: We didn't look at the storeroom again when we left the attic, did we...? I might really be able to stay here undiscovered.
entries.new: 我们离开阁楼的时候，没有再去看储藏室吧……？说不定我真能一直躲在这里，不被人发现。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Had I always been there all along? I had a lot of trouble visualizing exactly what had happened.
entries.new: 我难道一直都在那里？当时究竟发生了什么，我实在很难想象。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Trying to perceive any sound, I continued pressing my ear against the wall.
entries.new: 我继续把耳朵贴在墙上，想捕捉任何声响。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Once again, that led into minutes of silence, and as they kept passing, my concern only strengthened.
entries.new: ……又是一连几分钟的死寂，时间越久，我越是不安。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Was I really in the same place? Maybe the handleless door hadn't been the proof I thought.
entries.new: 我真的还在同一个地方吗？也许那扇没有把手的门，并不能像我以为的那样证明什么。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: This is probably the time we were locked in the attic, but we know things happened down here while we were above. ...What's with the complete silence, then?
entries.new: 现在大概就是我们被关在阁楼里的那段时间。可我们知道，我们在上面的时候，下面确实发生过什么。……那怎么会静成这样？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: The Akaro who appeared in the bedroom... He has to be the one I was with just now. If that's correct, Isla was actually in the attic as well when Erina heard her.
entries.new: 出现在卧室里的那个 Akaro……一定就是刚才和我在一起的那个。若果真如此，Erina 听见 Isla 的时候，她其实就在阁楼里。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: So then, what happened to them? Why did we never find Isla, and why did Akaro disappear?
entries.new: 那么，他们后来怎样了？为什么我们始终没找到 Isla，Akaro 又为什么会消失？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: We had left Akaro in the lower level of the bedroom. A while later, he disappeared. Furthermore, the chain hadn't been removed.
entries.new: 我们把 Akaro 留在了卧室下层。过了一阵，他就消失了。而且，锁链并没有被取下。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There was a simple explanation—disappearing with the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 解释很简单——用 Sekimeiya 消失。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: When the ominous silence had gone on for a while, I decided to open the door in front of the wall.
entries.new: 那不祥的寂静持续了一阵，我决定打开墙边的那扇门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Hallway A.{w} Immediately, I noticed something that differed.
entries.new: ……A走廊。{w}我立刻察觉到一处不同。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The elevator button is in place.
entries.new: 电梯按钮装好了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Is it correct that if I don't intend to change the past, it won't? If so, that'll be very convenient.
entries.new: 只要我没有改变过去的打算，过去就不会被改变——是这样吗？若真如此，那就太方便了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I mean, I have proof that I'll still be here hours later, so I can do whatever I want as long as I don't purposely change the past.
entries.new: 毕竟，我有证据证明几小时后我仍会在这里。所以只要不刻意改变过去，我做什么都行。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I went up the staircase. ...Could Isla have been in the attic?
entries.new: 我走上楼梯。……Isla 会不会就在阁楼里？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I had to see it with my own eyes. I had to confirm I was back there.
entries.new: 我必须亲眼看看，必须确认自己回到了那里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I reached the attic's door. Next to every elevator on the way up, the metallic panels had been properly attached.
entries.new: 我来到阁楼门前。一路上每部电梯旁，金属面板都装得好好的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I looked at the floor of the living room. Even though it had changed considerably, there were still recent footprints, and the empty suitcase was back on the sofa.
entries.new: 我看向客厅的地板。虽然变化不小，上面却仍有新鲜的脚印，那只空行李箱也回到了沙发上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wait a second.
entries.new: 等等。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I stared by my feet after stepping in and remembered something Atsuki had once said.
entries.new: 走进屋里，我低头盯着脚边，想起 Atsuki 曾说过的一句话。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: A-Are these Isla's? They can't be, right? And I think they're a bit too big.
entries.new: 这、这是 Isla 的吗？不会吧？而且我觉得有点太大了。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: I couldn't make any sound. Slowly, I stepped to the hallway and saw all that I needed to see.
entries.new: 我发不出任何声音。我慢慢挪到走廊，眼前的一切已经足够说明问题。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There's no handle here either...
entries.new: 这里也没有把手……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: That could've only meant one thing. As I stood there, we were all behind that door.
entries.new: 那只可能意味着一件事。我站在那里时，我们所有人都在那扇门后。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: So, is Isla here?
entries.new: 那么，Isla 在这里吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Like we'd once done, I took off my boots to reach the other bedroom while making the least amount of noise.
entries.new: 我像之前那样脱下靴子，尽可能不出声地走向另一间卧室。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It was empty.
entries.new: 里面空无一人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: So was the kitchen.
entries.new: 厨房也一样。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: And the storeroom.
entries.new: 储藏室也是。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...She's not here.
entries.new: ……她不在这里。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...{w}I put on my boots and closed the door.
entries.new: ……{w}我穿上靴子，关上了门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Then what the hell happened to her? Did she—
entries.new: 那她到底出了什么事？难道她——
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Hold on.{w} That's it. ...That's what happened!
entries.new: 等等。{w}就是这样。……原来是这样！
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: The identity of Isla's friend...{w} I had finally figured it out.
entries.new: Isla 那位朋友的身份……{w}我终于想通了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Isla had died, so how could she have been alive within a month? Atsuki had already stated that the recording was no trap.
entries.new: Isla 明明已经死了，怎么可能在一个月之内还活着？Atsuki 也说过，那段录音不是陷阱。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There were many things I had learned. Vaisude revealed that there was a large travel at around {time=16.} That was how he had appeared on the 24th of November, and it happened to fit with the approximate date Isla's friend had appeared.
entries.new: 我已经弄清了许多事。Vaisude 透露，{time=16.} 前后曾发生过一次大规模的穿越。正因如此，他才会在 11 月 24 日出现，而这也恰好与 Isla 的朋友出现的大致日期相符。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: And that's not all. This also explains another mystery: Akaro's disappearance.
entries.new: 而且不止如此。这还解开了另一个谜团：Akaro 的消失。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: There's someone else who appeared on the 24th of November. The person who escaped from a prison cell, who I really have to assume was Akaro.
entries.new: 11 月 24 日还有另一个人出现。那个从牢房里逃出来的人——我只能认为，那就是 Akaro。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: At {time=16}, there was a very large travel, and everyone who got caught up in it appeared on the 24th of November. Three people who traveled were Vaisude, Isla, and Akaro.
entries.new: {time=16}，发生了一次规模极大的时间穿越，所有被卷入其中的人都在11月24日出现。发生穿越的三人是 Vaisude、Isla 和 Akaro。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: The Akaro who appeared in the cell wasn't the same Akaro we originally met in the morning. In a way, that explains some of the questions I had.{w} Didn't Atsuki say that he'd seen Akaro once again? That was the version of him who escaped the bedroom with Sai.{w} Why did he appear in prison, and what did he do later? I don't know, but at this point I have no doubt Akaro was the Xyn member trapped with us.
entries.new: 出现在牢房里的 Akaro，并不是我们早上最初见到的那个 Akaro。从某种意义上说，这解释了我心里的几个疑问。{w} Atsuki 不是说过，他又见到过 Akaro 一次吗？那是和 Sai 一起逃出卧室的那个他。{w} 可他为什么出现在牢房，之后又做了什么？我不知道，但到了这一步，我已毫不怀疑——和我们一起被困住的 Xyn 成员就是 Akaro。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: And that's how both Islas met. ...Earlier, when we were in the bedroom, Erina's and Isla's behavior seemed different. That's because in that world, her "friend" never appeared.{w} This is the solution to Atsuki's problem. After going to the past, she didn't recreate what she had lived through. For her, that was happening for the first time.
entries.new: 两个 Isla 就是这样相遇的。……先前在卧室时，Erina 和 Isla 的举止有些反常。那是因为在那个世界里，她的「朋友」始终没有出现。{w} 这也解开了 Atsuki 的疑问。回到过去之后，她并没有重演自己经历过的一切。对她来说，那些事都是第一次发生。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: When I thought about it, all the things we'd heard about her friend made sense.
entries.new: 这么一想，我们听过的那些关于她那位朋友的话，就全都说得通了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: "She said that if we stayed calm in one place, nobody would be hurt."{w} That's exactly what we did. We stayed in a crystal room, and Isla never saw any of the dead bodies.
entries.new: 「她说，只要我们安静地待在一个地方，就不会有人受伤。」{w} 我们也确实这么做了。我们一直待在某个水晶展室里，Isla 从未见过任何尸体。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: "She said that even though she didn't know how it would end or how long we'd stay here for, she'd wait for me at home."{w} I see. The reason she didn't know how it would end was because she traveled to the past in the middle of the day, and she didn't know how long we'd stay because Katei hadn't been there to explain the alarm.
entries.new: 「她说，虽然她不知道事情会怎样结束，也不知道我们要在这里待多久，但她会在家里等我。」{w} 原来如此。她不知道事情会怎样结束，是因为她在白天就穿越回了过去；她不知道我们要待多久，是因为当时 Katei 不在，没人解释那阵警报。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It makes sense. Isla was told that seven people would get trapped and that it'd be three men and four women. That's just because the other Isla wasn't counting Katei.
entries.new: 这就说得通了。有人告诉 Isla，会有七个人被困住，三男四女。那只是因为另一个 Isla 没有把 Katei 算进去。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: There was one last thing Isla had told us. Her friend assured her that she would get to touch the Sekimeiya.{w} The Isla I'd just been with had touched it. In the crystal room, she asked about it, but Akaro told her not to. When he left Isla alone, I'm sure she took advantage of it. That was why the cabinet was open and why both of them appeared in the world I was in.
entries.new: Isla 还告诉过我们最后一件事。她的朋友向她保证，她一定能亲手碰触 Sekimeiya。{w} 我刚才见到的那个 Isla 就碰过它。在水晶展室里，她问起过它，Akaro 却不许她碰。等 Akaro 留下她一个人时，她一定抓住了机会。所以展示柜才会开着，两人也才会出现在我所在的世界。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There's only one thing I find strange... If she appeared in this world in that room, she would've noticed that a curtain had appeared on the floor with Naomi's corpse under it. ...Did she see it?
entries.new: 只有一件事让我觉得奇怪……如果她是在那个房间里出现在这个世界的，那她应该会注意到地上多了一块遮布，下面就盖着 Naomi 的尸体。……她看见了吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Hm... the Sekimeiya was inside the cabinet, so she had to climb inside to touch it. If she changed worlds inside the cabinet, she would have shut herself in there, because it's locked in this world. I wonder what exactly happened.
entries.new: 嗯……Sekimeiya 当时在展示柜里，她得钻进去才碰得到。如果她是在展示柜里切换了世界，那她就等于把自己关在了里面——在这个世界里，柜子是锁着的。到底发生了什么？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: And when did the recording come into play in all of this...?
entries.new: 还有，那段录音又是在什么时候掺进这整件事里的……？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: A sound came from the hallway.
entries.new: 走廊那边传来声响。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Did they open the door...?
entries.new: 是他们把门打开了吗……？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Someone was there, but I could only hear footsteps.
entries.new: 有人在那里，但我只听得见脚步声。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I made sure not to move, but I couldn't discern who it was.
entries.new: 我刻意一动不动，却分辨不出那人是谁。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It has to be us. ...We just left the bedroom.
entries.new: 一定是我们。……我们才刚离开卧室。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: They're still there.
entries.new: 他们还在那里。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: The sound wasn't reaching well where I was. There had been brief periods of silence, but I could tell the hallway was not empty.
entries.new: 我这边听得不太清楚。中间有几次短暂的安静，但我能感觉到走廊里并不是空的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Soon, the dry footsteps faded away.
entries.new: 不久，那干涩的脚步声渐渐远去了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Did they leave? That wasn't only one person.
entries.new: ……他们走了吗？刚才可不止一个人。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I should go back to the crystal floor.
entries.new: 我得回水晶层去。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I didn't like the idea of staying in the attic, but I could've been seen if I went all the way down.
entries.new: 我不想一直待在阁楼里，可要是一路走下去，说不定会被人看见。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: No matter who that was, I can probably make it down before them.
entries.new: 不管那是谁，我大概都能抢在他们前面下去。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I tried to open the elevator, but it didn't budge. Then, as soon as I pressed the button, I felt a spark in my mind.
entries.new: 我试着打开电梯，门却纹丝不动。可就在我按下按钮的瞬间，脑中仿佛有什么一闪。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Whoa, what the hell...?{w} Did this happen again?
entries.new: 哇，怎么回事……？{w} 又来了吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Dumbfounded, I stared at the button until it lit up orange.
entries.new: 我愣愣地盯着按钮，直到它亮起橙色的光。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Inside the elevator, I pressed the lowest button.
entries.new: 进了电梯，我按下最底层的按钮。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: While I descended the building, I reeled from confusion. ...What had just happened?
entries.new: 电梯下行时，我脑子里一片混乱。……刚才究竟发生了什么？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I opened the door on the crystal floor and made a quick dash to the storeroom.
entries.new: ……我打开水晶层的门，快步冲向储藏室。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I paid my utmost attention behind the door. What was about to happen was very important.
entries.new: 我把全部注意力都放在门后。接下来要发生的事至关重要。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There it is!
entries.new: 来了！
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Someone appeared from the staircase.
entries.new: 有人从楼梯口出现了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...It's more than one person. It has to be the same people who just left the attic.
entries.new: ……不止一个人。一定是刚刚离开阁楼的那几个。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: That meant it had to be us. It had to be us... Atsuki and me.
entries.new: 那就是说，一定是我们。一定是我们……Atsuki 和我。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Was that me? I just heard a voice.
entries.new: 那是我吗？我刚才听到了说话声。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I wasn't sure, but they didn't speak again. Instead, they got closer to where I was.
entries.new: 我不确定，但他们没有再出声，而是朝我这边靠近了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: And as the sound of their footsteps increased, they quickly decreased. Then, they opened a door. ...I had to think it was the event room's.
entries.new: 脚步声一点点变大，随即又迅速变小。接着，有人打开了门。……我想那一定是活动室的门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What the hell...? It has to be us, but it doesn't make sense.
entries.new: 怎么回事……？那一定是我们，可这说不通。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Something else had to happen, so I waited for it.
entries.new: 一定还会发生别的事，所以我继续等着。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I waited... for something that didn't happen.
entries.new: 我等了……可什么也没等到。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Nobody else came from the staircase side. In fact, ever since the footsteps had crossed the hallway, I hadn't heard anything.
entries.new: 楼梯那边再没有人过来。事实上，自从脚步声穿过走廊之后，我就再没听到任何动静。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: In just a few minutes, I began to doubt what had been confirmed. I doubted I really was back in that world.
entries.new: 才过了几分钟，我就开始怀疑刚才还确定无疑的事。我怀疑自己是不是真的回到了那个世界。
entries.speaker: i
