entries.text: I glanced at hallway A. Nobody was there, but I believed it was easy to confirm where I was.
entries.new: 我瞥了一眼 A走廊。那里空无一人，但我相信要确认自己身在何处并不难。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Cautiously, I walked to the lobby door. I opened it slowly, creating the tiniest gap.
entries.new: 我小心翼翼地走到大厅门口，缓缓推开门，只留下一道极细的缝隙。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: As I'd thought, something was wrong.
entries.new: 果然，有什么地方不对劲。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It was completely empty. My own body had disappeared even though a single drop of blood remained near the door.
entries.new: 里面空无一物。门边只剩一滴血，我自己的身体却不见了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Why... Why is nobody here?
entries.new: 为什么……为什么这里一个人都没有？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I went to the event room, where the door had been left open. ...The display cabinet was empty.
entries.new: 我去了活动室，门仍敞着。……展示柜里已经空了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There's no chance I'm not back, is there?
entries.new: 我总不可能没回来吧？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I had to be, and a way to be sure was in hallway B. But something else grabbed my attention as soon as I stepped in.
entries.new: 我肯定回来了，而确认这一点的方法就在 B走廊。可我刚踏进去，另一样东西便吸引了我的目光。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: A door was open. It belonged to the farthest crystal room, B6.
entries.new: 有扇门开着。那是走廊尽头的水晶展室 B6。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I approached it slowly and soon saw what was behind it.
entries.new: 我慢慢走近，很快就看清了门后的东西。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The Sekimeiya was just inside the room. Its color was white, and nobody was there.
entries.new: Sekimeiya 就在门内，通体白色，周围不见人影。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I could only frown as I walked up to it. That was the place we had traveled from after leaving the attic. Many things indicated I was in that world.
entries.new: 我皱着眉头走上前。这里正是我们离开阁楼后出发的地方。许多迹象都表明我就在那个世界。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But not all. There was something that wasn't right, and it was baffling.
entries.new: 但并非所有迹象都如此。有什么地方对不上，让我百思不解。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: So there are two Sekimeiya here as well...?
entries.new: 这么说，这里也有两台 Sekimeiya……？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: That had to be right, and no matter what was happening, keeping one was a good idea. Still rattled, I picked it up.
entries.new: 应该没错。不管正在发生什么，手里有一台总归稳妥。我心神不定，却还是把它拿了起来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The headache was coming back, so I left quickly and directed myself to the room I'd wanted to inspect.
entries.new: 头痛又犯了，我赶紧离开，走向那间想查看的房间。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: B4, where I'd been for hours. When I opened the door, I found what I expected on the other side.
entries.new: B4，我在那里待了好几个小时。推开门，门后的景象和我预想的一样。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Naomi was on the floor, under a curtain. There were bloodstains near her and on the wall, too.
entries.new: Naomi 倒在地上，身上盖着遮布。她身旁和墙上都有血迹。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Just what the hell is happening?{w} The Sekimeiya I have right now is the one we touched in that crystal room, right...?
entries.new: 到底发生什么事了？{w}我现在手里的这台 Sekimeiya，就是我们在那间水晶展室里碰过的那台，对吧……？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I just took it, so that's why we didn't find it later. ...Instead, we found it in a drawer.{w} That must not have been the same one. ...Is that it?
entries.new: 是我刚刚把它拿走了，所以后来才找不到。……结果，我们却在抽屉里发现了一台。{w}那一定不是同一台。……是这样吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: The structure of those events didn't make sense. There was a major contradiction.
entries.new: 这一连串事情根本说不通，其中有个极大的矛盾。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I approached one of the cabinets. Its side wheel was damaged.
entries.new: ……我走近其中一个展示柜。侧面的轮子已经损坏。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It's the same cabinet we saw that day.{w} ...Actually, I should keep the Sekimeiya here. I was thinking of bringing it to the storeroom, but that could be risky depending on what happened.
entries.new: 这就是我们那天看到的那个展示柜。{w}……说起来，我还是把 Sekimeiya 留在这里吧。我本来想把它带到储藏室，但万一出了什么状况，那样做可能很危险。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: After all, why had I traveled back to that world? Due to an idea I'd had, I didn't want to stay near the Sekimeiya. For the same reason, I had to turn the wheel.
entries.new: 毕竟，我为什么会回到那个世界？因为心里有了一个念头，我不想待在 Sekimeiya 旁边。出于同样的理由，我必须转动那个轮子。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Akaro set it to 5 °C, but that must not have been enough, because the Sekimeiya still worked when Isla touched it. ...We found it set to 0 °C, so that might be better.
entries.new: Akaro 把它设成了 5 °C，但显然不够，因为 Isla 碰到 Sekimeiya 时，它仍然启动了。……我们发现它被设成 0 °C，那样也许更保险。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I still couldn't easily believe what I was thinking. ...Had everything really happened as I thought?
entries.new: 我仍然很难相信自己想到的这个结论。……一切真的都如我所想的那样发生了吗？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I knew I had to be wrong about something, so what made the most sense... was that I was mistaken about what time it was.
entries.new: 我知道自己一定在某处弄错了，而最合理的解释……是我把时间弄错了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...After all, I had used the elevator.
entries.new: ……毕竟，我乘过那部电梯。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: In the attic, I'd been so distracted that I hardly considered the elevator would be audible. In fact, while I'd thought about it, I'd been blinded by the assumption that if I didn't mean to change the past, everything would repeat, and I was at no risk of being seen.
entries.new: 在阁楼时，我心神不宁，几乎没想过电梯的声音会传出去。事实上，我之所以没有细想，是因为被一个前提蒙蔽了：只要我无意改变过去，一切就会照原样重演，我也绝不会被人发现。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If everything did happen the same way, it was guaranteed that I wouldn't be found. Therefore, using the elevator to go to the crystal floor was safe. That had been my unconscious thought process.
entries.new: 如果一切确实照原样发生，那我必定不会被人发现。所以，乘坐电梯前往水晶层是安全的。这就是我下意识的思路。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But it had generated a logical issue in my mind.
entries.new: 但这让我的推理出现了一个逻辑矛盾。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Who had caused the noises I'd heard in the attic? I'd assumed that was the time we'd left the bedroom.
entries.new: 我在阁楼听到的声响是谁弄出来的？我一直以为，那是我们离开卧室时发出的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But what had happened after that?
entries.new: 可在那之后，又发生了什么？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Atsuki and I went down to the crystal floor and then to the event room. That's what I heard from the storeroom just now.
entries.new: 我和 Atsuki 下到水晶层，然后去了活动室。这是我刚才在储藏室听到的。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Then, we found the Sekimeiya in room B6. We touched it and traveled through time.
entries.new: 然后，我们在水晶展室 B6 找到了 Sekimeiya。我们碰了它，于是穿越了时间。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: We appeared back in the bedroom, and then we went to the lobby before our original versions arrived on the crystal floor. We determined that we'd gone five minutes to the past.
entries.new: 我们回到了卧室，随后赶在原本的我们抵达水晶层之前去了大厅。我们判断自己回到了五分钟前。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: However, that didn't make any sense.
entries.new: 然而，这根本说不通。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The elevator was another key detail to those events.{w} After leaving the attic's bedroom for the first time, we had heard the elevator twice on the office floors.
entries.new: 电梯也是这些事件中的另一个关键细节。{w}第一次离开阁楼的卧室后，我们在办公楼层听到了两次电梯声。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Then, when we traveled five minutes to the past, I pressed the button in the attic. That's why we thought it was us who called it from the attic and took it down.
entries.new: 然后，在我们穿越回五分钟前时，我在阁楼按下了按钮。所以我们才以为，是我们从阁楼叫了电梯，并把它乘了下去。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: And just now, when I called the elevator, I thought "Did this happen again? Did I once again call the elevator without realizing that I was going to produce the sound I'd already heard?"
entries.new: 而刚才，我按下电梯时还在想：「这件事是不是又发生了一次？我是不是又一次叫了电梯，却没意识到自己正要发出那早已听过的声音？」
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: That was wrong, though. It couldn't have happened "again" because both elevator trips were the very same.
entries.new: 可那不对。它不可能「又」发生一次，因为两次电梯之行根本就是同一次。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: After Atsuki and I touched the Sekimeiya and appeared in the bedroom, I called the elevator, producing the sound we heard before traveling. Now, right after the old versions of us went down, I called the elevator, producing the sound we heard.
entries.new: 我和 Atsuki 碰过 Sekimeiya、出现在卧室后，我按了电梯，发出了我们穿越前听到的声响。而这一次，就在过去的我们下去之后，我又按了电梯，发出了我们听到的声响。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Which one was right, and which one was wrong? Only one was the truth.
entries.new: 哪一个才对，哪一个才错？真相只有一个。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: That was the reason why I was skeptical about my surroundings. I was in that world, but there had to be something I was mistaken about.{w} If it was the time of day, everything made sense. If the sounds I'd heard in the attic hadn't belonged to our past selves, there was no contradiction.
entries.new: 正因如此，我才对周围的环境心存怀疑。我确实身处那个世界，但一定有什么地方被我弄错了。{w}如果错的是时刻，一切就都说得通。如果我在阁楼听到的声响并非来自过去的我们，那就不存在矛盾。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But was that it...? It didn't seem likely. From the storeroom, I was pretty sure I'd heard my own voice. That would've been when we'd checked the elevator to confirm that it arrived on the crystal floor.
entries.new: 在储藏室里，我很确定听见了自己的声音。那应该是我们去确认电梯是否抵达水晶层的时候。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If I just caused the sound we heard that day, then what the hell happened after we appeared in the bedroom?
entries.new: 如果那天我们听到的声响正是我刚才弄出来的，那我们在卧室出现之后到底发生了什么？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Just a few minutes prior, I'd confirmed nobody was in the lobby. ...But the versions of us who had touched the Sekimeiya in B6 were supposed to be there.
entries.new: 就在几分钟前，我还确认过大厅里空无一人。……可碰过 B6 那台 Sekimeiya 的我们，本该就在大厅里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Who had caused the elevator noises? No matter which one was correct, the other interpretation was completely wrong.
entries.new: 电梯的声响究竟是谁弄出来的？无论哪一种解释才对，另一种解释都完全错误。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'd been trying to combat my headache to understand what had happened. Even though both versions of things made perfect sense separately, it was impossible to reconcile them.
entries.new: 我一直强忍着头痛，想弄清发生了什么。两种说法各自都完美成立，却无论如何也无法调和。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...In the storeroom, I touched the Sekimeiya and the world around me changed. Could something like that have happened when we touched it in room B6?
entries.new: ……在储藏室里，我碰了 Sekimeiya，周围的世界就变了。我们在水晶展室 B6 碰它时，会不会也发生了同样的事？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: That seemed like it could make sense, but there was another problem. Atsuki had seen me after that point. That implied he was still in the same world.
entries.new: 这似乎说得通，可还有另一个问题：在那之后，Atsuki 见过我。也就是说，他仍留在这个世界。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'd been caught up sorting everything out in my head when I heard someone just outside the door.
entries.new: 我正忙着在脑中理清头绪，忽然听见门外有人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Who's that?
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: The sound only intensified, and soon, the door opened. When I saw who was there, I rushed over.
entries.new: 声响越来越大，很快，门开了。看清来人是谁，我立刻冲了过去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Erina...! A-Are you—
entries.new: Erina……！你、你怎么样——
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Before I could finish, she fell to the floor.{w} Her clothes were soaked in blood, and her expression was vacant. I moved to shake her shoulder, but she didn't respond.
entries.new: 话还没说完，她便瘫倒在地。{w} 衣服浸透了血，神情空洞。我伸手去摇她的肩膀，她却毫无反应。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wh-What happened...?
entries.new: 怎、怎么回事……？
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Disconcerted, I closed the door. I didn't want to be heard, and I wasn't sure who else was there. However, I calmed myself down when I recalled what had happened.
entries.new: 我心里一慌，关上了门。我不想让人听见，也说不准还有谁在。但一想起先前发生的事，我便冷静下来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Right... Okay. She's not dead.
entries.new: 对了……还好。她没死。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: That was the room where we'd found her, and she had fallen in the same position. I placed a finger on her neck and felt the pulse we'd missed.
entries.new: 这正是我们发现她的那个房间，而她倒下的姿势也与当时相同。我把手指搭上她的脖颈，摸到了那时被我们漏掉的脉搏。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: She said she got hit in the head, but who did it...? All this blood can't be hers.
entries.new: 她说自己头部挨了一下，可动手的是谁……？这么多血不可能都是她的。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Who could've hit Erina? ...Akaro, Sai, and Katei. However, no one else but Katei had lost that much blood.
entries.new: 会是谁对 Erina 下的手？……Akaro、Sai，还有 Katei。可除了 Katei，没人流过这么多血。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...The blood is fresh. ...Katei's already dead, then.
entries.new: ……血还没干。……看来 Katei 已经死了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I was once again lost. Everything was repeating, which meant that I hadn't been mistaken. What I'd heard in the attic was really us leaving the bedroom.
entries.new: 我又一次陷入迷茫。一切都在重复，说明我没有弄错。我在阁楼里听到的，确实是我们离开卧室的动静。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I doubted what to do. Sai and Akaro could've been very close by.{w} In the other world, Akaro had killed me, and in the one I was in, Sai would soon chase us with a knife. No matter what, I couldn't let myself be seen, so going to the storeroom was dangerous.
entries.new: 我一时拿不定主意。Sai 和 Akaro 很可能就在附近。{w} 在另一个世界里，Akaro 杀了我；而在我所处的这个世界，Sai 很快就会拿刀来追我们。无论如何，我都不能被人看见，所以去储藏室太冒险了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Katei and Erina left the attic together. They might've been attacked at the same time by Akaro or Sai.
entries.new: Katei 和 Erina 是一起离开阁楼的。她们也许同时遭到了 Akaro 或 Sai 的袭击。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: So, what about us? Where were our past selves?
entries.new: 那么，我们呢？过去的我们又在哪儿？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: According to my memories, we should have been in the lobby when I'd peeked into it, so I couldn't blindly trust what I remembered in that regard.
entries.new: 按照我的记忆，我朝大厅里张望时，我们应该就在里面；可在这件事上，我不能盲目相信自己的记忆。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Maybe I should go to the storeroom anyway. If everything will play out the same, I can be sure I won't be seen.
entries.new: 也许我还是该去储藏室。如果一切都会照原样重演，那我就能确定自己不会被人看见。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Wait, no.{w} I don't have to.
entries.new: 等等，不对。{w} 我没必要去。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I thought a little ahead. When we'd found Erina, we failed to realize that she was alive. Due to the shock, we'd barely stepped into the room.
entries.new: 我稍微往前想了一下。我们发现 Erina 时，并没有意识到她还活着。因为太过震惊，我们几乎没走进房间。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I could leave, but given what I knew, I didn't have to. If I stayed next to the door when it opened, our past selves wouldn't see me. It was better not to move.
entries.new: 我本可以离开，但以我现在所知，没有这个必要。只要门开时我待在门边，过去的我们就看不见我。还是不要动为好。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I waited next to the door. From there, the whole floor seemed silent.
entries.new: 我在门边等着。从那里听去，整层楼寂静无声。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Erina had completely passed out. She hadn't moved an inch, and as the seconds passed, I kept wondering where Atsuki and the other me were.
entries.new: Erina 彻底昏了过去，一动不动。时间一点点过去，我一直在想 Atsuki 和另一个我究竟在哪里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I didn't get it. Was I not properly remembering what had happened...?{w} I looked up at the camera. Was I being recorded in two different places simultaneously?
entries.new: 我不明白。难道是我记错了当时的情形……？{w} 我抬头望向摄像头。难道我同时被两个不同的地方拍下来了？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What...?{w} The green light still isn't there. That's odd...
entries.new: 什么……？{w} 绿灯还是没亮。真奇怪……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: The Sekimeiya was in my hands. I'd gotten distracted, so I hadn't left it in the cabinet. However, I'd also noticed something else that was strange, which had made me very reluctant to follow through with that.
entries.new: Sekimeiya 还在我手上。我方才走了神，没将它放回展示柜。可我也察觉到了另一处不对劲，因此迟迟不愿把它放回去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I didn't have to wait long before I heard a door opening. It sounded like someone had come from the lobby.
entries.new: 我没等多久，便听见一扇门开了。听动静，像是有人从大厅那边过来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Again, it's more than one person. ...Are they gonna go to the bathrooms?
entries.new: 又是好几个人。……他们是要去洗手间吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: They did.{w} Then, another door was opened. ...I knew it was the staff room's.
entries.new: 果然如此。{w} 接着，又有一扇门打开了。……我知道，那是员工室的门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It really is us. What the hell, then?
entries.new: 真是我们。那到底是怎么回事？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...et the Se—{w} ...has to be—
entries.new: ……拿到 Sekimeiya——{w} ……一定得——
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: It is. That was Atsuki.
entries.new: 没错。那是 Atsuki。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I remember what we did... After checking that Naomi's locker was still open, we found the Sekimeiya in a drawer in room B6. We brought it to the event room, and then we found Katei and Erina.
entries.new: 我记得我们做过什么……确认 Naomi 的储物柜还开着后，我们在 B6 房间的抽屉里找到了 Sekimeiya。我们把它带到活动室，随后发现了 Katei 和 Erina。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: As predicted, the steps eventually moved to the event room.
entries.new: 不出所料，脚步声最终朝活动室移去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If I'm not mistaken, they'll come here soon.
entries.new: 如果我没记错，他们很快就会来这里。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: My tension grew, but I had to be fine as long as I didn't make noise. Meanwhile, I kept wondering what to do with the Sekimeiya that I had. ...I could be sure there had always been two of them, as we had just locked one in its cabinet.
entries.new: 我越来越紧张，但只要不发出声响，应该就不会有事。与此同时，我一直在想手里这枚 Sekimeiya 该怎么办。……我已经能确定，它始终有两枚；毕竟我们刚刚把其中一个锁进了展示柜。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There was no remaining doubt in my mind that I was right, so I waited. After finding Katei, it hadn't taken us very long to come across Erina.
entries.new: 我心中已不再怀疑自己的判断，于是继续等着。发现 Katei 之后，我们没过多久就遇上了 Erina。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: And that was reflected by the sound behind the door. Mere minutes after it faded, the lobby door opened again.
entries.new: 门外传来的声响正印证了这一点。声音消失不过几分钟，大厅的门又开了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I knew full well the desolate atmosphere we'd experienced as we'd looked in every room. After that repeated, they opened the door next to me, and I was forced to relive the shock of seeing Erina's bloodied body through their sharp gasps.
entries.new: 我太清楚逐一查看每个房间时那种荒凉的感觉了。那一切重演之后，他们打开了我身旁的门；听着他们猛然倒抽气的声音，我被迫再次感受到那种看到 Erina 浑身是血时的震惊。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Atsuki took two steps forward, and I heard my past self crumple down. Hidden behind the door, I held my breath.
entries.new: Atsuki 向前走了两步，我听见过去的自己瘫坐下去。我躲在门后，屏住了呼吸。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: That's it... I can't look at her. Let's go...
entries.new: 够了……我实在看不下去。走吧……
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Slowly, Atsuki turned around. I couldn't see it, but I felt the despair that came from him.
entries.new: Atsuki 缓缓转过身。我看不见他的神情，却能感到他身上透出的绝望。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Give me a second.
entries.new: 等我一下。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Before they left, Atsuki detached the curtain from the cabinet closest to him and covered Erina with it.
entries.new: 离开之前，Atsuki 从最近的展示柜上扯下遮布，盖在了 Erina 身上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I exhaled. I may have been in the same world I'd come from originally, but there were loads of things I didn't understand.
entries.new: 我吐出一口气。我或许仍身处最初的那个世界，但有太多事情我还不明白。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: So now what?
entries.new: 那现在该怎么办？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: The Sekimeiya entailed a dilemma. I wanted to leave it behind, but that potentially created its own problem.
entries.new: Sekimeiya 让我陷入了两难。我想把它留下，可这么做本身又可能埋下新的隐患。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Oh...! This is what happened!
entries.new: 啊……！原来是这么回事！
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: When I thought ahead, the answer to a persistent question was finally answered.
entries.new: 顺着这个思路往前推，一个盘桓已久的问题终于有了答案。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I... I just trapped myself.
entries.new: 我……我竟然把自己困住了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I'd been going one step at a time, so I hadn't realized a direct result of what I'd done.
entries.new: 我一直走一步算一步，所以没意识到自己做的事已经直接造成了这个结果。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: After finding Erina, we went to the event room, and Atsuki sat next to the hallway A door.
entries.new: 找到 Erina 后，我们去了活动室，Atsuki 则坐到了 A走廊门旁。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I finally understood... The reason why he'd seen me, and why that would repeat.
entries.new: 我终于明白了……他为什么会看见我，又为什么那一幕会重演。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'm trapped. As soon as I leave this room, Atsuki will hear and see me. ...That's what woke him up.
entries.new: 我被困住了。只要一离开这间房，Atsuki 就会听到动静、看见我。……他就是这么醒来的。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...And I had to leave. If I stayed there for much longer, a search would eventually find me. That wasn't all—I knew Erina would soon regain consciousness herself, and I had a reason to think Sai would search the room I was in fairly soon. ...I had to leave, and as soon as I did, I would force our past selves out of the event room.
entries.new: ……而我必须离开。再在那里待下去，迟早会有人搜到这里。不止如此——我知道 Erina 很快也会醒来，而且我有理由认为，Sai 用不了多久就会来搜我所在的房间。……我必须离开；而我一走，就会把过去的我们从活动室里逼出去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I had a Sekimeiya with me, so teleporting out was an option. But it was one I couldn't risk, because I refused to leave the world I was in again.
entries.new: 我手上带着 Sekimeiya，传送离开本是一个选择。但我不能冒这个险，因为我不愿再次离开自己所在的世界。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: In the event room, I had fallen asleep very quickly. I'd been dead tired that day.{w} I felt a similar exhaustion at that moment. I'd been in the tower for many hours already, but they'd fortunately been much less dense.
entries.new: 在活动室里，我很快就睡着了。那天我实在疲惫不堪。{w}此刻我也感到相似的倦意。我已经在塔里待了好几个小时，但好在这些时间远没有那天那么紧凑。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: After I leave, Atsuki will call for me, and I won't appear.
entries.new: 我离开之后，Atsuki 会喊我，但我不会出现。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Unbelievable as it seemed, that aligned with what I wanted, so it made sense for it to occur. I could watch what had happened from a distance, and there was something I was curious about.
entries.new: 虽然难以置信，但这正合我意，所以它会发生也合乎情理。我能够从远处旁观已经发生的事，而且有一件事让我好奇。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There was yet another reason—it would've caused a problem that I was finally sure existed.{w} I couldn't interact with my old self. It was the same thing we'd considered with Isla. If my past self met the future me and tried to keep everything exactly the same, she'd have to replicate precisely what she'd seen me do. Every word, every movement. No human was capable of that.{w} It was crucial not to be seen by both her and Atsuki.
entries.new: 还有一个原因：那样做会引发一个我如今终于确定存在的问题。{w}我不能和过去的自己接触。这和当初我们与 Isla 讨论过的是同一回事。如果过去的我遇见了未来的我，还想让一切保持原样，她就必须把看见我做的每件事都分毫不差地复现出来——每一句话、每一个动作。没有人能做到这一点。{w}绝不能让过去的我和 Atsuki 同时看见我。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: A certain time was approaching. There was something I'd been avoiding thinking about.
entries.new: 某个时刻正在逼近。有一件事，我一直不愿去想。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: On that mountain, I made a decision...{w} To change the past and save everyone. Miiya, Isla, Erina, Katei, Naomi...
entries.new: 在那座山上，我下定了决心……{w}要改变过去，救下所有人。Miiya、Isla、Erina、Katei、Naomi……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: While that reality seemed distant, it was as close as ever. The time I'd found the Sekimeiya in the water tank would soon come. At that point, the Sekimeiya had shot me quite far through time, even though I didn't know why.
entries.new: 那个现实看似遥远，此刻却前所未有地近。我在水箱里发现 Sekimeiya 的时刻很快就要到来。那时，Sekimeiya 把我抛到了相当遥远的时间点，我却不明白缘由。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...When I go to the bathroom, I just have to stop my old self. ...That should let the Sekimeiya store even more energy, so if I touch it later, I'll go to November again. To a time before Miiya died.
entries.new: ……等我去洗手间时，只要拦住过去的自己就行。……这样一来，Sekimeiya 应该能蓄积更多能量；之后我再碰它，就会回到十一月。回到 Miiya 死前的时间。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: That was all I had to do. If I changed the past in just the right way, accomplishing what I'd decided was well within reach.
entries.new: 我要做的仅此而已。只要把过去改得恰到好处，要实现我定下的目标便并非难事。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: And yet... I didn't know what to do.{w} Hadn't I also decided that going to the past was a mistake?
entries.new: 然而……我却不知道自己该做什么。{w}我不是也认定过，回到过去是个错误吗？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If I didn't interfere, my past self would travel, and I would become myself again. I could just leave with Atsuki...
entries.new: 如果我不插手，过去的我就会完成穿越，而我也能重新变回我自己。我大可以就这样和 Atsuki 一起离开……
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But is that even the case...? Would that really be possible?
entries.new: 可事情真是这样吗……？那样真的可行吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: The Atsuki from this morning said that the recording was real. We won't simply leave at {time=21.}
entries.new: 今早的 Atsuki 说那段录音是真的。到了 {time=21.}，我们不会就这么离开。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: And that wasn't all. He was suspicious of me and asked if I was the real Shiroya.{w} ...Why? What happened after I went back in time?
entries.new: 而且还不止如此。他起了疑心，问我是不是真的 Shiroya。{w}……为什么？我回到过去之后，到底发生了什么？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Up until then, my safety had been guaranteed because Atsuki had seen me late into the day. Beyond that point, I couldn't be confident about anything. On top of that, it was a fact that I'd never been mentioned in the recording.
entries.new: 在那之前，我的安全一直有保障，因为 Atsuki 直到那天很晚都还见过我。过了那个时间点，我就什么都不敢确定了。更何况，录音里从头到尾都没提过我。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I also recalled that I'd been seen again later, wearing the clothes from the attic. That had only been briefly mentioned, so I didn't know what it was about.
entries.new: 我还想起，后来我又被人看见过，穿着从阁楼拿来的衣服。那件事只被简单提过一句，所以我并不知道究竟是怎么回事。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I looked down. When the Sekimeiya had begun to get too hot, I'd left it on the floor.{w} It was a bit difficult to decide what to do with it.
entries.new: 我低下头。Sekimeiya 开始烫得厉害时，我把它放在了地板上。{w}要怎么处置它，我还有些拿不定主意。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: My intention was to leave it in that cold cabinet, but I think something's odd about that.
entries.new: 我本打算把它放进那个冰冷的展示柜里，但我觉得这件事有些不对劲。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...Once I leave, our past selves will go to the attic. While they're returning, the elevator will be intercepted and Sai will chase them.
entries.new: ……我一离开，过去的我们就会去阁楼。等他们回来时，电梯会在半途被截下，Sai 会去追他们。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: They'll all end up in the event room, where Sai's attitude will flip. Something we didn't figure out was how he managed to not be found in hallway B when Atsuki searched through every room.
entries.new: 他们最后都会到活动室，而 Sai 的态度会在那里突然转变。我们当时没想通的是，Atsuki 把每个房间都搜遍了，他到底是怎么在 B 走廊里没被搜出来的。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: If I left the Sekimeiya in that cabinet, that would've given him a way out. He could've disappeared by touching it. That was why I'd thought that he might've been about to investigate the room and find out that a Sekimeiya was there.
entries.new: 如果我把 Sekimeiya 留在那个展示柜里，就等于给了他一条脱身之路。他只要碰它一下，就能消失。正因如此，我才觉得他可能正准备查看那个房间，并发现那里有 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: At that point, another Sekimeiya was in the event room. If there are only two, the only way Sai could've disappeared from one of these rooms is with the Sekimeiya that I have now.
entries.new: 那时，活动室里还有另一个 Sekimeiya。如果总共只有两个，那么 Sai 想从这些房间中的某一间消失，唯一的办法就是借助现在我手上的这个 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I would keep it cold, so he'd have to take it out, wait for Atsuki to investigate the other rooms, and touch it as soon as this one was about to be searched in order to get away.
entries.new: 我会让它保持低温，这样他就得先把它取出来，等 Atsuki 查完其他房间，再趁这间即将被搜的时候碰它一下，借此脱身。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: But it's not so straightforward, because according to Atsuki, he looked in every cabinet. If that's what happened, he should've seen the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 但事情没这么简单，因为据 Atsuki 说，他检查过每一个展示柜。若真是如此，他本该看到 Sekimeiya 才对。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Is it possible it teleported after Sai used it...? I'm not sure about that anymore.
entries.new: 会不会是 Sai 用过之后，它自己传送走了……？这一点我已经无法确定了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...{w}That was what seemed odd. Up until that point, everything I'd done that had matched with what I'd already lived through contained a purpose. The clothes, showing myself, the elevator... I hadn't repeated anything without a reason.{w} So then, what was going on? Would I leave the Sekimeiya there to give Sai a way to escape? ...Simply to avoid changing the past?
entries.new: ……{w}奇怪的地方就在这里。在那之前，我做的每件事都和已经经历过的过去吻合，但都有自己的目的。衣服、现身、电梯……我重复任何一件事都有理由。{w}那么，到底是怎么回事？我难道会把 Sekimeiya 留在那里，只为了给 Sai 一条脱身之路？……仅仅为了不改变过去？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It was weird. Because I had realized it, I had no reason to leave the Sekimeiya in that cabinet. Even though I wanted to hide it far from me, it didn't have to be in hallway B.{w} I didn't want to leave the Sekimeiya there. Aside from the fact that it would be consistent with my experiences, it would only bring negative consequences.
entries.new: 这很奇怪。既然我已经意识到了这一点，就没有理由再把 Sekimeiya 留在那个展示柜里。我固然想把它藏到离自己远点的地方，但未必非要放在 B走廊。{w}我不想把 Sekimeiya 留在那里。除了这样能和我经历过的事对得上之外，这么做只会带来坏处。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But didn't that mean Sai would still manage to hide anyway? After all, I wouldn't {i}not{/i} be doing it to change the past; disregarding my own interests purely to be consistent with what I'd already experienced wasn't how everything had worked so far.{w} That was what I was curious about and what I wanted to observe from a distance. How was Sai going to escape detection?
entries.new: 可这不就说明，Sai 到头来还是会藏起来吗？毕竟，我可不是为了{i}不{/i}改变过去才这么做；只是为了和已经经历过的事保持一致就不顾自己的利益，事情到目前并不是这样运作的。{w}这正是我好奇、也想从远处观察的地方。Sai 究竟要怎么逃过搜查？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Helix
entries.new: 螺旋

entries.text: The more I thought about it, the more I believed that leaving the Sekimeiya in the cabinet wasn't the call.
entries.new: 我越想越觉得，把 Sekimeiya 留在展示柜里并非上策。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: When I was sure, I looked at the door. It hadn't been properly closed, so I widened the gap without making a noise.
entries.new: 下定主意后，我看向房门。门没有完全关好，我便悄无声息地把缝隙推大了一些。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...It was as I'd thought. I could see Atsuki sleeping next to the hallway A door.
entries.new: ……果然如我所想。我看见 Atsuki 睡在 A走廊门边。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I took one step forward.
entries.new: 我向前迈出一步。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Immediately, Atsuki's eyes opened. Raising his head, he stared right at me.
entries.new: Atsuki 立刻睁开了眼。他抬起头，直直地盯住我。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I turned and walked down the hallway to reach the storeroom.
entries.new: 我转身沿走廊走向储藏室。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It really had been me. At that time, I had denied it completely, but the person Atsuki saw was the same me, in a sense.
entries.new: 那的确是我。当时我完全否认了这一点，但从某种意义上说，Atsuki 看见的人就是我自己。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: From inside the storeroom, I heard Atsuki slowly walking. He circled the floor until he was back at the event room.
entries.new: 我在储藏室里听见 Atsuki 缓慢的脚步声。他绕着这一层走了一圈，最后又回到了活动室。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Next, they would go to the security room to check the time before going to the attic.
entries.new: 接下来，他们应该会先去监控室确认时间，然后再上阁楼。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Something had just caught my eye.
entries.new: ……刚才有什么东西引起了我的注意。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The green light was on the hallway's camera...
entries.new: 走廊的摄像头上亮着绿灯……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Shiroya! Are you there!?
entries.new: Shiroya！你在吗！？
entries.speaker: a4

entries.text: It was ridiculous. ...I was, in fact, but I didn't want to be seen. Such a nonsensical prediction had turned out true.
entries.new: 太荒谬了。……我确实在，只是不想被人看见。那样荒唐的预测，竟然成真了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Our old selves walked to the stairs to reach the attic. As soon as they were gone, I left as well.
entries.new: 过去的我们走向楼梯，上了阁楼。他们刚一消失，我也离开了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'd left the Sekimeiya on the crystal room floor, as I hadn't wanted to be seen with it.
entries.new: 我不想被人看见自己拿着 Sekimeiya，就把它留在了水晶展室的地上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Oh. Don't tell me it's already gonna be gone.{w} ...Is this how Sai managed to disappear?
entries.new: 哦。别告诉我它已经不见了。{w}……Sai 就是这样消失的吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: That made a lot of sense, so I sped up. Could he have grabbed it so fast?
entries.new: 这么一想，倒也合情合理，我便加快了脚步。他能那么快就把它拿走吗？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: No. ...It's still here.
entries.new: 不。……它还在这里。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It was behind the door, where I'd left it. Carefully, I picked it up.
entries.new: 它就在门后，正是我放下的地方。我小心地把它捡了起来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Where should I put it...?
entries.new: 该放在哪里好……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Thinking about it, I walked to hallway C, where a sudden sound startled me.
entries.new: 我一边想着，一边走向 C走廊，忽然一阵声响吓了我一跳。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wh—
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I retreated immediately.{w} ...In hallway A, I'd just seen Sai. He hadn't seen me in return, but something was very odd.{w} He'd been exiting the storeroom with a knife in his hand and was visibly shocked after looking at the stairs, where there was nothing.
entries.new: 我立刻退了回去。{w}……刚才在 A走廊，我看见了 Sai。他没有看到我，可有件事很不对劲。{w}他手里握着刀，正从储藏室里出来，朝楼梯那边看了一眼——那里什么都没有，他却明显吃了一惊。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Slowly, I kept stepping back until I reached the lobby.
entries.new: 我一步步缓缓后退，一直退到了大堂。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The sound of his footsteps came from hallway B. Then, he started to open doors.
entries.new: 他的脚步声从 B走廊传来。接着，他开始一扇扇地开门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Did he notice me?
entries.new: 他发现我了吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: With his free hand, he'd been touching his mouth. He was the Sai who had chased us, and he was about to intercept the elevator with us inside.
entries.new: 他另一只手一直按在嘴上。他就是追赶过我们的那个 Sai——我们还在电梯里，他却正要上前把电梯拦下。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: He's the one who said I would die. ...It's the Sai who locked me in the attic.
entries.new: 说我会死的人就是他。……就是那个把我关进阁楼的 Sai。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: When he started getting closer, I approached hallway A.
entries.new: 等他开始靠近，我便往 A走廊那边靠过去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: That way, I avoided being seen as I returned to hallway C.
entries.new: 这样一来，我回到 C走廊时就不会被看见。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Sai appeared from the lobby and started to open doors in hallway A as well.
entries.new: Sai 从大堂出来，也开始逐扇查看 A走廊的门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What the hell is he doing...? It seems like he's being silent on purpose.
entries.new: 他到底在干什么……？看上去，他是故意不出声的。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I knew he'd soon go up the floors, so I circled back to hallway B.
entries.new: 我知道他很快就会上楼，便绕回 B走廊。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: My heart rate was increasing. I couldn't feel safe anymore. ...Why had Sai said that I would die, and why had he chased us with a knife?
entries.new: 我的心跳越来越快，再没有半点安全感。……Sai 为什么说我会死？又为什么提着刀追我们？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: His intentions were unfathomably enigmatic. However, I didn't think he'd declared my death because he'd already killed me. At one point, he'd stated that he'd be the one to kill me if he had to.
entries.new: 他的用意深不可测。不过，我不认为他说我会死，是因为他已经杀了我。他曾经说过，若真有必要，他会亲自动手杀我。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: And the knife he was holding... Where had he gotten it from? There was something to consider.
entries.new: 还有他手里那把刀……是从哪里弄来的？这事值得琢磨。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'd seen him exiting the storeroom, but he was searching through hallway A. ...So, he'd been in the storeroom before inspecting its hallway.
entries.new: 我看见他从储藏室出来，可他却在查看 A走廊。……也就是说，他先进了储藏室，之后才去查看 A走廊。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Could he have come from the outside door? It can't be, can it? But it would explain the knife and how he was in the storeroom right after I left it.
entries.new: ……他会不会是从外面那扇门进来的？不可能吧？可这样一来，刀的事，还有我前脚离开储藏室、他后脚就在里面的事，就都说得通了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I heard something behind me and quickly hid myself in the cleaning room.
entries.new: 身后传来动静，我赶紧躲进了清洁间。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Who was that?
entries.new: 那是谁？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Someone had been in hallway B. When I considered it, I concluded it had to be Erina.
entries.new: 刚才 B走廊里有人。我仔细想了想，断定那只能是 Erina。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I froze, wondering if she could've seen me. I still had the Sekimeiya, but I really didn't want to activate it.
entries.new: 我僵在原地，担心她是否看见了我。Sekimeiya 还在我手上，可我实在不想启动它。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It seemed I hadn't been seen. I couldn't hear her, but she wasn't coming.
entries.new: 看来她没看见我。我听不见她的声音，她也没有过来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I didn't know what was happening, so I had to stay there. For a while, nothing happened at all.
entries.new: 我不知道外面发生了什么，只能待在这里。好一阵子，什么动静也没有。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: That changed when someone started to get closer. The steps came from hallway C.
entries.new: 直到有人靠近，情况才有了变化。脚步声是从 C走廊传来的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Are they coming over here? That's someone else, right?
entries.new: 是朝这边来了吗？那应该是另一个人吧？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: The sound got louder until it was coming from right behind the door.{w} However, the steps kept going.
entries.new: 声音越来越近，最后已经到了门后。{w}然而那脚步没有停，继续往前走了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: This way of walking... It's got to be Sai.
entries.new: 这种走法……一定是 Sai。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Was he circling the floor again? He'd come from hallway C and disappeared toward the lobby side.
entries.new: 他又在绕这一层吗？他从 C走廊过来，又朝大堂那个方向去了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...{w}It didn't sound like he'd looked into all the rooms again, so I didn't understand.
entries.new: ……{w}听这动静，他不像是把每个房间都又看了一遍，我不明白为什么。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: When the silence returned, it stayed for even longer.
entries.new: 四周又安静下来，而且这次持续得更久。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Did he go upstairs already?
entries.new: 他已经上楼了吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: What about Erina? That must've been her, but where is she now...?
entries.new: Erina 呢？刚才一定是她，可她现在在哪儿……？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I thought about what would happen next in detail.
entries.new: 我在脑中仔细推演了接下来会发生什么。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Our past selves are in the attic, and they'll try to come back here soon. ...I guess I get how the chase started.{w} I think Sai was searching for someone while holding that knife. I don't know why, but it's very possible he wanted to find Atsuki.
entries.new: 过去的我们还在阁楼，很快就会设法回到这里。……追捕是怎么开始的，我大概明白了。{w} Sai 当时握着那把刀，像是在找什么人。原因我不清楚，但他很可能是在找我。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: The elevator's on this floor, and Sai went up to search for Atsuki. When we called the elevator from the attic, he was on the third floor and heard it.{w} He probably figured it was empty, especially if he knew it was on the crystal floor. From his perspective, someone called it from the attic and was about to go back down.
entries.new: 电梯停在这一层，而 Sai 上楼去找我了。我们从阁楼叫电梯的时候，他正在三楼，听见了动静。{w} 他大概以为电梯里没人——尤其如果他早知道电梯停在水晶展室那一层。在他看来，是有人从阁楼叫了电梯，正要坐它下去。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: That's how he intercepted us. Seconds after he heard it, he called it from the third floor, knowing someone would be inside. ...If he was looking for someone in particular, that might be why he wasn't right outside when we opened the door.
entries.new: 他就是这么拦住我们的。听见动静几秒后，他就从三楼把电梯叫了下去，明知里面有人。……如果他要找的是某个特定的人，那我们开门时他不在门外，也就说得通了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...How did the chase go down, though? We locked ourselves in the attic, but somehow he had another key to open it.{w} We thought we couldn't try to lock ourselves in a bedroom because he took the key, but it was still in the drawer when he and I teleported in there later.{w} But that's not all. I found out Sai had the keys to both bedrooms in his pocket, and he even frowned when he saw one was in the drawer. That must be why he didn't take it to trap us... Did he think it wouldn't be there because he'd already taken it?
entries.new: ……可那场追捕到底是怎么回事？我们把自己锁进了阁楼，他却不知从哪弄到另一把钥匙把门打开。{w} 我们以为不能躲进卧室上锁，是因为钥匙被他拿走了，可后来他和我传送到那里时，那把钥匙还躺在抽屉里。{w} 不止如此。我发现 Sai 口袋里两间卧室的钥匙都在，而且他看到抽屉里那把时还皱了眉。所以他没拿走钥匙来困住我们，多半就是这个原因……他是不是以为自己已经拿走了，那把不该还在那儿？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: After trying to escape, we'll all end up in the event room.
entries.new: 逃跑失败之后，我们所有人都会聚到活动室。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I should be able to stay here and leave when that happens.
entries.new: 我只要待在这里，等那时候再离开就好。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I tried to loosen up. The cleaning cart was gone, so there was room on the floor to nervously walk in circles.
entries.new: 我试着让自己放松些。清洁车已经推走了，地板空出一块，正好够我焦躁地来回踱步。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...They should be here soon. The chase didn't go on for that long.
entries.new: ……他们快到了。追捕并没有持续太久。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I had to attentively listen for our arrival, but my heartbeat wouldn't let me focus.
entries.new: 我必须仔细听我们过来的动静，可心跳声吵得我完全没法集中注意力。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It was late into the day. {time=21} was close to two hours away, and I'd touched the Sekimeiya in the bathroom a while before that.
entries.new: 天色已经晚了。距离 {time=21} 还有将近两个小时，而我在此前不久才在洗手间碰过 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The most important time was approaching, and I had no idea what to do.
entries.new: 最关键的时刻越来越近，我却完全不知道该怎么做。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I perceived the faint, running steps I'd known would come. We were going to the event room.
entries.new: 我听见了那阵预料之中的微弱奔跑声。我们要去活动室了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Shortly after they faded, the same sound repeated, and it quickly approached me.{w} It was Sai. He had appeared from hallway B, running into Atsuki.
entries.new: 脚步声刚远去不久，同样的声音又响了起来，并且迅速朝我逼近。{w} 是 Sai。他从 B 走廊出现，一头撞上了我。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: To avoid being heard, he slowed down momentarily until he bumped against Atsuki.
entries.new: 为了不让人听见，他稍稍放慢速度，直到撞上我才停下。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: They'll... be in the event room for a while. I should be able to leave now.
entries.new: 他们……会在活动室待上一阵子。我现在应该可以走了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I couldn't stay there, or else Atsuki would see me. Nervously, I turned the doorknob and slowly opened the door.
entries.new: 我不能留在原地，否则会被我自己看见。我紧张地转动门把，慢慢推开门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The event room was open, and I could faintly hear our voices. I carefully slipped to hallway C.
entries.new: 活动室的门开着，隐约能听见我们的说话声。我小心翼翼地溜到 C走廊。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'll be fine here.
entries.new: 我待在这里没事。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...It won't take much for Sai to run out. Is it a good idea to try to see where he went?
entries.new: ……用不了多久 Sai 就会跑出来。去看看他往哪边跑了，这样妥当吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: "If I don't intend to change the past, it won't change." As long as that notion was correct, I could peek out from where I was, knowing I wouldn't be seen.
entries.new: 「只要我不打算改变过去，过去就不会改变。」只要这个前提成立，我就可以从原地探出头去，而不必担心被人看见。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...He didn't have enough time to go to hallway C, did he...?
entries.new: ……他根本没时间跑到 C走廊吧……？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I didn't think so, and even if he had, his reappearance still wouldn't make sense.
entries.new: 我不觉得他去了。而且就算他真去了，后来重新出现也说不通。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The Sekimeiya was getting too hot, urging me to drop it, but I resisted. So close to it, it was undeniable that it had been the emitter of the strange smell.
entries.new: Sekimeiya 越来越烫，几乎在逼我松手，我仍强忍着。靠得这么近，那阵古怪气味的来源毫无疑问就是它。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: While I awaited Sai's next move, I looked around me, wondering where Erina and Akaro were.
entries.new: 我一边等着 Sai 的下一步动作，一边环顾四周，心想 Erina 和 Akaro 究竟在哪。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Prepared to react, I stood in place. I couldn't hear us from there, but I knew I'd notice Sai's escape.
entries.new: 我站在原地，随时准备应变。那个位置听不见我们的声音，但 Sai 一旦逃出来，我一定能察觉。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Then it happened. He dashed out of the event room, his swift steps reaching me.
entries.new: ……接着，他冲出了活动室，急促的脚步声传到我耳中。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: As fast as I could, I looked at the hallway.
entries.new: 我立刻朝走廊望去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Huh?
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Confused, I hid myself before Atsuki saw me. Then, I glanced at the Sekimeiya.{w} ...I still had it.
entries.new: 我一头雾水，趁 Atsuki 还没看见我，先藏了起来。随后我瞥了一眼 Sekimeiya。{w} ……它还在我手上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I don't get it. Why was he not found?
entries.new: 我不明白。他为什么没被发现？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Sai had sprinted straight ahead, shutting himself inside room B4, where I'd just been.{w} Could there have been a third Sekimeiya? If not, his disappearance couldn't be explained.
entries.new: Sai 一路直冲，把自己关进了水晶展室 B4——那正是我刚才待的地方。{w} 难道还有第三个 Sekimeiya？若非如此，他的消失就无法解释。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Ah, no.{w} I think I know what he did.
entries.new: ……啊，不对。{w} 我想我知道他做了什么。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: At once, I understood what had happened. Sai had merely been playing with us. He hadn't lied about that.
entries.new: 我顿时明白了是怎么回事。Sai 只是在耍我们。这一点他并没有说谎。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...{w}It was absurd, but given his grin, I was sure it was the right answer. Something we'd told him had allowed him to pull it off.
entries.new: ……{w}这太荒唐了，可一想到他那个笑容，我就确信答案正是如此。是我们告诉他的某件事，让他办成了这件事。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Where did you even get that knife!? Did you kill Katei and Erina?
entries.new: 你从哪儿弄来那把刀的！？你杀了 Katei 和 Erina 吗？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: ...No. I haven't killed anyone.
entries.new: 没有。我没杀任何人。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Listen, here's a good question for you. I've seen Katei's and Erina's corpses. If I killed them, how come there's no blood on my clothes?
entries.new: 听好，我倒要问你们一个问题。Katei 和 Erina 的尸体我见过。如果是我杀的，那我衣服上怎么一点血都没有？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: We told him Erina died, but he knew the truth.{w} Before, when he was looking through the floor, he came across Erina. After that, she woke up and left the room. When I was in the cleaning room, Sai walked through the hallway again. Maybe he was drawn to the sound and saw Erina was gone.{w} In short, he knew she hadn't died and that she wasn't in that room anymore.
entries.new: 我们告诉他 Erina 死了，可他知道真相。{w} 之前他在这一层搜寻时，撞见了 Erina。之后她醒了过来，离开了房间。我待在清洁间的时候，Sai 又从走廊经过。也许他是被声音引过去，发现 Erina 不见了。{w} 总之，他知道她没有死，也知道她已经不在那个房间了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: That was how he'd thought of a way to outsmart us, just like he said. He ran to that crystal room and covered himself with the curtain to make Atsuki think Erina was still beneath it. ...That was his trick.
entries.new: 他就是这样想出骗过我们的办法的，正如他所说。他跑进那间水晶展室，用遮布把自己盖住，让 Atsuki 以为 Erina 还在下面。……这就是他的把戏。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I waited for Atsuki to enter the cleaning room and slowly stepped away.
entries.new: 我等 Atsuki 走进清洁间，然后慢慢走开了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We didn't have time to search this hallway, so I won't be found here.
entries.new: 我们没时间搜这条走廊，所以我在这里不会被发现。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I returned to the secret section of the cold storeroom. It was around the time Sai and I had traveled to the attic, so I'd soon have no understanding of what would happen below.
entries.new: 时间差不多是 Sai 和我去阁楼的时候，所以很快我就对楼下发生的事一无所知了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: After a few seconds, I looked down at the glowing gem. The strong heat around the Sekimeiya seemed to have lessened.
entries.new: 几秒后，我低头看向那颗发光的宝石。Sekimeiya 周围灼人的高温似乎消退了一些。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Did it cool down a little?{w} It's still pretty hot, so it's not like I put it in the cold cabinets. That's weird.
entries.new: ……它好像凉了一点？{w} 可还是挺烫的，我又没把它放进冷藏柜里。真奇怪。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It didn't matter. I knew I had to think. I had to come to a final conclusion...
entries.new: 那都无所谓了。我知道自己必须思考，必须得出一个最终的结论……
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But it was impossible. The time was rapidly approaching, and it didn't seem like I'd make a decision I wouldn't regret forever.
entries.new: 可我做不到。时间正迅速逼近，而我恐怕终究做不出一个不会让自己抱憾终生的决定。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: While the minutes kept passing, it didn't feel like they were to me. I was firmly trapped, with very little time left.
entries.new: 时间一分一秒地过去，可在我心里却仿佛停滞了。我被牢牢困住，剩下的时间已经不多。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I hadn't heard our past selves in some time, so it was likely we'd already traveled.
entries.new: 我已经有一阵子没听到过去的我们了，看来我们多半已经完成穿越了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Someone was walking in hallway A. Since I didn't know who it was, that meant my past self wasn't there anymore.
entries.new: A走廊里有人走动。既然我不知道那是谁，就说明过去的我已经不在那里了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Who was it? It could've been Atsuki, Erina, or Akaro. Even though Sai had escaped from the attic, I didn't think it could've been him yet unless he traveled to the past.
entries.new: 会是谁？Atsuki、Erina，还是 Akaro？Sai 虽然已经逃出了阁楼，但除非他穿越到过去，否则应该还不可能是他。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Soon, identical-sounding steps passed by. They headed up the stairs.
entries.new: 不久，一阵听起来一模一样的脚步声经过，朝楼梯上去了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: They just left the floor. ...I wonder if it was Atsuki.
entries.new: 他们刚离开这一层。……不知道那是不是 Atsuki。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I wanted to leave, and that was a good time. I hadn't been able to get rid of the Sekimeiya, and I had the opportunity to leave it in the cold.
entries.new: 我想出去，而此刻正是好时机。我一直没能把 Sekimeiya 脱手，如今正好有机会把它留在这寒冷的地方。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I couldn't see or hear anyone, so I stepped to the event room and slowly looked through the door.
entries.new: 我看不到也听不到任何人，于是走到活动室，慢慢透过门往里看。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It was empty. Most importantly, the Sekimeiya wasn't on the floor, which meant someone had been there after our travel.
entries.new: 里面空无一人。最重要的是，Sekimeiya 并不在地上——这说明在我们穿越之后，有人来过这里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...It was probably Atsuki.
entries.new: ……多半是 Atsuki。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I moved to hallway B and walked to the crystal room in front.
entries.new: 我转到B走廊，走向前方的水晶展室。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Next to Naomi's body, the red curtain lay by itself. Without wasting time, I did what I'd planned earlier and left the Sekimeiya sealed away in the very first cabinet where we'd found it. When I closed it, a sound indicated it had locked automatically.{w} The wheel appeared damaged, but it still worked, so I was able to set the temperature to 0 °C.
entries.new: Naomi 的尸体旁，红色遮布孤零零地落在地上。我没有浪费时间，按先前想好的做法，把 Sekimeiya 封进我们最初发现它的那个展示柜里。关上柜门时，一声轻响表明它已自动上锁。{w} 旋钮看起来有损坏，但还能用，我便把温度设成了 0 °C。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Hm, it might not be a good idea to go back.
entries.new: 嗯，回去恐怕不是个好主意。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Atsuki told me that he searched for me. If he comes from the stairs while I'm in the storeroom, I won't be able to leave before I'm found. ...If I'm here, I can avoid being seen by circling the hallways, like I did earlier with Sai.
entries.new: Atsuki 说过他找过我。要是我在储藏室里，而他正好从楼梯过来，我根本来不及离开就会被发现。……待在这里的话，我可以像刚才躲开 Sai 那样，绕着走廊走，避开别人的视线。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I realized something. Up until then, there'd been reasons to avoid being seen. At the point I had reached, however, it wouldn't mean that much.
entries.new: 我忽然意识到一件事。此前我躲避别人的目光，总有种种理由；可到了现在这一步，被看见与否已经没那么要紧了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: My past self is in the attic, so as long as she can't see me, it shouldn't matter. ...I can be a bit calmer about that, then.
entries.new: 过去的我在阁楼里，只要她看不到我，应该就没事。……既然如此，我倒是可以稍微安心一点。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Technically, I was guaranteed to be seen again—it was what I'd been told.{w} Not knowing what would happen was a little nerve-wracking, but Sai had been one person to see me. There was a bit of time left until that could happen, as he'd been in the attic for a while.
entries.new: 严格来说，我注定还会被人看见——这是别人告诉过我的。{w} 不知道会发生什么，多少让人心里发紧，不过 Sai 就是会看见我的人之一。距离那一刻还有些时间，毕竟他在阁楼里待了好一阵子。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Where the hell are Erina and Akaro?{w} It's been so long since anyone saw Akaro. The one who came to the bedroom wasn't the same one who left with Sai. ...I know he's here, though.
entries.new: ……Erina 和 Akaro 到底跑哪去了？{w} 已经这么久没人见过 Akaro 了。来卧室的那个，和跟 Sai 一起离开的那个并不是同一个人。……可我知道他就在这里。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I waited, expecting to hear someone at any point. Until then, the floor seemed deserted.
entries.new: 我等着，以为随时会听见有人过来。而在那之前，这一层静得像空无一人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It was minutes later when I turned to the lobby. I felt like I'd heard someone there.
entries.new: 过了好几分钟，我才转向大厅。我好像听见那边有人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Is there anyone there? I expected them to come from the stairs.
entries.new: 那边有人吗？我以为会有人从楼梯过来。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Seconds passed, and I hadn't heard anything else.
entries.new: 几秒过去，再没有别的声音。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I could've been mistaken, so I slowly stepped to the door.
entries.new: ……也许是我听错了，于是我慢慢走向门口。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...No one.
entries.new: ……没人。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Had I imagined it...? I entered, drawn once again by the blood ahead. Without a doubt, it was where the bigger pool had been earlier.
entries.new: 是我幻听了吗……？我走了进去，又一次被前方的血迹吸引过去。毫无疑问，那里正是先前那摊较大血迹所在的位置。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...!{w} I didn't imagine it this time. There's someone in hallway A.
entries.new: ……！{w} 这次不是错觉。A走廊里有人。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I retreated slowly.
entries.new: 我慢慢退了回去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wait. There's someone in hallway B as well...!
entries.new: 等等，B走廊里也有人……！
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I doubted what to do as I approached the mechanical room.
entries.new: 我拿不定主意，脚步却已挪到机械室前。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I see. This is why I'll be seen. I can't enter either hallway, so as soon as someone comes here, they'll find me. It'll probably happen even if I go down.
entries.new: ……原来如此。这就是我会被看见的原因。两条走廊我都进不去，只要有人来到这里，就会立刻发现我。就算我下楼，恐怕也一样。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...{w}My only move was to wait. When I thought about it, I realized that being found wasn't so bad.
entries.new: ……{w}我能做的只有等。仔细想想，被人发现其实也不算太糟。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: As long as Atsuki was one of the people I'd heard, I could stop worrying about my well-being. If I was with him until my past self left the attic, I knew Sai and Akaro wouldn't be a threat because Atsuki hadn't said that something had happened to me.
entries.new: 只要我听到的脚步声里有 Atsuki，我就不必再担心自己的安危。只要跟他待在一起，直到过去的我离开阁楼，Sai 和 Akaro 就不会构成威胁——毕竟 Atsuki 从没说过我出过什么事。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But what would I tell him...? No matter how much I wanted to talk to him, what could I possibly say...?
entries.new: 可是，我该跟他说什么……？无论我多么想和他说话，又能说些什么呢……？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The Atsuki from this morning... where is he?{w} Will I ever find him again? ...He was a future version of the Atsuki here, but how will everything lead into what happened? How will he end up at the beginning of this day?
entries.new: 今天早晨的 Atsuki……他在哪里？{w} 我还能再见到他吗？……他是这里那个 Atsuki 的未来版本，可这一切究竟是怎样一步步走到那一步的？他又怎么会出现在这一天的开头？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: After my past self traveled to November, could I stay with Atsuki? Even though it was possible the exit wouldn't open, could I just stay with him? According to him, a Shiroya who wasn't the "real Shiroya" would appear. ...Was it possible for me to change reality in a way so that wouldn't occur...?
entries.new: 等过去的我穿越到十一月之后，我能留在 Atsuki 身边吗？就算出口有可能打不开，我也能就这样陪着他吗？据他说，会出现一个不是「真正的 Shiroya」的 Shiroya。……我能不能改变现实，让那种事不再发生……？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...The end was very uncertain, even more than the first time I'd gone through it. I didn't know what would happen, what I would do, or what I could do.
entries.new: ……结局悬而未决，比我第一次经历时还要不确定。我不知道会发生什么，不知道自己会做什么，也不知道自己能做什么。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...{w}It didn't seem like anything was happening. I'd been expecting either door to open, but a few still minutes had already passed.
entries.new: ……{w}似乎什么都没发生。我一直等着哪扇门被打开，可寂静的几分钟已经过去了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I know I didn't imagine it. There was someone in both hallways. I guess it's just a matter of time since I know for a fact I'll be seen.
entries.new: 我确定那不是错觉。两条走廊里都有人。既然我确信自己会被看见，那也只是时间问题了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Hm...{w} could it be that I have already been seen? What if I didn't know about it, but it already happened?
entries.new: 嗯……{w} 会不会其实我已经被看见了？也许我并不知道，但那件事早已发生？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It didn't seem likely that I'd just be ignored, but I had no way to know. No matter what, there was nothing else I could do but stay in place.
entries.new: 我不太可能就这样被人无视，但我也无从确认。无论如何，除了待在原地，我别无他法。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...roya!{w=0.7} Hey!{w=0.5} Wher— ...you!?
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: Wh—{w} Atsuki?
entries.new: 什——{w} Atsuki？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Shiroya! Can you hear me!?
entries.new: Shiroya！听得见吗！？
entries.speaker: a4

entries.text: What's happening...?
entries.new: 这是怎么回事……？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Like a sharp needle, Atsuki's voice pierced into my chest. The pain in those words wasn't one I'd heard before.
entries.new: Atsuki 的声音如尖针般刺进我的胸口。那话语里透出的痛楚，是我从未听过的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: You're okay, right!? If you can hear me, please come out! Say something!
entries.new: 你没事吧！？听得见就快出来！说句话啊！
entries.speaker: a4

entries.text: In the sudden manner they'd started, the shouts faded with a wail. Then, in their place came a shrill cry.
entries.new: 喊声起得突然，落得也突然，最后化作一声哀号。紧接着，取而代之的是一阵尖利的哭喊。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Atsuki was sobbing like a broken person.
entries.new: Atsuki 泣不成声，整个人都垮了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: With a trembling hand, I grabbed the knob.
entries.new: 我伸出手，颤抖着握住门把。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: As I pulled the door open, I saw Atsuki on the floor. He wasn't just crying—he was shaking. He was a wreck.
entries.new: 我拉开门，只见 Atsuki 瘫坐在地上。他不只是在哭——整个人都在发抖，已经彻底崩溃了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: H-Hey...
entries.new: 喂、喂……
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: ...My hoarse voice didn't reach him.{w} Gently, and trying not to stagger, I took a step forward.
entries.new: ……我沙哑的声音没能传到他耳中。{w}我尽量不让自己踉跄，轻轻向前迈了一步。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: When he saw me, he gathered himself enough to stop shaking and warily stood up.
entries.new: 看到我，他勉强压下颤抖，警惕地站起身来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Are you actually Shiroya?
entries.new: ……你真的是 Shiroya 吗？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: ...{w}I didn't know what to say. When his eyes pierced into mine, any words I could have prepared flew out of my mind.
entries.new: ……{w}我不知道该说什么。他的目光直直刺过来，我事先想好的话全都飞到了九霄云外。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wh-Where were you? What's with those clothes?{w} Are you the same person who disappeared with Sai?
entries.new: 你、你刚才在哪儿？这身衣服是怎么回事？{w} 你就是和 Sai 一起消失的那个人吗？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: The same person...? I'm not. Not in the sense he means.
entries.new: 同一个人……？不是。至少不是他说的那个意思。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It felt like my voice was stuck in my throat, and my thoughts were all over the place. ...Had that exact conversation always happened while I'd been in the attic?
entries.new: 我的声音像卡在喉咙里，思绪也乱成一团。……我待在阁楼的时候，这段对话每次都会发生吗？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I-I'm sorry... I'm very confused too. ...I-I guess so, though.
entries.new: 对、对不起……我自己也乱得很。……不过，大、大概是的。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: You guess so?{w} What do you mean? You remember everything, right?
entries.new: 你是猜的？{w} 你什么意思？你什么都记得吧？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Right now...
entries.new: 现在……
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: I stopped myself. From hallway C, a figure approached.
entries.new: 我打住了话头。有人正从 C走廊那边走来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Yes?
entries.new: 嗯？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: ...It was Erina. The look in her eyes and her way of walking had cut me off.{w} When Atsuki turned around, he hardly reacted, so I was unsure if he already knew what had happened to her.
entries.new: ……是 Erina。她的眼神和走路的姿态让我把话咽了回去。{w}Atsuki 回过头，却几乎没什么反应，我拿不准他是否已经知道她出了什么事。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'm glad to see you two are safe. I was a bit worried...{w} Wh-What's with those clothes? You weren't wearing them earlier, were you...?
entries.new: 看到你们俩平安无事，我就放心了。我原本还有点担心……{w} 这、这身衣服是怎么回事？你们先前穿的不是这个吧……？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Who the hell are you? Or even you... How can you two exist!?
entries.new: 你到底是什么人？还有你……你们俩怎么可能存在！？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: It was the Erina we'd assumed was dead. Her clothes were stained with blood, and she appeared to be groggy.
entries.new: 那是我们以为早已死去的 Erina。她的衣服上沾满血迹，人看上去昏昏沉沉的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Where were you? How did you just appear out of nowhere!?
entries.new: 你刚才在哪儿？怎么会凭空冒出来！？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: In response to that, Erina slowly knitted her brow.
entries.new: 听了这话，Erina 慢慢皱起眉头。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What do you not understand? Did you just pop into existence at some point?
entries.new: 你哪里不明白了？你是从某个时候凭空冒出来的吗？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: No... Why do you think that?
entries.new: 不……你为什么这么想？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Have you looked at that room? Your body is there.
entries.new: 你看过那个房间吗？你的身体就在那儿。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: What...? That one? It... can't be.
entries.new: 什么……？那个房间？不……不可能。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: I knew you were lying. I-I can't be here, of course not...
entries.new: 我就知道你在说谎。我、我不能待在这里，当然不能……
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: ...Shiroya, what the hell is happening? Answer my other questions. How can you exist when it shouldn't be possible? Did the same thing happen to Erina?
entries.new: ……Shiroya，到底出什么事了？先回答我别的问题。按理说根本不可能的事，你怎么会站在这里？Erina 也遇上了一样的事吗？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: To Erina? She should be dead, right?
entries.new: Erina 吗？她应该已经死了，不是吗？
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: I stepped to the door. Of course, Erina's body was no longer there.
entries.new: 我走到门口。果然，Erina 的尸体已经不在了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: About Erina, I think what happened isn't what you think.
entries.new: 关于 Erina，我想事情并不像你想的那样。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: That's probably right. I can't think of anything anymore.
entries.new: 大概吧。我已经什么都想不出来了。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: ...Under those stained clothes, there's no wound, right?
entries.new: ……那身沾了血的衣服底下，并没有伤口，对吧？
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Huh?
entries.new: 咦？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: There never was one. The body you think disappeared is her.
entries.new: 从来就没有什么伤口。你以为消失的那具尸体，就是她。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Do you mean that she never died?
entries.new: 你的意思是，她根本没有死？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: I nodded. When we found Erina, the shock of Katei's death was still affecting us. We hadn't checked to confirm her death because we hadn't even doubted it.
entries.new: 我点了点头。发现 Erina 的时候，我们还沉浸在 Katei 之死的打击中。我们从未怀疑过她是否已死，自然也没有去确认。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: A-Are you serious...?{w} Were you playing dead, then? Or just unconscious? It doesn't look like you feel very well.
entries.new: 你、你说真的……？{w}那你是在装死？还是只是昏过去了？你的脸色看起来很差。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: I'm not sure... I remember I was drawn to this room, and then I think I blacked out.
entries.new: 我也说不清……我记得自己像是被什么引到了这个房间，然后就没了意识。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Drawn? By a noise?
entries.new: 被引来？是听到了什么声音？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: N-No... Something stronger, but I'm not sure what, exactly. I don't know whose blood this is, but since I woke up, I've felt... groggy and numb.
entries.new: 不、不是……是更强烈的东西，可我也说不准究竟是什么。我不知道这是谁的血，但醒来之后，我一直觉得……昏昏沉沉，浑身发麻。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: I... see.
entries.new: ……原来如此。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: I had no idea what that was about. I'd been in the room when she had appeared, but I hadn't sensed anything like that.
entries.new: 我完全不明白那到底是怎么回事。她出现的时候我就在房间里，却什么也没感觉到。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Shiroya, do you remember finding her body as well? And you realized what really happened? ...You still haven't explained what you're doing here. Are you the same Shiroya who disappeared from the event room with Sai?
entries.new: Shiroya，你也记得自己发现了她的尸体吗？然后就想通了真相？……你还没解释自己为什么会在这里。你就是那个和 Sai 一起从活动室消失的 Shiroya 吗？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: ...I wish I could explain everything to you, but I still don't really know what happened.{w} But, yes. I'm really glad to see you again.
entries.new: ……我也希望能把一切都解释给你听，可我自己也还不太清楚发生了什么。{w}不过，没错。能再见到你，我真的很高兴。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: I smiled and felt a wave of relief. It didn't matter that I didn't know why I was there again—those words had been the most sincere of my life.
entries.new: 我笑了，心里一阵释然。自己为何又回到了这里，已经不重要——那句话，是我这辈子说得最真心的一句。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wh-What's with those clothes, then? Why is the cross not on them? Why did you ignore me when we saw each other in the event room and when I kept shouting your name?
entries.new: 那、那你这身衣服又是怎么回事？为什么上面没有十字？在活动室碰面的时候，还有我拼命喊你名字的时候，你为什么都不理我？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: ...Well, I—
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Hey... I'm still confused, but I have a question.
entries.new: 那个……我还是没搞明白，不过我有个问题。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: ...Huh?
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: The Sekimeiya... does it really make you travel through time?{w} How does it work?
entries.new: Sekimeiya……它真的能让人穿越时间吗？{w}是怎么做到的？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: What...?
entries.new: 什么……？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: If I understand it... touching it with your skin activates it, right? And you can go far into the past if it's out of the cabinet for a while.
entries.new: 如果我没理解错的话……用皮肤碰它就会启动，对吧？而且它离开展示柜越久，就能回到越远的过去。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: That's... what I've been working under, yes.
entries.new: 我……一直是这么认为的，没错。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: He looked at me in case I had an objection. Even after everything that had happened, that still should've been correct, so I nodded uncertainly.
entries.new: 他看向我，像是在等我有异议。事到如今，那按理说依然没错，我便迟疑地点了点头。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I was thinking. Why don't I just go back in time to save Isla?
entries.new: 我在想，我为什么不干脆回到过去，去救 Isla 呢？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Atsuki and I looked at each other, and I wondered about her proposition. What would happen if Erina changed the past? What would happen to the world and to us?
entries.new: 我和 Atsuki 面面相觑，心里琢磨着她的提议。如果 Erina 改变了过去，会怎么样？世界会怎样，我们又会怎样？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I don't know why I didn't think of it earlier. Someone killed her a few hours ago, so I just have to go to that time and prevent it.
entries.new: 真奇怪，我怎么早没想到。几个小时前有人杀了她，那我只要回到那个时间，阻止这件事就行了。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Saving Isla was something I could do. It should've been possible, given what I knew.
entries.new: 救 Isla，我做得到。据我所知，这事应该能成。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But I couldn't find the Sekimeiya. I kept looking at Isla's face for a very long time, and she told me that she could be saved. Then, I saw a girl, and after that I heard you shouting.
entries.new: 可是我没找到 Sekimeiya。我盯着 Isla 的脸看了很久很久，她对我说，她还能得救。然后我看见一个女孩，再之后，就听见你在喊。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: ...A girl? You saw Shiroya?
entries.new: ……女孩？你看见 Shiroya 了？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Um...{w} I guess it couldn't have been anyone else.{w} ...It must have been Shiroya.
entries.new: 嗯……{w}我想那也不可能是别人。{w}……一定是 Shiroya。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Oh, she did? I wonder if she's talking about the time before she fell unconscious, when I was in the crystal room with her.
entries.new: 哦，是这样吗？不知道她说的是不是她昏过去之前、我和她一起待在水晶展室的那段时间。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I also saw what happened to Katei... It looked horrible. Did someone do that?
entries.new: 我还看见了 Katei 的遭遇……实在惨不忍睹。是有人下的手吗？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: ...It couldn't have been an accident.{w} But anyway, the Sekimeiya's not in the event room.
entries.new: ……那不可能是意外。{w}不过话说回来，Sekimeiya 不在活动室。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Are you sure...?{w} Do you know where it could be? I really need to find it.
entries.new: 你确定……？{w}你知道它可能在哪儿吗？我真的必须找到它。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: No. I suspect Sai or Akaro must've taken it.
entries.new: 不知道。我猜是 Sai 或者 Akaro 把它拿走了。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: I knew where one was, but I couldn't bring myself to say it. Once again, the decision of whether to change the past had to be made, and I couldn't do it.
entries.new: 我知道有一台在哪里，却怎么也说不出口。要不要改变过去——这个决定又摆到了我面前，可我做不出决定。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...{w}Are you lying?
entries.new: ……{w} 你在说谎吗？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: What? No, I'm not.
entries.new: 什么？没有，我没骗你。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: ...{w}Is he not? Who has the Sekimeiya Sai and I traveled with?{w} ...If he does, I understand why he'd lie. Right now, he believes the past can't be changed.
entries.new: ……{w} 真的没有吗？Sai 和我一起穿越时用的那台 Sekimeiya，如今在谁手上？{w} ……如果在他那儿，我明白他为什么要说谎。眼下他相信过去是无法改变的。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Actually, that's right. He changed his mind on that before I got out of the attic. He said he'd changed the past.
entries.new: 其实，确实如此。我还没离开阁楼的时候，他就已经改变看法了。他说他改变过过去。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I frowned. ...What exactly was going to happen?
entries.new: 我皱起眉。……接下来究竟会发生什么？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The way you two reacted. You don't want me to save Isla, do you?
entries.new: 看你们俩那反应。你们不想让我去救 Isla，对吧？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: That's not it at all... Remember that Sai and Akaro took the cabinet key. They probably have the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 根本不是这样……你忘了，展示柜的钥匙是 Sai 和 Akaro 拿走的。Sekimeiya 多半在他们手上。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: It seemed Erina was seeing through us. Discontent, she walked to the event room.
entries.new: 看来 Erina 已经看穿了我们的心思。她一脸不快，往活动室走去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I-I knew it! You were lying...
entries.new: 我、我就知道！你在撒谎……
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Huh...?
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: You didn't want me to look at the cabinet!
entries.new: 你就是不想让我看那个展示柜！
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: The Sekimeiya's here... Did Atsuki leave it in the cabinet? I don't think he would have.
entries.new: Sekimeiya 就在这里……是 Atsuki 把它留在展示柜里的吗？我觉得他不会这么做。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I looked at him. As I'd thought, he was visibly confused—the Sekimeiya shouldn't have been there.
entries.new: 我看向他。果然，他一脸困惑——Sekimeiya 本不该在那里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Erina opened the glass and rolled the Sekimeiya into her purse, not wanting to touch it for the time being. Following that, she immediately let the curtain fall back down.
entries.new: Erina 掀开玻璃罩，把 Sekimeiya 拨进手袋里，暂时不想让皮肤碰到它。紧接着，她立刻把遮布放了下来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: After a long silence, the hallway A door opened. When we looked over, someone was stepping into the room.
entries.new: 沉默了很久，A走廊的门开了。我们望过去，有人正走进房间。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Uh...
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: It was Sai. He had already escaped from the attic.
entries.new: 是 Sai。他已经从阁楼逃出来了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What's up?
entries.new: 怎么了？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...What the fuck are you even doing here? Did you succeed with that plan of yours?
entries.new: ……你他妈来这儿干什么？你那个计划成了？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Oh, not quite, unfortunately. I thought Erina was dead. What's she doing with the Sekimeiya?
entries.new: 哦，遗憾，没成。我还以为 Erina 死了。她拿着 Sekimeiya 做什么？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: You thought that too? No. I'm going to go to the past to save Isla.
entries.new: 你也这么想？不。我要回到过去救 Isla。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Huh. I doubt that. The past can't be changed.
entries.new: 哼，我不信。过去是改不了的。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: That's nonsense! I'm going to the past, so I'll prevent Isla from dying. You've used the Sekimeiya before, right? How long do I need to wait to go enough hours back?
entries.new: 胡说！我回到过去，就能阻止 Isla 死去。你以前用过 Sekimeiya 吧？要等多久，才能回到好几个小时之前？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Um... It should be about fifteen minutes, but I still find it unlikely you'll change anything.
entries.new: 嗯……大概十五分钟吧。不过我还是觉得，你什么也改变不了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Sai... where the fuck did you go? Were you in the attic?{w} Do you know where Shiroya went? I saw her disappear with you.
entries.new: Sai……你他妈到底去哪儿了？你在阁楼里？{w}你知道 Shiroya 去哪儿了吗？我看见她和你一起消失了。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Isn't she next to you? What's with those clothes, anyway? Aren't they from there?
entries.new: 她不是就在你旁边吗？话说那身衣服是怎么回事？不是那儿来的吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...They are.
entries.new: ……是那边的。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: I see, they're definitely an improvement for you.{w} And just ignore me, Atsuki. I was busy sorting something out.
entries.new: 原来如此，穿在你身上确实顺眼多了。{w}还有，别管我，Atsuki。我刚才正忙着理清一些事。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: "Sorting something out". I couldn't help but react, as I knew he had just locked my past self in the attic.
entries.new: “处理点事情”。听他这么说，我忍不住起了反应——他明明才把过去的我锁进阁楼，这事我再清楚不过。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Oh, right, I'd forgotten about this too.
entries.new: 啊，对了，这个我也忘了。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: I found this just now. I tried to read it, but my head hurt a lot. Do you know what it is?
entries.new: 这是我刚捡到的。我想读，可头疼得厉害。你知道这是什么吗？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Out of nowhere, Erina took out a piece of paper from her purse and handed it to Atsuki. I saw some black letters on it, but I didn't recognize what it was.{w} Immediately, he stashed it in his pocket.
entries.new: Erina 冷不防从手提包里抽出一张纸，递给 Atsuki。纸上写着些黑色的字，可我认不出那是什么。{w}他立刻把它塞进了口袋。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: H-Hey... What was that?
entries.new: 喂、喂……那是什么？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Don't mind me, like you said.
entries.new: 就像你说的，别管我。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: You look pretty nervous. I saw something written there.{w} You were pretty in control of things when you pulled off that trick with the key earlier, so why is this getting you all worked up? Do you wanna hide it that badly?
entries.new: 你看起来挺紧张的。我可看见上面写着字。{w}刚才你耍那把钥匙的把戏时，一副胸有成竹的样子，怎么现在倒把你急成这样？你就那么想藏起来？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...{w}It's just a personal paper. It has nothing to do with you or the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: ……{w}只是一张私人纸条，和你、和 Sekimeiya 都没有关系。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Very intriguing, then.
entries.new: 那就更耐人寻味了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...A personal paper? I didn't think I'd seen it before.{w} When I glanced at him, he immediately looked away, leaving me a little surprised.
entries.new: ……私人的纸？我印象里从没见过。{w}我朝他瞥了一眼，他立刻把视线移开，让我有些意外。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: So, did any of you see Miiya...?
entries.new: 那么，你们有谁看见 Miiya 了吗……？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Wh...
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Who?
entries.new: 谁？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: You don't know her, right? I... I knew I wasn't going insane.
entries.new: 你们不认识她吧？我……我就知道我没疯。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: H-How do you know that name?
entries.new: 你、你怎么会知道那个名字？
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: She's the person I was with earlier, before I saw you two... It just came back to me. I don't know where she went, though.
entries.new: 她就是刚才和我在一起的人，在我看见你们俩之前……我刚刚才想起来。不过我不知道她去了哪里。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: What...? What just happened?
entries.new: 什么……？刚才发生什么了？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: That's not possible. How could she have seen Miiya!?
entries.new: 不可能。她怎么会见过 Miiya！？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: What's with that reaction? Don't you see she's just delirious?{w} She didn't die, but I have a pretty good idea of what happened to her. Say, did you hallucinate someone?
entries.new: 你这是什么反应？看不出来她只是在说胡话吗？{w}她没死，不过她身上发生了什么，我大致猜得到。话说回来，你是产生了幻觉，看见了某个人吗？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: That's not it. That's not just some name she made up.
entries.new: 不是这样。那不是什么她随口编出来的名字。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Do you know this person, then?
entries.new: 那你们认识这个人？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...We do, but Erina couldn't have seen her. She couldn't be here.
entries.new: ……认识。可 Erina 不可能见到她。她不可能在这里。
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: Are you sure? She could've entered through the storeroom. She could've even traveled from the future since the Sekimeiya's bound to be exposed to the outside world.
entries.new: 你确定？她也许是从储藏室进来的。甚至可能是从未来穿越过来的——Sekimeiya 迟早会暴露在外界面前。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: That's not what she means... She's not anywhere right now.
entries.new: 她不是这个意思……她现在不在任何地方。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Oh? Is she dead?{w} ...Wait, Miiya, you said...?
entries.new: 哦？她死了？{w}……等等，你刚才说 Miiya……？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: That was the biggest blow I'd been dealt in a long time. I'd grown to think I partially understood what had happened, but a few words were enough to shatter everything.{w} What did it mean? Could it have been another prediction from the world? Had my own decision been handed to me, confirming that I would save Miiya?{w} There was no way—that didn't make sense. If I'd changed the past, many more things would've differed as well.
entries.new: 这是很久以来我受到的最重的一击。我原以为自己已经大致弄懂了发生的事，可几句话就足以把这一切击得粉碎。{w}那到底意味着什么？难道又是世界给出的某种预示？是我自己的决定被提前递到了我面前，用来确认我会去救 Miiya？{w}不可能——这说不通。如果我真改变了过去，该有更多事情随之不同才对。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...No. She's with us. She has red hair, right?
entries.new: ……不。她跟我们在一起。她是红头发，对吧？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: ...Did you actually see her? What did she say?
entries.new: ……你真的见到她了？她说了什么？
entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: She told me her name, but she didn't look lost or anything. She knew me, too...{w} She just suddenly ran away, and I haven't seen her again. I definitely thought I hadn't seen her before, but I honestly wasn't sure.
entries.new: 她告诉了我她的名字，可她看起来并不像迷了路。她还认识我……{w}后来她突然就跑了，我再也没见到她。我本来确实觉得自己从没见过她，可说实话，我也不太确定。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: ...{w}There was no way to make sense of what she was saying. It seemed the structure of the world had been warped beyond comprehension.
entries.new: ……{w}她说的这些话根本无从理解。就好像这个世界的结构已经被扭曲到无法想象的地步。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I don't know how to interpret this. Did you all agree to make up this story for when I appeared?
entries.new: 我真不知道该怎么理解。你们是不是早就串通好，等我一出现就编出这套说辞？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Shut up.
entries.new: 闭嘴。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Well, I'm trying to figure things out myself and I thought I was close to understanding quite a bit, but now there's a bunch of shit I don't get, and it doesn't feel great.
entries.new: 我自己也在琢磨这一切，本来以为已经快要弄明白不少事了，结果现在冒出一堆我搞不懂的鬼东西，感觉可不怎么好。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: You did mean she died, right? Is saving her with the Sekimeiya not an option?
entries.new: 你刚才确实是说她死了吧？难道不能用 Sekimeiya 救她？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Sai, shut the fuck up. If it was, I promise you that we would've done it.
entries.new: Sai，你他妈给我闭嘴。要是能救，我保证我们早就做了。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Hm...
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Was Atsuki right? I didn't know anymore—I'd never known. Saving Miiya alongside everyone else was supposed to be possible, because traveling days to the past could soon occur. How did that tie into what Erina said, though? There was no longer anything that made sense.
entries.new: Atsuki 说得对吗？我已经不知道了——从来就没知道过。连同其他所有人一起救下 Miiya，本该是可行的，因为穿越回几天前的过去很快就会实现。可这和 Erina 说的话又怎么对得上？如今已经没有一件事说得通了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It's probably been close to fifteen minutes already, right?
entries.new: 差不多快十五分钟了吧？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: I'd say so. Yes, it's been almost fifteen minutes since I arrived.
entries.new: 我看是。对，从我到这里算起，已经快十五分钟了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Are you sure I'll go far enough back?
entries.new: 你确定我能回到足够早的时间？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: She died at around {time=14}, right? It should be enough, yes.
entries.new: 她是在 {time=14} 前后死的吧？那应该够了。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...Okay. I'm going, then. Are all of you coming with me?
entries.new: ……好。那我走了。你们都会跟我一起来吗？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Don't worry, we're far enough from you.
entries.new: 放心，我们离你够远。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I understand. Well... goodbye for now.
entries.new: 我明白。嗯……暂时再见了。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Sai had kept lying to Erina, claiming fifteen minutes was long enough to go hours back. However, I couldn't be entirely sure that was impossible.{w} As she got her hand closer to her purse, the three of us stepped back. Given what we knew about the range, we were outside of it.
entries.new: Sai一直对Erina撒谎，说十五分钟就足以回到几个小时之前。可我也无法断定那绝不可能。{w} 她的手一点点靠近手提包，我们三人齐齐后退。按我们所知的作用范围，我们已经站在范围之外了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But I was concerned. Were we highly mistaken about how the range worked? I didn't stop retreating until Erina's hand contacted the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 可我心里发慌。我们对作用范围的理解，会不会错得离谱？直到Erina的手碰到Sekimeiya，我才停下后退。
