entries.text: Kyuuka heard the door open. When he glanced over, he saw his older brother stepping in with a girl he'd never seen before.
entries.new: Kyuuka 听见门开了。他瞥了一眼，见哥哥正走进来，身边跟着一个他从没见过的女孩。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Who's that?
entries.new: 那是谁？
entries.speaker: nn

entries.text: She's a friend of mine. I'm just going to show her the house.
entries.new: 我的朋友。我带她参观一下房子。
entries.speaker: nn

entries.text: Without saying a word, she was brought upstairs. Kyuuka saw it as none of his concern at all. In his eyes, she was either somebody related to his parents' business or just another source of entertainment for his brother.
entries.new: 她一言不发，被带上了楼。Kyuuka 觉得这事同自己毫无关系。在他眼里，她要么和父母的生意有关，要么只是哥哥又一个消遣的对象。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: When night had come, he hadn't seen anyone else.
entries.new: 直到入夜，他再没见过其他人。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: After making his own food, Kyuuka walked to his bedroom. He couldn't easily fall asleep with things being so noisy, so he covered himself with the sheets.
entries.new: 自己弄了点吃的之后，Kyuuka回了卧室。四下这般吵闹，他很难入睡，只好把被子裹到身上。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The next evening, watching television as usual, he saw a familiar face. A girl had disappeared in the town where he lived.
entries.new: 第二天傍晚，他照例看着电视，屏幕上出现了一张熟悉的面孔。他居住的镇上，有一名少女失踪了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Kyuuka wasn't remotely surprised. They didn't operate in shadows; there was no need to do so.
entries.new: Kyuuka一点也不意外。他们行事从不遮遮掩掩，也没那个必要。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: ...She was the daughter of someone with strong ties to the town's leadership. That made sense. His brother was just carrying out something that was both productive and fun for him.
entries.new: ……她是镇上掌权者亲信的女儿。这就说得通了。哥哥只是在做一件对他而言既有好处又有趣的事。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Hours later, his older brother came down from upstairs. He looked cheerful and left after silently waving to Kyuuka.
entries.new: 几个小时后，哥哥从楼上下来。他一脸愉快，默默朝Kyuuka挥了挥手，便出门了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He'd learned the girl's name: Anora. It made no difference. Regardless of her name, she was locked in the same room as always.{w} Soon, he heard plaintive cries coming from above.
entries.new: 他知道了那名少女的名字：Anora。这并没有什么不同。不管她叫什么，都还是被锁在那间和往常一样的房间里。{w} 不久，楼上传来凄楚的哭喊声。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Kyuuka responded by turning up the volume.
entries.new: Kyuuka把电视音量调大了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Eventually, his brother came back with some bags he hadn't left with.
entries.new: 后来，哥哥回来了，手里提着几只出门时没带的袋子。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: A day had passed with no minute full of silence. In the living room, Kyuuka tried to ignore the muffled noise. Whenever those situations occurred, he went to school just to get away from it for a while, but he had to come home eventually.
entries.new: 一天过去，没有哪一分钟是安宁的。Kyuuka待在客厅里，尽量不去理会那阵沉闷的动静。每次遇上这种情形，他都会去学校躲上一阵，可终究还是要回家。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He didn't like it. He knew that girl was suffering, and he didn't want that.{w} However, he wouldn't talk his brother out of it, and he didn't want to annoy him. Furthermore, the room upstairs was always locked, and he couldn't bring himself to let anybody know.
entries.new: 他不喜欢这样。他知道那个女孩正在受苦，他并不想看到这种事。{w} 可他不会去劝哥哥收手，也不想惹他心烦。再说，楼上的房间总是锁着，他实在没法鼓起勇气告诉别人。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: She hadn't done anything to deserve it, presumably. Few of the people his brother brought home gave him that impression. He didn't think of himself as a bad person, and would have helped her if he could, but that was a mere notion. It wasn't realistic enough for him to act on.
entries.new: 她大概也没做过什么该遭这份罪的事。哥哥带回家的人里，很少有人会给他这种印象。他不认为自己是个坏人，若有能力，他也愿意帮她——可那不过是个念头罢了，还不足以让他真的动手。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: That was why he'd always stayed aside, quietly sitting on that sofa.
entries.new: 所以他一向置身事外，只是安静地坐在那张沙发上。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: But his mind suddenly changed when he saw something he hadn't seen in a long time.
entries.new: 然而，当他看见一样久违的东西时，心意陡然变了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: It was a key.{w} When his brother had gone up loaded with what he'd bought, he'd left his keys in the keyhole.
entries.new: 是一把钥匙。{w} 哥哥抱着一堆买回来的东西上楼时，把钥匙忘在了锁孔里。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Kyuuka silently stood up and walked over. He looked back, confirming his brother wasn't coming.
entries.new: Kyuuka无声地起身，走了过去。他回头望了一眼，确认哥哥没有下楼。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Then, he detached one of the keys from the ring and stored it in his pocket.
entries.new: 然后，他从钥匙串上卸下一把，收进了口袋。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Beyond the wooden ceiling, she continued to yell. On some level, such barbarism disgusted Kyuuka. He was getting tired of it.
entries.new: 木天花板的另一头，她仍在叫喊。这种野蛮行径让Kyuuka隐隐作呕。他也快忍到头了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Sighing, he lay on his side to muffle the sound entering at least one of his ears. He'd endured louder, and for longer.
entries.new: 他叹了口气，侧过身躺下，好让至少一只耳朵别进那么多声音。更响的、更久的，他都忍过。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Part of him really did wish to take action for once, whether it was from the presence of the key or not. It had been ages since he'd had a conversation with his brother, but at some point, a part of him had come to revile his sibling.
entries.new: 他心底确实有一角想索性行动一次，不论是不是那把钥匙的缘故。他已经很久没和哥哥说过话，但不知从什么时候起，他心里开始厌恶这个兄长。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He asked himself a question. Was it worth doing something?
entries.new: 他问自己：值得动手吗？
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Answering that was difficult for Kyuuka. He didn't like people. They were rude, selfish, and just too much effort to deal with. If any of them had cared about him, he might have thought differently.
entries.new: Kyuuka很难回答这个问题。他不喜欢人。他们粗鲁、自私，应付起来又太费力气。若是有人曾真正关心过他，他或许会有别的想法。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: On the other hand, he knew that he'd barely tried to speak to anyone in a long time, and his brother wasn't exactly deserving of anyone's attention, let alone approval.
entries.new: 可另一方面，他也清楚自己很久没有主动和谁说过话了；而哥哥这样的人，本就不值得谁来关心，更谈不上认可。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: His parents and his brother—his whole family—was composed of deplorable individuals. He saw himself as different. It wasn't his choice to hurt people, and he would have actively stopped it if he could.
entries.new: 父母和哥哥——他的整个家——尽是可鄙之人。他觉得自己与他们不同。伤害别人从来不是他的选择，若有能力，他也会主动去阻止。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: So, given the fact that he could, it only made sense to do so. When he thought about it like that, he came to a decision.
entries.new: 既然他做得到，那就理应去做。这样一想，他便下了决心。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The next day, Kyuuka stayed home. As soon as his parents left the house, he went up the stairs.
entries.new: 第二天，Kyuuka留在家里。父母一出家门，他便上了楼。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The phone was there. Quietly, he dialed the police's number.{w} When they picked up, he anonymously revealed Anora's whereabouts, claiming to have heard yells coming from the house. Then, before his brother could hear him, he slipped back to his sofa.
entries.new: 电话就在那里。他悄悄拨了报警号码。{w} 接通后，他匿名说出了Anora的下落，只说自己听见那栋房子里传出喊叫声。随后，趁哥哥还没听见，他又溜回了沙发上。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: There was no way out for his brother. He hadn't asked about the missing key, so thanks to that, he knew Anora would be found.
entries.new: 哥哥已无路可逃。他没有问起那把不见的钥匙，也正因如此，Kyuuka知道Anora一定会被发现。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Many years earlier, Kyuuka's parents had added a secret to their house. An entrance, or exit, nobody would notice. Kyuuka had seen it being used a handful of times.
entries.new: 许多年前，Kyuuka的父母给这栋房子添了一个秘密。一处谁也不会留意的入口——或者说出口。Kyuuka曾见它被用过几次。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The rumors about the mansion were known by the whole town. The first time that someone had disappeared, the police had quickly shown up.{w} Yet, thanks to that well-hidden exit, Kyuuka's brother had avoided being caught.
entries.new: 这栋宅子的传闻，全镇无人不知。第一次有人失踪时，警察很快就赶来了。{w} 可多亏了那处藏得极深的出口，Kyuuka的哥哥躲过了抓捕。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Kyuuka knew that when the police appeared, his brother would try to escape with the girl. However, with the key that he had taken, that would be impossible.
entries.new: Kyuuka知道，警察一到，哥哥一定会带着那个女孩一起逃。可钥匙已被他拿走，那就不可能了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Hey, Kyuuka. What was that?
entries.new: 喂，Kyuuka。刚才那是什么？
entries.speaker: nn

entries.text: His brother had appeared from upstairs. Internally panicking, Kyuuka responded.
entries.new: 哥哥从楼上下来了。Kyuuka心里一惊，应道。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: What was what?
entries.new: 什么什么？
entries.speaker: nn

entries.text: I heard a noise. Did you want to come see or something?
entries.new: 我听见有动静。你是想上来看一眼还是怎么？
entries.speaker: nn

entries.text: ...No. It was the TV.
entries.new: ……没有。是电视。
entries.speaker: nn

entries.text: Ah, ah, okay. You have some free time though, right? Want to learn the works? Job training.
entries.new: 啊，啊，这样。不过你现在有空吧？想不想学学这一行的门道？就当上岗培训。
entries.speaker: nn

entries.text: No. I'm tired, so maybe later.
entries.new: 不了。我累了，以后再说吧。
entries.speaker: nn

entries.text: You say that every time. Oh well. I'll get back to it. If you don't want to learn the family business, you'd better go to school more. Keep your grades up. Hehe.
entries.new: 你每次都这么说。算了。我回去继续了。你要是不想学家里的生意，那就多去学校，成绩别落下。嘿嘿。
entries.speaker: nn

entries.text: He went back upstairs. A few minutes had passed since Kyuuka had gotten off the phone. He'd accidentally alerted his brother, but that danger was gone. All he had to worry about from that point on was looking like an accomplice.
entries.new: 他回了楼上。Kyuuka挂掉电话才过了几分钟。他刚才不慎惊动了哥哥，可那点风险已经过去。从现在起，他唯一要担心的，是自己看起来像个同伙。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Barely seconds after his brother had gone back to the room, a sharp sound came from it.
entries.new: 哥哥回房不过几秒，房里便传出一声尖锐的响动。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: No more yelling. No more anything. It was silent. A horrible feeling like being submerged in icy water overtook Kyuuka.
entries.new: 喊声停了。什么声音都没有了。一片死寂。一种如被冰水浸没般的恶寒攫住了Kyuuka。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: His brother had a gun. He knew that. What he didn't know was why he would just shoot the girl.
entries.new: 哥哥有枪，这他知道。他不知道的是，哥哥为什么就这样把那个女孩打死了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The police were coming, and there was absolutely no chance his brother escaped with anything less than a murder charge. He deserved no less, but for him to kill her so suddenly was unthinkable. He hadn't given that impression at all a few seconds earlier.
entries.new: 警察马上就到，哥哥绝无可能脱身，至少也要背上一桩杀人罪。他罪有应得，可这样突然就把人打死，实在令人费解。几秒钟之前，他可一点也没露出那种迹象。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Kyuuka stood up and stepped up the stairs, eyeing the door warily. Each of his footsteps was carefully placed to prevent a repeat of being detected.
entries.new: Kyuuka站起身，走上楼梯，警惕地盯着那扇门。每一步都落得极轻，免得再被察觉。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The door wasn't locked. He gingerly nudged it open, not afraid that he'd see something worse than what he had before, but afraid that he might be shot by reflex.
entries.new: 门没有上锁。他小心地把门推开，不是怕看见比先前更糟的景象，而是怕对方条件反射般开枪。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The body of Kyuuka's brother was on the floor, completely immobile. There was no doubt in his mind that he was dead.
entries.new: Kyuuka的哥哥倒在地上，一动不动。他心里很清楚，他已经死了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Something connected in his mind. His brother hadn't gone up just to shoot her right away. She had shot him. His noise had been the distraction that allowed her to escape confinement and get a weapon.
entries.new: 他忽然把整件事串联了起来。哥哥上楼并不是一进去就要开枪杀她，而是她开枪杀了哥哥。是他弄出的动静引开了哥哥的注意，让她得以挣脱束缚，拿到武器。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The girl wasn't in the usual chair he used. Around it was an untied rope, and bloodstains much older than the ones surrounding Kyuuka's brother.
entries.new: 那个女孩不在哥哥常用的那把椅子上。椅子周围散着解开的绳索，还有比Kyuuka哥哥身边那些陈旧得多的血迹。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: But Kyuuka didn't see her anywhere. The girl had vanished. Bewildered, he stepped into the room.
entries.new: 可Kyuuka哪里都没看见她。女孩不见了。他满心困惑，走进了房间。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: In an instant, she emerged from behind the door and shoved a gun up to his face. The barrel took up almost his entire field of vision.
entries.new: 刹那间，她从门后闪出，把枪抵到他脸上。枪口几乎占满了他的整个视野。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He couldn't think of a thing to say. No longer feeling like he was sinking, he felt nothing.
entries.new: 他一句话也想不出来。那种不断下沉的感觉已经消失，剩下的只有一片空白。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Give m-me one reason... not to... shoot you too.
entries.new: 给、给我一个理由……让我不……不把你也打死。
entries.speaker: nn

entries.text: ...{w}I called the police. They're on their way right now.
entries.new: ……{w}我报警了。他们正在赶来的路上。
entries.speaker: nn

entries.text: Wh-What...? When?
entries.new: 什、什么……？什么时候？
entries.speaker: nn

entries.text: A few minutes ago.
entries.new: 就在几分钟前。
entries.speaker: nn

entries.text: Her hand was shaking violently, and beyond the metal barrel, Kyuuka could see her face.
entries.new: 她的手抖得厉害。越过那截金属枪管，Kyuuka 看清了她的脸。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: One of her eyes was missing, and the pain, dulled as it must have been, was getting to her. Adrenaline couldn't keep her going against exhaustion forever.
entries.new: 她的一只眼睛已经没了。那种痛想必早已麻木，却仍在一点点吞噬着她。靠肾上腺素硬撑，终究敌不过疲惫。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Why... Why wouldn't you c-call them earlier!? You were h-here... when I got here!
entries.new: 为、为什么……你为什么不早点叫他们！？我来的时、时候……你明明就在这里！
entries.speaker: nn

entries.text: He didn't say anything for a few seconds. The wrong response could've killed him.
entries.new: 他沉默了几秒。答错一句话，就可能要了他的命。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: It was clear that she was completely unstable. She had lost so much blood that her actions were slightly sluggish as well.
entries.new: 她显然已经完全失控。失血过多，连动作也变得有些迟缓。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Do you know what he would have done if I'd called the police earlier? What he did to you, but worse.
entries.new: 你知道我要是早点报警，他会做出什么吗？他会把你遭的那些事，变本加厉地再做一遍。
entries.speaker: nn

entries.text: Y-You didn't do anything! You let him... You let him do this!
entries.new: 你、你什么都没做！你就那么看着他……看着他做出这种事！
entries.speaker: nn

entries.text: ...The police will be here in a few minutes. You're safe.
entries.new: ……警察几分钟后就到。你安全了。
entries.speaker: nn

entries.text: I don't believe you!
entries.new: 我不信你！
entries.speaker: nn

entries.text: Kyuuka considered for a moment. He didn't have a good way to escape. Entering the room blindly had been a mistake for him.
entries.new: Kyuuka 权衡了一瞬。他找不出什么好的退路。贸然闯进这间屋子，本就是他的一步错棋。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He had believed that even if she was just like everyone else, not worth caring about, it would be a good thing to put a stop to what his brother was doing to people. And it could have ended up costing him.{w} All Kyuuka had accomplished was getting him killed and putting himself in a dangerous position.
entries.new: 他原以为，哪怕她和旁人没什么两样、不值得在意，能阻止哥哥再害人，总归是件好事。这念头本可能让他自己付出性命。{w}到头来，Kyuuka 做到的，不过是害得哥哥丢了命，也把自己推入了险境。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: There was only one course of action he could take at that moment, and it happened almost automatically.
entries.new: 那一刻，他能做的只有一件事，而且几乎是下意识地做了出来。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: After repeatedly knocking, the police forced the door open.
entries.new: 反复敲门无果后，警察强行撞开了门。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Drawn by the smell of blood and gunpowder, they immediately located the room where two corpses lay. A man and the kidnapped girl were on the floor.
entries.new: 循着血腥与火药的气味，他们很快找到了躺着两具尸体的房间。一名男子和那名被绑架的少女倒在地上。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Immediately, the entire mansion was secured, but nobody else was found.
entries.new: 整座宅邸随即被封锁，但再没找到其他人。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The next day, the news was published: Anora, the girl who'd disappeared, had been found dead high on a mountain. One of her eyes had been gouged out, and the other had a bullet through it. A bewildered Kyuuka read that article.
entries.new: 第二天，新闻登了出来：失踪的少女 Anora 被发现死在山上。她的一只眼睛被剜去，另一只则中了一枪。Kyuuka 满心茫然地读完了那篇报道。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: That day, he came back home and realized that his parents were there.{w} As usual, he had no idea what they would say.
entries.new: 那天他回到家，才发现父母也在。{w}和往常一样，他完全猜不到他们会说些什么。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Before they saw him, his parents looked terribly sad. However, when he appeared, relief spread through them.
entries.new: 他还没露面时，父母脸上的悲伤浓得化不开。可他一出现，那份悲色便化作了如释重负。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: His parents didn't talk about what had happened. While he found it strange, Kyuuka couldn't bring himself to utter a word about it either.
entries.new: 父母对发生过的事只字不提。Kyuuka 觉得奇怪，可他自己也开不了口，半个字都没说出来。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Kyuuka would be the family's final generation. That was something he was sure of.
entries.new: Kyuuka 会是这个家族的最后一代。这一点他确信无疑。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: However, even that was stripped away. On paper, at least. After what had happened with his brother, his last name carried a heavy stigma, and so his parents took action.
entries.new: 可就连这一点也被剥夺了。至少在纸面上如此。哥哥的事之后，这个姓氏背负了沉重的污名，父母于是采取了行动。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He was released from that family. Then, he kept secretly living in that mansion until he was given a new place in the center of the town.
entries.new: 他被从那个家族中除名。此后，他一直偷偷住在宅邸里，直到镇中心为他安排了新的住处。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: If nothing else, he appreciated that his job wasn't nearly as dirty as it could have been—and that he had some peace and quiet.
entries.new: 至少有一点让他庆幸：这份工作远没有那么肮脏，而且他还能落得几分清静。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Molehill
entries.new: 鼹鼠丘

entries.text: The lights turned on in the tower.{w} The lobby door opened, and a man stepped into the hallway.
entries.new: 塔内亮起了灯。{w}大厅的门打开，一名男子走进走廊。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: It was Katei, who had recently changed into his working uniform. Ready to begin his morning shift, he entered the security room.
entries.new: 是 Katei，他刚换好工作制服。准备开始早班，他走进了监控室。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: His colleague Cou was ready to leave. After greeting each other, Katei sat on his chair.
entries.new: 同事 Cou 正准备下班。两人打过招呼，Katei 坐进自己的椅子。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Over the phone, he'd learned Xyn had attacked again. It had happened on the 24th, and it had started during his own shift.{w} On that Thursday, there had been an event in the tower where many gemstones had been replaced. The next night, they had all been taken.
entries.new: 他在电话里得知，Xyn 又动手了。事情发生在 24 号，而且就始于他自己的班次。{w}那个星期四，塔里办过一场活动，许多宝石被替换。第二天夜里，它们全被劫走了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Long ago, his job had started to exclusively revolve around Xyn. Ashiya had been outsmarted repeatedly, and every countermeasure they designed was continually bypassed.{w} It was Katei's job to put an end to those incidents. However, his thoughts on Ashiya were far from positive. He'd worked in the tower for years, and he knew information that eluded public knowledge.
entries.new: 很久以前，他的工作就开始只围着 Xyn 打转。芦屋屡屡被人算计，他们设计的每一项对策都被不断绕过。{w}终结这些事件，正是 Katei 的职责。但他对芦屋的评价绝谈不上正面。他在塔里工作多年，知道许多外界无从得知的内情。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He was fully aware that none of his superiors belonged to the Ashiya family anymore. It had been long ago when the corporation had lost all ties to their actual bloodline.
entries.new: 他很清楚，自己的上司里没有一个人还属于芦屋家族。这家公司早已与真正的血脉断绝了关系。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Katei stared at the three monitors in front of him, and as he moved the cursor toward a folder, his heart began to race.
entries.new: Katei 盯着面前的三台显示器。当他把光标移向一个文件夹时，心跳陡然加快。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Xyn had circumvented their measures multiple times, but that hadn't been all. Camera footage had been erased, and they'd taken advantage of the rare times when the security room had been empty.
entries.new: Xyn 不止一次绕过了他们的防线，事情还不止于此。监控录像被人抹去，而对方正是趁着监控室难得无人的时候下的手。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Katei knew someone close to them worked for Xyn. There was no other explanation anymore.
entries.new: Katei 知道，他们身边有人替 Xyn 做事。事到如今，已经没有别的解释了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: There were many candidates he had considered, but they'd all looked clean. As he approached a hidden folder, he wondered again who it was. A few places in the tower weren't fitted with cameras, but trying to catch Xyn on video had long ago started to feel like a futile effort.
entries.new: 他考虑过的可疑对象不少，可每一个看上去都毫无问题。靠近那个隐藏文件夹时，他又一次想：到底会是谁？塔里有几处没有安装摄像头，但想靠录像抓住 Xyn，他早就觉得是徒劳。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Katei had ruminated on something for quite a while. He wanted to use the places without cameras to catch the infiltrator.
entries.new: 有件事 Katei 已经盘算很久了。他想利用那些没有摄像头的区域，揪出混进来的人。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Before arriving at the tower, he'd been told that footage of hallway A had been erased. That was why he'd been nervous all morning.
entries.new: 来塔里之前，他听说 A走廊的录像被抹掉了。所以整个上午他都心神不宁。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: But he had to be careful. Opening that folder might've been a bad idea.
entries.new: 但他必须小心。打开那个文件夹，也许并不是个好主意。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: How had Xyn erased the footage? It had always happened during times when the security room was vacant, but Katei thought that was off. Most recently, it had happened when he'd been out, but he didn't think anyone would've had enough time to remove the footage.
entries.new: Xyn 究竟是怎么抹掉录像的？每次出事，监控室都恰好无人，可 Katei 觉得这不对劲。最近这次发生在他外出期间，但他并不认为有谁来得及删除录像。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Could that computer have been infected? Like he'd done in the past, he spent the entire morning cleaning it up as much as he could.
entries.new: 那台电脑会不会中了病毒？像以前那样，他花了一整个上午，尽可能地把它清理干净。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: And when he was done, he sent the folder to an e-mail address that he had created at home.
entries.new: 做完之后，他把那个文件夹发送到自己在家注册的电子邮箱。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: That evening, he hurried to his personal computer. He'd been wondering all day if his plan had worked.
entries.new: 那天傍晚，他匆匆赶回自己的电脑前。一整天他都在想，自己的计划究竟有没有奏效。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He hadn't spoken to anyone about it. There was no way Xyn had known about it.
entries.new: 他没对任何人提起过。Xyn 不可能知道。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Finally, he logged into his account and downloaded the folder.
entries.new: 终于，他登录账户，下载了那个文件夹。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Inside it, there was a long video.
entries.new: 里面是一段很长的视频。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The day before Xyn's attack, he'd been forced to momentarily rush out of the security room. During that time, part of the footage had been erased.
entries.new: Xyn 动手的前一天，他不得已临时冲出了监控室。就在那段时间里，一部分录像被抹掉了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Katei had been waiting for that to happen. That was why, when he'd dashed out of the security room, he hadn't closed its door.
entries.new: Katei 一直在等那一刻到来。正因如此，他冲出监控室时，才没有把门关上。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The footage from hallway A had been erased, but had Xyn accounted for Katei's idea? During that time, another camera had been recording part of the hallway.
entries.new: A走廊的录像已经被抹掉，但 Xyn 有没有算到 Katei 这一手？在那段时间里，另一台摄像头录下了走廊的一部分。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The computer's webcam, tucked behind one of the monitors. It spent most of the time turned off, but that time, it had been recording the hallway through the open door.{w} Katei had pressed a button behind the camera to begin the recording, and it wasn't a new device in the tower. There was no way Xyn had learned of his plan.
entries.new: 那是电脑的摄像头，藏在其中一台显示器后面。它平时大多关着，可那一次，它正透过敞开的门，录下走廊里的情形。{w} Katei 按下了摄像头背后的按钮开始录像，而这并不是塔里新添的设备。Xyn 不可能得知他的计划。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Katei played the video, his trembling hand advancing it to the time he'd left the room. That had been the only time of the day when he hadn't monitored hallway A, so Xyn must've wanted to hide those few seconds.
entries.new: Katei 播放录像，颤抖的手把进度拖到他离开房间的那一刻。那是他当天唯一没有盯着 A走廊的时候，所以 Xyn 想遮掩的，一定就是那几秒。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The time was before {time=9.} When Katei saw his face disappearing from the video, he let go of the mouse.{w} Then, he saw all he needed to see.{w} Through hallway A, someone he knew passed by. They were pushing a cleaning cart.
entries.new: 时间停在 {time=9.} 之前。看到自己的脸从画面中消失，Katei 松开了鼠标。{w} 随后，该看的他都看到了。{w} 一个他认识的人推着清洁推车，从 A走廊经过。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: That was what Xyn had wanted to hide. Finally, he knew the identity of the infiltrator.{w} Ido, the janitor.
entries.new: Xyn 想遮掩的就是这个。他终于知道了潜入者的身份。{w} 清洁工 Ido。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: ...But he still didn't know what had happened. Gemstones had been stolen from one of the rooms, but that hadn't happened until the following night. Yet, when they'd gone through the available footage, nobody had entered that room at the time of the attack.
entries.new: ……可他依旧不知道究竟发生了什么。有一个房间的宝石被盗，但那要到第二天夜里才发生。然而，他们查遍手头能用的录像，袭击发生时并没有人进过那个房间。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Had they been moved? Katei stared at the cleaning cart, wondering if they'd been inside it. If that was the case, they could've immediately been taken out. However, during the time of the attack, Ido hadn't been in the building.
entries.new: 宝石事先被转移了吗？Katei 盯着那辆清洁推车，想着它们是否曾藏在里面。若真是如此，它们本可以立刻被运出去。可袭击发生的时候，Ido 并不在楼里。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: There was something else of value Katei learned. The footage of some cameras had been erased while he was out of the security room. However, as he'd suspected, nobody had entered it before his return.
entries.new: Katei 还发现了另一件有价值的事。他离开监控室期间，有几台摄像头的录像被抹掉了。然而，正如他所料，在他回来之前，没人进过监控室。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Katei had started working in the tower decades ago, and many years were still ahead of him. He had worked on the building's security before the security room had been constructed, but that hadn't always been his job.
entries.new: Katei 几十年前就开始在塔里工作，前头还有好些年要熬。监控室建成之前，他就做过这栋楼的安保，不过安保并不是他一直以来的工作。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: When he looked at the future, he hated it. He loathed the thought of working there for even another year.
entries.new: 想到未来，他只觉得憎恶。哪怕再多在这里干一年，他都无法忍受。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He had no respect for Ashiya, and there was nothing about what the company had become that he identified with. He had seen the building change over the years to the point where it simply didn't feel the same.
entries.new: 他对芦屋毫无敬意，公司变成如今这副模样，也没有任何让他认同的地方。多年来，他看着这栋楼一点点改变，到最后，这里已经全然不是从前的感觉。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Since Xyn had reared their head in pursuit of Ashiya, some concepts had become tempting to Katei.
entries.new: 自 Xyn 冒头、盯上芦屋以来，有些念头对 Katei 而言变得格外诱人。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: During his night shifts, he was sometimes the only person in the building. He had given plenty of thought to taking out Ashiya's collection of gemstones.
entries.new: 值夜班时，他有时是楼里唯一的人。他无数次想过把芦屋收藏的宝石弄走。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: It should've been simple. It had happened before, so he could claim that the security footage had suddenly been erased and that he hadn't seen anything through the monitors.
entries.new: 这本该很简单。以前也出过这种事，他大可以声称监控录像突然被抹掉，而他在监视器里什么也没看见。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: But that was too dangerous. Xyn seemed to know everything that happened in that place. What if they exposed Katei as being responsible? Would they dislike being impersonated? He was worried they would threaten him too.{w} And even if none of that happened, Katei didn't know what he'd do with those gems.
entries.new: 但那太危险了。那地方发生的任何事，Xyn 似乎都了如指掌。万一他们揭穿此事是 Katei 所为呢？他们会容忍有人冒充自己吗？他担心自己也会遭到他们的威胁。{w} 就算这些都没发生，Katei 也不知道自己拿到那些宝石后能怎么办。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: After everything, Katei didn't think it was fair that he had to keep working there; he couldn't bear the thought of staying in that place for much longer. His parents had died, and he wouldn't be able to support himself for too long if he left his job. ...It wasn't fair.{w} After Xyn's first attack, his mind had produced various scenarios that gave him what he wanted.
entries.new: 事到如今，Katei 觉得继续留在那里工作，对他并不公平；一想到还要在那地方待很久，他就无法忍受。父母已经去世，他若辞了工作，也撑不了多久。……这不公平。{w} Xyn 第一次袭击之后，他脑中就冒出过种种设想，每一种都能让他得偿所愿。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: When the morning came, Katei had slept very little. He'd wanted to find a Xyn member for so long, and he was confident he finally had.{w} Months ago, he'd come up with a tempting plan. However, it was fairly large scale, so he'd been very hesitant to set it into motion.
entries.new: 天亮时，Katei 几乎没怎么睡。他追查 Xyn 成员这么久，如今终于确信自己抓到了线索。{w} 几个月前，他想出一个诱人的计划。可那计划规模不小，他一直迟迟不敢动手。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He left his house earlier than usual. On the way, he called Lei. She was the only person he'd always been confident wasn't part of Xyn, as she wanted to catch them more than anyone else.
entries.new: 他比平时更早出门。路上，他给 Lei 打了电话。她是他唯一始终确信与 Xyn 无关的人，因为没有人比她更想抓住 Xyn。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Katei? What do you want?
entries.new: Katei？有什么事？
entries.speaker: lei

entries.text: I would like to talk to you later. It might not be a good idea to do it in the tower, so if I can meet you outside before my shift starts, that'd be great.
entries.new: 我想晚些时候和你谈谈。在塔里说恐怕不合适，如果能在上班前到外面见一面，那就太好了。
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: Is it important?
entries.new: 重要吗？
entries.speaker: lei

entries.text: Yes.
entries.new: 是。
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: I understand. I will be there as soon as I can.
entries.new: 我知道了。我会尽快赶过去。
entries.speaker: lei

entries.text: Thank you.
entries.new: 谢谢。
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: Outside the tower's entrance, Katei and Lei met. Furtively, they stepped aside.
entries.new: 在塔的入口外，Katei 和 Lei 碰了面。两人悄悄走到一旁。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: What is it?
entries.new: 什么事？
entries.speaker: lei

entries.text: I've had this idea for some time. If we're ever going to do something like this, it's right now.
entries.new: 这个念头我盘算很久了。真要做这种事，现在就是最好的时机。
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: After hearing that, Lei frowned. Meanwhile, Katei thought of the best way to phrase what he'd wanted to say for months.
entries.new: 听到这话，Lei 皱起了眉。Katei 则在琢磨，该如何把憋了几个月的话说得最妥当。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: It's evident Xyn has a way to be in the tower without being seen, even when we're prepared. I believe we have to stop trying to see them while they're attacking.
entries.new: 很明显，就算我们有所防备，Xyn 也有办法潜入塔里不被发现。我认为，我们不能再一味想着在他们袭击时当场看见他们了。
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: When we added locks to the cabinets, they were able to unlock them and even broke some of them. It was a while ago, but remember what we thought? We removed those locks to prevent future damage and because that would incite Xyn to easily come back, so we'd be able to catch them.
entries.new: 我们给展示柜加锁时，他们不仅能打开，甚至弄坏了几把。那是之前的事了，还记得我们当时怎么想的吗？我们撤掉那些锁，一是免得他们再来破坏，二是这样做会诱使 Xyn 轻易再来，我们才好抓住他们。
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: We added an alarm to be alerted that cabinets were opened, but it didn't go off when they attacked. At this point, I find it impossible to believe they can't externally access the computer. I've looked into it many times, but that has to be true.
entries.new: 我们加了警报，好知道展示柜被打开，可他们袭击时警报没有响。事到如今，要说他们无法从外部访问电脑，我实在无法相信。我查过很多次，但这一点肯定没错。
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: Do you think we should change out the computer entirely?
entries.new: 你觉得我们该把整台电脑换掉吗？
entries.speaker: lei

entries.text: No. Access to our computer can't be all they have. If we change it, they'll immediately know they lost that information, which could be bad. I would also not be able to protect the new computer at all times.{w} I have an idea. If I develop the mechanism behind a new alarm at home, it's possible they won't be able to bypass it.{w} I think this is what we should do so that they don't think we're suspicious of anything involving our computer setup.{w} Once I set up the software for this at home, I'll bring it to the tower's computer. If I do it well, it's unlikely they'll notice it.
entries.new: 不行。他们不可能只有进入我们电脑这一种手段。若把电脑换掉，他们立刻就会知道自己失去了那条情报渠道，那可能会坏事。而且我也没法时时刻刻守着新电脑。{w} 我有个主意。要是我在家里先把新警报的机关做出来，他们也许就绕不过去了。{w} 我认为就该这么做，这样他们也不会察觉我们对电脑相关的布置起了疑心。{w} 等我在家里把配套软件准备好，再装到塔里的电脑上。只要做得够稳妥，他们不太可能发现。
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: ...I see. I think that's worth doing.
entries.new: ……我明白了。这值得一试。
entries.speaker: lei

entries.text: Me too, but we have to be smart. If this works, we have to catch them.{w} We can't screw this up. If they really activate the alarm, they might still have a method of escape. We have to make sure that won't be possible.
entries.new: 我也这么想，但必须做得聪明。若计划奏效，我们就一定要抓住他们。{w} 绝不能搞砸。就算他们真的触发了警报，也还可能有逃跑的办法。我们得确保他们无路可逃。
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: How?
entries.new: 怎么做？
entries.speaker: lei

entries.text: I can build it so that when the alarm is activated, any exits will close. As soon as they open a cabinet, they will be stuck in the tower.{w} I have thought a lot about this. They have attacked during times I was in the security room, so we'll make sure one of us is always there. If the mechanism also locks that door, we will trap the attacker.
entries.new: 我可以把它做成这样：警报一触发，所有出口都会关闭。他们只要打开展示柜，就会被困在塔里。{w} 这件事我想了很久。他们之前几次动手时，我都待在监控室，所以我们得保证总有一人守在那里。如果机关也能把那扇门锁上，就能把袭击者困住。
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: ...Do you think this could work?
entries.new: ……你觉得这能行吗？
entries.speaker: lei

entries.text: It must. They have always attacked during the night, so I'm confident it will go smoothly.
entries.new: 一定行。他们一向在夜里动手，我相信会顺利的。
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: For the first time in what seemed like forever, Lei thought that one of Katei's ideas had real promise.
entries.new: 仿佛隔了许久许久，Lei 第一次觉得 Katei 的某个主意确实有成功的希望。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: How would the exits be locked, though?
entries.new: 可是出口要怎么锁上？
entries.speaker: lei

entries.text: That's what I can't handle. If I use the old system, I can have the mechanism ready for tomorrow. The installation would have to be done during the night, though, when no one else is here.{w} It will be independent of the computer, so Xyn shouldn't learn about it. I believe it's possible they're receiving the camera's feed, but the lobby isn't recorded, so they won't see it.
entries.new: 难就难在这里。若沿用旧系统，我明天就能把机关准备好。不过安装只能安排在夜里、楼里没别人的时候。{w} 它会独立于电脑，Xyn 应该不会得知。他们可能收得到摄像头的画面，但大厅没有录像，所以他们看不到。
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: But what about the windows? Shouldn't they be shut as well?
entries.new: 可窗户呢？窗户不也得关上吗？
entries.speaker: lei

entries.text: ...You're right—that would be seen. I wouldn't like to disable the camera system because they could learn something is being done under their noses.{w} Nothing happens on the higher floors during the night. I can modify the system from home as well to disable those cameras and loop a still image of the floors, then quickly install the modification on the tower's computer. I doubt Xyn will look at that footage, but if they do, they shouldn't notice the cameras were stopped.
entries.new: ……你说得对，关窗会被看见。我不想直接关掉摄像系统，那样他们可能会察觉有人就在他们眼皮底下动手脚。{w} 夜里楼上不会有什么事。我也可以在家里改系统，关掉那些摄像头，让楼层的静止画面循环播放，然后尽快把改动装到塔里的电脑上。Xyn 未必会去看那段录像，就算看了，应该也看不出摄像头已经停了。
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: However, we can't do it like the last time. Altering every cabinet to trigger the alarm is something that could easily be noticed, and it would take a long time.
entries.new: 不过，不能照上次那样做。把每个展示柜都改成能触发警报，太容易被发现了，而且耗时很长。
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: That's true, but it's what we would have to do.
entries.new: 确实，可我们也只能这么做。
entries.speaker: lei

entries.text: We can draw them to a specific cabinet. Do you remember when we obtained the Nomdaid? It was targeted by Xyn immediately.{w} If we procure something of that caliber, Xyn won't be able to resist a repeat. That will be the cabinet we'll need to alter, and since it won't be one currently displayed, we can modify it before they know it exists.
entries.new: 我们可以把他们引到某个特定的展示柜。还记得我们拿到诺姆达伊德的时候吗？Xyn 立刻就盯上了它。{w} 若再弄到一件那种级别的东西，Xyn 一定忍不住故技重施。要改的就是那个展示柜；既然它现在还不会展出，我们就能在他们知道它存在之前先动手改好。
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: Lei nodded thoughtfully. Katei's plan could definitely work.
entries.new: Lei 若有所思地点了点头。Katei 的计划确实行得通。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: I see. I will try to find a good fit for that.
entries.new: 我明白了。我会试着找一件合适的。
entries.speaker: lei

entries.text: Perfect. We should hurry up before they attack again.{w} If I'm not mistaken, the event for the 15th of next month was hindered. It was going to be a guided tour to cover the last wave of gems, but that can't be done anymore.
entries.new: 很好。得赶在他们下次动手之前抓紧时间。{w}如果我没记错，下个月15号的活动已经受到了影响。原定要办一场导览，介绍最后一批宝石，现在办不成了。
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: That's right. It's canceled as of now.
entries.new: 没错。目前已经取消了。
entries.speaker: lei

entries.text: When you find a suitable gemstone, announce it'll be shown on that Thursday. This way, if Xyn doesn't attack beforehand, we'll still solve that problem.
entries.new: 等找到合适的宝石，就宣布它将在那个周四展出。这样一来，即便Xyn没有提前动手，这个问题也能解决。
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: That's a very good idea. I'll do that.
entries.new: 这个主意很好。就这么办。
entries.speaker: lei

entries.text: Katei nodded slowly. That was what he'd needed the most.{w} The 15th was a Thursday, and also the middle point of the month. That meant that it was the day his work shift would change. In the first half of the month, Katei worked during the night, and in the second half, he worked during the morning.{w} Up until the 15th, he'd be in the tower all night, ready for Xyn's attack. However, he'd also learned Xyn made daylight moves. So, if the attack didn't happen before the 15th, Katei would be present during the event.
entries.new: Katei缓缓点头。这正是他最需要的东西。{w}15号是周四，也正好是月中，也就是说，那天他的班次会调换。上半月Katei值夜班，下半月值早班。{w}15号之前，他整夜都会守在塔里，等着Xyn来袭。不过他也已经知道，Xyn会在白天下手。所以，袭击若没在15号之前发生，Katei就能出现在活动上。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: I will do my best to find something appropriate. When it's ready, we'll put it in a prepared cabinet, and you will enable the system on the tower's computer.
entries.new: 我会尽力找一件合适的。准备好之后，我们把它放进预留的展示柜，你再在塔里的电脑上启用系统。
entries.speaker: lei

entries.text: Yes.
entries.new: 好。
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: Why don't we do it differently? Why not make it so that opening the cabinet locks the room it's in, as opposed to the entire building?
entries.new: 不如换个做法？让展示柜一打开就封锁它所在的房间，而不是整栋楼，怎么样？
entries.speaker: lei

entries.text: No. That could go wrong. Altering those doors is much more likely to be noticed, and if someone inside the room was quick, they could get out before being trapped.
entries.new: 不行，那样容易出岔子。改动那些门更容易被人察觉，而且房里的人动作够快的话，还可能在封死之前逃出去。
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: Katei's voice was stern. He couldn't waver in initiating the plan.
entries.new: Katei的语气很严厉。启动这个计划时，他不能有半点动摇。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: You think so? I was thinking about a mechanical lock, not a shutter.
entries.new: 你这么想？我考虑的是机械锁，不是卷帘门。
entries.speaker: lei

entries.text: That wouldn't work. They could keep the door open and put a hard object between it and the wall to prevent it from locking. I'm aware my idea is more complex, but we can't risk this.
entries.new: 那行不通。他们可以让门一直开着，在门和墙之间塞个硬东西，门就锁不上。我知道我的办法更复杂，但这件事不能冒险。
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: All right, we'll talk about it further.{w} I will let Cou know about this when he leaves, and I'll speak to Wis. Is that fine?
entries.new: 好，我们再详谈。{w}Cou走的时候我会把这件事告诉他，也会跟Wis说一声。这样可以吗？
entries.speaker: lei

entries.text: Katei nodded after a pause. Cou and Wis were the first people he'd personally investigated, as they shared his job. He couldn't be completely certain, but he really didn't think they were part of Xyn.{w} Katei's shift was about to start, so he bowed and stepped into the tower. As he walked to the security room, he sighed, relieved Lei hadn't put more pressure on him.{w} That would've prevented what he had in mind. It was something only he could do, and it was thanks to a key that had once saved him.
entries.new: Katei停顿了一下，才点了点头。Cou和Wis跟他做着同样的工作，是他最先亲自调查的两个人。他无法完全确定，但他实在不觉得他们是Xyn的人。{w}Katei的值班时间快到了，他鞠了一躬，走进塔里。走向监控室时，他松了口气——幸好Lei没有进一步向他施压。{w}否则他心里盘算的事就行不通了。那件事只有他能做到，靠的是一把曾经救过他的钥匙。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: It was the 6th of December. Katei had been shut in the security room for a few hours.
entries.new: 那是12月6日。Katei已经把自己关在监控室里好几个小时。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He was staring at the screens, knowing Xyn's attack could come at any time.
entries.new: 他盯着屏幕，知道Xyn随时可能动手。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Suddenly, an alarm blared. Immediately, he knew they were in the building.{w} But he didn't understand how that could be. Through the monitors, he couldn't see anyone anywhere.
entries.new: 忽然，警报大作。他立刻明白，他们已经进楼了。{w}可他不懂这怎么可能。他把监控画面全看了一遍，哪里都不见人影。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Ah, I see. The security system was hacked. It almost worked.
entries.new: 啊，原来如此。安防系统被入侵了。差一点就成功了。
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: Katei smirked. Before the alarm ceased, he found the anomaly in the system. Xyn had sabotaged it without being noticed.
entries.new: Katei冷笑一声。警报还没停，他就找出了系统里的异常。Xyn在无人察觉的情况下动了手脚。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: When Katei fixed the problem, all the screens updated, and through one, he saw a man in the event room. He looked disconcerted, desperately glancing around him.
entries.new: Katei排除故障后，所有画面都刷新了，其中一格画面显示活动室里有个男人。他神色慌张，正拼命四下张望。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Katei moved the microphone close to his mouth and turned it on. When he spoke, his voice played everywhere in the building.
entries.new: Katei把麦克风移到嘴边，打开开关。他一开口，声音便传遍整栋楼。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: We knew you would come. The gemstone in front of you was all we needed to draw you here.
entries.new: 我们早就知道你会来。你面前那颗宝石，就足以把你引到这里。
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: The man looked up, trying to find the source of the audio. Because his face was covered, Katei couldn't tell who he was.
entries.new: 男人抬起头，想找出声音的来源。他的脸被遮住了，Katei认不出他是谁。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Unfortunately, you have been trapped. You won't be able to leave this building.
entries.new: 可惜，你已经被困住了。你出不了这栋楼。
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: When he heard that, the man ran to the lobby. He disappeared from Katei's sight, but he soon reappeared, dashing toward the staircase.
entries.new: 听到这话，男人朝大厅跑去。他从Katei的视野里消失，但很快又出现了，正冲向楼梯。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: It's futile. The way to the second floor is locked, and the elevator has been disabled.
entries.new: 没用的。通往二楼的通道已经锁死，电梯也停用了。
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: The man ignored Katei's voice and took out a key.
entries.new: 男人不理Katei的声音，掏出一把钥匙。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Oh, Xyn even has that key? I'm impressed.
entries.new: 哦，Xyn连那把钥匙都有？真让我佩服。
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: With it, he unlocked the door protecting the next floor. However, when he saw the windows, he slowed down, unable to accept it.
entries.new: 他用它打开了通往上一层的门。然而看到那些窗户时，他的脚步慢了下来，无法接受眼前的事实。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Haha, it's useless! All the windows have been sealed. You cannot escape.
entries.new: 哈哈，白费力气！所有窗户都封死了。你逃不掉。
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: The man didn't give up. Instead, he turned around and ran to where Katei was.
entries.new: 男人没有放弃，反而转身朝Katei所在的方向跑去。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He arrived at the security room, slamming into the door behind Katei.
entries.new: 他冲到监控室，狠狠撞上Katei身后的门。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: This door is perfectly shut. You will not open it.
entries.new: 这扇门关得严严实实。你打不开的。
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: Finally, the man seemed to give up. After a few seconds of silence, he stepped back and fell defeatedly to the floor.
entries.new: 终于，男人似乎放弃了。沉默了几秒，他后退一步，颓然跌坐在地上。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Now you understand your position.{w} When the alarm played, Ashiya were notified. They will be here in less than ten minutes.{w} Before that, there's something I want to tell you.
entries.new: 现在你明白自己的处境了。{w}警报响起时，芦屋那边已经收到通知。不出十分钟他们就会赶到。{w}在那之前，我有件事要告诉你。
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: Slowly, the man looked up, once again trying to determine where Katei's voice was coming from.
entries.new: 男人缓缓抬头，又一次想辨明Katei的声音从哪里传来。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: It is not possible for me to unlock the exit. For that, Ashiya's input is needed.{w} However, I know of a secret way out.
entries.new: 出口不是我一个人能解锁的，那需要芦屋那边介入。{w}不过，我知道一条秘密的出路。
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: When Katei said that, the man stood back up. Had his hearing failed him?
entries.new: 听到这话，男人又站了起来。是他听错了吗？
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: In this building, there's a hidden door. I have also hidden the key you'll need to unlock it somewhere here.{w} If you don't waste time, you can leave before Ashiya comes.{w} This alarm has never been activated before. I will tell them that a malfunction set it off. If nobody's found when the building is unlocked, they will believe my word.{w} If you want that, there are two conditions you must agree on.{w} You have stolen from us countless times—it is undeniable that Xyn must be a wealthy group. For your liberty, you will provide me with 50 million yen. I believe that is a fair sum.{w} Secondly, you must reveal your identity in front of the cameras.{w} I know you, Xyn. I know a lot more than you think.{w} Ido is the mole; I know where you gather, and I've investigated many of you.{w} Just like I know you, you know me. For that reason, if anything were to happen to me, this recording and all the information I have will be immediately exposed.{w} Do you agree to these conditions?
entries.new: 这栋楼里有一扇暗门。开它需要的钥匙，我也藏在了这里的某处。{w}只要你抓紧时间，就能在芦屋赶到之前离开。{w}这道警报以前从未响过。我会告诉他们，是设备故障触发了它。解锁之后若没找到人，他们会信我的话。{w}如果你想这样，就得答应我两个条件。{w}你们从我们这里偷过无数次东西——不可否认，Xyn必定是个财力雄厚的组织。为了你的自由，给我五千万日元。我认为这个数目很公道。{w}第二，你必须在镜头前露脸。{w}我了解你，Xyn。我掌握的比你想象的多得多。{w}Ido是内鬼；我知道你们在哪儿聚集，也调查过你们中的不少人。{w}就像我了解你一样，你也了解我。正因如此，若我出了什么事，这段录音和我手上的所有情报都会立刻公开。{w}这些条件，你答应吗？
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: The loud voice faded with static. Before the silence could grow uncomfortable, the man nodded.{w} Then, he slowly took off his mask.
entries.new: 洪亮的声音在杂音中渐渐消失。还没等沉默变得尴尬，男人就点了点头。{w}然后，他缓缓摘下面罩。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: B-{w=0.2}Brother?
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: When Katei saw his brother's face, he snapped out of his daydream.
entries.new: 看到哥哥的脸，Katei才从白日梦里回过神来。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: It was going to work; Lei hadn't suspected him at all. After going over his plan and stepping into the security room, he reassured himself.
entries.new: 这计划行得通，Lei丝毫没起疑。他在心里把计划过了一遍，走进监控室，又给自己打了打气。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Katei got home and took something out of a drawer. He finally had a use for it.
entries.new: Katei回到家，从抽屉里取出一样东西。它终于能派上用场了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: All staff members were often checked despite their positions, and they had to leave their phones behind before beginning their work.{w} That was the reason Katei had set an alarm so early.
entries.new: 无论职位高低，员工都常被抽查，上班前还必须把手机留在外面。{w}正因如此，Katei才把闹钟定得那么早。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Before the sun had risen, he was outside the tower.
entries.new: 太阳还没升起，他已经站在了塔外。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: A while later, he showed himself in the lobby to begin his shift.
entries.new: 过了好一阵，他才出现在大厅，开始当班。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Once hours had passed, he left the security room and walked down the hallway.{w} He entered the storeroom, leaving it shortly after.
entries.new: 几个小时过去，他离开监控室，沿着走廊走去。{w}他进了储藏室，没多久又出来了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He had seen Ido cleaning those hallways countless times. He knew Ido was given multiple keys, which he often had at the front of the cleaning cart.{w} Katei waited for Ido to exit the building. Snow had just stopped falling, and Ashiya always wanted to keep the plaza outside the tower free of any buildup.
entries.new: 他无数次见过Ido打扫那几条走廊。他知道Ido手上有好几把钥匙，平时总放在清洁车的前头。{w}Katei等到Ido离开大楼。雪刚停，而芦屋一向要求塔外的广场保持整洁，不留积雪。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: That was when Katei walked to the cleaning room. The cart was there—Ido didn't always bring it with him, so he examined it carefully. However, he was surprised to find what he wanted on one of the shelves instead. It was the key he needed.
entries.new: 就在这时，Katei 走向清洁间。推车就放在那里——Ido 并不总把它随身带着，于是他仔细查看了一番。没想到，他要找的东西就在架子上。那正是他需要的那把钥匙。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He brought it to the staff room. There, he unlocked Ido's locker. Every day, Ido would change into a white uniform, leaving his normal clothes behind.
entries.new: 他把钥匙带到员工室，打开了 Ido 的储物柜。Ido 每天都会换上白色制服，把自己的便装留在柜里。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: His coat, which he always wore, was hanging inside. As fast as he could, Katei took the tiny device he'd retrieved in the storeroom and attached it to the coat's neck, where it'd be close to Ido's mouth.
entries.new: 他平日总穿的那件外套就挂在里面。Katei 以最快的速度取出在储藏室拿到的小装置，装到外套的领口处——那里离 Ido 的嘴最近。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: When he got back to the security room, he tested it to see if it was working.
entries.new: 回到监控室后，他试了试装置是否正常运作。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: What he had attached to Ido's clothes was linked to a tiny playback device. He took it out, and when he pressed the record button, a flat line appeared on the screen, indicating it was receiving audio feed.
entries.new: 他装在 Ido 衣服上的东西与一台小型回放设备相连。他把设备取出来，按下录音键，屏幕上便浮现出一条平直的波形，说明它正在接收音频信号。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The internal storage of the device would quickly run out, so he had inserted a large SD card in the back. Katei pressed the play button, and soft static began to come out of the speaker. Nothing else played, but he knew that nothing was making any sound in the staff room.
entries.new: 设备自带的存储很快就会写满，所以他在背面插了一张大容量 SD 卡。Katei 按下播放键，扬声器里传出轻柔的电流杂音。除此之外什么都没有，但他知道，员工室里本就没什么会发出声响。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He couldn't risk leaving the tower with the device, and he had to go to the storeroom only when it was absolutely necessary. When the hallways were empty, he went back to the staff room and left the device in his locker.
entries.new: 他不能冒险带着设备离开塔，只有到了万不得已的时候才会去储藏室。等走廊里空无一人，他才回到员工室，把设备放回自己的储物柜。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The next day, he listened to what had been recorded. The waveform highlighted the noisy moments, but after minutes of perusing, he realized nothing of importance was there.{w} After Ido's job had ended, he'd walked home and hadn't left again until the next morning.
entries.new: 第二天，他听了录下的内容。波形图上标出了几处嘈杂的时段，可他仔细翻看了几分钟，终于确认其中没有任何要紧的东西。{w} Ido 下班后便走回了家，直到第二天早上都没有再出门。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: From there, all Katei had to do was wait for Lei to do her job.
entries.new: 接下来，Katei 只需等 Lei 把她那一部分做完。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The following day was a Sunday. Even though the tower was closed, Katei still had to work in it.
entries.new: 第二天是周日。塔虽然闭馆，Katei 仍旧得在里面上班。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Alone on the crystal floor, Katei skimmed through the newest audio. Once again, it seemed nothing substantial had been recorded.
entries.new: Katei 独自待在水晶层，快速过了一遍最新的录音。这一次，似乎依旧没有录到任何实质内容。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: On Monday the 28th, he stepped into the building. Very few days of his morning shift remained.{w} He listened to what the bug had recorded, and yet again, he hadn't obtained anything valuable. It appeared Ido was always at home.
entries.new: 28 日星期一，他走进大楼。他上早班的日子已经所剩无几。{w} 他听了窃听器录下的内容，还是没能得到任何有价值的线索。看来 Ido 一直待在家里。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Could he have been mistaken? What if Ido wasn't with Xyn?{w} Perhaps that wasn't it. Maybe they were too careful, and spying on them like that was never going to work.
entries.new: 难道他判断错了？万一 Ido 与 Xyn 并无关系呢？{w} 又或者并非如此。也许对方太过谨慎，靠这种办法监视根本行不通。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Katei was hesitant. He didn't have a lot of time, and his will was wavering.
entries.new: Katei 犹豫了。时间所剩不多，他的决心也开始动摇。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: That afternoon, he received Lei's call.
entries.new: 那天下午，他接到了 Lei 的电话。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Hello. I believe I found what we needed.
entries.new: 你好。我想我找到我们要的东西了。
entries.speaker: lei

entries.text: ...You found a special gemstone?
entries.new: ……你找到那种特别的宝石了？
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: Yes. I just went to see it, and I think it'll fit what we need.{w} Apparently, Gan found it yesterday on Airun. It's a white, egg-shaped stone, bright and smooth, that he called the "Sekimeiya".
entries.new: 是的。我刚去看过，应该正合我们的需要。{w} 听说 Gan 昨天在 Airun 找到了它。那是一块白色的蛋形石头，光洁明亮，他把它叫作「Sekimeiya」。
entries.speaker: lei

entries.text: Good. Anything should work as long as we advertise it like the last time.{w} I have finished doing my part, by the way.
entries.new: 很好。只要像上次那样宣传，什么都行。{w} 顺便说一句，我这边已经做完了。
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: The alarm system's done? Perfect. We'll have the Sekimeiya on the 30th, so we might want to install the alarm the night before.
entries.new: 警报系统做好了？太好了。Sekimeiya 30 号就能到手，我们最好在前一晚把警报装上。
entries.speaker: lei

entries.text: Yes.
entries.new: 嗯。
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: Katei began to get very worried. If Ido wasn't part of the group, he had to know. He wondered if he could do something with the information Lei had just given him.
entries.new: Katei 越来越担心。如果 Ido 不是那伙人，他必须弄清楚。他琢磨着，能不能利用 Lei 刚告诉他的消息做点什么。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Katei's lone hunt had begun far in the past. He had looked into most employees and had conversed with all of them. Although he hadn't determined anything at the time, that might've ended up being useful, as Ido wouldn't find it strange if Katei suddenly talked to him.
entries.new: Katei 独自追查已经很久了。他调查过大部分员工，也和每个人都谈过话。当时虽没查出什么，如今却可能派上用场——毕竟 Katei 突然找 Ido 搭话，也不会显得奇怪。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He had to make sure he wasn't mistaken, so he briefly exited the security room and walked to the lobby.
entries.new: 他得确认自己没有判断错，于是暂时离开监控室，走向大厅。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Hey. How's it going?
entries.new: 嗨，最近怎么样？
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: Ido turned to Katei and bowed with a jolly expression.
entries.new: Ido 转向 Katei，满脸笑容地鞠了一躬。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Everything has been going good, thank you for asking. How about you?
entries.new: 一切都好，谢谢关心。你呢？
entries.speaker: ido

entries.text: ...I don't think I can say the same, unfortunately. You know what happened on the 24th. We're doing our best to catch Xyn, but we're as lost as ever.
entries.new: ……很遗憾，我可没法这么说。24 号的事你也知道。我们正尽全力追查 Xyn，却始终毫无头绪。
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: Is that so...? I hope you can figure them out soon.
entries.new: 是这样吗……？但愿你们能早日查个水落石出。
entries.speaker: ido

entries.text: Me too, but we're in a bit of a hurry. The event for the 15th was changed. We're going to pick up a valuable gemstone this Wednesday, and you probably remember what happened the last time an event of this caliber was about to be held. ...We have to catch them before that day.
entries.new: 我也这么希望，不过我们的时间有点紧。15 号的活动改了。这周三我们要去接收一颗贵重的宝石，上次办这种规模的活动之前出了什么事，你大概还记得吧。……我们必须在那个日子之前抓住他们。
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: Oh, really? I hadn't heard about that.
entries.new: 哦，真的吗？这事我还没听说。
entries.speaker: ido

entries.text: Yeah, it's called the Sekimeiya, apparently, and it was found yesterday. We're handling everything with utmost care, but we're worried Xyn might attack at any moment. Keep an eye out for me, and mention anything you think is suspicious.
entries.new: 是啊，据说它叫 Sekimeiya，昨天才被找到。我们处处小心，可还是担心 Xyn 随时会动手。帮我多留意着点，发现什么可疑的就告诉我。
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: Oh, absolutely. I'm sorry to hear the situation is this bad, but I trust you'll catch them soon.
entries.new: 哦，那是当然。情况这么糟，真是遗憾，不过我相信你们很快就能抓到他们。
entries.speaker: ido

entries.text: ...Thank you.{w} I have to go now. *sigh*
entries.new: ……谢谢。{w} 我得走了。*叹气*
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: Ido bowed again as Katei walked to the reception desk.
entries.new: Katei 走向前台时，Ido 又鞠了一躬。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The Copse
entries.new: 树丛

entries.text: You did a good job, Atase.
entries.new: 你做得很好，Atase。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: Behind a short chair, Atase's boss congratulated him. As he did, however, Atase knew he must've been called there for a different reason.
entries.new: 矮椅后面，Atase 的上司恭喜他。但 Atase 明白，自己被叫来这里，肯定还有别的原因。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Thank you. I'm glad everything went well.
entries.new: 谢谢。事情顺利就好。
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: Yes, me too.{w} How was it?
entries.new: 嗯，我也这么想。{w} 情况如何？
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: How? It was simple, of course.{w} I had to spend a long time in the tower, but it went as we'd expected.
entries.new: 如何？当然是轻而易举。{w} 虽然我在塔里耗了很久，但一切都如我们所料。
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: Good. I verified that we received everything. It seems nothing went wrong.
entries.new: 很好。我确认过，东西全都收到了。看来没有出任何差错。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: ...Yes. It went smoothly.
entries.new: ……是的。一切顺利。
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: Atase's boss stared into his eyes.{w} Why? Why was he being tested like that?
entries.new: Atase 的上司直直盯着他的眼睛。{w} 为什么？为什么要这样试探他？
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Is that all you have to say?
entries.new: 你要说的就这些？
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: Y-Yes. Am I missing something?
entries.new: 是、是的。我漏了什么吗？
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: If it's as you said, no.
entries.new: 如果你说的都是实话，那就没有。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: ...{w}Is this why you called me?
entries.new: ……{w} 你叫我来就是为了这个？
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: Yes. You can go now.
entries.new: 是的。你可以走了。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: Atase was confused. He'd been surprised to have been called four days after the assignment, but his boss's attitude had left him even more fazed.
entries.new: Atase 满心困惑。任务结束四天后忽然被叫来，本就让他意外，而上司的态度更叫他摸不着头脑。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: ...I'll go, then.
entries.new: ……那我先走了。
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: His boss didn't show the slightest sign of movement. After a long pause, Atase stood up.
entries.new: 上司纹丝不动。过了好一会儿，Atase 才站起身来。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Suddenly, five knocks reverberated through the small space.
entries.new: 忽然，五下敲门声在这狭小的空间里回荡开来。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Go ahead.
entries.new: 进来吧。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: The door opened, and the outline of a thin man appeared. Hesitantly, he looked into the room, worried he was a disturbance.
entries.new: 门开了，一道瘦削的身影出现在门口。他迟疑地向房里张望，像是怕自己打扰了什么。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: What do you want, Ido?
entries.new: 什么事，Ido？
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: ...There's something I have to tell you.
entries.new: ……有件事，我得告诉你。
entries.speaker: ido

entries.text: Speak, then.
entries.new: 说吧。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: I have been told Ashiya will pick up a... notable gem this Wednesday.
entries.new: 有人告诉我，芦屋这周三会去取一颗……很了不得的宝石。
entries.speaker: ido

entries.text: Who told you that?
entries.new: 谁说的？
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: Katei Kuiji, from security. He compared it to the situation with the Nomdaid.
entries.new: 安保部的 Katei Kuiji。他还把它和诺姆达伊德那次的事相提并论。
entries.speaker: ido

entries.text: Hm.
entries.new: 嗯。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: He said they'll show it on the 15th; the event is going to be changed.
entries.new: 他说会在 15 号公开展出，活动内容也要变动。
entries.speaker: ido

entries.text: What else did he say?
entries.new: 还说了什么？
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: ...That they're working very hard to catch us before that day, handling the situation with utmost care and having a lot of trouble with it.{w} The gemstone was found yesterday on Airun, and it's called the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: ……说他们正全力争取在那天之前抓住我们，对这件事处理得极为谨慎，也为此颇费周折。{w}那颗宝石是昨天在 Airun 找到的，名字叫 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: ido

entries.text: Anything else?
entries.new: 还有别的吗？
entries.speaker: kr

entries.new: ……没有了。
entries.speaker: ido

entries.text: Why were you told this?
entries.new: 为什么要告诉你这些？
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: I don't know. I think he was venting, honestly. I've worked there since years before the first attack, so I believe I'm considered trustworthy. We had a brief conversation this morning.
entries.new: 我不知道。老实说，我觉得他只是在发牢骚。第一次袭击的好几年前我就在那里做事了，大概因此才被当成信得过的人。今天早上我们聊了几句。
entries.speaker: ido

entries.text: I see.
entries.new: 原来如此。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: Thank you for letting us know immediately, and do so again in the future.{w} You may go now.
entries.new: 多谢你立刻来告知，今后也照这样办。{w}你可以走了。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: ...Yes.
entries.speaker: ido

entries.text: After Ido left the room, Atase's boss looked pensive for some time before inquiring what Atase's thoughts were.{w} Atase had been the most involved in Ashiya-related manners; as such, his superior was curious to know his thoughts on what they'd heard.
entries.new: Ido 离开房间后，Atase 的上司沉思了片刻，才问他有什么想法。{w}与芦屋相关的事务，Atase 一向参与最多，因此上司很想听听他对刚才那番话的看法。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: They must expect an attack is imminent, so I'm sure they have something prepared.
entries.new: 他们一定料定袭击就在眼前，想必已经做好了准备。
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: Of course.{w} Three days ago, our access to the tower's computer was terminated. It's unlikely we were detected, though, so they're repeating the same preemptive actions.{w} Infecting the computer again is not a priority. They must be paying close attention to it, and if they found out a way to identify us, we can't risk notifying them of the moment we regained access.
entries.new: 当然。{w}三天前，我们对塔内电脑的访问被切断了。不过我们不太可能已经暴露，他们只是在重复同样的防范措施。{w}再次入侵电脑不是当务之急。他们现在一定盯得很紧，万一他们已经找到锁定我们的办法，我们一恢复访问就等于通知了他们，这个险不能冒。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: ...{w}I have a thought.{w} The computer was cleaned, so they're evidently preparing something in the tower. However, we have very early information about the event they're preparing. If we want to make a move, it might be a good call to do it before they actually retrieve the gem on the 30th.
entries.new: ……{w}我有个想法。{w}电脑被清理过，说明他们显然在塔里准备着什么。不过那场正在筹备的活动，我们早就拿到了情报。如果要动手，赶在他们 30 号真正取回宝石之前，也许是个好时机。
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: What? That would be disastrous.{w} Did you not listen to Ido? He was told they're handling the situation extremely carefully. And he was told about a few key details.{w} Ashiya are hunting for a spy. If we take advantage of the information Ido was given, we're handing them his identity.
entries.new: 什么？那会闯下大祸。{w}你没听 Ido 说吗？对方告诉过他，这件事他们处理得极为谨慎，还透了几处关键细节。{w}芦屋正在清查内鬼。我们要是利用 Ido 得到的情报，就等于把他的身份拱手送出去。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: ...{w}You're right. That's a bad idea.
entries.new: ……{w}你说得对。这主意不妥。
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: ...{w}You can leave now. I'll think about this.
entries.new: ……{w}你先出去吧。这件事我再想想。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: Yes.
entries.new: 是。
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: Atase gave his boss a slow nod and walked out of the room.
entries.new: Atase 缓缓点头，走出了房间。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Why were you told this?
entries.new: 为什么要告诉你这些？
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: I don't know. I think he was venting, honestly. I've worked there since years before the first attack, so I believe I'm considered trustworthy. We had a brief conversation this morning.
entries.new: 我不知道。老实说，我觉得他只是在发牢骚。第一次袭击的好几年前我就在那里做事了，大概因此才被当成信得过的人。今天早上我们聊了几句。
entries.speaker: ido

entries.text: I see.
entries.new: 原来如此。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: Thank you for letting us know immediately, and do so again in the future.{w} You may go now.
entries.new: 多谢你立刻来告知，今后也照这样办。{w}你可以走了。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: ...Yes.
entries.speaker: ido

entries.text: Katei's heart rapidly pounded his chest. He had landed his first hit.
entries.new: Katei 的心脏在胸腔里狂跳。他的第一击得手了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Ido was part of Xyn, and Ashiya's bait had sunk into their pond. Shaking, Katei combed through the rest of the recording, but it didn't contain anything else of relevance.
entries.new: Ido 是 Xyn 的人，芦屋抛下的诱饵已经沉进了他们的水塘。Katei 双手发颤，把余下的录音逐一听完，却再没发现任何有用的内容。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The door to the security room opened.
entries.new: 监控室的门开了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: We have made the primary announcement of the Sekimeiya. We won't have it until tomorrow, but there's no way an issue will come up with Gan.
entries.new: Sekimeiya 的初步公告已经发出。宝石要到明天才能到手，不过 Gan 那边不会出问题。
entries.speaker: lei

entries.text: That's good. We have to build it up as early as possible, and we always announce the events well in advance.
entries.new: 很好。造势要越早开始越好，我们的活动一向都提前很久公布。
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: Jiro had called Atase again. When he stepped into the room, he was gestured to sit in front of the table.
entries.new: Jiro 又把 Atase 叫了过来。他刚进门，就被示意坐到桌前。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Have you heard about it?
entries.new: 你听说了吗？
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: Ashiya's announcement?
entries.new: 芦屋的公告？
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: Yes. They have revealed the existence of the Sekimeiya, and the details match what Ido was told.{w} I think your idea is now worth considering.
entries.new: 对。他们公开了 Sekimeiya 的存在，细节与 Ido 听到的完全吻合。{w}我看你那个主意，现在值得考虑了。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: Right. Now that the information is out, we won't be linked to Ido.
entries.new: 嗯。情报既然已经公开，就不会牵连到 Ido 了。
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: They think we'll attack the tower as usual. As you said, they cleaned up their computer, so what they're preparing has to entail the building.{w} We know Ashiya will obtain the Sekimeiya tomorrow, but we could've investigated for this information after the announcement.
entries.new: 他们认为我们会照旧袭击那座塔。正如你所说，他们清理了电脑，那么他们准备的事必然与这栋楼有关。{w}芦屋明天就会拿到 Sekimeiya，其实这些信息，等公告出来后再查也能查到。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: And we still need to do that. We don't know where the Sekimeiya currently is or what it looks like.
entries.new: 而且我们本来也得去查。Sekimeiya 现在在哪里、长什么样子，我们都还不知道。
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: No. We know enough.
entries.new: 不。我们知道的已经够多了。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: Ashiya said they will pick it up tomorrow as opposed to having it brought. We know that means the source is established and from Yushibana. It was found on the 27th, so that Ashiya will already have it tomorrow confirms it's currently here.{w} There are a few established points in contact with Ashiya, but not many. There are a couple of amateur collectors that try to sell all their findings to them. If it was found on the 27th and Ashiya already knew they would obtain it yesterday, it's likely they were immediately called about it in hopes they'd buy it.{w} The 27th is a Sunday, the day Gan closes his shop to go to the caves. It's highly possible it was him who found it. It was also given a name before Ashiya obtained it, which is something he has done in the past.
entries.new: 芦屋那边说，明天会自己来取，而不是让我们送过去。这就说明货源已经确定，而且出自丰花。东西是27号被发现的，芦屋明天就能拿到手，可见它眼下就在这里。{w} 与芦屋有往来的固定卖家不多，只有几位业余收藏家，挖到什么都会想卖给他们。如果东西是27号发现的，而芦屋昨天就已经知道能拿到，那多半是有人发现后立刻打电话通知，指望他们买下。{w} 27号是周日，正是 Gan 关店去山洞的日子。发现它的人极有可能就是他。而且这东西在芦屋拿到之前就已经有了名字——这种事他以前也干过。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: ...I understand. We don't know how it looks, though.{w} Should Ido try to obtain that information?
entries.new: ……我明白了。不过，我们还不知道它长什么样。{w} 要不要让 Ido 去打听一下？
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: I don't think so.
entries.new: 我看不必。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: Jiro took a cellphone out of a drawer.
entries.new: Jiro 从抽屉里取出一部手机。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Let's try this.
entries.new: 那就试试这个办法。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: With a serious expression, Jiro dialed a number and put the cellphone close to his ear.
entries.new: Jiro 神情严肃，拨通一个号码，把手机贴到耳边。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Yes?
entries.new: 喂？
entries.speaker: gan2

entries.text: Am I calling Musashi Gemstones?
entries.new: 请问是武藏宝石吗？
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: You are.
entries.new: 是的。
entries.speaker: gan2

entries.text: Glad to speak with you. I'm Zane, from Ashiya.{w} I'm calling you to confirm that I'll come tomorrow at {time=14.}
entries.new: 很高兴和你通话。我是芦屋的 Zane。{w} 打电话来是想确认一下，我明天 {time=14.} 过去。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: ...{time=14}? I was told it'd be at {time=21.}
entries.new: ……{time=14}？我听到的说法是 {time=21.}。
entries.speaker: gan2

entries.text: ...Oh,{w} really?{w} My mistake, I was looking at the wrong page.{w} You're right, it'll be at {time=21.} Is that still all right?
entries.new: ……啊，{w}是吗？{w} 抱歉，是我看错了页面。{w} 你说得对，是 {time=21.}。这样安排还方便吗？
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: Yes, I'll be here.
entries.new: 方便，我会在店里。
entries.speaker: gan2

entries.text: Perfect. That was all, then.
entries.new: 那就好。没有别的事了。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: I'll see you.
entries.new: 到时候见。
entries.speaker: gan2

entries.text: Goodbye.
entries.new: 再见。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: It appears you have a new job tomorrow.
entries.new: 看来你明天有新任务了。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: The plan was simple.{w} Atase had to pass himself off as an Ashiya member. In order to not be easily recognizable in the future, his figure had to be slightly disguised, and he knew how to change his voice.
entries.new: 计划很简单。{w} Atase 要冒充芦屋的人。为了以后不容易被认出来，他的外形得稍微伪装一下；声音方面，他也有办法改变。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: On November 30th, snow began to fall. Xyn had been preparing their move, and Ashiya did the same.
entries.new: 11月30日，雪开始飘落。Xyn 一直在为行动做准备，芦屋那边也一样。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Minutes before {time=21}, a car parked outside Musashi Gemstones. Atase emerged from inside it, wearing a long coat.{w} Stepping into the snow, he approached the bright window, leaving the prints of a new pair of shoes behind.
entries.new: {time=21} 前几分钟，一辆车停在武藏宝石门外。Atase 穿着长外套，从车里下来。{w} 他踏进雪中，朝那扇明亮的橱窗走去，身后留下一串新鞋的脚印。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He wasn't even close to calm. If Gan had told Ashiya about the call he'd received, they might've been waiting for Xyn's arrival.
entries.new: 他一点也不镇定。如果 Gan 把接到的那通电话告诉了芦屋，对方可能早已在等着 Xyn 上门。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Slowly, he pushed open the door, a wave of warm air hitting his guarded face.
entries.new: 他缓缓推开门，一股暖风扑面而来，拂过他戒备的脸。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Inside the shop, he saw a young man near the entrance, who only glanced at him emptily. Avoiding eye contact, Atase stared behind his shoulders.{w} Gan rushed over to the door after hearing the sound.
entries.new: 店里靠近门口的地方有个年轻人，只淡淡地瞥了他一眼。Atase 避开视线，把目光投向那人身后。{w} Gan 听到动静，匆匆赶到门边。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Hello. I'm sorry for coming earlier than arranged.
entries.new: 你好。抱歉，比约定的时间早到了。
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: No, don't worry! I'm happy to see you.
entries.new: 哪里的话，不妨事！见到你我很高兴。
entries.speaker: gan

entries.text: Gan's face shaped into a big smile. Then, he brought Atase to the reception desk.
entries.new: Gan 脸上堆起大大的笑容，随后把 Atase 领到接待台前。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: I'd like to see the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 我想看看那件 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: Yes. I have prepared everything. Wait here.
entries.new: 好。都准备好了。请你稍等。
entries.speaker: gan

entries.text: Gan walked away and shortly came back. He held a small, brown box between his hands and handed it over to Atase. During the time it couldn't be in the cold, he had made sure the Sekimeiya's temperature wouldn't go through the box.
entries.new: Gan 走开片刻便回来了，双手捧着一只棕色的小盒子，递给 Atase。这东西不能受冻，他事先已经设法让 Sekimeiya 的温度不会从盒子里散掉。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: I'm not done, give me a moment. Oh, and you're aware of what I discussed with Lei, right? The price will be double the usual.
entries.new: 我还没弄完，稍等一下。对了，我和 Lei 谈过的事，你知道吧？价钱会是平常的两倍。
entries.speaker: gan

entries.text: Surprisingly, Gan walked away again. As he did, Atase peeked into the box and saw an egg-shaped stone, glowing faintly. That must have been the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 没想到 Gan 又走开了。趁这工夫，Atase 往盒里瞥了一眼，看见一块蛋形的石头，泛着微弱的光。那想必就是 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: That was his time—he had it.{w} As he'd discussed with his boss, Gan had to be paid before leaving, so Atase couldn't simply step out of the shop. If he ran away, Gan would try to chase him and would immediately call Ashiya and the police, and it was possible he'd see their car. Atase slowly took something out of his large pocket.
entries.new: 这就是机会——东西已经到手。{w} 按他和上司说好的，离开前必须先付钱，所以 Atase 不能就这么走出店门。要是他跑了，Gan 会追出来，还会立刻通知芦屋和警察，说不定还会看见他们的车。Atase 慢慢从大衣口袋里取出一样东西。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: A grenade that would rapidly disperse smoke through the shop, knocking out everyone who inhaled it.
entries.new: 那是一枚烟雾弹，能在店里迅速散开浓烟，让吸入的人当场昏倒。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: As soon as he activated it, he dashed to the door, colliding with the light falling snow. A curtain blocked the view through the window, so no one could see what had happened from outside.
entries.new: 他一拉响，便冲向门口，一头撞进飘落的细雪里。橱窗被遮布挡着，外面的人看不到店里发生了什么。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Without slowing down, Atase ran to the car. He had seen the immense cloud of smoke appearing before his eyes, and Gan had been farther into the room. There was no way he'd avoided being knocked unconscious.
entries.new: Atase 没有放慢脚步，直奔汽车。他亲眼看见浓烟在眼前涌起，而 Gan 站的位置更靠里。那人不可能没被熏倒。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Faiten, another member of Xyn, had opened the car door. Atase rapidly stepped in and hurried to close it.
entries.new: Xyn 的另一名成员 Faiten 已经打开了车门。Atase 迅速钻进车里，急忙把门关上。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Go! I'm pretty sure he was hit, but Ashiya could come at any time!
entries.new: 走！他应该中招了，但芦屋的人随时可能到！
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: Faiten accelerated as fast as he could. The vehicle took off at a speed far beyond the legal limit, almost running over an old man past the first turn.
entries.new: Faiten 全力加速。车子以远超限速的速度冲了出去，转过第一个弯时险些撞上一位老人。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: At the appointed time, Lei gripped the handle of the door, ahead of a notary from Ashiya.
entries.new: 约定的时间到了，Lei 握住门把手，身后跟着芦屋派来的公证人。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: When she laid eyes inside the shop, a thin darkness hindered her sight.{w} Confused, she placed a finger on the light switch next to the door, but that turned off all remaining light.{w} Immediately, she flipped it back.
entries.new: 她朝店里望去，视线被一层薄薄的黑暗挡住了。{w} 她有些困惑，伸手按向门旁的电灯开关，却把仅剩的光也关掉了。{w} 她立刻又按了回去。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Both she and the notary were taken aback by the loud noise.
entries.new: 一声巨响，她和公证人都吓了一跳。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Astonished, they looked through the door and saw that the opposite part of the shop had disappeared. Their hearts almost stopped when they saw blood and human flesh on the edges of the hole.
entries.new: 两人惊愕地朝门里看去，只见店铺的另一侧已经不见了。看到洞口边缘的血迹和血肉，他们的心脏几乎停跳。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: It had been Xyn. As Lei stared at the scene, she found no other option.{w} They had never taken their attacks to such an extent before, but she knew they were responsible.{w} How? How had they learned about the time and place of the Sekimeiya's tradeoff? Had her phone been hijacked?
entries.new: 是 Xyn 干的。Lei 盯着眼前的景象，想不出别的可能。{w} 他们以前从没把袭击闹到这种地步，但她知道是他们干的。{w} 可他们是怎么知道的？怎么会知道 Sekimeiya 交易的时间和地点？她的手机被人动了手脚吗？
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: On the floor were Gan and a boy she didn't know. However, someone else had been farther ahead. ...Someone had just died, and she couldn't fathom it.
entries.new: 地上躺着 Gan 和一个她不认识的少年。可还有一个人倒在更里面。……刚刚有人死了，她怎么也接受不了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: ...Are you two okay?
entries.new: ……你们两个没事吧？
entries.speaker: nn

entries.text: The man beside Lei began to shake both bodies.{w} Soon, Gan, who had inhaled a lesser amount of the smoke thanks to the shelves, opened his eyes, obstructing the blood from flowing down.{w} In disbelief, he told Lei about what had happened, stuttering as he stared at the broken floor.
entries.new: Lei 身旁的男人开始摇晃地上的两人。{w} 没过多久，Gan 睁开了眼睛——多亏有货架挡着，他吸入的烟较少——血也没再往下淌。{w} 他难以置信地把发生的事讲给 Lei 听，一边盯着破碎的地板，一边结结巴巴地说着。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: While an ambulance was being called, Lei's phone was also by her ear, linked to the police.
entries.new: 有人叫救护车的同时，Lei 也把手机贴在耳边，和警察通着电话。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: I'm telling you they just escaped! They're in a vehicle—I see their tire marks outside the shop!{w} They must be found immediately! They just stole an incredibly valuable gemstone!
entries.new: 我说了，他们刚跑掉！他们开着车——店外还有轮胎印！{w} 必须马上找到他们！他们刚抢走了一颗极其贵重的宝石！
entries.speaker: lei

entries.text: When the boy woke up, he stood in a daze. Then, staggering forward, he stared at the back of the shop with desperate eyes.
entries.new: 男孩醒来后，怔怔地站在原地。随后他踉跄着向前，用近乎绝望的目光望向店铺深处。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Wh-Where are the two girls that were here?
entries.new: 那、那两个女孩呢？
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: There was silence. Nobody knew the answer, but they didn't think they could have spoken even if they had.
entries.new: 一片沉默。没人知道答案；就算知道，他们也不觉得自己说得出口。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: It went well. We're on the way.
entries.new: 「很顺利。我们正在路上。」
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: Faiten and Atase were driving away. Just in case, they couldn't go straight to their boss.
entries.new: Faiten 和 Atase 驱车离开。为防万一，他们不能直接去见老板。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The dim streets of Yushibana were empty, but the snow prevented them from going as fast as they wanted to. They had to be careful not to let the wheel marks show their destination.{w} When he had calmed down, Atase lifted the box's lid.
entries.new: 丰花昏暗的街道上空无一人，积雪却让他们没法把车开得像预想中那么快。他们得小心，别让车轮印暴露目的地。{w} 等心绪平复下来，Atase 掀开了盒盖。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He saw one of the Sekimeiya. It had to be what Ashiya had announced, as Atase had never seen a gemstone like it.
entries.new: 他看见了其中一颗 Sekimeiya。那应该就是芦屋公布过的那颗——Atase 从未见过这样的宝石。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Out of the blue, they heard a siren behind them.{w} Through the rearview mirror, they could see a police car approaching.
entries.new: 冷不丁，身后传来警笛声。{w} 他们从后视镜里看见一辆警车正逼近。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Wh-What!?{w} Stop! Don't keep going!
entries.new: 「什、什么！？{w} 停车！别再开了！」
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: Pale, Faiten pulled over to the right. He couldn't muster a word—he slowly looked at the box on Atase's lap.{w} Had Ashiya set a trap for them?
entries.new: Faiten 脸色发白，把车靠向右侧。他一句话也说不出来，只是缓缓看向 Atase 膝上的盒子。{w} 是芦屋设下的圈套吗？
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: ...Don't tell me there's a tracker in that box.
entries.new: 「……别告诉我那盒子里装了追踪器。」
entries.speaker: nn

entries.text: What? No, I didn't see anything.
entries.new: 「什么？没有，我什么也没看到。」
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: A police officer knocked on their door, demanding they open it.
entries.new: 一名警察敲了敲车门，命令他们把门打开。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: What's the problem?
entries.new: 「有什么问题吗？」
entries.speaker: nn

entries.text: We were notified your vehicle almost ran over someone at Maura. Two people saw you going at a much faster speed than the limit allowed.
entries.new: 「我们接到通报，说你们的车在莫拉差点撞到人。有两个人看见你们的速度远远超过限速。」
entries.speaker: nn

entries.text: ...Oh, is that so? Sorry, I don't remember how fast I was going.
entries.new: 「……哦，是吗？抱歉，我不记得自己当时开得多快。」
entries.speaker: nn

entries.text: The officer paused as he smelled the air.{w} ...Inside the vehicle, both men frowned. What was he doing?
entries.new: 警察忽然停住，嗅了嗅空气。{w}……车内，两个男人都皱起了眉。他在做什么？
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Hand me your license, please.
entries.new: 「请把驾照给我。」
entries.speaker: nn

entries.text: Faiten took out a few documents from the glove compartment and handed them to the officer.
entries.new: Faiten 从手套箱里取出几份证件，递给警察。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Step out of the vehicle.
entries.new: 「下车。」
entries.speaker: nn

entries.text: S-Sure.
entries.new: 「好、好的。」
entries.speaker: nn

entries.text: ...This is a screening device. Please take a breath test.
entries.new: 「……这是检测仪。请对着它吹一口气。」
entries.speaker: nn

entries.text: After a minute, the officer looked at the result.{w} It said "zero".
entries.new: 一分钟后，警察看了看结果。{w} 上面显示「零」。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: There are no traces of alcohol on you.
entries.new: 「你身上没有酒精反应。」
entries.speaker: nn

entries.text: Of course. I would never drink before driving.
entries.new: 「当然。我开车前从不喝酒。」
entries.speaker: nn

entries.text: ...{w}You can get back in the vehicle.{w} Please, make sure you don't drive over the speed limit.
entries.new: 「……{w}你可以回车里了。{w} 请务必不要超速。」
entries.speaker: nn

entries.text: Yes, I'm sorry. If I went over it, I promise that I didn't notice.
entries.new: 「好的，抱歉。要是我超速了，我保证自己当时真没察觉。」
entries.speaker: nn

entries.text: Faiten stepped into the car. As he did so, the officer received a radio call.{w} Trying to hide his haste, Faiten asked if he could get going.
entries.new: Faiten 坐回车里。就在这时，警察接到了无线电呼叫。{w} Faiten 竭力掩饰急切，问他能不能走了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: With his hand, the officer indicated to hold off.
entries.new: 警察抬手示意他稍等。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Suddenly, the officer's look changed.{w} Both men noticed he was staring at the brown box.{w} Then, the officer saw something else. On Atase's attire, there was an Ashiya logo.
entries.new: 忽然，警察的神色变了。{w} 两人都注意到，他正盯着那个棕色盒子。{w} 紧接着，警察又发现 Atase 的衣服上印着芦屋的标志。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: What's in that box?
entries.new: 「那盒子里装的是什么？」
entries.speaker: nn

entries.text: In this one? A present for my girl.
entries.new: 「这个？给我女朋友的礼物。」
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: Give it to me.
entries.new: 「把它给我。」
entries.speaker: nn
