entries.text: ...Should I? It's snowing, and I wouldn't like it to get dirty.
entries.new: 「……有这个必要吗？外面正下着雪，我可不想把它弄脏。」
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: Please give me that box.
entries.new: 「请把那个盒子给我。」
entries.speaker: nn

entries.text: Slowly, Faiten took it and handed it to the officer.{w} He lifted the lid, and his eyes didn't waver.
entries.new: Faiten 缓缓拿起盒子，递给警察。{w} 警察掀开盒盖，目光没有丝毫动摇。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Both of you step out of the vehicle.
entries.new: 「你们两个都下车。」
entries.speaker: nn

entries.text: Faiten and Atase looked at each other. Then, after a pause, Faiten extricated his lower body from below the dashboard.{w} The officer never expected the car to accelerate as he did.{w} It was Atase's foot that pressed down the accelerator. Immediately, the officer ran to his car as he yelled for them to stop.
entries.new: Faiten 和 Atase 对视一眼。停顿片刻后，Faiten 把腿从仪表盘下方抽了出来。{w} 警察完全没料到车子会突然加速。{w} 是 Atase 踩下了油门。警察立刻奔向自己的车，一边大喊让他们停车。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Later into the night, a handful of men were in Musashi Gemstones.{w} Everyone had been ordered to leave, and the scene had been preserved as well as possible.
entries.new: 夜深之后，武藏宝石店里还留着几个人。{w} 所有人都被命令离开，现场也尽可能保持原样。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Atsuki Hakutoki and Gan had been sent to the hospital. Their physical condition was fine, but they'd have to spend the night there.
entries.new: Atsuki Hakutoki 和 Gan 已被送往医院。两人身体没有大碍，但得在医院过一夜。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Under the shop was a channel sheltered from the icy air. There had been two more people inside at the time of the explosion. One of them had fallen through the floor, whereas the other had died on the spot.
entries.new: 店铺底下有一条通道，寒气侵不进去。爆炸发生时，里面还有两个人。其中一人从塌陷的地板坠落下去，另一人则当场死亡。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Shiroya Mirana had hit her head after falling from high up and entered a coma. As soon as the paramedics had reached that place, she had been taken to the hospital too.{w} A few people were scattered around where her body had fallen.
entries.new: Shiroya Mirana 从高处摔下时撞到了头，陷入昏迷。急救人员赶到后，她也被送往医院。{w} 在她坠落的位置周围，零散地站着几个人。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The forensic team. They were investigating the scene and had confirmed that the missing girl, Miiya Moiromo, had died.
entries.new: 是鉴识小组。他们正在勘查现场，并已确认失踪的女孩 Miiya Moiromo 已经死亡。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Something else had fallen with the rubble. An open box, identical to the one Atase had received.{w} Its lid had burst open on impact, and its contents had rolled away. A handful of people had seen the shining, egg-shaped stone within the darkness, but nobody had been allowed to touch anything. Its faint shine highlighted the drop of blood that had arced across its surface.
entries.new: 还有一样东西和瓦砾一同坠落——一只盒子，和 Atase 收到的那只一模一样。{w} 盒盖在撞击中弹开，里面的东西滚了出去。有几个人在黑暗中看见了那颗发亮的蛋形石头，但谁都不准碰任何东西。它幽微的光映照着溅在表面的一道血痕。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: When a woman from the forensic team felt the gem for the first time, she was taken aback. ...It was very hot.{w} Ashiya had quickly learned that only one of the Sekimeiya had been taken and asked the investigation team to return the fallen one. However, as it was related to the incident, it had to be inspected by them first.
entries.new: 鉴识小组的一名女成员第一次摸到那颗宝石时，吃了一惊。……它烫得厉害。{w}芦屋很快得知只有一颗 Sekimeiya 被拿走，便要求调查组归还掉落的那颗。可由于它与案件有关，必须先由调查组检查。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The woman grabbed the box and shut it inside. Then, gripping a flashlight with her tight latex gloves, she kept searching around the place.
entries.new: 女人拿起盒子，把宝石关在了里面。随后，她戴着紧贴双手的乳胶手套握住手电筒，继续在原地搜寻。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: When midnight hit, it was December.
entries.new: 午夜降临时，已经是十二月了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Katei's night shift had begun. Before entering the security room, he had spoken to Lei.
entries.new: Katei 的夜班开始了。进监控室之前，他先和 Lei 说了几句话。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Xyn had attacked the gem shop. However, for the first time, their plan had failed due to external factors; the Sekimeiya would be returned to Ashiya.
entries.new: Xyn 袭击了宝石店。然而这一次，他们的计划头一回因为外部因素而落了空；Sekimeiya 即将被送回芦屋。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: How had Xyn learned about the location? Katei didn't know, but it didn't matter.{w} The preparations for his plan had been completed, so he needed Xyn to attack again. It wasn't in Ashiya's interests to pursue the attack of the 30th any further. As if nothing had happened, the Sekimeiya plan needed to continue as devised.
entries.new: Xyn是怎么查到那个地点的？Katei不得而知，但这已无关紧要。{w}他计划的准备工作已经就绪，所以他需要Xyn再动一次手。继续追查30日那起袭击，对芦屋没有好处。Sekimeiya计划必须装作什么都没发生过，照原定方案推进下去。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: When the stillness had gone on for a while, Katei listened to the latest recording.{w} Nothing related to Xyn was there. Since Ido had told them about the Sekimeiya, the recordings had been nothing but uneventful.
entries.new: 静默持续了一阵，Katei听起了最新的录音。{w}里面没有半点与Xyn相关的内容。自从Ido向他们提起Sekimeiya，录音就一直平淡无事。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The SD card behind the device had been swapped out. If the device was ever found in the tower, Katei didn't want the information he had to be revealed; he needed it for himself.{w} It was a small card that wouldn't be questioned, so he could easily leave the building with it. After listening to Xyn's brief meeting, he had saved the recording on his own computer, inserting a new, empty card in the recording device.
entries.new: 装置背面的SD卡已经换过了。万一这装置在塔里被人发现，Katei不希望自己掌握的情报暴露出去；那份情报他还有用。{w}那不过是张小卡，不会有人起疑，他能轻易带着它离开大楼。听完Xyn那段简短的会面后，他把录音存进了自己的电脑，再往录音装置里换上一张空白的卡。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: At home, Lei hadn't calmed down yet. A young girl had died in Musashi Gemstones, and she'd learned the initial details.
entries.new: 在家里，Lei还没能平静下来。武藏宝石有个小女孩死了，初步情况她已经听说了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Xyn had impersonated Ashiya. Yet again, they had possessed confidential information to carry out their plan.
entries.new: Xyn冒充了芦屋的人。他们又一次掌握了机密情报，才得以实施计划。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: However, they hadn't known about the second Sekimeiya. After being given one, they had released a potent gas in the small shop which had put everyone to sleep.
entries.new: 可他们并不知道还有第二枚Sekimeiya。拿到其中一枚后，他们在小店里放出了强效气体，把所有人都放倒了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The girl's death hadn't been part of Xyn's plan. It had been the result of a common domestic accident, but Xyn had made it possible.
entries.new: 女孩的死并不在Xyn的计划之中。那本是寻常的家庭意外，却因为Xyn才会发生。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The Sekimeiya Xyn had stolen was being brought back to Ashiya, but the other one, which had fallen through the shop's floor, had been taken by the forensics. Lei had insisted that it be returned and kept cold; Gan had warned her about the temperature, but she had been told she would have to wait 36 hours.
entries.new: Xyn偷走的那枚Sekimeiya正被送回芦屋，可另一枚从店内地板掉下去的，已被鉴证人员取走。Lei坚持要把它取回并冷藏保存；Gan提醒过她温度的问题，但对方告诉她必须等上36个小时。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: You fucked up badly.
entries.new: 你们捅的篓子可不小。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: Atase and Faiten had explained the events to his boss. They'd managed to slip away and safely arrived at the meeting place.
entries.new: Atase和Faiten已经向老板说明了经过。他们设法脱身，平安抵达了会合地点。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Jiro looked stern. He wasn't a man to grow uncontrollably angry, but his eyes showed how displeased he was.
entries.new: Jiro神情严峻。他不是那种会任由怒火失控的人，但眼里已写满了不快。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Are you convinced you won't be tracked here?
entries.new: 你确定他们不会追到这里来？
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: Absolutely.{w} The car is parked quite a ways away, but the police will find it soon. We have to give it up.
entries.new: 确定。{w}车停在很远的地方，但警察很快就能找到。那辆车只能放弃了。
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: ...{w}Have you learned what happened?
entries.new: ……{w}出的事，你们听说了吗？
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: Wh-What do you mean?
entries.new: 什、什么事？
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: Someone died in Musashi. There was a gas explosion after you left.
entries.new: 武藏死了人。你们走后，那里发生了燃气爆炸。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: Both lackeys looked at each other, lost for words.
entries.new: 两个手下面面相觑，说不出话来。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: I-It can't be. We didn't do anything.
entries.new: 不、不可能。我们什么都没做。
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: Watch the news tomorrow. You knocked everyone out, so no one noticed the heater was busted and leaking gas. When Ashiya entered, there was an explosion. You killed a civilian. Someone else was sent to the hospital in a coma.
entries.new: 明天看看新闻吧。你们把所有人都弄晕了，所以没人发现取暖器坏了，正在漏气。芦屋的人一进门，就炸了。你们害死了一个平民。还有一个人昏迷住院。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: Do you understand? This is a major fuck up. Xyn does {i}not{/} get involved in murder cases.
entries.new: 听明白了吗？这次篓子捅大了。Xyn{i}绝不{/i}沾命案。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: ...That wasn't our fault, though. We did as planned.
entries.new: ……可那不是我们的错。我们都是按计划行事的。
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: You're right. All you did was draw the police to you and lose the Sekimeiya. You both should've been arrested, but now you're going to land us all in hot water.
entries.new: 说得对。你们做的，不过是把警察引到自己身上，再把Sekimeiya弄丢。你们俩本该被抓进去，可现在你们要把我们全都拖下水。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: ...{w}I don't think I'll be recognized.
entries.new: ……{w}我想不会有人认出我吧。
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: Atase, shut up. You might be done for already.
entries.new: Atase，闭嘴。你也许已经完了。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: What...?
entries.new: 什么……？
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: I'm going to ask you the same thing I did once already. Did everything truly go as planned on the 24th?
entries.new: 有件事我之前已经问过你了，现在再问一遍。24号那天，一切真的都按计划进行吗？
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: Y-Yes. Why are you asking this again?
entries.new: 是、是的。为什么又问这个？
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: That afternoon, an unidentified person escaped from a prison cell. I was later called and told that you were seen near that place, wearing the same clothes as them.
entries.new: 那天下午，有个身份不明的人从牢房里逃了出来。后来有人打电话给我，说你被人看到在那附近，穿的衣服和那人一样。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: Wait, what!? That wasn't me! I was in the tower at that time!
entries.new: 等等，什么！？那不是我！那会儿我正在塔里！
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: You say that, but we erased those records.{w} I don't know what the fuck is going on with you, but what just happened isn't acceptable. Now you're being hunted for causing a death, and the police pulled you over. Both of you are basically sacrificial lambs at this point.
entries.new: 你嘴上这么说，可那些记录已经被我们抹掉了。{w}我不知道你身上到底出了什么鬼名堂，但刚发生的事没法交代。现在你因为闹出人命被追捕，警察还拦了你们的车。到这一步，你们两个基本上就是弃子。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: Atase couldn't believe what he was hearing. He'd been part of Xyn for many years, and he'd never been told something like that.
entries.new: Atase不敢相信自己的耳朵。他在Xyn里待了这么多年，从没被人这样说过。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: ...Then what should we do?
entries.new: ……那我们该怎么办？
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: You have to be quiet. Wait, and when you're arrested, you stay quiet.
entries.new: 你们要闭嘴。等着，被抓了也闭嘴。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: Come on, we won't say anything, but isn't there something you can do?
entries.new: 别这样，我们什么都不会说，可你就不能想想办法吗？
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: Something I can do? What do you want, to go live in a different country?
entries.new: 想办法？你们想怎样，跑到国外去生活吗？
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: Why would I help you two? You allowed our first failure against Ashiya. I'm not sticking my neck out here. Anything involving you from now on will be exceptionally problematic.
entries.new: 我凭什么帮你们？对芦屋的第一次失手，就是你们造成的。我不会替你们冒险。从今往后，跟你们沾边的任何事都会麻烦得要命。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: ...What about the Sekimeiya?
entries.new: ……那Sekimeiya呢？
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: What about it?
entries.new: 那又怎样？
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: Are we... gonna do anything else about it?
entries.new: 我们……还要再做些什么吗？
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: Jiro didn't have an immediate answer for that question.
entries.new: Jiro一时答不上来。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Did you see it?
entries.new: 你见到它了？
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: I did. I was surprised by how it looked.{w} It honestly looks like an egg made of marble, and I think it was shining a little.
entries.new: 见到了。它的样子让我吃了一惊。{w}说实话，看着就像一颗大理石做的蛋，好像还微微发着光。
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: ...An egg? How big was it?
entries.new: ……蛋？多大？
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: A bit more than the length of this finger, I'd say.
entries.new: 大概比这根手指再长一点。
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: Jiro was pensive for a while. His plan had been so close to working, but he couldn't blindly throw out a new move.
entries.new: Jiro沉思了片刻。他的计划曾那么接近成功，可眼下不能盲目再落一子。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Go home for now.{w} Atase, I want you here tomorrow at {time=14.}
entries.new: 先回家去吧。{w}Atase，明天{time=14.}我要在这里见到你。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: ...Okay. I'll be here.
entries.new: ……好。我就在这儿等着。
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: Both men knew not to push the issue, so they slowly stepped out of the room.
entries.new: 两人都明白不该再追问下去，便缓缓退出了房间。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Atase got home late into the night. He'd lived alone for years, so he had nobody to wake up.{w} The first thing he did was look up the recent news.
entries.new: Atase 回到家时已是深夜。他独居多年，不必担心吵醒谁。{w}他做的第一件事，就是查看最近的新闻。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: As he'd been told, he came across an article from the 24th of November. Someone had escaped from a prison cell, but the story was enigmatic.{w} It hadn't been him; as he'd said, he had been in Ashiya Tower at the time. However, he couldn't help but feel that the man in the attached picture did strangely resemble him.
entries.new: 他像别人说的那样，找到了一篇11月24日的报道。有人从牢房里逃了出来，但报道写得语焉不详。{w}那并不是他；正如他所说，当时他人在芦屋塔。然而，他不由得觉得，报道所附照片里的那个男人，确实与他莫名地相像。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: When the sun rose, Atase still hadn't managed to fall asleep.
entries.new: 直到太阳升起，Atase 始终没能睡着。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The latest news was posted online, and he didn't have to search for what he wanted. The highlighted article said: "Twenty-year-old girl dies by gas explosion in Yushibana".
entries.new: 最新消息已经发布到网上，他想找的内容根本不用费心去搜。首页醒目的那篇报道写着：「丰花一名二十岁少女死于煤气爆炸」。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: His eyes locked onto the headline painfully, and he was unable to clear his suddenly clogged throat. It was the first time his actions had killed someone.{w} When he read that two friends of the girl had been there, a cold hollow expanded within his chest. He vividly remembered how he'd received the death of a close friend of his years ago. It hadn't been his intention, but he had created that pain for someone else, and a friend of the girl he'd killed was in grave danger as well.{w} It was the last thing he'd ever wanted to happen. However, his mind kept going to what his boss had said. It was true—his situation was volatile.
entries.new: 他的目光痛苦地钉在那行标题上，骤然堵住的喉咙怎么也清不开。这是他第一次因自己的行动害死了人。{w}读到少女的两位朋友当时也在场，一股冰冷的空洞在他胸腔里扩散开来。他清楚地记得，多年前得知挚友死讯时，自己是什么感受。他并非有意，却让别人承受了同样的痛楚；而他害死的那个少女的朋友，如今也身陷险境。{w}这是他最不愿发生的事。可是，他脑中反复响起上司说过的话。的确——他的处境随时可能生变。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He frowned as he finished reading the article.{w} He went over it again to confirm he hadn't been mistaken, but there was no mention of Xyn or their plan.
entries.new: 读完报道，他皱起了眉。{w}他又从头看了一遍，确认自己没有看错，可文中只字未提 Xyn，也没提到他们的计划。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Why...? There was no way Ashiya didn't think Xyn had been behind it. However, they hadn't been mentioned, nor had the Sekimeiya...
entries.new: 为什么……？芦屋不可能想不到是 Xyn 干的。可是报道里既没有提到他们，也没有提到 Sekimeiya……
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Initial Singularity
entries.new: 初始奇点

entries.text: The appointed time came. Atase had been able to get a bit of sleep, and he sat in front of his boss after a silent nod.
entries.new: 约定的时间到了。Atase 总算睡了一会儿，他沉默地点了下头，坐到上司对面。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: We're going to wait for Ido to come. He'll be here soon.
entries.new: 我们等 Ido 过来。他马上就到。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: All right.
entries.new: 好。
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: Ashiya haven't stopped talking about this Sekimeiya, and it was found two days before its announcement. Like you said, they're doing something in the tower, I have no doubt—that's why our name wasn't on the news.
entries.new: 芦屋那边一直在议论这块 Sekimeiya，而它是在公布前两天才被发现的。正如你说的，他们肯定在塔里动了手脚，我毫不怀疑——所以我们才没上新闻。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: ...Yes, that's very likely. I also noticed that.
entries.new: ……嗯，很有可能。我也注意到了。
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: A surprising amount of people have echoed Ashiya. It appears the Sekimeiya event is gaining a lot of traction. There's been a great deal of interest in it.
entries.new: 附和芦屋说法的人多得惊人。看来 Sekimeiya 的活动声势越来越大，外界的兴趣相当浓厚。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: Do you remember what Ido was told? Katei Kuiji's information was real, and he said they're doing their best to catch us before the 15th. They were sending the Sekimeiya to the tower, expecting our attack before the event.
entries.new: 还记得 Ido 打听到的话吗？Katei Kuiji 的情报是真的，他说他们正竭尽全力要在15号之前抓住我们。他们把 Sekimeiya 送进塔里，就是料到我们会在活动之前动手。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: Right.
entries.new: 嗯。
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: There was a knock at the door.
entries.new: 门外传来敲门声。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: "Enter."{w} Ido stepped in, sensing the tense atmosphere. Then, he sat beside Atase.
entries.new: 「进来。」{w}Ido 推门而入，察觉到了屋内的紧张气氛，随后在 Atase 身旁坐下。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Did you get it?
entries.new: 拿到了吗？
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: ...Yes. I didn't think I would, but I have what you asked for.
entries.new: ……拿到了。我本来没抱希望，不过你要的东西我带来了。
entries.speaker: ido

entries.text: The tower's janitor put his hand in his pocket and slowly took out a rectangular piece of paper.{w} It was a photograph. He handed it to his boss, who stared at it intensely.
entries.new: 这位塔里的清洁工把手伸进口袋，缓缓取出一张长方形的纸。{w}那是一张照片。他把它递给上司，上司目不转睛地盯着它。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: You were right. It looks like an egg made of marble.
entries.new: 你说得没错。它看起来就像一颗大理石做的蛋。
entries.speaker: ido

entries.text: When he showed it to Atase, he saw the same gemstone that had been inside the box. It was shut behind glass, and the wall in the background was from inside the tower.
entries.new: 他把照片给 Atase 看，Atase 认出那正是曾装在盒子里的那块宝石。它被锁在玻璃后面，背景里的墙是塔里的。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Y-You took a picture of it? Isn't that risky as hell?
entries.new: 你、你拍了照片？这风险也太大了吧？
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: That's what I thought too, but it went well.
entries.new: 我也这么想，不过结果还算顺利。
entries.speaker: ido

entries.text: Xyn had figured out a way to sneak tiny devices into the tower. That was the reason they'd chosen Ido as their associate.{w} Staff members were frequently inspected upon arrival, especially after Xyn's first attacks. However, the janitor's job entailed the maintenance of the tower's plaza. By bringing the cleaning cart outside of the building and using a different Xyn member to drop the desired device in it, they had managed to slip a small camera into the tower.
entries.new: Xyn 摸索出了一套把微型装置带进塔里的办法。他们也正因此才选中 Ido 做内应。{w}员工每次进塔都要接受频繁的检查，Xyn 最初的几次袭击之后更是如此。不过清洁工的工作包括维护塔前的广场。他们先把清洁车推到楼外，再由另一名 Xyn 成员把需要的装置丢进车里，就这样把小巧的摄像头带进了塔。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: How did you do it, though?
entries.new: 可你是怎么做到的？
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: The Sekimeiya was brought to the event room, and it was inside a cabinet. I hoped it would be out of all the security cameras' sight at some point, but that wasn't the case.{w} I wanted to use the cart to cover my hands so that I wouldn't be seen taking the picture, but it was easier than that.{w} Entering the event room was forbidden to the public, but I stepped in to clean it. As soon as I did, Katei Kuiji entered too—his night shift was about to end. It was very fortunate because a long curtain covered the Sekimeiya. He asked if I was curious about it and offered to let me see it.
entries.new: Sekimeiya 被送进了活动室，放在展示柜里。我原本指望它总有某个时刻会落在所有监控摄像头的视野之外，可并没有。{w}我本想用清洁车挡住双手，好让人看不出我在拍照，但事情比这还容易。{w}活动室禁止公众进入，但我要进去打扫。我刚进去，Katei Kuiji 也跟着进来了——他的夜班快结束了。运气实在好，因为那里有长长的遮布遮着 Sekimeiya。他问我好不好奇，还说可以让我看看。
entries.speaker: ido

entries.text: ...{w}Is that so?{w} What did he say this time?
entries.new: ……{w}是这样吗？{w}他这次都说了些什么？
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: He seemed to want to make small talk. I believe he doesn't suspect me.{w} He had a key for the cabinet, and he said they'd only made one for the event so that Xyn wouldn't be able to unlock it.{w} He even used it to open the cabinet and let me touch the Sekimeiya. It was pretty smooth and felt like cold marble.{w} It was kept refrigerated because it can apparently get damaged otherwise. He didn't say much else of importance, but he kept reiterating that they're hard at work upgrading their security measures to catch us.
entries.new: 他似乎只是想闲聊几句。我看他并不怀疑我。{w}他有一把展示柜的钥匙，说为了这次活动只配了一把，好让 Xyn 打不开柜子。{w}他甚至用那把钥匙打开柜子，让我摸了摸 Sekimeiya。它相当光滑，摸起来像冰凉的大理石。{w}它一直冷藏保存，据说否则会受损。别的要紧话他没多说，只是一再强调他们正加紧升级安保措施，好抓住我们。
entries.speaker: ido

entries.text: ...What the hell is that man doing?
entries.new: ……那家伙到底在干什么？
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: I don't know, but when he left, I knew nobody was going to be in the security room for a very short time. That's when I took the picture. ...Just in case the footage is ever reviewed, I still did it covered by the cart, so I'll only be seen uncovering the curtain again.
entries.new: 我不知道，不过他离开时，我知道监控室会有很短一阵子没人。我就是那时候拍的照片。……为防万一录像被人回看，我拍照时还是用清洁车挡着，所以录像里最多只会看到我再次掀开遮布。
entries.speaker: ido

entries.text: Jiro's eyes had a glint to them. He knew they couldn't take things lightly.
entries.new: Jiro 眼中闪过一丝锐光。他知道此事不能掉以轻心。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Do you know what the upgraded security measures he talked about could be?
entries.new: 你知不知道他说的升级安保可能是什么？
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: No. He didn't elaborate, and I haven't noticed any difference.
entries.new: 不知道。他没有细说，我也没察觉出任何变化。
entries.speaker: ido

entries.text: It's strange. You said the cabinet where the Sekimeiya is can be locked and unlocked with a single key. When they did that in the past, we broke them open, so they must've accounted for that.{w} When they linked an alarm to the cabinets, we disabled it remotely thanks to our access to their computer. Given what you've said, it's likely they're doing something similar, and that's why they cleaned their entire system. However, infecting it again to intercept what they're doing might be what they're waiting for.
entries.new: 奇怪。你说过，放 Sekimeiya 的那个展示柜只用一把钥匙就能开关。以前他们也是这么做的，结果被我们撬开了，所以他们肯定考虑过这一点。{w}后来他们给展示柜连上警报，我们靠着侵入他们的电脑远程关掉了。照你说的来看，他们很可能在做类似的事，所以才清理了整个系统。不过，我们若为了截获他们的动向而再次感染系统，说不定正是他们等着我们做的。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: A long time ago, Xyn had the chance to manually install a piece of software they'd created on Ashiya's computer. Thanks to the cleaning cart, they'd brought a storage device inside, and by keeping it in Ido's locker, they'd waited for the chance they'd needed. When the security staff was drawn out of their room, Ido had the chance to boot it up in their system.
entries.new: 很久以前，Xyn 曾有机会亲手把他们制作的软件装进芦屋的电脑。他们靠清洁车把一块存储设备带进塔内，藏在 Ido 的储物柜里，等待时机。等到安保人员被引开、离开监控室的那一刻，Ido 便得以在那台电脑上启动它。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Despite Xyn's knowledge in the field, creating an undetectable malicious program wasn't simple. Because of that, the application they placed on the computer was a harmless one. That allowed it to stay hidden, only booting up for instants at a time.{w} Its purpose was to check a path on the cloud owned by Xyn. If it contained a file, it would be downloaded and executed. However, if the file had already been downloaded once, the process wouldn't be repeated.{w} That remote method allowed Xyn to gain access to Ashiya's computer. They knew about their security system, but a malicious file couldn't remain undetectable for long. By shuffling it every few days, however, they had kept their connection to the computer for months.
entries.new: 尽管 Xyn 在这方面颇有本事，要写出一个无法被检测的恶意程序却并不简单。因此，他们装在电脑上的程序是无害的。正因如此，它才能一直隐藏，每次只启动一瞬。{w}它的用途是检查 Xyn 名下云端的一个路径。若那里有文件，它就会下载并执行。不过，若该文件已经下载过一次，这个过程就不会重复。{w}靠这种远程手段，Xyn 得以访问芦屋的电脑。他们了解对方的安保系统，可恶意文件瞒不了太久。于是他们每隔几天就换一次文件，就这样让与那台电脑的连接维持了数月。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: It entailed a risk. If the server file was found at any given time, reverse tracking Xyn could've been feasible. To prevent that, they had made sure their file wouldn't ever be automatically detected, but their connection to Ashiya had been cut a few days previously. They knew the computer had undergone a thorough cleanup that had managed to erase Xyn's file in the process.{w} However, what about the application that had been manually installed months ago? Had it been erased too?
entries.new: 这其中也有风险。只要服务器上的文件在某一刻被发现，顺藤摸瓜追查 Xyn 并非不可能。为防万一，他们确保自己的文件永远不会被自动检测到，但几天前，他们与芦屋电脑的连接还是断了。他们知道那台电脑经过了彻底清理，Xyn 的文件也在过程中被抹去。{w}可是，几个月前手动安装的那个程序呢？它是否也被一并清除了？
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Jiro feared the reason behind the computer's cleanup. If their original application was still present within the computer, they could infect it again by putting up a new file on the path. What Jiro didn't like was the thought that Ashiya were monitoring every change.{w} While the file itself couldn't be detected as malicious, they might've committed a manual cleanup to assure it or anything similar would be deleted. Then, if Xyn remotely downloaded a new one, its appearance would be noticed, and although it wouldn't be detected as malicious, Ashiya could be sure Xyn had sent it.
entries.new: Jiro 担心的是那台电脑被清理的原因。假如他们原先的程序还留在电脑里，只要在云端路径上放一个新文件，就能再次感染它。让 Jiro 不安的是，芦屋或许正在监视每一次变动。{w}文件本身虽不会被判定为恶意，他们却可能特意做了一次人工清理，以确保它或类似的东西被删掉。这样一来，如果 Xyn 远程下载了新文件，文件的出现就会被察觉；即便不被判为恶意，芦屋也能确定是 Xyn 送进来的。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He had come up with a test. To know if their original application was still there, he put up a different file on the path. Upon execution, it would send a request to a web server before deleting itself.{w} The request had been received, so Jiro knew infecting Ashiya's computer again was possible. However, he was considerably hesitant about doing it.
entries.new: 他想出了一个试探的办法。为了确认原先的程序是否还在，他在那个路径上放了一个不同的文件。它一旦被执行，就会向一台网络服务器发送请求，然后自行删除。{w}请求已经收到，Jiro 由此知道再次感染芦屋的电脑是可行的。然而，他迟迟下不了决心。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The event will be on the 15th, but until then, it seems the Sekimeiya will be in the event room, merely locked inside a cabinet. Nothing we can do should involve breaking it open.{w} It'll be there for two weeks; they definitely expect our attack, and they think it'll happen during any night.{w} You said the cabinet looks different than all the others, right? It was prepared specifically for this, and the computer was cleaned up. I'll repeat that Katei Kuiji said their intent is to catch us before the 15th.{w} There's one more thing that caught my attention. You were told that they'd only made one key for the day of the event. This means the key will be used on the 15th.
entries.new: 活动在15号举行。在那之前，Sekimeiya 似乎会一直放在活动室，就锁在展示柜里。我们无论做什么，都不该走撬柜子这条路。{w}它要在那里放两个星期；他们显然料到我们会动手，而且认为会在某一个夜里发生。{w}你说过，那个展示柜和别的都不一样，对吧？它是为这次活动专门准备的，电脑也清理过了。我再重复一遍，Katei Kuiji 说他们的打算是在15号之前抓住我们。{w}还有一点让我在意。你听说他们只为活动当天配了一把钥匙。这意味着那把钥匙会在15号用上。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: Oh, yes. He said he'd let me be the first to touch it and warned me to be very gentle.
entries.new: 啊，对。他说会让我第一个摸它，还叮嘱我要非常小心。
entries.speaker: ido

entries.text: The first to touch it. So they'll let visitors feel it during the event. That confirms that they'll unlock the cabinet, which we can't and shouldn't try to do.
entries.new: 第一个摸它。这么说，活动期间他们会让参观者亲手触摸。那就证实了他们会打开柜子——而这正是我们不能、也不该去尝试的事。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: Both subordinates were paying close attention and slowly understood what Jiro was getting at.
entries.new: 两名部下都听得聚精会神，渐渐明白了 Jiro 的意思。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: If we're going to attack, there are many reasons why it should be on the very day of the event. Now that Ashiya are putting so much effort into this, we can't follow along with their expectations.{w} ...And there's another important reason why we shouldn't try to steal the Sekimeiya any day before the 15th.{w} Since the announcement, Ashiya haven't stopped building excitement for this mysterious gemstone; they're likely being excessive on purpose. Today, the Sekimeiya's value is already greater than yesterday's. Every day it's kept as a mystery, Ashiya are artificially inflating its value.{w} On the 15th, the Sekimeiya's value will be the highest it can be. That is when we want it.
entries.new: 既然要动手，就有很多理由说明该选在活动当天。芦屋现在投入了这么多心力，我们偏不能顺着他们的预想来。{w}……而且还有一个重要的理由，说明我们不该在15号之前的任何一天去偷 Sekimeiya。{w}自公布以来，芦屋一直在为这块神秘宝石造势，恐怕是故意做得过头。今天 Sekimeiya 的价值已经超过昨天。它每多神秘一天，芦屋就在人为地抬高它的价值。{w}到15号，Sekimeiya 的价值会达到顶点。那才是我们下手的时候。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: ...How would we actually get it, though? It will always be guarded when the cabinet's open, and there's a security camera in the room.
entries.new: ……可我们究竟要怎么拿到它？柜子打开的时候，它一定有人看守，而且活动室里还装着监控摄像头。
entries.speaker: ido

entries.text: Ashiya are supposedly raising the scale of their measures. So should we.{w} You're right. When the cabinet is unlocked, we won't easily be able to access the Sekimeiya. But when it's locked, there's no way we will.{w} It is possible we could acquire the single key they have, but that's not exactly likely, and it would pretty much reveal Ido. This is why I'm willing to prioritize my first idea.{w} I asked you to bring a picture of the Sekimeiya because I found Atase's description of it interesting. It was supposedly found on Airun, that derelict mountain. I find that very hard to believe.{w} Where did Gan find it? There are no caves there, and like Ashiya are saying, this is far from a typical gemstone.{w} Doesn't it look too good to you? Its shape isn't natural if it's supposed to be a stone formed over the years. There's something about this story that is off.
entries.new: 听说芦屋正在扩大戒备规模。我们也得跟上。{w} 你说得对。展示柜解锁时，我们没法轻易接近 Sekimeiya；可它锁着的时候，我们更无从下手。{w} 拿到他们那把唯一的钥匙并非不可能，但希望不大，而且几乎等于把 Ido 暴露出去。所以我愿意优先考虑最初那个方案。{w} 我让你带 Sekimeiya 的照片来，是因为 Atase 对它的描述让我很感兴趣。据说它是在艾伦山那座荒山上被发现的。我很难相信这种说法。{w} Gan 究竟是在哪里找到它的？那里根本没有洞穴，而且正如芦屋所说，这远不是寻常宝石。{w} 你不觉得它好得过分了吗？如果它真是经年累月形成的石头，这个形状就太不自然了。这个故事里总有什么地方不对劲。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: It was found right after our latest attack, and right as the computer was cleaned up. What I believe is that the emergence of this gemstone is directly related to us.{w} Both of you compared it to marble, and it glows faintly. Added to its shape, vague origin, and the lack of details Ashiya are providing, I can't help but feel this was deliberately organized... As if the Sekimeiya was handcrafted to draw us to the focus of their upgraded security.
entries.new: 它是在我们最近一次袭击之后、电脑刚被清理干净时被发现的。我认为，这颗宝石的出现与我们直接相关。{w} 你们两个都把它比作大理石，而且它会发出微弱的光。再加上它的形状、含糊的来历，以及芦屋提供的信息少得可怜，我忍不住觉得这一切是刻意安排的……就好像 Sekimeiya 是被人手工做出来，专门把我们引向他们加强戒备的核心。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: Do you mean that they made the Sekimeiya?
entries.new: 你的意思是，Sekimeiya 是芦屋造出来的？
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: That is irrelevant. However, if they did, it would've been simple. They crafted a material of a single color into a simple shape. There are some that glow like this, and luminous paint would achieve the same effect.{w} It doesn't matter if the gemstone in this picture was fabricated. Ashiya are giving it real value. However, what I've said could be of immense use to us.{w} Ido, it felt like marble, right? We can have its dimensions, and the color and form aren't an issue. Do you know that molding marble is fairly simple?
entries.new: 那无关紧要。不过，如果真是他们做的，那也简单。把单一颜色的材料做成一个简单的形状就是了。确实有些东西会这样发光，用夜光涂料也能达到同样的效果。{w} 照片里这颗宝石是不是伪造的并不重要。芦屋赋予了它真实的价值。不过，我刚才说的那些，对我们可能大有用途。{w} Ido，它摸起来像大理石，对吧？我们能拿到它的尺寸，颜色和形状也不成问题。你知道大理石塑形其实相当简单吗？
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: ...What are you saying? That we could replicate the Sekimeiya?
entries.new: ……你在说什么？我们能复制 Sekimeiya？
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: We easily could.
entries.new: 这并不难。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: ...I see. So we could sell it as the real Sekimeiya.
entries.new: ……我明白了。所以我们可以把它当成真正的 Sekimeiya 卖出去。
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: Of course not. That would eliminate all our credibility.{w} I said this as a solution to Ido's question—how to obtain the real Sekimeiya.{w} On the 15th, if we take it while the cabinet's unlocked, it will be noticed immediately. The real problem is taking it out of the building.{w} We replace it with ours, and Ido takes it out with the cleaning cart.
entries.new: 当然不是。那会把我们的信誉彻底毁掉。{w} 我这么说，是为了回答 Ido 的问题——如何拿到真正的 Sekimeiya。{w} 15 日那天，如果趁展示柜解锁时取走它，立刻就会被发现。真正的问题在于怎么把它带出大楼。{w} 我们用仿制品把它换掉，再由 Ido 用清洁推车运出去。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: Do you really think we could swap them? How would that not be noticed?{w} Also, doesn't this create the same problem? If we managed to replace it with a similar-looking stone, how would we demonstrate we have the real one? If we sold it, Ashiya would claim to still have it.
entries.new: 你真觉得我们能把它们换掉？怎么可能不被发现？{w} 而且，这不会带来同样的问题吗？就算我们成功换上一颗外观相近的石头，又怎么证明真品在我们手上？如果我们把它卖了，芦屋照样会宣称 Sekimeiya 还在他们那里。
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: We could easily demonstrate it. And not only to assert our credibility, but also to let Ashiya know their measures have failed again.{w} I know who could do this for us: my good friend Cevin Neneco. I have an idea of how to account for this, but I'll need to think more about it.{w} Your other question, how the swap wouldn't be noticed... That has an easier answer.
entries.new: 证明起来并不难。而且不只是为了保住我们的信誉，也要让芦屋知道，他们的戒备又一次失败了。{w} 我知道谁能替我们办这件事：我的好朋友 Cevin Neneco。关于怎么解释这件事，我有个想法，但还得再仔细想想。{w} 你另一个问题——掉包怎么会不被发现……这个答案比较简单。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: We'd have to do it when the cabinet is open. However, we can't be seen either in person or from the security room.{w} There is a way. The same thing we used last time, a smoke grenade.
entries.new: 必须趁展示柜打开时动手。可是，我们不能被人亲眼看到，也不能被监控室看到。{w} 有办法。和上次一样，用烟雾弹。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: ...D-Do you want to release that in the tower?
entries.new: ……你、你是要在塔里放那个东西？
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: The event will consist of guided visits for three people at once, and it will start at {time=9.}{w} Like always, at that time, the floor will be almost empty. That's when we make our move—before anyone knows what the Sekimeiya is. We know the people who show up earliest get in earliest. Atase, you will be there first.
entries.new: 活动会以每次三人的导览形式进行，从 {time=9.} 开始。{w} 和往常一样，那个时段楼层里几乎没人。我们就趁那个时段动手——赶在任何人知道 Sekimeiya 是什么之前。我们知道最早到的人会先进去。Atase，你会第一个进去。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: Intimidated by his boss's words, Atase stared hesitantly. He hadn't heard the entire plan yet, but it already sounded dangerous.
entries.new: Atase 被上司的话镇住了，迟疑地望过去。他还没听完整个计划，却已经觉得危险重重。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Ido will be there too. Once you're inside, he will secretly give you a small grenade that he'll bring in the previous day with the cleaning cart. When the event begins, it'll go off in front of the Sekimeiya, and it'll knock everyone out. The smoke will rapidly rise up, so to avoid inhaling any, you'll immediately throw yourself to the floor.{w} The cabinet will be unlocked, which will give you the chance to swap the Sekimeiya. Ours will be in the cleaning cart, and so that you don't have to go back to the lobby, Ido will leave it in the cleaning room. After that, you'll keep acting as if you fell unconscious.{w} In the end, despite the attack, Ashiya will think they still have the Sekimeiya, so, the following day, Ido will be able to take the real one out.
entries.new: Ido 也会在那里。你一进去，他就会悄悄把一枚小烟雾弹交给你——那是他前一天用清洁推车带进来的。活动开始时，它会在 Sekimeiya 前引爆，把所有人熏得昏过去。烟雾会迅速上升，所以为了不吸入，你要立刻扑倒在地。{w} 展示柜那时会解锁，你就有机会掉包 Sekimeiya。我们的仿制品会放在清洁推车里；为了不让你再跑回大厅，Ido 会把它留在清洁间。之后，你要继续装作昏倒。{w} 最后，尽管遭受袭击，芦屋仍会以为 Sekimeiya 还在自己手里，于是第二天，Ido 就能把真品带出去。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: Wait a second... Wh-Why do I have to do this? Shouldn't Ido be the one? This could go horribly wrong!
entries.new: 等一下……为、为什么是我？不该让 Ido 去吗？这事要是出了岔子，后果不堪设想！
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: No. At the time of the event, Ido has no reason to be in the event room. Furthermore, it's likely the people present will be investigated, which could lead Ashiya to find the real Sekimeiya in the cart before we can obtain it.{w} This could go wrong, sure, but it can work. However, see it as a chance I'm giving you.{w} You screwed up badly. Not only should you redeem yourself to us, but to yourself. If you're found, you will be seen as a killer. Make sure this plan works before you think of asking for our help again.
entries.new: 不行。活动开始后，Ido 没有理由待在活动室里。而且，在场的人很可能会被调查，那样芦屋说不定会在我们拿到真品之前，就从推车里找到真正的 Sekimeiya。{w} 这事确实可能出岔子，但也能成功。不过，把它当成我给你的机会。{w} 你犯下大错。你不仅该向我们、也该向你自己赎罪。一旦被发现，你就会被当成杀人犯。先确保这个计划成功，再考虑向我们求助。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: W-Will you offer help if this goes well?
entries.new: 如、如果事情顺利，你们会帮我吗？
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: That's something you will have to ask again after the 15th. Until then, you're still nothing but trouble for us—disposing of you is what we should do. ...Do you understand why it is essential that this is not a failure?
entries.new: 那要等 15 日之后，你再来问。在那之前，你对我们来说依旧只是麻烦——按说我们该把你处理掉。……你明白为什么这件事绝不能失败了吗？
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: ...{w}I don't even get what you said, though. I'll still be recorded if I do this.
entries.new: ……{w}可我还是没听懂你刚才说的。我这么做，不还是会被拍下来吗？
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: No. The smokescreen will cover you. We'll make sure it works as a barrier for the camera.
entries.new: 不会。烟雾会遮住你。我们会确保它足以挡住摄像头。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: But what about the hallway!? I'll be seen going to the cleaning room!
entries.new: 可走廊怎么办！？我去清洁间的时候会被看到的！
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: That is one reason why smoke should also be released there.{w} Like in every guided visit, everyone else will be in the lobby. If smoke appears in both hallways, everyone will quickly evacuate, as they'll be worried about it being poisonous or there being a fire. Then, the exit will be guarded to make sure nobody runs out with stolen gems.{w} Katei Kuiji will be in the security room, so due to the smoke, he won't be able to leave it without falling unconscious, and he won't see what's happening in the building.{w} When everyone is knocked out, you will go to the cleaning room and obtain our fake. It is essential that you do this first to make sure no one sees you. You will leave your smoke grenade in the cart and subsequently go back to swap the gemstones.
entries.new: 这也是为什么那里也得释放烟雾。{w} 每次导览参观时，其他人都会待在大厅。如果两条走廊都出现烟雾，大家都会赶紧撤出去，因为他们会担心烟雾有毒，或者发生了火灾。随后，出口会有人把守，确保没人带着偷来的宝石跑出去。{w} Katei Kuiji 会在监控室，所以烟雾一出现，他只要离开监控室就会昏倒，也就看不到楼里发生了什么。{w} 等所有人都昏过去，你就去清洁间取出我们的赝品。你必须先做这件事，确保没人看见你。把你的烟雾弹留在推车里，然后再回去掉包宝石。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: ...Who will set off the smoke outside the event room, though?
entries.new: ……可是，活动室外的烟雾由谁来触发？
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: Nobody will. Setting up a timer is the easiest thing in the world. We know when they have to go off: at {time=9:04.}
entries.new: 不需要人。装个定时器再简单不过。我们知道它们该在什么时候启动：{time=9:04.}
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: No, we don't...! The event will begin at {time=9}, but we don't know when the cabinet will be unlocked!
entries.new: 不，我们不知道……！活动确实在 {time=9} 开始，可我们不知道展示柜什么时候才会解锁！
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: That doesn't matter. Ido has seen the key and how to use it. If the smoke goes off before the cabinet is unlocked, the guide will be knocked out, and they will have the key on their person.
entries.new: 那不重要。Ido 见过那把钥匙，也知道该怎么用。如果烟雾在展示柜解锁前就启动，导览员会被熏昏，而钥匙就在他身上。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: And where exactly will the smoke bombs be in the hallways?
entries.new: 那烟雾弹在走廊里究竟要放在哪儿？
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: Don't you remember? We can use the handrails.{w} Behind them, the small grenades will be hidden, and it works perfectly for us. The cameras in the hallways are placed to focus on the doors, so there are parts of the handrails that aren't visible.{w} When Ido is cleaning, he can secretly place a grenade and slide it toward a point of the handrail that's being recorded. We will need two per hallway, and it'll seem like anyone could've placed them the previous day.
entries.new: 不记得了吗？我们可以利用扶手。{w} 小烟雾弹藏在扶手后面，对我们来说正合适。走廊的摄像头都对着门，因此扶手有些位置拍不到。{w} Ido 打扫时，可以悄悄放下一枚烟雾弹，再把它滑到会被摄像头拍到的扶手位置。每条走廊需要两枚，看上去就像前一天谁都有可能放进去。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: Finally, both subordinates understood how serious their boss was and broke into a sweat. As they took off and draped their heavy attire on the back of their chairs, they began to process each step of what they would be performing.
entries.new: 两名下属终于明白上司有多认真，不由得冒出了冷汗。他们脱下厚重的外套搭在椅背上，开始逐一琢磨接下来要执行的每一步。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: ...And that's not all. There's something else we'll do that will divert suspicion from Ido.{w} After all, if this works, we still wouldn't be in the clear. After suffering such a major attack, will Ashiya really believe nothing was stolen? If they're careful, they might not believe it and end up finding the real Sekimeiya.{w} So, we will give them a reason to believe it.{w} Their focus will be on the Sekimeiya; that's what they expect to be targeted, and the measures they're taking clearly involve it, as proven by the new cabinet and it only having one key. Targeting a different room will be much less problematic.{w} In the morning, before the event, the cameras will be monitored. However, there are more cameras than monitors, and only the hallways and a few crystal rooms are displayed at once, correct, Ido?
entries.new: ……还不止这些。我们还要做一件事，把怀疑从 Ido 身上引开。{w} 毕竟，就算计划成功，我们也还没完全脱身。遭到这么大规模的袭击后，芦屋真的会相信什么都没丢吗？如果他们谨慎些，或许不会信，最后还是会找到真正的 Sekimeiya。{w} 所以，我们要给他们一个相信的理由。{w} 他们的注意力会放在 Sekimeiya 上；那才是他们预期会被下手的目标，而他们采取的戒备显然也围绕着它——新的展示柜和只有一把钥匙就是证明。相比之下，去针对另一个展室，麻烦会小得多。{w} 早上活动开始前，监控会有人盯着。但摄像头比监视器多，同一时间只会显示走廊和少数几个水晶展室，对吧，Ido？
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: ...Yes. I've never seen the smaller one in hallway A being displayed. It's normally just the hallway.
entries.new: ……对。我从没见过 A走廊里那台较小的摄像头被调出来。平时只显示走廊。
entries.speaker: ido

entries.text: Exactly. This means that if you put all the gems there into a case, you won't be seen. We would usually never do this, as it makes you the only suspect, but this isn't an issue this time.{w} The curtains aren't raised until {time=9:10}, so you'll leave all of them down. You'll also leave the case in the room, in the corner beneath the camera, so that we can have a visitor be there when the smoke is released, crouching right as it happens. If they keep their head near the floor as they exit the tower with the case, they won't fall unconscious.{w} Two minutes after the smoke has been released, he will attempt to flee. This will make Ashiya think their expectations were subverted and that the failed attack had that room as its final target.{w} ...I doubt Faiten will be willing to take this job under any circumstances, but I'll find the right person without telling them the full extent of the plan.
entries.new: 正是如此。也就是说，只要你把那里的宝石全装进箱子，就不会被拍到。平时我们绝不会这么做，因为那样你就成了唯一的嫌疑人，但这次没关系。{w} 窗帘要到 {time=9:10} 才拉起，所以你把它们全放下。你还要把箱子留在那个房间里，放在摄像头下方的角落。这样烟雾释放时，我们可以安排一名访客正好在场，并在那一刻蹲下。只要他带着箱子离开塔时把头贴近地面，就不会昏过去。{w} 烟雾释放两分钟后，他会尝试逃走。这会让芦屋以为他们的预想落空了，以为那场失败的袭击最终针对的其实是那个房间。{w} ……我怀疑 Faiten 无论如何都不肯接这活，但我会找到合适的人，并且不把计划的全部内容告诉他。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: Since the reason behind doing this is passing off that room as the target, the smoke will need to be released there as well, so that's where Ido will leave the last grenade.
entries.new: 既然这么做是为了让那个房间看起来像真正的目标，烟雾也得在那里释放，所以最后一枚烟雾弹就由 Ido 留在那里。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: ...But, what...? I'm very confused. All of this will be recorded.
entries.new: ……可是，什么……？我完全糊涂了。这些全都会被拍下来。
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: Yes.{w} Before, I said that infecting the computer again could be risky. While that is true, it won't be an issue if we take the proper measures.{w} When the smoke is released, I will infect the computer remotely. While Katei is overwhelmed by the attack, it'll take me a few seconds to erase the saved footage of the previous 24 hours. Then, I will immediately disconnect our access so that we can't be tracked.{w} This will work in four different ways.{w} It will remove the footage that incriminates Ido.{w} It will remove the footage showing the source of the smoke in the event room.{w} It will make them think we had to remove the hallways' footage to hide who placed the grenades there, when that's not actually needed.{w} And lastly, it will hide that we can access the computer at any time, because they might think we were able to erase the footage thanks to the commotion of the attack.{w} ...This is it. This is what we'll do, and how we'll nab the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 是的。{w} 我之前说过，再次侵入电脑可能有风险。确实如此，但只要措施得当，就不会出问题。{w} 烟雾释放时，我会远程侵入电脑。趁 Katei 被袭击弄得手忙脚乱，我只要几秒钟就能抹掉过去 24 小时的录像。然后我会立刻断开我们的访问，让他们无法追踪。{w} 这会起到四个作用。{w} 删掉会让 Ido 暴露的录像。{w} 删掉显示活动室烟雾来源的录像。{w} 让他们以为我们必须删掉走廊录像来隐藏放置烟雾弹的人，而实际上那并非必要。{w} 最后，还能掩盖我们可以随时访问电脑这一点，因为他们可能会以为，我们是趁袭击造成的混乱才删掉录像的。{w} ……就是这样。这就是我们的做法，也是我们夺得 Sekimeiya 的办法。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: Once the plan is a success, we'll get it out of the building with the cart. However, how do we let Ashiya know their Sekimeiya is fake? Whatever the best answer is, it relies on the crafting process.{w} You said the Sekimeiya's kept pretty cold. There aren't many chemical reactions that occur at low temperatures, but perhaps we could make use of one to damage the Sekimeiya after a couple of days of exposure.{w} If not, then a mere timed reaction would suffice, one that would break our Sekimeiya and leave behind a card with our name.
entries.new: 计划成功后，我们就用推车把它运出大楼。可是，怎么让芦屋知道他们的 Sekimeiya 是赝品？不管哪种办法最好，关键都在制作工艺。{w} 你说过，Sekimeiya 存放的环境相当冷。低温下能发生的化学反应不多，但也许我们可以利用其中一种，让它在暴露几天后损坏 Sekimeiya。{w} 如果不行，单纯的定时反应也够了——让我们的 Sekimeiya 碎裂，并留下一张写有我们名号的卡片。
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: When Katei saw the busy waveform, he knew his bait had been effective.{w} Since Xyn had attacked the gem shop, Ido hadn't spoken to his boss. Katei had wanted to know Xyn's position after their failure, so he had given Ido information about the Sekimeiya to report to his group.
entries.new: 看到那密集的波形时，Katei 就知道自己的诱饵奏效了。{w} 自从 Xyn 袭击宝石店后，Ido 一直没和上司说过话。Katei 想知道 Xyn 在失败后的动向，于是把关于 Sekimeiya 的情报交给 Ido，让他转告他所属的组织。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: At a low volume, he listened to the audio in his dim office. The second time, the conversation was a lot more substantial.{w} Katei thrilled internally; an overwhelming amount of details were being revealed to him. He finally knew many of Xyn's secrets that had tormented him for so long.{w} He heard Xyn design their plan, even though the end sounded muffled. Ashiya's lure wouldn't work; there would be no attack before the 15th, and most importantly, Katei could no longer follow through with his scheme.{w} Xyn would attack during the daytime. The alarm wouldn't be activated, and Katei's voice could be heard by other people. In addition, even if the alarm was activated, Katei wouldn't be able to offer a Xyn member a quick escape, as the outside of the building wouldn't be deserted.
entries.new: 他把音量调得很低，在昏暗的办公室里听着录音。第二次，对话内容充实了许多。{w} Katei 内心一阵狂喜；无数细节正展现在他面前。他终于得知了许多折磨他已久的 Xyn 秘密。{w} 他听见 Xyn 设计计划，尽管结尾部分听起来含混不清。芦屋的诱饵不会奏效；15 日之前不会有袭击，而最重要的是，Katei 再也无法实施自己的计划。{w} Xyn 会在白天发动袭击。警报不会启动，而 Katei 的声音可能被其他人听见。此外，就算警报启动，Katei 也无法帮 Xyn 成员迅速脱身，因为大楼外不会空无一人。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: However, there was something else Katei realized: Xyn were right. The Sekimeiya's value was already much higher than what Ashiya had expected.{w} To incentivize Xyn's attack, Ashiya had been building an air of mystery around the gemstone, which had rapidly expanded. Until the 15th, the Sekimeiya's worth would be far higher than everything else Ashiya had ever possessed.{w} Katei didn't feel pressured. He had very valuable information, and he had learned that the concept of his plan could still be executed, albeit differently. He could anonymously threaten Ido with the audio, but that would give away Katei's source of information, and unlike after his previous plan, Xyn wouldn't be indebted to him. As such, he decided to change his way of thinking for the time being.
entries.new: 不过，Katei 还意识到了另一件事：Xyn 说得对。Sekimeiya 的价值早已远超芦屋的预期。{w} 为了诱使 Xyn 出手，芦屋一直在给这颗宝石营造神秘气氛，而这种气氛迅速膨胀。到 15 日为止，Sekimeiya 的价值会远远高过芦屋拥有过的任何东西。{w} Katei 并不觉得有压力。他掌握了极有价值的情报，也明白了自己计划的构想仍可实行，只是方式要变。他可以用录音匿名威胁 Ido，但那会暴露 Katei 的情报来源；而且与上次计划之后不同，Xyn 不会因此欠他人情。于是，他决定暂且改变思路。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The Sekimeiya... he could obtain it himself and postpone the idea of blackmailing Xyn. He had the key to the cabinet and a trump card he'd saved for years—the storeroom's secret.{w} Before Katei's parents had died, the building had undergone severe expansions. The secret corridor had always remained a hidden part of the lowest floor, but nobody who knew about it remained.{w} Naturally, Katei had tested it already to deduce whether Xyn were aware of its existence. He had easily been able to confirm it had never opened during their attacks.
entries.new: Sekimeiya……他可以亲自拿到它，把勒索 Xyn 的念头暂时搁下。他手里有展示柜的钥匙，还有一张藏了多年的王牌——储藏室的秘密。{w} 在 Katei 的父母去世之前，这栋大楼经历过大规模扩建。那条秘密通道一直是底层不为人知的一部分，但知道它的人已经都不在了。{w} 当然，Katei 已经试探过，想推断 Xyn 是否知道它的存在。他很容易就确认，在 Xyn 的历次袭击中，那条通道从未被打开过。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: How could Katei take the Sekimeiya out of the tower? Despite all he knew, it wasn't a simple task.{w} He couldn't act out a fake Xyn attack when he didn't have the night shift: if he entered through the storeroom, he would be seen from the security room.{w} He could take action when he had the night shift. He could bring the Sekimeiya to the storeroom and claim Xyn had erased the security footage. But would such a thing be believable?{w} He wasn't worried that Xyn could threaten him anymore—he had the upper hand in that battle, as he could expose a good deal about them. Yet, Katei's story would be too convenient. His alarm would have to be somehow bypassed, and Katei would have to let them escape.
entries.new: Katei 要怎么把 Sekimeiya 带出塔？尽管他知道这么多，这仍不是件容易的事。{w} 没有夜班时，他无法伪装成 Xyn 的袭击：如果他从储藏室进去，就会被监控室看到。{w} 他可以在值夜班时动手。他可以把 Sekimeiya 带到储藏室，声称 Xyn 删掉了监控录像。可这种说法会有人信吗？{w} 他已经不再担心 Xyn 能威胁自己——在这场较量中他占了上风，因为他能揭发 Xyn 的许多事。可是，Katei 的故事会显得太过方便。警报总得被绕过，而且 Katei 还得放他们逃走。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: What if he activated the alarm by forcing open the cabinet? Then, when the exit unlocked, no Xyn member would be found in the building, and the Sekimeiya would've magically disappeared.{w} There was only one way Katei could make that work: by saying he had seen someone escaping toward the storeroom. However, he didn't want to reveal the existence of the hidden door yet.{w} There was no smooth story that let Katei weasel out. He didn't want to be investigated by Ashiya or Xyn, but every scenario sounded iffy and had him as an easy suspect.{w} That was until he realized that the perfect moment existed.{w} A moment where he wouldn't be the only suspect, and where his story would be believed without doubt: the day of the event.
entries.new: 如果他用强行打开展示柜的方式触发警报呢？那么出口解锁时，楼里不会找到任何 Xyn 成员，而 Sekimeiya 则会像变魔术一样消失。{w} 要让这套说法成立，Katei 只有一个办法：声称自己看见有人朝储藏室方向逃走了。但他还不想暴露暗门的存在。{w} 没有哪套说辞能让 Katei 顺利脱身。他不想被芦屋或 Xyn 调查，可每一种情形都漏洞百出，让他很容易成为嫌疑人。{w} 直到他意识到，完美的时机确实存在。{w} 在那个时机里，他不会成为唯一的嫌疑人，而他的说法也会被毫无疑问地采信：活动当天。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The day when Xyn would be in the tower, and when Katei would be in the security room. He could use their own attack against them to obfuscate his involvement.
entries.new: 那一天，Xyn 会在塔里，而 Katei 会在监控室。他可以借 Xyn 的袭击来掩盖自己参与其中。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He knew what would happen and what Xyn's actions would be. He immediately thought of a way to take advantage of them.
entries.new: 他知道将会发生什么，也知道 Xyn 会如何行动。他立刻想到了利用他们的办法。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The Sekimeiya cabinet had been designed to trigger the alarm upon being minimally damaged. At {time=9:04}, a vast cloud of smoke was going to be released in the event room. Even though the cabinet could be unlocked, the mere damage of the smoke could set off the alarm.{w} In any case, if the alarm went off at that time, it wouldn't be questioned: a real attack would've triggered it, so it would've served its function.
entries.new: Sekimeiya 的展示柜被设计成只要轻微受损就会触发警报。到 {time=9:04}，活动室里将释放出大片烟雾。即使展示柜可以解锁，烟雾本身造成的损伤也可能触发警报。{w} 无论如何，如果警报在那个时候响起，不会有人质疑：真正的袭击本就会触发它，所以它也算尽到了职责。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Katei had designed the system, and he knew Xyn didn't have access to the tower's computer. If he altered the system to automatically activate the alarm at that time, no one would know.{w} He could trap Xyn in the tower and commandeer the rest of their plan himself. In addition, Katei had another reason to trigger the alarm: to aid Xyn before his intervention. The only way their plan could fail was if people from the outside quickly raided the building despite the smoke. That was something the alarm could prevent.
entries.new: 这套系统是 Katei 设计的，他知道 Xyn 无法访问塔里的电脑。如果他改动系统，让警报在那个时候自动触发，不会有人知道。{w} 他可以把 Xyn 困在塔里，并亲自接管他们计划的剩余部分。此外，Katei 触发警报还有另一个理由：在他介入之前先帮 Xyn 一把。他们的计划唯一可能失败的地方，就是外面的人不顾烟雾迅速冲进大楼。而警报恰好能阻止这种事。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Katei's initial idea was promising, and he could develop it further.{w} Xyn would disable the hallway A cameras, where the security room and the storeroom were. That meant that before the attack, Katei could quickly go to the lobby to discuss what to do during the event with the police. That would be the last recording of hallway A.{w} Upon seeing the smoke, everyone would rapidly evacuate, unaware that the alarm was soon to be activated. Then, during the chaos, Katei would reenter the hallway.
entries.new: Katei 最初的想法很有前景，而且他还能进一步完善。{w} Xyn 会关掉 A走廊的摄像头，而监控室和储藏室都在那边。这意味着，在袭击发生前，Katei 可以迅速去大厅，与警察商量活动期间该如何应对。那会成为 A走廊的最后一段录像。{w} 一看到烟雾，所有人都会迅速疏散，没人知道警报即将启动。随后，在混乱之中，Katei 会重新进入走廊。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: That would no longer be caught by the cameras. As he'd heard Xyn's discussion, he knew that by crawling, he would avoid falling unconscious.{w} He knew what Atase's movements would be—the alarm wouldn't influence them. He would go to the cleaning room, so Katei had the opportunity to take the Sekimeiya out of the cabinet if it was unlocked. If it wasn't, he'd go take it from the cleaning cart after Atase finished his job.
entries.new: 这样便不会再被摄像头拍到。他听过 Xyn 的商议，知道只要匍匐爬行，就能避免失去意识。{w} 他清楚 Atase 的行动会如何展开——警报不会改变那些步骤。Atase 会去清洁间，因此只要展示柜未上锁，Katei 就有机会取出 Sekimeiya。若柜子锁着，他就等 Atase 做完清洁，再从清洁车里取走。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Then, he could rapidly go to the storeroom and leave the Sekimeiya behind the movable wall. Lei had told him it couldn't be kept at a warm temperature, but the storeroom's corridor was colder than the rest of the tower due to its lack of insulation and air conditioning.{w} Lastly, he would leave using his unique key. Everyone would be in front of the entrance, so he wouldn't be seen stepping out of the building. Then, he would appear from behind them, as if he had evacuated, which hallway A's camera would corroborate.
entries.new: 接着，他可以迅速前往储藏室，把 Sekimeiya 留在可移动墙后面。Lei 告诉过他，Sekimeiya 不能保存在温暖的环境中；储藏室的走廊没有隔热层，也没有空调，因此比塔内其他地方更冷。{w} 最后，他会用自己的专属钥匙离开。所有人都会聚在入口前，所以没人会看见他走出大楼。然后，他会从人群后方现身，仿佛自己也是刚撤离出来，而 A走廊的摄像头会印证这一点。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Nobody would be in the security room, so after twelve hours, the shutter would open. Then, someone inside the building would be guaranteed to be a member of Xyn and responsible for triggering the alarm.
entries.new: 监控室里不会有人，因此十二小时后，卷帘门会打开。届时，楼内必定会有一个 Xyn 成员，而警报正是由他触发的。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: However, nobody would know the Sekimeiya had been stolen because Xyn's fake would remain inside, and nobody would suspect Katei of having any involvement, as he couldn't have. Not even Xyn would suspect him.
entries.new: 然而，没人会知道 Sekimeiya 已被偷走，因为里面会留着 Xyn 制作的赝品 Sekimeiya；也没人会怀疑 Katei 参与其中，因为他根本不可能参与。就连 Xyn 也不会怀疑到他头上。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: And in the future, he could retrieve the real Sekimeiya from the storeroom without an issue.
entries.new: 而日后，他可以毫无阻碍地从储藏室取回真正的 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Everything was finally in motion, and the long wait for the day of the event began.{w} Ashiya, Xyn, and Katei. Each of those three parties had their own unique agenda.
entries.new: 一切终于开始运转，接下来便是对活动当日的漫长等待。{w}芦屋、Xyn、Katei——三方各有各的盘算。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Every night, Ashiya expected Xyn's attack. However, Katei knew it wouldn't happen yet and kept mentally rehearsing his plan.
entries.new: 每晚，芦屋都在等着 Xyn 动手。然而 Katei 知道那还不会发生，只是在脑中反复演练自己的计划。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Meanwhile, Xyn received their replica of the Sekimeiya.{w} Ido, who had seen, touched, and measured the original, confirmed there was no glaring difference between the two, and that unless Ashiya had foreseen a replica being created, it would work.
entries.new: 与此同时，Xyn 收到了他们制作的 Sekimeiya 仿制品。{w} Ido 见过、摸过并测量过真品，确认两者没有明显差异；除非芦屋早已预料到会有人仿制，否则这件复制品足以奏效。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: As the days approached, Ashiya realized Xyn were likely to not fall for their trap, and as Xyn had predicted, the Sekimeiya continued to grow more valuable in the eyes of the world.{w} Ashiya hadn't fully prepared the event yet, so a trusted employee of theirs was chosen to plan out the guided visits.
entries.new: 随着日期临近，芦屋意识到 Xyn 很可能不会中自己布下的圈套；而正如 Xyn 所料，Sekimeiya 在世人心中的价值持续攀升。{w}芦屋尚未完全准备好活动，于是选了一名信得过的员工来筹划导览参观。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Atase was under a lot of pressure. He had to make sure the plan was a success, and if he executed what had been laid out perfectly, the odds would be in his favor.
entries.new: Atase 承受着巨大的压力。他必须确保计划成功；只要把安排好的步骤执行得天衣无缝，胜算就会站在他这边。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: All the preparations had been made. Slowly, the days of December ticked up to the 15th.
entries.new: 所有准备都已完成。十二月的日子一天天过去，最终到了十五日。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: However, nobody expected what would happen on that day.
entries.new: 然而，那一天发生的事，没有人预料得到。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Eight people were trapped in Ashiya Tower, but they weren't alone. That was the catalyst of the construction of a mountainous maze.{w} Who reached its peak? It wasn't everyone who began the climb.
entries.new: 八个人被困在芦屋塔中，但他们并不孤单。这一切，成了筑起一座层叠如山之迷宫的契机。{w} 谁攀上了峰顶？开始攀登的人，并非都能抵达。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: You are lucky enough to have access to all its sides, but what about the peak?{w} Three parties formed the mountain's base, unaware of how high it would go.
entries.new: 八个人被困在芦屋塔中，但他们并不孤单。这一切，成了筑起一座层叠如山的迷宫的契机。{w} 谁攀上了峰顶？开始攀登的人，并非都能抵达。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Xyn
entries.new: Xyn

entries.text: Katei
entries.new: Katei

entries.text: Ashiya
entries.new: 芦屋

entries.text: Continue
entries.new: 继续

entries.text: Contrition
entries.new: 悔悟

entries.text: When the tower opened, Atase was the only person waiting outside. He wore light attire despite the cold.
entries.new: 芦屋塔开门时，在外等候的只有 Atase 一人。天这么冷，他却穿得很单薄。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He bowed at the receptionist and stepped in slowly. A man walked up to him, asking for his ticket. After showing it and confirming that he didn't have a phone, he stepped to the hallway B door.
entries.new: 他向接待员鞠了一躬，缓缓走入。一名男子迎上来，请他出示门票。他出示了门票，又确认自己没有带手机，然后走到 B 走廊门口。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: It was very early in the morning. For a while, all he heard was the receptionist shuffling a bunch of papers behind the desk.
entries.new: 此时清晨尚早。有好一阵子，他耳中只有接待员在柜台后翻动一叠文件的窸窣声。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The next person he saw was Ido. Without looking over, he casually made his way to the hallway.{w} It took him a while to come back. When he did, his clothes were different, and he was carrying a cleaning bucket.
entries.new: 他见到的下一个人是 Ido。Ido 没往他这边看，若无其事地走向走廊。{w} 过了好一阵，Ido 才回来。回来时已换了一身衣服，手里提着清洁桶。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Atase was relieved. Nothing had happened, so Ido's part of the plan had gone well. He didn't have the cleaning cart, as it was waiting for Atase with the fake Sekimeiya.
entries.new: Atase 松了口气。什么都没发生，说明 Ido 负责的那部分计划进展顺利。Ido 没有推清洁车，因为那辆车正载着赝品 Sekimeiya，等着 Atase 去取。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Idly mopping the floor, Ido got close to Atase. That was when he dropped a tiny grenade in his pocket. At that point, everything was ready—the action was poised to begin.
entries.new: Ido 漫不经心地拖着地，慢慢靠近 Atase，趁机把一颗小巧的手雷丢进他的口袋。到这一刻，一切已准备妥当——行动一触即发。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Atase turned around when he heard something at his back. Two more people were by the entrance: a boy and a girl.
entries.new: 身后传来动静，Atase 转过身。入口处又多了两个人：一个少年和一个少女。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Out of nowhere, Atase felt a sudden wave of heat. ...He had seen the boy before.{w} In Musashi Gemstones, he had been the first to be hit by the smoke. Atsuki Hakutoki was his name, and he'd been safely discharged from the hospital.
entries.new: 没来由地，Atase 感到一阵燥热。……他见过那个少年。{w} 在武藏宝石，少年是第一个被烟雾波及的人。他叫 Atsuki Hakutoki，后来已平安出院。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Atase swiftly looked away. On that day, his face had been disguised, but what if he was recognized? He stared at the floor as they walked closer to him, clenching his fists tightly.
entries.new: Atase 立刻移开视线。那天他易过容，可万一被认出来呢？两人越走越近，他死死盯着地面，攥紧了拳头。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: ...{w}He had to avoid eye contact; the boy next to him had lost someone, and it had been his fault.{w} He had taken a glance at the girl as well. Although he hadn't seen her before, the eyes below her red hair looked identical to the boy's.
entries.new: ……{w}他不能和对方对上视线；身旁那个少年曾失去过一个人，而那是他的过错。{w} 他也瞥了少女一眼。他从未见过她，可红发下的那双眼睛，和少年一模一样。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: {time=9:00} was distant. Long before it, police officers arrived outside the tower.{w} Atase's rough facial description must've been known. He didn't think he'd be recognized, but he couldn't bring himself to look back.
entries.new: 距离{time=9:00}还早。远在那之前，警察就已抵达塔外。{w} Atase 的大致长相想必已经被人掌握。他觉得自己不会被认出，可还是不敢回头。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: All at once, a wave of people flooded in. Faint chatter took over the silence, but none of it reached Atase. He had to look calm and know exactly what to do.{w} He saw someone he knew outside the lobby. However, that person didn't know who Atase was. His job was to take out a suitcase at {time=9:06.}
entries.new: 忽然间，人潮涌了进来。细碎的交谈声取代了寂静，却没有一句落进 Atase 耳中。他必须显得镇定，而且清楚自己该做什么。{w} 他看见大厅外有一个认识的人。但那人并不知道 Atase 是谁。那个人的任务是在{time=9:06.}取出手提箱。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Ido had left through the opposite hallway a while ago. When he came back, he started to mop the floor a second time.
entries.new: Ido 不久前从另一侧的走廊离开了。回来之后，他又开始拖地。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Slowly, the time kept passing.{w} After Ido was done with the little plaza, he entered again, mopping the new snowy footprints and the already shining floor.
entries.new: 时间缓缓流逝。{w} Ido 把小广场拖完后，又走了进来，擦去新落下的雪水脚印，也拖过本就发亮的地面。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: For a while, he kept doing that. He had to stay there, as he knew what was soon to happen in the hallways.
entries.new: 有一阵子，他一直重复着这些动作。他必须留在那里，因为他知道走廊里很快会发生什么。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Shiroya...?
entries.new: Shiroya……？
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: Atase's heart skipped a beat. Behind him, he'd heard the voice of Katei Kuiji. However, that name...
entries.new: Atase 心跳漏了一拍。身后传来的是 Katei Kuiji 的声音。可是，那个名字……
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Is this yours? I think you dropped it.
entries.new: 这是你的吗？我想是你掉的。
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: ...Thank you.
entries.new: ……谢谢。
entries.speaker: mnn

entries.text: Atase's head slowly turned to the girl.{w} She wasn't Shiroya. That was the name of the girl whose memory pressed down on his shoulders.
entries.new: Atase 缓缓转头看向那个少女。{w} 她不是 Shiroya。Shiroya 是另一个少女的名字，关于她的记忆一直沉沉压在他肩上。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Who was that, then?{w} Atase would soon learn.
entries.new: 那么，她是谁？{w} Atase 很快就会知道。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: At {time=9}, the door to hallway B opened. Through it came Naomi Cabca, who gave a brief explanation of the event.{w} It was time. Only four minutes were left.
entries.new: 到了{time=9}，B 走廊的门打开了。Naomi Cabca 从门后走来，简短地说明了活动内容。{w} 时候到了。只剩下四分钟。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Are you three the first group?
entries.new: 你们三位是第一组吗？
entries.speaker: sann

entries.text: Yeah, we've been here for a while.
entries.new: 对，我们在这儿等了好一会儿了。
entries.speaker: mnn

entries.text: Perfect. Please follow me to the event room to be the first to see the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 很好。请随我去活动室，成为第一批见到 Sekimeiya 的人。
entries.speaker: sann

entries.text: Quietly, the three people at the front of the line stepped into the hallway and were drawn to the room in the middle.
entries.new: 队伍最前面的三人悄无声息地走进走廊，被引向中段的房间。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: A single cabinet was there, covered by a velvet curtain. It was a sight Atase had seen before through a picture.
entries.new: 那里只摆着一座展示柜，上面罩着天鹅绒遮布。这样的景象，Atase 曾在照片上见过。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: All right. It would be helpful if you could tell me your names so that I know how to address you.
entries.new: 好。方便的话，请告诉我你们的名字，我好知道该怎么称呼。
entries.speaker: sann

entries.text: I'm Miiya Moiromo.
entries.new: 我是 Miiya Moiromo。
entries.speaker: mnn

entries.text: That was her name. It was one Atase remembered. Miiya Moiromo had been in the shop as well, but she hadn't been hit by the impact of the explosion.
entries.new: 原来是这个名字。Atase 记得这个名字。Miiya Moiromo 当时也在那家店里，只是没有受到爆炸冲击的波及。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: "Akaro Esata". For the first time in hours, Atase opened his mouth, voicing the name that had been on his ticket.
entries.new: 「Akaro Esata」。几个小时以来，Atase 第一次开口，说出了票上那个名字。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: ...Atsuki Hakutoki.
entries.new: ……Atsuki Hakutoki。
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: Naomi began to explain the story behind the Sekimeiya. As she did, Atase wondered if any bit of truth was coming out of her mouth.
entries.new: Naomi 开始讲起 Sekimeiya 背后的故事。Atase 一边听着，一边在心里琢磨：她嘴里能有几分真话？
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Part of the experience is the touch, so I will open the glass and let you experience it yourselves. However, I must insist that you be gentle and keep your hands inside the cabinet at all times.
entries.new: 体验的一部分在于触摸，所以我会打开玻璃罩，让你们亲自感受。不过我必须强调，请务必轻柔，且始终将手放在展示柜内。
entries.speaker: sann

entries.text: She took out a keyring. After inserting a small one into the cabinet, she unlocked it.
entries.new: 她取出一串钥匙，拣出一把小钥匙插进展示柜，打开了锁。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: I have a question.
entries.new: 「我有个问题。」
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: Hm? What is it?
entries.new: 「嗯？什么问题？」
entries.speaker: sann

entries.text: Atase suppressed his nervousness as best he could. The cabinet had been unlocked, so the plan was very close to succeeding. However, a few seconds still remained until {time=9:04.}
entries.new: Atase 竭力压住紧张。展示柜已经解锁，计划离成功只差一步。可距离 {time=9:04.} 还剩几秒。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He attempted to slow Naomi down. She had been about to raise the curtain and let them touch the gemstone. If that happened before the smoke was released, the Sekimeiya could be hit by it, which could later reveal that the clean one was Xyn's fake.
entries.new: 他设法拖住 Naomi。她正要掀起遮布，让他们去摸那颗宝石。若在烟雾放出之前掀开，Sekimeiya 就可能沾上烟尘，日后便会暴露出那颗干净的宝石其实是 Xyn 的赝品。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: You keep mentioning how valuable the Sekimeiya is, but is there proof of that? The way you're explaining it, you don't even say what kind of gem it is, only that it's "rare".
entries.new: 你一直说 Sekimeiya 有多珍贵，可有什么证据？照你的说法，你连它是什么宝石都没讲，只说是「罕见」而已。
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: But the value could've been arbitrarily created by Ashiya, as it's not being officially recognized as anything more than an unusual discovery.
entries.new: 但这价值也可能是芦屋随意定出来的——官方至今只把它当作一件不寻常的发现而已。
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: Well, I will let you decide that for yourself. As you said, it's not categorized because nobody was able to properly appraise it. That's all you need to be assured of its value.
entries.new: 这个嘛，就请你自己判断吧。正如你所说，它之所以没有被归类，是因为没人能对它作出恰当的鉴定。你只需知道这一点，就足以相信它的价值了。
entries.speaker: sann

entries.text: I apologize for being skeptical, but you must be aware that Ashiya aren't exactly recognized for their fairness.
entries.new: 恕我直言，我确实心存疑虑，但你想必也清楚，芦屋可并不以公正著称。
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: Do you have a reason to say that?
entries.new: 你这么说，有什么根据吗？
entries.speaker: sann

entries.text: Yes, that everyone in the lobby sounded as skeptical as I am.
entries.new: 有。大厅里那些人，听起来都跟我一样怀疑。
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: Maybe seeing it for yourself will convince you.
entries.new: 等你亲眼见到，或许就会信服了。
entries.speaker: sann

entries.text: That's what I'm hoping.
entries.new: 我也希望如此。
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: After a pause, Naomi shook her head and crouched beside the cabinet. When she raised the curtain, a huge cloud of smoke rose with it, coming from the grenade Atase had taken out of his pocket.
entries.new: 顿了顿，Naomi 摇了摇头，蹲到展示柜旁。她掀起遮布的瞬间，一大团烟雾随之涌起——那是 Atase 从口袋里掏出的烟雾弹散出的。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Before anyone could resist, Atase had already fallen to the floor. Looking down and covering his nose, he avoided having his consciousness fade.
entries.new: 还没等任何人反应过来，Atase 早已伏倒在地。他低下头、捂住口鼻，不让自己失去意识。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Once everyone plummeted down, a sudden, unsettling silence consumed the room.{w} What was happening outside? Had everyone evacuated? Had the gems been brought out in the suitcase? For a few seconds, Atase had to wait to make sure nobody remained conscious.
entries.new: 众人相继倒下后，一阵令人不安的死寂笼罩了房间。{w}外面究竟发生了什么？人都撤走了吗？宝石已经装进手提箱带出去了吗？Atase 不得不等上几秒，确认没有一个人还醒着。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He heard someone running through hallway A. It must have been the man with the gemstones, but why? Two minutes hadn't passed yet.
entries.new: 他听见有人从 A走廊跑过。那应该是带着宝石的那个男人，可为什么？两分钟明明还没到。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Atase's eyes widened. What the hell was that sound?
entries.new: Atase 睁大了眼睛。那到底是什么声音？
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He waited, wondering what was happening. ...Had the plan been a failure?
entries.new: 他等着，不知道外面出了什么事。……计划失败了吗？
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: After a few seconds, the loud noise faded. However, Atase could not hear anything else outside the room.
entries.new: 几秒之后，巨响渐渐平息。可除此之外，Atase 听不到房外还有任何动静。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: When he looked up, he couldn't believe he was in the same place. Very little light was being cast from the ceiling, and the walls had become dark.
entries.new: 他抬起头，简直不敢相信自己还在同一个地方。天花板上透下的光所剩无几，墙壁也已暗了下来。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The three people who'd been with him were lying on the floor. Once he knew he could move, he silently stepped to hallway B.
entries.new: 刚才和他在一起的三个人都躺在地上。确认自己能动了之后，他悄无声息地走向 B走廊。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Again, it was hard to believe it was the same place as before. However, nobody was there.{w} Covering his face, Atase dashed to the cleaning room.
entries.new: 同样很难相信这里和之前是同一个地方。可一个人也没有。{w}Atase 捂住脸，奔进清洁间。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: There was light; almost no smoke had gone through the door.{w} Occupying most of the space, the cart sat in the room. Without hesitating, he dropped the smoke grenade inside it.
entries.new: 里面亮着灯，几乎没有什么烟穿过门缝。{w}那辆推车占去了大半个房间。他没有犹豫，把烟雾弹丢进车里。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The fake Sekimeiya was there. However, Atase couldn't touch it with his bare hands, or he would leave smoky fingerprints on it. He took it with the clean sleeves of his shirt and brought it to the hallway, crouching so that the remaining smoke wouldn't make contact with it.
entries.new: 赝品 Sekimeiya 就在那里。可 Atase 不能赤手去碰，否则会在上面留下带烟的指纹。他用干净的衬衫袖子裹住它，拿到走廊上，又蹲下身，免得残留的烟雾沾到它。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Back in the event room, he walked to the cabinet. Like Naomi had been about to do, he raised the curtain.
entries.new: 回到活动室，他走向展示柜，像 Naomi 刚才要做的那样掀起了遮布。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: ...{w}H-Huh?
entries.new: ……{w}怎、怎么回事？
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: He stopped cold, suddenly bewildered. Two glowing stones were in front of him.
entries.new: 他猛地僵住，一时不知所措。眼前竟有两颗发光的石头。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Why? He couldn't comprehend what he was seeing.{w} Had there been two Sekimeiya?
entries.new: 怎么会？他无法理解眼前的景象。{w}难道 Sekimeiya 有两个？
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Atase had to rush, but he didn't know what to do. If he took both gemstones, Xyn's plan would never work.{w} Dumbfounded, he reached for one of the two; he could only replace a single one.
entries.new: Atase 必须抓紧时间，却不知该怎么办。若把两颗宝石都拿走，Xyn 的计划就绝不可能成功。{w}他怔怔地伸手去拿其中一颗——他只能换掉一颗。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He felt a screen of glass that he was able to slide open. Then, without placing his fingers on it, he took a gemstone out, swapping it with his.{w} Still in awe, he closed the glass and dropped the curtain down.
entries.new: 他摸到一层可以推开的玻璃。随后，他尽量不让手指碰到宝石，把其中一颗取出来，换成了自己带来的那颗。{w}他仍满心惊愕，合上玻璃，放下遮布。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He ran back with the gem in his hands. After locating the door, he moved into hallway B and silently went to the cleaning room.
entries.new: 他捧着宝石跑回去。找到门后，他进入 B走廊，悄声来到清洁间。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He dropped the Sekimeiya next to the grenade, and once he was done, Atase rushed back to the event room.
entries.new: 他把 Sekimeiya 放在烟雾弹旁边。做完这些，Atase 便急忙赶回活动室。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He made sure to close the door and stepped to the spot where he'd fallen down.
entries.new: 他特意关好门，走回自己先前倒下的位置。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: However, the darkness prevented him from noticing something.{w} Naomi was no longer there.
entries.new: 然而黑暗让他没能察觉到一件事。{w}Naomi 已经不在了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: While Atase lay down, he heard sounds around him: the floor wasn't empty.
entries.new: Atase 躺下的同时，听见四周有响动：地板上并非空无一人。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Just what was happening? Everything started to become stranger when nobody entered where he was.
entries.new: 究竟出了什么事？他待的地方一直没人进来，情况变得越来越奇怪。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: His job was to stay there, and that was what he did.
entries.new: 他的任务就是待在那里，而他也照做了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: ...{w}But he couldn't make sense of it. Why weren't they being rescued?
entries.new: ……{w}可他怎么也想不通。为什么没人来救他们？
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Wh—{w=0.4} *cough*
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: The boy woke up.{w} That was the start of a very long day.{w} During the previous weeks, Atase had come up with countless outcomes. However, the real one was far from any he'd devised.
entries.new: 那个少年醒了。{w}漫长的一天由此开始。{w}在此之前的几周里，Atase 设想过无数种结局。可真正发生的那一种，与他所设想的任何一种都相去甚远。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: They were trapped. The alarm he'd heard had removed all methods of escape.{w} When he learned Naomi had left the event room before his return, he had to hide his fear. ...Could she have noticed Atase's absence upon awakening?
entries.new: 他们被困住了。那阵警报夺走了所有逃生的手段。{w}得知 Naomi 在他回来之前就已离开活动室时，他只能把恐惧藏起来。……她会不会一醒来就发现 Atase 不见了？
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: That was one of his initial questions, but they didn't stop piling up. Atase would have to spend twelve hours in that building until he could leave.
entries.new: 这只是他最初的疑问之一，可问题却接二连三地堆积起来。Atase 要在这栋楼里待满十二个小时才能离开。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He didn't know how worried he had to be or what had triggered the alarm. Even though the building was full of cameras, he knew not to be afraid of them.{w} He was told the internet connection had been cut by the alarm. In the meantime, Xyn couldn't remotely access the computer. However, he knew his group well. According to Katei, at {time=21}, the connection would come back, and Xyn would immediately erase all the recorded footage.
entries.new: 他不知道自己该有多担心，也不知道是什么触发了警报。楼里到处都是摄像头，可他清楚不必怕它们。{w} 他听说警报切断了网络连接，Xyn 一时无法远程访问电脑。不过，他很了解自己的同伴。按 Katei 的说法，到了 {time=21}，连接就会恢复，Xyn 会立刻抹掉所有录像。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He recalled the conversation he'd had with his boss word by word; he knew how important it was for him not to fail.{w} Therefore, despite the unforeseen alarm, Atase had only one priority: to make the plan a success.
entries.new: 他逐字回想与上司的那番对话，清楚自己绝不能失手。{w} 所以，尽管警报来得意外，Atase 也只有一个目标：让计划成功。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Inside Out
entries.new: 里外翻转

entries.text: It was almost time.
entries.new: 时候快到了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Upon arriving at the tower, Katei had listened to the latest recording. As he'd hoped, Ido and his boss had talked one last time and gone over their movements.{w} Katei took out the SD card—he couldn't allow that audio to be heard by anyone else. As he didn't want the card on his person either, he hid it in the security room.
entries.new: 一到芦屋塔，Katei 就先听了最新那段录音。正如他所期望的，Ido 和他的上司最后谈了一次，核对了双方的行踪。{w} Katei 取出 SD 卡——那段音频绝不能让其他人听到。他也不愿把卡带在身上，便把它藏进了监控室。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The time was rapidly approaching, and he didn't have the opportunity to go back to the staff room. While he tried to remain calm, he hid the voice recorder as well. Although the large device could've been found if Ashiya searched, he knew the SD card wouldn't be, which was all that mattered.{w} Through the monitors, Katei saw the first group approaching the event room. He had to act.
entries.new: 时间飞快逼近，他已经没机会回员工室了。他强压心绪，把录音笔也藏了起来。那东西个头不小，芦屋那边若仔细搜查，或许能找到，但 SD 卡不会——这才是关键。{w} 透过监视器，Katei 看见第一批人正走向活动室。他必须行动了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Even though nobody was seeing him, he approached the hallway nonchalantly. During the previous days, he'd kept coming up with good excuses to get out of the security room at that time.
entries.new: 尽管没人看着他，他还是若无其事地走向走廊。前几天，他一直在为那个时间点离开监控室编造合理的借口。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Hallway A was empty, but as soon as Katei entered it, so did someone else. From the lobby came a man with long hair who he'd never seen before.{w} Paying no attention to Katei, he walked forward.
entries.new: A走廊空无一人，可 Katei 刚走进去，就有另一个人也进了走廊。从大厅方向走来一个长发男人，他从未见过。{w} 那人看都没看 Katei，径直向前走去。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Behind the handrails, Katei knew the grenades were concealed. However, he couldn't look at them because that footage was going to be reviewed.
entries.new: Katei 知道栏杆后面藏着烟雾弹。可他不能朝那边看，因为这段录像之后会被人查看。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Katei couldn't get distracted. Keeping his expression natural, he stepped into the lobby.
entries.new: Katei 不能分神。他表情自然地迈步走进大厅。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The room was full of people. All the visitors formed a line behind hallway B, while police officers conversed with Ashiya's guard.{w} Dote and Asfu, Katei's co-workers, greeted him with a smile. Their job was to uncover the cabinets in most of the crystal rooms, but they knew very few people there that day wanted to see those.
entries.new: 大厅里挤满了人。参观者都在B走廊后排队，警察则与芦屋的警卫交谈。{w} Katei 的同事 Dote 和 Asfu 笑着向他打招呼。他们的职责是揭开大部分水晶展室的展示柜，但他们知道今天在场的人里，几乎没有谁想看那些东西。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: One more person reacted to Katei's arrival: the janitor. However, only Katei noticed it, as Ido looked away immediately.
entries.new: 还有一个人对 Katei 的到来有所反应：那个清洁工。但只有 Katei 察觉到了，因为 Ido 立刻移开了目光。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: ...{w}Nobody was looking at him, and he didn't want to walk away from the door. As if waiting for the conversation to end, he stared at the police as they talked.
entries.new: ……{w}没有人看着他，他也不想离开门边。他盯着交谈中的警察，像是在等那番对话结束。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Katei's plan wasn't guaranteed to work, but he wasn't at risk. Once the smoke was released, the chance to step back into the hallway might not have existed. If someone gestured at Katei to evacuate, he couldn't turn around.{w} However, it didn't matter; he wouldn't be blamed for the attack, and Xyn's plan would still fail. Furthermore, he could attempt to sneak away outside and then reenter the building through the storeroom anyway.
entries.new: Katei 的计划未必成功，但他本人不会有危险。烟雾一旦释放，他也许就再没机会回到走廊里了。要是有人示意他撤离，他就不能回头。{w} 不过这无所谓；袭击不会算到他头上，Xyn 的计划照样会失败。再说，他大可以先悄悄溜到外面，再从储藏室绕回楼里。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The time passed faster than Katei had imagined. All of a sudden, he noticed the light in hallway A disappear.
entries.new: 时间过得比 Katei 预想的快。忽然间，他注意到A走廊的灯光消失了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Wh-What's this!?
entries.new: 这、这是什么！？
entries.speaker: nn

entries.text: Smoke! Something happened in the hallway!
entries.new: 烟雾！走廊里出事了！
entries.speaker: nn

entries.text: Someone opened the door in front of the crowd. In an instant, a plume of smoke invaded the lobby, and the door was forcibly shut again.
entries.new: 有人当着众人的面推开了门。刹那间，一股浓烟涌入大厅，门又被强行关上。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: It's in both hallways!
entries.new: 两条走廊都有！
entries.speaker: nn
