entries.text: Erina's voice sounded concerned, and I knew why. Isla's right hand was a fist; she was holding something.{w} But she shook her head in fear.
entries.new: Erina 的声音里透着担忧，我知道缘由。Isla 的右手握成拳，手里攥着什么。{w}可她却害怕地摇了摇头。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Come on, open it. What do you have there?
entries.new: 来，张开手。你手里是什么？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Erina had told us about it: during the two weeks before the event, Isla had sometimes hidden something in her fist. It appeared that had been Isla's friend, who still refused to open her hand.
entries.new: Erina 曾跟我们提过：事件前的两周里，Isla 有时会把什么东西攥在拳头里。看来她攥着的正是她的那位朋友——可即便如此，她仍旧不肯张开手。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: However, Isla's remaining strength was negligible. Erina gently forced her hand open until we saw her palm.
entries.new: 然而 Isla 已没剩下多少力气。Erina 轻轻掰开她的手，露出了掌心。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wet from her tears, her fingertip had a {tip=burn3}burn{/tip}.
entries.new: 她的指尖沾着泪水，上面有一处{tip=burn3}灼伤{/tip}。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wh-What is this...?
entries.new: 这、这是怎么回事……？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: I don't know... but it doesn't hurt...
entries.new: 我不知道……可是不疼……
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: Did you get burned? When?
entries.new: 你是被烫到了吗？什么时候？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Isla didn't reply. It didn't seem like she was sure.
entries.new: Isla 没有回答。她自己似乎也说不准。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Isla, I believe that it's January 5th, but please tell us why you're here. What happened to you?
entries.new: Isla，我相信今天是 1 月 5 日，但请你告诉我们，你为什么在这里。你身上发生了什么？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: It was clear nobody wanted to question why she was alive; no matter the answer, it had to be the Sekimeiya's doing.
entries.new: 显然，没有人想追问她为什么还活着；无论答案是什么，那都只能是 Sekimeiya 的手笔。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I...{w} I followed her steps.
entries.new: 我……{w}我是跟着她的脚步来的。
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: Her steps...?
entries.new: 她的脚步……？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Th-There was a hidden door outside. That's how I entered th-the storeroom.
entries.new: 外、外面有一扇暗门。我就是从那儿进了储、储藏室。
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: Wait, what!?{w} Is that door open!?
entries.new: 等等，什么！？{w}那扇门开着吗！？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: N-No. It clo—
entries.new: 没、没有。它关——
entries.speaker: il

entries.text: Before she could finish, Sai and Akaro ran out of the room. Then, even Erina hurried to pick Isla up and leave. They were all going straight to the door to see if they could open it.
entries.new: 她话还没说完，Sai 和 Akaro 就冲出了房间。紧接着，连 Erina 也匆匆抱起 Isla 离开。他们全都径直赶往那扇门，看能不能打开它。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Once again, I was the only one left behind, trying to get to a final thought.
entries.new: 又一次，只剩我一个人留在原地，努力想得出一个最终结论。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Isla followed "her steps"... and she thought Shiroya had to be here. Does that mean Shiroya recently entered from the storeroom?
entries.new: Isla 跟着「她的脚步」……而且认定 Shiroya 一定在这里。这么说，Shiroya 最近是从储藏室进来的？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Wait a second...{w} I might understand our misconception.{w} Somehow, we traveled days into the future, and the shutter was still here. That's what led us to think it never opened.
entries.new: 等等……{w}我大概明白我们错在哪里了。{w}不知怎么，我们穿越到了几天之后，而闸门还留在原处。我们因此以为它从没打开过。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: That's not it, though...! It actually opened minutes after we vanished from the 15th.{w} Long after that, it was closed again. That's why the security room is locked and the elevator isn't working. Those are the alarm's effects—we were trapped for a second time. That's why the corpses are gone!
entries.new: 可事实并非如此……！其实就在我们从 15 日消失几分钟后，它打开过。{w}很久之后，它才再次关闭。所以监控室才锁着，电梯也不动了。这都是警报造成的——我们第二次被困在了里面。尸体不见了也是因为这个！
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: This means the exit should still unlock within twelve hours... But will it be that easy...? Will we be allowed to leave this time?
entries.new: 也就是说，出口应该还是会在十二小时内解锁……可会这么顺利吗……？这一次，我们会被允许离开吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Why are the lights off, though? Why was nobody in the security room? Why was the attic unlocked? And why was the alarm activated again?
entries.new: 可是为什么灯是灭的？为什么监控室里没有人？为什么阁楼没锁？还有，为什么警报又启动了？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Why did we travel days into the future? Why didn't it feel like we traveled? Why did Shiroya enter the tower on January 5th?
entries.new: 我们为什么会穿越到几天之后？为什么一点穿越的感觉都没有？Shiroya 为什么会在 1 月 5 日进入塔里？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: We arrived on this day when, from our point of view, the lights went off. The alarm was activated before then, so it felt as if the shutter never withdrew...
entries.new: 我们觉得自己是在灯光熄灭的那一刻来到这一天的。警报在此之前就已启动，所以感觉就像闸门从未升起过……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: When? What's the deadline this time?
entries.new: 什么时候？这次截止到什么时候？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: And was it Shiroya? Whoever it was, they were here recently.
entries.new: 还有，那人是 Shiroya 吗？不管是谁，那个人最近确实来过这里。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...{w}Hm. Someone had to be here.
entries.new: ……{w}唔。一定有人来过这里。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Oh.{w} I know when it happened! I can't believe I didn't realize it, but it happened immediately before our arrival on this day!
entries.new: 啊。{w}我知道那是什么时候了！真不敢相信我居然没意识到——那件事就发生在我们抵达这一天的前一刻！
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Someone had been there right as the group had appeared on January 5th.{w} Atsuki knew that thanks to the last time he'd been in...
entries.new: 就在一行人 1 月 5 日出现的那一刻，那里已经有人了。{w}Atsuki 之所以知道，是因为他上一次待在里面的时候……
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Not the lobby.
entries.new: 不是大厅。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Not the hallways.
entries.new: 也不是走廊。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: You realized it, didn't you?
entries.new: 你已经察觉了吧？
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Not the attic.
entries.new: 也不是阁楼。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: I was so overwhelmed that I didn't notice it. When I went to the event room...
entries.new: 我那时太慌乱了，根本没注意到。我去活动室的时候……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: "The room was cold. Had Shiroya run to get the Sekimeiya? I carefully walked to the cabinet, moved aside the curtain, and tried to open the glass."
entries.new: 「房间里很冷。Shiroya 是跑去拿 Sekimeiya 了吗？我小心地走到展示柜前，拨开遮布，试着打开玻璃。」
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: "It should've been locked, but it wasn't. The glass was partially open, and I could put my hand inside."
entries.new: 「它本该是锁着的，却没有。玻璃半开着，我可以把手伸进去。」
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: "I felt the Sekimeiya's surface and confirmed it was still there."
entries.new: 「我摸了摸 Sekimeiya 的表面，确认它还在里面。」
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I only realized the Sekimeiya was in the cabinet when I felt it! That means it wasn't glowing!
entries.new: 我是摸到之后，才发现 Sekimeiya 就在展示柜里！也就是说，它当时没有发光！
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Although it was kept cold, the Sekimeiya was powered off. It had been used moments prior!{w} How can it be that it was powered off within the cabinet? When the cold hit it, it always regained its glow immediately.{w} The glass was partly open, cooling down the whole room. Was it due to that single detail?{w} Or was it something else? If I'm not mistaken, the longer the travel, the longer the Sekimeiya spends powered off...
entries.new: 虽然一直被冷藏，Sekimeiya 却处于断电状态。它不久前刚被用过！{w}怎么会在展示柜里就断了电？每次一遇冷，它总会立刻重新亮起。{w}玻璃半开着，整个房间都冷了下来。是因为这个吗？{w}还是另有原因？如果我没记错，穿越的时间跨度越长，Sekimeiya 断电的时间就越久……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I'd been under the impression that using the Sekimeiya would be futile; I hadn't known that the shutter wouldn't be there in the past, so I'd figured traveling through time would only make a bigger mess of things.
entries.new: 我一直以为使用 Sekimeiya 也无济于事；我不知道过去并没有那道卷帘门，所以认定时间穿越只会把事情搅得更乱。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I didn't know what I had to do in order to travel forward in time, but if I simply traveled enough time back to appear before our arrival, I could meet the person who had secretly trapped us in January.
entries.new: 我不知道该怎么穿越到未来，但只要往回穿越得足够远，回到我们抵达之前，就能见到那个在一月暗中把我们困住的人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I walked out of the bedroom.{w} Everyone else had already gone down.
entries.new: 我走出卧室。{w}其他人都已经下楼了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I left through the staircase and went around the sixth floor by hugging the right wall.
entries.new: 我从楼梯间出去，贴着右侧墙壁绕行六楼。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Attentively walking through the darkness, I reached the crystal floor.{w} I heard knocks and voices coming from the storeroom; it appeared Isla hadn't thought to keep the door open. Perhaps she hadn't been aware of the missing handle.{w} Without making a sound, I slowly tiptoed to the event room.
entries.new: 我小心地穿过黑暗，来到水晶层。{w}储藏室那边传来敲击声和人声；看来 Isla 没想到要让门开着。也许她并不知道门把手不见了。{w}我悄无声息，慢慢踮脚走向活动室。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The air was still cold, and when I raised the curtain, the Sekimeiya's glow appeared before me.
entries.new: 空气依旧寒冷。我掀起帘子，Sekimeiya 的光芒便出现在眼前。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It's still here... I'm a little surprised.
entries.new: 它还在……我有点意外。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: The glass wasn't closed, so I could reach it easily. Without directly touching it, I took the Sekimeiya out.
entries.new: 玻璃没有合上，我很容易就够到了。我没有直接碰到它，就这样把 Sekimeiya 取了出来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I just want to go a little while back. It should be simple.{w} This room is pretty cold, so it might not be a good idea to stay here if I want the Sekimeiya to gather energy.
entries.new: 我只想回到不久之前。这应该很简单。{w}这房间太冷了，想让 Sekimeiya 积蓄能量的话，待在这里恐怕不合适。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I walked to the hallway and entered room B5, which wasn't in range of the lower temperature. Then, I left the gemstone on the floor.
entries.new: 我走到走廊，进了 B5 展室——那里不在低温波及的范围内。随后我把宝石放在了地上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: With how dark it is, even if the others search for me, I'll be hard to find.
entries.new: 光线这么暗，就算其他人来找我，也很难发现我。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: The lights went off when Sai's watch read {time=21:03.} I need to arrive before that point, and now his watch must say almost {time=21:20.}{w} I need to leave the Sekimeiya here...
entries.new: Sai 的手表显示 {time=21:03.} 时，灯灭了。我必须在那之前抵达，而现在他的表应该快到 {time=21:20.} 了。{w}我得把 Sekimeiya 留在这里……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: If I wait for 10 minutes, I doubt I'll be able to go back 30 minutes at {time=21:30.}
entries.new: 如果等上 10 分钟，到 {time=21:30.} 时，我恐怕没法回到 30 分钟前。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: If I wait for 15 minutes, I doubt I'll be able to go back 35 minutes at {time=21:35.}
entries.new: 如果等上 15 分钟，到 {time=21:35.} 时，我恐怕没法回到 35 分钟前。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: If I wait for 20 minutes, I doubt I'll be able to go back 40 minutes at {time=21:40.}
entries.new: 如果等上 20 分钟，到 {time=21:40.} 时，我恐怕没法回到 40 分钟前。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: 35 minutes is probably too much.
entries.new: 35 分钟大概太多了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I'd say for about 25 minutes, so that at {time=21:45} I can travel 45 minutes back. I think that's it, based on all the travels, and especially everything that I just learned.{w} I don't have a way to measure the time by myself, though.
entries.new: 我看等 25 分钟左右正好，这样到 {time=21:45} 时，我就能回到 45 分钟前。根据之前所有的穿越，尤其是刚刚弄明白的这些，我想就是这样。{w}只是我没法自己计时。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Hm...{w} I can't measure the real time, but I might have a way to measure minutes.
entries.new: 嗯……{w}我没法知道确切时间，但或许有办法数分钟。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: The security room is locked, so I don't think there's anything on the crystal floor that isn't Sai's watch. There are a bunch of computers on the office floors, but I need access information to look at the time.{w} I can only think of the kitchen in the attic.{w} The refrigerator was working, so the oven should be too. There's still electricity, so I should be able to count the minutes that pass with that.
entries.new: 监控室锁着，水晶层上除了 Sai 的手表，我想不出还有什么能看时间。办公楼层倒是有一堆电脑，可要查看时间就得有登录信息。{w}我能想到的就只有阁楼的厨房了。{w}冰箱还在运转，烤箱应该也没问题。电还没断，用它来数分钟应该可行。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Faint voices were still coming from the storeroom. Like before, I ascended the stairs without making noise.
entries.new: 储藏室那边仍隐约传来说话声。和先前一样，我悄无声息地上了楼梯。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I arrived at the kitchen and kneeled in front of the oven. When I pressed the "on" button, a round light lit up red.
entries.new: 我来到厨房，在烤箱前跪下。按下「on」键后，一枚圆形指示灯随即亮起红光。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I set the lowest possible temperature and rotated the timer toward 22 minutes. Immediately, a quiet buzz indicated that it had begun to count down.
entries.new: 我把温度调到最低，又将定时器拧到 22 分钟。紧接着一阵轻微的嗡鸣响起，表示它已经开始倒计时。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I closed the door and walked back to the bedroom, where I lay on the same bed.
entries.new: 我关上门，回到卧室，躺回同一张床上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Unless the Sekimeiya's found, this should work. I'll come across whoever set this up, and most importantly, I'll appear before the alarm does anything.
entries.new: 只要 Sekimeiya 没被人发现，这计划应该能成。我会碰上设下这一切的人，而最重要的是，我会赶在警报响起之前现身。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Was I going against Shiroya's wishes? I couldn't care anymore. If it was her, I needed to know why she'd done everything.
entries.new: 我这是在违背 Shiroya 的意愿吗？可我已经不在乎了。如果那个人真是她，我必须知道她为什么要做这一切。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I didn't let myself fall asleep. A number of minutes had passed, and nobody had come back up.
entries.new: 我没让自己睡着。好几分钟过去了，始终没人上楼来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I reentered the kitchen. Less than two minutes remained on the timer.
entries.new: 我再次走进厨房。定时器上只剩下不到两分钟。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: In front of the oven, I watched the indicator rotate until it finished with a beep.
entries.new: 我守在烤箱前，看着指示盘一圈圈转动，直到它「嘀」的一声走到终点。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I can go now.
entries.new: 现在可以走了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I pressed the "off" button and went down the stairs.
entries.new: 我按下「off」键，走下楼梯。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Two floors down, I stopped abruptly. The others were making their way up.{w} I took a step aside and hushed my breathing. Unaware that I was there, they passed me by.
entries.new: 下了两层，我猛地停住脚步。其他人正往上走。{w}我侧身让到一旁，屏住呼吸。他们没察觉到我，就从我身旁经过。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Once the sounds of their movement had faded, I kept going down.
entries.new: 等他们的动静渐渐远去，我才继续下楼。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The Sekimeiya was still behind room B5's door.{w} I felt it through my sleeve and instantly determined that it had built up considerable energy. I had to quickly withdraw my hand to avoid harm.
entries.new: Sekimeiya 还在 B5 展室的门后。{w}隔着袖子，我立刻感觉到它已经积蓄了相当多的能量。为了不被伤到，我赶紧把手缩了回来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: This should be enough, but I wonder if it'll work as I want it to.
entries.new: 这些应该够了，只是不知道能不能如我所愿。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I was certain 25 minutes had passed since I'd taken it out of the cabinet. Without hesitation, I rapidly forced my hand through the wall of heat until I contacted the smooth stone.
entries.new: 我确信，从把它从展示柜里取出来算起，已经过去了 25 分钟。我不再犹豫，把手迅速探进那堵热墙，直到触到光滑的石面。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...{w}Did I... change places?
entries.new: ……{w}我……换了个地方？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I spun; the darkness around me was identical.
entries.new: 我转过身，四周的黑暗毫无二致。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wait! The shutter isn't here!
entries.new: 等等！卷帘门不在了！
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I stared in awe. I could see a streetlight within the night, illuminating the snow around it. I was in the lobby of the tower; a light from the reception desk confirmed that.
entries.new: 我愕然地望着。夜色中能看见一盏路灯，照亮了周围的雪。我身处塔的大厅——接待台透出的灯光证实了这一点。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It did work...! The alarm hasn't gone off yet!
entries.new: 成功了……！警报还没响！
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: However, when I tried to open the door, it was still locked. I had also been assaulted by a wave of tiredness and wished to lie down.{w} Suddenly, a sharp sound echoed in my ears. ...Had it come from hallway B?
entries.new: 然而，我试着开门时，门依旧锁着。同时一阵强烈的倦意袭来，让我只想躺下。{w}忽然，一声锐响在耳边回荡。……是从 B 走廊传来的吗？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Someone's there.
entries.new: 有人在那儿。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Was it Shiroya? Slowly, I moved closer.
entries.new: 是 Shiroya 吗？我慢慢靠近。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...{w}I stopped still. No sound could be heard anymore.{w} I didn't know what to do, and I was more than a little afraid. If that was the person who'd killed everyone, I was finally in real danger—the recording had guaranteed my safety for a long time, but it had become a past event, and the promise of my well-being had expired.
entries.new: ……{w}我僵在原地。四周再听不到任何声响。{w}我不知所措，心里不止一点害怕。如果那就是杀死了所有人的凶手，我终于真正身处险境了——那段录音曾在很长一段时间里保证我的安全，可它已经成了过去的事，那份保我平安的承诺也早已失效。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Huh?{w} What...?
entries.new: 咦？{w}什么……？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Though I couldn't see it, I looked at my hand. It hadn't hurt for a while, but it was where I'd suffered a painful injury in the elevator.
entries.new: 虽然什么也看不见，我还是看向自己的手。它已经不疼一阵子了，可那正是我在电梯里受了重伤的地方。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Amazed, I opened and closed it in succession. I could feel the injury was gone.
entries.new: 我惊讶地反复握了握。能感觉到伤已经不见了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Why...? I traveled to the past with it before, and it didn't disappear!
entries.new: 为什么……？我以前也用它穿越到过去，伤却没有消失啊！
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It must've had to do with the replicated location, but my attention was again taken by resuming footsteps.
entries.new: 这大概跟那个被复制出来的地点有关，但重新响起的脚步声又把我的注意力拉了回来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Are they Shiroya's...?
entries.new: 那是 Shiroya 她们的……？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I couldn't deny it, but I wasn't sure either.
entries.new: 我无法否认，可也不敢确定。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I think they just entered the event room. ...Are they planning to travel through time? The alarm will probably be activated from there.
entries.new: 她们好像刚进了活动室。……难道打算时间穿越？警报多半会从那里被触发。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I'm not sure what the best course of action is. Should I change the past to prevent the alarm from going off? That could be dangerous.
entries.new: 该怎么做才最好，我也拿不准。要不要改变过去，阻止警报响起？那样做可能很危险。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I could hear faint sounds, but I couldn't make them out. Trying to quickly come to a conclusion, I waited helplessly from a distance.
entries.new: 隐约能听见些声响，却辨不出内容。我想尽快得出结论，结果却只能无计可施地远远等着。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Oh, wait...!
entries.new: 啊，等等……！
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: If this is Shiroya, she came in from the storeroom! Isla seemed like she entered the tower by following her steps.{w} If Isla was able to enter from the outside, the door was open. I might be able to leave right now...!
entries.new: 如果这是 Shiroya，那她就是从储藏室进来的！Isla 似乎就是顺着她的踪迹进了塔。{w} 既然 Isla 能从外面进来，说明那扇门开着。我现在说不定就能出去……！
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I tried not to panic. Freedom was potentially in reach, but I couldn't let myself be noticed.
entries.new: 我努力不让自己慌起来。自由也许近在眼前，但我绝不能被人察觉。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Fuck! That's the alarm!
entries.new: 该死！是警报！
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: A loud sound came from behind me. When I turned around, I saw the streetlight beyond the glass disappearing. The shutter was beginning to cover it, and before I knew it, it was no longer visible.
entries.new: 身后传来一声巨响。我回过头，只见玻璃外的路灯正在消失。卷帘门缓缓将它遮住，转眼便再也看不见了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: No, it doesn't matter! It's not gonna lock the other exit!
entries.new: 不，不要紧！另一个出口不会被锁上的！
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I stepped back, placing my feet on the floor as slowly as I could. Then, feeling the wall, I walked to the next door.
entries.new: 我向后退去，尽可能放轻脚步落地。随后摸着墙壁，走向下一扇门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Hallway A extended beyond me. Was the other person still there? I couldn't hear anything.
entries.new: A 走廊在我前方延伸。那个人还在吗？我什么都听不见。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I didn't want to run in case the door was closed. I stepped to the left wall and walked as I counted the rooms.
entries.new: 我怕门是关着的，所以不敢跑。我靠到左墙边，一边数着房间一边往前走。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: One,{w=0.6} two,{w=0.6} three,{w=0.6} four,{w=0.6} five.
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: This one has to be the storeroom's! It's not even closed!
entries.new: 这扇肯定就是储藏室的！居然连关都没关！
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: When I looked through it, I saw a light. It was very faint, but it illuminated the narrow walls slightly.
entries.new: 透过门缝望去，里面有光。那光十分微弱，却稍稍照亮了狭窄的四壁。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Are those... the stars...?
entries.new: 那是……星星……？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Sheer Intent
entries.new: 纯粹意志

entries.text: What?
entries.new: 什么？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: No way.
entries.new: 不可能。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: A-Atsuki...?
entries.new: A-Atsuki……？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: H—
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: From behind, I heard a voice that made me jump.
entries.new: 身后传来一个声音，吓了我一跳。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: You...!
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: It was her, wearing clothes I hadn't seen in a long time.
entries.new: 是她，身上穿着我许久未见的衣服。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: A-Are you Shiroya...?
entries.new: 你、你是 Shiroya……？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: What? Y-Yes. Where are we? I just appeared here.
entries.new: 什么？是、是我。这是什么地方？我刚才突然就出现在这儿了。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Both of us just appeared here? The Sekimeiya was activated, and the range reached to the storeroom...
entries.new: 我们两个都是突然出现在这里的？Sekimeiya 被激活，范围一直延伸到了储藏室……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Hold on, isn't that...?
entries.new: 等等，那不就是……？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Behind her was the hallway B door, and on its edges was the dark outline caused by the smoke. However, it didn't look dry yet.
entries.new: 她身后是通往 B走廊的门，门边留着一圈被烟熏出的黑色痕迹。可那痕迹看上去还没干透。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: W-Wait, that...
entries.new: 等、等等，那个……
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: She looked back and realized the same. And most of the ceiling lights were off, like they had been in the morning...
entries.new: 她回头一看，也察觉到了同样的事。而且天花板上的灯大半都熄着，和早上那时一样……
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...It's the smoke, right?
entries.new: ……是烟雾吧？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Y-Yes, but doesn't it look different?
entries.new: 是、是的，可你不觉得样子不太一样吗？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: What...?
entries.new: 什么……？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: I'm not sure where we are. I just appeared here too.
entries.new: 我也不清楚这是哪儿。我也是突然出现在这里的。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Could we have been back at the beginning? Before asking anything else, I got closer to the hallway.{w} A sound from the other side caused me to stop; a door had closed.
entries.new: 难道我们回到了最初？我还没来得及多问，便朝走廊走近。{w} 对面传来一声响，我立刻停住——有扇门关上了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It seemed like nobody was coming, so I slowly continued until I gripped the knob. Then, when I looked through the door, a dark plume clouded my vision.
entries.new: 似乎没人过来，我便慢慢向前，直到握住门把手。透过门缝望去，一团黑雾模糊了视线。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Oh, fuck. Don't breathe.
entries.new: 操。别吸气。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Wh-What...?
entries.new: 什、什么……？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Erina, Isla, and Sai were on the floor. It was the start of the incident.
entries.new: Erina、Isla 和 Sai 倒在地上。事件就是从这一刻开始的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I couldn't believe it. I'd been so close to escaping, but it hadn't been permitted. I had no idea what was ahead of me anymore, but the tower held me in its grip like a python.{w} I lowered my head and saw my own hand. Exposed to the light, I could see the injury was still gone.{w} Then, I noticed something else—I wasn't hungry or tired anymore. Those sensations had also disappeared.
entries.new: 我简直无法相信。明明只差一步就能逃出去，却终究没能如愿。前方还会发生什么，我全然不知，而这座塔像蟒蛇一样死死缠住我。{w} 我低下头，看见自己的手。在光下，那道伤依然不见踪影。{w} 接着我又发现了一件事——我不再饥饿，也不再疲惫。那些感觉同样消失了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: A-Are we on the morning of the 15th?
entries.new: 我、我们是在15日的早上？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: I turned around warily. Shiroya was there, but I still felt that something about her was different. She didn't feel like the person I'd entered the tower with.
entries.new: 我警惕地转过身。Shiroya 就在那里，可我总觉得她有些不对劲。她不像那个和我一起进塔的人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Are you really Shiroya? The real one?
entries.new: ……你真的是 Shiroya？本人？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: What does that mean...!? Who else would I be?
entries.new: 这话什么意思……！？我还能是谁？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: ...What do you remember? Please, tell me everything.
entries.new: ……你记得些什么？拜托，全都告诉我。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: What!? I-I don't know what you mean! We got trapped here, and a bunch of things happened!
entries.new: 什么！？我、我不明白你在说什么！我们被困在这儿，出了好多事！
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: What happened? How did you end up here?
entries.new: 出了什么事？你怎么会到这儿来？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: H-Huh? A lot of things! Do you remember everything? Late into the day, we were in the lobby, and I went to the bathroom. There, I activated the Sekimeiya and appeared on the 30th of November, below that gem shop.{w} Then... a few days later, I entered the tower and touched the Sekimeiya. That's how I just appeared here.
entries.new: 啊？很、很多事！你全都记得吗？那天很晚了，我们在大厅，我去了洗手间。就在那儿，我启动了 Sekimeiya，出现在11月30日，那家宝石店的下方。{w}然后……过了几天，我进了塔，碰到了 Sekimeiya。于是就到了这里。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: W-Wait, that's all...? What about appearing after you'd gone to the bathroom? Do you remember that?
entries.new: 等、等等，就这些……？那你上完洗手间之后突然现身那件事呢？你记得吗？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: What? N-No...? I found the Sekimeiya in the toilet's water tank and went a long way into the past.
entries.new: 什么？不、不记得……？我在马桶的水箱里找到了 Sekimeiya，然后回到了很久以前。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: ...{w}Are you really... the real Shiroya? I don't really understand what you're telling me.
entries.new: ……{w}你真的是……Shiroya本人吗？你说的话我实在听不明白。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: She gave me a disoriented stare, as if she had no idea why I was so skeptical.
entries.new: 她茫然地看着我，似乎不明白我为什么这样怀疑。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wait a second. That sound from before was a door, right? It sounded like it came from the right wall.
entries.new: 等一下。刚才那声响是门吧？听起来是从右边那面墙传来的。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: ...I think so.
entries.new: ……我想是吧。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: It had to be that one, then.{w} That's where Naomi died and where I traveled for the first time. If the smoke was just released, someone might have just been there because it's where the temperature regulation cabinets are.
entries.new: 那就只能是那扇门了。{w}Naomi 就是在那儿死的，也是我第一次穿越时间的地方。如果烟雾是刚刚放出来的，那说不定有人刚去过那里——毕竟控温展示柜就放在那儿。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Were we really at the beginning, just like that? It didn't make any sense; if we had always been present, we would've been found on many occasions.{w} Were we going to change the past? I really wanted Shiroya to be telling the truth. If she was, we would get through everything, but I knew she had withheld the truth from me before.
entries.new: 我们真的就这么回到了最初？这说不通——如果我们一直都在，早就该被人撞见很多次了。{w}我们是要改变过去吗？我真心希望 Shiroya 说的是实话。如果她说的是真的，我们就能挺过一切；可我知道，她以前也瞒过我。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I think we just heard the culprit. I have no idea why we're here, but only a few people should be conscious at this time.
entries.new: 我想，我们刚才听到的就是犯人。为什么会在这里，我完全不清楚，但这个时间还醒着的人应该没几个。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I couldn't hesitate. The real culprit, the person who had removed the storeroom's handle, could have been present. Low to the ground, I scurried to the crystal room.{w} I turned to Shiroya, who was following me. At that point, I noticed something intriguing, but I couldn't stop there.
entries.new: 我不能犹豫。真正的犯人——那个卸下储藏室门把手的人——可能就在那里。我压低身子，快步溜向水晶展室。{w}我回头看向跟在身后的 Shiroya。那一刻，我注意到一件耐人寻味的事，却没法停下脚步。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We entered the room, and I closed the door behind us.
entries.new: 我们进了展室，我关上身后的门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Did you see the door to the lobby?
entries.new: 你看到通往大厅的门了吗？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: ...What about it?
entries.new: ……那扇门怎么了？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: We just left it open.
entries.new: 我们刚才走的时候没关。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Oh. Does that matter?
entries.new: 哦。有什么关系吗？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: You remember, right? When we met everyone else, Sai pointed out that it was open, and Katei said he did that. I'm pretty sure it looked exactly the way we just left it.
entries.new: 你还记得吧？我们和其他人会合时，Sai 说那扇门开着，Katei 则说那是他弄的。我敢肯定，当时那扇门的样子和我们刚才离开时一模一样。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: ...I see what you mean, but please answer one thing for me. Why are we here? Did something happen after I traveled to the past?
entries.new: ……我明白你的意思，不过请先回答我一件事。我们为什么会在这里？我回到过去之后，是不是出了什么事？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Are you telling me the truth? Do you not know what happened after?
entries.new: 你说的是真话？之后发生了什么，你真的不知道？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I don't...! I just told you. I appeared on the 30th of November.{w} I stayed at my apartment while my past self was in the hospital, and a few days later, I entered the tower.{w} I have no idea what happened there, though. The Sekimeiya was already in the cabinet, and I touched it since nobody was in the security room. After that, I appeared in the lobby with you. Now we're here.
entries.new: 我不知道……！我不是刚说了吗。我是在11月30日出现的。{w}过去的我住院时，我一直待在自己的公寓里；几天后，我进了芦屋塔。{w}不过塔里发生了什么，我完全不清楚。Sekimeiya 那时已经在展示柜里了，我见监控室里没人，就伸手碰了它。之后，我便和你一起出现在大厅里。再然后，就是现在这里。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: I didn't know what to think. While I was aware such lengthy travels were possible, what she was saying didn't sound right. Had she traveled to the future from early December? Why had we appeared at the same time, then?
entries.new: 我不知道该怎么想。我虽然知道跨越这么长时间的穿越是可能的，但她说的还是不太对劲。她是从 12 月初穿越到未来的吗？那我们又为什么会在同一时刻出现？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But it was impossible for me to think she was lying; her voice sounded as sincere as always.{w} When I'd activated the Sekimeiya from room B5... had I perhaps traveled to the first days of December?{w} I was stumped. If she was telling the truth, I couldn't explain what had happened to me.
entries.new: 可要我认定她在说谎，我做不到——她的声音一如既往地真诚。{w}当我在水晶展室 B5 启动 Sekimeiya 时……莫非我穿越到了 12 月初？{w}我陷入了困惑。如果她说的是真的，那我就无法解释自己身上发生的事。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wait, you said you traveled to the 30th? Did you try to save Miiya?
entries.new: 等等，你说你时间穿越到了30日？你试过去救 Miiya 吗？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I couldn't... I appeared too late for that, but I did change the past—
entries.new: 我没能……我出现得太晚，已经来不及了，但我确实改变了过去——
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: She cut herself off, as if doubting what she was saying.
entries.new: 她话说到一半就停住了，似乎对自己说的话也起了疑心。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'm trying to understand what you've said...
entries.new: 我在试着理解你说的这些话……
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Don't worry, even I don't understand anything of what I lived through. I'm not lying, though.
entries.new: 别担心，连我自己都搞不懂我经历的那些事。不过我没有撒谎。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: ...Then I'm not sure it would help if I told you what happened after you left.{w} Another version of you was there, but it wasn't you, right?
entries.new: ……那我不确定，告诉你你离开之后发生了什么，会不会有帮助。{w}当时还有另一个你也在场，但那不是你，对吧？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: N-No. I have no idea who that was.
entries.new: 不、不是的。我根本不知道那到底是谁。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Well, we weren't able to leave when the time came. I'm not sure what happened, why, or how, but the lights went off, and we couldn't get out.{w} ...You remember the recording, right?{w} It was real.
entries.new: 结果，时间一到，我们却没能离开。发生了什么、为什么会这样、又到底是怎么发生的，我都不清楚，但灯灭了，我们也出不去。{w}……你还记得那段录音吧？{w}那是真的。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Wait, what...?
entries.new: 等等，什么……？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Yes, it did happen. It wasn't a trick.{w} It still doesn't make any sense, though. I can't wrap my head around what happened.
entries.new: 对，那确实发生了。不是障眼法。{w}可我还是想不通。这件事我怎么想也想不明白。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: You said that you touched the Sekimeiya in the event room days before the 15th, right?
entries.new: 你说过，你在15日的几天前，在活动室碰过Sekimeiya，对吧？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Y-Yes.
entries.new: 是、是的。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: I see. What the fuck, then...? I don't get anything.{w} I thought I got caught up in your travel and both of us appeared in front of the hallway B door, the location where we were on the morning of the 15th.
entries.new: 我明白了。那他妈到底是怎么回事……？我完全搞不懂。{w}我本来以为，自己被卷进了你的时间穿越，两个人才会一起出现在B走廊门前——也就是15日早上我们所在的地方。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: But that makes no sense...! And look at my clothes, I wasn't wearing these on the 15th!
entries.new: 但这根本说不通……！而且你看看我的衣服，15日那天我穿的可不是这身！
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: You're right, actually. Were you wearing them when you touched the Sekimeiya?
entries.new: 说起来，你说得对。你碰 Sekimeiya 的时候，穿的就是这些吗？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: As she shook her head, my attention was grabbed by a cabinet I recognized.
entries.new: 她摇了摇头，而我的目光被一个熟悉的展示柜吸引了过去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...That's where the Sekimeiya was, right?
entries.new: ……Sekimeiya 原本就放在那里，对吧？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Yes, and look at the wheel.
entries.new: 对，而且你看看那个转轮。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: It's set to be cold... Oh, and it's not damaged yet. Wasn't this the one with a crack?
entries.new: 温度设得很低……哦，而且它还没损坏。这个不就是有裂痕的那个吗？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Yes... it was.
entries.new: 是啊……就是它。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I unlocked its lid, and both of us looked inside.
entries.new: 我打开了锁，掀开盖子，我们两人一起朝里面看。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wh-What?{w} I...{w} don't get it.
entries.new: 什、什么？{w}我……{w=0.4}不明白。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: The Sekimeiya was there.
entries.new: Sekimeiya 就在里面。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Someone left it in here.
entries.new: 有人把它留在了这里。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Yes, which is what I don't get. When we woke up, it was in the event room, still in its cabinet.
entries.new: 对，这正是我想不通的地方。我们醒来的时候，它明明还在活动室的展示柜里。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: You're... right.
entries.new: 你……说得对。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: I took the Sekimeiya out. Although the cabinet had been set to 0 °C, it wasn't cold, likely because it had been recently set. In contrast, the Sekimeiya was burning, forcing me to double layer the cloth of my sleeves.
entries.new: 我把 Sekimeiya 取了出来。展示柜的设定温度是 0 °C，柜内却一点也不冷，大概是刚设好不久的缘故。反倒是 Sekimeiya 烫得厉害，我只好把袖子的布料叠了两层。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It's set to 0 °C, but the cabinet isn't cold at all.
entries.new: 温度设的是 0 °C，可展示柜一点也不冷。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: It could've been set just now, so it didn't have enough time to cool off.
entries.new: 也可能是刚刚才设好的，所以还没来得及变冷。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: God, the Sekimeiya is burning, though...!
entries.new: 天哪，Sekimeiya 却烫得厉害……！
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Shiroya reached out to me, and I reflexively jumped back a bit. She didn't do anything, however.
entries.new: Shiroya 朝我伸出手，我下意识往后缩了一下。她却并没有做什么。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Sorry, when I touched it in the bathroom, its surroundings were incredibly hot. ...I can feel the heat, but it's nothing like then.{w} Do you know more about how the Sekimeiya works?
entries.new: 抱歉，我在浴室里碰到它的时候，它周围烫得吓人。……现在也能感觉到热，但和那时完全不能比。{w} 关于 Sekimeiya 的原理，你还知道些什么吗？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: I know nothing, and even less with what you've told me.
entries.new: 我什么都不知道，听你这么一说，反倒更糊涂了。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: It's working, so if we're really at the start of the incident, wouldn't touching it put us outside?
entries.new: 它现在有反应了。如果我们真的回到了事件刚开始的时候，碰它一下，不就能把我们送到外面去吗？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: M-Maybe. That's what I was thinking. It should be hot enough for that.
entries.new: 也、也许吧。我也是这么想的。热度应该够得上。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Once again, the chance to escape had appeared right in front of me. Was it finally a genuine opportunity?
entries.new: 逃脱的机会又一次出现在眼前。这一次，难道终于是真的？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Let's touch it.
entries.new: 碰一下吧。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: I nodded and got close to her. Slowly, my hand reached for the Sekimeiya in defiance of the burning aura around it.{w} However, the instant I contacted the gemstone, it vanished.
entries.new: 我点点头，凑近她身边。手顶着那股灼人的热浪，慢慢伸向 Sekimeiya。{w} 可就在指尖触到宝石的一瞬间，它消失了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Huh?
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: The Sekimeiya wasn't there anymore. We hadn't appeared anywhere else either, as I could still feel the burn on my fingers.
entries.new: Sekimeiya 已经不在那里了。我们也没有出现在别的地方——指尖的灼痛还留着。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Th-This is what happened before. It teleported, and we didn't travel.
entries.new: 这、这就是之前发生过的事。它传送走了，我们却没有穿越。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Oh.
entries.new: 这样啊。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: I couldn't believe it. All we wanted was to leave that place, but it was a hope constantly rebuilt only to be repeatedly crushed.
entries.new: 我简直不敢相信。我们一心只想离开这里，可这份希望总是一次次重新燃起，又一次次被碾碎。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wait, n-no... I-It can't be that.
entries.new: 等等，不、不对……不、不可能是那样。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: I followed Shiroya's eyes and almost fell back from the shock. The cabinet was shut, and the curtain neatly covered it again.
entries.new: 我顺着 Shiroya 的目光看去，惊得差点向后跌倒。展示柜已经合上，遮布也重新整整齐齐地遮住了它。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wh-What the fuck...? It didn't fall, right?
entries.new: 搞、搞什么……？它没掉下来吧？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: She denied it; the cabinet had closed without making a sound.{w} Could we have traveled back in time to a point before I'd unlocked it? In that case, why hadn't we teleported?
entries.new: 她摇头否认——展示柜是无声无息地合上的。{w} 难道我们穿越到了我打开它之前？可那样的话，为什么没有被传送？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Suddenly, we turned to the door. Someone was running through the hallway.
entries.new: 忽然，我们齐齐转向门口。有人正从走廊上跑过。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: As they did, we ran to grab the doorknob.
entries.new: 我们当即冲过去抓住门把。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: A bit of smoke remained in the air, and nobody could be seen. It didn't seem like we'd gone to the past.
entries.new: 空气里还残留着些许烟雾，视野中空无一人。看来我们并没有回到过去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: However, those rapid footsteps were still audible in the distance. It had to be the person responsible for our imprisonment...!{w} We ran behind the sound, covering our faces.
entries.new: 可是远处仍能听见那急促的脚步声。那一定就是把我们关在这里的人……！{w} 我们掩住脸，循着声音追了上去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: They had gone up the stairs, and the gray door was unlocked. We went up, hearing the echoing steps far ahead. If they were going to the attic, we couldn't slow down.
entries.new: 对方上了楼梯，那扇灰门没有上锁。我们跟上去，远远听着回荡的脚步声。如果那人要去阁楼，我们就不能慢下来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: When we got to the sixth floor, the crack of a door closing resounded through the air. We hadn't been fast enough.
entries.new: 我们赶到六楼时，一声关门声在空中回荡。我们还是慢了一步。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Damn it...!
entries.new: 可恶……！
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: As expected, the attic door was locked.{w} Had it been Naomi? She was the one with the key.
entries.new: 果然，阁楼的门锁上了。{w} 是 Naomi 吗？钥匙在她手上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Frustrated, I looked at Shiroya, who had a key in her hand.
entries.new: 我懊恼地看向 Shiroya，却见她手里正拿着一把钥匙。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What...!? Why do you have it!?
entries.new: 什么……！？你怎么会有这个！？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I... don't know... I found it when I entered the tower, in the mechanical room. I found the rusty key in a drawer in the security room as well, but... how is it possible I still have them when my clothes completely changed?
entries.new: 我……不知道……这是我进塔的时候，在机械室里找到的。生锈的钥匙也是在监控室的抽屉里找到的，可是……我的衣服明明全变了，这两样东西怎么还会在我身上？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: I frowned along with her, as it sounded unbelievable. She hurried to unlock the door and revealed the narrow staircase.
entries.new: 我也跟着皱起眉，这话实在难以置信。她急忙开了门，露出里面狭窄的楼梯。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Barely any light illuminated the steps. Following Shiroya, I began to silently ascend them.
entries.new: 台阶上几乎没有光。我跟在 Shiroya 身后，无声地往上走。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: When she reached the top, Shiroya peeked through the small gap between the door and wall.{w} Then, she turned to me.
entries.new: 到了顶端，Shiroya 从门与墙之间的细缝往里窥看。{w} 随后，她转向我。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Your perception of what occurred is gravely mistaken. Before Atsuki, Shiroya's figure vanished.
entries.new: 你对当时情形的认知错得离谱。在 Atsuki 眼前，Shiroya 的身影先消失了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: But before she could face me, she disappeared.
entries.new: 可她还没来得及转过身来面对我，就消失了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What!? Did she travel!?
entries.new: 什么！？她穿越了！？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I ran up the stairs and looked through the door.
entries.new: 我冲上楼梯，透过门缝看去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Nobody was there.
entries.new: 里面空无一人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But something was on the sofa that left me dazed. Two Sekimeiya were there, and one of them was powered off.{w} Next to them, I saw a set of keys. ...It was Naomi's.
entries.new: 可沙发上的东西让我怔住了。那里放着两台 Sekimeiya，其中一台已经关闭。{w} 旁边还有一串钥匙。……是 Naomi 的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Was Naomi here? Did she touch that Sekimeiya, teleporting Shiroya away?
entries.new: Naomi 来过这里？是她碰了那台 Sekimeiya，把 Shiroya 传送走了吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Naomi and Shiroya had disappeared. However, Atsuki didn't know something else had too.
entries.new: Naomi 和 Shiroya 都消失了。然而 Atsuki 并不知道，还有一样东西也一并消失。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Yes. Atsuki didn't see the suitcase Naomi had been holding; both Sekimeiya lay alone on top of the sofa's cushion.
entries.new: 是的。Atsuki 没有看见 Naomi 原本提着的手提箱；两台 Sekimeiya 孤零零地摆在沙发坐垫上。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: It was the suitcase that Naomi had been holding. Atsuki saw both Sekimeiya lying alone on top of the sofa's cushion.
entries.new: 消失的是 Naomi 原本提着的手提箱。Atsuki 只看见两台 Sekimeiya 孤零零地摆在沙发坐垫上。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Why are there two Sekimeiya...? Were there two from the beginning? Is this really why Sai had one in his hip pack once...?
entries.new: 为什么会有两台 Sekimeiya……？从一开始就有两台？Sai 那次腰包里带着一台，难道就是因为这个……？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Where the hell did Shiroya appear? Could she be back on the crystal floor?
entries.new: Shiroya 到底被传送到哪里去了？会不会又回到了水晶层？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I took a step back, hesitant to walk into the living room. My footprints would stay on the floor, and we'd never seen them.
entries.new: 我退后一步，迟迟不敢走进客厅。我的脚印会留在那里，而我们从未见过那些脚印。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wait, no... Shiroya couldn't have gone to the past.{w} If she had, she would've shown up immediately after her disappearance, right?{w} Could she have gone to the future...? Is that really possible?
entries.new: 等等，不对……Shiroya 不可能回到过去。{w} 如果去了过去，她应该刚一消失就立刻出现，不是吗？{w} 难道她去了未来……？那种事真的可能吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Or what if she went far enough to the past to appear outside the tower? The range picked her up, but not me. It was likely not a very lengthy travel, I'm just not sure how much I can trust the range.
entries.new: 又或者，她回到足够久远的过去，出现在了塔外？重叠范围把她带走了，却没有带上我。这次穿越的时间大概不算长，只是我实在拿不准这个范围有多可靠。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...And Naomi was definitely here. Why did she run up to the attic with the Sekimeiya, just to travel through time?{w} She didn't know we'd unlocked the way in, so she might think she locked the Sekimeiya in here.{w} ...Which is strange. After all, the attic was locked when we first came across the door.
entries.new: ……而且 Naomi 确实来过这里。她带着 Sekimeiya 跑上阁楼，难道就是为了穿越时间？{w}她不知道我们已经打开了入口，说不定以为把 Sekimeiya 锁在这里就安全了。{w}……可这说不通。毕竟我们第一次撞见那扇门时，阁楼还是锁着的。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I don't get it...! The Sekimeiya disappeared from the crystal room, and immediately, Naomi was bringing two of them up. At the same time, another one must've been in its original cabinet.{w} What the hell happened before we woke up? How many Sekimeiya are there...?
entries.new: 我完全想不通……！Sekimeiya 刚从水晶展室消失，Naomi 转眼就搬了两个上去。而与此同时，原本的展示柜里应该还有一个。{w}我们醒来之前究竟发生了什么？Sekimeiya 到底有几个……？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It was enigmatic. Naomi had to still be in the tower, but if Shiroya also was, why had she not come back?
entries.new: 实在令人费解。Naomi 一定还在塔里；可如果 Shiroya 也在，她为什么没有回来？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Could they both have gone to the past, but only Naomi reappeared in the tower?
entries.new: 难道两人都去了过去，却只有 Naomi 重新出现在塔里？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Suddenly, I realized I had to go back downstairs and found myself bolting out of the attic.
entries.new: 我猛然意识到自己必须下楼，等回过神时，人已经冲出了阁楼。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The storeroom...! Now I know it leads outside, and its handle must've been taken off at this time. If it was Naomi, I might get there before it happens!
entries.new: 储藏室……！我现在知道那里通向外面，而在这个时间，门把手应该已经被拆掉了。如果动手的是 Naomi，我也许能赶在那之前到！
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Shiroya could no longer have been in the building, but perhaps she was outside. As another chance to escape presented itself, I found myself gathering foolish hope once more.
entries.new: Shiroya 不可能还留在楼里了，但或许就在外面。逃脱的机会又一次摆在眼前，我竟又生出几分可笑的期待。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Almost no smoke hung in the air, and I could hear people on the same floor. I was not the only person there, but my only interest was the room I ran to.
entries.new: 空气里几乎没有烟雾，还能听见同层有人声。这层楼不止我一个人，可我唯一在意的，只有自己奔向的那个房间。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: In the storeroom, I rapidly shut myself behind the secret wall and approached the door.
entries.new: 一进储藏室，我便飞快地缩到暗墙之后，随即朝那扇门走去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: In the dark, I felt it for its handle.
entries.new: 黑暗中，我摸索着寻找门把手。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It is here! I can leave!
entries.new: 在这里！我能出去了！
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I couldn't believe it, but I gripped the handle and turned it with all my might.
entries.new: 我几乎不敢相信，却还是握住把手，用尽全力转动。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: You've gotta be kidding me. It's locked...
entries.new: 开什么玩笑。锁上了……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Wait, no, of course it is! That's why it was ripped off, so that we couldn't unlock it with the key that we found!
entries.new: 等等，不对，当然是锁着的！所以才有人把把手拆掉——好让我们没法用捡来的那把钥匙开门！
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I ran back to the hallway. We'd found the rusty key on the floor, in front of the event room.
entries.new: 我跑回走廊。那把生锈的钥匙，我们是在活动室门前的地上捡到的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If I get it and unlock the door, I'll definitely be changing the past, won't I? The police might even see me and set everyone free.
entries.new: 只要拿到它打开门，我肯定会改变过去吧？说不定警察甚至会看到我，把所有人都放了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: All of that no longer mattered. The real Shiroya had likely appeared somewhere, and I had a definite avenue of escape. I wasn't even aware of the possible consequences that would come, so I couldn't care about them. They were abstract things, and escaping was concrete.
entries.new: 这些都已无关紧要。真正的 Shiroya 很可能已经出现在某处，而我也确实有了一条退路。往后会有什么后果，我根本无从知晓，自然也顾不上。那些东西太过空泛，逃出去才是实实在在的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Where the fuck is it...!? It was right here.
entries.new: 该死的，钥匙去哪了……！？明明就在这儿的。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: There was very little light, but I couldn't see the key anywhere.
entries.new: 光线很暗，可无论往哪儿看，都不见钥匙的影子。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What the fuck!? I just want to leave!
entries.new: 搞什么鬼！？我只想离开这里！
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I didn't want to accept it, but the key wasn't there.
entries.new: 我不愿相信，可钥匙确实不在。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Was it not dropped yet?
entries.new: 难道是还没被丢到这里吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Although it was ridiculous, I went back to the chilly storeroom. It was a bit of a gamble, but the culprit had to arrive there relatively soon to detach the handle.
entries.new: 明知荒唐，我还是回到了阴冷的储藏室。这多少是在赌，但拆把手的人应该很快就会来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...{w}Wait, is that right?{w} Will the culprit really come in here...?
entries.new: ……{w}等等，真是这样吗？{w}那个人真的会进这里来……？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: When we found the secret wall, a single set of fingerprints was on it, meaning that it had been opened one time in the recent past. I swear I just saw those same fingerprints right now... Does that mean that nobody will come until our past selves find the mechanism?{w} Alternatively, what if they come from outside and won't touch the other side of the wall?{w} ...This doesn't make any sense, though. How is it possible we only saw one set of fingerprints? What about the ones I left just now?
entries.new: 我们发现暗墙的时候，上面只有一组指纹，说明前不久它被人打开过一次。可我刚才分明看见了同一组指纹……这是不是说，在过去的我们找到机关之前，根本不会有人来？{w}又或者，对方是从外面进来的，压根不会碰到墙的另一面？{w}……可这说不通。怎么可能只有一组指纹？我刚才留下的那些又算什么？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Did it mean that the past had changed? Was everything going to happen differently?
entries.new: 这是说过去已经改变了吗？一切都会以另一种方式发生？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...And where in the world is Shiroya? If she somehow went to the future, she'll definitely come here when she appears.{w} Is it possible she's outside and won't tell the police just so she can avoid changing the past...?
entries.new: ……还有，Shiroya 究竟在哪里？如果她去了未来，那她出现时一定会来这里。{w}会不会她就在外面，只是为了不改变过去，才不去告诉警察……？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: The key isn't in the hallway, the handle hasn't been taken off, I left extra fingerprints, and two Sekimeiya are in the attic. This cannot be the same morning. After all, if I'd been here since the start, I would've been found.
entries.new: 走廊里没有钥匙，把手还没被拆下，我留下了多余的指纹，阁楼里还放着两个 Sekimeiya。这绝不可能是同一个早晨。毕竟，如果我从一开始就在这里，早就被人发现了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: So what exactly is going to happen? Is everything gonna be different?{w} What about our past selves? If the past was changed somewhere, I'm no longer the other Atsuki who's currently here.
entries.new: 那么接下来到底会发生什么？一切都会变得不一样吗？{w}那过去的我们又怎么办？如果某处的过去已经被改变，我就不再是此刻待在这里的那个我了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I had to stay in the storeroom, merely hoping Shiroya would come. I had no desire to go back to the attic either; the Sekimeiya would clearly never aid us, and I didn't want anyone to slip into the storeroom while I wasn't present.
entries.new: 我只能留在储藏室，一心盼着 Shiroya 出现。我也不想再回阁楼去：Sekimeiya 显然帮不上我们任何忙，而我不在的时候，万一有人溜进储藏室就糟了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What the hell is all of this!? When I finally found Shiroya, she suddenly disappeared! There's no way I'm going to spend twelve more hours here from the start, and I have no idea what the fuck is even going to happen! How did everything turn into this so quickly!?
entries.new: 这到底算怎么回事！？好不容易找到 Shiroya，她却突然消失了！我才不要从头再在这里耗上十二个小时，而且我压根不知道接下来还会发生什么鬼事！怎么就变成这样了！？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I took a moment to recenter. Panicking wasn't going to get me anywhere.
entries.new: 我花了一会儿才定下神来。慌张解决不了任何问题。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Didn't Shiroya say that she found the rusty key in a security room drawer? What if it was her who changed the past?
entries.new: ……Shiroya 不是说过，她是在监控室的抽屉里找到那把生锈的钥匙的吗？万一改变过去的人就是她呢？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: If she grabbed it days ago, it wouldn't be in hallway A now.{w} And if the world changed independent of her actions, could the key currently be in the security room? I can't try to find it before everyone wakes up because the alarm locked the room...
entries.new: 如果几天前就被她拿走了，那现在它就不会在 A走廊。{w}可要是世界的改变与她的行动无关，钥匙此刻会不会就在监控室里？警报把监控室锁上了，我没法赶在大家醒来之前去找……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: The key was in the security room days ago... Katei was surely who dropped it, then.
entries.new: 几天前钥匙还在监控室……那么掉钥匙的人一定是 Katei。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It was earlier than I'd anticipated when sound came from the hallway.{w} From the lobby side, a group of people approached where I was.
entries.new: 走廊里传来动静，比我预想的要早。{w}一群人从大厅那边朝我所在的地方走来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Huh...? Is that everyone?{w} This isn't what we did. We went to the security room the first time we stepped into this hallway.
entries.new: 咦……？所有人都来了？{w}我们可不是这么做的。第一次踏进这条走廊时，我们是先去了监控室。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: However, the steps went to the crystal room in front of me.
entries.new: 可那些脚步却走向了我前方的水晶展室。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: That's the room where the gemstones were stolen. Why did they go there without entering the security room first?
entries.new: 宝石就是在那间屋子里被盗的。他们为什么连监控室都不进，就直接去了那里？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: From behind the wall, I was able to pick up a voice. It was Sai's, although I couldn't make out the words.
entries.new: 隔着墙，我隐约听见了说话声。是 Sai 的声音，只是听不清在说什么。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Do they know what happened there? Why, though? That's so strange.
entries.new: 他们知道那里发生过什么吗？可是为什么？太奇怪了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: They left the room not long after and walked closer to the stairs.
entries.new: 没过多久，他们便离开那间屋子，朝楼梯这边走来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: That's Katei talking, isn't it?
entries.new: 那是 Katei 在说话吧？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I focused as much as I could to understand what he was saying.
entries.new: 我竭力集中精神，想听清他在说什么。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...elevator won't move— ...arm disabled it.
entries.new: ……电梯不动了——……是警报，它把电梯停了。
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: ...Sorry, Isla, but there's no—
entries.new: ……抱歉，Isla，可是没有——
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: What the hell? This is entirely different from what we experienced.
entries.new: 搞什么？这跟我们经历过的完全不一样。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Everyone went up the stairs, leaving behind the bizarre silence.
entries.new: 所有人都上了楼梯，只留下那片诡异的寂静。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: They didn't even unlock the security room, so I can't go see if the key's there!
entries.new: 他们连监控室都没打开，我根本没法去看钥匙在不在里面！
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It was evident there had been a change in history, but where? I hadn't willingly changed the past, so someone else must have... Why had it had such a particular effect on me, though? Did I possess memories of the past reality because I'd traveled from it...?
entries.new: 历史确实被改动过了，可改在了哪里？我并没有主动去改变过去，那么做这件事的只能是别人……可为什么偏偏对我产生了这样的影响？我之所以还留有原来那段现实的记忆，是因为我从那里穿越而来……？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: That didn't quite make sense, but I knew the answer wouldn't be simple regardless.
entries.new: 这说不通，但我也清楚，答案本就不会简单。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Is that it? Did a person alter reality, or is what happened something else...?
entries.new: ……就这样？改变现实的是某个人，还是说，实际情况另有所指……？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: But most importantly, what was I supposed to do? I had no idea. Nothing was guaranteed.
entries.new: 可最关键的是，我接下来该做什么？我毫无头绪，也没有任何一件事能有把握。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If the past has already changed, no matter what I do, I'll have no direct relation to the Atsuki who just went up. ...That means my priority should be to find Shiroya, who's in the same position as me.{w} Where could she be? If she traveled through time and another deviation occurred, she might not exist in this world anymore.
entries.new: 如果过去已经被改变，那无论我再做什么，都和刚才上楼的那个 Atsuki 没有直接关系了。……也就是说，我该优先去找和我处境相同的 Shiroya。{w}她会在哪儿？如果她穿越了时间，之后又发生了一次偏差，她或许已经不存在于这个世界了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Assuming that was actually the case, was finding her conceivable in the first place? I couldn't even know that, seeing as I was already neck-deep in the nonsensical.
entries.new: 就算真是如此，找得到她吗？连这一点我都无从判断——毕竟我早已陷进一堆荒唐之中。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Once again, I didn't have to wait very long before I heard some of the others come back.
entries.new: 这一次，我也没等多久就听见有人回来了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Who's that? It's not everyone who went up.
entries.new: 是谁？回来的不是刚才上楼的全部人。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Quietly, they walked past the storeroom.
entries.new: 他们悄无声息地从储藏室外走过。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Following them, another person came from the stairs, crossing in front of the storeroom.{w} A few seconds later, someone else did too, but they didn't enter hallway A.
entries.new: 紧跟着，又有一个人从楼梯过来，从储藏室门前走过。{w}几秒后，另一个人也一样走过，却没有进 A走廊。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What the hell is happening here...!? Why is everyone silently walking around on their own!?
entries.new: 这到底是怎么回事……！？为什么每个人都一声不响地各走各的！？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: At some point, someone briefly entered the storeroom and left without saying anything. After listening for a few minutes, everything occurred in reverse. Several footsteps went up the stairs in a small group. A bit later, I heard a single person going up, followed by another shortly after that.
entries.new: 不知什么时候，有人短暂地进了储藏室，又一言不发地离开。又听了几分钟，一切便反过来重演了一遍。几个人结伴上了楼梯。过了一会儿，我听见一个人独自上楼，紧接着又是一个。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...{w}What the fuck just happened!? Is everyone gone again?
entries.new: ……{w}刚才到底发生什么了！？所有人又都不见了吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Nothing else could be heard on the crystal floor, but I had no idea what any of those people had done or who they were.
entries.new: 水晶层上再听不到别的动静，可那些人都做了什么、又是谁，我全然不知。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The silence continued for some time, and eventually, I was tempted to step out. Multiple people had walked toward the security room, but I didn't know if they'd entered it.
entries.new: 寂静持续了好一阵，我终于有些想出去看看。好几个人都朝监控室的方向走过，可我不知道他们有没有进去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Was one of them Katei? Nobody seems to be here, so I could go check if it's unlocked.
entries.new: 那些人里会不会有一个是 Katei？这里似乎没人了，我可以去看看门有没有开。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I slipped out of the secret corridor and opened the way out just a crack.
entries.new: 我从暗道里溜出来，把出口推开一道细缝。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Nobody was in hallway C.
entries.new: C走廊里空无一人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I slowly moved the other way.
entries.new: 我缓缓往另一个方向挪动。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: When I tried to open the security room, I found it to be unlocked.
entries.new: 我试着推监控室的门，发现它没有上锁。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Oh... all the screens are off.{w} It looks like the same thing that happened to us, where they all shut down at the same time. It seems it occurred again despite all the differences.
entries.new: 哦……所有屏幕都黑着。{w}看起来和我们那时一样，全部同时熄掉了。看来尽管情况处处不同，这件事还是照样发生了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I couldn't waste time, so I hurried over to the drawers.
entries.new: 我不能再耽搁，赶紧奔向那几个抽屉。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I doubt it's still here.{w} What's most likely is that Katei has—
entries.new: 我看它多半已经不在了。{w}最有可能的是，Katei 已经——
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I cut myself off. The key was there, deep within a drawer.
entries.new: 我把话咽了回去。钥匙就在那里，躺在抽屉深处。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Although I could no longer be certain that leaving the tower was what I had to do, I couldn't help but feel a brief thrill at the prospect.
entries.new: 虽然我已经无法确定离开塔是不是我该做的事，可一想到这个可能，心里还是忍不住一阵兴奋。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Was the universe going to allow it for once? Back in the storeroom, I pressed my hand against the hidden door, nearly out of breath.
entries.new: 这一次，世界总该容许了吧？回到储藏室，我把手按在暗门上，几乎喘不上气。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The handle was there, and so was the keyhole. I inserted the key, which confirmed it was the right one.
entries.new: 把手在，钥匙孔也在。我把钥匙插进去，确认正是这一把。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Really? Is leaving this place simply not possible?
entries.new: ……真的吗？难道离开这里根本就是不可能的？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It wasn't working. Although the key was the right one, it wasn't unlocking the door.
entries.new: 打不开。钥匙明明是对的，门锁却纹丝不动。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: This is absurd. What the fuck am I supposed to do!?{w} Do I wait half a day here, hoping Shiroya will just appear and the exit will open?{w} And then what? Two versions of us remain forever? ...This is insane! There has to be something we can do.
entries.new: 这太荒唐了。我到底该怎么办！？{w}难道我要在这里等上半天，指望 Shiroya 自己出现、出口自己打开？{w}然后呢？我们两个就永远这样并存下去？……简直疯了！总该有我们能做的事。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...{w}I had the rusty key, so an old thought came back to me.
entries.new: ……{w}手里握着那把生锈的钥匙，一个旧的念头又浮了上来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: "Unless I go back to thinking about thought-up loops, I suppose. There could be something that would work.{w} The person who killed Katei took that rusty key and walked out of the tower through the storeroom door, which was open. That created a location outside the tower where they were holding the key that could be replicated. Then, they reentered and used the Sekimeiya to go back in time. In the past, they appeared outside the tower holding the key, so they were able to unlock the door and reenter with something they'd obtained outside—like a knife. They left the door open so that their past self could exit with the key and create the replicated location."
entries.new: 「除非我又回头去琢磨那种假想出来的循环。说不定其中真有可行的办法。{w}杀死 Katei 的人拿走了那把生锈的钥匙，从敞开的储藏室门走出了塔。这样一来，塔外就多了一处可复制的地点——在那个地点，他手里正拿着那把钥匙。随后他重新回到塔内，用 Sekimeiya 回到过去。在过去，他拿着钥匙出现在塔外，因此能够打开门，带着在外面拿到的东西——比如一把刀——重新进来。他让门保持敞开，好让过去的自己带着钥匙走出去，造出那个复制地点。」
entries.speaker: n

entries.text: Could I pull off something like that, after all?
entries.new: 说到底，这种事我做得成吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I still have no idea how the replicated location works, but I could try it. I'll step out and spend a long time outside holding the key. After that, I'll come back in and travel to the past as many times as needed to appear outside holding the key so that I can unlock the door and let my past self out. I can't really construct it in a cleaner way.
entries.new: 我到现在也不明白复制地点是怎么运作的，但可以试一试。我先走出去，带着钥匙在外面待上很久。之后再回到里面，反复回到过去，直到我拿着钥匙出现在塔外，打开门，把过去的自己放出去。我实在想不出更干净的做法了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I stepped out of the secret area so that another self of mine could unlock the door without alerting me. My knocks from before would be their cue to do it.
entries.new: 我走出暗间，好让另一个我能在不惊动我的情况下打开门。我之前敲门的声音，就是给他们的信号。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Great. I'm just gonna be here all my life.
entries.new: 好啊。看来我这辈子都得耗在这儿了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I knew that feeling all too well. My plan had failed, but I couldn't know why. For all I knew, it was viable, but if the police or civilians were observing the surroundings of the tower, that was one of countless ways it would be blocked. It was possible I wouldn't have been able to unlock the door from outside either.
entries.new: 那种滋味我再熟悉不过。计划失败了，可我不知道原因。据我所知，这个计划本来是可行的；但如果警察或平民正在监视塔的四周，那也不过是无数种让它失败的情况之一。也有可能，我在外面同样打不开那道门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I sat down, defeated.
entries.new: 我颓然坐下。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I stayed on the cold floor, waiting for the door to open. It seemed the last hope that remained entailed being able to leave at {time=21.}{w} Was that going to happen, or was I going to wait another twelve hours just to be faked out again?
entries.new: 我坐在冰冷的地板上，等着门开。仅剩的最后一点指望，似乎就是 {time=21.} 时能不能出去。{w}那会成真吗？还是说我又要再等上十二个小时，到头来再一次落空？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...And would the secret door ever open? Would I ever see the Shiroya I'd just been with again?
entries.new: ……还有，那道暗门会打开吗？我还能再见到刚才和我在一起的 Shiroya 吗？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I didn't bother thinking; there was nothing else I felt compelled to solve, as the march of time alone would decide everything. Soon after I rested my jaw on my knees, I heard people returning to the crystal floor.
entries.new: 我懒得再去想。反正时间流逝终会决定一切，我也没有非解决不可的事。下巴刚搭上膝盖不久，我就听见有人回到了水晶层。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I knew everyone was outside, but I didn't want to show myself. If I had to wait all day again, I would do it peacefully—alone.
entries.new: 我知道所有人都在外面，却不想露面。如果还要再等上一整天，那我就安安静静地一个人等。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: When I stashed the key in my pocket, I noticed something else: another key had disappeared. ...The one that opened the locker that wasn't Naomi's.{w} When had it disappeared? I had only just realized it, but it was a result of one of my last two travels.
entries.new: 我把钥匙塞进口袋时，又注意到一件事：另一把钥匙不见了。……就是那把能打开另一个储物柜——不是 Naomi 的那个——的钥匙。{w}它是什么时候消失的？我到现在才发现，但这一定是我最近两次穿越中的某一次造成的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I heard faint voices sporadically, but I had no real idea of what was happening in the building. Once some time had passed, only occasional footsteps met my ears.
entries.new: 隐约的人声时断时续，但楼里究竟在发生什么，我毫无头绪。过了一阵，传进耳朵里的便只剩零星的脚步声。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: My body began to feel noticeably chilled, so I tried to cover myself well. Shiroya wasn't coming—that was very clear. ...Was Naomi present, though? I hadn't heard anything regarding her.
entries.new: 身上明显冷了起来，我尽量把自己裹紧。Shiroya不会来了——这一点再清楚不过。……可Naomi在吗？关于她，我什么也没听到。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...{w}What about the Sekimeiya? During the prolonged silence, I considered trying to find it. Assuming two existed, obtaining a single one wasn't too hard. Nobody knew about the hidden section I was in, so I could conceal it there.
entries.new: ……{w}那 Sekimeiya 呢？漫长的沉默里，我也动过找找看的念头。如果存在两个，弄到一个并不算难。没人知道我藏身的这处暗间，正好可以把它藏在那里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But I knew that would only complicate things further. Escaping the building by touching the Sekimeiya couldn't be possible; when that was supposed to occur, the Sekimeiya vanished instead.{w} What the hell had happened at that time? Why had the cabinet's state reverted? Without a thorough understanding of the Sekimeiya's powers, I couldn't begin to use it.
entries.new: 但我知道，那只会让事情更复杂。想靠触碰 Sekimeiya 逃出这栋楼根本行不通——正当该用它的时候，Sekimeiya 却消失了。{w}那时候究竟发生了什么？展示柜的状态为什么会恢复原样？不把 Sekimeiya 的力量彻底弄清楚，我根本无从使用它。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: So I stayed there, ignorant to the actual time.{w} ...However, I could tell that a few hours had passed.
entries.new: 于是我待在那里，不知道实际过了多久。{w}……不过，我大致能判断已经过了几个小时。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It had been a while since I'd heard anyone's voice. Only individual steps had crossed the hallway here and there.
entries.new: 很久没听到人声了。偶尔只有零星的脚步声从走廊那头传来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Hey! ...the fuck...! Where have you—
entries.new: 喂！……搞什么……！你跑到哪——
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: I looked at the door. It was Sai's voice, which I hadn't heard in a long time.
entries.new: 我望向门的方向。那是Sai的声音，我已经很久没听到了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There was no immediate response that I could hear, but I remained attentive. Had Sai seen someone who hadn't been there for a long time? My mind immediately went to Naomi.
entries.new: 我没有马上听到任何回应，但还是保持警觉。Sai是不是看到了某个许久不曾出现的人？我脑中立刻浮现出 Naomi。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I wasn't able to properly distinguish anything else, but I could at least tell that a group was in the hallway. I'd only understood Sai due to his volume.
entries.new: 别的话我分辨不清，但至少能听出走廊里有一群人。只是因为Sai嗓门大，我才听懂了他说的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: A few minutes later, even those faint signs of life faded out.
entries.new: 几分钟后，连那点微弱的动静也消失了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Are they not there anymore...?
entries.new: 他们已经不在了吗……？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It didn't seem so. Leaning against the wall, I attempted to think about nothing.
entries.new: 似乎确实不在了。我靠着墙，努力什么都不去想。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Minutes later, a couple sets of footsteps approached from the far end of the hallway. As always, my eyes instinctively turned to the door.
entries.new: 几分钟后，几串脚步声从走廊尽头靠近。我像往常一样，目光不由自主地转向门口。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It's certainly po— ...on this floor. Don't move fro—
entries.new: 肯定就在——……这一层。别走开——
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: ...Was that me?
entries.new: ……那是我吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...Okay.
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: ...{w}What?
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: That voice...
entries.new: 那个声音……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Was that Miiya...? ...I must be mistaken.
entries.new: 那是Miiya……？……多半是我听错了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Suddenly, the storeroom door opened, and I had to fight to contain my panic.{w} It appeared my past self was looking for something, as he quickly moved on to the next crystal room.
entries.new: 突然，储藏室的门开了，我拼命压住心里的惊慌。{w}看来过去的我正在找什么，很快又转向了下一间水晶展室。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It was her, wasn't it...? It was only one word, but wasn't that her voice...?
entries.new: 是她吧……？虽然只听见一个词，可那不就是她的声音吗……？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: While it seemed impossible, her existence in the tower had been mentioned before. Erina, Sai, and Akaro had all claimed to have seen her.
entries.new: 尽管难以置信，但此前确实有人提过她在塔里。Erina、Sai和Akaro都说过自己见过她。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Is she there, on the other side of the door?
entries.new: 她就在门那边吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Multiple people emerged from the lobby side and stopped in hallway C. Meanwhile, I could hear doors being opened.
entries.new: 好几个人从大厅那头过来，停在了C走廊。与此同时，我能听见开门的声音。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...you hear that?
entries.new: ……你听见了吗？
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: What?
entries.new: 什么？
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: No?
entries.new: 没有？
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: What are they doing? Searching for the Sekimeiya?
entries.new: 他们在做什么？在找Sekimeiya吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Stay the—{w=0.4} ...look at the mechani—
entries.new: 待在那儿——{w=0.4}……你看机械室——
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: That was my voice again.
entries.new: 又是我自己的声音。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I think they moved over to hallway B.
entries.new: 他们好像挪到B走廊去了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...right. Let's go.
entries.new: ……好。走吧。
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: And now they're going up.
entries.new: 现在他们上楼了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I emerged from the hidden area so that I could hear a little bit better. It seemed everyone was walking up the stairs.{w} Had I actually heard Miiya? If she was there, I had to see her.
entries.new: 我从藏身处走出来，好听得更清楚些。看来所有人都上楼了。{w}我真的听到Miiya了吗？如果她就在那里，我一定要见到她。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I closed the secret wall. I assumed everyone's backs were facing me, so I peeked out from behind the door. If Miiya was with them, I didn't mind being seen, but half of me thought my mind had played a trick on me.
entries.new: 我合上暗墙，料想众人都背对着我，便从门后探出头去。如果Miiya和他们在一起，我不介意被发现；可我心里有一半觉得，那不过是自己听岔了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Most of them had turned past the gray door; I could only see Sai's legs slowly disappearing.
entries.new: 大部分人已经拐过那扇灰门，我只看见Sai的腿慢慢消失在门后。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I approached the stairs, hoping I could watch them from a distance. However, all of a sudden, Sai stopped.
entries.new: 我走近楼梯，想远远看他们一眼。可Sai忽然停住了脚步。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Had he heard me? I stepped aside reflexively.
entries.new: 他听见我了？我下意识地往旁边一闪。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...What's up?
entries.new: ……怎么了？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Akaro, why is that door open?
entries.new: Akaro，那扇门怎么开着？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Shit. They noticed me.
entries.new: 糟了，他们发现我了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: As their suspicion grew, I stepped back several times. By the time they came back down, I was in hallway B.
entries.new: 他们起了疑心，我连退了好几步。等他们折返下来时，我已经退到了B走廊。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Sai and Akaro approached the storeroom and were followed by Katei, Erina, and Isla.
entries.new: Sai和Akaro朝储藏室走来，Katei、Erina和Isla跟在后面。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...What about Miiya? Is she not here?{w} My past self isn't either...
entries.new: ……Miiya呢？她不在这里吗？{w}过去的我也不在……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I couldn't see what was happening from where I was, but suddenly, I heard gasps.
entries.new: 我所在的位置看不到发生了什么，但忽然传来了几声倒抽气的声音。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What...?
entries.new: 什么……？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I got closer and shut my eyes in regret when I saw what they were looking at. They had found the secret corridor.
entries.new: 我走近几步，看清他们正看着什么时，懊恼地闭上了眼。他们发现了那条秘密通道。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What the fuck do I do now...? There's nowhere else to hide.
entries.new: 我他妈现在该怎么办……？已经没有别的地方可躲了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I looked around in desperation. I could never hide in a bathroom, as Katei would unlock it.{w} I saw the elevator was open; it was working, and the others had definitely been in the process of searching the whole building.
entries.new: 我绝望地环顾四周。洗手间根本藏不了——Katei 会把门打开。{w} 我看到电梯开着，还能运行，而其他人显然正在搜查整栋楼。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Did I really mishear that? Was that not Miiya...?{w} Where is my other self, then? What about the past Shiroya? She isn't here either.
entries.new: 难道我真的听错了？那不是 Miiya……？{w} 那另一个我在哪里？过去的 Shiroya 呢？她也不在这里。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I moved to the event room, an easy bridge between the hallways.
entries.new: 我转移到活动室。那里连接着各条走廊，行动很方便。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Just to check, I uncovered the curtain. The Sekimeiya wasn't there.
entries.new: 为确认一下，我掀开遮布。Sekimeiya 不在里面。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'm not gonna spend hours trying to hide from everyone. If I'm discovered, I'll explain what happened to me.
entries.new: 我没打算花上几个小时躲着所有人。真被发现了，我就把发生在我身上的事解释清楚。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: At least a few of them were still in the storeroom, discussing what they'd found. Some minutes later, I was surprised by the sound of someone walking through hallway A.
entries.new: 至少还有几个人留在储藏室里，讨论着他们的发现。几分钟后，我听到有人穿过 A 走廊的脚步声，吃了一惊。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What was strange was that they'd come from the lobby side. They'd come out of a crystal room to my left.
entries.new: 奇怪的是，那人是从大厅那边过来的。是从我左边的一间水晶展室里出来的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Was someone in there...?
entries.new: 奇怪的是，那人是从大厅那边过来的。他是从我左边的一间水晶展室里出来的。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Whoever it was had walked to the storeroom, but all the voices I could make out were too muffled.
entries.new: 那个人已经走到储藏室去了，可我能分辨出的说话声都太模糊。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Eventually, I stopped sensing people in the hallway.
entries.new: 最后，我感觉走廊里已经没有人了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Did they go anywhere?
entries.new: 那个人已经走到储藏室去了，可传出来的说话声太模糊，我根本听不清。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Just in case, I left through the other side.
entries.new: 为保险起见，我从另一侧离开了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Yeah, they're not there anymore.{w} Where did they go? There's no way they opened the door out, is there?
entries.new: 嗯，人已经不在了。{w} 到底去了哪里？总不可能把通向外面的门打开了吧？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: They hadn't. It was still locked.
entries.new: 没有。门还锁着。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Maybe they continued going up...?
entries.new: 也许他们继续往上走了……？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I stared at the crystal rooms in hallway A. There was only one farther ahead on the same wall as the event room: A1.
entries.new: 我盯着 A走廊里的水晶展室。再往前，和活动室同一侧的只剩一间：A1。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: That person... Did they come out of here?
entries.new: 那个人……是从这里出来的吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It was a little strange. After all, I knew the floor had just been inspected, and since the others had been about to go up, it was likely they hadn't found whatever they'd been searching for.
entries.new: 这有点奇怪。毕竟我知道这一层刚被检查过，而其他人正要上楼，看来他们并没有找到自己在找的东西。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I hadn't heard anyone entering the room, so if someone had left it, they had definitely done so after spending a while inside. That was what I found odd.
entries.new: 我没听见有人进过这间展室；既然如此，如果有人从里面出来，那一定是在里面待了好一阵子。我觉得奇怪的就是这一点。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The curtains were raised, showing that the cabinets had recently been looked into. Curious, I went ahead and opened them.
entries.new: 遮布被拉了起来，说明展示柜最近被人查看过。我出于好奇，也上前打开了柜门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I was surprised to find out my suspicion had been on the mark. A Sekimeiya was inside one of the cabinets.
entries.new: 让我意外的是，我的猜测竟然没错。其中一个展示柜里放着一颗 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What the hell...? So someone managed to hide it despite the search.
entries.new: 怎么回事……？竟然有人能在搜查时把它藏起来。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I knew an identical gemstone existed, so I went through the remaining cabinets until I was confident that it was the only Sekimeiya in the room.
entries.new: 我知道还有一颗一模一样的宝石，于是把剩下的展示柜逐一查过，直到确信这间展室里只有这一颗 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Should I take it? Now that I can't stay in the storeroom, it might be useful to keep it.
entries.new: ……要拿走吗？既然我不能再待在储藏室，带在身上也许有用。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Unsure, I reached in to grab it, and as I took it out, I was reminded of an unexplained problem.
entries.new: 我犹豫着伸手去拿；把它取出来时，又想起了一个没弄明白的问题。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...It's not hot at all.{w} That means it's not currently working, but it should be.
entries.new: ……一点都不烫。{w} 也就是说它现在没在工作，但按理说应该在工作。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: This is what happened sometimes. The Sekimeiya remained cold outside the cabinet, and touching it didn't do anything.
entries.new: 以前也出现过这种情况。Sekimeiya 放在展示柜外时一直是凉的，碰它也没有任何反应。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Hm... Could it be that out of the two Sekimeiya, only one works?
entries.new: 嗯……会不会两颗 Sekimeiya 里只有一颗能用？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: That sounded like a plausible idea, but it was denied by the time a Sekimeiya had appeared inactive in Sai's hip pack.{w} It was useless, and I didn't want to give myself another headache trying to resolve it. I put it back where I'd found it.
entries.new: 这猜测看似合理，但以前 Sai 腰包里的 Sekimeiya 也出现过毫无反应的情况，这个说法就站不住了。{w} 它没用，我也不想为弄清它再头疼一次。我把它放回了原处。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I wonder who hid it here, though.
entries.new: 不过，会是谁把它藏在这里的呢。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Where do I even go?
entries.new: 我到底该去哪儿？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: The tower was being inspected, so I figured the least likely places to be revisited were the bathrooms on floor 2.
entries.new: 整座塔正在被搜查，我想二楼洗手间应该是最不可能被再次检查的地方。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I shut myself inside one.
entries.new: 我把自己关进其中一间。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'll definitely be found eventually no matter where I stay.
entries.new: 无论我躲在哪儿，迟早都会被找到。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Was that voice really Miiya's? I need to know that.{w} It couldn't have been anyone else. If it wasn't my imagination, it was the real Miiya.
entries.new: 那真的是 Miiya 的声音吗？我必须确认这一点。{w} 不可能是别人。如果不是我的错觉，那就是真正的 Miiya。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I had no idea why she would be there, but if she was, that was the biggest question of them all.
entries.new: 我不知道她为什么会在那里，可如果她真在，那就是所有问题中最大的一个。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It's likely they'll all come back down. If she's here, I'll be able to see her.{w} She wasn't with the others in the storeroom, though. My past self and Shiroya were missing too...
entries.new: 他们多半都会下来。如果她在这里，我就能看见她。{w} 可她并不在储藏室那群人里。过去的我和 Shiroya 也不见了……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: They haven't come back yet. I have to assume they have access to the attic.
entries.new: 他们还没回来。看来他们应该是能进阁楼。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I decided that if nobody came after a while, I would quietly go up to see if I could find everyone.{w} But soon after that resolution, I thought I might've heard someone just outside the bathroom, separated from the rest.
entries.new: 我决定，如果过了一会儿还没人来，就悄悄上楼看看能不能找到大家。{w} 可刚下定决心，我就觉得洗手间外似乎有人，而且不和其他人在一起。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Did someone go to the crystal floor?
entries.new: 有人去水晶层了？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I went out and walked halfway down the stairs.
entries.new: 我走出去，沿楼梯下到一半。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Through the gray door, I saw Sai in hallway A, going from room to room.
entries.new: 透过灰色的门，我看见 Sai 在 A 走廊里，正一间间地查看。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What the hell is he doing now?{w} And what the hell is everyone else doing, letting him roam around freely?
entries.new: 他他妈在干什么？{w} 其他人又是怎么回事，竟然让他自由行动？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Was he the person who came out of that crystal room? If he traveled through time, he could've been there and in the storeroom at the same time.{w} But everyone had to see that person when they left A1. They would've reacted at seeing two of one person, and I guess it would've been a paradox...
entries.new: 他是不是那个从水晶展室里出来的人？如果他用了时间穿越，就可能同时出现在那里和储藏室。{w} 但那人离开 A1 时，大家肯定都看见了。看到同一个人出现两个，他们不可能没有反应——我想那会形成悖论……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: This is strange. He's likely searching for the Sekimeiya, which means he didn't hide it in that cabinet. However, a search just happened, so why is he doing this? Does he not trust the results?
entries.new: 奇怪。他多半是在找 Sekimeiya，也就是说，他没有把它藏进那个展示柜。可是刚刚才搜查过，他为什么还这么做？是不相信搜查结果吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I guess that's not all. There must be another Sekimeiya somewhere...
entries.new: 看来还不止这些。别处一定还有另一块 Sekimeiya……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I stepped away. I could still hear him moving downstairs, but the others were my concern.
entries.new: 我走开了。楼下还能听见他走动的声响，但我更在意的是其他人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I kept waiting in the bathroom.
entries.new: 我继续在洗手间里等着。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If Sai sneaked away, they'll notice it pretty quickly. He probably came down to search for himself, and he might find the Sekimeiya I saw.
