entries.text: Disoriented, he walked to the event room and found out the others had left both Sekimeiya behind for him.
entries.new: 他昏昏沉沉地走到活动室，发现其他人把两台 Sekimeiya 都留给了他。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He still had to complete his plan: to get out of the bedroom, he had to travel to the past.
entries.new: 他还得完成自己的计划：要想离开卧室，就必须穿越到过去。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Once he was done, Sai had both Sekimeiya for himself. Eager to resolve the doubts he had, he brought them both to a room—B6.
entries.new: 事情办妥之后，两台 Sekimeiya 都落到了 Sai 手里。他急于解开心中的疑问，便把两台都带进了一间房——B6。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Unfortunately for him, he was only able to resolve his two major concerns before the world around him changed.
entries.new: 可惜，他只来得及弄清两个最大的疑问，周围的世界就变了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: When we left the bedroom... we quickly found out the third Sekimeiya had disappeared from Naomi's locker.
entries.new: 我们离开卧室后……很快就发现，第三台 Sekimeiya 从 Naomi 的储物柜里不见了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Who the hell did that? There's no way it teleported out.{w} ...Did anyone else have the key after all?
entries.new: 到底是谁干的？它绝不可能自己传送出去。{w}……难道还有别人也有钥匙？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Yes, it was Akaro A.
entries.new: 没错，是 Akaro A 干的。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: It was Akaro A.
entries.new: 是 Akaro A。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: You might remember he world switched while he was in the staff room, and he had Naomi A's keys.
entries.new: 你或许还记得，他在员工室的时候发生了世界切换，而他当时带着 Naomi A 的钥匙。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: While he waited in room B4, he wondered if he had access to that locker, and when he went to confirm it, he saw someone had hidden a Sekimeiya there.
entries.new: 他在 B4 房间等候时，心想自己能不能打开那个储物柜，便去确认，结果发现有人在那里藏了一台 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Mystified, he took it out with no comprehension that he was no longer in his own world.
entries.new: 他大惑不解，把它取了出来，全然不知自己已经不在原来的世界。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: ...I wonder who it was. Maybe Sai, somehow.
entries.new: ……会是谁呢。也许，是 Sai 用了什么办法。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: After that, Shiroya and I found a Sekimeiya on the floor of a hallway B room, B6.
entries.new: 在那之后，我和 Shiroya 在 B 走廊 B6 房间的地板上发现了一台 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: When we touched it, I'm pretty sure we went to the future...
entries.new: 我们一碰到它，我敢肯定，我们去了未来……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: We appeared where we'd been ten minutes before, so we went ten minutes to the future.
entries.new: 我们出现在十分钟前所在的位置，也就是说，我们穿越到了十分钟后的未来。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: We thought we'd gone to the very recent past because the footprints we'd just left looked recent. Since we went shortly into the future, that didn't change.
entries.new: 我们以为自己是回到了很近的过去，因为我们刚留下的脚印看起来还很新。既然只是穿越到稍后的未来，这一点自然没有变化。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: And then, we concluded we'd gone five minutes to the past because we thought that we'd taken the elevator and caused the trip we heard before traveling. Instead, someone else used it from the attic after we left the bedroom...
entries.new: 接着，我们又断定自己回到了五分钟前，因为我们以为乘电梯的是自己，穿越前听到的响动正是我们造成的。可实际上，那是别人在我们离开卧室之后从阁楼用了电梯……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: On the crystal floor, we went to the lobby because our past selves hadn't gone there. Who did we hear if not ourselves? There was someone moving through the hallways.
entries.new: 在水晶层，我们去了大堂，因为过去的我们并没有去过那里。若不是我们自己，那听到的究竟是谁？当时有人在走廊里走动。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: "We heard an indistinct sound coming from hallway A, made by a door."
entries.new: A走廊那边传来一阵含混的响动，是门的声音。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: That's us. We just entered the event room.
entries.new: 是我们。我们刚进活动室。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: "We waited, and seconds later, the same sound came from hallway B. Unmistakably, a closing door had created it."
entries.new: 我们等着，几秒之后，B走廊也传来同样的声音。毫无疑问，那是门被关上的响动。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There aren't many people I can think of. Sai, Erina, Katei, and maybe the other Shiroya...
entries.new: 我能想到的人不多。Sai、Erina、Katei，也许还有另一个 Shiroya……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: But given the movements, I might know who it was...
entries.new: 但从行动路线来看，我或许能猜到那是谁……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: And that Shiroya... How the hell did she get there...!?
entries.new: 可那个 Shiroya……她到底是怎么到那里的……！？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Was she the Shiroya from this morning? Did she appear in the attic with Naomi and spend the whole day in the tower?
entries.new: 她就是今早那个 Shiroya 吗？她和 Naomi 一起出现在阁楼，然后在塔里待了整整一天？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It can't be. We would've seen her, and what the hell was the deal with her clothes!? Or anything that she said!
entries.new: 不可能。那样的话我们应该会看见她。而且她那身衣服到底是怎么回事！？还有她说的那些话！
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: She was the same Shiroya I'd been with. She remembered what we'd done. ...That's all I get.
entries.new: 她就是我认识的那个 Shiroya。她记得我们做过的事。……我能确定的只有这些。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: When we returned to room B6, the Sekimeiya we used wasn't there. Since we'd gone to the future, someone had time to take it away.
entries.new: 我们回到 B6 室时，用过的那台 Sekimeiya 已经不见了。既然我们去了未来，就有人趁这段时间把它拿走了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Instead, we found one in a cabinet drawer. It was considerably hot, so it was there for a long time.
entries.new: 取而代之，我们在展示柜的抽屉里找到了一台。它还相当烫，看来已经在那里放了很久。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: But we decided not to activate it and brought it to its cabinet.
entries.new: 但我们决定不启动它，把它送回了展示柜。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: If they had touched it, though, what would've happened? It has been a while since you asked for that.
entries.new: 不过，如果他们碰了它，会发生什么？你问起这件事，已经过了好一阵子了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Atsuki would've gone many hours back in time. The lights would not yet have turned on, and he would've found himself in the lobby.
entries.new: Atsuki 会被送回好几个小时之前。那时灯还没亮，他会发现自己身处大厅。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: You remember, right? He spent a long time in the staff room. Eventually, after the light was turned on in the morning, he was killed by Ido, who had the suitcase ready to prepare the attack.
entries.new: 你记得吧？他在员工室里待了很久。最后，早晨灯亮之后，他被 Ido 杀害了，Ido 早已备好手提箱准备袭击。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Before his eyesight failed, Atsuki saw four people he recognized.
entries.new: 在视力丧失之前，Atsuki 看见了四个他认识的人。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: "Two men, a woman, and a girl."
entries.new: 「两个男人、一个女人，还有一个女孩。」
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: One was Shiroya. She was naturally encompassed by the range when Atsuki touched the Sekimeiya.{w} However, she didn't appear in the lobby with him. Strangely, she appeared in a bathroom on the crystal floor, and when she left, she was seen from the security room and addressed through the microphone.
entries.new: 其中一人是 Shiroya。Atsuki 触碰 Sekimeiya 时，她自然也被纳入了范围。{w} 然而，她并没有和他一起出现在大厅。奇怪的是，她出现在水晶层的一间洗手间里；她出来之后，有人在监控室看见她，用麦克风对她喊话。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Atsuki recognized Ido and Suripo as well: he had seen both of them during the long wait before the event.
entries.new: Atsuki 也认出了 Ido 和 Suripo：在活动开始前那段漫长的等待里，他见过这两人。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The last person was Erina. She had been alive in room B4 next to Atsuki and Shiroya and appeared in the mechanical room.
entries.new: 最后一个人是 Erina。她原本在 Atsuki 和 Shiroya 隔壁的 B4 室里，之后出现在了机械室。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: However, she had been unconscious. Therefore, despite appearing in the past, she took a while to awaken.
entries.new: 不过，她当时还在昏迷。所以，尽管人已经出现在过去，她还是过了好一会儿才醒来。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Two impossibilities prevented this from happening. One was the butterfly effect.
entries.new: 有两个不可能之处阻止了这件事发生。其一是蝴蝶效应。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Precisely. Atsuki died.
entries.new: 正是如此。Atsuki 死了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: There should've been a world switch, but this is tied to the butterfly effect. After all, the Future Sekimeiya was between another Shiroya's hands, and that version of Shiroya couldn't have existed if they had gone to the past.
entries.new: 本来应该发生世界切换，但这与蝴蝶效应相关。毕竟，Future Sekimeiya 在另一个 Shiroya 手里，而如果他们去了过去，那个 Shiroya 就不可能存在。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Shiroya could have existed, but not Atsuki. That is because he died.
entries.new: Shiroya 可能还存在，Atsuki 却不可能——因为他死了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Perhaps that problem helped you figure out the Sekimeiya's mechanics. Because Atsuki died, he could never have appeared in the lobby—he wouldn't have been there in the future.
entries.new: 也许正是这个问题让你弄清了 Sekimeiya 的机制。Atsuki 既然死了，就不可能出现在大厅——未来也不会有他。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: However, there's something to recognize: he had a wound on his right hand, and in the darkness, he saw that he had a key shaped like the one for Naomi's locker. ...It was Ido's instead, though; his appearing location was where he would've ended up traveling to the future in a chain of travels.
entries.new: 不过，有一点值得注意：他右手上有伤，而且在黑暗中，他看见自己拿着一把钥匙，形状和 Naomi 储物柜的钥匙一样。……但那其实是 Ido 的；他出现的位置，正是他在连锁传送中前往未来时会落脚的地方。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: ...That was when we found Katei dead in the security room.
entries.new: ……就是在那个时候，我们发现 Katei 死在监控室里。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: When Katei walked out of the bedroom, Erina followed close behind.{w} She didn't believe Atsuki and Shiroya had killed Isla. ...Sai and Akaro had been with her the entire time.
entries.new: Katei 走出卧室时，Erina 紧跟在后。{w} 她不相信是 Atsuki 和 Shiroya 杀了 Isla。……毕竟 Sai 和 Akaro 一直和她在一起。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: However, Katei had been missing during that time, and he hadn't explained himself.{w} She didn't trust him at all; he'd been lying all day. ...He had faked going to the bathroom to take advantage of Isla's death.
entries.new: 然而，那段时间 Katei 一直不见踪影，也从没解释过自己的去向。{w} 她完全无法信任他；他整天都在撒谎。……他借口去洗手间，正是为了利用 Isla 的死。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: On the lowest floor, when Erina uttered his name, he turned around slowly.
entries.new: 在最底层，Erina 叫出他的名字时，他缓缓转过身。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: A single question was asked. "Where were you when we couldn't find you?"
entries.new: 她只问了一句：「我们找不到你的时候，你在哪里？」
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Katei realized the meaning behind that. Erina suspected him of causing Isla's death.{w} He sighed quietly and then spoke.
entries.new: Katei 明白这句话背后的意思。Erina 怀疑 Isla 的死是他造成的。{w} 他轻轻叹了口气，然后开口。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: I don't know exactly. When I was walking behind Sai, I suddenly appeared in the attic.
entries.new: 我不清楚具体是怎么回事。我走在 Sai 后面的时候，突然就出现在了阁楼。
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: ...What?
entries.new: ……什么？
entries.speaker: akinn

entries.text: It's the truth. It likely happened when Shiroya and Atsuki touched the Sekimeiya, remember?
entries.new: 这是真的。大概就是 Shiroya 和 Atsuki 触碰 Sekimeiya 的时候发生的，你还记得吧？
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: Why didn't you say this before!? And that doesn't tell me anything! Why didn't we find you!?
entries.new: 你之前为什么不说！？这根本说明不了什么！我们为什么没找到你！？
entries.speaker: akinn

entries.text: Katei stared into Erina's eyes. Her voice had never sounded so harsh.
entries.new: Katei 直视着 Erina 的眼睛。她的声音从未如此尖锐。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: I said I experienced the teleportation, and I am telling you the truth. I was beyond confused when I appeared there.{w} When I came down, the three of you were in the lobby.
entries.new: 我说过，我经历了传送，我说的都是实话。我出现在那里时，完全不知所措。{w} 我下楼时，你们三个人都在大厅里。
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: Although Erina wavered, she quickly dismissed Katei's claim as nonsense.
entries.new: Erina 虽然有过片刻动摇，但很快就把 Katei 的话斥为无稽之谈。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: You're not even making sense! You were hiding in the storeroom, weren't you?
entries.new: 你这话根本说不通！你就是躲在储藏室里，对不对？
entries.speaker: akinn

entries.text: What? No! There are cameras in hallway C. What I'm saying will be proven.
entries.new: 什么？没有！C走廊里有摄像头。我说的话会被证实的。
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: ...I don't believe it. The cameras aren't recording.
entries.new: ……我不信。摄像头根本没有在录像。
entries.speaker: akinn

entries.text: Yes they are! Don't you see the light!?
entries.new: 在录！你没看见指示灯吗！？
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: Katei saw nothing but hostility in Erina's face. Enough to appear as a threat.{w} Did she really think he had killed Isla? He didn't know anything about what had happened to her, but there was a way he could prove his innocence.
entries.new: Katei 在 Erina 脸上只看到敌意，那份敌意几乎称得上威胁。{w} 她真的以为是他杀了 Isla 吗？他对 Isla 的遭遇一无所知，不过，他有一个办法能证明自己的清白。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: ...You still haven't explained anything. Why didn't you say this earlier, and why didn't we find you?
entries.new: ……你还是什么都没解释清楚。为什么之前不说？我们又为什么没找到你？
entries.speaker: akinn

entries.text: Erina had no idea what to believe. No one else could've harmed Isla, but who would have? Why would anyone have done that to her daughter? Part of her wanted to abandon everything and just stop thinking altogether, placidly waiting the month it would take her daughter to return.
entries.new: Erina 不知道该相信什么。除了他，没人能伤害 Isla——可那又会是谁？谁会那样对待她的女儿？她心底有一部分想抛下一切，索性什么都不再想，就这样平静地等上一个月，等女儿回来。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: ...I'm not lying. Maybe I can prove myself.
entries.new: ……我没有撒谎。也许我能证明自己。
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: Katei started walking to the security room, gesturing at Erina to come with him.
entries.new: Katei 朝监控室走去，示意 Erina 跟上。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: It has been a long time since I've checked. Perhaps the security system is working again, just like what happened to the computer.
entries.new: 我很久没检查过了。也许监控系统又恢复了，就像那台电脑一样。
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: In silence, Katei kneeled under the desk while Erina watched expectantly.
entries.new: Katei 一言不发地跪到桌下，Erina 满怀期待地看着他。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Again, there doesn't seem to be anything wrong with this.
entries.new: 这一次，看上去同样没什么问题。
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: As he stood up, he nonchalantly took a rusty key out of his pocket and left it in a drawer.
entries.new: 他站起身，若无其事地从口袋里取出那把生锈的钥匙，随手搁进了抽屉。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: This time, I won't forget to keep it somewhere safer.
entries.new: 这次我不会再忘了，要把它放到更保险的地方。
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: ...Katei sat on his chair and started up the three screens. As Erina stepped forward, he pressed the "archived footage" button.
entries.new: ……Katei 在椅子上坐下，启动了三块屏幕。Erina 上前一步时，他按下了「存档录像」的按钮。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: O-Oh! I-It's working!
entries.new: 哦、噢！能、能用了！
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: A list of cameras appeared on the screen. Erina read them without so much as a twitch.
entries.new: 屏幕上浮出一列摄像头编号。Erina 逐一扫过，脸上连一丝抽动都没有。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Look! I'll show you that I was telling the truth!
entries.new: 看吧！我这就证明给你们看，我说的全是真话！
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: When Katei selected one, a video of hallway C came up, mainly focusing on the bathrooms. Frustrated, Katei used the time bar to skip ahead.
entries.new: Katei 选中其中一个，C走廊的录像随即播出，镜头主要对着洗手间一带。Katei 有些不耐烦，拖动时间条往后跳去。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Here! I'm about to disappear!
entries.new: 就这儿！我马上就要消失了！
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: Coming from hallway B, Sai stepped into C. Katei followed behind, and out of nowhere, his body vanished.
entries.new: Sai 从B走廊走进C走廊，Katei 跟在后面，忽然之间，他的身体凭空消失了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: See! That's when I appeared in the attic!
entries.new: 瞧见没！就是那时候，我在阁楼里出现了！
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: After he selected another camera and fast-forwarded further, Katei appeared from the second floor and entered hallway A.
entries.new: 他选了另一个摄像头，又往后快进了一段——Katei 从二楼走出，进了A走廊。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Just like I said, I wasn't here when she disappeared! I have no idea what happened to her, but I didn't lie!
entries.new: 就像我说的，她消失的时候我根本不在这儿！她出了什么事我完全不知道，可我没撒谎！
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: ...Did you kill Naomi?
entries.new: ……Naomi 是你杀的吗？
entries.speaker: akinn

entries.text: Huh? Of course I didn't!
entries.new: 啊？当然不是我！
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: Show me what happened.
entries.new: 把当时的经过放给我看。
entries.speaker: akinn

entries.text: ...{w}After a brief pause, Katei moved the cursor to a different camera.{w} He was calm. He knew very little incriminating footage was located in those folders.
entries.new: ……{w}短暂停顿后，Katei 把光标移到了另一个摄像头上。{w}他很镇定。那些文件夹里几乎没有对他不利的录像，这一点他再清楚不过。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Once he clicked on room B4's camera, a message appeared on the screen.{w} "{time=10:04}: Camera(s) disabled and associated footage erased".
entries.new: 他刚点开 B4 展室的摄像头，屏幕上就弹出一行字。{w}「{time=10:04}：摄像头已停用，相关录像已删除」。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Wh-What!?{w} The killer erased it! H-How!?
entries.new: 什、什么！？{w}是凶手删掉的！他、他怎么办到的！？
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: ...{w}{time=10:04}? Isn't that when we left you here?
entries.new: ……{w}{time=10:04}？那不就是我们把你留在这儿的时候吗？
entries.speaker: akinn

entries.text: Huh? It might be, but why does that matter!? The system wasn't working for me at the time!
entries.new: 啊？也许是吧，可那又能说明什么！？那时候系统对我根本用不了！
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: You killed Naomi, right?
entries.new: Naomi 是你杀的，对吧。
entries.speaker: akinn

entries.text: Katei hung his head. He'd failed to remember the deletion time would be displayed.
entries.new: Katei 垂下了头。他忘了，删除时间会被显示出来。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: ...I would never kill a person.
entries.new: ……我绝不会杀人。
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: You d-did. And not only Naomi, right?
entries.new: 你、你就是杀了她。而且不止 Naomi 一个，对吧？
entries.speaker: akinn

entries.text: You're wrong! I promise I didn't do anything!
entries.new: 你错了！我发誓，我什么都没做！
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: Katei's excuses were poor; he wasn't trying anymore. Even if he convinced Erina, he was done for, as the deletion time pointed straight at him.
entries.new: Katei 的辩解苍白无力，他也不再费心。就算说动了 Erina，他也完了——删除时间明明白白指着他。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: His mind was someplace else entirely. He couldn't let that message be seen.
entries.new: 他的心思早已飘到了别处。那行字，绝不能让她们看见。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He had already ended someone's life for his own sake. If he was quick, he could get himself out of there. ...And there were many more suspects than the first time.
entries.new: 为了自己，他已经夺走了一条人命。只要动作够快，他就能从这里脱身。……何况这一次，嫌疑人比上次多得多。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Katei turned around, ready to deliver a sudden blow, but he didn't expect the one that came first.
entries.new: Katei 转过身，准备冷不防地出手，却没想到先挨打的反而是自己。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: After a sharp collapse, Katei's body was on the floor, splashed with its own blood.
entries.new: Katei 猛地倒下，身体摔在地板上，溅满了自己的血。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Next to him was Erina. Katei's fist had contacted her head, and she had also fallen on top of the blood.
entries.new: 他身旁是 Erina。Katei 那一拳正中她的头，她也倒在了那摊血上。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Only one of them was alive.
entries.new: 两人之中，只有一个还活着。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Erina suddenly awakened and saw Katei's blurry outline.
entries.new: Erina 猛然醒转，眼前是 Katei 模糊的轮廓。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: She had killed him. She remembered what had happened. However, she could hardly keep herself steady.
entries.new: 她杀了他。她记得发生了什么。可她几乎撑不住自己的身体。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: She was unable to tell how much time had passed. The seconds had suddenly cut off for her, but she had to get out of there. Once she was able to stand, she walked to the door.
entries.new: 她说不清究竟过了多久。时间在她那里骤然断了一截，但她必须离开这里。等能站起身了，她便朝门口走去。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: She couldn't see anyone in the hallway, but the end was a bright blob. Suddenly, she felt the need to go somewhere.
entries.new: 走廊里看不到人影，尽头只有一团亮光。她突然觉得自己需要去某个地方。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: She approached the event room. Inside, a single drop of Katei's blood dripped off her.
entries.new: 她走到活动室。室内，一滴 Katei 的血从她身上落下。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Paying it no mind, she slowly walked out through the other door.
entries.new: 她没有在意，从另一扇门慢慢走了出去。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: She walked in a straight line. Then, beyond a door, she saw a body beneath a curtain.
entries.new: 她笔直地走着。随后，在一扇门后，她看见遮布底下躺着一具尸体。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: She had... avenged her. Naomi could at least rest in peace.
entries.new: 她总算……替她报了仇。Naomi 至少可以安息了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Someone closed the door behind her, but she didn't hear it. ...Only two other people did, and they mistook it as their own action.
entries.new: 有人在她身后关上了门，她没有听见。……听见的只有另外两人，而他们都以为那是自己关的门。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: ...I think I can imagine what happened.{w} We then found Erina's body, but she was still alive, and after we were in the event room for a while, the other Shiroya woke me up.
entries.new: ……我大概能想象出经过。{w}之后我们发现了 Erina，但她还活着；我们在活动室待了一阵，另一个 Shiroya 把我叫醒了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Why the hell was she there? And why did we not find her before? Did she avoid the searches with the Sekimeiya, knowing all of them were coming?
entries.new: 她到底为什么会出现在那种地方？我们之前为什么没找到她？难道她早就知道所有人都会来搜，靠着 Sekimeiya 躲了过去？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: She really must have been the Shiroya who disappeared with Naomi...
entries.new: 她果然就是和 Naomi 一起消失的那个 Shiroya……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: We couldn't find her, but suddenly, Sai attacked us.{w} I don't get that either...! Why did he want to kill us, and where did he even get that knife from!?
entries.new: 我们没找到她，Sai 却突然袭击了我们。{w}这一点我也想不通……！他为什么想杀我们？那把刀又是从哪儿来的！？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I thought you'd overstepped, but it seems I was the one who had.
entries.new: 我本以为是你越界了，看来越界的是我。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What the fuck did that even mean?
entries.new: 住口。你那话到底是什么意思？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Before that point, he seemed to slow down when it became clear that I didn't know why he was chasing us. ...He snapped out of it suddenly, though.
entries.new: 在那之前，当他发现我根本不知道他为什么追我们时，他的脚步似乎慢了下来。……不过，他很快就猛地回过神来。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: "Pensively, Sai glanced around the room. Suddenly, in visible shock, his whole body went one step backward."
entries.new: 「Sai 若有所思地环顾房间。忽然，他显然吃了一惊，整个人向后退了一步。」
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Sai saw the security camera behind Atsuki.
entries.new: Sai 看见了 Atsuki 身后的监控摄像头。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Earlier, Sai had experienced his first world switch. It was Atsuki A who he thought he'd been chasing.
entries.new: 先前，Sai 经历了第一次世界切换。他本以为自己追的人是 Atsuki A。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He realized Atsuki B didn't seem to know what had occurred and that he hadn't been crying, but it was the camera's green light that stopped him, as it otherwise would've been possible for that Atsuki to be a future version of the one who'd punched him.{w} In world A, Sai had noticed the green lights were gone; the cameras hadn't been recording. When he unknowingly returned to world B, he even saw the message on the computer that matched with the lack of green lights.
entries.new: 他意识到，Atsuki B 似乎并不知道发生了什么，而且也没有哭过；但真正让他停下的是摄像头的绿灯——否则，那个 Atsuki 也可能是打过他的那个人的未来版本。{w}在 A世界，Sai 注意到绿灯已经熄灭，摄像头并没有在录像。后来他在不知不觉中回到 B世界时，甚至看到了电脑上的那条消息，正好与绿灯熄灭的情况吻合。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: However, when he saw the green light again, he understood he'd been recorded chasing behind Atsuki and Shiroya with a knife. If he killed them, he would be the culprit.
entries.new: 然而，当他再次看到绿灯时，他明白了：自己拿着刀追赶 Atsuki 和 Shiroya 的样子已经被录了下来。如果他杀了他们，他就是凶手。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Sai didn't believe that footage would see the light of the day, but he couldn't risk his own life. As a result, he abandoned all intentions to use his knife as soon as that green light entered his eyes.
entries.new: Sai 不相信那段录像会有重见天日的一天，但他不能拿自己的命去赌。因此，那道绿灯一映入眼中，他就彻底放弃了动刀的念头。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Sai began to think about what he'd experienced. The Sekimeiya had disappeared from room B6, where Atsuki and Shiroya had found one...
entries.new: Sai 开始回想自己的经历。Sekimeiya 是从 B6 室消失的，Atsuki 和 Shiroya 正是在那里找到了一台……
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: They hadn't known yet that two existed: they thought the Sekimeiya had teleported to a drawer, meaning they might've missed that the Future Sekimeiya was still in that room.
entries.new: 他们当时还不知道存在两台：他们以为 Sekimeiya 是传送到了某个抽屉里，因此很可能没有注意到 Future Sekimeiya 仍留在那个房间。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Atsuki looked through every room in the hallway B and didn't find it after Sai had evaded detection there. He thought he could simply go twenty minutes back and obtain it before Atsuki's inspection, like he'd planned before dashing out of the event room.
entries.new: Sai 在 B走廊躲过搜查后，Atsuki 把 B走廊的每个房间都找了一遍，却没有找到。Sai 以为自己只要回到二十分钟前，赶在 Atsuki 检查之前拿到它就行——这本来就是他冲出活动室之前盘算好的计划。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: But... what had he experienced? Where was the Atsuki who'd been crying in the attic?
entries.new: 可是……他经历过的那些究竟是什么？那个在阁楼里哭泣的 Atsuki 又去了哪里？
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Sai had seen a dead body in the lobby near a pool of blood: Shiroya's.{w} Why was it not there anymore? Why had the pool of blood diminished?
entries.new: Sai 曾在大厅里看见一具倒在血泊旁的尸体：那是 Shiroya。{w}为什么尸体现在不见了？为什么血泊也变少了？
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He didn't know, but he'd seen Shiroya dead. Her fate had to be death, but Sai couldn't explain the body's disappearance yet.
entries.new: 他不知道原因，但他确实看见 Shiroya 死了。她注定会死，可 Sai 还无法解释尸体为何消失。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: She would end up dead... Someone would kill Shiroya. Sai just had to work out the structure of events.
entries.new: 她最终会死……有人会杀死 Shiroya。Sai 只需要理清事件的脉络。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He ran away and managed to hide in hallway B. I'm not sure what he did, but when he unlocked the cabinet, we spoke to him for a while. ...He was pretty confident that Shiroya would die and that the blood in the lobby was hers.
entries.new: 他逃走了，设法躲进 B走廊。我不清楚他做了什么，但他打开展示柜后，我们和他说了一会儿话。……他很确信 Shiroya 会死，大厅里的血也是她的。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...And that's when he and Shiroya disappeared from the event room.
entries.new: ……也就在这时，他和 Shiroya 从活动室里消失了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I also just said what my plan relies on: I must go back to the past, but I don't need to go too far. If I had another Sekimeiya hidden, what would the point of using this one be? I would just go back to the past with the other one I have, right?
entries.new: 我也刚说过我的计划靠的是什么：我必须回到过去，但不用回得太远。如果我另藏了一件Sekimeiya，那还用这一件做什么？直接拿手上那件回去不就行了？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: This is an actual question. If I know where another Sekimeiya is like you say, why would I not simply use that one?
entries.new: 我是认真在问。如果真像你说的，我知道另一件Sekimeiya在哪儿，那我为什么不干脆用那一件？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...Because it would've sent him to the future. He wanted to go to the past, and he knew the Sekimeiya in the cabinet was what he needed.
entries.new: ……因为那一台会把他送到未来。他想去的是过去，而他知道展示柜里的那台 Sekimeiya 才是他需要的。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: When he touched it, he and Shiroya appeared in the attic, which was inaccessible for me.{w} I'm not sure what happened there, but Shiroya told me Sai locked her in a bedroom.
entries.new: 他一碰到它，就和 Shiroya 一起出现在了我进不去的阁楼里。{w}我不清楚那里发生了什么，但 Shiroya 告诉我，Sai 把她锁在了一间卧室里。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: On the crystal floor, I was able to open another locker...
entries.new: 在水晶层，我得以打开另一个储物柜……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Why did I find its key in the cleaning room? Why didn't we find it before that point?
entries.new: 为什么我会在清洁间找到它的钥匙？为什么在那之前，我们始终没找到？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It should've been noticed plenty of times, when people were looking for the Sekimeiya. Maybe you realized that Akaro always went out of his way to look at that room before the cart disappeared.
entries.new: 人们寻找 Sekimeiya 的时候，本该有很多次机会注意到它。也许你早就发现，Akaro 总会在推车消失前特意去看那个房间。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: ...From the staff room, I used the Sekimeiya and appeared twenty minutes in the past, in the event room. I used that time to search through the upper floors, but I had locked myself out of the attic.{w} I ended up in the security room without finding anyone, but Erina had to be somewhere, likely with Miiya...
entries.new: ……我从员工室使用了 Sekimeiya，出现在二十分钟前的活动室。我利用那段时间搜遍了楼上几层，却把自己锁在了阁楼外。{w}最后我到了监控室，谁也没找到；但 Erina 一定在某个地方，很可能和 Miiya 在一起……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Many questions were eclipsed by a much bigger one: the note that I'd found on the floor of the staff room.
entries.new: 我在员工室地板上捡到的那张纸条，让其他许多疑问都显得次要了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I touched the Sekimeiya and went twenty minutes to the past. Then, when I returned to the staff room, I found that note. It's very likely it fell from my pocket when I sat on the floor.
entries.new: 我碰了 Sekimeiya，回到了二十分钟前。后来我回到员工室时，发现了那张纸条。很可能是我坐在地上时从口袋里掉出来的。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I never wrote it. What the fuck was it doing in my pocket? I don't believe anyone else left it on the floor.{w} Wait, no. This doesn't even make sense.{w} Nobody could've put it in my pocket, so what I must assume is that I appeared with it when I traveled to the past.
entries.new: 我从没写过它。它他妈怎么会在我口袋里？我不相信是别人把它丢在地上的。{w}等等，不对。这根本说不通。{w}没人能把它塞进我的口袋，所以我只能认为，是我回到过去时把它一起带过去的。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: From the staff room, I traveled and appeared in the event room. That makes sense—forty minutes later, we were all there when Erina was about to activate the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 我从员工室穿越，出现在了活动室。这说得通——四十分钟后，我们所有人都在那里，而 Erina 正要启动 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Oh, right, I'd forgotten about this too.
entries.new: 啊，对了，这个我也忘了。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: "Still sounding groggy, she traced my gaze up to her purse and took out a small piece of paper."
entries.new: 她语气仍有些昏沉，顺着我的视线看向自己的手袋，取出一张小小的纸片。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I found this just now. I tried to read it, but my head hurt a lot. Do you know what it is?
entries.new: 这是我刚捡到的。我想读，可头疼得厉害。你知道这是什么吗？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: "She handed it to me, and I snatched it away, gripping it tightly. My hands started trembling as soon as I glanced at the words again and saw those familiar letters."
entries.new: 她递过来，我一把夺过，紧紧攥住。视线再次落在那行字上、认出那些熟悉的笔迹时，我的手立刻抖了起来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Erina found the note I threw away. When I took it, I immediately put it in my pocket so that the others wouldn't see it. That's why I appeared with it in the event room forty minutes earlier...
entries.new: Erina 捡到了我丢掉的那张纸条。我接过它后，立刻塞进口袋，免得被其他人看见。所以四十分钟前，我才会带着它出现在活动室……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: However, this is illogical. Where is its origin?{w} I appeared with it and I threw it away. Then, Erina found it and gave it to me, which is why I appeared with it. ...It doesn't have a beginning.
entries.new: 可是，这不合逻辑。它的起点在哪里？{w}我带着它出现，又把它丢掉。然后 Erina 捡到它，交给我，所以我才带着它出现。……它根本没有开端。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I must have something backward. Otherwise, it doesn't make any sense.
entries.new: 我一定是哪里想反了。否则，这根本说不通。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Hm... I assumed Erina found the note where I'd discarded it, behind the handrail in hallway B.{w} But she only said "I found this just now."
entries.new: 嗯……我以为 Erina 是在我丢掉纸条的地方——B走廊的栏杆后面——捡到它的。{w}可她只说了「这是我刚才找到的」。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: If she found it somewhere else, it makes sense. She gave it to me and I gripped it tightly, which is why I appeared with it in the past and saw it roughly folded. Then, I left it behind the handrail, and it remained there.
entries.new: 如果她是在别处找到的，那就说得通了。她把它交给我，我紧紧攥住，所以回到过去时它才会跟着我出现，而我看到它被草草折过。后来我把它留在栏杆后面，它就一直留在那里。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Maybe this is it. After all, there's only one explanation behind that note—it came from another world.
entries.new: 也许就是这样。毕竟，那张纸条只有一个解释——它来自另一个世界。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...And Erina told us what happened right before that point. She met Miiya.
entries.new: ……而 Erina 把就在那之前发生的事告诉了我们。她遇见了 Miiya。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Could Miiya have had that note...? Did I really write it in another world?
entries.new: 那张纸条会不会在 Miiya 手上……？难道真是我在另一个世界写下的？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Why was she there, and where did she go?
entries.new: 她为什么会在那里？后来又去了哪里？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I put my hand in my pocket, but the note wasn't there. It had disappeared at some point.
entries.new: 我把手伸进口袋，纸条却不在里面。不知什么时候，它已经消失了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Right. The next time I traveled to the past, I didn't appear with it.{w} But... why? I should have.
entries.new: 对了。下一次我回到过去时，它没有跟着我出现。{w}可是……为什么？明明应该跟着的。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Although that was what it seemed like, concluding why it had vanished was relatively simple.
entries.new: 虽然看起来是那样，但它为什么会消失，其实并不难想明白。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Oh, it's like I thought earlier. I had the note when I traveled to the past. From the staff room, I appeared in hallway B and then slammed the storeroom door to create a new noise. After that, I waited in the bathroom on the second floor.{w} There, I put my hand in my pocket because I wanted to flush the note away. However, it wasn't there.{w} That's why I didn't appear with it. I wanted to flush it away, so if I had, I wouldn't have held the note in the future, and I never could've appeared with it.
entries.new: 哦，就像我之前想的那样。我回到过去时，身上带着那张纸条。我从员工室出现在 B走廊，然后用力摔上储藏室的门，制造出新的响声。之后，我在二楼的洗手间里等着。{w}在那里，我把手伸进口袋，因为我想把纸条冲掉。可是它不在。{w}所以它才没有跟着我出现。我想冲掉它；要是我真那么做了，未来的我手上就不会有那张纸条，我也就不可能带着它出现。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: These details... I wonder how many I missed.{w} Now that I think about it, something similar happened that very same travel.{w} When I touched the Sekimeiya, I had the locker key in my hand. However, when I returned to the staff room with Shiroya, I had it in my pocket. I still appeared with it in the past, but it was in my pocket.
entries.new: 这些细节……不知道我漏掉了多少。{w}现在回想起来，就在那一次穿越里，也发生过类似的事。{w}我碰到 Sekimeiya 时，手里拿着储物柜钥匙。可是当我和 Shiroya 回到员工室时，钥匙却在我的口袋里。我回到过去时仍然带着它，只不过它是在口袋里。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...That's because if I'd appeared with it in my hand, I would've then put it in my pocket. That redundant action was canceled, and I simply appeared with it already inside.{w} Along the same line of thought, I didn't go to the bathroom many times, did I? I didn't feel the need to.{w} Maybe that happened due to my travels—if I'd felt that urge upon going back, I would've gone to the bathroom. Then, in the replicated location, that wouldn't have been needed anymore. My bladder just automatically emptied without me noticing.
entries.new: ……因为如果我出现时手里拿着它，之后也会把它放进口袋。那个多余的动作被取消了，结果我出现时，它干脆就已经在口袋里。{w}同理，我去洗手间的次数其实并不多，对吧？因为我并不觉得有必要。{w}也许这是穿越造成的——如果我在回去时产生了那种冲动，我就会去洗手间。而在复制后的地点，也就不再需要去了。我的膀胱只是在我没注意时自行排空了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...There certainly are mysteries I still can't solve. Maybe I can, but I'm failing to do so.
entries.new: ……确实还有一些我解不开的谜。也许我解得开，只是没能做到。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Miiya's existence, Shiroya's...
entries.new: Miiya 的存在，Shiroya 的……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: In the event room, when Erina activated the Sekimeiya, the world around us changed, and Sai was the only one to travel through time.
entries.new: 在活动室里，Erina 启动 Sekimeiya 的那一刻，周围的世界随之改变，而穿越时间的只有 Sai 一人。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Atsuki had hidden the Past Sekimeiya in Ido's locker, so Sai went to the future.
entries.new: Atsuki 把 Past Sekimeiya 藏进了 Ido 的储物柜，所以 Sai 去了未来。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He had just been in the attic's bedroom, so he reappeared there with Shiroya. That is how he unintentionally locked himself in that room.
entries.new: 他之前就在阁楼的卧室里，于是便和 Shiroya 一同在那里现身。就这样，他无意间把自己锁进了那间屋子。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: When that happened, Shiroya was with us, but her clothes were different... She had appeared before me when I'd cried her name...
entries.new: 当时，Shiroya 虽然和我们在一起，但衣服却不同……我喊出她名字的时候，她就那样出现在我眼前……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: That was the real Shiroya, but what happened to her? How did she get there?
entries.new: 那的确是真正的 Shiroya，可她究竟出了什么事？又是怎么到那里的？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Was she the Shiroya from this morning, the one who'd traveled to the pa—
entries.new: 她就是今早那个 Shiroya 吗？那个穿越到过——
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Her words came back to me. She had told me that she'd traveled to November 30th.
entries.new: 她的话又浮现在我脑海里。她曾对我说，自己穿越到了11月30日。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wait, what the hell...? There's a major contradiction with that.
entries.new: 等等，这到底怎么回事……？这样说起来，可就有一个天大的矛盾了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: She said that she appeared below the gem shop... but that can't be. She wouldn't have appeared there if she'd gone from December 15th to November 30th.
entries.new: 她说自己出现在宝石店楼下……可那不可能。如果她是从12月15日回到11月30日，根本不会出现在那个地方。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: That location was exactly where she was on November 30th.{w} The only way for her to appear there is if she went fifteen days into the future.{w} ...To December 30th.
entries.new: 那个地方，正是她11月30日所在之处。{w} 她要出现在那里，唯一的可能就是穿越到了十五天后的未来。{w}……也就是12月30日。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...Could she really have gone to the future? Did that occur without her realizing it?{w} Right, I didn't think about it earlier, but the Sekimeiya that sent us repeatedly to January 5th at {time=21:00} was the one that Shiroya activated in the bathroom.
entries.new: ……她真的去了未来吗？难道连她自己都没有察觉？{w} 对了，我之前一直没想到——那台在{time=21:00}一次次把我们送往1月5日的 Sekimeiya，正是 Shiroya 在浴室里启动的那一台。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I couldn't know what had happened, but just the location where she'd appeared spelled it out clearly.
entries.new: 我无从知道究竟发生了什么，可她现身的地点本身就已经说明了一切。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wait, this is why...
entries.new: 等等，原来是因为这个……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It's why the chain of travels forward stopped on January 5th! It's gotta be!
entries.new: 正因如此，这一连串向前的穿越才会停在1月5日！一定是这样！
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Shiroya traveled to the future. She went to December 30th. Then, like she told me, she entered the tower through the storeroom days later—on January 5th.
entries.new: Shiroya 穿越到了未来，去的是12月30日。然后，就像她告诉我的那样，几天之后——1月5日，她从储藏室进了塔里。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: She didn't tell me exactly what she did, but I know she was in the mechanical room. She told me that she found the attic key there.{w} So she was looking for something, and without realizing it, she moved the Future Sekimeiya in the mechanical room. The next time that all of us appeared, nobody instantly activated the next travel, so we stopped on the 5th. That has to be it!
entries.new: 她没细说自己做了什么，但我知道她去过机械室。她说过，阁楼的钥匙就是在那儿找到的。{w} 也就是说，她当时在找东西，却无意间挪动了机械室里的 Future Sekimeiya。等我们所有人下一次现身时，没有人立刻启动下一段穿越，所以我们才停在了5日。一定是这样！
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I looked at the voice recorder.
entries.new: 我看向录音笔。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: 58:42. It's almost been an hour already.
entries.new: 58分42秒。已经快一个小时了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I didn't have much time.
entries.new: 剩下的时间不多了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Although it once seemed impossible, saving Miiya from the explosion should be simple. Very soon, if I touch the Sekimeiya, I'll be sent back to a point before she died.{w} ...Then, I could stop it. I could change the past.
entries.new: ……把 Miiya 从爆炸中救下，曾经看来毫无可能，如今却应该很简单。再过不久，只要我触碰 Sekimeiya，就会被送回她死去之前的时间点。{w}……那样，我就能阻止它。我就能改变过去。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: That would create the world that we want—the one we thought we'd have on that day.
entries.new: 那样一来，就能创造出我们想要的世界——那个我们以为在那一天本该拥有的世界。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...But there's still a big problem. If I do that, I can't live in it. Two versions of myself would remain.
entries.new: ……但还有一个大问题。若真这么做，我便无法活在那个世界里。那里会留下两个我。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: That had previously been a theoretical problem I hadn't needed to confront. However, it was the truth; although that world was attainable, it had no room for its creator.
entries.new: 这个问题从前只是理论上的，我无须面对。可它的确是事实：那个世界纵然可以抵达，却容不下它的创造者。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Given all I'd concluded, I could think of a slight workaround.
entries.new: 综合种种推论，我想到一个勉强的变通办法。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I could create that world and then leave it...
entries.new: 我可以创造出那个世界，然后从中离开……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: If I'm right, and touching the Sekimeiya when both ranges overlap will send me to the other world, I could do that after saving Miiya.{w} If it worked, although I'd end up in my original world, I would've at least facilitated the best one's existence.
entries.new: 如果我的推测没错，在两个范围重叠时触碰 Sekimeiya 就能被送往另一个世界，那我大可在救下 Miiya 之后这么做。{w} 若真能成功，纵然我最后会回到原本的世界，至少也让那个最好的世界得以存在。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: But I don't get what's happening right now. Why was Miiya in the tower?{w} If I did what I'm thinking, I would make sure our past selves don't go to the event, as that would put them in danger again. So, then, why is Miiya here? ...And why have I not seen Shiroya anywhere?
entries.new: 可眼前的一切，我仍旧想不通。Miiya 为什么会在塔里？{w} 若我按计划行事，一定会设法让过去的我们不去参加那场活动，免得他们再次陷入危险。既然如此，Miiya 又怎会在这里？……还有，为什么我到处都见不到 Shiroya？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...That time before {time=21}, why did Shiroya say that she didn't want to save Miiya? It couldn't have been the real Shiroya, but I can't figure out a reason.
entries.new: ……{time=21}之前的那一次，Shiroya 为什么说不想救 Miiya？那不可能是真正的 Shiroya，可我想不出其中的缘由。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...However, as I'd thought, doing what I'd proposed myself was simple. I only had to touch the Sekimeiya when the device displayed 65 minutes and 20 seconds.{w} As I could plan out the loop before executing it, there was a best-case scenario that I'd thought up.
entries.new: ……不过，正如我所料，执行自己的方案并不难。只要在装置显示65分20秒时触碰 Sekimeiya 即可。{w} 我可以在执行之前把循环安排妥当，也想好了一套最理想的情形。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I would appear on November 24th. That's 21 days before now, and it'll be January 5th in 21 days. Basically, if I think about what I'll do on January 5th, I can plan my arrival on November 24th.
entries.new: 我会在11月24日现身。那是现在的21天前，而再过21天就是1月5日。换句话说，只要先想好1月5日该做的事，我就能安排自己在11月24日出现。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: After November 30th, once everything is done, I could touch the Sekimeiya to go to our previous world. There, I know I'll be able to use the Sekimeiya on January 5th after we break free from the chain of travels.{w} ...If I plan this out so I obtain both Sekimeiya on the 5th, I can appear with them on November 24th, which will allow me to use them immediately after the 30th.
entries.new: 等到11月30日之后、一切尘埃落定，我可以触碰 Sekimeiya，回到我们原先的世界。在那里，等我们挣脱穿越的连锁，我知道自己能在1月5日使用 Sekimeiya。{w}……只要我事先安排妥当，让自己在5日那天拿到两台 Sekimeiya，就能带着它们出现在11月24日，这样在30日之后便能立刻动用。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: What I can't be sure of is that doing so will bring me to the world I was in. It could send me anywhere else.
entries.new: 唯一无法确定的是，这么做是否真能让我回到原先所在的世界。也可能被送到别的什么地方。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: If that happens, though, won't it be the world where Shiroya is? The Shiroya who disappeared from this world earlier today?
entries.new: 可若真是那样，会不会正好是 Shiroya 所在的世界？就是今天早些时候从这个世界上消失的那个 Shiroya？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...Would that be consistent? Even though I would've altered this world, would I be sent to the same place where she went?
entries.new: ……这样说得通吗？纵使我改变了这个世界，难道就会被送到她去的同一个地方？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I had no idea where Shiroya was, but I remembered the time I'd told her that changing the past was possible. Without a doubt, she wanted Miiya to be saved, and the opportunity to accomplish it was finally real. Even with all that I'd concluded, I found myself entirely lost, merely aware that Miiya's death was reversible.
entries.new: Shiroya 身在何处，我毫无头绪；但我记得自己曾告诉她，过去是可以改变的。她无疑希望 Miiya 得救，而实现这一点的机会终于真正摆在眼前。尽管已经推演出这一切，我仍旧茫然无措，只知道 Miiya 的死可以挽回。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If touching the Sekimeiya doesn't send me to our world, what that might mean is that on January 5th, I won't be able to have them. Then, I wouldn't appear with them on November 24th, so I suppose I'll know as soon as I travel.
entries.new: 若触碰 Sekimeiya 后没能回到我们的世界，那或许意味着1月5日那天我拿不到它们。这样一来，我也就不会带着它们出现在11月24日——看来，穿越的那一刻就能知道答案。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: If that happens, I'll have to wait until December 15th to change worlds during the incident.
entries.new: 若真是如此，我就只能等到12月15日，趁那场事件发生时切换世界了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...{w}Was it a flawed plan? I went over it again, and I didn't think so. I intended to change history. There was no option to check a note a future self of mine would leave behind to assure my success.{w} Saving Miiya was achievable. I'd dearly wished for that, hoped it was possible, been denied, and arrived at a real chance for it. It was a surreal thought, but there was no longer a reason to doubt it.
entries.new: ……{w}这个计划有破绽吗？我又推敲了一遍，并不觉得有。我本就打算改写历史。我也没法查看未来的自己会不会留下字条，好确认这样做能否成功。{w} 救下 Miiya 是可以做到的。我曾那样殷切地盼望、相信它有可能，也曾被现实否定，如今终于等到了真正的机会。这念头仿佛不真实，却再没有理由去怀疑。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Once it was created, I would let that world continue to exist by leaving it.{w} Would it be possible to find the Shiroya I'd been with? If so, would we be able to return to our world? Assuming we could do that, there would be nothing else to wish for.
entries.new: 一旦那个世界被创造出来，我便以离开的方式让它继续存在下去。{w} 我能找到曾与我相伴的那个 Shiroya 吗？若能找到，我们还能回到原本的世界吗？倘若这一切都能实现，那便再无所求了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But I still can't wrap my head around Miiya's existence in the tower. Does that conflict with what I'm aiming for?{w} How was she here? If I save her, I know I'll make sure none of us go to the tower. How is it possible that she was here all day?
entries.new: 可 Miiya 为何会在塔里，我始终想不明白。这与我追求的目标相冲突吗？{w} 她怎么会在这里？如果我救了她，我一定会确保我们谁都不去那座塔。既然如此，她又怎么可能一整天都待在这里？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I don't understand it, but it shouldn't be an issue regardless.{w} On top of that, I can't be content with just knowing that she was in the tower. I still need to act.
entries.new: 我不明白，但无论如何，这应该都不成问题。{w} 再说，光是知道她曾在塔里，并不能让我安心。我还得动手去做。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: The note I found in my pocket could've come from Miiya. Erina said that she saw her minutes before we traveled to the world where she existed...{w} That note implied only one thing: Shiroya's death. If that world was this very same one I'm in, and Miiya came from it, could that be why I haven't seen Shiroya...? Is it because she's not here at all?
entries.new: 我口袋里那张字条，或许是 Miiya 写的。Erina 说过，就在我们穿越到那个有她存在的世界之前几分钟，她还见过 Miiya……{w} 那张字条只暗示了一件事：Shiroya 的死。若那个世界正是我现在身处的这个世界，而 Miiya 也来自那里，这会不会就是我见不到 Shiroya 的原因……？因为她根本就不在这里？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: If I'm able to appear on November 24th with both Sekimeiya, I'll be able to freely travel back through time just in case there's any issue I can't foresee the first time around.
entries.new: 只要我能带着两台 Sekimeiya 出现在11月24日，就能随意穿越回过去，以防第一次行动中出现我无法预料的变故。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I exhaled slowly. I was ready to act. Even though the true shape of the universe was impossible to comprehend, I knew enough to be confident in myself.
entries.new: 我缓缓吐出一口气。我已做好准备，可以行动了。宇宙的真实面目固然无法参透，但我知道的已经足够，足以让我相信自己。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: And no matter what, it would lead to a result. No matter what it was, an outcome would arise from the labyrinthine structure that had formed around me.
entries.new: 无论如何，行动都会带来结果。无论结果是什么，那个在我周围形成的迷宫般的结构，终将给出一个答案。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I can do it, can't I? I can easily appear on November 24th. It has to be that day because it's proportional to January 5th.{w} I don't think anyone's still in the tower right now, so the range should only affect me.
entries.new: 我能做到的，不是吗？让我出现在11月24日并不难。必须是那一天，它与1月5日正好对应。{w} 现在塔里应该没有别人了，重叠范围只会影响我一个人。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: The time on the screen was 62:37. I'd taken the Past Sekimeiya out of the refrigerator as I'd pressed record, so I didn't have a lot of time to waste.
entries.new: 屏幕上的时间是62分37秒。按下录音键时，我已经把 Past Sekimeiya 从冰箱里取了出来，剩下的时间并不多。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: In the past, I won't be able to stay at my house. That means I'll need money to stay somewhere else.
entries.new: 回到过去后，我不能住在自己家里。也就是说，我需要钱去别处落脚。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...But that's not an issue. What I figured out earlier will help me here.
entries.new: ……不过这不是问题。之前想通的那些，正好能派上用场。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: In November, I could very easily obtain the money my past self has saved. However, I'd like to avoid doing that so I don't cause any issues.{w} Instead, I can just duplicate it. I can take that money, which will allow me to have it on January 5th. Then, I'll appear with it on November 24th, so it won't be necessary to obtain it from my past self.
entries.new: 到了十一月，想拿到过去的自己存下的那笔钱很容易。但我不想节外生枝，所以还是别那么干。{w} 不如直接复制一份。我取走复制的钱，就能在一月五日拿到它；再带着它出现在十一月二十四日，就不用从过去的自己手里取了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Of course, to have it on January 5th, I have to not spend it. There's another way to solve this—just duplicate it again.
entries.new: 当然，要在一月五日拿到它，我就不能把它花掉。要解决这个问题还有另一个办法——再复制一次就行。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: My body shook with anticipation, jittering all the way down to my fingertips. I was closer to leaving the tower than I had been in what felt like eons.
entries.new: 我因期待而浑身发颤，连指尖都在抖。距离离开这座塔，我从未如此之近，仿佛已等了千万年。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: On January 5th, if I'm able to get the Sekimeiya, that will happen inside the tower around the morning, after the point I traveled to the past. Since it's currently the afternoon, I'll appear at close to midnight on the 25th.
entries.new: 一月五日，如果我能拿到 Sekimeiya，那会是在塔内，接近早晨，就在我穿越回过去之后。现在还是下午，所以我将在二十五日接近午夜时现身。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...That's perfect.
entries.new: ……太合适了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I stopped thinking and stepped closer to the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 我不再多想，朝 Sekimeiya 走近一步。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: 64:47. The seconds were rapidly going up.
entries.new: 64:47。秒数正飞快地往上跳。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: 65. Only twenty more seconds.
entries.new: 65。只剩二十秒了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The aura of heat around the Sekimeiya had compounded immensely, but my senses were honed in on the timer. I barely registered the temperature.
entries.new: Sekimeiya 周围的热浪已积聚得极其浓烈，但我的全部感官都锁在计时器上，几乎感觉不到温度。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Lucid Dream
entries.new: 清醒梦

entries.text: 65:19. That was the last number my eyes saw before my sight blackened.
entries.new: 65:19。这是我在眼前一黑之前看到的最后一个数字。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Where—
entries.new: ……这里是——
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Touching the Sekimeiya brought back the darkness. However, I immediately discerned where I was: the place where I'd thought I'd appear.
entries.new: 碰到 Sekimeiya，黑暗再度降临。但我立刻辨出了自己身在何处——正是我预想会现身的地方。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It's the lobby. Since there's no light, it must be nighttime.
entries.new: 是大厅。一点光都没有，看来是夜里。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: There was something on my lap, and I knew what it was. A suitcase. It was open, and both Sekimeiya were in it.
entries.new: 腿上放着什么东西，我知道那是什么——一只手提箱。箱盖敞着，两个 Sekimeiya 都在里面。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It worked...! The Sekimeiya are here!{w} This is everything I need to confirm this'll work!{w} I'll go back to my world, and on January 5th, I'll be able to get both Sekimeiya!
entries.new: 成功了……！Sekimeiya 就在这里！{w} 有这些，就足够证实这个计划可行了！{w} 我回到自己的世界，到了一月五日，就能把两个 Sekimeiya 都拿到手！
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I could feel that my clothing hadn't changed. When I looked around me, I saw the sight I'd been longing for: the sky. As my vision adjusted, the multitude of stars above me took shape. The shutter, the barrier to the outside, was gone.
entries.new: 我能感觉到自己的衣服没有变。环顾四周，我看见了那个朝思暮想的景象——天空。视线渐渐适应，头顶的繁星显出轮廓。那道隔开外界的卷帘门，不见了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I stood up, speechless, and haltingly walked over to the door.
entries.new: 我无言地站起身，一步一顿地走向门口。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I could see snow on the ground, illuminated by a handful of streetlights. It was right there, behind a screen of glass.
entries.new: 我能看见地面上的积雪，被几盏路灯照亮。它就在那里，只隔着一层玻璃。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I placed my hand on the handle and gently pushed.{w} The door didn't open. As I'd expected, it was locked.{w} I couldn't go to the storeroom because the hallway cameras would record me...
entries.new: 我把手放在门把上，轻轻一推。{w} 门没有开。果然锁着。{w} 我不能去储藏室，走廊的摄像头会拍到我……
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I put my hand in my pocket, hoping I would feel cold metal.
entries.new: 我把手伸进口袋，盼着能摸到冰凉的金属。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Yes! It's here!
entries.new: 太好了！在这里！
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It was a keyring with a dog-shaped keychain—the one I'd found in the coat of a staff member, which I could obtain on January 5th. Since it had been in the clothes that staff member had worn when entering the tower, it was possible one of the keys unlocked the door. Appearing with it guaranteed that one would.
entries.new: 那是一串挂着狗形钥匙扣的钥匙——就是我在一月五日拿到的那串，原本放在一名员工的外套里。既然钥匙串是在那名员工进塔时穿的衣服里找到的，其中一把钥匙就有可能打开这扇门。带着它出现，就保证有一把能开。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There were four keys, and one was bigger than the others. Once I found the keyhole below the handle, I inserted it.
entries.new: 一共四把钥匙，其中一把比别的都大。我找到门把下方的锁孔，把它插了进去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: When it turned, my shoulders dropped, unable to believe the truth. I could set foot outside that place.
entries.new: 钥匙一转，我双肩一松，几乎不敢相信这是真的——我可以踏出那个地方了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: And when the door opened, I did so without thinking. I was no longer in the building; there was snow around me, and I was holding the Sekimeiya. Most importantly, I had a plan I could enact successfully.
entries.new: 门一开，我便不假思索地跨了出去。我已经不在那栋楼里了；四周是雪，手里握着 Sekimeiya。最重要的是，我有了一个可以顺利执行的计划。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: A lone key was in my pocket, isolated from the set—the rusty key I'd obtained in the security room. And in my other pocket, I found money.
entries.new: 口袋里有一把单独的钥匙，是从那串上取下来的——就是我在监控室拿到的生锈钥匙。另一个口袋里，我摸到了钱。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I could only stand there, feeling the cold air hit my face.
entries.new: 我只能站在原地，任冷风扑在脸上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I couldn't believe I'd really been able to walk out. I'd gotten far too used to being stopped. A faint buzz hummed around me, fading into the night. I took a step forward and was assaulted by tiredness.
entries.new: 我竟然真的走了出来，简直难以置信。被拦下太多次，我早已习惯了。耳边隐约有一阵嗡鸣，渐渐消散在夜色里。我向前迈出一步，疲惫顿时涌了上来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: So this is how I'll be on January 5th... I feel exhausted.
entries.new: 原来一月五日的我是这个样子……累得不行。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: And I had to go somewhere. The cold was rapidly getting to me, and a full night was still ahead.
entries.new: 而且我得找个去处。寒气正迅速侵入身体，而整夜还长着呢。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Where do I go? There's a motel in the center of town, but I'm not sure it'll be open.
entries.new: ……我该去哪儿？镇中心有家汽车旅馆，但不确定还开着没有。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I kept a replica of my keys outside my house, so I could silently sneak into my parents' room and stay there without alerting my own self. That wasn't something I wanted to do if I could help it.
entries.new: 我在家门外藏了一副备用钥匙，这样就能悄悄溜进父母的房间落脚，不会惊动我自己。但若非万不得已，我并不想这么做。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I suppose I'll have to see.
entries.new: 看来只能去看看了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I turned around and saw a large shadow covering the stars. It was the tower, looking even bigger than I recalled.
entries.new: 我回过头，看见一片巨大的黑影遮住了星空。那是塔，比我记忆中还要高大。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: With the same key I'd used to leave, I locked the front door.
entries.new: 我用刚才离开时用的那把钥匙，把前门锁上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Once I'd taken a few steps, all light was gone. Fortunately, I could navigate the streets without a problem.
entries.new: ……走出几步之后，四下里就一片漆黑了。好在这些街道我熟得很，走起来毫无困难。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I walked, unable to hear any sounds beyond my own steps. As I got closer to the center, more faint lights dotted the streets. Soon, I stepped into the widest street and approached a building I'd never been to.
entries.new: 我一路走着，除了自己的脚步声，什么都听不见。越靠近镇中心，街上零星的灯火就越多。不久，我踏上最宽的那条街，走向一栋从未去过的建筑。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There was a sign above the door. It read "Eagle Motel".
entries.new: 门上挂着一块招牌，写着「鹰旅馆」。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Is it closed? I don't see anyone.
entries.new: 关门了吗？一个人都看不见。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: There was a bell near it, so I pressed it.
entries.new: 旁边有个门铃，我按了下去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I waited, wondering if the sound had reached anyone.
entries.new: 我等着，心想那铃声有没有传到谁耳中。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It took me a while to discern that a tall man was approaching me. He turned on the lights and opened the door from the inside, his eyes showing that he'd been about to fall asleep.
entries.new: 过了好一会儿，我才看出有个高个子男人正朝我走来。他打开灯，从里面开了门，眼神迷迷糊糊的，像是刚要睡着。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: S-Sorry. Would it be possible for me to spend the night here?
entries.new: 抱、抱歉。能让我在这里住一晚吗？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: ...You don't have a reservation?
entries.new: ……你没有预订？
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: No... Something just came up, and I have nowhere to stay.
entries.new: 没有……临时出了点事，我实在无处可去。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: We have spare rooms, but it's ¥8,000 a night.
entries.new: 有空房，不过一晚 ¥8,000。
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: That's fine. I might have to stay a few days.
entries.new: 没问题。我可能得在这儿住上几天。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I suddenly looked down at myself and noticed that my clothes still had very faint traces of smoke on them, although, I thought, not identical to how they'd been before traveling.
entries.new: 我忽然低头看了看自己，发现衣服上还残留着极淡的烟味——不过我记得，和穿越前那副样子并不一样。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I paid one night's rate and was given two keys—one for the front door and another for a bedroom.
entries.new: 我付了一晚的房费，拿到两把钥匙——一把开大门，一把开客房。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: My attention was immediately grabbed by a digital clock on the table. It was {time=22:54} on November 24th, a Thursday.
entries.new: 桌上的电子钟立刻吸引了我的目光。上面显示着 11 月 24 日，星期四，{time=22:54}。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I can't believe it. I traveled three weeks to the past.
entries.new: ……真不敢相信。我竟然回到了三周前。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Within the tower, anything had seemed possible, but with the effect reflected in the real world, my mind couldn't accept it.
entries.new: 在塔里时，仿佛什么都可能发生；可当这一切真实地反映在现实世界里，我却怎么也接受不了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Both Sekimeiya were in the suitcase, and the smell of the tower still hung around me.
entries.new: 两块 Sekimeiya 都在手提箱里，我身上还留着塔里的气味。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The room was linked to a bathroom with a shower and a kitchen. I had a lot of things to think about, but my body dropped on the bed, giving me no chance to do so.
entries.new: 房间连着带淋浴的浴室和一间厨房。我有很多事要想，可身体一沾到床，就再没有力气想下去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wait!{w} The money... I have to duplicate it.
entries.new: 等等！{w}钱……我得把钱复制出来。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I'd paid for a single night, so I had to duplicate that amount and then the entire sum. I got out of bed and approached the suitcase.
entries.new: 我只付了一晚的钱，得先复制出这一晚的数额，再把整笔钱复制回来。我下了床，走到手提箱前。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: They've been outside for so long, I'm sure they don't have a lot of energy. I should be able to touch one without the range reaching anyone else here.{w} I wonder which is the future one. If I touch the past one, I'll just appear in the bathroom and stay there until my past self leaves.
entries.new: 它们在外面放了这么久，能量肯定不多了。我碰其中一块，范围应该不会波及到这里的其他人。{w}不知道哪块才是通往未来的。要是碰到过去那块，我只会出现在浴室里，一直待到过去的我离开为止。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I'd undressed before getting in bed since the room was warm. If I replicated my past location, the money I'd been holding would duplicate.{w} I placed the suitcase on the bed and separated both gemstones. Then, I touched one of them in the center of the room.
entries.new: 房间很暖和，我上床前就把衣服脱了。只要重现我过去所在的位置，我手里的钱就会复制出来。{w}我把手提箱放到床上，将两块宝石分开，然后在房间中央碰了其中一块。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: My vision went dark, but I could hear something. ...I wasn't alone.
entries.new: 眼前一黑，我却听得见动静。……这里不止我一个人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wait, is this...?
entries.new: 等等，这里是……？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: My bedroom. Not the motel's, but the one in my house. When I glanced at the source of the sound, I saw my own body sleeping in my bed.
entries.new: 我的卧室。不是旅馆的房间，是我家里的那间。我朝声音的来源看去，只见自己正躺在床上睡着。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What!? Why am I here...?
entries.new: 什么！？我怎么会在这里……？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I slowly stepped back, unable to take my eyes off myself. It was November; that self of mine hadn't yet reunited with Shiroya and Miiya. By the time I reached the door, I started to understand what had happened.
entries.new: 我慢慢后退，目光却离不开那个自己。现在是十一月，那个我还没有和 Shiroya、Miiya 重逢。一直退到门口，我才渐渐明白发生了什么。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: My clothes changed... I went to the future.
entries.new: 衣服变了……我去了未来。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I think I traveled farther than I expected. Maybe the Sekimeiya were gathering energy inside the suitcase even though the outside was so chilly. I must have traveled more than fifteen minutes through time, so the replicated location was from a time before I appeared in the lobby, when I was about to sleep in my old world.
entries.new: 看来我穿越得比预想中更远。外面明明这么冷，Sekimeiya 或许还是把手提箱里的能量攒了起来。我穿越的时间跨度肯定超过十五分钟，所以重现的位置才落在我出现在大堂之前——那是我还在原来的世界里准备睡觉的时候。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Trying to prevent myself from being noticed, I approached the front door. ...It seemed I had replicated my body on November 24th, and it was fortunate I'd appeared when I'd already fallen asleep.
entries.new: 我尽量不惊动那个自己，摸向大门。……看来我重现的是 11 月 24 日的身体，幸好现身的时机正好是我已经睡着之后。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I felt the handle and opened the door. The sky brimmed with stars, and my clothes were no longer protecting me from the freezing air. I had left the motel bedroom empty, so I ran there.
entries.new: 我摸到门把手，推开了门。夜空满是繁星，身上的衣服却已挡不住刺骨的寒气。旅馆的房间还空着，我一路跑了回去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Once again, I had to ring the bell to enter. To my surprise, an older woman opened the door.
entries.new: 我又一次按响门铃才进去。没想到开门的是一位年长的女人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Sorry, I had to go out for a bit. Where's the man from before?
entries.new: 抱歉，我出去了一趟。刚才那位男士呢？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Oh, old Stanley? He sticks to a strict sleep schedule. Next time, don't ring the bell, just knock. He gets mean when you wake him up. Along with you now.
entries.new: 哦，你说老 Stanley？他的作息可严格了。下次别按门铃，敲门就行。把他吵醒，他脾气可不好——这下连你也要挨骂了。
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: The Sekimeiya was still on the bed. There was no doubt it was the future one, as the clock showed {time=23:29.}
entries.new: Sekimeiya 还在床上。钟上显示着 {time=23:29.}，毫无疑问是通往未来的那一块。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I didn't change worlds, so the range of the other Sekimeiya didn't reach me. I hope nobody else traveled with me.
entries.new: ……我没有切换世界，另一块 Sekimeiya 的范围也就没有波及到我。但愿没有别人跟着我一起穿越。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I sat on the bed and panted, each inhalation bringing lancing pain. I was even more tired than before, and it took me a second to process why. The replicated location had been from when the past me was about to go to sleep.
entries.new: 我坐在床上喘息，每吸一口气都像被针扎。我比先前更累了，愣了一下才想明白其中缘由——我出现的位置，是过去的我正要入睡时的地方。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I didn't actually duplicate the money.
entries.new: ……钱其实没能复制成功。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: My old clothes were beside the bed, but I had to reset the Sekimeiya before attempting it again.{w} I sat up and walked to the kitchen.
entries.new: 原先的衣服就在床边，不过我得先把 Sekimeiya 重置，才能再试一次。{w}我坐起身，走向厨房。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Oh, there's a refrigerator here.
entries.new: 哦，这里还有冰箱。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It was running, so I knew it would work to cool off the Sekimeiya. After putting both of them inside, I grabbed the money from the pocket of my other pants.
entries.new: 冰箱在运转，正好可以用来冷却 Sekimeiya。我把两块都放进去，然后从另一条裤子的口袋里取出钱。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I took the Future Sekimeiya back out and waited a few seconds. Subsequently, I left the money on the floor and felt the surface of the gemstone.
entries.new: 我把 Future Sekimeiya 重新取出来，等了几秒，随后把钱放在地板上，伸手触碰宝石表面。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: My sight hardly changed, but I knew I'd teleported. I was holding the stack of money, and the original bills were on the floor. I could use them while I kept the duplicated ones until January 5th.
entries.new: 视野几乎没有变化，但我知道自己已经传送了。我手里握着一叠钱，原本那几张仍躺在地板上。我可以先花掉原钞，把复制出来的钱留到 1 月 5 日。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I have to duplicate a night's worth too since I already paid for it.
entries.new: 那一晚的房钱我已经付了，也得照样复制一份出来。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: The Future Sekimeiya was still powered off. I reset it to repeat the process, and once I'd duplicated the full amount of money, I left both Sekimeiya in the refrigerator again.
entries.new: Future Sekimeiya 仍处于关闭状态。我重置了它，重复同样的步骤，等整笔钱都复制好，又把两块 Sekimeiya 一起放回冰箱。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I fell to the bed. I didn't bother taking off my clothes the second time since they were a lot lighter than before.
entries.new: 我扑倒在床上。第二次我懒得脱衣服了，毕竟身上这身比之前轻快得多。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Before I knew it, I could see the sun through the window.
entries.new: 不知不觉间，阳光已经照进窗来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I looked at the clock, trying to remember where I was.{w} {time=10:09}, November 25th. It all came back to me when I saw those blurry numbers.
entries.new: 我看向时钟，努力回想自己身在何处。{w} {time=10:09}，11 月 25 日。看清那串模糊的数字，一切才重新涌回脑海。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I quickly got out of bed and checked the Sekimeiya in the refrigerator.
entries.new: 我连忙下床，去查看冰箱里的 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It doesn't seem like the Sekimeiya heat up inside, so they're fine here.
entries.new: Sekimeiya 放在里面好像不会发热，搁在这儿没问题。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: November 25th. On this day... I hadn't even received Miiya's call yet. Right now, I was at home all alone.
entries.new: 11 月 25 日。这一天……我连 Miiya 的电话都还没接到。这个时候，我还一个人待在家里。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I felt a little dizzy, so I put on my original clothes and walked out of the room to a cafeteria I'd seen downstairs.
entries.new: 我有些头晕，便换上原来的衣服，走出房间，去了之前在楼下看到的那间餐厅。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Fortunately, I had enough money to cover all the days I needed.{w} Once I felt rested, I went back up.
entries.new: 幸好身上的钱足够付清这些天的房费。{w}歇够了，我才回到楼上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I sat on the bed and went over what I would do.
entries.new: 我坐在床上，把接下来要做的事在脑中过了一遍。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I'm in the past of the world where Miiya was alive. If I don't change the past, will she not die? ...Or was she in the tower for another reason?
entries.new: ……我回到了 Miiya 还活着的那个世界的过去。如果我不去改变过去，她是不是就不会死？……还是说，她进塔另有原因？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I have the Sekimeiya, so maybe I should see what happens on the 30th and then go to the past. I can't risk the plan getting ruined due to a difference in the events that I'm not aware of.
entries.new: 我有 Sekimeiya，也许该先看看 30 号会发生什么，再回到过去。要是有我不知道的变故让计划泡汤，那可就糟了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: If what happened on the 30th repeats, why would Miiya have been in the tower? ...Is there an explanation for that?
entries.new: 如果 30 号的事会重演，那 Miiya 当初为什么会进塔？……这一点有解释吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: The concept of different worlds I have is rough, but I was thinking of something...
entries.new: 我对不同世界的理解还很粗浅，不过我在想一件事……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: If I save Miiya, my plan was to go back to my initial world. I can't stay in this one. That would allow this world to exist, at the very least...
entries.new: 我的计划是救下 Miiya 之后，回到最初的世界。我不能留在这个世界里。至少这样，这个世界还能继续存在……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: But after saving her, I could travel to the other world with Miiya, which would result in the same effect. The other world would end up with her, while this one wouldn't.
entries.new: 但救下她之后，我也可以带着 Miiya 一起前往另一个世界，效果并无不同。那样一来，另一个世界会有她，这个世界则没有。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I couldn't bring myself to do that. ...I had already accepted Miiya's death once.{w} Even if I was able to bring her to our world, would that truly be better? I would just create avoidable pain in another.
entries.new: 可我做不到。……Miiya 的死，我已经接受过一次。{w} 就算我能把她带回我们的世界，那真的更好吗？我不过是在另一个世界里制造本可避免的痛苦罢了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But I believe it's possible the Miiya in the tower came from a different world—from one in which she didn't die. That would explain why she was there with no influence of mine.
entries.new: 但我认为，塔里的那个 Miiya 有可能来自另一个世界——一个她并没有死的世界。这样就能解释她为何会在那里，且与我的干预无关。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Everything regarding other worlds was too hypothetical. I had to stick to what I'd planned.
entries.new: 其他世界的事，说到底都只是假想。我只能按原定计划行事。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I'll make sure she doesn't die. I'll make this world into the one we wanted. In the end, I'll have to abandon it, but at least I'll know it exists.
entries.new: ……我会确保她不会死。我会让这个世界变成我们想要的样子。到最后，我不得不舍弃它，但至少我会知道，它存在过。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: After November 30th, I'll go back in time and prevent her death. After that, I'll change worlds, hopefully arriving in the one I was in.
entries.new: 11月30日之后，我会回到过去，阻止她的死亡。然后我会切换世界，希望能回到我原本所在的那个世界。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: If that works, I won't want to change the past any further. My goal will be to find the real Shiroya, who I'm sure will be there at one point. Maybe when she disappeared with Naomi, or maybe when she was in the tower with different clothes. Once I make it there, we can leave together.
entries.new: 如果一切顺利，我就不再改动过去了。我的目标是找到真正的 Shiroya，她必定会在某个时刻出现。也许是她和 Naomi 一同消失的时候，也许是她穿着不同的衣服待在塔里的时候。只要到达那里，我们就能一起离开。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: That will work.
entries.new: 这样能行。

entries.text: That will not work.
entries.new: 这样行不通。

entries.text: ...It would work. Atsuki was sure of it.
entries.new: ……会成功的。Atsuki 对此深信不疑。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He had to dispel his doubts and be confident he would succeed. There were five days until the 30th, but there was nothing he could do until then.
entries.new: 他必须打消疑虑，坚信自己会成功。距离30日还有五天，可在那之前，他什么也做不了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He didn't leave the motel. It had all the food he needed and a bedroom to sleep in.
entries.new: 他没有离开鹰旅馆。这里有足够的食物，也有能睡觉的房间。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: While the final day approached, he made sure the Sekimeiya worked. He traveled a few minutes through time and confirmed that all he'd learned still applied.
entries.new: 随着最后一天临近，他确认 Sekimeiya 仍能运作。他穿越了几分钟的时间，证实自己先前掌握的一切依然成立。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: November 30th came. Atsuki was still in that room, although it would soon be his time to act.
entries.new: 11月30日到了。Atsuki 仍待在那间房里，不过很快就轮到他行动了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He didn't take his eyes off the clock. At {time=21}, he could hardly breathe, remembering what had once happened.
entries.new: 他的视线一刻也没离开时钟。到了 {time=21}，回想起曾经发生过的事，他几乎无法呼吸。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: ...It must've already occurred by that point. Miiya was likely dead.
entries.new: ……到那个时刻，事情想必已经发生了。Miiya 多半已经死了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He hated that it had been allowed to repeat, but otherwise his plan could've been hindered. Even though the time had passed, he couldn't go to the shop for fear of being recognized.
entries.new: 他痛恨让那件事重演，可若不如此，他的计划或许就会受阻。时间虽然已经过去，他仍不敢去那家店，怕被人认出来。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: ...He had to wait until the morning news to know if everything had repeated as he'd once experienced it.
entries.new: ……他只能等到早间新闻，才能知道一切是否如他经历过的那样重演了一遍。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He stared at the ceiling all night. The moment the sun rose, he went to the cafeteria and turned on the television.
entries.new: 他盯着天花板看了整夜。太阳一升起，他就去了餐厅，打开电视。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: His eyes bored holes into the screen, waiting for the news to begin. Once it did, a mass of headlines were shown at once.
entries.new: 他死死盯着屏幕，等着新闻开始。新闻一开播，一大堆标题同时闪过。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: ...{w}He didn't see it. None of them had been about a gas explosion in Yushibana.
entries.new: ……{w}他没有看到。没有一条提到丰花发生的煤气爆炸。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: It couldn't be. There was no way that wouldn't have made the local news.
entries.new: 不可能。那样的事，本地新闻不可能不报。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He kept changing the channel, but there was no mention of what should have happened the previous night.
entries.new: 他不停地换台，可昨晚本该发生的事，没有半点消息。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Had he made a mistake? When that thought occurred to him, he dashed out of the motel.
entries.new: 难道是自己哪里出了差错？这个念头一冒出来，他便冲出了鹰旅馆。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He ran toward the stone buildings as fast as the snow allowed him.
entries.new: 他朝着那些石头建筑跑去，雪地里能跑多快就跑多快。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: When he reached the street, he was able to see it in the distance: there was light in Musashi Gemstones.{w} He didn't stop running. He burst through the door and gaped at the owner in disbelief.
entries.new: 跑到那条街上时，他远远就看见了：武藏宝石里亮着灯。{w} 他没有停下脚步，一把推开门，难以置信地瞪着店主。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Oh, you're back! What's with the rush?
entries.new: 哦，你回来了！怎么这么急？
entries.speaker: gan

entries.text: Wh-What?
entries.new: 什、什么？
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: He looked at the far side of the shop. The floor was intact.
entries.new: 他望向店铺深处。地板完好无损。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: D-Did anything happen yesterday?
entries.new: 昨、昨天发生什么事了吗？
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: Hm? What do you mean?
entries.new: 嗯？你指什么？
entries.speaker: gan

entries.text: N-No?
entries.new: 没、没有？
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: I don't know what you mean. What are you talking about?
entries.new: 我不明白你的意思。你在说什么？
entries.speaker: gan

entries.text: After seeing the undamaged shelves, there was a question Atsuki had to ask.
entries.new: 看到那些毫发无损的货架后，Atsuki 不得不问一个问题。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: What about th-the Sekimeiya?
entries.new: 那、那 Sekimeiya 呢？
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: The Seki... How do you know about that name!? I was planning to use it in the future!
entries.new: Seki……你怎么会知道这个名字！？我可是打算以后再用的！
entries.speaker: gan

entries.text: Atsuki bolted out of the shop, ignoring the owner's shouts. He ran to a nearby bus station, where he'd met Shiroya and Miiya on that final day.
entries.new: Atsuki 不顾店主在身后叫喊，冲出了店铺。他跑向附近的公交站——最后那天，他就是在那里遇见 Shiroya 和 Miiya 的。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: There was nothing there. Atsuki recalled having seen a flyer with the words "The Sekimeiya" stuck on the post.
entries.new: 那里什么都没有。Atsuki 记得，柱子上曾贴着一张写着「The Sekimeiya」的传单。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Next, he ran to his own house.
entries.new: 接着，他跑向自己家。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Th-There's light in the windows... I'm not in the hospital.
entries.new: 窗、窗户里有灯光……我没有住院。
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: He couldn't believe it. The explosion hadn't happened.
entries.new: 他不敢相信。爆炸没有发生。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Why? And what next? He had no idea what to do, so he stood paralyzed.
entries.new: 为什么？接下来又该怎么办？他完全不知道该做什么，只能僵立在原地。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: However, that was what he'd wanted. He hadn't done anything, but the result had been the same.
entries.new: 可这正是他想要的结果。他什么都没做，结果却完全一样。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Speechless, he waited in front of his house.
entries.new: 他无言地守在自己家门前。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Light snow began to fall, but he kept watching his window. He could see a figure behind it, similar to his own.
entries.new: 细雪开始飘落，他的目光却始终不离那扇窗。窗后能看见一个人影，身形与他相仿。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He realized he'd been there for hours when his front door opened. ...It really was his own self, with an expression he'd personally long since abandoned.
entries.new: 直到家门打开，他才意识到自己已站在那里几个小时了。……出来的确实是他自己，脸上带着一种他早已不再流露的神情。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He didn't hide, but it didn't seem like he'd been seen. He saw his own body walking ahead, so he followed him.
entries.new: 他没有躲，对方似乎也没有看见他。他眼看着自己的身体向前走去，便跟了上去。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Eventually, they reached Seeuta D'ella Park. Miiya and Shiroya were there, waving at him.
entries.new: 最终，他们来到了 Seeuta D'ella 公园。Miiya 和 Shiroya 就在那里，正朝他挥手。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: It was what he'd most wanted. Those days were continuing beyond November 30th.
entries.new: 那正是他最期盼的事。那些日子越过11月30日，仍在继续。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: But there was something more pressing within Atsuki's mind.
entries.new: 然而，Atsuki心中还有更迫切的事。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: It didn't make sense. It was a world... that didn't make sense.
entries.new: 这说不通。这个世界……根本说不通。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Ending: Impossible Perfection
entries.new: 结局：无法企及的完美

entries.text: Lucid Dream
entries.new: 清醒梦

entries.text: Will this work...?
entries.new: 这样真的能行吗……？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: The most delicate part is altering the story of this world. When I changed the past, it was clear the result wasn't straightforward.
entries.new: 最棘手的地方，在于改写这个世界的来龙去脉。我上次改变过去时，结果显然没那么简单。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It almost created a mesh of realities. Some people kept their memo—
entries.new: 那几乎把几个现实织成了一张网。有些人还保留着记——
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: The sudden realization shattered all my thoughts.
entries.new: 那一瞬间的醒悟，将我所有的思绪击得粉碎。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: No... What am I thinking?{w} ...I didn't change the past at all.
entries.new: 不……我在胡思乱想什么？{w}……我根本没有改变过去。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I decided I'd try to change the past after I suffered that strange injury in the elevator... I used the Sekimeiya to travel more than half an hour to the past.
entries.new: 我是在电梯里受了那道奇怪的伤之后，才决定试着改变过去的……我用Sekimeiya穿越到了半个多小时以前。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: "I began to walk toward the event room to check the time, but voices stopped me."
entries.new: 我动身往活动室走去，想确认时间，却被说话声拦住了脚步。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: "I got close to the door and focused my hearing."
entries.new: 我凑近门边，凝神细听。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...just suddenly ran aw— ...honestly wasn't sure.
entries.new: ……突然就跑掉了——……说实话，我也说不上来。
entries.speaker: aki4

entries.text: "I recognized the conversation. I'd arrived approximately a couple minutes before the point only Sai had traveled."
entries.new: 我听出了这段对话。我到达的时间，比只有Sai穿越到的那个时间点早了两三分钟。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It was a couple minutes before Sai disappeared in front of us us. That is to say, a couple minutes before we changed worlds.
entries.new: 那是Sai在我们眼前消失前的两三分钟。也就是说，是我们切换世界之前的两三分钟。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: To change the past, I produced a sound in hallway A. ...A sound we never heard.
entries.new: 为了改变过去，我在A走廊弄出了一点声响。……一个我们从未听见的声响。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: When I slammed the door, I thought I'd changed the past because we hadn't heard that sound in the event room. But... the reason we didn't hear it was because we'd gone to a different world.
entries.new: 我摔上门时，以为过去已经被我改写——因为我们在活动室里没听到那声响。可是……我们没听到，原因是我们去了另一个世界。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: And in that world, I ended up taking the elevator up to follow Shiroya.{w} That had to be when we came back. For some reason, we went back to our world.{w} That's what that injury signified—the elevator stopped abruptly because it wasn't moving in our world, and I cut myself with the handrail as my body overlapped with it.
entries.new: 而在那个世界里，我为了追Shiroya，坐上了电梯。{w}我们一定就是在那时回来的。不知为何，我们回到了自己的世界。{w}那道伤就是这个意思——电梯在我们这个世界里本就没有运行，所以骤然停住，我的身体与扶手重叠，被割伤了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: "It couldn't have been going too fast, but as it ceased all movement, it propelled us upward, and we slammed to the floor."
entries.new: 电梯本该没那么快，可就在它彻底停下的瞬间，却把我们向上抛起，重重摔在地板上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: "I felt my right hand burning. I looked at it and saw a cut."
entries.new: 右手火辣辣地疼。我低头一看，只见一道伤口。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What!? You're bleeding!
entries.new: 什么！？你在流血！
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: "I could only process the intense pain coming from the wound. While I couldn't comprehend how it had happened, I understood that I had cut my hand with the handrail when our bodies lifted, as it had been right above me."
entries.new: 我脑中只剩伤口传来的剧痛。它是怎么来的，我一时想不明白，却知道那是身体被抛起时，被正上方的扶手割伤的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: And that was the exact world we'd been in before: the Past Sekimeiya was back in the staff room, where I'd hidden it. It didn't teleport back there.{w} Akaro was gone, and Sai was once again the person we'd been with in the event room. Also, the blood I would leave on the staircase was surely already there.
entries.new: 而那正是我们先前待过的世界：Past Sekimeiya回到了员工室，就在我藏它的地方。它不是被传送回去的。{w}Akaro不见了，活动室里和我们在一起的又变回了Sai。还有，我之后会留在楼梯上的血迹，那时想必已经在那里了。
entries.speaker: nm
