entries.text: "The doors opened, so I dashed out of the elevator as fast as I could, forcing my eyes shut to suppress the pain."
entries.new: 门一开，我便拼命冲出电梯，紧闭双眼强忍疼痛。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...{w}So, when I went back in time and produced that "new" sound... I didn't actually change anything. When I slammed the door, the event room was already empty.{w} And then, despite the difference I would've caused, Erina and I still got out of the elevator on the third floor.
entries.new: ……{w}也就是说，我穿越回过去，弄出那声「新」的响动……其实什么都没改变。我摔门的时候，活动室已经空了。{w}而后来，尽管我本该造成一些差异，Erina和我还是在三楼走出了电梯。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I thought I had created an incomprehensible mess of memories, but now I understand. It seemed like only Sai remembered the effect of my change because he was the only person there when I slammed the door. ...For him, the blood in the hallways was always there, whereas for Erina and me, it wasn't before we took the elevator.
entries.new: 我原以为，自己把记忆搅成了一团无法理解的乱麻，现在总算明白了。似乎只有Sai记得我那番改动的影响——因为我摔门时，在场的人只有他。……对他来说，走廊里的血迹从一开始就在；可我和Erina上电梯之前，那里并没有血。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: "I looked next to us, and as I thought, the other trail of blood was coming from the elevator. It was from the time I'd gone down after suffering the injury; the floor was proof of both realities at once."
entries.new: 我看向身旁，果然，另一道血迹是从电梯那边延伸出来的。那是我受伤后下楼时留下的；这片地板同时印证了两个现实。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What the hell? This means that I still have no idea if the past can be changed!
entries.new: 搞什么？这么说，过去究竟能不能改变，我还是毫无头绪！
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: No... there's no way, is there? All that must mean is that it's not possible. It wasn't changed a single time. When I produced the Sekimeiya's travel formula, I made use of hypothetical worlds all different from each other, but the real one never changed...
entries.new: 不……不可能吧？这一切只能说明，过去改不了。一次都没能改成。我在生成Sekimeiya的穿越公式时，用的都是彼此不同的假想世界，而真正的世界从未改变过……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I was out of my mind when I tried it with the storeroom door. I could travel to the past and close a door I've seen open, but if the past can't be changed, the explanation for that could be that I'd die of a sudden heart attack or something like that!
entries.new: 我拿储藏室的门做试验的时候，真是疯了。我可以穿越回过去，关上一扇我见过开着的门；可如果过去无法改变，那解释就只可能是——我会猝死于心脏病之类的原因！
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: There's no other way to know but to try it, though. ...And doing so is incredibly risky.
entries.new: 可除此之外，没有别的办法能确认。……而这么做，风险大得惊人。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Now what!? Technically, I could never die after traveling to the past, or else there'd be no future location to replicate.{w} Would I die by touching the Sekimeiya, then? There's no way to verify any of this...!
entries.new: 那又该怎么办！？严格说来，穿越回过去之后，我根本不可能死，否则就没有未来的位置可供复制了。{w}那么，我会因为触碰Sekimeiya而死吗？这些根本无从验证……！
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I was suddenly stuck, with no way to know whether what I wanted to accomplish was achievable. At the very least, my past travels seemed to confirm that I'd be alive on January 5th and January 26th.
entries.new: 我一下子卡住了——我想做的事究竟能不能成，我无从得知。至少，我以往的那些穿越似乎证明，我在1月5日和1月26日都还活着。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Is there a way to increase or decrease the chance that it's possible to change the past? Outright confirming it seems like it's off the table.
entries.new: 有没有办法提高或降低改变过去的可能性？直接去证实，看来是行不通了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I went to the kitchen, where I had both Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 我去了厨房，两件Sekimeiya都收在那里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I grabbed them and determined which one was the past one.
entries.new: 我拿起它们，分辨出哪一件来自过去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...What can I really do to check this?
entries.new: ……到底该怎么做，才能验证这一点？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: There was a salt shaker next to the stove.
entries.new: 炉灶旁边有一个盐瓶。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I think this is all I can do.
entries.new: ……看来只能这样了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I left it on the floor of the bedroom. Then, I stepped back to the kitchen and closed the door.
entries.new: 我把它放在卧室地板上，随后退回厨房，关上了门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I waited a few minutes, thinking about what I would do. Once I was certain, I took out the Past Sekimeiya and looked at the bedroom.
entries.new: 我等了几分钟，盘算着接下来该怎么做。拿定主意后，我取出过去那件Sekimeiya，望向卧室。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The salt shaker was no longer on the floor. It was on the rightmost nightstand, next to a bunch of salt scattered around.
entries.new: 盐瓶已经不在地板上了。它跑到最右侧的床头柜上，旁边散落着一摊盐。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I looked at it intensely; I'd known it was going to be there.
entries.new: 我紧紧盯着它；我早就知道它会在那里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Then, I waited a bit before I touched the Sekimeiya in the kitchen. When I did, I went a few minutes back in time.
entries.new: 接着，我稍等片刻，才去碰厨房里的那件Sekimeiya。一碰之下，我回到了几分钟之前。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Huh?
entries.new: 咦？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I appeared in the bathroom.{w} Silently, I glanced at the bedroom.
entries.new: 我出现在浴室里。{w}我默不作声地朝卧室瞥了一眼。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The salt shaker was on the floor, next to the closed door. I picked it up and slowly brought it to the nightstand.
entries.new: 盐瓶在地板上，就在关着的门边。我把它捡起来，慢慢放到床头柜上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...There was no salt on it. Its wooden surface was perfectly clean.
entries.new: ……上面没有盐。木质表面干干净净。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: So far, I've experienced both what occurs when you travel to the past with no intentions to change it and when you travel to the past with intentions to specifically not change it. What I don't know is what happens when you travel to the past wanting to change it—when all your actions have that intent.
entries.new: 到目前为止，我经历过两种回到过去的情况：一种是无意改变过去，另一种是刻意不让过去改变。我不知道的是，若怀着改变的念头回去——若每个举动都带着这个意图——又会发生什么。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...This might be a safe way to finally know.
entries.new: ……也许，这样就能安全地弄清楚了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I gripped the salt shaker and held it over the nightstand.
entries.new: 我握住盐瓶，把它举到床头柜上方。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If I shake my hand, a bunch of salt will fall out. I've already seen a pattern of the scattered salt. However, my intention is not to repeat it. I want the past to change—I wish for that pattern to differ.
entries.new: 只要我一抖手，盐就会撒落一片。那散开的形状我已经见过。但我并不想重演它。我希望过去发生改变——希望那形状与我所见的不同。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Abruptly, I shook my hand, releasing countless bits of salt.
entries.new: 我猛地一抖手，无数盐粒撒落下来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What would happen was not my call. I wanted the past to change, so if that was possible, I hoped the pattern would be different. If it wasn't possible, although I wouldn't do it on purpose, the pattern would be the same one I'd seen. The decision of whether the past would change was not mine; the universe would let me know instead. When my hand stopped still, I stared down.
entries.new: 结果如何，不由我决定。我希望过去改变，所以若真能改变，我盼着那形状会有所不同。若改变不了，那形状便会与我见过的一模一样——尽管我并非有意为之。过去变不变，不是我所能决定的，宇宙自会给我答案。手停下后，我低头望去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...It was identical. Every last bit of salt had ended up exactly where I'd seen it despite my wishes to change history.
entries.new: ……分毫不差。尽管我盼着改写历史，每一粒盐却都落在我见过的位置上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I... see.
entries.new: ……原来如此。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I could blow on it; I could make it change. However, that's impossible. Anyone who would blow on it wouldn't have made it here in the first place.
entries.new: 我可以吹一口气，让它变样。可那不可能。会去吹散它的人，根本走不到这一步。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: With my head down, I walked back to the bathroom.
entries.new: 我垂着头，走回浴室。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Soon, my past self came out of the kitchen. He saw the salt pattern and went back in time.
entries.new: 不一会儿，过去的我从厨房走了出来。他看见那摊盐的形状，便穿越回了过去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...It's funny. I thought I would appear in the bedroom instead, but I appeared in the bathroom.
entries.new: ……真有意思。我原以为自己会出现在卧室，结果却出现在浴室。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...Because I had no urge to leave. I had no idea what to do after that.
entries.new: ……因为我当时不想离开。那之后该做什么，我毫无头绪。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Eventually, I had to go eat something. When I got back, I sat on the bed, unable to clear my mind.
entries.new: 最后，我还是得去吃点东西。回来后，我坐在床上，脑子里乱成一团。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...And when I went to sleep, I was just as lost. The past couldn't be changed, so there was no point to anything.
entries.new: ……入睡时，我依旧茫然。过去无法改变，那么一切都没有意义。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I got up wearing the same clothes. With a persistent feeling of impotence, I went down to the cafeteria.
entries.new: 我穿着同一身衣服起身。那股无力感挥之不去，我下楼去了食堂。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: After everything I'd been through, saving Miiya was still impossible. However, I had seen her in the tower. That was the wild card, and it was what confused me the most.
entries.new: 经历了这一切，我依旧救不了 Miiya。可是，我在塔里见过她。那是唯一的变数，也是最令我困惑的地方。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Had she really come from another world? ...Had her existence been another mere illusion? I did all I could to refuse that.
entries.new: 她真的来自另一个世界吗？……还是说她的存在也不过是又一场幻觉？我竭尽全力不肯承认这一点。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If there was something I was sure of, it was that it wasn't up to me. It was evident the universe itself was what decided the outcome of everything.
entries.new: 若说有哪一点是我确定的，那便是这一切不由我做主。万事的结果皆由宇宙本身裁定，这一点再清楚不过。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: A large part of my plan had been ripped to shreds, but the last bit was still in my mind. I could reunite with Shiroya. We could go back to our world and leave together.
entries.new: 我的计划大半已被撕得粉碎，可最后一步仍留在我心里。我能与 Shiroya 重逢。我们可以回到自己的世界，一起离开。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: For that, I could change worlds at that very moment, but I knew everything would repeat. So in the world I was in, on December 15th, Miiya would be in the tower. ...I had to see that with my very own eyes.
entries.new: 为此，我此刻就能切换世界，但我知道一切都会重演。所以，在我所处的这个世界，12月15日那天，Miiya 会出现在塔里。……我必须亲眼确认。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: {time=12:43.} November 28th...
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I hadn't left the motel once. I mustered the will to get up and lethargically exited the room.
entries.new: 我一次也没离开过旅馆。好不容易提起劲起身，我拖着沉重的步子出了房间。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It'll happen in two days. Am I really not going to do anything just because I've convinced myself that there's no point?
entries.new: 再过两天就要发生了。难道就因为我说服自己毫无意义，就真的什么都不做？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It wasn't just that. I knew there was no point, and I didn't want to live through it again.
entries.new: 不只是这样。我知道毫无意义，也不想再经历一遍。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: When I came back up, all I could do was fall on the bed again.
entries.new: 回到楼上，我只能再一次倒回床上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I shouldn't change worlds now. I have to wait here...
entries.new: 现在不能切换世界。我得在这里等……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: But there are many days left until the 15th. It's November 28th, so the Sekimeiya were found just yesterda—
entries.new: 可离15日还有好几天。今天是11月28日，那么 Sekimeiya 是昨天才被发现——
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Wait.{w} This is wrong...{w} That can't be the case...!
entries.new: 等等。{w}不对……{w}不可能这样……！
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I ran to the kitchen, but I stopped myself before I opened the refrigerator.
entries.new: 我冲向厨房，却在打开冰箱前停住了手。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: No, I shouldn't open it. I have to think this through first.
entries.new: 不，不能打开。我得先把这件事想清楚。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I entirely failed to consider this! Katei told us the Sekimeiya were found on November 27th...
entries.new: 我竟然完全没想到这一点！Katei 说过，Sekimeiya 是在11月27日被发现的……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: That's impossible, though! I have them right here!
entries.new: 可这不可能！它们明明就在我手上！
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: In the attic, when I made a Sekimeiya travel with me, I couldn't duplicate it—the original one disappeared as soon as I appeared. Only one version of each can exist!
entries.new: 在阁楼时，我带着 Sekimeiya 一起穿越，却无法复制它——我一现身，原本那件就消失了。每一件都只能存在一个！
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: So, when I appeared with them on the 24th, the ones on the mountain must've disappeared. It's already the 28th, and there's no way they were found yesterday!
entries.new: 所以，24日我带着它们现身时，山上的那些一定已经消失了。现在都28日了，它们绝不可能昨天才被发现！
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I stared at the shut door. The Sekimeiya had to be inside, but the past couldn't be changed. I couldn't witness its interior before thinking, as I hadn't actually seen the Sekimeiya since three days prior.
entries.new: 我盯着紧闭的冰箱门。Sekimeiya 一定在里面，可过去无法改变。在理清头绪之前，我不能去看里面的情形——毕竟我已经三天没见过 Sekimeiya 了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If I opened the door and either saw them there or didn't see them there, it would be a fact locked in place. Not knowing for sure whether they were there or not was far smarter.
entries.new: 一旦打开门，无论看见它们在还是不在，都会成为既定的事实。不确认它们到底在不在，反而更明智。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It doesn't make any sense. I know the incident will occur on the 15th, so the Sekimeiya had to have been found.
entries.new: 这说不通。我知道事件会在15日发生，所以 Sekimeiya 肯定已经被找到了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: The event was announced tomorrow, on the 29th. That can't happen if the Sekimeiya aren't found on the 27th.
entries.new: 消息是明天，也就是29日公布的。如果 Sekimeiya 没在27日被发现，这件事就不可能发生。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: However, it would happen. It had to, or else everything would've been entirely different on the 15th.
entries.new: 可是它确实发生了。它非发生不可，否则15日的一切就会截然不同。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The tower had to be shut on the 15th, and I had to be there. ...That was how I could find Miiya and the real Shiroya.
entries.new: 15日那天，塔一定会封闭，我也一定会在场。……只有这样，我才能找到 Miiya 和真正的 Shiroya。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But I had the Sekimeiya. If that had removed the ones on the mountain, the butterfly effect would surely be immense.{w} That was why I had to consider a certain question and why I hadn't opened the refrigerator. ...Was there a way for the Sekimeiya to have been found the day before?
entries.new: 但我手里有 Sekimeiya。若因此让山上的那些消失，蝴蝶效应必然巨大。{w}所以我必须考虑一个问题，也才没有打开冰箱。……有没有可能，Sekimeiya 确实在前一天被发现了？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Is there any chance? If they were found, they can't be here anymore. Similarly, if they're here, they couldn't have been found.{w} Is it impossible...? That can't be...
entries.new: ……有这种可能吗？若它们被发现了，就不可能还在这里。同样，若它们还在这里，就不可能被发现过。{w}难道真的不可能……？不会的……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: There was one important fact: I knew where the Sekimeiya had been found. Katei had described an area that matched with a place I knew very well.
entries.new: 有一个关键事实：我知道 Sekimeiya 是在哪里被发现的。Katei 描述的那片区域，和我非常熟悉的一个地方对得上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If they're here right now... I could travel to the past and appear with them again as long as I know I'll have them in the future. Then, I could leave them on the mountain before the 27th.
entries.new: 如果它们此刻就在这里……只要我确定未来能拿到它们，我就能再次带着它们回到过去。这样，我就能在27日之前把它们留在山上。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: That doesn't work, though! The past would be changing. If I ever appear with them in the past, the ones in here would disappear, and I wouldn't be able to travel in the first place.
entries.new: 可这样行不通！那等于改变过去。只要我带着它们在过去现身，这里的这些就会消失，那我从一开始就无法穿越了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It's... not possible. They couldn't have been found yesterday!{w} But the past can't change, can it? Does that mean they're not in the refrigerator anymore? If I never open it, should I assume that they made it to the mountain somehow?
entries.new: 这……不可能。它们不可能昨天就被发现了！{w}可过去是无法改变的，不是吗？那是不是说，它们已经不在冰箱里了？如果我始终不打开，是不是就该认定，它们以某种方式回到了山上？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: What if... someone traveled to the past after I did, holding the Sekimeiya? That's a way they could've disappeared from here.
entries.new: 如果……有人在我之后带着 Sekimeiya 穿越回了过去呢？那样它们确实可能从这里消失。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Was something like that what I had to assume? How the hell had the Sekimeiya even ended up on that mountain...? And why had they even gotten to Ashiya Tower given their powers?
entries.new: 难道我只能作这样的假设？Sekimeiya 究竟是怎么跑到那座山上去的……？凭它们的力量，又怎么会落到芦屋塔里？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I recalled precisely what Katei had told us.
entries.new: 我清楚记得 Katei 对我们说过的话。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Eventually, up that mountain is a small field that's pretty well-hidden. It's not easy to spot, and you have to deviate onto a smaller path. All I was told was that it's fairly tucked away.
entries.new: 沿山而上，最后会到一小片相当隐蔽的平地。那里不容易发现，得岔到一条更窄的小路上去。我得到的说法只是，那地方藏得很深。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: That's where this was found.
entries.new: 这东西就是在那儿被发现的。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: What he pointed at was the third Sekimeiya. The one that didn't work...
entries.new: 他指的是第三个 Sekimeiya。也就是那个没能起作用的……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Where the hell did that one come from? There were three Sekimeiya since that morning.
entries.new: 那一个到底是从哪儿来的？从那天早上起，就已经有三个 Sekimeiya 了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: What really happened on the 27th? Were those three Sekimeiya found? And was that really the same place Shiroya and I used to go to?
entries.new: 27 日到底发生了什么？那三个 Sekimeiya 真的被找到了吗？还有，那真的是我和 Shiroya 以前常去的地方吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...It can't be that only the third Sekimeiya was found. When Katei told us that story, he was definitely talking about all the Sekimeiya; they were all found by the same person. However, Katei never mentioned any other Sekimeiya existing that entire day. ...And I'm sure that he and Naomi knew about it.
entries.new: ……不可能只找到了第三个 Sekimeiya。Katei 跟我们讲那段话时，说的肯定是所有 Sekimeiya；它们都是被同一个人找到的。可是，那一整天 Katei 都没提过还有别的 Sekimeiya 存在。……而且我敢肯定，他和 Naomi 都知道这件事。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: So, technically, I might have a way to make Katei's words into reality—that a Sekimeiya was found on the 27th. I only have to assume that he avoided saying when the others were.
entries.new: 所以，严格来说，我也许有办法让 Katei 的话成真——确实有一个 Sekimeiya 是在 27 日被找到的。只要假设他刻意没说另外几个是什么时候被发现的就行。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: If the first one was found on the 27th, this makes sense.
entries.new: 如果第一个是在 27 日找到的，那就说得通了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: There was another assumption I had to make: that I was no longer in possession of the Future Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 我还得作出另一个假设：Future Sekimeiya 已经不在我手里了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Finally, when the loop I had to make was in my head, I was ready to open the door.
entries.new: 最后，等我把必须完成的因果循环在脑中理清，便准备开门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...A single Sekimeiya was there.
entries.new: ……里面只有一个 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It's the Past Sekimeiya. This is all I can do to fix my mistake.
entries.new: 是 Past Sekimeiya。为了弥补我的过错，我只能做到这一步。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I took it out as I glanced at the clock.
entries.new: 我一边把它取出来，一边瞥了眼时钟。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I could still go to the past. I could make it back to the 27th.
entries.new: 我还能回到过去。还能回到 27 日。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Once there, I had to take the Future Sekimeiya out of the refrigerator and bring it to the mountain so that it'd be found on that day.
entries.new: 到了那里，我得把 Future Sekimeiya 从冰箱里取出来，带到山上，让它在那天被人发现。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Then, after the point I travel, the Past Sekimeiya will have to be left there too. It'll be found after the 27th, but that doesn't contradict anything that we were told.
entries.new: 然后，我还得把 Past Sekimeiya 留在那里，留在我穿越到的时间点之后。它会在 27 日以后被发现，这跟我们听过的说法并不矛盾。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: The temperature in the motel wasn't the same as the tower's, so the amount of time I had to store was different.
entries.new: 然后，在我穿越到的时间点之后，Past Sekimeiya 也必须留在那里。它会在 27 日以后被发现，这跟我们听过的说法并不矛盾。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Fortunately, the formula was the same, so after I noted down how far I traveled after storing two minutes, I knew how long I had to wait to make it a day back.
entries.new: 幸运的是，规律并没有变。我记下蓄能两分钟后能穿越多远，也就算出了要回到一天前需要等多久。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It was a little over half an hour, but I couldn't touch it there due to the large range that would form.
entries.new: 需要等半个多小时，但在那里不能碰它，因为会形成很大的重叠范围。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I'm certain it still gathers energy outside if it's in the suitcase, because when I touched the Sekimeiya after arriving here, I traveled a lot farther into the future than expected.
entries.new: ……我敢肯定，就算把它装在箱子里，它仍会继续蓄能。因为我到这里后一碰 Sekimeiya，向未来穿越的距离就比预想远得多。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I put the Sekimeiya and the clock inside the suitcase before walking down the stairs with the motel keys.
entries.new: 我把 Sekimeiya 和时钟放进箱子，然后拿着旅馆钥匙下了楼。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Below, I stepped out of the motel for the first time and walked toward one of the tallest mountains I could see past the buildings.
entries.new: 到了楼下，我第一次走出旅馆，朝我能越过建筑望见的几座最高山峰之一走去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I kept going until Airun's slope was before me, close to Ashiya Tower. Far in the past, there had been a path up the mountain, but I could no longer distinguish it.
entries.new: 我一直走到 Airun 的山坡前——那里离芦屋塔很近。很久以前，这座山上曾有一条小路，可如今我已经辨认不出了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: When I stepped up, my feet sank deep into the snow. The layer there was much thicker, and it showed clear signs of human presence.
entries.new: 我一脚踏上去，脚便深陷雪中。这里的积雪厚得多，还留有明显的人迹。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Soon, the trees began to cast many shadows around me, but I hadn't lost track of where I was. My legs continued moving autonomously until the sun was visible again.
entries.new: 很快，树木在身边投下重重阴影，我却仍清楚自己身在何处。双腿仿佛自有意识般继续向前，直到阳光重新出现。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: This place...
entries.new: 这个地方……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: A vast field surrounded by trees. It had been quite a few years since I'd been there, as evidenced by the tall grass that had grown in.
entries.new: 一片被树林环抱的广阔空地。我已经有好几年没来过这里了，丛生的高草便是明证。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: This is where the Sekimeiya were found. I can't believe it.{w} How is that even possible? This was our special place...
entries.new: 那几个 Sekimeiya 就是在这里被发现的。真不敢相信。{w}这怎么可能？这里明明是我们最特别的地方……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I trudged along and arrived at a cabin tucked next to the treeline.
entries.new: 我深一脚浅一脚地走过去，来到一间紧挨林边的小木屋。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Now this place hasn't changed much...
entries.new: 这里倒是没怎么变……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Who had been the last person to open that door? The inside looked exactly like the cabin in my memories. After taking a look around, I noticed something thrown away in a corner.
entries.new: 上一个打开这扇门的会是谁？屋里和我记忆中的木屋一模一样。环顾一圈后，我注意到角落里有个被丢弃的东西。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: That's...
entries.new: 那是……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It was a stuffed tiger, much smaller than I recalled. It didn't seem damaged, and it looked at me with the same smile as always. Sitting on the wood, it appeared to be waiting for Shiroya to come back and put him in the small pocket of her school bag, from where he would peek out at the vast mountain landscape.
entries.new: 那是一只老虎玩偶，比我记忆中小得多。它看起来没有破损，仍带着一如既往的笑容望着我。它坐在木头上，仿佛在等 Shiroya 回来，把它放进书包的小口袋里，好从那里探出头，眺望辽阔的山景。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I stepped back out, opened the suitcase, and looked at the clock. It was {time=14:03.}
entries.new: ……我重新走到屋外，打开箱子，看了看时钟。时间是 {time=14:03.}
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: After that, I tested how far I'd travel if I kept the Sekimeiya in the suitcase for two minutes.
entries.new: 之后，我测试了一下，把 Sekimeiya 在箱子里放两分钟，我能穿越多远。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I appeared inside the cabin, next to the door. When I looked outside, I saw myself in the middle of the field.{w} 35 seconds later, I disappeared.
entries.new: 我出现在木屋里，就在门边。朝外望去，我看见自己站在空地中央。{w}三十五秒后，那个我便消失了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I see...
entries.new: 原来如此……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: So I'll have to keep it in the suitcase for about forty minutes. I want to make it to yesterday morning.
entries.new: 看来得把它在箱子里放上四十分钟左右。我要回到昨天早上。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: The Sekimeiya was on the grass, next to the suitcase and the clock. I put it inside at {time=14:05.}
entries.new: Sekimeiya 就放在草地上，旁边是箱子和时钟。我在 {time=14:05.} 把它放了进去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I had to leave the suitcase there. Surprisingly, the cabin made for a good shelter from the cold.
entries.new: 我不得不把箱子留在那里。没想到这间木屋还挺能御寒。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It had a bed and a hatch in the floor, leading to an empty basement. There was much less dust than I had imagined, but I busied myself wiping it off.
entries.new: 屋里有一张床，地板上还有个通往空地下室的活板门。灰尘比我预想的少得多，但我还是忙着把灰擦掉。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I couldn't get over the fact that the Sekimeiya had been found there, but perhaps I was too full of myself for thinking that it could've been anything more than a coincidence.
entries.new: Sekimeiya 竟然会在那里被发现，我一直难以释怀。不过，也许是我太自以为是，总觉得这不只是巧合。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I spent the last stretch sitting on a bed. I could see the suitcase through the window, and at {time=14:43}, I stood up.
entries.new: 最后那段时间，我一直坐在床上。透过窗户能看见那只箱子。到 {time=14:43}，我站起身来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I grabbed the clock and walked outside.
entries.new: 我抓起时钟，走了出去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'll have to touch it as soon as I open the suitcase.
entries.new: 一打开箱子，我就得立刻碰到它。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I locked my eyes on those numbers. As soon as {time=14:45} appeared, I opened it.
entries.new: 我死死盯着那些数字。{time=14:45} 一出现，我便打开了箱子。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: That time, when my right hand reached for the Sekimeiya, my left one gripped the suitcase's handle.
entries.new: 这一次，我右手伸向 Sekimeiya，左手同时握住了箱子的提手。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: In an instant, the sun disappeared. I was in the motel, and seconds later, I noticed the faint noise surrounding me.
entries.new: 转眼间，太阳消失了。我回到了旅馆，几秒后，才注意到周围那阵微弱的声响。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It was my own self sleeping. When I glanced at the clock, I saw the red numbers I'd expected: {time=7:01.} November 27th.
entries.new: 睡在那里的正是我自己。我瞥了一眼时钟，红色数字正如我所料：{time=7:01.}11月27日。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I felt the motel keys in my pocket, and my hands weren't empty. One was holding the suitcase, while the other had a replica of the clock. However, its screen was blank.
entries.new: 我摸了摸口袋里的旅馆钥匙，两只手也都不是空的。一只手提着行李箱，另一只手拿着那台时钟的复制品。只是它的屏幕一片空白。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: This again...
entries.new: 又是这一幕……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I'd held them when I touched the Sekimeiya so that they wouldn't remain on the field. Only the Past Sekimeiya had been left there so that it was found later.
entries.new: 触碰 Sekimeiya 的时候，我把这些东西都握在手里，免得它们留在空地上。我只把 Past Sekimeiya 留在了那里，好让后来的人发现它。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I stepped to the kitchen without making noise. When I opened the refrigerator, I saw both Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 我悄无声息地走到厨房。打开冰箱时，两件 Sekimeiya 都摆在里面。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I grabbed the one on the left—the Future Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 我拿起左边的那件——Future Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I suppose I have to hurry. I didn't see the Future Sekimeiya in the field, which means that it'll be taken today.
entries.new: ……看来我得抓紧了。空地上没有 Future Sekimeiya，也就是说，它今天就会被人取走。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I put it in the suitcase and walked out.
entries.new: 我把它放进箱子，走了出去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The sun was beginning to rise. I took the same route back to Airun.
entries.new: 太阳刚刚升起。我沿着原路返回艾伦山。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I walked up, carving a path through the trees. Eventually, I stopped myself and looked back.
entries.new: 我一路往上，在树丛间开出一条路。走了一段后，我停下脚步，回头望去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I'm leaving the traces of footprints I saw.
entries.new: ……我留下的，正是我见过的那些脚印。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I kept going up until I arrived at the field, covered by the shadows cast by the tall trees. Before I got to the cabin, I took the Sekimeiya out and left it on the ground.
entries.new: 我继续向上，终于来到那片空地——高树的影子笼罩着它。还没走到小屋，我就取出 Sekimeiya，放在地上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'm sure I would've seen it if it had still been here.
entries.new: 要是它还在那儿，我不可能没看见。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Oh, it's a lot dustier in here...{w} I suppose that makes sense; I have to stay until I can return to the motel.
entries.new: 哦，这里的灰比我想的还要多……{w}也难怪，我得一直待到能回旅馆的时候。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I had to spend a full night inside. I'd done it in the past, but a story from earlier in 2011 made me feel a little unnerved at the prospect...
entries.new: 我得在这里面待上整整一夜。这样的事我以前也做过，可2011年早些时候听来的一个故事，让我一想到这一夜就心里发怵……
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It'll be fine. It's not so cold that I'm going to freeze, and it's only one night.
entries.new: 不会有事的。还没冷到会把我冻坏，何况只有一晚。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It was nothing new. I just had to wait there like I'd been doing in the motel.
entries.new: 这也没什么新鲜的。我只要像在旅馆里那样，在那里等着就行了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Strangely, the cabin made it easy. The memories all came to me as I stared at the little tiger on the floor. I didn't want to take him with me—Shiroya and I would come back for the one in our world. After a while, I removed the dust from all the wooden furniture, doing my best not to breathe in.
entries.new: 奇怪的是，待在小屋里反而容易熬过去。我盯着地上那只小老虎，往事一件件涌上来。我不想把它带走——属于我们那个世界的那一只，我和 Shiroya 会回来取的。过了一会儿，我把所有木制家具上的灰都擦掉，尽量屏着呼吸。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The clock I had wasn't working, so I had to rely on the sun to know the time. Before it set, what I'd been expecting finally happened.
entries.new: 我手上那台钟走不动，只能靠太阳判断时间。太阳还没落山，我一直等着的事终于发生了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Through the window, I saw an old man emerging from the trees. He slowly got closer, stunned by the place he'd discovered.
entries.new: 透过窗户，我看见一个老人从林中走出来。他慢慢靠近，显然被眼前这处地方惊住了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: When I saw his face, I recognized him. He was the owner of Musashi Gemstones.
entries.new: 看清他的脸时，我认出了他——武藏宝石的店主。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: He stopped in the middle of the field. He crouched down, and I saw the Sekimeiya between his gloves.
entries.new: 他在空地中央停下，蹲下身去，我看见他两只手套之间夹着 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...What the hell is going to happen with it? I know it'll be discovered that cold temperature is needed for it, but will it really be brought to Ashiya with no one having an understanding of its powers?
entries.new: ……这东西之后到底会怎么样？我知道人们会发现它需要低温保存，可难道在没人理解它力量的情况下，它真的会被送到芦屋去吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Wait... is he coming in here?
entries.new: 等等……他要进来？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: The door to the cabin opened. Keeping my mouth shut, I waited until it closed again.
entries.new: 小屋的门开了。我没有出声，一直等到门重新关上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Once it did, I emerged from below. I could see the man walking away through the window.
entries.new: 门一关上，我便从下面钻了出来。透过窗户，能看见那老人正往远处走去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...That's it, then. Everything happened as intended. Of course, the past didn't change.
entries.new: ……这样就算结束了。一切都按计划发生了。当然，过去并没有改变。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I sighed faintly before falling back on the bed.
entries.new: 我轻轻叹了口气，往后倒在床上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I'm getting really hungry, and I don't have water either.
entries.new: ……我饿得厉害，连水也没有。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: At the very least, I became tired fairly quickly. Soon, light stopped coming through the window, disappearing along with my awareness.
entries.new: 至少我很快就困了。不久，窗外不再透进光亮，我的意识也随之沉了下去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It was the third time I'd woken up on November 28th of 2011. I felt exhausted, and I had to walk all the way down the mountain path again.
entries.new: 这是我第三次在2011年11月28日醒来。我浑身疲惫，还得再沿着山路一路走下去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I should go as soon as possible, seeing as I still have some energy. ...I need to eat and use the bathroom too.
entries.new: 趁现在还有点力气，我该尽快动身。……我还得吃饭，还得去趟洗手间。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Yawning, I put the clock in the suitcase and drowsily moved through the rows of trees. The sun was well past the mountains, so I'd slept for a long time.{w} I entered the streets of Yushibana and walked to Eagle Motel.
entries.new: 我打着哈欠把时钟放进箱子，昏昏沉沉地穿过一排排树。太阳早已越过山头，看来我睡了很久。{w}我走进丰花的街道，朝鹰旅馆走去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I quickly looked at the time: it was {time=10:29.}
entries.new: 我赶紧看了一眼时间：{time=10:29.}
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There's still a while until my past self comes to the cafeteria, so I can be there until then.
entries.new: 距离过去的自己来餐厅还有一段时间，在那之前我可以待在那儿。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It was an open buffet, so nobody would be surprised by my eating habits when I came back down. I took my time, only accepting that I was full once about an hour had passed.
entries.new: 这里是自助餐，等会儿我再下楼，也没人会对我吃的量感到奇怪。我慢慢吃，过了大约一个小时，才觉得自己吃饱了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I waited, hidden from view, until my past self came down. Soon after I left, I reappeared from the stairs, holding the suitcase and wearing an uneasy expression.
entries.new: 我躲起来等着，直到过去的自己下楼来。我离开后不久，便提着行李箱从楼梯上重新出现，脸上带着不安的神色。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Finally I could go back up. I unlocked the bedroom and staggered in.
entries.new: 我终于可以回楼上了。我打开卧室门锁，踉跄着走进去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I don't have the Sekimeiya anymore. Now I can only change worlds on December 15th.
entries.new: ……Sekimeiya 已经不在我手上了。现在，我只能等到12月15日才能切换世界。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I'd had them sitting in the refrigerator for so long without using them. It was undeniable that I could've obtained anything with them; Sai had once talked about winning the lottery with ease.{w} But I hadn't worried about that because of the single guarantee I possessed: on January 5th, I would have both Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 它们就那么一直放在冰箱里，这么久我都没用过。不可否认，有它们在，我什么都弄得到；Sai 还说过，用它们中彩票轻而易举。{w}可我并不为此担心，因为我握着一个绝对的保证：1月5日，两件 Sekimeiya 都会在我手上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I can't rest easy for today just yet. In the afternoon, I have to make sure to be in possession of the keys, clock, and suitcase. Otherwise, they would've disappeared when I touched the Sekimeiya on Airun.
entries.new: 今天还不能就此松懈。下午我必须确保钥匙、时钟和行李箱都在我手上。否则，我在艾伦山触碰 Sekimeiya 的时候，它们就会消失。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Two days passed. It was November 30th, a day that would never fade from my memory. The Sekimeiya event had been announced the previous day, so everything would happen in the same way.
entries.new: 两天过去了。到了11月30日——这一天，我永远不会忘记。Sekimeiya 的展出消息前一天就已公布，所以一切都会照原样发生。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I didn't leave the room. By the time the evening came, I was stuck in a loop of reliving the explosion and its aftermath, shaking my head to drive those thoughts away, and having them return not long after.
entries.new: 我没有离开房间。到了傍晚，我陷进了循环：一遍遍重温那场爆炸和之后的一切，摇头把念头赶走，没多久它们又回来了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...And there was nothing I could do to stop it. If I'd tried to, I would have failed miserably.
entries.new: ……而我无力阻止。就算真去试，也只会一败涂地。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I attempted to close my eyes, doubting I would ever fall asleep.
entries.new: 我试着闭上眼，却不觉得自己能睡着。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: {time=7:11.} December 1st.{w} I'd gotten new batteries for the clock and confirmed it was accurate. I gingerly rubbed my eyes, grateful that I'd at least been able to sleep a little.
entries.new: {time=7:11.}12月1日。{w}我给时钟换了新电池，确认它走得准。我轻轻揉了揉眼睛，庆幸自己至少还睡了一会儿。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: When I fully regained my senses, I quickly got up and dashed out of the room.
entries.new: 等我彻底清醒过来，便立刻起身，冲出房间。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...The news. I need to see what happened.
entries.new: ……新闻。我得看看发生了什么。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I had a fact to work with—Miiya would exist on December 15th. Nervous at what I'd find, I intently watched the television.
entries.new: 我手上有一条可以依托的事实——12月15日，Miiya 还会存在。我忐忑不安，紧盯着电视。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The news was just starting. Before I could think, I saw text scrolling horizontally.
entries.new: 新闻刚刚开始。我还没来得及细想，就看见一行字横向滚动过去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: "Gas explosion in Yushibana".{w} At a low volume, a reporter began to talk about it.
entries.new: 「丰花发生瓦斯爆炸。」{w} 记者低声开始了报道。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Last night, a gas explosion occurred at a gem shop in Yushibana. An unknown individual released smoke that knocked four people unconscious, and some time later, the explosion occurred due to a gas heater that had depleted its surrounding oxygen.{w} Given the size of the explosion, the flame had been out before the smoke's release. Since everyone present was unconscious, nobody was able to recognize the artificial smell of the gas, which had no way to leave the enclosed space. At {time=21}, when the lights were turned on, the presence of smoke and gas caused a dust explosion.
entries.new: 昨晚，丰花的一家宝石店发生瓦斯爆炸。一名不明身份者释放烟雾，导致四人昏迷；其后，一台耗尽了周围氧气的瓦斯暖炉引发了爆炸。{w} 从爆炸的规模来看，在烟雾释放之前，火焰便已熄灭。由于在场者全部昏迷，没人能察觉出瓦斯那股人工气味，而封闭的空间又让瓦斯无处散去。{time=21}，灯光亮起时，积聚的烟雾与瓦斯引发了粉尘爆炸。
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: The blast hit two young girls who'd fallen unconscious, nineteen and twenty years of age. One of them was taken to the hospital after falling through the broken floor, but her condition is stable, as she was shielded by a shelf. The body of the other girl has not yet been found, but the chances that she is alive are slim.
entries.new: 爆炸波及两名昏迷的年轻女孩，一个十九岁，一个二十岁。其中一人从炸裂的地板坠落，被送往医院，但因为有货架挡住，伤势稳定。另一人的遗体尚未找到，生还的可能十分渺茫。
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: The other two people, a nineteen-year-old boy and the owner of the shop, were far enough from the heater that they avoided major damage.{w} The identity of the person who released the smoke is being investigated, as is their motive. Despite the outcome, it is unlikely that the explosion was intentional, and nothing has been reported as stolen.
entries.new: 另外两人——一名十九岁的少年和店主——离暖炉较远，避开了严重的伤害。{w} 释放烟雾者的身份与动机仍在调查。尽管结果如此，爆炸多半并非蓄意为之，也没有任何失窃的报告。
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: ...{w}I see. This is before they found her jaw. I don't even know why I thought I could expect anything else.
entries.new: ……{w}原来如此。这是在找到她的下颌骨之前。我都不知道自己凭什么觉得会有别的结果。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: After hearing everything again, my heart dropped into a black abyss. It almost felt like I'd been told the news for the first time again.{w} ...I really was powerless. The immense power I'd been able to wield meant nothing.
entries.new: 再次听完这一切，我的心沉入了漆黑的深渊。几乎又像是头一次听到这个消息。{w}……我果然无能为力。我曾能驾驭的那股庞大力量，此刻毫无意义。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Over two weeks were left until the 15th. Miserable, I shut myself in the bedroom. Knowing what was coming wasn't enough—I wound up isolating myself from the world in the exact same way I had the first time.
entries.new: 距离十五日还有两周多。我郁郁寡欢，把自己关在卧室里。光知道将要发生什么并无用处——我最终还是像第一次那样，把自己与世界隔绝开来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I wanted to see Shiroya. My thoughts were a mess, but all the uncertain possibilities ahead of me made me listless.
entries.new: 我想见 Shiroya。脑子里乱作一团，可前方那些不确定的可能，让我提不起半点精神。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The next time I stepped out of the motel was on December 9th, a Friday. Late in the evening, there was a place I wanted to go.
entries.new: 我再次走出鹰旅馆，是在十二月九日，星期五。那天深夜，有个地方我想去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: On the 15th, I would be able to use the Sekimeiya again. It was mandatory for me to be there and that the past would repeat.
entries.new: 到了十五日，我就能再次使用 Sekimeiya。我必须到场，过去也必须重演。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: However, naturally, I couldn't be in the lobby with everyone else. ...I had to enter the other way.
entries.new: 可是，我自然不能和别人一起待在大厅里。……我得从另一处进去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Ashiya Tower was before me. I could see people through the door and light behind all the windows.
entries.new: 芦屋塔就在眼前。透过大门能看见人影，每扇窗后都亮着灯。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The Sekimeiya have to be inside. Ashiya are waiting for Xyn's attack.
entries.new: Sekimeiya 一定在里面。芦屋家正等着 Xyn 来袭。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: If I found them, perhaps I could change worlds before the incident, even though that wasn't my goal.
entries.new: 如果找到它们，我也许能在事件发生前就切换世界——尽管那并非我的目的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I felt the rusty surface of a key in my pocket. I would have to use it to enter the tower without being seen.
entries.new: ……我摸到口袋里一把钥匙生锈的表面。进塔时要不被人发现，我只能靠它。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Before that, I stepped into the lobby. After being checked for any devices, I approached the reception desk and bought an entry pass to the hallways.
entries.new: 在那之前，我先走进了大厅。接受完随身设备的检查，我走到前台，买了一张通往各走廊的通行证。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I wanted to enter the tower in case I could pinpoint the Sekimeiya's location. I was curious to know if both had been found.
entries.new: 我想进塔，好确认 Sekimeiya 的位置。我也好奇，两件是不是都已经找到了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: However, I was met with a "Forbidden Entry" sign on the door to the event room.
entries.new: 然而，活动室的门上却挂着「禁止入内」的牌子。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: As expected, they're being kept in here.{w} I shouldn't bother checking inside. That could bring me problems, and there's no way only one was found anyway...
entries.new: 果然，它们被收在这里。{w} 我不该多此一举进去查看。那只会给我惹麻烦，而且怎么可能只找到一件……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I knew the cameras around me were displaying my image in the security room. Katei shouldn't have been there, but someone was watching my movements.
entries.new: 我知道，四周的摄像头正把我的影像送进监控室。Katei 应该不在那里，可总有人在盯着我的一举一动。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I wonder if whoever's in the security room also knows about the storeroom's secret.
entries.new: ……不知道监控室里的人，是否也知道储藏室的秘密。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: As if I was visiting the place normally, I entered a few crystal rooms and looked through their cabinets. All the gemstones were the same as on the 15th.
entries.new: 我装作寻常参观的样子，进了几间水晶展室，逐一查看展示柜。里面的宝石和十五日那天毫无二致。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Then, as I went through hallway A, I stopped myself before the storeroom. I opened its door curiously and peeked inside.
entries.new: 随后，我沿 A走廊走过，在储藏室前停下了脚步。我好奇地推开门，朝里面张望。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I wanted to see if my key would unlock the door. When I'd been in the tower, it hadn't unlocked that exit from the inside. I closed the door behind me and rapidly opened the secret wall.
entries.new: 我想确认这把钥匙能不能打开那扇门。上次在塔里时，它没能从内侧打开那个出口。我关上身后的门，迅速推开暗墙。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The handle was there, and with the rusty key inserted into the keyhole, a rough turn unlocked it.
entries.new: 把手还在。我把生锈的钥匙插进锁孔，用力一转，锁开了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The door opened. Through a small gap, I could see the snowy grass next to the tower.
entries.new: 门开了。透过一道窄缝，我看见塔旁覆着白雪的草地。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I frowned, but I couldn't waste time. As if nothing had happened, I stepped back to the hallway.
entries.new: 我皱起眉，却不能再耽搁。我若无其事地退回走廊。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The few people there didn't seem to mind me, so I walked back to the lobby.
entries.new: 那里寥寥数人都没有留意我，我便回到了大厅。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Why did it not work on the 15th? No matter how much I tried, the lock wouldn't budge...
entries.new: 十五日那天为什么打不开？不管我怎么试，那把锁都纹丝不动……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Whatever the reason was, it had worked in my favor. Katei hadn't been able to escape, and if he had, when the others found the door, they would've been able to get out too. With things like that, I wouldn't have been able to figure out the mechanics behind the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 不管原因是什么，这对我来说都是好事。Katei 没能逃出去；要是他逃走了，等其他人发现那扇门，他们也能出去。那样的话，我就没法弄清 Sekimeiya 背后的机制了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I couldn't be calm, though. If the key wouldn't work on the 15th, perhaps I wouldn't be able to enter the tower.
entries.new: 可我心里仍不安稳。要是十五日那天钥匙不管用，我也许就进不了塔。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I haven't seen you here before, have I? Have you taken a look at this?
entries.new: 我以前没在这里见过你吧？这个你看过了吗？
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: I was about to step out when a voice called for me.{w} It was the receptionist, who held out a green paper that I recognized.
entries.new: 我正要出门，有人叫住了我。{w} 是前台的那位，她递来一张我认得的绿色传单。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...The Sekimeiya event, right? I've heard about it, yes.
entries.new: ……是 Sekimeiya 的活动吧？我听说过。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I'm glad you have. Have you decided if you'll come back?
entries.new: 很高兴你听说过。你决定好要再来吗？
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: ...I might.
entries.new: ……也许吧。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Fantastic! I'll see you there, then.
entries.new: 太好了！那就到时候见。
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: ...Huh.
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I grabbed the flyer as she waved. By the time I stepped out of the building, the sun was completely gone. Only the cold was left, and nobody was outside.
entries.new: 她挥着手，我接过了传单。等我走出大楼，太阳已经完全落山。外面只剩寒冷，一个人也没有。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I walked to the left side of the building, hearing the woman's words replay in my mind.
entries.new: 我绕到大楼左侧，那女人的话在脑中反复回响。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Fantastic! I'll see you there, then.
entries.new: 太好了！那就到时候见。
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: ...I did see her. I remember that.
entries.new: ……我确实见过她。这一点我记得。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I went to the wall where the secret door was. Stepping on the tall grass, I felt the surface of the wall carefully until I was next to the storeroom.
entries.new: 我走向藏有暗门的那面墙，踩着高高的野草，仔细摸索墙面，一直摸到储藏室旁。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: This is the door. I can see the keyhole too.
entries.new: 就是这扇门。锁孔也看得见。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I had left it slightly open, so it was easy to find. With the key, I verified that I could lock and unlock it from the outside.
entries.new: 刚才我让它留了一条缝，所以很容易找到。我用钥匙试过，从外面能锁上，也能打开。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...It works. I should be able to enter through it as long as it still works on the 15th...
entries.new: ……没问题。只要十五日那天还能用，我应该就能从这里进去……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I walked away with the uneasiness that the receptionist's words had caused.
entries.new: 前台那番话让我心里不安，我就这样离开了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'll see you there, then.
entries.new: 那就到时候见。
entries.speaker: ns

entries.text: When Shiroya and I stepped into the tower, she didn't react to me at all. We were there extremely early and spent hours in the lobby, but it was as if she'd never seen me. That makes sense, of course—in that world, she hadn't.
entries.new: 我和 Shiroya 走进芦屋塔时，她对我毫无反应。我们到得极早，在大厅里待了好几个小时，可她却像从没见过我。当然，这也难怪——在那个世界里，她确实没见过我。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: But in this one, when Shiroya and I enter the tower, the receptionist won't react the same way, will she? ...Because of the brief conversation we just had.
entries.new: 可在这个世界，我和 Shiroya 走进芦屋塔时，前台的她应该就不会是同样的反应了吧？……毕竟我们刚刚才说过那几句话。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Didn't that mean... that I'd changed the past? I had changed something that I'd experienced in the other world.
entries.new: 那不就意味着……我改变了过去？我改变了在另一个世界里亲身经历过的事。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I began to walk somewhere.
entries.new: ……我迈开步子，走向某处。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Of course, this world isn't identical. What happened on the 15th was different, but none of that was related to my presence, was it?
entries.new: 当然，这个世界并不完全相同。15号发生的事不一样，可那一切与我的存在无关，不是吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...There might've been a big mistake in my reasoning.
entries.new: ……我的推理里，也许有个很大的错误。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Why was I not able to change the salt pattern? ...Because I had already seen it. In that sense, the past couldn't be changed.
entries.new: 为什么我改不了盐的图案？……因为我已经看过它了。从这个意义上说，过去无法改变。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: However, in this world, I never did experience the wait in the lobby before the hallway doors opened. I could've caused that event to differ from my world's, but I never truly changed this world's history.
entries.new: 可是在这个世界里，我从未经历过走廊门打开前在大厅等候的那段时光。我本可以让那件事与我的世界有所不同，但我终究没有真正改变这个世界的历史。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I came to a very familiar street. It was my own, and I could see my house far ahead.
entries.new: 我走到一条再熟悉不过的街道。那是我家的路，远远就能看见我的房子。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There was light behind two of the windows.
entries.new: 有两扇窗后透出灯光。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...{w}Our sleep schedule was all over the place. I spent most nights awake.
entries.new: ……{w}我们的作息彻底乱了。大部分夜晚我都醒着。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I couldn't see my own outline, but I remembered staring through that window every night. For that reason, the image I'd always seen was still engraved in my mind.
entries.new: 我看不见自己的轮廓，但我记得自己每晚都从那个窗口望出去。正因如此，我早已看惯的那幕景象仍深深刻在脑海里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I got closer to my house, hiding myself behind the gate.
entries.new: 我朝自家靠近，藏到院门后面。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: A lot of snow had piled up on it. Without thinking twice, I shook it all off.
entries.new: 门上积了厚厚的雪。我想也没想，就把雪全抖掉了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...{w}I was right. I changed my past, but not the past of the Atsuki from this world. In my memories, the snow piled on the gate never fell.
entries.new: ……{w}我猜对了。我改变的是我自己的过去，而不是这个世界的 Atsuki 的过去。在我的记忆里，门上那堆积雪从未落下。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: No rule had changed. I hadn't erased what I'd lived through. What had once happened couldn't be reversed.
entries.new: 规则没有改变。我经历过的事并没有被抹去。已经发生过的，无法倒转。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: However... I truly had power in the world I was in. It was a real second chance. I couldn't change my own past, but I had just changed the other Atsuki's past.
entries.new: 然而……在我身处的这个世界里，我确实拥有力量。那是真正的第二次机会。我改变不了自己的过去，可就在刚才，我改变了另一个 Atsuki 的过去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'd thought that everything would happen as the universe had decided—that my input would always be meaningless. ...But that wasn't the case. I had taken an action all by myself and changed something.
entries.new: 我原以为一切都会依照宇宙既定的轨迹发生——我的所作所为永远毫无意义。……可事实并非如此。我凭自己的意志采取行动，改变了一些东西。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I locked up. Did that mean that I could've saved Miiya? If I hadn't waited in the motel, could I have prevented her death?
entries.new: 我僵住了。那岂不是说，我本可以救下 Miiya？如果我没有在旅馆里干等，是不是就能阻止她的死？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Even if that was the case, I had already failed. I had failed to do it, and it was irreversible.
entries.new: 即便真是如此，我也已经失败了。我没能做到，而这一切已无可挽回。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Because I had seen the news. I had witnessed history of the world I was in, so it was no longer any different from my own. I'd had a chance, and I'd failed to notice it.
entries.new: 因为我看到了那条新闻。我亲眼见证了自己所处世界的历史，它便与我的世界再无分别。机会曾在我眼前，我却没有察觉。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The reporter had spelled out my negligence. I hadn't acted, so nothing had changed.
entries.new: 那名记者的报道，把我的疏忽摊在了明处。我没有行动，所以什么都没有改变。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: No, that can't be...
entries.new: 不，不会的……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It's the same case. Even though I have seen the news, in this world, I've never seen any physical indication that Miiya is dead. That was the biggest barrier in my world, and it doesn't exist here. The news report is the only real obstacle, and it's a crossable one.
entries.new: 情况是一样的。虽然我看过那条新闻，但在这个世界，我从未亲眼见到任何能表明 Miiya 已死的实物证据。在我的世界里，那曾是最大的障碍，而这里并不存在。新闻报道是唯一真正的阻碍，而它是可以越过的。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I no longer had the Sekimeiya. I couldn't travel back to the 30th.
entries.new: 我已经没有 Sekimeiya 了。无法回到30号。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: However, if I could... Miiya's death could be averted without the need to change the past. It isn't yet an impossibility...
entries.new: 不过，如果我做得到……不必改变过去，也能避免 Miiya 的死。这还不是不可能的事……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: And I knew everything that I'd lived through would repeat, so I could be certain that on the 15th, I would have the Sekimeiya for myself.
entries.new: 而且我知道，我经历过的一切都会重演，所以我能确定，到了15号，Sekimeiya 会落到我手里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Finally, it made sense, and my eyes went wide. The reason why Miiya had been in the tower... I understood everything, as it all aligned with what I had to do.
entries.new: ……终于，一切说得通了，我睁大了眼睛。Miiya 会出现在塔里的原因……我全都明白了，一切都与我必须做的事吻合。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I arrived at the motel, where I could be isolated from the world. Until I was certain about everything, I couldn't look at the news. Everything had to be in my head before the result was given to me.
entries.new: 我来到旅馆，在这里能避开外界。在把一切想清楚之前，我不能看新闻。必须先在脑子里把整件事过一遍，才能去看结果。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Oubliette
entries.new: 遗忘地牢

entries.text: The last days passed quickly. It was about to be December 15th once again.
entries.new: 最后这几天过得很快。12月15日又要到了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I knew what I wanted to do, and I knew it would work.
entries.new: 我知道自己想做什么，也知道那会成功。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The end was still murky. I had to go back to my world, and I couldn't know how smoothly that would go until the time came. However, I had prepared extra steps before that point.
entries.new: 最后会怎样还不清楚。我必须回到自己的世界，能不能顺利，不到那一刻没人知道。不过在那之前，我已经多准备了几步。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: In the tower, more than one person had been a killer. Someone had caused the attack, trapping all of us there. Despite all that, the security cameras weren't reliable enough to prove anything. I couldn't stand the thought of letting those criminals run free after everything was over.
entries.new: 在塔里，凶手不止一个人。有人发动了那场袭击，把我们所有人困在那里。可即便如此，监控摄像头也不足以作为确凿证据。一想到一切结束后那些凶手还能逍遥法外，我就无法忍受。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: For that, I had obtained two things.
entries.new: 为此，我准备了两样东西。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: In one hand, I had an empty USB drive. In the other, I had a roll of tape.
entries.new: 一手是空白的U盘，另一手是一卷胶带。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: In one hand, I had an empty USB drive. In the other, I had duct tape.
entries.new: 一手是空白的U盘，另一手是一卷强力胶带。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: While we'd been unconscious, someone had hidden the Sekimeiya in a hallway B crystal room. Perhaps there was more of the attack that they wanted to keep hidden.
entries.new: 趁我们昏迷的时候，有人把 Sekimeiya 藏进了 B走廊的一间水晶展室。也许那场袭击里，还有更多他们想隐瞒的东西。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'd thought of a way to expose what they'd kept as a well-hidden secret.
entries.new: 我想到了一个办法，能揭穿他们藏得极深的秘密。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I stepped out of the motel when the sun had already risen. I couldn't be in the tower too early, or I'd conflict with what I needed.
entries.new: 太阳升起后，我才走出旅馆。我不能太早去塔里，不然会和我该做的事撞上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Basically all smoke residue had faded from my clothing, and I'd left the suitcase and my clothes from the 24th in the bedroom before departing. On the way, I grew nervous. ...Was it going to work?
entries.new: 衣服上几乎已经闻不到烟味了。出发前，我把行李箱和24号那天穿的衣服留在了卧室里。路上，我越来越紧张。……会顺利吗？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Had I overlooked something? Was there anything crucial I was missing?
entries.new: 我是不是漏掉了什么？有没有漏掉什么关键的地方？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: In the world I was in, I could save Miiya. I knew that for sure. My uncertainty went further than that.
entries.new: 在我身处的这个世界里，我能救下 Miiya。这一点我很确定。我的不安并不止于此。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The news and the note I'd read in the tower... They signified the real problem.
entries.new: 那条新闻，还有我在塔里读到的那张字条……那才是真正的问题所在。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: How would it be solved...? I'd only been able to come up with a vague idea.
entries.new: 那该如何解决……？我只想到一个模糊的方向。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I could see the tower in the distance. I still hadn't shaken off that unsettling feeling, but I knew it wouldn't disappear until everything was settled.
entries.new: 远远的，已经能看见那座塔。那份不安仍未散去，但我知道，在一切尘埃落定之前，它不会消失。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: People were by the entrance. I could see Suripo and the line of civilians from that day. However, the left wall was unguarded.
entries.new: 入口处有人。我看得见 Suripo，还有那天排成长队的平民。不过，左侧的墙边没人看守。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I surreptitiously approached it. Immediately, what I'd been very curious to see was apparent.
entries.new: 我悄悄靠近，一直很想确认的东西马上映入眼帘。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It really is there...
entries.new: 真的在那里……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: The rusty key was inserted in the outer keyhole.
entries.new: 生锈的钥匙插在外侧的锁孔里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Really? Does this really make sense?
entries.new: 真的吗？这真的说得通吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: The reason why I hadn't been able to unlock that door from the inside... I had thought that if an identical key was on the opposite side, I might not have been able to turn it from the inside.{w} I wanted it to be there. I needed it to remain outside so that the door wouldn't be unlocked from the inside... so that Katei couldn't escape and so that the others couldn't leave when they found the door.{w} But... why was that key there? If it was just there because I'd known it would be there, that didn't really satisfy me.
entries.new: 我一直没能从内侧打开那扇门，原因就在这里……我原先猜想，如果对面插着一把一模一样的钥匙，从里面或许就拧不动了。{w} 我希望那把钥匙在那里。我需要它留在门外，这样门就无法从内侧打开……Katei 便逃不出去，其他人发现那扇门时也走不了。{w} 可是……那把钥匙为什么会插在那里？若说只是因为我早就知道它会在那儿，这个理由并不能让我满意。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Am I supposed to assume that I'll leave it here the next time? Then, to still have it in the future, I'd have to get the key that Shiroya had.
entries.new: ……难道说，下一次我也会把钥匙留在这里？那样一来，为了在未来仍然持有它，我就必须拿到 Shiroya 那把钥匙。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: That had to be the answer. It meant that a future self of mine was already in the tower... But it was a bit hard to swallow. I would just be leaving the key behind to explain why I hadn't been able to unlock the door. If that was it, maybe there was more to it that I was missing, as the origin of the idea was unknown to me.
entries.new: 答案只能是这样。也就是说，未来的我已经在这座塔里了……可这实在难以接受。我留下那把钥匙，仅仅是为了解释自己为何打不开那扇门。若果真如此，或许还有我没想到的地方——这个念头从何而来，我至今毫无头绪。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Despite the universe apparently deciding the outcomes of things by itself, actual ideas that went into effect had consistently originated from a human mind. I still thought that had to be the case, but it wasn't like I had a better explanation ready for the key.
entries.new: 虽说这个宇宙似乎会自行决定事情的结果，但真正生效的念头，无一例外都源自人心。我仍然认为理应如此——只是关于那把钥匙，我也拿不出更好的解释。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I locked the door while it was open and stepped into the storeroom. Once inside, I was able to close the door behind me, leaving it locked. It was fortunate—and guaranteed—that the door worked like that, and once again, I wondered why the hell it existed in the first place.
entries.new: 我趁门还开着先上了锁，然后走进储藏室。进去后，我从内侧把门带上，门还是锁着的。这扇门能这样运作，既幸运又理所当然——我又一次忍不住想，这扇门究竟为什么会存在。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I still had the rusty key in my pocket, but when I tried to use it from the inside, it wouldn't budge. As long as the other one was inserted, opening the door from the inside would be impossible.
entries.new: 生锈的钥匙仍在我口袋里，可当我试着从里面转动它时，它纹丝不动。只要另一把还插在外面，这扇门就无法从内侧打开。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I got closer to the hallway. It would very soon be {time=9.}
entries.new: 我朝走廊靠近。马上就要到{time=9.}了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Katei won't be in the security room... Nobody will see me getting out of here.{w} I'll be recorded. Maybe the footage will actually be seen by the police. ...That doesn't matter, though.
entries.new: Katei 不在监控室……没人会看见我从这里出去。{w} 不过我会被拍下来。也许那段录像真会落到警察手里。……那也无所谓了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I paid the utmost attention for any sound to use as a cue.
entries.new: 我全神贯注，留意着任何可以当作信号的声响。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There it was. As soon as I heard footsteps, I opened the door.
entries.new: 来了。一听到脚步声，我立刻打开门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: When I glanced toward the lobby, I saw two people. One was Katei, who'd just left the security room. The other was a man I'd never seen. He saw me exiting the storeroom, but he paid no mind as he kept approaching.
entries.new: 我朝大厅那边一瞥，看见两个人。一个是刚离开监控室的 Katei，另一个是我从没见过的男人。他看见我从储藏室出来，却毫不在意，继续朝这边走来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I couldn't afford to waste time either. Casually, I walked to hallway C.
entries.new: 我也没时间耽搁。我装作若无其事，走向 C走廊。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I made it just in time to see the event room closing. The first group was there.{w} I had very little time; the second group would appear at any moment.
entries.new: 我赶得正好，亲眼看见活动室正在关闭。第一批人已经进去了。{w} 我的时间所剩无几，第二批随时都会出现。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Fortunately, I was done in less than a minute. It had gone as smoothly as I'd hoped.
entries.new: 幸好不到一分钟我就办完了，一切顺利得如我所愿。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'd wanted to record the movements through hallway B. In our world, Katei had hidden both Sekimeiya in room B4. I knew things wouldn't be identical, but I hoped the truth would be recorded nonetheless.
entries.new: 我想拍下 B走廊里的动静。在我们那个世界，Katei 把两件 Sekimeiya 都藏进了 B4 展室。我知道情形不会完全一样，但仍旧盼着真相能被录下来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Near the lobby, one of the security cameras viewed the entire hallway. It was high up, but I'd foreseen that problem. Thanks to the handrail and the corner, I'd been able to reach its lens.
entries.new: 大厅附近有一台监控摄像头能俯瞰整条走廊。它装得很高，但这个问题我早有预料。靠着扶手和墙角，我够到了它的镜头。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: With the seconds I had left, I sprinted toward hallway C. I had to be somewhere during the attack.
entries.new: 趁着还剩几秒，我朝 C走廊冲去。袭击发生时，我总得待在某个地方。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The security room.
entries.new: 监控室。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I knew the alarm would lock it. If that happened, Katei could be fast enough to erase the footage I wanted to preserve.{w} However, I could avoid that by staying inside. He had told us once that the door could be unlocked from the inside without the need for the key.
entries.new: 我知道警报一响，那扇门就会自动上锁。若真如此，只要 Katei 手脚够快，就能把我想要保住的录像抹掉。{w} 不过，只要我待在里面，就能避免这一点。他曾经告诉过我们，那扇门从内侧打开并不需要钥匙。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: When I looked at all the monitors, I felt like a needle was piercing my chest.
entries.new: 看着满墙的监视器，我只觉得一根针直刺胸口。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Miiya is here. She's wearing the tanzanite pendant...
entries.new: ……Miiya 在这里。她戴着那条坦桑石吊坠……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: She and I were in the event room with Akaro. And... Shiroya was nowhere to be seen.{w} I couldn't believe it. No matter how much I stared at the footage, I couldn't believe that she was really a room away.{w} And the cabinet covered by that crimson curtain... Which Sekimeiya were there?
entries.new: 我和她，还有 Akaro，都在活动室里。至于 Shiroya，哪儿都看不到她。{w} 我不敢相信。无论盯着画面看多久，都不敢相信她就在一室之隔的地方。{w} 还有那只罩着深红遮布的展示柜……里面放的是哪几件 Sekimeiya？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Every monitor displayed different locations on the crystal floor except for one. One of the screens was covered by tape.{w} I kept my eyes peeled with anticipation. It was about to happen again. I would see that dense smoke appearing out of nowhere, and my vision would blacken.
entries.new: 除了一个画面，每块屏幕都显示着水晶层的不同角落。其中一块被胶带贴住了。{w} 我屏息凝神，紧盯着屏幕。那件事又要发生了。我会看见浓烟凭空涌出，眼前的画面随之陷入漆黑。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: All at once, it happened, and I finally confirmed the truth.
entries.new: 一切骤然发生，我终于确认了真相。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Did the smoke come from Akaro!?
entries.new: 烟是从 Akaro 那边冒出来的！？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: That was how it had seemed. In an instant, all the cameras hit by the smoke displayed a black screen.
entries.new: 看上去正是如此。一瞬间，被烟雾笼罩的摄像头全部变成了黑屏。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It was Akaro. He was the one who released it.
entries.new: 是 Akaro。放烟的人就是他。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: When Shiroya and I had appeared on that morning after traveling from January 5th, we'd been able to avoid falling unconscious by looking down as we'd run through the smoke. Akaro had to have thrown himself to the ground immediately to avoid inhaling it, as it had quickly risen to the ceiling.{w} I had to act again while I still could, but I waited a few seconds so that the exit to the outside would close.
entries.new: 1 月 5 日穿越过来的那个早上，Shiroya 和我一出现，就一边跑过烟雾一边低头，才没有晕过去。烟雾很快升到了天花板，Akaro 想必是立刻趴到了地上，才没吸进去。{w} 我必须趁自己还能行动再做点什么，可我还是等了几秒，好让通往外面的出口关上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Then I opened the door slowly, crouching and covering my face. The smoke was there, but I was very close to the lobby.
entries.new: 我蹲下身，掩住口鼻，缓缓推开门。烟雾还在，但这里离大厅已经很近。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Is someone here...?{w} Is it Katei?
entries.new: 有人吗……？{w} 是 Katei 吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I didn't want them to hear me, so I took off my shoes. I could hear a person crawling on the floor, but when I opened my eyes, I only saw a dark silhouette near the wall.
entries.new: 我不想让他们听见我的动静，于是脱掉了鞋。我能听见有人在地上爬动，可睁开眼时，只看见墙边一团模糊的黑影。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The alarm... It's even louder than I remember.
entries.new: 警报声……比我记得的还要响。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Unable to breathe, I took a silent step toward the light. I was in time to see the shutter locking in place and the smaller lights turning off.
entries.new: 我憋着气，无声地朝光亮处迈出一步。正好看见卷帘门落下锁死，小灯随之熄灭。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: In hallway B, most of the smoke had already gotten stuck to the ceiling.
entries.new: B走廊里，大半烟雾已经聚在天花板附近。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Aside from the second group, nobody seemed to be there yet. Protecting my face, I reached for the camera's lens and removed the piece of tape.
entries.new: 除了第二批人，似乎还没有别人到场。我护住脸，伸手够到摄像头的镜头，把胶带撕了下来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I returned to the security room as fast as I could. Someone had still been in hallway A, but I didn't think they'd noticed me. I still had my shoes in my hand.
entries.new: 我以最快的速度赶回监控室。A走廊里似乎还有人，但我想对方没有注意到我。鞋还提在我手里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I noticed the deadbolt was sticking out of the door. The alarm had just locked it, but since I'd left it open, I was able to step back in, and I used the inner handle to close it again.
entries.new: 我注意到门上的插销伸在外面。警报刚才已经把门锁上了，但因为门一直开着，我才能侧身进去，然后握住内侧的把手把门重新带上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I looked at the monitors as I put them on. The one that had been covered by tape showed the dark hallway instead. Its screen was being assaulted by the remaining smoke, but it wasn't enough to conceal the entire image.
entries.new: 我一边穿鞋，一边看向监视器。原先被胶带贴住的那块屏幕，此刻映出昏暗的走廊。残存的烟雾不断扑向镜头，但还不至于把整个画面遮住。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: In front of the computer, I clicked on the program that managed the cameras. From there, I accessed the archived footage.
entries.new: 我在电脑前点开管理摄像头的程序，从那里调出了存档的录像。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...It's all here, but Katei will try to hide it. In this world, the computer was shut down too.
entries.new: ……全都在这里。但 Katei 会想办法把它藏起来。在这个世界里，电脑也被关掉了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: On the screen, the culprits finally came to light.{w} Akaro came out of the event room and looked both ways.
entries.new: 屏幕上，罪魁祸首终于显露出来。{w} Akaro 从活动室里走出，左右张望。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...He did fake his unconsciousness. What is he planning to do...?
entries.new: ……他果然是装晕。他到底想做什么……？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Once he confirmed he was alone, he walked to the cleaning room. From there, he went back to the event room, holding a glowing object between his hands.
entries.new: 确认四下无人之后，他走向清洁间。再回到活动室时，他双手捧着一件发光的物体。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What the hell...? Is that a Sekimeiya?{w} No, I know what that must be. ...The third Sekimeiya. That's what the plan was about.
entries.new: 搞什么……？那是 Sekimeiya？{w} 不，我知道那是什么。……第三件 Sekimeiya。原来那个计划打的是这个主意。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: A few seconds later, he came back out. I couldn't see his hands, but he walked back to the cleaning room again.
entries.new: 几秒后，他又出来了。我看不见他手里拿着什么，但他再次走回了清洁间。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...This is why only the third Sekimeiya was there when we woke up.{w} When does Katei come into the picture, though?
entries.new: ……难怪我们醒来时，那里只剩第三件 Sekimeiya。{w} 可 Katei 又是什么时候插进来的？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I didn't have to wait very long to find out. After Akaro had returned to the event room, Katei appeared from the lobby.{w} Keeping his head down, he stepped to the cleaning room.
entries.new: 我没等多久就知道了。Akaro 回到活动室之后，Katei 从大厅那边出现了。{w} 他低着头，快步走进清洁间。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Was he working with Akaro?
entries.new: 他和 Akaro 是一伙的？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I was bewildered. He came out almost immediately with two Sekimeiya and walked back to the lobby.
entries.new: 我一时愣住。他几乎立刻就出来了，手里拿着两件 Sekimeiya，走回了大厅。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: He must be going to the storeroom, but he won't be able to escape with the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 他应该是去储藏室了，但就算带着 Sekimeiya，也逃不掉。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I'd caught the two culprits behind the attack on video. Feeling the rush, I inserted the USB drive into the computer.
entries.new: 我拍下了袭击事件两名犯人的影像。心头一阵激荡，我将U盘插进电脑。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Once I located the file corresponding to that camera, I saved it on the drive.
entries.new: 找到那台摄像头对应的文件后，我把它存进了U盘。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: With this, I can bring it to the other world too.
entries.new: 有了这个，我也能把它带到另一个世界去了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I knew Katei would try to erase the saved footage, so I created a hidden folder on the computer where I copied the file.
entries.new: 我知道 Katei 会试图删掉保存的录像，所以在电脑上建了一个隐藏文件夹，把文件复制了进去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...And I hope the police will find it in this world.
entries.new: ……但愿这个世界的警察能找到它。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Perhaps something else of value would be recorded, but I preferred to cut it short.
entries.new: 或许还能录下别的有价值的东西，但我还是决定到此为止。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...After all, I soon heard someone running outside the security room. Then, that person appeared in hallway B.
entries.new: ……毕竟没过多久，我就听见监控室外有人跑过。紧接着，那个人出现在 B走廊。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It was Naomi. She ran all the way down holding Katei's suitcase, and as she disappeared, another door opened.{w} From room B4, Shiroya and I appeared—Naomi had drawn us out. Then, Shiroya stared at the camera intensely, as if she was looking directly at me. Before I could even process it, they ran behind the sound, quickly vanishing from the frame.
entries.new: 那是 Naomi。她提着 Katei 的手提箱一路跑下楼，就在她消失时，另一扇门开了。{w} Shiroya 和我从 B4房间走出来——是 Naomi 把我们引出来的。随后，Shiroya 死死盯着摄像头，仿佛正透过镜头看着我。还没等我理清头绪，他们便循着声响跑向后方，转眼消失在画面里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Huh, what? Did she notice something about the camera? She didn't tell me about it, but I remember having to tug her shirt so that she'd follow me.
entries.new: 咦，什么？她察觉到摄像头有什么不对了吗？她没跟我提过这事，但我记得当时还得拽她的衣角，她才肯跟我走。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: And what was Naomi's role? Given how likely it was that Katei had killed her once, she might have intercepted him after resisting the smoke.
entries.new: 那 Naomi 又扮演了什么角色？既然 Katei 很可能已经杀过她一次，她或许是在扛住烟雾后截住了他。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I saw us going up the stairs in hallway C, so I changed the cameras. They were all assigned random numbers, but I managed to display the second floor through a camera that'd been showing a crystal room.
entries.new: 我看见我们正在 C 走廊上楼梯，便切换了摄像头。这些摄像头的编号全是随机分配的，但我还是设法用一台原本对着水晶展室的摄像头调出了二楼画面。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: With Naomi in the lead, our past selves ran all the way up.
entries.new: 由 Naomi 带头，过去的我们一路跑了上去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Oh, is that Katei...?
entries.new: 哦，那是 Katei……？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: He was tailing us, but he collapsed at the stairs two floors above. When he stood up, it seemed like he'd given up on catching us, and with his eyes shut tight, he slowly walked back down.
entries.new: 他一直跟在我们后面，却在上面两层的楼梯处倒下了。等他重新站起，似乎已经放弃追我们，紧闭着双眼慢慢走了下去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I looked at the sixth floor, where Naomi unlocked the attic. She stepped in, shortly followed by me and Shiroya.
entries.new: 我看向六楼，Naomi 在那里打开了阁楼的锁。她走了进去，我和 Shiroya 紧随其后。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Is Katei gonna come here? I should leave.
entries.new: ……Katei 会来这里吗？我该走了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I made the monitor display the initial crystal room again and stepped out.
entries.new: 我让监视器重新显示最初的水晶展室，然后走了出去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I went to the lobby, but a clear problem was about to arise.
entries.new: 我来到大厅，可一个明显的问题就要出现了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: My past self is going to go to the storeroom very soon, so I can't stay there again.
entries.new: 过去的我很快就要去储藏室了，所以我不能再待在那里。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: If I'm remembering correctly, in this world, the group didn't go to the security room after waking up. ...I can't risk staying there, though.
entries.new: 如果我没记错，在这个世界里，一行人醒来后并没有去监控室。……不过，我也不能冒险待在那里。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I kept cleaning the smoke off me. It had touched me again, so I likely looked similar to how I had in the morning.
entries.new: 我不断擦去身上的烟雾。它又沾到了我身上，所以我现在的样子大概和早上差不多。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Katei was the first to return. At a slow pace, he scanned the floor.
entries.new: Katei 是第一个回来的。他不紧不慢地扫视着这一层。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I just remembered when he said he'd used the security room's microphone while we were unconscious. That really was a blatant lie, which Akaro immediately realized if they weren't working together. Also, Katei will probably be confused when he finds out the security room's unlocked.
entries.new: ……我刚想起来，他说过在我们昏迷时用过监控室的麦克风。那根本是明目张胆的谎言——除非他们本就是一伙的，否则 Akaro 当场就会识破。还有，等 Katei 发现监控室没锁，大概会摸不着头脑。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I stayed behind the reception desk. Once Katei was next to Erina's group, someone else had come down.
entries.new: 我躲在前台后面。等 Katei 走到 Erina 一行人身边时，又有一个人下来了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: My past self, who went straight to the storeroom. I was unable to find the rusty key in hallway A, so I stayed inside.
entries.new: 那是过去的我，径直走向储藏室。我在 A走廊没能找到生锈的钥匙，于是留在了里面。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...What was going to happen? I'd hidden in the storeroom for hours, but I knew the way things played out would be vastly different from my world's set of events.
entries.new: ……接下来会发生什么？我在储藏室里躲了好几个小时，但我知道事情的走向会和我那个世界截然不同。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Eventually, everyone would disappear, and after that, my past self would bring both Sekimeiya to the attic to experiment with them...
entries.new: 最终，所有人都会消失；在那之后，过去的我会把两个 Sekimeiya 带到阁楼去做实验……
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I had to hold on until that point, when the Sekimeiya would be within reach again.
entries.new: 我必须撑到那一刻，等 Sekimeiya 再次变得触手可及。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I didn't want to be found, but I knew it could happen. The Atsuki originally from that world wasn't a past self of mine—him seeing me wouldn't be a contradiction.
entries.new: 我不想被人发现，但也知道这并非不可能。那个世界原本的 Atsuki 并不是我的过去之身——他看到我，也不会构成矛盾。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The seconds began to tick by. I had no place where I could safely stay, so I had to keep moving, my whole objective being to smoothly return to one particular point.
entries.new: 时间一分一秒地过去。我没有可以安全停留的地方，只能不断移动，而我的全部目标，就是顺利回到某个特定节点。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I couldn't travel forward in time to speed up the process because I hadn't been in the tower in the proportional past. However, I doubted I would have been willing to do that anyway.{w} ...To skip that last time I had... where Miiya existed. When I heard her voice, I couldn't stop myself from getting closer to the door.
entries.new: 我无法穿越到未来去加快进程，因为在对应的过去，我并没有待在塔里。不过，就算能这么做，我大概也不会愿意。{w}……毕竟，那会跳过我拥有的最后一段…… Miiya 还在的时光。听到她的声音时，我还是忍不住朝门口靠近。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...ou okay? I'm so—
entries.new: ……你还好吗？我真是太——
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: Don't worry. No— ...our fault.
entries.new: 别担心。不——……是我们的错。
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: She was there. It was proof that my effort wasn't worthless. But I couldn't even see her.
entries.new: 她就在那里。这证明我的努力没有白费。可我却连看都看不到她。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Aware that they could come to the lobby at any point, I walked away.
entries.new: ……我知道他们随时可能来到大厅，于是转身离开。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: After learning that they'd been trapped, the group saw the shutter for the first time. Then, once they stepped into hallway A, they directed themselves to the dark crystal room, A5.
entries.new: 得知自己被困后，一行人第一次看到了卷帘门。随后，他们一踏进 A走廊，便径直朝昏暗的水晶展室 A5 走去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It wasn't what we'd done. ...They weren't surprised to see its stained walls.
entries.new: 这和我们当初不同。……看到墙上那些污迹，他们并不意外。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: And the security room, which should've been their priority, had been ignored completely.
entries.new: 而本应成为他们首要目标的监控室，却被完全忽略了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Oh, huh. The suitcase isn't here this time.{w} Naomi ran up to the attic with it, and I didn't see it. But the Sekimeiya were on the sofa. It has to be that the suitcase was brought to our world as well, which is why we saw two.
entries.new: 哦，咦？这次手提箱不在这里。{w} Naomi 提着它跑上了阁楼，可我没看见。不过 Sekimeiya 在沙发上。一定是手提箱也被带到了我们的世界，所以我们才会看到两个。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...There's a reason why I believe Naomi hid upstairs if she's part of this, like I suspect. Above us are five desolate floors full of offices. However, there's a seventh floor that we call the attic, or the Ashiya floor.
entries.new: ……我怀疑 Naomi 也牵涉其中，而她若真牵涉其中，我认为她藏在楼上是有原因的。我们头顶上有五层空荡荡的楼层，全是办公室。不过还有第七层，我们称之为阁楼，也叫芦屋层。
entries.speaker: k4

entries.text: Unable to use the elevator, they all walked up the stairs.
entries.new: 电梯用不了，他们便全都走楼梯上去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I could follow them. It was good to know what their movements would be and the events that were bound to unfold. In the future, I could put that information to use.
entries.new: 我可以跟上去。弄清他们的行动和注定会发生的事，总归有好处。将来，这些情报或许能派上用场。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I had already noticed that Katei's behavior and the things he was saying were different. The group was going up to find Naomi, who had locked herself in the attic. Unknown to them, Shiroya and I had unlocked it, and Naomi was no longer in the building.
entries.new: 我已经察觉到 Katei 的言行与以往不同。一行人正上楼去找 Naomi——她把自己锁在了阁楼里。可他们不知道，Shiroya 和我已经打开了阁楼的锁，而 Naomi 早已不在楼里了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: On the second floor, the group looked through the offices. As expected, nothing was found, and they moved on to the third floor.
entries.new: 在二楼，一行人逐个查看了办公室。不出所料，什么也没找到，于是他们又上了三楼。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The same occurred upstairs.
entries.new: 楼上也是一样。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I followed them when they were going to the fourth, but all of a sudden, someone walked back down while I was following them.
entries.new: 他们上四楼时，我跟了上去；可才跟到一半，忽然有人掉头下楼了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I couldn't run all the way down, so I was only able to enter the first partition.
entries.new: 我没法一路跑下楼，只能躲进第一间隔间。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: That's me and Miiya...!
entries.new: 那是我和 Miiya……！
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: From behind a desk, I saw them walking beyond the glass, which greatly muddled their voices.
entries.new: 我躲在办公桌后，看见他们从玻璃另一侧走过，声音也因此变得十分模糊。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Before I could breathe, Erina and Isla came down as well. They appeared to be following the other two.
entries.new: 我还没来得及喘口气，Erina 和 Isla 也下来了。看那样子，她们是在跟着先前那两个人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Was that it? No one else seemed to be coming.{w} Why had they gone down alone? As I wondered that, a fifth person came from the upper floor.
entries.new: ……就这些？似乎不会再有别人下来了。{w} 他们为什么独自下楼？我正想着，第五个人从楼上走了下来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Akaro. He looked deep in thought as he walked.{w} While I was still fazed, the sixth person appeared. Sai trailed behind Akaro as he disappeared beyond the glass.
entries.new: Akaro。他边走边沉思。{w} 我还没回过神，第六个人出现了。Sai 跟在 Akaro 身后，一同消失在玻璃那头。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...What the hell are they doing?{w} I remember this. When I was in the storeroom, everyone came back on their own. I heard different footsteps walking beyond the wall.
entries.new: ……他们到底在干什么？{w} 这一幕我记得。我待在储藏室的时候，所有人都是自己回来的。我听见墙外传来不同的脚步声。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I kept waiting. After all, someone was missing.
entries.new: 我继续等着。毕竟，还少一个人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Where's Katei? Why is he the only person who hasn't come down?
entries.new: Katei 呢？怎么只有他还没下来？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I couldn't hear anything. Was he still above me?
entries.new: 什么声音也听不到。他还在楼上吗？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Assuming that he wasn't coming, I slowly emerged from the partition. Why in the world had they left Katei alone? Trying not to reveal my presence, I approached the staircase and went up to the fourth floor.
