entries.new: 我猜他不会下来了，便慢慢从隔间里走出来。他们怎么就把 Katei 一个人丢下了？我尽量不让人发现，走到楼梯口，上了四楼。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...There he was. I saw him walking toward the offices, looking a little disoriented.
entries.new: ……他在那儿。我看见他朝办公室那边走去，神情有些恍惚。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Instead of inspecting them, he kept going up to the fifth floor.
entries.new: 他没有去查看那些办公室，径直上了五楼。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Was he going to the attic? If so, why had everyone else gone down?
entries.new: 他要去阁楼？若真如此，其他人又为什么全都下楼了？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: From the second floor, I looked down as I kept myself hidden. I could see that someone was in the security room based on the light coming out of it.
entries.new: 我躲在二楼，朝下望去。监控室里透出灯光，看来里面有人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Then, the event room opened, and I could see a single person's lower legs.
entries.new: 接着，活动室的门开了，我只能看见一个人的小腿。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Those were Sai's shoes. It seemed everyone was separated, so I couldn't keep going down.
entries.new: 那是 Sai 的鞋。看来众人散在各处，我没法再往下走了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Let me guess. The Sekimeiya is about to have disappeared from the cabinet.
entries.new: 让我猜猜。展示柜里的 Sekimeiya 马上就要消失了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I entered the offices again and stepped into the second so that I wouldn't be seen through the glass.
entries.new: 我又进了办公室，躲进第二间，免得被人隔着玻璃看见。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What...?
entries.new: 什么……？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: As soon as I did so, I caught a glimpse of Katei. He was walking toward the crystal floor.
entries.new: 我刚躲好，就瞥见了 Katei。他正朝水晶层走去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What the hell? Did he not see me?
entries.new: 怎么回事？他没看见我吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: He walked past without looking at me. However, his timing left me confused. ...It was like he'd been waiting for me to step aside.
entries.new: 他从我身边走过，看都没看我一眼。可这个时机让我很困惑。……就好像他一直在等我让开。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I couldn't see his hands since they were held to his side, away from me, and he was likely just in the attic... It hasn't been very long, though.
entries.new: 他的手垂在身体另一侧，我看不见，而他刚才大概只是去了阁楼……可这也没过多久啊。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I didn't care about it anymore. When they had switched worlds, everyone had been alive. That was what mattered.
entries.new: 我不再去想这些。他们切换世界的时候，所有人都还活着。这才要紧。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: At that time, everyone was alive...
entries.new: 那个时候，所有人都还活着……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: However, what about later? The first time we'd changed worlds was still in my memories.
entries.new: 可是后来呢？我们第一次切换世界的情形，我还记得清清楚楚。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: When Erina touched the Sekimeiya in the event room, was the world we appeared in this one? ...Did everyone come back, or was it an entirely different world?
entries.new: Erina 在活动室里碰到 Sekimeiya 的时候，我们出现的地方就是这个世界吗？……是所有人都回来了，还是那根本是另一个世界？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It's gotta be this one, right? Miiya was alive, and we were told Shiroya was the one who died. For them, she hadn't been in the tower yet.
entries.new: 只能是这个世界吧？Miiya 还活着，而且他们说死的是 Shiroya。在他们那边，她那时还没进塔。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: When I remembered it, something else I'd heard made me grimace.
entries.new: 想到这里，我又记起听过的另一句话，不禁皱起眉头。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: And you too, Erina! I thought you'd died!
entries.new: 还有你，Erina！我还以为你死了！
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...Was that the fate lying in wait in the world I was in? Was it not going to be one free of suffering...?
entries.new: ……这就是我所在的世界里，等着我的命运吗？它终究不能免去痛苦吗……？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: People came from below. It sounded like it was the group of four: my other self, Miiya, Erina, and Isla. Ignoring the three partitions, they walked up.{w} I could hear their steps above me, but they rapidly faded. ...Their destination was likely the attic.
entries.new: 楼下有人上来了。听动静是那四个人：另一个我、Miiya、Erina 和 Isla。他们没理会那三间隔间，径直往上走。{w} 我能听见头顶的脚步声，可很快就远去了。……他们多半是去阁楼了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Then, just as I remembered it, a single person came from the crystal floor and proceeded to walk up, their steps hardly audible. That was repeated two more times, until the number of people who'd left the crystal floor was seven. Everyone had been completely unconcerned with the offices and gone straight up.
entries.new: 接着，和我记忆中一样，一个人从水晶层上来，继续往上走，脚步声轻得几乎听不见。如此又重复了两次，从水晶层离开的人一共是七个。所有人对办公室毫不在意，径直上楼去了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...They're all above me again, then.
entries.new: ……那么，他们又全都在我上面了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I waited in case someone else was yet to appear. A while later, nobody had come, so I cautiously left.
entries.new: 我等着，怕还有谁没出现。过了好一阵也没人来，我才小心翼翼地离开。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What were they all doing? What had caused those bizarre movements...?
entries.new: 他们到底在做什么？那些古怪的举动是怎么回事……？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Once again, I had to stop myself when I heard distant voices.
entries.new: 又一次，我听见远处传来说话声，只好停下脚步。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...ese would make the noise. Why did you not wa—
entries.new: ……这些会弄出声响。你为什么不等——
entries.speaker: sai4

entries.text: Because I didn't feel like humoring your condescending attitude. Are you satisfied now?
entries.new: 因为我不想惯着你那副居高临下的样子。现在满意了？
entries.speaker: k4

entries.text: Hardly. What do they open? And what's this thing? ...Tape?
entries.new: 差远了。这些是开什么的？还有这个……是什么？……胶带？
entries.speaker: sai4

entries.text: Oh...! I left the duct tape in the security room!{w} It sounds like Katei found it.
entries.new: 啊……！我把那卷胶带落在监控室了！{w} 听这意思，是 Katei 找到了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: They kept going up. They wanted to see whether one of the keys Katei had would unlock the attic.
entries.new: 他们继续往上，想试试 Katei 手里的某把钥匙能不能打开阁楼。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It did. Once it was unlocked, everyone walked in.
entries.new: 果然打开了。锁一开，所有人都走了进去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: He had the keys. That means he got the keyring that Naomi left behind.{w} Since the attic was locked just now, he definitely locked it while he was up here before.
entries.new: 钥匙在他手上。也就是说，他拿到了 Naomi 落下的那串钥匙。{w} 刚才阁楼还是锁着的，那就肯定是他先前待在上面时锁上的。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I couldn't get closer, so I waited behind. Some minutes later, I heard the elevator once.
entries.new: 我没法再靠近，只好在后面等着。过了几分钟，电梯响了一声。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...What? Is it working?{w} They just tried it on this floor, and it wasn't...
entries.new: ……什么？电梯能用了？{w} 他们刚刚在这层试过，明明还不行……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: While I frowned, I heard people walking out of the attic.
entries.new: 我正皱着眉，就听见有人从阁楼里走了出来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I abandoned my thoughts and hid inside the offices, which was all I could do to avoid detection.
entries.new: 我抛开思绪，躲进办公室里——要避开他们的目光，我也只能如此。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: From there, I saw the people who were walking down.{w} Myself, Miiya, and Katei.
entries.new: 我从那里看见了往下走的几个人。{w} 我自己、Miiya，还有 Katei。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The Sekimeiya...
entries.new: 那个 Sekimeiya……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Katei was behind them, holding a white Sekimeiya in his hands. Although the two at the front weren't seeing it, pain was written clear across his face.
entries.new: Katei 走在他们后面，双手捧着一只白色的 Sekimeiya。走在前面的两人看不见，可他脸上分明写满了痛苦。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: He's purposely avoiding touching it with his skin! He must be in pain because the Sekimeiya's gathered energy since it was taken out of the cabinet! I bet he can barely hold it.
entries.new: 他故意不让皮肤碰到它！Sekimeiya 从展示柜里取出来后一直在蓄能，他现在肯定很痛！我看他快拿不住了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: They disappeared from my sight. It seemed that the maximum number of occupants, four people, had taken the elevator down.
entries.new: 他们从我眼前消失了。看来电梯载着满员的四个人下去了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Why did he only have one Sekimeiya? What about the other one?
entries.new: ……为什么他只有一块 Sekimeiya？另一块呢？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Once there was some distance between us, I went down the floors myself.
entries.new: 等和他们隔开一段距离，我才自己逐层下楼。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: They're all in the security room. That means the computer's already shut down.
entries.new: 他们全都在监控室。也就是说，电脑已经关掉了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...Katei has to be responsible. I don't know why they didn't all go to the security room immediately, but this is the same thing he did in the other world.
entries.new: ……这一定是 Katei 干的。我不知道他们为什么没有立刻全都赶去监控室，但他在另一个世界就是这么做的。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: A while later, the group went to the lobby. I was able to hear that they'd moved to hallway B, but any distinct sounds quickly faded.
entries.new: 过了一会儿，一行人去了大厅。我能听出他们转到了 B 走廊，但很快就听不清了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Did they enter a room?
entries.new: ……他们进房间了？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: The indistinct sound was coming from the event room. They'd most likely left the Sekimeiya in the cabinet.
entries.new: 那模糊的声音是从活动室传来的。他们多半是把 Sekimeiya 留在了展示柜里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It was soon after when they experienced something unnatural for the first time that day.
entries.new: 没过多久，他们就在那天第一次遇上了不合常理的事。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Katei's shout was cut short. Then, voices of incredulity came from hallway A.
entries.new: Katei 的喊声戛然而止。紧接着，A 走廊传来难以置信的惊呼。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...at the fuck?
entries.new: ……什么鬼东西？
entries.speaker: sai4

entries.text: What— ...just do?
entries.new: 你——……做了什么？
entries.speaker: ak4

entries.text: ...this man just teleport?
entries.new: ……这家伙刚才传送了？
entries.speaker: sai4

entries.text: A sudden sentence I didn't expect came.
entries.new: 突然传来一句我完全没料到的话。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I just...{w} traveled to the past.
entries.new: 我刚刚……{w}回到了过去。
entries.speaker: k4

entries.text: The reality of their situation was told to them. Naturally, it wasn't something anyone could easily accept.
entries.new: 有人把他们的处境告诉了他们。当然，这不是谁都能轻易接受的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Why did Katei say that? He just touched the Sekimeiya and appeared in hallway A. ...Why did he immediately say that he'd traveled to the past?
entries.new: ……Katei 为什么会那么说？他明明只是碰了一下 Sekimeiya，就出现在 A 走廊。……为什么他立刻就说自己穿越到了过去？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I didn't understand. In my world, he had been completely opposed to the idea of time travel existing for a very long time.
entries.new: 我不明白。在我的世界里，他长期以来一直坚决否认时间穿越的存在。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Despite what had happened, Katei made them shut the Sekimeiya away before walking to the security room.
entries.new: 尽管出了这样的事，Katei 还是让他们把 Sekimeiya 收好，然后走向监控室。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The others remained inside the event room. Wanting to know what they were saying, I approached it slowly.
entries.new: 其他人留在了活动室里。我想知道他们在说什么，便慢慢靠近。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...efinitely working with Naomi. ...isn't being tru—
entries.new: ……肯定和 Naomi 是一伙的。……不可能是真——
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: Unlock i—
entries.new: 打开它——
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: The door wasn't fully shut, but it was difficult to hear what they were saying. I still managed to understand that they had the key to unlock the cabinet.
entries.new: 门没有完全关上，可他们的说话声还是很难听清。不过我总算听明白，他们手里有打开展示柜的钥匙。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...do we touch it?
entries.new: ……我们要碰它吗？
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: That's me.
entries.new: 那是我的声音。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I realized I'd made a sound. In an attempt to hear better, I'd revealed my presence.
entries.new: 我意识到自己出了声。为了听得更清楚，反倒暴露了行踪。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: When they opened the door, I was already in hallway C. I'd been able to react fast enough.
entries.new: 等他们打开门，我已经在 C 走廊了。我的反应还算够快。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: They started coming out to find who'd been there. A little nervous, I retreated to the second floor.
entries.new: 他们出来找刚才待在那里的人。我有些紧张，退到了二楼。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...They're looking into every room. I bet they think Naomi made the sound.
entries.new: ……他们在逐个查看每个房间。多半是以为那声音是 Naomi 发出来的。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I started to get a bit worried, but the sound stopped. They weren't continuing to the other floors.
entries.new: 我开始有些担心，声音却停下了。他们没有继续往别的楼层去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: When I looked down, I saw they were back in the event room.
entries.new: 我往下一看，见他们已经回到了活动室。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I stepped forward slowly, making sure not to reveal myself again. They had just learned about time travel, so I really wanted to hear what was happening.
entries.new: 我放轻脚步往前走，以免再次暴露。他们刚知道时间穿越这回事，我实在很想听听那边的情况。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...What is my other self thinking?{w} What is he thinking now that he's witnessed time travel for the first time? The events of November 30th... Did they occur as I imagine? If so, I don't have to wonder.
entries.new: ……另一个我在想什么？{w}第一次亲眼见到时间穿越，他现在作何感想？11月30日发生的事……是否和我设想的一样？若是如此，我也无需多想了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It seemed Katei was still in the security room, so I got closer to hallway B.
entries.new: 看来 Katei 还在监控室，我便向 B 走廊靠近了一些。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What!?
entries.new: 什么！？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: All of a sudden, the cleaning room opened. I stepped aside immediately, but I was able to see who'd been there.
entries.new: 清洁间的门忽然开了。我立刻闪到一旁，但还是看见了里面的人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Sai. His footsteps grew fainter as he walked to the event room.
entries.new: ……是 Sai。他往活动室走去，脚步声渐渐远去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: However, when I glanced at the hallway, he wasn't there.
entries.new: 可是，等我再看走廊时，他已经不见了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: He was gone. His disappearance stunned me long enough that I didn't react to a door opening.
entries.new: 他消失了。我愣了好一会儿，连门开了都没反应过来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: By the time I realized what had happened, I was staring into Miiya's eyes. She looked at me from the event room with a curious frown.
entries.new: 等我回过神来，已经和 Miiya 四目相对。她站在活动室里，皱着眉，好奇地望着我。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Should I get closer...?
entries.new: 我要再靠近一点吗……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I could hardly believe that I was seeing her alive and well. Strangely, her look didn't seem to share the same puzzlement.
entries.new: 我几乎不敢相信她还活着，就站在我眼前。奇怪的是，她的神情里并没有同样的困惑。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I took a step forward, unable to take my eyes off her.
entries.new: 我向前迈了一步，目光无法从她身上移开。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: So, i-it worked...? You went to the past?
entries.new: 那、那么……成功了？你回到过去了？
entries.speaker: m2

entries.text: ...What?{w} Did the other Atsuki just touch the Sekimeiya?
entries.new: ……什么？{w}另一个我刚才碰了 Sekimeiya？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Um... Y-Yes. I suppose so.
entries.new: 呃……是、是的。应该是吧。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I see. That's why Sai disappeared as well.
entries.new: 原来如此。难怪 Sai 也不见了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I can't... I can't believe it, though.
entries.new: 可是……我还是不敢相信。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Is Sai not here?
entries.new: Sai 不在吗？
entries.speaker: m2

entries.text: Oh, y-you're right. I don't think he's been here for a bit.
entries.new: 哦，你、你说得对。他好像已经有一会儿不在了。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: He, Katei, and the other Atsuki were missing. The group seemed equally perplexed about Sai's and my own disappearance.
entries.new: 他、Katei，还有另一个 Atsuki 都不见了。大家似乎也同样想不通 Sai 和我怎么会消失。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...They think I'm the Atsuki who just disappeared. If he traveled to the past, I should leave before he's back.
entries.new: ……他们把我当成了刚刚消失的我自己。如果他是穿越回了过去，我最好赶在他回来之前离开。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: How is this possible...? I don't get it, but if you went to the past, why didn't you appear in this room? That's what happened to Katei.
entries.new: 这怎么可能……？我实在想不通。可如果你真回到了过去，为什么没在这个房间里出现？Katei 当时就是这样。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Hm...
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Given what I saw, Katei traveled just a few seconds through time. He must have touched the Sekimeiya as soon as it was removed from the cabinet.
entries.new: 照我看到的情况，Katei 只穿越了几秒钟。他肯定是在 Sekimeiya 刚被拿出展示柜的时候就碰到了它。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I don't think I traveled a few seconds through time, but actually minutes. About twenty, I'd say.
entries.new: 我觉得自己穿越的不是几秒，而是好几分钟。我看有二十分钟左右。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I recalled the time they'd unlocked the cabinet again. If the other Atsuki had just touched it, his experience surely resembled what I was describing.
entries.new: 我想起他们后来再次打开展示柜的那次。如果另一个 Atsuki 就是那时候碰到的它，他的经历应该和我描述的差不多。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Oh, what? That long ago, we were still in the attic, right?
entries.new: 什么？那么早……我们还在阁楼里吧？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: As I nodded, the air around me felt somehow dense. The situation was so surreal that I could hardly believe I was really there.
entries.new: 我点了点头，只觉得周遭的空气莫名凝滞。眼前的情形太过离奇，我几乎不敢相信自己真的身在此处。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I saw the Sekimeiya near the hallway B door, sitting on top of its cushion. It was clearly gray.
entries.new: 我看见 Sekimeiya 就搁在 B走廊门边，搁在它自己的垫子上，颜色分明是灰的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: L-Let me see.
entries.new: 让、让我看看。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I placed my hand on it.
entries.new: 我把手放了上去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It's not doing anything, and it's cold. ...It must do nothing when it's this color.{w} It's just a thought, but maybe I traveled farther because it spent more time out of the cabinet. When Katei touched it, it had barely been out for any time at all.
entries.new: 它毫无反应，还是凉的。……变成这种颜色时，它应该就什么也做不了。{w}只是我的猜测——也许是因为它在展示柜外放的时间更长，我才穿越得更远。Katei 碰它的时候，它才刚从柜子里拿出来没多久。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: While everyone observed me, I put the Sekimeiya in the cabinet. In mere seconds, its white color returned.
entries.new: 趁大家打量我的时候，我把 Sekimeiya 放回了展示柜。短短几秒，它又变回了白色。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: This again.
entries.new: 又是这样。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: ...I still can't believe what just happened to me, but I think we should go along with what Katei said and leave this in the cabinet until we can leave.
entries.new: ……我到现在还是不敢相信刚才发生在我身上的事。不过我觉得，还是照 Katei 说的做，在能离开之前把它留在柜子里吧。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: The keyring was inserted in the cabinet, so I gave it to Miiya after locking the wheel manually.
entries.new: 钥匙串还插在展示柜上，我手动锁好转轮，才把它交给 Miiya。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I doubt they'll actually do that, but it'd be best if they did. If the Sekimeiya stays in here, all those tragedies won't happen.
entries.new: 我很怀疑他们到底会不会照做，不过那样最好。只要 Sekimeiya 留在这里，那些惨剧就都不会发生。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...I mean, what else would we do?
entries.new: ……不然还能怎么办？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: ...Did you make the sound in hallway B earlier?
entries.new: ……刚才 B走廊的声响是你弄出来的吗？
entries.speaker: m2

entries.text: Oh, yeah, I did. That was when I realized I had really traveled through time. I moved to the second floor fast enough to stay out of sight.
entries.new: 哦，对，是我。那时我才意识到自己真的穿越了时间。我及时跑上二楼，才没被你们看见。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: That's just insane. ...Were we actually searching for you? Where the hell is Naomi, then?
entries.new: 这也太荒唐了。……那我们刚才找的人，难道是你？Naomi 到底跑哪儿去了？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Actually, where is Sai? That's another good question.
entries.new: 说起来，Sai 人呢？这倒也是个问题。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: I know he was with us when we searched this hallway.
entries.new: 我记得搜这条走廊的时候，他还跟我们在一起。
entries.speaker: m2

entries.text: Did he go somewhere...?
entries.new: 他是不是去哪儿了……？
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Akaro looked through multiple doors, but he didn't find Sai.
entries.new: Akaro 接连查看了好几扇门，都没找到 Sai。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: He's not here. Did you see what happened to him?
entries.new: 他不在这儿。你们看见他怎么了吗？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: ...No. I was on the second floor, so all I know is that he didn't go up.
entries.new: ……没有。我一直在二楼，只知道他没有往上走。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: He's still here, then...
entries.new: 那么，他还在这栋楼里……
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: We heard faint sounds coming from the security room.
entries.new: 监控室那边传来隐约的声响。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Only Katei was there. While everyone entered, I stayed near the hallway, ready to leave at any time.
entries.new: ……里面只有 Katei。大家进去的时候，我留在走廊附近，随时准备动身。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Oh, I haven't been able to fix anything. I apologize.
entries.new: ……唉，我什么都没能修好。实在抱歉。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: He's doing the same thing as in my world.
entries.new: 他做的事，和我那个世界一模一样。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I am completely lost; I don't even know what the issue is. Everything is properly arranged and connected, so unless no electricity is reaching the outlets, I'm out of ideas.
entries.new: 我完全摸不着头脑，连问题出在哪儿都不知道。线路排布、连接都好好的，除非是插座根本没通电，否则我真没别的办法了。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Katei crouched under the desk, inspecting things once again.
entries.new: Katei 蹲在桌子底下，又把各处检查了一遍。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: And you still haven't found Naomi... You were inspecting this floor just now, right?
entries.new: 那 Naomi 还是没找到……你们刚才是在查这一层吧？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Yes. She wasn't here.
entries.new: 对。她不在这层。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: That's very strange. She might have been able to keep dodging us, but there's no way that'll work for too long. There's no place where she could hide forever.
entries.new: 这就怪了。她或许能一直躲着我们，可这样撑不了太久。这楼里没有哪处能让她永远藏下去。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: I kept looking at the staircase, wondering where the other Atsuki was. I was sure he had appeared in the past with Sai, but it was unusual that he hadn't shown himself yet.{w} The door to the lobby was open. As it was likely he was on a higher floor, I wanted to leave as soon as I saw him returning.
entries.new: 我一直望着楼梯，心里想着另一个我在哪儿。他应该和 Sai 一起出现在了过去的这个时间点，却迟迟不露面，这很反常。{w}通往大厅的门开着。他多半在更高的楼层，我打算一看到他回来就立刻离开。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wait a second. Am I falling for it again?{w} Katei touched the Sekimeiya and appeared in hallway A. He had just been there, as he'd walked from the security room to the event room.{w} He appeared in a past location! He could've gone to the future.
entries.new: 等等。我是不是又上当了？{w}Katei 碰了 Sekimeiya，然后出现在 A 走廊。他刚刚才经过那里——从监控室走到活动室。{w}他出现在了过去的地点！可他也可能是去了未来啊。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I could see the cabinet in the event room from where I was. What was inside it at that moment was the Future Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 从我站的位置能看见活动室里的展示柜。那一刻放在里面的，是 Future Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The only reason they think we went to the past is due to what Katei said. "I just... traveled to the past."
entries.new: 他们认定我们去了过去，唯一的依据就是 Katei 那句话。『我只是……穿越到了过去。』
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Why the hell did he say that!? He was carefully holding the Sekimeiya without touching it with his skin, so he knew about its powers...{w} If he had traveled to the past before, it's very likely that's what he assumed just happened again. He went a couple seconds to the future, so he couldn't notice his own misinterpretation. Unless he lied on purpose, I guess.
entries.new: 他到底为什么要那么说！？他小心地捧着 Sekimeiya，不让皮肤碰到它，可见他知道它的力量……{w}如果他以前穿越到过去过，那他很可能会以为这次也是如此。可他其实是去了几秒后的未来，所以察觉不到自己判断错了。除非——他是故意撒谎。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...Is there anything...{w} Oh, the elevator?
entries.new: ……有什么……{w}咦，电梯？
entries.speaker: m2

entries.text: Miiya saw that I'd been looking ahead. When she followed my line of sight, she noticed the elevator wasn't properly closed.
entries.new: Miiya 见我一直望着前面，便顺着我的视线看过去，发现电梯没关好。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It's not closed, yeah.
entries.new: 嗯，确实没关上。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: What...?
entries.new: 什么……？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Oh, it's been like that for a while. I noticed it when we walked down from the attic and figured the others purposely left it like that.
entries.new: 哦，那样有一阵子了。我们从阁楼下来时就看见了，还以为是其他人故意留着的。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: We didn't.
entries.new: 我们没有。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: It must not have closed properly when you got off, then. I've seen it happen in the past.
entries.new: 那多半是你们下电梯时没关严。以前也出现过这种情况。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Hm, I see. I didn't notice it.
entries.new: 嗯，原来如此。我倒没留意。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Me neither.
entries.new: 我也没注意。
entries.speaker: m2

entries.text: I wonder what I should do. I can't change my version of what happened, but the other Atsuki didn't travel to the past. ...Neither did Sai. That's why they're not back yet.
entries.new: 我该怎么办才好。我这边发生的事我改变不了，可另一个我没有穿越到过去……Sai 也一样。所以他们到现在还没回来。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: What I said still applies, though. They went about twenty minutes to the future. That's when they'll return.
entries.new: 不过我先前的说法依然成立。他们去了大约二十分钟后的未来，到那时就会回来。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...Wait, I just remembered the hallway B camera. The one that had its lens completely clean.
entries.new: ……等等，我想起 B 走廊那台摄像头了。就是镜头上干干净净的那台。
entries.speaker: m2

entries.text: Oh, they did notice it.
entries.new: 哦，他们确实注意到了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Excuse me...?
entries.new: 什么意思……？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Right, the one above the door to the lobby.
entries.new: 对，就是大厅门上方那一台。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Yeah, and the footage was being displayed up there.
entries.new: 嗯，而且画面就显示在上面。
entries.speaker: m2

entries.text: Are you serious?
entries.new: 你说真的？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: That makes sense. When they went to the security room, the computer wasn't disabled yet.
entries.new: 这就说得通了。他们去监控室的时候，电脑还没被停掉。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Katei and Akaro ran out of the room to confirm what we were saying.
entries.new: Katei 和 Akaro 跑出房间，去确认我们说的话。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: You saw it, right?
entries.new: 你看到了吧？
entries.speaker: m2

entries.text: What the hell...? Was it cleaned?
entries.new: 怎么回事……？是被人擦过了吗？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: There's no way we would know.
entries.new: 我们怎么可能知道。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: ...I don't have it anymore, but do you remember when—
entries.new: ……那东西现在不在我手上了，不过你们还记不记得——
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Wait, where the hell is Sai?
entries.new: 等等，Sai 到底去哪了？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Katei was told that Sai had recently vanished. Before he could begin to spit out more of his nonsense, Akaro forced him to hold off.
entries.new: 有人告诉 Katei，Sai 刚刚不见了。他还没来得及再吐出一堆胡话，就被 Akaro 拦住了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What were you gonna say? We've already searched for Sai, and the Sekimeiya's locked in the cabinet.
entries.new: 你刚才想说什么？Sai 我们已经找过了，Sekimeiya 也锁在展示柜里。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: ...{w}The duct tape, remember? Sai took out my keyring, and it had a piece of duct tape attached to it. That piece had smoke residue on it.
entries.new: ……{w}胶带，记得吗？Sai 拿出我的钥匙串时，上面粘着一截胶带。那截胶带上留着烟熏的痕迹。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: I know it was duct tape because one side was still sticky, which means that it was only hit on the front side. In other words, it was stuck somewhere when the smoke was released.
entries.new: 我知道那是胶带，因为它有一面还带着黏性，说明只有正面被烟熏到。也就是说，烟散出来的时候，它正贴在某个地方。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Where did it even come from?
entries.new: 那东西到底是从哪来的？
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: ...{w}When I walked down to the crystal floor, searching for you, I found it hidden behind a handrail and put it in my pocket to inquire about it. That's when it got stuck to the keyring.
entries.new: ……{w}我下到水晶层找你们的时候，发现它被藏在扶手后面，就收进了口袋，打算之后再问；就是那时粘到钥匙串上的。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Hidden behind the handrail? I think it fell to the floor when I was here. He probably found it when he was unplugging some cables.
entries.new: 藏在扶手后面？我记得我在这儿的时候它掉到了地上。大概是他拔线缆的时候捡到的。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I'd been quiet for a while, so I decided to speak. My voice came out rougher than I intended.
entries.new: 我沉默了一会儿，才决定开口。声音比我预想的要沙哑。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: So it was placed on the lens of that camera, which prevented the smoke from hitting it. Afterward, it was removed...{w} I'm confused about a few things. Why would someone do that? They had to already know the smoke attack would happen.
entries.new: 所以它是被贴在那台摄像头的镜头上，挡住了烟。之后又被取下来……{w}有几件事我想不通。谁会这么做？他一定事先就知道会有人放烟。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: And it was removed before we entered the security room.
entries.new: 而且，它是在我们进入监控室之前就被取下的。
entries.speaker: m2

entries.text: Katei sighed, dramatically sitting on his chair.
entries.new: Katei 叹了口气，夸张地一屁股坐回椅子上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What the hell is Naomi doing...? We can't even use the computer to figure anything out.{w} Do you all think Sai ran away on his own? Now we need to find both of them.
entries.new: Naomi 到底在搞什么……？连电脑都用不了，什么都查不出来。{w}你们真觉得 Sai 是自己跑掉的？现在倒好，两个人全得找。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: We lost track of him when we were searching this hallway, which would've been a good opportunity to sneak away. I have no idea why he'd do that, though.
entries.new: 我们在这条走廊里搜寻的时候跟丢了他，那确实是个溜走的好机会。不过，我想不通他为什么要这么做。
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Katei, clearly agitated, pressed the computer's power button again while looking at all the blank monitors.
entries.new: Katei 明显焦躁不安，一边盯着满墙漆黑的显示器，一边又按了一下电脑的电源键。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Maybe now you can believe that he was the one up to something. I'm just trying to do my job.
entries.new: 也许现在你们该相信，真正有鬼的人是他。我只是想做好分内的事。
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: None of us responded. For some reason, everyone looked tired. It seemed no one had the will to go find Sai.
entries.new: 谁都没有应声。不知为何，每个人看上去都很疲惫，似乎谁也没力气去找 Sai。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I remained quiet along with them, but that was because I was counting the seconds. I figured it had been close to twenty minutes since the other Atsuki and Sai had disappeared.
entries.new: 我也和他们一样沉默，但我是在数着秒。我估摸着，另一个我和 Sai 已经消失快二十分钟了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The empty screens were the only place anyone was looking. That was all I needed to silently escape, retreating until I was safely in the lobby.
entries.new: 所有人的目光都落在那些空白的屏幕上。这已足够让我悄悄脱身，一路退到大厅里才停下。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Nobody noticed that I'd left. Soon after my departure, Sai and the other Atsuki returned.
entries.new: 没人察觉我离开了。我走后不久，Sai 和另一个 Atsuki 就回来了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I wondered what would happen next. Would they realize what had occurred? Two Sekimeiya had been hidden somewhere, and just like in my world, their very existence was concealed.
entries.new: 不知道接下来会怎样。他们会发现发生了什么吗？两把 Sekimeiya 被藏在了某处，和我所在的世界一样，它们的存在本身被隐瞒了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: During the time I'd been hiding in the storeroom, there was an extended period of complete silence; I'd only heard sporadic footsteps every now and then.
entries.new: 我躲在储藏室里的那段时间，有很长一阵子一点声音都没有，只偶尔传来几声零星的脚步。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Although my perspective had grown wider, that was all that happened. However, I was able to understand it better from a distance, keeping my presence a secret thanks to the layout of the floor.
entries.new: 虽然我的视野开阔了些，但也仅此而已。不过，多亏了这一层的布局，我能藏住身形，从远处反倒看得更清楚。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The people in the security room split up. Atsuki, Miiya, Sai, and Katei went up the stairs. For a very long time, Atsuki and Miiya didn't come back.
entries.new: 监控室里的人散了。Atsuki、Miiya、Sai 和 Katei 上了楼梯。Atsuki 和 Miiya 很久都没有回来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Meanwhile, although calmness seemed to permeate the crystal floor, that was far from the truth.
entries.new: 与此同时，水晶层看似一片平静，实则远非如此。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Sai and Katei had returned. Everyone who I knew was on the crystal floor wanted the Sekimeiya. Not just the one in the cabinet, but the two hidden ones as well.
entries.new: Sai 和 Katei 回来了。据我所知，水晶层上的每个人都想要 Sekimeiya。不只是展示柜里那一把，还有藏起来的那两把。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I saw it with my own eyes. When Katei thought no one was watching, he took the Future Sekimeiya. The cabinet was locked, so he had a spare key.
entries.new: 我亲眼看见了。Katei 趁没人注意，取走了 Future Sekimeiya。展示柜是锁着的，说明他另有一把钥匙。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Then, he brought it to room B4. Strangely, like in the previous world, he chose not to hide it in the storeroom's secret area.
entries.new: 随后他把它带去了水晶展室 B4。奇怪的是，和上一个世界一样，他没有把它藏进储藏室的秘密之处。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: At that point, I realized that I'd been mistaken. I wasn't the only one to notice Katei.
entries.new: 那一刻我才明白自己错了。注意到 Katei 的，并不只有我。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: After he left, it was Akaro who entered that room, hiding the Sekimeiya behind his back as he stepped out.
entries.new: 他离开之后，进那间房的人是 Akaro——出来时，他把 Sekimeiya 藏在身后。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: They both wanted to obtain all the Sekimeiya, and it became evident that Akaro and Katei weren't working together. Along with Sai, they continued silently working toward their objective.
entries.new: 两个人都想拿到所有的 Sekimeiya，而 Akaro 与 Katei 显然并非同伙。再加上 Sai，三人各自沉默地朝着自己的目标行动。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: At one point, Erina and Isla remained in one of hallway A's crystal rooms, while the other Atsuki and Miiya were likely in the attic. It was hard to decipher everyone's goal, but all I wanted was to let the minutes keep passing without interruptions.
entries.new: 有那么一阵，Erina 和 Isla 待在 A走廊的一间水晶展室里，另一个 Atsuki 和 Miiya 则多半在阁楼。我摸不清每个人究竟想做什么，只希望时间就这么一分一分过去，不被打断。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It had been a while since Katei had entered one of the crystal rooms. ...I knew one of the Sekimeiya was there.
entries.new: Katei 进那间水晶展室已经有一阵子了。……我知道那里放着一件 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Had he activated it? I looked through the door and saw an open cabinet. Inside, there was a gray Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 他启动它了吗？我从门口望进去，只见展示柜敞着，里面放着一件灰色 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I figured that he would've traveled more than an hour through time, and the fact that I hadn't seen him yet seemed to imply he'd gone to the future.
entries.new: 我估计他穿越的时间超过了一个小时。既然到现在都没见到他，那他多半是去了未来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It appeared Katei was out of the picture, but Sai and Akaro were still around. When I saw them, they were looking for Katei, but they located the Future Sekimeiya instead.
entries.new: 看来 Katei 已经出局了，但 Sai 和 Akaro 还在。我看见他们时，他们正在找 Katei，结果却找到了 Future Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Since they were together, neither one revealed their true colors, and they brought it to its cabinet.
entries.new: 两人同行，谁也没有露出真面目，只把它送回了属于它的展示柜。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...However, as expected, it was Akaro who later took it out again.
entries.new: ……可后来把它再次取出来的，果然还是 Akaro。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I was witnessing a bizarre play. No matter how many details I was missing, their movements felt ridiculous. I considered that they might have been relocating the Sekimeiya so early in the off chance the shutter opened before the deadline.
entries.new: 我像是在看一出荒诞的戏。不管我漏掉了多少细节，他们的举动都显得可笑。我猜想，他们之所以这么早就把 Sekimeiya 挪来挪去，是防着卷帘门在期限之前就打开。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The same thing repeated. The Sekimeiya was found in one of the drawers in the lobby. That time, when they brought it to the cabinet, I heard what they were saying.
entries.new: 同样的一幕又重演了。有人在门厅的一个抽屉里找到了那件 Sekimeiya。这回他们把东西送回展示柜时，我听见了他们的谈话。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: They were blaming the people who'd disappeared. Although they themselves were responsible, Katei, the other Atsuki, and Miiya were the hidden culprits according to their narrative. It appeared they had locked themselves up in the attic.
entries.new: 他们在指责那些消失的人。明明该负责的是他们自己，可照他们的说法，Katei、另一个 Atsuki 和 Miiya 才是藏在暗处的元凶——那几个人似乎把自己关进了阁楼。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Of course, the Sekimeiya didn't remain in the cabinet for long. However, as I saw it being brought to the lobby, a sound in hallway A caught my ear.
entries.new: 当然，那件 Sekimeiya 没在展示柜里待多久。可是，就在我看着它被送回门厅时，A 走廊里传来一个声音，引起了我的注意。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The other Atsuki and Miiya were back. I saw them in the security room.{w} I didn't understand what they'd been doing. ...Why would they have locked themselves in the attic? And why had they returned?{w} Suddenly, a sound drew them to the lobby.
entries.new: 另一个 Atsuki 和 Miiya 回来了。我看见他们进了监控室。{w}我不明白他们此前在做什么。……他们为什么要把自己关在阁楼里？又为什么回来了？{w}忽然，一个声响把他们引向了门厅。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I had already been in the tower for hours. I didn't think a lot of time was left until they would all vanish from the bottom floor.
entries.new: ……我在塔里已经待了好几个小时。恐怕没剩多少时间，他们就会从底层全部消失了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'd tried to keep my distance from everyone, but seeing Miiya again made me slowly approach the entrance area.
entries.new: 我一直尽量与所有人保持距离，可是再次见到 Miiya，我不由得慢慢朝入口那边走去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I stood next to the far door. ...Were they on the other side of it? I couldn't hear anyone.
entries.new: 我站在最里面那扇门旁。……他们就在门后吗？我什么都听不见。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Instead, the faint voices I heard came from the event room.
entries.new: 我听见的微弱人声，其实来自活动室。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I was instantly alarmed. If they looked at the hallway, I would be seen.{w} I couldn't go to the lobby, and walking back could lead to me being noticed.
entries.new: 我顿时警觉起来。只要他们往走廊这边看一眼，就会发现我。{w}我不能去门厅，往回走也可能被人注意到。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Wait. Erina and Isla aren't there anymore.
entries.new: ……等等。Erina 和 Isla 已经不在那儿了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: The door of room A1 was slightly open. It made me gasp at first, but I quickly saw that the room was empty.
entries.new: 水晶展室 A1 的门虚掩着。我起初吓了一跳，但很快就看清房里空无一人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Are they the ones in the event room, then?
entries.new: ……那活动室里的人，就是她们了？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I didn't have time to think, so I stepped in.
entries.new: 我顾不上多想，便走了进去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I stayed tense by the door, unaware of whether I could leave. Someone was in the event room, and I didn't know their identity.
entries.new: 我紧绷着身子守在门边，不知道自己能不能出去。活动室里有人，而我却不知道那是谁。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...However, I couldn't hear anything from the lobby. Maybe they were no longer there.
entries.new: ……可门厅那边毫无声响。也许他们已经不在那儿了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I got closer to the wall and tried to listen through it.
entries.new: 我凑近墙壁，想隔着墙听个究竟。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Nothing.
entries.new: 什么也没有。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I didn't want to leave without being sure, but my fear was that Erina and Isla would return.
entries.new: 不确认清楚，我不想就这么走开，可我又怕 Erina 和 Isla 会折返回来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I could hear sporadic sounds, likely coming from the event room. They kept me trapped behind that door for minutes until I noticed someone walking on the other side.
entries.new: 断断续续的声响，多半来自活动室。那声音害得我躲在那扇门后好几分钟，直到察觉有人在另一侧走动。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Their faint steps went off to the lobby, which let me release the breath I'd been holding.
entries.new: 轻微的脚步声朝门厅远去了，我这才把憋着的那口气吐出来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: When I put my ear against the wall, the area still sounded vacant. That time, though, I knew for sure that someone was there.
entries.new: 我把耳朵贴上墙壁时，那一带听起来依旧空荡。可这一次，我确信那里有人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I focused intently. Suddenly, I heard an unexpected voice.
entries.new: 我屏息凝神。忽然，一个意想不到的声音传了过来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...ou there?
entries.new: ……有人吗？
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: What?{w} ...Who is that?
entries.new: 什么？{w}……那是谁？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...es! ...ower!
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: I was shocked. That voice didn't belong to anyone who should've been in the tower.
entries.new: 我吃了一惊。那声音不属于任何本该待在塔里的人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I turned my head abruptly. ...Had someone just come out of the security room?{w} I was fairly sure I'd sensed that, but I kept paying attention to the lobby.
entries.new: 我猛地转过头。……刚刚是有人从监控室出来了吗？{w}我几乎确定自己察觉到了动静，却还是继续留意着门厅。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The next time I heard it, the intensity of the voice was higher.
entries.new: 再次听到时，那声音更响了些。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Hey! ...there!
entries.new: 喂！……那边！
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: That was enough to let me confirm who it was.
entries.new: 这一声就足够让我确认那是谁了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Suripo...! That's him!
entries.new: Suripo……！是他！
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It was absurd for him to be inside, but I couldn't worry about it. I had to concentrate on what was happening behind the wall.
entries.new: 他出现在塔里实在荒唐，可此刻我顾不上这些。我必须专心听墙后的动静。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Someone ran. That was all I could make out.{w} Then, a noise like someone collapsing.
entries.new: 有人跑了起来。我只分辨得出这些。{w}紧接着，是一声像有人倒下的声音。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...{w}What? Is he gone?
entries.new: ……{w}怎么回事？他不见了？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: The next thing I heard didn't come from the direction of the lobby. It came from the wall behind me.
entries.new: 接着传来的声音并非来自大厅方向，而是从我身后的墙壁那边传来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Is... someone there?
entries.new: 有……有人吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Behind it should've been one of hallway B's crystal rooms, B1.
entries.new: 那面墙后面，应该是B走廊的水晶展室之一——B1。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...But, again, that was the last sound I heard before silence enveloped the building once more.
entries.new: ……然而，那同样是我听到的最后一点声响。之后，整栋建筑再度陷入沉寂。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I hadn't been mistaken. I'd heard Suripo's voice coming from the lobby.
entries.new: 我没有听错。从大厅传来的确实是 Suripo 的声音。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Could the shutter have unlocked? There was no way. I knew the tower would be sealed off for quite a while longer.
entries.new: 难道是卷帘门解锁了？不可能。我很清楚，这座塔还要封闭很长一段时间。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: How? How the hell was that Suripo? How did he get in?
entries.new: 怎么会？那怎么可能是 Suripo？他是怎么进来的？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Did he enter through the storeroom?{w} No. What am I thinking? My past self is currently there.
entries.new: 难道是从储藏室进来的？{w}不对。我在想什么？过去的我此刻就在那里。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I wanted to see it with my own eyes, but I couldn't afford to leave; I didn't know where anyone was.
entries.new: 我真想亲眼看看，可我不能离开——我根本不知道其他人都在哪儿。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Hallway A sounded empty as well, but I remained in that room. A short time later, faraway sounds made it clear I wasn't alone. I continued to bide my time in the hope that everyone else would congregate and I'd be able to slip away.
entries.new: A走廊那边听上去也没有人，但我仍旧守在那间屋里。没过多久，远处传来的动静让我明白，这里并不只有我一个人。我继续耐着性子等待，盼着其他人聚到一处，好让我能趁机溜走。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wh—!
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: After a few minutes had passed, a sudden gasp caused my eyes to shoot wide open. Miiya was behind the door, and I could hear myself as well.
entries.new: 几分钟后，一声突如其来的惊呼让我猛地睁大了眼睛。Miiya 就在门后，我也听见了自己的声音。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Oh...!{w} D-Did I just appear out of nowhere?
entries.new: 啊……！{w}我、我是突然凭空出现的吗？
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: What...? No, that's what happened to me.
entries.new: 什么……？不，突然出现的人是我。
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: ...Wait.
entries.new: ……等等。
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: Were you just in the mechanical room?
entries.new: 你刚才在机械室？
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: Yes... I touched the Sekimeiya a second ago.
entries.new: 是……我刚刚碰了 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: I showed up here as soon as you did that. Are we in the past...?
entries.new: 你刚碰完，我就出现在这里了。我们是在过去吗……？
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: ...{w}It teleported you as well? How come that didn't happen the other times?
entries.new: ……{w}连你也一起传送了？为什么之前几次没发生这种事？
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: And both of us appeared here...
entries.new: 而且我们两个都出现在这里……
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: Hey! What the fuck...!? Where have you two been!?
entries.new: 喂！这他妈怎么回事……！？你们俩到底去哪儿了！？
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: That's Sai. I'm pretty sure he's in the event room.
entries.new: 是 Sai。他应该就在活动室。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...Has anything happened?
entries.new: ……发生什么事了吗？
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: What...!? You've been gone for over two hours! Answer the question!
entries.new: 什么……！？你们已经消失两个多小时了！回答我的问题！
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: So this is the first time they've seen Miiya and the other Atsuki since they went upstairs.
entries.new: 也就是说，自从 Miiya 和另一个我上楼之后，这是他们第一次见到我俩。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: They were in the security room earlier, though. They weren't seen because they traveled to the future. The Future Sekimeiya was brought to the lobby, and they activated it. They just appeared in front of the security room, where they were in the past.
entries.new: 不过他们之前确实在监控室。之所以没人看见，是因为他们穿越到了未来。未来 Sekimeiya 被带到了大厅，他们启动了它。于是他们直接出现在监控室门前——过去他们就在那里。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: They were in the event room, but I couldn't pick up anything.{w} That was until Sai yelled.
entries.new: 他们人在活动室，可我什么也听不清。{w}直到 Sai 吼了一嗓子。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...H-Hey! What the fuck have you been doing!?
entries.new: ……喂、喂！你他妈到底在干什么！？
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: You found them too...?
entries.new: 你们也找到了……？
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: Akaro's voice came from the hallway.
entries.new: Akaro 的声音从走廊里传来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...ere sleeping alo— ...you been?
entries.new: ……一个人睡——……去哪儿了？
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: ...I've been here.{w} *sigh*
entries.new: ……我一直在这儿。{w}（叹气）
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: Oh...! Katei's here again!
entries.new: 哦……！Katei 又出现了！
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...here this whole time. I didn't go anywhere.
entries.new: ……一直在这儿。我哪儿也没去。
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: His words suddenly connected the dots. I understood what had happened.
entries.new: 他的话让我忽然想通了。我明白了究竟发生了什么。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Right. Katei went to the future a while ago. The range was large, so I bet it barely reached outside the tower.{w} It reached far enough to include Suripo, and they went far forward in time.{w} The locations match. Before the attack, Suripo was in the lobby, near the front door. At the time, Katei was still in the security room. That's where they appeared just now.{w} Those locations are from a time before the smoke was released; Katei's clothes should have no smoke on them. They were pretty clean anyway, so I doubt anyone would notice that.
entries.new: ……没错。Katei 刚才去了未来。范围很大，我猜它刚好伸到塔外。{w}刚好把 Suripo 也包含进去，于是他们一起跳到了很久之后。{w}位置也对得上。袭击发生前，Suripo 就在大厅靠近正门的地方；而当时 Katei 还在监控室。他们刚才正是在那里出现的。{w}那些位置对应的时间都在烟雾释放之前，所以 Katei 的衣服上不该沾到烟。再说那身衣服本来就挺干净的，我想没人会注意到。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Katei and Akaro had entered the event room, so I gave up on understanding what they were saying.
entries.new: Katei 和 Akaro 已经进了活动室，我也就放弃了去听清他们在说什么。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Where the hell is Suripo now, though!?
entries.new: 可 Suripo 现在到底在哪儿！？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Where was he when I was in the attic experimenting with the Sekimeiya? Did he change worlds as well?
entries.new: 我在阁楼试验 Sekimeiya 的时候，他又在哪里？他也切换了世界吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Wh...! ...you hear that!?
entries.new: 什……！……你听见了吗！？
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: Huh?
entries.new: 嗯？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: My own voice shouted those words. I frowned, as I hadn't heard anything.
entries.new: 那是我自己的声音在喊。我皱起眉——我什么也没听见。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Everyone came out of the event room and approached the lobby.
entries.new: 众人纷纷走出活动室，朝大厅走来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Who...{w} is this?
entries.new: 这……{w}这是谁？
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: Oh, Suripo's still there.
entries.new: 哦，Suripo 还在那儿。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...It was the next person to talk who left me in a daze.
entries.new: ……而接下来开口的那个人，让我彻底怔住了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Ah! Isla, stay over there!
entries.new: 啊！Isla，你待在那边别动！
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: What?
entries.new: 什么？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Isn't he...!?
entries.new: 他该不会是……！？
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: Wait, I recognize him too. Wasn't he there?
entries.new: 等等，我也认得他。他之前不就在那边吗？
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: Y-Yes... That's where I s-saw him, while we were waiting. Fuck.
entries.new: 对、对……我们等着的时候，我就是在那里看、看见他的。妈的。
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: That terror in my voice... It was easily recognizable.
entries.new: 我声音里的那股恐惧……任谁都听得出来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Don't tell me...
entries.new: 难道说……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: They all stepped in.
entries.new: 他们全都走了进来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...een here at the tower recently. I don't know his name, but he was inves— ...attack.
entries.new: ……他最近一直在塔里。我不知道他叫什么，不过他一直在调查——……袭击。
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: ...{w}This is a knife wound.
entries.new: ……{w}这是刀伤。
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: No way... A knife wound?
entries.new: 怎么可能……刀伤？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I couldn't believe what I was hearing. Suripo had been killed? ...I'd never looked at the lobby.
entries.new: 我不敢相信自己听到的话。Suripo 被杀了？……大厅那边，我始终没往那边看过一眼。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: You've been missing for the last three hours. Just as you reappear— ...no coincidence.
entries.new: 你消失了整整三个小时。偏偏就在你重新出现的时候—— ……绝非巧合。
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: What the hell are you talking about? How would I have left!?
entries.new: 你在胡说些什么？我怎么可能出得去！？
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: I cannot believe what I'm hearing! I've been here the entire time!
entries.new: 我简直不敢相信自己的耳朵！我一直都在这儿！
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: Yes, look at this! This is why I thought it must've been a knife. It was his own!
entries.new: 对，你看看这个！所以我才觉得一定是刀伤。那是他自己的刀！
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: ...his knife is gone. ...saw that he had a knife right here—
entries.new: ……他的刀不见了。……我明明看到这里有一把刀——
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: Wait... the knife was Suripo's?
entries.new: 等等……那把刀是 Suripo 的？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: If that's the case, the knife Sai chased us with... Where the hell did he get it from?
entries.new: 如果是这样，那 Sai 追我们时拿的那把刀……他到底是从哪儿弄来的？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: They found a walkie-talkie on him, but it seemed it had been damaged, and its battery was missing.
entries.new: 他们在他身上找到了一台对讲机，但似乎已经损坏，电池也不见了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: This happened just now. When I heard him talking, he was having a conversation with the policemen outside.
entries.new: 事情就发生在刚才。我听见他说话的时候，他正在和外面的警察对话。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Who the hell would've killed Suripo immediately after seeing him? I distinctly remembered that someone had entered the lobby seconds before I'd heard his voice.
entries.new: 究竟是谁，一见到 Suripo 就立刻下了杀手？我清楚地记得，在我听见他的声音前几秒，有人走进了大厅。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: And breaking the walkie-talkie... Was that done so that the group couldn't communicate with the outside, or was it done so that Suripo couldn't keep talking to them?
entries.new: 还有砸坏对讲机……是为了让他们无法和外界联系，还是为了让 Suripo 没法继续说下去？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Listening to the conversation, I grew a bit more confused.{w} According to the other me, Suripo hadn't been dead six minutes previously, so nobody could've killed him.
entries.new: 听着他们的对话，我越发糊涂了。{w}按另一个我的说法，六分钟前 Suripo 还没死，那就不可能有人杀他。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But that's wrong. He was dead six minutes ago.{w} Why is he saying that? ...Six minutes ago, I bet that version of me was already traveling to the future. There's no way he saw the lobby. Miiya's agreeing with him, though.
entries.new: 可那不对。六分钟前他就已经死了。{w}他为什么这么说？……六分钟前，那个我应该已经在穿越到未来了，根本不可能看到大厅。可 Miiya 却附和他。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: As I kept listening, I understood that their misinterpretation was the same—they thought they had gone to the past. If that was the case, none of them could have killed Suripo.
entries.new: 继续听下去，我明白了他们的误解如出一辙——都以为自己回到了过去。若真是如此，他们谁都不可能杀死 Suripo。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: This doesn't make sense, though. Sai just said it's {time=13:23.}
entries.new: 可这说不通。Sai 刚才说现在是 {time=13:23.}
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: That's what led Atsuki to say that Suripo was alive six minutes ago. At {time=13:17}, they'd seen the lobby was empty.
entries.new: 正因如此，Atsuki 才会说六分钟前 Suripo 还活着。{time=13:17} 的时候，他们看到大厅空无一人。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: For that to make sense, the other Atsuki had to know the time before traveling to the future. But if he knew the time before traveling, hearing the time Sai gave should've revealed that they went to the future.
entries.new: 要说得通，另一个 Atsuki 必须在穿越前就知道时间。可如果他穿越前就知道，听到 Sai 报出的时刻，就该明白自己是去了未来。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...{w}Oh!{w} That's not actually right!
entries.new: ……{w}啊！{w}不对，其实不是这样！
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: At {time=13:17}, the lobby was empty. That was before they traveled to the future, and somehow, they knew what the time was. They just said that they touched the Sekimeiya in the mechanical room.
entries.new: 在 {time=13:17}，大厅还是空的。那是在他们穿越到未来之前，而他们不知怎么就知道了当时的时刻。他们刚才说，他们在机械室碰了 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: More than twenty minutes have passed since I saw them in the security room, which was right after the Future Sekimeiya was taken out of the cabinet. Since they reappeared in hallway A, they went ten minutes to the future once the Sekimeiya had gathered power for ten minutes. Something like that.
entries.new: 我在监控室看到他们，是在 Future Sekimeiya 刚被从展示柜取出之后；从那之后已经过了二十多分钟。既然他们重新出现在 A走廊，那就是 Sekimeiya 蓄能十分钟后，他们往前跳了十分钟。大概是这么回事。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Atsuki and Miiya appeared at around {time=13:37.} The key to this is Sai's wristwatch.
entries.new: Atsuki 和 Miiya 大约在 {time=13:37.} 现身。关键就在 Sai 的手表上。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Earlier, Sai traveled to the future with Atsuki, which I deduced was almost twenty minutes to the future. So, ever since they appeared, Sai's watch has been more than half an hour behind. I'm sure that contributed to them thinking they'd gone to the past the first time.
entries.new: 先前 Sai 和 Atsuki 一起穿越到未来，我推断差不多是往前跳了二十分钟。所以他们现身之后，Sai 的表一直慢了大半个小时。他们第一次会以为自己回到了过去，肯定也是这个原因。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Sai just said it's {time=13:23}, but his watch is still behind. The computer isn't on, so he's not going to recognize that.{w} That's what's making Atsuki and Miiya think they've gone to the past again. They think they appeared back at {time=13:23} and that Suripo has just been killed.
entries.new: Sai 刚才说现在是 {time=13:23}，可他的表还是慢的。电脑没开，他也没法察觉。{w}正因为这样，Atsuki 和 Miiya 才以为又回到了过去——他们以为自己回到了 {time=13:23}，而 Suripo 刚刚遇害。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Sai went to the mechanical room, where he was told the Future Sekimeiya was. However, he came back claiming he hadn't found it.
entries.new: Sai 去了机械室——据说 Future Sekimeiya 就在那里。可他回来说没找到。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...was right. They're lying.
entries.new: ……说得没错。他们在撒谎。
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: I see. They said that the point they traveled to the past just happened. That means the Future Sekimeiya should've still been there.
entries.new: 原来如此。他们说自己穿越回过去的那个时间点刚刚才发生。那就是说，Future Sekimeiya 当时应该还在那里。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: In reality, it wouldn't surprise me if Suripo's killer took it several minutes ago. When the killer entered the lobby, the door to the mechanical room could easily have been left open by Miiya and the other Atsuki.
entries.new: 实际上，就算凶手几分钟前把它拿走了，我也不意外。凶手进大厅的时候，机械室的门很可能是 Miiya 和另一个 Atsuki 没关上的。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: They went down and found the Sekimeiya. Then, after they came back up, Suripo was there.
entries.new: 他们下楼找到了 Sekimeiya。然后回到楼上，Suripo 就在那儿了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Atsuki walked down the stairs to look for himself. Soon, he returned, admitting that the Sekimeiya was no longer there.
entries.new: Atsuki 亲自下楼去看了一趟。没多久他就回来，承认 Sekimeiya 已经不在那儿了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Added to the fact that Naomi hasn't been found, you can't possibly think we did this, right?
entries.new: 再加上 Naomi 至今下落不明，你总不会觉得是我们干的吧？
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: You didn't?
entries.new: 不是你们？
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: There's n-no way. I think Naomi's the first— ...ot only has she managed to remain hidden, but she also might have the same keys that we have.
entries.new: 绝、绝不可能。我想 Naomi 才是头号—— ……她不但一直藏得好好的，手里可能还有和我们一样的钥匙。
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: There are no cameras here, but we don't know if they're recording in the first place... —idn't inspect the whole building because you thought we were in the attic— ...have to be missing something that the culprit is aware of. Could there be a place we're ignoring?
entries.new: 这里没有摄像头，可我们也不清楚它们到底有没有在录像。你没把整栋楼查遍，是因为你以为我们在阁楼。我们一定漏掉了凶手知道的地方——会不会有某个被我们忽略的角落？
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: ...That's impossible.
entries.new: ……不可能。
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: If not, then one of you did this. Naomi's disappearance should be enough proof that we're missing something, though.
entries.new: 若不是这样，那就是你们当中有人下的手。不过，Naomi 的失踪已经足以证明我们漏掉了什么。
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: We have to find her or whoever else is here. It's almost guara— ...since this morning, and we didn't find him. ...more likely than some hidden passage.
entries.new: 我们必须找到她，或者还在这栋楼里的其他人。几乎可以肯定——从早上起，我们就没找到他。这比什么隐藏通道更有可能。
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: If it's neither of those, there's still an answer with the Sekimeiya. This policeman could've come from the future if he touched the Sekimeiya after {time=21}, and Naomi could've left the tower by going far to the past. We found the Seki— ...where it is now.
entries.new: 如果这两样都不是，那还有 Sekimeiya 这个解释。这名警察碰过 Sekimeiya，如果那是在 {time=21} 之后，他可能是从未来来的；而 Naomi 也许穿越到了很远的过去，从而离开了这座塔。我们找到了 Seki—— ……知道它现在在哪里。
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: We'll look everywhere. Not only could people still be hiding, but the Sekimeiya has to be somewhere too. I can't imagine the real person responsible doesn't know where.
entries.new: 每个地方都要搜。不仅可能还有人藏着，Sekimeiya 也一定在某处。我不信真正的凶手会不知道它在哪儿。
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: Go ahead and find Naomi for us.
entries.new: 那就麻烦你去把 Naomi 找出来吧。
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: The hallway A door opened, and they walked down to the far end. I got closer while being careful not to make any noise.
entries.new: A走廊的门开了，他们一路走到走廊尽头。我小心不发出声响，慢慢靠近。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...possible someone's on this floor. Don't move—
entries.new: ……这层楼可能有人。别动——
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: Wait. Are they really gonna search this whole floor?
entries.new: 等等。他们真要把整层都搜一遍？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Oh, what am I even saying!? Of course!
entries.new: 哎呀，我在说什么啊！？当然会啊！
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: My past self is about to leave the storeroom! I came out in the middle of a search.
entries.new: 过去的我马上就要从储藏室出来了！偏偏是在搜查途中出来的。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: As soon as I comprehended my situation, I began to hear doors opening.
entries.new: 我刚弄明白自己的处境，就听见各处响起开门的声音。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What the fuck? They're going to find me!
entries.new: 搞什么啊？他们会找到我的！
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: No. I wouldn't be found. I knew that.
entries.new: 不。我不会被找到的。这一点我很清楚。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I didn't want to be found. The time where everyone would disappear was very close. However, the steps in the hallway unnerved me all the same.
entries.new: 我并不想被找到。所有人消失的时刻已近在眼前。可走廊里的脚步声仍旧让我心神不宁。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There was no way to avoid it. I couldn't hide anywhere.
entries.new: 躲是躲不掉的。我无处可藏。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The Sekimeiya aren't here. I don't know where the future one is, but the past one is in hallway B.
entries.new: Sekimeiya 不在这儿。未来那台在哪我不知道，不过过去那台在B走廊。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: A door opened very close to the room I was hiding in.
entries.new: 离我藏身的房间很近的地方，一扇门开了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I could hear cabinets being opened. Then, footsteps came toward me.{w} The doorknob shook slightly, and the door slowly opened.
entries.new: 我听见展示柜一个接一个打开，接着脚步声朝我这边来了。{w}门把手轻轻一晃，门缓缓开了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I saw my own body stepping in. As he approached one of the cabinets, I knew there was only one thing I could do.
entries.new: 我看见自己的身体走了进来。当他走近其中一个展示柜时，我明白自己只能做一件事。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: This is very imp—
entries.new: 这非常重——
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Wha—
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: He turned around with a startled gasp. His reaction was even more drastic when he saw me.
entries.new: 他吃了一惊，倒吸一口气转过身来。看到我时，他的反应更加激烈。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wh-What!? Who are you!?{w} Are you... me?
entries.new: 什、什么！？你是谁！？{w}你是……我？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: I nodded, although it wasn't the entire truth.
entries.new: 我点了点头，尽管那并不完全是实话。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: This is very important. Stay here until the search is finished.
entries.new: 这件事非常重要。待在这里，等搜查结束。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: He couldn't fathom what he was seeing. However, he had already traveled through time. What was being presented was simply a request that he could take for granted—the way he saw it, there was no reason not to trust what he himself was saying.
entries.new: 他无法理解眼前所见。可他已经亲身经历过时间穿越。眼前这请求，在他看来理所当然——既然话出自他自己之口，就没有理由不信。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: W-Wait, why!? Why are you here!?
entries.new: 等、等等，为什么！？你怎么会在这儿！？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Be quiet! It's so that I'm not found, and just trust me, please.
entries.new: 小声点！这样我才不会被人发现。相信我，拜托了。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: ...{w}He nodded. It was the same thing I would've done.
entries.new: ……{w}他点了点头。换成我也会这么做。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I took a deep breath. Then, hesitantly, I approached the cabinets.
entries.new: 我深吸一口气，随后迟疑地走向展示柜。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I had to look through them so that the noise of looking through rooms continued.
entries.new: 我得继续翻查这些柜子，让搜查房间的动静别停。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Right, the third Sekimeiya's here. I'd forgotten that it was brought here before Erina and Isla came to this room.{w} This is the cabinet where my past self will see it. That means that the person who left this room was the Atsuki from this world.
entries.new: 对了，第三台 Sekimeiya 在这里。我忘了它是在 Erina 和 Isla 来这个房间之前就被搬过来的。{w}过去那个我会看到它的，就是这个柜子。也就是说，离开这个房间的人，是这个世界的 Atsuki。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I acted as if I hadn't found anything. When I was done, I walked to the door before glancing at Atsuki. From the despondent look in his eyes, I could tell that he was in a worse place mentally than I had been during the incident. He... I... looked horrible. Maybe he really was the Atsuki who'd written that note.
entries.new: 我装作什么都没找到。查完后，我走到门口，回头看了 Atsuki 一眼。他眼中那份消沉让我明白，他的精神状态比我经历那起事件时还要糟。他……我……看起来糟透了。也许他真的是写下那张纸条的 Atsuki。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The whole group was in hallway C.
entries.new: 一行人都在C走廊。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: As if nothing had happened, I walked to the security room first.
entries.new: 我若无其事地先走向监控室。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'd been able to camouflage myself in addition to something else.{w} If I hadn't been there, the Sekimeiya would've been found, but I could prevent that.
entries.new: 除了另一件事，我还隐藏了自己的行踪。{w}如果我不在，Sekimeiya 就会被人发现，但我能避免这种情况。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Just so that nothing else would happen, I could avoid "finding" them. It was better if no one used them during the time that remained.
entries.new: 为了不再节外生枝，我可以避开，不去把它们“找出来”。剩下的时间里，最好谁也别用它们。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Stay there! I'll look at the mechanical room again.
entries.new: 待在那儿别动！我再去看看机械室。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: When I stepped into the lobby, I saw Suripo's body on the floor. Blood covered both him and the tiles, evidently caused by the knife wound I'd heard them discussing.
entries.new: 我一走进大厅，就看见 Suripo 倒在地上的尸体。血浸透了他，也染红了地砖——显然就是他们之前议论的那处刀伤造成的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I still couldn't believe it; I hadn't expected that at all. Everyone else was alive, but Suripo's corpse had suddenly appeared in the lobby...
entries.new: 我仍然不敢相信，这完全出乎我的意料。其他人全都还活着，Suripo 的尸体却突然出现在大厅里……
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I didn't like doing it, but I crouched down and verified he was dead. Then, to avoid being suspected, I went to the mechanical room as if I was searching through the floor normally.
entries.new: 我并不想这么做，但还是蹲下身确认他已经死了。随后，为了不惹人怀疑，我照常装作搜查这层楼，走向机械室。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I began with hallway B. Immediately, I found a Sekimeiya in the first room, B1.
entries.new: 我从B走廊开始。第一个房间B1里，我立刻就发现了一台 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I felt the hot air around it. It had been powered on for a while already.
entries.new: 我感觉到它周围的热气。它已经启动好一阵子了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: This is the Future Sekimeiya.{w} When I was in the other crystal room, I heard someone here. After killing Suripo, this is where his killer left the Future Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 这是未来 Sekimeiya。{w}我在另一间水晶展室时，听见这边有人。杀了 Suripo 之后，凶手就把未来 Sekimeiya 留在了这里。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It wasn't until I entered the very last crystal room, B6, that I found the Past Sekimeiya. I had to quickly withdraw my hand. The air surrounding it was even hotter.
entries.new: 直到走进最后一间水晶展室B6，我才找到过去的 Sekimeiya。我不得不赶紧把手缩回来——它周围的热气更烫。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There's nobody here. I didn't find the Sekimeiya or any potential hiding spot we don't know of. If Naomi's here, she's somehow above us.
entries.new: 这里没有人。我没找到 Sekimeiya，也没发现任何我们不知道的藏身之处。如果 Naomi 在这里，那她一定是躲在我们上面的哪一层。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: ...Are you sure you were thorough? Do you know some cabinets have compartments inside? The Sekimeiya could be there.
entries.new: ……你确定都仔细查过了？有些展示柜里面还有暗格，这你知道吗？Sekimeiya 说不定就藏在那里。
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Yes, I looked in all of them.
entries.new: 嗯，每一个我都看过了。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Even the ones with temperature regulation? Did you make sure to close them?
entries.new: 连那些带温控的也查了？都关严了吧？
entries.speaker: k

entries.text: Those too, yeah. It took me a bit to figure out how to open them.
entries.new: 也查了。我还花了一会儿才弄明白怎么打开。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I knew how suspicious what I was saying was. Some people knew the Sekimeiya were in the rooms I'd just investigated, but I didn't care.
entries.new: 我知道自己这番话有多可疑。有人知道我刚刚查过的那些房间里就有 Sekimeiya，可我并不在意。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Before proceeding, I looked at both bathrooms and opened the elevator.
entries.new: 继续之前，我查看了两间洗手间，又把电梯打开。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I'll keep it open so that it can't be used.
entries.new: ……我让它一直开着，这样谁也坐不了。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: All right. Let's go.
entries.new: 好，走吧。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I went up first, as I couldn't bring myself to look into anyone's eyes.
entries.new: 我先一步上了楼，因为我实在不敢去看任何人的眼睛。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Hm, nothing.
entries.new: 嗯，什么也没有。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Wait here.
entries.new: 在这儿等着。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Can I do it instead?
entries.new: 不如让我来？
entries.speaker: m2

entries.text: Huh? Yeah, sure.
entries.new: 咦？嗯，好啊。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Miiya entered the partitions. I'd really just talked to her as if she had never died...
entries.new: Miiya 走进了隔间。我刚才竟然就那么跟她说话，就好像她从未死过一样……
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But I'd been able to see that she was suffering too. The world we were in wasn't yet what it could be.{w} I dug my fingernails into my palm, telling myself that the result would be worth everything.
entries.new: 可我也看得出来，她同样在痛苦。我们所处的世界，还不是它应有的样子。{w} 我把指甲掐进掌心，告诉自己，只要结果如愿，一切就都值得。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I didn't find anything.
entries.new: 什么都没找到。
entries.speaker: m2

entries.text: You looked everywhere, right?
entries.new: 每个角落都看了吧？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Yes, but did the others not come with us?
entries.new: 看了。不过，其他人没跟我们一起来吗？
entries.speaker: m2

entries.text: I think they stayed on the crystal floor and let us go by ourselves.
entries.new: 他们大概留在水晶层了，让我们自己上来。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Really?
entries.new: 真的？
entries.speaker: m2

entries.text: Yes, and we should continue. We have to find something. Be it Naomi or the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 嗯，我们继续吧。总得找到点什么，不管是 Naomi 还是 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Right now, the others have just found the secret area in the storeroom. My past self is already out of there.
entries.new: 此刻，其他人刚刚发现储藏室里的秘密区域。过去的我已经离开那里了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: We went to the third floor, which was empty. Then, quietly, we walked up the stairs again.
entries.new: 我们去了三楼，那里空无一人。随后我们又放轻脚步，走上了楼梯。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: When Miiya came out of the offices, I was about to keep going, but she was looking down at the floor.
entries.new: Miiya 从办公室里出来时，我正要继续往前走，却见她低头看着地面。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Nothing again?
entries.new: 又没有？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: She shook her head.
entries.new: 她摇了摇头。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If she's in the attic, she won't be able to take the elevator down, but this is very strange.
entries.new: 要是她在阁楼，就没法坐电梯下来。可这也太奇怪了。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: We headed to the staircase.
entries.new: 我们走向楼梯间。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Are you all right?
entries.new: ……你没事吧？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: ...Huh?{w} Yes.
entries.speaker: m2

entries.text: You look zoned out. Are you tired?
entries.new: 你有点魂不守舍。累了吗？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: A bit. It's okay.
entries.new: 有一点。不要紧。
entries.speaker: m2

entries.text: All right, but don't push yourself.
entries.new: 好吧，不过别硬撑。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Her mood seemed to have suddenly changed. She appeared a little disoriented, so I decided to look through the fifth floor offices while she stayed outside.
entries.new: 她的情绪似乎突然变了，人也有点恍惚，于是我决定让她留在外面，自己进去查看五楼的办公室。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I don't really expect Naomi to be in these, but it all gets weirder every time we move on. Could a secret place that Katei doesn't know about exist...?{w} There's no way, right? If the answer is somehow a hidden spot, he must've made use of it as well.
entries.new: ……我其实并不指望 Naomi 会藏在这些地方，可我们每往前走一步，事情就越是古怪。会不会有一处连 Katei 都不知道的秘密地点……？{w} 这不可能吧？如果答案真是什么隐蔽的地方，他没道理不利用。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: She didn't reply, opting to continue looking down instead. It made my stomach turn. She was alive, and I was sure she was pushing herself to be strong, but her sudden change had made it evident how hard it was.
entries.new: 她没有回答，只是又低下头去。我心里一阵发紧。她确实还活着，我也知道她一直在强撑，可她刚才那瞬间的变化，还是把这份艰难暴露得一清二楚。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I felt like there was something else buried in her eyes. I didn't know if I was imagining it, but I grimaced and kept moving forward.
entries.new: ……我总觉得她眼底还藏着别的什么。我不知道那是不是自己的错觉，只是绷着脸继续往前走。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...{w}You have the key, right?
entries.new: ……{w}钥匙在你身上吧？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: She nodded and took the keyring out of her purse.
entries.new: 她点点头，从手提包里取出钥匙串。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: No recent footprints...{w} It'll be fine if you stay here. If I don't find anyone, I'm gonna be pretty confused.
entries.new: 最近没有脚印……{w} 你待在这儿就好。要是我一个人都找不到，可就真搞不懂了。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I went through every room. As expected, they were all empty.
entries.new: 我把每个房间都查了一遍。果然，全是空的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...{w}I don't get it. Was Naomi never with us?{w} How is this possible? I know we've already been here for a long time, but that doesn't make it any less confusing. Where the hell is the Sekimeiya, also?
entries.new: ……{w}我搞不懂了。Naomi 难道从来就没跟我们在一起？{w}这怎么可能？我知道我们在这儿已经待了很久，可我还是一样摸不着头脑。还有，Sekimeiya 又到底在哪儿？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Let's just go back down. I hope they trust what we tell them.{w} ...We can't even take the elevator, damn it.
entries.new: 先下去吧。希望他们会相信我们说的话。{w}……该死，连电梯都坐不了。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: She didn't have anything to say. We went all the way back down, but that awkward silence hung around me the entire time.
entries.new: 她一句话也没说。我们一路走回楼下，那股尴尬的沉默却始终缠绕着我。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Where the hell are they?
entries.new: 他们到底在哪儿？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: ...The storeroom?
entries.new: ……储藏室？
entries.speaker: m2

entries.text: Oh. Well, I need to go to the bathroom. I'll be back.
entries.new: 哦。那我去趟洗手间，很快就回来。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I had to leave. The real Atsuki would soon reappear.{w} But it was hard to turn around. Miiya was right there in front of me—a friend who I'd thought I'd never see again, and who I might have been looking at for the very last time.
entries.new: 我必须离开。真正的我很快就会出现。{w} 可要我转身，实在太难了。Miiya 就站在我面前——这个我以为再也见不到的朋友，也许此刻就是最后一面。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: As I walked to the bathroom, I noticed she was going to the storeroom. I stopped myself once she was inside.
entries.new: 我走向洗手间时，看见她正往储藏室去。等她进去后，我停住了脚步。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I approached it, intrigued as to what they were talking about.
entries.new: 我凑近了些，好奇他们在说些什么。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: They'll go to the attic pretty soon. I can listen in without being seen.
entries.new: 他们很快就要去阁楼了。我可以躲着听，不会被发现。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I saw that they were all next to the secret door. I hid inside the crystal room at its left.
entries.new: 我看见他们都聚在暗门旁边，便躲进了左侧的那间水晶展室。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I approached the wall and put my ear against it.
entries.new: 我走近墙边，把耳朵贴了上去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...ut Atsuki had just finished looking through the whole floor.
entries.new: ……可 Atsuki 才刚刚把整层楼找完。
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: Exactly.
entries.new: 正是。
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: I can hear them well enough.
entries.new: 他们说的话，我听得一清二楚。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: What I think is that this door leads outside. The storeroom now stretches farther out than the crystal rooms, and it's a hidden locked door that would explain the policeman's appearance and Naomi's vanishing.
entries.new: 我的判断是，这扇门通向外面。储藏室现在比水晶展室延伸得更靠外，而这扇上锁的暗门正好能解释警察为什么会出现在这里，以及 Naomi 为什么消失不见。
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: W-Wait, really...? If a policeman entered, why did nobody else?
entries.new: 等、等等，真的吗……？既然警察能进来，为什么没有别的人进来？
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: They kept talking about the door. I knew it led outside, but it hadn't opened since that morning.
entries.new: 他们一直在谈论那扇门。我知道它通向外面，可它从那天早上起就再没打开过。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Finally, the other Atsuki returned.
entries.new: 终于，另一个 Atsuki 回来了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What the fuck is this...?
entries.new: 这他妈是什么东西……？
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: There he is. Do you know how to pick a lock?
entries.new: 他来了。你会开锁吗？
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: What? N-No?
entries.new: 什么？不、不会？
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: He was told about the discovery. Sai had noticed the storeroom was open while he was going up the stairs.
entries.new: 有人把这一发现告诉了他。Sai 上楼时注意到储藏室开着。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Did you really not know about this?
entries.new: 你真的不知道这件事？
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: I promise I didn't. I also don't think this door leads outside. There's no way I wouldn't have ever noticed it.
entries.new: 我保证我不知道。我也不认为这扇门通向外面。若真有这回事，我不可能始终没发现。
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: And it makes sense that you didn't know about it if it doesn't lead outside?
entries.new: 那么，如果这扇门不通向外面，你不知道它倒也说得通？
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: ...I'm just speechless. This room is practically unused, but I can't believe this existed.
entries.new: ……我只是无话可说。这个房间几乎没人用过，可我实在难以相信这里会有这种东西。
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: ...{w}Now a few things make sense, at least. As you said, nobody was found, so Naomi must've been here at some point.
entries.new: ……{w}至少现在有几件事说得通了。就像你说的，到处都没找到人影，所以 Naomi 一定来过这里。
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: Yes, yes. I'd like to advise you all on something.
entries.new: 好，好。我想提醒各位一件事。
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: I've made sure that if this door is opened again, I'll be able to tell.
entries.new: 我已经做了安排，这扇门如果再被打开，我就能知道。
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: ...Huh?
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...What? How?
entries.new: ……什么？怎么做到的？
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: I'm not telling you that. One of you could potentially manage to open this, so I'd rather not give you any indication of what I've done.
entries.new: 这我可不会说。你们之中说不定有人能打开这扇门，所以我不想透露自己做了什么。
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: What is this about...?
entries.new: 这到底是怎么回事……？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...I think that's fair. It wouldn't be wise to demand that you tell us.
entries.new: ……我觉得这样很合理。硬要你说出来，并不是明智之举。
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: Just trust me. I will know if the door opens. However, it's possible it won't and that the plan already finished after the Sekimeiya was brought outside.
entries.new: 相信我就好。门一旦打开，我会知道。不过，也可能它不会再开——Sekimeiya 被带到外面之后，计划就已经结束了。
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: Let's go to the attic.
entries.new: 去阁楼吧。
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: ...To the attic? Why?
entries.new: ……去阁楼？为什么？
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: Do you think I'll believe you were walking around for hours and we didn't see you? You either went through this door or were in the attic.
entries.new: 你觉得我会相信你转了几个小时，而我们却一次都没见到你？你要么穿过这扇门出去了，要么就待在阁楼里。
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: He wasn't with us. We know that much.
entries.new: 他没和我们在一起。这点我们很清楚。
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: You've said that before. I know.
entries.new: 你之前就说过了。我知道。
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: How do you intend to know whether I was there? I won't allow anyone in lightly.
entries.new: 你打算怎么确认我有没有去过那里？我不会随随便便让任何人进去。
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: No? Then how come they spent three hours sleeping there?
entries.new: 不行？那他们怎么会在那里睡了三个小时？
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: ...I haven't forgotten about that.
entries.new: ……那件事我没忘。
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: In the off chance Naomi's still in the tower, she's up there, being covered by the three of you. I want to go see it by myself, and I'm sure Akaro and Erina aren't content with your words alone.
entries.new: 万一 Naomi 还在塔里，她就在上面，被你们三个遮掩着。我要亲自去看一眼，而且我相信 Akaro 和 Erina 也不甘心只凭你们一句话。
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: They left the storeroom and the crystal floor.
entries.new: 他们离开了储藏室，离开了水晶层。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The rest happened as I'd already experienced it.
entries.new: 接下来的事，和我已经经历过的一模一样。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I stayed in that room until my past self went up. I'd chosen to hide in one of the second floor bathrooms, an unlikely place to be revisited.
entries.new: 我在那间房里一直待到过去的我上楼。我选了二楼的一间洗手间藏身——那地方不太可能有人再去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I went to hallway B. I knew Sai would be the first one to return and that he'd look through the hallway A rooms.
entries.new: 我去了 B 走廊。我知道 Sai 会第一个回来，也知道他会逐一查看 A 走廊的房间。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It happened even sooner than I recalled. Evidently discontent with my search, he walked from room to room.{w} He didn't care about the third Sekimeiya; he'd been the one to leave it there. When he came to hallway B, I was already in a room in hallway A.
entries.new: 一切来得比我记忆中的更早。他显然对我先前那番搜寻并不满意，一间一间地走了过去。{w}他并不在意第三个 Sekimeiya——把它留在那里的正是他自己。等他来到 B 走廊时，我已经待在 A 走廊的一间房里了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I just had to wait.{w} Sai would find the Future Sekimeiya and bring it to the event room. Then, the others would find the Past Sekimeiya and walk to the event room.
entries.new: 我只需要等着。{w}Sai 会找到 Future Sekimeiya，把它带到活动室。随后，其他人会找到 Past Sekimeiya，走进活动室。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The Future Sekimeiya would be activated in the event room—it was the one that had been gray, and I was far enough from its range. That would leave me alone in the tower with my past self.
entries.new: Future Sekimeiya 会在活动室启动——那正是先前呈灰色的那一个，而我所处的位置离它的覆盖范围足够远。这样一来，塔里就只剩我和过去的我。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Picture Frame
entries.new: 画框

entries.text: I'm sure everything has taken shape in your mind, but I wonder what shape that is.
entries.new: 我想，一切在你脑中都已成形，只是不知那形状如何。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: You remember this world, don't you? In it, many things weren't what they seemed.
entries.new: 你记得这个世界吧？在这里，许多事物都不是表面看上去的样子。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Its real shape is the last key you will need to reach the peak.
entries.new: 它真正的形状，是你抵达顶峰所需的最后一把钥匙。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Two people waited in the lobby. {time=9:00} was approaching.
entries.new: 大厅里有两个人等着。快到 {time=9:00} 了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: At that point, you may have realized something was wrong. Shiroya wasn't there; Miiya was occupying her place.{w} However, her name was spoken before the doors opened.
entries.new: 那时，你或许已经察觉到有什么不对。Shiroya 并不在那里，占据她位置的是 Miiya。{w}然而，在门打开之前，有人叫出了她的名字。
entries.speaker: c
