entries.text: Shiroya...?
entries.new: Shiroya……？
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: "I'd managed to leave my mind empty, but I abruptly turned around when I heard a quiet voice coming from my left. A man was crouching next to me, and when he stood up, I saw his older face underneath white hair."
entries.new: 「我好不容易让脑中一片空白，却忽然听见左侧传来一个低低的声音，猛地转过身去。一个男人蹲在我身旁；他站起来时，我看见白发之下那张更显年长的脸。」
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Katei said Shiroya's name...
entries.new: Katei 念出了 Shiroya 的名字……
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Is this yours? I think you dropped it.
entries.new: 这是你的吗？我想是你掉的。
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: "He showed me a ticket that must've fallen from my purse when I'd stretched my muscles. I nodded and put it back inside, all while unnerved by his stiff motions."
entries.new: 「他给我看了一张票，多半是我活动身体时从包里掉出来的。我点点头，把它放回包里，同时被他僵硬的动作弄得心神不宁。」
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Everyone brought an identification card to verify their own tickets. Of course, the tickets had everyone's names on them. Katei read Shiroya's name and called for her.
entries.new: 每个人都带了身份证件，用来核对自己的票。当然，票上都写着各自的名字。Katei 读到 Shiroya 的名字，便叫了她。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Miiya was there with her own purse, which contained three tickets. When she stretched, one fell out, meaning that her purse hadn't been closed. In world B, when Shiroya opened her purse, she unzipped it—the tickets couldn't have fallen from her purse, as it was closed since long before {time=9.}
entries.new: Miiya 也在场，她的包里装着三张票。她一活动身体，就有一张掉了出来，说明她的包当时没合上。而在 B 世界，Shiroya 打开包时是先拉开拉链的——票不可能从她的包里掉出来，因为那只包早在 {time=9.} 之前就一直合着。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Hopefully, it was enjoyable to catch any of these details. However, although Shiroya's absence could be reasoned out, it wouldn't be surprising if your gut told you something was wrong before that. For everyone who'd gotten trapped in the tower, Shiroya was a girl who had died weeks ago.
entries.new: 希望你在捕捉这些细节时，多少觉得有趣。不过，Shiroya 的缺席固然能靠推理得出，但在那之前，直觉就已经告诉你哪里不对劲，这也不足为奇。对所有被困在塔里的人来说，Shiroya 是个几周前就已经死去的女孩。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: When the group went up the floors, Atsuki found the key for the security room. Everyone splitting up created the chances for individuals to accomplish what they needed.
entries.new: 众人逐层往上时，Atsuki 找到了监控室的钥匙。正因为大家分头行动，各人才有了机会去做自己需要做的事。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The next time they reunited, Sai noticed the sound of keys coming from Katei's pocket. ...They were louder than they'd been before.
entries.new: 众人再次会合时，Sai 注意到 Katei 的口袋里传来钥匙的响声。……那声音比之前更响了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: When Katei was confronted, he showed them a set of keys belonging to Naomi. However, that's when he himself noticed something.
entries.new: 被众人质问时，Katei 拿出一串属于 Naomi 的钥匙。可也就在这时，他自己察觉到了异样。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: There were two identical keyrings in his pocket. That had made the metallic noise even easier to perceive.
entries.new: 他的口袋里有两串一模一样的钥匙。正因如此，金属碰撞的声响才格外清晰。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: At that point, Katei had traveled to the past one time. Upon appearing, he hadn't realized that the keyring Naomi had left behind suddenly appeared in his pocket.{w} Then, when he came across it, he put it inside. In that way, he came into possession of two copies.
entries.new: 那时，Katei 已经穿越到过去一次。他出现时，没有察觉 Naomi 遗落的那串钥匙忽然出现在自己口袋里。{w}后来他偶然摸到它，便把它收了起来。就这样，他手上有了两串。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: When Sai made him reveal it, he didn't know a second one remained in his pocket. That fact was what shaped Katei's actions.
entries.new: 当 Sai 逼他交出来时，他并不知道口袋里还留着一串。正是这一点，决定了 Katei 之后的行动。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: In this world, he insisted the attic should be kept locked, and he made sure the Sekimeiya cabinet would always be. That way, he could unlock them with his secret set, setting up Atsuki and Miiya, who had the other one, as the only possible culprits.
entries.new: 在这个世界里，他坚持阁楼应当上锁，也设法让装着 Sekimeiya 的展示柜始终锁着。这样一来，他就能用自己藏起的那串钥匙打开它们，把持有另一串钥匙的 Atsuki 和 Miiya 变成唯一可能的犯人。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Sai thought of a way to know whether that set was Naomi's: if one of the keys opened the attic, Katei's lie would be exposed.
entries.new: Sai 想出了辨明那串钥匙是否属于 Naomi 的办法：只要其中一把能打开阁楼，Katei 的谎言就会败露。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Before they got there, he decided to test if something else Katei had said was invalid too. On the sixth floor, he attempted to call the elevator, which should've been disabled.{w} They waited, but it never came.
entries.new: 到达那里之前，他决定再验证 Katei 的另一句话是否同样站不住脚。在六楼，他试着呼叫本该被停用的电梯。{w}他们等了许久，电梯始终没有上来。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: However, at that point, the elevator was already working again.
entries.new: 然而那个时候，电梯其实已经恢复运行了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The first time Katei traveled to the past, he walked to the crystal floor. He saw an Atsuki from another world, which later made him question what everyone was saying.
entries.new: Katei 第一次穿越回过去时，走到了水晶层。他看见了来自另一个世界的 Atsuki，这让他后来对众人的说法起了疑心。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Most importantly, he saw people leaving the security room, which had strangely been unlocked. That was his opportunity to shut the computer down. Since he was alone and hadn't told everyone about the cameras' green lights, in this world, he was able to power off the entire security system too as opposed to just one camera.
entries.new: 最重要的是，他看见有人从监控室里出来——那扇门不知为何没有上锁。这正是他关掉电脑的机会。由于他独自一人，也没把摄像头绿灯的事告诉任何人，在这个世界里，他不仅关掉了一台摄像头，还切断了整套监控系统的电源。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Later, when Sai called the elevator, Katei had already enabled it because he had found the attic key. However, it didn't come.
entries.new: 后来 Sai 呼叫电梯时，Katei 因为找到阁楼钥匙，已经重新启用了电梯。可电梯却没有上来。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Katei suddenly froze up; would they notice their mistake?
entries.new: Katei 猛然僵住：他们会察觉到失误吗？
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: ...The elevator was disabled. That's much more unlikely to have gone wrong. If it was working for some reason, the button would light up when it arrived.
entries.new: ……电梯处于停用状态。那种东西出故障的可能性要小得多。要是它不知为何还能运行，到的时候按钮会亮起来。
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: The orange light never appeared—the elevator was already there, and you might recall that was the case in world B as well.
entries.new: 橙色指示灯始终没有亮起——电梯早就在那一层了，你或许还记得，B世界里也是同样的情况。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: And not only that. Atsuki from world B was spying on the group, and when they entered the attic, he was on the sixth floor. He heard the elevator, but only once—when Isla, Erina, Sai, and Akaro took it down. Since it was called from the attic and Atsuki B only heard it once, it was originally on the sixth floor.
entries.new: 不仅如此。B世界的 Atsuki 当时正在暗中监视众人，他们进入阁楼时，他就在六楼。他只听到过一次电梯的声响——那是 Isla、Erina、Sai 和 Akaro 乘电梯下楼的时候。既然电梯是从阁楼呼叫的，而 Atsuki B 只听到一次，说明它起初就在六楼。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Either way, nobody saw through his ruse, and thanks to that, Katei was able to set up a stronger illusion later on.
entries.new: 无论如何，没人识破他的计策，也正因如此，Katei 之后才得以布下更牢固的假象。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: When everyone entered the attic, they saw the strange footprints on the floor. They led to the sofa, where the Future Sekimeiya was.
entries.new: 众人进入阁楼时，看见地板上有奇怪的脚印，一路延伸到沙发——Future Sekimeiya 就放在那里。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Most people believed the Sekimeiya should've been on the crystal floor. If that was the case, someone had to have brought it up very recently, but it didn't seem possible for them to have left the attic.
entries.new: 大多数人认为 Sekimeiya 本该在水晶层。若真是如此，就一定是有人刚刚把它搬了上来，可那人似乎不可能从阁楼脱身。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: That made Sai call the elevator, and it actually did arrive.
entries.new: 于是 Sai 呼叫了电梯，而这一回它真的来了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: That was the feint Katei aimed for—that the elevator had just been enabled. That someone had been in the security room after they'd all stepped into the attic.
entries.new: 这正是 Katei 想要的误导——让人以为电梯刚刚才被启用，以为在众人踏入阁楼之后，有人去过监控室。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Following that, when everyone saw that the computer had lost power, what he said was reinforced; it must have happened after they had tried to call the elevator on the sixth floor.
entries.new: 紧接着，众人发现电脑断了电，他的话就更显得可信——那一定发生在他们在六楼呼叫电梯之后。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: At the same time, the Sekimeiya had disappeared from the cabinet. From their perspective, it had been brought to the attic.{w} However, Sai knew the truth. Just like in worlds A and B, he had quickly hidden the fake Sekimeiya when everyone had split up, so the one they'd retrieved from the attic was different.
entries.new: 与此同时，展示柜里的 Sekimeiya 不见了。大家以为它被搬到了阁楼。{w}可 Sai 知道真相。和在 A世界、B世界一样，他在众人分头行动时迅速藏起了赝品 Sekimeiya，所以他们从阁楼取回的那一件，已经换成了别的东西。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: That was when everyone else learned about time travel. Right before their eyes, Katei went to the future.
entries.new: 就在这时，其他人第一次得知了时间穿越。Katei 就在他们眼前去了未来。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Atsuki reeled. He had to learn more about the Sekimeiya. He stayed close to it, and when the crystal floor had been inspected, he touched it.
entries.new: Atsuki 内心震动。他必须弄清 Sekimeiya 的底细。他寸步不离地守在旁边，趁水晶层接受检查时，伸手碰了它。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He went minutes to the future, but he wasn't alone. Sai had specifically gone to find the fake Sekimeiya he'd hidden, wondering whether it was still there, as well as whether it shared the same powers he'd witnessed. As he was returning to the event room from hallway B, he traveled with Atsuki.
entries.new: 他去了几分钟后的未来，但他并非独自一人。Sai 特意去找自己藏起来的赝品 Sekimeiya，想确认它是否还在原处，又是否拥有他亲眼见过的那种力量。就在他从 B走廊返回活动室时，他和 Atsuki 一起穿越了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Atsuki appeared in the attic, which was locked. The elevator had been left open on the crystal floor, so he couldn't leave through it either.{w} However, Sai appeared on the crystal floor since his group had left the attic earlier. He realized the elevator was open and allowed Atsuki to leave.
entries.new: Atsuki 出现在上了锁的阁楼里。电梯停在水晶层且门开着，所以他也无法借电梯离开。{w}而 Sai 则出现在水晶层，因为他的同伴们早些时候已经离开了阁楼。他发现电梯是开着的，便让 Atsuki 得以脱身。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: When they met, they thought they'd gone minutes to the past, although neither of them spoke about it. Atsuki recalled Sai had gone missing, so finding him in the past wasn't strange.{w} His misinterpretation arose due to Sai's watch, which had ended up minutes behind. When they returned to the others, they saw that everyone was in the security room.
entries.new: 两人相遇时，都以为自己回到了几分钟前，尽管谁也没有说出口。Atsuki 记得 Sai 曾经失踪，所以在过去遇见他并不奇怪。{w}他之所以判断错误，是因为 Sai 的手表慢了整整几分钟。等他们回到其他人身边，才发现众人都在监控室里。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: "As we turned around, we saw Sai staring at us next to the unassertive Atsuki."
entries.new: 「我们回过头，就看见 Sai 站在畏畏缩缩的 Atsuki 身旁，注视着我们。」
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Wh-Where were you!?
entries.new: 你、你到底去哪儿了！？
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: Me? I just took a detour to the bathroom.
entries.new: 我？只是绕路去了趟洗手间。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: Sai wasn't exactly aware of how blatant his lie was. According to his watch, he should've been missing for very little time, but it had been much longer than he thought since he'd vanished. He didn't reveal what had happened to him, and because of that, he was the only person aware of the Sekimeiya's range.
entries.new: Sai 并未意识到自己这谎撒得有多拙劣。按他的手表，他失踪的时间本该很短，可他消失之后实际过去的时间远比他想的长。他没有说出自己的遭遇，也正因如此，他是唯一知道 Sekimeiya 作用范围的人。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Hours later, Suripo's dead body suddenly appeared. There's one last thing to settle.
entries.new: 几小时之后，Suripo 的尸体突然出现。还有最后一件事需要理清。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Naomi still hadn't been found, and it seemed like nobody else could've committed the crime without having traveled through time. That belief led to a whole search with no result.
entries.new: Naomi 依旧下落不明，而如果不考虑时间穿越，似乎再没有别人能犯下那桩案子。抱着这样的想法，众人搜遍了各处，却一无所获。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Something very important was found, though: the storeroom's secret corridor.
entries.new: 不过，他们找到了一样极其重要的东西——储藏室的秘密通道。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Upon its discovery, you likely noticed that someone's actions differed from world B's.
entries.new: 在它被发现之后，你大概已经注意到，某人的举动与在 B 世界时不同。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: In world C, Sai did something to know whether the door was opened from that point on. That did not happen in world B.
entries.new: 在 C 世界，Sai 做了些布置，好知道那扇门此后有没有被打开过。这件事在 B 世界并没有发生。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The reason was the piece of duct tape they'd all seen. It had reminded Sai of his favorite novel, which made him think of setting up a check on that door.
entries.new: 原因就是众人都见过的那截胶带。它让 Sai 想起了自己最爱的小说，于是动了给那扇门做记号的念头。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: After that, everyone ended up in the attic, where they hoped they could calmly spend the rest of their isolation in the bedrooms.
entries.new: 之后，众人回到了阁楼，希望能在卧室里安然度过剩下的隔离日子。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Of course, that wouldn't happen. It was Sai who soon tried to go back down unnoticed.
entries.new: 当然，事情没能如愿。很快，Sai 就试图不声不响地下楼。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: What if Atsuki and Miiya hadn't alerted everyone to his departure?
entries.new: 如果 Atsuki 和 Miiya 没有把他离开的事告诉众人，又会怎样？
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: "Shiroya and Atsuki stayed in the attic. Sai had gone to the crystal floor, but they didn't follow him down."
entries.new: 「Shiroya 和 Atsuki 留在阁楼。Sai 去了水晶层，但他们没有跟下去。」
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: "Shiroya let out a sigh."
entries.new: 「Shiroya 叹了口气。」
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: "They had no strength left, so they kept resting, trying to ignore what was happening around them."
entries.new: 「他们已经没有力气，只能继续休息，尽量不去理会周围发生的事。」
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Indeed, your choice made Miiya become Shiroya.{w} The world changed drastically. The butterfly effect amplifies even a single unwitting change.
entries.new: 的确，正是你的选择让 Miiya 变成了 Shiroya。{w} 世界因此发生了剧变。蝴蝶效应会把哪怕一处无心造成的改变无限放大。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: In that world, Miiya couldn't have been saved. However, you wanted to know what would've happened if Sai was let loose. That caused Miiya to be replaced by Shiroya.
entries.new: 在那个世界里，Miiya 本来无法得救。可你想知道，若放任 Sai 自由行动，事情会变成什么样。于是 Miiya 被 Shiroya 取代了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: That was one of numerous changes, alongside...
entries.new: 那不过是众多变化之一，此外还有……
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: "Six pairs of eyes saw the identical scene."{w} Exactly, it was Katei's absence. The storeroom's door hadn't been locked, so he'd been able to leave before everyone awakened. In that world, nobody had told the group about keeping the Sekimeiya cold.
entries.new: 「六双眼睛看到了完全相同的一幕。」{w} 没错，问题就出在 Katei 不在场。储藏室的门没有上锁，他才能在众人醒来前离开。那个世界里，没有人告诉过众人要让 Sekimeiya 保持低温。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: "Six pairs of eyes saw the identical scene."{w} It was Katei's absence. The storeroom's door hadn't been locked, so he'd been able to leave before everyone awakened. In that world, nobody had told the group about keeping the Sekimeiya cold.
entries.new: 「六双眼睛看到了完全相同的一幕。」{w} 问题正是 Katei 不在场。储藏室的门没有上锁，他才能在众人醒来前离开。那个世界里，没有人告诉过众人要让 Sekimeiya 保持低温。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Sai roamed free for a long time, and on the crystal floor, he had access to both Sekimeiya. With his watch, he was able to figure out the basic mechanics behind traveling to the past and future.
entries.new: Sai 长时间自由行动，在水晶层上，他能接触到两件 Sekimeiya。借助手表，他弄清了前往过去与未来的基本机制。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: That's how he came up with a plan to remain with the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 他因此想出了一条能继续留在 Sekimeiya 身边的计策。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: What did he do? When he came back up, he showed everyone what the Sekimeiya were capable of. Right now, you understand them a lot more than at that time.
entries.new: 他做了什么？重新回到上层后，他向大家展示了 Sekimeiya 的能力。比起那时候，你如今对它们的了解已经深了许多。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: ...However, you might still have trouble figuring out what Sai did. He had to pull out something fairly clever to trick everyone.
entries.new: ……不过，你或许还是弄不清 Sai 做了什么。他为了骗过所有人，当时不得不用上相当高明的手段。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: If you ever want to go back and attempt to see through his scenario, I hope you're able to beat him.
entries.new: 如果你日后想回去试着识破他的布局，希望你能赢过他。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: In reality, Atsuki and Miiya brought everyone to the crystal floor in an attempt to find Sai. Before he was seen, the Past Sekimeiya was found in room B6.{w} Sai was in the event room, and he suddenly heard people approaching. Hoping it would let him escape, he touched the Future Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 实际上，Atsuki 和 Miiya 为了寻找 Sai，把大家带到了水晶层。还没等人看见他，Past Sekimeiya 就在水晶展室 B6 被发现了。{w} 当时 Sai 正在活动室，忽然听见有人靠近。他指望借此脱身，便碰了 Future Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Atsuki and Miiya brought everyone to the crystal floor in an attempt to find him. Before he was seen, the Past Sekimeiya was found in room B6.{w} Sai was in the event room, and he suddenly heard people approaching. Hoping it would let him escape, he touched the Future Sekimeiya.
entries.new: Atsuki 和 Miiya 为了找他，把大家带到了水晶层。还没等人看见他，Past Sekimeiya 就在水晶展室 B6 被发现了。{w} Sai 当时在活动室，忽然听见有人靠近。他指望借此脱身，便碰了 Future Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Y—! You scared the fuck out of me!{w} Holy shit! What the fuck are you doing!? You almost hit me with the door!
entries.new: 哇——！吓死我了！{w} 搞什么啊！你到底在干什么！？门差点砸到我身上！
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: He thought he was safe as soon as he touched it, but the door still burst open.
entries.new: 他本以为一碰到那东西就安全了，门却还是猛地被撞开。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Don't you think that's a better question for you? What are you doing!?
entries.new: 这话不是该我问你吗？你在干什么！？
entries.speaker: aknn

entries.text: I'm doing absolutely nothing.
entries.new: 我什么都没干。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: "We turned to Katei, who hadn't interrupted us. He was perplexed, staring at his empty hands."
entries.new: 「我们转头看向 Katei。他刚才没有插话，此刻正困惑地盯着自己空空的双手。」
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: What's up with you?
entries.new: 你怎么了？
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: ...Where's the Sekimeiya?
entries.new: ……Sekimeiya 呢？
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: What? I have no—
entries.new: 什么？我根本没——
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: I-It disappeared. I legitimately felt it disappear.
entries.new: 它、它消失了。我真的感觉到它消失了。
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: Excuse me?
entries.new: 你说什么？
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: Both had disappeared, as a world switch had been triggered. Oblivious, they found themselves in world A.
entries.new: 两件 Sekimeiya 都消失了，因为触发了世界切换。他们浑然不觉，已经身处 A 世界。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: "Sai spun and looked at the cabinet covered by the curtain. Then, he looked all around the room with a slight frown."
entries.new: 「Sai 转过身，看向被遮布罩住的展示柜。随后，他微微皱眉，环视了一圈房间。」
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: "I was also moderately puzzled. Katei couldn't have been lying. He didn't have the Sekimeiya, it wasn't on the floor, and he couldn't have hidden it anywhere without us seeing it."
entries.new: 「我也有些困惑。Katei 不可能在撒谎。Sekimeiya 不在他手上，也不在地上；他更不可能当着我们的面把它藏到别处。」
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Out of nowhere, the cabinet was covered by its curtain. However, that was nothing compared to what awaited in hallway C.
entries.new: 不知何时，展示柜又被遮布罩住了。然而，与 C 走廊里等着他们的景象相比，这根本不算什么。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The panel to call the elevator was gone.{w} ...All of them were. They had been ripped off on every floor.
entries.new: 呼叫电梯的面板不见了。{w} ……每一层都是如此。所有面板都被拆掉了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Wait, we didn't lock it, did we?
entries.new: 等等，我们没锁门吧？
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: What?
entries.new: 什么？
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: You're right... I forgot to tell you to lock it because I was annoyed that Sai left.
entries.new: 说得对……我因为 Sai 走了而心烦，忘了提醒你们锁门。
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: Whoa, then someone's definitely in here. Is it time to have a talk with Naomi? I wonder if she knows we can enter.
entries.new: 这么说，里面肯定有人。是不是该和 Naomi 谈谈了？不知道她知不知道我们能进来。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: In the living room, their footprints had disappeared.
entries.new: 客厅里，他们的脚印已经消失了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: And Katei was the lucky person who found the Future Sekimeiya in the open refrigerator. ...Opening it had been the last thing Sai A would ever do.
entries.new: 而 Katei 就是那个幸运儿，在敞开的冰箱里发现了 Future Sekimeiya。……打开冰箱，成了 Sai A 此生做的最后一件事。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Atsuki wanted to look at the BIOS's time, but the security room was locked. In addition, Sai realized the mark he'd left in the storeroom was gone. ...He was convinced someone had opened it, so he marked it again.
entries.new: Atsuki 想查看 BIOS 的时间，但监控室锁着。另外，Sai 发现自己留在储藏室里的记号不见了。……他认定有人打开过那里，于是又做了一次标记。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Of course, that was far from the truth, but it made them believe that someone else had entered the tower.
entries.new: 当然，事实远非如此，但这让他们相信，确实有别人进过塔里。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The next time they attempted to enter the attic, it was locked again.
entries.new: 下一次他们想进阁楼时，门又锁上了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: "We all stared at the door in shock. It was locked."
entries.new: 「我们全都震惊地盯着那扇门。门锁着。」
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Someone else is certainly in this building. I left the attic just now.
entries.new: 这栋楼里肯定还有别人。我刚从阁楼出来。
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: The truth behind that was the secret keyring Katei still had. Long before he'd traveled to the future, he'd left it in the security room so that he couldn't be found with it. He'd been able to retrieve it when he'd appeared there.
entries.new: 真相在于 Katei 还带着那串秘密钥匙。早在他穿越到未来之前，就把钥匙留在了监控室，免得有人发现钥匙在他身上。后来他出现在监控室时，才把钥匙取了回来。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He'd left the key inserted in the door because he knew what had happened with the elevator: it was in the attic despite the panel having vanished.{w} Inside, he'd found that world's attic key. He could keep everyone from entering the highest floor by locking the door in.{w} He left it by bringing the elevator to the sixth floor; he could keep it there as a hidden way up. Since he had his set of keys, he could always access the attic through the elevator he'd prepared.
entries.new: 他把钥匙插在门上没有拔走，因为他知道电梯出了什么状况：面板明明已经消失，电梯却仍停在阁楼。{w} 在阁楼里，他找到了那个世界的阁楼钥匙。只要把门反锁，就能让众人无法进入顶层。{w} 他离开时把电梯叫到六楼停住，留作一条隐藏的上楼通道。由于他带着自己的那串钥匙，他随时都能通过准备好的电梯进入阁楼。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: But... it was found when Atsuki attempted to open it.{w} Inside, there were the bodies of Naomi C and Shiroya A.
entries.new: 可是……Atsuki 试着打开它时，它还是被发现了。{w} 里面躺着 Naomi C 和 Shiroya A 的尸体。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The shock was natural. Naomi hadn't been seen for hours, and Shiroya had supposedly died weeks ago. It was undeniable that her existence was related to Atsuki and Miiya.
entries.new: 他们如此震惊也很自然。Naomi 已经好几个小时不见踪影，而 Shiroya 据说几周前就死了。她的存在与 Atsuki 和 Miiya 有关，这一点无可否认。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: But nobody knew what had happened to the two women, and all they could do was bring them to the lobby.
entries.new: 但没人知道这两名女子遭遇了什么，他们能做的只有把她们搬到大厅。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: With the elevator, the group was able to reach the attic again, where they found the single key in its inner keyhole.
entries.new: 借助电梯，众人再次来到阁楼，在里侧锁孔里发现了那把唯一的钥匙。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: ...Over thirty minutes later, a new dead body was found near the hallway C stairs.
entries.new: ……三十多分钟后，C走廊的楼梯附近又发现了一具尸体。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: It was Erina A's.
entries.new: 那是 Erina A 的尸体。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Erina C, who they'd been with, was in room A1 with Isla. Meanwhile, the world A group was waiting in room B4. After Sai, Erina had been the second person to leave.
entries.new: 和他们在一起的 Erina C，此刻正与 Isla 待在水晶展室 A1。与此同时，A世界的一行人正在水晶展室 B4 等候。Sai 之后，第二个离开的人便是 Erina。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: "Don't lie! It can only be you. You killed them."
entries.new: 「别撒谎！只可能是你。是你杀了她们。」
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Everyone saw Erina's body atop a pool of blood. Someone had just killed her, and Atsuki had heard her words before dying. ...She had confronted who she'd thought was the killer.{w} However, it quickly became clear that nobody could've easily committed the crime. Everyone stated what they'd been doing.
entries.new: 所有人都看见了躺在血泊中的 Erina 的尸体。她才刚被人杀害，Atsuki 听到了她临死前的话。……她曾当面质问那个她认定的凶手。{w} 然而，很快就查清，没有人能轻易犯下这桩罪行。众人也纷纷说出了自己当时在做什么。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Atsuki said that after being the first to leave the attic, he'd spent a few minutes on the second floor. He said that at one point, he heard the elevator once.{w} Miiya said that she'd left second and remained on the third floor until Atsuki ran up from below, letting her know what had happened.{w} Sai and Katei claimed to have been above them, and their versions of events seemed to confirm each other.{w} Akaro claimed to have left the attic last when Erina and Isla had still been sitting on the sofa, and that afterward, he'd stayed on the sixth floor alone.
entries.new: Atsuki 说，他最先离开阁楼，之后在二楼待了几分钟。他说中间有一刻听到过电梯的动静。{w}Miiya 说自己是第二个离开的，一直待在三楼，直到 Atsuki 从楼下跑上来，告诉她出了事。{w}Sai 和 Katei 声称当时他们在上面，两人的说法似乎互相印证。{w}Akaro 说自己是最后离开阁楼的，那时 Erina 和 Isla 还坐在沙发上，之后他便独自留在六楼。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The elevator was on the crystal floor. Since the panels hadn't been reattached, the "1" button must've been pressed from the attic.{w} It seemed like nobody could've performed a murder simply. The only way to get to the crystal floor after Atsuki's departure would've been by riding in the elevator with Erina and Isla. However, if that had happened, they couldn't have ended up above Atsuki when he'd gone to find everyone; nobody had seen them walking up, and the elevator hadn't been heard again.
entries.new: 电梯停在水晶层。既然面板还没装回去，那个「1」按钮只能是从阁楼按的。{w}看来没人能轻而易举地完成这场谋杀。Atsuki 离开之后，想上水晶层，唯一的办法就是和 Erina、Isla 一同乘电梯。可若是那样，等 Atsuki 去找大家时，他们就不可能出现在他上方——没人看见他们走上去，电梯也没有再响过。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: There were three main options in everyone's minds, and one was correct.
entries.new: 每个人心里都有三个主要可能，其中只有一个是对的。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Atsuki hadn't been lying; everything he said was the truth.
entries.new: Atsuki 没有撒谎，他说的每句话都是真的。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: People they didn't know about were present in the building—the world A group. However, none of them had left room B4.
entries.new: 楼里还有他们不知道的人——A世界的那群人。可那些人谁也没有离开过 B4 展室。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The answer had to be the Sekimeiya. Someone would travel through time and kill Erina.
entries.new: 答案只能是 Sekimeiya。有人会穿越时间，杀死 Erina。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: For them, that seemed like a fickle solution; there was no way to prove it. If that was the case, unless the culprit had already escaped, they had to search for them.
entries.new: 他们觉得这答案虚无缥缈，也无从证实。若果真如此，除非凶手早已逃出去，否则就只能去找。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: However, for you, that solution might seem odd.
entries.new: 不过，你可能会觉得这个答案很奇怪。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: You know what happened in that world. The Past Sekimeiya was in room B4 with the world A group.{w} It was in the cabinet where Akaro had put it, and it wasn't activated until he and Isla world switched to world B.
entries.new: 你知道那个世界发生了什么。Past Sekimeiya 和 A世界的人一起留在 B4 展室。{w}它就在 Akaro 放进去的那个展示柜里，直到他和 Isla 世界切换到 B世界，它才被启动。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: After that, what happened to it? Shiroya B found it and was able to world switch to world B. Later on, Sai B found it was well and world switched back to world B.{w} Lastly, Atsuki A found it and also world switched to world B.
entries.new: 那之后它又怎样了？Shiroya B 找到了它，得以世界切换到 B世界。后来，Sai B 也找到了它，再次世界切换回 B世界。{w}最后，Atsuki A 找到它，同样世界切换到了 B世界。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: That was it. The Past Sekimeiya from world A wasn't activated ever again.
entries.new: 到此为止。A世界的 Past Sekimeiya 再也没有被启动过。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: So then, who killed Erina? How did her killer show up before her and push her off the stairs?
entries.new: 那么，究竟是谁杀了 Erina？凶手又是怎样出现在她面前，把她推下楼梯的？
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Her killer couldn't have world switched before her. After all, they would've had to appear from world C, where Atsuki was experimenting with the Sekimeiya in the attic.
entries.new: 凶手不可能在她之前切换世界。毕竟，那样一来他们只能来自 C世界——那里 Atsuki 正在阁楼里试验 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The Past Sekimeiya couldn't have been used to carry out her murder. The key to solving it was the Future Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 这场谋杀不可能借助 Past Sekimeiya 完成。解谜的关键在于 Future Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: It was the one that Katei had found in the kitchen refrigerator. He hid it somewhere in the attic, which he locked, intending to keep it away from the others.
entries.new: 那正是 Katei 在厨房冰箱里找到的那一台。他把它藏在阁楼某处，并锁上阁楼，想让它远离其他人。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Before the world C group arrived in world A, only one person had touched the Future Sekimeiya: Sai A. However, he immediately died where he arrived. In other words, nobody from world A could've killed Erina.
entries.new: 在 C世界的人抵达 A世界之前，只有一个人碰过 Future Sekimeiya：Sai A。可他一到就死了。换言之，A世界的人不可能杀死 Erina。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Before her death, the world C group had been on the crystal floor; anyone who traveled to the future could've appeared there, bypassing Atsuki's view.
entries.new: 她死之前，C世界的人都待在水晶层；任何穿越到未来的人都能出现在那里，避开 Atsuki 的视线。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: But that wouldn't have been all. After appearing there, they would've had to make it above him, and such a thing didn't seem simple. No Sekimeiya could've been activated on the crystal floor, and the elevator never went back up.
entries.new: 但事情不止如此。出现在那里之后，他们还得绕到他上方，而这绝非易事。水晶层上不可能启动任何 Sekimeiya，电梯也再没上去过。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: People were leaving, and Isla said she wanted to come down too since she still hadn't seen all the gems. I noticed she was trying to cheer herself up a little despite the... two bodies we found, so even though I didn't want to leave, I went with her just so that it took her mind off it.
entries.new: 大家陆续离开了，Isla 说她也想下楼，因为她还没把宝石看完。我看出她是在强打精神——毕竟我们发现了……两具尸体。所以尽管我并不想走，还是陪她一起下去，好让她分散些心思。
entries.speaker: akinn

entries.text: "People were leaving". Erina and Isla were on the sofa then, and from their point of view, not everyone had left the attic.
entries.new: 「大家陆续离开了」——那时 Erina 和 Isla 正坐在沙发上，从她们的位置看，并不是所有人都离开了阁楼。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: There's only one person who could've done it.
entries.new: 能做到这件事的，只有一个人。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: "I walked to the bedrooms and opened the left one. I needed to throw myself onto the bed and be alone for some time."
entries.new: 「我走到几间卧室前，打开了左边那间。我需要扑到床上，独自待上一阵。」
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: "I stood in the middle of the floor 3 corridor. I didn't want to see the others, so I'd been thinking to myself."
entries.new: 「我站在三楼走廊中央。我不想见到其他人，就一直独自想着心事。」
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: "As anyone could've been anywhere, all I wanted was to wait. I could perceive faint footsteps above me, signaling someone was on the fourth floor. I approached a potted plant and sat next to it. I calmly felt the seconds pass, appreciating the sensation."
entries.new: 「谁都可能在任意位置，我只想等着。我能隐约听到头顶的脚步声，说明有人在四楼。我走到一盆绿植旁，在它旁边坐下。我平静地感受着时间一秒秒流逝，也享受这种感觉。」
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: A-Are you alone...!? Where are the others?
entries.new: 你、你一个人……！？其他人呢？
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: "He was pretty agitated, so I kept my composure and waited for him to tell me what had occurred. Everything about him gave away that he'd seen something frightful."
entries.new: 「他相当激动，我便保持镇定，等他说出发生了什么。他整个人都透露出他看到了什么可怕的东西。」
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: "Erina's body lay facing down over a vast pool of blood, traces of which started in the middle of the staircase. I didn't have to walk farther down to know she was dead."
entries.new: 「Erina 的尸体俯卧在一大片血泊中，血迹从楼梯中段一路延伸过来。无需再往下走，我也知道她已经死了。」
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: I-I think someone was on the floor above me at some point. Were you alone when you found her?
entries.new: 我、我好像有段时间感觉楼上有动静。你发现她的时候是一个人吗？
entries.speaker: mnn

entries.text: "I kept walking down while I silently wondered why he'd been alone. On the floor of hallway C, I pressed two fingers to Erina's body and waited for any perceptible movement."
entries.new: 「我继续往下走，心里默默想着他为何独自一人。在 C走廊的地面上，我伸出两根手指搭在 Erina 身上，等着感受她还有没有动静。」
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: It's not possible for us to take the elevator, so let's walk up. We should come across someone.
entries.new: 电梯是坐不成了，我们走上去吧。总会碰上人的。
entries.speaker: mnn

entries.text: "My heavy breathing was interrupting my words, and I didn't let my gaze stray from Erina. Being so close to her, I noticed that blood was coming out of the part of her head that hit the edge of a step."
entries.new: 我喘得厉害，话都说不连贯，视线却始终没离开 Erina。靠得这样近，我才发现她头上撞到台阶边沿的地方还在渗血。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: "With what we'd talked about, could Erina's killer be identified? I didn't think so, but there was a chance I was failing to consider something."
entries.new: 凭我们刚才说的这些，能找出杀害 Erina 的凶手吗？我觉得不能，但也许有什么是我没想到的。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: "She was there, casually leaning against the line of cabinets. I could hardly believe what I was seeing, but there was no wariness in her eyes and not even a trace of blood near her."
entries.new: 她就在那里，随意地靠在一排展示柜上。我几乎不敢相信自己的眼睛，可她眼里没有一丝警惕，她附近也看不到半点血迹。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Most people weren't aware that traveling to the future was possible. When Miiya noticed the peculiar smell again and touched the Sekimeiya, she immediately thought she'd traveled to the past.
entries.new: 大多数人并不知道穿越到未来是可能的。当 Miiya 再次闻到那股异样的气味、碰到 Sekimeiya 时，她立刻以为自己回到了过去。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: She appeared where she'd been in the past; it was what had happened before. That made her think she'd gone back in time.
entries.new: 她出现在自己过去待过的地方；眼前正是曾经发生过的事。这让她以为自己回到了过去。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: She was alone above the hallway C stairs when she suddenly heard Erina's voice.
entries.new: 她独自待在 C走廊楼梯上方，忽然听到了 Erina 的声音。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: "Don't lie! It can only be you. You killed them."
entries.new: 「别撒谎！只可能是你。是你杀了她们。」
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Erina had seen the bodies in the lobby. Shiroya had died, but she'd just been in the crystal room. Sai hadn't come back.{w} ...Naomi was dead, and earlier in the day, what had happened with the elevator buttons convinced Erina that the killer was someone they'd been unable to find.
entries.new: Erina 见过大厅里的尸体。Shiroya 死了，可她刚刚还在水晶展室；Sai 没有回来。{w}……Naomi 也死了。而那天早些时候，电梯按钮的事让 Erina 认定，凶手是一个他们始终找不到的人。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: ...Miiya.
entries.new: ……Miiya。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The way Miiya looked at her only made her more convinced. When she dismissed the accusation with quiet, cold words, Erina ran up the stairs in sheer agitation.
entries.new: Miiya 看她的眼神只是让她更加确信。当 Miiya 用平静而冰冷的话否定了指控，Erina 一时激愤，冲上了楼梯。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: She was quickly knocked back. In midair, she let out a yell that cut off upon impact.
entries.new: 她当即被撞了回来。她在半空中喊了一声，撞上时戛然而止。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Miiya wasn't sure what to do. She stared at Erina, processing the fact that she wasn't moving. Then, slowly, she took a few steps backward.
entries.new: Miiya 一时不知如何是好。她盯着 Erina，慢慢明白过来她一动不动，随后缓缓退后了几步。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Shock rushed through her when she heard footsteps approaching. Atsuki was about to see her.
entries.new: 听到脚步声逼近，她浑身一震。Atsuki 就要看到她了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: To hide from him, she rushed into one of the bathrooms on the second floor.
entries.new: 为了躲开他，她冲进了二楼的一间洗手间。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The first thing Atsuki did was run down the stairs and check Erina's pulse, which allowed Miiya to escape toward the third floor.
entries.new: Atsuki 先是跑下楼梯去探 Erina 的脉搏，Miiya 便趁机逃向三楼。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: There, she heard someone above her. She'd looked at the security cameras and seen no green lights, which perhaps meant that she hadn't been recorded.
entries.new: 在那里，她听见上方有人。她曾看过监控摄像头，没见到绿灯亮起，这或许意味着她没有被拍下。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Nonetheless, she was completely certain that she'd changed the past.
entries.new: 即便如此，她十分确信，自己改变了过去。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: However, after Atsuki came running from below, she soon realized that she couldn't easily explain what had happened.
entries.new: 然而，Atsuki 从楼下跑上来之后，她很快意识到，发生的事根本无法轻易解释清楚。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: It's not possible for us to take the elevator, so let's walk up. We should come across someone.
entries.new: 电梯是坐不成了，我们走上去吧。总会碰上人的。
entries.speaker: mnn

entries.text: She attempted to hide her future knowledge. At that point in time, the elevator hadn't been opened yet; nobody knew it was usable despite the broken panels.{w} And despite the fact that they should have been together recently, Atsuki had told her he'd been alone. ...Did that mean that she'd overwritten her past self?
entries.new: 她想隐瞒自己知道未来的事。那时电梯还没有被人打开过；面板虽已破损，却没人知道它还能用。{w} 而她明明不久前应该和 Atsuki 待在一起，Atsuki 却告诉她，自己一直独自一人。……这是不是意味着，她覆盖了过去的自己？
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: "I saw that the attic key was inserted into the door. We all entered to find the missing person."
entries.new: 「我看见阁楼的钥匙已经插在门上。我们一起进去找失踪的那个人。」
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: "I stared at the floor's footprints—the proof that the past had changed. I had no idea how, but it was undeniable that it greatly had."
entries.new: 我盯着地板上的脚印——那是过去被改写的证据。我不知道是怎么做到的，但无可否认，过去已经大不一样了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: ...Should I bring her to the lobby?
entries.new: ……要我把她带到大厅去吗？
entries.speaker: aknn

entries.text: To the lobby? Why?
entries.new: 带到大厅？为什么？
entries.speaker: mnn

entries.text: So she's with the others. Sorry, that was stupid of me. This time, this is actually where she died.
entries.new: 这样她就能和其他人在一起了。抱歉，是我糊涂了。这次，她确实是死在这里的。
entries.speaker: aknn

entries.text: "I went quiet. I'd begun to form a small theory, but it appeared I was wrong. After that, I realized I had no idea what had actually happened."
entries.new: 「我沉默了。我本已隐约想到一种可能，看来是我猜错了。随后我才意识到，自己根本不清楚究竟发生了什么。」
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: When everyone saw Erina's corpse and began to explain what they'd done, Miiya realized her perception was flawed.
entries.new: 当众人看到 Erina 的尸体、开始说明各自的行动时，Miiya 意识到自己的认知有误。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Had she only traveled a few seconds through time? She wasn't sure.
entries.new: 难道她只穿越了几秒钟的时间？她并不确定。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: When it was her turn to clear her name, she said she'd left the attic after Atsuki and that she'd stayed on the third floor.
entries.new: 轮到她自证清白时，她说自己是在 Atsuki 之后离开阁楼，然后一直待在三楼。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: ...Did Atsuki notice that contradiction?
entries.new: ……Atsuki 察觉到那处矛盾了吗？
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: I just wanted to be alone for a bit, but I didn't feel like staying put somewhere. However, I ended up spending the most time on the third floor, where I heard the elevator. I spent some time in the offices and some outside.
entries.new: 我只是想一个人待一会儿，却又不愿意老是停在同一个地方。结果，我在三楼待的时间最长，也是在那一层听到了电梯的声音。我在几间办公室待过，也到过外面。
entries.speaker: mnn

entries.text: Everyone stated that the elevator had been heard once, so she'd been forced to go along with it.{w} However, if she'd really heard it, she should've known that the elevator had ended up on one of the first two floors.
entries.new: 所有人都说只听到过一次电梯的声音，她也只能顺着这么说。{w} 可是，倘若她真的听见了，就该知道电梯最后停在了一楼或二楼。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: It's not possible for us to take the elevator, so let's walk up. We should come across someone.
entries.new: 电梯是坐不成了，我们走上去吧。总会碰上人的。
entries.speaker: mnn

entries.text: So, why had she said that they couldn't have taken the elevator up when she and Atsuki had seen the body? The panels hadn't been reattached—if the elevator had been above them, they wouldn't have been able to use it. However, if she'd heard it on the third floor, she should've known it was next to Erina's body.
entries.new: 那么，她和 Atsuki 看到尸体时，为什么说他们不可能坐电梯上去？面板还没有装回去——如果电梯当时在他们上方，他们就用不了它。可如果她是在三楼听见的，就该知道电梯当时停在 Erina 的尸体旁。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: ...Did Atsuki make that connection? Did he choose to omit the fact that he hadn't heard Miiya's footsteps above him?
entries.new: ……Atsuki 想到这一层了吗？他是故意略去了自己没听见头顶上 Miiya 脚步声这件事吗？
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: In any case, they found out that Erina was still alive. She and Isla had been in room A1 since they'd taken the elevator down.
entries.new: 总之，他们得知 Erina 还活着。她和 Isla 乘电梯下去之后，就一直待在 A1 室。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The next time a Sekimeiya was found, it was in one of the attic's wardrobes.
entries.new: 下一次发现 Sekimeiya，是在阁楼的一只衣柜里。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Look what I found!
entries.new: 看我找到了什么！
entries.speaker: ilnn

entries.text: "With two hands, Isla was holding one of the bed sheets, folded up into a sphere. It was wrapped around something, and I could tell what Isla was going to say before she did."
entries.new: 「Isla 双手捧着一条床单，已经团成了球状。里面裹着什么东西，而她还没开口，我就猜到她要说什么了。」
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: It's the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 是 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: ilnn

entries.text: What? The Sekimeiya's on the crystal floor.
entries.new: 什么？Sekimeiya 明明在水晶层。
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: No, I have it here. It was in the, um... wardrobe.
entries.new: 不对，它就在我手上。它刚才在，呃……衣柜里。
entries.speaker: ilnn

entries.text: It was the Future Sekimeiya that Miiya had activated. Within the sheet, it gathered energy very quickly.{w} The killer could've been hiding somewhere, so starting with the attic, they searched every floor. Since they had the Sekimeiya, they figured nobody could use it to hide from them.
entries.new: 那是 Miiya 启动过的 Future Sekimeiya。它在床单里蓄能极快。{w} 凶手可能藏在某处，于是他们从阁楼开始，逐层搜查。既然 Sekimeiya 在他们手上，他们便认为谁也没法借它躲过搜查。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: But the search didn't yield any results...
entries.new: 然而搜查毫无结果……
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The world A group was in room B4, but they weren't found.
entries.new: A世界的一组人就在 B4 室，却始终没被找到。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Akaro, Isla, Atsuki, and Shiroya remained there. Akaro and Isla world switched to world B, but Shiroya and Atsuki stayed behind.
entries.new: 留在那里的是 Akaro、Isla、Atsuki 和 Shiroya。Akaro 与 Isla 世界切换到了 B世界，Shiroya 和 Atsuki 则留了下来。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The reason they weren't seen was that everyone else world switched.
entries.new: 他们之所以没被看见，是因为其余所有人都发生了世界切换。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The world C group world switched...
entries.new: C世界的一组人也发生了世界切换……
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: When they were on an office floor. More specifically, on the second floor.
entries.new: 那时他们正在办公楼层。更准确地说，是在二楼。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Isla A touched the Past Sekimeiya in the cabinet. Akaro had set it to 5 °C, so it had slowly gathered energy. Since the Future Sekimeiya was on the second floor, the overlapping ranges created a world switch.
entries.new: Isla A 碰了展示柜里的 Past Sekimeiya。Akaro 把它设成了 5 °C，所以它一直在缓慢蓄能。由于 Future Sekimeiya 就在二楼，两者的重叠范围引发了世界切换。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Everyone but Shiroya B and Atsuki A world switched to world B. ...Alongside both groups, there was someone else who world switched as well.
entries.new: 除了 Shiroya B 和 Atsuki A，所有人都世界切换到了 B世界。……而除了这两组人，还有一个人也发生了世界切换。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Naomi C, who was in the lobby, world switched too.
entries.new: 待在大厅里的 Naomi C 也发生了世界切换。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Naomi and Shiroya were in the lobby, but only Naomi world switched. That happened because she was still alive.
entries.new: Naomi 和 Shiroya 都在大厅，但只有 Naomi 发生了世界切换，因为她仍活着。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: When Isla A touched the Past Sekimeiya, the Future Sekimeiya was just outside the partitions on the second floor.
entries.new: Isla A 碰到 Past Sekimeiya 时，Future Sekimeiya 恰在二楼隔断之外。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: ...Which was right above the lobby.{w} This is why Shiroya and Atsuki were the only two who didn't world switch—they were in hallway C.
entries.new: ……而那里就在大厅的正上方。{w} 正因如此，没有发生世界切换的只有 Shiroya 和 Atsuki 两人——他们当时在 C走廊。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: When the world switch happened, Isla C had the Future Sekimeiya wrapped up deep inside the bed sheet. She didn't immediately notice its disappearance.
entries.new: 世界切换发生时，Isla C 把 Future Sekimeiya 裹在床单深处，并没有立刻察觉它不见了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: However, what everyone did notice was that the elevator panel had reappeared. Not only on the second floor, but on all of them.
entries.new: 不过，所有人都注意到，电梯的面板重新出现了。不只是二楼，每一层都是如此。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Shiroya and Atsuki remained in world A with the corpses. When they went to the second floor, they saw the single Sekimeiya outside the partitions, which Shiroya was later able to use to return to world B.
entries.new: Shiroya 和 Atsuki 与那些尸体一起留在了 A世界。两人上到二楼时，看见隔断外孤零零地放着一台 Sekimeiya，后来 Shiroya 正是用它回到了 B世界。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The moment everyone else world switched to world B, the world B group was in the attic. They had locked themselves in a bedroom.
entries.new: 就在其他所有人都切换到 B 世界的那一刻，B 世界的那组人正在阁楼里，他们把自己反锁在了一间卧室里。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: And when the world C group saw the Sekimeiya in the cabinet, Isla unwrapped the bed sheet and saw that hers had disappeared. The Sekimeiya behind the glass was the Past Sekimeiya, which the world B group had left locked in the cabinet before going to the attic.
entries.new: 而当 C 世界那组人看到展示柜里的 Sekimeiya 时，Isla 解开了床单，发现自己的那台已经不见了。玻璃后面那台是 Past Sekimeiya，是 B 世界那组人去阁楼前锁进展示柜里的。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Wait, it's still here.
entries.new: 等等，它还在。
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: "Isla rapidly unwrapped the sheet to prove that she hadn't lied."
entries.new: 「Isla 飞快地解开床单，想证明自己没有说谎。」
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Hang on, it's not here. The thread I left.
entries.new: 等等，不在这儿。我留下的那根线。
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: It's not here...! The Sekimeiya!
entries.new: 没有……！Sekimeiya 不见了！
entries.speaker: ilnn

entries.text: ...I-Is this what you're implying? That it was taken out of the cabinet since the thread is gone and then brought to the attic? Then, at some point, it teleported inside again?{w} I have another idea. Let me take the Sekimeiya. Akaro and Katei, you watch the stairs.
entries.new: ……你、你是这个意思？因为线不见了，所以它被人从展示柜里拿出来，带到了阁楼？然后某个时刻，它又传送回了柜子里？{w} 我倒有个办法。Sekimeiya 我来拿。Akaro、Katei，你们盯住楼梯。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: Why?
entries.new: 为什么？
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: Because the last time it wasn't working, remember? I can test if it is now without activating it.
entries.new: 因为上次它没起作用，还记得吧？现在不用启动它，我也能试出它是否恢复正常。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: "Sai grabbed the Sekimeiya with his sleeves, causing the curtain to fall, and put it in the middle of the sheet."
entries.new: 「Sai 隔着袖子抓住 Sekimeiya，遮布随之落下，他把 Sekimeiya 放到了床单中央。」
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: It was very cold, so let's see if that changes.
entries.new: 它刚才非常冰，看看这样会不会有变化。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: "He wrapped it around with one layer of the cloth and waited a few seconds with his hand over it."
entries.new: 「他用布把它裹了一层，把手覆在上面，等了几秒。」
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: ...It is getting hot—definitely.{w} All right, I'm sure there's someone on this floor. Don't take your eyes off the stairs. I'm not sure we'll find them, though.
entries.new: ……热起来了——确实是热了。{w}好，这一层肯定有人。盯紧楼梯。不过能不能找到，就不好说了。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: Why do you say that?
entries.new: 为什么这么说？
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: Back then, you said it was burning and you could hardly hold it. Is it possible it teleports when it gets too hot?
entries.new: 当时你说它烫得几乎拿不住。会不会是热到一定程度，它就会传送？
entries.speaker: aknn

entries.text: And the next time we found it, it wasn't working. It could be that...
entries.new: 而下一次我们找到它时，它已经失灵了。会不会是因为……
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: It's working now, but we can test it. If the outer layer of the sheet felt hot for Isla, it's possible that it making the sheet hot made it heat up even more quickly.
entries.new: 它现在还能用，不过我们可以试一下。Isla 隔着布都能摸到烫，那也许是布被加热后反过来让它升温更快。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: "Sai wrapped the Sekimeiya up completely once again."
entries.new: 「Sai 又把 Sekimeiya 整个裹了起来。」
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Inside the wrapped sheet, the Past Sekimeiya quickly gathered energy. When Sai touched it in hallway A, they world switched to world C, leaving the sheet behind. The Future Sekimeiya had been very close, and its range was considerable, as it would soon make Akaro travel weeks to the future.
entries.new: 裹在布里的 Past Sekimeiya 很快积蓄了能量。Sai 在 A 走廊碰到它时，众人切换到了 C 世界，那块布被留在了原地。Future Sekimeiya 就在不远处，作用范围也相当大——很快，它就会让 Akaro 穿越到数周之后的未来。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Without realizing it, they were back in their world. They had made a full loop.
entries.new: 不知不觉间，他们已经回到了自己的世界。整整绕了一圈。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: They inspected the crystal floor, but nobody was found. Akaro and Isla A had remained in world B.{w} However, there were many things they noticed: Suripo's body had reappeared, and Shiroya's had disappeared. But Naomi was still there—she had returned to her world too, and the blood that had pooled below her had vanished.
entries.new: 他们查过水晶层，却一个人也没找到。Akaro 和 Isla A 留在了 B世界。{w}不过，他们注意到了不少变化：Suripo 的尸体重新出现，Shiroya 的却不见了。可 Naomi 还在——她也回到了自己的世界，而她身下积的那摊血已经消失了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: ...Oh wait, look at Naomi's head.
entries.new: ……等等，看 Naomi 的头。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: "From the wound she had, quite a bit of blood was pouring out."
entries.new: 「她的伤口正往外涌出不少血。」
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Yes, more blood is coming out than before.
entries.new: 没错，血比刚才流得更多了。
entries.speaker: aknn

entries.text: And it seems like it started just now, right? Otherwise, the pool on the floor would be much bigger.
entries.new: 而且看起来是刚刚才开始流的，对吧？否则地上的血泊会大得多。
entries.speaker: sainn

entries.text: They'd all returned to world C, but during the brief time they'd been in world B, Naomi's had been the only body in the lobby. She'd been bleeding from her head, so she'd left a large spot of blood on the polished floor.{w} That blood confused many people, but the person most thoroughly deceived by it was Sai B.{w} When he world switched to world A, only Shiroya's corpse was in the lobby, and there was blood next to her. Of course, he naturally assumed that it was hers, not Naomi's.{w} However, when he returned to world B, not only had the pool shrunk, but Shiroya's corpse had disappeared—she was still alive in that world.
entries.new: 所有人都回到了 C世界，可他们在 B世界逗留的那短短一段时间里，大厅里的尸体只有 Naomi 一具。血从她头部流出，在光洁的地板上留下一大片血迹。{w}那片血迹让不少人产生了误解，而被它骗得最彻底的，正是 Sai B。{w}当他切换世界到 A世界时，大厅里只有 Shiroya 的尸体，旁边还有一摊血。他自然以为那是她的血，而不是 Naomi 的。{w}可当他回到 B世界，血迹不仅变小了，Shiroya 的尸体也不见了——在那个世界里，她还活着。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: In world C, it became clear that understanding what had happened around them might've been out of everyone's grasp. Nobody had been found, but the bizarre occurrences within the tower hadn't stopped.
entries.new: 在 C世界，众人渐渐明白，身边发生的一切，或许没人能真正弄懂。谁也没找到，可塔内的怪事仍未停歇。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The security room had unlocked, Erina's body had disappeared, the Sekimeiya had teleported...
entries.new: 监控室的门开了，Erina 的尸体不见了，Sekimeiya 也传送走了……
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: That time, Miiya had found it in room A1. It was the fake Sekimeiya, which they decided to leave in the event room for good.
entries.new: 那一次，是 Miiya 在 A1 室找到了它。那是赝品 Sekimeiya，他们决定就把它留在活动室，不再理会。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: After that, things finally slowed down.
entries.new: 那之后，事情总算平息了一些。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: And a long time later, Miiya had the urge to lie down. She went to the attic, where she fell asleep.
entries.new: 很久之后，Miiya 忽然很想躺下。她去了阁楼，在那里睡着了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: When she woke up, the light suddenly turned on. That was the sign of a world switch.
entries.new: 她醒来时，灯忽然亮了。那是世界切换的征兆。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The exact appearance of the bed where she'd been had changed, but she couldn't notice that, as the light had been off. In the world where she appeared, the sheets had been messy as well.
entries.new: 她躺的那张床，样子其实已经变了，只是灯一直关着，她没能察觉。在她所抵达的那个世界里，床单同样凌乱。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Nobody was above her, and she heard sounds coming from the opposite bedroom. ...It was Shiroya, who'd been trapped there by Sai.
entries.new: 她上方没有人，对面卧室却传来动静。……是 Shiroya，她被 Sai 关在了那里。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Is there anything wrong with this?
entries.new: 这有什么问题吗？
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: ...Shiroya was locked behind that door. It follows that Miiya was in world B.
entries.new: ……Shiroya 被锁在那扇门后。照此推断，Miiya 当时在 B世界。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: However, the first time a world switch happened from world C, everyone went to world A.
entries.new: 可是，第一次从 C世界发生世界切换时，所有人都去了 A世界。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The world switch order is A - B - C - A... Why did Miiya go from world C to world B, then?
entries.new: 世界切换的顺序是 A－B－C－A……那么，Miiya 为什么会从 C世界到 B世界？
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: If she had world switched while she slept, she would have died. By lying in bed, she pressed the mattress down. Upon changing worlds, her body would've been split in half by an uncompressed mattress.
entries.new: 如果她在睡着时发生世界切换，她就死了。躺上床时，她把床垫压了下去。一旦换了世界，未被压下的床垫就会把她的身体从中间劈开。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The reason does not follow the order you're accustomed to.
entries.new: 原因并不按你们习惯的顺序来。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Can you recall another time a backward world switch happened?
entries.new: 还能想起另一次逆向的世界切换吗？
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: After Sai and Akaro escaped the attic's bedroom, Sai world switched to world A while in room B6. ...From world B, he went to world A.
entries.new: Sai 和 Akaro 逃出阁楼的卧室之后，Sai 在 B6 房间里切换到了 A 世界。……他从 B 世界去了 A 世界。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: What about a third instance?
entries.new: 那第三次呢？
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Yes. When Atsuki and Erina returned to world B, they had been in world C. Once again, they went from world C to world B.
entries.new: 对。Atsuki 和 Erina 回到 B世界的时候，他们原本在 C世界。又一次，他们从 C世界去了 B世界。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: When Atsuki and Erina returned to world B, they had been in world C. Once again, they went from world C to world B.
entries.new: Atsuki 和 Erina 回到 B世界的时候，他们原本在 C世界。又一次，他们从 C世界去了 B世界。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Is there anything interesting that these examples share?
entries.new: 这些例子有什么共同的特别之处吗？
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: That is not the case.
entries.new: 并非如此。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The similarity is that neither of the Sekimeiya were activated in their world.
entries.new: 共同点是，两个 Sekimeiya 在他们所在的世界里都没有被激活。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Exactly. Neither of the Sekimeiya were activated in their world.
entries.new: 正是。两个 Sekimeiya 在他们所在的世界里都没有被激活。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: That's wrong. In Sai's case, it was his first time.
entries.new: 不对。Sai 那一次是头一回。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The similarity is that neither of the Sekimeiya were activated in their world.
entries.new: 共同点是，两个 Sekimeiya 在他们所在的世界里都没有被激活。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: In Sai's case...
entries.new: Sai 那一次……
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: "Puzzled, he stepped into hallway B. ...What had just happened?{w} Out of nowhere, the Sekimeiya had disappeared.{w} He wondered if he'd traveled through time. Even though he hadn't touched the Sekimeiya, something peculiar had occurred."
entries.new: 「他满腹疑惑，走进了 B走廊。……刚才究竟发生了什么？{w}Sekimeiya 忽然不见了。{w}他怀疑自己是不是时间穿越了。明明没有碰过 Sekimeiya，却出了怪事。」
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Sai world switched without touching the Sekimeiya, and he had both of them.
entries.new: Sai 没碰 Sekimeiya 就切换了世界，而且两个都在他手上。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: So, then, why did he world switch? Is there another shared similarity?
entries.new: 那么，他为什么会切换世界？还有别的共同点吗？
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: That's not it. Both Sekimeiya had been used recently when Sai world switched.
entries.new: 不是这个。Sai 世界切换时，两个 Sekimeiya 刚被使用过不久。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: ...It happened when they were pulled from the previous world.
entries.new: ……是在它们被从前一个世界拉过来时发生的。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: That's not it.
entries.new: 也不对。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: It happened when they were pulled from the previous world.
entries.new: ……是在它们被从前一个世界拉过来时发生的。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Yes. It happened when they were pulled from the previous world.
entries.new: 没错。事情就发生在他们被从前一个世界拉过来的时候。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: When Sai world switched from world B to world A, someone world switched from world A to world B.{w} ...Shiroya.
entries.new: 当 Sai 从 B世界切换到 A世界时，也有人从 A世界切换到了 B世界。{w}……是 Shiroya。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: In the storeroom, she touched the Sekimeiya to return to her world.
entries.new: 她在储藏室里触碰了 Sekimeiya，回到了自己的世界。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: When Miiya world switched from world C to world B, someone world switched from world B to world C. In the event room, Erina, Atsuki, and Shiroya suddenly appeared in world C.
entries.new: 当 Miiya 从 C世界切换到 B世界时，也有人从 B世界切换到了 C世界。活动室里，Erina、Atsuki 和 Shiroya 突然出现在 C世界。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Every time a world switch was activated, it occurred in the world someone would be sent to as well. If someone was in the overlapping ranges of the next world, they would be pulled backward to the previous one. ...This swap begins to define the real meaning of the world switch.
entries.new: 每次触发世界切换，它也会发生在某人即将被送去的那个世界里。若有人身处下一世界的重叠范围内，就会被拉回前一个世界。……这种互换，逐渐揭示出世界切换的真正含义。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: When Erina and Atsuki returned to world B in the elevator, they had been in world C.
entries.new: Erina 和 Atsuki 乘电梯回到 B世界时，他们原本身在 C世界。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: It was Atsuki A—the person behind the "extra" elevator sound in world C.
entries.new: 那正是 Atsuki A——C世界里那声「多余」电梯响动就是他造成的。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He'd been escaping from Sai in world A and found both Sekimeiya, which brought him to world B.
entries.new: 他在 A世界躲避 Sai 的追赶，找到了两枚 Sekimeiya，结果被带到了 B世界。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He hadn't experienced the Sekimeiya's powers yet. Startled by the burn, he thought both glowing gems had merely disappeared.
entries.new: 他还没领教过 Sekimeiya 的力量。灼痛令他吃了一惊，他只以为那两颗发光的宝石凭空消失了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: In world B, he saw the Future Sekimeiya on the floor of the event room, which Erina had activated. He touched it, and as the Past Sekimeiya was still active in Ido's locker, he world switched to world C.
entries.new: 在 B世界，他看见活动室的地板上放着 Future Sekimeiya——那是 Erina 启动过的。他伸手碰了它；由于 Ido 储物柜里的 Past Sekimeiya 仍处于启动状态，他切换到了 C世界。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: ...He was only there momentarily.{w} After allowing Erina and his world B self to return to world B, he took the elevator up.
entries.new: ……他只在那里停留了片刻。{w} 等 Erina 和 B世界的自己回到 B世界后，他便乘电梯上去了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Out of nowhere, the elevator disappeared, and he fell all the way down onto that world's elevator, leaving him unconscious and wounded.
entries.new: 电梯毫无征兆地消失了，他一路坠落，重重摔在那个世界的电梯上，当场昏迷，浑身是伤。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: That was where the police found him—the only survivor of the incident.
entries.new: 警察就是在那儿发现他的——那起事件唯一的幸存者。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The light suddenly turned on; Miiya was pulled to world B. She heard Shiroya's voice and silently left the attic.
entries.new: 灯光骤然亮起；Miiya 被拉到了 B世界。她听见 Shiroya 的声音，悄悄离开了阁楼。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: On the crystal floor, she found the Past Sekimeiya in Ido's locker, where Atsuki had kept it.
entries.new: 她在水晶层找到了 Ido 储物柜里的 Past Sekimeiya——那是 Atsuki 先前放在那里的。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: "Despite being filled with questions, my mind was blank. My hand was drawn to the shape that had begun to take form behind the dark lines, and through the narrow space, I made contact, hoping with all my might that I would be brought to the awaited time."
entries.new: 「纵然满腹疑问，我的脑中却一片空白。昏暗的缝隙后，一个轮廓已渐渐成形，我的手不由自主地伸了过去；穿过狭窄的空隙，我触到了它，拼命祈愿自己能抵达那个等待已久的时间。」
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: After what had happened with Erina, Miiya had learned that traveling to the future with the Sekimeiya was possible. She wanted to be brought to {time=21}, out of the tower.{w} Through the slits in the locker, she activated it, and as Erina had just triggered the world switch, the Future Sekimeiya was powered off. Miiya went more than half an hour to the past and reset the Sekimeiya. When Atsuki B, who had originally hidden it there, later activated it, he only went forty minutes back in time.
entries.new: 经历了 Erina 那件事后，Miiya 明白用 Sekimeiya 穿越到未来是可行的。她希望自己被送到 {time=21} 的塔外。{w} 她透过储物柜的缝隙启动了它；而由于 Erina 刚触发过世界切换，Future Sekimeiya 已处于关闭状态。Miiya 回到了半个多小时前的过去，并重置了 Sekimeiya。后来，原本把它藏在那里的 Atsuki B 再次启动它时，只回到了四十分钟前。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Miiya appeared in hallway A and immediately fell down. An interesting location.{w} After all, forty minutes after the point she traveled, she was back in world C. She and Atsuki were running to the event room, which was what had made her fall in the past. ...The replicated location was from world C, but it was applied in the past of world B.
entries.new: Miiya 出现在 A走廊，随即摔倒在地。这地点很有意思。{w} 毕竟，穿越到那个时间点四十分钟后，她就回到了 C世界。她之所以会在过去摔倒，正是因为那时的她和 Atsuki 正跑向活动室。……那个被复制的地点来自 C世界，却被套用在了 B世界的过去。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: At {time=18:21}, Miiya found Katei dead. Following that, she noticed the flickering green lights of the security cameras.
entries.new: 在 {time=18:21}，Miiya 发现 Katei 已经死了。紧接着，她注意到监控摄像头的绿色指示灯在闪烁。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: "The cabinet was covered by its curtain. If the Sekimeiya was behind it, it was possible someone else was soon to be on the crystal floor."
entries.new: 「展示柜被遮布遮着。若 Sekimeiya 就在后面，那很快可能就会有别人出现在水晶层。」
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: "It was possible"... She wasn't sure if she had gone to the past.{w} She couldn't know if she had gone to the future because she had slept for an unknown period of time. The computer's clock couldn't confirm anything for her.
entries.new: 「有可能」……她不确定自己是否回到了过去。{w} 她不知道自己睡了多久，也就无法判断是否去了未来。电脑上的时钟同样无法为她证实什么。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Then, in hallway B, she was found by Erina B, who didn't recognize her. They entered room B4 and found the Sekimeiya that Shiroya had left in a cabinet, which they brought to the event room.
entries.new: 随后，Erina B 在 B走廊发现了她，却没有认出她。两人进入 B4室，在展示柜里找到了 Shiroya 留下的 Sekimeiya，并将它带到了活动室。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: When Miiya heard Atsuki's yells, she ran away without noticing that she'd dropped the note she'd been trying to prevent him from seeing. Erina had just reached into Miiya's purse to grab her keys, so it had remained slightly open.
entries.new: 听到 Atsuki 的喊声，Miiya 转身就跑，却没发现自己掉落了那张一直不想让他看到的纸条。先前 Erina 刚把手伸进 Miiya 的包里拿钥匙，包口因此还微微敞着。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He and Shiroya were there, talking to each other. After Erina joined them, Miiya attempted to eavesdrop from afar.
entries.new: 他和 Shiroya 就在那里交谈。Erina 也过去之后，Miiya 试图从远处偷听。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: They went to the event room, so Miiya entered the staff room to listen through the wall.
entries.new: 他们去了活动室，于是 Miiya 进了员工室，隔着墙壁偷听。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Minutes later, the same world switch that had pulled her to world B took place.
entries.new: 几分钟后，将她拉到 B世界的那场世界切换发生了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: She was the fourth person to world switch to world C. With her ear against the wall, both ranges encompassed her too.
entries.new: 她是第四个完成世界切换、来到 C世界的人。当时她耳朵贴着墙壁，两个范围也都覆盖到了她。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: In world C, the fake Sekimeiya was still in the event room, so it seemed like it teleported into the cabinet.
entries.new: 在 C世界，赝品 Sekimeiya 仍在活动室里，因此看上去就像是它自己传送进了展示柜。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Two hours remained until {time=21.}
entries.new: 距离 {time=21.} 还有两个小时。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Fortunately, everyone was able to leave safely. That included Naomi, who was woken up by the loud noise of the shutter.
entries.new: 幸运的是，所有人都安然离开了，包括被卷帘门巨响惊醒的 Naomi。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: However, a single decision nearly sent everything spiraling into destruction.
entries.new: 然而，仅仅一个决定，就险些让一切坠入毁灭。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Instead of the shutter, yells of pain that would've woken Naomi up before that time were almost let out. Disastrous yells that would've shattered everything that had been needed to get there.
entries.new: 差一点响起的，就不是卷帘门的声音，而是痛苦的喊叫——那会在那个时刻之前就把 Naomi 吵醒。那将是灾难般的喊声，足以让一路走到这里所需的一切尽数崩塌。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: They were yells that, in reality, nobody ever heard. At {time=21:04}, the police entered the building.{w} Even though everyone was alive, Suripo was dead on the floor. The officers could hardly believe their eyes while the survivors emerged.
entries.new: 那些喊声，现实中谁也没有听见。在 {time=21:04}，警察进入了大楼。{w} 尽管所有人都还活着，Suripo 却已倒在地板上，没了气息。幸存者一个个走出来时，警官们几乎不敢相信自己的眼睛。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: ...Two of whom knew what had happened. They knew that their lives after the 15th were ones that had been gifted to them.
entries.new: ……其中两人知道发生了什么。他们明白，自己十五号之后的人生，是别人赠予的。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Hopefully, you enjoyed this story.
entries.new: 希望你喜欢这个故事。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: It's not made for everyone, but I'm glad you're still here. ...We're pretty high up.
entries.new: 它并非为所有人而作，不过你还在这里，我很高兴。……我们已经爬得相当高了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Let's see... You answered {} out of {} ({}%) questions correctly. I hope you're proud of that.
entries.new: 让我看看……你答对了 {} 道题，共 {} 道（{}%）。希望你能为此感到自豪。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Of course, though, there's one last thing for you to see.{w}{w=0.3} The peak.
entries.new: 不过，当然，还有最后一样东西等着你去看。{w}{w=0.3} 顶峰。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Did you think you'd already seen it, maybe?
entries.new: 你是不是以为自己早就见过了？
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: ...What exactly is at the very top?
entries.new: ……最顶端究竟有什么？
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The Peak
entries.new: 顶峰

entries.text: The crystal floor was empty. Everyone had disappeared a long time earlier.
entries.new: 水晶层空无一人。所有人早就不见了踪影。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: My past self was in the attic. I'd been waiting at the bottom of the tower so that the large range of my past travel wouldn't reach me.
entries.new: 过去的我还在阁楼里。我一直等在塔底，以免过去那次大范围的时间穿越把我也卷进去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It's already been more than an hour. It should happen soon.
entries.new: 已经一个多小时了。应该快发生了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: What will happen after? Are the others gonna come back?
entries.new: 之后会怎样？其他人会回来吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I'd been resting my mind, but the hours that remained were still an unknown area.
entries.new: 我一直在放空思绪，但剩下的几个小时依旧是一片未知。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The first time we changed worlds, did we appear in this world? I've been wondering that for a while...
entries.new: 我们第一次切换世界时，真的出现在这个世界了吗？这个问题我想了好一阵子了……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I'm pretty sure the people we met belonged to this world, but the world we went to could've been the one they were sent to. They don't necessarily have to return to this one.
entries.new: 我很确定，我们遇见的人属于这个世界；但我们去到的世界，或许正是他们被送往的那个。他们未必会回到这个世界。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Hm...
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I realized I had a new piece of information to work with.
entries.new: 我意识到，自己手上又多了一条可用的信息。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Actually, I'm pretty sure the world we were sent to was this very world.{w} Sai asked me how Shiroya got into the tower. For him, she'd never been there.
entries.new: ……其实，我很确定，我们被送往的世界正是这一个。{w} Sai 问我 Shiroya 是怎么进塔的。对他来说，她根本没来过塔里。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I'd appreciate it if you told the truth, though. How did she get in?
entries.new: 不过，我还是希望你说实话。她究竟是怎么进来的？
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: She was with us from the beginning...
entries.new: 她从一开始就跟我们在一起……
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: That's false. Since she seems to be with you, I really doubt you were stupid enough to make her enter through the storeroom. That's what's strange, but perhaps you did.{w} Let me see.
entries.new: 不对。她看起来是和你一起的，所以我实在不觉得你会蠢到让她从储藏室进来。奇怪就奇怪在这里，不过也许你真这么做了。{w}让我看看。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: "Indifferent to my confusion and rage, Sai walked to hallway C."
entries.new: 「Sai 对我的困惑和怒火毫不在意，径直走向 C 走廊。」
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What are you doing!?
entries.new: 你干什么！？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: "Instead of answering, he entered the storeroom.{w} Seconds later, he returned."
entries.new: 「他没有回答，直接走进储藏室。{w} 几秒后，又折返回来。」
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I just wanted to verify that she hasn't entered through the storeroom yet.
entries.new: 我只是想确认她还没有从储藏室进来。
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I get it now. He had marked the door in some way—he could tell whether it had opened. So, he went to the storeroom and confirmed that his mark was still there.
entries.new: 我现在明白了。他在门上做了什么标记——只要门开过，他就能看出来。所以他才去储藏室，确认标记还在原处。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: That implies that it was this world. The mark existed, as the door hadn't opened since he'd left it.
entries.new: 这说明这里就是那个世界。标记还在——他离开之后，门确实没有开过。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: That means they'll return here. Just like we came back to our world, they'll come back here. It'll happen before {time=19.}
entries.new: 也就是说，他们会回到这里。就像我们回到了自己的世界一样，他们也会回到这里。而且会发生在 {time=19.} 之前。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: And that's not all...
entries.new: 而且还不止这些……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Sai, what time is it?
entries.new: Sai，现在几点？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Uh...{w} it's {time=18:43.}
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: {time=18:43.}.. That was almost twenty minutes behind the real time I estimated. That made me think that after traveling, Sai's replicated location had been of twenty minutes prior, and his watch hadn't stopped working.
entries.new: {time=18:43.}……这比我估算的真实时间慢了将近二十分钟。我因此猜想，Sai 穿越后所在的那个时间点，其实比现在早了二十分钟，而他的手表并没有停。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Now, I'm pretty sure that his watch was a bit more than twenty minutes behind, but it wasn't because he had traveled. It was the Sai from this world, who still had the time wrong from when he'd traveled to the future with the other version of me.{w} Later, when we returned to our world, Sai's time was accurate again, and I figured he must've synced it using the computer.
entries.new: 现在，我基本确定，他的手表慢了不止二十分钟，但这并不是因为他穿越过，而是因为这个世界的 Sai 曾和另一个我一起穿越到未来，表上的时间从那时起就一直不准。{w} 后来我们回到自己的世界时，他的手表又准了，我猜他一定用电脑校准过。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It happened even before I expected it. Suddenly, I heard a voice in hallway A.
entries.new: 事情比我预想的来得还早。忽然，A走廊里传来一个声音。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...pen again.
entries.new: ……又开了。
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: Wha—
entries.new: 什么——
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: But why is the sheet—
entries.new: 可为什么那块布——
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: I stood up immediately to hide.
entries.new: 我立刻起身躲了起来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Everyone's there! Erina too, she's still alive!
entries.new: 大家都在！Erina 也在，她还活着！
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: She was a bit closer to the staircase with Isla, and it seemed everyone had just appeared. I'd been sitting on the stairs, so they hadn't noticed me.
entries.new: 她和 Isla 站得离楼梯稍近一些，看样子所有人都是刚刚出现的。我一直坐在楼梯上，所以他们没发现我。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Sai went to the storeroom.
entries.new: Sai 走向储藏室。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...It hasn't been opened again.
entries.new: ……那扇门没有再开过。
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: Fuck... Let's hurry. The Sekimeiya might've appeared on this floor.{w} I didn't think this through. If someone's actually here, there's a chance it'll allow them to escape.
entries.new: 妈的……动作快点。Sekimeiya 可能已经出现在这层了。{w}是我考虑不周。要是真有人在这儿，说不定反而会让对方有机会逃走。
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: Suddenly, they began to look through every room.
entries.new: 忽然，他们开始逐个房间搜查。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: They're really all back, and my past self is likely already gone from the attic.
entries.new: 他们真的全都回来了，而过去的我大概已经离开阁楼了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: What now, then? I need to have the Sekimeiya for myself...{w} Am I going to be found? The Sekimeiya are in the attic, so I can probably use the future one to escape from them.
entries.new: 那现在怎么办？我必须把 Sekimeiya 拿到手……{w} 我会被他们发现吗？Sekimeiya 都在阁楼，我或许能用未来那台逃离他们。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: That wasn't needed. They found the third Sekimeiya, but when they were done, they didn't move up to the second floor.
entries.new: 那倒没必要。他们找到了第三台 Sekimeiya，可是搜查完后，并没有上二楼。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...{w}Are they not planning to keep going?
entries.new: ……{w}他们不打算继续往上搜了吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: They remained below, separate from each other.
entries.new: 他们留在下面，彼此隔开了一段距离。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Why? Why would they search like that only to not continue? Did they only want to find the Sekimeiya?
entries.new: 为什么？为什么搜成那样，却不继续了？难道他们只想找到 Sekimeiya？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...{w}Maybe I get it. They don't know that the world around them just changed.{w} Perhaps they just looked through the whole building, ending at the crystal floor. If that's when they changed worlds, they must think that the whole building is empty.
entries.new: ……{w}也许我明白了。他们不知道周围的世界刚刚切换过。{w} 他们可能把整栋楼都搜了一遍，最后来到水晶层。如果那就是他们切换世界的那一刻，他们一定会以为整栋楼已经空了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...And if that's the case, as long as they stay there, I can move freely above them.
entries.new: ……若真是这样，只要他们留在下面，我就能在他们上方自由行动。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Now I'm sure I'm in the world we once went to. That means I can do everything I want.
entries.new: 现在我能确定，我正身处我们曾经去过的那个世界。也就是说，我想做什么都可以。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: The end of my plan had always been blurry. After everything else, I wanted to find Shiroya and return to our original world, sure that the reality I wanted to shape did exist. I'd never truly known how to do that until just then.
entries.new: 我计划的终点一直都很模糊。在经历了这么多之后，我想找到 Shiroya，回到原本的世界，并确信我想塑造的那个现实真的存在。直到刚才，我才真正明白该怎么做。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We arrived in this world at {time=19.} At that time, I'll be able to meet Shiroya again.
entries.new: 我们是在 {time=19.} 来到这个世界的。到了那时，我就能再次见到 Shiroya。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: She was with us. Her clothes were different, but she was the real one—she had lived through much more than I had imagined.{w} She'll be here at {time=19}, and she'll go to the attic all of a sudden. That's where I'll be.
entries.new: 她曾和我们在一起。衣着虽然不同，但她才是真正的 Shiroya——她经历的事情远比我预想的多。{w} 她会在 {time=19} 来到这里，然后忽然前往阁楼。我也会在那里。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Then, I know we'll be able to return to our world. We merely have to be in the middle of the building.
entries.new: 那样一来，我就能确定我们可以回到自己的世界。我们只需要待在这栋楼的中间。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: When we took the elevator up, it stopped on the third floor. That was when we returned.{w} That must mean that the third floor was being encompassed by the ranges of both Sekimeiya, and someone activated one. If we're there at that time, I know for a fact we'll be able to return.
entries.new: 我们坐电梯上去的时候，电梯停在了三楼。我们就是那时回去的。{w}也就是说，当时三楼正处于两块 Sekimeiya 的重叠范围内，而且有人启动了其中一块。只要那时我们在那儿，我可以肯定，我们一定能回去。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I went up to the attic.
entries.new: 我上了阁楼。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: As I thought, I'm no longer here.
entries.new: 果然，我已经不在这里了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: The kitchen was empty, but I could see my footprints on the floor. I had very recently traveled to the 24th of November.
entries.new: 厨房空无一人，但地板上能看见我的脚印。我不久前才穿越到 11 月 24 日。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The Past Sekimeiya was on the marble countertop, already white again. By its side was the voice recorder with numbers on its screen.{w} 81:04.
entries.new: Past Sekimeiya 就放在大理石台面上，已经重新变回白色。它旁边是录音笔，屏幕上显示着数字。{w} 81:04。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The Future Sekimeiya was still in the refrigerator, so I put the past one inside too.
entries.new: Future Sekimeiya 还在冰箱里，我便把 Past Sekimeiya 也放了进去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I began a new recording.
entries.new: 我重新开始录音。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I was about to take the Past Sekimeiya back out, but my arm stopped itself.
entries.new: 我正要把 Past Sekimeiya 取出来，手却停住了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...{w}My heartbeat picked up, causing my fingers to jitter on their own. A thought had suddenly come to me.
entries.new: ……{w}我的心跳快了起来，手指也不受控制地发颤。一个念头忽然冒了出来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...It should be simple. I can travel to November 30th one more time. I know saving Miiya is within my reach—she's alive.{w} Then, I have to do what I just thought. I can enter the tower when the 15th comes. I can be in the attic at {time=19}, before Shiroya appears.
entries.new: ……应该很简单。我可以再穿越到 11 月 30 日一次。我知道救下 Miiya 并非遥不可及——她还活着。{w} 然后，我必须去做刚才想到的事。等 15 日到来，我就能进入塔里。在 Shiroya 出现之前、{time=19} 的时候，我可以待在阁楼里。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Was that really the case, though?
entries.new: 可事情当真如此吗？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: According to my estimate, it should've been a little past {time=16.} Three hours still remained until {time=19.}
entries.new: 照我的估算，此刻应该刚过{time=16.}，距离{time=19.}还有三个小时。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: My plan had been to use the Past Sekimeiya one more time after my past self's disappearance.
entries.new: 我的计划，是在过去的我消失之后，再用一次 Past Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I could live through November 30th a third time; I could save Miiya, as the news I'd read was the only obstacle in that pursuit.{w} In the world I was in, Shiroya didn't exist, but I had never seen her blood, no definitive proof of her death. Her absence was no real barrier.
entries.new: 我可以第三次度过十一月三十日，也可以救下 Miiya——毕竟我读到的那则新闻，是这条路上唯一的阻碍。{w}在我此刻所在的世界里，Shiroya 并不存在，但我从未见过她的血，也没有她已死的确证。她的缺席并不能算真正的障碍。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: After that, I had to return with Shiroya to our world. The way to accomplish it was by being in the center of the building at close to {time=19:30.}
entries.new: 之后，我必须带着 Shiroya 回到我们的世界。而要做到这一点，就得在将近{time=19:30.}时待在大楼中央。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: That was how I had to do it. If I attempted to change worlds before that point by using the two Sekimeiya, it was very likely I would appear someplace else. After all, that was how the group from the world I was in had vanished earlier, and I was completely confident they hadn't appeared in our world.
entries.new: 我只能这么做。若是在那之前就用两台 Sekimeiya 切换世界，我很可能会出现在别的地方。毕竟，我所在的这个世界里的那群人，先前正是那样消失的，而且我可以完全肯定，他们并没有出现在我们的世界里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It should've been doable—I'd never really considered otherwise. ...What made my arm stop was the connection I'd just made.
entries.new: 按理说，这应该办得到——我从未想过别的可能。……让我停下手来的，是我刚刚串起的那层关联。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Just before {time=19:30}, Sai had gone to the storeroom to check whether his mark had disappeared. At that time, the door hadn't opened yet.
entries.new: 就在{time=19:30}之前，Sai 曾去储藏室确认自己的标记是否消失。那时，门还没有打开。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...{w}I left the attic; I didn't feel comfortable thinking there. If anyone came up with the elevator, I wouldn't hear them, so I chose to go to the sixth floor, where I would hear both the elevator and any approaching footsteps.
entries.new: ……{w}我离开了阁楼。在那里思考，我总觉得不踏实。要是有人乘电梯上来，我根本听不见，于是我选择去六楼——在那里，电梯的动静和任何靠近的脚步声都能传进耳中。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Of course, my plan implied a future version of myself was in the tower. A version of myself who had been there since the morning.{w} I'd known that, which was why I'd followed the group's movements—so that I could give myself a route to hide throughout the day, aware of where to be at all times.
entries.new: ……当然，我的计划意味着，未来的我就在这座塔里——一个从早晨起便待在这里的我。{w}这一点我早就清楚，所以才一直留意那群人的动向，好给自己安排一条整日藏身的路线，随时知道该待在何处。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Could that really be the case, though?
entries.new: 可是，真的会是这样吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: When I thought about it after having witnessed the whole series of events, my heartbeat grew erratic.
entries.new: 亲眼目睹了整件事的经过之后，再回想起来，我的心跳便乱了起来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Is it...?{w} Just before the group left this world, the whole building was searched, when I replaced the other Atsuki without anyone noticing. Naturally, my future self wasn't found—that would've been a paradox, as I would've seen myself before knowing where I would be.
entries.new: 会是这样吗……？{w}在那群人离开这个世界之前，整栋楼都被搜查过——正是在那时，我不动声色地顶替了另一个 Atsuki。未来的我自然没有被发现。若被发现，就会成为悖论：那等于我在得知自己该去何处之前，就先看见了自己。
entries.speaker: nm
