entries.text: So, why was that me not found? How will I avoid being found?{w} At the time, every single place was inspected except for the hidden area in the storeroom. However, I couldn't have been there, as my own past self already was.
entries.new: 那么，那个我为什么没被找到？我又要怎样才能不被找到？{w}当时，除了储藏室里那处隐蔽的空间，每一处都被查过了。可我不可能待在那里——过去的我已经占着那个位置了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I'd had the thought in the back of my mind: if a similar problem arose, the storeroom's secret could aid me. ...That was no longer the case.
entries.new: 我心里一直存着一个念头：若再遇到类似的难题，储藏室的秘密或许能帮上忙。……如今这念头行不通了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: My future self merely has to be here at {time=19:30.} ...It's not exact, but I'll say the search happened at {time=14.}{w} My past self was in the storeroom from {time=9} to {time=14.} Immediately after I left it, the fake wall was found by this world's group.{w} I thought that in the worst-case scenario, I could enter through the storeroom after the attack. ...But that's not possible. As soon as it was found, Sai marked it, and I know that mark will still be there at {time=19:30}, right before we returned to our world.
entries.new: 未来的我只需在{time=19:30.}待在这里就够了。……时间未必精确，但搜查大约是在{time=14.}。{w}从{time=9}到{time=14.}，过去的我一直待在储藏室。我刚离开那里，这个世界的众人就发现了那面假墙。{w}我原以为，最坏的情况下，还能在袭击之后从储藏室进入……但那已不可能。假墙一被发现，Sai 就在上面做了标记，而我知道，直到{time=19:30}、我们即将回到自己的世界之前，那个标记都还在。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Knowing all that, it wasn't possible that a future self of mine would enter the tower after the {time=14} search.
entries.new: 既然清楚这些，未来的我就不可能在{time=14}的搜查之后进入这座塔。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: More importantly, it's very unlikely this would be possible either way. I shouldn't assume that I could enter through the storeroom without being seen. Technically, I could enter after {time=19:30} and travel to the past in order to be at the center of the building at the right time, but I don't know whether I'll be seen outside, and if I am, I'll be unable to travel back.{w} I shouldn't go back to the 30th with a plan that could fail, so I have to entirely rule out the storeroom.
entries.new: 更重要的是，无论怎么看，这都极难办到。我不能假定自己能不被人看见地从储藏室进去。严格来说，我可以在{time=19:30}之后进入，再穿越回过去，好在恰当的时刻待在大楼中央；但外面会不会有人看见我，我并不知道，一旦被看见，就再也回不去了。{w}我不能带着一个可能失败的方案回到三十日，所以储藏室这条路必须彻底排除。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: That meant that for a future self of mine to be present at {time=19:30}, he would've had to be in the tower since a time before my past self had begun to wait in the storeroom.{w} Since I was aware of that, how could I avoid being found by the search at {time=14}?
entries.new: 也就是说，未来的我若要在{time=19:30}出现在这里，就必须在过去的我开始守候于储藏室之前，就已经待在塔里了。{w}既然我清楚这一点，又怎么可能躲过{time=14}的那场搜查？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There's one way—by traveling to the future.
entries.new: 只有一个办法——穿越到未来。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: When could I have used the Future Sekimeiya to not be present at {time=14}?
entries.new: 我能在什么时候用上 Future Sekimeiya，好让自己在{time=14}不在场？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: After the smoke was released, it was brought to the attic in a suitcase. The next time it moved was when Katei brought it to the crystal floor with the other Atsuki and Miiya.
entries.new: 烟雾放出之后，它被人装进手提箱送上了阁楼。它下一次移动，是 Katei 把它和另一个 Atsuki 以及 Miiya 一起带到水晶层的时候。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I remember how he looked when he had it in his hands. He was in pain because the Sekimeiya hadn't been activated since it had been taken out of the cabinet.
entries.new: 我记得他双手捧着它时的神情。他当时疼得厉害，因为那台 Sekimeiya 从展示柜里被取出后，就一次都没有启动过。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: If my future self had used it before he brought it down, it would've reset and spent a while powered off. There's no way Katei would've had to hold it carefully like he did.
entries.new: 若是未来的我在他把它带下来之前用过它，它就会重置，并有一段时间处于关闭状态。那样的话，Katei 根本不必像那样小心翼翼地捧着它。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: If I'd touched it at that point, I would've had to be in the storeroom during the night to appear in the tower in the future. Maybe that's possible, but there's too much uncertainty; there's clear room for failure.
entries.new: 如果我在那个时候碰过它，那么为了让未来的自己出现在塔里，我就必须在夜里进入储藏室。或许这办得到，但不确定的因素太多，明显有失败的可能。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I could explain Katei's face in a different way: I could leave the Sekimeiya in a hot place as I touch it. However, both Sekimeiya were in the attic. I would have to find out which was which, keep the past one in the refrigerator due to its large range, and travel to the future.
entries.new: Katei 的表情也可以有另一种解释：我可以在触碰 Sekimeiya 的同时，把它留在高温的地方。可两台 Sekimeiya 都在阁楼里。我得先弄清楚哪台是哪台，把范围大的那台——也就是过去的 Sekimeiya——放进冰箱，然后再穿越到未来。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...I'd once put some thought into the type of web I was entangled in. I'd considered that in order to work around what you'd observed, having observed too much could be a fatal flaw.
entries.new: ……我曾花过些心思，琢磨自己究竟陷在怎样一张网里。我想到过，为了绕开你所观察到的东西，观察得太多反而可能成为致命的缺陷。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: At the time, I'd also come up with another concept in the form of thought-up loops, which were fundamentally similar to the way the Past Sekimeiya worked.
entries.new: 当时，我还想到过另一个概念——凭空设想的循环，它与 Past Sekimeiya 的运作方式在根本上相似。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It's uncertain whether traveling to the future before Katei brought the Sekimeiya down will work out smoothly. However, I have a way to know if it will.
entries.new: 在 Katei 把 Sekimeiya 带下来之前穿越到未来，究竟能否顺利成功，还说不准。不过，我有办法确认它是否行得通。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: A cue.{w} If I had a loop in my head, I could know whether it could be completed. If I thought about everything that I would do after touching the Past Sekimeiya, I could observe whether a cue I intended to leave would exist.
entries.new: 一个提示。{w}只要脑中存着一个循环，我就能知道它能否成立。若我把触碰 Past Sekimeiya 之后要做的每一件事都想清楚，便能观察自己打算留下的那个提示是否存在。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: So, could I do this? If it works, I'll draw a mark with a pen beneath a drawer on this floor...
entries.new: 那么，我做得到吗？如果行得通，我就用笔在这一层的某个抽屉底下画一个记号……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I went to the offices and walked up to the drawer I'd selected.
entries.new: 我走到办公区，来到自己选定的那个抽屉前。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...It's not here. There's no mark.
entries.new: ……没有。这里没有记号。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: There'd been clear uncertainty behind the loop I'd thought of, but thanks to the lack of the cue, the uncertainty could be erased—that loop wouldn't work.
entries.new: 我设想的那个循环背后，本有明确的不确定之处；而今提示并不存在，这份不确定也就有了答案——那个循环行不通。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It's impossible, then. I might be failing to realize the reason why it couldn't be executed. I don't know if it's just a tiny detail.
entries.new: 那么，这不可能。或许我还没意识到它无法执行的真正原因。也许只是某个极小的细节，我也说不准。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: What about entering through the storeroom after {time=19:30} and then traveling to the past? Could that be possible?
entries.new: 那么，在{time=19:30}之后从储藏室进入，再穿越回过去呢？这能办到吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: If it is, I'll go back in time to a point after {time=14} and leave a mark beneath that drawer. If I need to, I'll travel back twice in order to make it to a point prior to now.
entries.new: 若能办到，我就穿越回{time=14}之后的某个时刻，在那个抽屉底下留下记号。如果有必要，我会连续穿越两次，回到比现在更早的时点。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: There was nothing there.
entries.new: 那里什么也没有。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: That makes sense. That means I couldn't enter the building through the storeroom without being seen from outside.
entries.new: 原来如此。看来我没法不被外面的人看见，就从储藏室进入大楼。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I was growing nervous. Miiya was alive—success must've awaited me.{w} ...But could I be sure of that?{w} It was a guarantee that Miiya was alive, but what about Shiroya? The circumstances around her were what left room for doubt.
entries.new: 我渐渐不安起来。Miiya 还活着——等待我的本该是成功。{w}……可我能确定吗？{w}Miiya 活着是确凿的，但 Shiroya 呢？她那边的情形，才留出了疑问的余地。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: When the Future Sekimeiya was brought down from the attic, Katei used it. Then, the other Atsuki and Sai traveled minutes forward as well. There's no way I could travel before then.
entries.new: Future Sekimeiya 被从阁楼带下来时，Katei 用了它。随后，另一个 Atsuki 和 Sai 也向前穿越了几分钟。在那之前，我不可能穿越。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: But... the situation is the same later. I saw what happened to the Sekimeiya.{w} Sai, Akaro, and Katei moved them back and forth, but I remember it clearly—no place where the Future Sekimeiya was hidden was accessed by a future self of mine. My line of sight unconsciously blocked myself.
entries.new: 可是……之后的情形也一样。Sekimeiya 的遭遇我都看在眼里。{w}Sai、Akaro 和 Katei 把两台 Sekimeiya 搬来搬去，可我记得很清楚——Future Sekimeiya 藏身过的任何一处，都不曾被未来的我碰过。我的视线在不知不觉间，把自己挡在了外面。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: There's no way a future self of mine was on the crystal floor and wasn't seen by me or anyone who was there. The Future Sekimeiya wasn't activated, and neither was the past one.
entries.new: 未来的我若在水晶层，绝不可能不被我或在场的任何人看见。Future Sekimeiya 没有被启动，过去的那台也一样。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Katei did go a long time to the future, but even if I were to enter his travel's range, I wouldn't go past {time=14.}
entries.new: Katei 确实向未来穿越了很长一段，但即使我进入他穿越的范围，也越不过{time=14.}。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: And when the Future Sekimeiya was hidden in the mechanical room, the other Atsuki and Miiya used it to go to the future.
entries.new: 而当 Future Sekimeiya 被藏进机械室时，另一个 Atsuki 和 Miiya 用它去了未来。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Suripo's killer brought it to a room in hallway B. When I was enacting the search, I felt the air around it, which was burning. There's no way I had touched it before then.
entries.new: 杀害 Suripo 的凶手把它带到了B走廊的一个房间。我搜查时，感觉到它周围的空气滚烫。在那之前，我不可能碰过它。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...So is it not possible? Was there really no time where I could've gone to the future!?
entries.new: ……那么，真的办不到？我当真没有一刻能穿越到未来！？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I thought of using the Past Sekimeiya instead. Its only use would've been to travel seconds back to a room that had just been inspected. However, I'd also felt the air around it during the search, and it had been even hotter... That path was blocked too.
entries.new: 我转而想到用 Past Sekimeiya。它唯一的用处，不过是穿越回几秒之前，回到一间刚刚搜查过的房间。可搜查时我也感觉到了它周围的空气，而且还要更烫……这条路同样被堵死了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...{w}I felt lost. How the hell could I accomplish anything?
entries.new: ……{w}我茫然无措。这样下去，我究竟能做成什么？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Traveling to the future before the attack won't be doable, and after the 30th, Ashiya already had the Sekimeiya. The days up to the 15th are useless.{w} It was the owner of that gem shop who found the Sekimeiya. On the 30th, it's very likely they were in that box I saw...{w} But they were taken by the man who released the smoke, and he ran away with them.
entries.new: 赶在袭击之前穿越到未来行不通，而30号之后，Sekimeiya 已经落到芦屋手里了。到15号为止的日子都没有用。{w}找到 Sekimeiya 的，是那家宝石店的店主。30号那天，它们很可能就在我看到的那只箱子里……{w}可它们被释放烟雾的男人夺走了，他带着它们逃了出去。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I know the smoke was released thanks to the news report I saw, so I can't obtain the Sekimeiya and save Miiya together. Not to mention that to appear in the tower on the 15th, I would also have to be there on the 15th of November.{w} I'm sure that after the man ran away with the box, he was caught. That's what Katei told us about, and it's the reason why the Sekimeiya returned to Ashiya. There's nothing I can do there.
entries.new: 我是从看到的新闻报道里得知烟雾被释放的，所以我无法既拿到 Sekimeiya 又救下 Miiya。更何况，要在15号出现在塔里，我就得在11月15日待在那里。{w}我确信那个男人带着箱子逃走之后被抓了。Katei 跟我们讲的就是这件事，正因如此 Sekimeiya 才回到了芦屋。那边我插不上手。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Just in case, I need to try it.{w} A loop where I go to November 15th and remain inside the tower. Then, on November 30th, I take that box with the Sekimeiya.{w} As fast as possible, I make sure Miiya won't die and run away. Then, I travel to the future and appear after the search that happened at {time=14.}{w} I'll tell the police about the Sekimeiya's location before I travel so that they can find them and return them to Ashiya.{w} If this can work, a mark will be under that drawer.
entries.new: 以防万一，我得试一试。{w}一个循环：我先去11月15日，留在塔里。然后在11月30日，拿走那只装着 Sekimeiya 的箱子。{w}以最快的速度确保 Miiya 不会死，然后逃走。接着穿越到未来，出现在{time=14.}那次搜查结束之后。{w}穿越之前，我会先把 Sekimeiya 的位置告诉警方，好让他们找到 Sekimeiya、归还给芦屋。{w}如果这能行得通，那只抽屉下面就会有记号。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: {tip=ohnoitdidntwork}It wasn't there{/tip}. It appeared that couldn't work either.
entries.new: {tip=ohnoitdidntwork}那里什么也没有{/tip}。看来这条路同样走不通。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I kept thinking about the events that had occurred throughout the day in case I could find the smallest opening, but it really seemed like there was no place for a future self of mine to exist.
entries.new: 我一整天都在反复回想发生过的事，想找出哪怕一线可能，可看来未来的我根本无处容身。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Does this mean that I can't be here at {time=19:30}? But that's the single guaranteed way I have to go back!
entries.new: 这就是说，我不能在{time=19:30}待在这里？可那是我唯一能确定回去的办法啊！
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I could change worlds in the morning instead, after Shiroya and Naomi did. That's a lot less likely to bring me to the world I want, though...!
entries.new: 我也可以改成早上，等 Shiroya 和 Naomi 之后再做世界切换。可那样一来，能落到我想去的世界的可能性就小得多了……！
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...Maybe there was no way to skip the {time=14} search, but what about another way around it?
entries.new: ……也许{time=14}那次搜查是没法跳过的，但换个方向绕开它呢？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The Atsuki from this world looked at the rooms in hallway A. Then, I took his place and looked through the rest of the crystal floor.{w} Finally, Miiya and I completed all the other floors.
entries.new: 这个世界的 Atsuki 查看过 A走廊的房间。之后我接替他，把水晶层剩下的地方查了一遍。{w}最后，我和 Miiya 把其余楼层都查完了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: What if... my future self was in one of the hallway A rooms? Technically, that's how I was able to not be found that time. I told the Atsuki from this world to stay put, and he did so because it was his own request.
entries.new: 万一……未来的我就藏在 A走廊的某个房间里呢？严格说来，那次我能不被找到，靠的就是这个。我让这个世界的 Atsuki 待在原地，他照做了，因为那正是他自己的要求。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Could I do the same? Could I ask him to ignore having seen me?
entries.new: 我能照做吗？能让他当作没见过我吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I wondered that, well aware of the answer.
entries.new: 我这样想着，心里却清楚答案。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I recalled the time he'd seen me.
entries.new: 我想起他看见我的那一刻。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: "I saw my own body stepping in. As he approached one of the cabinets, I knew there was only one thing I could do."
entries.new: 「我看见自己的身体走了进来。当他走向其中一只展示柜时，我知道自己只有一件事能做。」
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: This is very imp—
entries.new: 这非常重——
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Wha—
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: "He turned around with a startled gasp. His reaction was even more drastic when he saw me."
entries.new: 「他吃惊地倒吸一口气，转过身来。等看清是我，他的反应更加剧烈。」
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wh-What!? Who are you!?{w=0.7} Are you... me?
entries.new: 什、什么！？你是谁！？{w}你是……我？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: "I nodded, although it wasn't the entire truth."
entries.new: 「我点了点头，虽然那并不完全是实话。」
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: This is very important. Stay here until the search is finished.
entries.new: 这件事非常重要。待在这里，等搜查结束。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: That reaction gave me the answer. That was the first time he'd seen another self of his.
entries.new: 那个反应已经给了我答案。那是他第一次见到另一个自己。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Could my future self have told him to react that way? ...Word by word?{w} I didn't think that was how it worked; his reaction seemed completely genuine. Likely, the only way for me to make such a thing work would've been by considering it before seeing his reaction.
entries.new: 未来的我有没有可能教过他那样反应？……一字一句地教？{w}我觉得不该是这样；他的反应看起来完全是真实的。恐怕，我要真能让这种事行得通，就得在看见他的反应之前先想到它。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Nonetheless, I verified whether it would work. If a mark was below the next desk, it would.
entries.new: 尽管如此，我还是验证了一下是否可行。如果下一张桌子下面有记号，那就说明可行。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Once again, there was nothing.
entries.new: 还是一样，什么也没有。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I thought back to the look in Miiya's eyes. It had changed at one point.
entries.new: 我回想起 Miiya 的眼神。有那么一刻，那眼神变了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What if she saw me? What if my future self was in the partitions on that floor?{w} Could he have told her to not reveal him?
entries.new: 如果她看见我了呢？如果未来的我就躲在那层楼的隔间里呢？{w}他会不会嘱咐过她别把他暴露出来？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: That felt a little strange. If that had happened, why would her look have changed in that way? I knew the answer couldn't be that I would instruct her to do so.
entries.new: 这感觉有些奇怪。若真是如此，她的眼神为什么会那样变？我知道答案不可能是「我吩咐她这么做」。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Not only that, but if I stayed in that partition, the reason would've been due to knowing how Miiya's demeanor changed. In short, the result would've caused the effect.
entries.new: 不止如此，若我藏在那间隔间里，理由必然是「我知道 Miiya 的神情会如何变化」。简而言之，结果成了原因。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Well, is that so? I did notice a while ago that there's something special about the offices on the fourth floor...{w} I'm pretty sure that nobody ever looked at them—neither in the morning nor later in the day. Miiya was the only person to inspect them. I spent the day following everyone to know where to be in a future loop.
entries.new: 哦，是这样吗？我先前就注意到四楼的办公室有些特别……{w}我敢说，不管是早上还是后来，都没人去看过那里。只有 Miiya 检查过。为了弄清下一个循环该待在哪里，我一整天都跟着所有人。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Could my future self really have been there all the time? Could that work?
entries.new: 未来的我真能一直待在那里吗？这行得通吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I tested it right away. If it could, a mark would be below a drawer...
entries.new: 我立刻验证。如果能行，某只抽屉下面就会有记号……
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There's nothing! What the fuck!?
entries.new: 什么都没有！他妈的怎么回事！？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Once again, it seemed my idea was deemed an impossibility by the universe. For one reason or another, it wasn't something that could occur.
entries.new: 开什么玩笑。我确信 Miiya 和 Shiroya 都能在这个世界活着，可我却回不了自己的世界？难道我只能指望换个时间切换世界会成功？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: You've gotta be joking. I'm certain Miiya and Shiroya can both be alive in this world, but can I not return to mine? Do I have to hope changing worlds at another time will work?
entries.new: 开什么玩笑。我确信 Miiya 和 Shiroya 都能在这个世界活着，可我却回不了自己的世界？难道我只能指望换个时间做世界切换会成功？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...It had to be at {time=19:30.} I was fairly certain about that.
entries.new: ……必须是在{time=19:30.}。这一点我相当确定。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If my future self had been in the attic when Shiroya and Naomi disappeared this morning, he would've appeared along with them. Even if not in the same world, I would reunite with Shiroya.
entries.new: 如果今早 Shiroya 和 Naomi 消失时，未来的我就在阁楼里，那他就会跟她们一起出现。即便不在同一个世界，我也能和 Shiroya 重逢。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I don't think that's possible, though. I would've had to be there before Naomi unlocked the attic. When I looked through the cameras, I saw that our past selves were right behind her.{w} Even then, because the range didn't reach me, I'm not sure it would've reached the kitchen. There's no way I could've been in the living room, and I didn't see my footprints anywhere.
entries.new: 可我觉得那不可能。我得在 Naomi 打开阁楼之前就待在那里。我看监控时，看到过去的我们就跟在她身后。{w}即便那样，因为范围没有覆盖到我，我也不确定它有没有延伸到厨房。我不可能待在客厅，而且哪里都没看到我的脚印。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...That's not even everything. I need to be certain the travel will work because there's no way I'll have another chance. If I intend to change worlds when Shiroya and Naomi did, even if it works, I'll end up in a different world from this one. This means that I'll be unable to leave a physical indication for me to see now...
entries.new: ……还不止这些。我必须确定这次穿越一定能成，因为我不可能再有第二次机会。如果我打算像 Shiroya 和 Naomi 那样切换世界，就算成功，我也会落在一个与这里不同的世界。也就是说，我没法给现在的自己留下任何实物记号……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I don't think it would work, but what matters is that there's room for failure. I can't afford that.
entries.new: 我觉得那行不通，但问题在于它有失败的可能。我承担不起。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I had been lost in thought for a while when something alerted me. Someone was walking up.
entries.new: 我出神地想了许久，忽然有什么让我警觉起来。有人正走上来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I quickly hid in the second partition and saw a single person walking past the glass. Fortunately, they hadn't seen me.
entries.new: 我赶紧躲进第二个隔间，看见一个人从玻璃外走过。幸好对方没有看见我。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Miiya? Why is she alone?
entries.new: ……Miiya？她怎么一个人？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: All by herself, she went to the attic. She'd been yawning, so perhaps she wanted to rest on the beds.
entries.new: 她独自一人去了阁楼。她一直在打哈欠，大概是想去床上歇一歇。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The Sekimeiya are in the refrigerator. She shouldn't see them.
entries.new: Sekimeiya 在冰箱里。不能让她看到他们。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I couldn't get distracted. I had to find a solution to my problem.
entries.new: 我不能分心。我必须为自己的问题找到出路。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I attempted to come up with something else. There had to be something that would help me...!
entries.new: 我试着再想别的办法。总该有什么能帮到我……！
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What if I let the Past Sekimeiya gather energy right now and I bring it somewhere so that its range reaches behind the tower?
entries.new: 如果我现在就让过去的 Sekimeiya 蓄能，再把它带到某个地方，让它的范围延伸到塔后方呢？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I activate it and go a few minutes to the past, knowing that in the future, my future self will be right outside the tower, waiting to be encompassed. If I do that and think that I'll be in the tower in the future, will I appear inside it?
entries.new: 我启动它，穿越到几分钟前，并且清楚未来的我正守在塔外，等着被范围覆盖。如果我这么做，同时想着自己将来要在塔里，我会出现在塔内吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Or would I run into the same issue as trying to appear with an item that I can't obtain? I need to test it.
entries.new: 还是说，我会像试图带着拿不到的物品现身那样，碰到同样的问题？我得验证一下。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I failed to see any cue.
entries.new: 我没能捕捉到任何征兆。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Really? ...Is it just because I couldn't enter the tower by my own means, or is there another reason...?
entries.new: 真的？……只是因为我没法靠自己进塔，还是另有原因……？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: There's gotta be something else. I could get into the tower through the storeroom and affect Sai's mark. That should allow the travel to put me inside the tower, which would bypass the mark. So, his mark would only be affected in a hypothetical world. It should work...!
entries.new: 肯定还有别的缘故。我可以通过储藏室进入塔内，从而影响到 Sai 的标记。这样，时间穿越就该能把我送进塔里，绕开标记。也就是说，他的标记只会在假想世界里受到影响。这应该行得通……！
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Something else... There had to be something else.
entries.new: 还有别的……一定还有别的什么。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What if the Atsuki that Miiya has been with is my future self?
entries.new: 如果一直陪在 Miiya 身边的人，就是未来的我呢？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It sounded interesting. Before that morning, I could've replaced the Atsuki of that world by making him stay outside the tower. Then, I could've hidden in plain sight by acting as the Atsuki who'd gotten trapped.
entries.new: 这个想法很有意思。在那天早晨之前，我本可以让他留在塔外，从而取代那个世界的我。然后我就能扮演那个被困住的我，光明正大地藏在众人眼前。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Of course, it was an impossibility: I would've observed my own movements all along, giving them no origin. However, if I had thought about that concept early enough, I felt it would've been viable.
entries.new: 当然，这是不可能办到的：我一路上都在观察自己的行动，那些行动便失去了源头。不过，如果能早一点想到这个构想，我觉得它其实行得通。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: My thoughts went back to the search at {time=14.}
entries.new: 我的思绪又回到了 {time=14.} 的那次搜索。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I had thought about everything: my past self couldn't have been in the rooms I'd investigated. He couldn't have been in the rooms the other Atsuki had investigated. He couldn't have been in the places Miiya had investigated.
entries.new: 我什么都考虑过了：过去的我不可能藏在我查过的房间里，也不可能在另一个我查过的房间里，更不可能在 Miiya 找过的地方。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: And he couldn't have been traveling forward in time.
entries.new: 他也不可能在向未来穿越。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Where the hell had he been, then? The answer I was looking for had to be somewhere as well.
entries.new: 那他到底藏在哪儿？我想要的答案也一定就在某处。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I hadn't forgotten about Miiya's change of attitude. She had come out of the fourth floor's partitions with an entirely different demeanor.
entries.new: 我也没有忘记 Miiya 态度的转变。她从四楼那些隔间里出来时，整个人判若两人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Why? I knew my future self couldn't have been there.{w} So, then, what could she have seen?
entries.new: 为什么？我明明知道未来的我不可能在那里。{w}那么，她究竟看到了什么？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It was clear the way I was handling my thoughts wasn't proper; I had to widen their scope.
entries.new: 显然，我思考问题的方向不对；我得把思路放宽一些。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: In the end, only two things mattered: saving Miiya and returning to my world. The way I was thinking about it, those two aspects seemed to be incompatible.
entries.new: 说到底，只有两件事要紧：救出 Miiya，回到我的世界。可按我眼下的思路，这两件事似乎无法两全。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: How else could Miiya be saved, though? How the hell could the news I saw be bypassed?
entries.new: 可是，除此之外还能怎么救 Miiya？我看到的那条新闻，又到底该怎么绕过去？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: There's no other way. I have to go back to the past again, to the 30th.
entries.new: 没有别的路。我必须再一次回到过去，回到 30 日那天。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: This is what I determined. I can salvage this world's history. Since I'm from another world, I can save this one.
entries.new: 我下定了决心。我能挽救这个世界的历史。既然我来自另一个世界，我就能救下这里。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It has to be me—someone who hasn't observed the truth of this world yet. That's the only way.
entries.new: 必须是我——一个还没有看清这个世界真相的人。这是唯一的办法。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It is the only way, isn't it?
entries.new: 这是唯一的办法，不是吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...I suppose it's not. Only one part of that is correct.{w} It doesn't have to be me, but the only reason I can do it is that I'm not from this world. Only someone who isn't from this world can divert this world's history from their own. That's a better way to put it.
entries.new: ……恐怕不是。那句话只有一半说对了。{w}未必非我不可，但我之所以能做到，只是因为我并非来自这个世界。只有不属于这个世界的人，才能让这个世界的历史偏离其原本的轨迹。这么说才更准确。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: That's... right. I'm not the only person who can do this. It can be anyone from another world.{w} And... at {time=19}, the Shiroya from my world will appear here and go to the attic.
entries.new: 说得……没错。能做到这件事的不止我一个，任何来自其他世界的人都行。{w}而且……到了 {time=19}，我那个世界的 Shiroya 会出现在这里，然后前往阁楼。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: She can do this too. ...Would that make a difference, though? Would that solve any problems?
entries.new: 她也能做这件事。……可那又有什么用呢？能解决什么问题吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I can tell her what I've learned. I can tell her everything. ...If she went to the past and saved this world, would she be able to be here at {time=19:30}?
entries.new: 我可以把我查到的一切告诉她，全部告诉她。……如果她回到过去，救下这个世界，她还能在 {time=19:30} 出现在这里吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: She couldn't have been in one of the rooms the Atsuki from this world investigated. The way he looked said more than enough. ...That means there's only one other possibility, but it doesn't make sense either.{w} It doesn't make sense.
entries.new: 她不可能出现在这个世界的 Atsuki 搜查过的任何一个房间里。他当时的神情已经说明了一切。……那就只剩下另一种可能，可那也说不通。{w}说不通。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: When I looked under the next drawer, it was clear that the universe disagreed with me.
entries.new: 我朝下一个抽屉底下看去，顿时明白，连宇宙都不站在我这边。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I almost burst out laughing at what I saw. Not only from the absurdity of it existing, but also from how cartoonish it was. Maybe Shiroya had doodled something so goofy-looking just to elicit that reaction.
entries.new: 看到眼前的东西，我差点笑出声。不只因为它竟然存在，本身就很荒谬，更因为它那副卡通般的滑稽模样。也许 Shiroya 就是故意画了这么个傻乎乎的东西，好让人发笑。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Stunned, part of me refused what I was seeing. It flew in the face of what I knew. If that was the truth, what was the meaning behind that search? Why had nobody been found?
entries.new: 我愣在原地，心里有一部分拒绝接受眼前的景象。它与我已知的一切相悖。若这才是真相，那次搜索又有什么意义？为什么谁都没有被找到？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Did it really make more sense than the other ideas I'd envisioned? ...Perhaps it didn't matter. Success had been assured to me—I was extremely puzzled, but I felt relieved more than anything.
entries.new: 它真的比我设想过的其他可能更合理吗？……也许这并不重要。成功已经得到了保证——我满心困惑，但更多的是一种释然。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Oh, that's right. The rusty key...
entries.new: 啊，对了。那把生锈的钥匙……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: That finally made sense. Before I'd entered the tower, the fact that I'd seen it in the outer keyhole had been almost ridiculous.
entries.new: 这下终于说得通了。进塔之前，我竟在外侧的钥匙孔里看到了它——当时我只觉得荒唐。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: And...
entries.new: 还有……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I felt a familiar sensation. In a few brief moments, swathes of problems still lingering in my mind slotted into place.
entries.new: 一种熟悉的感觉涌了上来。短短几瞬之间，我脑中仍盘旋的一堆问题都各归其位。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: At {time=19:30}, that's who activated one of the Sekimeiya. That's why we returned to our world.
entries.new: 在 {time=19:30}，启动其中一台 Sekimeiya 的就是那个人。所以我们才回到了自己的世界。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I stood up slowly, my vision momentarily blurry. After some seconds, I began to approach the attic.
entries.new: 我缓缓起身，眼前一时有些模糊。过了几秒，我朝阁楼走去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I couldn't see Miiya, but her footprints were visible.
entries.new: 我看不见 Miiya，却能看见她的脚印。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I was careful not to make a sound. The bedroom doors were closed, but it was very likely she was behind one of them.
entries.new: 我小心不发出声响。卧室的门都关着，但她很可能就在其中一扇门后。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I shut myself in the kitchen. The recorder was still there, counting up the seconds. It had been an hour and a half since I'd started a new recording.
entries.new: 我把自己关进厨房。录音笔还在那里，秒数一下一下地往上走。距离我重新开始录音，已经过了一个半小时。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...It must be about {time=17:30.}{w} I'll take the Sekimeiya out at {time=18:30.}
entries.new: ……现在应该是 {time=17:30.} 左右吧。{w}我要在 {time=18:30.} 把 Sekimeiya 拿出来。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It's strange... I know we'll change worlds at {time=19:30}, so I'll take both Sekimeiya out so that can happen...
entries.new: 奇怪……我明明知道我们会在 {time=19:30} 切换世界，所以我要把两台 Sekimeiya 都取出来，好让那件事发生……
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Doesn't that contradict what the universe just repeatedly denied? Won't I allow something to happen because I experienced the result first?
entries.new: 这难道不和宇宙刚刚一再否决的事情相矛盾吗？我岂不是因为先经历了结果，才让某件事得以发生？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Maybe there's something I'm missing. Maybe I don't really understand why it will happen.
entries.new: 也许我漏掉了什么。也许我还没真正明白它为什么会发生。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...I suppose it doesn't really matter, though. All I know is that it'll repeat.
entries.new: ……不过，算了，或许也无所谓。我只知道，那一切会重演。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I had to wait through the last stretch. I thought of going back to the sixth floor, but I chose to remain near the timer.
entries.new: 最后这段时间，我只能等。我一度想回六楼，最终还是选择留在计时器旁。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...{w}The news that I heard matched our world's. It was identical to how it would've been without my input.
entries.new: ……{w}我听到的新闻和我们世界的一样，和我没有插手时的版本完全相同。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: That's why I imagined everything had happened the same way. Then, I realized that didn't have to be the case. The news was the only thing I'd observed in this world.
entries.new: 正因如此，我才以为一切都以同样的方式发生了。后来我才明白，未必如此。在这个世界里，我观测到的只有那条新闻。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: One girl had been severely injured, and the other hadn't been found. It matched up with what I'd personally experienced, although it wasn't the end. Seeing as it was the only barrier in this world, I could've gone back in time, saved Miiya, and prevented Shiroya from being found.
entries.new: 一个女孩受了重伤，另一个下落不明。这和我亲身经历的一致，但事情并未到此结束。既然这是这个世界上唯一的障碍，我本可以回到过去，救下 Miiya，并阻止 Shiroya 被发现。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: That's what I thought as soon as I put together that I could alter this world's history. The news could remain consistent because it didn't lead to a single interpretation.{w} I also thought that everything finally made sense—that it was the reason why Miiya had been in the tower and why Shiroya had been absent. It fit with the plan I came up with, so I thought I finally understood this world.
entries.new: 我意识到自己能改变这个世界的历史时，首先想到的就是这一点。新闻报道之所以能保持一致，是因为它并未引出唯一的解释。{w} 我还以为一切终于说得通了——Miiya 之所以会在塔里、Shiroya 之所以不在，原因就在于此。这与我拟定的计划吻合，于是我以为自己终于理解了这个世界的运作。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...It didn't make as much sense as I thought. After all, I saw Miiya in the tower—I saw the result of a loop before I came up with it. The news hadn't actually been the only piece of this world I'd observed.{w} And maybe it makes real sense. ...I believe I know why I saw Miiya before I understood how she'd be saved.
entries.new: ……事情并没有我想的那么合理。毕竟，我是在塔里见到 Miiya 的——在我想出那个循环之前，就已经看到了它的结果。我观察到的这个世界的线索，其实并不只有那则新闻。{w} 也许这样才真正说得通。……我想我知道，为什么我会在明白她将如何获救之前，就先见到了 Miiya。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I didn't step out of the kitchen. Miiya was close by, but I hadn't heard anything. If she hadn't silently left, she was sleeping in a bedroom.
entries.new: 我没有走出厨房。Miiya 就在附近，我却什么也没听见。她若不是悄悄离开了，就是在某间卧室里睡着了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Sixty more minutes had been added to the timer. It was finally {time=18:30.}
entries.new: 计时器上又多了六十分钟。现在终于到了 {time=18:30.}
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: At the same time that I took both Sekimeiya out of the refrigerator, I began a new recording.
entries.new: 我把两个 Sekimeiya 从冰箱里取出来的同时，也开始了新的录音。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: This is it. When the timer hits sixty minutes, it'll be {time=19:30.}
entries.new: 就是这个时刻。等计时器跳到六十分钟，时间就会到 {time=19:30.}
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I should keep waiting on the sixth floor. I don't know if Shiroya will use the elevator, but if she does, that's where she'll come out.
entries.new: 我应该继续在六楼等着。不知道 Shiroya 会不会乘电梯，但如果她乘了，出来的地方就是那里。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I was about to leave when I heard someone behind the door.
entries.new: 我正要离开，却听见门后有人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...!{w} Who's here?
entries.new: ……！{w} 谁在那里？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Their steps approached one of the bedrooms and stepped inside.
entries.new: 他们迈步走向其中一间卧室，随后走了进去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Is that all? Are they going to stay inside? I'm pretty sure whoever that was arrived with the elevator.
entries.new: 就这样？他们要待在里面不出来了？我敢肯定，刚才那人是乘电梯上来的。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I stood still, awaiting any other movement. ...But it seemed they would remain there.
entries.new: 我站在原地，等着看还有没有别的动静。……但看来，对方会一直待在那里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wait a second. I might have overlooked something important.
entries.new: 等等。我可能漏掉了什么重要的事。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Even though I never saw Miiya in our world, Erina apparently did. She was definitely there at one point and left that note behind, right?
entries.new: 虽然我在我们的世界里从没见过 Miiya，但 Erina 显然见过。她肯定在那里待过，还留下了那张纸条，对吧？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: But she didn't stay there, or we would've seen her.
entries.new: 但她没有留在那里，否则我们就会看见她。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: That's odd. If Erina saw Miiya, it should've been at around this time. Slightly before it, actually.
entries.new: 奇怪。如果 Erina 见到了 Miiya，那应该就是在这段时间。准确说，还要稍微早一点。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Isn't she here right now, though...?
entries.new: 可她此刻不就在这里吗……？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: There was a chance she was about to appear in our world. If that would happen, it was evident I didn't understand the details behind it.
entries.new: 她有可能马上就要出现在我们的世界里。如果真是这样，那说明我显然还不了解其中的细节。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Perhaps {time=19:30} wasn't the only time where returning would be possible. It could occur earlier too, at a time I wasn't aware of.
entries.new: 也许能回去的时间并不只有 {time=19:30}。也可能更早，在我不知道的某个时刻。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If that time was still yet to happen, I had to get away from the Sekimeiya, or else I could disappear before Shiroya's arrival.
entries.new: 如果那个时刻还没到，我就必须远离 Sekimeiya；否则，我可能在 Shiroya 到来之前就消失了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I hid the Sekimeiya on a high cabinet shelf, as keeping them in a drawer would've severely messed with the temperature.
entries.new: 我把 Sekimeiya 藏到了展示柜高处的架子上，因为放在抽屉里会严重干扰温度。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Then, I stepped onto the sixth floor, and like before, I entered the offices.
entries.new: 随后，我走上六楼，像之前那样进了办公室。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Unless I've made a big mistake, she should be here in thirty minutes.
entries.new: 除非我犯了大错，否则她三十分钟后就该到了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: If one of the Sekimeiya is activated before then for some reason, that'll cause the world change that could still happen. Since I know we'll return at {time=19:30}, though, I have a pretty strong guarantee that the Past Sekimeiya won't be the one activated.
entries.new: 如果在那之前，其中一个 Sekimeiya 因某种原因被激活，就会引发那场仍可能发生的世界变化。不过，既然我知道我们会在 {time=19:30} 回去，我就能相当肯定，被激活的不会是 Past Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I was so close. It had been more than two weeks since I'd seen her.
entries.new: 就差一点了。我已经两个多星期没见过她。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I had plenty of things to say, but I wanted to know her story too. Why would she run up to the attic? Why were her clothes different? What had she done in January?
entries.new: 我有很多话想说，但也想知道她的经历。她为什么会跑上阁楼？衣服为什么和之前不一样？一月里她到底做了什么？
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Just thinking about it made the time go by swiftly. The end was truly near.
entries.new: 光是想着这些，时间便过得飞快。终点真的近了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I stood up and walked out. I was sure she was about to appear.
entries.new: 我站起身，走了出去。我确信她马上就要出现。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I didn't have the voice recorder with me, but it had been close to half an hour. I stood still, trying to perceive the faintest sound.
entries.new: 我没带录音笔，但已经过了将近半小时。我站定不动，努力捕捉最细微的声响。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: And it came. Finally, I heard what I'd been desperately wishing for.{w} Footsteps were approaching.
entries.new: 它终于来了。我听见了自己苦苦盼望的声音。{w} 脚步声正在靠近。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What!?
entries.new: 什么！？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It wasn't who I'd been expecting. Miiya and the Atsuki she'd been with were there, staring deep into my eyes.
entries.new: 来的人并不是我期待的那一个。Miiya 和跟她在一起的另一个我就站在那里，直直凝视着我的眼睛。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What the fuck...?
entries.new: 这他妈……？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: What the fuck? Why are they here!? Miiya should be in the attic!
entries.new: 这他妈怎么回事？他们怎么会在这里！？Miiya 明明应该在阁楼！
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Hey, answer me! You really were here... Are you really me? What the fuck is going on!?
entries.new: 喂，回答我！你真的在这里……你真的是我吗？这到底是怎么回事！？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: ...I didn't think you'd be here.
entries.new: ……我没想到你会在这里。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Wh-What!? What does that mean!? You're me, right?
entries.new: 什、什么！？这话是什么意思！？你是我吧？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: ...I am.
entries.new: ……我就是。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: What the fuck is happening, then!? I thought it was impossible that we'd see each other. Was that wrong?
entries.new: 那这到底是怎么回事！？我原以为我们不可能碰面。难道我想错了？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: In a way, yes.
entries.new: 某种意义上，是的。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: What the fuck...? Tell me, then! What's going on!? How the fuck can you even exist!?
entries.new: 搞什么啊……？那就告诉我！到底发生了什么！？你到底是怎么存在的！？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: ...I'm sorry, I'm not sure how to answer that question.
entries.new: ……抱歉，这个问题我不知道该怎么回答。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: What...!?
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: I know exactly how you feel, I promise. I will tell you one thing, though, since we've already met: you shouldn't worry about anything.
entries.new: 我完全明白你现在的感受，真的。不过既然我们已经碰上了，我就告诉你一件事：你什么都不用担心。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: It must be too early. When we appeared in this world, Shiroya spent a short while on the crystal floor. It must not be time yet.
entries.new: 应该是太早了。我们刚来到这个世界时，Shiroya 在水晶地面上待了一小会儿。现在还没到时间。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I shouldn't worry? There's no way you're actually me, right?
entries.new: 不用担心？你根本不可能是真正的我吧？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: ...I am. I promise, it will all be fine.
entries.new: ……我就是。我保证，一切都会没事的。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Wh-What...? How can you tell? And how would that even be possible!?
entries.new: 什、什么……？你怎么知道？而且这怎么可能！？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: I know how it sounds, but I genuinely don't have time to explain, and I'm not sure I could.
entries.new: 我知道这话听起来很荒唐，但我真的没时间解释，也未必解释得清楚。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: What does that even mean...!?
entries.new: 这算什么话……！？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Look, we're the same person. Just trust me, or yourself, on this. Sincerely, everything should turn out fine.
entries.new: 听着，我们是同一个人。这件事，你就信我，也就是信你自己。我说真的，一切都会顺利的。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: When he heard that, I saw my own body crumple down, and my heart ached. I didn't want to imagine how I felt.
entries.new: 听到那句话，我眼看着自己的身体瘫倒下去，心口一阵发疼。我不愿去想自己当时是什么感受。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: You believe me, right? Like I said, I don't have much time.
entries.new: 你信我，对吧？我说过，我时间不多。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: But that c-can't be the case...! Shiroya... died again!
entries.new: 可、可这不可能啊……！Shiroya……又死了！
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Again? What do you mean?
entries.new: 又？你什么意思？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Do you not know that? She was killed here, and her body disappeared from the lobby!
entries.new: 你不知道吗？她在这里被杀了，尸体却从大厅里消失了！
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: What...? What does that mean?
entries.new: 什么……？这是什么意思？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It can't be. She won't be in the tower.{w} This is the same as before! Someone is telling me that Shiroya's fate within the tower is death. Why have so many people said that!?
entries.new: 不可能。她不会在塔里。{w}这和之前一模一样！有人在告诉我，Shiroya 在塔里只有死路一条。为什么这么多人都这么说！？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: It's not true! I've never seen her dead! That must be a mistake.{w} She'll be fine. It's impossible that she will die in the tower. We'll make sure of that.
entries.new: 不是真的！我从没见过她死！那一定是弄错了。{w}她会没事的。她不可能死在塔里，我们会阻止这种事。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: You should believe what I say. I still don't fully understand how that works, but you have to trust me.
entries.new: 你该相信我说的话。这到底是怎么回事，我还没完全弄明白，但你得信我。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: ...You can't explain it? Then there's no way you're actually telling the truth, right?
entries.new: ……你解释不了？那你说的就不可能是真的吧？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: I am. While I can't be fully confident about what I'm saying, I'll just ask you to believe me.
entries.new: 是真的。虽然我对自己的话也没有十足把握，但我只能请你相信我。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: ...{w}Okay.
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: ...Good. I suppose there's one thing you could do, then.
entries.new: ……很好。既然如此，我想有件事你可以做。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: What?
entries.new: 什么事？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Wait here a second.
entries.new: 在这儿等我一下。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I turned around and went to the attic, where Miiya should've been.
entries.new: 我转身去了阁楼，Miiya 本该在那里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The Sekimeiya are still here. Neither of them were activated.
entries.new: Sekimeiya 都还在这里。两台都没有启动。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: What the hell, then? I don't get what happened...!
entries.new: 那到底是怎么回事？我根本搞不懂发生了什么……！
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: There was no time to wonder. After I grabbed the Future Sekimeiya, I dashed back out.
entries.new: 没空多想。我抓起 Future Sekimeiya，转身冲了出去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Huh...?
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Take this, but don't touch it.
entries.new: 拿好，但别用手碰它。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I handed him the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 我把 Sekimeiya 递给了他。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: You two should hurry back down. On the second floor, enter the second partition, leave the Sekimeiya on the floor, and wait there.
entries.new: 你们俩赶紧下楼去。到二楼，进第二间隔间，把 Sekimeiya 放在{tip=floor}地上{/tip}，就在那儿等着。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: On the second floor?
entries.new: 二楼？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Yes. From there, if anyone passes by, you should hear them. If you hear the elevator four times, you can go back down and place the Sekimeiya in its cabinet. Make sure that it isn't activated again.
entries.new: 对。待在那里，只要有人经过，你们应该都能听见。要是听到电梯响四次，就可以下楼，把 Sekimeiya 放回它的展示柜里。务必确保它不会再被启动。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: However, it's possible that the first time, instead of hearing the elevator, you'll hear someone running up. If that happens, once you hear the elevator two times, you can go down and place the Sekimeiya in the cabinet.
entries.new: 不过，第一次你听到的可能不是电梯，而是有人跑上楼的脚步声。若是那样，等电梯响过两次，你们就可以下楼，把 Sekimeiya 放回展示柜。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I wasn't completely sure if Shiroya would walk up or take the elevator. However, a while after that, they would hear Erina and my past self taking it. That would be their cue to go down.
entries.new: 我不确定 Shiroya 会走楼梯还是坐电梯。不过过一会儿，他们会听到 Erina 和过去的我乘坐电梯的声音。那就是该下去的信号。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: O-Okay, and... after that, you're saying everything will be fine, right?
entries.new: 好、好的，那……之后，你是说一切都会没事，对吧？
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: Yes. Wait patiently with everyone on the crystal floor and make sure to get out safely. I'll pray with you for what will happen after that.
entries.new: 对。和大家一起在水晶层耐心等着，务必平安离开。至于之后会发生什么，我会和你们一同祈祷。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: All... All right.
entries.new: 好……好吧。
entries.speaker: c2a

entries.text: The other Atsuki didn't waste time. As soon as he said that, he ran back toward the stairs.
entries.new: 另一个我没有耽搁，话音一落就朝楼梯跑了回去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Goodbye, Miiya.
entries.new: 再见，Miiya。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: It took all I had in me to say that and nothing more. It was a second goodbye. I would never see her again.
entries.new: 我用尽全力，才只说出这一句。这是第二次告别。我再也见不到她了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Goodbye.
entries.new: 再见。
entries.speaker: m2

entries.text: Oblivious to the gravity of her farewell, she turned around and left my sight.
entries.new: 她并不知道这句告别有多沉重，转身便走出了我的视线。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Once I could no longer hear their running, I found myself standing alone. ...I couldn't bring myself to move.
entries.new: 脚步声远去之后，只剩我独自站在那里。……我一步也迈不动。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If nothing happened very soon, I would've been wrong about everything.
entries.new: 如果接下来没有立刻发生什么，那就说明我全都错了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: When I heard the elevator, all the tension within me was released. She was there.
entries.new: 听到电梯声的那一刻，我全身的紧绷一下子卸了下来。她到了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: She'd called the elevator from the crystal floor. I waited, and seconds later, I heard it again.
entries.new: 她从水晶层叫了电梯。我等着，几秒后，又听见了一次。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wait, what? Why did I hear it again? Doesn't that mean that it's going to the attic?
entries.new: 等等，怎么回事？怎么又响了一次？那不就说明电梯是往阁楼去的吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Oh, that's right! She had the key!
entries.new: 啊，对了！钥匙在她手上！
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I bolted off as fast as I could.
entries.new: 我拔腿就跑，用尽了全力。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: She was in the hallway. When she saw me, it was apparent we'd both been looking for each other.
entries.new: 她在走廊里。一见到我，我就明白，我们一直在互相寻找。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There you are... You did come.{w} I'd forgotten you had the key to the attic.
entries.new: 你果然来了……真的来了。{w}我都忘了，阁楼的钥匙在你手上。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Are you... the Atsuki from this morning?
entries.new: 你是……今天早上的那个 Atsuki？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Yeah. I'm glad I wasn't wrong.
entries.new: 嗯。还好我没猜错。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Y-You knew I would be here, right? You remembered what happened.
entries.new: 你、你知道我会来，对吧？你还记得发生过的事。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: I nodded slowly. I was right about everything. ...We had reunited in a world other than our own.
entries.new: 我缓缓点头。我全都说对了。……我们重逢的地方，并非我们原本所在的世界。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Have you been here all this time? When you disappeared this morning, I tried to find you, but I was in another world, right?
entries.new: 你一直待在这里吗？今天早上你消失之后，我想去找你，可那时我已经在另一个世界了，对吧？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: I see. So she really is the same person who was here this morning.
entries.new: 原来如此。看来她确实是今天早上在这里的那个人。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I... think so. I learned a lot of things. It's been longer than you think since I saw you.
entries.new: 我……想是吧。我弄清了很多事。我上次见你，已经是很久以前的事了，比你想象的要久得多。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: What do you mean? You said the recording was real, right? What happened at {time=21}? And why did both of us appear at the start of today?
entries.new: 什么意思？你说过那段录音是真的，对吧？{time=21} 到底发生了什么？还有，为什么我们两个都出现在今天开始的时候？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: ...Why did we travel to this morning?{w} I know the answer now.
entries.new: ……我们为什么会穿越到今天早上？{w}现在我知道答案了。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I remember what you told me. You said you traveled to the 30th of November, and that a few days later, you touched the Sekimeiya in the tower. Is that right?
entries.new: 我记得你跟我说过的话。你说你穿越到了 11 月 30 日，几天之后，在塔里碰了 Sekimeiya。是这样吧？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Y-Yes. That's when I appeared with you in the lobby.
entries.new: 是、是的。我就是在那时和你一起出现在大厅的。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: No, that's wrong. I know what happened to you.
entries.new: 不，不对。我知道你身上发生了什么。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: She frowned. It seemed she hadn't entertained the possibility.
entries.new: 她皱起眉，似乎从未想过这种可能。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: You didn't go to November... You went to the future.
entries.new: 你没有去 11 月……你去的是未来。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: ...Wh-What? No I didn't. I went two weeks to the past.
entries.new: ……什、什么？不可能。我是往过去走了两周。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: I don't know why you think that, but I believe you went to the future.{w} You said that you entered the tower in early December. I believe that was the 5th of January instead.
entries.new: 我不知道你为什么会这么想，但我相信你去的是未来。{w}你说过，你是在 12 月初进入塔里的。我认为那其实是 1 月 5 日。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: The 5th of January? That doesn't make any sense.
entries.new: 1 月 5 日？这根本说不通。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Like I said, the recording was real. On the 5th of January, we were in the tower. That's why I appeared with you in the lobby when you touched the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 我说过了，录音是真的。一月五日那天，我们就在塔里。所以你碰到 Sekimeiya 的时候，我才会和你一起出现在大厅。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: N-No. No. How would I have gone to the future? There's no way.
entries.new: 不、不会的。不可能。我怎么可能去到未来？绝无可能。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: With the Sekimeiya. There were two of them.
entries.new: 靠的是 Sekimeiya。当时有两个。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I... know. I saw that too. What do you mean, though?
entries.new: 我……知道。那个我也看见了。可你这话是什么意思？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: I've thought about everything that happened. There always were two Sekimeiya, but only one of them made us go to the past. The other one made us go to the future instead.
entries.new: 发生过的每件事我都想过了。始终有两个 Sekimeiya，但把我们送往过去的只有一个。另一个，则把我们送去了未来。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: The one in the water tank sent you to the future, but that wasn't the first time. ...It wasn't the first time you'd traveled forward in time. There were others.
entries.new: 水箱里的那个把你送到了未来，但那并不是第一次。……你并非第一次穿越到未来。之前还有过好几次。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: She looked astonished. For a while, she didn't respond.
entries.new: 她满脸震惊，好一会儿说不出话。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: A-Are you serious...?
entries.new: 你、你说的是真的……？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: I am. I've been able to understand the Sekimeiya.{w} The Future Sekimeiya made us appear where we were in the past; I believe that could be part of your confusion. The Past Sekimeiya made us appear where we would be in the future.{w} ...And, if both ranges overlapped, the world around us would change instead.
entries.new: 是真的。我已经能理解 Sekimeiya 了。{w}Future Sekimeiya 会把我们送到过去我们所在的位置——我想，这可能是让你困惑的原因之一。Past Sekimeiya 则会把我们送到未来我们会在的位置。{w}……而一旦两者的范围重叠，被改变的就会是我们周围的世界。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: O{w=0.2}-Oh!{w=0.3} ...That makes sense. That's how I came back.
entries.new: 噢{w=0.2}——！{w=0.3}……说得通。原来我是那样回来的。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: She stared off into the hallway, working with the information I'd given her.
entries.new: 她望着走廊出神，在心里盘算着我告诉她的那些事。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: When she opened her mouth again, she asked what she most wanted an answer to.
entries.new: 等她再次开口时，问的是她最想知道答案的那个问题。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: So... what now? What will happen at {time=21}?
entries.new: 那么……现在怎么办？{time=21} 会发生什么？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: It'll be fine. We'll be able to leave.
entries.new: {cps=80}没事的。{w=0.4}我们能出去的。{nw}
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: She breathed a sigh of relief. Everything could finally end.
entries.new: 她松了口气。一切终于可以结束了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: This isn't over yet, though. We have to do one more thing.
entries.new: {cps=80}不过，{w=0.2}这事还没完。{w=0.5}我们还得再做一件事。{nw}
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: ...We{w=0.6} are going to save Miiya.
entries.new: ……我们{w=0.6}要去救 Miiya。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Wh-What? Really...?{w} Can the past really be changed after all!?
entries.new: 什、什么？真的……？{w}过去原来真的能改变吗！？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: That's not it. The past is set in stone.{w} But in a different world, the past is no different from the future for us.
entries.new: 不是这样。过去是定死的。{w}但在另一个世界里，过去对我们来说，和未来并没有什么区别。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Huh...?
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: We can save her in this world. If you travel, you can save her.{w} ...It has to be you, though.
entries.new: 我们可以在这个世界救她。只要你穿越回去，就能救她。{w}……不过，这件事必须由你来做。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: What do you mean?
entries.new: 你什么意思？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: I walked to the kitchen. The recorder's timer showed 44:24.
entries.new: 我走进厨房。录音笔上的计时显示着 44:24。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: That is the Past Sekimeiya. If you activate it when the timer reaches 63:14, you'll appear on November 30th. If you're there, Miiya will not die.{w} I can't come with you, though. If you activate it, anyone in the center of the building will go back to our world. If I travel to the past too, I won't be able to be there.{w} But, if it's you who does this, you will be. When December 15th comes, you'll be able to enter through the storeroom, and if you stay in the third partition on the fourth floor, you'll make it back to this point.
entries.new: 那就是 Past Sekimeiya。等计时走到 63:14 时启动它，你就会出现在 11 月 30 日。只要你在那里，Miiya 就不会死。{w}不过我没办法跟你一起去。你一旦启动它，位于大楼中心的所有人都会回到我们原本的世界。如果我也穿越回过去，我就没法待在那里了。{w}但换成你去做这件事，你就能留在那里。等到 12 月 15 日，你可以从储藏室进来；只要待在四楼第三间隔间里，你就能回到这个时间点。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: She looked overwhelmed. There was very little time left, so I was trying to explain everything rapidly.
entries.new: 她看上去有些不知所措。剩下的时间太少了，我只能尽量快点把一切讲完。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: W-Wait, so, I'll be able to prevent her death? And then, at this time, both of us will go back to our world?
entries.new: 等、等等，也就是说，我能阻止她死去？然后到了这个时间，我们两个都能回到自己的世界？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: When I nodded, her eyes briefly widened.
entries.new: 我点了点头，她的眼睛一下子睁大了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The seconds were passing quickly, so I had to make sure I could say everything I needed to.
entries.new: 时间一秒一秒地过去，我必须确保把所有该说的话都说清楚。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: You will appear on November 30th where you will be on December 30th. If you think about where you'll be, that's where you'll appear.
entries.new: 你会在11月30日出现，出现的地点就是你12月30日所在的地方。只要想想自己到时候会在哪儿，你就会在那里出现。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: ...What?
entries.new: ……什么？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: On December 30th, you have to be in that gem shop so that you appear there in November.
entries.new: 12月30日那天，你必须待在那家宝石店里，这样你才会在11月出现在那里。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: In the gem shop? I don't think that will be possible. ...It was still closed.
entries.new: 宝石店里？我想那不太可能。……那家店那时还关着。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: I-In that case, right outside it.{w} It was snowing on November 30th, wasn't it?
entries.new: 那、那就待在店门外好了。{w}11月30日那天在下雪，对吧？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I bit my lip. I didn't know what would happen if she were to appear right on top of falling snow, given what had happened to me with the elevator's railing.
entries.new: 我咬住了嘴唇。想起自己在电梯扶手上的那番遭遇，我不知道她若是直接出现在飘落的雪上会怎样。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: You'll have to be below a stone roof, where the snow won't hit you and there'll be none on the ground. Then, you'll be able to prevent Miiya from being hit by the explosion.{w} That's not all, though. There's something else very important. Your body can't be found.
entries.new: 你得待在一方石制屋檐下，雪落不到你身上，地上也没有积雪。这样一来，你就能让 Miiya 免遭爆炸波及。{w}不过不止这些。还有一件非常重要的事——你的身体不能被人发现。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: M-Mine?
entries.new: 我、我的？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: I nodded, although I still didn't fully understand that. ...Why was her body the one that had to go missing? If the news had to be merely followed, why couldn't Miiya's be the one that wouldn't be found despite her well-being? ...The only reason it had to be Shiroya's was because I knew Miiya was in the tower. I still felt like there was something else to all of that.
entries.new: 我点了点头，尽管我依然没能完全弄懂。……为什么偏偏消失不见的必须是她？如果只要照着新闻所述去走就行，那为什么不能是 Miiya 平安无事、只是她的身体没被发现呢？……而之所以偏偏必须是 Shiroya，唯一的依据就是我知道 Miiya 当时在塔里。可我总觉得，事情并不止于此。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Then, early on the 15th, you'll be able to enter the tower through the storeroom. You still have the rusty key, right?
entries.new: 然后，15日一早，你就能从储藏室进入塔里。生锈的钥匙还在你手上吧？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: ...Yes.
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: She showed it to me.
entries.new: 她把钥匙拿给我看。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: You'll be able to stay in the third partition on the fourth floor. I know that'll work, because after {time=14}, you'll go to the sixth floor and leave some kind of indication for me under one of the drawers. The fifth desk from the left, in the first partition.{w} After that, you'll only need to leave momentarily at {time=15:30.} If you're in the floor 2 and 3 staircase, you'll avoid being inside the range of a travel. The range might actually reach the crystal floor, but if you're in a corner of the building a floor above, you'll avoid it. Just not in the crystal floor staircase since that's where I was at the time.
entries.new: 你可以待在四楼的第三个隔间。我知道那样行得通，因为过了 {time=14} 之后，你会去六楼，在某个抽屉下面给我留下某种记号。第一个隔间里，从左数第五张桌子。{w}之后，你只要在 {time=15:30.} 暂时离开一下就行。只要你待在通往二楼和三楼的楼梯上，就不会落在某次穿越的范围之内。范围说不定会延伸到水晶层，但只要你在这栋楼上一层的角落，就能避开。只是别待在水晶层的楼梯——那个时间点我正在那里。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: O-Okay...
entries.new: 好、好的……
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: I'm sorry. There's not much time left.
entries.new: 抱歉。时间不多了。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: 50:06. I had to leave soon to escape the range, and I wasn't sure if I'd explained myself well at all. {tip=rush}Something about the rush I was in felt paradoxical{/tip}, but I had no time to try to think about it.
entries.new: 50:06。我很快就得离开，才能逃出范围，而我不确定自己究竟有没有把话说清楚。{tip=rush}这份匆忙本身似乎带着某种悖论{/tip}，但我没空去细想。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Let me check that nobody's in the bedrooms anymore. I don't know what happened to them, but someone might still be here.
entries.new: 我去确认一下卧室里已经没有人了。我不知道他们出了什么事，但说不定还有人留在这里。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I looked at the four separate bedrooms, which were all vacant. Meanwhile, I felt my fingers beginning to tremble. Shiroya was there again, and it seemed as if the future finally had a distinct shape.
entries.new: 我望向那四间独立的卧室，里面空无一人。与此同时，我感到指尖开始发抖。Shiroya 又站在那里，未来仿佛终于有了清晰的轮廓。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: That's it, then. Everything is ready.
entries.new: 那就这样吧。一切都准备好了。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: It will work. I'm sure.
entries.new: 会成功的。我确定。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Y-Yeah.
entries.new: 嗯、嗯。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Can I ask, though? ...Why are your clothes like this?
entries.new: 不过我能不能问一句？……你的衣服怎么是这个样子？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: O-Oh. I put them on hoping I would come back to the point you saw me.
entries.new: 啊、哦。我穿上这一身，是希望自己能回到你见到我的那个时刻。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Really? ...That's interesting.
entries.new: 是吗？……有意思。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: In fact, it seemed to go against most conclusions I'd made. There was no time to care, however.
entries.new: 事实上，这似乎和我之前得出的大部分结论都对不上。但我已经没有时间在意了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wait. You have the attic key. You should give it to me.
entries.new: 等等。阁楼的钥匙在你手上。把它交给我吧。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: You need it?
entries.new: 你需要它？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: No, but you will on January 26th. If I don't take it now, you won't be able to have it.{w} Because, at {time=21} today, the police will find you, and they'll take this key from you if you have it. I need to keep it.
entries.new: 我不需要，但1月26日的你会需要。如果我现在不把它拿走，你就拿不到它了。{w}因为今天 {time=21}，警察会找到你，要是钥匙在你身上，就会被他们收走。我得替你保管。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: And they won't take it if you have it?
entries.new: 放在你身上，他们就不会收走？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: ...No.{w} I'd tell you why, but there's not enough time right now.
entries.new: ……不会。{w}原因我可以告诉你，但现在时间不够。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Five minutes were left until she would travel to the past. For me, I was five minutes away from returning to our world with her.
entries.new: 距离她穿越回过去还有五分钟。而我，也只剩五分钟就能和她一起回到我们的世界。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I grabbed the Past Sekimeiya and left it on the highest cabinet shelf, where it wasn't easy to see.
entries.new: 我拿起 Past Sekimeiya，把它放到展示柜最高一层的架子上，那个位置不容易被看见。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If you activate it when it's there, in the instance that the people from this world come back up, it's possible they won't find it.
entries.new: 你把它放在那里再启动，万一这个世界的人重新上来，他们也许就找不到它了。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I see.
entries.new: 原来如此。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: ...{w}I should go. I'm sure your future self is currently on the fourth floor. She's been there for hours.{w} You understand everything I said, right?
entries.new: ……{w}我该走了。未来的你此刻一定就在四楼，已经待了好几个小时。{w}我说的话，你都明白了吧？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: ...I think so. When that screen says 63:14, I just have to touch the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: ……大概明白。等那块屏幕上显示 63:14，我只要碰一下 Sekimeiya 就行。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: You'll appear on the 30th, next to that gem shop.{w} I have to go now, but I guess I'm about to see you again. I'm sorry that there wasn't more time to explain.
entries.new: 你会在30日出现在那家宝石店旁边。{w}我现在得走了，不过看来我很快就会再见到你。抱歉，没能有更多时间解释。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: A-All right. I'll see you.
entries.new: 好、好的。再见。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: But before I knew it, my body had jumped forward in a sudden impulse and was tightly embracing Shiroya. I couldn't stand the thought of anything going wrong from that point on.
entries.new: 可回过神来时，我的身体已随一阵冲动向前扑出，紧紧抱住了 Shiroya。我无法忍受从这一刻起再出任何差错。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Right next to my ear, I felt her surprised breath, and after the initial shock, her hands slowly tightened up behind me. I couldn't believe what was happening, but I took advantage of it and rested my head on her shoulder.
entries.new: 我感觉到她惊讶的气息就在耳边。最初的一惊过后，她的双手缓缓在我背后收紧。我几乎不敢相信眼前发生的事，却还是顺势把头靠在了她的肩上。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I wished the moment could go on forever, but the clock was ticking. When I let go of her, I couldn't bring myself to say anything else or even look directly at her again.
entries.new: 我真希望这一刻能永远持续下去，但时间仍在流逝。松开她之后，我再也说不出别的话，甚至连再看她一眼都做不到。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It was hard to turn around, but I had to. With my body still shaking, I trudged to the stairs, aware it was the last time my footprints would be left on that floor.
entries.new: 转身是如此艰难，但我非转不可。身体仍在发抖，我拖着步子走向楼梯，心里清楚这是我最后一次在那层楼留下足迹。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: 63 minutes. Shiroya tightly gripped the device that had once been found in Isla's purse while her heart raced from Atsuki's sudden hug.
entries.new: 63分钟。Shiroya 紧紧握住那件曾经在 Isla 手包里被发现的装置，Atsuki 突如其来的拥抱让她心跳不已。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Her other hand was reaching high above her, close to the Sekimeiya as she withstood the immense heat around it.
entries.new: 她的另一只手高高举起，伸向 Sekimeiya，同时强忍着它周围灼人的高温。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: She hadn't traveled to the past, but she was about to. She stared firmly at the numbers on the screen and gradually moved her hand deeper into the heat.{w} After fourteen more seconds had gone by, she felt the hard touch.
entries.new: 她还没有穿越回过去，但马上就要。她定定地盯着屏幕上的数字，把手一点点探入那团灼热之中。{w}又过了十四秒，她的指尖触到了坚硬的表面。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Light snow was falling on a dim street in Yushibana. Despite the few lit windows, not one of them saw the figure of a young girl appearing by the entrance of a house, below a stone roof.
entries.new: 细雪落在丰花一条昏暗的街道上。几扇窗子亮着灯，却没有一扇看见那个少女的身影——她出现在一户人家的门口，头顶是一方石制屋檐。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: She found herself leaning on the cold wall and rapidly looked down. There, she was able to see some of the footprints she'd once left.
entries.new: 她发觉自己正倚着一面冰冷的墙，急忙低头看去。在那里，她看见了自己曾经留下的几行足迹。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: She traced them up to an opaque door on the opposite side of the street. Wasting no time, she dashed over and opened it.
entries.new: 她顺着痕迹一路找去，尽头是街对面一扇不透明的门。她毫不迟疑地冲过去，推开了门。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Remnants of the smoke were in the air. It had already been released, but it wasn't too late.
entries.new: 空气里还残留着烟雾。气体已经释放出来了，但还来得及。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: On the floor, she saw the first two people to fall unconscious—those who had already escaped danger.
entries.new: 地板上躺着最先失去意识的两个人——她们已经脱离了险境。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Behind the shelves were two girls. One was being protected by the wooden structures, whereas the other was an open target.
entries.new: 货架后面有两个女孩。一个被木架挡得严实，另一个却完全暴露在外。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: She crouched and grabbed the shoulders of the girl in red, shuffling backward to drop her behind the shield of shelves.
entries.new: 她蹲下身，抓住红衣女孩的肩膀，向后挪动，把她拖到货架的掩护之后。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Once that danger was removed, she stood up and looked at her own body on the floor. She didn't know the exact time, but her work wasn't finished yet.
entries.new: 危险解除后，她站起身，看向地板上自己的躯体。她不知道确切的时间，但她的工作还没有做完。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: She picked herself up by her shoulders and began to retreat.{w} However, a slight sound caused her to spin around, and her heart skipped a beat.
entries.new: 她抓住自己的肩膀，把自己扶起来，开始后退。{w}然而，一点轻微的响动让她猛地转过身，心头骤然一紧。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: She didn't see the door opening because a wooden shelf was blocking it. However, soon after she heard its squeaky sound, the lights turned off.
entries.new: 一具木架挡住了视线，她没能看见门被打开。可听到吱呀的声响之后不久，灯就灭了。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: There was practically no time to react. During the instants before the light came back, the girl closed her eyes and attempted to cover her face with her arms.
entries.new: 几乎来不及反应。在灯光重新亮起前的一瞬间，女孩闭上眼睛，抬起手臂护住脸。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The floor had been devastated, and she found herself falling with the rubble, the deadly light shrinking as she was consumed by familiar darkness.
entries.new: 地面已被炸得支离破碎，她随着碎石一同坠落，那致命的光芒渐渐远去，熟悉的黑暗将她吞没。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: She saw something shining above and heard very faint shouts. Her entire body was wracked with pain, but she was able to stand up.
entries.new: 她看见上方有什么在发亮，也听见极其微弱的喊声。全身痛得像散了架，但她还是站了起来。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: When she looked around her, she saw there was light there too: an egg-shaped gemstone had rolled away, and it gave off a soft glow.
entries.new: 她环顾四周，发现这里也有光：一颗蛋形的宝石滚落在一旁，散发着柔和的光晕。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: She heard a moan laced with pain. Her other self was conscious. She had been holding her as they'd fallen; that time, neither one of them had lapsed into a lengthy unconsciousness.
entries.new: 她听见一声带着痛楚的呻吟。另一个自己已经恢复了意识。坠落时她一直抱着她；这一次，两人都没有陷入长时间的昏迷。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Her friend had told her something very important: her own body couldn't be found. She didn't understand why, but a realization immediately came to her.
entries.new: 朋友告诉过她一件很重要的事：她本人的身体是找不到的。她不明白原因，可当即就明白了一件事。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: As she took a slow step back, she saw her own self awakening. It was difficult to make out, but she saw that the other her was staring at the distant gemstone.
entries.new: 她缓缓后退一步，看见另一个自己正在苏醒。光线昏暗，难以看清，但她看得出，另一个她正凝视着远处的宝石。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: That was when she understood... that the universe would do the rest—that she didn't have to enact something that was already meant to happen.
entries.new: 就在那时她明白了……余下的事，这个世界自会去完成——已经注定会发生的事，不需要由她来推动。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: She stepped back. She knew the way out of there.
entries.new: 她向后退去。她知道离开这里的路。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Meanwhile, the other girl approached the stone. The act of her touching it would be the {tip=force}driving force{/tip} behind a forthcoming attack in her town.
entries.new: 与此同时，另一个女孩走近了那块石头。她伸手触碰它。这个动作，将成为不久后降临在她所居城镇的那场袭击的{tip=force}驱动力{/tip}。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The girl found herself looking out upon a nostalgic view, but the snow was still piling up to form the scenery she'd once seen. Once more, she began walking to her empty apartment.
entries.new: 女孩望见一片令人怀念的景色，积雪却仍在不断堆积，渐渐堆成她曾经见过的模样。她又一次迈开步子，走向那间空无一人的公寓。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: But when she realized that it would soon be December 1st, her destination changed.
entries.new: 但当她意识到12月1日就快到了，她改变了目的地。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: She had once felt a false sense of freedom walking down that path, but the kind she felt the second time was genuine; she knew where the path went.
entries.new: 她曾在那条路上走过，那时感到的自由是虚假的；第二次踏上时，那种自由却是真的——她知道这条路通向何处。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: It led to a place she hadn't thought existed, and one that she was eager to reach.
entries.new: 它通向一个她从未想过存在的地方，而她却迫不及待地想要抵达。
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: I arrived on the fourth floor and looked at the wall to my right. ...She had to be on the other side of it.
entries.new: 我来到四楼，看向右侧的墙壁。……她一定就在墙的另一边。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Nobody had been found, but... she was there.
entries.new: 没有找到任何人，可是……她就在那里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I opened the door to the last partition.
entries.new: 我打开最后一个隔间的门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It's been a while.
entries.new: 好久不见。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: ...Yeah.
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: She rose from the chair she'd been sitting in, but she looked worn out. Although I had just left the attic, for her, that had happened fifteen days in the past.
entries.new: 她从坐着的椅子上站起来，却显得疲惫不堪。我刚刚才离开阁楼，而对她来说，那已经是十五天前的事了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: D-Did everything work out?
entries.new: 一……一切顺利吗？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Before she could answer, we heard a noise.{w} It sounded like the elevator had opened.
entries.new: 她还没来得及回答，我们就听见了响动。{w}听起来像是电梯开了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...ody's here! I... didn't pre—
entries.new: ……有人来了！我……没想到——
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: Has it been enough time already?
entries.new: 时间已经到了吗？
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: ...op the bleedi—
entries.new: ……快把血止——
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: I looked at Shiroya. We were back. It had really worked.{w} That was happening on the third floor, near the staircase. Our past selves had returned too, although they were unaware of it. Their voices hardly reached us, but I could understand them since I knew what they were saying.
entries.new: 我看向 Shiroya。我们回来了。真的成功了。{w}那声音来自三楼，就在楼梯附近。过去的我们也回来了，只是他们自己并不知道。他们的声音几乎传不到这里，但我听得懂——因为我知道他们在说什么。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...A-Ats—{w} ...not bleedi—
entries.new: ……A-Ats——{w}……没在流——
entries.speaker: q4

entries.text: That's right. My past self was waiting outside the offices after traveling to the past. Right now, Shiroya's in the attic, and Sai's on the crystal floor.
entries.new: 没错。穿越到过去之后，过去的我就在办公室外等候。现在，Shiroya 在阁楼里，Sai 在水晶层。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: What were you gonna say?
entries.new: 你刚才想说什么？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: ...Um, everything did go well, but...{w} I saw Miiya earlier. She came in here once, and I'm pretty sure she saw me.{w} She didn't say anything, though. I almost froze from the shock, but before I could react, she had already left.
entries.new: ……嗯，事情确实都顺利，只是……{w}我刚才见到 Miiya 了。她进来过一次，而且我敢肯定她看见我了。{w}不过她什么也没说。我吓得几乎僵住，还没等我反应过来，她就已经走了。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: R-Really?
entries.new: 真……真的吗？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: She nodded, still puzzled.{w} So, it really had been like that. It had happened as I'd imagined it.{w} I didn't get it. I'd known that she wouldn't be found thanks to the drawing under the drawer. Before seeing it, I hadn't come up with a reason to explain why Miiya hadn't found her, but at that point, I had realized that one wasn't needed. If she simply stayed there, she wouldn't be found. ...I still couldn't understand what had happened.
entries.new: 她点了点头，仍是一脸困惑。{w}原来，事情真的就是这样。一切正如我想象的那样发生了。{w}我不明白。多亏抽屉下面那张画，我早就知道她不会被找到。在看到它之前，我一直想不出理由解释 Miiya 为什么没找到她；可那一刻我明白，根本不需要什么理由。只要她就那样待在那里，就不会被找到。……可我还是不懂，到底发生了什么。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What about the you from the other world? Is she okay?
entries.new: 另一个世界的你呢？她没事吧？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Yes. She wasn't found at the site of the explosion, but she wasn't harmed.{w} ...Why couldn't she be found?
entries.new: 嗯。爆炸现场没有找到她，不过她没有受伤。{w}……为什么就是找不到她呢？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: ...To match the news report that I saw. I did travel to November too, before you did, but I failed to accomplish anything.
entries.new: ……为了和我在新闻里看到的报道对上。我也穿越到十一月去过，比你还早，可什么都没能做到。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I know. I saw you at the motel. I thought about staying there in case someone found me in my apartment.
entries.new: 我知道。我在鹰旅馆看见你了。我还想过就待在那里，以防有人在公寓里找到我。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: You were there?{w} By the way, what keeps happening to your clothes? They're the ones you entered the tower with again, but you didn't have them when you went to the past.
entries.new: 你在那儿？{w}话说回来，你的衣服到底是怎么回事？又变回你进塔时穿的那身了，可你回到过去的时候穿的并不是这身。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Oh, yeah. They're the ones from that world.
entries.new: 哦，对。这是那个世界的衣服。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: I see.
entries.new: 原来如此。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: ...Ah. That time, right before {time=21}, I did think that something about her looked strange. It was so late into the day that I didn't realize it was the complete lack of smoke on her clothes. ...And her pendant is gone too—the thing that tied her with Miiya disappeared when she went to the future.
entries.new: ……啊。那一次，就在 {time=21} 之前，我确实觉得她哪里不对劲。可当时天色已晚，我没察觉到原因是她衣服上一点烟味都没有。……还有她的吊坠也不见了——那个把她和 Miiya 联系在一起的东西，在她去往未来时消失了。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: She took a digital watch out of her purse.
entries.new: 她从手提包里取出一块电子表。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: You bought a watch? That's smart.
entries.new: 你买了一块手表？这主意不错。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: It's {time=19:37.}
entries.new: 现在是 {time=19:37.}
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Shiroya pointed out very faint footsteps coming from the other side of the wall. Although I hadn't noticed them, I knew she was right.
entries.new: Shiroya 指出墙的另一侧有极其微弱的脚步声。我虽然没听见，却知道她说得没错。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: That's us. Myself, Sai, and Erina. We're going to the attic.
entries.new: 是我们。我、Sai 和 Erina，正要去阁楼。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: They went around the floor and disappeared up the next staircase.
entries.new: 他们绕过这一层，从下一处楼梯上去，随即不见踪影。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Now what, then? I don't know what happened at the end.
entries.new: 那接下来呢？最后发生了什么，我可不知道。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Let's go down first. I need to do something very important.
entries.new: 先下楼吧。我还有件很重要的事要做。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Okay.
entries.new: 好。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: I had very little strength within me, and Shiroya looked dizzy when she moved. We took our time walking down, knowing full well that there was nobody left beneath us.
entries.new: 我浑身几乎使不上力气，Shiroya 走动时也一副眩晕的样子。我们慢慢地往楼下走，心里清楚底下已经没有人了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Let's go to the security room.
entries.new: 去监控室吧。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Katei's dead body was there, filling the room with a stench I'd forgotten about. The monitors were working, which meant that someone had been there fifty minutes previously. Although it was slightly strange, I could barely bring myself to care.
entries.new: Katei 的尸体还在那里，房间里弥漫着一股我早就忘掉的臭味。监视器还亮着，说明五十分钟前有人来过。这虽然有点奇怪，我却几乎没心思去在意。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Actually... I bet I know why. Only Sai could have used the computer, and not too long ago, he traveled to the past from the event room with Shiroya.{w} That would've disabled his watch, but the next time we saw him, it was working. Every time that happened, he came here to sync it with the computer's time. There was a drawer with a bunch of batteries.
entries.new: 其实……我想我知道原因。能用那台电脑的只有 Sai，而就在不久前，他还和 Shiroya 一起从活动室穿越回过去。{w} 那会让他的手表失效，可我们下一次见到他时，手表又在走了。每次出现这种情况，他都会来这里，把手表与电脑的时间同步。这里有个抽屉，里面放着一堆电池。
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: What's that?
entries.new: 那是什么？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: A USB drive I brought to the tower in the other world. I have enough to put Katei and Akaro in jail with the footage on this.
entries.new: 是我带到另一个世界那座塔里的 U 盘。里面的录像，足够把 Katei 和 Akaro 送进监狱。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Once the computer detected it, I saved two copies of the file. The normal folder with the saved footage was nowhere to be found, so I left them elsewhere. If necessary, I would reveal the location to the police. Then, I left the drive behind one of the drawers so that it could also be found.
entries.new: 电脑识别出它之后，我把文件存了两份。原本存放录像的那个文件夹怎么也找不到了，我只好把副本存到别处。若有需要，我会把位置告诉警方。随后，我又把 U 盘塞在某个抽屉后面，好让它也能被人找到。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: By the way, you left the rusty key outside the storeroom, right? Was that so that it wouldn't open from the inside?
entries.new: 对了，你把生锈的钥匙留在储藏室外面了吧？是为了防止门从里面被打开吗？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Yes.
entries.new: 嗯。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: That's what I thought. Not completely sure how much sense it makes yet, but there's nothing I can do to fight it.{w} I have the rusty key right here too, by the way, but there's a slight problem. I'll need it on January 5th, and since you gave up yours, you'll also need this one on December 30th.
entries.new: 我就知道。这其中的道理我还没完全弄明白，但也没法违逆。{w} 顺便说一句，生锈的钥匙现在也在我手上，不过有个小问题。一月五日我需要用它，而你既然把自己的那把交了出去，十二月三十日你也得用这一把。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Oh, I guess so.
entries.new: 哦……好像是这样。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: I looked under the desk. A Sekimeiya was there.
entries.new: 我朝桌子底下看去，那里放着一台 Sekimeiya。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: This is the Past Sekimeiya. My past self traveled with it very recently in the staff room, and Sai brought it here. It doesn't have a lot of power right now.
entries.new: 这是 Past Sekimeiya。不久之前，过去的我刚在员工室里用它穿越，随后是 Sai 把它带到了这里。它现在的能量不多了。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I left the rusty key on the floor of hallway A and closed the door.
entries.new: 我把生锈的钥匙放在 A走廊的地上，随后关上了门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We need to duplicate it. Otherwise, we won't be able to have it on those days.
entries.new: 我们得把它复制一份。否则那两个日子我们就拿不出钥匙了。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: ...{w}She didn't seem to know why that was the case.
entries.new: ……{w}她似乎并不明白为什么会这样。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'll go a very short distance back in time one last time. Since I left the key outside this room, my past self will be able to grab it and have it in the future. But since that will let me appear with it, I won't have to really grab it, which will duplicate it.
entries.new: 我会最后一次回到极近的过去。我把钥匙留在了这间房门外，过去的我便能捡到它，一路带到未来。可正因为如此，我现身时手里就会带着钥匙，不必真的去捡——于是钥匙便复制成了两把。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Will that actually work?
entries.new: 这样真的行得通？
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Yes.{w} As soon as I leave, open the door.
entries.new: 行。{w} 我一走，你就开门。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: ...All right.
entries.new: ……好吧。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: I stepped back and touched the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: 我后退一步，伸手碰向 Sekimeiya。
